Author: aida569
Title: Great place, delicious food!
Review:
Love the Chili crab with mantau. 
Great customer service. 
Delicious food 
I’m happy. 

The location is on 4th floor, Bayview Hotel.
Very comfy and welcoming.

Author: Jolemyn
Title: Compose your own Chinese Dinner
Review: Very quiet restaurant, there was only one other table occupied on a Saturday night. Food was not disappointing as we feared though, everything was fresh and quite tasty. Price was cheap too considering it's located inside a hotel. We went back two days later with some friends but it was closed. Nice place for long meals and chit chats but not for those in a rush.Show less

Author: nchiam
Title: Good food, nice environment, friendly staff & reasonably priced
Review: Had been dining here when we are in Melaka. Food is good with comfortable environment. Pleasant staff. Ideal for family or group gathering. Value for money. Highly recommended.

Author: serenemoon85
Title: Convenient & cozy restaurant
Review: Managed to dine in this restaurant during my stay at Bayview Hotel Melaka during our recent stay at Malacca. Food is pleasant and affordable.

Author: 174jayanthia
Title: Surprised
Review: Quiet restaurant. Few customers and staffers. Expecting a let down but I was pleasantly surprised.  Food was excellent, mid range pricing, fresh and tasty. Glad it rained and I was lazy to go out to eat :)

Author: chinfamily2019Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Chin Family Dinner
Review: We had dinner here on our last night at the hotel. Fandi, our waiter was very professional. Food was good but a bit slow which we didn't mind as we had our kids to entertain us. The food portion was more than reasonable, overall we paid slightly over RM150 for a full meal for four in a hotel. Kids were happy, wife was happy, my wallet was happy so I'm happy :) Show less

Author: koolguy163Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good value
Review: We composed a 6 course sit down lunch for some friends that's going away. Taste was good and good value too. We got our food pretty fast as we had pre-ordered. We had a trainee serving us, didn't speak much english but was always smiling and very attentive. They served free cordial and fruits. Will definitely consider returning. Show less

Author: CuteMonsterMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Family Dinner
Review: The restaurant is located inside the City Bayview Hotel. I was driving around and looking for a shop lot :)Food was great especially the salted egg lotus root. We ordered twice as someone else offered to paying :) I couldn't find anything bad to say. My hot spicy chicken noodle was awesome. Service was OK too. Will not hesitate to recommend. Mom already planning to go back for the porridge. Cheers!Show less

Author: Helloitslaila
Title: Well deserved
Review: They truly lived up to their “Number 1 best restaurant in Melaka”. The food was amazing! Cant wait to come back and dine here again.

Author: Eilingl
Title: A must go in Melaka for Peranakan cuisine
Review: A very good and recommended restaurant for modern Peranakan cuisine. Their sambal is to die for. Love every dish there. Reservations is a must.

Author: Sheena J
Title: Cheated
Review: I choose the set for 6-8 pax that was RM280+. Had to make a reservation in advance and even confirmed on the set via WhatsApp. Based on SOP they informed me they need to divide the tables into 4 eqch and the tables can't be combined. Suggested to me that they would need to divide the chicken dish and prawn dish to two portions. I agreed and re-confjrmed that the portions in halved. No specific reply was received except that yes and the set of RM280 I'd a rough estimate. I was shocked to receive the final bill of RM475.20. I asked the cashier how come there were double charges for chicken and prawn? She informed me they had to give me 2 as the portions would not have been enough. After coming back to the hotel, I realised that all the food items were charged individually and not based on the set as well. I seriously felt cheated. Why do you give a set for 6-8 people then if you know your portions are not adequate? I paid RM54 for 5 pieces of prawn that was meant for 6-8 people in your set? How do you expect a group of 6-8 people to share 5 prawns? I went with 7 adults and 1 child and the food came in small portions. Very disappointing. Never again. I visited the place based on the number 1 recommendation from tripadvisor. How reviews can be deceiving.Show less

Author: rutheransColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: EXCELLENT & WILL RETURN
Review: We came here after a tour of the forts and the museum quarter. We dined for Lunch in a Group of Seven and one child. The food and flavour was outstanding. They have against the odds paired professionalism and courtesy with old style home cooking. They made the effort of excellence and courtesy seem effortless. It was a sheer pleasure to speak to the staff and enjoy their cuisine. The Chicken Curry, fried fish and even the chendol was outstanding. The chendol here was marvellously put together. The kacang was the traditional red bean and not the kidney beans which for was beautifully original. Show less

Author: Exploration225803
Title: Good food and service
Review: We always made sure to visit Bulldog whenever we are in Melaka but due to the pandemic we have not been here for more than a year. Went there for dinner on 11-Dec and happy to say the food did not disappoint. Not to be missed is their cendol which is one of the best we have ever tasted. We had the dinner set which was sufficient for 3 persons. The restaurant also followed proper SOPs. Service was also excellent and attentive. Please do make early reservations to avoid disappointment as the have limited sitting during this period.Show less

Author: JojotanloveKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Small portions but great service
Review: As soon as travel restrictions eased we visited Malacca, upon arrival Bulldog was the first place we went for lunch. This place was recommended by some local friends and I thought let’s give it a go. The ambience and atmosphere is pleasant and most importantly the place was clean. I noticed the two waitresses that served us at the time continually sanitised their hands and the tables frequently. The waitress that took our order was polite and helpful. The one that served us was courteous. I thought the service was great and I really hope they continue to uphold this, good or even descent service is rare in Malaysia. The food was great, portions are small but taste wasn’t an issue. Food was fragrant tasty and well presented which I felt did some justice to Malaccas reputation. Overall I would definitely eat here again, Bulldog please keep up your good service and attention to cleanliness and next time please have the popiah in stock! ThanksShow less

Author: DexperienceReview
Title: Bulldog is so unique, magnificently awesome and yet welcoming to visitors. The environment is clean, neat and pleasant
Review:
Bulldog is so unique, magnificently awesome and yet welcoming to visitors. The environment is clean, neat and pleasant, making customers feel comfortable and relaxed with no pressure. 

Dex Ng Mong Meiyan Dexperience Poor Man

Author: WyminngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: First Class
Review: A Miss Tal, a self proclaimed short but vivacious and charming manager, took my reservation for dinner over WhatsApp. On the day of the dinner, I requested for a birthday cake for our table about two hours before dinner for my mum and dad and siblings. It was my brother’s birthday. Miss Tal replied to say they cannot provide a cake as my request was too late. However she took the initiative to order a cake for me from a cake shop. She even took the trouble to give me options on the cake shops and the available cakes. First class When we arrived at the restaurant, she introduced herself and recommended the dishes for dinner. We had the pai tee, popiah, prawn nenas lemak, chicken tempra, fried fish chili, okra and paku squid. Yummy and delicious. We wanted to finish up with their cendol for dessert but they have ran out of it. Tried the ice kacang and durian mochi instead which were good too. Definitely coming back here next time I visit Melaka Show less

Author: Steve PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Top quality food
Review: We were recommended Bulldog by our hotel when we said we wanted to try authentic Nyonya style dishes. The atmosphere at Bulldog is modern and so was the food presentation. I'm not an expert on Nyonya cuisine so I can't tell you how really authentic it was - but I just don't care really! They suggested we try the set sharing menu and made our choices and then food arrived. The spices were balanced and delicious, the whole menu made sense and we couldn't decide what our favourite dishes were - there were several contenders for favourite! The service was great, the food was even better, prices were good - this is definitely a place worth checking out.Show less

Author: AnginAir
Title: Excellent
Review:
Excellent service! I don’t recall top notch service for a long time. 

Food was great. But my favourite is the cendol! Ice well shaved! Not easy to find good cendol with pure gula Melaka. 

Overall, I like the whole atmosphere. Minimalist  with a nice bar.

Author: SolaranceSShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Tried the best by the people
Review: It’s a nice place to go... service was ok too... atmosphere wise, comfortable~Let’s start with the food.. my boyfriend and I prompt for the set for 2 that contains one fish, 1 veggie, 1 chicken dish and rice.The veggie... I decided to go for ladies fingers with Belacan... nothing to shout out about.. it’s just tasty The second dish was the chicken and wow it tasted surprisingly good... could use a bit more flavouring but it’s good. The chicken was so tender that I believe they either steam it long or they used a pressure cooker for the chicken. Either way, the texture was a winner!Finally, I believe this was the best of the best... the Jacket Fried Fish... was phenomenal. Crunchy yet soft. Flavour was perfect and surprise, more belacan INSIDE the fish Overall, I’d say this a quite a decent place to eat... my only advice, make more veggie dishes please Show less

Author: tree5
Title: Not a typical Nyonya Cuisine Restaurant
Review:
menu might be limited but everything on menu are must-try nyonya dishes for new taster, eg paitee, popiah, cendol, ikan sumbat etc.

nice atmosphere, and stylish decoration too

Author: Nisha3801
Title: Delicious Nonya food and v
Review: Delicious Nonya food and v friendly service. The flavours were all very delicate. Do book some of their popular dishes in advance. Highly recommend you try this restaurant.

Author: Deborah JNewbury, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent
Review: Found this restaurant by chance as went for a short walk, then realised I’d read great great reviews about it. Had an excellent meal here. Portions are generous and the flavours just wonderful, when they say spicy they mean spicy, but there are non spicy dishes on the menu. Really enjoyable meal, modern cooking, great service.Show less

Author: Cookiemonster8833
Title: Great food and service
Review:
Recommended by an aunt so dropped by this hip joint 15mins away from Casa Del Rio.
Chendol, brinjal and ayam limau purut was awesome. Service was also great throughout.

Author: jakeflo
Title: Nice surrounding
Review: Just go to Bulldog in the evening with the kids when the band is playing. Joy and her bad are fantastic . They sing all the oldies. The drummer is awesome especially with the music of Santana "Black Magic Woman". Drinks are reasonable and the kids will love their hot chocolate. The place is "NO SMOKING" which are good for non smokers and the kids.Show less

Author: RTWvisitsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Casual Dining
Review: The food was very well cooked, had excellent flavours and thoroughly enjoyable. The staff were excellent too - friendly, helpful and attentive. This restaurant is very close to the Majestic hotel if you are staying there and need good food within a few minutes walk. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Totally Enjoyed
Review: My wife and I went for a Valentine dinner - picked this place from the TripAdvisor information.Totally enjoyed the fixed menu - the ambience - the warm and friendly service. And the prices.Food was all very tasty and well cooked and very nicely presented.A good place indeed - a cut above many other Melaka eateries.Show less

Author: Liketotravel30
Title: Contemporary. Vibes
Review: Smaller portions to share, some non spicy food, but mostly spicy. No wine and very limited liquor. They were out of several dishes when we got there at 7:45 pm. Great service

Author: Coprolite54
Title: First rate
Review: Had an excellent meal here last night. Well run establishment , good food selection and attentive service. Would highly recommend.

Author: jieyip2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Highly recommended for authentic nyonya food.
Review: We came here with a recommendation by a local friend. The nyonya food and services were superb! We were here for lunch, nyonya laksa was so tasty! Authentic gula melacca cendol~ impressive. I was worried about the parking, as it’s located at the main street. We found a RM5 public parking area around the corner of the restaurant, 2min walking distance. Show less

Author: 265teresad
Title: Best restaurant in Melaka
Review: Best restaurant in Melaka so far, taste very  intense and nice. Suitable for chilli lovers. Sambal Udang is Super nice with steam hot rice. I love it so much.

Author: PSurretUnited Kingdom
Title: Delicious food. Great service
Review: Delicious food.We decided on this restaurant based on the reviews and we loved it too. professional service, good sour plum juice, and amazing Nyonya dishes, which were very nicely presented.The manager was very efficient, all the waiters/waitresses were good and whoever is the person who cooks in the kitchen is excellent. We’ll be back before we leave Malacca. Show less

Author: marcwatton1London, United Kingdom
Title: Great place slightly outside the crafty old teen
Review: We found this place via TripAdvisor and were not disappointed. Service was prompt and appropriate clearing thy table when needed. The food was cleverly presented and delicious. They added service but the owner assured me it went to the staff so we didn’t quibble. Glad we tried this restaurantShow less

Author: RoulNaserMelaka, Malaysia
Title: So sedap!
Review: They are just stones away from our favorite place, Sambal & Style. We enjoyed the cozy ambiance, as well as their flavorful baba nyonya cuisines. Their Cencaru Sumbat, Sambal Sotong, Ikan Bilis Goreng and stir-fried bendi are to die for! You shall end your meal with their ever famous cendol with gula melaka, i think the best in Melaka! We are definitely gonna again and again soon!Show less

Author: waitui2019
Title: Great stop!
Review:
Went there for dessert only and it was great!
Shame they ran out of ingredients to make an order of six ..

Author: last0nimneTulsa, Oklahoma
Title: An excellent selection of Baba Nyanya delights
Review: An excellent selection of Baba Nyanya cuisine. Service from Tal was beyond perfect. She and one other waitress somehow served a full restaurant and made everyone happy. Each time she was at our table we were treated like we were the only table in the restaurant. She patiently described every dish (successfully explaining why I should NOT order the smelly beans because the oder was distinctly “human poo”) and frequently inquired how we were doing. Food was amazing. No wine on offer but can be purchased by braving heavy traffic and purchasing at the 7/11 across the busy street and paying 60R per bottle corkage. Reservation suggested. Show less

Author: Tntvern
Title: Gastronomic affair
Review:
Fantastic local delights. Order the dishes and gobble down with rice. To die for!! Burrppp!!
Stay on for the alcohol and enjoy the environment too.

Author: Alre_Rin
Title: Great place to hangout
Review: Food is great, ambience is relaxing and when we came a couple of times, they had live performance. Will definitely come back.

Author: A DSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wow what a find!
Review: We (me, husband, brother and his wife) wanted to have dinner at a coffee shop round the corner of the hotel we were staying at. Finding it closed we 'mooched' around and saw Bulldog Restaurant. What a find!They serve mainly Peranakan dishes. If you are confused and not sure of what to order, their menu does have 'sets' for different party size. We ordered a set and were seriously impressed with the food. Taste and plating was well done.All I can say is that all the dishes we had were delicious and, for me, the brinjal and fried fish dishes were just the way my mum use to do it. So a bit like home away from home.Staff were very pleasant and welcoming. Definitely going back again when we next visit MelakaShow less

Author: eddyphdhong
Title: wonderful x wonderful
Review: here i tasted wonderful taste. beef. chicken. laksa noodle. perfect!! yes it’s here. traditional foods + modern interior made me happy. kalamanci juice is world best.

Author: kmquekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Peranakan food!
Review: Fantastic Peranakan food! Really delicious and has a distinct class to the way it is prepared. Servings are tapas like in smaller portions but the quality is good and a little like fine dining. We throughly enjoyed eating here and will come back again. Tal and her team have good service.Show less

Author: mariosg206
Title: Award the chef, shoot the furniture designer 😬
Review: Excellent food, no two ways about it. Flavourful, balanced, super tasty and spicy to boot. Service a bit on the slow side but the food is well worth the wait. The cendol is one of the best I’ve ever tried, not too sweet, just right! Loved the food and will definitely come again! But... Mother of God are the chairs uncomfortable! Who designed them?! Burn them! Or invest in cushions! Show less

Author: Seiya SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely place to enjoy local food
Review: Located near by Majestic hotel, Ramada Plaza and Bayview. Foods are quite nice, served in small portion with reasonable price, so recommended to order some more than your regular practice. Interior is very modern and it doesn’t look like the place offer fine local food. Staffs are attentive.Also good place to chill-out.You can enjoy live music performance on Saturday nights.Show less

Author: Suelowst
Title: Bulldog Melaka
Review: Food was average. Only the chendol is worth mentioning. The seats are very uncomfortable.  The set-up is more like a canteen. And by 2.30pm, they start switching off the lights.

Author: APisME95Philadelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Great food
Review: Great food and cool vibe at Bulldog. While the dishes are all local, it’s got that elevated taste and touch that make the food all the more delicious than the usual hawker stall cafeterias. Yes it’s a little pricey than those, but the change of pace with flavor and style definitely make Bulldog a must try!Show less

Author: Btslicea
Title: Not many non spicy options
Review:
The restaurant was convenient, close to many hotels. 
Food is really average, and there are not many non spicy options. The waiter warns you if it’s too spicy but then you are left with few choices. 
Music is really too loud.

Author: SusiEngland
Title: Modern, friendly, very good food
Review: Cool location with a good range of modern food - highly recommended. Dessert Bulldog Float was a really good surprise.

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Melaka bulldog spirit
Review: We were meeting one of my wife's old friends from Suzhou who'd relocated to Melaka for work so ut was an ideal place for catch up, having spotted it in trip advisor Clean and inviting with the minimalist black and white decor and wood surfaces separated with some red lamps by the bar. So good so far, service I think was thought about with the waitress recommending dishes and sizes depending on what we were eating. So this is keeping alive baba nyonya cuisine with a selection of We had pai tee as a small starter and then given one of us each didn't eat pork, seafood or beef we danced around it ordering a fish crispy fried fish with sambal, chicken-limau perut and some veggie options of okra and fried water spinach. Food was served briskly and accompanied by some steamed rice. We ended up having a couple more dishes, onion omelette and chicken sausage with onions and chilli. However that left no room for cendol. So that's a return visit on the cards. I've read people complain about background music but I didn't notice it possibly as we were enjoying good conversation and good food. With many hotels think residents may pop in, but if not I'd say give it a go.Show less

Author: DecadesontheRoad
Title: Possibly the best food, certainly the best service, cool decor but what an ugly ambience.
Review: Just minutes from our hotel around the corner, we decided to try Bulldog. Where did that name come from? It's a misleading misnomer unless it's a warning about the aggressive doof-doof music. The food was good and possibly the best of its type we had enjoyed in ten days travelling in Singapore and Malaysia. The staff were professional, as almost every review notes, and also friendly. The prices were reasonable. As an architect, I understood the hip decor but it was oh, so uncomfortable. The music was inappropriate for dining at that hour, not just loud but relentless. I understand the owner has been cautioned about this but insists playing it. Save it for later at night, when the place becomes a nightclub and it might be time to 'chill out'. Judging by the clientele tonight, however, nobody was enjoying it over dinner, not even the staff I suspect.Show less

Author: NicholasT793Worcester, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden gem to eat and drink in a busy town
Review: First time in Malaysia touring 5 locations in 2 weeks. First 3 days are in Melaka, arriving early evening and trying to find a place to get a small meal and drink.We were pointed to the Indian street near our hotel but at 9.45pm we’re finding most closing on a Saturday night!! Also no alcohol available in the restaurants, but that is the religion here so be aware.We stumbled on the Bulldog, which had also finished food service but had a band on and offers for the drinks (buy 4 get 1 free). The place has a new modern appearance inside, very open, high ceiling, long back and narrow, but very clean.Staff were friendly, the band were good and they did reasonable priced snacks (chicken wings, fries etc).A must to visit, I appreciate out of sorts from Yonker street, but a good place to eat and drink. We actually had a meal there on our third night, sharing several starters between the 6 of us, which was reasonable and good value.Definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: STH1981Singapore, Singapore
Title: The place to go in Melaka
Review: I adore this place to death. They have such simple but yet devilishly delectable Nyonya dishes. And you know that they use the freshest ingredients. The simplest KangKong and ladies finger stir fried with garlic dish contains so much wok hey it’s unbelievable. The Limau Perut Chicken is to die for. And great service and great drinks! And all at affordable prices!Show less

Author: andreapaul232016Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious
Review: A family member recommended this place and I also read they sold a great bowl of chendol for rm5!restaurant was also steps away from our hotel. Recommendation was spot on and the chendol was so so good. Malacca serves the best chendols! I only crave for it when I am in Malacca because its simply heavenly. The gula and the santan pair so well together. With nice soft saved iced and of course the chendol! Food was delicious. Fresh prawns with pineapple curry sauce. We cleaned the bowl. Pie tee shell was thin and crispy. So delicate and mouth watering.We had the crispy fried fish with their sambal and chap chye veg dish too. Service was good. I would love to have tried more items from the menu but we could not squeeze any more food in.Worth a visit if you are in Malacca. Enjoy!Show less

Author: adng1129Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great service and delicious food
Review: Food was delicious and service was exceptional. Ordered Ayam Tempra based on recommendation and it was SUPERB. Best Nyonya chicken dish i had. Fish was fried to perfection, non-greasy, crunchy outside while the flesh was still moist and flaky. Ending with the Nyonya all time favourite - Cendol was a perfect closure. Special thanks to the friendly and patient TAL for her excellent service and recommendations. This will definitely be on our go-to list next time we visit Melaka.Show less

Author: annemaried351
Title: Good laksa
Review: Was recommended as having the best laksa in Melaka.  Waitress warned it was very spicy, which it was but not terribly so.  Servings quite small.  Overall good, not great.  Chicken wings were delicious though, as was lime juice.

Author: josephwong0816Hong Kong, China
Title: Delicious food & good service
Review: We came here because of the good reviews and it didn’t disappoint us. The yummy authentic nanyang dishes came in small portion but were of good quality- good for two persons to try out different dishes. The prawns in spicy sauce and chicken in sweet sauce were both impressive. The refreshing cendol dessert was a perfect end for the spicy meal. Best restaurant we tried in Melaka!Show less

Author: Izza H
Title: Hot & Spicy Dinner Date
Review: The service was excellent. Fast and efficient. Not to forget super friendly and well mannered. The food was SUPERB AND DELICIOUS!! Everything was spicy but I would definitely recommend it for those who crave spicy food.

Author: Jolemyn
Title: Nyonya Food
Review: Had the chili garam fish which was fresh and tasty, nyonya laksa was good and cendul was probably the best i had in Malaysia. A tad bit overpriced probably due to the good reviews. Place is not that crowded.

Author: GabrielleA38
Title: Lovely atmosphere and great service!
Review: We had some nice meals at Bulldog tonight, and the service and atmosphere were especially great. Lovely fresh edamame beans, some vegan menu options and a tasty chicken bowl with steamed rice. Fresh orange juice and ice cold local beer! Thanks guys!

Author: FonglinMuar, Malaysia
Title: Food Not As Expected
Review: I have been to Bulldog several times - before and after they renovated the place. The staff is very friendly and attentive and kudos to them. Place is neat and clean. The last time I went with a friend, we ordered popiah and pie tee. Taste was still ok but the popiah skin had a bit of an eggy smell, and we did not see any shrimps, cucumber strips, bean sprouts, taukua, lettuce or strips of eggs for what constitutes nyonya popiah. It also looked as if it had shrunk. As for the pie tee, the pie tee shells were a bit oily and again no shrimp. By the way, the place does not cater to take aways. If you want to take away, you have to order the food which they bring to your table, and you put it in to your container which you have brought with you.Show less

Author: fairchrissieBridge of Cally, United Kingdom
Title: Next level Malaysian food
Review: Outstanding Malaysian food in a warm and welcoming environment. Very hospitable staff. Highlights were the beef in white pepper and prawn with pineapple curry. The flavours were spectacular! Thanks to the friendly staff who squeezed us in just before 9pm and didn't rush us out the door. You made our trip to Melaka extra special!Show less

Author: viking11Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Genuine and Delicious
Review: Had lunch there two days ago. Reservations are recommended as space is limited. The food is extremely delicious and very genuine. The standouts were their laksa, fried fish with sambal, prawns and cendol. The cendol used genuine gula melaka (you can tell from the taste as it is not wholly sweet but has a slight tinge of bitterness) and the laksa was full of the traditional spices that is a hallmark of nyonya cuisine. The service is also friendly and quickShow less

Author: F8167KNsimonwWargrave, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food !
Review: Well deserving of its reputation. A little out of the centre but worth the trip (and if, like me, you’re catching the bus from the Ramada Plaza, it’s the perfect location). I had squid and the fried snapper, both of which arrived quickly and were delicious. Spicy with the sauce which suited me but they did check how I wanted it! The staff are friendly and attentive. Nice modern vibe inside and a performance space which I’m sure makes for a fun evening! Show less

Author: lavnyan
Title: Good food
Review:
Food was tasty. Go early as food finishes fast. 
Authentic nyonya food
Try the sambal chicken, it was very tasty

Author: Camille HChicago
Title: Hipster meets nyonya
Review: We had dinner at Bulldog years ago and we made it our first food destination on our return to Melaka. The concrete floor is still there, the fountain has been replaced with a platform for live music on the weekend, but what remains is what we enjoyed last time: solid, good food (the restaurant has an A rating), ice cold beer and real drinks (gin&tonic), and a wonderful, attentive staff. The nyonya food was delicious, well prepared, and cendol was as good as everyone says it is.Show less

Author: yychoo
Title: Nice surprise!
Review: We found this place on TripAdvisor and it also turned out to be near our hotel Treasures. The food was great, especially their Nyonya style laksa! The ambience & decor is lovely & modern, and the service was just excellent! We had lunch here, and if there’s a next time, I would love to go here for dinner!Show less

Author: serenechew
Title: Wonderful dinner!!
Review:
The food here is excellent and simply delicious and the staff are attentive, polite and efficient. 
Cosy and pleasant ambience...lovely framed up collages of newspaper clippings from the '60's (and even earlier years) adorn the walls.

Author: KatherineC2645
Title: Nice decor, friendly staff
Review: A place to enjoy authentic Nyonya food on the contemporary renovated restaurant. Very friendly staff but food portion is a lil' small.

Author: 1john316Singapore, Singapore
Title: Chendol was outstanding
Review: Had dinner there on recommendation of friend. Ordered 4 items: chinchalok omelette, sambal lady fingers, ayam limau perut, and chendol. Here's my feedback: chinchalok omelette - quite good, fluffy and moist inside; sambal lady fingers - the lady fingers too old; ayam limau perut - chicken is quite tender, but hardly any fragrance from limau perut; chendol - excellent, soft crush ice and creamy gula melaka. Staff was friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: LouiseDenBosch
Title: Nyonya laksa to die for!
Review: Excellent Nyonya laksa for only 10RM. Unbelievable! A bit spicy, but I love that. Very friendly waiters also. 1 minute from the Ramada hotel. Go there!!

Author: Mark BPerth, Australia
Title: Fresh and proud of it
Review: Went for a quick late night snack on way back to hotel on our last night - wish we’d found it earlier. Nice trendy place, attentive and friendly service. Chicken wings were marvellous, fried sausage good but needed more chilli for me. But wait....Che dolce to die for. We tried Chendol all over Melaka and this stood head and shoulders above the rest. Soft, crash, bright green Pandan in a beautiful creamy gula and perfect granita. YUM. Show less

Author: laviosarMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Evening Celebration
Review: Been to Bulldog a few times, loves their food so much and decided to have my daughter and FIL’s birthday celebration there. Luckily have booked a table earlier, the restaurant was totally filled up. They have their CNY menu, even though the menu is small but all the Nyonya Signature dishes was all in!! Loves their Itik Tim, Sambal Sotong and Udang Lemak Nenas!!As a food lover, you can know they do not skimp on the spices and ingredients for all dishes. Price wise definitely reasonable with good value. Friendly and helpful crew. you guys rocks and did a very great job. Keep it up and see you all next time. Show less

Author: soniahgoonting
Title: nice place to have dinner... very relax
Review: nice place to have dinner but a bit pricey... but worth the price..for friday nite they have live band... nice place to chill to enjoy the weekend break

Author: rachndale2000Perth, Australia
Title: Those chicken wings!
Review: We stumbled across this place our first night in Melaka and got a table immediately, despite being a party of 8 with no booking. There were a few of the house specialties unavailable when we were ther - possibly due to the long weekend. Food did take a little while but drinks were served promptly. Portions were on the smaller size, but very tasty and the waitress was very accommodating and was trying her hardest to be everywhere at once. The absolute standout of the dishes we ordered were the chicken wings. Little Miss Fussy did not initially want the chicken but after eating the wings requested to go back there againShow less

Author: Simone2346
Title: nice , clean & quite
Review:
really great , specially the Ayam Tempra (recommended the normal portion , coz is so delicious).
Yummy Nyonya Laksa too.

Should extend the opening time for lunch.

Author: Notcolin21Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ridiculously slow service
Review: Ridiculously slow service for staple dishes that could have been prepared beforehand. Food is decent but experience is marred by inefficient service. Will not return. Ever.Show less

Author: Yohan1403Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Best Nyonya Kitchen
Review: The food was fresh and awesome,and a great value for the price. Highly recommend items :- Nyonya Pongteh Chicken- Fried Brinjal- Fish Asam PedasThis restaurant are busy and always full house. Reserve your place before you walk in.Friendly Staffs and good service Show less

Author: thedevilwalksin
Title: Overrated Outlet
Review: Restaurant had about 25 pax and about 6 tables empty. Me and my youngest were greeted at door and given menus with ordering done quite fast. Drinks were served within 5-8 minutes but our starters - popia & chicken wings took more than 30 minutes with the main course coming about 10 minutes later. The wait staff apologised to the table opposite us for the delayed food delivery yet neglected to inform us that there would be a 30 to 40 minutes delay on food delivery when they took our order or when the drinks were served. The food was average or below average to say the least - Nyonya food is not prepared on the spot but prepared earlier to encourage the amalgamation of the herbs, spices and other ingredients. The popia was made using an egg batter but sadly my local food court popia wins hands down - flavourful, crunchy, tasty while the serving @ Bulldog was just ....nothing to write home about. The chicken wings was hot ...and thats all i can say about it. The main chicken dish was average while the kangkong belacan loses hands down to the local makan shop.The restaurant was clean, bright and had a pleasant atmosphere with wait staff replenishing your water glass quite quickly but as we were there because of the food reviews, i was very disappointed. After asking for the bill and paying it, only then did the wait staff ask if "everything" was alright - it wasn't but i was already going to leave - and apologised for the long wait. As per our family credo - we try once but we wont try again.Show less

Author: yisiewt
Title: Short trip
Review:
Waitress very helpful . Nice ambience. Food quite nice especially the chendol with baileys . The place don’t allow takeaway . 
Sambal prawn with petai but petai very later . Price wise also bit more ex .

Author: Typo_DeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good vibe, great food & Amazing service!
Review: Drove pass bulldog on the way to Melaka city centre, the modern rustic design captured our attention and we decided to have dinner here before going back to KL. The food was really good and the waitress did a brilliant job at explaining and recommending us dishes with our picky preference. 5 stars!Show less

Author: danielcY6181JZJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Definitely worth the visit.
Review: A friend brought me to this cosy restaurant last year and we have come several times since. This visit was with a foreign couple and we ordered the cincaru sumbat, ayam buah keluak, otak, kangkung fried with garlic and finished with the ubiquitous (in Melaka) chendol. Unfortunately the pie tees were sold out. The otak served this time was of a different version than what we are used to but it was delicious all the same. The other dishes were of a high standard as well and the chendol was definitely one of the best we have tried. Service was exemplary. One of my favourite restaurants.Show less

Author: BlogAppetitOakland, CA
Title: Save room for dessert
Review: Well cooked and seasoned Peranakan food in modern, urban cafe setting. This is the food of the Babas and Nonyas, the Straits Chinese. A fusion of Chinese, Malay, Indian and Western flavors and techniques. As close to homemade flavor as I've eaten and far better than the touristy versions available on Jonker Street. Save room for Bulldog's versions of Melaka's classic shaved ice desserts. My favorite main was chicken in aromatic spices and lime.Show less

Author: capdinkieMalaysia
Title: All good!
Review: Came here on a Thurs night, place was pretty quiet. Service was good, but the food was even better! Must try is the chicken limau perut and if u can stomach reallllly spicy food then get the sambal udang (or probably anything with 'sambal' in the dish name). And then remember to wash it down with their chendol, which is one of the better ones we've ever tasted. Price is slightly on the higher side, but with tasty food and ambience and service like this, it's definitely worth a try.Show less

Author: 189fionaw
Title: Dinner at Bulldog
Review: We had an excellant meal here . The menu choice is small but the food is excellant with careful use of spices to bring out the very best of flavours

Author: Kelly CSingapore
Title: Excellent service + yummy food, that’s Bulldog
Review: Arrived on a rainy evening with my parents. A very attentive staff directed to our reserved table near the aircon for us & asked if it’s too cold for us, suggests that could switch to another table. While placing our orders, another waitress offered some recommendated dishes and suggests the suitable serving size for us. Really appreciate the great service here!  Everything’s so good especially the chendol! My favourites are Assam fish, popiah, laksa & not forgetting the bomb - chendol!!Show less

Author: Travel52947501283
Title: Cozy place
Review: definitely worth a visit with friend or family members making the trip happen was good , there was not any struggles and conflict

Author: Joanne C
Title: Nyonya cuisine and concrete decor
Review:
Enjoyed our lunch; the spicyness and flavour of the dishes we order was well balanced. Fully recommend the Eggplant, Okra, Ayam Lime dish. Service was excellent and friendly. 

Must visit if you want a interesting outlook on traditional Melaka nyonya food.

Author: johnnyG1970
Title: Recommended by a friend
Review: If you ever come to Malacca, it's a must. Food was delicious, service was exceptional, design of the interior extraordinary and welcoming. Well done Bulldog! Will come back should we stop over...

Author: MilkplumSydney, Australia
Title: Nice food
Review: Went on a Thursday night and it was pretty quiet. No live music. We ordered the pineapple prawns, lemongrass chicken, garlic kangkung and chicken wings.Everything was nice, strong flavours. But the poop chutes of the prawns weren’t removed which kind of put me off!! Chicken wings were excellent.Nice, friendly service.Show less

Author: SmileypokeyPenticton, Canada
Title: More than 5 stars!
Review: If I could give this restaurant more than 5 stars than I would. Delicious food, wonderful service and industrial style decor. We had Popiah, Chicken Curry, Prawns in Pineapple, Squid, Brinjal, and Cenjol for desert. With a bucket of 5 Tiger Beer, cost was 189 MYR for 3. Highly recommend this restaurant. The best we’ve had in Malaysia so far. Liked it so much we bought the t-shirt!Show less

Author: MR_BiRD1
Title: Peranakan in Bulldog
Review:
Came here last minute before driving back to Singapore. 
Love the design of the cafe.
Serves good & affordable food.
Cute and friendly waitress.

What are you waiting for?
Will be my first choice for peranakan food whenever im in Melaka.

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Peranakan Food
Review: True to taste Peranakan food although there is no pork. Must try is the Chendol, not to creamy and sweet. The taste is just right. The ambience is nice as the restaurant is housed in an old Peranakan house. The kitchen is clean and the restaurant is general is clean.Show less

Author: Squiff123
Title: Overrated peranakan food
Review: There were so many glowing reviews on this site that I just had to give this restaurant a try. It was clean, spacious and well organised; however, to be honest, the nonya food served to us was nothing special and probably quite mediocre by this cuisines standards, especially the otak otak that was more reminiscent of sliced fish balls.Show less

Author: 3xtraSingapore
Title: Nice place for Peranakan food
Review: The restaurant is easy to find and the staff are friendly and helpful.We had the squid, non spicy chicken, otak, popiah, chincalok omelette, chendol and chap chye. Our favourite is the squid, do note that it is spicy. The food is tasty although we find the portion can be bigger given the price. Place is clean and decor is nice. Show less

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Really close to hotel and very tasty
Review: Arrived at Ramada Plaza as it was getting dark so went on Trip Advisor to see where to eat. Astonished to find No1 place to eat in Melaka was 50m away. Surely not. But it was - took about 1 minute to get there. Didn’t disappoint. Food tasty and reasonably priced. Restaurant modern and clean and staff lovely. Show less

Author: andrewsivMelbourne, Australia
Title: Authentic peranakan, refreshingly good!
Review: The ambience was modern but casual. Well set up with touches of peranakan in the decor.That night we went, service was friendly with honest recommendations made. The food was nothing short of amazing. It was authentic and prepared to a tee – no shortcuts, traditional peranakan home-cooking brought to another level altogether. We tried their stir-fried sambal okra, cincalok omelette, ayam limau purut and otak. Every single dish was aromatic and meticulously prepared with such great finish. Apparently pong teh chicken is a go to dish but we just had that at home the night before. That night, we finished off with cendol for desert – looked awesome and tasted the part as well. The coconut milk was fresh and rich, the gula melaka was so pure and generous. Super!The food was very well priced especially given the quality and the ambience of the restaurant. We had a really good experience. Bulldog makes reasonable cocktails and have beer on tap. If you prefer, you can bring your own bottle of wine or whisky – corkage fee applies.Show less

Author: chang24Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy dishes especially the Kangkung Belacan!
Review: It's not the 1st time we visit this restaurant but definitely the 1st time we dine here. Our 1st visit was last year and the restaurant was closed! Yup, better check the business hours before your come. Our 1st dining experience here was a good one. Well worth the effort of coming back. We ordered simple dishes like Curry Chicken, Kangkung Belacan and Fried Eggs with Onions. It turned out to be a wonderful dinner as all the dishes were delicious. We also tried the Cendol which is really, really GOOD! Love the aroma and sweetness of Gula Melaka blending with fresh Coconut Milk, YUMMY! Yes, we definitely will come back for food in our next trip. Staffs are attentive but don't come too late as crowd getting bigger and they will tend to get very busy later. To ensure your service quality, come early. (unless you are a fan of live music; but we prefer quieter dining environment for dinner)Show less

Author: TKC192Wakefield, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly Staff and Great Food
Review: We visited Bulldog this evening, with our 8 year old daughter, for our first meal in Malacca. The restaurant is really easy to find (on a main road and with good signage). It’s modern in an industrial way. The staff were very pleasant and smiley and spoke excellent English. There was also a menu in English. We opted for two chicken dishes - the Nyonya Chicken Curry and the Lime Leaf Chicken dish as well as a lightly fried fish dish and some water spinach with garlic, along with rice. All of the food was absolutely delicious; it was spicy but not ridiculously so. We didn’t manage to eat everything but only because we were full. In total, the bill came to around RM140 but this included two rounds of drinks as well as the food which we felt was good value. I am sure there are cheaper restaurants but the food, staff and ambience were all excellent so we felt it was well worth it. In all, a lovely meal.Show less

Author: ze_succubusSingapore
Title: Seriously, so good
Review: I'm so glad we decided to visit Bulldog for our last meal in Melaka cos it just ended the trip right! Everything we ordered was tasty and spicy and for the level of comfort and deco, we were amazed at how reasonable the price was. Oh and the cendol, sooo good!Show less

Author: ChangBoris
Title: Great for food and hangout
Review:
If you are looking for a place to dine and hangout, then this is a good place to be. Great food with a good mix of Nyonya and western. Very authentic Nyonya with a twist. 
Live Band on Saturday nights.

Author: Yong T
Title: Nice nyonya food
Review: Really a nice restaurant with simple and delicious nyonya food. Portion slightly small but still reasonable

Author: CaroLynn128Calgary, Canada
Title: HORRIBLE PLACE
Review: Wanted to have dinner there with a group of friends. Arrived first with another buddy and entered and sat ourselves to a table awaiting the rest of our group to arrive. Then a staff member rudely told us to leave and wait outside (in the blistering heat) bcoz they were not opened for another 10 minutes! Told him that their door was open so we assumed that they were already opened for business and he said no and ushered us out of the shop and proceeded to lock the door then. Needless to say, we decided to have our dinner elsewhere and told everyone in our group to never eat there again! Never been so insulted in our lives !Show less

Author: cying5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Chendol is yummy!
Review: Visited Bulldog on late Sat night where only fingers foods and drinks are served. Nonetheless, I was there for their chendol. The chendol was served in thick coconut milk and gula melaka, it was very yummy. Your tongue deserved the chendol regardless how much calorie you gained. Live music was great too!Show less

Author: yss97Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya food in a pub
Review: It’s a pub that serves Nyonya food. The decor is modern. There is a bar and place for live music. And the menu has all the Nyonya favourites. We had the chicken pongteh, fried snapper in sambal and kangjung belacan, finished with the cendol- which didn’t have the green bits as they had run out! They had also run out of the otak-otak, popiah and pai tee- disappointing. However, all the dishes we got were tasty enough, though portions were on the smaller side. They are very near Ramada Plaza hotel, worth a visit if you are in that part of town. Show less

Author: Yi En P
Title: their CENDOL is a must
Review: it tastes so gaolat good with the gula melaka topping. u must order this, conlanfirm u wont regret trust jiejie gorgor :)

Author: JonD1044Singapore, Singapore
Title: Another fantastic meal!
Review: We visited Bulldog twice on our trip to Melacca...what lovely food and service! The Udang Lemak Nenas (prawn & pineapple in coconut curry) and Ilan Goreng Chili (fried snapper with chili paste) alone are worth a visit here. The food was delicious and if we had time we would come again.Show less

Author: MaxMeij
Title: Excellent food in modern design
Review: Colleagues took us here for lunch. ANd that was a great surprise. We has some excellent Baba&Nyonya dishes. Very tasty and well presented. The atmosphere is special: modern design, but with a cozy atmosphere. A place not to miss when in Malacca!

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Great food and service, unfortunately not all food available
Review: We went into Bulldog as soon as it opened on a Friday at 11:30am, being just around the corner from where we were staying at the Ramada Plaza. We liked the decor at first glance and were greeted and attended to immediately by the staff. After perusing the menus, we had made our choices only to be told that it was a big night before and they had sold out of a number of dishes, all of which we were intending on trying. The learning here is not to come too early as they may not have had enough time to prepare dishes again that may have sold out from the night before. After that disappointment, we selected the lime chicken and steamed Okra for rm9 each and the cendol for rm5. Each dish was delicious and very instagrammable. The dishes were not as expensive as we had expected either. We highly recommend this restaurant for some great Malaysian dishes and service.Show less

Author: hynw1
Title: Awesome service & food
Review:
We had a good time at Bulldog. 
The food was beyond my expectations.
I wish there was a friendly actual bulldog there since the name is what brought me there.

Author: hwds
Title: Excellent Choice
Review: Visited twice during my recent visit, located next to Ramada Place and Bayview Hotels. Modern atmosphere with excellent food and drinks. The selection isn't big, but very good quality.

Author: Amir H
Title: Nyonya Lunch
Review: Good quality food and excellent service. Located close to the centre of town. Spacious with an industrial vibe

Author: JoshChui
Title: Good but a little pricey
Review: This place serves Nyonya food with a slight twist.  Taste wise is yummy but price wise it's a little higher.  The desserts were excellent. Ambience is very upmarket.

Author: Melchua523
Title: Bulldog cafe first choice
Review: Love the meals over here, especially the laksa n the Bailey's cendol... On the weekends they live band at night. Staffs n the owner are very friendly n polite.

Author: mikeleesl54Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Bulldog Restaurant
Review: Overall, great local food servings and it will be good for travellers who wants to have a quick taste. The staffs are friendly and helpful. Really likes the ikan goreng cili garam, bendi and the ayam pongteh. The cendol is also good. It would be better if it is aircon because in the afternoon can be very hotShow less

Author: MikeR5284
Title: Outstanding
Review: A must visit for my family and me everytime we visit Melaka..great food,good service, reasonable pricing,clean environment...what more do you for when you eat at a restaurant.

Author: YenlengMYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ayam Limau Parut was fantastic!
Review: I don’t tolerate spicy food well; but ayam limau parut was (er-hem) to die for! Loved that they have steamed okra; very nicely steamed—soft but not overcooked. Pie tee and popiah was great too!Was in Malacca for an overnight trip—love the food here that after my first visit for dinner; I came back for lunch before I left the town. Staff are really nice and welcoming; and patient as well. Music can be softer; but I’m sure it’s just me. Would be back! Show less

Author: sigiriya j
Title: Really Good food
Review: We went in for a quick snack . the food was reasonably priced and delicious. the place is very clean and the service is good.

Author: Jennifer D
Title: Very enjoyable!
Review: Gets very busy but it is possible to reserve a table. Food was very enjoyable - tasty. Staff were efficient and friendly. Definitely worth visiting this restaurant. Prices were good.

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Unexpected Gem
Review: Visited this restaurant as the one I wanted to try wasnt open that day and found out that the food here is exceptionally good despite that it position themselves as a cafe (Sorry I am a little bit biased towards cafe these days as there are too many in the town and some are just overrated!) Went here with my friend and we ordered a few dishes as our lunch (Popiah, Ikan Asam Pedas, Nyonya Laksa, Cendol). All of them are excellent especially the Nyonya Laksa! It has rich flavor and served with beehoon/noodles, prawn, eggs, beans sprouts and others. All the ingredients are fresh and made it even better! One who visits this restaurant might as well try out their cendol (served with redbeans,cendol and the fantastic gula melaka!). Staff there were courteous and friendly. Thank you! Oh yeah not forget to mention, prices are definitely reasonable!Show less

Author: poppy313Singapore, Singapore
Title: Totally overrated, expensive tiny portion
Review: We went with a high expectation due to the thumbs up reviews but left disappointed. Environment: place is clean and minimal. Food: Not a lot of choices compared to other nyonya restaurants, extremely small portion, taste is so so. Laksa is not bad but not as good as the one at Jonker street. Price: extremely expensive for the small amount and quality. A bit cheaper than fine dining of course. We walked out unimpressed and yes, if you are not local or accustomed to local Asian cuisine, you would give it a 5 star ratings. This will be our first and last time at this cafe.Show less

Author: Flitz8
Title: Great service and good food
Review: Good eatery and service here professional and friendly.Had nonya laksa with chicken sausage.Laksa wasn't big portion but really tasty.Sausages good as well.Cendol really delicious.

Author: docrkd
Title: Authentic Nyonya food in Funky setting
Review: Great hipster style cafe with tasty food, really enjoyed the prawn and pineapple, spicy top notch curries and the lovely cendol...

Author: juju_raraPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Nyonya Laksa
Review: I keep coming back here for the aromatic Nyonya Laksa!Yes the food here is a little pricier compared to other local eateries, but the ambiance here is top notch. Clean, comfortable with a modern style.I also enjoyed the cendol. The ice was very finely shaved and not too sweet. My kids love the calamansi juice here. I appreciate that the menu has a few kid friendly items like ayam pongteh, different options of omelettes, sausages, etc. I didn't give it full marks for the following : The otak-otak was not to my liking, I find it a little dry. While the service is friendly and attentive, my noodles took a little longer than what I'm used to. But this won't stop me from coming back here or ordering the Laksa again! The location is convenient if you are staying at any of the nearby hotels. If you are driving, parking can be trickier to find from the main road. But there's more available closer to The Shore. Show less

Author: 683philipt
Title: Smart and Clean
Review: We were booked a table here by Trailfinders and it’s probably a good safe place to go to for visitors. The food seemed fine to me, but I am not an expert on Malaysian cuisine

Author: joshSAN186Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Nyonya food with a twist!
Review: We visited this place on a recommendation and found the whole experience a very pleasant and happy one indeed. From the interior design that was minimalistic (with some modern nyonya touches), to the really friendly and highly professional service (we were even 'given tips / advice' on our portioning), it was all good.This is not to mentioned the aromatic, flavour filled food / dessert that we had (Nyonya Laksa, Belacan Okra, Pai Tee, Ayam Pongteh, Cencaluk Omelet and Cendol). The taste was also slightly different as the staff explained that it was a personalized family's recipe.The portioning was smaller than the average shop as stated in the menu, "small portion, more option". This works out perfectly for us.We also found the price very reasonable for what we had there and would highly recommend anybody looking for a good nyonya food with a twist!Show less

Author: intrepid2458warwickshire
Title: Very good food
Review: This restaurant was a great find, just behind our hotel so it was good to go on a very wet evening and also to escape the madness in Jonker Walk. Food was excellent especially the Ikan goreng with chili. Portions are not big (even the rice is small) but it is all tasty. They do not serve wine though but will allow you to byo albeit at high corkage cost. They do have beers and spirits though. Show less

Author: Nuve21Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated, meant for foreigners or people who look for class than taste.
Review: We visited this place due to its good reviews.Food was not bad.But was not fantastic either,especially for its price range.Most of the people who came either a foreigner or married to a foreigner, whom don't really know the authentic original taste.Service is very good. Staffs are polite and nice. Place is also good. But we came for the food...Show less

Author: eloise883
Title: Bailey's cendol - a bomb !
Review: The bailey's cendol there are so good, although i feel that it's slightly overpriced but still worth a try. Limau perut is great, nice ambience, good service. Somewhere to go for when you're in urge of Nyonya food but don't have a huge group to share with.Show less

Author: russelld49
Title: great food simply presented
Review: truly wonderful flavours and excellent local food. friendly helpful staff. modern appearance and very good value. not to be missed, you must visit if in the area.

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Expensive, spicy and small portion
Review: After reading such good reviews we decided to try the food at this cafe.We found the food just so so , having tried better ones elsewhere. A lot of items were not available that morning as they were all 'sold out' the night before. Still we manage to order pongteh, eggs, chicken limau perut, otak(last 2pieces available we took one), fried brinjal, ikan gerang Asam and cendol. The coffee is just the 3-1 type or sachet, if I am right. It tastes like those anyway.The food were extremely spicy, even for my hubby who is the chillies king in the house. The non spicy menu are limited. Service staff were very attentive and friendly. Location is just in front of Orkid Hotel. Show less

Author: BilbodotcomUK
Title: Modern cafe with Malaysian food
Review: Visited twice. Located near the Ibis and Ramada hotels.It was a great find, nice modern place with friendly staff.Tried the laksa, chicken curry, peppered beef and chilli fish and they were all pretty decent (and fiery!)Highly recommended if you want a change from the usual semi-street-food cafes.Show less

Author: StroumpfetteFussa, Japan
Title: Visiting Malacca
Review: Too tired to go too far from our hotel we looked at close by restaurant. We wanted to eat local food and specialities with something that the kids could eat . 50 m from the hotel :BullDog cafe restaurant . We walked there and had a very nice welcome . The service was fast . The waiter helped with the food with what is spicy or not especially for our children chicken wings and rice were great for them . We ordered nyonya type of food with chicken, curry ,okra and watercress , rice and shaved ice-cream and vanilla ice-cream. All was delicious and as soon as we emptied our plates the waitress came and took it out of the way. They were very nice .Show less

Author: 901stanleylSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly restaurant
Review: We decide to take an evening scroll from jonker walk and finally find the restaurant by asking direction from the locals.The restaurant is opposite Hotel Orkit.This is our first time visiting Bulldog.The staff will very friendly and thoughtful over minor stuff which we find it worth to mention here.The staff was kind enough to go thru the menu and recommend us on their speciality.We order the fried brinjal, curry prawn, chicken wings and ayam pongteh with chendol to complete our dinnerThey will provide additional utensils without our request when we will sharing the delicious chendol with our daughter.Show less

Author: jasephine
Title: What a nice experience dinner
Review: We selected this restaurant by picking up most of the good review from here.First time visit Bulldog and they deserved the good comment, especially the tasty food.Highlights: Fried Okra (lady finger) with sambal belacanSambal Sotong (squid)Cendol **must tryDefinitely will return here again in our next visit to Malacca.Show less

Author: peilyn c
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Came all the way from KL and found this gem. Food is good and very comfortable for bringing families. Compliments to the chef!

Author: Lorraine K
Title: great meal
Review: Had a great meal here. Food excellent, atmosphere good. Small but good menu. Cendol brilliant. Would recommend.

Author: JamesW8143
Title: Modern cafe with authentic Nyonya cuisine
Review: Visited this place with 9 other friends, every dish was cooked to perfection. Love the fish, chicken, prawn and cendol. Atmosphere was lovely, clean and new feel.

Author: Pilvi N
Title: Best food in Malaysia
Review: Love the decor! Good service too, they explained us well all we asked. Great food, fresh and tasty. Had to go twice which we never do but it was such a good food, close to our hotel and so beautiful too.

Author: ChuckityChuck
Title: Awesome little place
Review: Small and well selected menu. Predominantly local food. Must try the chilly stuffed fish and laksa. Kill yourself if you don't taste the cendol. It is to die for.

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Nonya cuisine
Review: Very delicious nonya dishes available. Remember to request for less spicy for those who can't take too spicy food!

Author: AlFewreSydney, Australia
Title: Great food for so little
Review: Food and service was fantastic. They took the time to go through the menu and explain every dish prior to us selecting what we would order. Fresh juices and amazing food made for a very enjoyable night out.If we ever get back to Melaka, we will revisit this restauraunt for another fantastic mealShow less

Author: wwsmLittleRedDot
Title: Nyonya Gem
Review: We chanced upon this non-descript restaurant after checking-in Bayview Hotel across the road. It was late evening and we just wanted a quick bite before retiring for the night after a long workday. A/C was blasting downwards at the diners so it can get quite chilly. Cooking was done in a separate kitchen at the back with a bar counter separating the diners and service area. Wait staff were always anticipating and non-intrusive. 1st dinner – we ordered ayam pongteh, cencaru sumbat, ikan goreng asam, sambal sotong, sambal kangkong, chap chye and udang lemak nenas. 2nd dinner – we ordered cencaru sumbat (x2), Ayam Limau Perut, PoPiah (x2), Chicken Wings and Chendol (x2).We were pleasantly surprised at how good the food tasted even with the limited variety and small portion offered. After a mouthful of each dish, we’re transported back to our childhood days! It was that good! Almost as good as the way Mom & Grandma used to make! The cencaru sumbat was the highlight as we had it on consecutive nights. Cendol was equally good as well.We both agreed that this restaurant would be tagged high on our “return required” list!Show less

Author: SSiangLittle India, Singapore
Title: Good Nyonya Cuisine!
Review: Went there twice in this same visit to Malacca. Food was amazingly nice especially the sambal sotong and the omelet with chincalok. Their chendol is a 'die die' must try!!! Not forgetting, the superb mochi with durian filling. Staff is friendly, knows how to recommend dishes and food generally comes out quite fast. A 10/10 for service. The only reason this is not 5 stars is because I wish they could add in more dishes into the menu. Otherwise, this restaurant is the almost perfect Nyonya place to go to... a definite return on my next trip to Malacca. Show less

Author: jackuddinWorld
Title: Awesome Food AS Always!!!
Review: Cannot be missed when visiting Malacca. Kinda surprise that the Bulldog Crew still remember us. Food awesomely great!! Laksa and Ayam Limau Perut was a bomb and is proper Malaccan spicy level. Not watered down and they do not skimp on ingredients for all dishes. Too bad they are closing soon for their renovation work for a month time from mid Sept til November. Luckily we came at the right time and can't wait to see the new look for Bulldog and feeling excited for it!! And We will be back again for my Cendol tmr!!Show less

Author: ReneeDec2012Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good service & average food
Review: Visited this cafe twice this year. The food is not as tasty compared to the 1st time - laksa is way too spicy & cendol is not as good as before. Having said that, the staffs attitude and service kinda make up for it. They are certainly friendly though serving of food takes quite a while and it's not packed with customers yet.Show less

Author: ragamuffinkidSingapore, Singapore
Title: awesome nyonya meal
Review: i have read so many of other people's review and they are pretty true to their words. so i shan't repeat them. if you are residing around bayview hotel or plaza ramada, please do pop in this quaint and contemporary cafe looking restaurant called bulldog and let them blow the socks out of you with their nyonya cuisine. too bad i weren't here on weekends, otherwise i would have enjoyed the band performance as well :)Show less

Author: Michael CAberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: So unexpected
Review: My companion and l came upon this unpretentious restaurant by accident. We were staying at the Bayview Hotel in Melaka and on our first evening we walked into town, or nearly did, as the Bulldog restaurant is located about fifty metres from our hotel, on the other side of the road.Our food was served by really cheerful people, male and female, and was delicious. There are not hundreds of choices. There are about nine or ten, all reasonably priced. The restaurant is clean and has seating for about two dozen people. Next time we are in Melaka it will be our first stop.Show less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Best cendol in Melaka
Review: Had a dinner with family recently. Very cold as aircond blows directly almost on all tables. A small stage for band only during weekends. Food is classical nyonya food. Nice but small portions and quite pricey compared to other outlets. The cendol however is marvelous. One of the best around in Melaka, not sweet but full of the gula melaka fragrance. 4 adults and 2 children with a meal with 6 dishes cost 200+, reasonable except for the fish fillet that we ordered. Show less

Author: johnxavierSingapore, Singapore
Title: BULLDOG Restaurant
Review: Bulldogs is a bar and restaurant .It's very clean.very crowded at mealtimes.The waiters and waitresses are really awesome.The owner of the place acts as a waiter, cook, and Drummer of the band, ha ha ha, awesome guy.The band, called Alvin and Joy is very powerful indeed.A good repertoire of songs to their belt.I enjoyed the music the whole night.Want to go back there soon.Show less

Author: chiosupingsingapore
Title: Delicious and satisfying
Review: The food was very well cooked. The sambals packed a real wallop. We had the squid with petai. The squid was lovely and tender and the sauce was very tasty. Their fried fish in sambal was flaky and moist on the inside, but the bones and skin were golden and crunchy. The shaved ice in the chendol was feather-light and you could taste the grassy pandan in the obviously home made, almost translucent chendol strands. The only thing that stuck out as being odd was the club music playing in the background.Show less

Author: FoodEnthusedKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya food in modern settings
Review: We were recommended by a friend and we were pleasantly surprised that it was in such comfortable and contemporary setting, which is not usual for a Nyonya restaurant in Melaka. The menu is small, and we chose the chicken wings, chicken limau perut, sambal sotong and laksa. The dishes were not very big in size, but big on flavours! Delicious, spicy dinner.We ended with a bowl of cendol, which was the best cendol we had in Melaka thus far (and we had plenty). Service was only so-so, an Indian chap there was not very friendly and was pretty surly from the moment we entered. Show less

Author: jackjiahui
Title: Best Cendol w Gula Melaka, yummy nyonya delicacies, great & friendly service !
Review:
Nice place to visit,chill & have a drink. 
Love the sambal sotong w petai, also their cendol!
Enjoyed our saturday evening there with their yummy  food & friendly service from them :) 
I ll surely go back there again !

Author: jianeechloe
Title: Great place, best laksa and cendol👍👍
Review: I came here with my parent. It's awesome place, nice staffs and they serve very delicious foods. The Laksa it superb delicious👏👍. And yet I had my dessert of Cendol. I love Cendol here and it is the best👍.

Author: laviosarMelaka, Malaysia
Title: AWESOME FOOD AND THE BEST CENDOL IN MELAKA👍👍👍
Review: It's a superb ambience when I walk in with my family to have our dinner..very well presented food. Specially the Udang Lemak Nenas, Ikan goreng chili, Fried Brinjal n etc.. very Delicious n great foods..the dessert Cendol that we ordered its the best in Melaka. Good service n nice staff's. Will come back again..Show less

Author: VanessaG4805
Title: Came here once and will come back again :)
Review: Awesome service, great food, good vibes! Cendol is really to die for 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 Love the homemade cendol! Thanks to the 2 crews who served us, keep up! Will definitely come back again for more... :)

Author: Leo F
Title: Great place, nice staff & awesome food
Review: We really enjoyed our time at Bulldog's, the Laksa was the best we had so far and especially the Cendol was superb! The staff was so nice and courteous and made us feel welcome at all times! We would love to come back soon.

Author: dariuskam
Title: Awesome Place, Must come, Best Cendol in town!
Review: The cendol is awesome with home made gula melaka syrup and thick coconut milk. It's definitely one of my favorite. The cendol is marvellous with exquisite taste.

Author: Windflower8Malaysia
Title: Great Chendol!
Review: A simple place with good food and nice environment and friendly staffs. Most of all, the Chendol is one of the Best I have tried in Melaka, even those popular ones in Jonker's Walk cannot compare to this!What makes it different is the Gula Melaka and the fresh coconut milk used. Definitely worth a trip there as the place is situated away from the town center. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: llp2266
Title: Best chendol in Malacca!
Review: I like the food here especially the chendol. I have tried chendol in many places but still think this is the best. Right amount of gula and fragrant coconut.

Author: cortanawilson
Title: another surprise
Review: another place we tried based on its name, this time is a great idea, the food was great and everything was equally great.

Author: blujas
Title: Best cendol
Review: Great place for tourists and Locals. Laksa was good and so was brinjals and veggies (chap chye and four angle beans). But the highlight of the night was the cendol - sweet note to end a satisfying dinner.

Author: Gavin H
Title: Awesome
Review: Fantastic food and customer service would highly recommend for people who want to try local food very friendly and helpful staff

Author: AnnaR730London, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty fresh food, great value
Review: We had limited time in Melaka so were keen to try the regional specialties. Bulldog is a laid back, clean, modern style restaurant. The menu offers great local specialties and the staff are friendly and helpful; talking you through anything you are not familiar with. We shared the laksa which was delicious and spicy, a sweet chicken dish, and spicy fried okra. We finished with the chandol which was amazing! It came in at fantastic value, we would definitely return.Show less

Author: Ade-CSHGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Yummy Meal nice ambiance
Review: Nyonya Cuisine with a very unique name Bulldog Cafe, it doesn't really attract my attention when my partner suggested to have dinner here. After reading some reviews we give it a try.We were their last customer of the day before their closing. Due eating too much during the day we ordered just a few dishes. We had their Laksa, Ladies Finger with Sambal, limau purut chicken and a must have CENDOL. All of them are so yummy, my partner regret for not ordering another Cendol The service staff is (can't remember his name) very friendly and knowledgeable and sharing info about nyonya cuisine with us. Definitely not to miss this gem of Melaka "Bulldog Cafe" when you visit Melaka.Show less

Author: James CMelaka.
Title: Love the food and hospitality of staffs.
Review: Nice food and atmosphere here. Especially they had my preference of laksa, as I am on low carb diet, I don't take noodle or rice, but I love laksa, we came out with a nice name call "Laksa Kosong". That mean it is laksa with all the condiments but without noodles. Highly recommended this lovely restaurant when u in melaka town. Show less

Author: 271audreyn
Title: Best Nyonya Food in Melaka
Review: Visited for dinner 2 nights in a row because it's the best Nyonya food in Melaka (have tried most Nyonya restaurants in Melaka) with excellent service to boast and reasonably priced

Author: jackuddinWorld
Title: Extremely Yummylicious Food!!!!
Review: Visited Bulldog last weekend, the food was excellent!!! Loved their Nyonya food to the max especially the Udang Lemak Nenas and the Ayam Limau Perut!! Service was good and attentive , Two thumbs up to the Bulldog crew! The cendol is a must!, the best so far that i've had. Will definitely return on the next trip to Malacca. Keep up the good work guys! Show less

Author: N J
Title: Chic lunch Nonya
Review: Bulldog serves a full menu of flavorful Nonya fare at a very reasonable price. Portions are good. Make sure you get the cendol!

Author: Susan Owi S
Title: Baba Nyonya Cuisine @ taste
Review: Like the home made taste of baba nyonya: chicken ponteh, chicken limau perut, the cendol melaka is so smooth.

Author: Dream95083
Title: Unexpected gem in Melaka
Review: Had a friends birthday dinner here...the restaurant was very accommodating...Birthday girl enjoyed herself..the food was very good, you wouldn't expect it from a pub..price wise..very very reasonable. The performers were good too! Better than your usual hotel lounge singers...all in all a very entertaining night without breaking the bank.Show less

Author: James HGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: What a deliciously memorable meal!
Review: How fortunate to have stumbled upon this gem which was just across the street from the Bayview Hotel. My co-workers and I went for the set lunch which was simple yet super tasty and priced just right. While the curry chicken with popiah wrap was delicious, the ponteh chicken was even better imho. Also, the sambal sotong/squid as a side dish was fresh and not too fiery. For dessert, we had cendol melaka (which was so good that we came back for seconds the following day!). Even the service was great! The owners were so friendly and nice, it made the whole dining experience awesome. Will certainly go back there to try their other dishes.Show less

Author: NgFamilyLondon2013London, United Kingdom
Title: Chilli hot!
Review: We ate here for both lunch and dinner. The Nyonya food is good though pretty high on chilli content. Nicely presented food in a modern clean restaurant. Delicious kalamansi lime juice and lots of gula malacca on the cendol and ice kachang, though not much filling in either, just beans and no fruit or jelly in the ice kachang..Good friendly service. Air conditioned and comfortable.Show less

Author: shaunmc1958Sydney, Australia
Title: Great food and service
Review: This was our favourite food in Malaysia!! Went there twice during our stay in Malacca. Must try the Laksa, stir fried Kangkung with garlic and chilli (our request) and the most delicious Cendol. The chef here is excellent and the staff always friendly, welcoming and nothing is too much trouble as when we asked for extra fresh chilli with everything! A must visit in Malacca!Show less

Author: kanzlerk2017Maspalomas, Spain
Title: Good food good service
Review: Rahat the waiter was very attentive and explained all dishes in detail. Food was very tasty, it was the first but surely not the last time that we tried Nonya. Good value for money. Toilets are clean but need some renovation. All in all a nice dining experience. Show less

Author: rogerbushellGloucestershire, United Kingdom
Title: Absolute delight
Review: Visited the Bulldog having read trip advisor reviews - and because it was a 3 minute stroll from our hotel (Majestic). We were immediately welcomed and seen to our table. This set the scene for a great evening. Wonderful food (everything they say about the Cendol and Kachang is true) and excellent friendly service. Also very reasonably priced It's a pity that we leave tomorrow as we'd like to go back to sample the laksi .... perhaps another time!Show less

Author: rowanneg
Title: Serve the best laksa in town
Review: Delicious nyonya food with reasonable price. The have friendly staffs which wil attend to you.. not forgetting the cozy atmosphere..

Author: JoanneMS
Title: Good food and pretty awesome environment.
Review:
If you are looking for good Nyonya food accompanied by good music. Bulldog is the place to be.
Serves arguably one of the best laksa in town. And the pai tee is excellent.

Author: GardenCafeInKemaman
Title: Fantastic visit
Review: I visited this place on the night before I left Malacca. Nice food, nice dessert and nice service. Reasonably priced for a place with live band.

Author: k0hk3Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Nyonya food
Review: Just 5 minutes from Ramada Plaza along the busy Jalan Bendhara, the name of this café is intriguing. Much as I anticipate, I did not see any canine of such breed around. Though disappointed, the food was amazingly good. Price was affordable.Wife and I were famished when we reached this pork free café at about 1pm on a Friday afternoon. Much to my surprise, it was empty. Sometimes, seeing is disbelieving. We sat and ordered the food. 10 minutes later, 3 more tables were filled. One of the tables filled with 6 people. We were lucky to come early.Simple setting of modern neat wooden tables and chairs. A little pond with some koi swimming leisurely. A set of drums displayed in the middle of the cafe. I believe there is some kind of live music in the evening. Shortly, the food arrived. The fried okra (MYR9) with belachan chilli was yummy. It was cooked to the right texture. The belanchan chilli was the hero of the dish. Next came the sambal prawns(MYR32). Spicy and fresh, it had a very nyonya taste. Went well with the white rice. We heard about the otak. Unfortunately, it was not available. Next time must try, I made a mental note. The only dish we did not fancy was the nyonya pongteh chicken(MYR9).
