The stewed chicken with potatoes was overcooked and the gravy a little dilute.By this time, we were almost full. However, I could not resist to order the nyonya popiah (MYR5). Popiah skin was a little different from other stalls. Got a feeling it was home-made.The final item was the nyonya chendol (MYR5). How can one not have chendol when in Melaka ? The gula melaka was thick and aromatic sweet. Coconut milk was thick. Yes, they did not use the kidney red beans here. It was nice to have this cold dessert especially in the oppressive heat of Melaka.It was wonderful meal. We left beaming with delight……Show less

Author: rtwfofMackay, Australia
Title: Best meal I've had in 6 weeks of travelling!
Review: We had the Nynonya Pongteh Chicken (not spicy - for the kids), Nyonya Curry Chicken (just the right amount of heat and spice) and the Udang Lemak Nenas (curry prawns with pineapple in coconut milk)... EVERYTHING was amazing! The fragrant curried chicken was the best meal I have had in 6 weeks! The entire family ❤️'d this restaurant! Friendly and attentive staff, cold beer and delicious food! What more could you ask for!Show less

Author: Mabel_38Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesomeness!!!!!
Review: Situated near Ramada Hotel in Malacca, Bulldog serves good Malaccan food! The Assam fish is so tasty that my mum who normally eats only half a bowl of rice, ended up finishing 2! I cannot go without my cincalok omelette in Malacca, and Bulldog nailed my craving.. The Chendol is THE BEST I have tasted! Drizzled with Gula Melaka and Fresh coconut milk, the chendol packs oomph!Show less

Author: georginat565
Title: Peranakan food
Review: Best chendol I've ever eaten! Good food! Good service! Definitely worth a visit! Near ramada hotel. Curry chicken Assam prawns are good

Author: Ming Yu CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Peranakan cuisine by next-generation Peranakans!
Review: Real good food! Authentic Peranakan fare prepared by young Gene and his crew in a traditional shophouse. Is that an antique BSA motorcycle near the front door?! You can eat and drink your fill here without burning a hole in your pocket. While the adults savoured laksa (noodles in coconut curry), brinjal (aubergine/okra), lady's fingers and cincalok (fermented krill) omelette, my children picked the bones of the barbecued chicken wings clean - my youngest says they are the "best by far"! For an added treat, Gene takes off his apron and plays drums with the live band on Monday nights. Call ahead to reserve the cendol for dessert - it runs out very fast!Show less

Author: Willwork4holiday
Title: Excellent dining experience
Review: We returned to this restaurant as it is so good. Opposite the Orkid hotel, on the main road into Melaka, so in a convenient location. Attentive wait service, that made children welcome. The food is so delicious will definitely keep going back when next in Melaka.Show less

Author: quahy2015
Title: Delicious laksa and cendols!
Review:
I love the laksa and cendols!
a must visit and i think it's the best so far!

the laksa is full of flavours and spicy..just love it.

Author: ChanKSKen
Title: BEST CENDOL
Review: Once you've tried the cendol here at Bulldog, all others won't be able to compare. Love it to bits and a must have whenever I'm in Melaka. So glad they reopened =D

Author: EdwardQ_13Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Ooooh weeeee
Review: Dayum I luv Nyonya delicacies!!! Talk about a refreshing step back into the past. Traditional meets modern with this delicious food! If you are in Melaka, please stop by. This is a treat and you will definitely thank the chef! Remember, try the Cendol (pronounced Chen-dole) with a shot of Bailey's! !Magnifique!Show less

Author: JoannaT2031
Title: Delicious and spicy nyonya food
Review: Great service and food recommendations from the waiter. The fried brinjal (must try) was excellent along with udang lemak nenas and ayam limau perut.

Author: blackberrymastermalaysia
Title: They don't serve dogs
Review: A 2 minutes walk from Ramada you will find this nyonya style restaurant facing the main road. Food served were quite succulent if you are into spicy taste bud.They got live band but probably not during the weekend i guess.Floor staff are quite attentive and speedy. only matters is the food preparation for customers are very very slow. as i heard only 1 cook in the kitchen to prep your order. Price are reasonable. And there are no dogs inside.Show less

Author: seanlY2517TE
Title: Great food, awesome service and best music in town
Review: Mind blowingly good food. Reasonably priced. The service was courteous and prompt. But the icing on the cake was the music. A must visit if you're in malacca!

Author: NavinNishaalPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Baba Nyonya Taste
Review: Excellent taste and a must try restaurant in town. The cendol was extremely yummy and I enjoyed every bit of it. I ordered laksa and it was mind blowing taste! Overall enjoyed the food and its ambiance. Service was excellent and no areas that any could find any fault or negative. Would highly recommend this restaurant for a real baba nyonya taste in Melaka. Show less

Author: 1114Aikon
Title: Great one to try!
Review: Modern Nyonya food and Ice Kachang & Chandol are must to try! Young owner and stuffs are very friendly.

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: The best nyonya food in the town
Review: One of the best restorants in nyonya food and in malacca also. Great place, tasty food and frendly staff.We go there very offen. The food is amazing. Otak is nice laksa is one of the best,Prawns very tasty, the beef you must try...and can continue with many dishes more. I like all.Reasonable price clean and good deco. Also in weekdays have live music. Nice place running under younguer peopleShow less

Author: Mei Shan W
Title: Nostalgia with gd food
Review: When i was here 3 years ago, it used to be more of a drinking joint serving light snacks. Now it is more of a cafe serving good peranakan or baba nonya food. Menu is limited and they do not serve pork. despite the limited menu the food far surpassed the peranakan food served at nonya reataurants in melaka raya. The blend of spices are subtle. Highly recommended is the chicken pongteh and the nonya laksa. Oh the cendol is out of this world. Delightful service and prices are reasonable. BTW they also hv live music on friday and saturday night. Beers are well chilled. Whether u are a local or a tourist-u will like the charming old charm of this shopShow less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A watering hole just down the road from Ramada Plaza Melaka
Review: We found this place by chance (Googled nearby watering holes) as the lounge at our hotel was closed for the night. This place was not too bad – there was a live band playing that night. The ambiance was relaxing, however I found it a tad too cold. The place is fairly new, so they didn’t have any beer on taps at that point, only by the bottle.Show less

Author: christinechin25kuala lumpur
Title: Authentic nyonya food
Review: Was here for dinner recently and we enjoyed the nyonya food very much. At the waiter's recommendations, we ordered chicken cooked with limau purut which was spicy but very fragrant and tasty, prawns with pineapple curry, fried fish fillet with chilli, otak-otak and ladies fingers. The food was really good, not too spicy. On weekends they have a live band that starts playing at 9.30 or 10 pm. No wine but they serve beer. Service was good too, very friendly and welcoming.We liked the food and if we are back in malacca, we will definitely be back.Show less

Author: nroomasHino, Japan
Title: Cool and Hip Place, Beware of Very Spicy Food
Review: We, a family of three, went there on Wednesday evening, and they had run out of pai tee, popiah, and otak-otak. We alternatively ordered a few unknown local dishes; they were very spicy, which didn't bother me much, but my wife and daughter couldn't take much.The decor has a contemporary monotone theme; even the air conditioners are painted black. The place is basically clean and comfortable though I found the pop music played on the sound system quite loud.It would be good for young people to enjoy beer while munching on spicy food in a cool and hip ambiance.The portion of each dish is small through the price is reasonable.Show less

Author: W3591CBdavidf
Title: Great restaurant
Review: A really nice, relaxed and tasteful atmosphere and the exquisite food. A top address in malacca. Would highly recommend.

Author: jhnhassellPerth, Australia
Title: Excellent food at an excellent price
Review: Had dinner and drinks here for about $50 Aust total. Had a four different main dishes with a serving of rice each and dessert. The Tiger beers were cold and the service was spot on. Went on a Thursday night. Would highly recommend you give this a try. Agree with the other people who recommended it.Show less

Author: eohh
Title: Place to hang out with friends
Review: Its walking distance from my hotel and they have friendly staff. Too bad they close 9.30pm which is abit too early probably because of weekdays.

Author: FindTravelPartnerMalaysia
Title: Nyonya Food with live band
Review: Enjoy the nyonya food here, especially nyonya laksa and otak-otak. Must try their cendol and commando chip. Every friday and saturday will have live music. THis place very cozy, with great music. The owner very good in cooking and great drummer.Come here to celebrate my birthday with friends, but the owner give me a small surprise (ice cream cake), after they sing birthday song for me, all the staff will queue to wish you.Show less

Author: Kim J
Title: Great location excellent meals
Review: My Wife and I had dinner and drinks with our wonderful hosts William and Sylvia and stayed on to listen to Alvin and Joy sing some classics. Later on the owner/ chef Gene came out and played the drums. Fantastic night a place certainly not to be missed. Show less

Author: Eric D
Title: Nonya food in a modern atmosphere
Review: Enjoyed the local Malacca food, great climate control, hip music and nice people here. On Friday and Saturdays  there is live music. I will be back in July to check this out. Good luck with your nice place!

Author: WeiL825
Title: Have space for improvement
Review: Been here for 2 nights consecutively, when in small groups service is prompt and food is good. When in larger groups, service wasn't as prompt as staff wasn't alert and tact (eg if 20 seats were reserved they would insist that you sit at the allocated places and would not divide the food for you. They only relented when the boss came out to look but patrons were already annoyed) but food was still good. Show less

Author: Go55
Title: Nice place for a casual dinner
Review: Good nonya food - we loved the local fish and okra curry and the chicken pongleh. Also had some good stir died veggies. Serves beer and soft drinks. Cost about AUS $25 for two of us.

Author: 587bruceg
Title: This restaurant open on public holiday, great food
Review: We had arrived in Malacca by coach and we're looking for establishment to eat and Bulldog appeared.  The staff were most welcoming and attentive.  Even giving us a lesson in Bahasa Malaysia.  Food delivered was traditional and very welcome.

Author: Spritey123
Title: Fruit Fly Fest
Review: Loads of fruit flies. Had to cover our drinks with drink coasters. When our food come out we had to shoo them away from our food. Kids then discovered bowls of rotten fruit in the toilets and under sofa, where the flies breed. We're not quite sure why they would do this. Food was average, decor quite clinical. Wouldn't recommend.Show less

Author: DummiessmurfJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: - late updating for food that out of stock. No synchronised in taking order between the cashier and the kitchen staff. Seems like no communication among the staffs. - meal takes an excessively to be served which the stomach full by drinking water while waiting for food.- Paying the 10% taxes for nothing when the customer itself come to cashier for order and payment. - not providing the pictures of meals on menu quite hard for customers to know what it is.- such an disappointment for the ambience of the cafe, plain with dull decorations, the big glass windows without any curtains to cover the brightness and also the chair like silent killer are harmful to sit on. Pity to old people. - didn't follow the SOP; no distancing and some of the staff didn't wear the mask properly when serve the food.Show less

Author: Raswan31
Title: Not recommended
Review: Feedback : Date : 21/12/2020Time : 2pm1. We ordered Seafood pasta, egg & hash brown sandwich, Cajun chicken sandwich, and sweet potatoes • Seafood pasta-mussel and prawn were tasteless.• sweet potatoes were greasy & soggy.2. Food safety & hygiene• Drinking water was placed in a corner of the restaurant for the customers to go to if they wanted drinking water. With the current pandemic, this is a big health and safety issue due to un-sanitized contact point.• All cutleries, napkins, side plates were place on a trolley and exposed. Again, with the current pandemic this is another red flag.3. Service charge of 10 % was charged? We had to place our order at the counter, make several trips to the side station to pick up extra plates & napkins. The only service given was to deliver the food. Since this café is new, I was expecting check back to the food, service, etc... but no one cared to get feedback. So here it is. 4. Other matters• Parking space can be better. The empty space at the entrance can park early 4-6 cars. This can help your business.• Dining chairs and table are really uncomfortable. The chairs are flat wooden and sharp on the edges. The table is odd, when you sit on the table for 4 the table legs get in the way of your chair. • Staff need to be more friendly and communicate better. Need to improve on suggesting and upselling.Overall verdict- 2/10. Hope to see you guys improve in the future. Show less

Author: shareenadeanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Place with Good foods
Review: One of my favourite places to be while in Malacca. It usually packed with people during breakfast. I had Salmon Avocado toast and it will fulfilling and my tummy were happy until evening. The service is excellent and aunty who worked there are very friendly. Recommended place to try.Show less

Author: Nirav_Haji
Title: Loved it
Review:
Enjoyed our brunch but what stood out was the service.
Would highly recommend a visit.
Excellent way to start the day

Author: KUNADARYPenang, Malaysia
Title: Navy cafe visit
Review: I really love this cafe with unique menus❤️ Love love the smoothie bowl!! 100 mark for tat! Fresh fruits..perfect chillness n less sugar❤️ Their big breakfast set is perfecto:) definitely will recommend this cafe! Surely coming back again on my next trip. Keep it up navy staffs!Show less

Author: PositivelyImranShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Small cozy cafe.
Review: I'm shocked at the quality of the food here, it is astounding. I'm a university student so the price is affordable compared to cafes at KL. The decoration and atmosphere of this place is amazing for it's details in a vintage homely design that you can't find in KL city. The place is air condition and there's a quiet zone on the second floor for those needing the silence. The food as mentioned earlier is amazing! The big hearty chicken sandwich is a must to try. The mixtures of the vegetables, sauce, and grilled chicken will guarantee leave satisfied as a sandwich lover. Thank you very much to the team for their service and quality of their cafe.Show less

Author: baljitk2019
Title: Amazing!!
Review: Great atmosphere,  great food with great presentation.  Had breakfast and it was truly delicious. A quaint little place. Very attentive service staff. We  will definitely revisit!

Author: DOHAJO
Title: Quaint Cafe
Review: We gave this little cafe a try as it had a high rating on Tripadvisor. It was  small quiet cafe with great food.  The food was good and the wait staff was very nice.

Author: devika75_wanderlust
Title: Too good
Review:
Its was truly amazing to have our high tea over here..a welcoming cozy eat...we never regret to choose this place.the interior was a combo of modern n contemporary are on top
10/10✅✅✅

Author: SanJK89
Title: Fantastic heritage style dining
Review: Located in jonker Street, its a must go place for a cool heritage style dining. Offers variety of meal, western style. Price is reasonable for the portion you get. Good place to go.

Author: Alcinito
Title: Pork belly burger is the best
Review: Second time back to have pork belly burger and chill on a very hot weekday afternoon. Love the quiet ambience. Coffee is always good. Plenty of photo op on weekdays.

Author: jjourjon
Title: Terrible place ….
Review: I am French and my wife is from Melaka and I have been totally shocked by the bad and arrogant attitude.The place is definitely not friendly towards family and kids. We were received with attitude and discouraged to enter by the owner (?) insisting on the waiting time.Initially mentioning 1h waiting time then gradually saying it would be 1h30 mins while telling us not to wait inside but outside in the street near the road … obvious choice and very wise (I am sarcastic) when waiting with 5 kids of less than 9 years old of ageSuch business should not be recommended at all as it seems the philosophy is pure money making …Show less

Author: Alcinito
Title: Worth checking out
Review: After reading the reviews decided to head to The Baboon House. Did not disappoint at all. Good quality belly pork burger, home made beer and local coffee. Staff were friendly. Overall great ambience and nice space to chill.

Author: Happygolucky444
Title: Good burgers
Review: Looking for nice n tasty burgers..this is the place you should look into...the only downside.hard to get parking during weekends.

Author: reshvenir
Title: Delicious burgers
Review: Been almost 2 years I stopped eating McDonald's but the burger in baboon house was soooooo good. Very juicy and nice environment too.

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Nice setting..
Review: I walked in looking at the setup but found it a little overpriced compared to the quite average quality of fare that they serve.But the choice of items is quite huge.

Author: mahes1985
Title: Early breakfast
Review: We were the first customer of the day....i ordered the breakfast meal...it was prepared the way i requesred and the taste was excellent...the coffee was great....the ambience is cosy...the staff was super excellent....looking forward to come back again next time....Thank you for the experience

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Beautiful place and food - favourite in Melaka
Review: The place and the food are befitting of each other - just beautiful. It is lovely to look around whilst you wait for your food, which is just superb. Highly recommend...

Author: Littlearab
Title: Sort of Place Malacca needs more of!!
Review: Great little cafe for lunch, very quaint artistic setting. Something different from all the usual Malaysian chicken rice etc you can find in any Malaysian town. Owner has thought a lot about the offering. Western food though..

Author: poppyd466Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Yummy veggie option
Review: As a veggie, I was overjoyed when the waiter came over to tell us about the daily special which was a delicious falafel burger. Food was top notch, the drinks were healthy and tasty, the building is beautiful - covered in plants and antiques. All in all it’s rather an instagramable spot. Show less

Author: BigDaddSouthwark, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Burgers in Old Melaka Town
Review: Visiting Melaka post lockdown I decided to try this restaurant located off Jonker Street. Having tried many burgers around the world I was blown away by how good the burgers I tried were. Go for the lamb or pork patties. Restaurant is hard to find as hidden from the road.Show less

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: A must!
Review: A must to visit when in Malacca. This beautiful building with stunning architecture is a fabulous place to go for brunch or just a coffee. We enjoyed an excellent brunch. Food was delicious! Many options available from breakfasts, baguettes to burgers. Great atmosphere. We will return when back in Malacca. Show less

Author: DOHAJOAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: A hidden gem!
Review: It was recommended that we try The Baboon House for lunch by a friend who is an avid traveler and a food connoisseur! We were not lead astray! WOW!! this place is fabulous! From the amazing decor to the very scrumptious burgers on the menu, this place did, not disappoint!!So many options on the menu to choose from, it was hard to decide! While we waited for our food we wandered back through the old home to see all the fascinating artwork on the walls. So tastefully decorated, it was like being transported back in time!I will most definitely recommend this place to my friends and will be back again the next time I am in Melaka.Show less

Author: Abana87Leeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great (as long as you can get a seat)
Review: Popped here for lunch whilst waiting for our hotel check in to be available. Due to the size and popularity you may have to wait to be seated, but service is quick and it shouldn't be for long. The portions are excellent value for money and its handy location to places such as Jonker Street and the Baba & Nyonya Museum should make sure it goes on anyone's list of places to eat when visiting Melaka.Show less

Author: 378denk
Title: The cafe is closed for dine-in
Review: The cafe is closed for dine-in but we were able to take-away. Awesome pork belly and chicken burgers.

Author: sze2276
Title: Beautiful Cafe with Great Food
Review:
Beautiful place. Great food. Pork belly burger tasted wonderful. Loved the beans they used for my ham omelette breakfast.
Great service and staffs are very attentive.

Author: sweet_cindy1
Title: Great service
Review: We came across this place online after we turn away from the previous restaurant. What can i say, their burgers are good! Delicious! The service of the staff are very friendly too.

Author: zalnikor
Title: Not much to choose for vegetarians
Review:
Nice setting inside...The menu
 is basically burgers. They have a few choices for vegetarians. Had their portobello burger,not to  bad, could have had a few more potato wedges. Moderate
 prices ,portion size alright. Worth the visit.

Author: Makan_Tidor
Title: For the love of burgers and coffee, this is the place!!
Review: For burger hunters out there, this is the place  for some of the best burgers in town, especially if you are a pork lover. Their freshly ground coffee and kombucha are equally fantastic, not forgetting their staffs who treated us like long lost friends 👍🏻

Author: hxhxhx
Title: Restaurant with an amazing vibe
Review: A nice and quaint restaurant which serves delicious burgers. We came here for brunch and had a very pleasant experience. It has a very interesting and cool interior design and worth a visit if you are in the area. This place is a interesting discovery, would love to visit again soon!Show less

Author: paulprit7
Title: Breakfast Time!
Review: An absolute gem of a find. So quiant, so intimate, so delicious. Can't recommend this place highly enough. Hope our photos give you an encouragement to go along. Enjoy!

Author: yvonnet878
Title: Great place
Review: An amazing space and they serve great burgers including vegetarian options.  I had a really tasty portobello Mushroom Burger and a delicious piece of banana cake with ice cream.  We were served quickly and the staff were very friendly.  Highly recommend

Author: OlgaDimolia
Title: Great environment
Review:
Beautiful old house turned into a fantastic restaurant full of plants and artwork that give a unique  character!
Hamburgers and coffee were good.
A must see place in Melaka!

Toilets cleanliness needs more attention!

Author: noelhobden
Title: Beautiful interior, delicious food, good value.
Review: Full of green plants and artwork on the walls, the place feels relaxed and welcoming. The food is at a very high standard and absolutely delicious. Perfectly sized portions and good value. Well worth a visit if you're in Melaka.

Author: Sherwyn KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly staff and great food
Review: We came here for brunch on Sat. Delighted that we traditional didn't have to wait too long to be seated. Cosy traditional shophouse setting with beautiful air wells inside filled with plants. Very friendly staff that keeps updating us on the status of our order. Great burgers and the pork belly ones were sumptious and juicy. Great Malacca coffees too!Show less

Author: catredmond
Title: So cool
Review:
The tastiest burger I've possibly ever had!!
Such a cool setting too. Very friendly staff and an interesting selection of drinks.

Author: DaisyFitz432
Title: Love it
Review: Nicest burger I have had since I left my mothers kitchen in Ireland. Homemade delicious. Had an unreal ginger drink there too. Premises is class too. Cant recommended highly enough a must visit if you are in Malacca..

Author: Meg P
Title: Good burgers!
Review:
It's a good place to get burgers. It's one of those out of the way places. It's really nice inside. 
My enjoyed my burger though it fell apart as I was eating it and the bun was getting quite moist. It was very tasty though.

Author: Ngun CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Delicious Homemade Burgers
Review: The Baboon House serves very frrsh and yummy burgers. The homemade burger is soft & fresh with pumpkin seeds and other assorted seeds on the burger. The meat is not too salty nor sweet. Restaurant staff are polite and friendly.Too bad they close at 5pm and do not serve dinner.Show less

Author: carmen_from_canada
Title: A great burger place
Review:
We had three diffetent types of burgers, all homemade and satisfying, making us all very happy.  Beef and pork belly perfectly grilled.

What stood out however was the decor. An oasis from the choas of Jonker Street: you NEED to check out this place!

Author: RathiN24
Title: Yummy Burgers
Review: the burgers were really good. yummy pork and lamb burgers. wide range of drinks selection. ambiance of the place is quite chill. even though it was a busy sunday afternoon, the service was really good and friendly staffs.

Author: Michael OSunshine Coast, Australia
Title: Spectacular decor & interior
Review: Two of us dined here for lunch enjoying a cold drink and a couple of very nice chicken and lamb burgers. The service was friendly with excellent quality food. The interior is Chinese in origin beautifully decorated. As with the Chinese design the inside is cool and airy without air conditioning. Highly recommend this spot. Show less

Author: Melchua523
Title: Excellent patties
Review: Served yummy burgers, patties made by their own. Very juicy patties n great friendly services from the staffs. The environment were nice with garden view fresh air if you want 👍

Author: Citygal12456
Title: Good food. Good place.
Review: They offer nice pork burgers and they have a good selection of interesting and refreshing drinks. The place is quite picturesque and lots of pockets to take good photos.

Author: Mark BSouthampton, United Kingdom
Title: What a find !
Review: Looked this place up on TA and we weren't disappointed ! Amazing find. Tucked away in a little side road but once you open that door the magic begins.. it's a 200 year old house with REAL atmosphere. You look up to see the plants growing towardd the most. Food is fab. Very recommended.Show less

Author: 100Charlotte
Title: Great food in a lovely environment-ignore the forbidding entrance and go in!
Review: Great food in a lovely environment- cool and quirky inside if you work your way back through the rooms

Author: Jonathan C
Title: Must visit
Review: Exceptional experience. Amazing burger and coffee. Staff were very polite and attentive.  Would be the first place to revisit if in the area.

Author: Randy EHonolulu, Hawaii
Title: A Do Not Miss place ~
Review: This is probably the nicest and most interesting/artistic spot in Malaka. It's on the quiet street next to Jonker. Ask someone where it is. I only had coffee but the hamburgers looked amazing. Nice people, great art, an amazingly beautiful old "Long House" to explore with lots of cool things. A definite Must experience in Malaka, for sure. And prices are good.Show less

Author: Foody2017Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Staff welcoming and pleasant.
Review: Staff welcoming and pleasant. Food is lovely and plentiful. Very good value for money. The homemade ginger kombucha is lovely. It’s definitely worth a visit if your in the area. The house is fantastic in itself, so much character. It’s worth going just to have a look inside and a walk through to he back. It’s also worth noting that it’s family friendly with high chairs available and plenty of bits and bobs for kids to look at. Show less

Author: DeftlyDPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Best burger. EVER
Review: A friend recommended this restaurant too us and now we want to recommend it to everyone we know.The location is very central and when you enter through the front door you are transported to a world of comfort, old world charm & relaxation. Walk through the house to the back, it is simply gorgeous.The staff were friendly, chatty & informative.As for the food. We of course over ordered: a greek burger, a beef burger and a portobello mushroom salad. Each dish really seemed to have been created with love and attention to detail. The different tastes of each burger danced off our tongues, and each dish was perfectly balanced.i really didn’t want it to end.So we had coffee & desserts, a coconut ice cream & a brownie. Of course these were both delicious too.The price for all of this was a reasonable 121rm.I really didn’t want to leave and hope to go back again one day.Show less

Author: Sab26ess
Title: Unique place
Review: Love their salad and Burger !! Very unique decor and lovely ambience place. At the Jonker walk area, so you can take a break here while visiting and exploring Melaka.

Author: hailey_232
Title: The most picturesque place to dine in
Review: I just had my lunch with my family here. We love this place so much! The theme of the restaurant was unique which you’ll never experience it from anywhere. I recommend this place if you are looking for somewhere to take a good picture. The service over here, was phenominal! The lady server who assists us was enough to surprise us with her superb service! The only thing was there is no designed parking lot for this restaurant, so it was difficult to find a place to park our car. But overall, We enjoyed dining here! Strongly recommended! But this place isn’t halal please be informed on this for Muslim friends:) Show less

Author: ColSuku
Title: Best Burgers
Review: This place has all sorts of burgers that are succulent and tasty.  The best thing about this place is the setting.  There are so many plants, paintings, antiques and village house setting that is an experience you will surely enjoy.

Author: Maryworld44
Title: Nice place
Review: I love this place, lovely , unique and creative interior design. Nice staff and good food for a reasonable price. Burger really nice

Author: APisME95
Title: Delicious burger
Review: Great burgers, friendly/attentive staff, awesome building/ambiance. I highly recommend Baboon House.

Author: diegoquadrelli
Title: Wonderworld....
Review: Simply amazing... Good food but the most important thing is the hambient... Special and out of time.

Author: sondramac
Title: Highly Recommend
Review: This restaurant and both inviting and delicious. The decor is amazing.  So tastefully done and so peaceful. I would highy recommend it!

Author: LilyC1657
Title: Messy Queuing System
Review: We went there at about 1.30pm and were told to wait till after 2pm for a table so we waited. However, we keep seeing people being seated and we realised something is wrong when a couple with a young kid came in and made a reservation at 2.30pm just coz they didn’t want to sit there and wait. The couple came back and demanded a table at 2.15pm and so we checked with the server and were told we would get a table after the couple. After making some noise, we managed to go in before the couple. A word of advice is to make reservations before going as it can get crowded on weekends.Show less

Author: ArtoMoira
Title: Don't miss it !!
Review: Not too obvious from the outside, stepping in you realize you just made an amazing discovery. In traditional Peranakan building, loads of green, arty decorations, little 'courtyards' and cozy corners. Amazing place that you don't wanna leave for a while. On top of that, super friendly staff and good food.Show less

Author: milienb2016
Title: Amazing place
Review: A must see. Delicious food and wonderful atmosphere with character in spades. A really charming place.

Author: megoush95Luxembourg
Title: Great ambiance & good food
Review: If you’re looking for a nice place to grab a burger/coffee/juice then this is the right place! The interior design is the best part of this place. Super cosy, perfect to just sit down and read a book (they have a little library as well). The waitresses are super friendly! The backyard looks like a tropical garden with a table and some chairs for smokers. Would live here if I could. Show less

Author: pelalentedalu
Title: Delicious burguer
Review: The place is a bit hidden, I almost could find it but once you’re in it seems you’re in another place. Very particular and with a good environment. The burger was delicious.

Author: Terry SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Outstanding
Review: This eclectic restaurant serves up delicious burgers and an array of thirst quenching drinks. The service comes courtesy of a young, vibrant team who give the appearance of loving what they do. Whilst there are plenty of reasons to visit Melaka, dining in this beautiful space is as good as any!Show less

Author: Melchua523
Title: Serve excellent burgers
Review:
Love the environment n staffs are very friendly, they make their own patties n it's really taste good 
😋😋

Author: JalanjLNCARIMAKAN
Title: Holiday
Review: It was our second visits in the restaurant. Unfortunately the experiences that me & friends had were really bad. Jeremy who happens is the manager was very rude. Disrespect customer by showing attitude towards us. However, staff , Manju was very friendly and apologies on behalf of his mama her despite she was part-timer there. The manager did not apologise and continued to show his attitude towards others and his staff too. It shown how unprofessional he was.Show less

Author: Gökçe D
Title: Great coffee break
Review: Lovely decoration, very friendly and helpful staff. Coconut brownie and iced Malacca coffee were a good duo, both tasty. Great for a coffee break while exploring Malacca.

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: A Malacca highlight
Review: If you want to experience some classic Malaysian architecture, shop-house design, relaxed atmosphere and some pretty good food then The Baboon House is for you.We stumbled onto this gem after seeing people walking out the slightly obscured entrance, what a place, it's full of history and style.They seem to just do hamburgers and drinks, but don't let that put you off, it's worth the visit even just for a drink.Show less

Author: FarAway526803
Title: Mr & Mrs Gold
Review: Great venue with good ambience. Foodwise was delicious. Good value for money! The staff were very friendly and attentive.

Author: linyy29Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best burger place in Melaka!
Review: Best burger place in Melaka! Ventured here in 2018 and since then rated this place as "definitely must bring my friends"! The Baboon House opens from 10.00am till 5.00pm, hence it will be ideal to come before the usual lunch or dinner crowd to avoid any long queues. My friends tried the Beef Baboon Special and they loved the beef patties and even ordered second rounds as takeaways. For myself, I still prefer the Pork Belly Baboon Special as the meat is so nicely cooked and flavored. Their home made ginger beer was also a good drink combination with the burgers that we had to order a few rounds of it.The wait for the food was about 15-25 minutes (did not really bother) as we were occupied with taking selfies and group pictures around the restaurant. I do travel to Malacca quite a few times each year and this place is definitely a fantastic place to be at, which is also away from the usual Nonya & Hawker food.Show less

Author: Pupurfei
Title: EXCELLENT PLACE TO CHILL
Review:
Fantastic ambience especially to chill with friends.
The burger bun was soft and pork was juicy and well grilled waiting time approximately 30 mins on weekend.

Author: roadhawg2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing really special
Review: We went there at 12pm, was told to booked our table due to full house. They told us to come back at 3pm!!! Ok, went back at 3pm, still need to wait another 30min for our table. Upon taken our order, waited for another 30min for our food. End up we had our lunch at 4pm.Food qualty and taste wise, nothing really special. Coffee served was luke warm. Price is reasonable but for the long waiting time? Unless you've nothing better to do otherwise spend your valuable time somewhere else.Show less

Author: Sue G
Title: Cafe
Review: A cafe with a difference!! A cool retreat from the heat of the street! We sat amongst the ferns with water misting over us!  The meal was very enjoyable. Homemade ginger beer with lemon was a winner, as was my iced cafe latte!! Thankyou

Author: AlfaJaneMalaysia
Title: Little jungle in a cafe
Review: I am fascinated by the little jungle at the back yard of this cafe. It makes me feel so refreshing. The cafe serves mainly burgers. You can choose meat burgers or vegetarian. There are few types of salad to choose but l like the green salad with porto bello mushroom. There are lots of old decorative items in this cafe as l believe it belongs to the owner. There are old family photos hanging at the living hall. The food tastes good and the service is good too. Prepare to wait for more than 30 mins if you come on weekends.Show less

Author: nicolekathleen94Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great place to relax and have a nice meal and drink
Review: Amazing burger in a beautiful building.I decided to have a Western meal and I was not disappointed. I had the baboon house special and it was very tasty, fresh and not too oily with fresh lemonade. Must try, even if it's for a drink to escape the heat and relax somewhere quiet.Show less

Author: yegameisterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good burgers
Review: Went with family, total 6 of us. I had the Spicy Lamb Burger, solid and amazing, good wedges on the side. Others had the daily special which was a salmon bagel, also a big thumbs up. Pork burger was good. Juices and drinks were good except for the Vietnamese Iced Coffee...if you are used to the real deal, give this one a miss. Desserts were good all around. The summary: best burgers in Malacca!! Service was very efficient, pleasant and friendly. Good value overall.Show less

Author: Wayfarer115Ottawa, Canada
Title: Generous serving & tasty
Review: The burgers were large and tasty. We had the satay burger, which was a thick slab of marinated chicken topped with a thick layer of pineapple relish - delicious. The lemon ginger beer was tangy and bursting with fresh ginger flavour. The restaurant is festooned with plants of all kinds, looked like a tropical jungle and inkeeping with the restaurant name.The line-up to get in was long but moved quickly. The wait staff were energetic and worked hard to provide the best service possible, but be prepared to wait a while for your food.We had an enjoyable meal, and would recommend it to others.Show less

Author: Sandrayng87
Title: Chill atmosphere and great food
Review: Artsy Green place! Love the burgers + homemade lemonade tea. Superb combo! <3 <3 <3 best in Melaka!!

Author: khanwh74
Title: Tranquil Lunch
Review: Had 1 hour to spare after a long boat ride. Had a peaceful lunch at this cafe. Nice burger. Peaceful lunch. Will be back soon.

Author: Passenger03120238543Hartsville, South Carolina
Title: Quirky and good
Review: Walking into this place is like walking into a secret oasis. The main eating area is lit by a skylight and you are welcomed by green vines hanging from the banister of the second floor. They have embraced the old dank building they are in and have decorated it beautifully and eclecticly. It’s oddly nicely temped inside as well. The burger was nothing short of fantastic. Never in my life have I had such a hot (temperature) burger. It was literally raced to my table after being plated. I had the lemongrass and lemon and honey drink and it was sweet with no touch of sour. (Was expecting a little sour). Ended our meal with the brownie and it left a lot to be desired for me. I want to be blasted with chocolate when eating a brownie but this one was more of a coconut cake with a little chocolate and done in the guise of a brownie. It was paired with banana, ice cream, almond slivers and chocolate sauce. Not my favorite desert, but a darn good burger!!!Show less

Author: yiliyuli
Title: Quirky and Mysterious
Review: It's one street down from Jonker Street. They offer really quirky homemade drinks. We only had snacks and they were yummy. There were plenty of odd books available and interesting dark art for you to appreciate. There's nothing better than sitting in a cool Nyonya heritage on a hot summer's day.Show less

Author: steven f
Title: Best burger i ever had!
Review: No joke, it really happens. This is what I call burger. We have tried in the restaurant for pork belly burger, absolutely delicious. Next we took away both chicken burger and beef burger, we finished it during our highway drive, two thumbs up! I will come again, hunger for more...Show less

Author: ahouais
Title: Amazing atmosphere
Review:
Just amazing!! I had the veggy burger and oh my God !! 
The only thing is that the portions were small.

Author: tpLong
Title: Cozy Cafe
Review: Cozy cafe with relaxing feel.  Food taste is nice and staff are friendly too.  In the afternoon might bit hot as the fan not strong enough.

Author: NTS7374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic cafe!
Review: Drove by the cafe many times because it’s along a busy street parallel to Jonker Walk but did not realize it’s there because the entrance is covered with lots of vegetation.But I read many good reviews about the cafe and decided to give it a shot and it turned out to be a great experience!Like many cafes in Melaka, it’s situated in a shophouse but unlike many cafes, the Baboon House kept many parts of the shophouse in its original state. The 2 wells are still functioning; the kitchen set up is just like olden days; the skylight... nothing much is sacrificed for the sake of making more money (by removing such areas and adding tables). Spending some years growing up in a shophouse in the 70s, I can attest to the genuineness of this set up.Food wise, the cafe serves only burgers (at very reasonable prices) as mains. We tried the chicken and the beef burgers and they are all very good.Perhaps the great experience of sitting in an airy space, surrounded by memorabilia from the past 80 years, added to the taste of the food! Service was quick and wait staff was polite. Oh yes... another important point: this cafe is amazingly mosquito-free!Show less

Author: W4270CSangelal
Title: My favourite place for gourmet burgers
Review:
Repeat visit. Highly recommended restaurant for interesting dinning experience.

Cool place to chill out with friends and family. Tasty beef burgers with unique ambience. Friendly service crew.

Author: RuthyTunesAsia
Title: Hidden gem!
Review: We stumbled across this place, tucked behind a load of roadside greenery and were delighted with our discovery!The building has been allowed to gentrify in a tasteful fashion, with artwork displayed around the place and lush green courtyards.The staff were friendly and efficient. Between us we ordered a selection of burgers, salads and homemade soft drinks. All were excellent and freshly prepared.Would recommend a visit here for an interesting alternative to other places in the area.Show less

Author: Rob HCoto de Caza, California
Title: Cool joint
Review: We really didn’t know what to expect when we walked in but this place is very unique. It’s a very old Chinese home converted to a restaurant. There is no air conditioning so it can get muggy but the vibe is very nice. The service was good and the burgers are small but have great flavor. I had the special burger that had pineapple, bacon and cheese on it and was a mess to eat but worth the effort. All in all a very good place to eat and drink with friends. A must stop when in old town.Show less

Author: tryph0820
Title: Quaint place to eat burger and drink beer
Review: Interesting store concept. Relaxing ambiance, green, peaceful and quiet. Food was okay, ordered beef burger and ginger beer.. burger patty was dry, not juicy. I liked the ginger beer. Definitely must visit, not for the food, but bcos its unusually attractive.

Author: FranziskaG335
Title: Amazing "Jungle" Restaurant
Review: Very very original place. Unique decor mixed wish lush jungle overgrowth. Very friendly service and great burgers and smoothies. Highly recommend.

Author: desilvagsingapore
Title: Great For Burgers
Review: Interesting place with antiques items. Tried their Portabella Mushoom and FreshMango Juice. Burger was very tasty and the portion was huge with french fries which came piping hot and if i can say i loved their french fries. Their restaurant setting had an indoor and outdoor seating area filled with lush garden and potted hanging plants. Very interesting place. A place to just chill out with a book and away from the crowds. A must visit place is my opinion. Great staff and a good place for Burger lovers. Try it. Wont regret it. Show less

Author: sidneyslimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Memorable Meal
Review: Stepping into The Baboon House takes you back a few decades into the old Melaka. The restaurant made great use of the long and narrow interiors of the old Peranakan building, as well as the open courtyards and air-wells, to give its customers quite a visual experience. Equally impressive is the food. We had the Baboon Special Aloha Cheeseburger, Baboon Pork Belly Burger and their special homemade concoction of Organic SugarCane+Lime+LemonGrass juice. The burgers were just amazing! Made just right, and served with the most delicious potato wedges. The attentive and polite service capped off an overall awesome and memorable meal. Show less

Author: 520fangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fascinating Ambience
Review: Staffs were super friendly, ambience has a chill vibe to it and a very fascinating theme to it. Food was delicious but the beef burger was a little dry to me as I'm more to the juicy side, however my partner loved the beef burger more than I did and I loved the pork belly burger my partner had.Show less

Author: colin1201Singapore, Singapore
Title: good food, relaxed atmosphere
Review: ordered the lamb and beef burgers which were very rich in flavour.the texture was just right, not too dry.no idea why they gave us ketchup and chili.their wedges were so flavourful we didnt need sauces!the cool relaxed vibe also made it a nice place to chill out with my friendsShow less

Author: Gabriel TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome cafe with great burgers and relaxing atmosphere
Review: Went here for Christmas lunch after reading other reviews. This place does not disappoint and is a must go in anyone's itinerary! The burgers were great and the place was beautiful. I could spend a lazy afternoon admiring the decor. Awesome cafe and friendly staff, if you ever in Malacca be sure to visit this place!Show less

Author: ymLee1991
Title: Quiet place
Review: Food is quite good. Slightly on the higher side. Vegetarian friendly. They do have a cat and dog walking around. Place can be a little dark and quite quiet. Nice place to chill from a hot afternoon

Author: EarthlingJJ
Title: Great food and great drinks
Review: The aloha burger was really tasty and their special homemade lemon grass drink was great as well. Highly recommended. We enjoyed our lunch there.

Author: Jlmtd
Title: Best food
Review:
Great ambience in aquirky old house, with plants, artworks and friendly staff.
Plays good chilling music. Excellent home made food & drinks.
Definitely the best place in Melaka.

Author: The_Traveler010710
Title: Food Was Great But.....
Review:
We waited for an hour for our burgers because there were quite full on the day we came. Luckily the food was excellent!

All burgers that we ordered tasted very delicious, fresh, tender and juicy!

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Must visit
Review: A stunning restaurant and delicious food! There is so much to see in this restaurant - art work, decor, inner courtyards and hidden corners...it's just beautiful. Take a wander to the back through the amazing garden. The food, primarily burgers, is fresh and yummy. I had the spicy lamb burger and it was one of the best burgers I've ever eaten, just wish there was a little more meat to the burger in terms of all the other layers. The potato wedges were great too, wonderfully soft on the inside. Service was friendly and efficient. A definite must visit if you're in Malacca. Show less

Author: Jimmyngcm
Title: Quiet rustic cafe
Review: Nice setup of old rustic Chinese settings. Nice place for a quiet lunch. Antique settings with a lot of greenery. Recommended: Aloha Pork burger

Author: raymondt774
Title: Fantastic Burgers and very nice place
Review: Came to have lunch. Placed was pack but service still good. Place well decorated, heritage look. Food is fantastic. The must try is their burgers, exceptionally good. Price is reasonable. Will go again.

Author: lookplars
Title: Very nice burger with reasonable price
Review:
The restaurant is very nice. We ordered beef burger, pork burger, salad and drinks.
Soooooo delicious🤩

Author: SmileypokeyPenticton, Canada
Title: Great burgers!
Review: Great burgers here. We had the Aloha Beef Burger with pineapple, bacon and veggies. Comes with small amount of fries and salad. Burger too big to bite! Delicious. With 2 burgers, 2 beers and 1 ice tea, cost was 100 MYR. Little pricey for burgers and beer. Restaurant itself is lovely and is located in an old home on old Melaka. Service very nice.Show less

Author: Branavan A
Title: Great food and amazing ambience
Review: Ginger Kombucha and pork belly burger are must try! Great for a lunch or even just a quiet date. Been here thrice already

Author: yeeping87
Title: This is beyond this world
Review: Appeared in many bloggers post! Apparently cost only RM 10 or so. But when I was there, the cheapest burger was RM20! But then, it was worth the wait and every penny! Ordered Pork Belly burger - comes with homemade bun (generous with seeds), cheese and fresh garden vege. It also comes with two sides, wedges and potato salads! The pork belly is the killer (very much like Chinese Char Siew) as the fats just melted in our mouth! Did not regret my visit here. Good ambience and quiet place. Love the food and place. would definitely pay another visit here if I come again! Show less

Author: 879sylvieu
Title: Cool place but no drinks
Review: We came for having a drink in the afternoon. The place is really nice and cool. We asked for their special juices but they had none. They offer me another drink but it was already booked by another customer. We asked for a simple orange juice but don’t have any ! So we decided to leave this nice place.Too bad ! Show less

Author: Zeepbeep
Title: Excellent Breakfast find in Jonkers
Review: Was a Wed, most places closed in Jonkers and was lucky to find this hidden jem. Very nice vibe and atmosphere. Breakfast was excellent and very kid friendly.

Author: tanpeipei
Title: Cosy view and great place!
Review: A cosy and relaxing place filled with lush greenery set against the backdrop of quaint houses dated back to the 17th century.  Great food served here.

Author: KarthikS24
Title: Must go!
Review: I am glad I found this gem at Melaka! Very beautiful restaurant that serves great foods. Only got burger lovers. The waiters was very friendly and provided exceptional service. Definitely will visit again.

Author: Vitran1511
Title: Cozy view and peaceful place
Review: Wonderful zone for someone who would like to enjoy the atmosphere and drink the local and homemade beverages from the shop. I saw a lots of people they had lunch there like burger. Must visit if you are going to Melaka

Author: Patrick SPetaling Jaya
Title: The place that started it all
Review: Call it a cafe or art cafe, maybe the gourmet burger curio place? It doesn't matter, but this is the place to sip coffee or a cool drink when you're exploring the streets. Their renowned for their burgers. One of the best choices in the country. Buy an artwork or just imagine the time how this place used to be in the 40s. Its a cosy and relaxing place indeed. Show less

Author: JUDYLEE2003Kuching, Malaysia
Title: Cafe With Back In Time Setting
Review: This cafe served more burgers and at a starting price of RM20.00 plus, I find it value for money if I am looking for quality. I have not tried the other menu yet. Entering the cafe, you feel like travellin back in time to the 1950's with old photos, settings like all Chinese typical homes of our grandparents.Show less

Author: AlexisS2252Singapore
Title: Amazing burger
Review: I love everything about this place. We ordered the signature pork belly & lamb burger. It was a nicely seasoned patty (if you don't like spices, then maybe not), flavours are good. Good service and the place really looks like a traditional Peranakan house. We nearly missed it as the entrance don't look like a restaurant at all. It's just next to the Courtyard @ Heeren Boutique Hotel.Show less

Author: AnantharajuR
Title: Delicious burger
Review: We took the oriental chicken burger, greek burger and pork belly burger. My favourite out of all is the pork belly burger, pork was done well with beautiful char. Taste really good. Worth trying. Service is excellent too.

Author: doublescore27Singapore, Singapore
Title: Burger fixes
Review: We ordered 2 types of Baboon burgers, beef and pork teriyaki. Both were up to expectationsThe recipes had been tweaked since our previous visit. In addition, to potato wedges, the sides included potato salad, making the meal heavy on carbohydrates.It would have been better to replace the potato salad with more vegetables for a more balanced meal.Show less

Author: pamtjh
Title: Amazing pork belly burger
Review: Tried their signature pork belly burger and it’s was amazing! It was juicy and tender, perfectly chargrilled but not overly burnt. Would definitely recommend to try their burgers.

Author: ravshivaBengaluru, India
Title: Weird and good at it
Review: Unique, quirky, spooky, tasty.. are some of the expletives which can be used to explain this place. Hidden beside the famous Jonkers walk, you would miss it. But I suggest look for it and you will not regret it. Amazing food, unusual ambience and super staff makes this place a must visit. Do taste their homemade gourmet burgers. This one will always be on my list whenever I am in Malacca. Keep it going guys.Show less

Author: justin 2
Title: Very welcoming and relaxing place!
Review: We had a great time there and the atmosphere was very calming and relaxing! The food there was also very nice!

Author: JansenWAHoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Casual lunch break
Review: The hot freshly ground black coffee (without sugar) was smooth and aromatic, one of the best I've had. Those from "The Coffee Bean" and "Starbucks" pale in comparison. Had some "chicken bites" (quite like popcorn chicken) tasted amazing. I must say the quality of food served here pleasantly surprised me. Excellent!!Show less

Author: Vicente8
Title: Cool place for a drink
Review: Antic shop house in Chinatown beautifully kept in its old patina, with warm decoration and lush patios. Coll jazz music not too loud in the background: A perfect place for laid back drinks, friends and romantic talks, quite packed with young urban trendy chaps. The drink list is unusual with a real effort: home-made lemon grass and ginger drinks, beautiful fruit juices… The food is down a peg: It is about burgers and salads in a basic sweet salty fusion style. The baboon special burger is nothing gourmet or exceptional. Its bread is very average and the slice of pineapple on top of the meat has a taste of déjà-vu-can-do-better. Bill was far exaggerated. Fortunately, the home-made chocolate chunky brownie was delicious and service was nice and efficient. Will I come back? For a drink maybe.Show less

Author: amitgoenka20Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great interiors, average dining
Review: After several recommendations from friends, we visited The Baboon House for lunch on a weekend, It had a wait time of over 30 min, and then the food (merely a burger) took another 45 min to be served. The salad was standard - nothing extraordinary about it. Very limited vegetarian options. The staff was pleasant and interiors beautifully decorated. Would recommend visits on weekdays. Show less

Author: YWen19Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Terrible workers
Review: Had to wait 20 minutes in the line and the worker did a mistake and gave the couple who came behind us a table first. After we got our table, they asked if it was okay if we waited another 40 minutes for our food? Could've asked us first when we were still waiting in line. Service is terrible when they have a lot of customers.Show less

Author: Paul NPerth, Australia
Title: Very average
Review: Eclectic style and a great place to sit. BUT (and its bigger than Kim's), the food is very, very average. If these are the best burgers in Malaysia then I strongly suggest you don't eat burgers in Malaysia. More like a slider and nothing gourmet about it. I have had far better burgers for the same price at servos in country WA. Why eat here when you can go to indian area and get a brilliant tandoori set for half the priceShow less

Author: JoeB848Inverloch, Australia
Title: Beautifully Decorated Restaurant
Review: Located in Jalan Tun Tan in the tourist area in Melaka this restaurant offers a vast array of dishes, however, in my opinion the burgers are a speciality. Price are reasonable and the staff are friendly and helpful. The garden setting of this venue is very relaxing. Show less

Author: kohjeslyn
Title: Nice ambience! And nice owner and waitress
Review: Must come if you are first time or many times in Melaka!! superb burgers, nice ambiance and cool peoples!!

Author: Karine V
Title: Secret & very good
Review: I've been eating there, lovely muffins, and very good smoothie.  The place is amazing, so hidden,  and beautiful! (the price is expensive- for the country - even if it's good)

Author: Lucien_LEBry-sur-Marne, France
Title: Best burger in Malaysia
Review: Me and my family had lunch at this restaurant.It is a really old house in town with a stunning decoration. It's like this restaurant is from another time.The staff is really nice and friendly, thank you very much!!And the food is just amazing.We will be back for sure.Show less

Author: wendypunk
Title: Delicious Burgers
Review: I enjoyed the food very much, great service too. This place is very unique with tranquil open-air courtyard and art gallery.

Author: 901stanleyl
Title: Cozy corner
Review:
Second time visited baboon house.
Finally manage to try the lemon glass which is refreshing.

Order both the pork and beef burger w salad and wedges.
Simply delicious.

Price slightly on the high side but the experience and ambience is worth the visit.

Author: MoonByrneManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food and chill vibes!
Review: We really enjoyed our lunch at The Baboon House. The restaurant is super cool, filled with lovely art work and plants. There’s a great atmosphere and the staff were really friendly. The service was excellent, we didn’t have to wait long at all. The food was so so good!! We got a mushroom burger and a hash brown burger and they were both really tasty. The wedges and salad were also really delicious. The fresh lemonade is to die for, we ordered two each they were so refreshing and tasty. I would highly recommend this restaurant in Melaka! Show less

Author: Ngaire B
Title: Delicious!
Review: A lot of options for both vegetarians and meat-eaters. The house-made cider and kombucha was amazing. The burgers were equally delicious. Any where that sells kombucha is going to be a little pricey but worth the splurge!

Author: poetra2018
Title: Food nice but the price IS UNREASONABLE + service charge
Review: I visited Baboon House after read some reviews shown this Burger restaurant is one of the kind. The food is good but not to extend that I will come back for food and price is little too much for such foods and service charge. Overall nice jungle theme environment, good foods, services is just OK except for the food prices is the downfall. I have to give 3 for this.Show less

Author: FootballLover456Melaka, Malaysia
Title: LOUSY SERVICE AND OVERRATED
Review: We have visited Baboon House many times over the past few years, and am totally annoyed of what happened today. We were totally wheeling grandma whom is 91 years old and only needed the staff to open the other door so that the wheelchair will be able to pass through but the staff just ignored us. RUDE STAFF AND LOUSY SERVICE!We won't be back!Show less

Author: Flai64Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Burger Place In Melaka
Review: The Baboon House is certainly the best place to visit if you have enough of nyonya cuisine and have a craving for burgers. My wife and I ordered the beef and lamb burger and it was tasty and juicy. Loved their mashed potatoes and wedges too. Great burgers great ambience, I will return for sure in future trips.Show less

Author: Jim BFort Lauderdale, Florida
Title: An Ambience Unexpected
Review: Yeah, yeah, yeah, the food and service is very good, and the ambience unique. Go there and eat for sure. But what you really want to do is, whether or not you need to use their restroom or not, is to, after you order, take a stroll from your table back to the restroom anyway. It is far in the rear of the building, through a narrow passage way past the kitchen and a number of rooms and areas that will transfer you to another time and place. Just do it!Show less

Author: TheNayzerPhuket, Thailand
Title: Restaurant in Historical building
Review: Baboon house located in the heart of Melaka, parallel street with Jonker walk. I was amazed by how they turned historical building to nice restaurant but still preserving its old charm. I definitely fell in love with the place. Service was fast. Staffs were really welcoming. BUT I was disappointed by the food. The cheese burger was just average. I didn’t like that they put some kind of spice in the meat. Mint ice tea was excellent though. In conclusion, I would come here for the ambient, but surely not for the food. Show less

Author: snworb
Title: Burger Heaven
Review: A total recommendation for the ambience and the burgers. Very friendly and efficient servers. Only disappointment was the fact that some tourists ignore the house rules when it comes to "no photographs please"

Author: Someerr AMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great service, great burger!
Review: Although they were shutting at 6pm, they kindly let us stay and order at 5:55pm & even allowed us to wait for a friend to arrive. I had the Aloha burger and it was big & delicious!! The wedges were a nice alternative to fries for once.Semi-expensive for Asia, but still very cheap for the Western world, so if you’re really craving a burger & can wrangle your budget slightly - I would definitely recommend! Oh! And they have a (very obedient) puppy!!!! Show less

Author: violetmin6
Title: Best Burger in malacca
Review: A must visit cafe when I come to melaka. Good environment, Good foods. Different from most of the cafes in kl.

Author: elvyyyy
Title: Great spot for burgers!
Review: Highly recommend this place; the decor is unique and the atmosphere is relaxing. Great place to chill with friends - loved the pork belly burger it was fantastic! :) will be back again.

Author: Shuying T
Title: Delicious burger
Review: Love their burger. Have a lots of variety of burger. But abit pricy. Nice atmosphere and great staff.

Author: 645pamlWarlingham, United Kingdom
Title: Give it a miss!
Review: This is just about ok if you like burgers and precooked potato wedges. Otherwise, give it a miss!There are plenty of other very nice places to eat in Melaka.The Baboon House has an ambient atmosphere but that is all. The service is not very good, the staff are not particularly friendly and the food is not very good.I explained to the waitress that I am vegan and when the portobello mushroom burger arrived it was smothered in mayonnaise so I returned it. When my meal came back over 10 minutes later (& after my friend had finished her meal), all they had done was to scrape off the mayonnaise & present my meal as freshly cooked. It was disappointing to say the least. No imagination at all & poor service too. Would not recommend. Thumbs down I’m afraid.Show less

Author: Mia FSingapore, Singapore
Title: yummy gourmet burgers in a unique setting
Review: the burger (i had spicy lamb, could have been spicier though) was really good, albeit this is not the best burger i've ever had. price wise isn't ridiculously affordable to make it a "great deal" either. However, i like how the entire setting of the cafe (asian, quaint, vintage) is a huge mismatch from the food they serve (western, burgers). But it's a shame that patrons aren't allowed to take photos in the cafe. But i'm slightly confused though, clearly saw a couple openly walking around and taking photos, even asking the staff to help them take a group shot.Show less

Author: rickp777
Title: Lovely spot for lunch
Review: Quirky ambiance makes for a very nice spot for lunch. Food was great as were the drinks - particularly the lime and sour plum.

Author: anshuman m
Title: Burgers to Die for..
Review: This place is the place for burgers. Not only the burger the ambiance is breath taking.But sadly you cant take any photographs of the beautiful place

Author: artnola
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: I had a delicious cheeseburger in this very cool restaurant.  The decor was very funky and very soothing.  I would definitely recommend this place!

Author: Alex P
Title: DELICIOUS FOOD
Review:
love the burger and environment there~ but the price slightly too high...~
should come out with more variety of food..
food taste good especially the burger...

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: Very interesting place to dine. ..delicious lamb burger!
Review: Came by this place out of curiosity..before entry you have to buzz them and let them know then you'll be allowed to enter..The whole facade and ambience reminds me of pre world era and it's very appealing in a certain Gothic way. ..Menu is very interesting with a whole range of burgers and other delights to chose from and please do try the local Coffee ...Very friendly waiters too. ..best of all you can have a nice quiet meal here. .Show less

Author: FeliciakaurJohor, Malaysia
Title: AMAZING PORK BURGER❤
Review: Its definately a must to try this burger while you are in Melaka. Interiors are great, service is awesome and nothing can beat the Aloha Pork Burger. Also, if you love candles, try buying one of their handmade candles(only cost RM15) handmade by one of the crew sister.I would definately be back again. See you Baboon House❤Show less

Author: Coastal745363
Title: Unique cafe and nice food!
Review: We really love their Aloha cheeseburger with pork belly patty. This place has the most unique interior design and arts. Love it!

Author: Babymuji
Title: Yummy burger joibt
Review: Ordered pork belly burger and thoroughly enjoyed the meal. Food is served quite fast but drinks were a little on the slow side. Especially liked their potato salad! Will come and eat again when I visit Melaka!

Author: tzeeweeiMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice burgers
Review: We've waited quite long time to be served as there were a lot of people when we visited. Anyway, their burgers are really great and I love the wedges the most which are crispy outside and soft inside! Their Teriyaki Pork Chop Burger and Green Salad are worth a try. Will definitely be back again for other food! Show less

Author: 901stanleylSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique place to munch
Review: Finally have the opportunity to visit Baboon house for afternoon munch.We hv ask permission to only take photos on our food orders.Their home make lemon grass drink and most dessert are sold outTried their special pork belly burgers and with rose wine and orange beer.Nice place to dine and relax ...away from the afternoon sunShow less

Author: MWongJP
Title: Wowwwzz
Review:
Inside is just spectacular and takes you to another dimension altogether..
Food is very good.. burgers are excellent and so is the salad!

Author: csteh61Segamat District, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Pork Belly Burger
Review: Finally got to eat there. Have to wait for a while to be sited. The service was good. Order the pork belly burger and it turn out to be very nice. The drink with serai was nice. The ambience is like dinning in an old house. During the time of visit there was a heavy smell of incense. The surprise of it all is the sitting place at the back of the house. It is like in a garden.Show less

Author: Andrea S
Title: Fantastic place-must visit!
Review: One of the most extra ordinary places I saw on our trip. Only for enjoying the ambience you definitively should visit. For me as a vegetarian there's only one thing which doesn't fit: peace, harmony, tranquility and (meat)burgers. There are only 2 or 3 veggie meals, and to be honest, the veggie burger wasn't that spectacular. But the homemade cheese cake was tasty and there's a great variety of (healthy) drinks and desserts, so you might just come and enjoy a piece of cake and a nice drink. And the fantastic ambience!Show less

Author: SarahStuart93Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food arrived super late!
Review: My Boyfriend and i were here almost 2 o'clock (after peak hour) the waitress took our order and we waited for almost an hour. 50 minutes to be exact, the other 2 tables that came after us were served and when we ask if they could check up on the order. They said its beeing prepared at the moment because the kitchen was busy. So we waited again and the food came 20 minutes later.. so all and all we waited an hour and ten minutes just for our burger. By the way it was just one plate of burger. The wedges not warm it was just room temperature to slightly cold. Show less

Author: janeandoko
Title: Unique place
Review: Came here with friends for lunch and feel amaze with the unique theme and decoration inside, which like a jungle.

Author: 107andytKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lime juice packs a great punch
Review: Came here with a group a friends, they set up an area for us. The food was excellent, gorgeous burger. The lime juice was that perfect balance between sour and sweet. Service was top notch, good conversation with the waitress. Beautiful restaurant, Will come back here. Show less

Author: Elyn L
Title: Big portion
Review: Big portion and lovely food. You might have to share the food if you don’t usually eat much, especially girls. By the way, it’s also a nice place to have a gathering.

Author: Charles TSingapore, Singapore
Title: A hard to find but well worth the visit restaurant.
Review: This was a lovely discovery as the ambience is really unique and they unfortunately do not allow photographs. The restaurant offers burgers which are their own recipe and it is delicious !!! We also had the lemongrass drink and the lemon and orange home brewed beer and these were so refreshing. You need to make your way to the Baboon House as it is like walking back into time.Show less

Author: RatpackersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great cafe, a must visit when in Melaka
Review: This cafe specialise in burgers not just for meat eaters but they also offer 3 types of vegetarian burgers. This cafe was recommended by a friend and I highly recommend anyone not to miss Baboon Cafe when you are in Melaka. Four things I love about this cafe.1) No photos allowed inside ( selfie included) which means people are not looking down at their phone from photos taken inside and also of their food. it means people actually savour their food and have a conversation.2) The decor is amazing. An eclectic mix of traditional Straits Chinese furnitures , open courtyards, lots of indoor plants and modern art hung on the wall. We love, love the deco. It is also a shame that they do not allow photos because this place is a haven for photoshoot and Instagramers. However I did asked for permission and took two photos. :) 3) their residence cat Nana. Real chill. Scratch her jaw you get her attention, touch her belly, you get her claws. 4) Amazing food and service. A MUST VISIT when in Melaka. Show less

Author: LawMicahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fabulous Dinning Experience
Review: Been here every time I come to Melaka. Food is v.good, place is quiet because 1 of the rules for dinning here is not to make to much voice. But most important, the price is very reasonable. Keep up the good works and the standards of service and food. Show less

Author: doublescore27Singapore, Singapore
Title: Place for a burger fix
Review: I normally eschew fast food burgers. The burger at Baboon House is different. It is a healthy meal with vegetables and legumes. This was our second visit and we were not disappointed. Do not miss their home made cider either.The place is not conspicuous on the outside. You can walk right past it without noticing. This probably adds to the fun.Show less

Author: GTCSomesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Like the ambient.
Review: I arrived in Malacca on Thursday afternoon and went to Baboon House for lunch. I had a salad (lettuce, with pan-fried tomatoes, cucumber, popcorn chicken, fried beacon, and some toasted bread on top). Won't say it's like amazing, but it's OKayy. I also ordered a small pot of lemongrass tea. Good service.Show less

Author: Yamuna G
Title: YUMMY!
Review: All i have to say tooooo good! Food, Ambiance, Service was excellent! You definitely wont experience it anywhere. One Minus point i felt no photography & video. Otherwise SUPERB

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Western cafe
Review: A western food cafe in a historical peranakan shophouse. It has beautiful airwell with lots of plants n green.   very relaxing and experiential dining experience . The burgers and drinks are great to try. Been there several times and it is always good!

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Best burgers in town
Review: I've returned several times to this restaurant. They work with closed door concept which means you have to ring the bell before entering. If there is no space in side available you'll not able to enter, meaning the diners have a great sense of privacy. The burgers are the best in town and work making a trip for as well as the restaurant is very well decorated. Show less

Author: Trang294Vietnam
Title: A good place to get a drink, read a book and enjoy a lazy day
Review: My local friend took me to Baboon house (located near Jonker street) for lunch but I don’t like burger, so I just order a fresh drink called Ginger Kombucha. I like the design and the quite atmosphere here. We have a group of 5 and sat under well sky, a perfect place for a group. They decorate with a lot of tree make me feel relax in a secret garden. They also have a lot of unique painting. A good place to visit, get some drink and reading book and enjoy lazy dayThey do not allow to take a picture.Show less

Author: Angeline L
Title: Average food and below average drinks
Review: If the many rules are a quid pro quo for fantastic food, i wouldn't mind. But sadly, not the case. No photography, no loud noises (understandable), no joining of tables, max 6 pax (if i rmb correctly) per table. The entrance is locked - guest have to intercom before the staff lets you in. Greasy smell hit us the moment we entered the dingy shophouse. The burgers were averagely good. Starbucks made better iced cappuccino. The iced teas were a terrible waste of money as they were simply tea bags dumped in cold water. The tea leaves cannot infuse in cold water. So basically we were eating average food, received average service, in a very old shophouse. That's it.Show less

Author: Linda DTe Anau, New Zealand
Title: Nice meal and environment
Review: I was looking forward to a nice burger and found The Baboon house on TA. We used google maps to find as the map on here when we checked was wrong. Our meal was nice and staff were attentive, nice surroundings and price wasn't too bad which included our coffees. The restaurant is hidden behind a historical facade. And the burger was good.Show less

Author: SamEng527
Title: Over rated
Review: This was my 3rd time visit. Feel so disappointed. Service was good but the burger is over rated. Sorry to say, I won't be coming back again.

Author: vmco_mnlphManila, Philippines
Title: Not to my liking
Review: Reviews said their burgers are a must try, so I did. Was sorely disappointed. In fact, I enjoyed the side of fries and potato salad morethan the burger itself. The burger had an aftertaste that wasn't to my liking. Still, I appreciated their "no pictures" policy because guests can appreciate the quirky/hipster set up of the place. The decor, however, isn't unique in Melaka (saw lots of places with the similar style) so no regrets if one didn't get to go inside. Show less

Author: Matt SWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: An oasis of calm in Malacca
Review: I had the pleasure of living in Malacca for 3 years, so this review is based on my experiences over the last 3 years, rather than one specific visit.In summary, it is an excellent place to visit, with friendly staff, great food and the opportunity to enjoy the meal with a cold and refreshing beer.The Baboon House serves the best burgers I have had in Asia, even offering those of us with pork withdrawal symptoms the option of a pork burger!The menu is relatively small, and this is a positive point, because what they do - they do well!Being honest, sometimes in Malaysia it is hard to enjoy a peaceful and relaxing meal, but the owners of The Baboon House have solved this issue, with their own rules of no shouting or loud voices, maximum of 6 persons to a table ... all helping to create a tranquil atmosphere to relax. There is also a large bookcase, so there is the added pleasure of being able to read a book while there.The Baboon House is quite easy to miss when looking to find it for the first time, it is a typical Malaccan-Dutch style building - narrow frontage, but stretches back some distance, so there is a surprising amount of room inside.On a practical level, the toilets are safe to use (unlike many other places!).It is definitely worth a visit if you are in Malacca and want a break from noodles and rice!Show less

Author: Pinkydevil
Title: Secluded nice restaurant
Review:
Very nice restaurant, love the pork belly burger! 
However it will be good to spray insect repellent before you go as there are mossies around..
