Must try their cold pressed fruit juice,

Author: jasperjwb
Title: Wonderfully tranquil and stylish place
Review: The Baboon House is a wonderful place, situated in a crumbling shophouse and full of plants and artworks. The coffee and juice we had were great as well - but the best is definitely the location and the atmosphere. You're not allowed to take photos inside - good!Show less

Author: yuhaochen23
Title: Serene environment with lots of great art works
Review: I spent 17 days in Malaysia, and I have the best dining experience in this place. The place initially looks nonsense for me standing in front of the door looking inside because there is no table or seats, only some black and white photographies. But when their friendly staff led us into the courtyard, we are all amazed by its interior: lush ivy climbing on a wall with a beautiful mural behind, and there are a bunch of original paintings hanging in every corner. I remember I order an iced mint tea, and the tea is full of mint leafs, which is quite interesting. Best of all, the baboon house's location is great: near to the renowned Baba And Nyonya House Museum, so please make sure give this restaurant a try.Show less

Author: Pei Yi L
Title: Amazing
Review: Staff service is quite nice and foods are delicious.The address also very near with jonker street.cool.It is a very special place.

Author: ThomboyRome, Italy
Title: Nice burger & fresh fruit juice
Review: Let's admit it, this is not an excellent Michelin restaurant. I had better burger in other part of the world. But, the burger was descent considering it is located in Melaka, and fruit juice was fresh and nice. Most importantly, the traditional building is worth to visit while one is in Melaka. So, recommendable! Show less

Author: Denis W
Title: Food heaven
Review: We had the aloha burgers and brownies. It was really delicious. Maybe I would change a salad bec we got a potato salad and this combination (a burger, chips, potato salad) I find quite heavy. And finally, the space is amazing! True atmosphere and really great feelings from this architecture.Show less

Author: tawjanp
Title: Very beautiful place
Review: A very lovely place with good food and beverage. Burger and waffle may not be the best that i ever have but when it combine with the beauty of the place. This cafe is the 'Must' for Melaka.

Author: jnf9Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience, good Service, decent food
Review: Came here for lunch with high expectation after reading blogs about it. Ambience was good, service was attentive. Food wise, we ordered beef burgers and salad. The burgers were decent, but we find the patty a little bland. It is a nice place to chill though Show less

Author: Thalassophile76Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: a must visit place around jonker walk
Review: I love this place, its ambiance, its rustic shabby interior, the coffee, the red date and longan juice, the cake, everything about this place is extraordinary, they put a misterious concept starting from the entrance door, funny you have to ring a bell to just enter this cafe, in a second I enter this place my eyes were adjusting very contrast of bright shining sun outside and shady inside, no picture allowed but I broke the rule LOL, definitely one of the must visit eating place (or just relax and chill inside) while in Melaka, simply walk around jonker street and you'll find it for its eccentric facadeShow less

Author: smatth31
Title: Wakatepe Baboon !
Review:
Stuming Colonial house. Menu very simple, only burgers and 2 salad. 
Backpacker style. The juice of the day was amazing, and the burger was great. Just too much spice in the meat for my taste.
Waiter friendly
Nice Place !

Author: katenichollsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dreamy spot for food, coffee or juice.
Review: The decor within The Baboon House is amazing with lots of plants and quirky furniture (it's a shame you cannot take photos). We enjoyed our breakfast there but the burgers on the menu also looked great. The ambience is very relaxed, you feel like you could stay all day with a good book. The staff were friendly and efficient. A little gem within Melaka.Show less

Author: mychngPenang
Title: Great waffles - no photography
Review: To be honest, what compelled me try the food there was the fact that no photography is allowed. It made me curious about the decoration. Additionally, the hot and humid weather also acted as a 'push' for me to walk in to enjoy some dessert and the air-conditioning. I didn't order the burger since I just wanted something light, so I settled for the summerific waffles. Yes, the waffles were fantastic. But still, I wish my friends could've seen the product.Show less

Author: JOSETEN99Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great burgers but pricy drinks
Review: Burgers were a delight as usual. Had a teriyaki burger and a lemongrass juice made fresh in the house. Teriyaki burger was worth the price for RM19. Lemongrass drink is delicious but I wished the portion was more since it's RM9, it only adds up to one and a half glass. The portion for the side dishes however could be bigger, it decreased in size since the last time I came but I was told the reduction in size is due to wastage of food. Perhaps waiters could ask for customer preference as some people prefer bigger size to fill bigger tummies ! Overall everything was good. Show less

Author: ParisParis01Paris, France
Title: beautiful spot !
Review: It was so hot in Malacca and we were so hungry, that we stopped by this restaurant by chance. And WAhouu what an amazing place. It is a beautiful arty, green, trendy spot ! I loved the home made drinks. The graphics, the garden, the intimate tables etc etc It is a shame that I ended up eating a burger although it was really good ! I had a bbqprok with honey burger and i do admit is was really good. I just wish they had other food then burgers and there were more salad & fries on the side.other then that the place is a must stop for a drink wonder !Show less

Author: Thomas606Singapore, Singapore
Title: Western Cuisine in Melaka
Review: The restaurant is resided in an old shophouse. The signature burgers they served were amazing. You must also try their homemade concoction drinks. You cannot take any photographs of the restaurant as the owner of the shophouse still resides there. You can use your camera to take photographs of your orders! Give the place a try...for the food, the name of the restaurant and the ambience！ Show less

Author: cortanawilson
Title: different
Review: Came for lunch based on the name of the place, the food was good, the drinks were cold and the staff were friendly.

Author: alicia l
Title: Hidden long house w nice unique decoration
Review: They always hv special homemade drink such as kefir or ginger kombucha or wine and etc.. unique and I like homemade very much for drink or foods.

Author: Geraldine S
Title: Run out of pork and beef :(
Review: They ran out of pork and beef, guess what was left for a burger. We end up ordering ;Portobello Burger - could be betterLamb Burger - goodOriental Chicken Burger - chicken tasteless Their in house homemade orange lemon beer was really good. Ginger kombucha is good too. Show less

Author: Jessietlh
Title: Just Satisfactory
Review: Don't even think, if you like taking as you dine here. Signs at the door clearly informs you that photo taking is not welcomed.

Author: stefwong88
Title: Nice cafe with good food
Review: Went to Baboon House today for lunch after reading their good reviews. Well, no regrets as food was good & staffs were friendly. Love the ambience.

Author: Gene CJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good burgers & juices
Review: I've known about Baboon House for a while but never got there, due to not putting a high priority to go there as there's just so many food options in the area. However this time around, while planning to head to one of the famous Kopitiams near Masjid Kapitan Keling, which was apparently closed for a few days, I recalled the recommendation of a friendly local Malaccan man from the night before who was recommending that we try the handmade burgers at Baboon house, so that's where my friend and I ended up at. My friend had the signature Baboon beef burger (they actually let you choose if you want a beef/chicken or pork patty) and I had the pork belly burger. Both were nicely done, and no complaints there. Topped off with an iced Earl grey tea & a lemonade. Still feeling abit parched from the Malaccan heat, we ordered one of their cold pressed juices, water melon, pineapple with mint if I recall, was refreshing but personally would have preferred if it was served colder, but that might be a tall order as the juices were freshly made to order. The charm of this place is that it's a very laid back vibe with art and decor in the house. They even have a selection of books and reading material so you can just relax and take in the ambience while enjoying a read. They are quite particular about no photography inside, not sure if its part of their approach to preserve the mystique of what's the inside of the place? They even have signs stating that the Baboon House is a art restoration in progress (IIRC).Don't let the locked gate up front fool you into thinking they might be closed, the staff will buzz you in when you press the bell. Show less

Author: fvdp
Title: Love the ambience!
Review: The place has a lovely vibe and I could sit there having a delicious juice and just reading a book (comfy chairs would help though)! The burger was ok, have had better but the service is great!

Author: ron255100Newcastle, Australia
Title: This is a must
Review: This is the second time I've visited here. Once again I wasn't disappointed. Best hamburgers in Malaysia. What is even more impressive is the decor and the atmosphere. A peaceful sanctuary to enjoy your meal which is so different andEnjoyable to other cafes which are normally quite noisy. Attentive staff makes for an enjoyable experience.Highly recommendedShow less

Author: SanyaL82

Review: Forget about your "Camera Eat First" when you dine in here, And just enjoy the whole artsy environment. Had their Aloha Pork Belly burger which never let us down. The meat was very juicy and tender, well marinated and perfectly cook. It should crowned the best Gourmet burger in Melaka and it was never too over.Show less

Author: Anthony P
Title: Come back doe the burger and still as good
Review: I ate the beef burger and my friend got the pork belly. Mine was really tasty. My friend said his really good too, a bit on the sweet end.

Author: Bobtyth
Title: Just amazing
Review: Best burgers ever.  Good line of drinks.  Cool surroundings.  Loved the whole experience.  You will not be disappointed.

Author: SingaSwissSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good burgers in an interesting setting
Review: The house is quite nice and it has lot of interesting art and decoration - it's a very hipster place. The burgers , to be honest, for a place that is rated on this website as the best burgers in Malacca, are indeed very good (but not extraordinary). The whole "no pictures inside the house because a shaman lives here" thing is also a bit over the top, especially since people are still taking pics inside. It's still a great place to enjoy a good burger in a relaxed setting.Show less

Author: 498claracMalaysia
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Food was good, I had ordered the pork belly burger according to the waitress recommendation, with cold pressed juice (mix flavour of two, watermelon with another 1 fruit​ which I forgot), my fren order chicken mustard burger with another cold pressed juice (orange with carrot), both of our orders were really good. It's so so so delicious! I like the cheese layer that they put in my burger with 2 layer if pork belly!The only down side is you can't take photo in the restaurant maybe they wanted to keep as a mysterious place for you to come over and explore yourself plus there's full with artistic masterpieces​ around the long restaurant.I enjoy their food and ambience, very relaxing, I would give a thumb up and hope they maintain their quality Show less

Author: LucMa83Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing!
Review: Simply one of the best place I have ever been!The atmosphere that surrounds you leaves you ecstatic. We had a few special drinks they offer, most of them very natural and made on spot. The place hosts many pieces of art and paintings from local artists and offers a very inspiring mood.Show less

Author: Joanna SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful
Review: Recommended this place by friends and it was a real treat. A bank holiday weekend so Melaka was buzzing, this place was a real oasis. Quirky too, love having to ring on the door to be let in. We waited about 20 minutes for a table. The house is beautiful. Be sure to visit the toilets right at the back through kitchen and garden, then you get to see it all. The burgers were yummy and the juices were fresh and delicious. Service was great. Just a brilliant place to have yummy food and relax.Show less

Author: lw1959Wallaroo, Australia
Title: Unique special little place
Review: This place is very unique & we loved it. Loved the way you have to ring the bell for the staff to come & let you in. Interesting art works and it all works so well together with the atmosphere and food. Food was great, mostly burgers but well made & well presented. Drinks were great too with an unusual take on a few originals. Very relaxing, chill place & we aren't very young anymore lol. Definitely recommend a visit. Wish they were open for dinner too.Show less

Author: sw9285Kotte, Sri Lanka
Title: Amazing atmosphere and scrumptious burgers!!
Review: After reading the amazing reviews of this place and hearing stories from my friends, I made it a point to visit here during my last trip Melaka. I have to say, The Baboon House truly exceeded my expectations, it is a pity however that you are not allowed to click pictures inside the house. Everything about the place and the environment inside the house is quite unique, you have many replicas and artifacts relating to local culture, along with many cool aquariums with a variety of fish. The atmosphere just naturally gives you peace of mind and good calm vibes. This combined with their mouth watering, yummy burgers and variety of tasty beverages, make The Baboon House one of my top "GO TO" places in Melaka!Show less

Author: YX_657Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Every nice
Review: I went over for a brunch/ lunch type thing. Burgers are all day. I had the regular beef burger with added bacon. Along with the burger they have potato wedges and the salad of the day which was a potato salad. I had a lemonade which was freshly made. I asked for less sugar so it was a little by sour. The total was 117. A portobello burger (add bacon), pork belly burger (add egg) and a regular beef burger (add bacon). Along with an iced lemon tea, lemonade, adffogato and a smoothie. Please be aware that they don't take a party above 6 and no pictures. You have to press a bell to get in. It looks like their closed but take a closer look. Show less

Author: jschwa1
Title: Excellent quirky cafe
Review:
This cafe is as much an art gallery as a cafe - a shame they do not allow you to take pictures.
Excellent and well priced drinks with a pleasant and relaxing atmosphere.

Author: 281srtac
Title: My favourite!
Review: This place is soo pretty! A very nicely decorated cafe with great burgers and good service. My favourite in Malacca

Author: Camberleyannie
Title: Lovely place to be
Review: We had a nice light lunch here and particularly enjoyed the surroundings. You feel as though you are in the jungle. Unique!

Author: Ella S
Title: Wish we had money to eat here
Review: Although it is not too expensive, it Is out of our price range unfortunately. The place is awesome and you could spend all day chilling there. We both had coffees which were really good and Sat and enjoyed the aesthetics. Also eyeballing other people's food as it looks amazing haha. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: Me JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing!
Review: We didn't schedule to go to the Baboon House because the food is Western, and we like to explore local cuisine when travelling. Luckily, we discovered this place - it's absolutely and crazily magic. Grab a book, or your pen and paper and get inspired, or just sit and look around. Food and drinks are good, too - only minus is the limited opening hours.Show less

Author: StarStevensFamily
Title: Cool little spot
Review: A great little spot to have lunch. Small limited menu of mostly burgers but what they do they do really well. Great atmosphere and nice friendly staff.

Author: AlexandraM1827Bucharest, Romania
Title: Must goooo
Review: We found this place by mistake as our hotel was quite close...I was so pleasantly surprised: aquariums, little gardens and a lot of plants and books... Great decoration overall. Friendly staff, very tasty burgers and home-made drinks. The only bad thing is that one cannot take any pics :( Close to the Heritage Museum that is also a must see. Highly recommended, one of the most unique places I have ever been!Show less

Author: lancelotcymHong Kong, China
Title: Cafe with Unique Decoration & Great Food
Review: GOOD- The decoration is very unique, a bit quirky and contradictive (in a good way) , lots of old books and lively plants- I ordered a chicken burger, beer and hand made honey wine, the burger is super yummy as well as the honey wine- It is reconstructed from an old Chinese mansion, full of Chinese historyBAD- The price relatively high in Malacca and definitely worthy- You will need to press the bell in front of the door to get inShow less

Author: Trevor LWarana, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere and food
Review: My wife and I had breakfast at The Baboon House, and your immediate impression is walking into somewhere exclusive, where you are treated as a VIP. Entry is by pressing a door bell, whereby you are either escorted inside or told they are full. You are not on show to passing pedestrians as you dine in a shabby-chic environment that makes you feel relaxed and comfortableShow less

Author: BMNK65Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great burgers and refreshing homemade drinks
Review: Quaint place - you have to be let in by pressing a buzzer. Can see why they lock the front gates - the inside is a display of sculptures to paintings. Some of them look to be made from recycled wood and metal pieces. The front portion of the house is fairly dark and has a sculpture which my daughter described as an Egyptian mummy. However, past this and the place opens up to a bright, cool and cosy backyard with a light well. They specialise in burgers - each burger patty is hand made and well seasoned. I had the spicy lamb burger - amazingly good. My daughter was surprised i woofed it down even before she got going on hers. The burgers were let down by the commercial grade potato wedges. I also had the refreshing home brewed lemongrass drink - not too sweet, nicely chilled to beat the heat of the midday Malacca sun. I am so inspired by the burgers, i am going to get the bbq grill out this weekend.Show less

Author: nataliasZ8112JESingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome dining experience
Review: Few times we've been here and it never failed us. Tried their aloha burgers with all types of meat, Pork belly, Pork chop, lamb and beef. Our favorite is the pork chop. Suitable for children too because the meat is not spicy.Price is a bit ex, but it's worth the money...Show less

Author: sylalim
Title: Yummy Burger
Review: The portion of the burger is large and the patty is of a good proportion. The homemade sauce is nice and homemade lemongrass drink is good and not too sweet too. Go for the highly recommended Aloha Burger, u won't regret. The downside is no photography is allowed inside the Baboon House which I dun understand why. Otherwise is a good place to chill and dine.Show less

Author: grayinasia
Title: Cool chilled out place
Review: Lovely restaurant, good food and drinks, great building restored sympathetically with interesting art and decor

Author: HappyCowBelle
Title: Homemade burger
Review: Good place for dining. very private and no outside food allowed. NO photo. Food always serve with fresh ingrediants and nice smell. Non halal food.

Author: thesamuelwongMalaysia
Title: Not friendly
Review: Poor level of communication, unfriendly and did not allow us in, spoke through the bars and made us seem like we have to beg them for access but allowed Caucasian in while we were turned down. It's disappointing as we had more people and was eager visitors. No long anymore.Show less

Author: R6896IFsuebOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Just up the road from Baba Nyona Heritage Museum
Review: Google maps was sending me one place and TA another, The Baboon House is less than 5 minutes walk from the Heritage Museum.Resisted the temptation of a burger, everyone around me had one and they looked good. Opted for the sausage and rainbow salad, though removing onions and peppers, I left the replacement items to my server / chef. They substituted with green apple and red cabbage. It was awesome! Topped off with a sugar free lime and sour plum juice. Really, really good. The place itself is like a museum so you can't take pictures of the decor, which is amazing but here's a picture of my lunch. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: yuliyat2013
Title: Must visit
Review: This place will stay in your memory for a long time.A very smart idea of design by the person who made it.You really feel in jungle,with a taste of Mexico somewhere.Super place for lost couples,artists and photographers.And food was excellent.

Author: puriris
Title: Nice reprieve from the heat
Review: Nice burgers and good coffee and attentive staff . The surroundings are interesting and the air conditioning is good too

Author: Kevin T
Title: Nice place to have breakfast!
Review:
This place have the best beef burger!!!
The desserts are really nice as well!
The lemon grass drink is a keeper! 
We will be back! :)

Author: TanE247
Title: Best place for burger lovers!
Review:
Their in-house special beef burger was really delicious. 
The lemon grass drink was tasty as well!
We will definitely be back!

Author: Wai Ho L
Title: Very Unique restaurant to chill out
Review: A very bohemian place to visit. Nice burger and drinks. I would recommend this place. A variety of cocktails.

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: It's a keeper
Review: I had to go in here. Looking at the reviews I knew it was probably not going to hurt a bit. I can say in honestly it did NOT hurt. Great old balcony house in the period of the neighborhood. Not all renewed. A bit of a weathered survivor. Being a history buff this was not lost on me. It's legit. I guess one reason you're not supposed to take pictures is there does seem to be quite a few original looking pictures. Art of all sorts. Plus, it's a draw to come someplace with that pressure on it. It's a nice idea. There are two rules spelled out on signs here; and they both knock squarely on the main clientele. Which of course is PRC. No pictures and keep quiet. It was worth a trip just to see that! I had their house special beef burger. It was quite a taste sensation. If you NEEDED ketchup then you must've put it on instinctively before you tried it. If you tried it first and still put it on, you need to stop smoking! Your taste buds have died. There was, in my opinion, one discordant flavor on there. Cucumbers. I like them fine, but raw, they don't play well with others. I pulled them out and all the other flavors and textures kicked in. A Stella and the burger was rm50, so I'll be back to bread and water for a while...Show less

Author: albatross-549Melaka, Malaysia
Title: amazing Burgers!
Review: A very different and sumptuous burger . This joint is hidden away in the lane ,and parking can be a problem . The food finishes off pretty early . The lemon grass drink was yummy ! Overall a good experience in a different type of joint ..Show less

Author: GlobeTrotting805076
Title: Hot burger house
Review:
Very exotic atmosphere from the front gate.
But no photo allowded except for your own meal.
Burger good but quite too much curry flavor, which makes me not eat more than one.
Fantastic Lemongrass drink!!

Author: Happytummyy
Title: Jungle in the middle of Jonker St! Best place to relax!
Review: Revitalize the spirit of true Melaka Hospitality and American culinary passion. The showcase of art pieces, the original baboon interior, the dense garden, the son-bathing turtles and the nice natural environment will make you feel like in the jungle. Best place to relax. But it's pity that photography is strictly not allowed inside the restaurant. Show less

Author: melvina KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth every cent
Review: We were a little skeptical initially about the hype surrounding this place but the hype is well deserved. The burgers we had were amazing, one of the best we've had anywhere. Service was good, plus we enjoyed the peace and quiet. Will definitely stop by on our next trip here.Show less

Author: LuluVancouver_B_C_
Title: Wonderful Atmosphere and Food
Review: A wonderful haven of cool and quiet in Melaka. The food is fabulous with lovely juices. A terrific place for lunch!

Author: kdbkathmanduHobart, Australia
Title: Fabulous respite from the crowds
Review: This place is a hidden gem - ring the bell to be let in, and enter into a beautiful courtyard with plants, good food, good service, chilled drinks including homemade kombucha and Keffir & the house rule of no photos or loud noises. Great spot to relax and recharge - highly recommendShow less

Author: Bhoyritch
Title: Wow. A hidden gem. So glad to enjoy this place.
Review: This place is incredible. Upon arriving to this amazing little gem only to be met with a locked gate and a bell to ring. A minute after someone appears and let's us in. We walk in to the one of the coolest restaurants I have seen worldwide. The natural light, plants and artwork make this place perfect for lunch or snack. The burgers are superior and the special drinks and smoothies are first class. A define must visit on any trip to Melacca and I can't wait to return again. Excellent food at excellent value.THE BABOON HOUSE!!!!! You guys deserve full credit. Amazing.Show less

Author: Lizzy-Loop
Title: LOVED IT!
Review: Dropped in here for delicious made-in house burgers. They were so good we talked about them throughout our travels and tried to make them ourselves when we got home. Really quirky art work/installations inside too but you're not supposed to take pictures. Definitely go!

Author: Mac J
Title: MUST VISIT
Review: Went here with my girlfriend whilst on travels in asia, this was one of if not the best place we ate within our 5 month trip, the place is unique and quirky, the food is delicious as are the drinks, it has a great vibe and atmosphere. The staff are friendly and always smiling, this is why we ended up eating here everyday for the 3 days we were in melaka.It's a must visit if in the city.Show less

Author: spytan
Title: Interesting decor, ok food
Review: Service was reasonable and the food ok though we felt it was on the high side for the type of food offered.

Author: LisaO1868
Title: Best burgers in Malacca
Review: The baboon house is located at the small and quiet side of Jonker Street but do not judge the small and non air conditioned dining place. Their Burger is comparable to a burger you would get in a fine dining restaurant. The burgers patties are filled with the juicy and tender meat that is complimented by a slightly toasted bun. Their seasonal desert (Mango Panna cotta) is a must try as it is YUMMY.I highly recommend this place to any who enjoys a good ol Burger.Review by my son JoelShow less

Author: hanchiny
Title: Food & art
Review: The place is a piece of art itself and dining in an environment with so much greenery and authencity, the food was interestingly tasty!

Author: DivaNathan
Title: Not sure what the fuss is
Review: Nice ambience. Good food. Pity couldn't take photos to show off the ambience. But while my porkchop burger was fine, it wasn't fantastic. Sadly I felt that my usual BK Whopper had more zing.

Author: 398limwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delightful Place for a burger
Review: We had the house special. I totally enjoyed my pork chop burger which was well marinated and came with a slash of bacon, a piece of pineapple, onions, cheese and some great sauce. The visit was a treat for the eyes. It was a museum of sorts but v artistically restored. My son has never been inside such an old Peranakan terrace house was fascinated. The longhouse has a small garden near the washrooms behind with well chosen greenery. Very pleasant and worthwhile. My only complaint is no photographs are allowed.Show less

Author: albertxlIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic burgers with scenic view
Review: Although the our orders took quite some time to serve, it was worth the wait. They don't allow any photography in house which I think is bogus because the view is breath taking in the restaurant, I mean must well make full use of free publicity amiright? Although a little pricey but it's around what typical gourmet burger restaurants would charge.Show less

Author: Wang C
Title: Oasis next to Jonker
Review: Having a good lunch in a well ventilated, cool and dim environment with a whiff of incense. Novel decor of youthful energy. The burger is very nice and affordable at 18-20 ringgit. A very nice detour off the hot Jonker street and also a nice break from getting overloaded with Peranakan food or chicken rice balls. No photos allowed and they close at 5 pm. A true life style joint.Show less

Author: Wayne SPerth, Australia
Title: Good find in Melaka
Review: We were staying next door and wandered in for a coffee. Lovely place and very relaxed atmosphere. Had a browse of the menu and decided to try the burgers as well. Food was good and the staff were lovely. Easy to stay and while away a wet afternoon here.Show less

Author: marcellor613
Title: Great secret sanctuary
Review: You will not spot this place unless you are intended to find it!! Great secret resto with lovely arts and beautiful courtyard seating for your breakfast till dinner. You want something different then this restaurant will value your time and money

Author: 824huangp
Title: Nice Ambience & Food
Review: Simply love the unique decor and ambience, but no photo-taking of the interior though. The burger is excellent too! Will visit again if we come to Melacca next time!

Author: JanGremmen
Title: Loved it
Review: Relaxed atmosphere, excellent food and amazing interior, no photographs allowed. Definitely recommended

Author: Raj09rSydney, Australia
Title: A good escape with great burgers
Review: It's a unique experience with a calm and serene setting where you can eat in the midst of plants. No photos allowed and you can't be too loud as the owner wants an atmosphere where you get away from the hustle and bustle of the life outside. You also need to ring a doorbell to get in so it's never crowded and people can't just walk in and walk around.Can't praise the staff enough. Really friendly and great attitude,The food was great. Not Malaysian but still great burgers. Would definitely recommend a meal there! Thanks for the experience.Show less

Author: thompeyMale
Title: Love it❤️
Review: It is unusual, I like the fact you are not allowed to take photos in here. The burgers were just OK they could have done better. Lovely people but lack of friendly approach rather they have a silent and quite approach which is also ok. Love the arts they have totally unique and make the place so wicked. Overall love the whole experience Show less

Author: coachlesMalaysia
Title: Loads of character, good food.
Review: If you're looking for a 'boutique' restaurant, you've found it in The Baboon House. The first part of the mystery is in finding the place. It's not on the main road of Jonker Street but in a parallel road and it's quite secluded.Secondly you have to ring a bell to gain entrance, and when you do this you sometimes have to wait in lobby which is more like a minimalist art gallery. Then you get in to the main rooms which are full of character and based around an open central atrium, draped with plants. All very atmospheric.The food is very nice, served by attentive staff, but it's the environment you'll probably come back for. Very stylish.Two pieces of advice. Don't go there for dinner, they close at 5 and sometimes before that. If it's raining get there early or be prepared to wait. It seems to be a haunt for people to shelter from the elements making a coffee last for two hours while they do their hipster thing.Show less

Author: SohH62
Title: NIce decoration, burger and brownie
Review: This was my first meal in Malacca as it was just beside the hotel. Was pleasantly surprised by the decorations which was very nice and artistic. Too bad as no photos was allowed. Services was very prompt. We ordered a beef burger, a pork chicken burger, a special baboon desert with brownies, banana and ice cream and also a tropical lemongrass. I would say everything things that we had was nice. The beef is soft, the chicken is cut in thin slices, the lemongrass wasn't too sour and the brownie was unforgettable. The prices are also reasonable. The one thing that I did not give it a perfect rating of 5 was it closes too early.Show less

Author: Pat555
Title: Good atmosphere. Great service
Review: Good burgers at reasonable price. Great service and helpful recommendations on food to try.  Never push for more orders. Atmosphere is pleasant with very interesting decor.

Author: foodandtraveling
Title: Amazing venue
Review: Its a must see burger shop. Very very unique restaurant. Food is fresh and nice. Its a nice burger house if you are in melaka and homesick about burgers.

Author: jia11
Title: Best burgers ever!!
Review: We love the atmosphere and the food. The burgers definitely worth every calories.  Lemongrass drink is refreshing and tasty. Will definitely be back again.

Author: IvanlianSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Food, Quaint Setting
Review: Visited The Baboon House again from my previous trip up to Melaka and they didn't disappoint, food was on point, as before. Finding the place is always a challenge, as it's hidden among the other shop houses that line the streets of Melaka. Getting in to the dining area has a locked gate that only the staff can open is another obstacle. Oh, did I mention about parking? Parking is the biggest challenge yet. although parking spaces line the street, finding an available lot is harder than striking the lottery. Normally, you'll find yourself parked a distance away, and whatever you do, remember to get a parking coupon booklet. It costs 6RM for the entire booklet and 60cents for an hour. Cheaper than a fine you don't want to be paying.The hassle is worth it though, once you sink your teeth into the juicy burgers that The Baboon House serves up. I can still taste it in my mind now, 3 days after eating. Seriously, if you're still contemplating on where your first food stop should be, look no further, this will always be our first stop for food. Show less

Author: Terry BDeal, United Kingdom
Title: An odd place but a good experience
Review: We almost never eat burgers but after two weeks of great Malaysian cuisines we heard from a friend that Baboon was good so we tried it. Bit strange having to ring a bell and wait for someone to open the door but the reception was then friendly. Hd to wait about ten minutes for a table but we were then taken to a pleasant table in a semi-open courtyard. It is a burger joint but there are vegetarian options. We opted for one beef and one lamb burger and tried their ginger beer while we waited. It was so good we ordered two more.The burgers were very good being seasoned well and were very generous in size. So much so that eating them at nearly 2 pm meant that we had no appetite for any supper that evening. They were accompanied by excellent chunky home-made fries which went down well with the tomato and chilli salsas. The service was efficient and friendly. They have a no photography rule for some reason but the cafe hosts art works and is a nice place to spend an hour or so. We think most of the other guests were Singaporean and they all seemed to be enjoying their food. If we visit Melaka again we will probably go back to Baboon. One warning - it is not an easy place to spot and it is on the left hand side of the street as one walks away from the river.Show less

Author: Charlotte B
Title: amazing place, tasty food
Review:
A peacefull atmosphere for an amazing restaurant.
We felt like home with all the plants, cosy tables, aquariums, little gardens...
Great decoration with impressive paintings.
The food (mainly burgers) is tasty, made with fresh products. The home-made drinks are really good!

Author: Richard-Hotel-FoodBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Hipster Melaka Lunch
Review: We went to The Baboon House for lunch, with our 2 year old son. The ambiance and decor is relaxing, arty and trendy (we felt very welcomed and comfortable). They seated us at a table with plenty of space on and around the table so we could park our buggy. The staff were friendly and even told our son about the large fish in the garden he should go and see (as he was enjoying looking at the fish inside). The food was great, very western, but fantastic quality. We ordered the pork belly burger which was AMAZING, the pork and chicken salad which was so tasty and then wedges and chicken for our son, which we both enjoyed too, especially the chicken. Would recommend if you wanted something different to the Asian cuisine, and you wanted super delicious food. Show less

Author: meowleng92
Title: Nice Food and Relax-able environment
Review: Worth to have a try. The parking is limited, be patient and please remember to put parking ticket...

Author: cherlizzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful Art!
Review: I love this place for the art and the sense of tranquility. Pretty therapeutic to chill here. Look out for art pieces on the walls.Burgers tasted good with a touch of spice on the meat patty. Homemade orange beer was very interesting and refreshing.Service staff are prompt and polite. Overall a good experience.Show less

Author: m00lahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy burger secrets hideout
Review: Entering the Baboon House is like Calvin & Hobbes "no girls club" - you arrive and press a doorbell and wait for someone to come to the door before you're allowed in. But it's a quick painless process that just makes the place that little bit more mysterious. The menu is all burgers that include some vegan choices. No photography is allowed in the house but I got permission to take photos of the food. I personally prefer the lamb patty in the Baboon Special which my other half ordered, mine was the beef which was pretty good too. Burgers were very good. Tropical lemongrass drink is refreshing on a hot day but I'd have liked it with more lemongrass. Brownie with bananas and vanilla ice cream was average. The centre of the courtyard has a sliding zinc roof that allows air and light to get in when it's not raining. Show less

Author: snotbotty
Title: THE best burgers!
Review:
Been here a few times and never fails to disappoint. Burgers are amazing. Fresh home cooked ingredients used. Staff are attentive and helpful.
The home made juices are great too.
Would definitely recommend.

Author: 42SandraB42Chicago, Illinois
Title: Yummy Mango Pannacotta & Lemon Grass Drink
Review: Such a nice place. You have to press a bell and wait to be let in which is a bit weird, but the service was fast and friendly, and the food was excellent. The decor was cool - my table had a fish tank inside it! Great place to come for relaxing drink or meal. Show less

Author: Abiiir
Title: Excellent
Review: Lovely food experience if your a fan of burgers. Works like a charm. The interior is really nice and service was good. The atmosphere is relaxed but no way to capture it in a pic as it's forbidden ;)

Author: rachel f
Title: Fun brunch
Review: Good food interesting set up  - the service was really good and the burgers were juicy tender and well made

Author: JenileeRSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best meal in Melaka!
Review: Although it took us a while to find this place, as it is quite hidden in a back street off from Jonker Walk, it was so worthwhile! There are signs to say 'no photos are allowed to be taken inside the restaurant'. However, we managed to take a couple of photos of our food and the surroundings. A must visit when in Melaka! Recommend you definitely add this to your list of places to visit for lunch. The Baboon Special beef burger and wedges was excellent, as well as the homemade ginger beer! Good quality meat and a little spice.Show less

Author: annemacasinagQuezon City, Philippines
Title: Detachment from the World
Review: Upon entering Baboon, you will be greeted by a signage that no photos are allowed to be taken inside the restaurant. Only food ordered are allowed to get a snap. If you wanted a place to detach yourself from the busy streets of Melaka, then Baboon is the place for you. Guests are not allowed to talk loud, act rowdy, take photos. They want the solemnity of the place to be preserved. MUST VISIT! Show less

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Good yummy burguer and nice decoration
Review: Very good place. All is nice there. Friendly staff. Yummy burguer nice decoration and artist ambient.The place is very comfortable. We order the special house burguer with grill pineapple and the teriyaki burguer very tasty and nice and about drinks the sour_plum is very refreshing.This is a place for have a very nice lunch time. We will come back very offen...im sureShow less

Author: 207aur_lienm
Title: Best home made burgers in Malacca
Review:
Best home made burgers in Malacca.
The meat inside is very fresh and delicious 

They have also great home made pineapple and ginger beers.

Author: Vivian_SYS
Title: Awesome burger
Review: Burger was good but the waiting time is killing. If you do not like to queue, you may just forget about this place.

Author: Aimee AManila
Title: Once Is Enough
Review: This restaurant was right next to our hotel so we decided to try it after a long morning walk. The main door is normally closed, and you have to press the doorbell to get in. The entrance is rather dark and no picture taking is allowed that these give an eerie feel to the place. There are artworks inside that the owner probably do not want photographed. There is also a bit of landscaping and some old furnishings combined with modern ones which give the place an average look.The food fare is mainly burgers. We ordered the set meal with salad and potato wedges. We detected a bit of Nyonya spice in the burger which made us enjoy our burger less. The potato wedges were good and so were the fresh fruit drinks. A visit though to this resto once is good enough. Show less

Author: FeeyonaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So so only
Review: My husband and I ordered the pork belly burger and chicken burger for breakfast this morning. Not very impressive. The pork belly is wayyyy to fat for our liking bcoz of its meat portion which was only 10% our of the whole piece. Although the interior designing was not bad but ambience may not be suitable due to the Chinese joss sticks/ incense burning. We found it rather difficult to breathe due to the smell. We were also not allowed to take photos due to its so called exclusivity but I personally don't see why the management should impose such a restriction. This can be quite a turn off to some I reckon. Show less

Author: filippol77
Title: Good experience
Review: My impression of the place was excellent. Food amazing. The only thing that really bothered me is that writers kept running. This puts the customer is a state of rush, which is not nice. Customers can wait for 10 or 15 minutes longer because the place is beautiful. It would be a nice wait!Show less

Author: WinnieX_12
Title: Nice ambience
Review:
Great place to hang out but no photography allowed hence no pics to share. Max 6 pax a table. It seemed like there's many T&c. 

Pork belly burger is yummy!

Author: shemin61Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unique food & drinks! Nice décor!
Review: Nice artsy café that serves unique burgers and drinks. We had pineapple beer! The burgers were yummy and juicy. It’s a cozy artsy and vintage café décor with loads of plants. Price wise, its mid-range, not too expensive.Strict house rules of no photography. Note that you are not allowed to take photos of the interior and of people. I had asked if we could take photos of the food (it was allowed). But no photos allowed of my partner and I with the food. I’m still wondering why there was such a rule, I guess they don’t want tourist to come into the place to just take photos and not order any thing? Not sure why.Show less

Author: jackiech0ng
Title: Short visit to melaka
Review: Environment very cosy with special artistic designs. Food average not that great. Serve special juices. Will recommend for a visit

Author: kumar8a
Title: Baboon House Visit
Review: This place never disappoints me. Its been some time since my last visit but the quality & charm remains the same. Love the ambience and the laid back vive in this place...a definite place to visit whenever your in Melaka

Author: adeline8899
Title: Nice food and environment
Review: The burgers and salads were awesome! Nice place to cheer with friends! Strictly no photo except on food and drinks~ Always full house and kitchen close at 5pm.😊

Author: julia_cayat_phils
Title: Good food, great ambience
Review:
Located near Jonker walk, it's a great place to rest as it is peaceful. 
Food tastes amazing and staff are friendly.
Ask the staff for recommendations and you won't regret.

Author: dramanbhonsleMumbai, India
Title: Burgers for kings!
Review: This was our first official meal in Melaka & man were we blown away by the quality of the burgers. The meat was crisp yet juicy on the inside (especially the Beef & lamb iterations) & the buns were the perfect combination of firm yet fluffy. There's no dignified way to munch on a burger so we dug in with our hands. The potato wedges sides are among the best I have ever had (And I have had many)! Crackling on the outside & almost molten on the inside. Potato has never tasted so good. The egg salad that comes with the burger was the perfect accompaniment as well. It's amazing how all the flavours worked so beautifully together. The more I think about The Baboon House, the more I begin to wonder when I will have the opportunity to go to Melaka just for these beautiful gourmet burgers. Everything about this place was so well preserved & thought out. It's the perfect balance of rustic & hip. The place opens at 10:30am and shuts at 5:00pm so you should probably get there by 4pm latest. The Baboon House is also an art space set among a beautiful bungalow with some of the most amazing gardening work I have ever seen in a restaurant. Make sure you walk all the way to the toilet as well to see their back garden past the kitchen. It's so so so bohemian & dreamy. Make sure you ring the doorbell to gain entry (part of its exclusive charm). Be prepared to wait if you reach in the morning for breakfast. We went to the Calanthe Art Cafe for a quick cuppa while we were requested to return in 30 minutes. Their house rules prevent photography & you begin to understand why that would go against the ethos of this charming & quiet place where you can dig into one of their super duper daily specials & unique homemade drinks (the ginger beer, orange beer, lemongrass cooler & honey wine were to die for especially in the hot weather). Any burger that you have here will be exceptional. Even the vegetarians are catered to if that's a concern. Make sure you go here if you're in Melaka for an enthralling culinary experience difficult to replicate in a big city. You'll have a tough time not returning to this place. It's that that that that that good!Show less

Author: CarlosCazorlaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Most charming place
Review: As you enter, it seems quite secretive. You have to ring the bell and wait as you peep through the bars to try to see the inside. Photos are not allowed inside, which adds some mystery. I loved the decoration and the mixture of plants and furniture. A great place to visit. We just had some homemade drinks. A fair range of food and beverages are available. It opens from 10am to 5pm. It can get busy but it is still relaxing and has a great atmosphere. I would say it has been the highlight of our trip to MelakaShow less

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Environment
Review: What I like this place most is..no noise, we can have food in very peaceful manner ....staff are friendly and the burgers are good. Clean. The owner do restrict the amount of customer so that the noise level is kept to minimum. You can simply sit down and admire the man made beauty.Various drink and limited brand of beer available.Show less

Author: carimakanman
Title: The Baboon House
Review: nice food and relatively inexpensive. The signature food is it's burger. Wow !  talking about it, makes me hungry.

Author: Rennie L
Title: Amazing experience
Review: I ordered a portobello burger and a ginger beer. The food was just okay, and the beer is unique. It has a great environment to chill. Would definitely come here again.

Author: dearjenniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pleasant experience!
Review: The main different of this place from the other cafe's is that they have a very beautiful, pleasant old house and nature view, but not really a good place to sit and dine - it can't be improved though. The atmosphere was quite relaxing as well, despite the place do not have aircon installed. The main thing here are the foods was great and very authentic. It has been something I'm looking for in a cafe unfortunately it is very hard to come by in Kuala Lumpur which the cafe over here are mostly with great ambiance and atmosphere but served bad quality of foods and can be really overpriced/overrated. The Baboon House certainly not a bad choice for a great dine in! Will I go back? Definitely!Show less

Author: smallhun b
Title: Nature escape
Review: Mixture of mother nature green plants + baba Culture home ambient + Europe classic music + asian hot weather~ special drink orange / pineapple / Ginger beer not bad~ new taste!

Author: Fuwa CKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Great art gallery cafe
Review: They served burgers only. Vegetarian burger is available too. Food is average but affordable and fast food serving. Non-halal. Accept cash & cc. Reservation is needed if u plan to go during lunch time. Walk-in is welcomed but have to wait 30min top, which is fine for me as we visited Nyonya house across the street to fill the time. Max seat per table is 6 pax. Strictly no photo inside the Baboon House except pic of ur food. Owner is a great artist. Every art u see in the house was drawn by him. An animal lover(especially dog, elephant, monkey). If u have extra time, you may walk around and you will notice there's some animal skull for decoration, beautiful fish tank, weird animal drawing (human head with dog body), elephant legs (not sure if it's real), books (especially Buddhist) and lots of plant. Show less

Author: catherine_lan_weiziSingapore, Singapore
Title: A different world from the outside..
Review: I adore the set-up of this cafe! I like the fact that we had to ring a bell in order to get into the cafe. Stepping into the house was like entering a different world altogether. I enjoy the interior design of the house together with the many artsy wall paintings. They also had a small bookshelf. I loved the idea of grabbing a book of the shelf with a nice cup of coffee, passing time in this corner of Malacca, away from the crowd. I respect the idea of no photography in the house, because it makes me want to return to it again to enjoy the place. My partner and I ordered a burger and salad, both of which were delectable and unforgettable!Show less

Author: Travellingeverymonth
Title: Great taste of nonya
Review: We had dinner there and ordered their house specialty "nut curry chicken" which had a unique and authentic taste. My husband wasnt quite so keen on it so it is defnitely an acquired taste. Good food overall. Slightly pricy but tasty.

Author: samanthas792Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice setting to chill out!
Review: A nice greenery set up to enjoy quietness. Had a homemade lemongrass honey lemon drink which is very refreshing. Didn't manage to try the food as i was very full after breakfast. This cafe has a no photography rule. However i don't understand what a big fuss of patrons taking photos in the cafe. This is just so common nowadays where people & friends meet and would like to keep a memory the places visited. The set up of the cafe is just normal nothing phenomenon. Anyone would & could duplicate the concept of the cafe without referring to any pictures. Show less

Author: BenjaminBreegKent
Title: What a setting! Loved it!
Review: Heritage building, easy to walk past without noticing... But once inside. Wow. Like stepping back in time. Good drinks menu - mostly soft drinks - and a selection of burgers. House rules on the door ensure quietness and selfies are banned! Hallelujah. Best eatery in Malacca - the opposite experience of Hard Rock Cafe! Show less

Author: May_MalekVancouver, Canada
Title: Unique restaurant with an amazing atmosphere and food
Review: This place is a must in Melaka, so make sure you give it a try before leaving the city.We tried the burger and the salmon pasta and both were amazing, and the staffs were super nice.It's like eating in a Forrest full of art for couple of hours. Their aquarium-like tables and unique art are just adorable.Show less

Author: Kevin T
Title: Great place to enjoy the ambient!
Review: I like the lay back and green ambient here.  Good place to have a drink or meal after walk around in Jonker street.  The pork chop signature Burger is really delicious.  If you can drink wine,  must try their home made honey wine.

Author: lengying
Title: Good burger! Limited seats though!
Review: The ambience is very nice! It's green....nice music.....relaxing mood going on....their aloha burger (we choose pork chop) is super delicious! Worth trying! Price is affordable!

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Zen burger-eating mode
Review: Yes, we’ve seen about every permutation of burgers by this point. The Baboon House is an unsung hero in a world of overstuffed and overpriced burgers.Inside is a space that more closely resembles a dense garden than a restaurant. Beaten up wooden tables and chairs punctuate grubby shelves and art-strewn walls in a nice natural lush tropical environment.The basic menu is short, to-the-point and has possibly the best burger readily available to most Malaccans. Baboon special aloha cheeseburger is a delightful assault on the senses. The homemade bun is perfectly soft. The juicy baboon beef patty is thin enough to not be a belly bomb and are accompanied by a profusion of cheddar cheese, grilled cheese, streaky pork bacon and fresh veggies. The Oriental chicken burger was also simple and spot on and the tropical lemongrass drink (lemongrass, lemon and honey) complements the food very well.You will surely be in zen burger-eating mode. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…Show less

Author: Keith LRiyadh, Saudi Arabia
Title: Mix of good and less-good
Review: First, it's a great space - interesting, attractive, peaceful, welcoming. And the staff was very good - knew their stuff, friendly, helpful. Dessert was pretty great as well (sticky brownie - and a good one), as was coffee. Finally, the juices and smoothies were good. So for coffee and cake mid afternoon, relaxed and breezy, this is 5 star. The savory food, on the other hand, is just not good. It's fairly creative but misses the mark in almost every way. I honestly can't understand the positive hamburger comments - it's a square of wildly overspiced meat cooked to well done and smothered under a mass of sauces and toppings. I can see people liking it as an oddball alternative, but the phrase "good burger" seems undeserved. We tried 2 versions and both were consistently overwhelming (spice level and messiness) and underwhelming (flavor and texture) at the same time. Also tried pork belly, which was poorly conceived. Anyway, I would come back for coffee and juices and dessert for sure. But for lunch, there are far better options. Show less

Author: Tania_C_NZWhangarei, New Zealand
Title: The best burger I've ever eaten
Review: This place is beautiful and the food is absolutely amazing.It's very unassuming from the outside, but inside it's a lovely setting with plants, lots of natural light, art work, all in a historic local building. I had the Aloha Burger and it was exceptional. If you're after super cheap Malaysian food then this isn't the place - it's more Western style. But if you've already had plenty of local food and want something different, and still great value compared to what you'd pay at home, then this is a must.I highly recommend this place!Show less

Author: CrazyKumar
Title: Nice place to chill!
Review: Nice cafe. Great host and loved the ambience. Great burgers, nice green plants all over, you can sit relax and read a book.  Must visit cafe.

Author: KBook7Lyon, France
Title: Ring the bell, and enter a different world...
Review: If you are overwhelmed by the density and noise of South East Asia, and need an oasis of peace, with good coffee thrown in, this is the place for you. Congrats to the owners, who have built this place up in contrary to all the pressures of a touristy town. The tables are well spaced, peace reigns, art is everywhere, as well as an abundance of plants and greenery. We went for the coffee which was really good, and dessert (yummy chocolate brownie), and regret not being there to try the burgers. No photography allowed, but not pushy about it. Just a wonderful atmosphere of peace, old books lying around, people talking instinctively in hushed tones, the sense that we are not in a rush here, stay as long as you please. And you will. Please walk all the way to the toilets at the end of the garden, pass the kitchens and the art workshop, to see how amazing the place is. You'd think a group of four adults and four kids will spoil the ambiance, but the kids settled down quickly and calmly to card games, and we ended up having a good break between all the walking and visiting. Highly recommended for a place of rest and tranquility.Show less

Author: Harry_EinisKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Exceptional
Review: Super cool cafe near jonkers. You have to ring the buzzer to be let in. The rustic old house is beautiful with pot plants and hanging creepers up the walls. Burgers were fantastic, lovely fresh baked buns, juicy patties. Great coffee & drinks. Best & coolest western style cafe in Melaka.Show less

Author: Marty KAsheville, Nc
Title: I'd live there!!
Review: The earthy ambiance was soothingly calm and the food was delicious. The owner and staff could not have been more welcoming as well as helpful with food selections. I was in need of healthy food with vegetables and they provided some delicious options for both food and freshly made juice combinations. Very good latte as well.Give yourself a treat and go there.Show less

Author: eikchyunh
Title: Very good ambience & Superb burger
Review: Was reserved to have burger in Melaka. But totally worth the try. Went to The Baboon House for lunch on my birthday. I loved the lemongrass drink. All of us like the burgers that we ordered. Very cozy, with a cat beside us, cleaning the fur and sleep... Make us feel like sleeping too.Show less

Author: PhuahKT
Title: Nice burger and environment
Review: The cafe environment is very classic and nice. A lot of nice drawing inside. Aloha burger (pork patty) is very delicious. The patty is very juicy and soft. Recommend to try it.

Author: 88gaian
Title: Good burger and good ambience
Review: The environment is cozy and food was nice. But one bad things is the map in the trip advisor was making us turning and 20min search in the street just to locate the restaurant

Author: Janneke v
Title: Best coffee in weeks
Review: Haven't had a decent coffee in weeks. The Baboon House made up voor a lot a cups of Nescafé. Great coffee, nice ambiance and a fine european breakfast. Brown Bread, at last!!

Author: Fuwa CKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Great art gallery cafe
Review: They served burgers only. Vegetarian burger is available too. Food is average but affordable and fast food serving. Non-halal. Accept cash & cc. Reservation is needed if u plan to go during lunch time. Walk-in is welcomed but have to wait 30min top, which is fine for me as we visited Nyonya house across the street to fill the time. Max seat per table is 6 pax. Strictly no photo inside the Baboon House except pic of ur food. Owner is a great artist. Every art u see in the house was drawn by him. An animal lover(especially dog, elephant, monkey). If u have extra time, you may walk around and you will notice there's some animal skull for decoration, beautiful fish tank, weird animal drawing (human head with dog body), elephant legs (not sure if it's real), books (especially Buddhist) and lots of plant. Show less

Author: Lina_TanSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Traditional settings and Great food!!!
Review: We visited the Baboon House on Monday as most restaurants were closed. We were a bit apprehensive as we were not fans of burgers.However when we arrived, we were fascinated by the traditional and natural settings. It was very relaxing.The staff were very friendly. We ordered a beef burger, a chicken burger, a pork burger and a salad. These were the best burgers we ever eaten - testified by 6 paxs !!!We went on to order drinks and other dishes on the menu although we intend to have a light lunch as we plan to try other food later.A Must Try if you are in Malacca!!!Show less

Author: Wong E
Title: Love this place
Review: Great atmosphere and delicious food! The pork burger is TASTY! Not to forget also the special juice. Love this place.

Author: Ann SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not to be missed, a hidden gem!!
Review: Finding the place could be some work as it's hidden under it's own theme (I guess that's how they want to be). They are at Heeren Street, right next to Courtyard @ Heeren. It's an absolute surprise once you find it and get inside. It's mesmerizing and beautiful. We got a perfect spot, under the open roof. It was so dreamy. The food was awesome and the staff was lovely. If you're visiting Malacca, you have to find The Baboon House. I can guarantee, you'll be delighted. After our meals we talked to the staff for some time and they explained why they restrict photography inside the restaurant. Still visitors take pictures with staff not knowing. Do not do that, if you visit. Respect the place and rules. All in all a lovely time to remember. Will definitely visit again.Show less

Author: el-madrilleno
Title: Awesome atmosphere, excellent burgers
Review: A historical house converted into uniquely decorated restaurant with plants and art elements.  I enjoyed a special beef burger with lemongrass homemade drink in a quiet and relaxing atmosphere.A little hard to find as Google has positioned incorrectly. Look at the homepage for the right address.Show less

Author: Payal2013Balikpapan, Kalimantan Timur, Indonesia
Title: Mysterious surprise
Review: We sauntered in to the Baboon House, all 8 hungry travelers, well past 2 pm on a Saturday afternoon. We stood outside the door of what seemed liked someone's house and rang the bell several times before it was answered. We were finally greeted by a young lad who said we would have to wait in the outer chamber of what looked like an art gallery whilst our table would be set. A sign forbidding any photography was pointed out to us . In anticipation of what was to come, we walked through the arched doorway into a central courtyard and we were all immediately struck by how simply the whole place was done up with old artefacts and knick knacks and art pieces obviously collected over time. The Baboon House prides itself on serving burgers- freshly made, with breads and parties that have fresh ingredients. The juices were freshly squeezed and the burgers were beyond divine . We sampled lamb burgers, hash browns, pork burgers, mushroom portobello burgers and they were all made beautifully. We loved the quaint aura of mystery the place had. I onlh wish the waiting staff were a little more well informed as anything we asked, he needed to go back to check for . A place I would recommend the burger lover to go and try - not your overloaded, greasy , hugely sized portion but a fresh and tasty home made style one!Show less

Author: alfredfangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent burgers in a cool place
Review: The shop front can be hard to find, as the signboard is carved on wood with plenty of greenery around it. We had to backtrack to find it eventually. Once inside, the place has a unique ambience full of old world charm. Food-wise, the burgers and drinks were delicious, and it's definitely a good place to chill out to escape the heat! We left feeling very satisfied.Show less

Author: Ming Li C
Title: With family and friends
Review:
Great ambience and sincere service. In love with such a unique place. Doing part to conserve nature.

Enjoy the tasty burgers cook to perfection.  

Love life.

Author: 104preetys
Title: Unique
Review: Located next door to Courtyard @ Heeren.. A very unique eating experience with great food, excellent environment, friendly staff and with affordable prices (compared to burger joints in kl) Try their pork belly burger and homemade lemongrass drink..Note: they dont allow pictures and loud noises!Show less

Author: tumata25
Title: Very relax and beautiful place, good drinks
Review: We loved the place, it was very lovely, lots of trees, flowers and fishes tank. The drinks were local drinks at a reasonable price and really good, we definitely recommend. We will come back tonight to try the burgers that we only could see.

Author: Chin-PinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful place with amazing atmosphere
Review: Went on a holiday with my husband and two children aged 11&14. I had always read the great reviews about this place and finally decided to try it out.The atmosphere when we walked into the restaurant was amazing. The wait was about 10-15mins as it was a Saturday but it was fine. We ordered 3 burgers: the gourmet beef burger, egg and bacon cheese burger, pork belly burger. As my daughter did not want a burger. We ordered a tuna toast and chicken wedges for her. We also ordered two honey lemon drinks , a ginger beer and a pineapple beer.The food came relatively quickly. It was delicious! The drinks were also very good.The restaurant is very deep and there is a garden on the way to the toilet where you can actually sit and have lunch on a table. Overall, we found the place very pleasant and peaceful although it was crowded. We will definitely return next time.Show less

Author: Leconcombre2014Luxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Very nice house and ambience, good burger
Review: Amazing house decorated with taste and talent. Very nice atmosphere. The burger (alomost the only option) is good and tasty. The few fries coming with it good have been better though. homemade beers have too much yeast. the service by a yourng French girl is very good. A nice place for lunchShow less

Author: Kuniko DHenrico, Virginia
Title: Interesting eatery
Review: We stopped here for a light lunch. It was only few steps from our hotel. It was also recommended by a friend. The burgers and sandwiches were good, but what's inside the cafe was more interesting. Lots of art work and collections of everyday life items such as old records, antique sewing machine, house plants, etc. Show less

Author: iamjosiah
Title: Homely and friend staff with good food
Review:
The hospitality of the wait staff was so great we felt like we were at home. It was like entering a shrine and just chilling with friends! 

The burger was really juicy!

Author: moseswwKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Kinda weird place but i like it
Review: The entrance is locked up and you need to be let in, or let out; in other words not really welcoming. then comes the warnings; no photos, not even selfies. you start to think this is a place that doesn't want you in.you walk into a place that looks like it is run by some backpackers hired by the owners. don't expect good service, but then expect some really good burgers!!ordered a couple of burgers, and they were really good! as you eat, you start to appreciate the surroundings (and the staff). how the mismatch of décor and the total lack of cohesion comes together, letting you relax and just enjoy the time. plus the strong aroma of the burning incenseShow less

Author: DavidL5262Paraparaumu, New Zealand
Title: No Selfies!
Review: Went in to escape the noontime Melaka heat - you have to ring the buzzer to be let in. No AC, but a cool (in both senses of the word) courtyard. This is really a classy burger joint and the burger lunch we had was delicious. We also tried their lemongrass drink and a bottle of homemade pineapple beer - both very refreshing. Our French-accented server was very friendly and the pseudo-ethnic rustic artwork decorating the walls gives a fun and quirky ambience. Maybe the best thing is their policy of no photos and no selfies - a real relief in a touristy town like Melaka. Recommended.Show less

Author: bway1777
Title: Nice
Review: Definetely recommended one .. I think the burger specially pork belly burger is their signature and best one among others ..

Author: MrunaliniB
Title: Fantastic ambience, yummy food !!
Review:
Fresh and delicious burgers (spicy lamb burger and beef burger were both yummy)
Refreshing drinks esp the lemongrass drink
Great relaxing ambience and old school feel
No photography 
Friendly staff !!

Will defi visit again when in Melaka. Dont miss this one !!

Author: hkimwah81
Title: Excellent!
Review:
Delicious burgers! 
Good service.  Love those home made stuffs... 
I will give 6 stars if photography is allowed... haha (but I respect the rule)

Author: dewdrop1303Singapore, Singapore
Title: Personal and friendly
Review: A lovely exclusive place. Nice staff who listens to their customers. My little one was super hungry and craving for banana and they gave him ... FOC with a little cup of warm fresh milk as we requested. The burgers and coffee were also tasty. We ate at 10 am and it filled us up till 3 pm! The best part was they kept the beautiful house to its original state and we had a lovely time just exploring it. Definitely will go back there again. Show less

Author: GeoffD395
Title: Great Burgers
Review:
If you like burgers and interesting decor (inside gardens and water features) This is your place. 

If you are not into burgers forget this place, as there isn't much else on the Menu.

Drinks and Coffees are great too

Author: siashereBerlin, Germany
Title: The most original lunch experience in Melaka!
Review: This place is an absolute must-visit when in Melaka! The homemade lemonades are made with love and served with care. Refreshing cold lemongrass-ginger drink is going to leave you wanting more - it's that good!The burgers are as good as they can get - perfectly seasoned, delicious fresh produce and top quality service. The portions are generous as well and will satisfy even the hungriest travelers!Overall, absolutely amazed with Baboon House! I recommend it to absolutely every one: top-notch burgers, unique atmosphere and friendly service.Show less

Author: Victoria C
Title: Really disappointing!
Review: We were excited to come and try this restaurant as it's higy rated. I had booked our table for 4 people days in advance. But when we arrived at 7.30pm, they had not reserved us a table and had given them all away to walk-in customers. They then started moving customers who were already sat down to make room for us. It was embarrassing and awkward! The waiter was very friendly and brought over our drinks quickly. But we waited 40 mins for our Top Hat starters and an hour for our Mains. I had the Rendang Wild Coriander special with 4 different types of rices. They all tasted very similar, except for the coconut rice. The rendang sauce was nice but the beef needed to be slow cooked for longer as it was a bit chewy. They told us they had just opened up after CNY, and they clearly weren't ready. Overall, it was a really disappointing experience.Show less

Author: 19carinaj
Title: Good authentic food with excellent svc
Review:
Beautiful ambience & authentic nyonya food coupled with excellent service by staff especially Carson who serves with a smile. 
Loved their signature dishes, difficult to select the best. 
Though their sago pudding was a hit with my son😊

Author: AlcinitoKuching
Title: Nice local eat
Review: Our hotel staff recommended Wild Coriander which closed late at 10pm & within walking distance. Thumbs up for overall amazing service (especially Carson who went out of his way to make us feel so welcome), good dishes (we had pai tee, rojak, rendang, chendol). Definitely a local joint based on customers there. Walk through the restaurant to the canal for after dinner stroll. Prices were very reasonable. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Pioneer55532691241London, United Kingdom
Title: Unprofessional
Review: Unable to book (tried to via WhatsApp but told to just walk in). Waited outside with other hopeful customers as told to do by the sign at the door. Empty tables visible. Ignored for 30mins then someone came and said the kitchen was now closed. Unprofessional, appalling customer service. Suggest you go elsewhere and save yourself the time.Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food 🥘 Great Hospitality 🕺🏻Fast Service 🏃‍♂️
Review: This is our 2nd time dining here, last in November 2018. We made a right decision despite weather was not permitted (raining). We walked from Casa Del Rio to Wild Coriander. This time, we ordered Beef Rendang, Rojak, Cendol, Sambal Udang, Okra with Sambal Udang Kering, Salted Egg Layer Cake, Blue Pea Rice and Nasi Lemak. Beef rendang was so so good ... the meat very soft and tender. The sambal udang is also nice, but a bit spicy. The cake was so awesome, no words to describe! Hospitality and service was also Good especially Carlson. Keep it up ! Show less

Author: Alizek7899
Title: Wild Coriander
Review: Everything recommended was delectable. It's a complete experience of authentic peranakan cuisine. The pandan layer cake is the best I ve ever tasted.

Author: Shanthan80
Title: Brought me back to my childhood
Review: That’s how good the food is . It took me back to my childhood in Ceylon road in Singapore . My Grandmother in my dads side and family have a strong Melaka / Muar influence in cuisine and this just hit the spot with the mee Siam . Looking forward to our second visit tonight on consecutive days . The dishes tasted like “ home cooked food “ and the decor felt so homely , warm and nostalgic. Moved by the experience and highly recommendedShow less

Author: lolarahmanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Everything was perfect!
Review: The food is amazingly delicious, the staff were very friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. We felt as if we were given a customized treatment from the moment we enter the restaurant until we leave. The view at the back of the restaurant is amazing too. Love it. Come with someone special and you'll feel the magic of the restaurant even more.Show less

Author: mohdoqbaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb food, fabulous decoraton ambiance
Review: We were looking for something different for dinner and we got it. And we loved every bit of it. We tried their Wild Coriander Special Beef Randang, the dish comes with 3 different rice and bunch of sides, and the devil curry chicken Yes be prepared to have that devilish spicy kick but its worth it. Ended the whole dinging process with a slice of local flavoured cake recommended by the staff. The decoration and ambiance is superb rustic and natural. All in all great experience.Show less

Author: SolaranceSShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Amazing experience! Food and Service
Review: Excellent place for lunch and dinner. The food is a medium selection but the way they flavour their food? Flawless... so much care was done when you done there.. the food, the flavouring, the service too! My god the service was top notch, we gave a good tip to him... don’t know his name but he behaves like a (Malay) supervisor. But wow, he’s the real deal! Up selling is good, he’s friendly and he was really paying attention to me and my boyfriend to match our energy when servicing us. I never had that much fun since forever. He’s probably the supervisor and he looks Malay to me. Well done man! But let’s not forget the food, the flavouring was phenomenal... the eggplant (Brinjal).. oh god I never see a restaurant who serves a whole eggplant.. flavouring was earthy like mushrooms, we tasted a hint of anchovies too... not sure about the rest but damn we couldn’t stop digging in the sauce.. Totally recommend this dish.The Pai Tee was surprisingly light... not like the usual one I ate at Chicken Rice shop lol... it’s crunchy but not enough to hurt my gums when I put a whole pai tee in my mouth... tasted yummy too...The main dish we ordered was definitely for sharing. Don’t eat it alone cuz it has 4 types of rice served with the rendang, some veggies on the side and phew the sambal... if ur not strong, don’t eat it.. it’s really spicy . Flavouring is perfect on the rendang... we ordered the chicken one and wow the chicken was nicely tender and delicious! Great for sharing with 2 people.Finally.. the desert. We thought we wanted the cendol but then the supervisor looking guy (Wish I knew your name ) recommended us the cake... supposedly rare and can never be found elsewhere. So me and my boyfriend decided to try it and it didn’t disappoint. It was unique to say and they used pandan with salted eggs layered together. The taste was balanced, sweet and salty... delicious?... no... perfection... and they don’t sell this everyday too.. now we both know why Overall... an amazing place to go too when you come to Melaka... come here.. it’s worth it!Show less

Author: Y5411DFpaulkPalmerston North, New Zealand
Title: A fantastic local food restaurant
Review: A fantastic local food restaurant a short walk along the river from the top of Jonkers Street. We were lucky to get a boardwalk table beside the river on a busy night and the food was superb traditional local fare. The ambience is excellent. The service was friendly and attentive. Show less

Author: 558karenm558Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: Blue rice - and it was good!
Review: Our Malaysian guide recommended this place, and it was definitely a good find. Friendly staff, and interesting menu. Pretty easy to go meat-free. The butterfly flower rice, sambal bendi (okra with sambal) and brinjal pajeri (aubergine in wonderful rich sauce) were all excellent. Drank local ('ish) Anchor beer to make a nice change from the ubiquitous Tiger brand. Nice space.
