We ate lots of good street food too in Malaysia, and obviously you can eat a lot cheaper than the 60RM (around £12 for two) that we spent here, but definitely recommend this eatery.Show less

Author: senfaaaMalaysia
Title: One of the nice food in Melaka
Review: We were walking around the Melaka River before our departure back to KL at noon. And we found this Wild Coriander's back door, it looks comfy outdoor and a waiter approached us. We were directed to sit indoor which was very cooling (considering the heat outdoor) and comfy as well. It has some nice Nyonya portraits and decorations. My lady who doesn't really fancy spicy food ordered a chicken green curry with blue-coloured rice, and the green curry chicken was not too spicy for her.Meanwhile i ordered Mee Siam (spicy)~ Both tasted great, and it was definitely better than some other nyonya food that i had in the past few days. It concluded our Melaka trip with satisfaction!Show less

Author: ongmck
Title: A cozy Nyonya restaurant with river sitting options
Review: The fares are quite genuine and tasty to a Nyonya guy like myself. The ambience is very tastefully decorated and its air conditioned. Recommend to try their starter of cup stuff veggie and stuffed spicy fish. Reasonably price and they do serve local tiger beers.

Author: msturnereGeraldton, Australia
Title: Character, charm and lovely fresh food
Review: A lovely restaurant, the chicken rendang was melt in you mouth delicious, and all the other food we had was equally sensational to the taste buds. We have been here before in past years and it has never disappointed. Good value for money. Only two tables by the river but plenty of tables inside where the ambience and character ooze from every room. Staff were friendly and happy to help in anyway. Show less

Author: pauloM7736RF
Title: Very good food!
Review: Great local food and very tasty deserts. If you’re looking for a reasonable priced restaurant I’d definitely recommend Wild Coriander:) It’s also located at the riverside which makes it even nicer!

Author: TomMontagnani
Title: Very nice food at good prices! Staff is very nice and friendly
Review: Very good food. I had chicken redang and it was very good. Also a big variety of desserts. Staff is very attent and friendly

Author: RTWvisitsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Tourist trap
Review: We found the food and service to be poor. The Beef Rendang was very tough and the Chicken Rendang had virtually no meat on the bone. Worst of all, they have they have the unacceptable and unhygienic habit of reusing disposable plastic drinking straws from other customers.Show less

Author: Angel_PoohBearSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nyonya Food
Review: Took Grab to the restaurant for dinner. You may have missed it if not for the driver who drops us right in front of the restaurant. As we did not make any reservation, the seats outside (which is by the river) are fully occupied. Nonetheless, the ambiance of the inside restaurant is also pleasant. The staff is friendly & he would take time to introduce the items on the menu. We had kueh pie tee & I can guarantee that most people would love it. As for mains, we ordered the Wild Coriander Specials which consists of 4 different types of rice with beef rendang. The sambal chili which must be accompanied by the nasi lemak was superb. While we were enjoying the drinks after the dinner, the staff recommended us to try their in-house dessert - coconut ice cream with pandan pancake (filled with coconut). Prices of food are reasonable & we will back to try other items on the menu.Show less

Author: Katie M
Title: Wonderful ambiance and amazing food
Review: Restaurant is superb. Best lamb shank I have ever tasted. the location was beautiful on the river, the ambiance was so lovely and the food was amazing we returned twice.

Author: gertjangeraedsBeijing, China
Title: Top notch food and service at very reasonable prices
Review: We, a family of 4 from The Netherlands with 2 young kids all enjoyed the superbly prepared Indonesian dishes we ordered. Some spicy, some less so, but equally nice. The cuisine is quite diverse (not only Indonesian style which we enjoyed, but much broader Asian). Staff was very attentive, friendly and professional. The atmosphere is very laid back. All in all, kudos for a fantastic team in the kitchen as well as waiting.Show less

Author: BenYorkie
Title: Very Enjoyable
Review:
A traditional old shophouse which is now a bar and eatery serving nyonya food.
We only popped in for late afternoon drinks and snacks but certainly enjoyed the atmospheric surroundings, the good service an some tasty pie tees.
All good.

Author: pdjtravelerCalgary, Canada
Title: Delicious food in a bright, casual atmosphere
Review: Delicious food! Wild Coriander was recommended by our guide in Penang as a good place for Nyonya food while in Melaka and we weren’t disappointed. The atmosphere is casual and bright. Serving staff cheerful and friendly. We began with pai tee for appetizers then had chicken rendang and laksa for mains. Both were delicious though I wish restaurants would use boneless chicken in their dishes. So much easier to eat. Dessert was a surprising treat of Pandan salted egg custard layered cake. Unique mix of flavors. Show less

Author: Radkaduby
Title: Definitely worth the visit
Review:
Good and authentic Peranakan food. Amazing Sago pudding!

Great service, friendly staff and good vibes.

Author: goodboycrabby
Title: Chandon
Review: The food was amazing, but the best part was the waiter Chandon! Thank you very much for explaning us everything and being so nice!

Author: bethan559Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: So disappointed
Review: So disappointed with our meal at Wild Coriander. We passed it and read all the great reviews and decided to go on our last night. The food was bland and took ages to arrive. If you get a table in the restaurant or outside it looks really nice but we ended up in the entrance. All around not as good as the reviews suggested. Show less

Author: philhellich
Title: Great place from starters to desserts
Review:
Great place from starters to desserts
Warning: as usual, Malay food may be spicy. OK prices with good variety of choices. Try the special with 4 different types of rice.  Little terrace on the river side !

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: This is clearly popular and
Review: This is clearly popular and had to wait for a table . The food is ok not the greatest but a nice ok meal . Not sure I would rush back . If you ask if something is spicy according to them “ it’s medium spicy “ some was pretty spicy Show less

Author: Gotravel1881Port Dickson, Malaysia
Title: Delectable
Review: Chanced on this Cafe while out searching for a late lunch in the vicinity. Did not disappoint. Food was flavorful with good portions. Friendly attentive staff especially Carson and team. Well adorned with a mixture of peranakan and Chinese deco all thrown in. But sadly was told the seating by the River was not open. Recommended.Show less

Author: PSurretUnited Kingdom
Title: Nice decor and atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is nicely done inside in a simple home-ish way, with a good atmosphere. The food was nice, it was not very warm though which worried us a bit to start with. The service was nice too, although after an initial smiley welcome at the door we were told to wait a few minutes to be seated and they just got distracted so we had to remind them we were still waiting to be seated not just looking around. After that all fine. They are looking for staff if anyone is interested and they do need some, it’s quite busy which is great for them, just slightly too touristy for us. We tried it once, nice but we’ll try other places over the next couple of days. Show less

Author: charissetay
Title: Ambience good. Food not so great.
Review: So sad, so sad! Not sure why the reviews are so good.Based on my first and latest experience, it wasn’t good.We ordered 3 dishes - rendang beef, otakotak and bendi with sambal. Beef was hard, half of our bendi were old and hard but the rempah and sambal respectively were done very well. Just the main meat and vege were hard. Otakotak was hard and dry! Cendol was good, fine ice, and Gula malacca was fragrant. It came with red beans on the top. Enjoyed the cendol overall. Staff and ambience on point! Comfortable place. Would’ve sat by the river if it didn’t rain. Show less

Author: 277iann
Title: Delightful lunch for 7 people.
Review: Delightful lunch for 7 people. We were treated to delicious beef rendang, lamb shank, chicken mushroom, prawn curry, brinjal, lady’s fingers & butterfly pea rice. The dessert (pancake with coconut ice cream) was well worth the preparation time. Would wholeheartedly recommend Wild Coriander!

Author: 155perr
Title: Very tasty food, nice atmosphere
Review: Very tasty food, nice atmosphere and welcoming staff. We where a family of five. We got a big table and a couple joined us. That worked out just fine.

Author: Liam K
Title: Nice ambience
Review:
Very spicey even for the locals.
 Good setting for tourist. Food and beer most attractive. Not cheap though. Better inside than outside

Author: X8485RGmatth
Title: Our favourite meal in Malaysia
Review: We has a two week holiday and stumbled on this little gem by the river. Delightful setting, lovely (and affordable) food, great service. Our server Chandon was great. Go, enjoy!

Author: Kenneth YPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A true gem by the river
Review: This was another recommendation from the lady at the hotel front desk and she was spot on with this one. The food is authentic nyonya and the servings large without the price to match. The rear of the restaurant opens out to the river and it gets quite nice after the sun sets. It's a good place to enjoy a cocktail. Show less

Author: mrscourtneyMount Maunganui, New Zealand
Title: Delicious!
Review: Best meal of our SthEastAsia trip. I had the chicken rendang special - delicious. The husband's beef rendang was pretty spicy. Our daughter liked the mee siam; smaller portion, just right for kids or light adult dinner. Spotless restaurant, options by river or inside, wonderful staff and delicious food.Show less

Author: 352NHE
Title: Very friendly service and good value for money
Review: Very friendly service, nice small terrace on the back with a view on the river. Food was delicious and the value for money is high. I had a laksa, served in a quantity I could not finish. It was a late lunch.

Author: ck kSingapore
Title: Saturday lunch @ Wild Corr.
Review: Nice place, beautiful murals on the wall. Very nicely curated ambiance and rustic enough to give off that old Nonya charm. Food wise - very mediocre. We had their mee siam which tasted aweful. I cannot understand for the world why did the meesiam tasted so lemak? I have eaten numerous mee siam all over malacca but this is the first time with so much lemak (coconut milk). The other dish we had was their Devil Curry. I liked that. Herbal curry and fantastic aroma. Lovely to go with rice. Coffee was aweful as well. Very diluted and tasteless. Horrible. We ordered two jars of cookies off their shelf. We opened it to eat with our coffee and realised that the cookies were turning rancid. Feedback to the staff, and even asked one of them to try a piece. But owner was kind enough to refund us although they claimed the cookies were freshly baked. I bed to differ on that point. Service was not too bad. But one thing to note to owners of beautiful nonya restorans, How can you have foreign workers like Indon and Banglas handling food. They have no or little idea on how Nonya food will taste like. I know you can teach, you can train. But still, you'd need someone local to be there all the time to ensure food quality and service. Show less

Author: SaumSudhir
Title: You’ll end up ordering everything - and loving it all
Review: The food here was absolutely amazing. We couldn’t help order more than intended after we saw what our fellow diners were eating and wanting some for ourselves. The chicken rendang is tender, juicy, and extremely flavorful. The top hats were a delicious appetizer, and the butterfly pea rice and coconut rice were fabulous. We also ordered a plate of vermicelli noodles (the name is slipping my mind) and it was spicy yet tasty. The laksa was subtlely flavored (it is MASSIVE though!)Despite the obvious freshness and complexity of our dishes, the service was efficient and the servers were polite and helpful. The only area I think needs work is the decor - it’s a little tacky and kitschy at the moment, and doesn’t do the food and service here any justice!Overall, a great experience.Show less

Author: Mary-Ellen E
Title: Very pleasant.
Review: The food was tasty, with the option of not being too spicy, if that’s your preference. Charming waiter, lots of plants and cool (but not cold) temperature.

Author: FellowTraveler823790
Title: Wonderful food, beautiful location and superb service!
Review: Last week I was at Wild Coriander with my partner and I am happy to say it is a gift that keeps on giving! The food (as always) was exceptional, just writing about it makes me hungry :P. The food and lovely atmosphere was made even more enjoyable through our wonderful waiter- Mr. Chandon! He took such good care of us, he was ready to recommend dishes when need and was friendly and very professional. Thank you Chandon for making this an even more unique experience than last time, we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves and look forward to coming back soon!Show less

Author: todordaskalov123
Title: Very delicious
Review: It was very delicious and the crew was very friendly. The atmosphere is very nice. Prices are really fair.

Author: VivienHP
Title: Fresh Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Great little peranakan place. Had the Wild Beef Rendang special which came with blue rice. Kids loved it. Was worried that all dishes would be spicy but they had non-spicy mee siam and pie tie which my 9 and 4 year old devoured.

Author: eddyphdhongSeoul, South Korea
Title: wonderful old chinese style interior restaurant
Review: the first thing to say about this restaurant is interior. i thought i was in old time. every place were fill with antique items like chairs and tables, paintings and many kinds of items. tasty foods were also great. location is awesome. front door is in front of river. back door is in the main road.Show less

Author: Kortum
Title: Exploring
Review: Great dinner loved the food. Great decor as well. Love the local flavour. Sit outside it was hot inside.

Author: Zapper808Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So so....
Review: Just as title says, it's so so. Food is nothing to shout about and kinda pricey, taste wise just normal, service is mediocre. The only good thing about this place is the friendly waiter who is originally from Shah Alam who enjoys the orchestra. He is very friendly and talks to every table to ensure everyone is having a good time. The rest needs a lot of training. The disgusting dirty dishes trolley would roll up next to you to wait for you to eat your last bite, the restaurant is not even half full. Too lazy to roll it to the back and come back again. Show less

Author: Kruiza
Title: Good food beautiful seating
Review: Good food beautiful seating by the river (out the back). Try the top hats very delicious. Service was good however the kitchen was very slow.

Author: andysS5067JZ
Title: Super food!
Review: Tried coming in yesterday but ofcworthy note theyre closed on Wednesdays. No reservation needed at 6pm and plenty of lovely tables to chose from. We had the beef rendang, mixed vegetables and 1 portion of rice and this was more than enough for 2! Price more than some others we ate at but the quality was much higher standard. Dinner tonight was MR40 before drinks.Show less

Author: Lubnna
Title: Lovely place!. 🥰
Review: Very nice and spacious place.  The menu is varied both food and drink.  The staff is friendly.  The price is correct.

Author: RoyThia
Title: Superb food
Review: Great atmosphere.. the food was also very tasty.. try the wild coriander set for a vastly exciting culinary experience.. the handmade kueh is also delicious! Service was fantastic!

Author: JodieG925Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: This restaurant really showcases Malaysian cuisine
Review: This restaurant really showcases Malaysian cuisine - we lived in Malaysia for 5 years and Wild Coriander is the best Malaysian food we have eaten ! We highly recommend the Beef Rendang and the Lamb Shank also the French Green beans with garlic and oyster sauce!! Special thanks to Chandon for fabulous service. Show less

Author: Michael O
Title: We dined here for dinner and
Review: We dined here for dinner and ordered a Malay style lamb shank dish. The meal was pretty good, service also good and typically Malay in that is was a bit quirky. The restaurant was of Chinese build and decoration making the atmosphere comfortable and interesting.

Author: XanderT7
Title: Excellent
Review: Great mains and delicious deserts. Friendly staff. We requested and received the tables at the river side of the restaurant. Great experience.

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great hospitality and amazing food!
Review: Melaka is a location famous for its nyonya food due to its peranakan roots. A visit to this historical town is never complete without trying out their traditional peranakan fare. One can find numerous nyonya restaurants in melaka, but as the quaint little town grew in tourists visits, somehow, to find a good one among the many on offer here is getting more and more difficult.Thankful to have found this little small restaurant while I’m in melaka this time. Dining at this restaurant was really an experience. From the deco inside the restaurant, the utensils used and the food itself, i was soaked thoroughly in the peranakan culture, in a good way of course.The restaurant is housed in a traditional house. The owners really make an effort to introduced the peranakan culture into the dining experience. I was very impressed. To top that up, the food was simply amazing. The family was served by Carson, who impressed us so much with his hospitality that we felt really grateful. He’s not someone who simply hand over the menu, but explained the dishes found within the menu. He made some wonderful recommendation and was attentive throughout the meal. He was really genuine and forthcoming which made our entire meal, a totally enjoyable one!Please do yourself a favour and try their nyonya kuays when you are there and you wouldn’t regret it! I was very sad after tasting their kuays truly. Why you may ask and the answer is that I will have a very hard time trying to find kuays in Singapore with similar taste and texture.Thank you Carson for the wonderful experience that we had at wild coriander. Please stay the same always! Show less

Author: AM0909London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food & great service
Review: Very chool ambience, great food, superb service by Chandan,good airconditioning & wi fi & a river view- what's not to like. We went without tein babies & were instantly made to feel at home. Their ginger, lemon grass,lime drink was really nice, the lamb shank was fabulous! Everything we ordered was so good. Certainly going back there.Show less

Author: nathaliefern
Title: Good Peranakan food!
Review: The Peranakan fare at this restaurant were great! Really good prices for the food we ate! Most restaurants would have charged more for that quality. Protip: if you ask to go to the back at night, you get to dine beside the Melaka river :)

Author: RossR908Thames, New Zealand
Title: Brilliant food
Review: Had our dinner here tonight. First experience of Malay food in Melacca. Had pie tee for a starter - very tasty. The beef rendang was tender with just the right amount of spiceyness and served with rice and various condiments. My wife had the laksa which was way to big for her to eat but the flavours were spot on. Had the sago with coconut cream and gula to finish the meal - loved it too. Will definately make a return visit before we leave and highly recommend. Show less

Author: 100Charlotte
Title: Great food on both occasions we visited.
Review: There always seems a crowd in this pretty little restaurant and you can see why. The Pie Tee are delicious as a started and the beef rendang and beans in garlic did not disappoint. All at a very reasonable price. Highly recommended

Author: Judy H
Title: Wonderful!
Review: This is a wonderful restaurant that is a fusion of Asian and nyonya cuisine. The rendang and beans were standouts. The setting is lovely and so refreshing and cool after a long walk in the hot Melaka sun. It is definitely worth a visit,

Author: Steve1481948
Title: First class in all aspects.
Review: We walked past this place looking for somewhere to eat dinner. It looked way above clean and tidy and we thought if the food is half as good as the place looks it should be perfect.Well the choice and quality of the dinner were excellent and the cost was unbelievable inexpensive even in Melaka.We have been back twice more and Chandon the waiter goes out of his way to ensure you have an enjoyable experience.We will be returning before we leave Melaka.Show less

Author: Tracie0909
Title: Tasty
Review:
What a lovely restaurant!
Very friendly staff to help with menu choices.
The dishes were absolutely delicious with a great little spicy kick. Thoroughly recommended.

Author: Chicco2018A
Title: Top food
Review: Ate here a few nights ago, loved the food! the staff was really nice, they immediately found us a table, and explained the menu with patience ad knowledge. The quality was really good, and the ambience made it for a lovely night.

Author: mwestlan
Title: Nice place to visit
Review: Beef rendang and green curry recomend. Nice and clean restaurant. Airco inside. Polite staff.  It is close to city center.

Author: kmquek
Title: Good service average food
Review: The service here is good but the food is really a disappointment. There are much more options available in Melaka with far superior food quality.

Author: jontravelsandeats
Title: Yummy rendang!
Review: Would go back again. Yummy rendang! You have to try the chicken and the beef rendang. Friendly server. Interesting interior for the Instagramme.

Author: LilyLi777
Title: Family visit
Review: Amazing food and ambiance, beautiful presentation! Amazing service provided by Carson, had a wonderful time. The beef rendang in particular was delicious, and so tender!

Author: Bushymartin
Title: Excellent local food, great service
Review: Excellent local food, fresh and tasty, excellent service. Great setting next to the canal. Great place. The food was very quickly delivered

Author: NajihaR7
Title: A gem in the city!
Review: Beautiful cafe. Amazing service. Awesome food. The tables at the back entrance (riverside) are my favourite spot for a sweet little dinner date with my partner.

Author: yisiewt
Title: Short trip
Review: Hidden restaurant beside a hotel . Within Little India of Melaka . Hard to find parking lot . Restaurant has very nice ambience. Very good customer service and food and drinks was great . Definitely worth a try when I come Melaka.

Author: KereruHuggerWellington, New Zealand
Title: Outstanding!
Review: It is true what they say, absolutely amazing food. Seriously, the beef rendang is the best we have ever had. We also had the Brinjal Pajeri which was melt in mouth devine. The Udang Masak Lemak Nenas was highly recommended too and if we weren’t heading away tomorrow we would be back to have it. The Pie Tee was a perfect balance of taste for starters. Highly recommend. 6 stars Show less

Author: Odyssey811876
Title: Awesome authentic dinner
Review:
We had a delicious dinner at Wild Coriander. Enjoyed the fabulous shared lamb shank dish with Nonya vegetables as an extra. Great drinks menu too. 
We will be back!

Author: taniamonk
Title: Totally delicious
Review: Fabulous food and service. We tried the beef rendang, laksa, pie tees and noodles. One of the few places we have visited that labels the gluten free options. Great for kids too.

Author: denisel318Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Rendang & Fantastic Service!
Review: The service alone is worth the visit. We read the great reviews on Wild Coriander and stumbled upon it while we were walking along the river in the evening. One of the dishes we ordered was the rendang which was one of the best rendang dishes I've ever had. The service provided was great and Carson and his team went out of their to entertain our 3 year old daughter. She loved it so much that we went back the next night to have dessert and to say hello to the staff. The best tables are the 3 small tables by the river which are perfect for couples.Show less

Author: Bedjet
Title: Amazing beef rendang
Review: Staff is really nice and the restaurant is lovely . The beef rendang was to die for , the best we had within our two month travel around Malaysia. The pie tee was also very nice . We made the mistake to come here on our last day in Melaka so couldn't come back for more ... we did get another portion of beef rendang take away tho !!Show less

Author: Cymber263Melbourne, Australia
Title: Absolute banger!!! Highly recommended
Review: My girlfriend and I had been walking around Melacca for a while so we were quite hangry, and when we found this place, we immediately fell in love with the place and we were served some 5star food with even better service. If you ever have the pleasure of being served by Carson, please give that man a bells! He was ever so attentive and his recommendation's were spot on!Show less

Author: DeathsDragon95Hinckley, United Kingdom
Title: Nice
Review: We were looking for somewhere to have a drink and found this place as we were walking past. The place was empty more or less inside although the small seating area outside the back with views of the river was full. We found and table and ordered drinks which were nice. We decided to order some food as well for a snack which we had a couple of different things to share. The food didn't take too long to come and the dishes were quite nice. Overall the place seemed clean, the decor is nice. The staff are friendly. The drinks were nice and the food as well. If you're in the area maybe try this place maybe more for drinks but the food is worth a try.Show less

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: A lovely visit...
Review: Highly recommended. The place is full of colour, charm and character; the food and coffee was beautiful; it was good value - and above all, the staff were so friendly, helpful and good fun. A really lovely visit.

Author: twnteoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch
Review: Visited following the excellent reviews. We ordered pie tee, aubergine pajeri, beef rendang and otak otak, plus 2 bluepea rice. Pie tee casing was greasy, the filling was very bland with no sengkuang that we could taste. Can't identify the filling!.The aubergine pajeri taste was towards the indian flavour rather than a Malay flavour so that is a personal preference.The beef rendang was tender but doesn't taste like the Malay rendang. However it was flavoursome with the spices.Otak otak was not bad but I thot the texture was suppose to be fish flake rather than fish paste/cake texture.The rendang & aubergine was spicy!.Overall food was ok but nothing fantastic that I will go be rushing back to.Ambience and setting was quaint and lovely.Show less

Author: Timothy D
Title: Don't bother
Review: Made a booking, turned up. They seemed so cool when making the booking. Indifferent staff in an empty restaurant. Couldn't provide options for a vegetarian, couldn't provide options for a meat eater, seemed unable to even deliver upon menu items. We left after the initial drinks, this place is a train crash. With so many options in Melaka to choose from, give this one a miss. CheersShow less

Author: 2adults3kidsonBudgetPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Unassuming outside amazing inside
Review: This time we found WC rated highly in Google and gave it a try. Arriving on a weekday, we managed to find spots in the limited carparks right outside the restaurant. Entering the place was a 2 stage experience starting with nice to wow as we were sat in the middle of the restaurant. Deco is really nice, staff very friendly and food was delicious at good prices(RM15-25 per own portions). Their special chicken or beef rendang is a winner and we also enjoyed their special laksa. Don't miss their avocado gula melaka shake. Their backdoor exits to the river path which is also a nice instagramable spot. All in a recommended place for lunch.Show less

Author: Devika7005
Title: Nostalgic eats
Review: First at all the environment was too good..it was calm,peaceful in and out..the decoration part was simple yet historical based in baby nyonya concept..i love that 10/10.foods was good.. i love their sides more than the main dishes..tomyam was quite ok but prefer more spicy..overall was a good eat ..7/10Show less

Author: Nicola H
Title: Excellent
Review: Really good food. Lots of vegetarian options, and one of the few restaurants we’ve seen where gluten free options are marked (handy for the coeliacs on our group). The laksa is particularly recommended, but bring a friend (it’s huge!!)

Author: Rhys B
Title: Rhys
Review: Fantastic food and service! Thank you very much guys. I highly recommend the prawn/pineapple dish with rice, incredible and spicy!

Author: S6361FRstevesHoensbroek, The Netherlands
Title: Fantastic evening with very good food and service
Review: A pearl of a restaurant. Sometimes when you arrive in a restaurant you know in the first 30 seconds that it will be a good night.We arrived on a bike and asked if we could leave them at the back of the restaurant on the waterfront. Better than that the waiter said i will put them safe away for you. All the waiters where very friendly and took time to explain the menu and dishes. Also giving good advice about not ordering to much. We love eating and tasting new dishes also because i am a professional chef.So i am always looking for good food and service.We had the fresh mango lassi to cool down.It was one of the best we ever had in asia.We had the pie tee top hats as starter . veey light and crispy with a vegetarian filling. For main course we sheared the chicken randang an prawn pineapple curry with coconut rice. Both fantastic flavours. I make a goed randang but today the spicing was spot on For dessert we had the salted egg custard layerd cake with coconut ice cream and some extra palm sugar siroop. I will definitely be trying to recreate those tastes when i go back home. hope you have the same experience as us 1 tip for the waiters slow down a bit with the courses1 tip for the owner or chef put on a tasting menu. So that we can enjoy more of your food.Show less

Author: Romand F
Title: Few days in melacca
Review: Perfect place, perfect food and lovely persons! You have to go if you love nice cooking. Enjoy et listen the good advices of the waiters

Author: johnm136Perth, Australia
Title: Lives up to its reputation
Review: Visited this restaurant twice in our short trip to Melaka and found the food consistently excellent. The restaurant was located close to our hotel and backs on to the river. The decor is great and the staff friendly and professional, with the cost being affordable. Would recommend to everyone.Show less

Author: Tom M
Title: Tasty evening
Review: Very nice decorations inside and food to match! The staff are really friendly. You just have to order a mango lassi in case you're not used to eating the Malaysian medium-hot dish might be a very hot dish for european people but still such good food! We're very happy we found a restaurant near the river Show less

Author: abrogers2001Perth, Australia
Title: Tantalising flavours right next to the river
Review: We went to the River Side Cafe for lunch, but the owner was absent, so we wandered a few doors down on the embankment to this restaurant. It was a great move ! The food is authentically Malaysian with a few culinary twists that would put it in the top rank world wide. We had Mee Siam and Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang, both of which were well presented and very tasty. Meal cost was A$23 for two. There are several freshly made fruit juices available. The decor in the place has been developed with imagination and good taste. There is little in the way of parking and given the location I would not try driving there. For a really excellent light lunch, I can recommend this place.Show less

Author: tujoe
Title: A must visit when in Melaka
Review: We read up the reviews on Trip Advisor before deciding to visit this restaurant. And we were so happy to have done so. Firstly, if you are into Peranakan / Nonya cuisine, or like to try out, this is the place. The decor gives a very old world, warm feeling, And the food is simply to die for. We tried the Lamb Shank curry, with a thick sauce. So tender and juicy to the bone, simply mouth watering!! Also tried their signature Brinjal dish, and the mildly spicy achar.The suggested Lemongrass drink was too good, and a must try. Overall a great restaurant, though maybe a bit pricey.Show less

Author: sheosrai
Title: Delicious
Review: The food was really good and tasty here.  The ambiance is really nice and the service prompt.  Please go there early or book a table has it got really crowded from 630 pm onwards.

Author: tpLong
Title: Nice Decor
Review: The restaurant is nice decor i.e. wall painting.  Not much comments on food as Im vegetarian. However, there are some vegetarian options there.

Author: 538vincentkEssen, Germany
Title: Skip this place unless you like medan selera food
Review: We had a meal here on our last day in Melaka. Having dined in other Peranakan restaurants, this was truly a disappointment. In fact, comparing it to the others is just an insult. None of the dishes had any depth of flavour and the presentation was atrocious. Placing lettuce leaves and tomato slices on every dish is what you do with nasi goreng in a food court. We should have walked straight out after looking at the menu. Ordering from it was a mistake. Show less

Author: tonyking8652Essen, Germany
Title: Everything was awful
Review: Billed as a classical nonya restaurant NOTHING served came even close to tasty food!Four dishes cane out all items plonked onto what appeared to be a half of a lollo bionda lettuce and a few slices of raw tomato and cucumber? What on earth has that sort of presentation got to do with good Malacca cuisine?The fish was diminutive and dry, the supposedly spicy devilled chicken was dry and tasteless , the Otak-Otake was rubbery ( more like Spam) and the only slightly tasty item was the brinjal . but the grey sauce looked very unappetising!The staff too , all came over as sullen and TOTALLY disinterested!A thoroughly bad choice!Show less

Author: 404MMMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Tasty, friendly and nicely decorated
Review: Food was great, nice decorations. We tried several dishes, all were top. Rendang meat is pretty spicy for some, I loved it. Do try the lassi drink if you think food is too hot. Nb pls trough out the filthy mats before the toilet.At the back you walk directly to the river.Show less

Author: 306cathrynn
Title: Great for meat eaters
Review: As meat eaters, my daughter and husband thoroughly enjoyed their meals. Well cooked and tasted delicious. The vegetarian dishes myself and my other daughter shared were not the best. The rice was over cooked and chewy, the vegetables flavourless and only luke- warm, but at least they provided some vegetable dishes, which is better than many restaurants in area!The service was excellent - helpful and attentive staff.Show less

Author: Jackking1342
Title: FANTASTIC Food, Friendly staff
Review: Air Bandung is amazing there,A plentiful number of dishes to choose from, not too spicy  best chendol durian ever.A place that's certainly worth your money, with a lovely atmosphere bringing you to true Melaka.

Author: RickyR1305Singapore
Title: Great food and interior decoration
Review: All the food we had ordered was delicious! Nothing taste bad at all. The restaurants staffs were friendly, can speak English and always smiling. I feel very relax to come here for dinner. I choose to sit inside to enjoy every detail of their interior. We ordered quite a lot of food for 3 people and the final bill come in was reasonable. Will return again.Show less

Author: Florie D
Title: Very good and friendly staff
Review: Had a great experience at Wild coriander. The food was really good and staff very friendly. I really recommend this address for a good dinner in Melaka

Author: Nadia Van Camp ... T
Title: Local restaurant
Review:
Local atmosphere. Half of the dishes had to be taken by 2 or more persons. To find something not too spicy for kids is an adventure, but the staff guided us through the menu with good advice. 
Overall good food.

Author: Murray S
Title: Great Discovery
Review: Some brief research led us to Wild Coriander and we're more than happy we did. The food was great and very well priced. The chicken rendang was fantastic and the desert tray was eclectic. A great discovery.

Author: pavani9597
Title: Great food and ambience
Review: Just had dinner at this lovely place. Was intrigued with the deco . But the food did not disappoint. All the dishes was very good and tasty. Highly recommended.

Author: Chandara KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful Cosy Place with Excellent Excellent Food
Review: Excellent food with great ambience. Must try's are 1. Ondeh ondeh....wow ,the gula melaka oozing out2. The chicken rendang....awesome3. Mutton curry ...the thick gravy, and my 1st impression was my mom's cooking4. The variety of rice .....beautiful and it compliments with the dishesThe owners are simply great , ambience is made out of great personalities ,music ,deco and service. Will go back again....Show less

Author: 987cathycPeregian Springs, Australia
Title: Excellent Lamb
Review: Have the lamb. It was beautiful. Full of flavour, falling off the bone, fantastic. Beef rendang very generous serving. Staff pleasant and food came out quickly. A bit slow to clear the plates afterwards. Coconut ice cream with Gula Melaka was a lovely cleanser after the meal. Lovely feel and busy. Show less

Author: shaikhy2016
Title: Absolutely delightful service and food
Review: Felt being at a Peranakan Home with great hospitality and flavorful food. Particularly like their desert spread.

Author: Majkenpetersen
Title: One of the best in town
Review: Located a few minuts walk from the river. It was a bit of a coincidence that we found it for lunch. We had som great beef rendang and refreshing lime juice. Food was delicious and cozy athmosphere. Absolutely no complaints. Would gladly visit agin.

Author: LivingTravel_21
Title: Food and personal are amazing
Review:
I found this place thanks TripAdvisor.  Beautiful restaurant, nice style & comfortable. The food was excellent and same for the personal! 
I recommend the rendang dishes :)

Author: nick c
Title: Great food
Review: We had 2 dinners and 1 lunch during our 4 nights in malacca. Kept going back as we loved the food and ambiance. Staff were really friendly and helpful. Cafe is a typical peranakan house on the river with some seating outside. I really enjoyed the beef rendang and the appetisers.Show less

Author: SaigonnedGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: It’s a hidden gem. Decorated in Peranakan style. Very nice decor. The food was tasty. Avocado milkshake was superb. Perfect place for a lot of photos and good food. The portions r large for small eaters. The back is leading to the river. Only 2 tables at the riverside but u can only sit here at night when it is cooler. The waiters r polite. It only has a limited range of Peranakan food. Eating at night by the river I believe would truly be an experience. We where there in the afternoon. But it was cool inside. Would highly recommend this place at least once. Show less

Author: TerryandSian
Title: Good evening meal
Review: Just tried this restaurant after reading previous reviews, very good food and helpful staff, we’ll visit again.

Author: Caroline-vlt
Title: Romantique
Review:
Very good ! You have to go there ! A bit expensive for Malacca but it is totally worth it. The location was amazing on the river 
And the staff very good and nice

Author: foongailiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Gem in Malacca
Review: Peranakan Dishes at it’s best. Mushroom chicken and lamb stew are fabulous. The meehoon gets a . They have the Nonya Desserts spread on the table for you to pick and choose. Must try. Sadly, I wont recommend the cendol, it is disappointing. The atmosphere in the restaurant are so serene (in the middle section) and sort of opened up to a courtyard in a restored shoplot of a Pawn Shop. Away from the hustle bustle of nearby tourist crowd, the restaurant is tucked away by the river side.Be warn the food here maybe a bit spicy for non asian but it is somewhat of fine dining of local Peranakan food. Give it a try.Show less

Author: K2514TAamyb
Title: Great food and great staff
Review: This was a great place for our first night in Melaka. We asked for recommendations and they did not disappoint... the fish and chicken were especially delicious! Our experience was made even better by the friendly staff and lovely riverside setting. Thank you!

Author: Gabr_Docker
Title: Nice linch in a really nice restaurant
Review:
The good:
-	very nice-looking restaurant and ambient atmosphere
-	great service
-	food and drinks: great selection
-	affordable

Although the food was good, but it was missing the WOW! Factor.

Definitely recommended!

Author: darenbilas
Title: Hidden gem in Melacca
Review: We stopped by at Wild Coriander because of its unique ambience. Good serving of local food and hospitable crews as well. I highly suggest to try it when you visit Melacca

Author: serenebooJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Delightful local cuisines in a quaint ambience
Review: It was the most memorable meal we had in Melaka. You won’t go wrong by ordering what is recommended by the experienced staff. The lemongrass drink brewed using their in-house recipe was so refreshing that my husband ordered two glasses for himself. The lamb shank was an excellent choice because it was tender and melt in the mouth. The rojak which was made of generous array of juicy fruits was exceptional. Overall, it is surely a restaurant I would come again in my next visit to Melaka.Show less

Author: saifsphereSydney, Australia
Title: Great Service and Awesome food
Review: By far the highlight of having dinner here is the service. The waiters will ensure you have a great meal with a massive smile on their faces. The restraint itself is quite large and set up for entertaining groups. Their menus features a vast amount of great dishes designed for sharing with friends or family. The area sitting next to the river is small but if it's full, inside is just as pleasant. Show less

Author: GanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome fried non spicy meehun
Review: Went in for dinner. We were attracted by the deco of the shop- truly peranakan setting. We had a table by the river. Awesome to watch people walking past, joggers on their run, tourists on the Melaka river cruise. Had a great time savoring the authenic nyonya food. The non spicy fried meehun was awesome. So too were the pie tee and acar acar. After dinner, we had a walk along the river. Was an enjoyable walk - looking at the murals, lighted up buildings, lighted up bridges, restaurants and hotels , other people on the same path.Show less

Author: 7erence7amCanberra, Australia
Title: Delicious fusion food with a perky interior deco
Review: We were actually looking for a Peranakan restaurant and stumbled upon this gem of a restaurant. The interior was bright, colourful and enticing. We sat by the courtyard, admiring the intricate detailing of the interior decoration.The menu was fascinating, it wasn’t a traditional Peranakan spread, but it had a fusion of Chinese and Indian cuisines, with a hint of European twist to its dishes.A special shout out to Carson, a young gentleman who served us. We were very happy with all his recommendations. The lambshank was simply delicious, the rojak was the best we’ve ever had, and the desserts were just unforgettable. Must try the salted egg yolk cake!Of all the dishes, I have to dedicate one paragraph to the mushroom chicken. This is in fact a very common dish, and very easy to prepare, even for an amateur weekend cook. But Wild Coriander has perfected it. The chicken is cooked to just the right doneness, the flavours are blended to just the right intensity, and the mushroom are braised to perfection.Show less

Author: Brent C
Title: Good lunch, nice view, friendly service
Review: There is a big space inside with aircon , if you want to sit by the river best to go at night when it’s cooler, unless you are ok to eat very spicy but excellent octopus sambal in the extreme heat.

Author: HayleyandDarren
Title: Lovely food in Melaka
Review: Really good restaurant by the riverside. We ate at a table next to the river with a great view. Food was also really nice and excellent value.

Author: D9335JXsophieb
Title: Great ambiance
Review: We accidentally bumped unto this restaurant and were very pleasent suprised! The ambiance is great, service very good and the food was delicious!

Author: Sue G
Title: Evening meal
Review:
Lovely setting along the river with very friendly staff. Meal was traditional and interesting. Nutmeg ice is a novel drink to try if not done so before!
Thankyou all for an enjoyable evening.

Author: 265felihSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best food we’ve had in Malacca
Review: We went there twice, for lunch and for dessert.Wild coriander is in a charming old building, next to the river. It’s very cool without using AC and overall a very relaxing place.We tried their beef rendang (absolutely excellent) and Rojak.For dessert, we tried the Durian Chendol (delicious) and had some traditional crepes with coconut and gula Melaka.Show less

Author: martynr242Sydney, Australia
Title: Best Beef Rendang Ever
Review: Charming host, excellent food and good prices. And did I mention the best beef Rendang ever? We tripped across Wild Coriander on the way to Riverview and given the high occupancy and great position on the river we made a last minute change. No regrets and would highly recommend. Show less

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Not for us
Review: Well the service was amazing, the presentation was a real wow and that's where it ends. If you like chilly you will love this place cause I like but this was rediculous inedible comes to mind. My wife was ill when we got back to hotel and I was just starving because I really could not eat. We asked politely if it was spicy and the response was 'yes sir, little bit spicy' . I have a beautiful photo of the food but when you eat it uuuuck...Show less

Author: elenatG5666SOSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hits and misses
Review: The achar was really good, a little on the sweet side. The rest are just alright...Disappointed with the kueh pieties - the cups were stale and the texture became tough and chewy rather than crispy.There’s no sambal belachan but the friendly staff gave us three types of chilli paste that we that we didn’t find exciting or inspiring.We had desserts - salted egg yolk cake gave a hint of the egg yolk. The sago gula melaka was a huge let down that we left it after a spoon - too much coconut milk and too little gula, the coconut milk taste strange as well plus the sago was overcooked, too soft and lumpy. We also had glutinous rice cooked in brown sugar and we kept biting into bits of uncooked rice. The only dessert that we smiled to was the kueh with green Pandan custard, fragrant but texture can be better too. Chendol was just alright The friendly staff saved the day...Show less

Author: 680martijna
Title: Diner
Review: We visited Wild Coriander for diner with a family (5 pax). The food is very nice and the service is friendly and excellent. Traditional Melaka taste with spicy elements.

Author: Wayfarer115Ottawa, Canada
Title: Overpriced & mediocore food
Review: We went there with high expectations based on several reviews. The restaurant is along the river and has a pleasant decor. Seemed like a pleasant spot to drink a few beers and eat some more refined food; but we were disappointed. The menu looked appetizing and items were priced significantly more than many local restaurants in town; but the fried noodles were very skimpy on ingredients and no better than what others serve in town for half the price or less. The wait staff tried to work hard, but delivering food to tables using a noisy cart on the tiled floor detracted from the dining experience as well. So, although the restaurant had many good points going for it (location, decor), it did not deliver on its intended mission.Show less

Author: Q435EUpeterl
Title: Nice and friendly place
Review: Good food in nice environment was our experience being a small family looking for tasty local food tonight in Melaka. To be recommended to families and smaller groups.

Author: marco365509
Title: Very nice
Review: Prob the best place on the river for couples, table next to the water, nice wood, good service, Carson is the guy you want to be served by, he is real good. Cold beers and nice dessert.

Author: capsicum0620Thailand
Title: Tourist trap
Review: Now...the challenge would be to hire a traditional Malaysian cook and have her/him blind tasting the dishes featured on the menu..My..my...... this place is to Malay cuisine what Taco Bell is to the Mexican gastronomy.Everything was bland beyond imagination, cooked hours (if not centuries) in advance and definitely too sweet. The Chicken from Hell (Approximate quote of its name on the menu),for example, was a disaster. A failed copy of a Massamam chicken any apprentice cook performs flawlessly in Thailand. When we asked for some chilli paste, the waiter told us "we are an Asian restaurant, Sir. We don't have any.." That sure left us wondering where we had landed.. We eventually ended up with a spoonfull of soja sauce with chopped chilli... As if Malaysia did not have any Sambal...Another of those impostures unmasked..Show less

Author: 563imret
Title: Very good
Review:
Excellent food and very friendly staff. Best spot to sit is the small outdoor terrace at the back on the river side .
Can recommend the ‘share’ dining option. Large enough portions. Most important everything tasts delicious!

Author: chanapatm
Title: Perfect place
Review: This place is absolutely recommended. Great location by the river with pleasant atmosphere. Staff is very attentive to recommend food choice to you. The menu is truly authentic to Melaka. Great place especially considering the taste, the view, the service and the price. Definitely recommended.

Author: miamiaaaa
Title: Lovely staff
Review: I received warm greeting from the staff here.he introduced me a nice pandan dessert. It’s so annoying that tripadvisor ask me to entry at least 50 words. I am think of deleting the app. Screw tripadvisorjdjdfbfhdjjddnjddkkskfnfkf學學課返兇猛學學考穿吻我第物秒看過能否再一次機會。但你自己都江堰支援服務中心人物之外！你自己說不定有沒有

Author: KevD168
Title: Good local food
Review:
Food was good, tasty and enough for two people. 
Place is very nice, not close from the Main Street and it’s good for enjoying a quiet and good diner. 
Spices are well dosed!
Service a bit slow

Author: laladabCambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food next to the river
Review: The food was amazing! Beef redang was out of this world, green curry was superb and I couldn’t have enough of their aubergines in vegetable sauce! The service was very good too. The space itself was beautiful, spotless and nicely decorated! Overall one of the best eateries in Melacca! Show less

Author: richardwarwick1969
Title: Wonderful highly recommended
Review: Great food (randang beef in particular). Great location just off the beaten track. Great, smiley service. Good value.

Author: Sebapetter
Title: Very cosy, good atmosphere and nice food
Review:
Very nice restaurant and friendly staff. Cosy location and tables by the river. 
The lamb shank was supreme! But the pineapple prawns was way to spicy - though they told us medium spicy.

Author: FelixMW87Munich, Germany
Title: Beautiful evening directly at the river with great service
Review: We (German couple 29 & 32) were there for dinner and had some great a little spicy food and a beautiful evening. You can bring along your own bottle of wine but have to pay ~15 Ringgit corkage The view is nice, prices are very very fair und the meals have an absolutely sufficient size. We honestly enjoyed the evening and can recommend this restaurant without a doubt. Show less

Author: Hannah M
Title: AMAZING FOOD AND SERVICE
Review: Im an expat living in KL and this was a brilliant restaurant for a weekend trip to Melaka. Great service, friendly, engaging and happy staff, that were efficient and helpful. Food was delicious and the freshly made ondeh-ondeh was the best I have had in 20yrs. Thank you so much ☺️Show less

Author: helentingg
Title: Delicious!
Review: We ordered the Wild Coriander special and nasi lemak with beef and chicken rendang respectively. Really good food in a lovely environment, service was wonderful as well. Will definitely recommend.

Author: dvrsty
Title: Great food fair prices
Review: Delicious food, nice variaty on the menu, friendly and helpfull staff and all for realy good prices.

Author: Exploration98626
Title: Great food, even better service.
Review: Really good food, a very pleasant environment and a staff who are suitably attentive without being intrusive.

Author: KimOfTheNorthNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Average food but great service and lovely setting.
Review: Alas, we thought the food was nice enough but very average. My husband had the Wild Coriander special platter, which he said was nice but very bland. I ordered the crab dish, which is the meat of one small soft shell crab mixed with spices and put back into the main shell with a small side salad. I then ordered a laksa which was nice. But the setting is beautiful if you sit outside, and the staff are friendly. We were served by a really lovely older chap who was very chatty and made us feel very welcome! So my star rating is just for the food. Definitely go here for the ambiance and maybe try some different meals.Show less

Author: mpmilestogo
Title: Very nice food!
Review: The restaurant is along a quieter part of the river which I appreciated for dinner. The beef rendang is most excellent but the rest of the food looked good too.

Author: Jessica1285
Title: Nice restaurant by the river!
Review: We had lunch here, nice waiters, incredibly tasty food, the tables by the river are great, such a beautiful spot to have a nice and chilled lunch! Cheap prices, definitely worth a visit!

Author: EricKlaessonJurong, Singapore
Title: Intense tasting experience
Review: One of the best food experiences we have had in SE Asia in 6 months. The Rendang is just excellent and really made with love. The service is good and all that, but it’s a waste of words to even mention it when the food is that good. It’s beautifully presented and a flavor explosion in your mouth. I’d go back to Melaka only for this restaurant.. (and the night market ofc, but that’s another story). Dont forget to look at the desserts. Maybe too sweet for some, but deliciousShow less

Author: WorkToTravel123Toronto, Canada
Title: Fantastic food, ambience, service
Review: We loved the food and ambiance here. There are seats outside next to the river which gives a very nice breeze and view. The food is excellent and reasonably priced. We had beef rendang for two, blue rice, coconut rice, and four beers for just 75myr (25$ cad). We ate here twice on our very short stay in Melaka. Note, the food can be very spicy so ask your waiter which dishes are mild. The service was also excellent.Show less

Author: JonasM1815
Title: Simply great, best choice
Review: Great location near the river (about 8 tables outside), authentic interior with tasty diches for reasonable prices (15-20 MYR/ main-dish). Very service minded staff. On a quiet Tuesday the restaurant was almost packed, so I only guess you should make a reservation in the weekend.

Author: Scharting_Smith
Title: Worst dinner in Malaysia
Review: The location is great but the food was very disappointing. I had a Green Chicken Curry and cannot remember having such a rubber like meat anywhere else in SE Asia. I definitley recommend to go for a different restaurant in Melaka.

Author: jessi1996x
Title: Great food and friendly staff
Review: Had some lunch here today and it was really nice! Lots of options on the menu and also great fresh drinks . My personal favourite was the Pie Tee. The staff are very nice too and the view is beautiful outside :)

Author: hazinheiraSingapore, Singapore
Title: New Year’s Eve dinner
Review: We booked the New year’s eve dinner here due to the fair amount of positive reviews on Tripadvisor. The staff gave us a huge table, as they were not really organizing themselves according to bookings. We ordered the laksa and a special dish with a variety of multicolored rice – my wife explained she was vegan therefore the staff said they would remove the egg from the dish. The laksa tasted amazingly but the special rice dish ended up by coming to the table with an egg half. We also tried the sago pudding for dessert – we asked for no sugar and this time we got exactly want we wanted and enjoyed it very much. The space is quite lovely, in an old house and with a lot of plants everywhere. The prices were okShow less

Author: martin wBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: Very acceptable local food
Review: Four of us staumbled upon this restaurant whilst strolling around and after talking to the staff and reviewing the menu returned for dinner. We ate a range of food, both meat and vegetarian. Everything we tried was terrific. Despite being Malay alcohol was served. Service was good and friendly. Toilets were clean. Nothing was rushed or delayed.Cannot recommend highly enoughShow less

Author: Mark B
Title: Great food and service
Review: Everything with a twist. My beef tending - nice and spicy and moist with tender meat. 4 different rice - white, coconut, turmeric and BLUE FLOWER. My partners Laksa so creamy. Very attentive waiter. Can sit out by the river or inside in the cool

Author: Hurrell4
Title: Excellent
Review: Went there on our first night in Melaka after being recommended by our hostel. Opted for one of the large meals between 2. Portion size was perfect and food quality exreamly high.

Author: Carlndndnd
Title: Friendly place, very nice Malaysian food
Review:
+ :
Excellent Malaysian food
Good value for food
Good spot
Very friendly people
Overall amazing

- :
Nothing except alcohol is more expensive than food

Author: diewald024
Title: Great
Review: Came here with a group of people, and one friend liked it enough to want to come here 3 days in a row (we were already planning to leave the day after so we only managed to come twice heh) Very nice food, and great friendly staff! Beef rendang highly recommended Show less

Author: E2742RYmichaelmGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely riverside eatery
Review: Set in a tastefully decorated shop house backing on to the river walk, this restaurant is always busy, a testament to its product. An intelligently designed menu that offers a mixture of local dishes from which it is difficult for a diner not to find something to like. Staff friendly, helpful and unobtrusive. Cold beer is available and they will accommodate the hardened imbiber with a corkage charge system. Ignore the negative whingers who are genetically programmed to find fault in everything. Sit outside in the cool breeze coursing down the river, enjoy the location and the lovingly prepared food. I defy you not to smile and agree its a great spot.Show less

Author: paultH1845XDSurbiton, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food by the river walk.
Review: As a starter for first time travelers to Melaka or Malaysia not conversant with Laksa or Rendang this could be for you. This restaurant provides a menu which has a mix of Western, Malaysian & Nyonya dishes, some being a fusion I felt to cater more for the Western palet. However, both the beef & chicken Rendang were very tasteful & delicious, with their own particular individual flavours. Laksa was also worth the try.Staff are very helpful in advising on menu choices. Paul T.Surrey, UK. Show less

Author: Sassy17th
Title: Wonderful location on the side of the river
Review: Great service and menu choices. A wonderful dessert which is the house speciality. Service was quick but not in your face disturbing your meal.

Author: Gerald KSingapore
Title: Average food in a place with nice decor and ambiance
Review: I read the great reviews of the food in this place and decided to try it out. Many said that the nonya food here was great, but I have tasted better in Melaka. The decor and ambiance is nice, and also the limited seating at the waterfront. However, I came here for the food.I ordered the pietee, the udang lemak nenas, the beef rendang, and the kueh ketayap. The taste of the food was not authentically nonya, and I would not rate this place a nonya restaurant/cafe. It also had things which are not traditionally nonya, like lamb shank. I would rate this place sort of a fusion food with nonya, malay, and western mix.Of all the food that we ate, the kuih dadar in the kuih ketayap tasted best, but the kuih dadar taste overpowered the taste of the coconut ice-cream, so if you order that desert, eat the coconut ice-cream first.Show less

Author: Alan_S_P_1956Greater London, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to eat
Review: This is a really nice place to eat, especially outside by the river. When I arrived there were no outside tables, but the owner quickly set one up for me. The food is very good with lots of flavour. The chicken Rendang was excellent. Two courses and a Mango Lassi = RM35 - Very good value. Definitely a place to visit.Show less

Author: Stravaig2
Title: Delicious food
Review: Very delicious food, read about it on TripAdvisor and just had to visit ourselves. It was really worth it. The different foods are all absolutely delicious. The rojak was really delicious and the chicken rendang also. Would definitely go back again.

Author: Seanjotadhg
Title: Absolute Bargain
Review: Location, Location,Location , without the price tag. A wonderful setting right on the river and come early to snap up a table. The cuisine is distinctly local and the price of such quality food makes this a destination worth visiting.

Author: julle0Cherating, Malaysia
Title: Nothing great, not even the view
Review: Food was below average. Signature meal contains four kind of rice and just a little bit side dishes. Didn’t taste any good. Price was cheap and so was the quality. Table by the river sounds nice untill the cruise ships goes by every 30 seconds! Can’t recommend this to anyone.Show less

Author: 152ians
Title: Perfect
Review: Amazing lunch with delicious food... look out for the chicken Rendang...mee Siam and ikan cencaru sumbat... as for the service... bravo and hats off to Carlson... made us feel like home... a must visit

Author: Gary_ChildersChilders, Australia
Title: Great Location- Efficient Staff- Worth Visiting
Review: Really enjoyed our meal at this restaurant. The meal was filling, the atmosphere excellent (loved the fact that you sat on a patio right next to the river) and the staff were very friendly. Most of the people sitting in the restaurant were Westerners and there were families there, so the place is very 'tourist friendly'. Beer was served and was a reasonable price. Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Relaxing patio by the river...
Review: Located right on the river walk, south bank, about 50 metres west of the Kg. Jawa pedestrian bridge. They have another entrance on Kanpung Pantai St. Seating both in and outside. This restaurant definitely caters to tourists, but manages to stay close to the Nyonya cuisine that Melaka is renowned for. There is a decent selection of dishes suitable for singles and couples, and another section of larger dishes aimed at bigger groups. Vegetarians are catered for, but vegans may want to step carefully........I had the Lemak Rice, nicely garnished with traditional sides (I love those fried anchovies!), served with an excellent bowl of Beef Rendang. The generous portions left no room for dessert. The menu also offers seafood, chicken, lamb and veggie options, and of course, Laksa!. The casual service was great, and the servers very friendly and informative. A drink, main course and dessert will lever about MYR 45 out of your wallet, including tax and tip.Show less

Author: Mary BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food and beautiful ambiance restaurant
Review: My family and I were in Melaka for 5 days and we only found Wild Coriander Restaurant on the 2nd last day and we all loved it. The ambiance of the restaurant was beautiful and rustic and it was by the river. The food was excellent and we tried nasi lemak, laksa and rojak and also the dry mee siam. The service personnel was very polite and professional. We went back there for lunch and dinner the last 2 days as it was such a pleasant and nice restaurant. I would highly recommend anyone in Melaka to visit Wild Coriander Restaurant by the river near Jonker areaShow less

Author: Pep GKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere, food so-so
Review: We picked this place for dinner as for some reason all the recommended Nyonya restaurants were shut on Thursday night. The restaurant is set in an old converted house, so it's beautiful inside - somewhat reminiscent of the museums Melaka is famous for.The menu had selections of either indivdual meals (think noodles or briyani rice options), and also family styled dishes for sharing with rice. The menu is mainly made of Malay dishes, rather than peranakan style.We opted for the lamb shank curry, and a beef rendang, assam prawns, some sort of ulam salad thing, curried aubergine, a round of rice, and also mee siam.Some of the food was good (lamb shank curry was very nice), but everything else was just so-so. Service was not attentive at all, and the food came very slowly - ie we had 2 dishes come with rice quite quickly, but then a long wait in between. With a family of 8 people this meant we were all just nibbling for a long while.Some of our ordered desserts also did not show up - and this could be because they were understaffed. On the night we were there they only had 3 servers with a whole bunch of tables full in the outside area facing the river, and 3 other big families (including us) inside the house.Overall, it was OK, and probably better for romantic drinks rather than a big family dinner!Show less

Author: Simone2346
Title: quite and reasonable
Review:
been there our last day in Melaka for early lunch.
Portions were big starting from appetizer , noodles and veggie too.
Do not order spicy unless you can handle it.....

Author: 2019hp
Title: Perfect year end dinner
Review: The place is cosy and beautiful. We tried few of the Nonya dishes and they were well done. Service staff was pleasant. Good food at Unbelievable prices.

Author: Angeline L
Title: Best Lunch in Malacca!
Review: Don’t miss out sitting by the river for lunch. Service and food were so personable and family-like. We didn’t want to get up and leave straight away after our meals :D Just enjoyed the tranquility of it. We’ll be back x

Author: Riiinainen
Title: Nice restaurant and good food!
Review: The food was very good (we ate prawns and vegetables with rice) and the service was quite a quick and good. I would recommend that place because of the river view and a comfy place to stay!

Author: KateM1981High Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, service slow
Review: Popped in after reading reviews and little else being open on a week night. It's a really nice setting which feels like someone's house, or you can sit on the river. The food was good, and very good value. Beef and chicken rendang were the best we'd tried in melaka. Coconut ice cream and local pandan pancake were also good along with the fresh orange juice. What let's this place down is some of the staff,not all as some were obviously working very hard. We waited nearly half an hour for our plates to be cleared. We guessed that each waiter had their own tables and our waitress had just given up and disappeared on her phone and no one else seemed to want to clear despite walking past numerous times. Eventually I asked another waiter to clear the table and he brought me the bill. Still hadn't cleared the plates. Our waitress reappeared and didn't seem in the slightest bothered about doing any more work that evening. I'd recommend the building and food and the friendly man who I guessed owned the restaurant but some other staff need a bit of training. Don't go if you're in a rush. Show less

Author: Rosemary03East Sussex, United Kingdom
Title: Cheerful and great setting
Review: This simple restaurant is situated directly on the river though there are tables inside. The abundant greenery outside is what caught our eye from the opposite bank. It is licensed, alcohol is served outside. We chose beef rendang and Thai chicken curry, both were delicious. A great choice.Show less

Author: tricam
Title: Not bad. Staff poor
Review:
We ordered the:
 Pie Tee - excellent.
 Omelettes - also excellent.
 Traditional house rendang special - tasted ok but they got the order totally wrong and forgot the rendang.
Staff were inattentive and communication was poor.

Author: MinaLim_KULKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic nyonya taste and ambience
Review: A perfect setting for family gatherings! My fav is the pineapple pajeri! The toasted desiccated coconut pineapple juice is out of this world! The family serving is generous, though overall it’s a little on spicy side. But that’s how nyonya should be right? Kuih ketayap (local pancake) is the best I have ever tasted! This will be one of my fav restaurant no doubt. Oh yes, the local staff (non Chinese staff) all speak mandarin! Show less

Author: chelva58Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: We went there for lunch. Called a few dishes, most of it were below average as compared to other restaurants in Malacca. In fact, when we were there, there were only 2 customers on a Saturday lunch time. I do not know how they got a good grading even though? Definitely will not recommend this restaurant to my friends. Show less

Author: heydd55Saint John
Title: Wild Coriander
Review: The food here was amazing and sat by the river in the afternoon shade was memorable.If it's too hot the sit inside the pleasant surroundings.The price was fair considering its for tourists.You can wave at the many boats passing by. Good place to meet fellow travellers.Show less

Author: Roy LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rustic venue with charming staff... food's not bad too!
Review: My second choice venue after the first one didn't work out coz first choice didn't open for lunch, and turned out to be a lucky mistake.Place was tricky to find on a fairly deserted street on a Sunday but the interiors made up for it with its Peranakan-feel shophouse and yard in the middle brightened by the open skylight (unlike those in Singapore which are glass-covered and feels sanitised in comparison). We picked right under the skylight and thankfully the weather was quite cooling and the ceiling fans were good enough to stave any heat.We tried a mix of different dishes. from laksa to dry mee siam to rojak.. Also had kueh pie tee and mushroom chicken. Will probably pick the dry mee siam as the favoured dish among the savoury but it was the dessert that won the day with both the conventional chendol and the durian chendol and also the local pandan pancake with ice cream (kuih ketayap). And the crown went to their special cake which was salted and sweet at the same time.Special mention to the staff as well who were earnest and tried their best despite the numerous changes in orders we gave them. They made the meal complete.Show less

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Charming & delicious
Review: We visited this restaurant on the strength of reviews and were not disappointed. Though this is an eatery, it feels like a home with adjacent 'rooms' that have a distinct feel about them. There is also outside seating by the river which is tranquil, but it is along a public footpath. The service was lovely (and patient) whilst we decided what to eat. We had the fruit rojak to start, my first time eating it. It was delicious - both sweet and savoury. I had beef rendang, wonderfully presented and very tasty! Each element of the dish was great which resulted in a wonderful lunch. We sat there for quite a while, enjoying the food and lovely, calm atmosphere. A definite stop in Melaka! Show less

Author: moses k
Title: Average food but good service
Review: The food is ok and the portions are reasonable. I tried the four rice beef rendang special. The beef was really good while the other dishes were ok. The service was good and the staff were attentive.

Author: jb5t0
Title: Great local and Asian food
Review: Love both Nasi Lemuk and Beef Rendang so I ordered both and was not let down. Both were 8 or 9 (out of 10). Service was 10, view was 11.

Author: David SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Riverside oasis
Review: This long, thin restaurant stretches back from the street to the river and is a short walk from the heart of Chinatown. Beyond the kitchen and outside are a handful of tables situated close to the water and fringed by attractive vegetation. It was actually pretty magical to watch the river boats cruising by as dusk fell, notwithstanding that between us and the restaurant was a quite well frequented public footpath. The service was attentive and really friendly. We loved the food: exceptionally tasty with a beautiful array of different coloured rice. A memorable place to round off our short stay in the city.Show less

Author: Zulazman28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ideal for tourists, locals maybe disappointed!
Review: Although decoratively a charming venue this is really "tourist central". The restaurant itself stretches from the road (its right in the centre of the old Malacca CBD so it's surrounded by merchants and tradesmen) to the river walk.It was after lunch time and by mid afternoon we were the only other table occupied. The other was a backpacking German couple who were travelling Asia and they ate several dishes with gusto. Asian food must be fascinating with exotic tastes and flavours.For a local it was too touristic. The food was cooked for a foreigners palate. Despite the reviews it was unexceptional and disappointing. Nonetheless the food was OK. I suppose for true local flavours you need to go to the typical stalls instead.However its as much for the ambiance! It's a beautiful building and worth the visit. The hot lemongrass, ginger and mint tea is great. Perfect for a rainy afternoon! Show less

Author: Warg57
Title: Good food and a nice place to eat
Review: We enjoyed eating here, not only because the food was good, but also because it was a lovely place to have dinner, and the staff were so helpful and individual.  We had a very pleasant evening.

Author: antandjuliebBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful riverside find!
Review: I was in Melaka for just 2 nights with my husband and son in October and while walking along the river we stumbled across Wild Coriander. Some other guests sitting outside told us how fab the food was, and after talking with the very charismatic host (so sorry we didn’t get your name) we got a table outside. The gentleman- who spoke many languages - recommended some meals for us, all of which were delicious. He then brought us four different puddings which were local specialities which we enjoyed. All staff were very friendly and service was very efficient and the meals were delicious. I would definitely recommend Wild Coriander for an enjoyable evening in beautiful Melaka Show less

Author: borneo88Miri, Malaysia
Title: Great setting and excellent food
Review: We saw this restaurant from one our Malacca River Cruise boat and liked the setting so we took a Grab car from the River Cruise terminal to the restaurant. The journey only took 5 minutes. We managed to get a table outside on the walkway next to the canal/river which was a great vantage point to take photos of the boats going by and observing life on the river. This restaurant offers local food and we decided on the Beef Rendang and Otak Otak and fresh vegetables. Both were excellent and the portions were generous. As dessert we decided on coconut ice-cream with a local pancake.The customers were mostly tourists like ourselves and service was efficient and friendly. They are great with kids. Come early as some of their favourite dishes sell out fast. Wild Coriander is not a gourmet restaurant but offers excellent local food in a unique setting. Dinner for 2 including one beer and a soft drink came to RM 80.00Show less

Author: NoobabLondon, United Kingdom
Title: We walked out
Review: This is the first time I give somewhere just 1/5 on trip advisor.We waited for 10 minutes in the foyer. Every single staff member that walked past just ignored us, we could see the restaurant wasn't completely full. Eventually we interrupted someone to ask if they had space and if they accepted credit cards. The staff member said "We take US dollars" and then walked away. We left and no one seemed to mind. This experience was contrary to all the hospitality we encountered elsewhere in MalaysiaShow less

Author: 58gayathrij
Title: Wonderfull feeling
Review: We had dinner here...the place suprised me...it was jst magical...a place of fusion of culture...the food was good and the portion was excellent...mst say the staffs were so great they sure know to steal your heart...my little one wantted a jingle bell frm the xmas tree...and tey let her have it...its a magical placeShow less

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Very Delicious Local Favourites
Review: The stayed next to this restaurant in our previous stay in Malacca but we didn’t aware of this gem. The food was superb, portion is big, and reasonably priced. We tried nasi lemak with beef rendang, pai tee, curry laksa, rojak & cendol! All were soooo delicious and fresh. Show less

Author: Sarah_dorozBrisbane, Australia
Title: So good we went back a second time!
Review: This place was amazing...lovely and quiet sitting right by the river, friendly service and relaxed atmosphere. Food came out so fast. First night we had the beef rendang special and tonight I had the noodles and my partner got the chicken rendang. Also had to get the little pie entrees - delicious. Highly recommend it!Show less

Author: 594eileenhThatcham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely meal - lovely peoplle
Review: My friend and I had a meal at Wild Coriander this evening. The waiter who served us was so friendly and helpful - he made us feel very at home and well looked after. The place itself is lovely - such a nice atmosphere. We started with spring roll and curry puff, then we had Mee Siam Special and the vegetarian Wild Coriander special. The food was really tasty. We’d really recommend this restaurant for anyone visiting Melaka, both for the food and the friendly service.Show less

Author: Alex H
