Title: A tender evening
Review: A second try (the day before they were closed) we don't regret. A delicious meal nicely served sitting on the terrace alongside the river. Looks like the staff loves their job serving with a smile. This all for a very reasonable price

Author: Ferenc SBudaors, Hungary
Title: The best restaurant in Melaka
Review: I found it at tripadvisor and I was not disappointed at all. The restaurant is in a wonderful location on the riverbank, fortunately we got place on the terrace. The staff is very friendly and will help you choose. There are smaller, larger portions, everyone finds the taste appropriate. We ate a wonderful soft and delicious lamb's our friend's vegetarian dish. Prices were friendly, 100 MYRs were on the bill. I really recommend it .Show less

Author: YaseLisa
Title: Very delicious and authentic malaysian food!
Review:
We don't eat meat or fish and found here tatsy delicous vegetarian dishes wich we ate with rice!
We had mixed veggies and the eggplants!
With a water and a little dessert we payed only 30myr at all!

Author: Martkozl
Title: Great spot in malacca
Review: Definitely recommend this place when you’re in malacca, neat decor and great local food.  Service was very friendly.  Try the pie tee, delicious.

Author: aoidinc
Title: Fantastic service, tasty well presented food
Review: Extremely helpful and funny waiter - gave us brilliant advice on what to order and was just so welcoming. Food was delicious - I went for the vegetarian special and wow. The combination of flavours worked very well and there was a really good mix of healthy fruit and veg with the rice and currys. Also the dish was just so well presented - very pretty. Generous portions. My friends all really enjoyed their meat and fish dishes. Would definitely recommend. Show less

Author: macksterz
Title: Best Rendang in town
Review:
Very nice restaurant. We had a table outside next to the river. Food is ridiculous tasty and nice.

Go there and you won't be disappointed. Prices reasonable.

Service okay and friendly

Author: Paulus v
Title: one of the best rendangs in a month time traveling!
Review: A bit on the pricey side for malaisian standards but the beef rendang is devine! Their terrace is nicely located and if you are lucky you will be spotted by and waved at by a group of chinese visitors on a canal boat.

Author: NielsG114
Title: Great meal, good service
Review: Carson, the young waiter, gave good advice about the food, the place and in general. He really knows how to make the costumers feel welcome, talkative with a good sense of humour and good knowledge, and still respecting you to enjoy the food on your own.The food is delicious, very good value for money. The place it self very cozy and nice. 100 % satisfied. Show less

Author: AnnaKalraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Many items from the menu are from outside
Review: We came to this restaurant because it was highly rated on Tripadvisor. I am gluten free and I asked the staff about some items and they said "we don't know if it is gluten-free, because it comes from outside". So, otak-otak, fruit rojak, crab flower cake and rice noodles were confirmed to be from outside producer. That was disappointing, that food was not freshly cooked.We have tried 5 items (rice, brinjal, fruit rojak...) and taste was ok.Show less

Author: LoveTravel824537
Title: Fantastic Beef Rendang!
Review: We loved the nice atmosphere and amazing food in this restaurant. Very friendly staff.Great view on the river.

Author: SmileypokeyPenticton, Canada
Title: Very good food, service and ambiance.
Review: Very good food, service, and ambiance at this restaurant. We had Beef Redang, Flower Crab (1 between 3 just for the taste), Bok Choy with Garlic, Butterfly Rice, and the Brinjal (eggplant in sauce). With 2 beer and 1 hot tea, bill was 93 MYR. I think I would opt for the Coconut Rice next time as the Butterfly Rice is a bit gummy. The Beef Redang, the Brinjal and the Bok Choy were excellent although the sauce for the Beef Redang and the Brinjal are similar. The Flower Crab is tasty but quite like a crab cake in a shell. Overall, highly recommend.Show less

Author: brian sSydney, Australia
Title: Amazing food and service
Review: This is the best restaurant that i have been to in Malaysia. The food has amazing flavour and the servings are quite large (believe the menu when it says for 2 people) a beef rendang for 2 costs rm$23 and a laksa for 2 cost rm$13 rice rm $1.5. I have eaten hear 3 times and everytime it has been amazing.Show less

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Wow!
Review: Went for lunch on a very hot day and what an oasis this was. Very pretty decor with nice greenery indoors and the iced lemongrass, ginger and lime drink was perfect thirst quencher. It came recommended but I was blown away by the food. The special mee dish I had came with lettuce, a first for me for a noodle dish, but a great addition. The Nasi lemak and chicken rendang was also beautifully presented and tasty. Reasonable price and with the option to eat out by the river a good option for dinner too. Show less

Author: Aba1968Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty Malay food
Review: We ended up in this restaurant by chance when a River View restaurant waiter took us to the Wild Coriander. The place is nicely decorated. We had different dishes to share and they were all delicious. One of the waiters had a bit of an attitude but we just ignored it. We had a pleasant meal at a reasonable price and were able to discover some of the Malay delicaciesShow less

Author: SophieN1451
Title: Best food in Asia!
Review: Came here last night for a dinner with friends and was completely blown away but the delicious food, the amazing ambiance and the super friendly staff. The food was impeccable and doesn’t break the bank. It is so worth a trip down to wild coriander, especially if you can get a seat outside by the river! Thanks for a wonderful evening :) xxxShow less

Author: charlescasual
Title: Flavourful dinner
Review: Located in the heart of Melaka, Wild Coriander offers a great selection of Asian cuisine with the local flavour twist. Highly recommended to order Pie Tee as appetizer! The servers were very friendly and helpful. It was a soothing and relaxing dinner here.

Author: RobynBSydneySydney
Title: Ambience is wonderful
Review: Location and service are perfect.We had 2 dishes both served with rice - lots of it! Beef rendang was good, the vegetable curry underwhelming. I was expecting more vegetables and not 4 scoops of rice, admittedly that is what the picture showed. Better to order individual dishes with rice on the side rather than a set meal. Show less

Author: Babette E
Title: Perfect!!
Review: The food was really amazing! Lamp shank is a must try! Crab, rendang and pie are all delisious!! Friendly staff and nice admosphere.

Author: larapierotti
Title: Included in Top 10 Gluten Free Restaurants, didn’t offer single thing.
Review: This restaurant is included in the “Top 10 Gluten free restaurants in Melaka,”. I went in and asked about gluten free options and showed my gluten free card in Malay and they told me they couldn’t offer me anything. I told they I could eat rice and vegetables without any Soy Sauce and Oyster Sauce and they refused to make me anything. For a restaurant that is in the Top 10 Best GF restaurants to not make anything suitable is misleading and dissapointing.Show less

Author: Travelicious_K
Title: Casual dining
Review: Absolutely loved this place. The ambiance is very relaxing. I would recommend sitting outside by the river. The food is good and cheap.

Author: MnS24
Title: Great dinner
Review: In Malaka for a few days and decided to try Wild Coriander. Fantastic setting next to the river. Staff really friendly. We both had the beef rendang which was just perfect.

Author: RaymondisaiahSingapore, Singapore
Title: NOT THE BEST / authentic, local / peranakan restaurant. MORE OF AN LOCAL INDONESIAN RESTAURANT.
Review: WANT TO HEAD DOWN HERE FOR A MEAL? HEAR ME OUT FIRST. Headed down here for a dinner (with my family) and was utterly dissapointed. THE beef rendang, the beef was tough and dry. It was coated with a sauce which was full of peanuts and star anise in flavor. Tasted more like an indonesian style of rendang as compared to a peranakan style. Not suitable for kids / people who cannot take spice. As it was over spicy.The Samabal Udang, Prawns were undercooked, some parts of the prawns were raw. The sauce was just spicy and had not much taste to it.The Kueh Pie Tee, Nothing special, it was bland and just an average dish.The Chap Chye. This is A real insult to the peranakan style chap chye. As it was cooked in a weird pink sauce, the taste was plain weird. We had one mouth and just gave up on it. (The rest is history.)The Achar awak, nothing much to say. It was nothing special / plain and do not taste anything like a peranakan style of achar awak.The Mushroom Chicken, Bland chicken chunks (I dont think they even bother to season it). Even the sauce cant save this dish as the sauce was bland and the only flavor we could taste was the overwhelming taste of star anise. The Lamb Shank, the Only dish which was somewhat edible. Lamb was tender, but the sauce tasted almost similar to the dark sauce (kechap manis) which is use for indonesia BBQ food.Overall The only saving Grace of this restaurant is the overwhelming number of tourists (who may not know / have yet try out authentic peranakan dishes) that deems this is the best / real peranakan dishes. Afterall its interior deco was interesting and they have outdoor dining by the river. Maybe that whats attracting the crowd. Who knows?Servers were rather friendly and attentive to out needs. Good job on that.TO AVOID DISSAPOIMENT DO GIVE IT A MISS. I know its affordable but i would rather you spend your money elsewhere. If not you are always welcome to try it out and have your say on it.Show less

Author: TomGuppySherborne, United Kingdom
Title: Simply wonderful
Review: Food ☑️Service☑️Setting☑️Food was fantastic! My wife and I chose beef rendang for a main with a different rice option each. We order pak choi as a side and a starter 'pie tee' (mini vegetable pies). All was superbly presented. Beef rendang was incredible, one of the best I've ever tasted. Service was brilliant throughout. Meals came together, in good time. One of the waiters was excellent with our 2 year old daughter. Setting is simple beautiful. Out the back of the restaurant is the river and there is a seating area. Food and drinks are reasonable. Fantastic experience, can see why others like it. Show less

Author: NazhiraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!
Review: Came here for lunch with my family. We were one of their first customer as they open at 12pm. Was a little skeptical about the place as it was empty at the time. But when the food arrived, super yummy! Sambal udang, masak lemak nenas, bendi cili oh so yumms. Dont forget to try their superbly delicious cendol Show less

Author: SingaporelonegrangerSingapore, Singapore
Title: So sedap (delicious)!
Review: We were a hungry group of nine and we proceeded to order many items. All were delicious. The kueh pie tee was scrumptious and warranted a second order. The beef rendang was wonderfully flavoured and the devil's curry had a kick which we relished! The eggplant had an unusual thick gravy which we also enjoyed. For dessert, I ordered chendol which was outstanding - it was beautifully displayed and generously drizzled with salted gula melaka. One slight downer was I wanted to add a scoop of coconut ice cream but they could not oblige. No matter! Just order the ice cream separately and heap it on yourself - so decadent but oh so good! The best part of the meal was that it was easy on the pocket.Show less

Author: 401limj
Title: good food
Review: good environment, good food, good service. The green curry is hot and spicy. But delicious. But parking less.

Author: SparkzJordanLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Reasonably priced local food in a nice setting.
Review: A lovely little restaurant in a heritage listed building situated by the river and away from busy Jonker street. Very romantic setting if you choose to dine outside. The menu is short and sweet with a good selection of local cuisine at a very reasonable price. We chose the Beef Rendang with achar awak, Chicken with Mushrooms and Bok Choy in a garlic and oyster sauce with an extra portion of rice. The restaurant was very busy as it was Saturday night so it took a little while to order but the food all came out hot and correct. The beef was amazingly tender but the rendang sauce wasnt the best as it was extremely pastey and hard to enjoy. The chicken with mushroom was good with 4 pieces of thigh meat on the bone and some large mushrooms in a nice light sauce. The bok choy had awesome flavour and cooked just right although it was kept in it's bulb which was a nice presentation technique but was hard to eat without a knife to cut it. All in all a good experience as the beer was also very reasonably priced compared to a lot of other restaurants in Melaka, my only suggestion would be to visit for lunch or early evening to avoid the hectic rush.Show less

Author: chloesworld_7Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Nice spot by the river, but felt under staffed
Review: Ate here on a Sat evening and it was pretty busy. With only one main waiter on duty you could feel the pressure. However, the food wasn’t bad for the price. We ordered the beef Rendang, which was tender and full of flavour however the sauce was very thick and patsy. Mushroom chicken was nice, and the Bok Choy sauce was fantastic, but it would have been nice if separated more (still being connected at the stalk made it difficult to eat. Overall, it is a nice setting and if in the area for a couple of night I would recommend it. Show less

Author: KendirgiQuebec City, Canada
Title: Beautiful restaurant and good food!
Review: The Wild Coridander propose a good menu. I took a lemongrass and ginger limonade, it was so good. I tried to find some today but I haven't seen the drink anywhere else. My husband and I both had Rendang we were very happy with our choices. The presentation is impeccable and the food is delicious. There was four different kind of rice in my plate and it was very interesting to taste de difference between all of them. The prices are honest for what you get. Of course, it is more expensive then eating at the market but much more agreable!!!! The setting of the restaurant, by the river, is charming.Show less

Author: mgsteinPhiladelphia, PA
Title: Ridiculously inexpensive for great food
Review: We were in Melaka on a tour and our tour guide recommended this restaurant. I had previously read about it on TripAdvisor so we went willingly. I don’t like really spicy but others in our group do like spicy food. There was something for everyone and we all were very happy with our choices. I highly recommend the French beans with garlic and black bean sauce and the mango banana smoothie. Others had the rendang and really liked that. Show less

Author: Eva M
Title: Nice visit
Review: Laska was very very fishy was not a fan. But the chicken rendang was very nice. Wasn’t a lot on the individual menu but there was a sharers menu! Prices are ok

Author: hannesontrip
Title: nice location at the river
Review: excellent location at the shores of the river, go there just around sunset and enjoy the atmosphere. Watch closely the river as monitors are frequently spotted. Menu has the usual choice of Laksa dishes, rather for Western taste, but totally ok for one evening

Author: Nyet2013San Diego, California
Title: Spicy Food
Review: The restaurant happens to be next to our hotel and we went because of good reviews.The restaurant ambience is quint, seems clean. There is even an outdoor sitting by the river but we passed because of a faint unpleasant smell from the river.Indoor is nicely decorated in floral/plants theme. The waiter was friendly and helpful.We ordered the typical local Nyonya food, with blue flower rice, rendang and laksa. However, we both found the food very spicy and barely okay for us to eat. (and we do LIKE spicy foods, just not that spicy!) :) But it was very fragrant though. Prices were not expensive,not cheap either.Show less

Author: BahrainbabeSofia, Bulgaria
Title: Lovely restaurant decor. Food ok.
Review: I was surprised that this restaurant has such amazing reviews! The food was fine. Nothing more than that. We had omelette- you can’t go wrong with that for kids! Beef rendang- I really liked the meat but the sauce paste was strange and after a while I couldn’t eat it. The chicken green curry which was overly spicy and not very tasty. The chicken had lots of small bones in it. The bok choy in garlic which was just horrible. The bok choy needs to be pulled apart first and then the sauce can marinate it. The pieces were way too big and hard and the sauce couldn’t penetrate the layers! The rice was lovely and I liked the waiters a lot. Bit disappointed but the price was amazing Show less

Author: Julia V
Title: Delicious!
Review: Very good food and beer for a small price. Nasi melak beef rendang is recommended. You should definitely go there when you visit Malaka.

Author: pen0809
Title: Nice setting but average food
Review: The starters we had - top hats and rojak - were great, but the main courses were not exceptional.  The service was rather slow (even when bringing our drinks) and the management a bit chaotic. The setting was lovely by the river.

Author: harrietjuh
Title: Friendly staff, good food!
Review: We went here after finding out that the place we had actually selected waa closed when we got there. So it was kind of a guess. We are happy to have ended up here because the food was really great. I I could go again I would and not bother about trying any other place. This is is absolutely the one to go to. The food is super and prices are very reasonable. Excellent value for money.Show less

Author: 901stanleylSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice friendly dinning
Review: Went for early dinner.Place was not crowded yet.Staff are friendly and recommend many dishes for us to try.End out , have to ask them to packet the balance as we could not finish them. Their special drink was avocado from no which was deliciousShow less

Author: LipSengYap
Title: Heritage Dining by the River
Review: The restaurant is within a heritage building, tastefully decorated to suit its identify, with outdoor seating by the river. Get a taste of improvised Melaka cuisines while enjoying the view.

Author: Kathy BMelbourne, Victoria, Australia
Title: Perfect
Review: The setting for Wild Coriander is beautiful with outside tables facing the river. We ate inside and the decor is delightful, set in a traditional tube house with lots of antique details. Service is attentive with good English spoken and an English menu. Food was excellent and prices cheap for the quality of food.Show less

Author: Meg T
Title: Brilliant Food
Review: Very tasty beef rendang curry, could do with a bit of bread with it to mop up the curry, but rice was nice enough with it. Would eat here again!

Author: June V
Title: recommended
Review: The best in Malaga. I try so many dishes around jonker street and found out this restaurant serves the finest and favour dishes. Highly recommended to everyone.

Author: TanakaWootay
Title: WOW!!!
Review:
Best Malaysian food around!! Been in Malaysia for quite some time now- in and out!!
Found this place on a simple- but fun river walk!!
Try everything- top hats, rendang, green Currie vegetables!! Dumplings!!!

Author: peterwM1651HE
Title: Authentic and friendly dining in pleasant surroundings
Review: Best dinner in Malaysia with super-friendly and amusing service. Loved the Nasi Lamak with Beef Rendang. Great value and cool decor.

Author: marlonccSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great experience
Review: We walked in on a Saturday evening for dinner without a reservation. He place was busy and we were lucky to get one of the last tables in the restaurant - all the outdoor tables by the river were taken. The beef rendang was probably the best that we’ve ever eaten. The stuffed flower crab and brinjal cooked in a spicy- sweet sauce was also very nice. The portions are large and the three of us couldn’t finish what we ordered. Can’t wait to go backShow less

Author: mclarennn
Title: Best Asian food in Melaka
Review: The food was really amazing, and good recommendations by the staff overall we had a amazing dinner. I like the beef rendang that was really amazing. Highly recommended and definitely will come back again.

Author: jaysantosphMakati, Philippines
Title: Big servings, okay Malaysian food
Review: The overall draw with be the table sitting along the river. It was quite a view at night. No mosquitoes as some pointed out here.The service can be a bit slow (it was a full house) but the staffs are attentive.The beef and chicken rendang with 4 types of rice viands were good. The rojak was to my liking as well. The sour plum drink is ordinary.Try the place for a good dinner.Show less

Author: Los_BubusQuito, Ecuador
Title: A must in Melaka
Review: A great option if you want to try a traditional malay food! We ordered the pie tee and the lamb great plates for sharing! They had a nice drink menu full of local fruit juices and teas! The service excelent!!!! Our server was funny and helpful. Prices standard for restaurants in the area. Show less

Author: WNFdiary
Title: We kept coming back!
Review: The crunchy appetizer - Pai Tee, Nyonya Chap Chye - light vegetable soup, strong Udang Masak Lemak Nenas or simplified Prawns with Pineapple soup and Rice cooked in four different ways were all delicious. Completely different and all very good. You can imagine we were full after that but when the main course is so good there is always some room for dessert. Their homemade coconut ice-cream with Gula Melaka syrup was the one that we still can't forget. For that one, we kept returning for the rest of our stay in Melaka and ended up buying some Gula Melaka to take with us. Otherwise, the staff was kind and happy to help us with any questions regarding their food and in general about Melaka. The restaurant was clean and nice looking. We especially liked the open part next to the bar and the outside terrace which is right next to the river. This is the place we highly recommend visiting, for a detailed description of each dish and other Melaka suggestions feel free to visit our blog WNFdiary.Show less

Author: annalisab716
Title: Excellent!
Review: The food is perfect for us . its a bit spicy the pineapple prawn though but we dont mind its just so yummy! Must try Pie tree and pineapple prawn. This is our 2nd visit in Wild Corriander and we never get over with it. Thank you guys !.All staff were so friendly.Show less

Author: GraceN1010
Title: Good service
Review: Good service, the staff were very friendly and helpful. Food is a little blend for my liking. However the beef rendang is very tender.

Author: Lpulitude
Title: Nice cosy restaurant
Review: Good peranakan fusion food. Nostalgia setting and nice background music. Must try their Chendol. Reasonably pricing.

Author: 350suebWeston super Mare, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: Looked at reviews on trip advisor and decided to give this place a go! We were not disappointed! Quirky little place by the river, but food was fabulous!! Never had blue rice before but certainly will again! Beef rendang was really tasty! Staff friendly and helpful regarding amounts to order and what to have! The salted egg custard layered cake was beautiful- as was the pancakes with coconut ice cream! Lovely meal- and with drinks for 2 of us was under £25. Really good! Show less

Author: BSmith25
Title: Local food in lovely setting
Review:
The setting is really lovely, we sat outside by the river early evening and it was beautiful. 
Friendly and helpful service.
Plenty of Malaysian dishes to choose from, mostly costing the equivalent of approx £2.50 - £3. The fruit rojak was really good!

Author: worldwidetempleLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food, good prices
Review: We had a pleasure of visiting this restaurant after 4 weeks of travel in Malaysia and I can honestly tell that this was the best of all the moderately priced places that we have visited. The food was superb, the starters surprising, the mains fulfilling and the local drinks exquisite. We didn't have room for any desserts, but they all looked so tempting. Plus the service was super kind and efficient. I had a pleasure to meet the chefs and congratulate them on their efforts - they were super humble and grateful. I wish I could come back some day... And I wish you all the best, guys!Show less

Author: Noriko NTokyo, Japan
Title: Full of taste, kindness and sofistication
Review: I visited Wild Coriander in the middle of my city exploring on a burning day. This cafe was like an oasis and definitely I picked a right place to hydrate and cool down myself.Everybody both customers and waiters looked happy in the traditional styled interior with a lot of greeneries. Following to the friendly and kind waiters' welcome, I enjoyed nice Chendol, shaved ice desert filled with Malacca's iconic black sugar "gla melaka" as well as Onde onde, a Pranakan sweets also full of gla melaka. Their tiny but powerful Onde onde was the best for me among all that I have tried in Singapore and Malaysia. I found they also had a nice tables outside along the river. I was not in a mood of drinking at that time, but was sure it would be extremely nice to enjoy a glass of cold white wine in that table area. As they do not serve wines so far, you can bring your own with only RM15 corkage charge. Lists of beer such like Tiger are already available.I went back to ramble about in the town again, and found I didn't have enough time to catch my bus to go back to Singapore. I remembered one of the waiters at Wild Coriander suggested me I should look for them if I needed to catch a Grab as I had no wi-fi access on that day. Thank them, I was able to catch my bus just before it left.Definitely Wild Coriander became a memorable part of my visit in Malacca. Looking forward to visiting them again.Show less

Author: RogerE505
Title: Great authentic lunch
Review:
Nice heritage building, good location facing the river, well decorated, good service though the music was slightly too loud.
Excellent house special tasting plate with 4 different rices and yummy beef rendang.
Simple and good value for money!

Author: Nina_MostMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great Rojak
Review: Seatings is inside and outside. We choosed to sit outside, table for two, next to the river.I loved my refreshing drinks from lemongrass, ginger and lime. They have not been too sweet, just as I like it. For dinner we have had entry Rojak. And it was delicious! This is fruit bowl in special sauce. For meal we did have Wild coriander signature dish chicken rendang with 4 different rices. It was ok. We have ordered Nyonya mixture of vegetables but didn't like it. Service was excellent and guys are doing a great job.Show less

Author: JimmyLancaster
Title: Excellent service and great food!
Review: We’ve had the beef rendang and it was lovely! The staff is very kind and try to make you feel comfortable with some jokes, but definately know how to make some excellent Malay food! A definate recommendation!

Author: 120xinc
Title: Awesome!
Review: This place is one word. Awesome. The staff is so helpful and the food is great. There was a bothersome mosquito and a staff member took the time to make a mosquito repellent. 100% will come back.

Author: TanakaWootay
Title: Wild and yummy!
Review:
Great local fare!!
Great little action on the canal
Easy to walk from center of Melaka
Nice wait staff and buses!!
Great decor!
Good energy

Author: R H
Title: Beautiful food, beautiful location
Review: We were lucky enough to get a table outside by the river and could enjoy the lovely atmosphere. The menu covers all bases, and the food we ordered came promptly. Delicious and interesting menu, with great staff.

Author: Tonyscribbler
Title: Rendang curries were fabulous.
Review: Whilst the riverside is nice, don't fall in, as you will probably not surface again.  Therefore having an excellent rending curry to distract you from the water is a major bonus.  These, chicken and beef, were on of the best.  Flavours were beautiful.

Author: savourynotsweetGeneva, Switzerland
Title: generous portions, good food, but a bit weird
Review: On the plus side, this is a very quirky little place to eat with interesting furnishings and the portion sizes are very generous. However, there isn't actually a huge choice of dishes. I had the nasi lemak with chicken rendang which was very tasty but not outstanding. Given the price I expected something special.Maybe it was because the place was almost empty but there was a sort of weird atmosphere from the staff. Can't put my finger on it but it didn't feel relaxing here. No one bothered to say bye after we'd paid. 3.5 is a more accurate score and I wish TA would change the scoring because the difference between 'average' and 'very good' can be substantial.Show less

Author: Spectrum83Boulogne-Billancourt, France
Title: Disappointing
Review: I don't really understand the good reviews about this restaurant. Yes, the place looks very nice, beautiful and the chairs are comfortable. Quantities of food are generous. But the taste is not here: very spicy but lake of salt or something I would say. Plus one of the waiters was a bit pretentious and try (too much) to make us order several things we did not want. They did not come to put off our plates. We had to go and see them to order dessert. Chendol is ok.Show less

Author: Rob S
Title: Thought I'd gone to heaven.
Review: The nasi lemak with beef rendang was to die for !!! Great service, view and friendly staff. What more is there to say?

Author: KiridarenJ
Title: Can try rojak
Review:
Came for lunch to get rojak , was quite great. Dinner was a little bit meh, as the food terribly lacked oomphhh..or in other words , lacked salt. The worker very hardworking and friendly too.

Should try but don't get your hopes high.

Author: Excursion769963
Title: nice view and friendly service💕
Review:
川沿いの素敵な風景とお洒落なインテリアを楽しめました。
店員さんもフレンドリーでGood!
デザートも可愛い感じでした。

We enjoyed delicious food and nice view!
In addition, interior of restaurant was very fashionable.
And because clerk was very friendly, we had a good experience of Malaysian food(^-^).

Author: Ulf H
Title: Nice outdoor sitting close to the river
Review: Good food but stressed person who tried to serve all tables. Forgot what we ordered. The food we got was fantastic.

Author: Steve W
Title: Straightforward food in lovely setting
Review: We ate twice here- once with family who live in Johor. Good choice in sharing menu and spice level not too bad for Europeans!We sat inside both times and very relaxed. Service was ok for us both times.Beef Rendang well prepared and laksi excellent. The blue rice will test you.Show less

Author: cityvisitor208Cheshire, United Kingdom
Title: Feeling & atmosphere ! Great experience
Review: We ate at this restaurant late at night just before they closed about 10.25pm. We sat outside by the river. The setting was magical. The food was really excellent. Two delicious vegetarian starters - “top hats” little vegetable pies in wafer thin pastry cups, and crunchy veg in a spicy sauce. Then chicken and beef with rice. Finally salted egg custard cake - eggy sponge layered with a sweet buttercream, and chendol. We drank fresh carrot juice. The waiter Carson was fabulous - really friendly, helpful and entertaining.Show less

Author: Anh N
Title: It was perfect!
Review: I had the Nasi Lemak with chicken and even though it was too big of a portion for me I enjoyed every bite of it! It really hit all the notes. The mango banana smoothie and the friendly service rounded up everything perfectly.

Author: Daniel4242
Title: Bad food and service
Review: Sitting outside at the river is the nice thing at Wild Coriander. Service is slow and unorganized, food bad to mediocre. I cannot understand the good reviews here. Have a drink and eat somewhere else.

Author: FloreGdr
Title: Great place to try malaysian food by the river
Review:
Really good food with local meal (and good quantity). Prices are around 20 RM
The waiters are very nice and the location incredible !!

Author: B1008Ryan
Title: Chicken Rendang Rice
Review: Can share each other if want try another thing. Nice place and nice view if u got table near by the river.

Author: Jennifer DWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Great ambience!
Review: Great location - try to get table out by river. Beautiful setting inside and out. Staff efficient. I thought the food was ok but would not rave over it. Had beef rendang and found it a bit dry. I am sure there would be other dishes that would have been better.Show less

Author: AnnieW1734
Title: Lovely waiter lovely food lovely location lovely lovely
Review: We found this restaurant from TripAdvisor and were not disappointed. We had a sweet table by the river with the sun setting and the food was delicious. I can't actually remember what we had exactly but it was definitely very good. Our waiter Carson was fantastic - really friendly and attentive, even though it was busy and he had a lot of tables. He recommended a super tasty pandan cake for dessert which I wish I could eat every day. He is number one.Show less

Author: Expat_TravellerSG
Title: Lovely setting & wonderful food!
Review: This is a great little find! Relaxed, informal and most importantly wonderful food. I highly recommend the beef rendang, which is one of the best I’ve had in a very long time! The Mee Siam is excellent as well.

Author: Stay74544
Title: Lovely restaurant on the river
Review: Great food and happy, welcoming staff. Ate there twice for dinner. They have a few tables outside which have a lovely view onto the river.Worth a visit. Would recommend the beef rendang. Their beer is also a good price when compared to other nearby places. Show less

Author: LottaH416
Title: Cheap but not tasty
Review: Malaysian food. The portion was big, but the food was not tasty. Surprised because this restaurant has so good reviews in tripadvisor.

Author: Flitz8
Title: Good food by the river
Review: Had a chicken rendang special,the portion size was big and price was good .Overall meal was good but could be better .View by river is really lovely

Author: IndySig
Title: Nice dinner
Review: We had a couple appetizers and a bowl of soup out along the river. Our waiter was very nice and the food was good. Nothing outstanding, just nice and very reasonable.

Author: TheNayzerPhuket, Thailand
Title: Great ambient
Review: Wild Coriander is located right by Melaka river. It can be accessed from the river walk or the Main Street. We ordered signature rendang which was average. Drinks were ok. Service was quick. Special thanks to the staffs who patiently get Grab car for us and entertained us while we were waiting. Show less

Author: Itchy-Feet_AundMAarau, Switzerland
Title: Malay food at its best in a nice location
Review: We were welcomed superfriendly and led to an inside table as the outside seating was full. We ordered two starters and a main to share and everything we had was simply delicious. I fell in love with pie tee! The nutmeg drink was also very good and a good pairing with the food. Well done guys!Show less

Author: Marika_Jose2015Kyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Beautiful and tasty!
Review: We went to this cafe for lunch by recommendation of our guesthouse owner. The cafe is in old historic building, with a back terrace facing the Melaka river, where you can enjoy the view, and it’s beautifully decorated inside. We really enjoyed our food and atmosphere. And the prices are not too expensive too. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: RoxanneLee1002Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed...like really
Review: The environment is really nice, however comes with mosquitos as well -.- ordered the beef rendang special and laksa...i must said so so only, nothing special and it's not like delicious also...the worst is the milo ice, no taste at all! I never had milo so nipis before! Totally unacceptable for a local like me! If you just want to chill with drink is ok, but it's definitely not a place to have delicious yummy meal, i rather go eat chicken rice lo...Show less

Author: billyw784Bramcote, United Kingdom
Title: Average.
Review: While the food is ascetically pleasing it wasn't actually very good.The chicken reading as part of the lager dish of different rice, well it was all bone and no more than a spoon full of chicken in total, the prawn/pineapple curry had a good amount of prawns but they were whole in their shells and hadn't been cleaned so they were still full of poo.Saying all of that the garlic and oyster green beans and the mango/banana smoothly was very nice Show less

Author: Alan W
Title: Oasis in Melaka
Review: Great place to have quiet meal in Melaka by the river.  Excellent variety, fantastic value - around 50 RM for two with beer.

Author: SupersonicJem
Title: Good food good ambience
Review:
Was searching for vegetarian options on TripAdvisor and I ended up at Wild Coriander. 

Vegetarian choices wasn’t a lot but we love the place! We visited on a Tuesday afternoon which was not crowded. 

Would visit anytime again in Melaka!

Author: judithchrisal
Title: Even better than expected
Review: Went based on tripadvisor reviews. It was the freshest, tastiest food we ate in Melaka and the service was great too, friendly and efficient. Advise to reserve for dinner.

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beautiful decor and average food
Review: The large traditional house is located along Jalan Pantai and the river. We decided to sit inside and enjoy the nicely decorated and comfortable place. The tables by the river are smaller but it's nice out there too. Food was not exactly outstanding but solid. The wild coriander special chicken rendang was good. The gravy is not as rich and heavy as in some other places. The flower crab was tasty. The chap chye was a bit disappointing. More like steamed veggie. The Kueh Pie Tee were solid. Overall not very expensive for a restaurant. Service staff was friendly.Show less

Author: 201kamh
Title: Great ambiance, food look nice but taste is jz ok
Review: This is a place with great ambiance of Nyonya culture. The food look nice but the taste is just ok. The price is reasonable as the portion is big. You may consider to share with ur partner or friends if you are small eater.

Author: GavinJ594Aboyne, United Kingdom
Title: Interesting place but not particularly good food
Review: My wife and I went down there following a lot of rave reviews. The location is great and there are 4 tables out by the river which are nice, the waiter is a hoot and a great character. The food is tarted-up more than it should be, with options of 4 colours of rice and various mix-and-match food plates. The rendang beef curry was very good but the rice was cooked a while ago and the Gula Malacca was pretty solid stuff with limited Gula and a lot of Coconut Milk.Nice place for a post-dinner walk up-river though.So all in all - nice location, fun staff but pretty mediocre food.Show less

Author: clumman1Dundee, United Kingdom
Title: Sensational tasting beef rendang
Review: One of those curries so perfectly balanced with flavour and spice that your entire mouth is engulfed with an array of different sensations that keeps you guessing the ingredients with every mouth. To compliment this experience the staff and interior make for a very comfortable and memorable dinning experience.Show less

Author: ChrislccKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Little gems
Review: A riverside restaurant that serve very good Nyonya food. The environment and the ambience is very traditional yet very comfortable. The price are reasonable and affordable too. The restaurant can house a very large group within it's long building. Given it's popularity, reservation is recommended during peak seasons.Show less

Author: Y4639MGpaulhCourtenay, Canada
Title: Great little restaurant on the river
Review: We took advantage and ate on the riverside patio. We ordered a prawn dish with side dish of rice and a clam dish. The prawn dish had 6 prawns and the sauce was on the hit side but enjoyable. This is the first time in Malaysia that our dishes came together. Our waiter was attentive and while he had limited English he could communicate. The river side tables were a great place to eat. We would eat here again. Show less

Author: 756beni
Title: Average food, Great ambiance
Review: The location was fantastic! Unfortunately I found the food way too salty to be enjoyable. I’d give it a miss.

Author: jeanettewqx
Title: By the river
Review: Love the ambience! It was a pleasant visit. The food was unexpectedly not over rated too, (as malacca tend to overprice their food as they have many tourist visiting). I would give 5 stars for the environment, and 3 stars for the food. The food was a little too much for one person’s portion tho. The cake was a little too salty. Will definitely visit this place again to try the rest of the food on their menu!Show less

Author: Hans K
Title: Quite restaurant along the river
Review:
We found this one on Tripadvisor and visited with our family.
The restaurant is a long one from the river side to the street at the other side. The dishes are Malaysian ones and delicious with cold beer and fresh juices

Author: JaelleeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food with great ambiance
Review: Visited Wild Coriander on 22Jan, ordered their Wild Coriander Nasi with beef rendang, Laksa and Cendol for dessert. The rice set was delicious but portion are too much for one person, it’s good to be shared if you’re a small eaters. The best beef rendang I’ve ever had, the meat are tender and spiciness just nice. Cendol are good too!Show less

Author: Bryan HPortland, Oregon
Title: Understaffed, but still a nice dinner ...
Review: We went on a Monday night, early, to make sure to get there before any crowds. By the time we left, staff were running around frantically trying to get drink and food orders as customers began to get impatient, etc. We didn't have a problem ... got our food in a timely manner and enjoyed the local cuisine (although I had no idea what I was eating exactly.) The "Vegetarian Friendly" note that they've attached to what they cook is ... well, a bit exaggerated. There were three total dished that were veggie on the menu, two of which were pretty boring and didn't inspire me. That left one real option ... which was interesting. The food was tasty, the service ... a bit inexperienced shall we say ... the ambiance perfect. There are three big rooms to eat in .... including an outside area by the water which we chose not to opt for. Check it out ... the prices were reasonable, by the way.Show less

Author: SaraGrunKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food & services
Review: Went to this restaurant first for our dinner and then returned for lunch and even late evening snacks. Really impressed with the food quality, taste and the services. A special mention of Carson the waiter. Very knowledgable, hospitable and a fresh of breath air to engage in communication. Definitely will return again when I am in Melaka.Show less

Author: ashesbar
Title: Rendang
Review: Really enjoyed our lunch here. Had the rendang with chicken which was so tasty, full of wonderful flavours. The staff were very friendly and helpful, and on learning we were Irish, even treated us to cupla focal gaeilge.

Author: YeeSeng
Title: Good food with reasonable price
Review: We had our dinner here on a normal weekday, hence the restaurant is not so crowded. Very relax environment and the staff is attentive. The price of food is very very reasonable although they are situated at the tourist spot!

Author: Sifuram
Title: Exquisite Cuisine
Review: We ordered simple dishes and it was delicious. Carson the owners son was our consumate host. Pricing was so affordable. The cusine was varied, the decor very tasteful and the service very attentive.

Author: supersimmonottinghamshire
Title: Stunning setting, homemade food
Review: We had chicken rendang and beef rendang followed by salted caramel egg custard pudding. The food was delicious, clearly made with love from scratch and the service was good too. Our bill came to 69rm, which included two beers and a lemongrass and ginger soft drink. The view along the river was an excellent accompaniment to a lovely meal. Go if you can. Show less

Author: hobwatPoole
Title: Riverside gem
Review: I preferred the relatively limited menu here and thoroughly enjoyed our traditional meals of Nasi lemak with chicken, and laksa, sitting by the river on a very peaceful Sunday evening. Meals were tasty and portions perfect.The service was pleasant and courteous. All in all, very good value.Show less

Author: rbeightonGeneva
Title: Delicious and lovely atmosphere
Review: The food and ambience at wild coriander were delightful, sitting outside on a candle lit table by the river watching the pleasure boats go by in the evening was relaxing and very pretty. The food was plentiful and tasty and the staff worked very hard all evening to serve us and look after us. Especially recommend the lamb shank, rendang curries, salted egg custard cake and the sour plum calemansi soda!Show less

Author: Honey2StarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Food with Nice View
Review: This nice Peranakan restaurant by the Melaka River offers nice view during sunset, definitely a good place to hangout for dinner. They also offer indoor seating if you prefer brighter ambiance, do beware of mosquitoes though.Their menu offers a good range of nyonya dishes, which is really appetizing and taste good. I would recommend to order a few dishes and share within the group. They also have really nice local drinks which is definitely interesting for tourist to try. The price range here is pretty reasonable too.Show less

Author: David S
Title: Great enviroment, great meal, great service.
Review: The meal was delicious, the restaurant looks very nice and there's an opportunity to go out too. Nice traditional music.

Author: 594JaneS594Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely atmosphere and innovative meals
Review: We all tried the Wild Coriander special which is beef rendang with four different rices and several sides. The meals were huge and it was beautifully presented. The taste was fine and some parts were amazing but the beef was a bit fatty. I also tried the lemongrass, lime and ginger drink which was divine. I would definitely recommend this place as the setting is lovely and the staff were very friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: Nkp99Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience with good food
Review: This is one of the best meal for me in Melaka with my family. Found it accidentally while walking along the Melaka river enjoying the murals. Though the restaurant looks classic with the retro style decoration, the food portion is good and not too pricey. We specially like the rendang chicken and stir fried French bean. Show less

Author: Nina CRichmond, Canada
Title: First meal in Melaka!
Review: This place certainly does not disappoint. The portion is big and priced reasonably. We had the laksa and the beef with four flavoured rice was divine! I really enjoyed the meal. However we went around 2pm and somehow the service was very slow. I was half way through my food until I got my drink. Show less

Author: Paul GValor, Spain
Title: The best meal we ate in Malacca
Review: This is an outstanding restaurant. The menu is very interesting and the food has a home made quality and is very tasty. My friend and I were very impressed. The restaurant is in a lovely old building and the service is great. The prices are very reasonable too. Show less

Author: shaunsee
Title: I love this place and it’s food!
Review: Beef rendang is definitely one of the key items that you should try! And the waiters are friendly as well.

Author: John CBali, Indonesia
Title: Just Right
Review: We give this place a solid thumbs up! We have a 5 year old daughter so clean is important and difficult to find in this area. The bathrooms, the inside and outside of the restaurant, and the staff hit the mark.Arriving shortly after they opened at noon, we sat at a table along the river in the back of the place. Other than many noisy boats going by, a real nice way to spend part of our Sunday eating a delicious lunch.The beef rendang was very tasty and it came with the 4 different rice servings. Such strong flavors and very well presented. My wife had nasi lemak...rice with coconut milk. Delicious .  Two meals were enough for the three of us. The meals were served hot and did not take long to prepare. An appetiser of pie teh was delicious and five pieces were enough. Fresh cilantro and other fresh spices/seasonings make this a sure item to try. This place offers a good value and a nice location away from Jonker!!! That place is off limits for us. Very important for us to stay away from that busy street...it lacks any originality. Worn out concept.We would eat here again and would recommend to family and friends. Rarely do we give a 5 rating. They get one though!Show less

Author: 206hungl
Title: Lunch
Review:
Had lunch by the river, a very unique experience. Nice nyonya cuisine. The staff is very helpful and friendly. 

Indoor is nicely decorated if u don't like to sit outdoor. The food portion is big, price is reasonable too. 

Highly recommended.

Author: jasont474
Title: Good Baba Nyonya Food
Review:
Ordered few recommended dishes (food rojaks, 4 colored rice set, nasi lemak and mixed vege), tasted good.
But price wise quite costly.

Author: Asiatrav1982
Title: Excellent Malay dish and friendly service
Review: Nice restaurant at the riverbank with nice Malay dishes. Excellent service from the staff. They warned us for pickpockets, make sure your valuables are safe!

Author: chuckwow
Title: Blue rice with beef redang MMM tasty
Review: The blue rice is delicate both in flavour and aroma and here its great located by the river great staff good location away from main streets ..

Author: 22charlyfHong Kong, China
Title: AMAZING
Review: What a great experience ! The service was immaculate, very friendly. Unfortunately I didn’t get the chance to get the names of the waiters but the whole team has been doing an outstanding job. They even went to get me cigarettes as they don’t sell any. I went for the beef Redang, that was absolutely amazing ! So colourful with the right amount of spice. Then, as a pandan leaf lover, I tried a new experiment from the kitchen and they served me a beautiful cake looking like a cheesecake (rice instead of cheese) ! I loved it !! The place is very well located and perfect for a romantic dinner with candle by the river. Sadly, I was alone that night lol Prices are also very descent. Show less

Author: umieumairah
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: I like the food,their environment and drink they serve.their service also good.my mother like their special menu from them.i will choose again your restaurant when i miss your mango banana drinks 😊

Author: DavidB1971new zealand
Title: Wild Corwander Laksa Heaven
Review: I think I just died and want to Laksa Heaven!. I only wanted a light dinner, when the bowl came I did not think I would eat half of it. Served with a whole lime and a bowl of chili, I was in ecstasy from the first mouthful and it did not stop until I reached the bottom of the bowl. The young waiter (who is born and raised locally) was very friendly and happy to recommend menu items. Sit at one of the two tables on the river boardwalk if you can, the view is fantastic. Sadly I do not have time to return there on this trip. It was a real highlight of my 2 day stay.Show less

Author: 552WendyH552
Title: Service on the river
Review: Really enjoyed the evening here. Started with top hats and took the waiters advice on the rest. Pineapple prawn dish was the best with great pancakes and ice cream to finish up.

Author: 931jannien
Title: Ambience and delicious food
Review: Absolutely loved their laksa. It just seemed like an endless bowl, I kept eating and didn’t seem to progress towards the bottom! The dish defeated me but I did give it my best shot, sooooo yummy!

Author: Wyntn
Title: Would definitely go again!!! And again!!!
Review: Service was alright, not wonderful though. Noticed that the staff pays special attention to foreigners compared to locals. That's a set back. Atmostphere outside was cozy. Food is very good! Desserts were the best!

Author: centralvalleylilypadLos Angeles, California
Title: Getting hungry just thinking about this place
Review: My husband and I came after an exhausting day of walking around Melaka, and we were not disappointed. I asked the waiter for his recommendations, and he basically took over, which was great for us -- the meal was unforgettable. We had generous portions of a veggie dish; two meat dishes, including AMAZING chicken rendang; dessert AND drinks for an extremely reasonable price (think <$15 USD), and all while overlooking the river. Service was fabulous, and the dinner was easily one of the best meals I had in Malaysia. Definitely would recommend.Show less

Author: weiminn2018Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great new find for me: ambience and food.
Review: Good Pernakan food is increasingly hard to find in Malacca because many "famous" restaurants in the strip next to the padang have switched to No pork rule, and their prices have become ridiculous because of the tourist trade.Wild Coriander is an exception.We arrived late for dinner because we were shopping along Jonkers market, and it was empty. We enquired and they said that many of the diners had left as most eat early, intending to drive back to their own cities (it was a Friday night).Food: We ordered the kueh pai ti, 5 on a plate with the sambal in the center - very tasty, I thought the fried scallions did not go with it, but it added a different taste. The centerpiece was their speciality, beef rendang with 4 types of rice- instagrammable and delicious. Each dish had their own texture, quite different from the taste that we are used to in the Peranakan dishes in Singapore.Value: Good prices and good sized servings.Service: plain and un attentiveAmbience: laid out like a Malacca house, good decoration. We would have loved to sit next to the river at the back of the restaurant, but it was raining.It is a little diifficult to find because it is on a less travelled street.Show less

Author: johnpc22
Title: Nice.
Review:
Been there before only for a beer. This time hungry
 Eat their redang with different rice's. Not so sure that worked. But the overall view is the food was excellent, with helpful staff. So I will return and not just for a beer.

Author: itnas_oul
Title: Nice spot by the river
Review: Nab one of two tables on the river if you can. Great scenery, nice food, a chill beer and ever spot a monitor lizard swimming in the river if you're lucky!

Author: ant7007kuala lumpur
Title: Simply irresistible...
Review: We were staying next door at RC hotel and we walk around town wandering and looking for a nice place to dine. When we realised that there is peranakan restaurant nearby, we were fortunate. The peranakan foods they served very tasty, simple and we were lost for words. Highly recommended prawn with pineapple and cook in yellow coconut gravy. Our families/relatives from hong kong and toronto loves it very much. Even so the foods bit late, we guess they lack of staffs but we understand that good food need longer time to prepare and worth the wait. Show less

Author: DwoodaSt. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Glad we booked
Review: We chose the restaurant based on T A reviews and are glad we booked as we got a lovely riverside table - unsurprisingly these are in great demand. The food was nice but did not live up to the reviews we had read. Portions were generous and the pineapple curry was fantastic. Meat dishes less good - would eat vegetarian here next time. Nevertheless we had a good evening and were pleased to get a cold beer!Show less

Author: rlsh07Singapore
Title: Horrible food
Review: We ordered the following items 1) laksa with bee hoon. I don't know how to describe but I couldn't finish it because it was really hard to finish 2) otak - I taste it and I spit it out. It was that horrible. The food for me was really horrible. Even the nice view at the back along the river could not save it. The service is good though. That's the only saving grace of it all. Show less

Author: WTisSearching
Title: Recommended
Review: Pretty good food here. We thoroughly enjoyed our dinner. Service was also friendly. Will return if in Malacca again.

Author: JaclynW128
Title: Comfortable place and delicious food
Review: The food is delicious and service is absolutely great. The food comes in big portions and luckily we didn't order a lot. The pai tee is strongly recommended!

Author: Jorge6880
Title: Wonderfull terrace restaurant
Review:
Nice food in a wonderful terrace beside the quiet river.
Friendly staff, tasty food and cheap/average price restaurant.

Author: TeflonTony
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: We came for lunch and had nasi dulang and the laksa. Both were good. The ambience was good. The lady boss was friendly. We will come here again in our future trips to Melaka.

Author: 22112-mlmmKingsland, United Kingdom
Title: Birthday dinner
Review: On the canal in lovely setting, the food was delicious. We had stuffed crab and beef redang, devil chicken curry and laksa. All delicious. Beef very tender. Chicken very hot! Lovely blue rice. Friendly attentive staff. Don’t sit in the plants - lots of bites and a sticky juice drips from it!Show less

Author: 193elinenPrivas, France
Title: Nothing special
Review: We came here after reading the positive reviews, but for us it was a let down. No seats available outside alongside the river. We had the beef rendang and a noodle dish. Both were rather bland. The mango smoothie tasted like mango juice with milk, not fresh and not really nice. Wouldn't go back again. Show less

Author: WHChewCheras, Malaysia
Title: Good food and nice view
Review: The food is good, reasonable portion unlike those near jonkers street. Tasty and not too spicy, this suitable for kids. Drinks are mostly homemade like nutmeg drinks, lemongrass etc. Excellent!!The view is good because if you sit behind the restaurant it's next to the river.Show less

Author: Storyteller735546
Title: Quick Dinner by the River
Review:
Good ambiance by the riverside.
A quaint place to relax while enjoying delicious local cuisine.
Friendly and outstanding customer service.

Author: NaonedizNantes, France
Title: Awesome dinner along the river.
Review: I went to this place after reading all the good reviews on T.Advisor. And i havn't been disappointed. I first sat down inside. 5 Minutes after, an outside table became available. Very quiet place just along the river. Nice little view. I had the "Wild coriander special". And it was really nice. The meat was tasty. Rice cooked four ways, really nice too. The waiter has been really nice & smiling all the time. I definitly recommend this place.Show less

Author: Moodee C
Title: Taste of peranakan flavor
Review: We wanted to go to another famed/touristy peranakan restaurant but chose to try Wild Coriander instead - no regrets! Enjoy generous-sized food portions in a tastefully preserved shop house with antique art pieces and interesting trinkets. Cool respite from the Melaka heat & touristy crowds (I visited on a Monday afternoon).Show less

Author: 768AmyCTainan, Taiwan
Title: We enjoyed the dinner a lot
Review: This is an old fashioned long house, I love the decor a lot. Most of the item has a price tag that you may purchase. They also provide seats along the riverside.We ordered a few dishes: Signature Laksa, Pajeri Brinjal, Beef Redang and Pie Tee.I like Pajeri Brinjal the most :) Beef Regang is soft and tender, pie tee is a good appetizer . The Signature Laksa wasn't that amazing. All in all, we enjoyed the meal here. The staff was friendly and cheerful.We visited on a Sunday night, only a few tables so it was a relaxing meal. This restaurant is only 5-10 mins walk away from jonker street. It's good to have a walk after the dinner. The parking is not that difficult in front of the restaurant.Show less

Author: Melanie B
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: We visited Wild Coriander on 1st October and loved it! Very eclectic decor and atmosphere and delicious food. The rendang with 4 coloured rices was melt-in-the-mouth, yummy laksa and tasty top hats. Excellent desserts too. Portions are large. Staff friendly and helpful and very reasonably priced. Would thoroughly recommend it and we will be back! Show less

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Fusion and authentic nonya cuisine
Review: Very interesting nonya cuisine and concept. Love the dishes they serve in the menu. Nice ambience and just next to the river. Nice options to choose either inside aircon dining  or alfresco dining options. Love this place!

Author: mastelbmProvince of Como, Italy
Title: Nice position along the river and reasonable cuisine
Review: We selected this restaurant in Melaka mainly for his location along the river and also for the positive recensions we read. We were lucky to have a table on the street just facing the river. The cuisine is okay but not as good as we expected. Let’s say reasonable. The service was slow. The price more than reasonable. OK for the location.Show less

Author: janc0115
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Cosy place and awesome food, staffs are friendly & attentive. Had a relax & enjoyable lunch during the trip. Keep up the good work!

Author: reDc223
Title: Must Visit for Authentic Nyonya Dishes!
Review: A restaurant definitely worth a visit for authentic Nyonya food in Melaka. The ambience and food truly brought the Baba & Nyonya culture back into its roots, with their interior decor and oldies music to fascinate the ears, eyes and more importantly the taste buds. Visited with a few friends and service was efficient. Waiters were tentative about our orders and food arrived relatively quick. The beef rendang was rich in flavour with the rice cooked perfectly. Mee Siam and laksa was rich in flavour too! After dinner, we had desserts that were amazing especially the kueh ketayap with coconut ice cream and salted egg pandan layered cake (which was not too sweet and have this unique taste). Overall, the price was reasonable for such good food and ambience. For that, I highly recommend a visit to this restaurant. Will definitely come by again to try out other dishes. Show less

Author: jermpinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice restaurant in a old fashioned long house, but food was below average
Review: The restaurant is inside a nice old fashioned long house, with a small terrace next to the canal (kinda feels like Venice again). However, disappointedly, the food was below average. We ordered two of their signatures, i.e. Nyonya laksa and mee siam. The laksa was creamy and full of coriander flavours but otherwise lack of spices, and depth in flavours. The mee siam was probably the worst I had, completely tasteless even with extra doses of chilli sambal in every spoonful. For drinks, if u are considering to order the sour plum and calamansi, note that they put in vanilla ice cream in it, which is kinda weird for me. Show less

Author: 960ongm
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: The restaurant is bit hidden, but the interior is nice. Good price with good food. Friendly owner too.

Author: RobertoTotaro
Title: Friendly service and good food
Review:
This was one of the best restaurants we visited during our 4 weeks round trip of Malaysia. The personnel was very friendly and attentive, and the food excellent.

I can only recommend it.

Author: lexuazlShah Alam
Title: Great Peranakan dishes
Review: Despite Malacca being the root of the peranakan culture, it's not easy to find restaurants that serve good peranakan food. Wild Coriander is a great find because it serves up a satisfying one. The Wild Coriander Special (beef) was especially good, and the portion is big enough that two (or three, if you're a small eater) can share. The laksa is nothing like the Jonker 88 laksas, but it's fragrant in its own right too. The food is great, but I think the highlight of my meal is my drink: avocado smoothie with gula melaka. Smooth, without being cloyingly sweet. Relatively cheap for its huge portion, and staff members are friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: Dorine H
Title: Great Food by the river
Review: Lovely restaurant with very friendly staff. Service was very good, we had some explanation on the menu! We ordered beef rendang to share with nasi Lemak and roasted egg plants, which were a house specialty. The waiting time was short and the food delicious! The beef rendang contained lots of flavour and the level of spiciness was perfect. All in all we had a great dinner here. Show less

Author: Linda DTe Anau, New Zealand
Title: Nice meal and staff
Review: We stopped here for dinner and we are glad we did. The meal is nice and the staff are attentive, you can sit by the river and we found this quite pleasant. The menu was a bit confusing as beside most it stated (3 to 4 people ) which is for when you are ate sharing plates around a group, each dish is enough for 1 person. Everything is reasonably priced and we enjoyed our time here. Good staff as well.Show less

Author: 4ft11bckpckerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: THE DIE-FOR SALTED EGG CAKE
Review: It was a good place to gather with friends and really good food. I mean like, I see SALTED EGG croissant and cupcakes but this one here. OMG. I can't even describe how good that was. The food, needless to explain, you should definitely drop by if you're in Malacca. Friendly peeps too.Show less

Author: FrouFoo
Title: Nonya fare
Review: A large group of us stopped by here for lunch during a short trip to Melaka. We got to try a large selection of the menu, all of the traditional Nonya food. The ambience is charming and beautiful, and it even has an outdoor area at the back facing the canal!Show less

Author: Angela W
Title: Tasty and interesting
Review: Lovely place with outdoor seating by the canal. Food was very tasty, beef rending was an explosion of spices, soft drinks were refreshing. I sampled two: ginger, lemon...drink mix, sour plum drink was more like a sweet creamy shake and not so much to my liking. Communication skills could be improved since they have so many Western guests - staff even had trouble understanding cold/hot drink, but hey, I don't expect everyone to speak English or a Western language when I travel Malaysia.Show less

Author: bartlomiejs2016
Title: Delicious
Review: service is very active and communicative. My laksa was delicious and made me full but i will get back to try out more

Author: szotdogsMelbourne, Australia
Title: An accidental (but good) discovery!
Review: Was walking along the river and looking for a late lunch - plus I was very keen to try devil curry as recommended by a friend. So in I went, and wasn't disappointed. The devil curry was very nice, hot and spicy, just like I had hoped for.The waiter was also very kind to lend me a screwdriver as I needed to remove the tripod plate from my camera so I could change batteries.If I'm in Melaka again I will be returning, as I'm sure I'll be doing the river walk again.Show less

Author: Lil-belsg
Title: Tasteless food
Review: We ate dinner at the restaurant after a friend's recommendation. We were very disappointed with the tasteless dishes like chap chye, omelette and lamb shank. Drinks were too sweet.

Author: OverseasamericanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb atmosphere-
Review: Loved the atmosphere here- felt like old Melacca. The spices and tastes of the Rendang, and sautéed vegetables was superb Price was quite a bargain but I would pay more if there were less bones. Far too many large and sometimes even sharp bones in the meat. Would be 5 star with less bones Show less

Author: Otilio_bocadiglioBilbao, Spain
Title: Typical & home made!
Review: In our dinner in this restaurant we had the chance to find a nice restaurant with servers that tried their best to communicate in any language (we saw English, Spanish and French) to suggest to tourists best dishes. Local typical dishes are highly recommended (sharing them in order to try the most of them), and juices & smoothies naturally made at the moment. Nice way to spend an evening tasting local dishes!!Show less

Author: 810yannickw
Title: Good nyonya food
Review: Good food for a great price. It's not a must have been but it still worth it. Location is great if you can eat outside.

Author: scotaussie
Title: Quaint little place
Review: Lovely setting in old building with fans. Limited menu for 2 although more for larger groups. We had set dishes with Randang which were great value and excellent. 5 min walk to Jonkers walk

Author: blujasAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Malaccan Nyonya cuisine
Review: The last time we wanted to eat here, the restaurant was closed. Today, we were not disappointed. Staffs were friendly although busy. Foods and drinks came on time. I was hungry and ordered quite a fair bit - from pie tee, three types of meats (devil chicken, Rendang beef and rendang chicken), brinjal, Rojak, otak, laksa, Mee Siam, lady's fingers, chap Chye, omelet, to their wild coriander special plate ... and finally the dessert of coconut filled pancake with coconut ice cream - we are a very happy and belly fulfilled family now! :) price was reasonable I'd say. :)Show less

Author: H7473USbenjaminl
Title: Authentic Nonya Food at reasonable prices
Review: The host, Carson was a friendly guy. The food was very reasonably priced. Loved his recommendation for my family of 6. We ordered the laksa, Rojak, pie-tee, coriander special, rendang, lady fingers and brinjal to share.The dessert is a must try, pancake with ice-cream. It was made fresh, so be patient. We will definitely visit again. Show less

Author: Pooie_12
Title: Very friendly service
Review: A very helpful young man chose 2 dishes for us - both were good especially the laksa. The restaurant is large and interesting with a smaller dining area at the back on the river.

Author: 484t_in
Title: MORE THAN EXPECTED
Review: We had a very great dinner at the restaurant. The food amazed me in our first day in Melaka. The staffs were so helpful and friendly. He supported us alot about the food. I wish I could come back oneday.

Author: Vera M
Title: YAMMY FOOD
Review: Friendly, helpful staff; delicious, local, authentic food; nice table next to the river; lovely atmosphere - a good spot to try out if you're in Melaka! It's well located in the heart of the old town and easy to find.

Author: MelvinLinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good!
Review: We came across this place on Tripadvisor, and saw that it had pretty good reviews. We then decided to give it a try, and it met all expectations.The food quality was good. While it is not exactly authentic, but the chefs did a good job, and we enjoyed our meal. The prices were also reasonable for the quality, and it was likely more affordable than some other establishments located in the city centre which might have not been able to match the Wild Coriander in terms of quality.The staff members, while somewhat eccentric in their mannerisms and speech, were on the whole sociable and helpful. It took a little bit of getting used to them at the beginning, but after awhile, we felt quite comfortable with them.The restaurant’s location made getting there a little of a challenge, as even with the GPS device, we encountered slight difficulties locating the place. And even after we got there, getting a parking spot was not easy. But the dinner experience made the effort worth it in the end. It was also probably because of this reason that the restaurant was less crowded than we had originally imagined it to be.Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Foodster2012
Title: Dinner
Review: Wonderful, traditional cuisine.  Attentive service and the beef rendsng and laksa were excellent.  Exceptional value too.

Author: alexpilgrim
Title: Great juices (and food!)
Review: Really good Malay curries - great recommendations from the waiter too! The juices and smoothies were amazing, along with the traditional Malay dessert. Lovely setting looking over the river - sit outside!!!

Author: Cyanobacteria
Title: Great place but slightly slow
Review: Lovely atmosphere. Cooled by fan rather than air conditioning. Clearly popular judging by the number of guests. Friendly staff. Tasty food. I had the beef rendang. So why only 4 stars? Little niggles only ... half the drinks order hadn't arrived 20 mins later and the general service was a bit slow. The waitress (from France) didn't seem to be familiar with the menu. By the time we were ready to order dessert at 9:30 there was only a limited selection. If they were not so busy I'm sure they would have deserved 5 stars. Still worth a visit. Show less

Author: 65martijns
Title: Cosy and great food
Review: Amazing food and great friendly waiters! Restaurant is central but located in a more quiet area. A good spot to relax for a nice lunch or dinner.

Author: catherinelee800
Title: Overrated
Review: Food is ok only. Prices reasonable. Didn't really taste like nonya food. We ordered otak otak which didn't come. The rendang and devil curry was only passable. Ambience is good if you can get a table by the river.

Author: nadineo241Newport, United Kingdom
Title: Family friendly restaurant with a good variety of Malaysian classics
Review: Walking round malacca one evening last week our family were struggling to find a restaurant that wasn't a tourist trap. Some of the restaurants advertising nyonya food were very expensive and most of them seemed to only be serving drinks. After looking at the reviews we decided to give Wild Coriander a try and it opened til later. The restaurant was in a traditional malacca style house with the back part of the house set romantically on the river.  The service was very good with the servers running to the kitchen to put through the orders as quickly as possible. The food quality was good too in particularly the Pie Tee which was fresh as you like and so tasty! The biryani rice was also tasty and went well with the rendang. It's a very comfortable restaurant and we loved the small details and plates on the wall throwing back to old malacca times.Thank you!Show less

Author: Tiger05Sydney
Title: Highlight of Malaysia
Review: We stayed in a house just across the river and had a late dinner here after arriving from the airport. We sat outside overlooking the river and really enjoyed the food and the ambience. Both the Beef Rendang and Laksa were superb as was the selection of entrees recommended by our helpful if slightly eccentric waiter. This was our first and likely best meal during our week in Malaysia -strongly recommend for a simple yet very memorable and amazingly affordable meal!Show less

Author: Aliff F
Title: One word, Wow!!!
Review: I tried their Nasi with Rendang Beef and Pandan Salted Egg. One word to describe them, Wow! Recommended!!! The other dishes we tried is Nasi Lemak with Chicken Rendang. The chicken rendang was so lemakk! Omg!! The taste of the rendang that you will come here for the 2nd time! Recommended as well!Show less

Author: mackemjimSunderland, United Kingdom
Title: Wonderful find.
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant while on a riverside walk, there was just a small sign on a doorway. The staff were very friendly without being overpowering and suggested different dishes to try. The atmosphere was relaxed and had a wonderful ambience. We had several dishes including beef rendang and all were very tasty. Can highly recommended this restaurant and would definitely go again if we were in Melaka any longer.Show less

Author: JohnArthurRutt
Title: Totally worth visiting again
Review: We visited the restaurant with my parents, who were over for a holiday from japan. The behaviour of the staff was attentive and enthusiastic, if at times also slightly eccentric. This particular night, the only beer in stock was Carlsberg, which was disappointing. We ordered beef rendang, mutton curry, bok choi and a few other dishes which names escape me. Every entree was absolutely delicious! The flavours were distinct, the produce was fresh. We got the bill and were surprised to find that a large meal for t people amounted to rm67! We hope that everyone who visits melaka and is looking for authentic local food chooses to come here; they really deserve to do well. Do yourself a favour and overlook some of the eccentricities, because the food is totally worth it!Show less

Author: Saisons2011Hong Kong, China
Title: Good Food. Friendly Staff.
Review: Having dinner in there during my short stay in Malacca. There is no air-con in Wild Corriander, but they have large fan so its okay for me. Greeted by very friendly staff with kindly offered recommendations. I've ordered a Beef Rendang with rice and a Cameron Highland tea. The beef was soft and nicely spiced and the price is okay.Show less

Author: pjbpjb
Title: Waited for 45 minutes...didn't even get drinks
Review: We were very excited to eat at this place after reading the TripAdvisor reviews. We ordered food and drinks with the waiter. Nothing arrived for 45 minutes. This was the case for two other tables. Ended up having to leave and eat elsewhere. (Lovely decor however!!)Show less

Author: BTChevalierParis, France
Title: An excellent dinner
Review: We had an excellent dinner in this restaurant aside the Melaka river. They have three outside tables which offer a beautiful view but be careful, there are also a lot of mosquitos !Menu selection is not large and offer only malaysian specialities. Food was excellent especially the desserts: we tasted the local pancake with coconut ice-cream and it was delicious !Staff was also very friendly and service was fast. Last but not least, prices were not expensive. We paid 53 MYR for two including drinks + main courses + desserts.We really recommend this place !Show less

Author: danjorTMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Incredible food, nice atmosphere
Review: Food was so good and you got alot and the drinks were also very taste. We ate here a few times in our stay. The staff are always very helpful and kind.Everything on the menu is very clear and well set out.and loved the outdoor seating options.Proper Maylasian Food!Show less

Author: MrYan_40
Title: Dinner close to the river
Review:
We had dinner and we're sitting outside close to the river - really beautiful and so quiet. 
The food was really good - we took the Wild Cordiander Rendang chicken and a spicy entrance.
Highly recommended !

Author: E156DRsimons
Title: Good Laksa
Review: Very goods food. We took the Laksa. This soup is very different from the Penang Laksa we ate earlyer our trip. Very good taste. We suggested to call it Melaksa.

Author: FrankchescaBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Rendang
Review: Staff were great and worked really hard. The lemongrass lime and ginger juice was excellent and I will be trying to make it myself at home! We ate the Special Chicken and Beef Randang and it was superb! A little too much food for lunch though, we would have been fine sharing one with perhaps a side order.Show less

Author: SteffenH1043
