Title: Great dinner, nice setting
Review: We had dinner and were sitting at the back by the river, 7 of us, we enjoyed the very nice food and great service. Special thanks to Carson Emmanuel Lee for making this a great evening !

Author: shanana21Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unpretentious place for a simple meal
Review: Went for a late lunch with a big family group. The wait staff were generally patient and attentive to our needs. The restaurant was a cool respite from the sweltering heat although it was not air conditioned. The food took a little longer than expected to arrive. By the time we received the pie tee the base was already soggy and not the crispy type of pie tee cup one would expect. The rojak and achar were nice as the peanut garnish was finely ground. The wild coriander special was a nice touch as a main meal. Was too full to have dessert, would have liked to try the salted egg pandan cake! Pricing was quite reasonable too.Show less

Author: alexbP9492CW
Title: Lunch at the wild coriander
Review: Great meal, great service, great atmosphere. The beef rendang and rose flavoured milk were amazing. Thanks Guys!

Author: TheHairyTraveller1Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great food, great place
Review: Me, my fiancée and our friends all ate here one lunchtime and the food was incredible. I had the Wild Coriander Beef Rendang and it was delicious, the different types of rice gave us a new taste of Malaysia. The staff are lovely and always make sure that you have everything you need. Would definitely recommendShow less

Author: CAMEL369
Title: Dinner
Review: Food, service is fantastic... highly recommended! Drinks that are recommended taste really good! Why need 100 words to submit? If a few words can describe the fantastic service..

Author: AnnaR730London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic fresh and tasty food in a beautiful setting with friendly staff
Review: This place is a must for visiting Melaka. The restaurant is just off the river and a short walk from the busy Jonker st. We had the pie tee, rojack, beef rendang, followed by the coconut pancakes and ice cream. It was all delicious- among the best food we had in the two weeks we spent travelling Malaysia and Singapore. The restaurant is in a beautiful old building and the courtyard style, gently splashing water feature makes this a cool and relaxing place to spend a few hours escaping the heat. The drinks were excellent too and the staff friendly and helpful. We will return on our next visit to Melaka! Show less

Author: kellstar18England, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely place
Review: I had a lovely meal here. Sat and ate by the river. I had the Wild Coriander Special Beef Rendang. Everything on the plate tasted amazing! The service was also really good, the staff were very friendly and brought a fan outside for me because it was really hot! Would definitely recommend. Show less

Author: alessandram889Udine, Italy
Title: Great food with great service
Review: The food was very good, very well served and with kindness and accuracy. All is home made, and delicious. The price is very affordable and they also gived us 3 desserts for free to taste with the group of 13 people we were! I definitely recommend it to anyone who wants a nice dinner in a very good atmosphere! Try the tables by the river for a romantic getaway! Show less

Author: Joss_Gamble
Title: Great place to eat!
Review:
Friendly staff and lovely food. 

We were there on a particularly quite night and had a lovely time. The food is nice and the selection is good.

Author: Alfred L
Title: Lunch with family
Review: Authentic setting, friendly and attentive  service, great Mee Siam and food. Good price for a restaurant.

Author: 305maxis
Title: Totally Recommended
Review: The place is really beautiful with good chairs and tables, good attention! Normal price for local and great food!

Author: dylanlen
Title: Best food in town!
Review: Wandering around we found this beautiful place. The inside and the outside (a terrace along the water) are both beautiful.We tried the Pie Tee for starters, absolutely hit the spot! It was a fresh flavour explosion in the mouth. The Prawn&Pineapple with blue flower rice was delicious too. You can tell that everything was cooked fresh and with passion and love by the chef! Service was great, no pressure as you get sometimes in other restaurants. Very reasonable priced, also for backpackers.Will definiteky come back when we get the chance :)Show less

Author: 217geraldines
Title: A hidden gem
Review:
Within the walking circuit, this restaurant is long, cool, spacious and  tropical and has seats onto the river. 
A lovely experience. Beef Rendang multi layered with flavours.

Author: walby67
Title: Awesome Food
Review: Walking along the river at Melaka we found this hidden gem. The food was amazing and very reasonably priced, and the service friendly and efficient.  This is a must to try when you are in Melaka. We will definitely go back.

Author: brsterkAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Cosy restaurant serrving authentic nyonya food
Review: I went there with my husband for lunch. I thought the food tasted like home made food and was deliecious. Presentation of the dish was pretty. Spacious restaurant with good service.For desserts, I ordered sago pudding. Loved the gula melaka but thought they were over generous with the coconut milk.Would return. There aren't alot of restaurants serving such food in that area and so its nice to have them there.Give it a try. Its not too far from Jonker Street at all.Show less

Author: violette7
Title: Best place in the area!
Review: After a deception lunch and breakfast we were blessed to find this place. The food is amazing, healthy and fresh. Not to be missed.

Author: ever_pasawayLas Pinas, Philippines
Title: New kid on the block
Review: I've heard that this place has only been around for a few months and they are already getting good reviews so we tried it out. The interior was a mix of old and new. It's pretty far from the heart of Jonker Street so rent is not as high and they have a very spacious restaurant compared to the rest. We tried the Beef and Chicken Laksa with rice and it was on par, nothing special from the other laksa we've tried. But their Sour Plum Calamansi juice was a surprising find. Recommended. Show less

Author: Xsies22Singapore, Singapore
Title: WoW!
Review: Agreed that this is a gem!Lovely terrace at the river and the food is amazing! We ordered some signature dishes to share. The starter, Pie Tee, is just art. The flavours of the food just explode in your mouth and they use real flowers to color the rice blue. The homemade avocado smoothie was a real surprise!!! The staff was kind and really helpful!! We will definetely come back next time @ Melaka.Show less

Author: LoveTravel640749
Title: Delicious food, lovely staff
Review: Wild Coriander is an absolute gem! We loved it's riverside setting which is only a short walk from the busy/commercial Dutch Sq but feels worlds apart. There is a lovely outdoor seating area and the inside is cool and inviting.My partner and I ordered the nasi lemak with beef and chicken redang- both dishes were outstanding and the chicken was unbelievably tender. We also treated ourselves to local pancakes with coconut ice cream for dessert- delicious!The staff are lovely too. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: JohnmwolfsMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Superb local cuisine, truly cheap
Review: We had beef and chicken rendang, best so far in Malaysia. Try the wild coriander special. RM 17.50. Plate with butterflyflower,plain and brown rice as well as Nyoman pickles, pineapple and chicken rendang. Lovely desserts. Sister restaurant of River View Cafe. Free table water. In a relaxed atmosphere with an incredible hospitable waiters team and, if you feel like, sit at the board of the river. Show less

Author: Andrew JMontreal, Quebec, Canada
Title: Great dinner
Review: We were staying next door and stopped to look at the menu. The server that came to greet us was incredibly friendly and seemed excited to tell us about the menu. We were pretty excited to try it and we're definitely not let down.The laksa was astoundingly good, the nasi Lemak was asleep delicious. Nothing we had there was below excellent.Don't miss the desserts. The pancake with ice cream was sublime.The price is a little higher cause it's a restaurant but honestly I think it is definitely worth it.Show less

Author: JoaoEspinhaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovey night with great food
Review: We discovered the Wild Coriander while on our boat river cruise. We were greeted by a friendly staff. The Laksa, the Mee and the pie hats were delicious. Inside is spacious and cosy. Outside is also nice to sit along the river. If back in Melaka we are happy to revisit again the Wild Coriander!Show less

Author: Ram Rakesh P
Title: True Malacca food
Review: Great environment. Great food. Laksa os the bomb. Sad to see there is no crowd when this place deserves all the attention.

Author: Adrian D
Title: very good nonya food
Review: this has to be one of the best nonya restaurants in melaka,it has limited outdoor seating, so you need to book in advance

Author: SanyaL82
Title: Thank you!
Review: I'm not a big fan of nyonya food even in a pure malaccan. However this restaurant really served a good quality of nyonya food. Laksa broth was more to coconut milky flavour and the wild coriander special which contain of 4 different flavours of rice was amazing! (I'm a spices flavour lover) the chicken rendand was my fav. Truly an aromatic one! I thank you for serving me all those delicious food.Show less

Author: AnpeneGermany
Title: Delicious local dishes with excellent service
Review: We located the Wild Coriander while taking the river boat tour. The name attracted us and so we, a group of 8, decided to give it a try. We were very pleasantly surprised. Our friendly waiter Carson gave us excellent recommendations. We enjoyed a variety of specialities, all freshly made and equally delicious. A small taste of some of the deserts completed the perfect meal. I can highly recommend Wild Coriander! If we have a chance, we will come again!Show less

Author: KevinM10004
Title: Perfect
Review: I was staying nearby and spotted this place which was not on my list of recommendations. So glad I did. Gorgeous setting if you can grab a seat outside but the interior is spacious and light too. The happy staff are very friendly. I am on a quest for the best rendang and this came pretty close. Authentic, dry sauce bursting with flavour. The best bit was the empat beras (four rice) though, closely followed by delicious pickles. Not only great to taste but unbelievable value for money too.It's only a few minutes off the usual Jonker Walk establishments and you will be rewarded in droves for the detour.Show less

Author: lovelyliz4London, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely delicious!
Review: My sister and I visited the wild coriander as we were staying in the rooftop guesthouse just over the road and I'm so glad we did! It was one of the tastiest meals we had in Malaysia! I had the laksa which was amazing and my sister had the beef rendang. We were also lucky enough to get one of the tables outside by the canal. It was a lovely setting and the waiters were lovely and friendly too! I would definitely recommend!!Show less

Author: Nouk1963Haarlem, The Netherlands
Title: Super delicious
Review: Fantastic restaurant we had chicken rendang and beef rendang also a mixed vegetable dish. We had a nice meal for a friendly price. The staff was very friendly and provided well service. Location was lovely. It is out of the regularly route so not to busy, but you are recommended to go there and sit on the river side from Melaka. Show less

Author: FrozzieAustralieIngleburn, Australia
Title: Venice Malaysian Style
Review: The nicest restaurant we visited while in Melaka. My wife and I found this delightful little restaurant while riding our bikes in the old part of Melaka. The location is great, it's a really well renovated old building with tables by the river making for a great atmosphere. The food was great offering some regional specialties as well as western favourites. The waiter attentive and friendly and to top it off the prices very reasonable. Deserves to be in the top three. Show less

Author: Pointblank777
Title: Cosy and comfortable seating. Delicious food.
Review: Great location by the river, very spacious and well thought-of seating options. Amazingly cool atmosphere without air-conditioning. And most importantly the food is excellent with the freshest of ingredients. Friendly and attentive service. Not to be missed when in Melaka.

Author: Cvapoorani L
Title: Delicious
Review: Beautiful environment, delicious food, and friendly staffs .. The food really yummylicious  and for sure I will come again to taste other dishes.

Author: thandsmut
Title: Blue rice
Review: Friendly restaurant with some interesting local foods. The blue butterfly flower rice is a definite novelty. No aircon but airy with the fans and high ceilings.

Author: Ross W
Title: Great setting
Review: Good home cooked food, very friendly staff, had the chicken rendang and finished off with local pancakes topped of with coconut ice cream.Will try the prawn and pineapple next visit. This is one of the better places to eat.

Author: buckersamy
Title: Amazing home cooked food
Review: Incredible food and friendly service. Try the prawn mango curry, rendang and the fresh coconut ice cream. A great traditional setting right on the river and reasonably priced.

Author: vicki_broderickKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely riverside restaurant
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant and were so pleasantly surprised! Ben and Carson were really helpful and made excellent suggestions for some dishes to share. The bok choy and French beans were fresh and tasty and the prawn and pineapple curry was delicious. The meat in the beef rendang was very tender and the banana cake with coconut ice cream was a great recommendation! The price was excellent and the inside of the restaurant was clean and a nice calm environment. Definitely recommend.Show less

Author: steveleslie1959
Title: Good food
Review: Tasty food, very reasonably priced. Delicious coconut ice cream with homemade pancakes. Extremely good service from very friendly and helpful staff.

Author: Marieke974Brussels, Belgium
Title: Friendly and tasty
Review: This restaurant was just next door to our accomodation. The food is really good and tasty and no so expansive. I recommend their dessert the pandan pancake so good. Waiters their is friendly and a good service . Wonderful dinner in front of the river !Show less

Author: SawChanFriburgo, Germania
Title: Very nice and cosy
Review: Found this cute place while walking down the riverside. It was a great idea to stop by and have lunch. I had a delicious malaysian dish and upon recommendation a very refreshing tropical fruit smoothie. The staff was super nice and polite! The atmosphere is very inviting with lots of plants inside.Show less

Author: hayleybakkerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely setting, great service & food
Review: This restaurant is new and deserves to be discovered by a wider audience. We sat at an outside table along the beautiful river side at candle light. The interior of the restaurant is also beautifully decorated. We ordered various meat and vegetable dishes and it was all delicious and gave a good impression of the local specialties. Would definitely recommend the beef rendang! Service was outstanding would definitely go back when in Melaka.Show less

Author: preetscorp
Title: Excellent taste & service!
Review: A very vibrant environment with excellent service, the food tastes really good and is full of flavour. Would highly recommend it to anyone who loves Spanish food.

Author: fongw2018
Title: Disappointing visit
Review: 29.12.2021Reservation was made one week earlier but yesterday's visit to Salud doesn't excite us. We were not greeted friendly and the waiter did not seem happy to welcome us.The restaurant was under-staffed. The waiter was prompt in clearing off the table. However, it was rather impolite for him to do so as we couldn't continue eating without cutlery. We still had unfinished dessert and later, it was being yanked off too. .As for the food, the salad was being served after all the mains. The anchovies tapas was quite good but the paella and churros were rather disappointing. We couldn't taste the saffron in the paella and the colour was nothing similar to it. The churros was slightly undercooked and the chocolate dipping was liquidy.. The pork skewers was over-salted. Fortunately, the staff had accepted our complaint for the pork skewers and waived it off our bill. It also took almost 10 minutes for the waiter to bring us the bill. After waiting for another 10 minutes, we went to the cashier to retrieve our credit card and made payment. My card was just left unattended on the counter. ☹️Show less

Author: sjman41Penang, Malaysia
Title: Warning-Think Twice
Review: My wife and I visited the restaurant on 26 Dec2021 for dinner around 6:30 pm. The person greeting me at the door inquired whether I had a reservation and I said "No, how could I?" and I showed him on my phone that I had dialed their number as listed on the web 6 times between 3:00-4:30 pm and always got a Call Back response. He then mentioned it was the owner's number who was now in Spain. Curious to use that as the only contact number in their Web listing. They were fully booked but we could sit at the bar which we accepted. The waiter plunked two dishes in front of us, but even after waiting did not bother to furnish place mats like I saw done for all other dishes already set. The personnel and atmosphere (we were the only ones in the restaurant at that time) just felt wrong and we decided to leave. But at the door another staff member inquired why. I told him this purportedly was a somewhat upscale restaurant, certainly not cheap, and that I felt slighted by not having place mats and just bad service. His excuse was they were fully booked, as if that is a reason. He never apologized for the inconvenience but his parting words when I left the restaurant were " We also don't want people like you here". That probably characterizes the level of this establishment. Nobody looked remotely Spanish rather I felt I was in a Pakistani/Bangladshi restaurant.I have no idea about their food and never will. For sure the staff I have seen has absolutely no class.Show less

Author: NovitecRosso
Title: Horrible nightmares
Review: On November 19 we called to make a reservation for Christmas night, and we double call to make sure our time and date and the lady who picked up the phone said ok confirmed. Then we arrived on Christmas Eve night just to found out that they are closed on Christmas night. Well thought to myself ok maybe she moves my reservation. I called to check my reservation and she told me my name isn’t in the system, and they are fully booked on the whole weekend. Such a disappointment with her service kept saying impossible I said ok to ur reservation on Christmas night. make sure you guys call least 10times to confirm your reservation.So sad that she doesn’t want to admit her error and call herself the general manager of the restaurant.Show less

Author: David G
Title: Very original
Review: We stopped by by chance one evening and managed to get a table outside (booking recommended). Had a jug of scrumy sangria and a selection of tapas,excellent quality. Very attentive waiting staff, worth a visit.

Author: STan3009
Title: Neither a big hit or miss!
Review:
Ambience and atmosphere are good, but the waiter service is downright bad. Limited selection of wine lists. Food is generally at saltier side. 

p/s : The lady owner is courteous and friendly to patrons.

Author: CtfgdcKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent discovery
Review: What a treat, for a change of Melaka traditional excellent delicacy’s. Some friends recommended the best in town if you like authentic Spanish food prepared and cooked from the chopping board to your plate in front of you with Chef Breo talking about what he’s doing for you to enjoy his culinary expertise and the products imported directly from Spain, all paired with an array of wines and other stuffs to enjoy. The super host Maria who’s there to recommend your next dishes and drinks and make sure you’re confortable and Happy. A perfect evening right in the town center between shopping and night live. IL be back Show less

Author: HSloh
Title: A sour ending to an otherwise good dinner
Review: Everything was ok until at the end of the meal, I had shredded glass pieces in my mouth and bruised my tongue. Yes you read this right. I thought it was some sharp pieces of ice in my sangria as I was finishing my drink but when I spit it out I realized it was pieces of glass that resembles the glass straw I was drinking from so I checked the straw but no,my straw wasnt broken or cracked. The edges were smooth. I quickly notified the waiter n showed him the pieces and also showed him my straw was not broken in case he thought it was my fault for breaking the straw. Yes, I was annoyed but I did not raised my voice and I asked for the manager prescence as I sensed the waiter's english may not be the best and I thought in this kind of situation the manager should be alerted. He apologised said he would come back to me.i saw him walking to the reception/service area to discuss with the rest but after sometime no one came back to us. Nothing. Fine, we asked for the bill and the bill came with no discount and no apologies from the owner or the manager in sight. It was as though nohing happened and they expect a customer who just got hurt by a piece of glass in their drinks to walk out quietly. I seriously do not know what they expect from us. I demanded for the manager n yes I raised my voice (in case the owner wants to penalize me for raising my voice . Seriously what to do you expect when you treat your customer in this way?) I'm not going to deny it. Someone showed up but nope he wasn't the lady manager that served us. He was extremely defensive because the first sentence that he said was " this never happened in our restaurant before" what do you mean by that? Yes it is an accident and it happened. What is the point of saying it never happened? The action that you chose is the crucial factor in determining if you care about your customer. I was of course angry because it sort of Implied that I was at fault. I also said how can you expect me to pay for a drink with glass pieces inside and you guys showed no intention of compensating us. We are not trying to be cheap or taking advantage of a free meal. Even if food is horrible I will still pay for it but no I'm not going to pay for a drink which has glass pieces inside ! This is consumer right. He kept saying yes I'm here to say sorry and let's not make it a big deal. There you go guys, tell me if he is not being defensive. The only benefit of doubt I can give is he is not very wise with his choice of words. In the end they took out the price of th glass of sangria. But tbh, nothing they do will change anything as they had been given a chance. The fact that no one came back to apologise when the first feedback was given is already bad enough.an apology which came after a big fuss was made is too late and obviously not sincere. Who the hell in their sane mind doesnt apologise over having objects that bruise your customer's tongue??Show less

Author: tonyhJ9770AYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A great dinner
Review: Run by a lovely Spanish couple, great value and good selection of wines. Food was magnificent, accommodated my vegetarian friends with no fuss to create a beautiful paella, on par with best I've had including trips through Spain. My pork was excellent, overall a great experience, will be back. Show less

Author: shaddapustinkMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The best place for tapas in melaka
Review: A great space for dinner, events and parties! They have a great selection of wine, beer and gin from Northwest of Spain. Even their meat are imported from Spain. If you are looking for a taste of Spain, look no further than Salud Tapas. Highly recommended to try their Nordes gin n tonic Show less

Author: tree5Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Gem in Jonker Street
Review: Now you can tell people that Jonker Street is not about Street food or nyonya cuisine only.Order any pork dish and i am sure it wouldnt disappoint you.Tapas standard are average, not the best but they are good enough! We love their drinks menu with cocktail & wine variety.Show less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good Spanish food
Review: A good and if I am not wrong the only Spanish restaurant in Melaka. My relations ordered a variety of food which was quickly devoured as we were hungry (therefore a lack of photos). We had paella as our main dish with ibico pork. The atmosphere was good. The salad was refreshing and we had a potatoes dish as well. We had churros for dessert. The service exceptional but mind you the food is not cheap. Show less

Author: josslerUK
Title: The Food needs more flavour
Review: For me, the food we ordered lacked flavour. The tapas & the paella were simply not delicious. And they should be. Or, if they aren’t dishes that the chef really loves cooking, delete them from the menu & focus on the less touristy Spanish cuisine alternatives that Maria (the charming Spanish manageress) told us was the chef’s forte.We felt that the prices were too high for what we received. I note many management rebuttals asserting that the cost is fair considering that the produce allegedly comes from Spain. But to be honest, I think the restaurant could source comparable quality & cheaper produce locally, and thereby reduce the prices a bit. Many of the Spanish cheeses I ordered are available in KL - and at a price that would still offer a good margin. So why import them?I also note restaurant comment that all the seafood is bought fresh, daily. Well I cannot agree that the seafood in my paella was fresh / the prawns were mushy & literally tasteless (as if defrosted). Good, fresh prawns are flavoursome & fabulous - they are what I want in my paella. Along with more garlic, some white wine, more seasoning (a pinch of chilli or chorizo) etc. SALUD’s recipe is unlike any paella I have eaten (or cooked myself) before. And it’s not as good. I hope the restaurant takes this point constructively & adjusts the recipe. Having debriefed Maria on the above points, she was professional & courteous, and offered us a complimentary dessert. So, Would I go back? Maybe. But having now read so many of the poor reviews, and seen some pretty unprofessional management responses...I think I’ll steer clear for a while to see if the restaurant attracts plenty of positive reviews over the next few weeks. If it does, I’ll take Maria up on her invitation to give SALUD a second chance. Show less

Author: TomGuppy
Title: A special evening
Review: Beautiful authentic tapas accompanied by a fantastic selection of beverages with excellent service by Maria and her team. A super evening was had by a large party on a very special event. Couldn’t have asked for a better venue!

Author: DOHAJOAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Delicious Tapas & Sangria!
Review: We happened to pass by this restaurant while walking to Jonker Street in the afternoon. It was closed at the time, but we were anxious to give it a try for our evening meal.WOW!! we were not disappointed! The place had a warm cozy feel to it when you entered. The manger, Maria was graciously in conversation with some of the diners when we entered. She came over to our table and struck up a conversation with us too! Since I speak Spanish the conversation was in Spanish! Such a lovely and friendly young woman! She made us feel very welcome!The food was outstanding!! Each plate we ordered seemed better than the last one! The flavors just danced in my mouth! The Sangria was probably one of the best ones I have tasted! ( have been to Spain so I know my sangria!)I would highly recommend this restaurant to my friends and I will most definitely go again the next time I am in Melaka!Show less

Author: mlle_deniseberlin
Title: Sublime Authentic Laudable Unpretentious Delicious
Review: There are very few establishments which seem to overcome all the boundaries erected by modern travel to having an authentic wonderful culinary experience. Even fewer in number are places offering cuisine foreign to the country that they are operating in. People will always tell you that the best cooking is in the home country, or even that the ingredients cannot travel across the seas...the Irish say that Guinness is best sampled in Ireland, the French will swear that you can only truly appreciate fois gras when on French soil etc etc etc... At Salud a small dedicated team led by a wonderfully energetic (and wise beyond his years) chef from the tip of North Western Spain has managed to achieve the impossible. Despite all challenges they have succeeded in presenting a truly authentically Spanish experience ( with Gallego touches -where else can one see Felloas on a menu outside of Galicia?Answer: Inside Spain -only rarely, outside of Spain, Never! )Unfortunately we could not manage to get as far as dessert.. maybe in the next lifetime. For our tapas we chose the extremely well balanced Ensaladilla (better than my mother in law), Coquettas filled with a sublime salmon mousse, the coating was cooked to perfection and finally a tortilla cooked right in front of us, now here perhaps one tiny personal matter: I prefer my tortilla a tiny bit more "runny" but that is how my wife's uncle literally throws it together, my wife on the other hand who is Spanish and knows about food thought it perfect. Sorry, I'm Irish. We had a bottle of Estrella 1906 Reserva beer which paired perfectly. We then ordered a bottle of the house red, very decently priced,but cautiously enquired as to whether it was ok? No need to worry, the wine is well stored, essential here where the temperature hardly ever descends to 20°. The chef assured us that although it was the house red it was a good wine and it was around then that we started to see his personal pride in everything under that fine timbered roof. Alongside the Garnacha-Syrah blend we enjoyed the Secreto Iberico (I was hoping to try the Paella but my wife overruled me and we chose the pork). This came with three sauces. Our bill was an extremely reasonable 70€. Similar in price to Spain..but.. and here is the whole point..the quality was higher at Salud and that despite it being on the other side of the world in a tropical climate. Bravo y mucho exito! D&WShow less

Author: TravelmadEdinburghEdinburgh
Title: Excellent - So Good We Visited Twice
Review: At the end of 3 weeks travelling around Malaysia it was time to have something different for dinner especially in a place that looked as attractive as Salud, I confess to being slightly put off by some negative comments but we were very impressed, so much so we went back for lunch on our last day. We travel extensively in Spain and have done over more than 25 years and eaten a lot of tapas during that time. The five tapas we chose for dinner were all top notch example of classic tapas, well cooked and presented and good quality. Yes the dishes are more expensive than local dishes but with the setting, presentation and some imported items what would you expect. We returned or lunch & shared a Huevos Rotos with top quality Jamon, comfort food before a long journey home. Thank you to Beorgan, hope the spelling is correct, & Maria for excellent food and hospitality.Show less

Author: HesterEOegstgeest, The Netherlands
Title: Fantastic tapas!
Review: We had dinner comprising several tapas. Starting with two nice gazpachos (with a very subtle taste); gambas al ajillo; ensalada salud, falafel and the best was a freshly cut piece of salmon, transferred into a fantastic tartare (with avocado, lime dressing, oregano, parsley). The best meal we had for weeks. This place deserves at least 5 stars. Gracias!!!!!Show less

Author: chrisrC3957GKCannock, United Kingdom
Title: Over rated
Review: Way over rated. Are there a year ago and remembered it to be good. Having told visitors that it was best restaurant in Melaka I was embarrassed. Poor service, very poor tapas and way over priced. I paid the bill because I felt obligated to after such a poor experience. In KL this place wouldn’t survive six months. V sad.Show less

Author: Mandy Lea S
Title: Must visit when in Melaka!
Review: Great ambience, loved watching the chefs cook as we ate. Spanish beef and pork was amazing. Great front of house and perfect location. A little pricey but worth it.

Author: Angela SWigan, United Kingdom
Title: Pleasant change to Nadi Lemak!
Review: Haven eaten rice, rice and more rice for past few days, finding this tapas place was just what we needed. Shared a few tapas with a fellow traveller from our hotel we met in the doorway to the restaurant. Great choice of food, lovely beer and wine to wash it all down and would highly recommend. The chef from Spain, cooked food authentically, waitress too was from Spain.Show less

Author: btsFoodhunter
Title: A must go!!
Review: Great places!! Dropped in this evening for a glass of wine and at the end we stayed there until almost closing. We started to order some tapas like coca catalana and croquettes..delicious!! We ordered a bottle of a fantastic Spanish wine and watched as more and more beautiful dishes were being prepared so we ordered more... Everyone looks enjoying the show and the lovely atmosphere!!The staff super attentive and really professional.We love this places!!! Highly recommended!! Show less

Author: irepatMadrid, Spain
Title: Decent food but quite pricey for Melaka.
Review: We had some beers and tapas, the food was good but not exceptional.Price is on the high side, probably due to the fact that many ingredients are imported.If you’re after a European meal in Melaka this is the place to be, however there is better value for the money available in Melaka.Show less

Author: Micael27
Title: Amazing food
Review:
The food was simply amazing, not particularly cheap but worth every cent!
The place is cozy, clean and pretty and the food superb

Author: 393agnesm
Title: Great find
Review: Popped in for a drink - super sangria . Staff very helpful and polite and obviously well trained around food hygiene - made a reservation for dinner tomorrow - so looking forward to it !

Author: 471satiiParis, France
Title: So good that we come bck for lunch!!!
Review: omg this places is really amazing! The food was so good that me and my couple we come back for lunchbthe next day. Here we tried the best food of Malaysia. The ambient, the wines, the services and all super clean!! Definetly we super recommend this places. Take a break of the asian food here was the best!!!Show less

Author: gotomix2011
Title: One of the best restaurant in Melaka
Review: Awesome food well cooked by a Spanish chef. Entertaining open kitchen bar. Everthing on the menu is Spanish. If you go tapas, take at least 3 per person.

Author: FrequentFlier809388Odawara, Japan
Title: Good only to foreigners
Review: Food was mediocre at best. For price and claims as a good Spanish restaurant, we are disappointed. Only the grilled Squid with mashed potatoes had fantastic taste. Sadly waiters were not friendly as reviews mentioned. Very robotic and not helpful at all. They look friendly only to westerners. The manager seems to visit only tables with Western guest. Felt discriminated.Show less

Author: Meg P
Title: Food was great!
Review: Food was really great! The best meal I had in Malaka. It's really good food and the sangria was excellent. The reception is very nice and the service is really good.

Author: 129fredericbKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly reception and service, good food
Review: We had a wonderful dinner and lunch here, although it must be said: when de charming manager is not there (for lunch) it was not as good...Wonderful tapas and main courses, great wines by the bottle and the glass and a wonderful environment.To be honest, all the other restaurants in the old centre of Malakka are not very convincing except SALUD.Show less

Author: shirleycunningham1London, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing Food and drink as usual with some great new choices
Review: We have been coming to Malaka for 11 years and have seen many changes, one of the best was when Salud opened 4 years ago. Every time we come to Melaka, a visit to Salud is a must for us. We loved your new wines and beers as recommended by Maria, who as always welcomes you with a wonderful big smile. We decided we would only have the Tapas which were amazing,we were then offered Chefs new desserts to try, Mini Cheesecake and a wonderful plate of small cubes of cream cheese covered with a large slice of quince, a delicious sauce and sprinkled sliced almonds. The service was good and we were sad to leave but we had arranged to meet some friends and we were now very late. A really great evening.Show less

Author: kmquekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Maria and her boyfriend runs this Spanish restaurant
Review: Maria and her boyfriend both from Spain runs this restaurant. Food is not fantastic but it’s good value for money and a nice change from just eating local food the entire trip. We had a nice selection of Spanish beer and Prima wine from their hometown. Food was ok and we had a good time.Show less

Author: RedKitty_12Seattle
Title: BEST restaurant Melaka
Review: Excellent tapas and cocktails! We had dinner here and enjoyed the ambiance and attentive service. The sangria and spanish gin drinks were the best. We liked this place so much we returned for lunch the next day. Inadvertently left my credit card behind. We were walking back to our hotel after the Jonker Night Market and walked past the restaurant. Our server came running out with the credit card I didn't realized I had left behind. Love this place. Would highly recommend for a memorable Melaka experience.Show less

Author: Rishibsilchar
Title: Service was sad
Review: I visited the restaurant yesterday, that is 4th of November.. Food was good the problem was with the attitude of the waiter who was serving our table, There is a cemented slab to seat against the wall, they did not provide me a cushon to seat, there were few people on my left and right side who had the cushon to seat.. When i raised the issue, he told me that they cant provode me cushon. And then he walked away.. Later when i asked for the manager who never turned up at all, later on after 15 min the waiter comes back and ask me if i wish i can shift to some other place.. I felt it was not profational.. I jope the woner of this restaurant deals with the issue.Show less

Author: smellydofuSingapore, Singapore
Title: A tapas bar that doesn't really serve tapas
Review: Variety was lacking. Not sure why this restaurant is rated so highly. If you have dined at a real tapas bar before, you would know that the restaurant isn't really serving tapas. Paella was cooked using basmati rice and prawns with garlic was like stir fried in Chinese style. Salad was alright. Grilled octopus leg was pricey but not bad.Also, there was lizard poop on my table. The waiter cleaned it off after I brought it up.Show less

Author: jeryros
Title: Always an Awesome Experience!
Review: Whenever I am in Malacca we do not forget to dine to this great Spanish restaurant! Awesome food especially the Spanish beef. The wines are truly Hispanic to the last drop. I hope to visit again soon!

Author: coffeeaddict20019Singapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome and fresh food
Review: As I am writing this review, I am salivatingThe food was soooooo good.I went there for my son's birthday celebration and never regretted it.The manager Maria Marcos gave us a warm welcome and the waiters were attentive to our needs.It is abit on the higher end but the quality of the food is worth the price.We ordered a starter of assorted iberico and cheese,Rustic bread with spiced butter,Crujientitos(honey mustard chicken)Paella,Griilled pork with sweet potatoes and 3 sauces,and for dessert we had churros and brownies.The bread was to die for,hot from the oven with their speciality butter.The best butter I had tasted so far!The grilled pork was juicy and the sweet potatoes complimented it:)The assorted meat and cheese was another level,each bite brought me such much of happiness.Paella was full of flavour and the seafood was fresh.The brownie was more of a cake texture but still super delicious and the churros were not my favourite.I prefer mine to be a bit more crispy and flavoured with cinnamon.We paid MYR 360 for this meal.A hole in the pocket but we left with a contented smile and tummy.If you are looking for a heavy meal ,this is not the place as the servings are small.They live up to their small bites,big flavours!We will be back when we are in Malacca.Show less

Author: PreveenkumarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive, small portion and not many varieties.
Review: For a place with price rocketing sky high, i would expect the waiters to at least speak or understand English. The portion was tiny, and food was cold. If you are a vegetarian, forget about this place, you will have to go to some other shop after paying the bill here coz there's literally nothing worth for you to try there. Meat lovers who only eat a small bite of meat will like this place, however they don't exist. The close up pictures got me good, it's misleading.Show less

Author: Peter AMelbourne, Australia
Title: Consistently great
Review: Always visit Salud when we’re in Melaka. This time was midweek and Maria had a pretty full house under control. The menu has expanded since our last visit with a few more tapas and at least one more main. Food quality remains high and that’s why we keep going back. Maria suggested we try a new wine - Monastrell and Shiraz blend - which was very good. Finished off with cute little churros and a walk back down Jonker.Show less

Author: DennismyEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Great EVENING!!!
Review: If I could give 10 stars I would. Flawless from start to finish!!! Best restaurant in Melaka. Main ingredients are imported from Spain. It was amazing watch how the Spanish Chef preparing your food with utmost attention to detail.The Spanish manager was really attentive to us and she did an awesome job recommending items from the menu. We had a great evening here.Show less

Author: Evelina BLund, Sweden
Title: Surprisingly awful
Review: This is going to be quite a long review and not a very good one I’m afraid. In all honesty this is the first negative review I’ve ever written as I’m not normally disappointed with restaurants but this experience really was extraordinary. Me and my partner came to Salud last year and had the best time. We were impressed with both the food, drinks and staff and therefore decided to bring our friend there again this year when we visited Melaka together with him. As we arrived to the restaurant we were greeted by the staff and the manager came and spoke to us and recommended wine. We had a lovely chat and she told us she came from the Canary Island and seemed to know quite a bit about Spanish food and wine… We decided to order some tapas to share. To our surprise, some of the food arrived literally five minutes after we had ordered it and it was stone cold. It clearly had been been ready and just out waiting for someone to order it for ages. We ordered the rustic bread (similar to bruschetta) with tomatoes and garlic spread and it was both cold and completely soggy. It wasn’t edible. We also ordered the potato tortilla and it was also stone cold and completely dry. I told the waiter that the tortilla was cold (I’m not entirely sure he completely understood me as he didn’t really speak English) and he asked “You don’t want it cold?” and I asked if it was meant to be served cold, as I had assumed it would be served hot. He said he would check with the manager and then never got back to us. The manager, a red haired woman, finally came over to us and asked how the food was. We told her that unfortunately we were quite disappointed with the bread and tortilla as they were inedible and cold and since they arrived within five minutes of us ordering they clearly couldn’t have been cooked after we had ordered them. She said she would check with the chef, but she went off and didn’t get back to us. We were still hungry and didn’t want to order more food so after waiting for ages we just asked for the bill. The manager came back as we were about to pay and we asked why she never got back to us or even offered to replace our food with new warm food. She got very defensive and said that from the moment we entered the restaurant all her staff had told her that we were in a bad mood so she didn’t want to waste her time on us as it would create a bad ‘vibe’ for her. I tried to explain that we were not in a bad mood, just disappointed with the cold food, a problem that could have been easily solved by her just replacing the food with fresh, warm food. She disagreed and then started talking to us in a very condescending way saying that the rustic bread literally cost the equivalent of 1€ and if 1€ meant that much to us, she could take 1€ off the bill. We said that there was no need for that and that we’d obviously pay the full price for the food but she snatched the bill out of our friend’s hand and went to change it- taking RM5 off the price. As she came back, she was still defensive and in a bad mood and we told her that we didn’t want to argue, we were happy to pay full price and that we just wanted to leave. She then replied “good, you should leave. I don’t want customers like you in my restaurant anyway”. I have actually never experienced anything like this before. I’ve never been spoken to like this in a restaurant or being treated this unprofessionally. She obviously didn’t care about the restaurant's reputation or her work position as a manager, so I assume she was related to the owner in some way as she clearly can’t have been educated in service business or in the restaurant business and obviously wasn’t worried about her job position or receiving criticism. It’s just a shame as we were only in Melaka for two days with our friend and really wanted to take him out for nice meals and make sure he had a great time, but this really was an awful experience.Show less

Author: Dreamer313490
Title: Good, but not everything good
Review:
Falafel, meatballs, satay, potatoes, cold cuts/cheese, were all great.  Presentation very good.  Staff friendly.

The Caesar salad was not good.  The olives  were terrible, could get better out of a jar.  Chorizo not great and only get one per order.

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Spectacular Spanish Surprise
Review: This wonderful busy restaurant serves authentic and amazing food. The buzz is great and the staff are passionate about the ingredients that go to make their delicious food. We sat at the open kitchen bar and watched the staff work so hard to produce dish after dish of tasty food, beautifully presented and made to order. Key ingredients are imported to ensure the tastes meet the restaurant’s high standards for authentic flavours.We had a fabulous evening, enjoying awesome cuisine in a wonderful atmosphere. If in Melaka, you need to go to the Salud Tapas Bar and Restaurant.Show less

Author: Jennie D
Title: Exciting new venue
Review: Visited Salud for first time during 4th trip to Melaka.  Thoroughly enjoyed the ambiance, great service, varied menu.  Well worth making the time to enjoy.

Author: louisee501Essendon, Australia
Title: Really tasty lunch stop
Review: My partner and I stopped here for lunch after exploring the Jonker st district. The food was excellent, we sat close to the open kitchen and my partner who is a chef was very impressed with the two boys working in the kitchen. The food was really tasty and authentic. The wine well priced as well which is a nice option when you don’t get to drink much wine in Malaysia. The only downside was the young guy who was waiting on tables. It felt like he didn’t want to be there and he wasn’t very friendly. Don’t let this stop you going though as everything else about the restaurant is great! Show less

Author: Sulifamily
Title: Weekend fun
Review:
Spent the day walking around old town Melaka and found this amazing place. 
Best Margaritas and delicious food. The service was very good and the venue was refreshing after a hot afternoon of exploring. 
This is a must stopover when visiting Melaka

Author: wenxinnnnnBatu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: First and last visit
Review: Googled and found this restaurant. Ambience was alright but food in general, tasted really bad as if it’s cooked without sincerity. Made me really curious as of whether I really got what I paid for. The steak was especially salty to the extent where it’s almost unpalatable. Definitely wouldn’t recommend anyone to visit. Everything else ordered was equally unappetising. High expectations because of the reviews online but no kidding it’s really, really bad! Very disappointing.Show less

Author: Branko_IngridNetherlands
Title: Top Tapas in the Far East
Review: Between all the local food this tapas place is a very welcoming change. The food is prepared with great passion and is delicate tasting. The Spanish owner is very kind and of course loves talking about his home country. Many of the specialties are brought from Spain.5 star rating for food quality and service.Show less

Author: pelalentedaluBelo Horizonte, MG
Title: Good food and environment
Review: This place is delicious. Well decorated, good music and friendly staff. I had a refreshing drink made by wine and some tapas. A bit pricey for the city but it’s ok, it worths. Must goShow less

Author: Venture655427
Title: Perfect!!!
Review: Hello it was perfect last night with our two families. Made us feel if we were in Spain! Advice to others go there before its crowded!!!

Author: scnufSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent fine Spanish food in Melaka!
Review: The ambience is great. Location is at Jonker street so pretty central, however it makes parking a bit difficult. The food is decent and delicious, family members loved all the specialties. Price is reasonable for the food, but definitely at high end for locals. Favorite is the garlic prawns tapas. Show less

Author: Peter AMelbourne, Australia
Title: Melaka’s finest
Review: The must visit place for us to eat when we are in Melaka. All of our guests get dragged along with us. Well run, professional staff and a tasty reliable menu.It’s the tapas really. Don’t think we’ve ever ordered a main course. They look fine, but we prefer to share a number of tapas plates around the table.Good wine list and Maria can always assist if required. Saw some Spanish beer arrive last night, but it needed to chill.Very reasonably priced by western standards.Melaka doesn’t have a great number of western food options and this is the standout for us.Show less

Author: MajkenpetersenAarhus, Denmark
Title: Delicious tapas
Review: Located close to our hotel, this was an easy dinner solution for us. Very European food and suroundings. Food was absolutely delicios, but a bit pricey compared to the rest of town. A really good choice if you are feeling af bit tired of rice and noodles.Show less

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: A lovely night out
Review: A visit to Salud is like a warm hug from a friendly Spaniard. Comforting, passionate and just that little bit sexy.It's probably fair to suggest Salud is one of the best restaurants in Malacca, maybe even all of Malaysia, the quality of produce, and the care taken with presentation is impressive, add in some wonderful atmosphere and you're in for an evening to remember.We were just a party of two so sat at the long bench overlooking the kitchen bar area, it makes for a night of theatre as well as giving a sneak preview of the other dishes available.There's an impressive wine list, with a really nice house wine, red and white by the glass and bottle, if you travel anywhere in Malaysia you'll know that the wines are usually on the high side of the price spectrum, Salud's wine list is in keeping with those prices but still fair and worth splashing out on a bottle.All in all a great night out in the centre of the town.Show less

Author: wcrk2015
Title: Memorable as always
Review:
Was there for a special anniversary dinner and they lived up to our usual expectations.
Warm and friendly staff, excellent food, great ambience.
One the best tapas we have had in some time - very reasonable prices too.

Author: BogdanCCiuta
Title: Beautiful Galician gem hidden in a vibrant city
Review: Have to start off by saying hats off to the wonder that is the food. Did not expect to be brought back to my youth in Andalucia by a restaurant in Melaka. But Salud and its gorgeous food managed to bring me back memories of many wonderful days at my favourite tapas chiringuito in Estepona. From simple pan con tomate, to a beautifully cooked secreto iberico, and a flamboyant fiery chorizo that has my wife giggling with anticipation, I can without a doubt recommend this place for anyone wanting a taste of Spain's heartful cuisine. Also as a side, the owners are lovely, and very open and passionate about their work. I did not get a chance to taste the Tio Pepe he showed me he had hidden in a cupboard for special ocassions, but I hope I will get a chance in the future. Salud, you really are a gem.Show less

Author: Ashok PMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic
Review: The chef is Spanish, and he gets authentic cheeses and cured meats from Spain. He's also passionate about his cooking, and it shows in the end products. He uses the best available fresh local produce along with the food sourced from Spain for his delicious tapas. He used to have Spanish beer, but unfortunately no longer does. However, the Spanish gins are great!Show less

Author: acline2771
Title: Wonderful meal with great hosts and staff
Review:
We were warmly welcomed into SALUD and it set the tone for a wonderful experience.  The service was the best we experienced in Melaka and the food was delicious.  Many of the tapas portions were larger than expected.  
Don't miss this gem of a restaurant.

Author: Jessica4519Spain
Title: Excellent dinner in melaka
Review: We were on our honeymoon moon trip and this restaurant was highly recommended! After having dinner there the first time we understand why people are recommending it...a great choice of delicious food and good prices, a fantastic atmosphere and great stuff made that we went there a lot of times during our stay. If you like to taste a lovely Spanish wine and food you have to go there...it's just awesome!!!Show less

Author: hannedpbelgiumDendermonde, Belgium
Title: Very good patas bravas en Rose wine
Review: Ather 2 weeks traveling we were very happy to have some western food. Tapas were delicious! Very good patatas bravas , iberico croquetas and gambas! Portions ( besides the patatas bravas ) were rather small, even for tapas, buth very good. They have some nice rose wine as well. Friendly staff. Show less

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Spanish food made a change
Review: Dined here for some tapas and wine to have a break from Asian food and beer! The house red and rose were quite nice at 22 RM a glass. We had the honey chicken, chorizo, ham croquettas and bread so quite a light meal but tasty. We were a little disappointed with the chorizo as there was no sauce and usually at Spanish restaurants it has a good sauce for mopping up the tasty oils with bread. Service was excellent though. Show less

Author: Melchua523
Title: Salud..
Review: Nice environment, cosy place but a little bit costly to dine in... Meals, drinks and staff are quite friendly...

Author: Marianne VKuantan, Malaysia
Title: One of the best in Melaka
Review: A real Spanish Tapas place. We tried the Iberico ham and cheese platter. Croquettes with ham as starters.Pork cheeks and Spanish beef as main corse. Checks a bit disappointing, to much gravy. The rest very good. Complained about the fries and they changed it. Very good wine.Overall av good service. Show less

Author: kaybP509FG's-Gravenzande, The Netherlands
Title: Hidden gem in Melaka
Review: What a beautifull hidden gem in Melaka this is. The food was very good. Prices were quite fine as well for western standards. The tapas is really good, restaurant is nicely composed and the staff is very friendly. Was surprised to see how little people were in the restaurant during the time we ate there. Definitely a welcoming change of scenery after all the rice and noodles we ate while being in malaysia. Show less

Author: Toby R
Title: Tasty Bits
Review: Good tapas restaurant. Counter in front of the kitchen allows visitors to observe the food preparation. Many interesting dishes. Mostly Mediterranean style foods. Very nice break from Asian food.

Author: Sebapetter
Title: Very good and authentic spanish tapas
Review: We had a very nice dinner here. Tasty and authentic spanish tapas and also very good red wine! Goat cheese salad was really nice!

Author: dan k
Title: Proper Spanish grub.
Review: Get the tortilla and the prawns. Super service, great drinks (gin selection and happy hour beer) and beautiful coffee. Came to about 100myr per person.

Author: Nicholas B
Title: Great food, wine and atmosphere
Review: Fantastic food. Great to watch the chefs prepare.  Spanish rose was a superb wine.  Highly recommend replace to eat.  The food was great prepared in front of us and we were served by attentive staff and great hosts.

Author: Rob HCoto de Caza, California
Title: Wow
Review: We came here due to the ratings and it did not disappoint. We walked in around 7:30pm and Maria found a table for us within 30 minutes as the place was packed. Since it was our first visit here we let Maria order the entire meal for us. She started with some smaller tapas and moved us through the menu to to the larger plates. The seafood paella was the hit of the night but all the food was fresh, hot and flavorful. The entire bill with 10 beers and 3 margaritas was $200US. As with the other reviewers this is a must stop when in Malacca. I do suggest you make a reservation as the place is small. Well done to Salud!!Show less

Author: pws3932Penang, Malaysia
Title: pws
Review: Situated at the heart of Jonker Walk, it is no doubt that Salud Tapas is one of the best places in Melaka that offers authentic Spanish food with a modern twist.Finest Spanish cuisine that is tangy, zesty and well seasoned with herbs and spices. Cozy ambiance and atmosphere with friendly hospitality from the manager, Miss Maria as well as her staff. Show less

Author: P8109ZWjulies
Title: Amazing!
Review: Wow! A amazing tapas bar. Great food all cooked fresh right in front of you. Brilliant chef. Cannot praise enough. Staff friendly and good wine at a reasonable price.  Must try you won’t be disappointed . ❤️

Author: YauKuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Beyond fabulous
Review: Where on earth to start? This is a fabulous Restaurant. We dropped in without reservation on a very busy Saturday night at peak time in the middle of Chinese New Year when Melaka was really buzzing. So how lovely to be greeted by a very friendly Spanish lady (Maria, co-owner with the Spanish Chef we later found out) who took great effort to get us a nice table. The service was excellent and all staff really tried to make things go well. There is a small Spanish wine list and as I was unfamiliar with those offered I asked Maria. She brought two bottles to the table and said she recommended both but personally liked the 2016 Prima, a Tinto de Toro and Garnacha blend, which was not on the list. It was superb and very smooth with a delicate flavour.The menu is very interesting and has some unusual Tapas. We had Gazpacho and Iberico, but these you can get elsewhere. Then we tried the Coca Catalana, a traditional Spanish Canapé with anchovies on top and were blown away (see photo). They were fabulous. I could have eaten them all night. The Tostada de Cecina, Dry beef dressed with black pepper, nuts and olive oil on rustic bread was also superb and I start to run out of superlatives to describe all the food. These were the two most stand out dishes we had, but things were so good throughout we returned the next night, not something we usually do. The next night we had to have the Coca Catalana again, but we followed this with Chorizo al infierno, Spanish Sausages from Hell (see photo). I can tell you Hell is not such a bad place if this is what they serve! We also had meltingly good Abondigas, pork meatballs cooked in Grandmothers sauce and stuffed ourselves with a Paella, with saffron, chicken, seafood and vegetables (it takes 20 minutes but it is worth it). There is also a black squid ink version we did not have space for. We ended the evening chatting to the Chef at the Bar and drinking Spanish Marc (like Grappa but much better). It was the perfect end to a wonderful meal and a magical evening. This is a meal we will remember for a very long time.PS They also have the Spanish Gin called Gin Mare which I have had only once before (in Kuching of all places) and I believe it is the best there is and if you like Gin you really should try it..Show less

Author: Sascha_B20142014Groningen, The Netherlands
Title: Fantastic authentic tapas - better than many tapasbars in Spain
Review: You wouldn't expect this in Melaka, or Malaysia at all but thankfully, the sweet hardworking Spanish couple came here and run a beautifully styled restaurant that has been thought through in a flavourful menu, logistics(how to run a kitchen with employees who don't understand the taste, speed and culture of tapas, let alone acquire the correct ingredients), interior( even toilets are beautiful) and good drinks.(no standard awful cocktails and sweet juices)Well, they did it-and how. It was a true pleasure to see how well people received their quality, eye for aesthetics, enjoy the tapas made with lot of care.We came in for just some small bites to share: we ordered a mix of Iberican meats and manchego and an other sheep cheese. After that bread with gazpacho, croqeutas with mushrooms and a beautiful trufflemayonaise(home made mayonaise), grilled octopus with a beautiful potatocream, albondigas in pumpkinsaucs. The albondigas were made of course grounded porc, which resulted in a beautiful soft texture without the classical gummifeel of cheap meatballs. The sauce was original and rich.We could not resist a dessert: a deconstructed cheesecake in a glass with strawberrysauce and crumble and chocolatebrownie:fluffy, moist, made with very good dark chocolate accompanied with homemade vanilla ice cream, quincesauce and whipped cream.An evening out couldn't be more complete. Of course, this restaurant is quite expensive compared to other restaurants. But it's the difference of eating food and dining a night out being entertained and feeling totally lucky!Show less

Author: Z4298OOtonym
Title: Excellent
Review:
Great place , great staff , great food
Early evening supper the menus choice was excellent as was the quality.
As good as any Spanish tapas bar and excellent quality

Author: huiiwen95
Title: Celebrating
Review:
Nice environment & reasonable price, will consider to visit again.
Better if have some photo of foods in the menu, it would be easier for customers to refer and order.

Author: arianna0405Ancona, Italy
Title: The best dinner in Melaka
Review: I've stayed in melaka for three weeks and Salud tapas was a great discovery.Is the best place if you want to have dinner with typical Spanish meals.Tapas y raciones are the best I have ever tried trust me. We were there with a Spanish friend and he also said they were very very good.If you are staying in melaka and you have already tried local food and nyona cuisine, you have to go there and order a jar of sangria and enjoy your time with friends in a very nice place. Strongly recommended Show less

Author: troycav
Title: Excellent tapas.
Review: A must try if you are in the area.   Stuck to the tapas.  The grilled squid was perfect as too the spicy prawns.  Fresh and delicious.  Been back twice in my short stay to Melaka.

Author: Voyage402766Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best New Year's Eve Dinner
Review: I came in as a solo diner on new year's eve, which was probably the reason that I managed to get a place to sit. You need to make reservations to ensure you get a place because this place is really good! The food here is simply outstanding. The Chorizo from Hell is a definite must try for the show that you get at your table - they flame the sausage in front of you. And it tasted great. The paella I had was nice. And for dessert I had their cheesecake which was superb. Don't give this place a miss when you're in MelakaShow less

Author: xavi_diliDili, East Timor
Title: Awesome Spanish bites far from home
Review: As a Spanish I can say this is a real Spanish food restaurant. The place is nicely decorated and the staff ( special mention to the very welcoming Spanish couple) are very attentive. It is difficult to find a real Spanish restaurant in this latitudes, and yet they manage to have the best products imported, and with the passion they put in preparing everything expect nothing but really good food.We tried the first day a variety of tapas, including the amazing tortilla de patata and the superb tabla mixta(real Spanish cheese and jamon). For the second visit we went for the paella, which is prepared as if we were back home :)Felicidades pareja!Show less

Author: Mike BJohor, Malaysia
Title: Great food & drinks but a bit pricey !
Review: Took a group to SAlud and were wow'd by the decor, the efficient service, the quality of the tapas and drinks (sangria was awesome). Portion sizes were ok but could be more generous especially the paella. A very enjoyable evening and manager Maria looked after us superbly but could improve on offering better value for money when compared to other similar restaurants nearby.Show less

Author: AllyC09Singapore, Singapore
Title: Memorable Christmas with Marvellous Experience and Food
Review: We came from the South to celebrate our 1st Christmas at Malacca. Hoping that we could have some decent foods and drinks. Guess what? “We found it.”SALUD is indeed a cosy and relaxing restaurant that carry gems. Initially I was being skeptical about this place at the point of making the reservation. However? We got blown away by the Authentic, Spectacular and Charming lady, Ms. Maria upon our arrival. Excellent patience and unbeatable spirit with her love of her job to greet everyone of her guests with a bright smile and exclusive attention. (Not yo mention is a tsunami at the restaurant aka Christmas Eve. Lol)On a contrary, I am really unable to comprehend how many flavours and heart works by the chef who created our Marvellous menu. It was brilliant, divine and ingenious. (The foods are telling us “Scrumptious”).We are indeed blessed and it was a sensational Christmas. Thank you to SALUD and the wonderful people in the restaurant who has given us a Memorable Christmas. Show less

Author: henryglioriKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb!!
Review: We tried 5 or 6 different tapas and they were all super delicious!! Also the dessert was amazing. Nice place, with the kitchen in view. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: David SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Impressively run and attractive restaurant
Review: Visited on the strength of TripAdvisor reviews and was not disappointed. Although we loved the various local cuisines it was still a welcome change to sample authentic and well prepared Spanish tapas. Inside there is a separate dining area with conventional tables and a long open kitchen with a row of seats in front plus a few taller tables with higher chairs. The kitchen staff looked thoroughly professional and well trained. We were charmingly served by someone who originated from the Canary Islands. The food was interesting and varied and it was a welcome change to drink red wine that was genuinely palatable. It was enjoyable to watch the food being prepared and overall a place to recommend.Show less

Author: baccus60Penang, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Spanish Food
Review: Prime location. Parking was no problem. Simple decor, not cluttered, relaxed ambience - I was very comfortable in the restaurant. Good service, pleasant staff. Food was really good, authentic Spanish and I enjoyed every mouthful. We were a party of three and we shared 2 tapas, 2 mains, 2 desserts and a salad. We were served a tiny sauce bowl of pickled olives, onions and gherkins while we waited for our food. Tapas came first - 4 pork balls cooked in "grandmonther's sauce" with 2 slices of bread to soak up that delicious sauce. Next, 6 prawns cooked in garlic - the prawns were sweet and fresh, a tad tiny but we were fine with that. Mains were duck confit with a side of salad and string potatoes, and a platter of Iberico pork slices on a bed of roasted diced patato. Both mains were a pleasant surprise. The pork dish which my daughter commented looked like Korean stir-fry from the photos we googled was far from Korean or stir-fried! Juicy, tender and full of flavour.. The duck confit was done very well, it was simply delicious. We ordered the Salud Salad which came with slivers of sweet mango, jamon and a 2-inch diameter 3/8-inch thick log of goat cheese. A salad worthy of the restaurant's name! Dessert was homemade cheese rolled up in quince which was literally, to die for. The slightly salty, firm but soft cheese and the sweetness of the quince paired off beautifully and unlike any dessert I've ever had. The other dessert of crepe with a brushed layer of bittersweet chocolate topped with a scoop of vanilla ice-cream didn't wow us unfortunately. The crepe wasn't as soft as we had hoped and it was a little too chewy. Luckily we ate the quince dessert after the crepe so that was an excellent way to finish our meal and we quickly got over our disappointment with the crepe. Overall a really good dinner. We'll come again for sure. Salud has our recommendations.Show less

Author: annpK7508VK
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Just round the corner off Puri Hotel where we stayed. Drinks and food reasonably priced and waiters were very friendly and attentive. Good place to chill and relatively crowded on a Saturday night.

Author: powerwSingapore, Singapore
Title: It’s a Wow
Review: We just wanted to look for a place for some drinks as we already had dinner somewhere else.. we went to Salud.. total 7 of us including 3 kids.. all of us enjoyed our “second round”... tapas was well plated and tasty to go with some wine. Love it and will definitely come back again when in Malacca! Great ambience too.Show less

Author: borneo88Miri, Malaysia
Title: Gem of a restaurant
Review: We stumbled on this restaurant on our first evening in Malacca when walking around the old part of town. Unfortunately, the seats on the first floor roof top and outside were already taken so we settled for a table on the ground floor near the inner courtyard. The menu is small with a great variety of tapas and main courses. The food lends itself for sharing and families. We decided on 4 Tapas dishes and a Paella to share. There is a good drinks menu with wine by the glass and bottle. The food came out fast and the food quality was excellent. Owner run establishment who checks on the service and food personally. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: popcin22London, United Kingdom
Title: Absolutely delicious!
Review: The food and service was excellent! I was pleasantly surprised just how good the tapas were having had 'Spanish' food elsewhere in Malaysia. We ordered the garlic prawns - quite possibly the best garlic prawns I've ever eaten! I could have happily eaten another portion. We also had the squid and croquettas with jamon, though the 'jamon' was very minimal the taste of the croquettas and ooze factor was great, just melted in your mouth. What was also different was that the tapas came out one by one, after we finished one dish, another arrived whereas I have normally experienced tapas being brought out together. This unfortunately meant that when we were rather stuffed, the patatas bravas arrived! It was such a delicious dinner and nice to have a different cuisine that was such good quality. The atmosphere was also great and it was nice to see the chefs at work. I would definitely recommend eating here during your visit to Melaka.Show less

Author: 13_Mel
Title: Just great
Review: I know this is not Malaysian food, but there is so much great Malaysian food in Melacca that sometimes it is nice to have something different.   This is vey authentic and Maria the Manager is very welcoming.   Great for lunch or dinner.

Author: martinhelmantel
Title: Great food nice ambience
Review: Really a good choice when you want to try something different in Melaka. Nice dishes, good quality. Also for kids enough choice. Outdoor space is not huge, but just ok.

Author: Janny1974travellerDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great food and atmosphere.
Review: Maria, the manager, was a fantastic host and obviously loves her restaurant. The service was excellent, the staff were really friendly and the food was delicious. I recommend the jamón, the gambas pilpil (prawns) and the pluma (pork) - these were fantastic dishes. The restaurant also has a great wine list. An authentic Spanish experience and one that we will repeat when in Melaka next time. Show less

Author: JannChiaAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Rating of 5/5 for me
Review: This restaurant was just opposite our hotel and so we thought of giving it a try as i was looking for a proper dining place to celebrate my hubby's bday.The staff is friendly and attentive. Very good service from them. The food was yummy. The sausage under the tapas category is a must try. It was sooooooo delicious. The squid was good too. It came with a cream layer which was so yummy. As for the ham and cheese, i find the taste was abit too strong for me. Anyway, is a personal choice. Some will definitely like it. As for drinks, we started with sang ria. It is the best sang ria for me. Even the ones i had in Spain will have to give way to this. We tried many other drinks too and they were all good. However selection not much. I will definitely come back. Had a great night. yday. Loves the atmosphere.Show less

Author: javiercard2017Bilbao, Spain
Title: Yummy!
Review: We visited Melaka last september and we just found this spanish restaurant by chance and must say that it was a pleasant experience! We had been travelling around Southeast Asia for almost one month and we just wanted to savour some spanish food and it was really like eating at home, so delicious, well cooked and presented on the table! Everything was perfect, the food, the service and the atmosphere, a slice of Spain in Melaka! If you want to enjoy good spanish food in Melaka go to La Salud, you won´t regret it, on the contrary!Show less

Author: Crisper1
Title: Awesome Restaurant
Review: This place was fantastic! Friendly team, open kitchen that was very well run, menu was great and the Spanish food was awesome. Prices were good for the top quality experience. Thanks for a great night guys!

Author: AnnaKalraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Was closed for lunch
Review: We were highly recommended to visit this tapas bar. We scheduled it for our Sunday lunch (we had only 2 weekend days in Melaka). We can around 2 pm and the place was closed, they said "chef has not come".Show less

Author: Aba1968Singapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Spanish restaurant in Malacca
Review: We had been told about this restaurant when we arrived in Malacca and we decided to give up to nostalgia (we were a large group of Spaniards) and decided to have dinner there. It was really good. We were located in the upper floor, in a space that was great for the adults and children to have a loud dinner and enjoy all tapas that kept coming in! We liked the 'secreto', the cheese table, the squid and many others. The tomato bread (pan tumaca) was soggy but it is quite difficult to achieve the usual crunchy Spanish bread in such a humid climate. Breogan and Sara make the experience really niceShow less

Author: WilliamChua
Title: Great Tapas in Melaka
Review: It is a gem to find in Melaka. The tapas are good cos they have vegetarian selection. Friendly staff and good service.

Author: Jaxx86Gillingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious tapas- loved this place!
Review: We came for dinner and absolutely loved this place! The food we had (patatas bravas, gambas al ajillo, tortilla and iberico ham croquettes) was all delicious- the best tapas we have ever had outside of Spain. The restaurant has a really nice atmosphere with an open kitchen and all of the dishes are cooked fresh in front of you. For incredible, authentic tapas, I would certainly recommend this restaurant and will definitely visit again if I ever come back to Melaka!Show less

Author: Ragunath_k7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: Must try restaurant if you are in Melaka! Great choice of spanish food n wine. The food was excellent but the service could have been betterShow less

Author: MichelleS9557
Title: Good Vibe
Review: Had some good wine and yummy dessert at Salud. Nice place to just unwind as the staff are friendly, wines are good and music was great.Show less

Author: thiathia
Title: Awesome place
Review: Awesome place with great tapas and wines. Its a great experience to see how the chefs cooking over their open kitchen. Will go back again to savour more of their food

Author: ABYVRCanada
Title: Top choice for non-asian food
Review: Spanish food is probably not the first thing on your mind when you’re traveling through Malaysia, but if you get an urge to take a break from the Asian cuisine while you’re in Melaka, look no further than Salud Tapas in the heart of the old town. What stands out first as you walk into this impeccably designed restaurant is an open and extremely clean kitchen. I can’t emphasize enough the clean part of if because it’s really stands out as one of the cleanest restaurants that I’ve been to throughout my travels (in Asia or elsewhere). Then there is the staff, who are super friendly and willing to give detailed description of all of their gastronomic offerings. The chef is from Galicia (northern Spain), which makes the food here deliciously and truly Spanish. Their wins are also from Spain, and all of it is presented with a genuine desire to make your visit an unforgettable one. I would rate this place as a 5-star even if it were in Spain, but the fact that its takes you through an authentic Spanish culinary experience in the middle of SE Asia makes it deserving of some extra bonus points. Show less

Author: Bruno_OnkelinxBlanden, Belgium
Title: Just excellent !
Review: After 4 weeks travelling in Malaysia (and all sort of food tours to try out the local food) my pallet was ready again for some European flavours. And we picked this one on our last evening as very big fans of Spanish cuisine. Oh boy we enjoyed the food : the best paella I ever had (and I’m sort of specialising in paella’s and risottos) with the famous crispy bottom layer, excellent meat (with enough salt) and the indicator of a excellent Spanish restaurant : the croquettas de jamon.
