The Spanish chef did a very good job, I felt in Spain. A good patxaran would have finished the dish perfectly.Show less

Author: 565michellem565Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Early dinner with great vibe
Review: I read about this place in a guide book and we headed there for our one dinner in Melaka. We hadn't eaten much for lunch, so we were hungry early. Ordered drinks and 4 tapas dishes, sat on the porch area and chillaxed in the warm evening. I loved the music they were playing. The building opposite is painted a happy yellow and blocks the direct sunshine in the early evening - is good. The rosé my companion ordered was gorgeous, while my cocktail was a bit unbalanced. I swapped to the rosé and enjoyed the rest of our time there. The food was consistently good. I wish this place was just down the road from me - I would go every second day!!After our meal, we strolled through some of the old town and visited the temples. From this point of view, the location is good.I'm already planning to return with my family!Show less

Author: Gina2023Canberra, Australia
Title: Unexpectedly Fabulous
Review: Stumbled across this tapas bar while wandering the streets of Melaka, a little more expensive than the local dining options but the food, sangria and the service were all brilliant. So good in fact that although I was looking forward to exploring the local food we went back here for a second meal. Show less

Author: BeckyWattoP
Title: Amazing
Review:
Thank you, Salud for a wonderful evening yesterday. We came to celebrate our first wedding anniversary and everything was as spectacular as we hoped it could be. 
It’s a gorgeous little restaurant with lots of character, atmosphere and food to die for! 
Thoroughly recommend.

Author: krishbala
Title: Authentic
Review: Great Sangria by the glass, also Tinto de Verano. Very, very, very very good croquetas de Jamon. The cook is spanish and knows his way around the kitchen. Cant wait to go back to try the rest

Author: Vilas D
Title: Awesome
Review: Awesome place and very good food. Very clean place and a impresionant service. Totally recommended. Choose the secreto ibérico, it's tasty!

Author: PinJoueCentral Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Great Customer Service But Lousy Environment
Review: First of all,credit goes to Abin,our server.He has been very patient with us and he excude the 5* smiles and warmth when serving us.Kudos to him.I like the food served and defitinely deserved the 5* rating.Compliment to the Chef.I would have given a overall 5* if the seating arrangement was carefully designed taking into consideration of the poor ventilated area to include a smoking zone in the middle of no where...which I feel is a decision.We enjoyed the dinner but was put off by the 2nd hand smoke contributed by a group of youngsters....We left with smoke stinking our hair and clothes.The airwell was partially covered.I wonder how did MPMB approved this smoking zone layout?Show less

Author: DaveThompson16Ampang, Malaysia
Title: Good food, decent price
Review: Salad is a little different to the usual Melaka restaurant. A bit more sophisticated. Serving tapas and other Spanish dishes, it sits in the fairly unique niche of upper mid-range establishments. The ambiance is quiet and intimate - the perfect place for couples, or anybody looking to get away from the hustle and bustle of Jonker Walk. We had patatas bravas, chicken in honey and mustard sauce, and Serrano ham croquets as starters. All were delicious. We then shared a seafood chicken paella, which was also very good. With a glass of wine each and one soft drink, it came to RM175. Quite steep for Malaysia, but worth it for the quality. I would put Salud up against any tapas restaurant in KL or Singapore, but at much more reasonable prices. Recommended for serious eaters. Show less

Author: valeriedecost
Title: Very good products!
Review: Very qualitative products! Very nice place, great staff. It’s maybe a little bit expensive for Malaysia but i supposed it’s because of the very good and fresh products! Such great ham and goat cheese!

Author: Pancho628
Title: Very good Spanish food
Review: The place serves authentic Spanish food in general.  Octopus, ham, membrillo are excellent.  Needs to expand Spanish wine selection as an improvement.  Service is very good and friendly.  Prices are fair and location is convenient. Thanks Maria for your hospitality and service.

Author: VictoriaCorGarBarcelona, Spain
Title: Amazing Spanish food & friendly staff
Review: We went for dinner to this Spanish restaurant and I must say the food was absolutely amazing. We have had meetballs and they were so tasty. Also try their " tinto de verano" which is just glorious!!Maria was super friendly to us and she even explained a little bit of the events they use to organise there.Definitely will come back on my next trip to Malaysia.Abrazo enorme chic@s!!! olé. Show less

Author: Rafael F
Title: Surprisingly good Spanish restaurant in Malacca
Review: Thanks to Maria and her friendly and skilled staff for the nice dinner yesterday evening in Malacca. My wife and I never imagined such an excellent genuine Spanish food could be eaten in a place so far from our home town, Madrid. Muchas gracias!

Author: Linda CToronto, Canada
Title: Nice atmosphere, friendly staff, good food.
Review: Looking for a break from over two months of local foods, my choices at Salud fit the bill. My sangria was perfect, I ordered mesclun salad with thin slices of mango, thin cured ham (prosciutto?) and a big slice of goat cheese with a side of herb/oil dressing, accompanied by grilled squid on a bed of whipped mashed potato with carmelized onion. Could have been better (cheese more toasted/melted, onions carmelized, they were just lightly fried), but I enjoyed the food and the restaurant has a good atmosphere.Show less

Author: nickdI1361CZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprise find in Melaka
Review: Had dinner at Salud and was expecting it to be good, but it was better than that.... We had Patatas Bravas (crisp and well spiced with pimenton), Gambas (quite fresh and cooked with plenty of garlic and olive oil), Iberico ham (moist and really full of flavour) and Coca Catalana (great balance of sweet roasted veg and salty anchovy). The chef is Spanish which clearly helps in the food’s sourcing and authenticity. Overall the food compared very well with that in the best Singapore tapas bars and of course was considerably cheaper! Highly recommended restaurant if you want to try real Spanish tapas.Show less

Author: zkyerhys
Title: Mouth-watering, melt-in-the-mouth dishes that are a must have!
Review: Introduced this 2018 Lunar New Year the delightfully delicious Castilla - pork ribs is a must-have. Galician beef, Chipirones and the mixed platter will send you on a culinary journey. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️😋

Author: Cristina GCastellon
Title: Surprised Spanish Bar
Review: I was visiting Melacca for the new year in February, and suddenly I saw a Spanish Restaurant. I am no very friend of Spanish Rt when I am abroad, but something made me to go in. I asked for a white cafe and looked around. Was the kind of place that I love! open kitchen, clean, clear, bright, good menu, good chat. Then decided to go next day. The Head chef talked to me about his background and why Malasya to work and live, and also on that ocassion his lovely girlfriend Maria came to chat with me. Good warm.people!Also I asked for a Gazpacho andaluz which was really tasted and a mango salad. made with spanish jamon.and fresh marinated mango. the red wine by the glass flavoring and.bubble. And overall the staff service great! very welcome, attentive, fast and smiling all time. A spot on place to breath from.the chillis and have some traditional Spanish food.Well done guys!Show less

Author: intrepid2458
Title: Quick tapas lunch
Review: Popped by briefly and shared a meat and cheese board with some nice bread and wine and thoroughly enjoyed it. It was early so very empty but the staff were very attentive and we would definitely go back if time permitted.

Author: nm121388Singapore, Singapore
Title: So much potential, however sadly disappointing.
Review: I've had a chance to read through the reviews posted by other customers in order to compose a fair, balanced, and accurate description of the experience I had at your restaurant. First, there were several plus points. These include a good ambiance, a warm welcome, and a great location. I also enjoyed that the kitchen was the focal point of the restaurant. The sangria was delicious and well made, and the cheese board starter was lovely. It was a good touch to come by and explain each cheese. These first impressions built up positive expectations that the rest of the meal would end up being superb. Unfortunately, this wasn't the case.The bamboo clams were rubbery, far too salty, garlicy, and full of mud/sand. They lacked any form of subtlety and delicacy. Do yourselves a favour, come to Singapore, and try the bamboo clams at one of the local hawker centres. Adapt some of their techniques and flavours into what you serve. I also had very high expectations of your paella. You mention in several of your responses (to other customers on Tripadvisor) that this dish is made in a traditional manner, using recipes from mothers and grandmothers. Sadly, this grandmother must not have been a very good cook. You also mention several times that this isn't tourist paella, and also that there are many variations of this dish depending on the regions of Spain. Regardless, paella is supposed to smell and taste amazing, with saffron, garlic, wine, and a whiff of delicious seafood. What we got was completely lacking. It might as well have come out of a packet of uncle bens microwave rice. The rice was dry, bland, and overcooked to the point of being burnt. The calamari were shrivelled and rubbery, and the prawns tasteless and few in number. There was no aroma of saffron or garlic. This dish may pass for paella in Melakka, but please don't hype it as the best of traditional Spain. It simply isn't! It might as well have been made by blind vegetarian nuns living in the mountains who have never seen a prawn. It's a shame because you state in other responses that the ingredients you use are of good quality. Unfortunately, they are wasted by poor cooking methods. For example, the clams are already dead… there isn't any need to murder them further to the point where they become shrivelled and stringy.The evening continued to get worse. We originally selected some form of calamari that wasn't available, so then opted for the pork meatball tapas. The waitress eventually brought some squid, which we said that we didn't order. We reminded her again that we ordered the meatballs, and then waited for about 30 minutes. We then noticed that the cooks were idle in the kitchen and nobody was actually cooking any meatballs. That's when we asked the waitress when our meatballs were due, only to be told they were never ordered! I then asked for the bill, and politely exited after paying. As you commented, yes it was a misunderstanding on what was ordered. However, your staff should have corrected this and served the meatballs instead of walking away and leaving us waiting. These are just the basics of customer service. You commented previously that we seemed unhappy and "miserable". No, not even your poor paella or service could make us miserable. We were however rather irritated because your restaurant has a lot of potential, but sorely disappointed. There are many customers like me who feel strongly enough about their poor experience that they take the time to write reviews on tripadvisor. Don't insult them with poorly written English. Rather, take the time to absorb feedback given, and then work on improving things. Arrogance is not the right approach. Yes, be proud of your Spanish heritage. There's lots to be proud of and celebrate, especially the food. However, don't do your country a disservice and try and fool people with poor copies of what should be amazing Spanish tapas. Your responses to other customer reviews make note that you are authentic Spanish. That's great… now just learn to cook authentic paella! I don't have to be Spanish to know the difference between good and poor paella.Show less

Author: 640camillerGeylang, Singapore
Title: Miserable
Review: Just came back from dinner at Salud. The quality of the food was horrifyingly poor- - Paella: soggy and flavorless rice, with 7 skinny baby shrimps (some of which shrimp heads only) and 4 calamari that were smaller than finger caps. - Bamboo clam tapas: not fresh at all and had lots of sand in it. One star for the location. Show less

Author: travel_enthusiast2
Title: Great tapas, awesome service!
Review: Just go and enjoy, kind service, great food (if you want something that is authentic spanish). Highly recommended!

Author: Dave K
Title: Great Service,  Great Food, Just needs some Music
Review:
Great food and fantastic Spanish wine.
The owner was really friendly the rest of the staff were doing their job. 
My only complaint is that some music would really help with the atmosphere

Author: Aija BGold Coast
Title: Stylish Spanish restaurant away from bustle of Jonker Street
Review: Fresh minimalist decor provides a sense of calm. Wooden panels, tall ceiling, clean polished cement floors. Open just 2 years a young Spanish couple are providing tapas and other tasty dishes. Spanish wines complement the meals.Favorites were Pork kebabs, Croquettes, Honey Glazed Chicken bites, Iberian Pork and the Potato Fritatta. Avoid the Paella, too dry, insufficient sauce, only 2 prawns and very few chunks of chicken. Overall a pleasant experience. We enjoyed meeting and chatting to Maria one of the young business partnership about her hopes and plans for the restaurant including menu ideas.Show less

Author: JaclynCarmen
Title: Ms
Review: Warm welcome, friendly and the food here are fantastic. They serve a variety of beverages, wine and beerzzz...

Author: Len19oatcakeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst owner we've ever experienced
Review: Our second visit to the lovely melaka and our first ( and last ) visit to salud. We ordered patatas bravas and calamari whilst we perused over the drinks menu. Our patatas came within 10 minutes and were fine..the calamari on the other hand never arrived so we asked ( twice) where it was..it arrived 30 minutes later and obviously not fresh calamari! We both tried it but it was inedible!! As we were both hungry we ordered something else, the prawns in garlic and chilli... What arrived was basically uncooked prawns with the largest amount of garlic ever, and it too was white and most probably just blanched, the oil didn't taste of chilli either, just a chilli sitting on the top,!The most terrible tapas we've ever eaten . These are the dishes we would order all over the world when we are in a tapas restaurant so we know what each dish should look and taste like. We felt so strongly we asked to see the manager, who , when we explained about the food she shrugged and said this is Malaysia!!?? Then proceeded to argue with us that all their food was perfect and she was gobsmacked that we refused to pay for two of the uneaten dishes saying she had NEVER ever had any complaints. As I've now read in the reviews there have been many many people complain about the quality of the food. The owner then took her partner ( the chef) out to talk to us and he too proceeded to argue with us that they were authentic tapas! The owner lady then took our bill out and had the audacity to leave nothing off for the uneaten inedible food... Claiming that's something THEY would never do if food was inedible in a restaurant they had chosen to eat at.needless to say we didn't pay the two items and will never return!! I think in all my dining years I've only ever had to refuse to pay a couple of times.. I hardly ever write bad reviews...but this owners response to our comments was the worst we have ever experienced! Show less

Author: HelloWorldPhiladelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Revisit to Salud, so disappointed!! :-(
Review: I revisited Melaka, and went back to find my favorite restaurant from my last trip, Salud!! And unfortunately I was so disappointed this time!! :-( The place itself was still lovely, ambience and all, but the food per se was so less than average, I was really sad to experience! And less than average food at the still high price tag (which I'd found worth it last visit), doesn't bode well.The Sangria was the only saving grace, which was very nice. We ordered the pork and I think a mushroom dish as well. I'm sorry I seem to have forgotten the exact menu items we had. But none of them seemed as good as they were last time! But the meat was tough and the taste was way below what I remembered. Admittedly last time we had the lunch with just the owner on premises, and he'd cooked for us, while this time we went early evening, and the owners were not around. Perhaps the other chef's need more training. I usually love giving nice feedback, and this was a place I'd loved to review earlier, but I was so disappointed this time, I wanted to let you know, so the restaurant will still maintain its great standards again. It's a lovely little place you have there, I'd love to come back to a better meal!Show less

Author: Alex CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: To satisfy urge for authentic Spanish food
Review: If you like Spanish food when you are in Malacca, this is a must place to visit. Their Chief Chef Brio managed to satisfy our craving for delicious Spanish food. Must try dishes are the Galician Blond Beef Steak and Iberico Pork Cheek, really tender and juicy cooked to perfection. The architecture and ambience of this place is truly one of a kind in Malacca. Will definitely come back for more. Show less

Author: AdammikaeelJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Unclean prawns
Review: We had heard about this place before coming to Melaka.We had already eaten, but decided to sit anyway and snack during the evening. It is tapas after all.The menu looked great, as did the place itself. Alas, they only offered about 6 savoury items from their whole menu for that evening. That was sad, and offered very little in the way of vegetarian or seafood (we are not vegetarian but enjoy a variety with tapas, which is the point of tapas isn't it).One of the plates we ordered was the garlic prawns. Given the look and feel of the restaurant (trendy and upmarket), as well as general food standards in Malaysia, we assumed that the prawns would be cleaned. They were not and we have now learned the hard way.We ate the part of the prawn below the vein, and did our best to avoid the vein. It tasted ok, but the meal itself was spoiled. Shocked that a place of this calibre does not clean their prawns.We will however try to give them another chance. Hopefully they serve more than 6 savoury items off the extensive menu!Show less

Author: andrewfbartonLichfield, United Kingdom
Title: Excuse me but why isn't this place listed?
Review: I love Tapas and this is the first place in Malaysia that I have found that does a really good job of providing a real taste of Spain ....... perhaps their choice of beer could be questioned but the list of Tapas available on a Monday night was still excellent and we watched them preparing and cooking it and the flavours and tastes were excellent. We challenged them with the whisky they had available to go with our chocolate crepes and they came up with a Scottish blend called monkey shoulder which as a scot I've never heard of but give it it's due it wasn't bad. So I'm hard pushed to fault it and will happily return Show less

Author: DanWee555Singapore, Singapore
Title: Spanish Eats
Review: We've never tried tapas before and we're suitably impressed. The decor was pleasant and warm, but the music a tad bit loud (techno in a Spanish diner..) some guitar would have set the mood. The small bites were flavourful and some red wine with the pork enhanced the flavours even more. Service was good as we were the only couple there at 5pm ; )Price was reasonable and location is next to Jonker. All in all a nice meal.Show less

Author: FreijoMadrid, Spain
Title: Highly recommended and I will definitely come back again!
Review: We went for having dinner and the food was excellent! the tapas were really tasty! As a Spanish leaving abroad, it made me to feel like at home! :) the croquetas and pulpo were the best! The staff were really nice and professional! Maria thanks for being very welcoming and friendly! It is really good value for money!Show less

Author: KiaBoHeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Potential to be better.
Review: New and nicely furnished Tapas restaurant off main Jonker walk of Melaka.For those looking to have a different cuisine and dining experience vs jostling for seats and having lots of nonya food always, Salud does offer a different venue and experience in Spanish tapas.Sangria was good and i had 2! Octopus was not bad though the consistency of the potatoes across batches could be improved as we could see the food being prepared by the chef in the open kitchen. Experience was however marred by the service reply in a could be improved response to tell us that they have closed the kitchen already for further orders. Though the chef did obliged kindly, it does give a little bit of unpleasant aftertaste. Worth to go and try still.Show less

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Very Poor Service
Review: 1) Cleanliness : Good but wash room dirty2) Food : OK, not that great. If you want just to experienced the place and go without any expectation, then OK3) Service : Very poor. The waiter/waitress busy with their mobile phone and just keep customer waiting. Everything is slow.If you require good quality food and good service, avoid this place. But if you are not particular about these two, then fine.Show less

Author: Peroni10Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Tip Top Tapas
Review: We're in Malaysia. We hit Malacca on a quiet night - so many restaurants closed in the evening. So we wandered into Salud thinking this will probably do. We were so not disappointed- staff were great, food was fantastic - and they had a fair selection of wines. A Spanish Restaurant in Malaysia? Don't think twice, it's alright. Show less

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Spanish food
Review: Is not within our expectation but it is still passable. The cuisine served is over rated. The customer service is not too expectations, it would be great if they could add more customer service excellence. I must say one of the positive feedback they have Nice ambience and creatively decorated interior. Show less

Author: Cristina Mihael... SEncinitas
Title: Best restaurant in Melaka!
Review: Amazing service - thank you Maria! Amazing food every time and recently they tested a new dish - Steamed Salmon with assorted seafood in an amazing broth. I would call it fusion French-Spanish-Seafood great!Try the one Spanish Cabernet Sauvignon they have on the menu - it is very special, although all their red wines are great.Show less

Author: jermpinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best dining experience in Malacca
Review: Our best dining experience in Malacca yet. Definitely a nice change of palette after days of having nice local peranakan cuisine. The restaurant setting is very nice, with a little courtyard/ airwell. We ordered a few tapas, and a seafood paella. The tapas were excellent. We had flambé prawns with garlic, gazpacho (chilled tomato soup), spanish omelette, and grilled squid with some kind of bechamel sauce. Especially the prawns are fresh and succulent, and the gazpacho is very refreshing. The paella, however, is abit too salty to our preference. We sent it back and the chef tasted and confirmed that's how it should be. So, we didn't question further. But, we still couldn't accept it. For desserts, we had the crepe with chocolate (minus the cream), and this was the highlight! They used some good dark chocolate. Overall, a very pleasant dining experience. We chose to be seated in a high table where we can witness the actions in the kitchen, and it was fun, seeing how serious the head chef was, how much attention he puts into every single dish. Highly recommended, and will definitely come back again. Show less

Author: Rommel IPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere & friendly staffs
Review: A business colleague brought me here for dinner. Good selection of Spanish wines but staffs lacks the knowledge of recommending one with the food. The cold cut platter & cheese board were so so and not classic Spanish. The octopus & potatoes were great and the Huevas with potatoes & chorizo we just so so. Definitely will come back to try other dishes.Great team of staffs and very friendlyShow less

Author: Michael5425081955
Title: Genuine Tapas Bar
Review: My wife and I had lunch here and it was a memorable experience. Food is prepared right in front of you and its is authentic, not a Malaysian version! recommend the draft Kronenbourg 1884 Blond beer!!

Author: Stephen HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The real deal helmed by a skilled Gallician couple
Review: Spanish delight with the real influence of Galicia, the Atlantic coast area of northern Spain. No molecular fuss but tasty plates of the real deal using fresh local produce. Wines are an excellent choice but do recall that we Malaysians suffer our horrendous tax. Great Albarino selection and the overall wine list is very well balanced.Charming Maria knows her stuff and her chef partner whips up the Tagline 'Small bites.Big Flavours."The kitchen hums and we enjoyed the bar stool action. As good as any in Kuala Lumpur/Spanish coast - for real tapas.Show less

Author: zkyerhys
Title: A must-go, must-wine & dine in Melaka!
Review: I keep going back to Salud every time I'm in Melaka. Pick anything from the menu and you'll not be disappointed. Some of my fave dishes. The pork is a must have!

Author: 99vincekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Memorable Spanish tapas, great sangria
Review: A welcome surprise just off Jonker walk. This tapas bar has an open kitchen / grill where you can watch the very professional staff prepare the food, and a friendly and attentive wait staff. The sangria is worthy of Spain, and the tapas selection is varied and delicious.Show less

Author: saraausieBrisbane, Australia
Title: Nice to chill place!
Review: Nicely refurbished building with nice spanish food. Food is nice and they have nice wines. Service is good.Show less

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super Salud - Super Tapas
Review: We were surprised to see this tapas bar/restaurant at the corner of Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock and Jalan Heng Lekir. More surprised when we walked in and saw how pleasant the interior surroundings were and how welcomed we were by all the staff we eyeballed.We had a table for two by the window and near the bar/ kitchen counter area.All excellent - no complaints. Good service, good wines and excellent freshly made tapas. We could watch the team preparing the dishes to order which in itself was enjoyable. We will be back when we are next in Melaka - likely in September.Show less

Author: CatijellySwitzerland
Title: Tasty authentic Tapas
Review: We were there as a Family for lunch in our trip through Malaysia. Even though we were almost the only people, food and drinks were fast served. As European and often in Spain, we know how Tapas have to taste and we were not disappointed. They were all very tasty. We would come again!Show less

Author: Mee Mee C
Title: Best tapas in Malaysia
Review: I fall in love to the Iberican ham and the tumaca. All the tapas are very very tasty. I think this is a great place. The Chef Traba has the level for a Micheline star. The staff is very friendly and Maria help me to order the Spanish wine. Awesome dinner. International 5 star because I cannot give 10Show less

Author: hannaklu
Title: Very good!
Review: We had a lovely Spanish-style dinner here. Food was very tasty, the restaurant is looking great on the inside and the outside. Would recommend to everyone!

Author: vcf86Milan, Italy
Title: Feeling home abroad
Review: Incredible place in melaka to eat spanish food. The experience with chef traba was excellent, he's performing on a great open kitchen in front of you. Dishes with real spanish products. Show less

Author: Graeme LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner at the counter was entertaining
Review: We wanted a European restaurant where we could find some pork and wine. Sitting at the counter we were well entertained by the chefs of duty especially a young Chinese man who was so focused and hard-working it was a delight to watch. The menu was quite small but what we ate was quite good although the pork meatballs could have been more seasoned and the churros were a little heavy. The Spanish wine we drank was excellent. Yes, we would go back.Show less

Author: Oldmistal
Title: Great food, great service
Review: My wife and I and our adult daughter had a wonderful evening in this lovely tapas restaurant. The service and food were excellent and could not be faulted. I would recommend this place to anyone.

Author: 448michelk
Title: Great tapas!
Review: We had a very enjoyable evening here, the quality of the tapas is very good and the service excellent

Author: niclsling83Los Angeles, California
Title: Salud tapas
Review: Love the food. Fresh vege, tapas, chef constantly providing good quality food at fast pace. Enjoyed the atmosphere as food continues to come. Salad is great as well. Can't say enough. Must come and try for yourself. Show less

Author: segaryputrajaya
Title: The food is average..
Review: Excellent setting and a lovely place to hang out with friends. The staffs were very friendly. We ordered the mushroom croquetas, Coca Catalana, Paella (squid ink). Both 3 dishes were below average. I'm a big fan of Spanish food so I personally feel the food didn't taste good. Disappointed. I might consider to go again to try other dishes.Show less

Author: Armand_BCNBarcelona, Spain
Title: Amazing Tapas! Excellent quality+presentation
Review: Amazing restaurant for Spanish tapas. In oldtown of Melaka, this couple run this restaurant with really high quality products and excellent presentation in each of their products. Highly recommendable.Show less

Author: Beatrice1992Germany
Title: A very unique restaurant for Melaka!
Review: This is the only Spanish restaurant I know in Melaka. It felt like diving in to Europe just for dinner. Tasty food, great ambience. Expensive for Malaysian standards but the place to go if you feel like eating somethin different. The owner and staff are extremly friendly and made the experience wonderful.Show less

Author: MarcelM2871Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: No cook no meal
Review: After facing important parking limitations, 3 of us got there on 10 July at 13:30 hours to be told food is not servedThe cook is not in and we do not know when the restaurant will open.When the publicity says open at 12:00 hours and it is not, what other expectations will not be met.Show less

Author: MaitieliLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very nice place and amazing original spanish food
Review: We are an Italian couple quite used to Spanish food and we have to admit the taste and selection of their tapas will not let you down. Ingredients are for sure from Spain and you can tell the chef is Spanish too. You can see him by the counter preparing every plate and check it out before it's served. I didn't give five stars just just because the tapas didn't come all together but in couples and service is not the fastest - understandable considering the chef wants to cook every dish. The place is also very welcoming and cosy, just in the middle of the most touristic area. Staff is very kind and smiling. Show less

Author: rinakalpanathsinghSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best restaurant in Malacca
Review: Thoroughly enjoyed the meal here. Not had such good food for a Long while. Wonderfully fresh food cooked to perfection and served in small portions. The staff are great and the ambience is perfect to enjoy the tapas and wonderful Spanish wine. If you love good food then you must try this place. You will not regret this. thank you Maria and gang for this wonderful evening. Show less

Author: Zwerg69
Title: Best Tapas in Melaka
Review: Nice atmosphere in the restaurant and excellent hams and cold cuts from Spain and nice other dishes only can recommend the place worthwhile a visit

Author: miguel_da_Vilaa
Title: Amazing!
Review:
The venue is just beautiful. The staff super friendly and the food make me feel I am back in Spain.

Please, try the coca Catalana and secreto

Author: aliciayuenws
Title: Perfect place!
Review: Absolutely amazing place, the food is great and the service is tip top. Kudos to the chef for hitting the note for every dishes I tasted. I would definitely recommend anyone to come here when they are in Malacca.

Author: adele mKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worthy of a try
Review: Secreto iberico and anchovy with crackers were the highlights to our meal. Serrano ham & mushroom croquetas, and the fried calamari with black garlic sauce were decent. Paella was alright.Would love to try the other dishes next time round, by which hopefully churros will also be offered on the menu. Show less

Author: Mohumad A
Title: Lovely food
Review: So delicious food, grilled pork with potatoes the best! And the Spanish beef is amazing. The staff was very friendly and give to us a great service. We were recomended by the spanish manager and she introduced to us a amaizing rioja wine. The best that i had tried for long time ago.Must try this Spanish restaurant in Melaka.Thank you.Show less

Author: ajoseph2016Batam, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic. Great food great setting
Review: We just stumbled across this place while looking for somewhere to eat in Melaka. The food was fantastic. The service was great. Lovely decor and very clean. It was wonderful just drinking a nice glass of wine with authentic Spanish food. Some of the best chocolate crepes I have ever had too! Can not speak too highly of the place. Will definitely go back.Show less

Author: R442EKdanielcBeaconsfield, Australia
Title: Birthday Dinner
Review: Scrumptious food with very friendly host.This dinner make my day . Specially love the secretive iberico and TapasShow less

Author: McJ0e7777Miri, Malaysia
Title: Amazing food in da town!!
Review: I went there with my friends and we enjoyed a lot in ther!!!! The food is really yummy, the quality of the food is amazing and the price very reasonable. The staff is very attentive, Teh recommended us the food and were great!!! After finish my dinner, they send us Upstairs and we drink spanish gin tonic!!!! Omg i cant believe the Gin is so nice!!! For sure this is our new place in Malacca to drop by!! I will be back soon :))) love this place so much!Show less

Author: DianaJHKHong Kong, China
Title: This was a nice find at the end of a busy day!
Review: We were greated by the manageress/owner of the restaurant who comes from the Canary Islands. We chose with her help a nice bottle of spanish red wine to go with our meal. We had a nice Paella, not the best I. Have had but not too far off it. The ambiance of the place was really nice and for us it was the end to a perfect day.Show less

Author: Srdan13
Title: Great night to be in Melaka
Review: We came at 22:55h and at Salud Tapas Bar; they stop serving at 23h. Although we came very close to 23h, and it would have been understandable if they have refused to serve us, with only slight persuasion staff showed us to our table. Staff was very accommodating and helpful; full of useful advise and recommendations. Waiters were always there and if you need anything you will have in a minute or two.Firstly we ordered appetizer, recommendation of charismatic Spanish girl, which was for four of us and it provide a great beginning. Main course came within 15 minutes of our order and it was also great. After the main course we ordered deserts which was really cherry on top on this great experience.With moderate selection of beer to accompany the meals, late at night when no one wanted to serve us, it proved to be one of the great nights which we will all cherish and remember with smile.Show less

Author: ClairbeartanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Charming interior for chilling
Review: The food is pretty average, nothing to die for. We would think that ordering the standard tapas wouldn't go wrong - nothing went wrong, just food. Price range is reasonable. Sangria was so-so.The decor thought deserves the credit with a very comfortable alfresco dining.Show less

Author: MairGravatt
Title: TASTY TAPAS
Review: Good Spanish tapas served in a pleasant ambiance by great staff.  By Malaysian standards the wine was also reasonably priced.

Author: Adrian D
Title: The best restaurant for non-malaysian food
Review: This is a real gem for Spanish food in melaka, the grilled pork served on fried cubed potatoes is simply amazing

Author: ylimeSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: next best choice for non-Malaccan / Asian food
Review: the best restaurant ambience in Jonker Street for a nice casual dining experience. highly recommend if you have tried all the must-eat Malaccan food and would like something non-Asian.we enjoyed our dinner very much here with one starter (Serrano ham) and some rustic bread to go with, two tapas (Patatas Bravas and mushroom croquettes), one main (squid ink Paella good for two) and finally dessert (Filloas i.e. Spanish crepe with chocolate sauce), one glass of wine and one mocktail - total bill RM 200 which is just a fraction of the price to have it in SG.Show less

Author: tongteckl
Title: Excellent food!
Review:
Excellent Spanish food! Just try it! 
Assorted Ibericos - ham Spanish cheese and cold meat. 
Croquestas - mushroom croquestas
Coca catalana - recommended!

Author: M VMarseille, France
Title: Very good tapas
Review: My family and I enjoyed the tapas very much at this nice restaurant. The food is authentic and delicious. The menu is quite good and its surprising to find such good Spanish food on this nice street in Malacca. Would recommend for those interested in something to snack on besides Asian food.Show less

Author: Camberleyannie
Title: Nice Portuguese restaurant
Review: Nice ambiance. A little strange finding this kind of food in Malaysia but we enjoyed the difference. Friendly service. A little expensive compared to other restaurants here.

Author: Attjepatatje
Title: Tapas real nice
Review: Real nice tapas restaurant in Melaka. Staf is very helpful and gives good advice. Food is delicious and the atmosphere relaxed. Choice of the tapas is not extremely large but sufficiënt.

Author: Loue57
Title: Delicious
Review: What a great find this was.  Great tapas bar, Food was fantastic, wine list good and staff friendly.  Located on the corner of Heeren street & Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock, after dinner its an easy stroll home via jonker street.

Author: clemencenils
Title: Excellent Spanish food in Malaysia
Review:
Very good restaurant , people very nice . Not authentic food in Malaka but very good taste. 
We recommend strongly

Author: cmttul
Title: Excellent authentic food
Review: Spanish food is one of my favourites so I didn't expect it to be done so well by Asian chefs. The food and ambience are excellent and I was treated to extras like olives and padron peppers by the chef. My tortilla was delicious. Highly recommend if you want a break from Asian food Show less

Author: TravelsWithMyHPHigh Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Not cheap by Malaysian standards but the food was very tasty and the tapas portion sizes generous. Service was attentive and even though we ordered the cheapest bottle of wine it was still perfectly drinkable. Good place to eat if you fancy a change from the Asian cuisine.Show less

Author: fash
Title: EXCELLENT FOOD
Review: Food were excellent, drinks were nice, service was timely, great ambiance and friendly owners. highly recommended

Author: rkigervaron
Title: Very good
Review: Very good food-- fresh ingredients, quality imports-- good wine.  Nice place and very good service...

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: Taste of Spain in Melaka
Review: My friends (3 of them) and I had visited Spain last October for 3 weeks. We had enjoyed all the tapas from Seville, Granada, Cordoba, Barcelona and Madrid tremendously. The thing that we missed the most from Spain is the amazing tapas. So, when I came across Salud from a cousin, I post haste messaged Salud via Facebook to make reservation for pre-Christmas / early birthday dinner. Maria who is from Spain replied in less than an hour to my enquries. Salud is housed in an old heritage building with much of its architecture and design intact. The interior is beautiful and tastefully done creating a nice and romantic ambiance. It is on the intersection between Heeren Street (Tun Tan Cheng Lock Street) and Jonker Street. Parking will be an issue especially on weekends when Jonker Street is closed for the night market (Jonker Walk). The staff especially Maria are amazing. They had assisted in planning a surprise early birthday dinner for a friend (who is indeed surprised). The food is simply delicious and very authentic. It is as if we are in the streets of Selville or Granada again. We ordered paella, gambas (prawns), tortilla (Spanish potato omelette), piquillo pepper mushroom etc. The crujientitos (honey mustard chicken is superb. Each and every dish is good and mouth watering. The 6 of us enjoyed ourselves tremendously. The price is reasonable for the food and ambiance provided.Show less

Author: invisible999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Tapas/Spanish restaurant but limited selection
Review: We stopped by at this restaurant on our way back from Malacca. It was around 3PM on Sunday afternoon and this might be a factor but for in Tapas/Starter/Main selection ONLY tapas was available and even in that section only half items on menu. However everything we've ordered was quite good.If you plan to visit, it would be a good idea if you check in advance if they serve only partial or full menu.Show less

Author: Chriszchyn
Title: Good food
Review: Love the food there despite is pricey. The Spanish lady do introduce the signature dish and also ensure we satisfied with our food

Author: MathieuP1375
Title: Short selection of amazing tapas
Review:
Nicely decorated, modern and clean, open kitchen, the first impression is very pleasant.
It really becomes amazing when you try the food !
Amazing pork treasures, bread with tomatos, sliced hams and sausages. Very tasty and all well prepared.
Very recommended

Author: seastream2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Christmas dinner
Review: From the moment we made the reservation till the end with the last drinks upstairs the experience was fantastic. Their Manager Maria is a total sweetheart and even it was a very busy night she managed to fix everything - I also loved how she talked to all of the customer personally :)The food is really great and wine pouring generous (we had set menu with eine pairing). My fish was perfectly cooked and my husband absolutely loved his pork dish. We would definitely dine here again - Highly recommended!!Show less

Author: andtsy
Title: Nice spanish restaurant
Review: Saw this restaurant as it is just opposite our hotel. Went in and it has nice ambience. They have nice spanish food with open kitchen and nice wine too.

Author: SharpsharkMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Still great,,,taste ambience service and value
Review: Centrally located a stone's throw away from Jonker street, this is a truly authentic Spanish restaurant. Our second time here, and again the experience was amazing. Top qualtiy Iberico top and the rest of the tapas was equally enjoyable. Price is a fraction of what you would need to pay for in fancy restaurants in KL and Singapore. Tapas is not tapas without wine ! and Salud has a decent and affordable wine list. Maria will be happy to make recommendations. Could not remember the names of the three bottle of Spanish wines that we polished but they were under RM200 each. In summary, if you are in Melaka and not looking for local food - Salud is a must! Merci beacoup!Show less

Author: Michael OAdelaide, Australia
Title: Loved it. Great food, great flavors.
Review: We had prawns with garlic, chicken and also pork skewers as our 3 starters. Prawns were delicious, as was the garlic. Soft and not overpowering. Ckicken was cooked perfectly, with a delicious sauce. Pork skewers were so tender, I thought initially that it was chicken. Delicious. For mains we had a seafood squid ink paella which was excellent. Had a couple of glasses of house red, which was good. Chatted with the chef and the matrade to thank them for their attention to flavors. The service here is good, ambience is good & the prices are very reasonable. This place ticks a lot of boxes.Show less

Author: Elise C
Title: Attentive service and great foods
Review: We stumbled upon this restaurant while walking to our hotel. They caught our attention when we saw a staff hand-cutting the giant ham in the open kitchen thru the transparent glass window. We went in and there was this lovely lady ( I believed she's a Spanish) who patiently explained ways to complement the Iberian ham from Spain. We had the best selling ham with cheese, bread and wine. Amazing experience overall. Show less

Author: HelloWorldPhiladelphia, Pennsylvania
Title: Awesome Spanish Delight!
Review: We strolled in at Salud one afternoon and had the place to ourselves- we'd seen the place hopping busy the night before. And that was great for we could admire the ambience leisurely, sat at the bar near the open kitchen area and have a small chat with the chef cum co-owner! The food was amazing, with Jamón ibérico straight from Spain. My Gezpacho was authentic, and the steak (chef suggested) was delicious! It was a wonderful experience, and if I'm back I'll certainly revisit Salud!!Show less

Author: ChristineM6189
Title: Solid Tapas in Melaka
Review: Following a night of meandering down the streets of Melaka and wandering through the nightmarket, we chanced upon Salud and decided to give it a try. Great ambiance- nice corner location, and really great food. The Manager, Maria made sure that we were taken care of- so service was on point, and what we had ordered was great. Will definitely stop by next time in town.Show less

Author: JoCeLynMikaMalaysia
Title: Nice environment
Review: I like the honey mustard chicken very tasty! We order the bread together with the ham, if the bread thicker a bit will be good. The main course was tasty with the white sauce and salt & pepper. 3 drinks with all 4 dishes cost around RM155++.Show less

Author: milescowdryKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A great find
Review: In a sea of somewhat dubious restaurants, this was a beacon of excellence. Great food, good service and excellent standards of hygiene. We travel often to Spain and the jamon (Iberian ham)and quesa (Spanish cheese) were up there with good Spanish fare, and the rest of the food was delicious and pretty authentic.Show less

Author: VwmuchFood4funSunshine Coast
Title: Lovely food
Review: Anchovies best ever. We were recommended to go to this place by one of the staff at Sid's. A bit expensive esp the wine but food was really good and the staff knew their stuffShow less

Author: leo0408Kajang, Malaysia
Title: Great Place with Friendly Staffs
Review: Came here for late dinner.Nevertheless, we received a very warm welcome. Interesting ambiance but was little stuffy. But, almost forget about the stuffy environment with the attentive service rendered by the staffs. We had cheese, tapas & wine. Appreciate the effort of the Spanish lady who provide a brief history about cheese from Spain.Show less

Author: tan142
Title: Excellent Food & Services
Review: The chef in Salud prepares the most authentic Spanish food using ingredients mostly from Spain itself. Secreto Iberico is a must for every of my visits.

Author: zcemp13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Go on - treat yourself to the Oysters! You will regret if you don't!
Review: So I normally would ask myself if I would come back to the restaurant, and this one fell in to the bag of yes's. Nothing to shout about because it's really super good, and my only comment was that, the chef was having a pissy missy day, and couldn't stifle out a smile (so quiet lunch, and no conversation at all). Would be good if he eased up a bit that day. Maybe it is once off. So back to the food? YES, I will come back for more, this coming Christmas. My whole family will be coming to celebrate. This place can be like a reception area to celebrate anniversary type of restaurant. Beautifully decorated, and very very relaxing, I can imagine. Especially after a few round of drinks.... Well done!!! I will be back!Show less

Author: jimtanwl
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Visited salud for dinner as it is just opposite the hotel that I am staying. Environment is good with nice Spanish food, especially the paella. Service is also good. We had our dinner accompanied by Spanish wine in this restaurant.

Author: Deborah J
Title: Recommend
Review:
Great staff, friendly and helpful, great  building and ambience- as well as good quality tasty food!
What more can you ask?

Author: CPhunPutrajaya
Title: Fabulous food & awesome service
Review: The dinner was a birthday celebration. And boy, we were in for a treat... The food was prepared right in front of us as we were seated at the bar. The wine list is impressive. Service was definitely top-notch. The staff could read our minds and knew what we wanted even before we asked for it. If you find yourself in Melaka, do check out this place. You will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Priyanka SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, lovely dining experience
Review: We had dinner at Salad and Tapas yesterday. The ambience is very relaxing and nice. We had a good meal, where my mum’s diet restrictions were catered to and all the dishes ordered were tasty. The owner is a very cheerful and friendly Spanish lady who interacts with guests and makes it a lovely dining experience, with the support of a great staff. We would definitely recommend dining here when in Melaka. Also the location is amazing, right off Jonker street.Show less

Author: Vivian_SYSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not Authentic Spanish Food!
Review: Environment is good but very disappointed with the food. Came here for a mini celebration expecting to have some good authentic Spanish food however we got served with cold soggy 'fried calamari' and very bad paella.Show less

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Spain Meets Melaka
Review: I am uncertain if the dishes served in this restaurant are authentic Spanish recipes for I have not been to Spain. However, their meals are definitely unique and served as an eye opener to the locals. The kind Spanish lady who runs this restaurant was very helpful in recommending signature dishes and seemed to be very welcoming to all of her guests regardless locals or foreigners.Good ambience. Lightings are perfect but it can get really hot and sweaty in this restaurant. I would also suggest selections of Spanish music to be played on air to create that atmosphere. Skillful cooks and I have seen a demonstration of their professionalism as they control the flames while roasting a piglet in front of my friends and I.Prices can be quite stiff hence this is not my daily hang out joint. However, it is worth a try.Show less

Author: DarrenL2039
Title: Mixed bag of feelings. Mostly disgusted
Review: We were celebrating birthday for a family member. Visited the restaurant in the afternoon to pick a table for our reservation. Arrived in the evening to find that our reserved table was given to other customer. Yes we were late by 15 mins but no effort were made to call us (number was given during reservation). Alas we were given another table nearby. And the staff were kind enough to give us a complementary pancake to make up for the mistake.Then came the highlight: we brought our cake for the celebration. After the cake cutting, we asked the staff to pack the remaining cake (about half) for our takeaway. It never came back and we only remember after leaving. We went back 20 mins later to take the cake, upon reaching home and opening the box, only less than 20% of the cake were left. They had our number and never called and just assumed we didnt want the cake (despite specific order to PACK IT FOR OUR TAKEAWAY), and ate it, and had the audacity to hand us back the remains when we came back!!We are extremely disgusted by this. Please just tell us you have discarded our cake that woule have been better. Now we are left wondering what happened to the missing part of the cake and whether it is safe to consume the remaining cake. This is sort of traumatising to be honest. Wil never EVER visit this place again.Show less

Author: HKinseyParaparaumu, New Zealand
Title: Definitely not Spanish!
Review: The staff seemed to be in a hurry to get rid of us. The tapas didn't arrive together, then they served a main while we still were eating the tapas.The staff are nice, but not enough to compensate for the rest of the experience.Show less

Author: Ragunath_k7
Title: Excellent Food n Drinks
Review: If there is one restaurant/bar you should visit in Melaka, this is it! Friendly staff, good tapas and lovely settings!!!

Author: Vicki_ClunesGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Best meal for years
Review: I can't praise the meal we had here enough. It was elegant, surprising sometimes and delicious. It's the best meal I've had for many years. Each dish - 3 tapas shared, a starter of goat's cheese and specialty ham with lettuce etc for me and octopus main for my partner - delivered extraordinary taste sensations. 6 out of 5 if I could.Just don't expect Malaysian because it's not. It's Spanish. A nice change after 2 weeks of Malay and Chinese food. Show less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: This was a great place
Review: The ambiance is lovely, the drinks very nice. It's a place you can come to for a drink or two anytime of the day, while enjoying some tapas. The service was a little slow though, probably because they were short staffed. Otherwise, great place!Show less

Author: SharpsharkMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice Tapas Friend Owners Great Wine List
Review: The title of the review summarizes our experience there. The setting is beautiful and strategically located right in the heart of old Melaka town. We enjoyed our tapas which was prepared right in front of us. Iberico was delicious. Wine list, although not extensive was sufficient and well priced. This shall be a must visit restaurant each time we visit Melaka. Salut Salud !Show less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Nice ambience and Spanish food
Review: Very nicely renovated unesco heritage building. Went for lunch on a weekday, not many customers. Food was nice, the tapas were nice. The pork dishes were quite well done. Happy hours beer was worth it.Price is the same for similar Western restaurants.Nice place for Spanish food and also a drink in Melaka.Show less

Author: NCNGSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: So good
Review: The atmosphere is superb, clean and cosy. We ordered virgin mojito, non-alcohol but with lotsa fresh lime and mint, it was so refreshing. We also ordered the signature tapas, coca catalana and main fish secreto iberico. Both of them were so good, the sauce, the combination was perfect. Must tryShow less

Author: rickoar
Title: Michellan Quality Level
Review: My wife and I stopped for what we thought was a couple drinks and tapa snacks but what we had was an amazing dining experience. Service was very good attentive paying attention to small details. The food was presented in amazing beauty with superb taste.

Author: susanv606Apeldoorn, The Netherlands
Title: Seriously good food - and great staff too
Review: We really enjoyed our tapas dinner and wine at Salud tonight. Salud is a new restaurant in Melaka, serving spanish tapas and wines. The tempranillo wine, top of the list, least expensive, was already a gem. And the tapas: olives, serano ham, mango goatcheese salad, bread with tomato, gambas, mussels hidden in veggies, patatas... Everything was just simply delicious. My favourites are the mussels and the salad with mango. We had great seats - right at the bar, looking at the kitchen. The staff was great, looking after us and made sure we were happy. Congrats on your beautiful restaurant (downstairs) and bar (upstairs) - We'll be regulars here, that's a promise.Show less

Author: Thanpisit D
Title: Nice decorations
Review: Nice restaurant good in decorations they using the old house and turn it to be a hip bar. I love the wine list it quite get along with iberico ... So yummy

Author: Laura M
Title: Lovely place and great food
Review: Went for dinner with my family, the food was very tasty with very nice people and a lovely place. We tried omelet, black paella and salud salad, all of them were perfect! And the wine that the manager recommend us was amazing. I would recommend it with no doubt! I will come back for sure!Show less

Author: Yujin LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pretty good food. New & still needs a bit of settling down on service.
Review: Interesting to find a Spanish tapas place in Melaka. Food was pretty good. Sangria was nice. Bloody Mary was a bit too experimental for me. Paella was a bit disappointing but all the rest were quite good.Show less

Author: 262gls
Title: Tapas in Malacca
Review: Service was good and selection tapas. Layout of restaurant quite modern and functional. Yummy crepe! Will be back! Good red wine (Rioja) to complete the menu....

Author: Jeremy_C_MHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reservation was totally messed up.
Review: Well, would have liked to taste and agree to the reviews. Reservations were confirmed for 1145am-noon. But lo and behold, arrived at 1145 and they were totally closed, boarded up and no lights inside!! Durrh??!! Hello?? Knock knock, anyone home ?Fortunately a young female staff happened to walk by and said they only open at 1pm!!! She helped to call the manager but ... guess they could not do anything to accommodate us. Told us to come back at 1pm! Show less

Author: Kuroneko300Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Spanish experience in the heart of Malacca
Review: A taste of Spain right in the heart of Malacca's busy touristy area. Ambiance of the place is really great - if you can book upstairs open terrace to feel even more like you're in Spain (but only if you can ignore the humidity of Malacca). Good selection of tapas, but cheese platter selection was a bit disappointing. Iberico pork was delicious, anchovy platter a good opening appetizer. Dessert didn't pique our interest so skipped this. Overall, a good introduction to Spanish food. Service could be improved - but the host Maria was friendly and made up for it. Good place to hang out or for family dinners. Show less

Author: 655frederiquebMelbourne, Australia
Title: Refreshments before dinner
Review: We went there just before dinner to have a nice drink. I ordered the sangria and my partner ordered the mojito. We both really enjoyed the place. Drinks were great, staff were friendly and it has quick service. Downsides would be, that it was actually very quite at that time, and the place is very modern which didn't appeal to me.Show less

Author: MchylinsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Modern, refreshing and friendly staff
Review: We only came in for drinks but it was a good experience as a whole. The look and feel of the restaurant is slick and modern with an open kitchen. You can choose to sit in a bar-style setting inside or choose a more traditional restaurant type table outside in their courtyard. The staff is very friendly and very good at making cocktails! We would come here again (oops, we already have ;))Show less

Author: Katie-ElizabethM
Title: Nice friendly atmosphere
Review: Just came for drinks but the food looked yummy! Lovely inside and out, the decor is beautiful, really enjoyed our visit.

Author: maevdbAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Great food, nice vibe
Review: Delicious tapas! The paella was good, but the tapas was better! Next time I come, I think I'll just try the whole menu of tapas. Do yourself a favour and order the sangria too. There's a special ingredient that the menu just indicates as 'something else' and it made the sangria truly something else!Will definitely be recommending this place to friends and family.Show less

Author: 243georginam
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: We had a really nice dinner here. We had some bread with tomato and a plate of iberian ham and cheese to start with. We felt like in Spain. After that we tried the garlic prawns, the coca catalana and the secreto iberico. Absolutely everything was delicious. We recommend this for the ones who miss home while traveling a long time (like us) and for the ones who want to try authentic Spanish food without having to fly there. And to make it even more perfect we had an AMAZING cheesecake! Don't miss it! Thanks Maria for your recommendations and for being so attentive with us! Show less

Author: stacykaohao
Title: Fantastic food. Will definitely come back again.
Review: The Paella is fabulous, so is the Queso Fresco con Membrillo and Secreto Iberico. Perfection. Will definitely visit again. No doubt about it.

Author: HaleyFiege
Title: Great restaurant!
Review: Really enjoyed this place. Great interior, friendly and attentive staff and good happy hour deals on beer. The food is all the best classic Spanish tapas, with a few local fusion dishes which I enjoyed a lot. Would def eat here again.

Author: Gary DBusselton, Australia
Title: Tapas in the Historic Part of Melaka
Review: Trip Advisor Review inspired visit...weren't stunned, but far from disappointed.Beautiful Old Godown Building beautifully restored, minimalistic, but very nicely done. Hostess (Owner) was very affable and appeared to chat briefly at each table. Overall the service was excellent.Drinks were very cold, and the Sangria was fabulous. We enjoyed the Tapas, with our favourite; the Honey Mustard Chicken...others were good.Other Mains being delivered looked good...so would come back again.Show less

Author: wcrk2015
Title: Nie ambeince
Review:
Cozy set-up and lovely bar. Extremely friendly and helpful owner.
Nice sit-out if the weather permits.

Author: YuC102
Title: Searching good  food
Review:
Good place to having small tapas  bites.
Amazing place to  enjoy food and drink :)
Nice place to have wonderful dinner.
Chef and the staff, is lovely and friendly 
Salute

Author: mbaasSingapore
Title: Lovely Restaurant, Great Service, Average Food
Review: We were in the mood for tapas and pleasantly surprised to find such an elegantly decorated restaurant in Melaka's old district. We were seated at the bar which gives one a good view of what's going on behind it in terms of food preparation. The staff is very friendly and the head chef seems quite dedicated to his task. Unfortunately however we do feel the food needs more work. For example, at least three different tapas simply required salt to bring out the intended flavours. The Patatas Bravas were a disappointment as well. For some reason they were drenched in a strange red sauce which made it impossible to actually enjoy the patatas bravas itself. Some attention is required for the temperature the red wine is served at which was too cold when we visited.Show less

Author: miloaustraliaaustralia
Title: Best tapas since San Sebastián
Review: Hubby and I had a great tapas night at this new funky bar and restaurant. Food was spicy and delicious. We tried 4 tapas and 3 deserts (I know we are greedy ) couldn't fault anything, congrats to the Spanish chef and also the lovely Spanish hostess, she made us very welcome. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone who would like a little something different in Melaka.Show less

Author: TAN666Batu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: salud tapas
Review: is a great place hanging out with buddies having spanish wine ,good environment to relax, spanish food are make me surprise and i am love it so much especially Secreto (grill iberico pork),wow its great taste when you have wine together,Tortilla española (potato omelette) , Pan tumaca (bread with tomato, Olive oil ) and Jamon y queso (cold cuts ham and cheese) also are my no regret lovely tapas.Show less

Author: AkkedasOslo, Norway
Title: Very good food, service a little disirgabised
Review: We just walked into this restaurant. We were presented the menu immediately. However the ordering of the food was a bit confusing and disorganized. The food took some time to get, however it was beautifully presented and was very tasteful. I wish we had gotten all of our orders at the same time. The restaurant it self was clean and beautiful. Price for five tapas and 6 drinks was 170 ringgit. Can recommend this place to both families and couples. Show less

Author: Pascal CKuala-Lumpur
Title: Pleasant surprise
Review: This recently open tapas place is an excellent addition to the scene, with a truly Spanish food experience than can not be mistaken, with quite affordable pricing. My wife and I spent 3 days and 2 nights in Malacca over a long weekend and went twice to SALUD. We loved the gazpacho, the croquetas, the paella, the ham. The wine and drinks are normally priced for Malaysia. It was a pleasure to watch the open kitchen and it was noticeable that young children equally enjoyed the kitchen action.Overall a great food experience on a corner just outside of the popular Jonker street.The service can still improve and create a fell that plates will come, will not be forgotten. One as to wait a bit on a busy day to get some food on a table.Show less

Author: Enrica L
Title: The best one
Review: We went here yesterday evening .. Just because we found it on trip advisor ..and we were very satisfied:-) the plates were beautiful and the flavour great :-) we are travelling from.so long and tried many places but this is the best one..

Author: PandAClark-Phil
Title: Good food but very disorganized service
Review: The staff were very friendly and the food was good but service was very disorganized. Orders taken by local Malaysian staff were well managed but orders taken by Spanish manager were confused and delayed. Her staff were apologetic but the manager was dismissive.

Author: pebble82Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, friendly staff, great night out
Review: We dropped by this newish Spanish restaurant/tapas bar located along Jln Tan Cheng Lock. There were alfresco dining, a bar next to the open kitchen and a dining area. We opted to sit in the informal courtyard just off the dining room.Staff Thomas, who used to work in Singapore was quick with his welcome and introduced us to Chef Traba who hailed from Galicia, northern Spain. Co-incidentally we were on holiday in that part of Spain late summer/early autumn 2014 so we were familiar with the cuisine.The patatas bravas were tasty but the sauce was a tad too spicy even for us chilli lovers. We would have preferred the sauce to be served on the side rather than over the potatoes. The portion of grilled octopus was smaller than what you get in Spain. However it was nicely cooked served with salad and a not too spicy paprika-based sauce. The garlicky prawns served in a claypot were delicious and cooked perfectly. Dining in a Spanish restaurant, of course the choice of wine had to be from Spain. Thomas recommended a nice bottle of Albariño wine from the Rias Baixas region which we also tried in Galicia. This was a little pricey but a great match with the food.Dinnner for two, including wine came to slightly under RM300. For sure we will be back here to try out other dishes when we are next in Malacca.Show less

Author: SnipserDublin, Ireland
Title: Delicious Tapas and Outstanding Service
Review: Definitely one to visit when in Melaka.Stumbled across this fine tapas bar while wandering around Melaka. Great atmosphere and the hosts are very friendly. You can sit at the bar and see your food being cooked while enjoying a nice cold beverage.Highly recommended for a small snack or a bit more. Enjoy!! Show less

Author: Alcoyano1Klebang Kechil, Malaysia
Title: JUST LIKE HOME!
Review: OLE SALUD!Frankly speaking, wasn't expecting such Spanish culinary experience in Malacca. I'm from Spain and getting Spanish food in Asia, unlike Italien, is difficult, and near impossible with an anthentic taste. The secret of their delicious food is that it's first imported directly from Spain (Including the pork) and second, it's made by truly amazing chefs, which are also "imported" from Spain. ;)You get a true taste from Spain, without having to spend trillions in flights and hotels. On top of the excellent food, the modern design and warm welcome makes this restaurant a place to taste and enjoy, even with family and kids. They also adapted their food by proposing no beef, respecting local religious beliefs. Luckily, they still kept the delicious Spanish porc. ;)Be ready for an amazing experience. You'll be warned ;)Show less

Author: oldestteenagerAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: A new restaurant in Melaka
Review: At last there is another restaurant to add to the small list of good dining experiences in Melaka. The menu is quite small but they will be adding new items. We particularly liked the Tabla de Ibericos (meats) and Tabla de Quesos (cheeses). You can either have a separate table or sit at the bar where you can watch the Carver slicing cuts from a whole leg of pork. The staff are friendly, attentive without being intrusive and very helpful. The walls however could do with some Spanish pictures or posters as it seemed a little spartan. The music was suitably subdued but was not really appropriate for a Tapas bar however that will not stop us from going again or recommending Salud to friends. Overall an enjoyable evening out.Show less

Author: Helge58
Title: Best restaurant in the area.
Review: Very good food and Spanish vine for a reasonable price. Best Resturant in the area. The Serano was brilliant in combination with a good Rioja.

Author: 499beatrizgTalavera de la Reina, Spain
Title: Just perfect!
Review: Being Spanish we can say that the food is so good. We ordered meat with potatoes, they came with alioli sauce, it was perfectly done and very good quiality, flavour just like home. We had cheese and croquetes as well, all perfect, very real flavours. Sangria was very nice aswell.All in all, we highly recommended if you want to have real Spanish food.Show less

Author: annerob10Hobart, Australia
Title: So good we went back again
Review: Just happened on this gem not far from Jonker St.The menu was great and catered for all tastes including our 3 grandchildren.Staff were terrific and very attentive and the owner even came over and had a chat to us.The spanish cheeses were a highlight.Show less

Author: 743ninapVienna, Austria
Title: Authentic, excellent Spanish cuisine
Review: After eating Asian rice dishes for some weeks we were craving Spanish food just like back home. "Salud" fulfilled our expectations and served us some authentic tapas of excellent quality after giving us a very warm welcome. It didn't only taste like home, it also felt like home thanks to María, the friendly manager who recommended us some dishes and who showed us around the restaurant which is, by the way, a very stylish and impressive place. We especially loved the croquetas de jamón! And before leaving Melaka, we'll definitely come back for a tapas or three. (Or four. Or five.)Show less

Author: yannick707
Title: We came back...and still brilliant!
Review: We were here in January and left with a great feeling. And again, they all did a great job! Great team, great food and always with a smile. Thanks guys!

Author: KhidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food and delightful company
Review: Our Malaysian friend brought us here for dinner and we loved the food, especially the Iberico Pork!!! The starter with the Anchovy and the chicken are also highly recommended! The 2 bottles of white and red wine that were recommended by the manageress won us over. We will definitely go back to Malacca just to eat here. Show less

Author: GillK26Milton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Chilled atmosphere nice food and wine
Review: It's hard in Melaka to find a bar/restaurant serving food AND wine. Salud does. It was a Saturday evening we saw Salud and it has space for four of us in the inside courtyard - although that meant shifting two tables together. We sat In the internal courtyard away from the noise of Jonkers St. Why does everyone in Malaya, including the 'bicshaw' drivers play such loud cheesy music. It's such a relief to go somewhere with a lower decibel level. Salud plays music that's much less invasive, so you can chat and laugh and hear each other.The service was excellent - we had a constant supply of iced water, napkins etc, as we kept using and dropping ours.Wine was decently priced 100 RM per bottle of house wine - Spanish Tempranillo which was very pleasantly drinkable.We had an assortment of tapas and main course dishes simply ordering more as we get hungry. They were all very good, someone knows their Spanish cooking. We would have given the restaurant a full 5 star rating except that we could not get the dessert we wanted, it had run out - and the only offered about 4 dessert choices. Those that were available were good - except maybe the deconstructed cheesecake, which toasted amazing but eas more like fruit and cream cheese.And unfortunately the coffee machine had broken so we could not finish our meal with a coffee. For some of us who don't drink tea this was a disappointment.Once the coffee machine is fixed and the desserts re-stocked All Will Be Well.Thank you to all the staff who looked after us so well.Show less

Author: Bárbara CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Review of a Spanishexpat living in Malaysia
Review: I have been to many restaurants in Malaysia that call themselves Spanish but the food is most of the times disappointing... Finally I got to eat some real good quality Spanish tapas that satisfied my Spanish cravings. On top of that, the restaurant's facilities and ambiance is amazing and the staff as well as the managers are very warm and professional. I definitely recommend to people who want to experience real Spanish food or Spanish expats like me to go visit "Salud" because it is definitely worth a try.And despite the fact that we don't eat pork, the chef managed to do a few variances in certain dishes in order for us to enjoy our meal and so we did. We're definitely going back next time we visit Melaka.Show less

Author: ScorpionTravellerKuala Lumpur
Title: Nice addition to Malacca, needs a few improvements.
Review: We're glad to discover a non-halal tapas bar in Malacca with Serrano and Iberico on its menu. It has a pleasant ambience, however the welcoming experience could have been more friendly. First, our paths were blocked by a scooter parked on the walkway within the restaurant, and the hostess was not very enthusiastic. So much for first impression...Menu has good selection of tapas, mains, sharing platters and desserts. Skewered pork was tender, well marinated but slightly salty. Roasted red pepper sauce tasted incredibly acidic, too heavy on lemon squeeze. Chicken fillet with honey mustard dip and alioli was average as they were slightly burnt and dry. Abondigas was nicely presented in a claypot, which highlights the Malaysian element. Flavours were good but served warm. Unfortunately, Patatas Bravas was a disappointment. The natural flavours of potatoes were masked due to heavy smear of alioli and 'acidic' red pepper sauce. Rustic bread was delicious, served thinly sliced but became soggy quickly as tomato spread was on a thick side (rather than rubbed with cherry tomato, then drizzled with olive oil). Wine list covers most "usual suspects" within the Spanish region. Tempranillo was served way too chilled, first sip of the wine was a tad off until it settled in room temperature. Dining experience would have been a lot pleasant if there was more interaction with customers, instead of gathering and chatting among the service team -- lack of genuine Spanish warmth. No one approached our table to seek for feedback on food and service which is pertinent to any F&B establishment. A lady (dressed in shorts) was seen hanging around in the open kitchen, an absolute no-no from safety and hygiene standpoint. Food is generally decent and we will still return to try other items on its menu.Show less

Author: cristiloren
Title: Excelent spanish food
Review: Beautiful building and decoration, amazing food and cool and relaxing atmosphere. The staff is super nice and friendy and the chef is a real spanish cook! I highly recommend to try the "coca catalana" ( sardines and vegetables on top of a crispy puff pastry).

Author: rolando381
Title: Authentic! Homely! Ambience tops it all! 100 year old building restored tastefully!
Review:
For a classy restaurant with sensible pricing and kids menu :)

Menu best pick: Secreto (pork) and Gambas. Mix cold cut. Taste just like in Spain

Author: MalaysiaAnnHarrison, Australia
Title: Excellent Spanish Fare
Review: Had tapas and drinks with friends here. They have seating upstairs and downstairs. Downstairs is suitable for sit-down dinners whereas the upstairs has a more casual air and is great for tapas and drinks. The iberico ham and cheese platter were excellent as was the wine we had. Maria, who I believe runs the restaurant, was most helpful in her suggestions as to the desserts which were also very tasty. I especially like that they have not tried to "localise" the food. All in all a very pleasant night out with good food and wine.Show less

Author: bubbles_csKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice restaurant
Review: Friendly management , staff & chef , tapas that serves pork , good ambiance , I like it here , not bad for a new restaurant , very nice place to chill and eat , don't have to dress up , easy nice place to eat chill Spanish tapas that serves pork Show less

Author: ayie-jogankz
Title: Nice dinner
Review: Warm welcoming by the staff. The food was excellent as well. Patatas bravas was really nice (be careful if you're not used to spicy food cause it more spicy here). Price little bit expensive for backpacker like me, but I think it still on reasonable range for this kind of restaurant. It was good dinner !Show less

Author: Kristinah87Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Late dinner at Salud...
Review: A good place to hang out with family and friends. The staff are friendly, we were greeted by a Spanish lady, she brought us to our table and even recommended the food and drinks that we should try. Really love their service, the food and the atmosphere. The best part is they are open for dinner menu even at 11pm on weekdays whereby during that time, most of the restaurant at the area will close their kitchen for dinner and only open their snacks menu. Give it a try if you visit the area.Show less

Author: RolleuJonesCHong Kong, China
Title: Espanol Tapas by espanol Chef
Review: Lovely restaurant with delicious Spain food,Comparing another chain store La Bodega,Salud is more down to earth and have a more friendly price tag.The entire environment is decent, clean cut and there's bar tapas seat.The Spain manager is friendly.Food portion is small as its tapas,Good location in Melaa most pop tourist hot spot jinked street.Sangria is nice.Paella is traditional.
