Means that the rice maybe less cook and more chewy as the original Paella should be. Surprisingly they serve the Huevos xxx , that's a main course of eggs and hams which is common in Spain but seldom to see in Asian tapas bistro or restaurant.Show less

Author: De_singasAvoca Beach, Australia
Title: Great food, great atmosphere, great location
Review: Very welcoming, friendly service and delicious authentic Spanish fare. We were looking for baboon burgers and happened to stumble across this tapas restaurant, our lucky day. They've done a great job renovating this place to create an inviting place where you can easily drink and eat away the afternoon away.Recommend the Salud salad, coca Catania, ham and bread (pork sliders), kids chicken and fries, and chocolate crepes. 5 stars all round, thanks guys!Show less

Author: rolliedooSingapore, Singapore
Title: A lot of room for improvement
Review: Reached here at 730pm and was greeted warmly by the staff. They seem knowledgeable and friendly. We decided to go with the paella and two other dishes and was told that the waiting time for the paella was going to be 30 mins. The two other dishes were served swiftly and it tasted okay, nothing much to shout about. At about 9pm, we were famished and the paella was still not served. We decided to cancel our order and head over to the night market for dinner. I understand that this establishment is still new and there's a lot of room for improvements. Hopefully when or if I come back next time, I'll get to try the paella without such a long wait.Show less

Author: pzam184
Title: Great spot!
Review: We stayed for a few days and came here twice. Atmosphere is great, very chilled. Food is DELICIOUS! Head chef Breogan is very talented, we especially loved the croquetas. And manager Maria is very welcoming, definitely recommend!

Author: Steve A
Title: the new Tapas in town.
Review: Just like the other tapas restaurant across town, this one surely easy to find. strategic location near Jonker street. And it serve PORK?? A must visit and meet the Spanish Chef Traba. Kudos.

Author: yannick707
Title: Wow!
Review:
Guys, great job!
The service, the food...just amazing!
Special thanks to Thomas, made us feel like home. Keep going, we will be back for sure!

Author: Lana_Turianska
Title: Do not miss Grand Opening
Review: A visit to SALUD tapas bar of Malacca will show you how these small plates define—and preserve—fusion of the Malaccan - Iberian way of life.

Author: annamoneCairo, Egypt
Title: Xmas dinner 2020
Review: We booked the xmas dinner though table app and mentioned extra whishes because we don't eat fish. The chef called us personally to discuss a Menü change!Located on the 41 floor we had a fantastic view over Melaka, the food was very tasteful and the wine card quite big. They played nice xmas songs and the waiter were very attentive. Couldn't have a better celebration.Show less

Author: yihanku
Title: I was so so regret to chosen
Review:
I was so so regret to chosen this restaurant for celebrated valentines dinner, our reservation time is 8.30pm, starter came at 9.00pm, main course came at 10.05pm, dessert came at 10.43pm, 
AND the foods was TERRIBLE, Low Quality, Low Standard!!!!
WE DEFINITELY WON’T VISIT AGAIN,

Author: feliciadionMelaka, Malaysia
Title: My fiancé choose here to celebrate
Review: My fiancé choose here to celebrate Valentine’s Day ! End up waiting for the food almost freaking 2 hours !!!!! I’ve asked twice to different waiters but not even one freaking person come and answer me how long do I have to wait more !!!!! Seriously , you guys made my day !!!! 1st and last time here !!! Nice place but super slow !!!!!!! Show less

Author: hanimsubandiMuar
Title: His birthday celebration
Review: Having my fiancee birthday celebration at pampas recently...we have a good experience, the staff are very friendly...eventhough the booking was made on the same day , the staff are still able to provide the arrangement for my fiancee birthday celebration....The ambient is soothing and we wish to come again to this place.Show less

Author: sulin1912Pasir Puteh, Malaysia
Title: It was our very first time
Review: It was our very first time dine here.The astmosphere was sooth,the view was trully breaktaking and the staff was really helpful. He even offered himself to take our pictures and suggested the best place to take photo. (I forgot his name). I will surely come again. The steak was mouth watering and we had to take it away since we were full to finish the tendeloin and mix platter in one shot.Show less

Author: AnsonLee0524
Title: The rudeness of the Indian old man.
Review: Unbelievable rudeness of the Indian manager....We went to the bar to spend our weekend evening, there were only few tables occupied.We saw there were two birdcage designed tables were empty, so my friend requested to sit one of the empty birdcage seat there, but the Indian old man showed sour face and said to my friend: How much are you going to spend ? My kind hearted friend replied: we are going to order wine.So finally he agreed to let us take it ....I was about to confront with this rudeness Indian old man, but because I was the guest of my friend, so I decided to calm down for my friend.How rude and the way he looks down on people, if there is a minimum charge for taking a special table or a private room , he should explain nicely , not just throw the rude question with a sour face : How much are you going to spend ?? If you seriously want all the guests come to spend certain amount of bill before entering your bar, please put a BIG note at the entrance, I suggest the old Indian guy should go for a service training before working in F&B .Show less

Author: Anthony K
Title: Wife birthday dinner.
Review: The cost is considered high for a lot people. Food quality is above average. Environment is good for premium dinning.

Author: jo_210119
Title: Birthday celebration and excellent moment
Review: First time to dine here. Amazing atmosphere, the view was awesome and nice. Awesome dinner and service was great. Overall everything was great and satisfied.

Author: Gary F
Title: Excellent establishment !
Review: I had dinner at this restaurant & I was very happy with the whole experience.The view was amazing,there was a viewing deck on the roof,the seating was great as the tables are well spaced so you don’t feel pushed on top of other patrons which was nice.The staff where extremely friendly & helpful,the steak was delicious,cooked perfectly with decent portions,also drinks where like doubles,they where very generous with the alcohol.At the end of the night my phone died & the waiter offered the use of his phone to organize a taxi back to my hotel.Great atmosphere very relaxed & cool.If you enjoy really great steak this restaurant is worth booking.Show less

Author: Paul MStubbington, United Kingdom
Title: A very pleasant evening with outstanding views of Malaka
Review: Easy to book on line, more difficult to find as little signage to restaurant ground floor entrance.Front of house staff ver efficient and although I had said it was for a wedding anniversary meal we were seated in prime position to experience the night time view of Malaka.Our starters were excellent and desserts were also.The main course of sirloin steak was a disappointment because of the method of cooking have left the meat swimming in oil.It did not look very appetising but when scraped off the meat was well cooked to our taste, Jacket potato excellent but would have liked more vegetables .Do not ask for mustard as the item supplied was not my understanding of either UK, USA or French style mustard.Wait staff were young but tried very hard and responded to any request.Show less

Author: Pengat2pisang
Title: Birthday celebration
Review: First and last time to dine here. Food worst,chicken tandoori is very dry, pampas seafood jumbo platter tasteless like u put the same sauce for chicken tandoori on top the seabass. The only best thing is sunset view. Waiter attitude good. Price?? Not match with the food taste.Show less

Author: LambertL44
Title: Excellent moment in pampas
Review:
The curry cream pasta with tiger prowns was truly amazing.
The service was really great. The view is very nice too!

Author: hopepestSingapore, Singapore
Title: I would return
Review: Awesome dinner and a view! We almost gave this restaurant a miss cos there was a horrible review on the service and the food photos by other guests were unappealing. Truth be told, the lighting was conducive for a romantic night out; not food photography (as it should be).The calamari was juicy with crisp batter served with tartar sauce made by the restaurant. Lamb chops/rack was done medium well (I wasn't given an option) but it was tender. The beef shot rib was perfectly tender.Show less

Author: claud1neJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice place but terrible experience
Review: We wanted to eat there because of the location but after what we been through inside the restaurant we left without actually experience the beautiful night view of Melaka.The waiter who served us, i don't know whether he is making fun of us for not knowing some of the dishes name on the menu as our English is not superb or just trying to be funny. Either way, we felt uncomfortable. The serving period is alright, you don't have to wait hours to eat. The food I ordered is not tasty but my friends food are okay. If this weren't for the scenery, we definitely will not go there and now, even with the view, we will not go back as well.Show less

Author: 520fangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Splendid Experience
Review: Service was great, ambience was fantastic and food was delicious. Brought my boyfriend here for his birthday and he was delighted by the view as well as the food. He even mentioned that he will not forget this experience. However, I would recommend not to play pop music and instead play some slow songs like jazz as pop songs don't match the atmosphere. Overall everything was great. Show less

Author: Gregg LHong Kong, China
Title: New year kind of thing
Review: We went for the new year set dinner. You may ask what a vegetarian is doing in a steak restaurant but I was with a family of carnivores. That being said the chef and staff were very accommodating by creating a special meal for me. They made up the cost difference by giving me a drink and ordering off the al a carte menu. The vegetarian meal was good and apparently the steaks were devine.The staff was top notch! Extremely attentive and professional. The views were outstanding! We are also allowed to go to the bar next door for the new year's celebration. Again great outdoor views. We did have a problem finding it because there are no real signs or directions but if you park in the visitor parking, park near the hotel. The elevator is on the opposite side of the hotel elevator. Alternatively if you go to the hotel you can also just walk around the building. I'd recommend anyone coming to malaka to eat here. There's good value for your money. Show less

Author: sivasagi25
Title: Boxing Day Dinner
Review: Recommended by friend. Had reservation at 7pm.splendid view from the restaurant.spend 20 mins walking around enjoying the sunset. Staff was friendly,food was good,ambient was fantastic.both open air and indoor seating available.

Author: o0o124Osaka, Japan
Title: Relaxing environment and nice food
Review: The environment around is really relaxing and can cause u to put aside ur stress. Part of malacca can be viewed from here . The scene is really nice in addition of the course being served made u satisfied and enjoyed. Do recommend if u come to malacca Show less

Author: jeffreyvietJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Magnificent view
Review: I was at The Shore Hotel after dinner and was told of this place on the 41st Floor with a fantastic view of Melaka. A set of 3 pints of Guiness Draft and 3 pints of Hieneken set me back by Rm 200 but the view and athmosphere was worth it. I had chips to go with my drinks I saw food being served which looked delicious and I look forward to dine here on my next visit.Staff were very attentive.Show less

Author: GaryL3551Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice view with awesome food!!
Review: If you fancy good steaks while you're in Melaka, then you definitely do not want to miss out on this place. Located on the 41st floor of The Shore with an amazing view of Melaka City. It's steak is to die for. For steak lovers, you definitely will not regret this dinning experience.Show less

Author: nelizzaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Things can be improved...
Review: My partner booked a table here to celebrate my birthday. Service and food was good too. What bothers me the most is that our table are close to the sliding door leading to the open terrace and people were going in and out and NEVER closed the door. Please stick a sign on the door to get people to close it everytime they walked in and out, some diners here don't really have brain sometimes. This restaurant is on below the Sky Tower. You will not have access to the Sky Tower after dining if you don't pay additional MYR25 per person. What we could suggest you to do is get a free entry for your diners who have spend MYR300 or MYR350 and above (this numbers can be set by the Pampas Management and Sky Tower Management subject to the number of diners and amount spent) at the restaurant. Just our 2cent piece of adviseShow less

Author: adrian0714Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice view coupled with delicious food
Review: We dined at Pampas on our last night in Melaka. Honestly, we chose Pampas only after Alto Sky restaurant at the Hatten rejected us entry as we were inappropriately dressed. Well, turned out to be a blessing in disguise. Also, the restaurant had indoor dining as well as an al fresco area. For those who do not wanna dress up, you’d wanna consider Pampas. For the record, they admitted us into the dining lounge, and for that I am very appreciative. Our family did not have anything smart casual or formal during this trip.Here’s what we ordered: Calamari rings and Salmon Roulade for starters, Angus beef tenderloin, perch fish fillet, fish and chips and baby lamb leg for mains. They were brilliantly cooked, and worth every penny. Also, we had a very pleasant, helpful and warm waiter serving us, although I did not get his name. Thank you and we’ll definitely be back the next time we are in town. Show less

Author: 196meeraaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: My Father Got Surprised
Review: We were not in a planning to dining here.We went upstairs for The shore Sky Tower experience. The night view from the top were so beautiful. Than the way back I noticed there is this Pampas Restaurant so we decided to chill there. Had some cocktails which were really awesome and informed a server to arrange brownie dessert written Happy Birthday to my father. The whole team really surprised my father with birthday song and the brownie with candle.Thanks for the whole team! Keep up the good work! Show less

Author: PrasaanthN2
Title: Amazing view
Review: Visited last night, the place had an amazing view. The food was not that pricey given the ambience. We had the norwegian salmon and baby spinach lamb leg and octopus leg (starter). Food was well presented and it was huge. The dessert was pretty good too. We have to mention the service provided by Ira was simply amazing. She immediately made us feel calm and we had a good laugh. You guys should keep people like this as they are hard to come by.Show less

Author: cherlyne88
Title: Mouthwatering mains
Review:
Went with a family of five and ordered 6 mains to share. The food and service were both excellent and I would go again. Food prices are pretty alright but we ordered about an average of RM100 per main.

The view was great too.

Author: shaun517Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: 1st class location with 3rd class staff
Review: I just had my dinner with an old friend at the restaurant, no doubted it has a nice view of the Malacca town, but the staff that served us was rude. This supposed to be a so called 'fine dinning' restaurant, but the staff never smile. The front desk receptionist not even greet us when we arrived, and when I ask too much about the menu, he just pointed to the menu and ask me to read it myself. It's either he's can speak proper English or he just don't know how to explain. We sat at a table near the kitchen and you can hear the chef talking and cooking and walking around in and out of the kitchen like a 'mamak' shop. Very disappointed with the service and it really spoiled my night.Show less

Author: vickyo3Adelaide, Australia
Title: Superb surprise
Review: Our family couldn't decide on where to go for dinner during our short break away in Melaka. This restaurant totally ticked all the boxes. Superbly cooked steaks, delicious home made pastas, great modern menu and a good selection of wines, all of this while taking in a stunning view.Staff were attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. I do suggest you make a reservation as tables with the best window views go quickly. There is a great outdoor cocktail bar too which offers spectacular endless views over the city. Really glad we came here and will highly recommend it to others.Show less

Author: IvansLowSingapore, Singapore
Title: Most recommended place to dine in
Review: 20.5.18 which I just went to Pampas Sky Dining with my wife to celebrate our 1st wedding anniversary, the place is so nice and good ambience to chill out. Would specially thanks to Mr. Ganasan and his great team on their great, friendly and professional service throughout our dinner. We both enjoy much the dinner but unfortunately unable to test their wine as my wife is pregnant now. Definitely will return visit on next trip ! Show less

Author: KatherinaA15Singapore, Singapore
Title: 服务态度超级恶劣
Review: 今天我和朋友家人长辈总共7个人在晚上9点多来这个地方打算看风景放松心情。在我们从电梯里出来要转进去这个餐厅的时候（基本上是在电梯外面），一位马来招待员走过来双手打开把我们挡住。 她说：“why are you here?”虽然当下觉得很奇怪，可是我们还是回答她说：“we are here for the sky bar”. 她：“is anyone of u going to buy at least one drink?” （她是用手指着我们说这一句话，我是慢半拍的人，当下也可以感受到她的不友善和瞧不起人的态度）当下的我们也来不及反应，也因为我们没有看到菜单，也不懂里面到底有什么可以吃还是喝的，而且我们当下也不是每个人都可以喝酒。我们和她说“no...”她：“you all minimum have to buy at least one drink then only can enter.”然后她就直接把我们晾在一边，完全没有要招待我们的意思。我们当下是很惊讶也不懂为什么她会这样对我们 我们每个人都很失望不能进去这个点评不错的地方。给管理层的建议，食物再好，服务员的素质也是很重要。 就算我们当下进去了这个餐厅，有这样的服务员，呈上的食物再好也是会被扣分！最重要的是，这个服务员表现出这个餐厅只服务喝酒消费的人。其他喝果汁饮料吃东西看风景的顾客就滚一边？真的要好好检讨一下！Show less

Author: subaanab2018Seremban, Malaysia
Title: We had fun
Review: Celebrated my husband's 30th birthday here...We simply love the way the waiters guided us on the menu and served us professionally.. They also made us feel comfortable.. They were very friendly.. Loved the ambience of the place. The food and drinks were extraordinary.. A must visit place!! Show less

Author: erashmahmudKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Place in Melaka for Fine Dinning
Review: The view is great. Just an advice. The outside sitting is very nice to have a drink and enjoy view. Not so much for having dinner. For dinner sit inside. The food is good. With nice selection of food range. Enjoyed the meal and the ambience. Highly recommended if you are in melaka and looking for a fine dinning to celebrate an occasion Show less

Author: huntforgoodtimes
Title: Incredible food, great experience.
Review: I took my boyfriend here for a Birthday treat and it was amazing. Good selection of drinks, very accomodating staff, relaxed atmosphere, incredible food and a beautiful view to top it off. People should go for food as well as drinks as the food was top notch. We also had a fantastic time arriving a bit early to see it get dark. A fantastic experience.Show less

Author: David M
Title: Extremely good dinner for a western style steak house
Review: We shared a Caesar salad, 350gm Tenderloin steak cooked perfectly medium rare with mashed potatoes and snap peas. For dessert, we shared the molten chocolate cake with ice cream. Wow, it was as good as the great steak houses in New York at less than 1/2 the cost! The view was fantastic and the service was spot on!I would recommend it in a heartbeat for those looking for steak in Malaysia. Show less

Author: tzeeweeiMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great services and food!
Review: Firstly, I would like to provide a very good comment on the environment and services provided there. The staff are nice and everyone smiled and greeted us whenever they passed by. This makes us feel so warm. Not only that, their food served are really delicious and are in a large portion. I've ordered the Al Freddo Pasta which was not in their mew menu, but they still tried to ask the chef to prepare it for me as I requested. This makes me to have a really good impression on the staff's services. I've also tried their Chicken Roulade with Spinach and this is nice too! Will definitely visit again next time!Show less

Author: singaporeatourist
Title: location is pretty, food/drink not so great
Review: We were there for an afternoon break. Served beer that wasn't chilled enough, and calamari was of the frozen-defrost type. Chicken wings were slightly better. Nice idea with the cages and it's just nice to be up on the top of a building.

Author: Narvin27
Title: Sky High Delight
Review: Great location for dinner with family and love one. Great ambient and the food was prepared fast. Service was great and food was delicious.

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dining at the top in Melaka
Review: This must the highest dining restaurants in Melaka, whereby one can have a magnificent unobstructed view of the city. You can also have a wonderful sun setting sight from here. Food wise is reasonable and steak is their specialty. Don’t fear for those non-beef patrons as they do serve seafoods and pasta too. For diners free parking is available at the ground entrance to the building, hence you need not to park at the indoor parking lot, which might be a little confusing as their isn’t any visible signage guiding patrons to the restaurant. Servers are friendly but not professionally trained. Unlike most proper restaurants, whereby the server knows exactly who ordered what and place the exact orders to the right patron. Furthermore, when you order a bottle of wine they will not let the person to taste them before serving. They only show the bottle then start pouring/serving it to all the diners without seeking for taste testing approval.Show less

Author: withjoeyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Reasonable price at the "sky"
Review: Reasonable price at the "sky", reservation is advisable if you are going for a special occasion, or you may opt to reach early, enjoy the sunset then dinner. Very windy on the out door sitting and is advisable to go for it, instead of indoor. Nice viewShow less

Author: ancyancySingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place for evening drinks!
Review: This was the best find in Malacca. We didn't eat but had drinks at the rooftop bar. It was a great way to see the town from the 41st floor, without paying an entrance fee! (vs the 42nd top floor)As it is a rooftop bar with no AC, I would recommend coming up later in the evening as the sun sets. Malacca is way toooo hot!Show less

Author: Choonfong
Title: Splendid buffet spread
Review: We had cream of mushroom soup, chicken curry, moussaka, fish baked fillets, potato salads, chocolate gateau and fresh sliced fruits. Good service with attentive staff and great views from the top.

Author: 8twenty
Title: Nice place to chill out at night
Review: Lovely place to hang out at night and enjoy the view of melaka~ u dont need to pay for entrance fee and can enjoy the scenery as well

Author: esther tammy DSingapore, Singapore
Title: No meaning behind its luxury Name
Review: Its my first visit, after the opening of Pampas. Live in Melaka, but due to work constraints I never had the opportunity to visit the talk of the town! Anyway, on the 26th of April I decided to give a shot calling the steakhouse for general enquiries. Its Wednesday, it Ladies night, so hey! lets get more information about that. A guy picked up my call (number reflected on Facebook page) to my surprise It was the beginning of my terrible experience. I asked how do we go about ladies night, Eg: Any rules? Any cover charge? The response I got did not give me a fine dining feel kinda service. The guy gave me a very brief detail "you can only have 1 choice of cocktail the whole night" thats fine. So I asked if we can order food? To my surprise the answer I got "Oh sorry ma'am for food there is no free flow of food" Hmmm so did this guy actually listen or ask me about what I meant? Anyway, I wont explain further. Me and my friends arrived at the lift lobby, there were only 1 fire lift to the 41st floor & it took us about 30mins waiting time (FYI) Upon arrival, we were guided to the indoor and outdoor seating. The place was literally empty probably 2-3 guest chillin around with the music sounded as if there were a large crowd! So we were seated, waiter presented the menus and nothing mentioned about ladies night. But I thought that's fine. So I asked: is there ladies night? Waiter: ermm after 9pm ma'am.Me: its 9:15pm now? Waiter: oh! Yes it just started. Me: how do I go about? Waiter: you can go to the bar. Me: what can I order? Waiter: you can check with them ma'am.Now the frustration comes in.I walked to the bar, asked for the cocktail they serving, and it was (Juliet). So I said can I have 3? (Obviously its for me, and my 2 other girl friends) Bartenders nodded and I walked back. Suddenly the waiter approached me saying:"Ma'am for ladies night you need to collect yourself and it will not be served to you" Me: oh well, What's next? I walked to the bar and a supervisor comes up to ask "whats the actual problem ma'am? You can tell me so I can see how to improve the service" Gosh! Is this how a supervisor speaks? After much hoo- haa, I took my 3x cocktails for the ladies night and I gave up asking anything. We ended up ordering hot lattes for the night.Our steaks were okay, not the best as it seems.Lamb: too much fat. It came with no mint sauce. Chicken: meat too tough. Overall we enjoyed the ambiance with the view, chats and laughter since our last reunion. Didn't refill the "ladies night cocktail" too much hassle. I wish the management take this feedback seriously otherwise it brings no meaning behind the purpose of its name & sky dining. Don't forget there were no napkins too! 1 glass of iced water is RM5? This is hilarious when I come from a Luxury property our guest gets complimentary bottled water as many as they want! Pampas / The Shore management its time to relook? Show less

Author: tanpyMalaysia
Title: Beautiful place for dinner & drinks
Review: I was surprised to find a good dining place in Melaka. Finally a nice western restaurant I can visit in my future trip to Melaka. Breathtaking views at night. Food was good. Price of KL restaurant standard. We had some drinks at open air area after our indoor dinner. Was surprised there were nice breeze outside and don't feel warm at all. There was a DJ playing music which is not too noisy. Crowd were mainly locals and local tourist. The staff were well spoken and friendly. Whole family including old folks and kids can enjoy in this restaurant indoor or outdoor. Great place and will definitely visit again. Show less

Author: copyrabbit
Title: Windy and cozy at night
Review: Brought my family with 2 elderly and young kid to the place at night. Cool breeze and cozy at night with nice scenery. The calamari and chicken wings are delicious! One down side, need to wait for the lift which take longer than usual.

Author: ellanec2013Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Birthday special occasion in Melaka
Review: Came here during my birthday weekend outing to A'Famosa. My husband took me to a special dining at night to celebrate my birthday. Foods is quite nice. Consider worth the price and we order a dessert cake. View is very nice. We sat inside the restaurant then walked outside. It is more quiet inside.Show less

Author: farahevans
Title: nice view
Review:
Have been here many times .First because of the view and close time quite late . The service from staff very nice. Welcoming and friendly . 

Food also very nice but quite expensive .

Author: Rob HCoto de Caza, California
Title: Very disappointing
Review: The view is spectacular from the bar and the table seats by the window but that is as far as it goes. There was 4 of us and we started with a Vodka Martini and explained exactly how we wanted it with "NO VERMOUTH". The drinks came out with Vermouth and where exactly 1oz. We sent them back and got a major attitude from the waiter and bar tender. One of our guys went to the bar and showed them how to make our drinks. The restaurant refused to turn on the air conditioning for over 1 hour and if you have traveled to Malaysia you know you need air! We then ordered dinner and a bottle of wine. The waitress brought out the wine and showed us the label and then poured us the taste and it was sour. The bottle had gone bad as the wine was rust tint in our glass. We then told her to take it back and she refused and said she was going to have to pay for it if we didn't. After much arguing with all the staff, they finally took if off our bill. The food was cheap but just OK and that is why I am giving this place 2 stars. For this to be called a steakhouse is confusing to me as they were out of the best steak and was 6:00PM. Follow the reviews and stay away or just go to the bar and have beer, they cant mess that up.Show less

Author: invisible999Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing...
Review: So this is 'the' fancy place - on 41st floor of the hotel. It comes with three attributes 'view/atmosphere', 'food' and 'value for money'. The catch is - you have to select ONLY one from above three and letter two are not really available for selection.If you come here to have a tasty meal - you will regret it and to add insult to injury - you'll feel cheated of you money. Money you spent on a single meal is enough to feed a family at excellent local restaurant. Especially try to avoid meals with shrimp in them - I had a feeling that they died due to natural causes and then been served at this restaurant - after that meal had to spend reminder of my evening at bathroom.Nothing bad can be said about service, but again - if you want to be on a safe side just order glass of wine, sit inside and enjoy the view.Show less

Author: subas2017
Title: Over rated
Review: Poor service, poor food and over hyped. Atrocious prices. Frankly you will get better food on ground level then this over rated place.

Author: fOODSLOVEr668
Title: Great View
Review:
Invited by some business partner and this was my first time been up there. 

Great view from the top, serving wide range of wine, staff were very friendly hence the food can be better.

Author: Asher-Aander
Title: very good quality food and scenic view of the town
Review: instead of paying to go to the sky deck, we chanced upon this restaurant and decided to give it a try. the western steak was extremely good and we would strongly recommend!

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: Great view from the top! but go day time
Review: Food nothing great. However the view is impressive. The Pizza was with chunky meat but still small for a medium eater like me.

Author: evieleeyi
Title: Not bad.
Review: Environment is good, unfortunately I went on a rainy day. Food portion is quite small compare to the price. Food tastes are still alright (I ordered a prawn spaghetti with curry cream source and rack of lamb). The only bad is I ordered a mango juice and it came with orange juice. Under dim light, I couldn't see the colour of the juice (well, the colour of orange juice & mango juice are almost the same) and both of it have the same price so I'm still OK with it. Show less

Author: bhcohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: We decided to try the Pampas Steakhouse as it looks impressive from the advertisements. This is my review. The views is to die for, you can see right around Melaka from here. The service I must say is excellent as the waiters were very attentive to all the customers. Unfortunately sitting at the outside bar was a bit of a disappointment as the music just kept blasting which make the environment unpleasant.We moved inside to the restaurant for our meal, again views and service is outstanding but the air conditioning was not set to the correct temperature as we were perspiring while having our dinner. Hoping that they could address the above. Show less

Author: AndrewDarwinWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Solid, good service. Food a bit average
Review: Nice modern setting high up with great views. Good service, menu ok. Starters good, steaks were a bit disappointing but not terrible. Cuts were a bit skinny and seasoning could have been better, and medium rare was not very pink at all. Nice bottle of Prosecco. Nice to see how big Melaka is, and to plan our walking route the following day. Not sure if I'd go again as we prefer local cuisine......but was an enjoyable night.Show less

Author: HO K
Title: Nice scenery and food
Review: Special location of the restaurant, in the middle of town. Western food, ok taste, not too expensive. Romantic environment :) Definitely nice scenery. Will come again!

Author: judithkrishnan
Title: Views amazing of Malacca
Review: Nice Place great view you can see beautiful Malacca at night and if you come earlier both day and night views

Author: Florence CMalaysia
Title: Amazing Panoramic Views
Review: Have a beautiful panoramic views and a great place to chill. They have 3 areas here, a lounge, the steakhouse and the open air bar. Nahit was friendly and helpful. He help us for a very nice group picture. Worth to visit. We will be back again.Show less

Author: albatross-549Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Enjoy the panoramic view of the Melaka city
Review: The place located on the 41st - the second highest floor of the relatively new Shore Mall and Apartments with a grand city view, was our location last month for a friends' get-together .The Bar has some interesting cocktails and mocktails on menu.Bartender is very enthusiastic and likes to mix with the guests. We as a group ordered a number of mocktails and cocktails, which were well received by the friends.The Pampas Steakhouse serves a good mix of Beef Cuts, Seafood, Poultry and Pasta. I tried Barramundi Fish fillet, which was well made. The other dishes were of chicken preparations, and pastas.The group had a satisfying visit Show less

Author: Merinda_angel
Title: Delicious food and wonderful view
Review: Last night was my very first time dinner in this restaurant, friend said the tower where the restaurant at is second tallest building here in melaka. Great view from up there, my order is seafood platter, and its yummy. I suppose to order steak as they are famous with it, but other choice are also worth to try. I like the chicken breast stuff with spinach, baramundi fish, and the starter too. Love the scallop. For those who want fine dining here with good view and nice food, this restaurant is a good choice. Will come again soon. Show less

Author: Christina S L
Title: Fine dining above the maddening crowd
Review: One of the few fine dining restaurants in Melaka. Lovely food and throw in a spectacular view and you have the start to a lovely evening. We enjoyed ourselves tremendously and will definitely visit again.

Author: mcjmzfrancoSpain
Title: Awsome view
Review: The view is worth the visit. The restaurant is situated on the 41st floor of a modern mall in the old part of the city, it is well decorated, the staff is friendly and quite efficient; the quality of the food is high as well as the price but the view at sunset 7:15 is worth the visit. You can see the Melaka Straight and the zig zags of the river.The only problem is that it was a bit warm at the beginning until the air conditioning refreshes the place, but you can have a drink outside and later go in for diner. Show less

Author: Cherry L
Title: Not worth the place
Review: The lift to the restaurant is hard to find. The food were just average, service are great. I prefer the steak in Hard Rock Cafe more.

Author: suniljatanaMuar, Malaysia
Title: Dining Experience with Melaka skyline in the background
Review: Visited the Pampas Restaurant on 22nd July 16 and it was an exhilarating experience dining on the 41st Floor of the Shore mall with the Melaka Skyline in the background. The service was very prompt though the menu was a trifle limited especially if you are fond of chicken dishes and also if you are veggie. We had ordered for chicken breast grilled and pasta.which was up to the mark. The cocktails come with tantalizing names like sex on the beach, which is nothing more than vodka with cranberry and orange juice. The place has decent ambience and worth visitingShow less

Author: HanermanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Halal AA beef, done well but you can't turn a pigs ear into a silk purse
Review: First, the service was quite good getting us to our seat and taking our order. Much better than when the restaurant first opened. We got our starters all at the same time and they looked pretty good. However, my smoked salmon did not taste fresh at all. I did eat it though so I cannot complain too much I suppose. On to the main course... a rib eye steak. Being halal beef, it already is tough from the poor animal being tortured to death. AA cut at beat, just not very good meat to start with. However, they did my steak very well with garlic butter, giving it good flavour. Too bad they couldn't improve how tough the steak was. Nice presentation though and the veggies served with it were superbly cooked. I can't say enough about the good service and the general ambience of the restaurant, however the meat should have been AAA for this level of restaurant. Can't avoid the halal beef issue in Malaysia, unfortunately, but AAA would have made up for it somewhat. My wife had the local fish and she was happy with that. But as a meat eating westerner, to me it's all about the quality of the meat. Show less

Author: VincentCham32
Title: Ecellent view.
Review: Went there in the afternoon just to have some beers and light snacks with friends. The view was breathtaking! A nice relaxing place to be at.

Author: Dcrn999
Title: food is ok but nice view.
Review: The view is good.  Service was ok only. Food is quite nice but not that impressive that would make want to go back again and again.

Author: Backbonekent
Title: Nice view
Review:
Visit this restaurant at May with family. We have enjoy our time at here. The night view is fantastic and the environment is romantic. 
Ps. The lift is slow

Author: RubenN346
Title: Dinner with view
Review: Pampas has a good Panoramic view with a subtle ambience. Kudos for having an establishment like this for a small city like Melaka. Menu selection is quiet extensive and like its name is a meat eaters haven. Staff require some improvements in terms of language and understanding of the wine menu selection. But you can call Aileen who is very helpful.Definitely a place to visit if you are a couple wanting some time together.Show less

Author: jaschintazSingapore
Title: Worst dining experience ever
Review: We've had the worse dining experience ever tonight, and that's saying a lot given the number of restaurants I've frequented around the world. Requested for a table with a view, but got a lousy table in the middle. Waitress serving us couldn't even get our wine order right. Our food took 1 hour to reach us despite us asking 3 times, and when it finally reached us, was cold. Other tables who arrived after us received our food before us. There was a ruckus in the kitchen with shouting and smashing of plates. Waitress spilled our wine when pouring. When we provided feedback, the "head" waitress looked extremely hard pressed to accept it and last but not least, we were charged, not a single cent was waived for all the inconvenience we had to go through. Suffice to say, this will be the last time we will be patronising this place. Great view, but too bad the service is worse than what you get at a Malaccan McDonald's.Show less

Author: simono611Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great environment but average food
Review: Pampas is located on the 41st floor in The Shore Melaka and offering an excellent view of the heritage city skyline. Recommended to have a romantic dining at night as I consider the view is more beautiful. Recommended for couple who want to chill and relax.Show less

Author: ScorpionTravellerKuala Lumpur
Title: Commendable service.
Review: It's generally challenging to find a restaurant that serves decent International menu in Malacca. Food is generally good, but not outstanding. Size of scallops was tiny (sliced into half), and combination with tequila and pineapple compote was lacklustre. It did not project any acidity from the pineapple (when it should), which may be better replaced with salsa. Fat around chicken roulade was not skinned, accompanying sauce was greasy and mashed potato was grainy. Norwegian pan seared salmon had a nice crisp on its surface, but slightly overcooked. It was unfortunately a farmed fed fish with prominent lines of fat, instead of deep sea fish from the Atlantic for the price that we pay. White wholegrain mustard sauce was runny and spinach was soaked. Not the best accompaniment (beurre butter may work better), but acceptable, taste wise. Service is top-notch by Ailene. Not only attentive, she exudes a natural welcoming personality with good product knowledge. Wine selection may not be available according to its menu. Best to ask. Choice of furniture does not blend with its overall ambience, bulky and looks like a banquet hall. Lights are way too bright, lack of mood lighting for dinner atmosphere. A small terrace is a nice addition for a romantic night out. Access via the lobby can be confusing as signage by the lifts are not prominent enough. There are two male attendants behind the counter, badly dressed (sloppy in shorts and flip flops) who are in a world of their own, not on hand to help visitors. Not a good representation to the restaurant.Show less

Author: souldoc7
Title: Great ambience but average food
Review: It's a perfect place to get a night view of Malacca . Ambience is great , service is satisfactory. Food to me is average as I have tasted much better one elsewhere which is more affordable. Great place for new couples as well as old couples who reminisce the good old days . Recommended to go at least once Show less

Author: Marc N
Title: Perfectly cooked steak
Review:
Rib eye here came out perfectly medium as i requested, albeit a long waiting time to get it served during the busy hours.

The panna cotta is also very creamy and delicious.

Author: jesslyn p
Title: Unpleasant experience
Review: Great view but the service needs to be improved1) the waitress gave us the menu only when we asked for it (after 15mins seated)2) my friend found some empty/used sugar sachets in the container when they served it with tea3) food is served but need to personally asked for the cutleries Show less

Author: phoebet546
Title: Splendid dining place in Malacca
Review: This is probably the highest dining place in Malacca at the moment.View was awesome as you can see the town from such a nice view up high.Food was great. The salmon was perfectly cooked, seared and crispy on the outside but still moist n tender on the inside.The appetizer; scallops with pineapple was a refreshing twist with the taste of the caramelized pineapple and spices infused in it. After dinner in the restaurant, we continued the night in their outdoor bar. The only downside was, the music was a tad too loud.Show less

Author: novice2006
Title: A gem in the sky
Review: I am so happy I found this hidden gem in Malacca skies.  The service was great, the food and drinks excellent and the music rocked Malacca town! Totally recommend this place guys!

Author: Jolee93
Title: A night to remember (cena migliore)
Review: One word to describe the place: Excellent. Mr. Ariva and Ms. Aileen plus the dining team are all very friendly and super nice. The food is just A-M-A-Z-I-N-G!! Definitely a place to go to for a memorable experience.

Author: docMalacca
Title: On high
Review: Had a 3 course dinner. The grilled lamb was satisfactory only. Ambience was great ; lovely night view over Melaka from the 41st storey !

Author: Bernard Fmelaka
Title: Great steak with great view
Review: Was there with visiting friends & family. 6 of us ordering 4 starters to share and a main dish each plus water & a bottle of red wine. Starters were all good with particular mention of the duck ham, and scallops which are very well executed. The steak is really good for Malaccan standard, but no sure impressed with the fish. View was good. Would suggest to go before sunset to enjoy the view and dine through the dark with the night view. However, not pleased with the music that was blasting from the outdoor bar during dining. Not sure if it is the usual set up or just because there was the Ms Tourism World event that the music was blasting.Show less

Author: StellaOPYKuala Lumpur
Title: Dine with an Excellent View
Review: The moment I stepped out to the outdoors, I was instantly beaming. The view , the setting , everything was spectacular. They say 1st impression counts. This certainly did. We were greeted by a lovely waitress named Shirley last Friday and she was very attentive and friendly. We were instantly at ease with her. After our appetizers, she gladly gave a us a tour of the place. We managed to catch the Manager and the other staffs who were all pleasant. For food however, I ordered my fish and I must say it can be improved as the fish was rather bland and the vege can be roasted instead. My partner had a steak and it was alright. Overall, if food can be at par with the view and setting, this Restaurant would be a Sky High!Show less

Author: NeerChan
Title: Far fetch from the main branches
Review: When my husband and I heard about Pampas opening in Melaka, we were excited coz we love the pampas grill in bukit ceylon and never fail to stop by for a meal whenever we go up. Obviously we r not from KL and Melaka is much nearer to us.Unfortunately, when we arrived at the restaurant,we were at awe as although we were the first and only customers to step in, all of the staffs stared at us in shock - made us think whether we came too early (6.30pm on Thursday) or that we didn't look like humans? It took them about 2min before someone waited on us.Thereafter, they improved but slightly. Steak was acceptable but not up to par, we ordered medium but turned out mostly cooked. Our vege side dishes was raw and the waitress told us it's not supposed to be cooked completely? So...Quite disappointed. Show less

Author: RAJ_Grewal23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent place but choose your days.
Review: The meals were decent, but as it was new year eve.. the meals were restricted. Fair enough as they limit the choices but the lack manpower made them take a while to serve you.. since it was new year eve, we choose the fine dining segment as it be just nice for us.. but then doors were open for the bar next door to come in.. n tables flying in.. ppl from the sides coming in.. n there was no one to give a courtesy apology or a word with the mayhem going on.. I know its new year but some ppl skill would work nicely.. nice place, but could be better managed...Show less

Author: PowerpuffAngie54Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Great view with affordable dinning experiences! BEST STEAK in TOWN
Review: It's a steak lover's blessing to have found this place, they offer one of the best serving of steaks in the city. Great ambience as it's located on the 41st floor! Their food can always pair with nice selection of wine or cocktail. Order your favourite part and enjoy it. The service staffs & chefs observe great care to serve your order, very accommodating on the done-ness of the steak while doing your order. Their portion are good and the price are reasonable. Be it coming here with friends or family, or any special occasion, It will always a pleasant beefy great time! Pampas Grill also offer a good selection of pasta and desserts. Two Thumbs Up!Show less

Author: M5865AErichardh
Title: A place for dining.
Review: Going up to pampas is a little troublesome but other then that. The food is superb, great service, lovely environment. A place where you would want to bring your family along.

Author: Melchua523
Title: Our countdown dinner gathering
Review: Nice view from 41 flr,awesome meals, cosy place n friendly staffs. Love this place too much. I'm already here many times.. 😍😍😍😍😍

Author: Beano55
Title: Favourite spot in Melacca
Review: We had a little trouble finding it but when we did we were so happy we did. We had one of the best steaks we've had in a long time. The outside garden was spectacular and romantic and we made a reservation to come back the next night at sunset. The staff were attentive and helpful.This place is a must for dinner or just drinks with a killer view.Show less

Author: Jack C
Title: Not so tasty lamb shank
Review:
we ordered steak and lamb shank,  steak was good but unfortunately,  lamb shank was poorly done and not up to expectations. 
House wine was average,  can't complain for the price that we paid for such wine

Author: Zingg HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good food and also great view
Review: Nice steaks and good selection of wine with reasonable pricing. Restaurant is at thetop most floor which one can have a nice impressive view of Melaka City. However,to locate the entrance to the lifts for Restaurant seems rather too obscure. No propersignage to indicate the entrance.Show less

Author: 438saritam
Title: One in a million
Review: Great food : love the pasta & chocolate granache . Superb ! Great & friendly staff : Indhra , Ailene , Umi , Kevin , John , Thomas and lots more , plus the experienced chefs Great ambience : beautiful 360• breathe taking scenery from level 41 , Shore . Most of all , there are more great people to meet like long time or long lost friends . Come one , come all for celebration . See you again PAMPAS ❤️Show less

Author: max13maxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Value for Money - great place for sunsets and to chill!
Review: Classy, elegantly furbished restaurant in the heart of Malacca, next to the river. Sited on top of probably one of the highest points in the city (41st floor), with an absolutely breath-taking and commanding view of the entire city, literally at your feet. Watch the sun sets over the Straits of Malacca, enjoy a glass of fine wine and savor a delectable selection of western cuisine. Best of all, was surprisingly affordable for such a classy joint, certainly excellent value for money! ... Will come back whenever in town! Thanks Mr Ariva and team for a wonderful time!Show less

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A touch of class everyone can afford!
Review: Children are welcomed! When I made the reservation, I thought we would have to change our plans due to our 5 year old. But I was very pleasantly surprised. Unlike other "classy" diners, they do not restrict children. Two thumbs up to that!Expecting the menu to be highly priced, again we were wrong. Very reasonably priced food. I had the Seafood combo (i think that's what it's called) and it was divine! My personal request for omitting dairy in any of my food was noted by our server, Indra (thank you!)The husband ordered a steak. Our order taker missed asking for the weight and done-ness which she then apologized for, but luckily he enjoyed ever bit of it!We took a quick walk outside and noticed the amazing view of our beautiful Melaka...it was breath taking. The ambiance outside was slightly lighter feel compared to the stylish settings inside. Was a little chilly but I liked it anyway.Parking=====Our only issue was the car park. Since the restaurant is within a mall/hotel there was a bit of confusion when we left the restaurant after the mall operation hours. I strongly suggest asking for parking instructions before.Overall=====I had a wonderful time and will surely be back. Soon.Show less

Author: Shelina KLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great view and great food.
Review: It is unusual to have a restaurant with a great view. Usually you have one or the other but not both. Commanding view of the Melaka town - all you need is serious lighting architects on the rest of the town. The whole experience was superb. The contemporary setting is stunning with the views of Melaka as the backdropThe food is always top notch & the bar is the best around. What makes stands it out from the competition is the attention to detail & customer service provided by the management and their team ...you made our nite very special....Thank you PampasShow less

Author: raymond j
Title: simply Breathtaking view with the most amzing and tasty food
Review: came here with a invitation from a friend..and the moment I walked in the view was breathtaking.ordered a black angus rib eye steak and the food tasted as amazing as the view..its a must place to visit in Melaka..

Author: max13maxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique jewel in the sky... excellent Value for Money!
Review: Classy, elegantly furbished restaurant in the heart of Malacca, next to the river. Sited on top of probably one of the highest points in the city (41st floor), with an absolutely breath-taking and commanding view of the entire city, literally at your feet. Watch the sun sets over the Straits of Malacca, enjoy a glass of fine wine and savor a delectable selection of western cuisine. Best of all, was surprisingly affordable for such a classy joint, certainly excellent value for money! ... Will come back whenever in town! Thanks Mr Ariva and team for a wonderful time!Show less

Author: Praboo A
Title: Perfect place for a good gathering
Review: Great food and warm ambience. Makes you feel warm and comfortable while dining there. Friendly and amazing staffs welcomes you as you step in the restaurant and serves you well. Highly recommended!

Author: Yumi S
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing views of melaka. Great steaks  and fantastic service too. They have 3 areas here, a lounge, the steakhouse and the open air bar. Highly recommended.

Author: PAULDGIBSON007Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: EXCELLENT - LOCATION, FOOD, SERVICE
Review: This restaurant is located at the top of the tallest building in Melaka on the 41st floor with wonderful panoramic views. The restaurant serves excellent steaks with first class service, also their is a large open area with a bar and at night live music from a DJ. This is a MUST visit restaurant / bar if you are in Melaka I have absolutely no hesitation in recommending this establishment.Show less

Author: yeap_my
Title: Must have
Review:
Always a nice place for dinner in Melaka. Tandoori chicken as always, juicy and tasty. 
Worth a try on spinach and double cheese naan.

Author: Idaaaa888
Title: Superb!
Review:
Excellent. Nice place a bit crowded. But the food is awesome so nice taste.

Parking easy. Staff friendly.

Author: eatlovepray0503
Title: Authentic
Review: They serve many types of roti naan here. Cheese naan is a must to have with the tandoori chicken. One of the best naan we ever had. Worth the trip!

Author: creaboulait13
Title: Filling dinner
Review:
Tasty and affordable. Place tends to be crowded so arrive early!

Go for the cheese naan and tandoori chicken!

Author: JAMILEYJAAFARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Average Pakistani Cuisine"
Review: This restaurant is just great in name because it tastes too simple and too creamy. I have tried and do not need to come again because it feels too bland compared to Pakistani restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. Probably because it is the only Pakistani restaurant in Melaka. If the owner of this restaurant notices he needs to come to Kuala Lumpur and taste for himself the cuisine of Pakistani restaurants here and make changes for his restaurant. It is not worth it to have to queue for food like this.Show less

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Nothing great
Review: I did not find this place worth any special comment just that they do a ok indian food fare and a bit on the spicier side.They need to improve the quality of service.

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Passable
Review: What makes this eatery so popular? Perhaps its the quick service and the predictable menu-ed pricing, choice and assurance that the taste would not go wrong. Perhaps there are not many eateries offering similar fare that they rank as “best” among the scarce lot. It’s passable.Show less

Author: FaizjoharMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Rudeness Of Staff
Review: Today I and my family are very disappointed in what happened . Their work is very rude and has no ethical way of serving customers . He prevented my family from entering the permits because one of us could not read the body temperature properly . It will be my FIRST and LAST for visiting this place !Show less

Author: Perry BHong Kong, China
Title: Wonderful, spicy Indian food!
Review: This was a great find. I loved the Indian food here, particularly the tandoori chicken and the wide range of naan breads available. Local spices were also represented in all their fiery glory, Melakan cuisine being known for its heat. As i operate under the maxim,'the spicier the better', this was great for me.Show less

Author: 323franz
Title: Food coma
Review: Best cheese naan and chicken in town I could eat the cheese naan every day :) go there early so u don't need to wait too long

Author: dewynne15
Title: Good naan.
Review: Affordable great triple cheese naan. Not for the butter chicken though. Packed with dinner crowd, but ample seats al fresco (aka road side).

Author: Rangga_1985Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Always have a good food here
Review: If you want to eat proper and nice tandori, this ia the right place to eat. Don't forget to eat with double cheese naan to make it even better. You have to be patiently wait to be seated. And make sure you call the waitress come to them, because they are reall short handed. Show less

Author: VivasummerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Tandoori chicken ever!
Review: We were quite critical with the claim but it turned out to be true. The chicken was tender, fresh, marinated just nice with a hint of spiciness and smokiness (ok, can be quite spicy if you don't eat chilly). We each ordered the 2nd portion for ourselves. The garlic nan was solf, fluffy and went well with the chicken and the curry sauce. A must try!Show less

Author: ceenu1969
Title: Tasty indian punjabi food
Review: Its one of the best place for spicy chicken tandoori... Crowded in evenings price is affordable  and taste nice... Seats placed outside open space.. Relax and dine... Mid range

Author: passportbob1
Title: Tasty stop
Review: My stop followed too close to the last food stop. Wasn’t that hungry, but wanted to taste. Excellent Kashmir naan with raisins. Flavorful curry dish. Mango lassi drink perfect. Need to return more hungry. Good local spot that doesn’t disappoint for price and variety.

Author: 118dejad
Title: Would recommend
Review:
Would recommend
Great food, very cheap, fast service, their naan, tandoori chicken, butter chicken and other sauces are delicious!

Author: zigav2017
Title: Great indian food in Malacca
Review: I tried Tandoori chicken with some plain rice and naan bread. Everything had good taste and prices were low so I would recommend it.

Author: keerteganb
Title: Don't understand the hype
Review: Came here with an expectation with all the hype.. Was served a tandoori chicken which wasnt well cooked. Told them and they took it and brought it back but still raw on the inside the best part they were nt apologetic or whatsoever mango lassi was more like Manggo juice... Cleanliness is bad after seeing 5 plates stacked on one other n served to customer naan was decent.... Left disappointed but atleast the stray cats had a feast after I left... Still trying to figure out the hypeShow less

Author: Tasha WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Indian Food
Review: This restaurant is highly rated for a reason. Definitely try the big mango lassi, so delicious and cool!As we couldn't decide we ordered all of the vegetarian dishes and some yellow biryani rice as well as some plain naan and a cheese naan.6 large mango lassi, 3 plain naan, 2 yellow biryani rice, one cheese naan, and six vegetarian dishes came to RM143 ~£30 ~$45CADHighly recommend!Show less

Author: maeltoshioPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dirty restaurant
Review: Super crowded,food wise ok..the tandori chicken tender and juicy.Nan bread very soft .The only problem the restaurant very dirty ,i just wonder the business definetely make a lot money why cant they hire people to clean it up.How the Health enforcement can let they run the business with that cleanliness.Show less

Author: bmhamzahPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bad service if you are local people
Review: No doubt the nan bread very soft and tandoori chicken is delicious..I just don't like their service..I can see they are more polite to westerners..Plus's this restaurant cleanliness terrible..I don't know how come the enforcement let them running the business with that kind of cleanliness..see it by urself to believe itShow less

Author: Sivrej
Title: Really nice!
Review: Good, very affordable food! Good service. Friendly. You can watch naan bread being made and it's really nice! Really recommend. Make sure you try tandoori chicken.

Author: esquire838
Title: Safe: taste vs price
Review: Its a Mamak joint (Halal Indian Muslim) that specialises in naan bread, tandoori chicken and mango lassi. Popular by the size of the crowd. Mango lassi is a tad expensive for the size (medium mug).

Author: travel_123499Calgary, Canada
Title: Delicious
Review: We ate here a couple of times during our stay in Melaka. Both times, we gorged out on the tandoori chicken and naan. We echo previous reviews that the naans are great and so is the chicken. The restaurant's owner was very helpful in assisting us make our selection of dishes, making recommendations and in instructing his staff about our choice of spici-ness. The service is fast and efficient.We were happy with our first meal and returned for a second.Show less

Author: RabitaJSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Indian Fare
Review: We had such a surprise when the food orders came to our table. Firstly, the place not only serves naan through they are reknown for their large, soft fluffy breads. The curries in general are quite savoury so be prepared to inform them if you prefer a milder dish. We had an early dinner and could barely finish the 3 naans we ordered. The tandoori chicken is a must have when visiting so best to come in a group to enjoy more variety!Show less

Author: jamusteo
Title: Fluffu Naans
Review: Delicious naans and juicy tandoori chicken. Should try their butter chicken which can serve as sauce or you could eat it just like that.

Author: b63
Title: Amazing Naan!
Review: We went for an early dinner and I had cheese naan and tandoori chicken and a large mango lassi. Amazing!! The Naan bread was some of the best I've ever had! Highly recommend this place!

Author: azr_1959
Title: Best tandoori and Naan!
Review: Best tandoori and naan. Must try food when come to Malacca. Come early after open at 6pm. The later will more crowd.

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Very good Naan & tandoori chicken
Review: Place serves very good naan which is large and very soft.The daal ( bean) sauce was thick and tasty with the naan.Tandoori chicken was excellent .It is tender and tasty with the naan.Service was good.Ample car parks.Lots of tables inside and outside restaurant.Operated by Pakistani owner and staff.Show less

Author: Kruiza
Title: Great tandoori chicken and roti
Review: Great tandoori chicken and fantastic roti. Classic suburban restaurant here in malacca. Great to get away from jonkers and the tourists. This is a place the locals eat every day.

Author: AAdrivesingapore
Title: Fluffy naan n yummy side dishes
Review: It’s a 10mins walk from jonker st (ie if u start off from the end of jonker far away from the red house). Else take cab, esp if it’s around 6pm when the setting sun is still blazing.The naan is fluffy n soft, and comes in all flavors. The yummiest I had is the butter naan. The side dishes, the dhal, spinach purée, butter chicken are good too. The tandoori chicken is tasty n tender...can tear with a fork.The drinks are good too. I liked the Teh-Tarik cos it’s not overly sweet and the little tartness of the tea came across nicely.Show less

Author: JohnNg636
Title: So so crowded but worth the wait
Review: Excellent nans, mutton, chicken curry and moist tandori chicken. Although there are lots of tables on the roadside, a part of malaysian mamak culture, one still find a challenge looking for an available table. Worth the wait.

Author: Michael OSunshine Coast, Australia
Title: Superb authentic Indian
Review: We took a Grab to this restaurant for dinner. The setting is mostly rudimentary street dining, but very interesting to watch the cooks making and cooking naan and tandoori chicken in the ceramic barrel ovens. We tried cheese naan, butter chicken, tandoori chicken and mutton Buhna. All was delicious. Be aware no alcohol is available here. The food was excellent and the whole service cost about $22 AUD including soft drinks and rice. Show less

Author: 171traviss
Title: Mouthwatering tandoori, one of the best naans ever
Review: The only reason I can't give five stars is because of the service, which is a bit slow (definitely worth the wait) and saw me have to ask twice for the lassi I ordered. The butter chicken was one of the best I've ever had, as was the naan. Everything is hot, fresh and absolutely packed full of flavor. Show less

Author: 100CharlotteNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Fab curry in lively street restaurant
Review: Wait until a table is vacated and grab it. It will be cleaned as you sit there and there is full waiter service. This is clearly a very popular place to eat and was very busy but our food was great and we didn’t wait long. It was recommended to us by a local man of Indian origin so we thought it would be good and it lived up to expectations. Show less

Author: A7aMAd1B
Title: Superb Foods!
Review: My favourite eating place when we’re going to Malacca. Never miss it. Butter chicken with naan cheese garlic!

Author: Shakey39Stratford-upon-Avon, United Kingdom
Title: A Melaka institution
Review: An incredibly popular Indian restaurant in a quiet area less than 10 minutes walk from Jonker Walk. The curries are good but what brings the crowds are the freshly cooked naans and tandoori chicken. The restaurant has lots of tables outside and uses two large pot ovens for naans and chicken. Portions of chicken are big and the freshly cooked meat is succulent with enough spice in the marinade to bring a bit of heat to the lips. Lassis are also popular. Despite its popularity service is swift.Show less

Author: 437marcelc
Title: Dinner
Review: It was the best tandoori chicken I ever had, so juicy and tender full of flavour. Great combination with the fluffy naans.

Author: JoanneW2532
Title: Tandoor to die for
Review:
Great tandoor street food...tasty , hot, spicy.... quick and efficient service. Busy, lots of street tables but quick turnover- highly recommend!
Melaka is food heaven!

Author: Rudyandles
Title: Must try
Review: Ate here twice whilst staying in Melaka. Only a short walk (maybe 10 minute) from Jonker Street. The tandoori chicken is devine, so juicy and full of flavour. Naan bread is also a must when eating here. I tried for the first time the fresh fish cubes that were coated in the best ever batter that I have ever eaten the fish just melted in my mouth. We left with our stomachs just about bursting.Show less

Author: BJBudimanJaafar
Title: Change owner & change menu
Review: Already change ownership. Now offering pakistani brayani , tandoori etc. No more Malaysian and western cuisine. We are disappointed because we look forward to dine here and try some western and malaysian food with the good rating.

Author: George C
Title: A very cool place to have a pizza and a beer
Review: This restaurant, run by two very friendly Canadians, offer delicious, custom made pizzas at a very affordable place.  We ate indoors, however, they have a beautiful terrace overlooking the river.  Great location and great pizzas!

Author: bereroques
Title: Nice place
Review:
Pleasant staff, nice view, quiet place qnd good service, 
However better to come for a drink than for food

Author: Smvaquino
Title: Dinner
Review: Western food. The food is big serving for 1 person. Cozy, they lack red sauce spaghetti at the time of our visit which my daughter is into... but she’s happy with the noodles and ice cream served to her...

Author: AntonM482Zhuhai, China
Title: Relaxing ambience with good view and service
Review: My friends and i came across the the place by accident while we were looking for a pace to take some pctures of the river boats, being a hot day we decided to have something to drink and because of the good service we decided to stay for the food as well. the prices are reasonable, the selection is good and the food was delicious. It's defenitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: abrogers2001
Title: Disappointing - owner absent
Review: We went here but could not get served because the owner was absent.  Nice outdoor eating area by the river.

Author: tessa2020
Title: Lovely menu and view
Review: We went a couple times as the menu choices were good, reasonably priced and it was lovely to sit by the river. Friendly, helpful staff too.

Author: 265felihSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very nice setting nearby the river, food with varying quality
Review: A couple of tables next to the river in a small garden. It’s beautiful at night.The food is a bit strange: we had a some calamari rings and a fried rice.The calamari were terrible. The worst I’ve ever had : soggy and tasteless. Couldn’t finish.The fried rice was wonderful - a bit Chinese style (not to dry, and clear) with a lot of fresh seafood and a tiny omelette.How does the rest of food stack up between the delicious and disgusting ? Not sure i want to know.Show less

Author: mpmilestogoMerida, Mexico
Title: Very good Nonya Laksa
Review: Really like the location of the cafe. You can eat right next to the river. I will enjoyed the laksa and the mango lassi. I wish they had more on the menu though. It’s a beautiful and quiet spot to eat away from the more crowded tourist areas. Please consider adding more to the menu. Show less

Author: Rinzzy J
Title: Disappointing
Review: This place has extremely limited options on the menu. Mostly beef dishes. Chicken chop size was not at all acceptable(Chicken piece was extremely tiny) against the pricing of it and the coleslaw with it was too runny. The brown sauce with it was ok. We also tried the nasi goreng kampung however sadly it was also another disappointment. It was very bland and tasted more like jus rice fried in egg. I think they should really consider having more chicken dishes options too on their menu and also reconsider the food portion (especially the size of the chicken for chicken chop). Show less

Author: paultH1845XDSurbiton, United Kingdom
Title: Nice setting, limited menu.
Review: This cafe has friendly staff, nice river view like lots of other restaurants. However, the menu is mainly western with few S.E. Asian or local dishes. Some of the local dishes were not even available including the Nasi Lemak chicken curry. The dishes we did order were nice enough but nothing more. Desserts & drinks were average. A bit over priced for what's on offer. Then if you just enjoy the river breeze & a few alcoholic beverages, after a few, you won't care about the limitations.Paul T.Surrey, UK.Show less

Author: amirajefry
Title: HIGHLY recommended 👌
Review: friendly server, best food especially Kampong Fried Rice! i love this cafe! and the river view was wonderful. i had a great time with my friends that day, we were eating while seeing the view, it was the best moment ever 😍

Author: AndrewU_11Perth, Australia
Title: Tasty and inexpensive
Review: We enjoyed sitting by the Melaka river in the evening in the eclectic surrounds of the River View Cafe.To the delight of our children they serve a range of Western food, although I found there local dish selection quite limited.Prices were very reasonable and the food was very nice.Show less

Author: nazranay2014
Title: Good environment, good good
Review: Good environment, nice artwork inside and seating by the river outside. Dessert was unavailable even though present on the menu. Recommend the mango lassi.

Author: EnochmingoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice homestay with river view, cafe downstairs
Review: The cafe is located at the downstairs of the shoplot but there is homestay located upstairs of it. It provided the customers with river view that can amazed the customers. The homestay is pretty old but still good to have a stay for travelers. It is near to the main jonker street and convenient for travelers.Show less

Author: Debaprasad B
Title: Seat with drink and enjoy an evening!!!
Review: While my stay at Melaka came here for a drink and early dinner. It was wonderful to seat and enjoy the boats passing by and of course the view was so nice. Food was good too.

Author: macksterz
Title: Nice view over the river
Review:
Good food and wines. Service perfect. Location next to the river so you see the turing boats pass by.

We also had a drink here on another OCCASION

Author: nabila a
Title: cafe with a beautiful view
Review: its a beautiful place to dine. i tried buffet here, it was good. location, interior and management was good and should be experienced while staying in melaka.

Author: 68Seng
Title: Evening meet up with friends
Review: Friend family came pit stop in Melaka at Sunday evening from south before heading back to KL. Decided to meet up at riverside area so that they can enjoy the night scenic view of Malaka river, as well having our dinner. I choose River View Cafe base on some good postings in FB from friends who have been there. They served local, western foods and desserts. Nasi lemak chicken curry was tasty, the kids enjoy the ice cream cake. The river view was great with river cruise passing through and flow, but the condition was a bit humid and hot with little winds or breeze if you choose to sit on the open space riverbank area. Overall we enjoy our meet up there with a nice Melaka night river view. Show less

Author: 609shanem
Title: Nice food peaceful meal
Review: Really good lunch menu available. We had the beef rendang which was so nice and also tuna sandwich which was great. Service was quick and professional. Nice peaceful setting beside the river! Good prices on coffees juices and smoothies as well - coffees were 8RM and the juices and smoothies started from 7.50RM. Show less

Author: chloesworld_7
Title: Coffee by the river
Review: Walking along the river we see a little place open with some seats by the river and under a little shade - perfect!  We stopped for an iced coffee and it was a very pleasant stop with the beautiful setting. Prices were very reasonable.

Author: teachtravel2019Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Lovely lunch by the river
Review: We came here based on the reviews on here and can say we were absolutely delighted with our food and the service. My husband had the nasi lemak beef rendang and I had the nasi lemak chicken curry. Our boys had chicken nuggets and fries. All our food was delicious particularly the beef rendang. My husband says it was the best meal he'd had in Malaysia! This restaurant is in such a lovely location on the river side yet prices are reasonable and there's a good choice of meals. It was quite cool inside the restaurant too with some interesting pictures and artefacts. Their sister restaurant, Wild Coriander, also looked lovely but we choose River view for the western options for our kids. Would highly recommend this restaurant. The guy serving us was friendly and gave great service. Hope we come back to Malacca one day and eat there again. Thank you! Show less

Author: KendirgiQuebec City, Canada
Title: Good food, good service, beautiful terrace!!!
Review: The menu isn't that exhaustive but what we took was very tastful. There's a good choices of western breakfasts available all day. We had rendang and kampong and were both happy with our choices. The restaurant also have a good selection of desserts, probably not made there but very satisfactory when your are craving for chocolate. We had the chance to get a table outside, by the river. The service was VERY attentive. They dont' take credit card but since it was our last meal in Malaysia, I did want to withdraw any money. So instead of letting us go, they offered to accompany us at their other property so we could pay by card. What a nice gesture and what a nice way to end our trip in this beautiful country!!!!Show less

Author: Judyfosse
Title: Relaxing setting for dinner
Review: Had dinner on the river.  Lovely quiet setting, watching the passing tour boats. Menu has both local and western food options. We chose the beef rendang and fried rice. Great service, cold beer, excellent mango lassi. Reasonable prices.

Author: Nina_Most
Title: Relaxing
Review: Very nice place to relax. We have done exactly that. In early evening is so nice. On this occasion we have had a drink only. Service was quick.

Author: AChen88
Title: Nice Place to Relax with Malacca River view
Review: Nice place to sit & relax with panoramic Malacca river view , they serving buffet menu dinner as well as live music during weekend

Author: AqilAdamNg
Title: Nice view, but average food
Review: Food was a-ok and moderate. Nothing special other than just the location over-seeing the Melaka river. Food prices are not that worthwhile

Author: Ulf H
Title: Faantastic restaurant at the riverside.
Review: We ordered different Malaysian dishes and was served fantastic food in fantastic environment! Excellent food with very good service.

Author: Jack FBandung, Indonesia
Title: Enjoying the Meal while Looking at the Beauty of the Melaka River
Review: Here is one of the places of interest when you are in the vicinity of Melaka River, you can enjoy the dishes available with a view of the beauty of the Melaka River. In the state of the night, this place is good enough to enjoy, especially while seeing Melaka Cruise passing in some time beside this place.Show less

Author: Steviekerr88Newmarket, United Kingdom
Title: Nice lunch spot by river.
Review: Service was very friendly. We started off with a freshly squeezed pineapple juice which was very fresh. The club sandwich was tasty but not overwhelming and I would also say the same for the chicken curry, although we ordered that with a nasi lemak which was delicious especially with pickled vegetables. Only a couple of tables by the river so you have to time it right. Show less

Author: MrDavetheSarks
Title: Awesome Place for Lunch
Review: Small out of the way cafe with a nice menu and some great views of the canal. Staff really friendly, and place is very relaxing. Prices not bad either, but the atmosphere is magical.

Author: GoyoRicoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over-rated; at best a 3 star
