Review: Clearly the shop/hostel does an excellent job managing their trip advisor rating Certainly an adequate shop, but I read beef rendang from several reviews and was disappointed to arrive on Saturday lunch and menu was reduced to only chicken curryThe service was great, very attentive staff.It’s a coffee shop with 10 tables; hardly a top rated restaurant Show less

Author: lauracT8379HR
Title: Friendly staff
Review: What stood out at the river cafe was the extreme friendly staff! We enjoyed the atmosphere at the river and has a nice dinner.

Author: Alice SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Serene Location with Fantastic River View
Review: Was there for an early lunch. Ordered Beef Rendang Nasi Lemak and Mango Lassie. The Nasi Lemak was O.K. but the Cafe could have been a bit more generous with their Ikan Bilis and Peanuts. The Rendang gravy was good, cooked just right - not too sweet, not too salty. But I was quite disappointed with the Beef - too much fats! I spent some time cutting away those oily, fatty and unhealthy stuff from almost every piece of the Beef I had. Otherwise, I would have had a very satisfied lunch, as the Beef was very tender. The Mango Lassie was indeed very good, thanks to the reviews of Trip Advisor's members. Service was a bit slow even though there were not very many customers at that time.Show less

Author: bat-and
Title: Nice food by the river
Review: Nice food and good service. We had dinner at 9.30 pm with no many people around, very quite atmosphere. I recommend this place!

Author: ERDFirefighterEdmonton, Canada
Title: Nice quiet location
Review: We came upon the Riverview while walking along the river. Sat down for a beer and enjoyed the quietness of the location. We returned here two more times once for breakfast and once for dinner. Both meals were very good. Dinner we had 2 meals 4 beer and a dessert and the bill was 80 ringgit.Show less

Author: Tzahilevi
Title: Funtastic
Review:
Very good place. Food delicius.
Quit place by the river.
Few minutes walk from main places.
Amazing amazing food. And the prices are very chep

Author: 2steljo
Title: Great view
Review: A lovely cafe with great spot to sit and enjoy the river at the back. Nice food and friendly helpful staff.

Author: szeweieng
Title: Great lunch spot along Melaka river
Review: We went there for cozy lunch time. We sit behind restaurant just to view the river. Main course is nice. Price is reasonable. Service is quick. Waiters and waitresses very friendly. Overall, we will surely come back for another time.

Author: gracep1572
Title: Normal cafe
Review:
Normal for me n my friend...
Nice environment
Nothing special 
Staff friendly 
Price medium
Food average 
Limited selection of food

Author: koopookyStockport, United Kingdom
Title: Impressed!
Review: My husband had Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang and I had Nasi Lemak with Chicken Curry, both were excellent! We also took a walk and later came back for dessert. The husband commented,"Best Beef Rendang so far hands down." Sitting next to the river sipping my watermelon juice woth great food was sublime, very peaceful and romantic. You see the boat cruises going past with minimal noise, general joggers and few people walking past. The prices are very reasonable compared to the main restaurants on the "strip."The server was friendly and fantastic. Hope to come back again! Show less

Author: KJxRoRo
Title: Romantic Dinner
Review: Great ambience. Very quiet and great view along side a river. Had chicken chop and it was delicious, chicken was crispy. Free dessert for me as well as it was my birthday 😀

Author: Ydad
Title: Low key restaurant in a pleasant setting
Review: We had a nice dinner in this pleasant restaurant along the river. It’s a lot of fun watching the little tourist boats float by as well as bikers and joggers while eating a kampung fried rice.

Author: sunny c
Title: Leisure
Review:
The restaurant ambient is nice ,leisure,relaxing .
Lay out of restaurant comfortable.

The foood is nice.back lane view is melacca river ,got boat and flowers and plant .

It s romantic .
Thumbs up .

Author: Bliz1221
Title: Fantastic food and affordable pricing, friendly and excellent service
Review: Food wise is cheap and tasty, generous portion as well and serving time is relatively short. Come early and sit beside melaka river ( rear of the restaurant )

Author: tomkateSouth Australia
Title: Favourite Malaysian meal
Review: We visited Melaka for a day trip and because of the positive reviews on Tripadvisor we had lunch here. Very quaint restaurant on the river. Excellent service. We were eating with someone who was actually from Malaysia so perhaps Geoff ordered the best food from the menu for us. Meal was so memorable. Loved it. Eating here made my trip to Melaka so special. Geoff said too he will recommend this restaurant to others as he hadn't know about it previously.Show less

Author: charlietectorNewent, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely, romantic meal
Review: My partner and I visited on a Monday night and it was lovely and quiet. There was a wide range of food including fusion, Malaysian and western options! The pulled pork burger and chicken curry with nasi goreng was a particular highlight! Another thing to mention was the brilliant service, the lady was attentive, happy and went out of her way to help us.Lovely place to eat!Show less

Author: pttanpt
Title: Lousy food & Poor service
Review: Five of us went to this café for lunch on 19/8. 4 of us ordered the Kampung Fried Rice & 1 ordered "Nasi Lemak with Curry Chicken" set.The Fried rice was so salty that we cannot even eat it ! The curry chicken not only hard but the taste is the worse that I had so far.At first, I told the waiter (foreign worker) that the fried rice were too salty but he ignored us. After that I told the Chinese lady (looks like the leader) about how salty the fried rice, but she also ignored me & walked away. At last I saw the guy whom looked like the boss of the café & told him about how salty of their food & the taste of the chicken. I even asked him to try it himself, but he pretend that he is busy & just walked away without even border to find out what's wrong with their food.We realized that it's meaningless to talk further & we decided just to pay & walk out from the café.Even it's free meal, we will not go back to this café again. What kind of lousy food & bad service it is. It's not fit to operate such café in this kind of tourist area.Show less

Author: Thomboy
Title: Excellent view and decent food
Review: We had nice diner here in Saturday night. The food was decent and the smoothie was nice. The river view is an asset to visit here. The staff was very friendly too.

Author: Peter HGrantham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, great service.
Review: For great quality food and fast friendly service you must try this riverside cafe when visiting Melaka.Sitting by the river it is a lovely setting to enjoy some excellent food. We chose to eat there after reading other reviews and we were very impressed. A big thank you to Lucas who was really friendly and welcoming. 10/10Show less

Author: HemaVik
Title: Relaxation with the awesome view
Review: This is my 2nd visit to this cafe... I really enjoy coming here for the view. It's so relaxing. The food is another plus point. Surely will come back here again...😍

Author: danjorT
Title: Lovely place for a quick bite or a full meal.
Review:
We had breakfast here a few times, once outside on thier river view seating and once inside. the staff and very friendly and helpful.

The food its self is well cooked and presented.  and they have great deserts!

Author: TheHairyTraveller1Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great food and great staff, right on the river.
Review: We've eaten here twice now and both times we've really enjoyed our meals. It's right on the river and first thing in the morning, it's great to sit on the river as the sun brightens everything. It has a very homely vibe. We'd definitely recommend it. :)Show less

Author: nichallett
Title: Lots of choice and a great location
Review: A great option if you want to find somewhere quieter and away from the busier areas. The pulled pork burger, beef rendang and Nasi Kemal were all very good with their own individual take on the Malay classics.

Author: Elle1nadHereford, United Kingdom
Title: Really good food with a lovely canal view
Review: Visiting the river view cafe at night time is a lovely little spot. The lights from the cafe reflect on the water which makes this place a really special spot for dinner. I was apprehensive about sitting outside as the rivers in Malaysia often smell like a public toilet but I'm pleased to report that our dining experience was bad smell free. My boyfriend and I between us had the mushroom soup which was really tasty. The herbed toast accompaniment was basically garlic bread and is so tasty!We then had the beef rendang curry and the spaghetti with meat sauce. The food was good and filling and the restaurant had a nice atmosphere. Recommended. Show less

Author: seastream2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful sights, but food was just ok
Review: We had the beer bucket which was reasonably priced. Food was ok, but nothing special and the waitress was quite funny.They also have tables inside with kinda hipster decor - however we liked the place and especially their view should not be missed, but enjoyed if possible (small restaurant so not too many seats outside).Show less

Author: Carson L
Title: Cill out
Review: The river view cafe melaka is best place to hang out outside back of the place very quite and very nice the sever is the best the food was great and the guava pie is good and the food was feabulas nice

Author: LeanneS1253Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great little cafe!
Review: My husband, daughter and I had a short stay in Melaka over the Easter break. Our friends recommend this little spot, and we loved it. Great view, great food and the staff were very friendly. Our 2.5year old loved waving to the boats cruising by. We will definitely go back again. Show less

Author: M V
Title: Ok
Review: Small restaurant with small menu.  Food is pretty good at very reasonable prices.  For those on a tight budget more then anyone else.

Author: calg93London, United Kingdom
Title: Best pancake I have had in SE Asia
Review: Banana pancake for 7.5r with a coffee or tea and fruit! was awesome best pancake Iv had in SE Asia hands down and I have been away for 8 months. Lots of other breakfast sets for cheap aswell girlfriend had scramble egg and bacon with roast salad and fruit with a tea for 12.50r. Nice on the river view .. anyway back to eating my pancake.Show less

Author: PatchTheCatchGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food with a nice view
Review: A nice little joint on the river. I decided to get some food as the sun was setting and as the reds and purples fade from the skies the lights alongside the river shimmer across it. Very pleasant food, very reasonably priced and nice staff.Definitely recommend it for a relaxing, quiet evening meal.Show less

Author: karengZ9134ADAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Charming, friendly cafe in a great setting.
Review: We stumbled upon this place quite by chance and enjoyed a peaceful, relaxing lunch overlooking the river. The food was very good, chicken curry, rendang curry and mushroom soup, and we were very tempted by the desserts and the drinks. May have to come again to try some of them. Friendly and efficient staff and a location away from the bustle of the busier streets of Melaka ensured we had a very enjoyable meal.Show less

Author: 647merlina
Title: Great staffs with good and reasonable food
Review: This restaurant serves good and reasonable food and tops it with great and attentive service. Really great promotion when every dessert cost you RM3.90 only with every main meal ordered. Desserts are good too. No GST nor service charge.

Author: AthieDevPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Must try.
Review: It's located by the riverside and the view is superb for dinner. Food is good and very cheap. No tax or svc charge. The desert was half price for each main course. Watch out for the mosquitoes especially in the evening. Staffs are friendly and helpful. Will go again.Show less

Author: Ambassador497190
Title: Nice food .Next time come again...staff very friendly )))
Review: Very good here...we come here again))nice food...staff very friendly ...inside cafe look interesting can see

Author: Pagan B
Title: Delightful!
Review: This place is literally located on the riverside and you can eat and drink along it or inside as you please. It's a small cute cafe with the most delicious food!! It was right next door to our hostel and we went as the price was super cheap and we're pleasantly surprised and ended going back 2 or 3 times to eat here! The food is mainly Malaysian with some western choices. There's a breakfast and dessert menu too! The food here is soooo tasty and everything you could want. It's by far the best thing I've eaten in my whole time in Malaysia!! The staff are super friendly and make the cafe super welcoming. The cafe is always busy so if your in town I'd definitely be making a visit!Show less

Author: Me JSingapore, Singapore
Title: peaceful
Review: We had to giggle when the waiter said "oh, sorry, we don't have that", because that's what I remember another reviewer writing about this place - that many things on the menu are not available. So we ended up simply having a tea along the river (outside), which was calm and very relaxing as part of our stroll along the river. Happy that a quiet place to have something to drink exists - but not worth more than 3-4 stars.Show less

Author: Ross WBerwick upon Tweed, United Kingdom
Title: Nice riverside restaurant
Review: Found this riverside restaurant and had a very nice chicken curry, service friendly and very good, the waiter was from India and had very good English. We had to make do with Carlsberg beer as they did not sell Kingfisher. I finished off with Creme Brulee which was fantastic.This restaurant is NOT open on Tuesdays, go and try.Show less

Author: Kay BSt Sampsons, United Kingdom
Title: Relaxing riverside restaurant
Review: We found this restaurant along the river walk and enjoyed a couple of beers before our dinner. My husband had pasta arrabiata which was vegetarian. I had a Malaysian rice dish (sorry I can't remember its name). The member of staff who served us was polite and friendly and spoke good English. The food was very good. It is a lovely place to relax and watch the world go by. We noticed that the restaurant was not open on Tuesday or Wednesday.Show less

Author: RaJSheffieldSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Not what we expected.....
Review: Our experience at this restarant was definitely interesting and one that makes us smile. The food available was limited, despite what the menu said and the waiter / owner said he could not recommend the snacks (as they were bought in) but highly recommended the mushroom soup and pumpkin soup. In fact, searching through you will find that most reviewers also seem to have had the soup!!!The main courses was served within minutes of ordering, which questions how freshly cooked they really were. The really amusing part was the waiter / owner strutting around the table watching us while we ate. All in all, a very amusing evening but not one to be repeated.Show less

Author: eetsie
Title: Very nice Place to eat and drink
Review: Really nice food (housemade chickenrice) and one of the best Mango Lassi (also selfmade) I have ever tasted!

Author: HemaVikPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best place to relax...!
Review: I wanted to visit this cafe on my previous visit to melaka but couldn't make. But this time manage to find it. Awesome! Great place to have your meal and relax... Customer service is Superb! Thumbs up! Reasonable price. The cafe is beside the river... I had a great time here with my husband. Surely will visit again..! Show less

Author: travelholicj70Singapore, Singapore
Title: chill by the river with excellent service
Review: really nice to eat and chill by the river. however, outdoor seats are very limited. you either have to go early, or go slightly later. food is very affordable, though taste is normal. had the curry chicken rice but it only comes with one piece of chicken. suggest that they allow customers to have add-ons by topping up a certain amount. choice of alcohol is not a lot also (if I remember correctly, there are only 4 or 5 choices of beer). service is excellent! overall a great and affordable river side cafe to come!Show less

Author: mrchase2
Title: Relax by the river!
Review: Relaxing meal and drinks on the Melaka River. If you're lucky, you can sit outside on the boardwalk. Beer and food and coffee are available. Will return!

Author: Peter LWigan, United Kingdom
Title: Good location by the river.
Review: This was an excellent restaurant with the one significant fault of having a very limited choice of Malay dishes. Prices similar to central Chinatown but with the advantage of a great location by the river. This is not at all obvious from the street entrance, which may explain why it is not busier. In a trendier location, people would be queueing out of the door for riverside dining like this. If still peckish after dinner, the cafe does some rather nice desserts in good portions. Very pleasant staff (proprietors maybe?)Show less

Author: Road20yearsQuebec, Canada
Title: Need to relax?
Review: Go sit by the river, quiet and pleasant away from all other restaurants sitting on the sidewalk. I wasn't looking for high cuisine, so I was satisfied. Nice and simple little menu with a few choice of veggie plates and some nice cheese cake. All at a reasonable price. It's an InvitationShow less

Author: jlei60Byron Bay, Australia
Title: Great cafe in a great location
Review: This is a great little cafe in a great location away from the crowds. We sat out side by the river. The food is delicious and the staff are really friendly. Their mango lassi is a must try and also their brownies. All the food we ate there was really tasty and reasonably priced. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: cproffitt
Title: Hardly any food choices left
Review: We had the chicken curry and a salad, but only because our first two choices weren't available (and they didn't tell us about the second one until ten minutes after we ordered). Inexpensive, though and staff were friendly.

Author: 736sapnak
Title: Lunch by the riverside
Review:
A refreshing place to b in the heat 
Fresh Yummy food at the same time reasonable rates 
Beautiful seating arrangement inside as well as outside by the river 
A must visit place 
I'm going there again fr sure

Author: graphi
Title: A perfect hideaway
Review: I liked this cafe mainly because it is located by the river, away from the busy streets and the crowds. You can have a nice dinner here (both Western and local), watch the river, and enjoy the silence!

Author: marcellor613
Title: Nice quite place and great food
Review: You will love this place trust me. Great cuisine affordable price and quite river side seating. You may need to look further from the road side but easier to find from the river side

Author: Gerard W
Title: Small good quality restaurant
Review:
Little terrace at the water was no option due to the heavy rain.
Inside there are a few tables with a really nice atmosphere. Service was friendly and speedy. Food served was delisious, including asian and western dishes.

Author: thzoe
Title: Foods and environment just so so...
Review:
To our family trip, the foods are just so so. 
Environment is under our expectation. Nothing is special about this restaurant.

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Mosquito place and low quality food
Review: The localization is nice...near the river but is infected by mosquito. The menu is a mix about asean and western but the quality is very low. We order spagguetti thats come cold and dry...the frozen spring rolls very bad and other dishes that better no remember.The menu card is horrible in design and full in fat and oil. Forks and spoon need clean well.The best think is the staff but no enought for have a good experience thereShow less

Author: sundancaaustralia
Title: PERFECT BY THE RIVER
Review: A nice quiet place to enjoy a cold beer and good and good food and we use this Riverside restaraunt to have good Breakfast and Dinner as its always good and fresh and nothing better than sitting by the river with a cold beer or shake and found this place to be an excellent place to chill out with the best staff of Carson & Raymond & Alice the cook to serve you ---so what more can you want Good Food Cold Beer and Staff that care if your happy and attend to you in such a way that you love going back there as we do Big thumbs up and thanks for makeing my days in Malaka special Ken & RoseShow less

Author: Snizkate
Title: Amazing
Review: Food was delicious, location is perfect, staff was very polite and  after the dinner (before paying) we got a Creme brulée for free. I definitely recommend!

Author: Jaume C
Title: Delicious!
Review: The place is really nice, we loved their decorations. During our stay in Melaka we went there many times. The sets for breakfast are cheap and really good. We enjoyed so much everything we tried, especially we loved their nasi lemak with beef and the nasi kampung! They have also amazing desserts, we had once the ice cream cake and the brownie, both really really yummy! For dinner you can also sit at the tables at the backside of the restaurant, nearby the river :) Beside the great food, the service was great too, so that we can totaly recommend this place!Show less

Author: danta83Sepang, Malaysia
Title: Peaceful Lunch
Review: Stopped off here on our walk of Jonker Street and surrounding area. I would recommend getting one of the tables out the back on the river as views are great. Service is excellent and food is okay, small choice of local and European dishes. The beer is chilled to perfection.Show less

Author: May_MalekVancouver, Canada
Title: Great staffs and good food
Review: We went there twice and we loved most of their dishes. It's well situated so you can enjoy the view while dining there. It might be a bit pricey comparing to other places, but the convenience and kindness of people working there made us go again.Show less

Author: mized
Title: Late couple dinner
Review: We ate dinner a late evening. The food was good, and the view on the river and the lit walkway on the other side made the view pretty. A nice experience.

Author: peteandchris46Hartlepool
Title: Fantastic food and people
Review: Great place to eat, meet people and pass the time. The food is delicious and fresh, great place to enjoy a meal outside by the river. The staff are incredibly friendly and always have time for a chat, a special mention must be made for Mani, Raymond, Carson and Alice. Thanks again guys for another great time, we will see you all again soon for more Guava Pie.Show less

Author: Spjuth
Title: Authentic food in simple and calm setting by the river
Review: A Saturday evening we sat down for a nice, authentic meal in this cozy, calm riverside restaurant. A bucket of beers quickly disappears and the delicious food too!Very flexible staff that made sure new tables were place out on the river side when new guests arrived.Show less

Author: Cruiser646736
Title: Really good restaurant with a nice river view
Review: The food was tasty, big quantity and quality, and quite cheap! We also appreciated the service! If you're in Malacca don't miss it!

Author: RoadtripWardAlmere, The Netherlands
Title: Food is great. People are great. Service is great.
Review: Food is really good for an excellent price. As in all other cafés, the Western food is a little more expensive (but you don't go to Melaka to eat Western food right?). Local food is great as well.We've had breakfast and dinner there, both very good and very nice people.Show less

Author: NIs888Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Friendly reception and nice internal design
Review: The internal design with lots of old stuff which used by our grand grand parents make us to recall some childhood memories.Comment on the foods, my personally think that it's just normal as others cafe, nothing special.This cafe facing to the river, you can having your meal with the river view, there are no air-con seats and air-con seats you can choose your own.This cafe near to the Jonker Street, Christ church and those small museum.You can take a cab to reach there with reasonable price.Show less

Author: SC1010101Newton Abbot, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Cafe
Review: Be prepared to be greeted in your own language and to have a good yarn for at least an hour. The guys in this cafe are awesome, very friendly and full of great advice!The best beef rendang I have had in a long time can be found here at a very good price. The beer is cold, the tea is good. What more could you ask for!Seating is available on the river and has shade for the hottest part of the day!Show less

Author: 581CatherineMBarcelona, Catalonia, Spain
Title: Great food and friendly service right by the river
Review: At first look of the menu, it looks like a typical tourist restaurant, spaghetti bolognaise and omelettes. However, on enquiry the waiter listed a series of local dishes which did not appear on the menu. I had the beef Rendang with rice, pickle and sambal sauce. It was delicious, soft and tender beef which just fell apart, in a rich sauce full of spices. I had a mango lassi to finish which was creamy and fruity. The terrace out the back is right on the river and very quiet. I watched the tourist boat cruises go past and otters playing in the water. Very tranquil. Show less

Author: rudilaxmi
Title: family trip
Review: Spent a great family evening here while visiting Melaka. There was something for everyone on the menu from children to Grandparents. A lovely atmosphere sitting by the river and good service.

Author: SareD3
Title: Breakfast & lunch
Review: We had great breakfast and lunch dishes for a fair price. The banana pancakes and the typical nasi are recommended. Also a very friendly waiter!

Author: Kdog0110Bridge, United Kingdom
Title: delightful location and superb food
Review: Came for lunch here. Arrived just before 1300 and got the only table outside in the shade overlooking the river. A lovely peaceful spot. The waiters were so welcoming and immediately set up a fan to keep my wife cool. I had the Nasi Lamak with Beef Rendang. It was superb – especially the beef – really tender in a thick sauce with just the right level of spice. My wife had the chicken curry and rice which was creamy and mild. I was wary of the lassi as I thought it would be a little salty but I ordered the mango one and could not have chosen better – like a superb fresh fruit smoothie made with yogurt made on the premises.The whole meal and drinks cost less than £8 in total. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: SurinBalwinderjit
Title: Lovely and Quaint
Review: Our second visit here....nice little restaurant. Outdoor seating by the river is the best. Food is western with a small menu of local food. But ambience is 1st class and service is world class. Food is good too.

Author: LeoKuo
Title: Dinner here
Review: We had dinner here, because there is no store after 7 o'clock! I try pork chop which is delicious! The service is ok. It's good to try here!

Author: Worth W
Title: Name sums it up
Review: I had a very pleasant light evening meal here - pizza and a couple of Carlsberg draft beers, which is pretty much the standard weak lager for Malaysia. Pizza was nothing special and the service was slow, but it was still a great place to chill and hang out and enjoy the view without a lot of hustle and bustle.Show less

Author: willyfoxelviajero
Title: Just ok, nothing special
Review: As said in other reviews, nothing special. Saw the menu and did not find many choices, less for kids. Finally only a drink at the terrace near the river. Nice view.

Author: NgSP80Melaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: lunch here
Review: having lunch here.the choices maybe not much, but the taste still ok so far.for local the price maybe a bit higher.atmosphere is good with selection of dining area of open air and aircon.at night there will be open area facing the river also, nice view from there.can have a try if got extra time when visiting melakaShow less

Author: MaudWelAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Not clear why this scores so high?
Review: We followed Tripadvisor on our first night in Melaka. Highest ranked place open for dinner around 8pm. Yes, the staff was friendly, but very chaotic. Still always with a smile. Yes, the food is cheap and comes quickly, but there is not much choice and I really have had better nasi lemak, beef curry and pork chops (very greasy). If you decide to go, sit outside, by the river. Nice romantic view. But overall I am pretty sure there must be much better and still value for money restaurants in Melaka. I would look further!Show less

Author: Fuwa C
Title: Friendly service
Review: Went there on rainy day so outdoor seat (river view) are not available. Friendly staff, fast food serving, clean environment and affordable price. Payment in CASH only. Nothing special with the food menu. Asian+Western food.

Author: ew815Darlington, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely food for family meal
Review: We booked based on trip advisor and were not disappointed. We were 3 generations of one family with varied tastes. The menu is not huge but there was something perfect for everyone. My mother in law loved the pork, the chicken curry and beef rendang were fabulous. And my kids loved the calamari and fried rice. The mango lassi was also a huge hit. There was beer on offer but note if you fancy a glass of wine you need to bring your own and pay corkage. Would definitely eat there again. We sat outside and watched the river boats. It is only 5-10 min walk back to the bustle along the river which in itself was a lovely post dinner activity. Show less

Author: 519H
Title: Great friendly service
Review: Had a lovely meal. Excellent service and good value. Setting by the river hard to beat. The cafe was very quiet when we arrived about 7pm but it became busy by the time left about 9.

Author: jurjenv2014
Title: Very nice location, great beef rendang!
Review: Very nice location on quiet part of the river bank.  Very friendly owner worth a nice menu, a combination of local food and western food.  We can recommend the beef rendang, pulled pork burger and the mango lassie!

Author: lardy73
Title: Great Little Find!
Review: Carson is a very entertaining host, food is fantastic, something for everyone. Spaghetti bolognaise great, kampong delicious and springrolls good too. I would recommend this place for all!

Author: Marissa P
Title: Friendly Service, Delicious Food
Review: Warm greetings and smiling faces met us as we opened the door to River View. The workers were extremely accommodating and easy to communicate with, which is always a plus for a deaf couple. My partner and I shared the Nasi Lemak Beef Rendang which was flavorful, tender, and accompanied with rice, fried anchovies, pickles, peanuts, cucumbers, and chili paste. We also had the pumpkin soup which came with herb toast, very good as well. The Mango lassi was a perfect dessert for us to share and the free ice cream was warmly offered to us by our awesome server. We highly recommend this restaurant to anyone wanting to check out an affordable and pleasant taste of Melaka! Show less

Author: georger412
Title: Riverside restaurant
Review: In Melacca for a couple of nights and picked this restaurant based on other reviews. As mentioned not much to look at from the outside but tables out the back beside the river are very pleasant. The menu is basic but the food is very tasty. Service was fantastic with Carson the perfect host - he should be on stage!!! Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: Explore449844
Title: Great food, fun atmosphere .
Review: We ate the local specialities, beef rendang and chicken with rice. Host was great. Very friendly. Sat inside as hot outside and mosquitoes about. Situated right next to river as name implies.

Author: redmarv2017Nijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: Nice terras, Good food, prices & staff
Review: Had some beers, order a pumpkinsoup which was good flavoured and had a local dish (fried Rice, papadum and shrimps) which was really good! Prices where really good! Quality/price more then recommend this place! And some Nice enthousiastic staff working here!And your seeted @ the Riverside quiet and easyShow less

Author: HappyCowBelleMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A traveler feel reastaurant
Review: The restaurant is suitable for all ages. Western, also offers Malay, Chinese and so on. Food taste good, the price is reasonable. Waiter attitude amiable. The most important is a beautiful environment, you can dine in the evening beside the river. Toilet hygiene also manage very well. A restaurant worth considering.Show less

Author: AnthSydneySydney, Australia
Title: Lovely setting, really nice staff
Review: We went for a Saturday evening meal and chose to sit outside given the pleasant setting on a quiet part of the river. Small menu of local and western food options. We chose the beef rendang nasi lemak and the chicken curry nasi lemak. Both were tasty, excellently spiced and spicy, with good quality meat. All staff were charming. Well worth a visit. Show less

Author: Katie-ElizabethMBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, service and views
Review: Having stayed for 3 nights in Malaka we have visited this place for 2 of the 3 evening meals. The food is great my favourite being the Chocolate walnut brownie!! A must! Service is personal and friendly and the beautiful views by the river are a must at sunset.Show less

Author: GeoffD395Warsaw, Poland
Title: Great food, but too hot to eat outside
Review: We have been trying to go here for ages and finally got here for Sunday brunch. It was too hot to eat by the river (and with small kids a bit dangerous) so we ate inside. The food was excellent and very well priced. Will go back again.Show less

Author: louisiannegrace
Title: Good food, relaxing ambiance
Review: Nice ambiance, good food and the staff is friendly. I would love to come back again next time to try other dishes.

Author: stoko42Taunggyi, Myanmar
Title: Great food, attentive staff
Review: This is a great little cafe hidden away by the river. Due to rain the outside seating by the river was closed. Even though the cafe itself doesn't very special it is worth staying for the food. The staff are super friendly and attentive they serve great pork meatballs with mash potato and my wife had a very interesting slow cooked pork belly stew. And the ice cream mud pie desert was delectable. Definitley worth a visit if you are in Malaka. As a bonus they also play funky 1950's tunesShow less

Author: TheresaSeow
Title: Good place for couples
Review:
Great service and ambience. Will go back there when we visit Melaka again. Food is above average. Will recommend couples to try this place.

Would recommend the restaurant to put some fan outside during hot season.

Author: Michelle C
Title: OUTSTANDING SERVICE
Review: I've lived in KL for 6 months and this is the first taste I've had at true customer service. Not only is the location great, a beautiful cafe, amazing food, but the people working here really take pride in their work and it shows. The owner was fantastic and even ran us all around town to help us pick a hostel. Amazing. My only complaint is that I wish I could have gone back on Tuesday but they are not open. :(Show less

Author: Lester125
Title: Deliciously affordable great food
Review: Just go and hunt for this place, I would prefer it for myself but I want it to stay open till my next visit ehehehe, great food and unbelievable prices. You ll be amaze

Author: U556DLjessicabLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely location, great service and inexpensive food
Review: We came here for breakfast and sat inside with the air con. The staff are extremely friendly and will give recommendations. I had a breakfast set which was more than enough food for a great price including a coffee and fresh watermelon. My friend got the beef rendang and a big serving too. She also got the mango lassi and it was amazing. Highly recommend if you like lassi, cheap food with local and western options and for a riverside view.Show less

Author: Lenneke W
Title: Great!
Review: Really nice place, go sit at the back, next to the river, it's great! Good food, okay cappuccino and really friendly people. You should go here!

Author: FlaevrinMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Romantic dinner by the river!
Review: Had a wonderful dinner here. Don't be put off by the view from the street. You have to go through the cafe to the tables along the river bank. Opt to sit outside for a more romantic feel. The moment we were seated, we were impressed by the friendly service, romantic ambience and beautiful view by the river. The setting is pretty, especially at night with lights reflected on the water. The food was simple (but flavorful!) and not expensive. They had western and local dishes and a variety of desserts. Personal recommendation is the chicken chop (with brown sauce) and mango lassi. Fried squid was delicious. If you are looking for something local, go for the nasi lemak. Service was excellent with friendly waiters. Definitely would come again.Show less

Author: DutchCariocaRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Service with a smile, but food mediocre
Review: Actually surprised that this restaurant is rated so high. It is actually very simple. Food is 'home made' and indeed not restaurant quality. For what you pay (very cheap) you cannot expect too much. Rendang beef quality was done with low quality meat. Service is worth praising though, as is 5 cold beer in an ice bucket for MYR 40. I probably would not have made the detour to get and dine here if it wasn't for TA. I think you should look for nicer places. Show less

Author: Snowie05
Title: Hot Mid afternoon hideout
Review:
Only order few drinks (two ice lemon tea & a 5-greens juice) but the staffs are still friendly and serve us patiently. 

I believed night time river view will be very wonderful.

Author: madonnajonesSydney, Australia
Title: Went for dinner didn't stay
Review: The beers may be cold and not expensive but there is nothing authentic about this place. Sitting on the smelly waterway eating spring rolls filled with cabbage doesn't rate number 5 in Malaka for me. The fact that the young men asked that we do a review speaks volumes. All home made I'm told but really people I expect better when I come to experience a culture and its cuisine. Show less

Author: Kelvin K
Title: Great little restaurant
Review: Nice friendly staff with a good menu at reasonable prices. Various seating areas inside and out. Local people here as well as tourists which is a good sign.

Author: benpF3675WA
Title: Terrific service and food
Review: Luckily settled for a dump of a hostel in Chinatown so I came across this place. I recommend the pumpkin soup, kampong fried rice, nasi lemak w beef rendang. All good. They have a nice outdoor area riverside but I stayed inside for air-conditioning and internet (hit and miss). You won't regret dining here.Show less

Author: Ceara3
Title: Perfect
Review: Delicious food, awesome location, good prices, friendly and attentive staff. Cannot fault! Even if there are no more tables left outside the staff will quickly put more out to accommodate you!

Author: LondonFoodLover909
Title: Lovely staff, average food
Review: Yes the staff are great.Yes the prices are cheap.No the food is not delicious. The vegetables with fried rice were boring and bland in a watery sauce. Hardly any veggie choice so one of us ended up with a sandwich for dinner! Loved the squid balls and addition of real mayonnaise.Setting is quiet and quite pretty with staff who can't do enough for you. Felt very looked after but wouldn't go back for the food. Show less

Author: Sara M
Title: Finally....customer service!!!
Review: After living in KL for over a year and eventually comming to Melaka. I have to honestly say this is the best (if only) place I have ever received an open, friendly and warm welcome in Malaysia. I was actually greeted, served and spoken too by some great personalities. A rare find here.Show less

Author: Jorn M
Title: Beautiful spot, good food, friendly people
Review: We had dinner tonight at this restaurant in Melaka. We sat next to the canal at the back of the restaurant. Was a really nice quiet spot and the people that help you are very friendly. Definitely try the pulled pork burger, it's delicious! Prices are also very good, even the beer is well priced (just 8 Ringgit!). We come back tomorrow, 5 stars from us!Show less

Author: PaulC582
Title: Service with a smile😃!
Review: Great food served in a stunning riverside location by the best waiter we have ever come across. A must for anyone in Melaka. You will not be disappointed. Brilliant value for money and outstanding service from Carson.

Author: cmnd90County Dublin, Ireland
Title: Great value, beautiful view
Review: The River View Cafe is truly a Melaka Gem. The view of the river is stunning, the food is delicious and fantastic value, too. The staff are very friendly - happy to recommend the best dishes and go the extra mile for their customers. Ask for Carson - what a lovely gentleman! Also, I heard Hugh Jackman ate there the other day - so keep your eyes peeled! Show less

Author: thomas c
Title: birthday
Review: it is a nice place, just beside the river. the  view & the design of the cafe very nice.not bad for the customer service👍👍.birthday suprised for my girl friend ^^...highly recommended....

Author: boundaryOntario's Thousand Islands, Canada
Title: A bit disappointed
Review: This restaurant is beautifully situated on the river walk. It's quieter than the Jonker Street places and quite pleasant. I ordered their Kampong Fried rice. It was nicely presented with a papadum but it didn't taste fried. It tasted like steamed rice with a couple of shrimp, some dried anchovies and some minced vegetables all stirred together. And very little seasoning - the real Kampung rice, as I understand it, is fried with chilli belacan. I'd give this one a miss if I were you. My partner had the grilled pork chop with mashed potatoes and a white sauce. It was quite tasty. Show less

Author: AnnieL3003
Title: Cute and definitely visit there again!
Review: Nice view of river and fantastic smoothies! Strongly recommend Mango Lassi, Banana & Pink Guava and Banana & passion fruit for the drink!

Author: Kee F
Title: highly recommend
Review:
nice enviroment and nice serving ~ 
highly recommend the dessert , will visit again for their dessert and food !!

Author: JulietheShark
Title: Lunch
Review: One of the best dishes I've ever had, Kampong fried rice so flavourful! Nice location with outdoor space and a/c indoors. Would highly recommend this place.

Author: Khid
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: Went yesterday for Sunday Brunch and love the whole feel about the place! The food and the service even great. We had a very relaxing time waiting for the home cooked Redang Chicken cooked by the owner's wife. It was yummy!!!

Author: CalcifierMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cool Indoor Space Too~
Review: I went for breakfast with a few of my friends. Didn't get to sit by the riverside though, however the indoor space is also a great place for friends gathering since its quiet and have a typical Melaka rustic design.The weekday English breakfast sets are simple, affordable and gives a home-made feel.Show less

Author: heliopolis1London, United Kingdom
Title: best for service, price and location
Review: Now eaten here for a second meal.Same staff, adequate Menu, Excellent service. A t My second visit and just as good as the first with adequate menu and excellent service both in English.Lovely setting outdoors with riverboats, City lights,gentle breeze.And the cheapish beer andthere are other lovely drinks.Everyone must try it once and return. Show less

Author: Marc Q
Title: Relaxing place, friendly and quick staff
Review: A place to chill out in the evening, having a cold beer, after a hot day visiting the city. Staff is really friendly and attentive. I can't say anything about the food, since we add only appetizer which were good, but not exceptional.

Author: Sparklesorbet
Title: Great food and right on the river
Review: We went here for lunch, great location on a quiet spot of the river. Friendly and attentive staff. I had the pulled pork burger which was exceptional. My boyfriend had chicken sausage fried rice which was good and is one of the cheapest we've seen in this area and a decent size portion. Would also recommend the guava pie and star fruit juice (it grows on you!). Five stars. Show less

Author: Paul HSuffolk, United Kingdom
Title: A delightful setting and equally delightful staff.
Review: We had breakfast at River View and were so impressed by the friendly and helpful staff we returned for an evening meal. The 'western food' we had was delicious (fish and chips followed by Mud Pie) and the river side tables are a perfect setting. Breakfast was an excellent omelette and bacon and again the staff made sure everything was prepared to taste. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: ThomasFromEarthKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cozy place
Review: This is a nice riverside place. You can choose to sit in the airco room, the fan room or outside. Nice outside tables on the riverside for a romantic moment ;) Staff is very friendly and they play relaxing old jazzy music. The juices here are 100% made of fresh fruit and really good. Toilets are very clean aswell. Great place!Show less

Author: melanieh305
Title: Good Food, Great Location
Review: The food was very nice and a good price, gad vegetarian fried rice. Location is great as close to the river but outside really touristic area, so you can see other places as well. Staff was really friendly.

Author: hedonistaSouthend-on-Sea, Essex
Title: Great Food with a River View
Review: This place was recommended by a travel friend and it did not disappoint! The tables are positioned by the river side affording great views. I went for the Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang as recommended by Carson and the Rendang was superb!A perfect rendezvous point to meet friends and watch people and boats pass by. Service was excellent so keep up the good work Carson :-) Show less

Author: Siyanna S
Title: Lovely staff
Review: Great food and lovely staff! We would love to come back! The view outside its great 😄 perfect place for breakfast, dinner and dessert 🍰

Author: Cherie M
Title: Great View & Good Service
Review: We went here for breakfast today as it was a short walk from our hotel. We both had the set breakfast. And ordered juices also . The meal was cooked perfectly. Juice freshly squeezed and ice coldStaff were friendly and prompt The view was a added bonusShow less

Author: Vvien CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great ambience and service!
Review: Saw a blog review about this place and I was interested to check it out. Came here around 3pm on a thursday. Walked here with the help of googlemaps from our hotel near Dataran palawan.Service is good here. We wanted to sit outside and enjoy the view of the river but it was very hot. The staff was proactive to bring out the fan for us and also a mosquito coil when he saw mosquitoes around our table. You can enjoy the view of the river with the frequent river cruise passing by while you dine here. I guess it would be more suitable if you come during morning or evening, instead of a mid afternoon like me.Food is affordable and reasonably priced. I ordered their burger which came alongside fries and a salad. I was told that they make their own burger buns. It was tasty and value for money. The serving is big. I tried their milkshake too.Thumbs up! Show less

Author: Anna B
Title: Valentine's Day Dinner
Review: My partner and I went here on V-day, two days ago. The waiting staff were oh so friendly and helpful! Food was delicious (I had the beef rendang) and we sat outside overlooking the river...very romantic!I would highly recommend this place for its food and ambience (esp if you are lucky enough to get a table outside). Melaka as a town (Chinatown) is very small and very easy to make your way around on foot. You can reach the restaurant by walking along the river or on the street side. It is accessible for wheelchairs, strollers and walk-ins (no booking was needed, although at 8pm there was one table left).Show less

Author: Paraa007Batam, Indonesia
Title: Brilliant little restaurant
Review: Stayed at the river view guest house and big thumbs up for the owner not marketing their sister property and tipping about other places... However went based on reviews and not disappointed.. Enjoyed sitting outside overlooking the canal and having nice kampung(village) fried rice(I kept ordering it everytime I went) .. It was delicious and the service was fantastic too. Recommend it Show less

Author: nuril2016
Title: Amazing
Review:
The service was great. Workers are so kind and friendly.
 Also, view was perfect.
I ordered meat sauce spaghetti and banana juice.
 I think this is the best restaurant in melaka.

Author: DharshainiPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Simply Authentic..!!
Review: Classic view with great menu of dine.. Food was served not too long from the time we ordered... Asian and Western style dishes with exotic incredible taste along the river view experience. It simply gives you a smooth relaxing sensation afternoon to enjoy the food served!!.. Friendly serving staffs and you surely would wanna come back another time...Show less

Author: InasuitcaseSandpoint, Idaho
Title: Breakfat
Review: Wonderful staff - attentive and helpful. Prices are reasonable. No ala carte choices or substitutions are allowed. Presentation is lovely. Breakfast is hard to screw up unless you serve it lukewarm to cold. It wasn't busy yet that's what I received - cold toast and egg. The sausages (er, hot dogs) were lukewarm. Thankfully the staff and the lovely view made up for it. Too bad they don't have room for more tables on the patio. Show less

Author: maisugarcookieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre food. Excellent service. Great view.
Review: The service here is excellent, quick and very friendly.We ordered the Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang and Nasi Lemak with Chicken Curry. The nasi lemak is mediocre, but the beef rendang and chicken curry kicks some punch.We had iced lemon tea to compliment our meal, and was disappointed that it was unsweetened tea.The restaurant internal decor is very nice and sitting by the river view is a wonderful experience.Show less

Author: AllanShelly
Title: Amazing place and best service
Review: Thank you for making us feel so welcome. Bn is amazing and has a personality full of bubbles. He has made us want to come back every night.

Author: 54austinNew York City, New York
Title: No idea why this place is so highly rated
Review: My partner and I just visited this place based on the reviews on this site...did we go to an entirely different place? The cafe we went to had greasy, mediocre food. We had the fried fish dumplings, seafood tofu, club sandwich and kampung rice. While inexpensive, I'm sure there are many other places in Malacca that are better. Skip this place.Show less

Author: TozsaRBudapest, Hungary
Title: Breakfast with History Album of Malacca
Review: Though they have only 2-3 tables at the river side - the inside is pleasant as well. Banana pancake and local coffee was excellent. With freshly squized orange and carrott juice. Do not forget to take one of the albums off the shelf to read something about local Peranakan people during your meal, Guys serving us were super friendly.Show less

Author: YeeYan
Title: Tasty and Cheap
Review: The environment is great, clean and with some simple Christmas decor. The staffs are very friendly. The food is very tasty and cheap. Tender and juicy pork chop is sell at RM13.00

Author: Melvin v
Title: Great place!
Review: We visited the café twice and we would like to thank Carson and collegues for their great service! The food was nice, especially to be enjoyed while sitting next to the river and smiling at the tourists, occasionally passing by in the river boats.

Author: Jharris1993
Title: AMAZING:
Review: Best Mango Lassi I've had in Asia! And the most beautiful views I also ended up having the squid rings which were cooked perfectly! Friendly, helpful staff I had a great experience here :)

Author: jesvin21Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great experience, friendly and accommodating staff, thumbs up!
Review: We were a group of eight ladies who showed up at this restaurant on a Saturday night with no reservation. The place was packed but the owner was kind enough to accommodate us after only a 10 min wait, which we didnt mind as it was raining outside. Food was great and service was excellent. We stayed until past closing time but the staff didnt seem to mind and were very friendly. It made our last night in Malacca truly special. We will be back!Show less

Author: laurabar2015
Title: nive quiet location,friendly staff
Review: very relaxing sitting outside, fresh juice,very nice local food, the western food not so good. still good for the price you pay which is quite reasonable.

Author: tempat_akanSydney, Australia
Title: Good food, friendly staff
Review: We ate here a couple of times during our visit, the food is good and the servings large. Very good value for money.The chef makes some very nice inexpensive cakes and desserts if you want to indulge yourself and the cold drinks will keep you coming back for more.Very much recommended. Show less

Author: DavidStephensenBendigo, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere and great food
Review: We asked about good Peranakan food handy to Jonker St and this place was recommended. The riverside location was lovely and the food excellent and inexpensive—perfect for our last night in Melaka. The really notable thing was the friendly atmosphere. Everyone who arrived was treated like an old friend, and some were, I think. The energetic young waiter had a remarkable memory of people who had visited a long time before. They had a truly impressive array of delicious-looking western-type desserts on offer, but we were in the mood for more traditional dessert so went elsewhere on this occasion.Show less

Author: leechin1101Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Dessert Delight
Review: Loved the western dishes & the desserts esp the Ice-cream Mud pie & the Walnut Brownie with ice cream. Didn't take any picture but for you all to try out and you will definitely want to come back for more!! I did & will come back.Show less

Author: 란영 김
Title: trip for rest
Review: Food is not bad & cheap price. But the service was not good. They forgot my order and made us wait pretty long time....They have to improve the service. One more, do not expect good environment at all. when i was having dinner outside, mosquito bite me a lottttttt. Show less

Author: LewisSG
Title: Love this place!
Review:
Greeted by the friendly staff. Patiently introduced their signature food & drinks. The western food was really good and very reasonably priced.
Rm 60 for 3 main dishes+ drinks and a dessert. Will visit again!

Author: RobinHamburg040
Title: Good " Break
Review: Good, western breakfast here :) Nice juices and eggs! Recommended! Its nice to sit outside, just at the Melaka River! :)

Author: Nickclw
Title: Great food
Review:
The food was great. Tried the pork burger and pork ribs. Amazing stuff from Melaka. The price was easy on the pocket too. The view of the river was lovely. The staff were friendly and accommodating.

Nick and Karen

Author: TreeblackGold Coast, Australia
Title: Amazing food with friendly service
Review: After reading all the great reviews we headed over to the River View Cafe with our 4 year old. Had their new menu addition of pulled pork burgers. Amaze balls!!! Our son loved the heart shaped chicken nuggets and fresh juice. Carson gave great service and even topped off the meal with a beautiful slice of cheese cake. Thank you for making our last night in malacca special. Show less

Author: Budgett123
Title: Great banana pancake breakfast!
Review: worth checking out, nice staff, good and cheap food! nice view of the river out on the back and places to sit! would defiantly go back!

Author: David HAntigua, Guatemala
Title: Pleasant Change
Review: If you need a western food fix this is a good choice. I had the Sunday Breakfast with a tasty bratwurst and bacon. Along with scrambled eggs and mushrooms. All good but the mushrooms come in a birds nest called a hash brown basket. If I hadn't remembered it from the menu I wouldn't have thought it was something to eat. Aside from the basket it was all good and the menu looked good.Show less

Author: OurPerspectiveNewbury, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Dinner
Review: Lovely spot by the river, open for lunch and dinner. Good range of food, both local and western and very reasonably priced as well. Friendly and relaxed service (misses out on the top score as the service was a little to relaxed at times, but that's my only grumble). Worth a visit and would recommend. Show less

Author: Christine J
Title: Great food
Review: Great place to eat and relax, all food fresh and amazing.a must place to eat and relax by the river and enjoy the peace and quiet of the area.

Author: H481WJroberts
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Enjoyed very good meals, especially the truly excellent mud cake icecream. Staff highly attentive and friendly. No wine - but shop next door had a great merlot for only MR25. In summary, a a very pleasant (and cheap) evening. Would definitely return.

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mildly bohemian cafe with EXCELLENT MUDPIE
Review: I like the ambience of the place. It was adorned with great paintings, an eclectic mix of furnitures and accessories and some books. The cafe is creatively designed. You can sit on the couch or by proper wooden tables. It is a very simple and small place, but the prices are reasonable.I had mudpie and a cup of local coffee.The coffee was not very robust, disappoingly, and my friend's ice milo was diluted. BUT BUT BUT the redeemer of the day was the MUD PIE. It was so good, you just have to try it!!! It was worth my try and i'd be back for it.It was not overly sweet or too cloying but just nice. Try the dessert, if anything. This place is worth popping by- if you are alone or with another friend. I'm not sure if they can accommodate large crowds though. Service staff was really helpful <3WIFI WAS WORKING WELL :)Show less

Author: carynbear
Title: Merdeka Luncheon
Review: Good place to chill out n good food to fill up ur stomach😊. Affordable price wf No GST n Service Charge😄

Author: AHM73Sydney, Australia
Title: Terrible service, disorganized kitchen, ordinary food.
Review: When we arrived my young needed to go to the bathroom. I had to ask 3 times, and wait 10min, for them to restock the exhausted toilet paper in the bathroom. This should have been a sign of things to come. The guy in "charge" ran around like he was the only person doing anything, but wasn't doing much. We ordered 2 juices for the kids, and they delivered only one and said they had run out (only to offer us the extra one later). We waited 30min before my wife and I got our meals, but waited an HOUR for the kids meals (simple fish & chips). I had to repeatedly ask where the food was and they appeared to have no idea. They apologized numerous times, but then had the hide to charge us full price for the meal. Food wasn't even that good. My 4 yo requested that we never go back there again. He doesn't need to worry. Show less

Author: huibw2014Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Simple quiet charming place
Review: Quiet place on the river: nice ambiance inside, river side terrace. We had freshly brewed iced tea, nasi leak with rendang (excellent) and good fried rice. Fast and friendly service. With a bill of only MR 34 for two it was also one of the best values we have encountered.Show less

Author: Samuel KBratislava, Slovakia
Title: Very good weatern dishes
Review: I have been here couple of times, asian food was decent. But the last visit I opted for western meal and was taken by surprise. Greates pork chops I have had out in asia. Also very helpful and nice staff. If you are on a longer trip and get in mood for some familiar taste, go for it. Pricing is also very reasonable. Nice place.Show less

Author: AndyAnnable
Title: Great place at a decent price!
Review: We struggled to find a decent place that was open before 11am and at a decent price! After a little walk round we found this cafe which was about half the price of the others we had seen. And the tables out the back were free so you can sit by the river and eat! It's nothing too fancy but decent portion sizes and the coffee is good! I just enjoy sitting outside when it's nice so it was a great little find. The service is decent, can get a little slow when it's busy but otherwise very good. Show less

Author: ShaunandSam2014London, United Kingdom
Title: Two visits
Review: Well located premises. The food that we ate here was excellent and the menu supplimented by special dishes. Outside by the river was pleasant for dining and inside was cool and relaxed for a drink or two. The establishment offers very well priced accomodation, but contact directly to confirm availability. A well run family business. Would highly recommend.Show less

Author: Tiki PBarcelona, Spain
Title: Good food, good prices, attentive staff
Review: We are not the early birds type (mostly late ones), and we ended up going for dinner quite late a couple of times, but were always welcome with a smile.The food options are quite varied, with local and Western dishes with good price (still more expensive than local restaurants, although not too much). Portions are good, and the atmosphere is pleasant. When we told them it was our wedding anniversary, they gave us some dessert on the house (so kind!).Only downside is one of the staff members insistingly trying to sell us more items we didn't want, otherwise recommended!Show less

Author: JonesmeisterAmersfoort, The Netherlands
Title: Authentic food on a great location
Review: Just outside the hassle of Melaka is this small and simple restaurant along the river. We ate pumpkin soup and beef rendang and our kids spaghetti. Everything tasted very good. Maybe the best food we ate on our trip through Malaysia. You can really taste the food is made with "love". We sat outside and that is a perfect place with views over the river. All this for 20 RM per person. Does it get any better?!Show less

Author: Julia_1506Tirol, Austria
Title: Great place to stay!
Review: If you are searching for a nice place by the river of Melakka you should go to the Riverview Cafe. You can sit by the river or inside, in a room with style. They ofer daily breakfast, lunch, dinner or snacks, also great cookies. The poeople are very friendly and helpful. We liked it very much!Show less

Author: GauchoMatero
Title: Great food, funny people and (mostly) nice music
Review:
Big breakfast, and good for chill out or making some work. Bicycle rental, wifi and electic usb-plugs available.
Thanks!

Author: Viveqa S
Title: Awesome food
Review: We had a wondeful dining experience by the river. Shall never miss the taste of their mango lassi and their desserts! Thanks for keeping the taste buds alive!

Author: DaudRayPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: The place for Sunday breakfast
Review: After a disappointment down the street we walked along the river front & found this classic place. It was hard to find from the street sign--they need a more visible sign there. But the ambience is just right, service is prompt and very helpful, food portions generous and food delicious. Bkfst ti 3:00 PM.Show less

Author: hengsy
Title: Nice and peaceful environment.
Review: Nice and peaceful environment. Food is good. Staff here is friendly also. Car park available right in front of the restaurant.

Author: pgiddingsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Peaceful and delicious!
Review: A really peaceful cafe in the centre of Melaka. Everything is vegetarian with a good deal of vegan options. We had the sweet and sour mushrooms and Tom yum soup, both were really good. The passion fruit ice tea was a highlight. It is very quiet, we've been a few times and it has never been very busy - it has a nice calm atmosphere! We come here every time we are in Melaka and will definitely be back again! Show less

Author: 809vivienv
Title: Appetizing
Review: Yummy vegetarian food in a peaceful ambience. Happy to be able to eat oyster omelette without the oysters

Author: TonjaO3
Title: Amazingly delicious!
Review: We loved the food here so much, that we just had to come back the next day. Great selection of delicious food, suitable for vegans.

Author: GilcoSouth Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent vegetarian food
Review: Had supper at the Mori after reading TA reviews and it didn't disappoint. Had the black vinegar Vege pork, nyonya curry and crispy tempeh. All well cooked and satisfying. Reasonable prices too. Delicious passion fruit juice (without straw, didn't even have to refuse them). Would eat there again.Show less

Author: Jessie_caca
Title: Good Concept and Delicious Food
Review: We like the food and the services,strongly recommended the Teochew kuey tiaw and black vinegar vegetarian pork! Yum😋

Author: DrSanjMDurham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious vegetarian food beautifully presented in a lovely place.
Review: After finding this restaurant on reviews, we had try it. Got stuck in traffic & arrived 15 minutes before last orders. Staff still very helpful & got our order in!We had monkey head mushroom satay; fried lotus with honey; fried cauliflower with salad sauce; Hokkien noodle; belacan indian goa bean; sautéed veg & mushrooms & brown rice. All beautifully presented & delicious. Compliments to chef. Lovely ambiance in restaurant. Very clean & great quirky style! One of our guests is not vegetarian but thoroughly enjoyed the food. Only downside is we didn’t have time to try the desserts. If you’re driving there, beware the lane is very narrow! Maybe park elsewhere & walk there. Will definitely be going back next time in Melaka. Show less

Author: PSurretUnited Kingdom
Title: Nice food but...
Review: As one of the top 10 trip advisor ranked restaurants in Malacca, I decided we’d try it out, especially as it’s vegetarian. The food was very tasty and we were not disappointed. We were however a bit unlucky being right after Chinese New Year as 2 of the drinks we tried to order where out of stock and all the cakes and desserts were also out of stock so we had to go somewhere else for something sweet. The service is odd, not bad but odd and detached. They obviously get such a flow of customers that they probably are exhausted I think. Anyway very nice food so in the kitchen they’re doing a great job but the service meant that in my view it can’t be a 4 or 5. You almost wish you could just take away the nice food back to your accommodation instead. Show less

Author: marcwatton1London, United Kingdom
Title: Great food but weird atmosphere due to acoustics of place and looped music
Review: We chose this restaurant as a result of its rankings on TA. We were not disappointed with the food which was delicious and fairly priced. However the atmosphere is odd. Partly I think because it is a relatively small room and the acoustics are bad and we could hear every uninteresting word of the German woman on the next table. Furthermore the music was on a loop of one song which frankly was annoying after the second time. The waiters were ok but not over friendly either.Show less

Author: zambrosiaAuckland
Title: A haven on a wet night in Melaka
Review: We were staying just a few minutes away and looking for somewhere to eat when we spotted a row of hanging Japanese lanterns in an adjacent side street. Warmly welcomed into a oasis of calm. We were given plenty of time to peruse the menu, plenty of choice. Food so good we returned for lunch the next day!Show less

Author: S_Shah910
Title: Good food and atmoshere
Review: Nice atmosphere. Good service. Had the Nyonya fried rice. It was ok. Price a little high for this one pot meal.

Author: 346ast
Title: Foods are excellence, up to standard.
Review:
Nice ambiance, nice food, affordable price.
Location is not too far away from attractions, within walking distance can reach.

Author: tzeyann
Title: Lovely vegetarian restaurant
Review: Beautiful restaurant and lovely environment. Dishes are made beautifully and taste wonderful. I would recommend coming here if you are in malacca

Author: helenaa342
Title: Delicious vegan dishes and cake, nice zen atmosphere. We will be back
Review: The menu has many vegan options. We ordered the tempeh fish, some noodles with different types of mushrooms and veggies. Everything was really good and the vegan chocolate cake was the perfect way to end a delicious dinner

Author: angelon120
Title: Cute, cozy and amazing food!
Review: The staff is super nice and the food is delicious and affordable. We had a lovely lunch. Super recommended!

Author: Steve MLeicester, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing food ☺
Review: We had the spicy 'fish' and the satay sticks. The fish was delicious, the feel was just like the real thing and had such an amazing flavour. The satay sticks were made from mushroom which were really meaty. Would definitely reccomend to anyone wanting to try vegetarian foodShow less

Author: Missymiche
Title: Vegetarian day
Review: The ambience of the restaurant is very comfy and cozy. The staffs are friendly and attentive to customers. Food taste superb

Author: cattiers
Title: Very nice food! It’s our second
Review:
Very nice food! It’s our second time to visit. Our kids love the satay “beef” and honey crispy lotus! Lovely environment with Zen theme! Highly recommend 

Highly
Highly recommend

Author: Cfarr96Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty vegetarian food and calming atmosphere
Review: The friendly service and the calming atmosphere along with the delicious feel good vegetarian food made for a lovely experience and evening at Mori. A bit more expensive than what our backpacker budgets are used too but still felt it was good value for money plus it’s nice to go to a nice restaurant once in a while. Left feeling full, relaxed and happy! Reccomended the crispy fried Tempeh which isn’t in our photo. Show less

Author: andreasb21-0103
Title: Great atmosphere, great food!
Review: Nice experience, it is a hidden gem of vegetarian food here. They have some special home-made chili, overall, I personally reccomend Mory

Author: RandolphCarter1919Australia
Title: Perfect healthy choice
Review: After travelling and fried takeaways we needed a vege fix and this place for the bill. Sweet and sour tofu and mixed vegetables in a clay pot with spicy rice. All meals were very tasty and my body nearly went into a anaphylactic shock of all the nutrients it was absorbing. Nice relaxing restaurant not far from the main drag.Show less

Author: joannebN9235EUGroningen, The Netherlands
Title: Perfect vegetarian place to eat!
Review: It is a very nice restaurant to eat vegetarian. My boyfriend and I eat vegan and this was also not a problem! If you order tea you can get a refill. The people who work at this place are very very kindly. It is a nice quit place to get some rest! Really peaceful. Oh, and least but not least it was very very clean (the cleanest in South Asia so far! Even the toilet!!). The price is a little bit higher then in the rest of Malaysia but not too high! Oh and they have vegan cakes!! Okay that was it! Enjoy! You should go there! Show less

Author: Doge2292
Title: Great vegetarian food
Review:
Had a great meal here. Excellent spot for vegetarians with a lot of variety of vegetarian food.

Environment is also really peaceful.

Author: AiSeeT
Title: Nice food and excellent ambience
Review: My friend and I love the food so much that we decided to go back again the next day with more buddies.

Author: jywee
Title: Good food
Review: A bit pricey but they used better ingredients. The environment is good as they played good soothing music. Would recommend travellers

Author: stamyfPerth, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: We chanced upon this restaurant and it was a shame that it was on our last night in Melaka otherwise we would have surely come back! The food is high quality and tastes delicious. The serves are extremely generous and the ambiance is nice. They also accept payment via card. Excellent value for money.Show less

Author: Kentcp73
Title: The vegetarian food are so delicious
Review: We are seldom eat vegetarian food but this shop have a well cook. The food are delicious and I ate 2 bowl of brown rice 😄

Author: Foodiemissy
Title: Excellent vegetarian food
Review: One would think that vegetarian food is quite tasteless and boring with fake flour meats. But this is new age, with real vegetables served. The black vinegar and ginger vegetarian pork is a must to order! I would definitely come back for more! Try for yourself. :) Well recommended.Show less

Author: Tripforyou23
Title: Best Veg food in Malaysia??
Review: Honestly I ended up eating here 3 times in 2 days because the food was so good. Everything I ate was exceptional and I fell in love with Monkey Head Mushrooms. The flavor is amazing and the portions are large by Malaysian standards. It is a bit more expensive than budget eateries, but it is definitely worth the 3 or 4 extra ringgit. If you are vegetarian or vegan this is a must in Malacca. Show less

Author: S138BYchriss
Title: Peaceful lunch
Review: Tranquil corner of Malacca’s China Town district with an authentic selection of local vegetarian dishes and natural teas and iced drinks.

Author: louiso592Sydney, Australia
Title: Excellent food, service & ambience
Review: Came on a Sunday evening and was not crowded. Service was excellent from the moment we stepped in and the food was just exceptional. We had basil fried rice, oyster omelette and the kampong fish which were all beyond expectations. The hot lemongrass drink was also great. Would highly recommend to everyone! Show less

Author: chonglingzi
Title: Vegan Food
Review:
下午3pm进来吃个简餐，结果越吃越好吃，不知觉又加点～ Peaceful Environment + Delicious Vegan~

Recommend: Satay，Vinegar vege pork & Sarawak Laksa.

Author: kunals66
Title: Good food. Relax & calming Zen type ambient.
Review: Good food. Relax & calming Zen type ambient. I would recommend the Monkey head mushroom sate & Spicy Fried Rice. I would love to come back again.

Author: Mark_Bay_64
Title: Exceptional lunch experience
Review:
Our new favourite in Malaka, we will come back again and again.

A Vegetarian/Vegans delight, quality food made to impress. The restaurant is clean, the service faultless and soft music playing in the background makes for a relaxed dinning experience.

Author: 53pluscountriesWest coast, USA
Title: Lovely vegetarian lunch in a cool and peaceful environment
Review: I thoroughly enjoyed lunch here. It's a very relaxing and quiet place, and the food was quite good. I do like it when you're not bothered by staff at a restaurant, but they took it a little too far, I had to wait 15 minutes to get the attention of staff to pay when I was finished with my meal, so not a place if you're in a hurry.Show less

Author: Annielim79
Title: Nice foods, good environment
Review: This is my second times here. The foods is good with relaxing music. Good places for family and friends gathering.

Author: Tioh Y
Title: Nice
Review: Me and my family loving this peaceful and cozy environment :) feel like coming back home to have a nice hot delicious food 🍲 will visit again next time.

Author: 436evajKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious lunch in central Melaka
Review: Just what we needed after spending our morning visiting Melaka’s temples, shops and museums. I had their signature dish and my freind a curry dish. All was freshly prepared and very tasty. The café is situated in quiet street just off the busy parts of Melaka. Very serene place to recharge. Show less

Author: tpLong
Title: Vegetarian Cafe
Review: I like the atmosphere i.e. quite and cozy.  Good for discussion and get together with friends or family.

Author: FoonglengY1
Title: Food hunting
Review: The food is truly tasty 😋 is really surprise me and w the cozy environment, this place is worth it visit. U will love it.

Author: 656audreyw
Title: Great food!
Review: The food was very Nice! I did not even notice it was all vegitarian! Great choice of tea! And the people are very friendly!

Author: Arts_1928Wolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious
Review: After visiting the bustling streets if Malaka, this is perfect, relaxing spot for dinner. I brought my fussy, vegetarian mother here and she loved it! The crispy tempeh, sweet and sour jackfruit, satay monkey head mushrooms were delicious. There is a range of teas also. We left feeling healthily full! Definitely recommend especially for vegetarians.Show less

Author: Limyiting94
Title: Comfort environment
Review: A cool and comfort place for short rest drinking Traditional Chinese Tea.Beautiful tea set.Nice service.

Author: 697colins
Title: Nice looking restaurant with delicious food
Review: I've had the Laksa and it was very tasty. Perfect spiciness and a big portion. The ginger tea was one of the best I've had. I would totally recommend!

Author: bykailin
Title: Yummy and healthy
Review:
Healthy and yummy vegetarian food. The sets are a good portion size for a solo traveller. 
Relaxing ambiance with soothing instrumental music.
Air conditioned, which is a nice relief from the heat. No mosquitos in the restaurant.

Author: MandyF973
Title: Great Food And Nice Ambience
Review: Lovely place and great food. Food are delicious And staff are friendly. Will definately come back again

Author: Moonjellie22Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely ambience
Review: It’s a lovely restaurant tucked away in a corner around Jonker area. If you are driving, they have a small private lot right in front of the restaurant where you can park at. You need to take off shoes to enter the restaurant and the decor is tastefully done in wood. The food is awesome. I don’t like tempeh but I ate their tempeh!! It shows how delicious theirs is. Everything’s else from noodles to monkeyhead mushroom satay is really really good. Service is warm and friendly too. Definitely a restaurant worth going to! Show less

Author: Victoria900Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious healthy meals
Review: We enjoyed the food so much that we came back again before leaving Melaka. We ordered the black fungus vinegar clay pot dish, fried lotus roots, herbal soup rice set, mushroom veggie rice set, Sarawak laksa and all tasted wonderful! The ingredients were really fresh. A must try for vegans and vegetarians visiting Melaka. Show less

Author: Ingrid K
Title: Fantastic food and ambience
Review: We had Chinese tea and lunch here and wish we had more time here to try more dishes. Every dish was delicious and a lovely peaceful ambience in the restaurant. Highly recommend!

Author: Chow M
Title: Had Dinner and Lunch here
Review: The Sarawak curry is yummy here. Overall food is quite good, for vegetarians this is a very good place to eat and stay.

Author: Verotepli
Title: Best veggie lunch ever!!
