Review: Definitely worth it! Every dish we had was super yummy. Loved it. Great option for everyone not only vegetarians/vegans.

Author: CatChee
Title: Cozy Vegetarian Restaurant
Review:
Nice vegetarian meal in this restaurant. Its lovely to have gathering with friends and family.
Quite spacious and good environment!!

Author: rohinee1Changi, Singapore
Title: More of Mori pleases !
Review: We visited The restaurant on a whim - but we’re so happy that we did ! The ambience to start with is completely serene - it’s rare to walk into a restaurant where they ask you to take your shoes off and when you do walk in - a sense of beautiful tranquility overcomes you - which is so removed from all the hustle and bustle that’s on the streets outside.The food is delicious! We tried the Monkey Head mushrooms and the curry rice set- both of which were delectable! Truly recommend !Show less

Author: Charchit ALondon, United Kingdom
Title: Heavenly vegetarian food!!
Review: Although we're not strictly vegetarians, we like to have one proper vegetarian meal whenever we travel. We found this place online first and while it is slightly off the main road, it turned out to be a hidden gem! The decor itself was so inviting, we were asked to take our shoes off, and welcomed by some really nice 'zen' like music.We ordered Olive Fried Rice which was amazingly good, which we combined with some Soursop juice (recommended by the host). Even our 18 month old daughter loved the Fried rice, so it wasn't spicy at all. I must however say that the highlight was the peanut sauce that came with our Fried mushroom Satay - it was to die for. so if you are a vegetarian, and have some taste for this kind of food (as it isn't what things might taste where commercially available), it is a must visit.Show less

Title: Great value for money
Review: Great service and large portions. Amazing vegetarian good. Make sure you come here if you're in Melaka.

Author: Benji77awSingapore, Singapore
Title: Absolutely wonderful in every aspect
Review: Food QualityStunning. Fresh, well prepared and presented. Care and pride is represented in the way they cook. I had two meals here during my stay in Melaka. (Lunch & Dinner) Service Friendly, accurate and professional. They check for your dietary preference (no eggs etc), food may seem a long wait for the impatient, but if you know kitchen tasks, this is considered fast. AmbienceCalming and very clean. No shoes are allowed into the dining area. Deco is very neat (zen) making it relaxing. Kitchen is far away, so no noise of pots/pans etc. Show less

Author: loong0218
Title: Tranquil and peaceful restaurant
Review: this restaurant offers good food and tranquil environment for your meal. The portion of food is not bad too.

Author: Paradise20921950051
Title: Gathering
Review:
Nice and cosy place for dining....
Healthy food taste good... 
Only parking place limited... 
Need to walk a distance

Author: Elyne LGlasgow, Scotland
Title: Great variety of food
Review: I have visited here a couple of times with my family and friends. They have a wide selection of dishes and I always order their black vinegar “pork”. They play soft and relaxing music so overall ambience is nice. However, it can get crowded during weekends and public holidays. It’s a bit difficult to get parking around this area but I’d still recommend paying a visit here for the food!Show less

Author: Reinier T
Title: Some of the best food we've ever eaten
Review: Lovely little vegetarian eatery (also an homestay). The 'monkey head mushroom' satay we had here is one of the best food we have ever eaten. Juicy, firm and just perfectly spiced. Highly recommemded to both vegetarians and non vegetarians

Author: sunnyg863
Title: So many nice choices
Review: Good ambience, polite staff and good fresh  vegetarian food ...Lots of options to choose with different level of spices to suit ur palate ... Enjoy

Author: WKaury80Malaysia
Title: Mori Vegetarian Food Restaurant at Melaka
Review: This restaurant offers bestest vegetarian food in Melaka and the bestest hospitality.The staff are very friendly and patient. They have rooms just incase customers wanna put up. So toz who are vegetarian and looking for food to indulge in this is highly recommended. Check out their rooms if u plan to stay up at Melaka.give 1 try guys,ul love the vegesShow less

Author: igrc75
Title: Lovely drinks and very helpful
Review: We called in here to escape the storm just as it opened. The drinks we had were very nice and they also helped us book tickets for the show the following day.

Author: natsuy12
Title: Dinner at
Review: Nice food & nice ambience! The staff is very friendly and helpful. She has specially informed the kitchen not to put eggs for the fried noodles after knowing we do not take eggs. 😃

Author: kenzasassi13
Title: Beautiful place in Malacca
Review: Nice restaurant, varied menu with delicious options. The ambiance is really calm and cosy. The service was also really good.

Author: riccardoa745
Review: Warm and relaxing atmosphere.From the reviews that I have read earlier the food its quite expensive but the set menu is totally worth it...such a good value for ,the food is very delicious and service, really attentive and polite.Also they have an amazing selection of healthy chinese teas.I totally recommend it.Show less

Author: 808danyelg
Title: Coming back!
Review:
Lovely vegetarian restaurant, relaxing atmosphere and amazing food!
Berry nice staff and food came fast.

Author: 865xug
Title: Real Deal!
Review: Pure vegetatrian Place with carefully prepared drinks and dishes! Air conditioned and everything is clean! So hard to find places likes this in Malaysia! Also nice to take a break from the busy streets in that area

Author: wanderlust091
Title: Lovely environment and food
Review: Discovered this quaint restaurant in May and fell in love with it instantly. Very comfortable and peaceful environment. Food and service was great! Coming back again now and am sure this is not the last!

Author: meshpk
Title: Great Vegetarian option!
Review: Very peaceful restaurant. Felt at ease and very safe about the food that we are consuming. The food was great. Will come again.

Author: MairiW30
Title: Peaceful place
Review: Lovely place with friendly staff and good food, it's vegetarian with some fish based dishes but they're are easy to avoid, take your shoes off at the entrance and relax in this meditative dining experience.

Author: wynnem2018
Title: Wonderful service
Review: This place has such a homely feel, making my cousin and I feel very comfortable, food is up to top notch and staff is lovely! Definitely recommend Vegos and vegans around the world to come!!!

Author: krupac2014Bengaluru, India
Title: Vegetarian food... but not the Indian style
Review: If you are looking for Indian flavours here, you'll be disappointed. But if you are happy to find just some veg kitchen, then this is a good find near Jonket street. The place is well done-up, you leave your footwear outside. The staff is very soft and polite. They help you choose your dishes.The food was exotic to us Indians and not so satiating afterall. We also ended up paying a good sum here... We didn't return to the place. That doesn't mean there was an issue at their end. For their service and decor, full marks!Show less

Author: Alyssia B
Title: Excellent healthy vegetarian food
Review:
Not always easy to find good quality/healthy/vegetarian restaurant : Mori tea house is one of the rare one to offer all of these,in a beautiful and peaceful place. 
I strongly recommend to go there :)

Author: 719charlotteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice tea and vegetarian food
Review: We have dinner there, food is delicious and nice atmosphere. Mid range pricing, we ordered for the smallest servings but still too big for two of us. Special and recommend to try:Dish: Fried lotus Drinks : 'glutinous taste ' pu er Tea (refillable for hot water).Show less

Author: Lois P
Title: Excellent Vegetarian food!
Review: This is a must visit if you are in Melaka. Even if you aren’t vegetarian! Amazing food and nice people!

Author: frenchi108Melaka, Malaysia
Title: One of the best veggie restaurant I've been to
Review: The service and ambience are just as good as their food, just extraordinary. We got about 10 different dishes for a party of 4 and it was under US$10 a head, couldn't believe how affordable the prices were for such a quality dinner. A must if you are in Melaka, don't miss it.Show less

Author: Journey74821
Title: Feels like home
Review: We’re very happy to find this gem close to Jonker Street. They offers great food, good tea and a relaxing atmosphere away for the busy streets. We ordered osmathus and rose hips tea as well as Teochew noodles and vinegar “pork”. They’re both delicious. The place is clean as you have to take off your shoes (slippers provided). Highly recommended!Show less

Author: helenao348
Title: Serenity atmosphere
Review: Nice and quiet environment.  A good place for tea and relaxation. Family , business and friends meeting is suitable.

Author: Loiselizabethh
Title: Incredible food!
Review: Me and my partner came here last night and we're greeted by the very welcoming staff. We ordered the Dragon Well tea and an iced tea and they were both lovely and served with traditional Chinese cups. We ordered a variety of things from the menu as we are both big vegetarian foodies and wanted to try as much as possible after reading other reviews on here. The food came out quickly and steaming hot which was great. We highly recommend the fried lotus, we've never had anything like it before but it was amazing! We also had tofu, mushrooms with satay and brown rice, all of which were lovely and full of flavour.The staff were great, the place is lovely and clean and it is only a short walk from the river and Junker street. We will definitely be eating here again and would recommend it to anyone! Show less

Author: _G2339XS
Title: Awesome Food
Review: Every dish that we ordered was delicious. My favourite was the fried cauliflower, lady finger with special spicy sauce and veggie oyster omelette. The black vinegar and ginger vegetarian pork goes with rice very well. The buttermilk mushroom and fried lotus with honey are also worth trying. Will definitely go again next time. Show less

Author: keefenkong
Title: Nice and comfortable Tea House
Review: Very clean Tea House with comfortable environment. No outside shoes allow, so must leave shoes outside the door steps and wear a clean slipper into the Tea House. You may not like it but it is hygene. The food is nice with reasonable prices.

Author: SergeBlancSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Haven of peace and taste near crowded Joncker street
Review: Very tasty and colorful cuisine. They serve a nice mix of Chinese and local inspired recipes. Their satay with money mushrooms is even better than usually with chicken. Even the non-veggies will not miss the meat!The place is in a quiet street a few meters away from the busy Joncker street. Very relaxing.Show less

Author: Vacation700487
Title: Great vegetarian foods
Review: Discover this vegetarian shop in the heart of Malacca Town. Hidden away from the busy road. Is a great place to have Lunch and Dinner as well enjoying traditional Chinese tea.  Is a great environment to stop and relax. They do server individual set meal.

Author: Yee T
Title: Unique n cozy residence
Review: Spent 2 nights at Mori teahouse n residence with my friends. Book 2 rooms with attached bathrooms. Highly recommended to stay with your families. The place is clean, comfortable beds with beautiful in house atmosphere . Nice ambience. Lovely place to stay as its strategic location is just walking distance to the famous jonker walk n historical sites. Very safe place to stay with security control. Staffs are friendly,polite n helpful.We can use uber and grab car around the area. This two story residence house a Vegetarian restaurant as well. May also enjoy their sister cafe Kaya kaya cafe which offer western menu. Will stay again at Mori for my next visit..Show less

Author: Emily BChicago, Illinois
Title: Complete opposite experience from all the other reviews.
Review: Such a strange evening....by far the most rude staff I have encountered in Malaysia, she seemed a bit more friendly to the Chinese customers, but the attitude definitely didn't match the environment. We weren't asked if we wanted a drink and then when we asked for one she was very short and dismissive of us. Then, the food. We ordered the first and fourth set and a bowl of the "soup of the day". The seasonings (or lack thereof) and textures were sooooo off. Cold, strange dishes, old (or overcooked) rice, and soup with absolutely no seasoning only water as the base.Show less

Author: gamintraveler
Title: Excellent Vegetarian food!
Review: We had dinner and we liked it so much. We had a delicious mushroom soup, tofu and omelette. The portions are big enough for every order and prices are good for the quality. Chinese tea was great! The staff were very friendly and gave us good recommendations for dinner.Show less

Author: TanE242
Title: Like the different types of Tea
Review: Good food, great hospitality but only 1 cook!. Good recommendation from the 1 and only host cum waitress cum cashier cum Tea preparer. Should hire more helper , in fact can see their hiring advertisement in front. May have to wait approximately 20mins for food to be served if there are customers ahead of you. But 6-6:30pm is a good timing for dinner as we are the first to be there at 6:15, whereas those that come in after us have to wait until all our 7 dishes are served before theirs are served..Show less

Author: JIA SHEN LJohor Bahru District, Malaysia
Title: Harmonious tea house
Review: This tea house follows a Zen design, and the environment brought a harmony sense to me. It was nice to be there to enjoy air conditioning around noon. We had one glass of Puer tea with glutinous rice (refillable) and a bowl of dessert (white fungus and lotus seeds). That tea was nice and smooth, while that dessert was overly sweet.Their waitress (cum casher) was talkative and attentive, despite his service quality was mediocre. She did provide us a book to leave our personal comments to the shop owner, and that experience was quite retro.Overall, this tea house is recommended.Show less

Author: michaeliK4926EF
Title: Great place, very quiet and great food
Review:
I've like the relaxing atmosphere and the food. One of the best vegetarian places in malacca. 
Price is reasonable.

Author: Douglas N
Title: More than just a tea house.
Review: Mori Vegetarian Tea House is also a residence for travellers wishing to stay near jonker and still enjoy a hotel like residence the staff is wonderful passionate and understanding would totally stay there again on my next visit.

Author: haiqallomarMelaka, Malaysia
Title: New Le QUE Shop
Review: Hi, this restaurant has moved to Jalan Kubu, their new place is so comfortable. Their new shop is so pretty with vintage them. Their food was really good. They are specialist in steak! I tried their Australia Tajima Wagyu and every cents that i spend is really worth! All people that come to Malacca must try their foods! They also sell pasta and smoked dish. Their new menu “Grilled peri peri chicken” was also Its comparable even to Nandos! I would recommend this restaurant to everyone that love western food! Their food presentation was also pretty! It was like im eating at fine dining restaurant! Really like it! 10/10 Show less

Author: FerikingAnkara, Turkey
Title: Superb, tasty food! If you travel to Melacca try their steaks!
Review: The restaurant is Vintage style, service was good & friendly staff, the food is unique & tasty. I went their 2 days in a row, I had Black Angus (grain fed) steak it was tender & delicious, & their double cheese brisket (love)! Recommend restaurant! Will visit soon again!Show less

Author: farahnajwa
Title: BEST AGLIO IN TOWN!
Review: Recommended by a friend and got the best Aglio Seafood in town👍🏼 Portion banyak, harga kena dengan food. First time makan smoked rib BURGER and it was superb. Gonna repeat very soon!

Author: haiqallomar
Title: spaghetti chicken teriyaki
Review: everyone should try spaghetti chicken teriyaki. it’s so good and the portions also big. Chicken teriyaki is really good and i want to repeat eating at this restaurant

Author: Aswad M
Title: The best Western Restaurant in MELAKA
Review:
Visited here with my beautiful girlfriend❤️ We enjoyed the food very much. We ordered smoked ribs and chicken garlic cream. The environment is pleasant and their staffs were friendly.

p/s : Worth waiting😍

Author: izzatinzr
Title: The food is really delicious,
Review: The food is really delicious, my father really like lamb shank from Le que. You guys should try menu from Leque.

Author: Rayan C
Title: Our Anniversary Dinner
Review: Nice ambiance with creativity, although it's simple. The Food was delicious as we ordered their Steak & Lamb with Nacho as Starter. Its highly recommended to visit this place if you are looking for delicious and simple Western Food.

Author: eefah_raf
Title: Recommended restaurant 😍
Review:
Menu 1st yg i try dkt sni is salmon,sedap brbaloi sngt dgn hrga dengan portion salmon yg agak besar
While my fiance plk try their signature menu lamb shank burger..sooo yummyy and puas hati sngt2😍
Sngt recommended..💖

Author: 323franz
Title: We enjoyed the food and environmental
Review: We totally enjoyed our food, environmental and the nice staff!! We will definitely come back! We ate spaghetti, salad and steak and all of us been satisfied.

Author: dorish364Batu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: Tasty food
Review: We came the third time to Le QUE. The food we ordered was Spagetti Carbonara with smoked chicken and an other chicken dish as well as. a portobello mashroom soup, which was made from scratch. All was hot served and very tasty. You get value for money. The service is good. I recommend to drink with herbs, very refreshing.Keep up the good work and that more people come to dine at Le QUE!next time we go for the beef dishes!!Show less

Author: apricotDaleWhington
Title: A Not So Great Dishes
Review: Ordered "Smoked Charcoal Chicken with Cheese" and "Carbonara with Smoked Chicken".Visually looks average but appetising. - 0.5Smells good and delicious. - 0.5Taste however, such a let down. Carbonara taste MILKY and CHEAP. Smoked charcoal chic is a bit soft but the taste is very AVERAGE. The chickens are marinated with satay's flavour, very weird I must say. - 0The price point is I must say, quite expensive since it tastes mehhh. But the serving is a lot. 0WOULD I COME AGAIN? NO. But if i do, i'll definitely try the beef menu. - 0Show less

Author: kimikajai
Title: If you got tastebuds, you’d like this place
Review: I like their pasta very much i can’t get enough of it. I tried their aussie wagyu sirloin steak and it is among the cheapest in melaka. The steak was as exactly as i want it. And their dessert could get you off your feet. Excellent services. Excellent food.Show less

Author: Connector48303936499
Title: Best steak with affordable price!
Review: Great service! Steak wagyu is quite affordable and vv luscious to have. The dessert, pisang bakar gula melaka is heavenly good and a-must-try for everyone.

Author: maeltoshioPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Tomahawk Steak..😍
Review: We decided to dine at this restaurant base on the review and they do served Tomahawk steak..since all of us wanted to try Tomahawk Steak..We choose Wagyu Tomahawk Steak,and they do serve other steak .Its just you need to make reservation for Tomahawk at least one day before lucikly for us we order it in the morning and they have it in stock..the tomahawk come with Portabello mushroom soup which is super delicious,ice.lemon tea and side dishes..its all in..The food was good.the waiter the waitress very friendly we all just love the service..Ambience cosy..just my personal opinion maybe need to add more plant..green plant.but last and not least thank you for the Free complimentary dessert. Waffle Pisang Bakar Gula Melaka...we all agreed its a perfect ending for hour dinner.Overall we will be back to try other dishes..Show less

Author: bmhamzahPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best Steak.Best restaurant
Review: We decided to try this restaurant for.our last night in melaka.since every family decided to have western food for our dinner..My first impression of this restaurant is their service..We get a warm welcoming.and every staff put smile face when we entering this restaurant.The waitress very good in explaining detail about the food..We ordered wagyu steak,smoked chicken,lamb shank and pasta.almost every dish we ordered all base on recommendation..Every single dish spot on...I recommended to try their wagyu Steak..and lamb shank..I'm not a fan of the chicken but my wife said the chicken delicious pair with homemade peri peri sauce which is better than nandos claim by my wife..not to forget their waffle Pisang bakar..it's to die for.perfect ending for our dinner..I'm writing this review because of the the waitres service and the quality of the food..I can see they are genuine in serving people..I have been told the owner is the chef..No wonder the waitress keep on asking about the food to get the feed back..2 thumbs up from my familyShow less

Author: HidHermitMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cheaper alternative to high-end steak options
Review: Taste great, service excellent. Options limited due to stock availability. Price by the weight so please take note as pricing per 100gm and most steak is at least 300gm per piece. If you want wagyu at a cheaper price, this place is a good alternative. Lamb shank was so tender they require no knife, short rib tastes sweet and nice. Portobello mushroom soup was thick and creamy. Grilled chicken was juicy. Even their mashed potatoes were mouth-watering. All steak and lamb options came with free iced lemon tea and mushroom soup. The higher end steaks were upgraded to portobello mushroom soup. Ambiance was cozy and intimate.Show less

Author: AlphaYankee305
Title: BEST STEAK EVER
Review: Ever since I knew about its existence, I have been meaning to come and try it myself. Finally, I brought myself together with my wife and little kid to give it a go. Our first time dining here was wonderful, if I was not being exaggerating. The steak was on point, the chicken was not disappointing too. Props to the cook, even some other prominent steak joints could not get it right sometimes. The atmosphere was cozy, inviting. At this moment of writing, I have actually done my second visit and it was all the same experience. Lastly, you wouldn’t have to break a bank dining here. Definitely will visit more.Show less

Author: acaylarhMelaka, Malaysia
Title: THE UNIQUE WESTERN RESTAURANT 😍
Review: First time nampak Le Que restaurant nih di facebook ada keluar dia punya ads, and tonight sy decide nak dinner dekat sini. So far alhamdulillah tak rugi datang Le Que ni sbb T-bone steak yg sy order tu exactly same as in the picture that they post recently.. Rasa dia unik and sy tak pernah rasa lgi steak yg big portion, murah dan paling best skli SEDAP guyss. Their waffle pisang bakar pon seriusly superbbbest. Every single their menu was UniQue, lain drpd restaurant lain jual and lastly for me REALLY HIGHLY RECOMMENDED Show less

Author: 832syafiqsazali
Title: Excellent Food
Review:
The food is super tasty.. Price is cheap compare to what i get..

Value for money.. Premium Food with "Marhaen" (Affordable) price..

Author: syabilazman
Title: The Best Waffle in Town..
Review: We found out this restaurant from Face book advertisement.. very clean Restaurant..the menu quite different from other restaurant..We ordered spaghetti cheesy seafood i have been its new menu.Wagyu Ribeye steak and dessert we tries Choc fondue Waffle.The spaghetti Really wow me and i couldnt imagine to eat cheesy sauce with spaghetti.what i can say the sauce its a homemade not premix.While my friend had the wagyu steak,its was delicious too.its comes with free portabello mushroom soup.The bestt part t dessert Choc fondue waffle..Its suit my palate..choc fondue the portion just nice for 2-3 person.over allthe food delicious,portion Is good.Will be back again..the most important thing the restaurant asset is their staff very friendlyShow less

Author: nqssafeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The Best Restaurant in Melaka 👍🏻
Review: This is the best restaurant I ever went. Its cool, the price is cheap and affordable. I recommended you to taste their bestseller menu which is Double Cheesy Chicken, Waffle Chocolate with Marshmallow, Waffle Pisang Bakar, and one of the best dessert is Waffle Chocolate Fondue. The taste kinda delicious and yummy & if you are from another country or state you should come to this restaurant (LeQUE) and try this out. It's worth it. There are many more menus like Steak "Black Angus Sirloin", Smoked Beef Short Ribs, Lamb Shank and Charcoal Smoked Chicken. I've tried and veryyy satisfied! Seriously you should try, I'm sure you will not regret! Plus ya! I like this restaurant because their staff (Is & Echa) kinda friendly, polite and nice to their customer and also the food very scrumptious! Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food passable, service needs work
Review: The food is western fusion, leaning on steak and pasta. The setup is an ordinary shop lot, non-aircond, ambience has no specific theme.Taste: Passable to good (depending on menu). Price: here’s the clever bit. They show price of steak per 100gm so there is no telling what the final bill will end up to. They don’t give indication either; apart from “minimum 300g”. Since they accept only cash, it’s a bit of a risk. The price level does not match the ambience. Service: snail pace. We were not forewarned how long our order will take (when they knew all along what the backroom is like). We were initially served a dish we did not order (good indication of the system). Some surprises: they ran out of their popular dessert (they know its in demand). The bill: “we ran out if paper so we cant issue one” (imagine a bank saying they run out of money). Show less

Author: najmah2306
Title: Best Western Food In Malaysia and Excellent Service! Comparable to none.
Review: My family of 4 was in Malacca for 4 days and we had dinner twice and lunch once at Le Que. That speaks volume about how much we really love the food there. We tried all the pastas - cabonara, salted egg and seafood aglio olio. They were very tasty and well cooked. We also tried the smoky bbq chicken which had the perfect smoky flavour and the bbq + black pepper sauce was simply delicious. We tried thr tomahawk steak which was generous in portions and delicious. The mashed potatoes and cheesy fries were very tasty too. The cheese sauce for the fries was not the typical nacho cheese sauce you usually get in sg. Its their homemade cheese sauce which was very flavourful. The dessert, caramelised banana with ice cream amd gula melaka, was perfectly presented with the bananas beautifully caramelised and the gula melaka was authentic. I can say it was better than what I had tried in Hagen Daaz. Their milkshakes are interesting and comes with ice-cream and chocolates. Just perfect! Besides the food, I would like to also say kudos to the staff who were very attentive to our needs and always having a smile on their faces. Overall a very very good experience.Show less

Author: myrfnd
Title: Awesome n fast service
Review:
Better place for steak n Lamb at reasonable prices... Try their T bone n Lamb Shanks n Chicken n Ribs
Fast service n very hospitable n ample parking..
No Regrets.. Thanks.. Will come again

Author: Farrah Hanim M
Title: Delicious Food
Review: Food was great. portion was just nice. Environment is great and clean. Would like better if the corn is grill. Price wise is affordable for all. Overall surely will return again

Author: studio24reza
Title: Absolutely Fabulous
Review:
Absolutely Fabulous food.
Superb friendly personnel.
Value Money.
Good food portion.
Surprisingly tasty and unique..

Author: MohdShazwanM
Title: Good service
Review: Nice cuisine and friendly service, but take a long time for serving order. Reasonable price. Recommended

Author: info1almcore
Title: Awesome ambience, great taste and quantity the most important HALAL.
Review: A nice cool cafe that serves splendid food with halal compliance. The price is at the normal range.. last time I went there with the group of my friends it still within student budget range. I like their chicken teriyaki so much.

Author: sarahhamzah19Labuan Island, Malaysia
Title: Good food with good environment! Super delicious halal food. MUST TRY!!
Review: I went Melaka with my small family to celebrate my daughter's birthday. We staying there for 3nights. We found Leque for birthday celebration at 2nd night.The place quite cozy, with nice people there. The foods different than other places. They not only served western food, other foods like Mee and Nasi lemak also available. I love the drinks as well quite refreshing! Every one come to Melaka must try the foods! Highly recommend!Show less

Author: Dhia Aurora Ais... A
Title: Wonderful art design on the wall wiyh great food's taste
Review: Its a good place to have some relaxing time with friends and family . Also, the walls was full with art which i think its has very good to take picture for our memories in malacca . Soon i will bring all my friends to come here again for my next visit . To added, I loved all the foods recommended by their hostess. Show less

Author: Fazida
Title: Nice affordable fusion food
Review: Have a dinner with family here. All family member ordered different menu. Food was good and quite affordable. Nice environment.

Author: Sufiah A
Title: ok visit
Review: i pay a visit since i saw this place got plenty of good reviews. maybe they've changed their chef or something but it was totally not on par with what i paid.Show less

Author: Mohamad S
Title: Family vacation in Melaka
Review: We tried all the different types of asam pedas, nasi lemak ayam bakar, lamb chop, pisang bakar, le creme brule and oreo cheese. All were excellent. Highly recommended.

Author: FazillahBadarulKlang, Malaysia
Title: Affordable and nice environment
Review: Been attract for their nice environment for diner spot.Pronounce as "laku" is one of the halal food restaurant near jonker st.Affordable price comes with nice foodBeen trying this mussel char keuy tiaw for only RM 5.90 with teh tarik ice cost about RM 3.90 Nice place to hang out for dinerOut of the noise and great foodFriendly staff and nice outdoor placeWill drop by again in my next visitShow less

Author: JoeyJoe91
Title: Delicious dinner
Review: The atmosphere is lovely.. the food is really delicious.. everyone in my family love what they order.. the drinks are nice too.. i order a herd drink.. the taste is awesome.. definitely must visit this restaurant

Author: cmnd90
Title: Yum yum yum
Review: Amazing local cuisine at an unbeatable price. The lamb shoulder was so flavoursome, and the teriyaki was a delight. The desserts were the cherry on top! Ask for May - a wonderful hostess, who made us feel very at how at Le.Que!

Author: clarencesia
Title: Great Food!
Review: Decided to visit this restaurant after surveying online. My gf and I had a great meal. Impressed by the Chef's culinary skills. Highly recommended!

Author: Hussin_family
Title: Tasty food and excellent customer service
Review: We went to Le.QUE for dinner on Friday 18th March. It was surprisingly quiet that day. We ordered Lamb Chops, Assam Pedas Ikan Pari, Pisang Bakar, Mushroom soup and some drinks. They seriously serve perfectly cooked food and on top of that, their staff are genuinely friendly and warm.Food was so good, we decided to order more, another round of lamb chops, Assam Pedas Otak-otak and Spaghetti Aglio Olio(beef).It was a truly satisfying meal, one of the best-tasting food we've had.Please keep it up, Le.QUE :)Show less

Author: foto_melakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Ambience, Great Food
Review: I have heard a lot of good things about this restaurant/cafe although it did take quite some time for me to experience it for myself. However, one thing is for sure. It was certainly worth the visit.I have to admit that the first thing that caught my attention about this restaurant was its interior. I simply love the ambience. The interior was simple yet tastefully designed, thus giving rise to a very relaxing atmosphere...something which is important to me if I were to look for a place to relax and enjoy my cuppa.Where food is concerned, there is a wide range of delicacies available to tempt your taste bud. In short...great food and value for money.Show less

Author: FilipF320
Title: Delicious fishcake and Apple ice tea
Review: This place was really excellent! Me and my friends were recommended the fish cake special and also the Apple ice tea, not what we would have aimed for to begin with but we were very happy that we tried it! One of the best drinks I've had this while trip and fishcake was really good too. Only bad thing was a extremely salty egg that came on the side, but not a big deal of course. However we accidentally embarrased ourselves and the waiter as we reacted on salty egg so dramatically that they came over serveral times afterwards looking devastated because they thought we hated the food when we in reality really liked the dish, I mention this to further clear this up so that the people working there can understand how sorry we are for bringing about the misunderstanding. Again excellent food, and excellent service!!Best regards, three silly SwedesShow less

Author: RS D
Title: Dinner at Jonker Street
Review: I brought my family for dinner today and honestly enjoyed the food we had. Even better was the warm and friendly service!Even my fussy 9 year old daughter found something to her interest. She finished all her food.My favorite was their Assam pedas dishes. 2 thumbs up!Show less

Author: travelismycupoftea
Title: Awesome
Review: Tq le Que. Great food...value for money n nice staff esp her name is May the food planner and nice ambience

Author: Nuraini AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas Kupang
Review: I've never seen asam pedas made with kupang before here. It's pretty good - you must try asam pedas while in Melaka after all, and this gives a nice unique twist to it too. Show less

Author: razak24434Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Cosy,relaxed and really cool place
Review: I'm no food expert, but I've tried the pasta with prawns and cream sauce ... two thumbs up! Looked not much at first, but really made me stuffed :) My wife liked the garlic chicken. The kids enjoyed cream brulee and pisang bakar with ice cream.Show less

Author: driPJPetaling Jaya
Title: Hidden gem
Review: One of the very few halal restaurant in Jonker area selling local and Western delights. We tried the asam pedas pari and the pisang bakar (grilled bananas with gula Melaka).Would definitely come back for the pisang bakar.Show less

Author: AmiAziz
Title: Worth a revisit
Review: Great place to hide from the hustle. Came here with my friend, absolutely love the interior!  Great food, friendly staffs, easy to locate, price for the foods they serves is really worthy. Tasty and lots of options!

Author: leaveatraceSofia, Bulgaria
Title: Great place, food and service!
Review: I can only recommend this restaurant! The place itself is very nice and spacious. People are friendly, they greet you many times :) explain you everything from the menu, respect any additional requests you might have (for example for me, I wanted no spicy and it was really not spicy!). The food is very delicious. We went there two times. The cream sauce chicken was the best chicken I have eaten in Southeast Asia so far! And the banana-icecream desert is one of a kind! We have really enjoyed our time in the Le.QUE! Thank you! Show less

Author: 276JAMES
Title: Excellent food and friendly staff
Review: I ate the chicken signature dish followed by creme brulee and water to drink. My bill was about 30 ringit. The taste was excellent, though I found the portion size of the main meal a little small. The owner was helpful and friendly.

Author: raihana106Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Halal retaurant/cafe near Jonker Street
Review: My husband and I were here for late lunch. We ordered, lamb chop, chicken pasta and banana splilt (pisang bakar). My husband describe the lamb chop as delicious and sophisticated. The chicken pasta was delicious and the taste are really nice. The banana splilt (pisang bakar with 3 aiskrim scoop) was delicious too. For me the main highlight for this restaurant is that it is Halal and the location. It is quite hard to find this kind of restaurants that does not serves alcohol in this area. Show less

Author: Pierre G
Title: Nice option for lunch
Review: Went there for a late lunch when everything was closed nearby. We were very happy with the quality of the food and the service. Very friendly staff. They had a selection of both local and western food, we wanted to stick to the local taste and had the stew. Drinks were very nice too.Would recommend.Show less

Author: IzatSalleh
Title: Anniverssary Dinner
Review:
The food was great. The service is good. Friendly staffs and relaxing atmosphere. Thank you LeQue. Garlic Chicken & Aglio Olio + Add ons, The kitchen was accommodating the special request.

Thank you again from the bottom of my heart.

Author: SaifNaharKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food with friendly service.
Review: A lot of delicious food. We had chicken & stingray asam pedas sets with rice, garlic bread with mushroom soup, a bowl of fries, a choc cupcake with Apple of my eye & herba soda drinks for about rm60. The service was quick since were the first one in after a private event. Then ppl who come in drooves afterwards had to wait a bit longer.No kid specific meals - which can be improved for future menu, i guess. Overall, a very good experience. High on the list for a revisit.Show less

Author: amardanialsPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Simply Delicious
Review: If your stomach fancy something delicious, LeQue might be the place to fulfil your cravings.The food is freshly cooked by the chef and it's worth a try. The cooking time might be long but the food was worth the wait.Located one street after Jonker street in Melaka.Show less

Author: PerfectLucky
Title: Awesome food...so worth it
Review: Friendly and polite staff, cozy environment...we had asam pedas pari, asam pedas otak-otak, asam pedas tenggiri, chicken teriyaki pasta, garlic grilled chicken, coffee float, creme brulee, pisang bakar gula melaka (definitely must try), choc flan and cucur badak. We ate here 3 days in a row. What can i say? The food is awesome. Do come early if u plan to have dinner here. Le Que will definitely be on my go to list in Melaka.Show less

Author: SmallAndSweetShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic...must try!!
Review: Excellent food, service and ambience.... what else can you ask for!! We were wondering along Jonker street trying to find a decent halal restaurant for lunch when we bumped into Le Que. The review seemed decent hence we decided to try our luck. We had asam pedas, chicken terriyaki, coffee float and various desserts. Indeed it was awesome. We highly recommend this restaurant for simple reasons.....the food were awesome, service with a smile ..... definitely value for money. We will definitely come again whenever we are in Malacca. -- fr Shah Alam, Malaysia --Show less

Author: jon_labukl
Title: poor services compare to price..
Review: we order a simple set of meals... 1 set of asam pedas + 1 rice plate, 2 mushroom soup, 1 ice lemon tea, 1 coffee and 2 cold water at 8:50pm...they took 20 minutes to deliver the drinks...and another 20 minutes for the food... so please advice your customer if you cannot served the food on the estimate usual time...the assam pedas is still average...not worth waiting that long...Show less

Author: AzaredaniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner your way
Review: This restaurant was one in the list of my wifes to-go-while-your-in-Melaka. We came for our dinner and it was full house. Its just my wife and I waited outside for a while since there was no seat, and made it inside later on.My wife got the assam pedas mussels, while I ordered the sting-ray. A good simple portion, for me its affordable and not that pricey.Tempted to eat stingrays at the stalls along the roads, but for the ones going for halal-eatery, u can find it at this restaurant, as they also serve their western selections.Show less

Author: cokatacimalaysia
Title: If 4 table are full dont bother to drop by..
Review: We went for dinner at 9pm..we order and wait until 15 min for drinks 5 min later for soup and 10 min later for main dinner of 1 asam pedas..yup 30 mins till get serve, server inform us that due to one group came in with 4 table of 16 people they 3 cooks could not handle the orders of the western food from the group. we ask why they did not inform us beforehand..the server said one of the previous server saw us sat down and she already gave the menu to us to order.so she doesnt want to inform us...???Taste and size of food platter does not reflect the price..If u do see 4 table full in a group..dont bother to drop by..unless u dont mind waiting..Show less

Author: mmattt
Title: Lovely
Review: The food was delicious, we had an Asam Pedas with mussels and one with sting ray, both were fantastic. Service was great and the staff are really friendly. Also, really good value for money

Author: andhini p
Title: Nice to visit
Review: Find the halal meal is so difficult in Malaka, lucky we find this place. Ayam asam pedas and the dessert is so delicious. The staff is helpful and kind too.

Author: AI1980
Title: Great local food !!!!
Review: Really really good food and very friendly service. We had the speciality dish Adam padi with chicken and another one with mussels and both was excellent! As a starter we had sweet potato dumplings with prawn filling - delicious and even the mixed salad was perfect with oil and vinegar (a rare find in Malaysia) For all we paid 36 RM which is great value for this fresh, local and homemade food Show less

Author: rirismadjidBalikpapan, Indonesia
Title: I love 'Nasi Goreng Bilis'
Review: Little bit difficult to find halal's food in Malaka. I don't know, maybe i just didn't really try so hard to find it. And lucky Us to find this small cafe , that provide alot of Halal's food. One of my favorite is Nasi Goreng Bilis with half boiled egg. I really enjoy out breakfast time here. This cafe will be in my list for the next visit :) Oh ya and another value of this cafe is friendly staff :) they helped us to take a picture ^_^Show less

Author: Zainariah
Title: Jalan jalan Cari Makan
Review: Highly recomended to all.. The best assam pedas in Malacca.. I tried Chicken Terayaki.. the new menu.. and the taste was so good.. Come and try.. i m sure you will satisfy..

Author: Athirah J
Title: Lovely!!
Review: First of all.... Me and family satisfied with the services and the foods..... Start from our drinks... Main course and the last one is desserts... Everything going very well including their nice waiter.... I love their dessert... Both!! Creme brulee and peach & banana crumble pie. That was awesome!! I'm gonna come again soon.... !!! Good job Leque!! Show less

Author: RosshaSingapore, Singapore
Title: We love, love, love it here!
Review: We just finished a round at Jonker Street and was walking back at the back alley to have dinner. As my dad requires soft diet, finding suitable food for him was a bit of challenge. We entered this nice restaurant and was approached with friendly faces including the chef. We requested for soft food e.g porridge since it was not on the menu and he was so obliging to accede to our request. Atmosphere and the service is tip-top! Food tasted so good and my dad finished every single portion on his plate and especially the stingray assam pedas. We would definitely come back and try their other dishes and I believed the restaurant exceeds beyond our expectations. It is a must to whoever comes to Melaka to dine in this restaurant.Show less

Author: Jeanie LVietnam
Title: Great Malaysian food
Review: We order 2 Malaysian dishes called Pari (Stingray dish) and Otak otak (fish cake). It is fish cooked in a soup which seems to be a fish soup with some Malay ingredients. These dishes are a bit hot but not burning your tongue. Both dishes are amazing and authentic to us. We ordered creme brullee for dessert. The caramel on the top was a bit overcooked but in overal the taste is acceptable. We drapped up the lunch with a cup of kopi o. The total price plus the 2 more cokes for the lunch is quite cheap @ 43 ringgit for 2. Staff is super friendly. We would highly recommend to those looking to try the local food here.Show less

Author: David P
Title: East Meets West
Review: This snazzy little Restaurant is a pleasant surprise. Great food. Stylish presentation. The decor uses Javanese imagery, with intricate chalkboard drawings. Personal service from the staff and the owner.A sweets bar serving the NZ and Australian favourite - Pavlova!A European feel which is married with the regional culture. Oh, and even an umbrella stand.Take time to discover this treat.Btw. Is Halal.Show less

Author: diyanaalbakri
Title: Halal and nice.
Review: Halal and nice food, friendly crew, price slightly expensive. But the foods were nice. And pina colada. Didn't have the chance to eat their asam pedas and deserts as they're not ready yet. Good environment especially for family.

Author: SaufiRahim
Title: Worth a visi
Review: At first we don't even know this restaurant was exist, we found this place when we are searching for Halal food in Jonker Street from the web.From the outside, we a bit sceptical.When we go inside, it a whole other story. The staff was friendly.Superb food with great presentation.Spacious, suitable for large crowd.The only issue is to find parking space.Other than that, everything is nice.Worth my trip.Great job Le.QUE Team.Hoping you guys will survive for a long time.Semoga sukses selaluShow less

Author: arryanabila
Title: Love it
Review: The foods are so delicious, friendly owner &  the interior design is very nice! Keep it up! We ❤ LeQue 👍

Author: Maria M
Title: Awesome food and friendly environment
Review: What can be said on the food and the staff here is just expectations The food exceeded my anticpation from a restaurant hidden from the main path The hunt for this restaurant is worth it all as the treasure cuisine they serve of local and international cookery is just mouth watering and leaves you craving for more ...Kodos to the friendly statt and great service , if I am ever again melecca again here is where you'll find for sure Show less

Author: enones
Title: Great as claimed
Review: Had assam pedas for dinner . Tried the stingray and beef assam pedas. Great as it was accompanied with cincaluk. Garlic cream chicken was excellent too. Having this halal joint along Jonker Street corridor is a welcoming treat to all.

Author: Valiant78Singapore, Singapore
Title: Well worth it!
Review: Conveniently located just around the corner from our hotel. Didn't look like much from the outside but the food is great and crew was friendly. They were preparing for the arrival of a group and you can see they take great pride in making everything was set out properly.Highly recommended! Show less

Author: sophiemD8835SE
Title: Delicious food with lovely staff
Review: I went to this restaurant for dinner having read the reviews on trip advisor and was very glad I did. I had their signature chicken in a cream sauce which was absolutely delicious and came with great homemade mashed potato. For 18 ringitt it was amazing and better than most sauces in restaurants at home! The drinks were also very nice and refreshing and well priced. The staff were very attentive and helpful at recommending places to go. Some friends of mine also went and said that the local food they had was good too so I would highly recommend the restaurant! Show less

Author: asteepgradientWellington, New Zealand
Title: Great low-key hangout
Review: Lovely simple menu with a few good local dishes to try. 'Asam Pedas' with stingray was delicious! Came with lots of vegetables (which can be hard to find when eating out in Malaysia). Staff were really friendly. Good range of non alcoholic drinks. The iced apple tea is a must-try. All round good experience at a reasonable price.Show less

Author: jeank0840Seoul, South Korea
Title: Neat, Friendly, and Awesome
Review: The restaurant was neat, and its interior was unique. Every staff was very friendly, lively, and delightful. Most of all, the food was awesome, it gave me great experience to reminisce about Melaka. We recommend this restaurant that drop in and try its food when visiting Melaka.Show less

Author: Karam T
Title: Good stuff
Review: Good food and great drinks, the workers and owner are very friendly and always welcome feedback. Have nothing else to say but adding words for trip advisor's 100 characters submission.

Author: Apehal
Title: Western food the best i ever had !
Review: The food very delicious . And the owner very friendly . I fall in love with the food and the restaurant 😊

Author: Kraken5150Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It is a MUST
Review: The portions for the food was just right, and the taste was worth the Melacca trip alone. Don't have to worry about the price - it's just stupid cheap, in my opinion. You may not find a restaurant that is as welcoming in Melacca as this one - especially for the young at heart. The service represented it, and the presentation was modern yet 'quaint'. I have never sat in a restaurant for more than 2 hours, but I ended up staying for about 5 or so hours because of the simple modern artistic decor... and of course ordering the 'Air Soda Herba' about 5 times (or was it 7 times). I don't know what is it about the food but it made me go "Shut up, just take my money." - In a very very good way, that is. Will recommend, and have recommended, and will always come to dine whenever I step foot in the historic land of Melacca. Thanks for the hospitality and the presentation #Le.QueShow less

Author: AsmawiABAZ
Title: Simply the best! Halal & worth it to try out!
Review: My family love this place especially my three daughters.. grill food superb and the side dishes make it more perfect! Clean place, comfortable and got unique wall decoration! Definitely recommended to all! Well done chef yem and the team! 👍👍👍👍

Author: CloudyMarvelLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious traditional food and warm service
Review: This delightful cafe is well worth a stop while you're in Melaka. I had a tasty and spicy fish stew, followed by an excellent sago dessert (tapioca pearls with coconut and brown sugar). Service was attentive and friendly throughout and the cafe is a very chilled-out place. As a bonus it's close to the river and attractions like the Baba Nyonya Museum and 88 Heeren Street. Enjoy!Show less

Author: 762pimv
Title: Great food and very kind service
Review: We had nice Malaysian food at this restaurant. The service was really good, the hostess was very kind to us and wanted to know if everything was nice. All the staff where very polite. Would definitely go back there.

Author: hafsah2k
Title: Awesome food
Review:
Very friendly staff and fast service.
Food super tasty and in good quantity. Walking distance to Jonker Street. A bit difficult to find a parking spot

Author: nienaf2015
Title: Awesome!
Review: It's a very nice place to dine in with family or friends. At affordable prices, you can enjoy the delicious food especially the famous Two Ways Chicken Garlic Cream. It's a must visit restaurant if you're in Melaka!

Author: Aldoaldo164Bad Vilbel, Germany
Title: Outstanding pasta and impeccable service.
Review: One of my favorite restaurants in all of Southeast asia. Waiters speak very good English and give you a lot of information about the food. I spent 20 ringit on a drink, a big plate of (some of the best) chicken pasta (I've ever had) and a dessert. Definitely worth checking out!Show less

Author: Najatusyima S
Title: Dissapointed with Stiff and salty pasta
Review: -Nice and friendly staff.-Drinks was superb. Asam boi soda with serai ★★★★-My fiancee cant swallow thier salted egg pasta.-It is too salty! Its like someone pour a bottle of salt in it.(alert that the ingredients is salted egg.but please taste the food first before launching your new menu to a cust)-they used angel hair pasta for thier menu,and the pasta was extremly hard to bite and once i cant swallow it too.maybe they want to be fast,and not boiled the pasta properly. So we only have a drink there and left our plate as same as they serve it to us. Sorry but wont coming there again for foods.Show less

Author: rosiedahh
Title: Nice ambient, good food
Review: Went there with my family. Found the place by chance n luckily I've checked Tripadvisor earlier on for places to eat. When I saw it, straightaway told my family bout the pastas there. Decided to sit outside where nobody was sitting there n it was really nice n cosy. Ordered spicy beef n salted egg pasta n honestly I'm not a fan of salted egg. To my surprise, I finished up the whole thing. Lamb chop was well recommended too as the meat was tender. To the manager@supervisor, Thanks for your frequent visits to our table as she was worried that the service was slow n no one attending to our able as we were sitting outside. Well recommended n I will definitely come again when I'm in town. Show less

Author: narsclawKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: It was the Labour day weekend and Jonker St was packed. Internet connection was crappy maybe due to the crowd. With very limited halal food options nearby and hungry stomachs, we were looking forward to try le.que after it came back as a result from Google. When we arrived around 3 plus ish, we could see there were staff inside but there was no indication whether the restaurant was closed or open as there was no signage. No operating hours either. We tried knocking but they couldn't hear us so we decided to rest and sit outside the restaurant. Just as we were about to leave, one of the staff came and opened the door and he let us in. We were relieved thinking that we would finally be getting some food. He gave us the menus and we ordered even though we thought that it was weird that the menu didn't have assam pedas or lamb stew as mentioned on the internet which people were raving about. 10 minutes after taking the order, the same staff who let us in and handed the menus, apologized and mentioned that the owner went back thus they couldn't serve us food. We were puzzled and confused nonetheless and left taking our empty stomachs with us.Show less

Author: mayzatulakmarm
Title: Great Pasta
Review: First time i walk into this restaurant...i wanted to had pasta...i really love to eat Aglio but in this restaurant they only serve Aglio Prawn n Mushroom...i cant take prawn...but i dont feel regret bcoz the Chef volunteer to make a special Aglio menu for me...he had suggest me to have Aglio Beef....it is really satisfied me n so great...i love it and really...really love it...that was the beautiful moment i had at Le.QUE...the chef owesome n the food serve so good with the beautiful plating presentation...tq Le.QUE im really satisfied....Show less

Author: Nur I
Title: Great halal food
Review: They have 2entrances, one at the back facing casa del rio and one in front of artisan loft if i'm not mistaken. The place is very simple and cozy. Love the food especially chicken teriyaki spaghetti & assam pedas. For any customer who wants halal food, this is the place you should dine in as there are lack of halal restaurants around this area. Great place to have gathering as well. Love love loveShow less

Author: phia113Melaka State, Malaysia
Title: not satisfied
Review: I'm from melaka and I think it's great there is a halal restaurant in jonkers street but unfortunately my first visit there was a disappointment. I just ordered the herb soda and a creme brulee because I wanted to try out the restaurant, I was alone at that and it wasn't majorly full but the service was so so slow and the creme brûlée was not even cooked properly. It took them 45 minutes just to get my soda and creme brûlée, On the plus side the owner's mum was a friendly lady. I'm not a tourist so if their service was good they would have had a regular customer. I'm sorry to say I won't be coming here again.Show less

Author: Lieya21
Title: Food
Review: The food is awesome plus the spaghetti very nice especially the sauce..really love it..recommend place to come.. 😊😊

Author: SamirBHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome!!
Review: Me and a group of friends were just walking around the alley, and we saw this 'pantun' (poem in Malay) hanging outside the cafe. It was just annoyingly funny and we decided to drop by and the consider having lunch there or not.When we entered, it was just cosy. We wanted some good ol' rice, but unfortunately, the cafe was out of dishes for rice. They had just Asam Pedas to go with rice. One of us decided to go with that. The other four of us decided to have some 'Western', and I went with the Teriyaki Chicken Pasta, and a good cool cup of iced honey lemon tea.Serving came after some time, considering the place seemed to be understaffed. But when it came, boy was it good! We even joked about pretending to be food tasters/bloggers, to perhaps get good food for free, but dang! We spotted a TripAdvisor decal on the front door of the cafe. Lol!Overall, the place serves good food. You just gotta distract yourself while waiting for the food to arrive, probably browsing through your photographs or something. If the cafe owners are reading this, you have an awesome menu. Do not waste it with below-par services. You have very friendly staff and we can see they're doing their best, but hopefully next time the dishes are all ready, and get that fresh juice machine up and running!In any case, keep it going!Show less

Author: Moon_hmz
Title: Alright
Review: Had a satay nasi goreng and also asam pedas. The food tasted salty to me, but my husband said it was ok. He liked the asam pedas, said it had a nice texture.

Author: saddiqsuhailaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Brilliant!
Review: We stayed at the Calanthe loft just opposite the restaurant and decided to to have lunch there. Best decision during our stay in Melaka. Food was great (Fried Vegetarian Pasta, pumpkin soup, 2 way chicken), wish we could have seconds. Co-owner (Wan) was incredibly friendly and patient. We were impressed by his genuine love for the city when overhearing his conversation with other patrons.We loved the food so much we decided to have supper there that very night. This time, we had lamb chop which was great too although it could be slightly more tender. We also recommend the herbal soda.We wish LeQue success and sincerely hope we'll get to visit again and try other (and maybe new) dishes!Show less

Author: Oliver K
Title: superbe
Review: It is amazing what you get for the Money at this place. The staff is really nice, the ambience is nice as well, they are really quick and the Food is just really tasty, can only recommend this place

Author: SorinBuCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Tasty and relaxing
Review: We have ordered 2 dishes, one signature dish which is Gulai kawan with white rice, and chicken teriyaki. Both were delicious and the people around also seemed to fully enjoy their food. The staff was also very friendly and answered our questions about local food with a luxury of details. The place itself was clean and relaxing, enough space between tables, nice music in the background. Happy with the choice.Show less

Author: ZARJMiri, Malaysia
Title: Melaka need more Halal restaurant like this
Review: The staff that serve us really make this restaurant look like a 5 star hotel service. Keep up the good job bro. Give him a raise.The plating for your food is not something you expect on the a restaurant look like this. It's amazing.Come to KL and open a restaurant here. I'll rate this restaurant as 5 star with 5 star service.Show less

Author: syifa n
Title: Cheap, delicious, good ambiance and HALAL!
Review: It's hard to find halal food in Jonker Street, Melaka. I've been rejected 3 times by restaurants (because it's non halal and i'm wearing hijab) before i finally found LeQue. My friend and I saw the "HALAL" sign at the back side of the restaurant. It looks small and not very convincing at first but we already starved so we enter the restaurant anyway. We just realized that we're coming from back door when we enter the building. And turns out it's a very nice restaurant with cozy ambiance and a very friendly staff. They gave us detail info about the menu and answer our question patiently. When the dishes come out, i must say that i'm grateful that i got rejected from other restaurant, the food was sooo delicious! This one is a very recommend restaurant to go to when you're in Melaka.Show less

Author: YanaJoe11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Its HALAL
Review: the food is very delicious and cheap. the most important is that its halal. around jongker walk is hard to find halal food. no alcohol drink were in the menus. the service is the best as the staff is really friendly. they serve asian western n some malaysian food in their menu of the day. highly recommended. worth every cent you pay. n not to forget try the herb soda. its delicious.Show less

Author: PutriYobymiciJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Halal restaurant
Review: when i come to malacca, made me confuse. Not easy to find halal restaurant in here.So when we walk, i see "halal restaurant". And i come and try this restaurant.See the menu, in my heart just say "oh my God, western food?" Made me want get out from this restaurant.But when the staff come and explain the menu, ok i try this resto.And i choose 'chicken with creamy sause'.This menu really delicious and i like it.Salad with olive oil, and creamy sause it's good.Show less

Author: jhoye
Title: outstanding service!
Review: The crew is well informed of their dishes-very accommodating. The plating is instagram-friendly; the dish is also not disappointing. Thumbs up!

Author: Malaysiantraveller68
Title: Hope to return for a meal
Review: This time, we just dropped in for a snack and drink. Would recommend the herbal soda and the pumpkin soup was good too. Hope to try their assam pedas and other mains on a future trip to Malacca.

Author: Zarinanurzali
Title: Satisfied and happy customer
Review: Great cafe, just had our drinks. Soda cola, Milo awake and soda herb! Love em all. Definitely coming here again for its food. People are very warm and helpful. Need more of this kinda restaurant in Malaysia!

Author: LiyanaMN91Putrajaya, Malaysia
Title: worth first try!
Review: it is a very nice and calm place... simple decoration and lot of space too, not too crowded... i love the simple decoration^^, the people were nice too:D i don't remember the girl's name, but she kept smiling and be patient with us when taking order... about the food, i've had asam pedas and it's was delicious! the best asam pedas in malacca i ever taste! why? because it suits me well:) i love the kuah to be pekat;p the fish texture also good, smooth and not smelly... keep up your good job, le que!! will come back here if i'm visiting malacca again:)Show less

Author: AyueAzahari
Title: a really good service
Review:
the food was very tasty 
and plus the service was really great. such a place for relaxing and maybe its suited for couple as well.

Author: Surianie AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: simply great food
Review: Tumbs up for food n presentations at LeQue. The food I tried was the asam pedas ikan tenggiri n lamb chop. Both taste good. Even the salad served with the lamb chop n the mashed potato was good too. Not forgetting the desserts, I loved the cream brulee and cannot get it out of my mind. Not bad for a young chef . Very friendly and warm services makes you feel welcomed. The prices of food was suprisingly cheap. Very proud to see young malaysians putting their efforts to be in food business. Bravo, keep it up u guys. Can't wait to go back to LeQue.Show less

Author: CherryjubileeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Le Sedap but Le Lambat @ Le Que
Review: Nice arty café serving halal Malaysian and Western dishes, across from Calanthe Art Studio and Prive and on the same street as the Heeren Hotel and Gingerflower Boutique Hotel.Food is reworked Malaysian and Western e.g. fried rice with satay (about RM15), pastas and salmon steak (about RM23). Dishes were tasty, nicely seasoned but salmon was overcooked and dry. Agonisingly long wait for dishes which should be simple to cook, but these could be due to teething problems despite a near-empty cafe. Long list of drinks - had the bandung syrup with whipped cream, which was quite delectable but not outstanding. Wait staff very friendly and pleasant.Overall nice experience. Would go back and try something else if in neighbourhood.Show less

Author: jacinth2014Singapore, Singapore
Title: Serving Delicious Food and Over the Top Service level!
Review: We ate here on November 30th, 2014. It's not too crowded because it was at the back of the main Jonker street(If my sense of direction correct(lol). This restaurant is a good choice because they are open until 12 midnight. We got too hungry and couldn't find shops that offer restaurant food at 10 pm near the lively Jonker street and found this place because of its rather interesting sign " Eat here or we'll both starve".The food presentation is very pleasing and the table wares they use are China. For tea loving people, they use fresh leaves and one pot is good for two people and you can ask for a refill.Summing it up, good food, great service and a relaxed environment makes an excellent chomping experience.Show less

Author: K SHue, Vietnam
Title: Amazing food, great price
Review: I was hungering for some western food and came across this restaurant. They serve both local and western cuisine and when I found something on the menu that I wanted, I stepped inside. The waiter was very courteous and my food came out more quickly than I expected. I ordered the lamb chops and wow! It was delicious! There were two large pieces of meat, delicious mashed potatoes and a light salad to the side. Every item on the plate was well-balanced in flavor and complimented the other parts of the dish.The best part of the meal was the price. 19 ringgit for lamb chops! Where I come from the meal could have easily cost almost one hundred ringgit. Highly recommend for the price, taste, and the service.Show less

Author: Peshaloo
Title: #LeQue aka Hang Lekiu
Review: Nice and cozy place to hangout after long walk around jonker walk. All I can say is try it and you know it.

Author: megaustraliaaustralia
Title: Unexpected Service level
Review: Staying in nearby Gingerflower Boutique Hotel, I needed a top up after eating way down on the river. The beef curry was excellent. Hubby contemplated the carrot cake, then thought he had dec ided to watch his waistline and declined. The carrot cake arrived just the same, and was delicious. A perfect top up for both of us. They deserve the comments from Aimi K and jlowtpShow less

Author: Aimi K
Title: Great Meals!
Review: Love the foods here. Western or Asian dishes, tried a few especially the Chicken cream sauce and the asam pedas tenggiri. Variety beverages and healthy too! Not to forget the cakes, cheesecake chocolate cake, carrot cake with a bigger portion for 2-3 person to share.

Author: Sylvia P
Title: A hidden gem in Jonker street
Review: A nice and cosy ambiance,  warm and friendly staff, good tasty food with reasonable price. A must go place if you were in Jonker street.  Thumbs up to one of the young owner, Izuan with his warmest hospitality. Will definitely recommend it to friend.

Author: cravingstars
Title: A great awesome meal
Review: A very best place to eat at jongker. They served great tasty of food and friendly services. I tried the carbonara beef, with a creamy texture of cream..yummy. Another dish is grilled salmon, and the gulai kawah which my friends ordered. i think the gulai kawah is their signature meal, recommended to try. For the salmon, is serverd with large grilled salmon and you can get it with a decent price. The restaurant was simple and nice. Last but not least we had our creme brulee.Will definitely will come here again to try moreShow less

Author: adammukrizMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: A place not to be missed in Melaka.
Review: Its a.lovely diner....We enjoyed the time spent at this restaurant very much..The ambience was nice with simple.deco..They have a open kitchen which u can see what the Chef cooking..:) We were greet by friendly staff ..we feel.welcoming...We were recomended to try their local.food ..but the local food very limited..we decide to order aglio prawn and asam.pedas...I love the presentation of asam.pedas very much..they serve it in tajine..Aglio prawn-its taste so good..I found its quite unique..a little bit different taste from.the aglio i used to eat..Asam.pedas...very to our liking..Not to spicy..just nice..highly recomended...We even got to talk with the chef and we found out they just open the restaurant for 1 month..a new restaurant must visit if u in jonker...Its definitely a place which i ll be visiting again soon..Show less

Author: naren d
Title: Marvelous
Review: We tried the asam pedas ikan tenggiri and asam pedas ikan pari and it tasted superb.Eating the spaghetti carbonara also gave our palette a wonder of taste.It is a place we would recommend for anyone who wants to feel at home.The shop is very clean the staff themselves are very friendly.The shop is simple but pretty.Although the shop is quite difficult to find but it was worth the search.Show less

Author: MagicMaguroKuala Lumpur
Title: Delicious authentic Asam Pedas made with love
Review: As per title, the Asam Pedas is delicious, as is the carbonara. The place is opened by two lovely guys, one of whom is the chef who makes your meals with love. Top quality flatware and silverware to boot! Worth your time and money. It would be a good idea to ask them for daily recommendations before placing your order.Show less

Author: Angie KKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service, decent food.
Review: With 3 kids with ages from 7 to 17 in tow, my husband & I had to make a fast and good decision as to where to have a late lunch within walking distance. Jonkers St was full of tourists, so going there was out. We walked towards Casa del Rio and found 2 off white boxes outside a normal looking cafe with equally normal looking laminated menus on top. CARBONARA! Finally, my picky eaters' favourite food! We walked in, it was slightly cool yet slightly humid. Maybe it was late b'cos we were the only patrons there. It was good as we received very personalized service and not so good since some dishes were sold out.Decor - very basic and kinda bare. No pictures nor any display of dishes.Food - I personally like the asam pedas ikan pari, not too pedas, just right. My husband's lamb stew had that right amount of smell & taste which was not too strong. As usual my kids went for pasta. We finished up with chocolate lasagna which was pretty decent.Yes, I would eat there again on my next trip to Melaka. By then I hope to see more of the tradisional nyonya style desserts like ondeh-ondeh, putu piring and otak-otak. No doubt we can get those at nearby Jonkers but then why would I want to go into that crowded area when I can have it brought to me in comfort especially when it's too hot or wet outside.Show less

Author: Robin L
Title: Out of the world
Review:
Awesome is the word...
You should go try it. Bring lotsa people, friends, relatives and etc. Asam pedas fish is crazy... Try people try.

Author: athirahfoodlover
Title: I love #LeQUE with its nice servicw n food
Review: I went #LeQUE on september 7th 2014.. What can i say about this restaurant is i love it... Easy to find... Near jonker walk... Hehe by the way.. I really love their creme brulee n asam pedas ikan pari...taste good.... Yummy... n the price is reasonable...Nice food..nice view n nice services..... U guys.... Should try... Coz i satisfied with it Show less

Author: doremon2014Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: new vibe in jonker walk
Review: it's hard to find halal food around jonker walk. but when i come across calanthe house, i saw this new restaurant and decided to give it a try. even though the deco is still minimal for newbie restaurant, but the food is quite awesome. i fall in love with their lamb stew & CSO cheese cake. they also serve asam pedas. will come again soon.Show less

Author: paiki1
Title: Not worth visiting.
Review: Foods is so so, price is expensive and dishes serve in small portion.Restaurant is very quiet, no customer.Shop cleanliness is okay.Difficuot to find parking, quite a distance for walking to the restaurant.During this pendamic time still expecting Singapore customer to walk in?Show less

Author: Angela S
Title: Ok food
Review: Our hotel recommended us to visit this restaurant. It was ok, nothing to write home about. It was served hot but like all Malaysian foods so far always on the bone! We visited Restoran Ole Sayang which was by far more superior.

Author: eatdrinkstayBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great experience
Review: We were recommended this hotel by a guide and she was right it’s excellent. Jimmy welcomed us to a table, he was great fun and explained the menu to us. He was very proud and loved that we picked a chicken dish with a unusual nut in it that he was able to demonstrate how to eat which made the whole experience interesting fun and above all the most delicious food. We had beers and felt it was the best meal we had so far on this holiday . We did not feel it was expensive but if it did cost a little more it was well worth it, very clean throughout and lovely kind friendly service . If I was here longer I would return with out hesitation. Show less

Author: Neil D
Title: Excellent
Review: This is a lovely restaurant with delicious food and helpful and friendly staff. Jimmy helped us to choose the dishes that were not too spicy and was an all together excellent host. Highly recommended

Author: cpr2exssydney
Title: Quality Peranakan food
Review: Restaurant is close to St Peters church and we came here after evening Mass. quality food with unusual offerings- kacang botor with sambal. Udang Lemak Nanas was amazing! Ayam buah keluak was also very good. Their sago gula melaka is also of a very high standard. Highly recommended! Show less

Author: Tee A
Title: Less than ideal nonya food
Review: Went there with a group of 8. Were disappointed with most of the dishes. This is definitely not an authentic nonya food place and it contradicts with most of the reviews I read here.I would say this restaurant offers dishes of what a typical nonya restaurant served, that's all.Show less

Author: eddyphdhong
Title: excellent traditional restaurant
Review: my first dinner was perfect in this restaurant. fish. vegetables. prawns curry. coconut jelly desert. great and kind restaurant

Author: carollai4393Kuching, Malaysia
Title: THE BEST NYONYA FOOD THAT I HAVE TRIED IN MELAKA
Review: Very nice food that we ordered from MANIS J NYONYA and my favourite dish is SAMBAL PETAI SQUID and they really provide a very good service and all of them are so friendly especially the owner , Miss Jennifer...thank you for all the nice food in your restaurant and all the nice food really get rid of my tiredness and bring back my happiness.Show less

Author: mwestlanWarsaw, Poland
Title: Good food close to the Magistic
Review: Restaurant is located a few minutes walk from the hotel the Magistic. The food had very good taste. The place is clean and the owners are nice people. Very convienient place for people who want to eat outside the hotel and not walk to far away. Show less

Author: Roger H
Title: The best food in Melaka
Review: One of the best food experiences I have ever had. Home cooking to handed down family recipes that deliver endless taste sensations. An absolute gem, almost worth travelling to Melaka for this food alon.

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not the best nyonya food in Melaka
Review: This is a nyonya restaurant which we decided to visit out of convenience. We ordered food for our group of 7. Some of the food we ordered include otak-otak, chicken buah keluak, chap chai, fried fish with chili (Ikan goreng chili garam), asam prawns, cuttlefish in sambal petai, fishball soup & kacang botol stir fried with chili. Generally the food was only satisfactory. The best dish was the fried fish in chili & the otak-otak. Acceptable nyonya food but there are better ones out there.Show less

Author: ContentedTraveller51
Title: Fantastic Food
Review: We ate at this restaurant last night and were very pleasantly surprised at the quality and taste of the food - excellent! We will return this evening and sample some different dishes. Highly recommended.

Author: 487michelle
Title: Great food
Review:
Staff were very friendly and helpful with suggestions of the best dishes to order.
Food was excellent and plenty of it.
Great place to eat.

Author: kenjoo_82
Title: Nyonya food melaka
Review: Is a business trip with 8 pax of us. Looks hygiene with glass partition between kitchen and sitting area. To show confidence to the customers that their hygienist. Food serve to the table consider fast and taste good as well.

Author: SFT118
Title: Not crowded
Review:
Friendly owner who served us and recommended few of their signature dishes. 

Loved the spicy squid with petai (sticky beans) of the 6 dishes we ordered.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: just average...
Review: Located near Jonker. Popular with tourist & groups. Simple layout, air conditioned. Service is a hit & miss. Rather pricey.We tried their otak otak, friend chicken, spicy fried rice, kangkung belacan, cincalok omelette, prawn sambal, asam pedas fish, pie tee & chicken lobak. All were average at best. Asam pedas was rather weak, no kick to the gravy. Only highlight would be the lentil crackers as appetizers.Wouldn't recommend unless you are nearby & looking for a meal.Show less

Author: BillyH516Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice authentic peranakan food
Review: We tried two dishes, Ayam Buah Keluak and Petai with prawn as we are familiar with these two dishes, and they are really good (there are only 2 of us, cannot order too much). Do take note that lunch is up to 3pm and dinner will start at 6pm.Show less

Author: W6135UKjanesMalaysia
Title: Excellent nyonya food
Review: Chose this restaurant after reading lots of positive reviews. My family and I were not disappointed. It is a great little restaurant, family run. The waiter was friendly and gave recommendations and information about some of the dishes. We chose a selection of spicy dishes (for the adults) and non spicy dishes (for the children). All were delicious. Show less

Author: Magdalene TSingapore
Title: Fantastic Food
