Author: lavanian2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Author: 95lawrencenWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Buzzing and Inexpensive
Review: If you are looking for plush decor and sophisticated ambiance, this is not for you. If you want to feel the real atmosphere, here it is! Not only is the food good, but this restaurant (frequented by local people - a good sign) is the absolute best value for money I think I've ever encountered.Show less

Author: zalnikor

Review: Favorite place for the locals. Inexpensive tasty Indian food. Thought was a vegetarian restaurant but it's not.   Though there are enough choices for vegetarians. Gets 4 stars because of cheap prices.

Author: royrr121Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Experience dictates that where
Review: Experience dictates that where locals of different races, outstation visitors and tourists comes regularly to this particular restaurant for breakfast and lunch does say a lot about the place itself. Serving South-Indian food, It is clean, airy and they are quite prompt in their services. The pricing is reasonable and the food is good. Be prepared to do the ‘waiting time’ as it can get packed over the weekends .. Show less

Author: Sherry U
Title: Very inexpensive but delicious
Review: Very inexpensive but delicious food. Great selection. It’s clearly a spot that locals love and it gets busy    I had the set vegetarian lunch and was very happy with my meal.

Author: hsf8
Title: Eat here
Review: Highly recommended. Onion rawa thosai was delicious. Regular thosai, apam, and nasi lemak were very popular with other diners.

Author: andysS5067JZ
Title: Authentic food and atmosphere
Review: Food here is served on a banana leak on he table. Dal, curry, raita served from large pots then rice piled on with sambhar. The only place ive eaten lke this before was India itself!. We also had tandoori fish piece and chicken paratha served with coconut and tomato chutneys. Delicious. And all less than MR25!Show less

Author: 960laurencecNagoya, Indonesia
Title: Banana leaf meal
Review: It serves the best banana leaf meal with free flow of rice & sauces, pappadomg & vegetables. You only pay for the extra meat or drinks you ordered. The food is just delicious & yummy, white rice soft as well. Price reasonable. Place is always packed even when I was there at 2:30pm. The staff are friendly keep moving around to serve the free flow food. A must visit if you love banana leaf meal.Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service
Review: We visited on account of rave reviews and the TA sticker the place earned. As Im from Subang, I wanted to rate the place against Nirwana and Kanna, two of recommended banana leaf establishments in Subang. My verdict: those 2 fare better. But if ur in Melaka craving for banana leaf fare, no doubt that Selvam is your place. They have an array of dishes and reasonably priced. Their chai tea however is too richly brewed. Do ask for hot water if u prefer milder version. Upside: polite waiters and cashier. Downside: parking is a bane. There is one at Tabung Haji around the corner pass the Public bank.Show less

Author: justinrZ3902URMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good food, the rest needs to improve
Review: Just arrived in Melaka and this restaurant was five minutes away. Thought I'd give it a go since they had vegan options.The staff seemed to be uninterested in everything around them and even dismissive of my desire to dine in.The food itself was great and a nice change of pace from Singapore where anything under ten dollars is probably fast food or not very good.Cleanliness could use some work. There were ants on the counter when I paid.Show less

Author: Shakey39
Title: Cheap tasty Indian street food
Review: Open little restaurant serving a small menu of extremely cheap Indian street food. Have eaten here a couple of times. Naans are good and so are the stuffed rotis. Tandoori chicken is served in big portions but is a bit dry.

Author: Denzel L
Title: DISAPPOINTED
Review: Food getting from bad to worst...dal & spinach served were tasteless. Other family members & friends also complaint the same. Would stop patronage this place once & for all if food were found to be inferior in quality come the next visit.

Author: SowDep
Title: A good tosai time !
Review: I had a lovely time at Selvam this Sunday evening tasting a delicious masala tosai and a banana tosai but I'll be back for the appam !! Thank you so much for the delicious food !

Author: BeniYianni
Title: Cheap street food

Author: thaddaiosy
Title: Cheap and delicipus
Review: Simple restaurant, with delicious food and quick service. Nice and clean too! We had many of the paratha/roti/tosai and all lovely.

Author: CIXINTEOH
Title: Good food but impatience service

Author: walkabout_00147

Author: Captaindanush

Author: sukravathanees

The service also excellent two young guy were in blue served us and they were so joyful and friendly.I would recommend to go to this place the food were so tasty especially the brinjal that served as one of the vegetableShow less

Author: tigerprawn100India

Title: Good food

Author: David SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic Indian cuisine, bustling atmosphere
Review: Selvam is situated across the river from Chinatown and slightly off the tourist track so its clientele is overwhelmingly local. It comprises one large high-ceilinged room with open kitchen in the corner, more like a market place than proper restaurant. Although we were offered menus, essentially what was on offer were three different vegetable curries served with rice on a freshly washed segment of banana leaf. This could be supplemented by small plates of meat or fish dishes chosen from a tray brought to the table. If you are squeamish about eating with your hands this is not for the place for you. The food was pretty tasty and overall we really enjoyed our experience here: it was certainly extraordinarily good value.Show less

Title: Awesome veggie Indian!! On the banana leaf

Author: 194FaridehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious and exciting
Review: First of all, I just read some if the reviews and was very sad and displeased by some biased opinions, written without any consideration to the quality of this restaurant. Personally, I know this restaurant for more than 6 years and sometimes we go there for a succulent 100% pure indian food.I always try to write objectively, so help me God, and usually, I dont give too much stars for Indian restaurants in Melaka because the majority of them are unhygenic. However, this one, is far far better than the other Indian restaurants in this city. Why I say biased opinion? Becsuse this restaurant has been selected and elected as one of the best Indian food restaurants in Melaka. This means that inspectors and food connoisseurs have given points to it. And with reason...!! The food is very very good. But, according to Melaka standards and not to Kuala lumpur's standards, we have to say that. The lication is situated just opposite Junker street, near Bandhara street, where Little India finishes. It is a few meters away from the Saint Francis Xavier's Church, near a square, with hundreds of pigeons, waiting to be fed...Your plate is a banana leaf and a lady comes aling with various recipients in her hand and pours you strange dishes, multicolored, some spicy, some non spicy and then another one clmes alongg with a big trolley, offering you beef plate, chicken plate ir fish plate, with all kinds of food made with dough, which are some kinds of dumplings, either with potatoes or onions or chicken or spicy vegetables. You have dozens of choice, in your food predilection and each plate is different from that of your neighbor, because you are offered numerous choices. The four or five different food the lady offers you, on your bana leaf are stupendous! Sometimes, I get so excited by the taste and texture and spices that I start to smile and/or read happily by such generous exhibition of delicious food! And my husband looks happy at my happiness and soon returns to his own delicious culinary preoccuption, with a red sweaty face, because of his choice of spicy food, and this time, it is I who smile at him. The chairs and tables are very simple, everything is quite old, but My...! What delicious and fresh food, can you find there! I have gone various times to check upon the cleanliness of the kitchen or washroom and each time, i have come bavk satisfied to my table. The kitchen is big and the cleaning and washing of forks and spoons is done in the correct, orthodox way, and nobody is doing a dirty business there, in hiding. The prices are NOT expensive at all, unlike some of the reviews I have read. They have not been just and fair. And the staff ate extremely hospitable and smiling. Especially the two or three Indian ladies who are the owners and who behave according to Indian hosputality. And it has won so many Hourmet prizes, which you can see for yourselves, and which means, there surely must be somethi g here, folks, to have made this restaurant become the yearly winner of best Indian restaurant, no? Go and eat your lunch there, with a secure heart! Show less

Author: pathmini r
Title: Try the Friday special.
Review: We went to selvam as a group of 20. The Friday special Vege & Non Vege was awesome. The best ever tried. I think others should come and try their food items with reasonable price. Their staffs welcoming was excellent. Suitable for all race's and its halal. Thanks to the owner Ms Angeline Selvam and her team.Show less

Author: Lovely Ray Trav... S
Title: Horibal and expensive
Review: We went for a meal and the mutton was horibal and we had to pay 47 for 2 of us. Service was not to my expection and the shop was not clean .

Author: SurinBalwinderjitKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just Average
Review: We had an Indian breakfast of Rawa tosai and Ghee tosai served with dhall and 2 types of chutney. Taste was average. We also ordered a plate of mutton varuval but was disappointed as the some mutton pieces were tough and chewy while others were tender due to uneven cooking. Plus point ... the restaurant was clean and waiters were attentive.Show less

Author: slackilaaliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Truly delicious South Indian food
Review: If you want to try a honest and satisfying Chettinad unlimited meal then this is a place to be. The place is decently clean and simple but dont judge based on the place. The food is heavenly and tastes like homemade food cooked with lots of love. For 2 pax unlimited meals with 2 sets of non veg we paid a decent price of Rm 24. Show less

Author: karlvintherAssens, Denmark
Title: Great value for money
Review: Selvam is all you want from a restarant. It is tasty and well prepared food for small money. The naan bread is exelent and it all come with a smile. We had tandori chicken, fried rice and naan bread.With carrot juice.34 ringit.The place has a lot of locals as guests and is genuien Malaisian. Go there. You will not be disapointed.Show less

Author: Tomás C
Title: Try the banana leaf!!!
Review: Excellent food, great service. The banana leaf is really tasty no matter which option you choose. No problem asking for extra rice/veg/sauce

Author: GopivnHanoi, Vietnam
Title: Decent Banana leaf meal
Review: On a hot day, after a visit to the tourist spots was craving for South Indian food. Three of us went to this restaurant and it was jam packed. Luckily within 10 minutes got a table and we had a nice banana leaf meal, which was denitely decent enough. Me and my wife were vegetarians n our friend who is a non-vegetarian, also informed us that he thoroughly enjoyed his spread. Would definitely return on our next visitShow less

Author: dan0mi
Title: Clean, friendly good food
Review: We had the banana leaf set menu. It was super filling & delicious! Going back for lunch today, been daydreaming of it all morning! The staff was super friendly which is a nice bonus too!

Author: noahp876
Title: Tasty, cheap vegetarian
Review: Love the South Indian food of Malaysia. This place doesn’t disappoint. Don’t let the naysayers fool you, eat with the locals and have good food and fun.

Author: Mark R
Title: Best Breakfast
Review: Excellent roti, tosai, dahl and condiments. Good service. Fresh, clean and central! Roti telur (egg) is a favourite as is the pisang (banana) roti. Kopi not as good as others in Melaka, but the Marsala tea was tops!

Author: Prasad_Nadkarni
Title: Awesome place
Review:
The restaurant is centrally located near the tourist area. We tried string hoppers, rava dosai and masala tea. The staff member was extremely courteous and the service was pretty quick.

Quality of the food was excellent and our first experience was pleasant.

Author: Enkidu-backpackerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Creepy staff, good tandoori,bad naan, good price
Review: We visited for tandoori and cheese Nan. Tandoori came first, quite small bit looked really good and great taste. Green sauce was quite watery. Then naan came, plain Nan! When I had asked for cheese Nan. I returned it back and then cheese naan came with just little cheese in center. Staff didn't even bother to take order but when we were going to pay, he was looking inside my shopping bag exploring my stuff with his eyes which was really rude and creepy!Show less

Author: zulfirman erosw... SMedan, Indonesia
Title: Good for breakfast
Review: Im indonesian, who loves to eat rice at morning. And Selvam has a good Nasi Lemak, with boiled egg as topping and covered with banana leaf.Ordered hot Teh Tarik as beverages gives a good combination. Breakfast at Selvam makes a good start for a day.Show less

Author: Jane C
Title: Not got what you paid for? Best excuse ever!
Review: I have eaten at the Selvam restaurant many times and always had excellent food. Today however, I decided to treat myself to the Friday Special - 11 curries plus rice served on a banana leaf. The meal included a small cup of soup, a cup of buttermilk and a small sweet for a desert.The waiter was delivering the cups of soup and milk to everybody else but kept avoiding me, even when I directly asked him for mine twice.I questioned this at the cash register to be told first that they had no soup or buttermilk. I pointed to the tables. OK, but you ordered a different meal. I pointed to the menu.And then THE BEST excuse... Westerners don't take them because they don't like Indian food!Excuse me!?! I had just hoovered up 11 types of the most delicious Indian curries.And then the lady realised what she had said and laughed.I did have a great meal but maybe some of the staff should change their attitude and be a bit more respecful to their customersShow less

Author: GiangV47
Title: Super delicious
Review: Incredible delicious food. If you like it spicy order the chicken in the red sauce (forgot the name) omg, it's a miracle!! Also the vegetables and the different free sauces are crazy good. And don't forget a lassi for the spiciness. Place looks weird but is 100 % worth a visit. Show less

Author: oakarom
Title: Must to go
Review: Menu that I eat is cheese naan, chicken. Teast is good, price is cheap, staff is kindly. If you want Indian food in Malacca, go to Selvam.

Author: micklupin
Title: Best indian food ever!
Review: Amazing indian food, almost better than in southern India, at ridiculous price (a couple euros per person!!!)

Author: muniswaran m
Title: Nice place
Review: Im not so sure for their food,seem im bought fried noodles but the place is clean,fast response from service team.Their fried noodle is really tasty worth of trying.

Author: DaBrownPotatoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Best Indian food I ever had
Review: Fantastic food, fast service. They also serve economy mee hun and nasi lemak (both also super delicious). If you are uncertain what side dishes to order(eg.: don't understand the menu) just go overto the hot food counter, all the side dishes are there.(popular side dishes are: mutton curry and chicken masala)quick tip: 1.the place is packed during weekend mornings 2. when you order a drink, make sure to say kurang manis( koo-rang mah-nees) which translates to less sugar.Show less

Author: 743oles
Title: Authentic Indian restuarant
Review: Delicious indian food. Banana leaf dishes when it's best. Do also try their Roti Canai for breakfast. Prices are nice too.

Author: SatwantK104
Title: Great food fast service
Review: Lovely food. Service is fast. Authentic ice lemon tea with 2 big limes.  The mee goreng, roti prata, masala thosa and masala prata were nice. Definitely recommend it.

Author: Belle L
Title: Food tasty but
Review: The food is tasty but the price isn't cheap for local people as I have local friends that only try one time as they charged really really expensive . I don't find anything fancy about the food tho .

Author: jk262232
Title: Chicken Peratal
Review: The best Indian food that I had in Malacca. Their chicken peratal & chicken cutlet highly recommended. Worth for your $$$.

Author: cvaprksh
Title: Nice
Review: The food is very good and same goes with the price @ average price but worth it for the taste of the food.

Author: greatestguy
Title: Graveyard face!!!
Review: Food is tasty but don't expect uniqueness or any special treatment...normal indian restaurant with very sad faced waiters...a small smile will be great!! Other then that I tried fried fish..lovely taste..i have rated 3 star bcos of the service if not will be 5 stars

Author: ekta p
Title: Service was quite sloppy but food awesome
Review: Dosa, idli, tea, and appam were great.Service was extremely slow and a couple of our ordered items didn't show up till 30 mins, After asking we got to the know that the food had finished, which the waiter didnt bother to inform.

Author: EricLoga
Title: Delicious chutney 👍
Review: Thosai, chutney and curry was extremely good. Nice ambiance. Need improvement on customer service. Went there for breakfast. Will return some day for lunch. The chicken varuval was attempting 👍

Author: dcorn1Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it!
Review: Came back here 2 nights in a row because we loved it so much! Had the veg and rice on a banana leaf which is so nice. They're good with portions and the lemon ice tea is the best I've ever had! Highly recommend this place. Show less

Author: alexanderbG5835ZF
Title: Friendly, cheap, tasty
Review: Came here while visiting Melaka. We're in need of some cheap India food and this place really delivered! Food was really tasty and just so, so cheap! Would be back in a flash if I'm ever near by again.

Author: NI3-279
Title: Excellent tasty food
Review: Visited this restaurant twice during my stay at Melaka. Excellent tasty and spicy Indian good with good variety

Author: S V
Title: Great
Review:
Delicious Food. 
But Parking In That Area Was Quit Difficult.
A Must Try Indian Banana Leaf And Tea..

Author: Julie S
Title: Dinner
Review: My family and I had a banana leaf curry dinner here. Its very good value for money. We were served with rice, vegetables, poppadums and a choice of fried chicken or fried fish.It was very casual. We shared a table with other diners which was no problems at all.Its a place where backpackers could have a decent and nutritious meal without leaving a hole in their pocket.Everyone were made very welcomeShow less

Author: MEAFaroAlgarve, Portugal
Title: Very cheap and very tasty
Review: A place where i went with Lonely Planet's recommendation. Full of local people, food served directly from buckets to a banana leaf. The look is not very good but the food is delicious and very cheap. We ate the set menu and also ordered lamb and chicken biryani. It was all excellent, as was the lime juice. Incredibly cheap. Really enjoyed.Show less

Author: indianp2014Oslo, Norway
Title: Good breakfast.
Review: Had an authentic Indian breakfast of idli and thosai. Prices were so low I dont inderstand how they keep the shop open. The Respatex tables and green plastic chairs gave it a look of the 70s. Will be coming here for breakfast every day of my stay in Malacca. Show less

Author: KulenMountainKouple
Title: Just okay
Review: we are vegetarian South Indian and this place is really underwhelming. The food is just okay. It's not bad, but it's not flavourful either. If you're craving lunch on a banana leaf then maybe check it out, but don't expect tasty food. I wouldn't go back. The place has a lot of meat but was easily accommodating to vegetarian. Show less

Author: coffeeaddict20019Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mouth watering dishes at affordable prices
Review: I went to Malacca for a short trip and chanced upon Selvam during lunch time.We ordered dry mutton curry,prawn sambal,fried fish and 3 banana leaf meal with vegetables.The food was to die for if you love authentic and spicy South Indian food.It feels like it's from your grandmum kitchen.I can't exactly remember how much we paid for it but it's less than 60 ringgit.Well worth the delicious food and attentive service.Loved every morsel and will definitely visit Selvam if I go to Malacca again Show less

Author: Bhupinder2010
Title: Nice tea
Review: went there for evening tea and had snacks. The staff was friendly and the tea and snacks were delicious.

Author: mhfw
Title: Nice apam and more
Review: We have been returning to Selvam for Chinese New Year breakfast. Love the apam with coconut milk and brown sugar. Service is fast and friendly.

Author: SiewKuenYee
Title: Good thosai and curry
Review:
We came here for breakfast because it is near our hotel. We were pleasantly surprised that the thosai was authentic, curry and dhall were good. 

The apom was good too!

Author: NOBYCHAYANSingapore
Title: Selvam that made my Melaka trip tasty
Review: Read a lot about Selvam and finally managed to find this place very close to St FX church during my trip last weekend.. We had Saturday dinner with some variety of things, with lime juice and nescafe coffe.. their Lime Juice is very cheap and of great taste.. Need to admit that the lady who serve us was friendly and got good service.. we all enoyed.. we returned here for Sunday breakfast.. it was crowded.. glad that i could find this gem.. the price is amazingly cheap with good quality food.. the payment method can be improved, now we need to tell them what we ordered and they will tell the amount, this can be automated/improved..Show less

Author: Road20yearsQuebec, Canada
Title: Yep it taste India
Review: For having been in India many time, yes it taste India, on Tamil Nadu side. So the food was good, as was the service and the price.Just the lassi, I wouldn't recommend it...There is no ice in a lassi, and no milk..So try something elseShow less

Author: Suhanesh C
Title: So so only
Review: Food was okay only and edible. Lots of improvement need to be done. Cleanliness is not satisfactory. They were moving serving tables while customers are still eating and hit a customer's table with food without even apologizing.

Author: Stanley789
Title: Fried Bee hoon wasgood
Review:
Unfriendly Staff :)  but bee hoon goreng was good.

Ordered Roti Canai which was so so. 
Ginger tea above average :) 
Will not return unless stay at The Pine hotel again.

Author: azimahc
Title: Good food, fast service
Review: Love this place.. food is good, the service, fast and friendly. We esp like the big young guy who served us. He was polite, friendly and very helpful... too bad we forgot to ask his name. The only problem to this place is, to look for parking.Show less

Author: Gypsytwitchers
Title: Tasty authentic Indian food
Review: They have updated their street sign so I have posted the latest. Have had breakfast and lunch there today. Friendly attentive staff. We are vegetarian and the have a great spicy Indian vegetarian food. We will be back.

Author: zafers753
Title: Affordable and tasty
Review: Selvam is a nice spot at the entrance of Little India of Melaka. They serve banana leaf food of southern India. Nice food and value for money place. Do not expect high end service but still ok and friendly place.

Author: 262erinas
Title: Recommended
Review:
The food was really nice. The staff also very friendly *thumbs up*

Btw i stayed at The Sterling Hotel. It's only 5 minutes walk from the hotel.

Author: Tasha3469
Title: Mrs
Review: Very bad service with spicy food!!! Server is rude. Didnt expect this. Went there after read review from trip adviser but all upside down!

Author: Musaaphir
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: It's an authentic South Indian restaurant, and Not a Malaysian (Mamak) restaurant. Extra points to the excellent service and very friendly and courteous staff.

Author: Uma S
Title: Awesome food
Review: Went there for lunch.Ate two banana leave meal with 3 different vegetables,papadam ,prawns sambal,fried fish,pepper mutton and fish curry.The food was simply delicious.Definately one of my most favourite restaurant

Author: Rujuuu
Title: Cheap, vegetarian food!
Review:
Great for vegetarian backpackers!

Banana leaf sets are great! Cheap and cheerful :) there is a good mix of locals and tourists. A nice experience of South Indian food

Author: KarthikeyanSubbiah
Title: A typical Malaysian Tamil Restaurant-Must Visit Place
Review: Loved the food... Great location... Friendly staff and great service attitude... Typical authentic Malaysian tamil style food.. filled with curry aroma... Typical old style ambience and Great value for money... A big thumbs up..... A must visit place

Author: Barney1994 L
Title: Cill out
Review: I like the roti cannai and you must try they the tarik and one think they are two staff is Gloria and Angelin and the chicken briayani but is only Sunday only

Author: PaihiaMTB-Jonny
Title: Pretty good feed
Review: Went for dinner one night after reading review and it was pretty good. Not that amazing though  to be quite honest, there are better places and worse. Had the banana leaf set and was cheap enough.

Author: Prem78
Title: Ok Food; not so Ok Waiters
Review: Visited this place for lunch with family. Food is the normal south indian fare. What irked me most was the attitude of one of the waiters who was rude to my 78 year old dad who wanted another glass of rasam (indian soup)

Author: Michele F
Title: Best Indian food in Melacca
Review: We have been here for a quick lunch, the food was really good. They have different menu during the day. Good quality and well cooked

Author: Abdulghani_SaeedMiddle East
Title: Authentic and Locals seem to like it.
Review: For a solo traveler backpacking, it was a delight to fine this place, recommended to me by taxi driver. Food taste great, its cheap, its simple, its quick and the staff are friendly and ready to help with anything. I had the rice with vegetables (on a banana leaf of course), chicken, a boiled egg and fresh lime juice. It was more then fulfilling (it fact i was stuffed).Show less

Author: zakiaNorway
Title: Good traditional south indian fare
Review: We had lunch with banana leaf rice with all the vegetarian trimmings plus meat curries if you desire that n great thosai in the evening.

Author: Severine B
Title: very good Indian food for a tiny price!
Review: We got the banana leaf set meal, the dosa and a can drink for 12rm only. No small portions like in the touristic restaurants, but a big plate full of food. Go here and avoid overpriced food for tourists.

Author: WendyF891Lewes, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing experience
Review: Yes it was cheap. Yes it was the fastest food ever. I had expected more given the rave reviews but at best it filled a hole. The flavours were not great and the experience disappointing. The chicken had so many bones it was tricky to find the meat. Show less

Author: 616jeetgill
Title: Stay away
Review: Stay away of this restaurant..horrible food and even worse customer service.. waiters talk as tho they are going to fight and don't even gv what u ask for..food is 2/10.. didn't enjoy anything served.

Author: corh275
Title: Good food, simple seating
Review: The ambiance is basic as most of these places. The food is lovely, served om a banana leave. the juices are fresh and the service good. All try to help you as much as they can even when English is difficult. Save some space for desert, the pastries are delicious. We even bought some for a afternoon snack the day after. Show less

Author: Gavin_MarieGold Coast, Australia
Title: Basic but Fun
Review: If you like basic and authentic Indian food then this place is worth the experience. All meals are served up on banana leave and everyone eats with the right hand (cutlery available upon request). The staff circulate with pots of food which they spoon onto your leaf. If you wish to get close to an authentic local experience then this will meet your needs at a very budget price.Show less

Author: 290rissrMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great South Indian cuisine
Review: I've been patronizing this restaurant since high school. What I love about the place, is its consistency in cooking. I really enjoy dining there. Eating its thosai that is served with curry and a plate of chilli mutton really makes my day. The ambience is also has an appealing factor that makes patrons feel comfortable. The price is affordable.Show less

Author: Twent14
Title: Lunch
Review: This was the first restaurant we visited on our Malacca trip. My husband had rice which was served with two varieties of vegetables. I had a chapati which was served with a dry potato curry.They brought a platter to the table filled with small serves of assorted dishes for us to pick from . They all looked delicious. We had chicken and cuttlefish. We also each had a cup of rasom. The chapati was very well made - soft and flavorful. Overall we enjoyed the lunch. The bill was reasonable but I wouldn't consider it cheap by Malacca standards.Show less

Author: Ashdey
Title: Good good - value for money
Review: Stopped here for a short breakfast. The food was good and cheap and definitely recommend this place, especially if you are on a budget.

Author: Lardylove
Title: Selvam
Review: Relatively cheap and cheerful Indian restaurant with a big selection. Very accessible to tourists looking for an Indian descent experience.

Author: Roy11FP
Title: Banana leaf classic
Review: No plates, just a large bit of banana leaf, and food arriving by the ladel-full. Great curries, for next to no cost (approx £2 each)

Author: Andrew T
Title: Indian Banana Leaf at it best.
Review: Sinply the best Indian food in the town. It wide range of indian dishes will dazzle every customers and if you were there on Friday, do not miss to try out their vegetable Nasi Beriani. It comes with a numbers of delicious indian vegetable dish and finishing it with larsi (preferred mango larsi) will surely made you eant to come again. For a more authentic Indian dinning experiance, ditch your spoon and fork, use hand instead. Show less

Author: Nada R
Title: Value for money
Review: Good Indian food and its cheap. clean area and good for family dining. The parata was nice and the appam was wonderful

Author: selvaranips
Title: Superb lunch with variety of vegetables
Review: We went for late lunch and the banana leaf meal was nice and the vegetable combination was good. They serve other food from 3 pm onwards so good for those whom like to skip their heavy meal. Fast service and superb lunch for vegetarians. We do see a lot of tourist having their lunch and coffee time so i belief it is a must place to try for lunchShow less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Selvam Restaurant
Review: Went there for lunch, love the spicy chicken and food here. Overall food here quite cheap and love the tosai here.

Author: ayie-jogankz
Title: Good enough and cheap
Review: Went to this Indian restaurant tonight. On the menu, they have some special food only for some specific days. The food was good, and the staff was friendly also. I prefer to eat in this kind of restaurant cause they open this place for everyone (not for tourist only). It was nice to saw people who eat here was mixed between local and tourist. Don't be hesitate to ask if you need some assistance for order.Show less

Author: najimudeen
Title: Selvam restaurant
Review: This restaurant is located in the little India area of Melaka. The vegetarian and non vegetarian food are served at a very reasonable price

Author: helena jEastcote, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap and cheerful
Review: We were in Melaka for Chinese New Year so understandably so much was closed for the public holiday as we were mooching around hoping to find somewhere for a cuppa and a snack. We happened upon this restaurant which was buzzing almost exclusively with South Indian clientele. Had a very tasty dosa and coconut chutney and a cup of masala tea. Very basic absolutely no frills but it must be ok as it was so full. The next day we returned for lunch when the choice is more limited. They give you a banana leaf and dollop the rice, curry and dhal. They give you water too. It costs the equivalent of a couple of quid and you leave feeling satisfied.Show less

Author: sarmi S
Title: Worst Indian food ever in Malaysia.
Review: We went there for lunch. It was the worst meals served. The south indians from India will hate those dishes to the core. Sambar is nothing but a hot red watery fliud with no taste. Service was also poor. There were few foreigners who were eating lunch.. am afraid they would have created a worst feeling on Indian food after lunch here.Overall a worst experience.Not recomended atall.Show less

Author: chrismE5291OENottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great food great value
Review: Beautiful food and great value for money, English speaking waiters that went through the menu with us explaining which dish was spicy and which was veggie and pointing out what accompanied what, and serves ice cold beer to go with it, am going back today for seconds!!!!!Show less

Author: 276JAMESBangkok, Thailand
Title: Great local indian food & culture
Review: This joint seems popular with the locals and has a good selection of curries, indian breads, deserts and fruit shakes. Very cheap, you can expect to eat a big meal + drink for less than 20 ringit. They seem to offer certain parts of the menu at different times of the day, I couldn't really get my head around it.Show less

Author: AmirulH299
Title: Very bad taste,Very expensive
Review: Rm23 for a person with horible tenggiri fried fish,they serve with 3 cheap cost veggeis with no taste,the veggie taste flat,only the chicken curry paretel tasty,dhal oso not so tasty,for rm23 not worth it,i dont understand how they charge,when i ask them to itemisied bill they explain like not happy,its not wrong for us customer to know the price,i would not recomend to visit selvam coz very3 priceyPlease try to go to CHETTY KETING behind a small path near by kg pantai,only two person husband n wife for many year serving this place,most of melaka stayin people eat here,very3 cheap,the taste very tasty,not boring to eat,u can eat so many times coz its very nice n tasty,the enviroment like in INDIA,the entrance is from behind a small path,the place a bit messy,but i asure u its clean,looks like not clean,first inpresion,i seen the owner cooking the chicken curry n vadai,the preparation is very2 clean,i always visit melaka n eat here,seen them cook so many times,i hve been there many times,this place was recomended by a friend of mine stayin here from his birth,my friend say this place is here from the days his father was young,so guys go try out n find CHETTY KETING,ask indian in melaka bout this place,i give personaly 5stars,price with rice,3 delicious veggie,chicken paretel n a small fried fish with added rice n curry n veggie is only rm6,this 2016,can say worth it a damm cheapHIGHLY RECOMENDEDShow less

Author: pzam184
Title: Simple and delicious
Review: We are here twice in our three days in Melaka and loved it. Great service, they even went out to find some beer for us. Food is delicious.

Author: Neesha NPenang, Malaysia
Title: Affordable and nice food
Review: We went there at night,around 9+p.m. The food was so cheap you would not believe it. The taxi driver who brought us there said "Tak cukup nasi,tambah sampai cukup" which translates into:"Not enough rice, add till your hearts' content" And we sure did. We practically stuffed ourselves with banana leaf rice and some naan with tandoori chicken. Some were spicy but others are not. You can ask for a taste of the curries to see if it's spicy or not. The staff are very friendly and are always prepared to help you out.For more experienced Indian food eaters,this will serve as average but for beginners, this will be something good.Show less

Author: melaniaekasari
Title: Tasty spicy lambs
Review: I went to this Indian restaurant to have lunch, since i like spicy food and meat, i chose lamb and rice, it was delicious. Didn't try any other food, but the staff are friendly. The price also quite cheap. They also serve banana leaves

Author: garlic1927Bournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Simple South Indian cuisine
Review: Easiest way to locate is to walk up river path past Hard Rock Cafe and when you see St Francis Xavier church cross over bridge and Selvam is on the corner in front of you. Food here was simple but good. No frills restaurant with good range of rotis. We had breakfast here and the mango lassi was superb. The menu covered lunch and dinner as well with limited choices, but, good valueShow less

Author: RAJ_Grewal23
Title: simple but delicious..
Review: simple cheap banana leaf food that doesnt disappoint. You've got ur basic banana leaf veg n then add ons as u may.. just close to jonkers park..

Author: Snehaldutt
Title: Tasty South Indian Food!!!!
Review: Must have if you are eager to eat South Indian cuisine after tasting the Malay food.Good variety in vegetarian & non-vegetarian dishes.Food served on banana leaf best enjoyed with hands(throw away the forks n spoon).They even serve chappatis & butter milk.Finger licking tasty.Would definitely eat there if we visit Melaka again!!!!!!Show less

Author: Danmeek
Title: Banana leaf deliciousness
Review: Order the vegetables with rice on banana leaf and then choose which meat curries you want.  I ate here twice in two days and it was just delicious.  The service is fierce but if you are friendly you will get friendliness back.

Author: lonelyrunner_91Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food at affordable prices.
Review: Made 2 visits here during my trip.201/12/15 - was here for an early dinner. Order the Vegetarian Banana leaf set which cost RM 4. Although it wasn't fantastic it doesn't disappoint either. Any add-on (meat dishes) costs extra. 21/12/15 - Came here for breakfast. Ordered two plain pratas, putu mayam (vermicelli hoppers), masala thosai and washed it all down with a cup of Masala Chai. Enjoyable experience. Total bill is RM10The wedged layout of the restaurant is adjacent to the traffic junction so it was ideal to sit down and observe the hustle and bustle. However, the staffs should put on a much friendly demeanor.Show less

Author: InbamJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Average Banana Leaf Food
Review: Decided to have lunch here after seeing reviews on Trip Advisor. I must say that food was average.Order banana leaf meal and mutton briyani. We added on fried fish, dry fried chicken and mutton. Food was not warm and rather bland.No one was around for us to ask for extra curry or water. They were quite busy looking at the customers who were walking it. Also it would be good for someone to constantly clear the rubbish off the floor and for the management to cover up the dishes on display. You wouldn't wanna find a fly in your curry Show less

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Above average at a place with limited choice
Review: Melaka doesn't have many Indian food outlets, the most only 3. Selvam may fare slightly above average than others. They serve normal south Indian food with good selection of side dishes of meat, seafood. Overall its an average place to visit, can return if need curry fix at Melaka.Show less

Author: Bruce CDarwin, Australia
Title: Good banana leaf set
Review: Had the lunch time banana leaf meal. Service comes to you first with the rice, then a choice of spicy or mild sauce, then the vegies, then various meat options. I enjoyed the service, but can imagine some people not liking it. The food was simple and tasty at a reasonable price. Pineapple juice excellent. Worth the walk from the tourist strip to save a few RM. Show less

Author: Annaconda110Mexico
Title: .. always good, after all these years
Review: .. since they move across the road next to the bank, the already popular indian restaurant got better, vegetarian banana leaf only 4 ringgit, buttered naan 2.50, Tandoori chicken 6 rm, small dish of spicy chicken 5 rm, and mutton 6 rm. If you are on a tight budget or with money to splash out it's worth a visit, it can get busy at the weekends and holidays, it closes around 21:30, so get there earlyShow less

Author: Sara WWageningen, The Netherlands
Title: Okay food, horrible service
Review: It took a long time before we could order. It was quiet when we were there and the waiters did not feel like working. When the grumpy waiter arrived with our food he did not say anything, he just put the plates on our table and left.Food tasted okay, but the mango lassie was very watery because of all the ice. Compared to The previous food I had eaten in KL this was below average.Show less

Author: Pallavi09Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Indian food over a banana leaf spread
Review: This was our first time visit with family (small kids). Being vegetarians, they had good biryani rice, vegetables, dhall etc. They had options of tauhu sambal (finished at that time), vegetarian fish etc. Overall, the team was helpful and the food was above average. Parking was available not to far off so it was fairly accessible.Show less

Author: Micky3885
Title: Very reasonable great Indian food
Review: Food served on banana leaf, all very fresh and asked by staff how spicy you prefer. Basic, no frills restaurant, seemed family run serving very nice food at very good price.

Author: krissafeSingapore, Singapore
Title: A good indian food place in melaka
Review: A group of us had lunch at this restaurant on recently.we had mutton,chicken,fish, and other dishes which we shared .The food was served on banana leaf.All of us were given standard vegetables,pappadam.After food I had 'teh tarik'.Overall we enjoyed our lunch.The place was crowded for lunch.Parking was difficult as we parked quite far from the restaurant.Show less

Author: Shaish2829
Title: Banana Leaf Curries
Review: We ate here on a recommendation of their Banana Leaf curries, and were slightly disappointed, It was not the culinary experience we had been led to expect.

Author: Abu Bakar MShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Definitely one of the best banana leaf restaurants in town!
Review: They moved from their original place which was just opposite to where they are now. The food quality is just as great as it ever was. A lot of selection. Friendly staff. Very attentive. Service was very good. Whenever I have an urge for banana leaf, this is where I go to. I am glad that over the years they have managed to maintain the standards of this restaurant.Show less

Author: J O
Title: Value for Money
Review: The food at this restaurant was excellent and the location is strategic. Very tasty food for a cheap price.

Author: banu r
Title: Good South Indian food
Review: The place is clean, food is served fresh and good taste. They serve only south Indian dishes; their tea time snacks are superb; typical south Indian taste. Staffs are friendly but not well versed in English.

Author: Joyce G
Title: Excellent food and very reasonably priced!
Review: We had 5 banana leaf. .1 plate of fried chicken. ..1 chicken perathal. ..1 mutton perathal. . . 1 egg scramble..2 plates ikan bilis sambal.. 1 fish cutlet. Total bill came to only RM54 for 5 pax!

Author: Victor B
Title: great value for your money!
Review: On the corner of Little India, close to the dutch quarter, is a green restaurant with a great variety of naan, roti and more. We had 4 naan with different kinds of yummie dip and vegetables and one roti canai, 4 drinks for 27Rm!

Author: WiserTravellerLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fresh and Tasty Indian food
Review: We discovered Selvam as it was close to our guesthouse in Melaka. Over the course of two days we ended up going here three times as the food was so good and great value for money.The environment is clean and friendly which is not always the case in Melaka. The menu is quite broad from different parts of India but we always opted for the freshly made Dosai and Paratha which our family and children really loved.The food is also very well priced and we would not hesitate to return for a casual meal next time we are back in Melaka.Show less

Author: Lucy B
Title: Good cheap food!
Review: No thrills restaurant but the food is very good, nice sized portions and very cheap. Had the combined set with chicken and for two dollars got meat rice veg and poppadoms. Would go back!

Author: sandranatalia33
Title: Nice and cheap Indian food
Review: Selvam is popular amongst tourist and local people in Malacca. The food is nice and cheap. Their staff are nice and generous with the spices on table.

Author: FromKluang
Title: Delicious Indian foods
Review:
One of the great indian foods in Melaka. It located end of little india road.
I had visit this restaurant for few times.
Their service is pretty fast and the foods is great.

Author: SathiyaNarayana... KSingapore
Title: Yummy Indian food
Review: At Melaka we were really craving for a good Indian food. When we visited Little India, we saw quite a few Indian restaurants and difficult to choose. Finally we choose Selvam restaurant instead of a Chettinad restaurant opp to this based on the number of customers and it was a good choice.We had egg dosa, rava dosa, prata, chicken curry, mutton curry and lassi. Everything was awesome. The Sambar and Chutney given for dosa also tasted very good. We missed the chicken briyani as it was over. If we get a chance again, will definitely won't miss the briyani. The price is very cheap too. For all that we had eaten, we paid only around 10 SGD.Show less

Author: sivam127
Title: lunch
Review: service ok, indian vegetarian food not up to standard, Dhall curry plain and flat taste.friend ordered fried mee mamak , very plain .

Author: shwetadhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Homely South Indian food at ridiculously cheap prices
Review: We were starved for flavour after having spent a few days in Cameron and so this restaurant was such a blessing!There's No frills, No fuss - the service is quick and the food so cheap. A rice meal (unlimited) with 3 curries is 4 MYR and the dosas (thosai) 2-4 MYR.The 4 of us over stuffed ourselves here for about 20 MYR. Such joy!Show less

Author: AndyAnnable
Title: I've visited a few times and it's always as good as I remember!
Review: When ever I leave KL to visit Melaka I get excited for the food, an no trip to Melaka is complete without a banana leaf meal! Add in some tandoori chicken and a Teh Tarik and your night is complete, the food is not only amazing but it's so cheap here. Perfect location next to the bank and you can just smell the food outside and it draws you in.Definitely stop by and have the banana leaf on your visit.Show less

Author: shoshanagould
Title: Great Indian food
Review: Really good Indian food restaurant at the end of Little India closest to the river. Everything I had (I went twice!) was delicious and cheap. One thing - they only serve some items at certain times of the day, so plan accordingly!

Author: Divya YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Indian Food
Review: The place located near Melaka's Little India. We were there for breakfast.The food was generally tasty but there price was very very expensive compare to KL. We just ate 2 Pure Milk Coffee, 2 Ghee Tosai with Chicken Peratal the price is RM20.60.Overall good and tasty food. Maybe will visit in next trip.Show less

Author: Arjan d
Title: excellent food
Review: Indian food how it should be. This is the best place to eat indian food in Melaka. Really enjoyed eating there.

Author: Emma_CubeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Decent Food and Great Price
Review: Food was decent, not the best food I've had in Malaysia but nice enough. The good thing about it was the price. There's a few decent veggie options on the menu and I like they serve a lot of it on a Banana leaf. Tandoori was yum.Show less

Author: kaushalyavMalaysia
Title: Need to improve service
Review: Decided to dine at Selvam's after reading overwhelming responses from other patrons. But it was not so pleasant as it sounded for others. Went there in small group of 3 for lunch. Lunch hour on a weekend, coincide with PH and school holiday. The restaurant was packed like crazy, managed to get a table at a corner. Tainted banana leaf was spread infront of us (requested to change) and the food were served (veges, rice, curries, and other dishes). And that's where the good service stops. We got to wait for 10 minutes to get a top up of curry and water after informing the waiterss who is busy walking around serving new customers who walk into the shop. The waiting time was so long till we got pissed off. We are aware that people are flocking into the shop and they need to serve them but it seemed that we got ignored. The food was good but curries are watery. Maybe too many customers that day. No much comment on the food coz it just fills up our tummy and we really wanted to walk away from that shop without ruining our holiday mood. All i can say is, they need more waiters on busy days. And definitely need to improve their service level. The food is cheap compared to KL or JB.Show less

Author: veronikaz272
Title: Very good food for a good price
Review: I've never really had Indian food before and decided today to try it. As I had no idea what to expect I found it helpful that the menu was in English. The waiter was really nice and helped us in how to eat the food properly with hands! (they put everything on a banana leaf)Delicious food, a lot of choises and a clean place to eat at.Show less

Author: NmhateyAustin, Texas
Title: Great place to have Indian veg and non veg
Review: We were impressed by their menu items and ordered the rava masala thosai, onion roti, and banana thosai. We like how they just left the dhaal and chutneys in front of us to take as we required, not like other places where you are served it. Price was also cheap for the amount and quality of food. Will definitely visit here again to try their thali (big quantity for small price) as well as their non veg items. Fast service and clean place to dine.Show less

Author: Monie_Lau
Title: OK Banana Leaf Rice
Review: Not bad and ordered a Masala Chicken. Price is very cheap. I was very satisfied with their service too.

Author: ceemohanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice & Clean
Review: We had breakfast here. The place is clean, tables and chairs neatly arranged, and it's blissfully free of the heavy smell of spices. The restaurant is not air-conditioned, but it's airy and comfortable. This wedge-shaped establishment in Little India lies next to a busy junction, making it a good place to hang out and observe the locals. We had the usual Indian breakfast fare of roti chanai, rava thosai, sweet appom and uppuma, with nasi lemak and mee siam thrown in. The food appeared freshly prepared, with slightly muted flavours, certainly nothing offensive. We ended our meal with some delicious traditional South Indian coffee, made with fresh milk. A good place to go for an introduction into Malaysian-Indian cuisine, especially if your preference leans towards less spicy, low salt food. Show less

Author: Escape374499
Title: Excellent
Review: Amazing food that's served very quickly. Staff were friendly, prices were very good value and the restaurant is clean and in a brilliant location.

Author: Binzels78Preston, United Kingdom
Title: A cheap hearty feed
Review: Visited Selvam as we felt we'd had our Chinese fix of Melaka and fancied a change. Great food very reasonably priced. Helpfully, the menu is in English with explanations of what everything is so if you aren't used to this type of dining experience, fear not. The water spoke English and I found the staff to be thoroughly efficient and accommodating. Highly enjoyable and we're stuffed. Show less

Author: victorrajavelm
Title: CETTINAD DELIGHT
Review: Awesome Indian food. Great blend of spices to taste. Just scintillating and gastronomical. Try first!

Author: clemicam
Title: Awesome food
Review: Cheap, simple and excellent food, vegetarian friendly. Go for it, get your fingers ready, no cutlery needed!

Author: YaptonBoy
Title: Excellent banana leaf restaurant
Review: Went here several times during stay in Malacca - on my own and with family (including Malaysians).   Good food at a good price.

Author: Melanie PWestern Australia, Australia
Title: Dinner to Remember
Review: Amazing food and such great value for money. If you love Indian food then make sure you make a visit to Selvam when in Melaka. Staff were very friendly, atmosphere great and food served on banana leaf was so yummy. We were all talking about how great dinner was for days after and wishing we could return and will definitely do so when next in Melaka. You can easily get there with a short walk (under 10 mins) along river boardwalk from Dutch square, passing Church Of St. Francis Xavier and then just cross the road to reach Jalan Temenggong. You will not regret it.Show less

Author: Fouz ESeoul, South Korea
Title: Excellent food!
Review: We came here under the recommendation of a Lonely Planet guidebook and yes, they were right to include it in print! This place is great :D Go for the banana leaf meal (RM4) and you'll be satisfied! Try the watermelon juice too if you're thirsty (another RM4). A lot of the locals come here (many Indians included) so that's always a good sign.It's kept clean and the staff are friendly! There's a sink for washing your hands too if you prefer to eat with your hands, although you can ask for cutlery.Happy travels and joyful eating!Show less

Author: PonmalarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Healthy & Tastiest food
Review: Coming here for a second time..for banana leaf lunch. Food is awesome..similar to home cooked food taste. The food here not only tasty but it’s healthy too as they use less salt and less oil in their food preparation. We really love it. Both their vegetarian & non-vegetarian menu are superb. A must go for healthy & tastiest choice of Indian food in Melaka.Show less

Author: rengaray
Title: Good selection, fast service
Review: Overall the food is above average and the service was good, apparently they moved to a smaller area as compared to before. So table space is limited. Can be considered especially if you like good Indian style breakfast.

Author: Krish R
Title: Absolute value for money and nice people!
Review: Cheap and best Indian food in the town. The people are very nice and caring too! Banana-leaf Thali (vegetarian) just 4RM!!!

Author: ruby6088Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Indian food at its best..
Review: for breakfast as early as 7.00 am one can have tosai, roti canal etc with chutneys and dhall curry..and price is very reasonably cheap...for lunch one can have banana leaf rice and dinner tandoori chicken ...the taste is also superb...recommended for those who wants to try Indian food at its best...Show less

Author: LingLioe
Title: Spicy Indian
Review: The food was great. Cheap and delicious. I couldn't resist nasi goreng and teh tarik everytime I ate there. Good staffs and smiley people.

Author: Kamen_777Sofia, Bulgaria
Title: Strangely good :-)
Review: It took me some effort to give this restaurant a try, as it looks basic-basic, to the level that I question their sanitary standards...We did however give it a try and it was OK. The food was tasty without being outstanding, and the people were friendly.I can't say that this is a must visit Indian, but it's certainly an interesting experience.We will remember it more for the fact that it was a basic, non-touristy local restaurant than for their food.Show less

Author: Gary712Adelaide, Australia
Title: Indian Banana Leaf Rice meal at its best!
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by local Malaccan people, as the best Banana leaf Rice meal in Malacca.We have to agree, that it was truly a great dining experience.Our regret was that we did not have time to return again on this trip.The service was good, but fast and so our meal was over all too quickly, but the food was great.This was our first Banana Leaf Rice meal experience, and we wish we had ordered 2 serves instead of sharing just one.The blend of flavours spices, sauces was exceptional. This is a very enjoyable way to enjoy Indian food.The fact the restaurant does not sell alcahol was no deterrent, as the flavours of chilled lime juice complemented the meal perfectly.Show less

Author: Srinthia
Title: Good indian food.
Review: The food are extremely tasty. Close to home cook. Avoid to go on busy days as they are short of manpower.

Author: Pestyjnr
Title: The real deal
Review: You could be in India. Well it is in Little India. Fantastic tasting curries. Everything looked and tasted delicious. Could not ask for more authentic food. Great prices. Give it a go. You will be on a winner.

Author: brownbag68Geelong
Title: Tasty Indian experience at rock bottom prices
Review: This was a lot of fun - food is served on a banana leaf and it is great, tasty Indian food at a ridiculously low price. The curries is all in bain maries, but that actually helps you choose something. The food is not the best I've had but that that price, I couldn't have expected any better. Great home made roti and naan. Tasty curries, good service and a fun experience. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Gary712
Title: Fantastic Indian dining experience
Review: Great Banana Leaf rice restaurant. Unimposing reatuarant, but excellent food and quick service. Non alcoholic beverages.

Author: Mayura_105Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Indian Food
Review: Since my in-laws are vegetarians we were hunting for some vegetarian options.Trip Advisor itself suggested me this place. I have no regrets. I wouldn't say its the best Indian food I have ever had but its decent food and the best as per the need of the hour.Show less

Author: Your_Melaka
Title: Best Tosai
Review: Beside Tosai, the Banana Leaf Rice is excellent. There are a wide range of Roti Canai to select. The drinks taste good.

Title: Selvam Restaurant
Review: As a food taster in Asia Pacific - this Restaurant do have recipe of INDIA in Malacca. Enjoy your meal with Banana Leaf.

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Incredible Indian Cuisine
Review: I went to this outlet many times for breakfast and lunch and the service standard and staff's working tempo are consistent. Variety of meat, vegetarian dishes and wondering what to be order. Everytime I dine in there, I felt like the atmosphere similar in Chennai where the staffs going around with silver compartments serving dishes to diners and you may see also stacks of banana leafs on standby. Good very Good Show less

Author: lauralikescatsSydney, Australia
Title: Cheap and yummy
Review: I'm not a huge Indian fan, I usually only order butter or tandoori chicken. It was a shame when they said they had run out of tandoori and naan bread!! Nonetheless I tried something new and had the chicken set, it was abit spicy and had bones it but it was yum! I would also recommend the roti bread.I would definitely go back just to have the tandoori and naan because I was so looking forward to it. The staff have limited English, but the food was served pretty much as soon as it was ordered.Show less

Author: AndyAnnable
Title: Wow! Cheap, awesome food and friendly staff.
Review: I ate here last year as it was recommended by a friend, when I returned to Melaka for a day I made sure I visited the new location. Still great. Had a banana leaf with rice, 3 different sauces and veg. It's awesome and you can keep getting more if it doesn't fill you up. The tea is pretty awesome too. Should check this place out and have a banana leaf.Show less

Author: JayjoelhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor service
Review: I visited the shop on Tuesday,21/10/2014 between 10.30am-11.00am. The shop had only few customers and mainly were foreigners and few locals.I approached the waiter to give my order (when it should be the other way round) as none came to me and guess what?..the waiter had eye contact with me and clearly heard what I said, but, just ignored and walked away to clean tables. To my horror, shouldn't the waiter be arranging for the food to be delivered to the table and later looking into cleaning the tables. This particular waiter was taking his sweet time cleaning tables and the other shop assistants who were in the shop was just too busy talking stories. Agreed that there were between 5-6 unclean/uncleared tables, but, shouldn't the dine in customers needs comes first. After all, the shop was not busy and the waiter could always clear off tables once the food has been ordered. From my observation, the foreign tourist were absolutely clueless as to what to order as they had no idea what is being offered given the fact they are most likely unaware what is the particular food mentioned in the menu all about! This restaurant should learn to buck up off your service and just start loosing customersShow less

Author: Ponmalar
Title: Tastiest indian banana leaf food in Melaka
Review: Well known for banana leaf in town and the restaurant located nearby the famous Jonker Street. Tasty banana leaf food with lots of variety for both vege and non-vege and price is really reasonable.

Author: Slow209Bramhall, United Kingdom
Title: Best food in Malaysia
Review: We came here every day of our stay in melaka for Breakfast and tea because it was such good food at a very reasonable price. It was only over the road from a great guesthouse. The rice dish served on a banana leaf filled us up for the day and the tandoori and naan combination for tea was delicious. Would recommend to all travelling through Malaysian peninsular!Show less

Author: Tangapushpam
Title: Fabolous indian banana leaf food
Review: Just go there to enjoy their wonderful tasty meal. Fridays are always the best since they serve varieties of side dishes. Yummy. Much recommended to go

Author: Patricia N
Title: NoWay!
Review: Me and my bf make it a point not to come here anymore, the food sucks and its not worth the price that we paid..! 😡

Author: Manjulikapramod
Title: Authentic South Indian Food
Review: The food was tasty, absolutely fulfilling and it made me happily dig into the banana leafs. The Rasam and buttermilk were authentic, loved the puffy idli and dal-rice was yummy.

Author: Hoffqoff
Title: Superb and clean
Review: Super tasty. Everything was good. Their chai, their idlly, their thali, their tandoori chicken we loved too. Ah and their salt lassi! I'd dare say it's just as nice or even nicer than in India.

Author: Muzmazlan
Title: Excellent Banana Leaf Rice
Review: Just eat the basic set of the banana leaf set was enough. The vegetables were tasty and the curries were excellent!!

Author: DJSchoPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap, tasty and consistent
Review: We went here every day for three days and tried breakfast, lunch and dinner. Friendly staff, picture menu and very good food for a reasonable price (good combination deals but we think the best value is the tandoori chicken and naan combo!). Also highly recommend their mango lassi and an excellent ice milo, have a meal here!Show less

Author: michaeltang64Hong Kong, China
Title: Quick and Accommodating
Review: My girlfriend and I came here late at 9:30 but this was still open.We ordered something really basic like the Nasi Goreng and Mee Hoon Goreng. Both were decent. We also ordered Thosai which came with a dhall and two chutney. The hygiene for these sauce were questionable by Western standards (they look like they've been here for a week) but I think by the standard if a local food joint they are acceptable. The Thosai was also fresh and savory. Price wise it was affordable. The restaurant was quite clean and we actually saw the waiter cleaning the table with soap. Show less

Author: daniel m
Title: Consistently good food over 3 days
Review: My partner and I ate here for 3 days running because we struggled to find diverse veggie food nearby. Food was always fresh and very flavoursome. Recommend the masala dosa. And have some of fried dahl ball.

Author: Chef_tony0321Karlsruhe, Germany
Title: Great Lunch Spot
Review: Selvam was recommended to me by my hostel, so I went there for lunch. They specialise in one dish for lunch, which is served on a banana leaf (rice, vegetables and some meat/fish/whatever). The service was fast and the food was great. On top of that, it is actually very cheap. I would recommend it any time!Show less

Author: BubblezzzSingapore
Title: The best meals we had in Melaka
Review: Seriously. Everything else seemed overrated in comparison. Selvam's by contrast, EXCEEDED our expectations. Very very reasonably priced, delicious south Indian food in an authentic setting with great, speedy service. It was so good, we went back again the day after. Try the briyani rice and definitely order a dish of sambal squid - tender morsels of squid in a spicy chilli/curry sauce. Mmmm. It's late night now and I want me some again.Show less

Author: WarmlyAndCoPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Brillant Indian Meal experience
Review: We always go to Selvam every time we are in Melaka. They moved! The new shop is now next to the Indian DVD/video shop or near Public bank. It was fairly busy when we arrived. It was 9 of us but they are very accommodated and quickly put tables together. The food was same as before. Love the spicy squid. Their Biryani rice tasted so nice. Unfortunately, nothing is not spicy so it was hard for the children. Our children loved dearly of their popodum.Show less

Author: amy2kChicago, Illinois
Title: Very good, simple food!
Review: This restaurant is about 100 meters from the Discovery Cafe. It is a no frills place with little decor and an open store front. I went for its simple but tasty food. I ordered the southern Indian food on a banana leaf; then added a piece of fish; a Thosi and a cup of milk tea. The service was fast; and the waiter even made some exaggerated gesture to let me take a picture. The fish was ok, the various sauces were good; and the Thosi was excellent. I enjoyed my meal with the milk-tea. It was well worth the trip.Show less

Author: tanyasen1
Title: Delicious and cheap
Review: Delicious Indian - Malay food. Not quite Indian but has an interesting Malaysian twist to it. Looked fairly hygienic (at least more so than some of the more grimy places down the road). Food tasted really good

Author: Annaconda110Mexico
Title: Selvam 'the one and only' moved premises 2 months ago !!!
Review: from a loyal selvam customer .... please don't be fooled or tricked into thinking that the indian restaurant 'Sri Maja' which now occupies the building where Selvam USED to be, is the genuine thing because it's NOT ! Selvam has moved across the road by the traffic lights on the opposite corner, if you stand anywhere on the road junction you can't fail to see their name above the windows. Never accept second bestShow less

Author: Mike HNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, incredible value
Review: I found this place by chance, although I recognised the name from Lonely Planet. I had the vegetable thali (rice with light curry sauce/gravy,poppadoms and three types of salad) and added on a portion of chilli chicken too. The food came quickly, there was loads of it and it tasted superb! My entire meal (including an iced tea came) to 10RM, which is less than £2. Just amazing :)Show less

Author: laurayjosue
Title: Good value set lunch
Review: Good value for money for their set lunch. Tasty food with a good variety. Would have been nice if it was a bit hotter, but cold food is usually the case with set meals from a buffet. Service was quick and attentive.

Author: thecelticllama
Title: AWESOME vegetarian
Review:
Friendly, quick, and considerate service. Extremely vegetarian-friendly.

Great amount of (delicious) food for value: 4RM vegetable thali, 2-4RM roti, 3-4RM lassi. 

Worth visiting multiple times as menu evolves from breakfast to thali to dinner sets throughout the day.

Opens at 7:00am.

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: New premises but same good food
Review: In Feb 2014, this south-Indian restaurant moved to the other side of this busy traffic junction. It is clean, tidy and bright and with the same, smiling staff.We make the trip into town on a Friday lunchtime especially to eat their 'vegetarian special' - ten small portions of vegetable dishes served on a banana leaf with rice (choose white or bryani) and trimmings. The dishes vary from week to week but they are always tasty and filling. Since relocating, prices have increased a little, so now, for two specials (one with plain rice, one with bryani) and a large bottle of water the price is RM20.50. You get a little cup of payasam afterwards, as well. If you wish, you can choose to add separate meat or fish dishes.The restaurant is always busy and these new premises are slightly smaller, so unless you don't mind waiting, it pays to be there before 1pm. Their special is served between midday and 2pm.People have commented that it is nothing special. Maybe not but service is speedy, the restaurant is clean, the staff helpful and the food good. That's not something that you can say about every restaurant in town.Show less

Author: jamutra2001
Title: Nothing Great
Review: The food was decent. I have ate better Indian food in Singapore. We went for dinner and had little to choose from as they were done with many dishes.

Author: Kesh KKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Nearest to the Tourist Attaractions
Review: The nearest Indian Restaurant to the Tourist area, It will shift just opposite the road come Jan 2014. Its like any Indian Restaurant but i must admit its very clean. We had breakfast there the usual Tosai, Roti Canai and its like what you'd get. Teh tarik ( tea made in a pulling fashion) was why in went in in the first place. A good teh tarik is hard to get here at least for me since i'm not familiar with malacca. At night we passed the shop and the workers were washing the entire floor and mopping it with dettol! (antiseptic solution). Its near the river area and if u can find Public Bank, you can see this place. Good place for teh tarik!Show less

Author: SaravanaK303
Title: Visited melaka for the first time
Review: Im an indian guy...i love indian food n the food in this restaurent was awesome...the only thing that suprised me was the price...it was kinda expensive but its alrite for a 1 time visit

Author: KateM42
Title: Best Indian food outside of India
Review: Honestly some of the best comfort Indian food I've had outside of India. There's a large selection of food, we tried two types of rotti, two types of naan, chapati and thosi and it was all excellent. Dishes are inexpensive as well, the most we spent on a meal for two people was 10.80MYR, with four dishes and two chai teas. Definitely a place to eat.Show less

Author: teenagesab_87
Title: An old award winning place
Review: When I arrive, most of the dishes already finished. It was arround 7-8pm that time. Do come early~ good tosai and banana leaf rice with chicken dishes... Missed the tandoori and other dishes~ gonna be earlier next round.

Author: Nollaigglas
Title: Don't be put off by appearances
Review: When we entered this eating house we were a little taken aback. We sort of expected a "restaurant" in the formal sense but this place is nothing like that. Food is served on banana leaves and delivered to the table in various pots. But the food is delicious and exceptional value. Staff very friendlyShow less

Author: gregoryscottjonesEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Indian food!
Review: The tandoori chicken was great with unique mint/coriander sauce. The butter naan was a real WOW moment! Absolutely delicious with a tasty Dahl side sauce. The banana lassi was also very good. The service wasn't the best but this isn't an a la carte restaurant. It's authentic Southern Indian grub served in a canteen environment. A filling meal with drinks only cost £6 for two. Amazing food for cheap prices. Perfect. Enjoy. Show less

Author: Karthik SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Melaka trip on 09 & 10 Nov13
Review: The location in google maps is incorrect. It is actually much closer to Melaka River and Discovery cafe on the same road.I don't understand why this restaurant has a great rating on tripadvisor, probably because it is the nearest Indian restaurant to main tourist areas. It is no different from any other south indian restaurants in Singapore and Malaysia.Menu was very limited, just meals and few basic tiffin items.Food quality was good, but cleanliness needs to be improved. We visited on two days, customer service was good during first visit and very poor during second visit. Would recommend this only if you are short on time and can't walk long distance from main tourist areas of Jonker street and Red square. Otherwise there must be better options for Indian food. I didn't have time to explore various dining options in Melaka, so can't suggest a better alternative.Show less

Author: sallymaymillsNembrala, Indonesia
Title: Fantastic vegetarian, amazing value
Review: We were recommended this restaurant by our hostel manager and thrilled by the Friday vegetarian special thali. Six dishes plus rice, chapati, masala chai and a dessert for two, total bill less than $8. Amazing value. Tasty, authentic Indian served on a biodegradable banana leaf. Bustling with locals at all hours of the day. Naan and tandoori served after 4pm. Show less

Author: glostev
Title: Marvelous!!
Review: The food was finger licking...it taste good specially Friday vegetarian special with 8 types of veg and condiments...Really excellent..In the evening,I went to have chicken chunck yogurts with naan was fantastic..it was best food experience and staff was helpful ,friendly...Don't missed it and value ...

Author: Rebecca T
Title: Just right
Review:
Yummy food, amazing prices, friendly staff that are eager to please. Spot on. 

It's also in a central location and easy to find which is always a plus!

Author: JoseLuisG160
Title: can find much better indian/tandoori in Melaca
Review: This is a very basic banana leaf restaurant with rather bland flavours and nothing really special about it. Tandoori was disappointing. Pak Putra is miles better. After our holidays in Malaysia this was at the very bottom of all Indian food we tried.

Author: peteandchris46
Title: Great Indian food
Review:
Great Indian food in a great little restaurant.
Good choices and something for everyone.
Staff are very helpful and friendly, without doubt the most tasty Indian food and excellent value.

Author: travman999
Title: Great!
Review: Great cheap meal - lots of variety. Highly recommended. Good selection of veg and non-veg curries incl fish, chicken, lamb. However not a relaxing dining experience.

Author: Chris101111Auckland, New Zealand
Title: The best
Review: A Sunday afternoon visit for a banana leaf vegetarian meal. Food was the best we have had in Malaysia, staff friendly and very helpful, lots of locals as well as westerners. Silly low price of 4 rm for a filling meal. We will be back again.Show less

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Really tasty and cheap Indian food. Friday Special is not to be missed!
Review: We have eaten at Selvam many times over the past 5 years and never once have we been disappointed.Make sure you go on a Friday lunchtime -12 until 2 - when the Friday Special is available.10 portions of Indian vegetarian dishes served on a banana leaf with either plain rice or byriani rice (recommended). These dishes change regularly, so if you went two weeks in a row you would most probably have 5 or 6 different dishes. If you want to add some 'meat' dishes to your meal then at the back of the restaurant there will be maybe 10 additional dishes you can choose - egg, fish, meat, chicken.The Friday Special is just 7.50RM that's about £1.50 or 30 Bob! You will not walk away hungry!Also in the evenings they do tandoori chicken and naan as well as all manner of other dishes. The restaurant itself is a bit 'basic' but its always clean. The food is delicious!If you are in Melaka on a Friday lunchtime then go to Selvam!Show less

Author: NorwenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very simple
Review: Looks like a cookhouse where you can order directly from trays of food on display. Not much of dinning atmosphere but it is suitable if you are in a big group or families with children as the tables are easily available and indian music is loud and upbeat.The nann (garlic and butter) bread and tandoori chicken are very good, do ordered them if you can wait at least 15-20 min.Show less

Author: Annaconda110Mexico
Title: "value for money" banana leaf at 4mr !
Review: ..... Now I spend a lot of time in Melaka I eat in Selvam Restaurant quite often, and find the prompt service and overall food quality excellent, you are made to feel welcome and the staff are very helpful when deciding what you want to eat, whether its tandoori chicken, nan, roti, mesela tea, vegetarian, rice, spicy chicken or lamb, etc, and if you don't want spicy food or less sugar in your tea or coffee you just have to ask, they are very accommodating, they open at 7am and close around 21:30. It's definitely worth a visit for a meal, or just a tea or coffeeShow less

Author: totuccio83Verona, Italia
Title: What a surprise!
Review: In a square full of traffic you find this typical nice place! They bring you immediately a banano leaf as dish,putting onto rice and a soup,with three different sauces. Then a guy comes with a lot of different meals (tofu,vegetables,fish or chicken) that you can choose or not. Service is nice and fast and price is definitely low! (We two were full and we paid only 21 MYR,beer included!!). Go there and use your hands to eat!Show less

Author: balibariElancourt, France
Title: Good tandori chicken and drink for 3 Euros !
Review: If you do not mind the lack of real air cond, basic tables and chairs, poor decoration, etc. yet if you wish to have a real tandori chicken for a rather cheap price, and really mixing with the local population if you "like other cultures", then I do recommend you the place indeed !Show less

Author: RoscoeHR
Title: The best yet in Melaka
Review: Found this place and was very happy we did. We were trying to work out what to order and a local helped us out. Food comes out and is placed on the banana leaf. Consisted of Dahl, veggies, rice, two curries and some other condiments. The food is moderately spicy, though the host was nervous it would be too hot, but it was not really that hot but I imagine some people may find it so. The aromatic chicken curry was the highlight. Packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. Give this a try if authentic Indian food works for you. Show less

Author: NalinW_12Marsfield, Australia
Title: Best Curries
Review: This is one of the best banana leaf places I have tried. Nice Malay/ South Indian flavours. Food is fresh and very hygienically handled.
