If you are in the area it is worth going to.Show less

Author: twnteoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Hot with not effective aircon pub.
Review: We wanted to have a couple of drinks..but ended having only 1!.4 of us, a frozen berry margarita, pint and 2 homemade lemonade, 1 with mango.The place was hot, air con was not effective.The homemade lemonade was like a dash of lemon and topped with a fizzy soda while the mango lemonade just had a spoon of mango puree added but taste artificial.By the time we left, we were sweating!Not a relaxing evening.Show less

Author: christopherpJ9947XG
Title: Sid's Pub on the river...
Review: Came to Sid's on two occasions during my 3 weeks in Malacca City on business Good food, friendly wait staff and a nice atmosphere as it sits on the river. They kept the windows wide open so the breeze off the straits could flow in. Despite the haze from the fires in Indonesia, this was still a pleasnt experience. Will return when i am back in a few weeks...Show less

Author: Adventurers049
Title: Great spot
Review:
This pub is located on the bank of the river, so the setting cannot be beaten!
Service was friendly and good... and the beer was lovely and COLD!

Author: KuffyStaveley, United Kingdom
Title: Perfectly Placed for Any Time Of Day!
Review: Sid’s bar has one of the best view on the river and is open throughout the day and evening. It came recommended to us by a Melaka local. It is clean, bright and open with good space between the tables. It’s elevated position overlooking the river is perfect for watching the world go by.Staff are very courteous and helpful and there is free wifi. Although we only went there for drinks we were very tempted to return for dinner as the food being served looked delicious.The basil infused homemade lemonade was a wonderful mid morning reviver. I would certainly return.Show less

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambiance and great music
Review: Didn’t try their popular cocktails only had beers. We ordered nachos and the family size was very large. The place has a nice and authentic pub feel to it. Waiting staff are fantastic too. The live band was fabulous. If you’re a fan of blues and old rock, here’s the place to be. Hope to return soon. Show less

Author: horan_126
Title: Mid-high priced drinks, average service, but good view
Review: Good view out to the river, service charge and tax added to drinks on top of menu price. Chain pub with unenthusiastic service.

Author: APisME95
Title: Nice spot on the river for cocktails
Review: Fantastic and extensive cocktails! Very reasonably priced for happy hour. Loved the vibe here on the river and the pub feel. Bartender and waiter were very chill guys.

Author: RatingDuoMerak, India
Title: Nice riverside joint
Review: We sat here to spend our last hour at Malaka. The service is attentive and friendly. We got even a tip on what to order, which was a cheaper and better option*. If you need a break from the busy sights and sounds of jonker - watch the river and sip your drink. You might get lucky and spot some riverside wildlife!*Be prepared to pay a little extra for the view!Show less

Author: nzoutofofficeWellington, New Zealand
Title: Discrimination against being solo
Review: I intentionally came to this place for its riverside setting, tables by windows opening out over the river. I had planned a late afternoon drink and early dinner, however having arrived to all the window tables being full, I took a seat in the centre of the pub and ordered a drink. After 20 - 30 minutes, I noticed a couple with their baby were packing up to leave their window seat and so began to stand and take my drink/bag to the table, only to be stopped by the waiter and told I couldn't sit there as it's for a 2-4 people and I was on my own. The pub was most definitely not full and there were plenty of other tables for 2 - 4 people also (which coincidentally was the same size as the table I'd ben seated at already). I was speechless and so paid my bill and left to eat my dinner elsewhere along the river. As a solo traveller I accept there are some things I just have to suck up, like hotel room costs, taxi costs etc. but never in my 20 years of international travel have I been unable to sit where I would like to at a restaurant. (it's not like I was seated at a table for 8!)Show less

Author: E7777AAjohnrGeraldine, New Zealand
Title: An evening by the river
Review: Called into this bar for a beer at lunchtime, the staff were very helpful and friendly so we returned in the evening to have a light meal and more cool beers as we watched the tour ist boats go up and down the river. The night lighting on both banks of the river were very spectacularShow less

Author: NicholasT793Worcester, United Kingdom
Title: Great bar for drinks and meals- reasonable prices and great location
Review: After a walking tour in Melaka with the steaming heat it was great to sit down in SIDS bar, based on English pubs, next to the river (bit smelly but ok), we had ice cold beers at happy hour prices.Great value, open windowed bar, nice ambience and friendly nature of staff.Actually popped in twice here over the days because it was so pleasant, just off Yonker Street and the hustle and bustle.We had lovely lunchtime meals here, fish and chips, panini’s, pie and chips- all cooked fresh and served hot at reasonable prices.One of the better bars we used over the days we were in Melaka.Show less

Author: SulifamilySydney, Australia
Title: Great Atmosphere
Review: We dropped in while walking through Melaka river precinct. Great Atmosphere, fantastic gin and tonics plus a very lovely waiter. Clean toilet considering it’s in a very high tourist area plus very cosy pub atmosphere.Really enjoyed it and wished we had stayed for dinner. Busy but still great service and looked like live music at night. Right on the river it’s an interesting place to go. Show less

Author: patrickwilliamg
Title: Good bar good river view
Review:
An average place for that area, good selection of beers, food was presentable, we found the staff most polite and helpful.
It was intriguing watching the lizards on the river bank.
Would we go again, most certainly.

Author: chuckyJellie
Title: Cold beers
Review: Great find right on the river, cold beers great music and happy staff. Would definitely return when next visiting Melaka.

Author: farsyaahmad
Title: Chill place for a beer. Not great for anything else.
Review: First day, went for beers (good) and food (I'm sure the photo of the cottage pie received speaks for itself). Then in the evening, went for cocktails; had a clueless waiter and an awfully rude bartender that did not want to accept that I had severe allergies, which I specifically mentioned before ordering. My boyfriend went over to confirm that they'd written down my allergies, only to have the bartender scream at us, saying he already started mixing the the drink and therefore we needed to drink it, or just leave it but still pay for it. His exact words were, 'Don't drink la, but you will lose your money'. He even asked me WHY I had allergies. Will never go again. Show less

Author: cl41r3Nottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Average food but nice view of the river
Review: I visited Sids as I wanted a nice view and craving a full English which I spotted on their menu. The view was pretty. The service was ok. The food average and over priced so not as described on the menu. When I asked I was told that they didn’t do it that way anymore. And seemed annoyed that I had asked for the missing items. With no suggestion of reducing the price which would have been fair as not all items were on the plate. Being alone I didn’t want to debate that. Anyway. I got the bacon and pork sausage which was what I had craved so that was a positive. Would I return. Probably not. Show less

Author: lousrevews2k19
Title: Louis
Review:
• Nachos. Cheese from a can. Meat from a can.
• 2/10 would not get again
• Didn’t even get guacamole
• Not best impressed
• Sid = Sad

Author: izzabizzLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Squirty cheese from a tin :(
Review: We ordered the nachos here as well as the cheesy chips and gravy. They were terrible and so overpriced. They obviously used squirty cheese which tasted sour and gross and the chilli con carne meat in the nachos tasted like it was from a tin. The soured cream also tasted off. Having tasted just a couple nachos we asked to return it but the waiter said he couldn’t do anything which I guess is fair but to then have to pay 10% service on pretty bad food that tasted like it was from a tin in a cellar was pretty sad. Squirty cheese from a tin shouldn’t be in the same category as nachos which cost over £6....it is literally cheaper in a Mexican restaurant in soho, central London and at least then I’m getting guacamole and salsa. :( a sad trip tbhShow less

Author: MoadRa
Title: Good but pretty expensive
Review: We decided to take lunch in this bar. I ordered a burger with was pretty good (Good size!), but a sauce should be added to make it even tastier. My friends ordered pastas and fish. The view is good. The prices are pretty expensive.

Author: DebraR199Darwin, Australia
Title: Divine desserts
Review: We called in here for shelter as the rain fell. Decided on a meal which was pretty ok. Luckily we had a table overlooking the river and we sat and watched the tour boats pass. Very pleasant indeed. It's a replica english pub and popular with tourists. Service was excellent and friendly by locals. Decided on 2 desserts and boy were they divine cheesecakes. All in all a splendid little pub to sit and watch boats pass by on the river....and eat glorious desserts!!!Show less

Author: RoadTripRogerPutnam, Connecticut
Title: It was hot, and (British or not) the beer was cold
Review: Not a lot of options for a cold beer in Melaka, but Sid's was one that came handy. I understand this is a chain, which helps explain why an ersatz Brit pub exists here. People were friendly and service was good. Great location overlooking the river.Show less

Author: Mr_rossduncanAdelaide, Australia
Title: Sad
Review: Taking up what is surly Malacca's number one location, right on the river at the beginning of Jonker street, you'd expect this place to either reflect some Malaysian heritage and style, or be a haven of class and cool style for modern travelers.Sadly it's just a dull old fashioned too loud dump. Boring food, dull drinks, uninterested staff, there's not much to recommend.Show less

Author: Sm2018solo
Title: Old English style pub
Review: Smack right in the middle of Jonker Street. You can hear a live band sings after 9pm in the front, while sit back and relax at the back watching small boat cruising through the river, sipping your martini.

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Rendezvous Point
Review: Located at the corner of Jonker street overlooking river cruise. You can even sit outside and enjoy the sip of beers and light refreshments. It's a non halal pub and basically caters to tourist and locals though. Happy to meet my old buddy Mat Salleh Richard who works there after a long hiatus and he is always in his jovial mood. Show less

Author: SanJK89
Title: Good Spot
Review: Located strategically at Jonker Street beside the river. Great spot to hang out for couple of beers and food. View is good. Friendly staff. Will go again.

Author: SG-lmh
Title: Hanging out with a pint of beers
Review: Just sitting by window and enjoying the wind from Malacca river and living music. You can leave the annoying crowd behind. Good beers and ciders.

Author: stuffmatters
Title: Comfort food, great location
Review:
Sids is superbly located overlooking the fort and Malacca river enabling a great view on river life and close to Malaccas main attractions. 

A great spot to chill and enjoy a cold beer and some classic bar comfort food.

Author: capsicum0620Thailand
Title: Location...
Review: ..is all that matters. Well, at Sid's, the service is also excellent: courteous and swift.As in any Malaysian bar geared at tourists and expats, the beer is outrageously expensive, and the selection offered quite depressing. Malaysia is NOT a place for beer lovers.This being an English pub, we did not order any food. What was served at the table next to ours comforted us in our opinion.Show less

Author: dan k
Title: Duped by cocktail offers
Review: It was great to sit on the river and the bartender was good, very tasty drinks. Unfortunately, the bill was considerably more than expected and the depicted offer was not honoured. The duty manager apologised and accepted an error from a member of his team but refused to correct the bill. We live in KL and are fans of the Sids / Gravy Baby franchises but were disappointed on this occasion.Show less

Author: Jash_London
Title: Great drinks selection
Review: Excellent if you need a wide selection on the menu - besides the usual which is available in Melaka, you will find excellent cocktails, Guinness, and good wine.

Author: Restos
Title: Best cocktails ever !
Review: Nice pub in front of the river. They make the best cocktails we ever had!! They are kind. Thanks a lot !

Author: MrMarkT
Title: The Beer was good Not the food.
Review:
Ordered the Fish and Chips. British pub. No fish and chips.
Ordered the Steak and mushroom Pie. They threw it in the microwave and it was 1/2 cold and 1/2 hot. the vegetables were warm but not cooked.
Not impressed. will not go back.

Author: Low2002
Title: Friendly service
Review: The waiters are very friendly and provide excellence service.  The place is relaxing except for the occasional super hyped trishaw riding pass with loud music

Author: DavidGpangPangbourne, United Kingdom
Title: Comfortable pub with decent food and cold beer!
Review: We'd been travelling around Malaysia for two weeks and fancied something different o the great Asian food we'd been eating. The fish and chips was excellent! We also came in for drinks on the previous 2 nights and sat and watched the river as the sun went down - saw Monitor lizards on the river bank beneath us.Show less

Author: emmabirch89Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Just popped in for what was advertised as a pint
Review: Looking for somewhere to watch the game and popped into what's advertised as a pub pulling real pints, we couldn't resist the idea of a pint but sadly got less and was charged more than listed on the menu. Although we were sat at the bar we were charged service which isn't normal considering all he did was pull a 490ml "pint" and pass it to us, what was advertised as a 20rm pint was actually 23.2rm a pint including what they call a ++ ... not much but if you're on a budget not really a nice surprise. We don't expect to find the classic British pub experience on this side of the world as it's not what we came for but we would at least like to know what we are paying for and would like other like minded folk to know the same. Service was prompt and staff friendly but the "no nonsense" promise on their website doesn't extend to having a full pint at the price stated on the menu and sneaky service charge. (see pic)Show less

Author: Mark JFalmouth, United Kingdom
Title: In transition - awful
Review: Visited Sid’s on a what should have been a busy Friday night but bar was fairly quiet. Seems to be changing management or ownership to the GravyBaby chain of restaurants...? But transition isn’t going well - service was poor, several things on the menu were unavailable, food was very slow arriving, two dishes were not as ordered and two never arrived. We even saw them bringing in our cooked rice from another restaurant nearby! As my wife still hadn’t received her meal by the time everyone else had finished, we decided enough was enough and left. Staff were very apologetic but there were enough of them working to ensure even a minimal level of customer service should have been possible. A regular patron told we should have just had a drink and not ordered food as the place had gone downhill recently. Shame, because the location is good and Sid’s used to be a reliable place for food, drink and a nice riverside atmosphere. Hope they sort things out quickly! Show less

Author: JacktarLancsukLancs uk
Title: Tranquility away from the mayhem of Jonker Street
Review: Visited Sid's Pub twice during our stay. On both occasions we managed to get sits by the open windows so we were able to watch the tour boats go sailing past. Also turned out to be an excellent spot to watch the monitor lizards in the river. Service was prompt and there was only a short delay for it to be delivered to our table. sandwiches were nice and fresh and my daughters cooked meals were piping hot. Friendly staff and a nice ambience. A nice place to chill out away from the chaos of Jonker StreetShow less

Author: martin w
Title: Good vibe on a hot evening
Review:
Just dropped in on a hot, steamy evening.  Drinks were good and reasonably priced.  Staff friendly and helpful. Well positioned at the end of Jonkers by the river.
Went back the next night for more again after mooching around the town

Author: AzurianWorthing, United Kingdom
Title: Good food with reasonable prices
Review: We tend to avoid British/ Irish pubs when we're traveling, but we'd been away for a month, fancied something without spices and ate here three times.. Besides they were showing 6 nations rugby.. Beer and food prices were excellent, certainly not the most expensive beer in Malaysia, not even the most expensive in Melaka. Food was good and tasty- we had burgers , meatballs, fish and chips and a pie. The service was good, the tables by the windows had a great view and everyone was really friendly. What more could you want?.Show less

Author: chuckwow56Norwich, United Kingdom
Title: Visited twice for food enjoyed both times.
Review: Some reviews have been opinion rather than fact, i am fussy the chilli con carne n rice was tasty good size portion and served with a smile , the second time was a pie n chips i missed my english grub after 3 months, pie was full of meat , tasty but flaky pastry top was a little burnt , chips were skin on type not my favorite but well seasoned and o.k.Both meals were big servings With a view of the river while you eat its one of the best of its type in malaysia though cheaper beer is just a minute walk away , you will be sitting on the street instead of inside you pays your money .Live music weekendsShow less

Author: Casandra MJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Amazing western food and atmosphere
Review: From an American perspective, this place is great. Since moving to Malaysia, we have struggled with the quality of "western" food, or at least what is considered "western" food here. Sid's Pub was a fantastic testament to quality and selection of what is considered western food. I had the cottage pie topped with mashed potatoes and my husband had a ham and cheddar sandwich. Both were very good (the cheddar was thick and was very fresh), but the sandwich was GREAT when dipped in the gravy that came on the side with my cottage pie. My cottage pie also came with a side of vegetables that were cooked perfectly and very buttery. The drinks and food are a bit higher than the surrounding locations that are not western, but overall worth the price and doesn't necessarily break the bank. We had beer and Smirnoff's continually served without having to flag down the waitstaff which we appreciated. Excellent service overall. Music that was playing was chill and makes you feel like you're in a true hangout spot but does need a larger selection of music that cycles. In the three total hours we were there, over two visits during CNY, I think we heard the same playlist repeat a few times. I'd also like to point out that the pub is not overly crowded with tables and seats - when some friends met us there later in the night, it was easy for them to find us, navigate over, and find a seat.Overall, we really enjoyed stopping here and will return if we visit Melaka again.Show less

Author: Jood07United Kingdom
Title: Great food, atmosphere and staff
Review: Came across Sid's Pub as we escaped the famous night market (don't washe your time on that!), so went for lunch the following day. It's one of the few places that has a couple of recent veggie options so we shared a Ploughman's Lunch (without any of the add-on meats) and a Spring Pie. The Ploughman's was groaning with the weight of the cheese, a good assortment of pickles and fresh bread roll. The pie was hot and delicious. A couple of beers were sunk and I had fresh orange juice which was served in a large glass, not one of those piddly little things which holds a teaspoon of liquid.I've been a vegetarian for over 50 years and find Malaysia especially difficult as far as veggie friendly places. There has been a great swing to Veganism In the UK recently and I think vegans in Malaysia.....I'm fact much of SE Asia....will struggle even more than I do. Be warned.We sat at a table overlooking the river enjoying our meal....and conversation! Although there was music it was as it should be In The Background! Hurray!The staff were friendly and attentive, the place was clean, the atmosphere relaxed and the food was good. As far as our party of three are concerned this was actually the best bit of our Malaccan weekend.Show less

Author: dannyw885Shenzhen, China
Title: Deceptively Overpriced
Review: Went for two beers and was told it was happy hour, only after ordering where we shown that happy hour didn't change the price at all. And after they'd begun pouring the drinks they kindly informed us that there was a 10% service charge for a drink in a pub. Plus an additional 6% service tax. More expensive than a pub in London and uncomfortable stools.Show less

Author: 2019hpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good ambience and hospitality
Review: Sid’s pub is one the best places to have drinks in Melaka. The staff is very pleasant and goes extra mile to make you comfortable. It’s a good place for family too. We had a lovely evening at Sid’s pub and it’s in the books for next visit too. Show less

Author: 570vincentd
Title: Nothing special
Review: For a drink, it's OK. For dinner, I got a minimalistic mushroom bruschetta and a good sandwich but with chips, Lays one are better. Kind of British pub but Asian way..

Author: OkieDokie28
Title: Horrible Christmas Service
Review: I’m still currently sitting at sid pub. Horrible Christmas 3 course set. Dry minimal stuffing roasted turkey. ( never mind about that maybe doesn’t have enough technical skills to cook turkey ) but the worst of all is the service which is unforgivable. Waiter doesn’t even know what is on the menu of the Christmas lunch. The bowl for the mushroom soup was stained badly. Didn’t even served out the last course which was the minced pie even though all payment was made and was about to walk out the place. How to even give the place a second chance when the cutlery and plates bowls are all stained dirty ...... summary Filthy !!!When you are drunk you don’t care what goes into your mouth ( but I DO CARE )Show less

Author: satanbug
Title: A local version of an English pub
Review: If you miss sticky tables, football on TV, deep fried food, miserable staff and the most expensive beer in Malaysia, this place will deliver. Enjoy.....

Author: happydevo55Portland, Oregon
Title: Very good atmosphere, drinks and service, but very expensive
Review: This place has a great location on the river and very pleasant to sit there. The drinks were good. I had a couple of pints of Tiger that were served very cold, and my wife had a margarita which she thought was great. The service was also very good, the waiters were pleasant and looked over us well asking frequently if we needed anything. The only disappointing part was when we got the bill - in addition to the prices already being high they add a 10% service fee. This made the price of 2 pints of Tiger and one margarita at 90.50 MYR which is very high. I would likely go back based on quality, but....Show less

Author: MiaaMiPuchong, Malaysia
Title: best pie in town
Review: recommend homemade pie, chicken mushroom pie is a must try if you have no idea what to order. Chicken sausage (abit spicy) is perfect match with the cold draught beer. Nice overlooking the river view with boat passby. Nice location, staff are friendly, good environment. Definitely will back again. Show less

Author: RFO01
Title: Not enough Stars
Review:
The best most accommodating pub in malacca

Couldn’t not do enough to ensure I was catered for! 

Brilliant

Author: HonisoiquimalypenseDerby, United Kingdom
Title: Great pub on the Riverbank!
Review: This was our “go to” sanctuary where you can escape the hubbub of Jonker Street and have a cold beer sitting watching the river. Staff are friendly, beer is cold and the wine good! Food was a tad disorganised but quality was good. This should be on you “visit” list!!Show less

Author: andyetc120Battambang, Cambodia
Title: Excellent riverside location, great staff and live sport.
Review: Located in a perfect position over looking the river, Sids pub is a great riverside bar with excellent live music and one of the only places that shows different live sports.Ric and his staff are very friendly and welcoming and it’s the perfect place to while away the afternoon overlooking the river, enjoying good food and drinks, with a mix of locals and tourists alike coming and going. Thanks for your hospitality!Show less

Author: TalithaMM
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Great pub (to watch the games). Fair happy hour prices. And great location on the river. They also do live music upstairs.

Author: Carole H
Title: Beer by the River, What could be better?
Review: Sid's is a great spot to end the with a glass of beer on the patio. Let the fans cool you, let the river boat tours entertain you, let the beer revive you.

Author: ClubGGGToorak, Australia
Title: Pleasant pub
Review: A wide selection of all drinks is available and beers of course, on tap and in bottle.You can have a bite there too, mainly finger food like French fries etc.Nice service, polite and fast.But an expensive place, MYR80 for 3 pints of beer!Show less

Author: gioniaontour
Title: Malaysian England
Review: Although this is not a typical malay bar, we had a drink in this english pub. If you miss england and want to choose among a range of good tap beers and chips, this is the place for you!

Author: Aussie0ldieTownsville, Australia
Title: A little bit of England in the heart of Asia.
Review: Great place to share a jug of beer or other drinks and English fare! If you're lucky enough you can snag a table overlooking the canal and watch the world go by. Friendly staff and also lives sports on tv.....Australia v Pakistan in the cricket.Just to remind you, prices are +tax and service.Show less

Author: Markm1972
Title: Friendly, good beer
Review: Lovely spot on the river. Get a seat by the window and watch the world go by. Friendly service, beer and food both good.

Author: kentwongbug
Title: Great chilling place!
Review: A very british feeling pub where located next to Malacca's river. Great service, great ambiance and great beer. Do stop by at this pub and grab the river's view table to enjoy the Malacca's night. Overall, highly recommended!

Author: wessyuk
Title: Relaxing drinks
Review: Sid's Pub, we have visited in K.L. After walking and enjoying this beautiful place we enjoyed a relaxing drink, no food, lucky to get a table by the river, great views down the river I could have sat there for hours. Great atmosphere, we visited in the afternoon. Good watering hole.Show less

Author: 134MichaelP134Brisbane, Australia
Title: Good location
Review: A good spot for a beer or two, if lucky enough you can sit by the Windows over looking the river.The staff on my two visits are all very friendly.I only had the ploughman light meal both times, I found it not to be a heavy meal and was enough after try some of the food on Jonker StreetShow less

Author: ellag182
Title: Great pub
Review: Nice pub by the river with a good view. Great food and service, relaxed atmosphere. I stopped by a couple of times there and I really enjoyed it.

Author: MrThrill
Title: Top pub.
Review: Great pub on the Melaka River with views up, down and across the river including watching the giant water monitors. Lovely cold beer, happy hours, good snacks and good service. Great bluesy, musician on Sunday afternoons.

Author: Christopher VNew York City, New York
Title: Toursit Trap
Review: Great view but that's about it. A proper tourist trap for those who aren't so adventurous to try street food or Malay food. Only went here because on a Sunday/Monday night mostly everything is closed so there aren't many options to choose from (especially after a 500km drive down to Melaka).Show less

Author: Inspire757452
Title: Nice pub by the riverside at Jonker Street Melaka
Review: This is really a nice pub by the river side at Jonker Street Melaka..After a half day walk at the Jonker Street..it would be great to relax here. Happy hour price for beer here is reasonable.. got few varieties of beer too. Nice!!!

Author: bangziBoise, Idaho
Title: get a table by the window with a nice view over the river
Review: we came into this place after we were done wondering around and still had a few hours before heading back to kuala lumpur. it's located near the old town square and jonker street by the river. we had a table by the window overlooking the river towards the old port, nice view! we weren't bored looking at boats coming up and down and large lizards swimming around, birds catching fish. our 7 year old had a good time here as well.we had a hot dog and a malay mutton with rice, both were tasty. beer was cold and plenty!Show less

Author: Bill R
Title: Proper pub
Review:
The staff was really friendly and the food was good.
Nicely situated at the side of the river with an open area to drink as well

Author: SparkzJordanLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great English pub vibe on the beautiful river!!
Review: Great English Pub in an awesome location on the river at the end of busy Jonker Street!! Nice relaxed atmosphere with live music over the weekend and various screens showing the English Premier League football matches!!They have a promotion throughout August offering Heineken & Guiness at happy hour prices until closing. A pint of Heineken will set you back 23rm (Usually 28rm) and a pint of Guiness is 20rm during this promotion. There is a large variety of food on the menu even though we didn't eat there during our stay, some good old English dishes on offer which would be great if your missing home style food. Prices are generally on the expensive side for Melaka. Would definitely recommend a visit though!!Show less

Author: chloesworld_7Peterborough, United Kingdom
Title: Nice little pub with outside deck
Review: We stopped by to have a beer and although not the cheapest, it has a nice vibe. However, for Aug they are offering happy hour all day for Heineken and Guinness for a pint. We didn't eat here as we had already eaten for the evening, however the menu did look pretty good. If you are craving some pub food this would be your place, bangers and mash, Sunday roasts and pies are all on the menu.Show less

Author: Eithne K
Title: Cracking roast!
Review: Me and my friend went to Sids for some food and a drink by the river the location is perfect and the food is such good quality- was the taste of home we were both craving! The staff are all lovely and the little extra efforts from the management went such a long way. We felt really well looked after and it won't be long till we return!!Show less

Author: KendirgiQuebec City, Canada
Title: Nice terrace!!!
Review: We went just for a drink. We had two Guiness that cost more then our bus ticket for Singapore but It was worth it. Ok, a Guiness is a Guiness but the setting of this pub is beautiful. We went because we could sit on their inside-outside terrace, with a nice breeze and good view of the river and the city. Quite relaxing moment after hours of walking and sweating!!! Staff attentive and smiling!!!Show less

Author: albatross-549
Title: Good friendly place!
Review: Great location to enjoy with friends... Location is great... Enjoyed the ambience... Music could be softer

Author: SharonBBPanama City, Panama
Title: Fun stop to meet intersting people and have a draft beer...or 2.
Review: Good draft beer. Pub food okay but we like the Malaysian street food so we cannot judge the food much. What we liked was the friendly atmosphere where we 2 met people from far flung parts of the world. Good meeting place right in the heart of Melaka.Show less

Author: KrisT1476
Title: A great place with excellent staff, food and beverages.
Review: Really enjoyed my time spent at Sids Pub. Great location along the melaka River in Jonker's. This is in no way a sports bar, but a great place to catch many sporting events i.e. world cup, MotoGP etc. Great selection of food and beer on offer and for a real reminder of home I recommend the Sunday roast with a pint of what you like. Rick the manager has a great wealth of knowledge regarding the local area and further afield as well as being a genuinely nice bloke. The staff are great, very friendly and attentive but not annoyingly so. There's plenty of space split across 2 floors and live music over the weekend (I missed this due to world cup being on but I met Mark from the band who advised me its a good mix of rock and blues) I was also fortunate to meet Geoff the owner of Sid's Pubs, kudos to Geoff for his business idea and sticking with it. It works mate and I thoroughly enjoyed my time here over 2 weeks. Thank you and your staff for making my time in melaka a great time.Show less

Author: H4948UVlisap
Title: Time to relax after a busy couple of days
Review: After a hectic couple of days in Singapore, Melaka is the perfect place to unwind. Sid's Bar offers a great selection of drinks, great looking food (we didn't eat), a relaxed atmosphere and a good view to watch the boats and the world go by.

Author: U2836LRsimonk
Title: Very overpriced and out of atock
Review: Nice place next to the river but it’s very overpriced. Half the draft beers displayed are not in stock.

Author: Judyfosse
Title: Nice setting,but pricey.
Review: Great setting on the river, but over priced for both food and beers. They advertise a happy hour price for beer, but don’t make it clear what size beer you are getting.

Author: GBOK01Southport, United Kingdom
Title: NIce having a drink watching the river.
Review: Good food with a good menu and large windows that opened wide to let the breeze in. It is also just around the corner from jonker steet where there are lots of shops. It also has wifi Meleka is a nice place to visit for a day trip as most of the attractions are very close to each other,Show less

Author: marloncc
Title: A happening place on Jonker street
Review:
A great place to stop by for a drink. We got a table in the balcony which also allowed us view of the TV to catch the live World Cup match. 
Attentive staff and reasonably priced.

Author: theperceptivefoodiePenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Awesomely windy, good service
Review: A really great place to just sit by the river, enjoy the cool breeze and a nice glass of beer. It also feels cooler because they have the air-conditioning on, in open air! The service was great, and the blue cheese mushroom on the menu was divine. Deliciously smooth and creamy with a zing of blue cheese. Slather that on the toasted bread that comes with it, and my tummy was warmly satisfied. Ahh.....Show less

Author: 358bartr
Title: Nice place during World Cup!
Review: Spend two nights here watching the football World Cup. Nice place with a good atmosphere, friendly staff and good service. Liked the Guinness on draft :)

Author: BritLynn2Edmonton, Canada
Title: Feels like a real British pub!
Review: Finding the black and white building that was Sid’s Pub on a very hot day in Malacca was fabulous. Walking in to the cool interior with the open windows and tables overlooking the river was wonderful. My family were publicans in Britain for 25 years and had four pubs during that time so I know when I say it feels like a real Brit pub-not just a fake tourist trap. Have an ice-cold draft Tiger beer and relax watching the tour boats going up and down the river.Show less

Author: HansblixHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Good food, worth the high prices
Review: I ate here solo on a weeknight during a 3-day visit to Melaka in May. The restaurant is in the center of the historical area. I had the fish and chips which was comparable in size and quality to the the fish & chips I had when visiting England and Ireland a few years back. The interior of the restaurant is nice and if you get there at the right time like I did, you can get a table with a view of the river.My only gripe is that the staff were too eager to clear my table as the owner (Sid) was sitting at the bar watching them work. The staff probably felt pressured to look good for him and this made me feel uneasy as I felt a bit hurried to finish my meal. Still, I would go back there again if I ever return to Melaka. Again, the portions were big and the quality was outstanding.Show less

Author: Grazy P
Title: Bar Tender
Review: I asked this guy at the bar something, and this fierce looking woman looked so unhappy, she was obviously jealous, gave me the side stare as if she was ready to bit me up.  #neverletloversworktogether

Author: ChrisA826Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great service
Review: I didn't come to Malacca to visit an English pub but since the football and the aircon were on, it seemed like a good idea. We were treated like locals, got a great seat to watch the world cup and friendly banter with the staff. Definitely a great place to end your day in Malacca. Show less

Author: SteveH6183Glen Waverley, Australia
Title: What a hidden gem
Review: Arrived in Malaka over the festive season, walked what seemed like miles looking for a sit down restaurant. We came across Sids pub, we were greeted at the door by a lovely fellow, the publican I think, nothing was a problem. Coldest beer in the area, great mix of cuisine, and a fabulous aspect over the river, supported by a fantastic service team .What a great find.Thanks sids pubShow less

Author: Gianna I
Title: Great place!
Review: Came here with my friends.Love the view of the Malacca River on the second level with the live band and all. Everyone's so friendly here. :)

Author: meshpk
Title: Wonderful band!
Review: I was reading the comments and wondering "what about the great band?!"I had a great time just now rocking along to great music from the band. The place had great views of the river but most imptly, an excellent sound system and a great band. If I am back in Malacca, Sid's Pub is a must-visit.Show less

Author: ChangKaHinkSandakan, Malaysia
Title: Guiness Stout was perfect! But cocktails... not really...
Review: On our first night there, we had Guinness Stout and they was just nice! Smooth... And just the right amount of flavour, no sourness or anything weird! I also ordered a lychee martini, and that was also something I really liked! It was well-made and the vodka was just the right ratio!On the other hand, the frozen colada was weird-tasting, maybe because of the mixing ratio (not enough rum) ; the margarita was not bad, but I would suggest having it on the rocks.The service there was great! And the staff are all quite friendly, and approachable! Wish to head back for the beer there, again! Show less

Author: 181julesi
Title: Cider and the view are the reason to go
Review: Geoff opened Sid's in Melaka about four years ago and it is the biggest and brightest bar on the quayside, It is right next to the bridge and gives a nice view,The food is Sid's so expect a mix of traditional British pub food and some odd local dishes. My steak and onion pie was great.Drinks are not cheap but they have cider on tap so no complaining from me.Overall a welcome addition to the Melaka street scape.Show less

Author: NikhilNahar
Title: Amazing stop over
Review: A good cozy hangout to grab couple of chilled beers. This place is lively & filled at any hour, it offers a great view of the river from most of its window tables. Easy to spend couple of hours

Author: NLSTLS
Title: Nice spot, awful food
Review: The spot is amazing and the location perfect, the choice of beers is very good. But don’t go there for food it’s not good at all except fries !

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: More pluses than minuses
Review: As I was looking into the entrance of Sid's, I had to laugh when a staff member/manager? came up and boasted having the best food in Melaka. A great bit of promotional bull**** of course, as British-style pub food is no match for what else is offered in Melaka. I suppose for those who like pub food, the choice of items would seem appealing.The attraction is the location and having a bit more variety of beer other than simply Tiger. Service was sporadic but no worse than seems to be the norm in Melaka when things can get hectic.Show less

Author: MatSallKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best place to hang out in Melaka
Review: Ideally placed next to busy Jonker Walk yet away from the noise and crowds. Typical good British type food and beers you expect of Sids Pubs (in KL). Staff and service a little slow but only to be expected on busy weekends. Great place for tourists to recharge batteries before heading back out to the tourist sites, which are all within walking/staggering distance. Park downriver and walk up the side road.Show less

Author: Bill_Stacy
Title: Nice view and tranquil Setting
Review: You can get some good food here, enjoy a beer and watch the boats go up and down the river while doing so. The service is impeccable. Seating is rather limited but adequate. Food is good.

Author: Csaba FBudapest, Hungary
Title: Bad experience
Review: I only went in to drink an espresso - something you will rarely find in South East Asia, but they said they served Espresso. No, they brought me a mug of terrible brown water and charged me for an espresso, and when I said to them espresso was not like this, they even showed me an espresso cup saying yes they know. But when asked why on earth they didn't bring me what I ordered, they just shrugged their shoulders. It is not only the espresso that I was angry about, but much more about the behaviour - not used to this kind of behaviour from people in Malaysia.Show less

Author: 439nevilles
Title: Fresh blast
Review: The aircon works well . Free Wifi and clean toilets.  Did I mention that the food is quite tasty. Took a while to get the food to the table after ordering.

Author: beatricel330
Title: Beer was not up to expectation
Review:
Went to this bar for its draught Guinness Stout and Heneiken. 

Both beer were served with too much foam, not cold. 

Disappointed

Author: Jennifer D
Title: Disappointed!
Review: Warm beer. Hot glasses. Does not work. Nice location and lovely looking out windows and watching the goings on by the river. Didn’t bother eating once we discovered the beer wasn’t cold.

Author: IndySig
Title: Great river view
Review: We stopped in for a cool drink and a basket of chips. Both were good and refreshing and the view was relaxing. Pub food and not Malaysian fare if you are looking for a change.

Author: PeterC7505
Title: Good location and food
Review: On the river or street view with a obvious english flavour.Good value food and pleasant staff.I would of given them a 5 but wifi very poor.That aside a pleasant good value spot

Author: 907pamc
Title: Nice pub by Jonker
Review:
Nice place to end the heritage tour.

The place is by the river...good food, cocktails and friendly staff.

Look for the friendly filipino staff.

Author: D5140LXthomasa
Title: Amazing staff and roast
Review: Amazing pub with great food and even better staff. They cover all the sports you need and have great beers on tap! Would definitely recommend. Rick (manager) went the extra mile on the Sunday roast and made the roast potatoes almost taste better than mum’s roasts! Show less

Author: MrDavetheSarks
Title: English Pub
Review: Nice English pub in a former English colony. Really the only actual pub in the area. Nice views of the river as well.

Author: libra1148Middlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Good pub food
Review: We arrived at Melaka at lunchtime as a party of six. The staff organised a table for us to sit together . We all ordered different dishes and everyone enjoyed their meal which was served hot and was plentiful .The pub is well positioned on the riverside and you could watch the river tour boats going past. The pub us tastefully decorated and had a good range of drinks which were reasonably priced.This pub is well worth a visit if staying in Melaka.Show less

Author: DJD140215Stamford, United Kingdom
Title: Location Great; Food Okay
Review: During our three days in Malacca, we went to Sid’s Pub three times: twice for drinks; once for dinner. It’s in an ideal spot to see the boats going along the river and the atmosphere is good. My rating is influenced by these factors. I was disappointed with the food. My husband said his cheeseburger was “okay” but my minced beef and onion pie turned out to be a chicken pie, which was partially burnt on top. I still ate the filling, though, as my husband’s burger had arrived several minutes before my meal, and I didn’t want to have to wait for a replacement pie. I did mention the mistake when the waiter came to collect our plates but he looked at me blankly. The mash and vegetables accompanying my pie were good, as was the dish of gravy. There was a decent selection of drinks available. Show less

Author: fjto76
Title: Chilling
Review: Nice and cozy place to chill. The pub located facing the Melaka River and it was indeed a breath taking view. We really enjoy our moments.

Author: Dave K
Title: Nice place to sit on the veranda and watch life on the river go buy
Review:
Sat and waited for the sun to go down so we could experience the Jonkers Markets.
The Guinness was cold and the fries hit and spicy. Service was friendly whats not to like,

Author: Francine QKuala Lumpur
Title: Ran out of rice?
Review: This place has the perfect location, but it's probably best for just a drink. We knew from previous reviews to check which items were actually available before ordering, so were looking forward to the (available) lamb curry. However, the waitress came back after a few minutes to ask if we minded having it with chips, as they had run out of rice! How can that happen in Asia?Show less

Author: Dave CYork, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place for cool drink and meal
Review: Visited a number to times, love the large floor to ceiling window doors overlooking the river. Great selection of drinks from cocktails to European beers and wines, only had a few sharing snacks but tasted lovely people sat near us had full meals looked very nice will return to try next time in Malacca Show less

Author: HSeeingtheworldWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Great little pub in excellent location
Review: We visited on two occasions, both just for drinks.On the first occasion it was just before 11am and they were not really open, nevertheless the waiter showed us to a table by the river and we enjoyed an great pint of Strongbow, which, in the heat of Malacca went down a treatWhilst there we had a chat to Sid, who, like my wife, was brought up in Bournemouth, so they had a reminisce Later in the day on our way back to the hotel we dropped in to slate our thirst again. Although Sid was not there several of the staff recognised us and made us welcomeUnder normal circumstances I would not go to an English pub abroad, but, on this occasion I am glad we made an exception Show less

Author: Len19oatcakeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great wee pub and lovely owner
Review: Great live music, yummy food ( we are there in the evening too as it was delicious) The staff remembered us from our visit at lunch time and gave us a warm welcome. The lovely owner then came over to chat to us , recommended us food and chatted. After we had eaten he asked if we would like to listen to the live music upstairs which was great! Also a nice touch was he sent over two free drinks which was a lovely surprise. Great wee restaurant and pub, very much worth a visit whilst in melakaShow less

Author: cluffy2014Salisbury, United Kingdom
Title: A real English pub!
Review: If you're the sort of person who likes to travel thousands of miles and then eat/drink in an English pub then read on. If you're not, stop here!My wife and I have spent several weeks in travelling round Thailand, Laos, Vietnam, Cambodia and now Malaysia. We have been very good and eaten rice meals till they are early coming out of our ears! Last night we went in a Malaysian restaurant and, today, my wife was down with a bad stomach. Enough! We went in SIDS Pub. Bliss! Pie and chips, salt and vinegar, a nice chilled pint and a waitress who took the trouble to find us a table by the river. Tomorrow we'll be back eating Asian food. But just as a one off Sid's was marvellous!Show less

Author: SohyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice cool beer by the river
Review: Nice place for a drink by the river. Good choice of beers, ciders and liquor. The menu is quite extensive too though we couldn’t try except for the fries. The place has a nice ambience and helpful and Friendly staff and it was nice for rest our feet and enjoy a drink by the river.Show less

Author: PinJoueCentral Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Bad Customer Service
Review: We were directed to a table which is directly infront of the washroom.(Photo attached).We did not have a choice.Told the waiter we would change to a new table as soon as one availeble.He noded.They did not bother at all to transfer us to another table when was availeble and let others took over.When approached the counter,the Malay/Philipino lady just told me off rudely that the availeble table was given to someone else.There‘s no customer service in this pub.The other 2 guys were just merely food servers.No finess,no communication and not service minded.The listed price are not cheap.If you are selling at 5* prices, please provide 5*service.Show less

Author: Colin ABrisbane, Queensland, Australia
Title: OK bar, ordinary but expensive food
Review: We got to Sid’s at 7.20 just as the local mosque started the incredibly loud call to prayers. That lasted 5 minutes as usual and we sat at a window overlooking the river. We ordered drinks and looked at the menu. Standard Malaysia/ British pub grub, but no steaks. We ordered fish and chips- not available. We ordered Steak and Onion Pie- not available. We then went through the menu with the waiter to see what was available before settling on a beef burger and pork sausages with Heinz bak s beans and mashed potato. The burger was MYR 30 and consisted of a small factory made frozen beef patty like those you get at the supermarket, on a soft bun with one slice of tomato and a little bit of lettuce. It came with frozen chips. Tasteless except for the beef seasoning. They did have sauce sachets on the table so I added some ketchup. The pork sausages were even more expensive and came with Heinz baked beans as promised and really bad mashed potatoes. Tasted like rancid butter and perhaps that’s what the problem was. Paid a little more than what you would expect for drinks but nothing to complain about here. Nice place to sit and watch the world go by with a drink but wouldn’t eat there again. Show less

Author: rbeightonGeneva
Title: Watered down spirits and cocktails???
Review: Great location with river view and friendly staff BUT BUT they must surely water down the drinks because all three drinks (gin and tonic and two cocktails) tasted extremely weak (and we know how they should taste). Better to go to the riverside cafes and bars just upstream from the bridge (take the small path to the right of Hard Rock Cafe).Show less

Author: richardandkidsBeverley, United Kingdom
Title: A taste of home
Review: The place brought a smile to our faces. This would be a good pub in the Lake District or the Yorkshire dales. Just the right balance of food, drinks, tv screens, football and music. Food was nice. It's expensive compared to local rice dishes but the prices are on there so there are no surprises. Loved the ploughmans plate! Show less

Author: cweitatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique food, good customer service
Review: The food was very Indian Western fusion. Didn't expect that. The taste of the food is pretty unique and hard to find. However, it does not suits anyone who does not like spices. The place has telecast of soccer matches, some classics playing in the background and of course a good place to chill with a drink. Show less

Author: Malkey_AUSMelbourne, Australia
Title: Riverside Pub
Review: Great location behind H&M off Jonker St, pub overlooks Melaka River. Lots of choices on the menu, however for our visit a large portion of dishes had “sold out”. Second and third choice meals were delicious however. Funky tunes belting out through the sound system help overcome the pungent river smell that engulfs you as the wind picks up if you choose a balcony table. Happy to return, hopefully the food planning over busy festive periods improves next time. Show less

Author: AHC_1990
Title: Just don't go here for the food
Review: Great atmosphere, view and location. Ideal for a relaxing drink. But don't bother with the food, it's expensive, the portions are small and it's not very tasty (lack of taste and burned vegetables). Staff/ service is nothing special.

Author: martinhW7937GEChapel-en-le-Frith, United Kingdom
Title: Ideally Situated.
Review: A very pleasant classic style pub serving a range of beers,lagers & soft drinks. We took shelter in SIds Pub during a ferocious thunderstorm & glad we did! The far end of the pub has open concertina type French windows that open up onto the Melaka River. The pub is situated near to the junction of Jonker Street & Heeren Street,next door to the Tourist Police Station. Recommended as a sanctuary against the nearby hustle & bustle & very cool on a hot day. Staff are friendly & prices pretty much as you would expect.Show less

Author: Kim T
Title: It's a classic pub in a great spot
Review: Sid's is a chain so you know what you're going to get, and that is quality hearty British food, nice surroundings, good loos, sport one the TV and well trained staff. The Melaka outlet is in a lovely building right on the riverfront so you can wave at the river cruise boats sloshing past and the water monitor lizards nearby.It's not cheap but it is honest and fair value. We enjoyed it- recommend the burgers and the pies. Show less

Author: LizzyLeetonLeeton, Australia
Title: A great find in the heart of Melaka
Review: This is another place we found during one of our walks around town and what a great find it was. We ended up coming here twice during our stay and both times it was excellent. The tables on the river are great with relaxed and excellent service, The food was great and the beer was cold and the toilets were very clean and 'westernised'. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: familyguy34Manchester
Title: Western retreat
Review: Sids pub is a great place to go to get a real British pint and proper pub grub. I visited every day over a 4 day trip to Melaka. The place felt good...quite relaxed actually. Food was always freshly cooked and Burgers were amazing - the staff....well, what can I say...a great blend of people. There is Rick the boss, a friendly guy full of charisma but short on height (bit like me hey Rick ; ))..really friendly welcoming guy, the staff (didn't meet them all). Christina, happy smiley waitress charming and sweet and then Alan, big smiles and super white teeth...and then there is the friendly mischievous one...Sabrina, loads of character and happy to serve you. Already as I write this, I am leaving Malaysia on a plane - thinking about the guys at Sids. Take care all of you...u lovely people!Show less

Author: Kalevi K
Title: Outstanding staff, menu and view
Review: Rick, the manager is a great host. His staff brought out the power tools to help my daughter make a sea shell necklace. My wife enjoyed authentic, hearty comfort food. We all watched rugby and F1 during their long happy hour. The view was the best, sitting over the river. Unlike other places Sid's has a private river front seating area so the runners and bikers don't run over your toes like other places on the river. Show less

Author: brunasJ5940XI
Title: Nice place
Review: This is a very good place if you want to chill with river view and have a cold beer. They also have very nice burgers and sandwiches. I really recommend this place. One of my favourites in Malaca.

Author: kiwi-traveller-PS
Title: Nice to chill overlooking the river
Review:
Dropped in for a lunchtime beer after walking the river banks for a couple of hours - great service - refeshing breeze

Magic

Author: vanessatW1891MYSeoul, South Korea
Title: Great live music!
Review: Been at Sid’s at a Saturday night and they had great live music there! Happy hour for beers all night long at very reasonable prices and the food was really good as well, although the sausage dish was a little bit too spicy haha. Definitely a must go place in Melacca!Show less

Author: GarthElvis
Title: Serviceminded and very clean
Review: Visited for breakfast. Had cauliflowersoup and my wife had sandwich. Both were tasty. Medium priced. View over the river. Serviceminded personell and superclean.

Author: countrybumpkin888
Title: Best bar in Melaka!
Review: Went to Sid's on their 10th birthday evening. Great drinks deals and impeccable service. The manager Rick went above and beyond, we loved hearing his story and will definitely be back if we're ever in Melaka. Thanks again for a great night!

Author: Bryan CDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Loved This Place. When Multiple Times
Review: Very cool bar, with a varied menu. Beers very reasonably priced (My drink of choice is usually Guinness draft, and they had the cheapest I could find for a pint at 24 Ringgits). Right on the river. To find it, it is just around the corner from the Hard Rock, on same side of the river. Great find.Show less

Author: QcruiserQueensland
Title: Nice place.
Review: We stayed close to Sid’s Pub and would pop in for a drink late in the afternoon. It was great just to sit there, have a drink and enjoy the river activity’s. The staff is very friendly and the prices are reasonable. We didn’t try the food. Show less

Author: Squiff123
Title: A burned mince pie!
Review: I was so looking forward to some British pub grub I waited 20 minutes to receive a mince and onion pie. That’s ok, 1000s of miles from home - worth the wait?! My colleague ordered salmon. The pie arrived burned - yes the crust was black! Now surely the kitchen staff, who incinerated the pastry realised this, but no it was delivered to my table. Being so hungry, I accepted this burned offering because there would be another 20 minutes for another one. How disappointing when the kitchen staff should have realised the mistake, rather than palming off burnt offerings!Show less

Author: eyeHateSandPreston, United Kingdom
Title: A Taste of Home
Review: We had been visiting the Jonkers Street and walk. Went up the tower ride and generally exploring Melaka. Afterwards we were in need of refreshment and came across this place. Had a lovely relaxing drink sat overlooking the river. Idyllic. Free wfi available to catch up with friends & family. Some familiar names on the bar including Guinness - Cheers! Show less

Author: nandhias
Title: Nice place to Chill Out
Review: Nice Pub to chill out after roaming around Melacca. Good Location surrouded by  Museums, restaurants and hotels. 2 Floors with an old English pub concept and nicely designed bar. We got a table overlooking the river. Staff were very nice and good service.

Author: Robert LKuwait City, Kuwait
Title: Very nice, authentic grub
Review: Yes, it's what you'd expect from S.E. Asian Food. Fast, nice seating inside, but with that minimalistic Asian Feel. (just whats necessary - nothing more) hahahah.. Food was hot, and fresh, nice place. Mostly tourists from what I saw... which means it's IN & OUT fast for more activities. I liked it.Show less

Author: NigelG407Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great British Style Bar
Review: A wonderful expat bar offering a great selection of British food. From Shepherds pie to Vindaloo curry they have it all. A few tables overlooking the river - near to the heart of Old Malacca. Patrons are predominantly expat or western tourists. Food so good I dined there twice for dinner, during my visit. Good selection of beers and drinks generally. Free wifi and fair air conditioned - open to the river on one side. Great food great service. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: RIverside Haven
Review: Sid's Pub is in an excellent location - just by Jonkers St, just by the bridge across the river and right on the riverside itself.Lovely atmosphere - you really do feel that you are in a jolly old English pub. We got a table right overlooking the river and could relax, and watch the tourists across at the old Dutch Fort, the boats going up and down the river, and enjoy our drinks and food.A good menu and we enjoyed a snack of Cromer crab cakes, and the crispy whitebait. Both tasty as was our wine - at very attractive happy hour prices.Good friendly staff, helpful service - and fair prices.Very good - well worth a visit especially for families; it is kid friendly in our view.Show less

Author: Roselin D
Title: Nice and safe place for ladies
Review: Nice food and drinks. Their mutton vindaloo was awesome. the place is next to police station. we 4 gals felt very safe

Author: Mummeldidummel
Title: Nothing special
Review: It is nice that they have irisch specialties aside from burger or steak. The staff is very friendly but sometimes a bit overchallenged. The menu lists no non-alcoholic drinks, but they do have some.

Author: sl0wm0Singapore, Singapore
Title: a complete pub experience
Review: great food... had a proper fish and chips and bangers and mash after a long time :)great beveragesa superb band that plays blues and old school rockfriendly staff and a view that looks into the riverwhat is not to like?it is not cheap, but cant say it is exorbitant i hapilly paid for the vibe and the music. I will definitely come back :)Show less

Author: DiscerningDoyenneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Beaut beer and fab fries
Review: The Guinness was served nice and cold, the fries were hot and delivered soon after ordering, the atmosphere was great – we sat at a street-level table overlooking the Malacca river which added to the ambiance – and the service was friendly and efficient. The prices weren't bad either and the toilets were clean (at least the ladies were - the men's remain unchartered by this female reviewer). With easy access from Dutch Square and Jonker Street, this was a great place to relax at the end of the day having pounded the pavement all over Malacca. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: AprilflameKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely spot on thecruver
Review: We had dinner and drinks at Sid's after a day of sightseeing. Seemed to be more a place for drinks than meals but it could be that it was early evening. Lovely atmosphere and great view of the river. Good service and food. Relatively pricey for Melaka but it's worthwhile. We enjoyed being there and will return.Show less

Author: Jo SSydney, Australia
Title: A Great Vibe
Review: Sid's is a great little bar to relax and enjoy some relief from the heat. The beer is cold, the atmosphere welcoming and the staff eager to please. The manager, Rick, keeps a close eye on things and is always good for a chat, particularly if you like motorbikes, and his team are well trained in keeping the customers happy. Special shout out for Daya and Sabrina who had our favorites memorised after day 1 - it was a pleasure to keep going back.Show less

Author: Lisa A
Title: Beautiful old building with a stunning river view and great food
Review: If you are looking for some very wholesome and high quality English food this place is a must. Great food and good prices. Plus you can sit on the edge of the building hanging over the rive for an amazing view.

Author: julian n
Title: Good pub
Review: Sids pub is a good place to have a drink and chill out,the staff are very attentive but sorry Sid it's nothing special!

Author: Nikki V
Title: The Pub with the best views in Melaka
Review: We visited this pub right after a long journey we had to arrive to Melaka from Tioman. The place has a good selection of drinks and nibbles and a great setting. It is also perched right over the river a few meters down the main bridge to Jonker's. Definitely the best and most relaxing atmosphere in town!Show less

Author: Brendan B
Title: A very pleasant watering hole
Review: Sid's Pub is just a stones throw from the hotel I was staying at, has the best pint of Kilkenny in Asia and located in the best part of Malacca. The service was excellent. A great place for people watching and river views.

Author: RobertP7785
Title: Frozen fish
Review: My fish and chips were still frozen when served, and over-peppered.  Lovely riverside venue.  Beer was suitably cold.

Author: JessicaHudsonUK
Title: Great food and great service. No Irish Music, though :(
Review: The food was lovely and the service was fantastic! I'm always a bit gutted that there is no Irish music in Irish Bars in Asia though. :(

Author: SabrinBedi
Title: Nice location and view
Review: Its definitely nicer than the outlets in KL. Friendly staff and the view if the malacca river while you wine and dine is worthy.

Author: Monika P
Title: Fabulous setting for a drink overlooking the river
Review: Sid's pub is beautifully decorated and the terrace on the top floor offers views over the river. Staff are very friendly and helpful. Cocktail list could be more extensive.

Author: ivanf587
Title: Cosy ambience
Review:
Had a fun time at the top floor verandah as I sipped my Guiness. The ambience was superb while the music by live band was equally nostalgic and strong.
Lovely place to unwind and catch some breath while resting.

Author: 234keet
Title: Friendly hangout.
Review:
I'll drop by this place every time I'm in Melaka. Simple cozy friendly bar. Great place for night cap or before dinner drinks. 

Tried the cocktails and will recommend to forego. Stick with the beers!

Author: alj_travelsTucson, Arizona
Title: Nice veranda, good spot for a beer
Review: Had a beer here and enjoyed the view over the river. Went during happy hour, so beers were inexpensive, and the staff was friendly. The view over the water is nice -- although there are a couple spots that small quite bad from the trash below, so choose your seat carefully.Show less

Author: mickjane21
Title: good beer on the river
Review: Good bar on the river near Jonker st. Beer was cold with a good extended happy hour and friendly staff. Did'nt eat here but the food seemed popular.Nice place to relax.

Author: 217geraldinesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Cool Verdanah, chill out atmosphere..
Review: We only popped in for a chilled beer on the deck at 11.30. often post bruch. Very welcoming,smart Tudor, black et white decor, food follows architecture,..and it has a SIT DOWN toilet. Now thats something not to take for granted ladies, in the Jomnker area. Music offered on some nights..a comfortble hang out.Show less

Author: merryweather29
Title: Nice place to sit with a drink but expensive
Review: We enjoyed our drink here and the service was first class.  Just as well as your drink will cost you by the time they have added service charge and taxes.

Author: crazygweiloPetaling Jjaya
Title: Lovely place to eat and drink,
Review: This used to be Howards restaurant pre 2010. It got revived as Sids, apparently sometime in 2015. I think the venue is near enough perfect, in terms of location, appearance and atmosphere. It 'fits' Melaka perfectly.It might be more expensive than other competing venues, but you are paying for a location, and an ambience. Sitting at the windows, relaxing, watching the tourists go by in riverboats is calming and therapeutic,I had the Sunday roast here, it came out perfect, with the vegetables Al DenteShow less

Author: Clare W
Title: Lovely place for a drink with a view
Review: We had drinks over-looking the river - very relaxing! We didn't eat here but the meals we saw looked good.

Author: GlenT870London, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to watch the world go by
Review: Sid's Pub is a nice place to stop for a cold drink or two on a hot day to escape the sun and the throngs of day trippers to Melaka. It's near the bridge, with wide opening windows and tables looking out across the Melaka River where you can watch the tour boats and monitor lizards going about their day or watch a game of football should the need arise.Show less

Author: Angie_BLondonLondon
Title: Fantastic service at a really pretty pub
Review: Visited Melaka over the long weekend, and ended up in Sid's Pub three days in a row. It's a great place for a pre-dinner drink, lovely views of the river, with a relaxed atmosphere despite being quite busy. The staff were quick to notice when we were out of drinks, and came over to offer another, without feeling like they were constantly hovering. They very were polite and friendly, which makes the place seem very inviting. The second time we went, there was a live band on upstairs, which was good fun. On the third visit we hadn't planned to go in, but only had a very short time before our coach back to Singapore was due to leave, and having already waited 50 minutes in a nearby restaurant before being told that the over wasn't working so we couldn't have our meal, we decided that Sid's pub might be our best bet. When we arrived we explained the situation to one of the staff, namely that we had to be in and out within 30 minutes and our meals arrived within 10 minutes of sitting down. Of course we could have got some local street food within minutes as well, but sometimes all you want is a burger and chips or some other pub food, and some air conditioning! We were very lucky and even got a window seat by the river so we got one last look at one of the most beautiful views along the river. The food was good, definitely just what we were after, and we were so grateful to the staff for helping us out wit such quick service. Loved this place, and if we're ever back in Melaka will definitely go back.Show less

Author: Nobbynonads
Title: great
Review: Some tables overlooking the water making for a very pleasant watering hole. The usual pub grub food and a good selection of drinks at reasonable prices. Show sports on large screens for those addicts like myself.

Author: lw1959Wallaroo, Australia
Title: Great place to relax
Review: We spent a lot of time at Sid's Pub as we spent 6 days in Melaka. Pub has great outlook over the river where its good to relax. Service was excellent and very friendly. John you were a standout, thanks so much for your great service and friendly smile. However all the staff were very attentive & friendly. Thankyou. The drinks and food were a good price, especially at "Happy Hour". Pub food but it was of a really good standard. Atmosphere in the pub was great also, loved the live music. Met some really interesting people whilst chilling in the bar. Best seats in the house are obviously right in the open large window areas on the river front. Highly recommend a visit here.Show less

Author: Gorm L
Title: Was here several times - good water whole
Review: Drinks a bit higher in price than down the road - but location justifies this. Great location for an afternoon beer or a bottle red in the evening

Author: Dan BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good (western) food, not the service
Review: Food is pretty standard pub grub, the building and atmosphere is nice, with live music through most of the day (weekend at least).Over the course of two visits orders were forgotten and mixed up too much. Sure we were part of a big group, but orders were written down and still came back wrong. For orders where there were options (e.g. Sunday roast with the soup or how well we wanted the beef cooked), we were not asked for our preference.We still came back a second time, as we were craving a greasy breakfast, but that's the only reason to come here, a craving for foods you miss from back home.Show less

Author: FunkyMarshmallow
Title: Good food by pricey
Review: If you need a bit of western food this is the place to go but you will also be paying western prices. Beer expensive, burgers OK and service is friendly

Author: M V
Title: Good Pub
Review: This is a nice English pub with a good menu.  The food is authentic and high quality.  Good drinks on tap and service is also good.  Nice spot to relax by the river as you wander the old town.

Author: oldestteenagerAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: Sid's Pub Melaka has a new menu
Review: Sid's Pub on the Melaka River has just introduced a new menu. The mushrooms in blue cheese sauce were excellent. To follow I had a superb beef and onion pie whilst my wife had the Pork Vindaloo. This is a great place to chill out and watch the world go by, whilst supping good beer and wine. Sid's Pub is easy to find as it is in the heart of old Melaka at the end of Jonker Street.Show less

Author: Lasrin
Title: OK beer and average food
Review: Happy hour prices for Guinness which was a good thing. Food menu is quite limited, I had a hamburger which was rather average.

Author: MaksmumMelbourne, Australia
Title: River views and okay food
Review: Sid's Pub is on the river and it is lovely to sit and watch the water, river boats and people as you relax with food and drink. Food is fine with the fish and chips being exactly what I wanted/needed at the time. Nice place to spend some time in the heat of the day.Show less

Author: MightyRedsFikSingapore, Singapore
Title: Place to chill & watch BPL
Review: Just need a place to chill and wind down after a long day and catch up a game and lo and behold ! Sid's Pub is the place !! Have an open mind when dining at Pubs in Malaysia cos alcohol are expensive :) I had a great time though and not bothered about the bill as long as the ambience is great , I'll be more than happy to spend ! Staffs are attentive and will keep checking if you need anything else for refill or any additional orders. Friendly staff they are !Show less

Author: PhilsgonemissingBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place but expensive
Review: Needed western food after months of travelling and got it here. Good burgers and cold is what we got. Now it's not cheap and totally overpriced for Malaysia but it was good so i was happy and full. If you want a traditional pub this is the place to go. Staff and service we're excellent Show less

Author: TheBeav57
Title: Check the prices!
Review: It was a nice place to duck out of the heat but even with "happy hour prices certainly not Malaysia prices!

Author: goamelb
Title: Good ambiance
Review: Good place for a drink after sight-seeing. On the 'river' and easy walking distance from anywhere! Cold beer and cider. Small food menu but the pork ribs were good as was the beer batter cod.

Author: Rebecca20155Paris, France
Title: Great location
Review: This is a great location near jonker street but it is so expensive and has a very creepy dark feel to it. When we went we were harassed by a couple of guys there. I wouldn't recommend if you are a western woman. Show less

Author: JayB355Tamworth, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Pub with Riverside Location!
Review: We visited here during a trip to Melaka to rest and get a rewarding drink after busy day seeing the sights and walking Jonker street.True to its advertisement Sids is a quintessential British Pub serving classic homely foods, draft beers and refreshing cider to sip on the balcony over the river.The staff will be sure to make sure you enjoy the visit. This is a great addition to the Jonker scene so make sure you visit - even if you just rest your feet and grab a drink!Show less

Author: chuckwowengland
Title: Right on the river boozer
Review: Good busy pub with normal for malaysia I.e. Expensive think £3 for a small bottle of larger £4 for half of guiness but that is the going rate so this bar. With good location and a real pub feel is a must visit river side tables are few and quickly taken ,Show less

Author: sacred21Malaysia
Title: A hidden gem
Review: We were cracking our heads thinking of where to settle down for drinks when the uber driver dropped us of by chance in front this place. So, we thought why not?Nice environment and ambient for relaxation. We had a table by the window where you can watch the world go by especially river cruises passing by.The band started playing passed 8pm, not too bad a band except they could not do most of the song requests. What a bummer!Show less

Author: Expedition613658
Title: Fantastic pub
Review: This pub is in an ideal location next to the river and close to Jonker street. Serves good food and has a good atmosphere

Author: AnneDickieWimborne Minster, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly popular pub
Review: What a great bar! I'd researched Melaka prior to our arrival and was determined to track down Sid's Pub, which was in fact a short stroll from our hotel, Casa Del Rio.After a drink at Geographer's Café we headed back to Sid's. The manager greeted us and mentioned he'd seen us wandering around earlier in the day. The waitress was friendly and smiling and we enjoyed a couple of Tiger Beers before heading back to the hotel.The following night we returned and managed to get a great table overlooking the river.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Justin M
Title: Best pub location in Malaysia
Review: Sid's kindly hosted our after match presentation for a one off footy match, having made the excursion from KL that morning. More than just a place to eat and have a few beers after a game it is a friendly, affordable pub that knows its identity and capitalises on it. It doesn't try to be a "gastropub" or a wine bar or any of that other nonsense. Good pub grub, cheap beers, a very welcoming host and fantastic band to boot. Added that to, its probably the best pub location (right on the Melaka River with fantastic views from it's verandah) I've come across in Malaysia. Must visit.Show less

Author: Nilufer153
Title: Great place to chill out
Review: Great setting overlooking the river. Excellent service, enjoyable food, clean and easily reachable. Enjoyed!

Author: edwardoluanaighKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect Location for Good Food and Cheap Drinks
Review: We had a great time here last Saturday night :) Sid'd Pubs are well known for their atmosphere and friendly service, but the Melaka outlet adds a beautiful location to that as well. Great place to stop for a few drinks at any time of day while gazing out over the Malacca river. I can recommend the full english breakfast as as well - stacks up very well indeed.Show less

Author: BangsarKiwi
Title: Breeze on the river!
Review:
Great airy restaurant on the river - high ceilings and a cool breeze deliver a perfect environment to take a break from a stroll around Malacca.
Staff are friendly and accommodating, lovely place all round for any type of visitor.

Author: DrummondSiddleRoyston, United Kingdom
Title: Great riverside venue
