Review: Probably the best location for a bar in Malacca. Lovely place to enjoy a refreshing beer and to watch the world slip gently past on the Malacca river. Great service and sensibly priced snacks with the Fish n Chips a firm favourite. Best price for beer along the river.Show less

Author: moochie77
Title: Wonderfully clean with great food and the best drinks
Review: A very welcome respite from the heat and bustle of Jonker's street and the surrounding area, with great service, friendly and helpful staff. Has to be the 'must go and enjoy' venue on the Melaka river.

Author: JasonBray
Title: Best Pub in KL
Review: Great atmosphere and even better people. Sid's pub in the local drinking hole for some many of the local sporting team and each one has a great time.

Author: jacoby985
Title: Best Pub in Malacca
Review: Sid's has a great river view just across the iconic Jonker Walk bridge. Besides sponsoring the top social league team in the league, the only team that has won the British Cup 5 times out of 6 , and confidently coming in top 4 in most years, something Arsene Wenger would be proud of. Sid's gives us fat expat and local blokes a jolly time post game with their amazing happy hour beers and stouts! Good place to meet like minded people and the pub food is sumptuous. 5 thumbs up, oh wait....Show less

Author: isabellemX1890CR
Title: nice river view
Review: Drinks are in good price and the river view is fantastic. Live band is also in great performance. It's a must-go bar along the Melaka River.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner & drinks with a river view
Review: The food was good, the staff were amazing. They were very friendly and went out of their way to make our experience as pleasant and enjoyable as possible. Try and get a table with a view of the river. It’s really pretty, especially at night. There aren’t many tables in that section and are a crowd favourite. They don’t take reservations, so it really depends on how crowded the place is.Show less

Author: Narrabeam
Title: Great riverside watering whole
Review:
Very friendly efficient staff.
Good beer & cocktails reasonably priced.
Simple pub food - western/Asian but good cooked.
Great for watching the world go by on the river.
Nice clean toilets and good wifi.

Author: NickPinderKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sid's Pub. The new jewel of Jonker Street
Review: Ok where to start? Apart from being the real thing, Sid's has a great little area at the back overlooking the river. Another great little area at the front for your al fresco moment. Inside, its all real, good pub memorabilia, the great staff, good beer, wine and really good pub food. The bacon sandwich was knock out. It's now one of my favourite places to take friends and visitors. What is also nice is it gets a lot of tourists and a lot of oversea visitors coming back time and time again. I expect the Sunday lunch will be excellent and it remains on the bucket list... The best part is ... it has good pub atmosphere. A must try if you're in Melaka. Read the History of Melaka: "Malacca is a Malaysian state on the Malay Peninsula's southwest coast. The capital, Malacca City, has a colonial past seen in its preserved town center, the site of 16th-century, Portuguese St. Paul’s Church. It's also home to Christ Church, built by the Dutch in the 18th century. Next to Christ Church in Red Square is the Stadthuys, the Dutch-era town hall now housing a museum of Malaccan history and ethnography. It's now a UNESCO Heritage City and it has it's own Sid's Pub. What more could you ask for...? "One more for the road...?" ... "Madness not to...!"Show less

Author: RoyF31Newark-on-Trent, United Kingdom
Title: Superb
Review: What a find this place was superb, wonderful views across and down the river and a real English menu with all the favourites.The wine is inexpensive for Malaysia and the staff are a delight first class service without being intrusive.The windows are open onto the river and the temperature is just right with fans helping to keep the place cool without the chill of air conditioning found in some places.We were only in Melaka for four days but Sids became our local a great experience don't miss it.Show less

Author: JohnyG111
Title: Perfect location
Review: Great pub/restaurant with a lovely riverside setting. Beautiful old building, sympathetically restored. Great selection of beers and an interesting menu. Well worth a visit.

Author: Stephanielenalee
Title: It was an 'okay' pub...
Review:
Read some good reviews about it and decided to give it a try...got there around Nine'ish was expecting huge crowd but nope...only a couple of tables are occupied. Band was ok...musics are fine...
Service is ok. Nothing to shout about actually ☺

Author: uncle_albert5
Title: Great Happy Hour spot
Review: "Happy Hour" is daily until 8 PM and they have special prices on beer and some food. We had a jug of Tiger beer and a great dish of cauliflower, peas, and bacon topped with melted cheese. So good that we ordered another!

Author: O299RNdeniseh
Title: Great place to visit for a cold pint on a hot day!
Review: We visited this pub as part of our day trip to Melaka and were very impressed with the service, view over the river and the lovely cold beers which went down a treat on such a hot day!

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Easy
Review: Was in here a few times. Ended up hangin with Vick the manager on more than one occasion. Very engaging. Quite the host really. Staff supported a good time every time. Highly recommend it for drinks. Arguably the best location down by Jonker Street. I was lucky enough to catch a big bike event one Saturday night. Good times!Show less

Author: landseairmudWorld
Title: Great service, fantastic view, good food
Review: We had to the bacon wrapped sausages twice in the same day...within a few hours apart. We went there for beers in the evening, went back had dinner somewhere else and then decided to go back to Sid's. The service is great, warm and friendly. At night we ordered a bottle of wine simply because the atmosphere sitting by the window is to die for. I could not ask for a better bar.Show less

Author: tim252
Title: Proper pints
Review:
Went here for a drink and was not disappointed. Nice welcome. Good range of draught and bottled beers. The draught served in proper pint glasses, very refreshing.
Worth a visit

Author: AndersW788
Title: The Perfect Pub in Melaka
Review:
Great atmosphere, view on the river with a very nice breeze! Service is Excellent, always good sports on TV. Pub grub is OK & the beer is COLD.
Highly recommended if you are visiting Melaka

Author: Marty1340
Title: Chilling by the River...
Review: Where else to watch the boats go up and down the river than sat by the veranda in Sid's Pub at Jonker's.  Great beers on tap, food readily available and all in a building with history and ambience

Author: Sandy W
Title: Great pub by the river
Review: If you're lucky enough you can sit at one of the window tables and enjoy an I cold beer / glass of wine. One of the nicest drinking venues in Melaka. Didn't have any food so can't comment on that.

Author: Wouter V
Title: Visiting Maleisia
Review: We walked for seven hours so the sight ofF Sid's pub with its cold beers was very welcome to us.We enjoyed a lovely half pint of ice cold draft beer.It is lovely located on the riverside.

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Good location, stunning view
Review: Stashed at the corner, in the far end of Jonker street, Sid's Pub was a relatively new addition to Malacca's bar scene. It was previously operated under the name of Harpers but that was ages ago.The interior was typical of a pub and nothing remarkable. It was the river side seating that was the main highlight. Not that the river was going to win any cleanliness awards anytime soon, but its still a river nonetheless. Every couple of minutes a small tour boat carrying will sail by carrying a full load of tourists.We ordered a couple of pints of local brew to coll down from the scorching heat and a plate of pigs in a blanket. Its tasted just alright and nothing that leaves any lasting impression. Overall Sid's pub is a nice place to chill over some drinks and soak in the river view.Show less

Author: 674jerrywThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Nice pub at excellent location
Review: Went here for a few beers after sightseeing in Melaka. The interior of this pub is really nice, with big windows looking out on the river just at the beginning of Jonker street. It must be one of the nicest spots in Melaka. They have an upper floor as well but it was closed when I was visiting. I can imagine the view is even better from up there. Definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: mrscrispy2Perth, Australia
Title: Average
Review: Ok pub food. Nothing to write home about. The place on the river is lovely but the slow services and average food let down what could be a great place. The menu is very small which I could deal with if there was a variety. A simple salad would be great - no vegetarian options. Only really burgers, sandwiches, and fried foods.Show less

Author: jomo50blue
Title: Popped in for a drink.
Review:
Popped in for a drink but stayed for a bite to eat.
Lovely position overlooking the river. Nice place to sit and relax and have a drink mon a sunny day,

Author: lingsue123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Some staff with an attitude
Review: Pub was empty at 9.30pm (only about 2 tables occupied at the time). My hubby had a drink while my aunt and mum who don't drink and myself, who's pregnant accompanied him. One service staff very obviously signaled at another that we only ordered ONE drink for the whole group and shook her head, right in front of me as I was looking at them, obviously intentional for me to see. If it was crowded, I would have told the hubby to skip his drink, not occupy your space and deny you of your business. But it was empty and we were there for only 15 minutes. I guess the price of that 1 drink is too measly for the staff.Show less

Author: Julie SPerth, Australia
Title: A little bit of England in Melaka
Review: Sid's Pub was our "local" during our stay in Melaka for Christmas. A good variety of drinks available and the friendly happy staff made each "happy Hour' a treat. The pub has a lovely location on the bank of the Melaka River with large windows that open over the water. Very relaxing.Show less

Author: glorias445
Title: Location on the river with big lizards on rocks
Review: Food was terrible we had 4 different meals they were all pretty ordinary. IVe eaten in many pubs in the U.K. Sorry Sid this doesn't stack up.  Big lizards on the rocks where you overlook the water. Not my cup of tea

Author: adrianoleSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great view, fresh beer...disappointing food
Review: We passed by Sid's Pub on the River Cruise and it looked like the perfect place for a sunset beer and bite. We got the first half right...but the food was a big let down. The ribs were tough and lacked flavour (I thought they were supposed to be marinated Sid?), fish and chips were more chips than fish and well, need I write anymore... All that said, it's a great place to unwind after a day of touring but I suggest you try the chicken rice across the street when dinner time comes.Show less

Author: Sarah B
Title: Great pub grub!
Review: Wonderful location right on the river (try and get a table right by the water) with a typical pub-style menu. Food was great, with 'proper' English pork sausages and bacon. Nice for a drink and they show the football as well.

Author: seastream2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheap wine during happy hour and great view :)
Review: We stayed here for couple of drinks and lunch. The view is fantastic and wine class of good tasting sauvignon blanc was nice and cold + reasonable RM15 during happy hour. The crub was OK- normal pub food but nothing wrong with it and service was very quick. Their toilets are spotless which is always a big plus!Show less

Author: MohdAdamKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: It was raining and was looking for a shelter and have a cup if coffee
Review: Was walking along Jonkers and it started to pour heavily. We saw a nice looking joint and decided to go in for a cup of coffee.. Alas, the waiter told us they do not serve coffee, neither do they have any hot tea. Seems kind of peculiar not to have any hot drinks in the menu especially coffee or tea, which are quite basic.. But they are a Pub after all... Show less

Author: 506willh
Title: Nice restaurant on the water
Review:
Good food - had the chicken basket and was tasty.  Burger was so so.
Good view - night time is better
Good staff
You will like it

Author: mossiec
Title: Good food and great service
Review: Visited Sid's twice over our families 2 day stay in Malacca. Good food (burgers, chicken wings and chicken strips) and drinks and great attentive staff. Perfect location on the bridge at the end of Jonkers Street. Worth a visit👍

Author: JoParfitt
Title: OK food, amazing view!
Review: it's pub grub. Our ribs were fine, but it's not a place for those who like lots of veg! Superb location at night, bang on the river though and nice ambience.

Author: Danny Y
Title: A MUST VISIT!!!
Review: We had one night in Melaka on our way to Singapore and it happened to be my girlfriends birthday so we were desperate to find a good place for a few drinks. We found sids bar in the early afternoon and after 2 drinks decided to return at night with a full group of 17 and it was brilliant. The owner joined us and even 'bought' a round of 17 drinks. If you like a drink in a friendly atmosphere with a great view you must go here. Show less

Author: 759alastairw
Title: Great pub visited twice in a day
Review: Stopped for urgent refuelling after a walking tour of Melaka in the heat great visit so returned for supper and more beer. Good food ,buzzy place would definitely recommend especially to any sports lover as all football from U.K. on

Author: RasikaTMBombay
Title: Great vibe
Review: 2 storey pub located by the river (as most places are, for a city that has a central canal!). Went there at an odd hour for lunch (3.30pm!) & got good service. Menu is typically pub-friendly so typical options. Enjoyed the airy space & town/river views.Show less

Author: kuepper
Title: Safe bet
Review: Relaxed environment in this centrally located bar by the river where you can watch the river trips go up and down.

Author: AlphaMinahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly service
Review: After a day of visiting historical sites, jostling with crowds and dealing with the scorching heat of Melaka, a tipple at Sid's offers a great respite. The wait staff here are very friendly, prompt and energetic. Overall, there's a great energy to the place. A nice pit stop for cold beer.Show less

Author: philipwhitehead2016
Title: It is so good to have a place to visit that you know will provide quality service.
Review: Our third visit met all expectations in terms of the setting, the food and drink, the service from the staff, and, above all, the quality of the experience.

Author: raymondp604Metung, Australia
Title: Went once never went back
Review: Not sure about this joint but somethings just not quite right with the atmosphere. Great position over looking the river but just does not have the low key vibe of most of the little bars along the river. Show less

Author: Sonya G
Title: Great pub
Review: Excellent service, friendly staff and good prices in happy hour.  Recommend this pub for relaxing  time and great view of river

Author: SabrinBedi
Title: Nice indeed
Review: It has an excellent view of the Melaka river..   very cozy and private for dinners and excellent service. Will be back  ..

Author: Terry BDeal, United Kingdom
Title: A place to retreat to at midday.
Review: A sports pub is not the sort of place we would normally visit in South Est Asia but its spacious size and coolness were appealing at midday when the temperature was over 30. We found a table overlooking the river and ordered very welcome local beer which was not overpriced. Service was extremely prompt and very cheerful. We had not intended to eat but ordered salad and snacks and some fries which were fine. The clientele seemed to be a mix of English, Singaporean and Australian but the atmosphere was not rowdy although the television could have been quieter. It is what it says it is.Show less

Author: VwmuchFood4fun
Title: Good location
Review: Went here twice but it was only on second trip when we saw more substantial food being delivered that was asked what is was as not on menu - they have another menu seems like a closely guarded secret. Staff friendly

Author: brianfourexAdelaide, Australia
Title: Piss poor service and drinks
Review: This place is a rip off, DO NOT waste your time or money, Hendricks gin and tonic nearly $10 but you would be hard pressed to recognise the gin as Hendricks and tonic water must be expensive here as there wasn't much in the glass!!!! Female drinks waitress rude and in your face, counted the cash in front of me as if I was going to rip her off!!! Drink served in common garden tumbler, I thought gin and tonic was served in a tall glass!!! go elsewhere for a drink this is a tourist trap.Show less

Author: Vacation439950
Title: Poorly done
Review: extremely overpriced for the drinks purchased. 28mr.....almost AUS $10 for half a glass of lukewarm gin (supposedly Hendricks) and tonic. The cocktail menu was very limited and the cocktail we ordered was warm and inocuous despite the promise of being otherwise. The presentation was poor and the service not much better. .... the waitress counted our money at the table in front of us! We paid more for two drinks....well one and half really, than we did for our entire dinner with drinks only a short time before.Show less

Author: stevefindlay
Title: Great place, great location and great staff
Review: Really good bar/restaurant with fabulous staff and an awesome location. We worth a visit for a drink or bite to eat.

Author: Yvonne L
Title: Wonderful location
Review: Go within happy hour.  Great prices and the good is always good and well priced.  Staff are all very friendly and helpful.  A must when in the are

Author: simonlW341RWSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quick lunch but there is more
Review: Scouring the place for a quick lunch by the river in Melaka and stumbled across Sids. The place looks new and we could see the lunch crowd was sparse but also saw the place is geared up for live music and dinner /drinks. The old warehouse conversation has been done exceptionally well and the location is excellent. Lunch was ham and cheese baguettes which were served with tapioca chips - excellent. Plenty of beers on tap to cool you down on a hot Melaka day. The wife decided on the ploughmans lunch which was also a treat. Will be returning when time permits...Show less

Author: Alvin C
Title: Nice pub
Review: Nice place for a rest and pint after walking around jonker. Pretty decent price for the drinks . Service was ok

Author: pjb152
Title: Randy & Pete's pro fishing tour!
Review:
Fantastic Pub in Malacca!
Great food, music backed up with excellent staff!
We'll be back in November!

Author: alisonw200
Title: Wonderful friendly staff
Review: Visited Malacca for a few days and visited this wonderful pub the staff were all so friendly,we stopped for a drink on the way to eat every evening couldn't fault the place

Author: jcarroueeHue, Vietnam
Title: Great atmosphere, excellent service
Review: Was there with a group of friends after a short trip. The food was excellent, the service prompt and attentive, never once had to ask for a drink, there was always someone there to take a new order.There was a live band that night, a good crowd, and a lively, fun atmosphere.We liked very much the 1st floor bar overlooking the river, as well as the feel of the place.Will definitely return soon.Well done Sid's team.Show less

Author: samhaggagKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: a Soujurn to Sid's
Review: I went to Sid's pub last Saturday and had a fabulous time enjoying the atmosphere, the band(s) and the great service. Staff are amazingly friendly and helpful. Services was excellent and the food was very good. what I enjoyed the most was the band. The music was some of the best live music I'd experienced in a bar in a very long time. Great place to spend an evening with family or friends.Show less

Author: Edward CKilkenny, Ireland
Title: Relaxing by the river.
Review: I was in Melaka with a veterans rugby team, average age very north of 40 most from Kuala Lumpur. On Saturday afternoon we'd played a local team of equally vintage players the Highlanders. So naturally we needed a place to celebrate our fine victory. Sid's is the perfect choice. In fairness we all Drink in the Sid's Pubs in KL, but that in no way colours my judgement. The pub is set out over 2 floors with an area for a band on both floors the back of the pub face directly onto the river(?) and is bright, well finished and the breeze through on Saturday night cool. There are TV's downstairs to watch New Zealand beat sundry other teams at Union. The food served was excellent, the staff very efficient and friendly, the drinks chilled nicely and the selection of spirits all that you could expect. Prices are very competitive and certainly no higher than less comfortable venues in the area. Sid's is metres' from Jonker's Street, over the bridge from the Church etc. take the first left and it's 50m away.If you're in Malaysia, you really owe it to yourself to visit Melaka, more interesting than KL, and if you're Melaka you really should drop into Sid's Pub to escape the crowds, heat and shopping opportunities.Show less

Author: ErikHK28
Title: Great for a beer in great location
Review:
Located right in the Center at the river side is this pub. A new setup opened this summer. Limited food menu which we did not taste yet. 
Anyway if you want to enjoy a nice beer recommended.

Author: duff3833Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: So good we had to go again
Review: We spotted this pub from the square and went in for drinks and a bite to eat. Staff was friendly and quick, and everything came out prompt and was delicious. The decorations are cozy and tasteful, and we enjoyed reading the quotes on the wall. We ended up going back for Brunch the next day and met one of the partners who gave us some great tips of the area and KL. The all day breakfast was awesome and very well executed. The pub overlooks the river and has a nice breeze coming through. Overall, this was a great pub to visit, and would happily recommend this establishment to any tourists or locals looking for a taste of the west. Well done guys :)Show less

Author: GrandroversKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Friendly welcoming bar
Review: We went in for drinks and later for food ,a nice friendly welcome by staff. Overlooking river , so lots to look at. Advertised British beer on drinks menu, but had run out , delivery being another week or so. Good atmosphere, live music in the evening, good place to go.Show less

Author: Shikin_Gia
Title: Awesome
Review:
1) very good and relaxing pub with the best live band performance that lighten up the environment.

2) the price is affordable with friendly staff with nice and delicious food variety.

Author: Pieter DDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: By far the best pub in Melaka
Review: Went there as friend rider with the Head Hunters MC for their annual Ashes to Ashes ride. This was the first time I visited Sid's after they opened the second floor!On a Saturday afternoon we reached Sid's with some 19 Harley's and guess what, we could park all roadside in front of the pub. They reserved the entrance parking for all bikes! With the blessing of the local authorities!! (Amazing guys, big big thank you!)We can safely say it's a biker friendly bar too!The pub itself is located superbly along the river and close to Jonker's. For smokers there is the outside covered part as inside is no smoking zone. The bar is inviting and welcomes youngsters, couples, families and groups like ours with no problems and no complaints. No complaints is important cuz boy were we thirsty and demanding ...! Food is nice and good quality "bar grub", and amazingly, a special Local Flavors Buffet was organized, fantastic!If you go upstairs there is more ample space including a balcony overlooking the river.Later the evening the House Blues Band starts performing upstairs. What an atmosphere they create! The guys Rick, Geoff, Jeff and all other staff (sorry forgot your names) have done an amazing job! Feels like coming home!As I said, it's by far the best pub in and around Melaka, go and find out for yourself!Show less

Author: HKinsey
Title: Service is great
Review: This is right by the river so great to watch people. Food was so so but ok as the ambience is od and service is better than first rate

Author: MusicMan267Cardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Very welcoming pub
Review: We had two nights in Malacca and headed for the nearest pub as we were keen on having a cold beer.We began a friendly chat with Ric the manager who gave us great advice. They had live music upstairs, and as a musician, Ric took me up for the perfect spot on the balcony.I ended up getting up for a jam with Mark and his band.Sabrina our waitress was amazing and even popped out to pick us up some cigarettes. Great night, great people.Show less

Author: Y4757ZEstever
Title: Watching the rugby
Review: Possibly the best pub location in the country. Great service staff  ... Make you want to come back again and again

Author: SCochraneBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Great bar
Review: As an Englishman I'm always reluctant to visit English pubs on holiday, in this case 7,000 miles from England. I was won over though by the clean, smart interior and the breezy balcony overlooking the river. The wines are great and service was good. There aren't many places to stop for a beer / wine like this in Melaka so if that's what you're looking for, try it out.Show less

Author: Carmel G
Title: Great vibe going on here!
Review: What a great pub right on the river, with lots of atmosphere. Popped in here in the afternoon for a few drinks and ordered some light bites, which were yum; bowl of chips and really meaty pork ribs. We came back again that night and there was a band playing upstairs, really good.. Place is relaxed, with lots of air flowing in the through the open windows onto the river. Upstairs there is a lovely balcony overlooking the river. Staff very good, friendly and attentive. Draft and bottled beers and full bar. Also has TV screens showing live sports. Overall great place to head to in Malacca. Show less

Author: Mikapalloza
Title: Outstanding service, food and beer
Review:
You don't need to look any further....this is the bar for you. Very friendly staff who look after everyone even though the bar may be busy.
Food is really nice and atmosphere is friendly.
Check it out!
Thomas the waiter is a legend too.

Author: MachoLaherinoArgentina
Title: Best of Melaka!
Review: There is no better place in Melaka to enjoy a nice could beer with the best view of the river and the great atmosphere of Sid's Pubs. In top of that, the service is just great. All at very reasonable prices. What else do you want?Show less

Author: marilyne2375
Title: Quaint premises
Review: Friendly and helpful staff. Overlooking the river which has its good and bad points. Nice quaint setup and homely premises.

Author: LouiseC936Bath
Title: What a treat - a must visit!
Review: A must visit in Melaka. A great pub in a superb location right next to the river and at one end of Jonker Walk. Windows open onto the river which makes it interesting and offers a cool breeze. Cider and Guinness were excellent and the food was delicious. Staff are pleasant, well trained and very attentive. We will definitely go back when next in Melaka! Good job all!Show less

Author: Karen FLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Great location and good cocktails
Review: We sat by the window and watched the river and the boats going past. While we were there a family of Monitor Lizards were playing around the bank just below the pub. The lychee martini was excellent. Food was quick and the fries were really good. Show less

Author: BenjaminBreegKent
Title: Decent place - but check your bill
Review: I like this place. Nice manager - warm welcome. Good selection of beers, reasonable food menu. Service staff are attentive, which is the least you would expect when paying a 10 per cent service charge (plus 6 per cent city tax). The food was expensive for typical pub fare (fish and chips, bangers and mash) and the drinks - though generally costly in Malaysia - cost more than a pub in London (Strongbow pint is £6.50 or 32 ringgit). Was disappointed to discover - when checking my bills and receipts once I'd left Malaysia - that I had been charged for 2 pints of Guiness. I should have checked,, silly me.A pint of Guiness costs 23 ringgit, so on top of the service and city tax charges, I paid nearly £9 for drinks I never had! Check your bill.Show less

Author: verbijsterdMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Not bad
Review: Lovely, airy location on the river. The food is OK, but vegetarians beware: we were about to order the veggie burger but were told it was actually not vegetarian... This must be one of the few places on the planet where this is the case ;-)Show less

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: lovely addition to Jonker's...
Review: There are quite a few good pubs in Jonker's but they have been around quite awhile & are starting to age. Sid's is a great addition & it is located right by the river canal. The layout is typical of all Sid's pubs. They have another floor but didn't really check it out. Service is friendly & attentive.We went two nights in a row to catch the Olympic badminton finals. Great atmosphere. Can get a bit stuffy as the windows are open overlooking the canal so the AC can't really do its job. Nice cold beers, stout & cider plus good snacks. What more can you ask for when winding down. Will definitely return when in Melaka.Show less

Author: MarkR6903
Title: A Breath of fresh air for Melaka!
Review: As a American Expat living in Malaysia more than 38 years and the last 25 in Melaka, Sid's new Pub (There are 7 in Kuala Lumpur) coming to Melaka is truly a breath of fresh air. A decent place for decent people. Quality intelligent/Friendly service, decent pub grub and a view right on the Melaka River that cant be beat anywhere! Live Sports on the big screens plus music from the 70's/80's downstairs and some Bluzzy Jazzy Live Music upstairs Thursday thru Sunday. Upstairs is available for private functions as well. You will not find a more dencent place to spend your day or night in Melaka. Resonable prices as well!This one stands out from all the rest! Otherwise you have your normal programmed Keyboard/music to slit your wrist by along with some creeps around to ruin your night. Family's, Travellers, and lots of Pretty Girls all seem to feel safe here.Show less

Author: salini15Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Jokers top pub
Review: It's a great place by the river with good ambience. The waiters and waitresses are friendly and prices are great. Happy hours on Saturdays are all day and thats a double bonus. Sports channels all the time with coverage of latest news and games. A place to stop at at anytime if passing through jonkers. Show less

Author: Sightseer640374
Title: Great Reception and Venue
Review: We visited Sid's Pub twice in two days and on both occasions the welcome and the service were excellent. Thomas, mine host, was very thoughtful and showed us around the pub. The location, beer and food were all 'just right.

Author: 268harvinsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely Times With Loved Ones. Perfect Ambience.
Review: Last weekend, I visited the Jonker walk with my loved ones. It was utterly amazing. I was pretty astonished with the location of the pub and how splendid the service was. The view by the river side, so much of tranquility. There are few views or tips that would be useful I guess.1. They have a live band upstairs which closes by 11pm. Amazing they are.2. The waiters are so soft spoken and helpful especially when you are really confused with what to get.3. A must try is the beef burger. No doubt its amazing.4. Smoking is NOT allowed inside the bar. They do have high tables and chairs outside on the pathway which is where we sat as some of them in the group smokes. but no doubt, it was still beautiful to see the mix of people walking around and yes CATCHING POKEMONS.5. For POKEMON lovers, there are 3 pokestops around the sids. HAHA.6. The price of the booze here is a little higher than in KL that i cant deny. Its worth it.Well, it is indeed a layed back pub where you meet people and socialize. NOT NOISY AT ALL. Trust me its amazing.Show less

Author: Getaway372720
Title: Great pub in a great location!
Review: Went for dinner at this great pub right on the river in central Melaka. Food was good, good beers, but most importantly amazing service! Would recommend to anyone in the area to head over. Well worth it and if you can get a seat near the back, the views of the Melaka river are fantastic!Show less

Author: Christina S LMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Lovely evening out
Review: Did not know this gem was in Melaka!! Went there on a trial run with my friends and we all had a great evening. Food was good. Not a very large selection but what was served was good. My fiancée loved the Kilkenny on tap!! Definitely going there again!!! Show less

Author: SheenaSubashKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Great Pub Smack-Dab in Quaint Jonker Walk
Review: I have been a patron of Sid's Pubs for 6 years and I must say this outlet takes the cake! Spacious, well-designed and airy, it's a great place to hang out at any time of the day. The food served up is classic British Pub fare, and the draught beers are top notch. The manager Ric runs a tight ship with excellent service from the staff. Brings to mind the line from the sitcom "Cheers" - "sometimes you wanna go where everybody knows your name". This pub is highly recommended and frankly I don't see myself patronising any other place when I am in Malacca! Show less

Author: klmuzz
Title: Great pub and a genuine reason to visit Melaka more
Review: Great location, well set up, clean and professionally run. Loved the atmosphere of the opening day. Cider was cold and service was first class

Author: Peter Alan GByron Bay, Australia
Title: A little slice of British culture!
Review: If you have never been, you need to go now. A great place to have a cold beer after trekking around Jonker's and fighting off the Chinese "Mainland" Tourists. Great beer (best Guinness in Melaka), Scotch eggs, real pork sausages and no beef bacon here, just good old fashion English "heart attack" food. Don't buy the Hard Rock Tee-shirt, everyone has one, go and get the Sids Tee shirt and be unique. Show less

Author: Cluis67Malaysia
Title: A new arrival.
Review: Sid's Pub at Jonkers is the new kid on the block in Malacca. It is very well situated along the river and boasts great views. The Irish Pub chain is well known throughout Malaysia and at last Malacca has its very own. It's colonial style building fits in well with its surroundings and it definitely has the atmosphere of an English pub at home. The menu is Western and includes an all day proper English Breakfast and will soon be extended to include Sunday Roasts. So if you want to enjoy a good pint with a fantastic view and where staff is very welcoming and friendly then this is the place for you! Enjoy!Show less

Author: NickP2629
Title: Best Pub in Melaka
Review: Could not get a better location. Excellent views, drinks, food and staff. Upstairs perfect for private functions.I will return to Melaka just to go to Sids!Show less

Author: Peter HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome place and a great night
Review: Went here with a group of friends last Saturday night and had a great time. For me it was just perfect as I could watch the super rugby match downstairs whilst having my favourite Strongbow and when that was finished I went upstairs and had a bit of a dance whilst listening to a great live band.Staff were lovely and the decor is just lovely with the location in the heart of the Jonkers area is just superb.Show less

Author: KhongLoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Irish Pub by Melaka River
Review: Sid's Pub has been renowned in Malaysia for their neighbourhood Irish Pub chain, and now they have landed Melaka. They are popular on the Irish Draught Guinness Stout, and Cider(they served other beer as well Tiger/Heineken) and other Irish dishes, from Irish Pies to typical Irish Beer Food. The quality are quite controlled and similar with what they had in KL, as well as a view on the riverbank of Melaka.Show less

Author: lionelf558
Title: THE bar to visit in Malaka
Review: Great new venue! Fantastic view and very nice staff. Good beer good food. The pub is perfectly located close to the bridge. The decorating and ambiance fits well in Malaka in the colonial style.

Author: oldestteenagerAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: Something new in Melaka
Review: A great new arrival in Melaka, Sid's Pub on the bank of the Melaka River at Jonker Street has all the atmosphere of a traditional English pub. The beers and food are excellent and the menu is soon to be expanded. I am looking forward to the forthcoming Sunday Roasts! The upper bar is going to have live music and has great views from the balcony. Show less

Author: 7Critic777
Title: Best pub in town
Review: At last Melaka has a REAL pub. Although we live 15k away it has become our local. The food is delicious, the music is good and it has the authentic ambience of a British pub. Long live Sid's Pub!

Author: ytryana
Title: overrated and overprice
Review: overrated and overprice. taste are average nothing special. durian puff MYR3.5. Cuby durian MYR6.9 (very small & expensive). It's actualy a pancake durian in Indonesia (Jakarta & Medan).

Author: richtee2019
Title: Below My Expectation
Review: Came to this ‘bakery’ because someone recommended its Durian & Yogurt puffs. Tried both but really not up to my expectation. Could be better.

Author: STANTE0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Over rated, hope they improve
Review: Given the number of TripAdvisor ratings, expected way better. Puff is neither fluffy or crispy soft. Cream taste as others mentioned is too delicate barely taste the soupsop, and durian not strong. Hope they improve on their puffs. Bought at 9pm, so maybe sitting for too long...Show less

Author: Rebecca TSingapore, Singapore
Title: One Bite!
Review: The durian puffs are really delicious! 1 for RM 3.50, 6 for RM 18. Thin soft crust with cold durian cream filling, a cool sweet treat on a very hot day! Advice given to finish in one bite but we did not follow, took a small bite and the durian cream oozed out all over, can be messy, bring wet tissue along!Show less

Author: Best127Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not As Expected
Review: Their supposedly signature one bite Durian puff is not as addictive as expected. It didn’t deliver the kind of aroma and oozing texture instead I found it watery and the cream puff is put it bluntly totally disappointing!The Durian Chendol is just too sweet and the staffs are not welcoming at all. They are busy with their own works despite we are the first few customers to arrive. Nice ambiance unfortunately is also a hot spot for mosquitoes! Show less

Author: Helen0830
Title: Delicious
Review: The taste of durian puff is very good. Will come for it again if we do revisit melacca. The price is roughly six durian puff in one box cost RM15 and we have bought three box for it.

Author: Ande LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chendol with good quality gula Melaka
Review: We wanted to try Jonker 88 Chendol but it was sold out. A stone throw away we found 'Taste Better' and decide try their Chendol. The price was M$5.90 a bit more expensive than Jonkee88. The owner assured us that they use better quality ingredients. I must agree that indeed the quality was good. They also have durian puff, the durian pureewas awesome but the pastry need improvement. Service was good !Show less

Author: Patrick Terence LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Durian Puffs were YUM!!!
Review: We came here especially for the durian puffs. OMG! They were amazing!!! We ordered a dozen. Be warned though ... there will be durian fillings splattered all over if you bite into it ... that is how full the fillings are. You have to suck out the fillings a bit or put the whole thing in your mouth ... it will explode in your mouth ... durian ecstasy.Show less

Author: ReinaJ27
Title: Super Nice Ice Cendol
Review:
Must try dessert when you visit Malacca. Strategic location right side from the entrance Jonker Walks.
Their Ice Cendol and durian ice cream are very nice.

Author: Dahnaraj
Title: Cendol of Excellence
Review: One of the best cendol I have tasted with real Gual Melaka taste. Try traditional Melaka cendol before even try other type of cendol. Prefer to have fresh Durian flesh compared to iced durian for the Durian cendol. Overall excellent and worth the price.

Author: Asangki N
Title: Too sweet
Review: First time came to Melaka and interested to try local foods/beverages, like es cendol. Found this place in google and I think the Es Cendol here had a big portion, but tasted too sweet.

Author: 1424sharanh
Title: Best cendol
Review: I tried their cendol- after trying the jonker 88 famous one. I feel the cendol here is THE BEST. Cozy environment, and similar price. And the cendol is really rich and creamy! Definitely underrated,and worth trying :) will surely come again in the future!

Author: Elyn L
Title: Must try durian puff and yoghurt puff
Review: A must visit place if you happen to be in Jonker Street. I love their durian puffs and yoghurt puffs so much! You've got to finish the puff in one bite to experience the mini explosion in your mouth! I‘m sure you’d love it!

Author: Spotty-Leopard
Title: RM$3 for Durian Puff
Review: There are several outlets along Jonker St. Buy 1 and pop it in your mouth for the durian-mind blowing experience

Author: Hwee Mean T
Title: Bad service
Review: Dropped by for snacks and desserts. Durian puff tasted average as the pastry texture was stale. Staff service attitude was not friendly, and dining area was messy too.

Author: CharleneT418
Title: Original Durian Puff in Jonker Street
Review: The Original Durian Puff in Jonker Street. The Puff is Full with Durian cream. One bite Durian Puff. Finish it in one bite to avoid spill ! Explosive durian Cream. The durian cream Bombard and spread into your mouth when you bite it. The Durian Puff is awesome. Not too Sweet and The Puff ( Skin) is so puffy ! Original Durian inside the durian puff . Served in cold but it's so refreshing , Nice try ! I guess , Durian lover will definitely like it !Show less

Author: boborygmi
Title: Should be called tasteless!
Review: Forget about trying the durian chendol. Mediocre chendol topped with insipid watery duriany liquid. Much better off saving the calories for the durian chendol at the tried and tested san su gong a few shophouses down the street.

Author: garetjax72Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very poor durian chendol
Review: Tried the durian chendol here, which is supposed to be good. It was very insipid, with only a small dollop of pale durian paste and hardly any gula melaka. Very few ingredients as well. There are much better chendols to be had, even along Jonker Street.Show less

Author: Wenyager
Title: One bite durian puff - must have for durian fans
Review: Went to Jonker walk and realized a few spots throughout the street that sells these.  Best to eat when it’s fresh and chilled.  Not to be missed if you are a durian fan.

Author: KH_LyeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Go For Durian Desserts
Review: Durian Puffs and Durian Yoghurt Ice cream satisfied our craving for durian themed desserts. Put a puff into your mouth and a squish of durian filling burst out with a bite. Nice! The durian yoghurt ice cream had strong durian favour but the consistency was too frozen ...less nice to have to bite into frost.Show less

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ...lovely black coffee and pineapple tarts!!....
Review: I stumbled upon this place as it was raining very heavily and in desperation i wanted some black coffee and pineapple cookies,previously i had purchased the durian puffs here many times too.But at this visit i bought my durian puff at another shop down the street.Anyway bought the pineapple jam tarts here,and they were up to my taste soft and low sugar and absolutely loved them.The lady who is the owner was really pleasant and really fussed around and made sure my coffee was done to perfection.She also had a chat with me,that was really nice of her.Black coffee comes in a big cuppa for only RM2,lovley to have with the pineapple jam tarts for Rm10 for a box.You can have your coffee at the back of the shop,there are chairs and table to be seated.Will definitely return.Show less

Author: Charles TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing open face pineapple tarts
Review: Sadly their tarts are over-rated. We were so disappointed that their open faced pineapple tarts did not even match up to some pineapple tarts we can get back in Singapore. They use margarine and so we lowered our expectations but even then they just did not come close to what we expect of good pineapple tarts.Show less

Author: Kelly P
Title: A good try, but a little expensive
Review: A box contain 6 puffs, we mix 3 flavor, have soursop, yogurt and durian flavor. RM 15 per box. Prefer the yogurt flavor and the durian flavor for the durian lover.

Author: MrGoh
Title: Love the durian puff
Review: I am not fond of durians. But this durian puff is yummy. You need to put the whole piece into your mouth without biting it to get the best experience. The fragrance of durian will burst in your mouth!

Author: Patrick LMelbourne, Australia
Title: Snacks Galore
Review: Visited this confectionary shop for some in-between meals and something to take back to the hotel.We gas their durian, yogurt and soursop puffs. The durian puff was great. The other 2 is pretty ordinary but then it's only our personal preference. Not too expensive for RM13 or AUD3.60 for 6 puffs. Show less

Author: Maxteo919
Title: It really explodes in your mouth but durian taste can be stronger in the puff
Review: The durian puffs are sold in a box of 6 for 13 RM. Each puff really explodes in your mouth but durian taste can be stronger. Not fantastic but please give it a try when you are near.

Author: chiayieyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best durian puff I ever had
Review: It's the best. Tried it for the first time last year and couldn't forget it since. However I must admit it does have less durian taste now compared to when I tried it a year ago. But overall it's still the best durian puff I've had. The yogurt puff is nice, too for people who don't eat durians.Show less

Author: RoyThia
Title: Best Durian Puff in Melaka
Review: The durian puff just melts in your mouth. Caution to place the entire puff into your mouth else it will get real messy. Highly recommended to any durian lovers.

Author: ChloeY236
Title: Nice durian puffs
Review: If you love the king of fruits, you will love this dessert! They also serve soursop ones too! Like they say, eat in one mouth, don't bite it into half if you don't want the fillings to squirt onto you!

Author: msnakimSingapore
Title: Explosion in the Mouth
Review: Durian flavour was a tad weaker than it was a few years back, but it's still good! Please pop the entire puff into your mouth. Do not attempt to bite into the puff, or it will explode and mess up your hands and perhaps that lovely blouse. (There's a tap for you to wash up if you do get durian cream all over.)Forget about the durian flavoured coffees. They taste odd!Show less

Author: Johnstanno
Title: Please follow instruction =)
Review:
Cheap and nice creamy durian puff. We love it very much!

Yes follow the instruction - Put the whole puff in your mouth!! Or risk the experience of 'erupting' durian fillings.

Author: doraemonger
Title: No longer the same
Review: Tried it in 2015 and it tasted great but this time, 1 piece of it, is enough for me. It doesn't have the strong durian taste anymore and was very sweet. Overly sweet for my tastebuds so won't purchase it in future.

Author: Mokkey8
Title: Always come here when in Malacca
Review:
If you like durian and you happen to come to Malacca then try the puffs here.
Have to eat it cold

Simply Delicious!

Author: Kim Yong L
Title: Amazing durian puffs!!!
Review:
The durians puffs was amazing!
My family members and I loved it so much!
We will definitely be back!!!!

:)

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Best place for durian lovers!
Review:
The durian puff is really yummy!!!!!
It's a bit pricey but it's definitely worth it!!!!

Would recommend all durian lovers to come to TASTE BETTER! :)

Author: yanamohamedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Heavenly Puff
Review: Just forget about the mango yoghurt flavour, the durian puff is sufficient enough to send you to heaven! Pop a whole durian puff to your mouth, and get ready to float. I am sure durian lover will agree with me that this is such a heavenly snack!Show less

Author: Grace Yang G
Title: Durian is life!
Review: AWESOME! Durian is one of my favourite fruit and my friends who tried the durian puffs here for the first time, they all like it

Author: Farahhsuziee
Title: Durian puffs
Review: I am a durian addict so for me this durian puff is to die-for. The filling is sweet and creamy and it almost felt like you eat the real durian. But the price is a bit expensive. 6 pieces for RM13. Heads up: You really need to eat it in one mouthful. If not, it is gonna explode! Show less

Author: DibyneDavao City, Philippines
Title: Place to shop pasalubong and souvenirs
Review: This place is also located in Jonker Walk. It is known for durian products, so I tried those that were priced at 2ringgit. But I recommend this place to shop for pasalubong items. They have a lot of choices for goodies that you can bring home to your families and friends. They have sweet, and salty hopia. They also have pastries with different fillings like pandan and chicken floss.Show less

Author: Lee_family_219053Singapore, Singapore
Title: Durian oozes out from the pastry
Review: Walking along Jonker Street one will find many shops offering this durian puff pastry. Sedap! Good but could be better if the pastry was thinner. One bite and be careful as the durian filling oozes out. There are 3 flavors; durian, cempedak and yoghurt. I had both durian and cempedak and can say the durian flavor is stronger and the cempedak had a mild taste of the fruit. Go try all the shops and surely you will come back to this shop. The shop also sells many other traditional pastry like loh por ben, mor lor so and pineapple tarts.Show less

Author: Stanley789
Title: Sweet and creamy
Review: This could be the closest replacement to a real durian. Got 6pcs for rm13 is expensive. If you are craving for durian, you can try this. It is sweet and creamy

Author: WilsonWSAng
Title: Delicious snack
Review:
The durian puff was the signature but for non durian lover, they have a yogurt flavour and chimpdak(taste like jackfruit) flavour.

Took a box of 6 at 13RM and mix all flavours.

Worth a try if you are at jonker street.

Author: cherlizzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good snack but a little too big
Review: Tried this since many have recommended it. Was advised to finish it in one bite as the durian filling will burst out. Had a little challenge as the puff was a little too big for me.Durian filling was flavorful, would prefer filling to be more creamy. Puffs are sold in a box of 6.Show less

Author: 64helainec
Title: Cheap and superb
Review:
"EAT IT IN ONE BITE ! "
The explosion of durian cream puff inside ur cavity is satisfying for durian lover 😍
Not pricey and worth to buy! Trust me

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: No restorant. Only takeaway
Review: Not is a restorant.... is only a old shop that sell durian puff.otherwise Sour and bad in texture. I feel like a tipical shop that only looking for the turist money. BadShow less

Author: karyen
Title: Nice durian puff
Review: Really delicious. Soft but not soggy puff is fully filled with creamy durian filling. The cream will just burst out even if you gently bite into the puff. That's how the advice of "Don't bite, put the whole puff in" come about.

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Best Cream Puff Ever Tasted
Review: I am not an expert in cream puffs but I have eaten my fair share of puffs and these durian cream puffs are by far the best I have ever tasted. Kudos to the mastermind behind this recipe. I love their durian sundae as well. The taste of durian is simply rich and fulfilling and it does not taste like artificial flavoring.I have tried durian puffs in other parts of Malaysia and out of Malaysia but none of them tasted as genuine as these creations. Definitely a must try!Show less

Author: kopijaki
Title: Tasty puffs
Review: Was abit doubtful when I saw the puff, tried it and it taste really good. The cream is watery and durian taste is just nice. Not so strong that the room will smell durians but just nice that you can taste it.

Author: 88gaian
Title: Delicious durian puff
Review: The puff was so delicious and the durian cream is complete match for the puff. The price is average and worth it. Although the puff was a bit bigger then the usual one bite size.

Author: clara5280Singapore, Singapore
Title: Durian puffs
Review: Wanted to buy soursop puffs too, but sold out. Only gotten the durian puffs which are also yummy. Durian Filling is runny type, not the usual thick durian flesh/ cream but still taste great! You really gotta eat whole & allow the filling & aroma to burst in your mouth (bite the 1st puff half and made a mess.. Dirty hands, wasted) Think there's a kiosk @ SG VivoCity, not sure if it's franchise or just similar concept. Show less

Author: YX_657
Title: Amazing
Review: Like the name you should I eat it in one bite otherwise the cream inside will squirt everywhere. Very duriany taste. 6 is for 10.60rm

Author: 753lydiajKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Better ..Not so..
Review: Saw many people eating this stuff and decided to give it a try... the have put a note at the shop that it can last for 5 hours with refrigerator. .. but when we bring back home (banting) its kind of sour... its a durian puff but too sour... mayb it became like tat due to heat or something else... but really disappointed for not getting to taste it at its best...Maybe staff can remind customers to finis it asap if they planning to bring back home. .Show less

Author: NeuihsL
Title: Emmmm...
Review:
Once you try it, you will love it. After a long hot walk along the jonker street, this is a good dessert to cold you down. 
Must try..

Author: alfredfang
Title: Good durian puffs
Review: The filling is really delicious and full of durian goodness. The pastry is not too thick with enough chewiness. It's better to heed their advice and eat it all in one shot!

Author: wynsum
Title: Yum Yum
Review: Taste great esp to durian lovers! Remember to put the whole piece into your mouth or the filling will burst out!

Author: 225matthewn
Title: Delicious!
Review:
We chanced upon while shopping in Hatten mall. Tried both Soursop and Durian puffs. 
Both had different textures and taste profiles. 
Highly recommended for a typical hot day.

Author: Henrik B
Title: Fantastic durian puffs 😋
Review: Only stopped by to taste the durian puff and it was indeed delicious. Not sure if it is a cafe to sit down in and eat but for a quick stop it was great

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: It taste fresher here compare to the outlets
Review: The company have venture into franchise , I tried the durian puff at the Taste Better outlets at Atria , Sunway pyramid and Setia mall but it doesn't taste as good as the one in Melaka at the jonker street . Here you can get freshly made durian puff while at the outlet is like an overnight puff with hard pastries .. Still prefer the main outlet one here in Melaka . Show less

Author: jyowpp
Title: Durian puffs
Review: Very good durian puffs.  A must try if you are in Malacca. I almost miss this shop as there is another Taste Better store at 106 on the same street which is closed.  The address is no. 96 and it is at the corner.

Author: mouselee72
Title: Best durian paste .
Review: Exactly one bite the best if our mouth not too small . The paste will spill out easily if we thought of small bite . Best durian paste  , even had durian smell in my mouth hours later. Worth trying it .

Author: graceeyunMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Yogurt puff the best!
Review: I always try their yogurt puff everytime I passed by the shop. Although the shop is famous for their durian puff (I never tried before as I'm not a fans of durian), you can also try their yogurt puff! The yogurt is "melting" once you bite it. In fact, you should eat it all in 1 bite. Recommended!Show less

Author: AspierL
Title: Taste Better ? No ! Taste of Heaven
Review: A must durian puff to eat in Malacca ! Don't waste a single opportunity to taste this ! Trust me ! One bite , bring you to heaven ! HAHA !

Author: BevenLau
Title: Explosion of Durian!
Review: Have you ever experienced having an explosion of Durian cream in your mouth?  If not,  this is a MUST EAT before you die! For all durian lovers out there, this is a must try experience.

Author: trvkaki
Title: Durian puffs not bad
Review: This is the place to go for good durian puffs at a reasonable price. There is a branch at dataran mall though the items they carry are lesser.

Author: Wewe_vip
Title: Dragon fruit yogurt ice-cream is nice!
Review: Went there on afternoon, and yes the weather was really melting me. Saw they promoting their new flavor of ice-cream which is Dragon fruits yogurt ice-cream. The taste is really nice and unforgettable!

Author: meyxtine
Title: Love it!
Review:
For durian lovers, these puffs are delish! A must try for sure. 

Caution: Biting into the puff will cause the durian fillings to ooze out, creating super messy hands! Try stuffing the whole puff into your mouth instead! Lol.

Author: Rizky S
Title: so goood..
Review: must try for durian lovers. and please follow the instruction. don't bite, just eat it whole. otherwise you'd made a mess with all the creams.

Author: carine3366Singapore, Singapore
Title: Durian lover Must try it
Review: The weather was very hot, this is the best time to had this durian puff. 1 pcs is RM$2.20, 6pcs will be cheaper.You really need to eat the whole thing at one go else the durian cream will flow out. Recommend durian lover to try it.Show less

Author: andyjalimSingapore, Singapore
Title: A bit disappointed
Review: I brought some of my singapore colleague over m'cca before good Friday on 24th Mar base on the recommendation online a must try food, apparently the durian puff is not cold enough. The content within is a bit dilute and can't feel the texture of durian which they claim they have tried some better one in singapore.Show less

Author: shalinideaven
Title: Durian Puff that is Heaven in your mouth
Review: The best durian puffsss.. Soft pastry and super rich and creamy durian creame inside that just explodes in your mouth with sweet creaminess. We had it like every day when we went to Jonker. To die for. absolutely. Opens till 11 pm at night.

Author: blue_joy15
Title: Excellent Durian puff.
Review:
A must try.

The durian puff is good and prefer durian than the sour sop.

They do sell Melaka products like mee suah and others varieties of hand made noodles.

Author: MyLittleLife
Title: Yummy durian puff&ice cream!
Review: My favourite is their durian puff and durian ice cream. Heard tat the  durian puff is made of durian fresh,one bite fall in love whole life!

Author: andybianSingapore, Singapore
Title: Superb Syrian Soursop puff
Review: Excellent frozen puff, reasonably price, the filling is authentic and very generous. Do note that if you plan to take away and will be staying outdoor without refrigerate for couple of hours, don't bother cause my durian filling had turned sour after staying outdoor for few hours, very disappointed for throwing away tons of delicious puff.Show less

Author: willwin9391
Title: Best puff
Review: The best durian puff, now i tried new flavour yogurt n soursoup, they're good too but i prefer the yougurt one, must try if come to malaysia

Author: lazypigcess
Title: One mouthful filled with Durian and Puff
Review: Good to takeaway and gift for friends/family. Simple and easy puff. Do not bite into it, else the fillings will splurge.

Author: Dewicious
Title: One very big bite
Review: They r selling it 6 for RM10.60 which is quite reasonable priced. The puff is not to thick but the filling is more of diluted watery durian than creamy durian. Flavor is still there but not too overwhelming, overall it's very good for its price.

Author: lias205
Title: Puff durian
Review: Open widely Put it all in your mouth then let it burst. The puff is moist with tasty durian inside. Better eat in cold otherwise seems like melted. One bite is not enough. Buy 6 for RM 10, with yogurt, soursop and durian variant. Mixed or one type of your own taste. Nice to try. Show less

Author: Suzanne B
Title: Dragon fruit yogurt icecream
Review: I really liked the icecream.  It was quite refreshing on a hot afternoon.  Couldn't really taste dragon fruit, just a nice frozen yogurt.

Author: Chow Hock SSingapore
Title: Taste OK
Review: They got a few branches within Jonker street and the shopping malls. Not as great as I thought so, the durian filling is very fluid, and the feel and taste is not great. Nevertheless, give a try if you had not done before. Price is reasonable. Show less

Author: sheronlee
Title: Not too bad
Review: The durian puff is quite good. It's fresh and delicious. It's best to eat it immediately upon purchase. If you are in Jonker Street, you have to drop by this shop to buy the puff.

Author: RAJ_Grewal23
Title: One bite is more than enough..
Review: Just a bite, thats all u need to enjoy the tasty filling which includes durian, yogurt n sour plum..

Author: Liana L
Title: Durian puff
Review:
Already try their durian puff, its really really delicious.
Don't miss it !!  
One is never enough, must try it !!

Author: Jedai79
Title: A MUST TRY!
Review:
A MUST try! Well, we don't know if TASTE BETTER is the best in Malacca but they really taste GOOD!

Diagonally opposite Geographer Cafe, Jonker Walk. 

Remember to finish each puff in one mouthful. 一口吃。Yummy! Delicious! 

RM10.80 for half a dozen of them.

Author: bent2182
Title: Durian Puff...surprise !!!
Review:
Must buy item in this store, if you are durian fans ==> must try!!!
There is other biscuit available in the store as well. The price is reasonable.

Author: Xin-FangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth to try!
Review: This one-bite durian puff can be found everywhere in Jonker street. We ordered 3 puffs with each cost RM2.20. The durian filling was rather watery but with inviting fragrant. One would have difficulty to consume it in one bite due to its size, especially the ladies. Nevertheless, worth to try when you are here.Show less

Author: alethea20Singapore
Title: Melt in your mouth durian puffs
Review: Their durian puffs really live up to the standard of all the good reviews. The puff itself is soft, the durian filling was heaven; it melts in my mouth, just enjoy the moment. It was sold 6 in a box for RM10.60. Awesome! Must have in every Malacca trip. Show less

Author: 1979jimz
Title: One bite puff
Review: If you are a durian lover. You will like this. One bite and pop into the mouth. The smell of the puff and the real durian. Yummy. Price is affordable

Author: BakesieLas Vegas, Nevada
Title: Eat the durian puff in ONE BITE
Review: We were excited to try the famous one bite durian puff. It is important that you put the whole thing in your mouth and chew. The center is liquid and it will be messy if you don't. This also gives you no choice but to get the full taste of the durian inside. The durian flavor was on par with an onion. I wasn't a fan of the durian taste but the pastry was amazing! A MUST TRY if your interested in tasting durian. It was a fun experience at 2.20RM a puff (.51 cents/USD).Show less

Author: RouYi L
Title: Affordable and Tasty
Review: Affordable pricing, 6 at 10.60. Its tasty and a nice snack to combat the hot weather. Would have preferred the puff to be thinner but it is still good overall

Author: WSLEE74
Title: Thumbs up !
Review: One of the many shop we stop by along jonker walk. This undoubtedly one of the best. There are many shops selling the same durian puff but we still prefer this shop.

Author: icosmosenterprisePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Superb Durian Puff
Review: Oh, this durian puff is just amazing. Everytime I come to Melaka, I will surely come here again to try the durian puff. One bite is enough to satisfy you. A must try snacks. The durian is also very delicious as it melts in your mouth. Super Nice!!Show less

Author: Friska_Said
Title: Yummy and Creamy
Review: Soo yumm. Puff is light and fluffy stuffed with durian vla which is soft, creamy, and soo durian! Price is also affordable for a tasty durian puff. Recommended!

Author: damienchiang
Title: Excellent puffs at RM2.20 apiece
Review: Nice melt in your mouth durian puffs, even better than some of the famous ones in Singapore! No regrets and it's very nice! However, when I ate a bite of it, some fillings got sprayed onto my shirt. Be warned!

Author: szeweiengKulai, Malaysia
Title: Creamy puff so good can messed up myself
Review: The first time i bite the puff, i literally dirty my whole self with duriam creams. Yiks. After that lesson, only know that must put everything in the mouth in order to taste the creaminess. This is great snack in the hot afternoon. I recommend this to anyone for tea break at 3pm.Show less

Author: Jivakaran B
Title: Creamy puffs
Review: The best durian puff along Jonker street. Competitive pricing for superior puffs. Cold and creamy just the way it's supposed to be.

Author: blueneutron
Title: Shiok & Creamy!
Review: Very duriany and light texture. Love the burst when I pop the whole puff into my mouth. Great burst for the hot weather too!

Author: 211selinan
Title: Yummy durian puffs
Review: My second time here.  The puffs are filled with Durian cream.  Used to be really yummy as the cream was fluffy, but this time around the cream lacked fullness and fluffiness.  Nevertheless,  they managed to maintain the authentic  taste of durians.

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bombastic durian puff
Review: Yummy durian puff.If you walk past the store, you should give it a try. The durian in it is very creamy and not as pungent as the real fruit. I ate it immediately and it really does explode in one's mouth. This is something unique, very different from the durian puff i always eat back home in Singapore. Excellent for all durian lovers. If you've never tasted durian, this is a good start really!Show less

Author: chongs477
Title: Creamilicious!
Review:
The durian puff taste sweet & creamy!
This is the one you shd try, priced at only RM2.2 per piece. Definitely worth it!
I got mine along the jonker street vendor

Author: audreylsg83
Title: Best durian puff
Review: Real good. Even my 3 year old love it.  Bought it at their shop at Dataran Pahlawan and avoid the queue at Jonker Street. You can really taste the durian.

Author: joeyting82
Title: Nice puff!
Review: This shop durian puffs are good, taste milky n durian. For those that don't like durian, then may try on their other flavor, eg. yogurt, etc.

Author: fandy1983
Title: Best durian puff in Malacca
Review:
This is one the best durian puff i ever tasted. Shocked* on the first bite, the durian cream is burst out if you not in the whole puff into you mouth.

Recommend to Try the jackfruit puff as well.

Author: Meltedcheez
Title: Awesome durian puffs!
Review: One of the best durian puffs I've tried. A little pricy compared to the others but I guess it's alright for now till something better comes along.

Author: yunaldoc
Title: Famous for the puffs
Review: I'm not quite a durian lover but this taste pretty nice. Good recommendation for those who loves durian. Can check out other local snacks as well.

Author: FromKluang
Title: Great durian puff
Review:
I like durian very much but not durian products.
But after trying this durian puff it surprised that the taste is so original
like fresh durian. Strongly recommend for this shop if you like to try durian puff.

Author: KT_BOY
Title: Best ever durian puff
Review: Bought 2 durian puffs to try. Need to pop the entire puff into your mouth otherwise the durian filling will ooze and flow down the mouth. Really tasted like a freshly opened durian.

Author: LimYP_SporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic yoghurt ice cream - great for hot days
Review: Chanced upon this and tried the red dragon fruit yoghurt ice cream. OMG! It's heaven sent cos Malacca was super hot all day long! We return the next day to eat it again. Tip: To avoid the queue, just go for the ice cream in small tubs.Show less

Author: zoem882London, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely Durian puffs
Review: There is obviously a lot of interest generated for this place because of the trip advisor reviews, with lots of tourists seeking it out to taste the puffs. As a durian lover I was sceptical, as many 'durian flavoured' products do not tend to compare to the real thing. I was pleasantly surprised with how beautifully flavoured the inside of these puffs were. The texture is very close to durian, without being too heavy. The pastry is light and airy.A great discovery, I went back everyday of my stay in Melaka to have my daily fix. Show less

Author: Twenkly
Title: A mouthful of durian
Review:
I do really like this durian puff, went there each time i go Jonker Street.
I recommend to those who like durian and visit during non-durian season to have a taste!

Author: Michjy
Title: Yummy durian puffs
Review: Famous for its signature durian puffs which served chilled. Love it where the puffs are light & soft in texture, mouthful durian custard that makes you put the whole puff all-in, don't bite & you will love it at the first bite. Yum yum yum!

Author: AsiansharkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Love at first bite!
Review: We didn't sit in the shop but just bought a couple of the famed durian puffs and ate on the go, although the shop looks relaxing and a good respite from the mid-day sun. My advise to others who buy the durian puffs - follow the shop's advice and pop the whole puff into your mouth, otherwise the durian paste will spill out making a big mess on your hand! Which is also why....it's so yummy!!Show less

Author: JulianF584
Title: Served chilled...
Review: Great snack for the walk down jonker street....It's served cold..taste great....and the puff is not sweet....The "aunty" serving us was super friendly and ask us not to buy too many first but to come back if we like it..."not a good way to do business, you say?...."...well she is confident of her product..We going back again tomorrow..Show less

Author: Eittus
Title: Yummy!
Review: Best durian puff! I love it! The puff is light and fluffy. The cream is cold and smooth with strong durian taste. Not too sweet. Like eating durian ice cream! Woohoo. Love it.

Author: kiml558Singapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing puffs, friendly staff
Review: Besides the durian puff, they also have the soursop puff. Both are delicious. The fruit filling explodes in your mouth. Take the friendly staff's advice - eat it in one mouth, don't bite! The puffs are available in boxes of 6 (rm11) or in single pieces (rm2+). Show less

Author: shirrrrly
Title: Yummy puffs (Y)
Review: The durian puffs are the best of the best! Please remember to have it one shot (don't bite it half way). I tried biting it halfway and regretted it immediately! Soursop puffs and yogurt puffs are nice too, basically the puffs there are nice. It literally tingles your taste buds! Show less

Author: kaushalyav
Title: Durian puff.. All time favourite!!
Review: One bite durian puff is so amazing! One thing I like about this shop is, the taste remains the same.. Th durian tastes like heaven. I'll buy this whenever I'm in Malaca. Worth trying!!

Author: MrGoh
Title: Super Yummy
Review: Super yummy. Must try again and again and again! Must eat with one bite. I don't like durian but I like this puff. It's super amazing. Super must try!!! Don't be fooled by stalls along the night market. Look for this shop!

Author: Samuel C
Title: Perfect for Durian Lovers!!
Review: Its durian puffs are the best. For those who enjoy Singapore's Goodwood Park Hotel's durian buffet, this is very comparable and at very affordable prices!!

Author: BerryTan93
Title: Delicious Durian Puff
Review: The durian puff is just tasty and so durian, nothing else, service is good. They also sell ice cream which is not nice quite nice..

Author: Jiamin_OKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Durian Puffs
Review: One of my favorite places to go especially in the afternoon when it's scorching hot! It's very difficult to stuff the whole puff into my mouth, so I always have to carefully bite some parts of it to make it slightly smaller before stuffing it into my mouth. Love it when the puff burst inside my mouth, DURIAN!They have other flavors like dragon fruits (sometimes), nangka, and yogurt too, but durian is my most preferred choice. All the time!Show less

Author: Stephanie_kikyo
Title: Nice durian puff
Review: Durian puff is so delucious, be sure to a one, otherwise it will juice erupted. Would also like to eat eat. Will not miss every pass.

Author: KaZsingapore
Title: Fragrant Sweetness in Mouth!
Review: It can be challenging to pop the entire puff into your mouth in a bite, but it is definitely worth it! The explosion of flavors (if you are a durian lover) in that bite is AWESOME. Delicious, affordable and good service. Highly recommended!

Author: Isis71Singapore, Singapore
Title: So so...
Review: Abit over-rated, cost Rm$2 for a puff...durian filling was too liquid & smooth hardly feel any texture.Show less

Author: lillopillo
Title: Nice durian puff, disgusting durian rice ball set
Review: In my opinion the rice ball set was REALLY WEIRD. I'm all for trying new things, but we really didn't understand what they were thinking putting this together. It consisted of a big dry rice ball, with a bit of durian inside. Some pickles on the side. The whole thing is so bizarre tasting in the mouth. Worst thing, that costs 10RM. However we decided to give another try to this shop so we had the famous puffs (2RM each piece or 10RM/6pcs). Thankfully those are really perfect, too bad they don't have the sane consistency. We came back a few times to have them.Show less

Author: hweeyingJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Yummy "One bite puff"
Review: I bought 6pcs for RM10 for take away. There are indoor seating also where you can enjoy the puffs inside the shop. I had remind my kids have to put whole puff inside the mouth instead of bite. My kids love it so much. They love durian taste, the puff not too thick neither too thin. I even saw a tour guide brought the foreign tourists to try this famous puff. Don't miss this if you are at Melaka!Show less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So good!
Review: Their durian puffs are so yummy! Pastry filled with a decadent durian cream filling - so, so good! If you're a durian lover, this is a must try. They are very afordable - RM10 for 6 durian puffs. You can either order takeaway, or sit in the shop and enjoy them.Show less

Author: NachongJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Perrrfect for durian lover
Review: Its one of the food kiosk on Jonker street. Its main offering is durian puff. The puffs were very light and fluffy and the durian cream filling has a very rich durian taste without the feeling of "too much". Myself am not a durian lover, but this puff made me want for more, and one puff definitely was not enough. Show less

Author: PutriYobymiciJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Durian Puff Love it
Review: I know this resto from my friend, she said this durian puff really delicious and must try when come to Malacca.And finally i found you Taste Better resto, and i buy six Durian Puff.the first i bite this durian puff, hmmmm yummy this puff use real durian not pasta.Taste Better have another taste except durian, like cempedak and i forgot what another taste.6 Durian Puff = 10 MYR.Show less

Author: MrGohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hard to find but so yummy
Review: This place is rather hard to find. It is situated towards the end of Jonker if you come from the bridge. Along the way, you see many "imitation" stalls and shops selling durian puffs. So make sure you note the pictures so you do not fall for the fake puffs along the way.The puffs at Taste Better really taste yummy. You MUST eat the whole puff at one bite to get the best experience. I am not fond of eating durians, but I love this puff!Show less

Author: herysiandySurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Try durian puff at least 1
Review: I'm not durian lover but once i put the puff in my mouth, i want more! Amazing!... try to eat fresh. I bought 6 pcs and walk back again to buy 6 more... :) They will told u how to eat:1. Put all pieces in your mouth and enjoy...Gonna miss this for a long time!Show less

Author: HerianiJakarta, Indonesia
Title: One time go!
Review: Visited this place because of Tripadvisor and we quiet enjoyed the durian puff. When the kind guy in the counter tried to explain on how to keep it in the fridge, right away I said, no worries we will finish it all on the spot. One dozen of the original durian puff was gone very fast. The have 3 types of puff, original, yoghurt and jack-fruit beside durian ice-cream which we didn't try that night. To my taste, the puff should be softer, so it really could melt in your mouth, unfortunately the pastry/choux was kind of hard maybe because it was kept in the display fridge or maybe it was supposed to be like that. Anyway, be careful because it could be messy, you really have to eat it in a go!Show less

Author: msnakim
Title: Durian Puffs!
Review:
Yummy yummy yummy!  We ordered half a dozen, finished on the spot and got another half dozen!

The address is at 96 Jalan Hang Jebat (Jonker Walk), opposite Geographer Café.  Don't miss it.

Author: Adrian LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sour taste but durian is good
Review: Tasted the yogurt puff and durian puff. The yogurt puff seems to be very sour and its like spoilt. I do not whether it is suppose to taste like that or not. However, the durian puff is good as usual. Tried it for more than 5 times and it still good. =)Show less

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Those durian puff were love at first bite
Review: The thing is, I love actual durians but I’ve never been a fan of anything durian flavoured – ice cream, cake, whatever. Taste Better is a small little pastry shop but everything looks pretty tempting, I can’t decide what to get. Don’t be intimidated by the array of unusual flavours here! This. Blew. Me. Away. Confession: I loved it. There, I said it!!The sign crystal clearly states: 1 Bite Puff: I shot all in, don’t bite! Was so good that I ate up the whole puff at one go? not quite.
