Overall, I was impressed by my experience. Bite into one of the morsel sized Durian puffs and the Durian literally explodes from within the thin pastry. Not too sweet and yet made of the real deal. Rich, creamy, smooth. Heavenly.Here’s where to go for your drool-worthy durian fix. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…(www.perfyi.wordpress.com)Show less

Author: Zee90
Title: Durian Durian Durian!!!
Review: I love Durian.. so bad that I will try all dessert related with Durian. Recommended by some friends, I have no hesitate to try this, and it's just melt in your mouth. Recommended!!!!thay sell it at Jonker Street, they even have it at the Dataran Pahlawan shopping mall, and they even open a counter at the night market, awesome!!Show less

Author: Deepa G
Title: Heaven of Durian Puffs
Review: Basically I'm a durian puffs and taste better shop of durians really heavenly yummss. It's a must to drop by to taste better durian puffs shop if you're down in malacca. Highly recommended.

Author: XynTSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Burst in your mouth
Review: You can see many other stalls selling similar product but you have to try this, the one with the good "Ho Chiak" sticker. Get one and put the whole thing into your mouth and the during filing will burst inside your mouth. Have to try this version of Malaysia's king of fruit made productShow less

Author: lohh91
Title: Authentic Durian puff!!!MUST TRY!!!
Review: Taste Better's durian puff is the best and authentic durian puff in melacca, MUST  try their durian one bite puff and durian ice-cream!! They sell chinese traditional biscuits too!! This durian puff is the only one I prefer!!! Very GOOD!:)

Author: Sharon1T
Title: Durian Puff
Review: For those who likes to eat durian, it is a must to try durian puff which is very famous in Jonker Street. 1 Bite Puff, 1 shot all in, don't bite !!

Author: shiroatkl
Title: Must try - Durian Puff
Review: There serve yummy durian puff. There is a signboard saying one bite per puff or else the puree will flow out.

Author: Coolbreeze88Singapore
Title: Indeed it was really Taste better
Review: If you are a durian puff lover..you must try when you are at jonker street (they have 2 stall there) The puff and the durian inside's taste is so fragrant and nice!!!! Put the whole puff in your mouth and the durian will "explode" within your mouth. Thumbs up :) Their ice cream was gd also.I have try another stall name durian cottage which is also located in jonker street. The ice cream was nice..but the puff u can try from taste better..cos the puff itself was quite hard and the durian paste was quite little.Craving for taste better durian till bought some more when i was at ksl mall (JB) :)Show less

Author: corrine6Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Be warned, durian puff explodes!
Review: During our 3 days stay in Jonker, we stopped by 3 times for their durian puffs. Twice on our 2nd day, and one last stop before we leave. The puffs are kept refrigerated, so it's nice and cool when you pop it in one mouthful. Then, that's when the puff explodes! Hahaha! There are signs that says eat in one bite. The staff at the stall will also remind customers during every purchase to eat the puff in one bite. If not, you'll find half of the yummy durian fillings on the floor, on your hand, or on your clothes. Better don't risk it. Besides, the filling is too yummy to be wasted like that!Some days the puffs are slightly bigger than other days. I nearly choke myself while trying to stuff the whole puff into my mouth from the 3rd batch of purchase :pShow less

Author: CarplaneshiptrainSingapore, Singapore
Title: try the durian puffs here!
Review: They serve yummy durian puffs that has to be eaten in one bite otherwise the durian puree will flow out onto your hand/legs/trousers etc... We tried the durian white coffee as well - unique. Location is just along Jonker street. Easy to find. Their sister shop about 5 shops away sells durian rice balls.Show less

Author: dianahamasubaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food and experience with HRC Melaka
Review: We reached at the cafe around 2.40pm after we had our lunch at one of the cafes in Jonker Street. So, we came in just want to hang out with friends.When we came in, just 3 tables occupied. We chose a table at the corner near to the stage. At the time we reached, no live band and we ok with it.The ambience was great and cool. Play along with rock music and songs. We enjoyed so much.We ordered classic nachos, brownies and drinks. The plate of nachos was extremely huge. We didn’t expect it. The taste was fantastic. The brownies was also yummy. Not too sweet. Match with the ice cream. And both are very recommended. The staff were very attentive and helpful. One of them even help me to get my member id using my email because i didnt know how to retrieve it. But i forgot to ask his name as i always do. Thank you sir!Show less

Author: Nrafyna99
Title: Good places to go
Review: Best places to go in Malacca after a long hot morning taking the history of this World Heritage city to rest in the guaranteed quality environment. The foods also delicious and affordable 👍🏻

Author: peanutChong
Title: Truly disappointed! Not the hard rock we know
Review: Truly disappointed! Not the hard rock we know. Waiters attending customers in haste, very expensive for Melaka standards, toilets are dirty!  It’s a shame!

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Good location
Review: I walked in because they are centrally located, have a good offering and of course have free wi-fi.Overall happy.

Author: fOODSLOVEr668Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: We reached there around 10.45pm, the greeter told us that no more dinner serve, which there is no sign or any information. We have no choice and have to go to the restaurant beside the river to settle our dinner. When we are back to the café at around 11.15pm, the greeter again told us they are closing, but the sign clearly stated they are closing at 12.00 am. After we begging him, only he allowed us to enter to have drink, and the greeter showing us his kind of sour face, just like we are drinking for free.We are asked to sit at the tables outside, whereby in the café was having full blast of air-cond without a single guest? We are in the group of 6, asking to join 3 tables or more, so that easy for us to talk, Hence, our request was rejected due to social distancing. However, another high table with high stools were allowed for 6 persons, not even 1 meter distance? Maybe the manager was in the table with the group, therefore they are allowed to sit together without social distance.Show less

Author: SensiDaveMalaysia
Title: Reliable
Review: They have managed to incorporate the HRC into old town Malaka very well. It does not jar the eye like the Gravy Baby just down the road.I don’t use HRCs very much but when I do it is because I know they can be relied upon to deliver what I want, how I want.After a hot afternoon exploring the backstreets my need was for an ice cold drink. Their Gin and Tonic was exactly right. So right I had another! The following day we met some friends for dinner and they have a small daughter. HRC did it again, exactly what you need, how you need and served by always friendly crew.Show less

Author: zmyusof
Title: The hot fudge brownies never fail
Review: Stopped by here for desert last week and left happy. Their hot fudge brownies are amazing. No live band show due to Covid 19 SOP

Author: Y5411DFpaulkPalmerston North, New Zealand
Title: Perfect
Review: The HRC in Melaka is the perfect spot at the top of Jonkers Street after a long hot morning taking in the history of this World Heritage city to rest in the guaranteed quality environment of HRC. Due to COVID and low tourist numbers it was our first time ever that we did not have to queue for entry to a HRC. The temperature was perfect, the beer temperature was perfect, the food was perfect. And Elton John costume sat on the wall behind us. The price was $$$ but I guess you pay for perfection. We will return.Show less

Author: Y1479KSmarkc
Title: Just nice they have one here
Review: Bought our standard pin and moved on, nice location but didn't try the food.  It's all the same though.

Author: L54Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super duper expensive
Review: I just wanNa know why a nachos should cost me 90 RM They didn’t have any happy hour , just offer one type of beer and the food was so expensive for the place and quality.There is awesome restaurant in Melaka so try to go there . For normal meal for of us spend 600 RM there .Show less

Author: baljitk2019
Title: Great 👍
Review: As usual Hard Rock never fails.  Great drinks. Great food.  Great friendly service.  Went there twice in a week.

Author: FizahRomanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Having hamburger pepper ..
Review: Having hamburger pepper .. where they wanted to charged us for RM45 for this ???Not even proper patties and buns.. instead sourdough! Over rated for the price definitely isn’t us.We don’t mind paying high price if it worth what we ordered for.Staff very slow responsive unsure what they are doing ... need to call them many times before you place the order.We left with disappointment and will never come back Show less

Author: josslerUK
Title: Overpriced & soulless. The
Review: Overpriced & soulless. The food was bland & tasteless. The restaurant was empty & the ‘rock music’ inaudible. We asked the staff to turn it up - after all it is a HRC - and they told us that they weren’t allowed to!Then the bill arrived... RM48 for a child’s small milkshake!!! More than a pint of Asahi beer! Utterly shameful.A rubbish, overpriced sham. Not consistent with the HRC franchise. Avoid.Show less

Author: William7788SingaporeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Poor service and staff double charged us
Review: We were charged double the bill as I wanted to give my friends ab treat and pay for the bill but not knowing that two of my friends had paid for their part of the bills. This amounted to a substantial amount. When we found out and protested, they said they will not charged us as I believe they were caught out. However, my friend's credit card bill was not voided. One of the staff even standoff and challenged my friend. They should all be sackedShow less

Author: RudieVenMuar, Malaysia
Title: So let me set the scene.
Review: So let me set the scene. My daughters birthday. We drive 110km ( round trip ) to get to Hard Rock Melaka ( my daughter sees herself as a rocker ) . Get there around 8pm and lucky it’s not full. On the contrary there are only 6 tables with people. We want to order we have to look and call for a waiter. We order. 3 by drinks1x Nachos starterMains:One chicken satay for the princessOne Fajita DuaOne striploin with a extra side of onions rings & garlic bread. So we wait and wait and wait. No drinks comes. All of a sudden here is my onions rings. Then comes 2 Milkshakes. Then comes the nachosThen the garlic bread and then my steak. All of a sudden the table looks small. I ask them is it possible for us to have the starter and then you bring the mains out. The waiter looks confused and says but I am bringing your Fajita now. This is where I got upset. I said keep it in the kitchen and take my steak back as well. Once we done with this we will have the rest. STILL I DID NOT RECEIVE MY DRINK!!!!!We are done and ask them for the mains and I also ask where is my drink. Reply ........ oh they forgot to make it!!!!!! Never one of us was asked if we wanted another drink or anything else. We paid and left. Went I get dessert outside from another shop. I have to congratulate the management on F£&@ing up a special night by not training their staff properly and for not knowing how to run a restaurant ( I’ve been in the food business at many levels and I know crap when I see it). I would never ever set foot in Hard Rock again. It’s a disgrace the service we got. You were almost empty you should be pampering the tables and selling more and more to them. We would have easily still have dessert and coffee. But I guess it’s your loss Hard Rock. Show less

Author: 471satiiParis, France
Title: Just normal
Review: I ordered coffees and some snacks. There was a live band nice but we cannot talk between us..the music was really loud.Show less

Author: 8MikeM
Title: Expensive
Review: Compared to local places this is very expensive. Staff was attentive and helpful. Rhett is a nice outdoor sitting area beside the smelly river

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Modern Amongst Old
Review: Located at the junction of Jonker Walk and the bridge to the Red Square is the modern cafe amongst the old heritage buildings. Overlooking Melaka River a great combination of historic views and modern lifestyle. Great place.

Author: Muru KMumbai, India
Title: Nice place to hang out
Review: After a hectic visit around Melaka we parked ourselves in this place on the river. Spent a couple of hours drinking some good Asahi draft beer. The server was a great guy. Forgot his name but he had a huge Rastafarian style hairdo. He talked the chef into making us a huge platter of nachos to share. Had a great timeShow less

Author: villamorantonio
Title: Great western food meal but
Review: Great western food meal but a bit too overpriced. The servings are quite big and the service was awesome and very helpful.

Author: syabilazman
Title: Great burger
Review: great place,friendly staff,best pace to have a burger..dont miss the live music show..Overall its a great experience for me

Author: shareen k
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: Good food, nice ambiance. Overall good place to chill. Service was a bit slow though. Will visit again.

Author: boycsChester, Uk
Title: WALK ON BY
Review: Wanted a beer and wifi. First impression, ok. Nice and cool. Then tried to order a beer from the list. Only a couple of brands available, and not the cheapest either. Ended up paying a ridiculously high price for a Heineken. First waitress gave a wifi code that was invalid. Next waitress gave another code, also turned out invalid. Next waiter gave the correct code, but turned out router wasn't operational. Fourth waiter(!!) said they'd been very busy and the router turned itself off in those circumstances. At this point there were 5 customers, including ourselves, outnumbered by staff. None of them showing any interest in rectifying the situation.If I ever return to Melaka I'll pass by this place and go somewhere more local, where I expect the prices would be significantly lower, and the staff more grateful for our custom. This is a sad example of a tired old brand.Show less

Author: mrbbangMalaysia
Title: No food after 11pm
Review: Arrived at 11pm were told no food to serve as the kitchen is closed. What HRC is this? Is this even legit HRC or just some franchise using the name only? 11pm on Friday night no food? No wonder it isn't crowded in a HARD ROCK Cafe! Show less

Author: MALAYSIANWANNABEKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The band rocks! But everything else sucks
Review: Don't waste your time at this place if you are interested in good food or service. If you are a true Hard Rock fanatic, it might be worth your time. The food is crazy expensive and mediocre and everyone was frustrated with the lackluster service. Hubby's salmon was overcooked and my salad came without the promsed pecans. The staff is friendly but undertrained and people were constantly raising their hands to get their attention. The band was fun and we enjoyed the live music, but I would never go back again. Chili's is a much better value for money if you want to go to an American chain in Malaysia (unless you really want to see Aerosmiths guitar). Show less

Author: versaseKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the worst food in Melaka!
Review: One of the worst customer service and food! Flat tasting food and even worst service. Time to close this place down and give it go McDonalds and they can do a better job! Pricey and not worth the food. Music acoustic is off and way too loud. Show less

Author: puchkaBengaluru, India
Title: Fun and food
Review: Just before entering Jonkers street, one cant miss this restaurant with their staff welcoming customers. The music is loud and foot tapping. Typically American food with large servings. Service is quick and servers polite and helpful. The burgers are big enough to share for small eaters as it comes with fries as well. A must place to eat.Show less

Author: avinashchandraa
Title: Superb Ambience  tasty food and high quality service
Review: Right near the zMelacca River and the entrance of jonker walk   we visited  our favourite restaurant. Delighted with good music  fun atmosphere  full service bar and burgers, or enjoyed our coffee and cake. Love to visit again for a meal.

Author: richtee2019Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Could Be Better
Review: Came for Christmas Eve Dinner. No reservation allowed and the waiting system was bad. We finally gotten our table and ordered some steaks & ribs. Food were ok except for a rib that was too hard. But the manager was fast and kind enough to change it and ended up giving us a delicious lamb rack. There was a good local band ‘Split Fire’ singing on the night. Overall it was a good night out for our family.Show less

Author: 26hoy
Title: Band was OK and good.
Review:
International foods and all fast foods served and served by the fast food prices globally.
Beers was nice and place was good for business chill

Author: Adrian HPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice environment and good food.
Review: Those hardrock fans is A MUST visit when coming to Melaka. -The dinner meal although is pricy when looking at the menu.However when the serving is big portions and quality eventually well maintain.-Serving level up to par, friendly staff.-Sitting environment are chilling and relaxing, especially your are tried traveling whole day.-Sad point is they do not has happy hour sessions on December, due to system adjustments.Show less

Author: 171traviss
Title: Undercooked burger, sneaky extra drink charges
Review: I'm a long time fan of hard rock, having been to their cafes in many different countries. I regularly get the same burger and order it medium rare and never have any issues, but here it was grossly undercooked, to the point that most of it looked raw. When I mentioned this to my server he brushed it off and suggested it might be because they use processed patties rather than fresh ones... The manager took it off my bill after realising I wasn't going to eat it as he came to clear my table. Whilst disappointed I decided to stay for another lemonade and a bit more music since they'd done right by me by removing the burger from the bill. I was shocked to see my lemonade had increased by over 70% in price because it was after 10:30pm. This is stated on a single line of a drinks menu, but like most people I just look at the price listed next to the drink I would like, and presume that is what I will pay, especially when it is my second of that drink!  Perhaps if I ordered the burger medium well I wouldn't have had any issues, but this is how I always order my burger at Hard Rock and it's the first time I've had an issue. Especially given how expensive this place is compared to local options, I really don't think it's worth going to this particular one. Show less

Author: rockkapak78Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice and cozy
Review: Had late night supper with my wife for our 11th anniversary after strolling at Jonker Walk. Gladly, the staff placed us for outside seating. Nice view.We had onion ring and Coke. The portion was more than enough for 2.The live band played well. Loved it.To come back again in the future with my kids.Show less

Author: RossR908Thames, New Zealand
Title: First impressions
Review: This was our first visit to a Hard Rock Cafe. Was impressed with the overall presentation and the music was a really good mix for most tastes. My wife had a southern salad and I had the cheese burger with monterey Jack cheese. Both meals were tasty and a generous serving size. Prices are above average but guess you pay for the name. Would I go back yes but not often. Show less

Author: Dziauddin M
Title: Outstanding Performance from Splitfire
Review:

Nice dinner and foods as well.
Thank you to Ekee for taking care of our table

Keep on rockin' guys

Dean
Hard Rock Fans

Author: Leonard L
Title: Lovely Sunday Evening
Review: Lovely Sunday evening with delicious food and band (Splitfire) performance. Will definitely recommend HRC if you’re looking for evening entertainment along Jonker street.

Author: Foody2017Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Nice building but food is just so expensive for what it is.
Review: We’ve visited a few hard rock cafes around the world and they are all pretty much the same. We had a couple of the sharing plates and a drink. It was so so. Staff were friendly, service a little slow. To be honest, I’d stick to the local cafes and restaurants in the area. If you want a burger, visit The Baboon house which is around the corner. You’ll pay around £4 here for a homemade burger in comparison to Hardrock’s £12+. In my opinion it just isn’t worth it. Show less

Author: AzmeerSulongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Birthday party with family
Review: We went to HRC Melaka to celebrate my birthday. There was about 11 of us having lunch. It was very well organized, the staff assisted the party planner to decorate the table nicely. The ambience and music was good. The food was fantastic, and served quite fast too. The staff are friendly. We had a jolly fun time together. The staff at the Rock Shop (Marco )was very helpful as well while we choose some t shirts and souvenirs. Thumbs up to HRC Melaka.Show less

Author: 575richardm575Ciudad Juarez, Mexico
Title: Mmmm
Review: Order a burger... They say in the add that is jalapeño... Please that is not a jalapeño, slow service and Was not full, But still they Apply service charge...Show less

Author: azmanf2019
Title: Dinner with family
Review: Good music but the food quality and taste, i think there's a lot to desire disspointing dinner but my 5 year old kid did enjoy the music... ⭐⭐⭐Show less

Author: DesertSurferDhahranDhahran
Title: Not up to the Hard Rock Cafe standards
Review: Was disappointed with our dinner at HRC. No pork on the menu (there is pork everywhere in Malaysia!!)Beef ribs were fatty with very little edible meat! Poor & slow service, food quality not great, and no free refills of soft drinks (no where in the world when we have visited HRC have we not had free refills!!). Asked the waiter about this policy and his only reply was - I only started working here and don’t know about other Hard Rock Cafes. Coke was RM10.34 each....Would definitely not waste your money visiting this restaurant despite the good location (probably the only positive point about the restaurant). Sad day when Hard Rock Cafe doesn’t serve good food!Show less

Author: brendas329
Title: Great respite from the heat!
Review: We stopped here to get drinks, sit in air conditioning to cool off from our travels, and to use their clean bathrooms. It was a good decision and felt like heaven. Our total for 7 drinks (Mango Coolers, Strawberry Basil, Cappucinos) was 194R.

Author: ckk757
Title: Small pricey and loud.
Review: Just as we expect from any HRC. Still they have a great collection of memorabilia.  The location is perfect just on the end of jonker street and opposite the Stadthuys.

Author: Tonisysten
Title: Hard Rock Fans
Review: All the ways i really love to dining at Hard Rock Cafe worldwide.Love the food,band,and specially is thier music!!!

Author: RuslenaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Syaqeel Umair's Unforgettable 13th Birthday Celebration
Review: Unforgettable birthday celebration with love ones. Celebrated my son's 13th birthday with his cousins and close aunt. He sure is one lucky boy to celebrate in Hard Rock Cafe and having the live band's undivided attention the whole night. Memories to last him a thousand years.Show less

Author: montash32Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rock is loosely interpreted if going here live music.
Review: The Hard Rock is a worldwide institution and deservedly so; however, this venue left us feeling a little lacklustre. First of all, the band, although decent, took very large intermissions, offered to indulge requests but then chose what they wanted to sing, and incorporated Ariana Grande amongst other teener bopper pop music into their lineup. The food is delicious and the drinks are strong but both are unnecessarily mercenary on the wallet. If you want to experience Australian food and drink prices in Malaysia, it's a great place to spend the evening. Show less

Author: Ricky-indo777Bali, Indonesia
Title: Melacca hard rock cafe
Review: This othentic hard rock cafe is another place you must visit if u go to melacca city. This hard rock cafe was located in the middle between jonker street night market and Stadthuys.And this hard rock cafe is right beside malacca river and have very relaxing outdoor area looking at the dutch square.They have live music to acompany us chill out.You must get reservation if you want to feel the relax situation at this hard rock cafe.Show less

Author: abrogers2001Perth, Australia
Title: Lunch - at a price
Review: The evnue is great - right on the riverfront with an outdoor eating area. It is beautifully air conditioned, which is a treat after slogging around in the tropical heat. There were few people there on our visit. The menu is pretty extensive (same as all other Hard Rock Cafes) We had Nachos and Club Sandwich. The nachos were good but not exceptional. The club sandwich was bland and nowhere near the quality of say Miss Maud's. We had a variety of juices and cocktails. Be warned the cocktails cost A$16 each. For one course each for two people the bill was A$35 (excluding drinks). Go there for the air conditioning and the cocktails.Show less

Author: tujoe
Title: Hard Rock Melaka rocks!!
Review: We went there for 2 consecutive nights during our stay in Melaka, and we were pleasantly surprised by the quality of music.The band "Shockwave" from Indonesia did some amazing numbers and both the lead singers did a fabulous job. Thoroughly enjoyed the ambience and the music sitting by the Melaka river late in the evening.Show less

Author: iammanishgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hard Rock Cafe along the river
Review: Am a fan of HardRock Cafe's and it's a must visit if the visiting city houses it. And this ones location is just by the passing Malacca river, making it even more apt for an evening meal with great cocktails that Hard Rock is famous for. So as i got there, made sure that got a seat by the river side, the view was fantastic and one could just sit by and relax as time passes by. As for the food I ordered the Grilled Salmon that came along with mashed potatoes and stir fry veggies and a mojito to go along with. As usual the food never disappoints here and staff are always super cordial. Loved the place.Show less

Author: QuielGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Same HRC but lacking service
Review: We went there on a holiday period which a bit crowded, might be the reason why the service was lacking.- food that we wanted to order i.e. chicken tenders were out of stock; full rack ribs not available;- drinks mojito which is the most basic run out of lime - anyway many choices to choose from but if you’ve visited several HRC you can compare that this one stand out for lacking of service + music choices were great+ location was superb, as after shopping from jonker street can unwind looking at the river+ point the guy at the rock shop, he was welcoming, pleasant and despite several people inside the shop he tried his best to attend to each customers need Show less

Author: ThengleSingapore, Singapore
Title: Typical Hard Rock
Review: Stopped by for a late night supper - it’s basically the same as every Hard Rock on Earth. Some basic menu and solid food. It was VERY noisy so we sat outside which was quite nice (above the river). Went there because some of us craved comfort food but why not try the incredible local fare if you are in Malacca? With that said, if you want something that is like every other member of this chain in the world, stop by. Show less

Author: aleeakbarhg

Review: I always visit Hard Rock shop every country I visited. the first place I come as I arrived to destination will be Hard Rock Shop. and bought my self Hard Rock shot glass for my collection

Author: agj0hnnyKuching, Malaysia
Title: Staff very rude
Review: One of the stuff very rude to us " the bald one and using spec at night . Not a kind of service that we expect from a great and well known place such as Hard Rock. Show less

Author: SulifamilySydney, Australia
Title: So cool
Review: The Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka was so cool in many ways. It was so hot during the day that the cafe had any aircon plus it lived up to the usual Hard Rock image. We stayed for lunch which was really good. Drinks were cold and refreshing plus very friendly staff. As always the Hard Rock In Melaka lived up to the global brand. Show less

Author: Jessgiang123

Author: Stephenchu1230
Title: They are busy hard rocking tha serving.
Review: One is on the phone The other is busy doing something under a table. They seem to be very proud to work in hard rock more than actually working itself. Food is overrated, drinks are poorly made. Besides the grand view, where you can also view it for free from many other points this place is so over priced. Food taste is so soShow less

Author: John L
Title: Very Ordinary
Review: While visiting Melaka, we decided to give this place a try as one of our freinds wanted western food. The place was not very busy, but we found the service appalling. On top of that, we ordered beef burgers that came out raw the first time. We sent them back, but they came out raw again. we ordered a round of drinks to begin with, but one of us did not recieve a coke. After ten minutes we asked the waiter about it and he said he would get on to it. We called him back 5 minutes later because it still had not arrived.... After another 5 minutes of watching them stand around the bar....we actually had to go up there and demand it. Overall a very poor result and not a good look for the brand. I would not recommend this place to anyone....Show less

Author: Mark WDallas, Texas, United States
Title: Always a FUN place to go !!!
Review: Right in the heart of town, at the end of Jonker Street and on the Malacca River, you just can't beat the location. Always good food and great service. This is my oasis in Asia. A good place to get a great burger and fries or quesadilla and coke. BTW, great prices on gifts as well. I always find something for the kids there.Show less

Author: Hepi555Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lacking in service
Review: Craving for fajitas so we thought wouldnt go wrong with HRC. Firstly, quite surprised their cushioned seats were rather worn out. Service was rather slow even though I counted not more than five tables during non-peak hours. Service staff was not forthcoming. Food was alright.Couldnt put a finger to what was missing in the overall experience that should be uniquely HRC's.Show less

Author: kopibabySingapore
Title: Very patient staff at boutique shop
Review: Five of us went there for lunch. Service was not great but the food was decent for the price we paid. The kids had their usual spaghetti bolognese. After the lunch we went to the boutique to check out the merchandise. We ended up spending a lot of time there, buying some t shirts. And I have to give credit to the sales staff there in the boutique - very patient with us and the kids. Entertained our requests to try in the different designs. Patient in letting us decide on the sizes to buy as gifts. Show less

Author: mckrei
Title: Worst service and food at a very high cost
Review: Let me start by saying we are not whingers! We realise mistakes can happen, but thus was constant!Inattentive staff. The only good thing was the corona beer, which they can't stuff up!We ordered an iced coffee with a small amount of milk and lots of ice. The opposite came out, we sent it back, still undrinkable.The nachos didn't come with the sour cream that was meant to be standard, nor our guacamole that we ordered. After finally getting a waiters attention it came, only to be literally dropped on the table, the sour cream upside down. The waitress took it away and came with a 'fresh' one.The side of vegetables had cauliflower in it that was old, it had dark patches on top and some of the tops had been cut back to get rid of the black. Side of chips was average.We came here as we hadn't been to a hard rock in years, turns out to be the worst food we have received on our 2 week holiday. And the most expensive.Show less

Author: Pollyana T
Title: Nice music
Review: Nice music, good food and drink but expensive. We ordered nachos and was so good, not too spicy and delicious.

Author: nour6mah
Title: Best view everrrr!!!
Review: since i am in Melaka and i am not big fan of Asian food, so my escape was to run to Hard Rock Cafe, staff was sooo friendly, ambiance like all HRC in all over the word, food was amazing! and the VIEW :o OMG feeling i m in VENICE !! thank u for this nice experience :)Show less

Author: ElsaCLNew York City, New York
Title: Very good live entertainment and food
Review: It was my first time at a Hard Rock Cafe, and we were treated to a live band! We enjoyed listening to familiar songs!I like the Cafe’s high ceiling and booth seating.Their char kway teow, a Malay dish of flat noodles, has squid in addition to shrimps and slices of fish cakes as well as regular noodles but without the thick, flavorful, salty and sour dip that The Social in KL has.My husband was happy with his burger snd French fries.Show less

Author: Said AKulai, Malaysia
Title: Entertaining wife and son
Review: Normally just passing through when in KL, but in Melaka while walking along the river saw Hard Rock Cafe. Why not gave it a try, it's nearly 30 years since trying out the burgers in KL Hard Rock Cafe. So just out of curiosity just walk in an have a pleasant evening in Melaka HRC. Always have been trying something new whenever traveling either locally or abroad. Show less

Author: Adrian PLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Bland food and a band that couldn't sing in english
Review: Well at the price this restaurant charges I would have expected far far higher. Tasteless was what we ate. Fajitas were what we chose and it may as well have been a lump of cardboard. Then on comes the live band who just could not speak English ok so I'm not in an English speaking country you may say but then sing others not English. In the plus side the band was great had they sacked the singers and got new ones it would have been awesome .If you are even thinking of eating here I would suggest you bring your own spices otherwise you'll be disappointed .Show less

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Nice band
Review: We had a fantastic evening enjoying the band performance. Good showmanship and active guests' participation.The cocktails were beautifully presented albeit the pricing slightly high for non alcoholic.The location was easy to find but with limited car parks.Overall, will recommend to drop by for a fun evening.Show less

Author: overSace
Title: Customer Service
Review: Decided to eat lunch here during my first visit in Melaka. The place was empty upon entering...and an usherette guided us to our table. Took minutes before our orders were recorded. Asked to have the food served at the same time.First, the waiter brought my friend’s order. I asked him why only one food was being served but then he didn’t answer and just placed the food on our table, and left. So we wait for another 10 minutes before both of us could start eating. Twisted mac with chicken arrived but then the chicken seemed to be massacred when it was chopped. I’ve bee many times to different Hard Rock Cafe’s but this spot surprised me. Next thing that happened, I finished my meal and then the waiter asked if he can take my plate out. But surprisingly, he was taking the plate of my friend who, on the spot, was still holding a fork. Like.... seriously??? Were they trained before they’re put on the floor? Show less

Author: mcbenlim83
Title: Breakie
Review: Nice atmosphere but quite pack at night....live band music is definitely the best after a day work of hustle and bustle....

Author: YingYingOH

Author: DKZ78

Review: very nice enviroment , food also nice n music balance with guess...sometimes slow , sometimes middle n the best parts when midnite ... heavy music with the energy of music band .. will not make u bored... if i come here , the best part n must punch card is HRC when im travelling again...Show less

Author: ypy73

Review: Great Place to Relax for a short drinks and Snacks after a long day shopping , place is so near to 三叔公 well known place from the locals and brought nice gift also

The iced tea was also very tasty. Our waiter, Atai, was very friendly and helpful. Atai is a fine asset to this franchise. Show less

Author: Adera37
Title: Good staffs

Author: 656audreyw
Title: Love the band!
Review: The food and drinks are good! But the band Enigmatic Six is brilliant! Very good musicians, great choice of cover songs! Thank you for the great evening! Hope to see you a next time!

Author: vivian b
Title: Family Dinner
Review: yay! we've enjoyed the big servings of salads and chips during our dinner, burgers and chicken meal. My parents and sister are visiting me in Singapore and I brought them to Melacca. We were at Jonker street, and it was quite busy that evening. It was to crowded and I don't know where to bring them for dinner. I saw the hard rock café. Im glad, the price is not as expensive compare to Singapore. We are a group of 5 and Im in charge of the bills. It didn't cost much and my parents enjoy the dinnerOur waiter was Pook. He was accommodating and fast.Show less

Author: tryph0820Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best place to spend the night in Melaka
Review: Pleasant ambiance+great food/drinks+live music =best way to spend the night. Went here around 9pm... ordered cheeseburger with fries and milkshake. Best cheeseburger i had for a long time! And the milkshake was so delish! I loved it here... food, ambiance, and staff. Really good value for money. Show less

Author: Rob HCoto de Caza, California
Title: Not very good
Review: Went here last night with 3 colleagues and the service was slow and the food was bad. The restaurant was not busy and there many staff standing around. I ordered the beef ribs and they were the worst ribs I have ever eaten. They were cold, dry, over cooked and full of fat and grissle. I wanted to send them back but our server never returned to the table. We couldn’t even order a second beer. Finally we flagged down someone so we could pay our bill and leave. Not a typical Hard Rock for food or service. To many other options in town.Show less

Author: sauber182
Title: Live band members have a good voice
Review:
Definitely be coming back for more music if and only if the band was still the same band in future.

One good recommended meal - 10oz burger. Super tasteful.

Author: Travel_roundnow
Title: Good
Review: The ambience was great, a strategic place. Loved the live band, but it was abit on the loud side. Food was okay, pricey but portion was large. The waitress Esther was friendly and helpful.

Author: martin wBracknell, United Kingdom
Title: You know what you're getting
Review: When you've had one plate of noodles too many or you're just longing for a burger this is your place. It's the same the whole world over. It could be London, Singapore, wherever...Slightly more expensive that McDonald's but a whole lot better (in my view).It's just where you need it, by the river at the end of Jonker St in the heart of the busy tourist spotsShow less

Author: NishchalSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Big name with worst service
Review: Location is real good, by the river, on one end of Jonker street... and live music adds to the ambience.Went in a hope to experience the same.Ordered couple of dishes... and relaxed for a while...Relaxing times stretched... but no serving yet.After a while, reminded a staff about the order, and continued waiting....Kept waiting in a hope order will be quickly served... as already reminded.After really Long wait and losing patience, again enquired about the order, .... after a while... staff came apologising for missing order and started asking again about the order....was the last straw to break...Cancelled the order and walked off from really a Hard Rock... a real shame on the staff and the managing team.Show less

Author: 445tonylStockton-on-Tees, United Kingdom
Title: The worst of the worst
Review: This was the worst burgers we have had here.Asked for well done. Served medium and warm. Returned one of them to kitchen. Returned to us microwaved still not well done just inedible.Staff more interested in having fun than serving.Manager did apologise and removed meal from bill. Hence 3 stars and not oneShow less

Author: typ1226
Title: Nice hang out cafe
Review: HRC is a very nice hang out place with friends and family. The view along the riverside is beautiful with colourful lighted bulbs

Author: ZarinaA122Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: HRC Melaka
Review: Location is good close to Jonker Street, tourist attraction and the hotel I was staying. Food and beverages, the same as other HRC franchise in Malaysia for example KL and Penang. The main attraction it is by the river side, creating a different ambience and view at night.Show less

Author: arianna0405Ancona, Italy
Title: Not so good
Review: It is good if you want to eat some western food but it more expensive than any other place in Melaka and the service is really slow.By the way when there is live music the tables on the river are really nice you can enjoy your after dinner time there. Show less

Author: 2019hp
Title: Good music and ambience
Review: Good place to visit for few drinks in Melaka. Right on the entrance of Jonker street. Staff, music & ambience is good.

Author: chuckwow56
Title: Standard hard rock burger n beer with rock n roll.
Review: Good nasi goreng ,nice river side location ,standard of service is good during day good value compared with england or singapore prices beer pricey even for malaysia

Author: minimogzz
Title: Great chill out place after a walk in Jonker Street
Review: As usual, Hard Rock Cafe never fail to disappoint. Great staff, nice food. But merchandise at the Rock Shop was kind of limited.

Author: LovelyJohorean
Title: Nice place chilling
Review: Nice place to chill and have drink and meet up with friends and hard rock alwalys the best. No matter which location.

Author: HolidaysHHMalaysia
Title: Christmas Eve Dinner Reservation Failure
Review: Very Bad Experience and unprofessional with the current HRC melaka management. Wanted to make a reservation but was turned down 4 days ago. Called again and they said we can reserve if we order 2 of their christmas set for 10 pax reservation and pay in advance at the restaurant.When we arrived earlier to make payment, the representative when back and disappeared and the manager appeared and now said we have to pay for 10 sets @ RM160 each to make the reservation.He then said no confirm reservation and ask us to come early to get a table instead if we dont order their set.Extremely disappointed with such commercialized and greedy management.Making us come all the way and make payment and take us for fools.I decided to have my Christmas eve dinner at a better restaurant elsewhere.Show less

Author: satanbug
Title: Hard Rock in Malaysia
Review: It doesn’t feel right to have a HRC in Malaysia but here it is. The menu is predominantly western with Asian alternatives. It was all pretty average and expensive although the band and the beer made me happier as time went on. Enjoy......

Author: IreneP2501Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: I ordered java lava burger & fish and chip, free one kid’s meal, chicken burger. In the end, all the chicken patties & the fish meats too dry and too hard. Especially for kid, my kid was totally not able to bite it! Not worth for the price!Show less

Author: ngnyokfong
Title: First impression of melaka hard rock cafe
