Author: btin2005Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love all serve all
Review: Nice place to hang out at night with beautiful songs sang by the group but background of the band was too loud. Overall , family and friends came here to relax .Show less

Author: ShamTaxi
Title: KL To Melaka
Review: Nice place in malaysia.You should go and enjoy to this place.Nice place with a good restaurant and taste

Author: Veni1206
Title: Wind down
Review: A good place to wind down after a walk at the busy jonker street. The nachos are a must try. Good atmosphere.

Author: Nazura A
Title: Great food, good music
Review: Love the band NAQITA and been there for 3 times since they started their gig there.  The food is good and the ambience is just perfect, with beautiful night view of the river next to the cafe.  Friendly and accomodative staff, with superb customer service.

Author: Jlmtd
Title: Typical of every Hard Rock
Review:
Hard Rock is abig worldwide brand. You get the same here as everywhere else in the world.
Service friendly, food is standard western.

Author: 58gayathrij
Title: Wow
Review: Had a great time..here...mst say the place was with so much of class...and the staffs were so freindly...i was so happy its was a closed non smoking hangout...it was great to take my little one there...we had a great time...

Author: imthejessicatKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fun chillaxing night!
Review: Went there with a colleague on a Sunday, so it was pretty quiet in terms of crowd. Music was awesome - the live band played some epic rock songs from the past and present. When the band was off, they played pop-rock songs.Lovely decor; strong DNA of the Hard Rock Cafe chain. Smoking area with high chairs and tables available. Two glasses of wine and two pints of Carlsberg: RM144Show less

Author: musaab_mhdDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: The Best
Review: Me personally I am a big fan of Hard Rock Cafe and I was shocked to see it open there. Definitely would recommend to go there and grab a bite. It’s clean, amazing ambiance and lovely staff as always with a partial view of the Malacca River. Located next to the Red SquareShow less

Author: Mnazarudin
Title: HRC
Review:
Like others HRC.
Good place to hangout with great food.
Nice ambiance to chill out here. Fast service and helpful staffs.

Author: Shuhada I
Title: Awesome Place To Hang Out
Review: We had agreat time in Har Rock Cafe food was awesome...also i would like to say one of your Team Member Faheem really take the effort to the next level of F&B Service...he even recoment us few best of your food...we really had a great evening...Show less

Author: Nomad53607226266
Title: Amazing!!!
Review: Had a brilliant night here, the music was class and service was perfect. Highly recommended!!! Faheem who served us was brilliant and made sure the drinks were flowing! Show less

Author: Seaside20923957125
Title: Dinner
Review: Great service from staff name ATAI !! Very friendly and helpful. Great food & great service! Hard Rock Cafe Melaka THE BEST! Show less

Author: dnxhuong
Title: Great place
Review: I came for a late afternoon coffee and fell in love with the place so I came back again for dinner and drink. It’s a too relaxing place to leave early and I ended up with a few drinks, with very nice service from Pook, a cute handsome waiter. Riverside, cozy, free. I’ll definitely come back. Thanks Pook and hope to see you again. Show less

Author: jasonanthony192Melaka, Malaysia
Title: worst manager
Review: I am writing today to complain of the poor service I received from your company on October 20, 2018. I was visited by a representative of Hard Rock Cafe Melaka, while seated at the bar. On a positive note the service by the servers were tip top and so was the food which i thoroughly enjoyed. Unfortunately, the let down was to have witnessed one of Hard Rock Cafe Melaka's representative consuming alcohol beverages while on duty. It was very shocking, unprofessional and straight up unacceptable in any terms. I am most annoyed that I was very eager to dine at Hard Rock Cafe due to the great and positive reviews and beliefs the company stands by but despite that my impression of Hard Rock Cafe has been tarnished, and I am now concerned about how the existing business is being managed by your firm. Especially when the company and people of Hard Rock rave about how customer is your number one priority and should be treated fairly. This i say because when i was seated, every order of mine and others alongside me were served second to your representative who is not only placing his order after us but also under the influence of alcohol while on duty! So why is he the priority? The worst of all was when i inquired regarding the representative stated above only to have found out that he was not just any so called worker but is a manager of the cafe itself! U could only imagine how frustrated i felt at that moment not only because he is enjoying himself at peak hours being served by his team instead of helping them but also because none of your staff had the courage to confront/address the situation when they were clearly aware. In the heat of the moment, i didn't get his name but he was a very dark, tall and bald man.I trust this is not the way Hard Rock wishes to conduct business with valued customers I have been with you since the company opened and never encountered such treatment/observations before. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss matters further and to learn of how you propose to prevent a similar situation from recurring. I look forward to hearing from you.Show less

Author: Inspire469439
Title: Dinner at Hard Rock Cafe, Melaka
Review: We had a well recommended dinner at Hard Rock Cafe. A very polite Pook served us. Because we had a very heavy lunch Pook recommended us to share which is sensible. After walking for a couple of hours of walk, Pook recommended a jug of Carlsberg cooling beer and lime juice for those who can't drink. Staffs are friendly as well. Unfortunately, the band starts at 9.30pm, we didn't have a chance to enjoy listening to the band. Overall, we highly Pook as the best service person of the night. Well done Pook! All the best in your career.Stella, SingaporeShow less

Author: christinash58Kampong Kiarong, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Hard Rock Cafe
Review: It’s our first time here and he gave us a really great service .Thank you for the wonderful dinner @pookShow less

Author: ZZiDive
Title: Hard Rock rules!!!
Review: Visiting HRC in different parts of the world is so fun.  The menu and fare hits the spot every time. Come check out Malacca'z branch and walk the river!

Author: jes2011
Title: Good Dinner!!! Impresss
Review:
Dinner was good, really up to standard. Reasonable price, friendly and good hospitality waiter..(cant remember his name)

Good ambiance and highly recommended..

Author: Kitty0811London, United Kingdom
Title: Weekday lunch
Review: The location is good ish, I guess. We ordered the set menu for lunch. The food was disappointed for a Hard Rock Cafe standard. The service is poor. The cafe is literally empty, the stuff at bar is fooling around and the waiters are mostly hiding in the kitchen. We were left alone for half an hour after we finished our food. We physically went to the front reception to get our own bill. Show less

Author: telshukSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pit Stop in Melacca
Review: If you've had a long ride on the road, this is a recommended pit stop for your trip. Placed in the centre of the busy tourist town, the staffs welcomed us with friendly smiles. Well maintained restaurant which was air-conditioned. Staffs were able to offer recommendations on their menu as well as places to visit nearby. Small conversations exchanged whenever they were free and without much interruption to our lunch.Wifi available for us, although it's kinda laggy. Steak was prepared well for a medium rare. Washroom was clean and comfortable. Show less

Author: KatieC4080Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice location but too many fails
Review: We ended up here as we arrived into town late at night and didn’t have time to do the usual exploring. It’s a great location at the start of Jonker Street overlooking the river. Live band on Friday night. And that’s about it. The staff were all very quick to smile and say hello, but were mostly inattentive to actual service. We had to call them over several times for drinks and ordering. The first beers were served warm. Then they forgot my meal. Nobody noticed and no follow up. When I chased it up, I did receive an apology, and was told it would come in 6 more minutes (something about hand written dockets). When it finally came (well after my husband had finished his undercooked hamburger), it looked nothing like the picture (Southern Salad). They had used crumbed chicken strips instead of the southern style buttermilk chicken that I was really looking forward to. I left at least 75% of the dish and nearly all of the chicken, and it was cleared by the waiter without a flinch. I usually only review the great places that we dine, but this experience was such a disappointment and let down. When you charge a premium price under the guise of an international brand like hard rock, there’s no excuse to get all these things wrong without any care or attempt to repair. Show less

Author: Markm1972Ashford, United Kingdom
Title: Monday evening
Review: Went on a Monday evening and absolutely no atmosphere. Food was average and for Malaysia very expensive. Portions were very big though. Show less

Author: pedromrmaMaputo, Mozambique
Title: To avoid
Review: Some how the employees must think they are Rock Stars and we, costumers should serve them because not only they take FOREVER to knowledge you, they come as if the world owes them something and for last they don't know nothing about nothing.So, unless you are a shareholder of the HardRock Cafe and know all there it is to know about it, I would recommend: Enter, buy the t-shirt, leave asa fast as you possible can.Show less

Author: KakamalKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rockin' on the river
Review: I've visited this place on Friday night for having my birthday dinner with my partner. We have contacted them a week earlier to make a reservation unfortunately they don't take any reservations for Friday & Sat dining. Luckily the time we got there around 8.45pm the place was still half empty then we managed to get an outdoor riverside table.We have ordered Hickory Smoke BBQ Duo Combo (RM89), Black Pepper Steak (RM88), Mud Pie (RM45), French Fries (RM14), Cafe Latte (RM23) and 2 Cokes (RM24). Total spend plus tax and charges was almost RM300. The service and food was great and fast served except for my ribs it was a bit hard. The place started to be packed around 10pm as the Live band performing at 10.30pm on Fri & Sat nights. There are RM10 extra charges for every drinks after 10pm. The band was good I kind of enjoyed it. This HRC is a bit special as it located by the river and I definitely will come back again.Show less

Author: Daniella SMaidstone, United Kingdom
Title: One of the nicest hard rocks I’ve been too
Review: First off, we didn’t actually eat here, only drinks, but hard rock food is hard rock food in my opinion. What makes Melaka HRC special is the building and the staff. The building is beautiful. Right in the middle of the heritage centre, surrounded by old heritage buildings, HRC blends in but also stands out as an inviting bar. It’s right next to the river so on a nice day, I suggest sitting outside by the river and watching the world go by (if you are susceptible to mosquito bites, wear repellent!). It’s so lovely. The staff are very friendly too. Would definitely go back to this hard rock.Show less

Author: LaksamanaKiagos
Title: Cosy Good Service
Review: Had lunch with my family, nice cosy place. Food almost similar with other HRC Worldwide, except they have this unique Rendang Burger. Good service and polite staff.

Author: TheGreatWhiteG
Title: Great Food
Review: A very refreshing break from the heat of Jonker Street in Melaka. Loved the potato skins and the mojitos. And it was air-conditioned. Friendly staff, clean toilets - what more could you want?

Author: louts86
Title: nice for night life
Review:
was nice experience to spend night dinner with my frned , the live band was nice and staff friendly 
prices some how high specially after 10 pm 
very crowded during weekend but the food is yummy

Author: David123888
Title: Great Service by Haikal d Bartender
Review: First of all i would like to thank all The Staff Front & back of the house for the great service on 9/9/2018 U guys did a great job.Thanks Haikal for Entertaining 3 of us at the bar area and providing us your wonderful 5 star service.Nasi Goreng and Jumbo platter was cook to perfection and we understand your kitchen team was bz and have to deal with alot of orders , This is how stress to deal with POS System haha.The nasi goreng definitely has a good kick of spice into it man ! Me , my father & my cousin will always come back to Hard Rock whenever we r back in Melaka.Band was awesome and they Rock whole night !!Thanks Once again for all your wonderful service !!!  Regards , Brigadier General Johnny Lim & Family ( Angkatan Tentera Malaysia )Show less

Author: zenboyc
Title: Merdeka!
Review: Been there yesterday , everything was nice. The foods are good , Live band is pretty NICE , I will give 101 out of 100. The only problem is, the sound system too loud , I can’t really enjoy the live band. Will be better if they reduce the sound... and may I know what’s the price of the Carlsberg Tower. Show less

Author: Prabek
Title: Rocking
Review: very nice ambiance , excellent food, great staff very caring for children, and not to forget the live rock band. Mesmerizing location.

Author: bobN6078XOSan Diego, California
Title: The illusion!
Review: I have been to a number of hard rock cafe locations. Never had this experience.Walk in and the A C is blowing. Love that part.... it's about 25% full, so expecting great service.Get to the table, and we are brushing food off the booth. Wait almost 20 minutes to give out order.35 minutes later the food arrives. Both burgers were undercooked to just over raw.Waited almost 10 minutes for silverware after the plates hit the table. They forgot my cheese and guacamole.The kicker. ... he wrote down our order.The manager (I assume) offered to refill the kids drinks. Tack on another site 10 minutes and when he approached our table with the check for the other table... yeah.... then realized he got that wrong and got the drinks to the kids.The fries were decent, the burger is good once it is actually cooked.Just the worst experience I have ever had at a Hard Rock Cafe. The price for food here is easily quadruple most all other restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. I will never return here. Show less

Author: adampeterr
Title: Awesome !!
Review:
I really had an awesome good time over here!! 
Hard Rock Melaka is located at Jonker Street, so it's really happening ...

The staffs are friendly ...
Cheers !!

Author: Jia_SZFZKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A brand u can't miss
Review: Been here so many times but never was I disappointed with the performing bands before. Sorry but NAQITA was not my favourite band so far. I went there to chill but the song selections was rock, rock and rock. I mean, I don't mind rock songs but those were the songs that are not very familiar. Blame me, maybe I'm not too exposed to the songs they played. Vocal, performance and music was good, but the song selections were not pleasant for me. HRC staffs services as usual, very good and friendly.Show less

Author: HamiraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly and helpful staff
Review: Had dinner at HRC....food was tasty and huge portion Enjoy the ambience.Service very good. Staff will come to us and checked if everything is okay. Gd service.Will like to thanks staff Faiz for helping me to connect with his Wi-Fi. Been trying using the HRC Wi-Fi and my own mobile data but the connection too slow. I was trying to book grab. Faiz saw me walking u and down trying to get connection he offer to use his own Wi-Fi. I'm really appreciate his help.Overall all the staff are very friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: jacqqqNCL / KUL
Title: Just Anothef HRC
Review: You just can’t miss this place. Strategically located by the riverside, a stone’s throw from Jonker Walk. Good live music. A mixture of local and tourist patrons. Drinks, as expected, is a bit on the high side. Been there, done that. Good spot for after dinner drinks to end the nite.Show less

Author: Michael DSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food & Music Just as You Would Expect From Hard Rock
Review: Located right in the centre of town and directly alongside the bridge between Jonker Street and the Clock Tower. Living to the standard of all the Hard Rock Cafe's we have visited this outlet provided the same consistent high quality of food and music . The burgers were delicious and the staff very friendly and helpful. A great oasis in the otherwise scorching eat to have a meal or spent the entire evening.Show less

Author: 396tamarapZagreb, Croatia
Title: Horrible service!
Review: For such a famous brand the service was really terrible. Knowing that HRC is much more expensive than local food we were hesitant to go in at first, especially since as Europeans we didn’t want to eat western food. However we saw they offered a daily menu (soup, salad, main course, dessert and drink) for 36 MYR so we decided to get in afterall. Firstly they gave us normal menu without any word of the special offer and than uppon our request the waiter very hesitantly gave us the daily menu as well. My friends took the menu while I decided to go for a normal meal after which the waiter seemed to be even more annoyed by us evidently rolling his eyes at me.After 30min wait 2 main courses cama, 10 min later the third. We had to ask for the soup and salad which were included. By the time it came to the table the main course went cold. All the while my main course (special, not from daily nenu) hasn’t arrived until after my friends finished their meal. After 1,5h we finally finished lunch having 3 waiters exchange at our table. Luckily the food was delicious but not enough to jusify the service and price. Definitly stick to local street food!Show less

Author: SylviaL1821
Title: Good experience
Review: Although the receptionist was very rude, one of the staff,Rowan, was exceptionally kind and helpful. He made us feel comfortable. We really appreciate his hospitality.Show less

Author: justgo2016Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: We went there for some drinks after our dinner. The venue @ 8.00pm was crowded but we managed to get a table for 10. Service was efficient and the atmosphere was lively with good music and songs from the band.A good place for a night out.Show less

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not Cheap. Prices International.
Review: Joint was not that crowded, even on a Saturday Evening.Food so-so, but pricing is a tad expensive for Melaka, but international rates however.Ample staff who provided great, prompt and friendly service.Show less

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Sunday Crowd
Review: Crowd of visitors already built up near passed noon time. Sited by the side of Melaka River and main entrance is from Jonker Walk. A place to rest your legs after walkibg on the long stretch of Jonker Street (Jonker Walk) from the Stage end.

Author: atiejay j
Title: Love the shop!
Review: The original rock shop used to be very small near the location today. Now, it offers dining as well as rock shop too! It is near most attractions in Malacca such as the Red Square.

Author: krystalehBedford, United Kingdom
Title: Good location and service
Review: Very nice staff who seemed to thoroughly enjoy their jobs so worked very well together. Went in the afternoon for a cocktail and were invited back for live band in the evening. Excellent band did covers and very fun to sing along with. We had some sharing food e.g. nachos, potato skins and seasoned fries. Very substantial portion. Spent a lot of money but had a very good time so worth it. Very happy with experience and service was great. Show less

Author: 194FaridehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome. Expensive. Worth seeing it
Review: As usual, it is very expensive and it is located in a very nice and strategic place, in the heart of Melaka: near the river, in Jonker street, in a square, where everything worth seeing and tasting and buying is located. The dishes are super. However, not every tourist can afford this place. It is definitely for rich families, couples or lovers who want to eat something good, snd pay the price. For my family and I, it was quite expensive, but we went there, only fof the sake of our grown up children, wishing to give them a nice and expensive dinner. The music, was so so. Show less

Author: Jaszy_77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Except staff!
Review: Excellent service by the Hard Rock Cafe's staff.. They treat you like a VIP guest and make you feel comfortable and we'll served..The live music, food, drinks and the ambience of the place is just superb! Though a bit pricey but iwould definitely go there again!Show less

Author: Hodge67
Title: Late lunch and drinks.
Review: Staff were great, music was a pleasant volume, food was edible and the beer was cold. What more could you ask for really, on a hot Melaka afternoon.

Author: FrancGuedes
Title: Good place to eat our food
Review:
Hard Rock is very well situated right near of the river and Jonkers Street
The food is about the usual with good quality. The interior is also great with all rock memorabilia.

Author: bjulius485Kota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: This place was dope asf!
Review: The first thing that we do when we got here is googling what is the famous club here in malacca town. A lot of the feedbacks were, of course none other than MIXX club. But when we went there it was closed. We were like so devastated. Then i told myself, hey why not hard rock? And we went there afterwards. The first night which is (17/8 ) was lonely. But the band was awesome. Good singers. We enjoyed it very much. The staffs were friendly. But there this one staff that stood out the most.it was Rowan. He's extremely very friendly. One of the best example of good customer service. Anyway , one of the best hard rock cafe I've ever been! We had a blast!Show less

Author: Nidal TKuwait, Al Kuwayt, Kuwait
Title: Good food
Review: Had lunch with the family here and enjoyed the food. Only feedback is that the service was terribly slow when the restaurant was not occupied.Show less

Author: gayan1991Singapore, Singapore
Title: Was not up to expectation
Review: There is a band playing in late evening and the place is active yet food is not much nice. There is buffet and it's cheap if you are planning to eat a lotShow less

Author: Me25double1
Title: Good Food Good Music
Review: Love this place a lot! The staffs were very welcoming and cool and offered very good service. The food was amazing!!!~ huge portions, enough to share. Had some cocktails too, which were good as well. Good location too, and the interior is very spacious and cozy. Awesome music was played throughout the night. An experience I will never forget!Show less

Author: reviewedbyherKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great meal as always!
Review: Really good food, service and atmosphere as always! Staff were really friendly and chatty. We were seated on the balcony right by the river and it was really relaxing because there was a nice breeze and that salty sea smell. The food as per usual was what you'd expect at Hard Rock, nice and high quality. One point to note is that there is fairly limited parking beneath the restaurant.Show less

Author: TravelCQ
Title: Great bbq beef ribs!
Review: Yeah the header here says it all. Everything else is just like a hard rock cafe. But what's great is the location of the restaurant and the river view from the terrace.

Author: Valenz O
Title: For live music and foods
Review: Nice place and better than HRC in KL. Good staffs and sooooo friendly. Great music and musicians. Overall excellent

Author: aihua1331
Title: Hard Rock Cate - Melaka
Review: Average Hard Rock Cafe.  Went for a drink (late afternoon), the staff were pilot and courtesy.  Offering their best to bring comfort to customers.  Just the simple same Hard Rock Cafe

Author: marlonccSingapore, Singapore
Title: An average experience
Review: We were there late evening after a late dinner. While the place wasn’t too busy, service was slow. Prices are pretty steep and cocktails are pretty much watered down. We had a much better experience at a pub round the corner. Show less

Author: Stanislaw1972
Title: Upper level of HRCs
Review: One of the four Hard Rock Cafes in Malaysia, nice venue, friendly staff, great ambience. Food - 80% as usual, but also some local dishes. Beverages - as usual. Generally speaking,good place to go.

Author: 801richardy
Title: Great ambience
Review: This is a great place to hang out for dinner and drinks. We had a table right in the middle near the front of the stage and well positioned to enjoy the live band. We had fish and chips which was a tad oily but taste good otherwise. Food and drink prices are way too high though.Show less

Author: 246geraldinep
Title: Entertaining
Review: The place was good and really amazing to spend the night while listening to music and sitting beside the river. So serene and nice view at night

Author: damiantehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still good as usual
Review: Went there on 16/6 for early dinner. Ambience is just as nice as my last visit 2 years ago. Ordered steak, fish&chips and fajitas. Portion was its normal huge size and tasted good. This is a great stopover for cold beer on a hot afternoon before venturing into Jonker walk. Show less

Author: Xiaoling10
Title: Food, music, fun. Repeat.
Review:
Massive burgers, delicious quesadillas and chicken wings. Wonderful food, live music and great company. A recipe that won't go wrong. 

Located on the fringe of the historical town, this is a great place to go to after taking in all the sights.

Author: JwpgohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience is as expected for all HR cafes but food average
Review: Visited HR Melaka last week and had a meal there with the family. Was rather quiet on a weekday for dinner. The food is rather average. For a city full of other food options, you might be better off trying them.Show less

Author: I_S_B_L_o
Title: Great music
Review: Hard Rock was great. The love music was fantastic and the singers sang really well. Service was warm and attentive.

Author: chinyih66
Title: Great Location
Review: Just right after you cross the bridge on the right beside the famous Melacca Chicken rice ball before you enter into Jonker Street. We were there during the happy hours, sitted outside oversee the Windmill Dutch Square and below is the Melacca river. Nice place to have a break for a drink or meal.Show less

Author: AllysaF3
Title: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka Iftar
Review: This is my first time visiting any hard rock outlet. Despite that I have to say my family and I were very pleased with the warm service of the very well trained staff and of course the mouth watering selections from the buffet. What we indulged in the most was the lamb rendang which was soft like how we prefer and fool of flavour. Even so there were a wide variety of selections from the traditional ulam to the delicious kuih. I'd definitely recommend berbuka at hard rock. Not only the food is well served but the atmosphere is really rocking and awesome. Its definitely underrated because many aren't aware of the ramadhan buffet in hard rock cafe. A better marketing would benefit all. Anyway I'll definitely let my friends and family know of my satisfying experience.Show less

Author: ChangKaHinkSandakan, Malaysia
Title: The burger was BREATH-TAKING!!! (Literally)
Review: The burger I had, which is the original legendary burger, was really breath-taking because of the thick steak patty topped with turkey bacon and onion rings! It is so addicting that I almost could not stop myself from stop chewing.However, sadly the burgers we had were served cold when they arrived, and the restaurant itself should really power up the air conditioning in here...Show less

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Much improved experience after previous disappointment approx 5 years before
Review: I decided to give the Hard Rock Café a second chance after being seriously disappointed approximately 5 years before. On the previous occasion, soon after the establishment had opened, I said never again due to the non existent service, the inability to serve the food in one go (there were four of us), to get the orders correct and high prices charged. I felt so disappointed I actually called over the manager, and complained bitterly (she did agree that the service was unacceptable and recompensed us appropriately).But enough of the negative. I made a spur of the moment decision to revisit, for drinks only, and was very glad I did. Service was impeccable and friendly, the music and ambience was fantastic (it was a Sunday night) and the outdoor sitting area had been converted into a smoking allowed area (it wasn't before). The location of this balcony area next to the Melaka River was wonderful, especially at night with all the lights.As mentioned I only had drinks, no food, but thoroughly enjoyed myself. Will visit again, and will recommend to others.Now if you could only lower the prices a bit !!!Show less

Author: saigonsoniaHo Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: I gave them another chance...still disappointed in their music selection!
Review: I have been to the Melaka Hard Rock Cafe twice, once with a friend, once with my family. We were all disappointed, both times. The main issue we had both times was the music. We are all hard rock fans and we live for rock music, live concerts, electric guitars and so on. In Hard Rock Cafes all around the world (I've been to many), we are always delighted to listen to fantastic music during the entire meal. In Melaka however, the first time I went, we were forced to listen to Justin Bieber the whole time! I complained and the waiters said it was a special 'Bieber' day. Second time around, it was during Ramadan and the music was local Malay pop music the entire evening. They said it's because it's Ramadan. I respect the culture and religion, but this is still a Hard Rock Cafe and should feature some of the things that make the franchise so popular, such as a great rock playlist, no matter what the day or occasion is.Food is good, service is fine, decoration is great as in all Hard Rock cafes, but between Bieber day and loud Malay pop, I simply will not take the chance again. It's a pity...Show less

Author: maslijongMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful place with some point to improve.
Review: Been here for ramadhan buffet. The interior as well as the exterior setup is perfect.Just need to add up more food choices. It’s Hard Rock so exclusivity has to be there rite. I suggest the cafe to have a signature menu for ramadhan.I understand that most of your staffs are young. Etiquette are good but the environment has to suit the event. Per say, during ramadhan buffet u should play low key raya music rather than the usual hard rock musics. Cuz after a long day of empty tummy, people would like to eat in peace & calmness.Also, please slow down the music because buffet remadhan mostly attended by family, they talk to each other while eating, loud music is unnecessary.Overall service was good, food is moderate, setup is perfect, environment is somewhere between good n moderate.Show less

Author: amewscuriosityJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: All You Can Eat Buffet during Ramadan
Review: Dear Penny and team HRC, First of all I'd like to convey my sincerest thanks to you and HRC for having us last night. Thank you very much. As for the All You Can Eat Buffet, we truly filled our tummy to the brink of gluttony and yeah ironically in the holy month. We'll work on that later Menu:Potato Soup was creamy and thick and I could even find the creaminess in its aroma too and definitely fulfilling paired with the crispy buttered bread, they were just a beautiful match. Salad with multi choice of dressings. Not forgetting the Ulam too. Main course - The Gulai Ikan Tongkol simply is my mom's favourite. She ate with happy heart and happy tummy and would recommend it too. However The Nasi Hujan Panas where you have coloured rice, my uncle mentioned that the red coloured one was tad half-cooked as for the other colours of green and yellow it cooked well. The Mee Goreng was a little stiff. The Black Pepper Chicken which I tried myself, I love it, I even ate it with Roti Jala. So my Roti Jala had not only one companion but two; The Black Pepper Chicken and The Curry Chicken. The Roti Jala was simply yummy, and it's one of my favourite. I love how it charred and burned a little and it added to its crispiness on the outer ring and soft towards inside. Perfect balance of texture for my choice of Roti Jala. Well, The Curry Chicken, what can I say; quoting my Uncle "This curry tastes just like how our Mom used to cooked in the old days!!" her mom being my late grandmother. To have that memory of having tasted something so good and homemade in yesteryear and having to taste it again is just blissful. I wished I could pack some for my journey home The mutton cooked in Rendang some were tender and some were quite chewy. Wished there were more variety of cooked vegetables beside the salad and local green leaves, perhaps at least 2 choices. The Satay; all of us are satay loving people. The size of satay beef/chicken cubes on the skewer stick were generous, well marinated and spiced though wee bit hard. Regardless we still enjoyed it all. The Laksa; was recommended by cousins as well and they loved the Laksa condiments. While happily chatting away, we had our next round with the selections of local kuih, fresh fruits, and also light Kerabu Sotong, Kerabu Mangga and Bubur Pulut Hitam. As for the drinks, all of them were tad too sweet and thanks a lot for the chilled plain water. The hot drink was no longer hot during the buffet. With a cone of ice-cream I ended my buffet. That itself made it perfect. Hence with little improvement might make it better. Venue :The ambience was somewhat relaxing and chill. Couldn't ask for more. Really had a nice time hanging out with families and eating together at HRC Melaka. All staff were very attentive throughout the buffet. Your choice of music selection played in the background as if we were already gathering and celebrating for Eid made all of us elated. Due to some of us won't get to see each other on this coming Eid and somehow last night were some sort of make up for that. For this I'm thankful to you guys in HRC Melaka.  Have a rockin' day!Show less

Author: 181julesi
Title: Blisteringly good cocktails, very American food, great service, amazing prices
Review: Hard Rock is really the place to go for American food, burgers are killer, so much cheese and junk that your arteries harden just looking at the menu. But sometimes your vegan diet of ruffage that a horse would find tireseome sometimes is just tooooooooo boring and you need a dose of cheesey Americana.Great location, in the centre of old Melaka on the quay side. Go outside and watch the boats and smell an estuary or inside in the air con to hear the band. Not that you have much choice, they are loud. The band the night I went was the house band and they were better than most. No one wants original music in a Hard Rock so they belted out the old favourites.I had the starter platter, great but my arteries took a week to forgive me, The potateoe skins were really good. I had the brownie for dessert with ice cream and it cost a fortune, was huge and sweet and would challenge the most ardent sweet tooth but well made.Staff were great, they really try.Cocktails made a buzz, they use premium spirits and mix them very well. The price must reflect this so they are not cheap but good value. When the bill came I just shut my eyes and paid and rock and rolled off into the night.Show less

Author: grentoczz
Title: Bad food, bad service.
Review: Food is actually terrible, but thats ok because I wasnt expecting anything else from the Hard Rock cafe. The service was bizarre and uncomfortable. We had about five different servers fussing over us the whole meal. Halfway through our order one of them took all our napkins away before we could protest saying he'd get us new ones?? But then never did. When we were finished another server asked us would we like to see a menu for a sandwich or a burger maybe... we'd just finished our burgers. Then when we were sitting finishing our drinks a waiter sat down at our table with our bill asking us to do "research" by signing in to a website and typing in a code and reviewing the food. Bad enough, but she wanted us to do it immediately!! Very unpleasant experience all round, I'll continue avoiding the Hard Rock cafe. Show less

Author: danahlaineYangon (Rangoon), Myanmar
Title: Rock it
Review: Hard rock always rock. Nth much to say. The staffs are friendly. The foods are delicious. Only one thing different from other hard rock cafe i have visited, The music is too loud. Show less

Author: Bill_StacySan Diego, California
Title: Spent a lot of time in this place. Friendly staff!
Review: I was in Melaka for 3 weeks on business, by myself. One of the places I found myself in the evenings was Hard Rock, Melaka. The service was really good, beers cold and live band played a good mix of old and new. Really liked the Carlsberg gal there too! Super sweet! Show less

Author: ellsworthsanchez1Surigao City, Philippines
Title: warm welcome and nice ambiance
Review: Me and my freind looking for a place to eat and luckily we passed by hard rock cafe. Then suddenly one of the waitress come near to us to offer their menu. She was very freindly and approachable. She recommend good food to us she gives us exellent service. The food was great!..Show less

Author: gayhcLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent dinner
Review: Having missed lunch we were walking in the old town of Malaka and fancied an early dinner. Oddly (to us) we were attracted to the Hard Rock Cafe as it occupied a great spot by the river and we knew we could rely on the food. Mostly we have been eating good local cuisine but the lure of a burger was too much. We were not disappointed! The food was excellent - Caesar salad, spicy Rendang burger followed by ice cream. Our server was delightful and efficient. Altogether a great choice. Show less

Author: sivasagi25
Title: Lunch with associates
Review: Had lunch at Hard Rock Cafe Melaka. Parking available at basement with 50% off parking fees for HRC customers. Welcoming and very enthusiasm staff.Food was good and the ambient was awesome.

Author: 155thihasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great staff and large portions of food
Review: We wanted to escape from the heat in the afternoon hours from Jonker street and this place offer us an oasis of our own. Staff attitude was great with genuine attitude to serve you. The portion of the food was huge and thankfully we only ordered 1 adult and 1 kid meal. And of course the taste was excellent. If you want to take a break from the hot sun and enjoy some music this is the place. We regret we didn’t have the time to visit it during night time for dinner. Show less

Author: GTWiratiJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Enjoy the food and the drinks😍
Review: Hi Hard Rock Melaka!Nice to visit here.Recommended food and drinks.I ate Nasi Goreng and it was delicious. Eventhough it was 4pm. I should had snack but i choose heavy meal. Nice ambience too. Especially during sunny day. It was nice to see the view of Stadhuys from Hard Rock TerraceShow less

Author: beatricel330Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Something different in the old city Melaka
Review: Went to this restaurant ordering two pints of draught Kronenbourg and a set of Combo appetizer (It comes with Skinned Potato served with cheese, onion ring, spring rolls, chicken wing and chicken fingers). The restaurant atmosphere was good (the typical Hard Rock ambience). Staffs there are always so friendly and energetic (Thanks to Kai that took our order and served us!). However, it is a little bit overpriced especially their cocktails, house pouring wine was surprisingly cheaper though.Show less

Author: Bear00786Ontario, Canada
Title: Not worth the visit.
Review: many other places in town to see. food was good but over priced..Joker street is right there walk along the river many other choices.Show less

Author: PeterC7505
Title: Pleasant but expensive
Review: Nice spot overlooking river but, for me too noisy at night especially on weekends.Drinks with service charge (10%) place it at high end of price. Go there for a drink, coffee (1 only)overlooking river, nice spot.Show less

Author: nik_menJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Like any other hard rock
Review: It is what a regular hard rock cafe is supposed to be. Food is good but theres room for improvement. The location is great, right at the river and next to the beginning of jonker street. Opposite to it is H & M store and really close by to all major tourist attractions. Hence the location is prime. The staff is courteous but somehow it lacks a bit in the whole hard rock vibe or maybe it was the time we visited. But definitely worth a visit and maybe follow it up by another cafe as the area is full of them, so cafe hopping would be great idea.Show less

Author: GraceLim
Title: Not too bad....shop never carries the classic fridge magnet anymore
Review:
The food was not bad as rather similar to the rest of the Hard rock....

Went there to purchase the classic hard rock fridge magnet but to our disappointment, this hard rock also never carries anymore.

The staff are friendly and polite. 

Will go again....

Author: PipPaul WBuckfastleigh, United Kingdom
Title: Pretty standard
Review: Like Hard Rocks around the world this clone is much like any other - though cheaper than in the US.We had half bbq'd chicken between us, with onion rings and caesar salad. We had failed to notice that the chicken came with fries and beans, the latter being curried!!!!Just as the salad and onion rings hit our table the manager (?) came to apologise that the chicken would be a little longer as he hadn't been happy with its cooking when it was being sent out. We weren't very happy with this as we have had enough of Asian restaurants sending out a table order of food in dribs and drabs as it suits them. In this case we weren't happy at the onion rings sitting getting cold whilst we waited for the chicken. In the end the food we had was fine, tasty and plenty for us. But of course it cost compared to a Malay/local mealShow less

Author: slackilaaliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Second time here & love the friendly staffs
Review: This is still the best place to chill on jonker street. The staffs are genuinely friendly and make it a point to have small chat with you. In terms of price it is pricey if you compare to malaysian standard of living. But again if you are from Singapore or from the West, it is pretty decent for the experience.Show less

Author: PamzinziKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Short Trip Feb’18
Review: The restaurant is overlooking the river. Diners can park their cars at the basement with discounted rate. Classic rock deco with cool ambience. Had set lunch and a’la carte menu. Recommended casual place to all kind of age and family friendly. The Rock Shop is also great. The staffs are friendly and you will be taken care by the staffs. One should come to this restaurant. Show less

Author: EmmaLovesLifeNew York City, New York
Title: Does definitely not meet the standard of other Hard Rock Cafes.
Review: Very poor service and food. We did not get what we ordered several times, it took ages until our food arrived, and in the end it was still not what we had ordered. Eventually I was not even hungry anymore. The waiter acted very strangely and had lots of odd explanations why he continuously brought the wrong food: “We do not have guacamole tonight!”, just to arrive 15 minutes later with guacamole. Very disappointing for a well-known restaurant chain.Drinks and music (live band that night) were good, but we were not able to really enjoy that as the rest of our experience was rather annoying.Show less

Author: Sin Tien LPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Drink,Drank,Play !!!
Review: A must visit place in Melaka.As I’m the fans of HR,so the place is just good for me to spend my whole night there with my families..it is located beside Jonker Street;the most exciting place during weekends in Melaka.Between,you can also got for clothes shopping as H&M is just opposite the HR Cafe.Show less

Author: Nikoleta G
Title: Worst food in Malaysia
Review: We thought to stop by for lunch while in Melaka and regreted it. I had one of the wok meals and my sister had the lunch special. That was the worst food we had in Malaysia and maybe even ever. The vegetables were spongy and tasteless, the chicken wasn’t cooked properly and was raw. Not to mention it was way overpriced even for a good and tasty meal. So disappointing. Never againShow less

Author: azwayuniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fine dining dinner
Review: We made a reservation and ordered gold set dinner menu. I chose Black Pepper Steak cooked with medium well but I think it was cooked medium rare. Thus I couldn't finish the steak but overall me and my husband enjoyed our dinner there with great ambiance and performances. The staff also were cheerful while serving us.Show less

Author: fjto76
Title: Beautiful
Review: Very attentive and friendly staff's, amazing view facing the Melaka's River. Perfect combination while enjoying our refreshment. Definately highly recommended for nice and cozy place for hang out.

Author: Joannsoh
Title: Great locations, good ambience get away from terribly jam pack jonker street
Review: We had to escape to hard rock from the heat and crowd at the jonker.We were surprise that they maintain the food quality well as we frequent hardrock in other places too on and off.Delicious Seafood Fried Kway Teow.You can get a seat overlooking the rivers.Locations is great,just a short walk from st Paul hill and A Farmosa.Show less

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Going for desserts
Review: Want to have a good big portion of brownies or applecrumbel you won't get dissapointed here. I enjoy comming here to treat my girlfriend on dessert after a meal elsewhere.

Author: i_am_wa2Seremban District, Malaysia
Title: Foods & live band were amazing
Review: This was my first time to Hard Rock Cafe Melaka and I was so impressed with the staffs and the foods. I went to KL and Penang before but not really satisfied with the foods. We ordered BBQ Chicken and Quesadillas and both were amazing. The price was slightly expensive but it was standard price in all HRC. The BBQ Chicken was in big portion and we could even share the meal. The performance was amazing and we really enjoy our night.Show less

Author: AmmyY14
Title: Great enviroment
Review: Visits here with my husband on our anniversary last year and we are satisfied with it. There are live band which makes the mood perfect for us. We are served very nicely which we had an waiter just to serve us. Very nice indeed!

Author: FonglinMuar, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: My friend and I went there to get something to eat. We sat a long time and no one served us. THe waiters / waitresses just looked at us and left. We understand if they are busy but others who came in later were served. We waited a while more and indicated that we would like to have our order taken. Again the waitress just looked and busied herself elsewhere. We waited a while more and left. There's better service elsewhereShow less

Author: Linda TStockholm, Sweden
Title: Overpriced, overpriced, overpriced.
Review: More than double times the price one would pay at other western food places. Skip this one unless you don't trust any other place to eat. They keep trying to push their store items. Service was okay, except they tried to take my plated before I had finished. There are several better options for burgers and western food with in 200 meters. Their lunch set is acceptable, but other places are better.Show less

Author: RatnamR11
Title: Awesome live band
Review: It was my first visit to Hard Rock Cafe. Their live band performance was awesome. Would love to head back someday to try their food.

Author: Publikacafe
Title: melaka river view
Review: fun night, but a bit pricy, near to Melaka historical city and Jonker street. This was my first time visit to hard rock café in Melaka, good experience.Show less

Author: Arnold M
Title: Great food, service and atmosphere
Review: We went to the Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka for lunch. At the time they had a lunch only 4 course meal deal for 38 ringgit. The delicious meal consisted of soup, ceaser salad, and burger and chips, a brownie and ice-cream and unlimited soft drink. Apart from this the other meals were also enjoyable but slightly pricier. The service was great and fast, staff were friendly and worked efficiently. The atmosphere was funky and exciting, just as you'd expect at a Hard Rock Cafe. Overall, highly recomended.Show less

Author: lynnzulkarim
Title: Good night out
Review: Fun night out with friends. Friendly waiters and good service. Lively band. Of course, don’t expect to have a decent conversation. 😀

Author: travelling_beauty27Hamilton, Canada
Title: Super cool ambience!
Review: This was my first visit to a hard rock. The live music was amazing, theBand members came around after their set to meet you which was really nice. The venue is really cool too! I had the burger & fries $50myr which was really good!! The alcohol drinks are very expensive ($50-80 myr) so we stuck to pop Show less

Author: Nina CRichmond, Canada
Title: Pricy food but good atmosphere
Review: We decided to switch back to western food after a few meals of curry laksa and etc. This place is perfect for that if you miss your typical western food. Steak was reasonable and the burger was very good. Price was about 70 USD for two people which is quite expensive considering Melaka. However the seats on the balcony by the river side was worthwhile but make sure you go early to grab a seat! Show less

Author: williamsL4164QF
Title: good dining place
Review: As always, a nice place to get American food. my burger was excellent. Some local food as well. really nice playing band. A very nice evening with the family indeed.

Author: ktshuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good place to chill
Review: My first visit to a Hard Rock Cafe and love how friendly the staff were. We were there for a drink mid day before dinner. The menu looks good for dinner there. Would love to head back someday to try their food.Great place to hangout to avoid the heat or rain. They have free wifi as well. Nice of them to provide kids with stuff to Color while their parents enjoy a drink there.Show less

Author: JennyLau_Pg
Title: Great location and friendly staff
Review: Great location and super friendly staff! It's by the river overlooking the red square, nice view for dinner when all the lights are lit up!

Author: 594JaneS594Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overpriced average food - interesting settinng
Review: As my title suggests, this is a Hard Rock Cafe - you do not go here for gastronomical excellence but to immerse yourself in rock music and memorabilia. In those ways, it did not disappoint. However, we paid 3-4 times as much for a family meal here as we did at every other restaurant that we dined in during our Melaka stay. The burgers and steaks were average, at best, but the chips were really good. Show less

Author: 650jimmySingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Ambiance next to the river
Review: My mother-in-law, my wife and I visited Melaka on 23rd and 24th Dec 17 to celebrate Christmas and visit historic places like Church of Saint Peter (since 1710) and Majestic Hotel.We had our dinner at the Hard Rock Cafe, Melaka which was next to the river and Jonker Walk (weekend night market). We enjoyed seating outside because we like to wave to the tourists on the boat. You could also hear the evening birds singing (6pm to 7.30pm). The crowd gathering, the bright lights trishaw, the bright lights along Jonker Walk (lots of roadside stalls and people bargaining over the prices).We ordered chicken satay (one dozen) served with peanut sauce, nasi goreng, fried potato, house burger, had cocktail drinks, beers and hot beverages. We enjoyed the LIVE band and LIVE broadcast of Premier league matches.When you are next in Melaka, make it a point to go to Hard Rock Cafe to enjoy food and/or cold beer or enjoy LIVE music or simply buy a Hard Rock glass or TV shirt as a gift.There was a car park below the building for the convenient of patrons.Show less

Author: raoflatiffSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place but Food is Just ok
Review: Great place to rest after a walk at Pahlawan walk and before starting Jonker Walk. It’s just across the little bridge. The location and setup inside is very nice. The food was very average. The chocolate brownie was too dry and served the wrong way which was difficult to consume. Show less

Author: Belchua
Title: Great food n place for family with teens
Review: Second time here after many years. Nice place with great food n service. Spent approximately 300 Myr on the food n drinks for family of 4. Definitely a must try for the appetizer platter if you wish to try all types of finger food they have.Show less

Author: WilliamY007
Title: Thumbs up
Review:
Great live band. A must place to visit when in malacca 
每当出国夜生活迷茫时、你找到这家拉风滴Cafe，有吃有喝有Live Band，混到安睡了。

Author: gracep1572
Title: Great lunch on week day
Review:
Go for lunch set RM38 nett with soup of de day, salad, classic burger or spaghetti (change weekly) with drink and dessert! 
Good service too!

Author: Nightdj31
Title: Good place with live band
Review: Quite a cosy place with live band singing while having a meal there. It's located at the beginning of the Jonker Street. The food is generally good.

Author: MrsMomTravels
Title: Melaka HRC
Review: Travel from Kuala Lumpur to Melaka takes about 2hrs...nice ambience to dine in...near to all historical UNESCO areas

Author: SurfingWildBandung, Indonesia
Title: Best Place for Comfort Food
Review: Have been here a few times, even once during my birthday when they brought out a cake and sang for me. As a restaurant it has pretty much the same food as all the others and my favourite is always the Chicken Fajitas and the milk shakes.So if suffering a little from culture shock or from the heat, then head towards the Hard Rock Cafe and it's airconditioning for a cool down. The place is very close to the clock tower, just head across the bridge past the Tourism Center and it is at the corner with the beginning of Jonker Street.Show less

Author: LynH528
Title: The steak was a no-no!
Review: Their medium well was hard to chew, so we complaint and they did kindly offer to change the steak, but it was still hard to chew and swallow! Their salmon however was grilled to perfection, loved it!As usual, great service and ambience - kudos to our server Ruth! Show less

Author: umieumairahJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: I like their service
Review: My brother give a compliment for your salmon.he say your salmon soo delicious the taste.just a bit dry no gravy like black pepper sauce.but he satisfied with the food.your steak the taste juicy but need to cook a bit long so the meat will be more soft.i like your service.i feel soo comfort when your staff asking us if our food ok or not and offer us if we want some coffee.i hope i will come again hard rock caffe maybe at another branch.Show less

Author: Nathaniel Renea PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best place to eat in Melaka
Review: My wife and I where disappointed with the service and attitude of most of the restaurants around Jonker street......Until we ate at the Hard Rock Cafe, awesome service, brilliant atmosphere. The food is delicious and a couple can have good meal with drinks for about 250RM - including the 10% service fee. Also live bands on the weekend. Show less

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: Best in Malaysia, so far
Review: As far as location goes, this HRC is the best in Malaysia. Next to the river, where river cruise boats ply, and at the apex of Jonkers. A bit jammed getting to and fro on weekends, so walking there is quite an easy option if you live in a hotel nearby (10-15 mintes from say Hatten). Food is better than most other HRC - comes out fresh and appetising. It has a raised centre stage, where a good sized 6-8 piece band can really belt it out. I can"t commend the staff, though. Maybe not well trained. Very slow to notice customers to take orders, even preferring not to notice you waving at them.Show less

Author: MARKW8357
Title: Great place to unwind
Review: Great food, friendly & attentive staffs. An excellent place to relax & unwind after a hard day of shopping & sightseeing. Being to a few HRC chains already, have yet to be disappointed so far.

Author: VedaS1
Title: Great Ambience and very cozy
Review: We spent 3-4 hours at a stretch in Hard rock cafe. We went straight after 3 hours journey from Singapore and the place was so relaxing and pleasant on entry itself.We had good finger foods and cocktail was one of best I have ever had. Its truly a kids friendly place. They gave the kids some colours and books to keep them occupied. Totally a thumps upShow less

Author: 901stanleylSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cozy place to dine and relax
Review: An nice environment to relax and hv lunch to escape the scorching afternoon sun.We hv the set lunch. The portion seen small compare to other restaurants in other part of the worldThe staff are well trained to ensure you have a nice tym either to chill or chit chat..Show less

Author: GabrielY931Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill, with live bands during certain nights.
Review: Why would I even bother to review a chain restaurant you might ask? Well, if you spend enough time in Malacca like I did (about 5 days), you realise that this place provides a welcome respite from the endless shopping, eating and walking around the sights. Excellent and friendly service, and cool escape from the tropical weather.It's huge as it occupies it's own property, and the toilets are sparkingly clean, which is a good relief compared to the restrooms in other establishments. There's a lovely stage for performances, and it can get crowded during live band nights (which is why I wasn't able to go for the dinner), so do go in early. For lunch, they open after 11am, so you might have to wait awhile if you go in right after opening like we did.The menu is pretty standard compared to the other Hard Rock cafes across the world that I've been to, so nothing much to be surprised about. But the portions are really decent, and they really take the effort to make sure customers are happy. My hot drink was only warm when it reached me, so they quickly took it back and brewed a fresh cuppa for me. My pal's club sandwich came without pickles as ordered, and immediately they remedied it, and gave us a basket of nibbles to make up for the mistake, which wasn't a big deal if you ask me.The manager came by at least twice to chit chat, and came across as very warm and genuine. Took the effort to explain to us when was band nights, the emphasis on choosing good local musicians to perform, and interesting nuggets of info. Really a good place to hang out, watch the live bands (when available), and enjoy the hearty food/drinks, which whilst pricier than local alternatives nearby, are well portioned and tasty. There's also a verandah area where you overlook the canal and right across the famed Dutch Square and red Christ Church, but it's only partially sheltered from the tropical elements, so didn't choose to dine there.Show less

Author: R_VikKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, fantastic atmosphere and impeccable service!
Review: We went here for dinner with our infant. The staff were uber friendly, attentive and always paying attention to the minor details. We were very very well take care of. Highly recommended even with kids.The food was really good to boot! The music is a no brainier of course, fabulous as always all across the planet. We thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. Thank you Hard Rock Melaka!Show less

Author: AngBayanKo
Title: Happy Hour
Review: Took the alfresco table overlooking the river and famous red church is such a nice view. Accompanied by the birds chirping I thought that was perfect. It was happy hour and had some drinks & fries only.

Author: AdammikaeelJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Oh Cheeseburger!
Review: Based on what follows, I would have given 3.5 out of 5 if I could. However, I must be clear at the start that it is a good place for drinks, great milkshakes, music, and nice atmosphere. Also, the service was EXCELLENT!! Both the manager and our waiter were attentive, friendly, and made us feel at home!! I would give a solid 5 for service....Save for Starbucks, we don't frequent franchises while travelling, but the cheeseburger craving had spoken.We started with the nachos. These were ok. Despite the waiter joking about how ordering two dishes in a row with cheese would make someone ill, the nachos had almost no cheese at all! We love cheesy nachos, but all we got was a plate of dry corn chips with some raw tomato and jalapeño spread around. The chocolate shake with hints of Milo was amazing. Probably one of the best shakes I have ever had. Too bad it wasn't on the menu. I had to ask after it despite its absence from the menu, and luckily they could do it. It should be both listed on the menu and recommended by the staff!The original burger with cheese was a cheaper alternative to simply ordering their big cheeseburger. I had it with Swiss cheese. The burger was good, but there is absolutely no sauce in the burger, nor is there any basting on the patty. It was thus a bit dry to eat at times, but I still enjoyed it.My brother-in-law had the Java burger. There was a nice hint of coffee on the patty, but the aftertaste on the meat was strong and meaty, to the extent that we were convinced it was mutton. It tasted like low quality mutton, but the waiter was sure it was beef. That was concerning.My wife enjoyed her nasi-goreng (she didn't feel for any American diner fare).All in all it was good and when the hangover strikes again, we would be more than happy to return! Show less

Author: mollymermaidxEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Disappointing, slow service
Review: The waiters were nice, the waitress who greeted us lovely... but the service past our greeting was poor. There were a lot of staff on and not many dining so our service was poor. We ordered a burger, fajita and side of fries. The fries arrived, 5 minutes later the burger. After waiting my bf began eating as it was going cold. He had finished his meal and my fajitas still hadn't arrived. When i asked a waiter if my food was coming he said 15 minutes after starters. I explained we haven't had a starter and that he had finished his main course and mine wouldn't arrive. He told me 15 minutes without any shock or apology so I cancelled my food. They didn't offer us desserts or drinks or try to rectify the fact I hadn't eaten. The meal was taken off the bill and they acted as if that was the redemption, however as I never received the meal it didn't make up for anything as I hadn't wateb. Really disappointing. I've noticed a lot in Asia that courses arrive separately but didn't expect it from a big chain. Show less

Author: irishfamily178Dublin, Ireland
Title: Not gaucamole & no burger buns
Review: A very disappointing visit to Hard Rock. Nachos cooked and handed out and then told they had no guacamole despite ordering it at an added cost. Getting it change was a drama. Friends ordered burgers but 1 had to have 1 without a bun because they ran out of them. It was a bit like faulty towers really Show less

Author: Iveta88BBrno, Czech Republic
Title: Only nice place
Review: We decided to visit legendary Hard Rock Cafe. Beautiful place, nice staff, great atmosphere and thats end of positives. Very high prices which dont mirror the level of cuisine. Hamburger? One of the most expensive hamburger I have ever eaten and the chef probably doesnt know What does it mean "medium". Both of ordered hamburgers were more than well done. Sad story. Staff offered us new one but We were so hungry and afraid that it will be the same..Show less

Author: KitchieVM
Title: Great!
Review: Great view of Dutch Square and River. Great food and great service! Food was just cooked to perfection. The steak was great and so is the the cocktail

Author: 222yasmeentDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Peaceful meal by the river
Review: The Hard rock café staff are lovely. The food comes in huge portions and is equally delicious. There's an outdoor seating area overlooking the river, which I'd recommend if the weather allows it. Its location is right in the middle of the tourist attractions, so it's a good place to stop if you're not too adventurous with your food and have a craving for nachos/burgers/pasta. Show less

Author: alistair15
Title: Refreshing drinking time
Review: Enjoy the view and ambient of the cafe. Drinking is a must after a hot day around Melaka. Food is always good. Crowded yet with enough room to feel comfortable.

Author: Bryan CDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Overpriced, But I Guess to be Expected
Review: I stopped in here on my way across the bridge from the Square to Jonker. Heard a band going on, which turned out to be average at best. Drinks expensive (of course). Nothing to write home about.Show less

Author: Terrencechen
Title: Have a coffee and chit chat with friends
Review: A good place to have some drinks and gathering with friends. The western food are nice na the environment is good! It is just beside the jonker Street.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Upscale Restaurant
Review: The restaurant is located at the entrance point of jonker street & beside malacca river. Relaxing environment & good river view

Author: 564kaylev
Title: Very disappointing experience
Review: We recently visited Hard Rock Cafe for lunch after being. Drawn in by the fantastic lunch special they were offering, unfortunately it was a public holiday and therefore the offer was null and void. We decided to stay for lunch regardless. After waiting quite a while for anyone to come by and take our order we ordered 2 burgers and 2 entrees. Our food all came out at drastically different times so 2 of us were completely finished our meals by the time the 4 person was even served. On top of that, our food came out Luke warm. Finally, they were offering a "buy one entree get one free" promotion that was very misleading and after following the procedures on the sign the staff told us that only some people can use it right away and everyone else has to wait until they receive an email. It is a fantastic location and I have had good experiences at all the previous hard rock cafes I have been to, but if you are paying western prices I expect western standards in such an international establishment. Show less

Author: shun_1201
Title: Best location for rest
Review: It's located at the center of Melaka. If you get away from heat, it's good place to take a rest with good Melaka scenery

Author: Romuluz75Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Quintessentially hard rock
Review: Dropped by for lunch and to kill time before a meeting in Malacca. Decided on the HRC due to ease of parking adjacent to the restaurant and availability of cuisine suitable for my muslim friends. The HRC is located strategically at the beginning of the famous Jonker St and a stone’s throw from the Stadthuys tourist attraction. We settled on the set lunch of peranakan phong teh + steamed white rice + sambal belacan with caesar salad, and ice cream + brownie desert and free flow of ice lemon tea. One of my friends had the fried rice with chicken satay and a fried bullseye egg. It was delicious. Service was quick and efficient. Outdoor seating is available and overlooking the Malacca river. Pricing of meals especially the ala carte items are typical Hard Rock Cafe prices, similar to that of the HRC outlets in Batu Ferringhi and KL.Show less

Author: Cagliostro-IntusKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to spend time with friends.
Review: Had chance to spend a very good time with some oversea friends. Nice selection of beers and food. Try their burgers, you will not be disappointed.The Staff is friendly and very helpful. Hard Rock Cafe, will be my preferred place to spend time during my next visit in Melaka.Show less

Author: DJLengYein
Title: Collect their merchandise
Review:
If its ur first time here
U have to come to this place to collect the HRC merchandise heehee
Every HRC fans from all over the place will take time to visit this place

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Cafe
Review: Nice ambience and Located in central area where the river is. Like the river view and heritage shophouse. Nearby UNESCO places of attractions. Food is pricey though. Show less

Author: J2997LKjamesp
Title: Great place for a few boys to cool down
Review: We were out for a cultural walk around Melaka and popped in for a drink and a meal. Great service, the bar staff were very polite and greeted us at the door. We were told it was happy hour and what drinks we could get.Food was excellent, good to have a break from more traditional Malaysian street foods.I ordered a Texan burger with pulled chicken. Very good, hot and came with fires and a small slaw.Nice view of the river and at the entrance of the night markets.Show less

Author: NazdaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: The employees were extremely nice and friendly. Food was ok. It was a bit warm inside so one of the employees lend me his portable fan! I forgot his name but he was attentive. The toilet was a bit messy, paper towels everywhere and there was no soap. I informed the staff and apparently they had this problem where non-patrons using their toilets. Overall was a good place to escape from the chaos and heat of the city.Show less

Author: MasheetaaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: last nite i was in hard rock cafe to have my Dinner and celebrate our 7th years anniversary , i order black pepper steak n grill chicken its was very nice and the potion quite big.. even i have to wait more then 10 minute for waitress to serve but their know how to take care of their customers! well done! i very enjoyable with the Dinner! she’s really take care good of us! congratulations to Miss Ruth and Hard Rock Cafe malacca ! and the price of food is just nice not so expensive! i will come again next time .. recommended to all..Show less

Author: mistral579
Title: Some issues
Review: After spending the evening walking about town, we headed here for dinner and some drinks. We sat outside at the terrace overlooking the river as we were told the inside was all booked up by PwC for their corporate event. However the PwC employees showed up very late and we were done with dinner and drinks way before a single person from PwC showed up. I ordered a fresh shandy as it was offered on the menu but the drink I was given just straight up tasted like beer, which was weird. Not a hint of Sprite or anything other than beer. Even after asking for Sprite to be added in, it still didn't taste like a decent shandy. We left and headed to Sid's Pub, where I was at least able to enjoy a light and flavourful alcoholic drink like Tiger Radler. The river views at HRC were nice though.Show less

Author: Port HPerth, Australia
Title: School group tour
Review: Extremely poor service for a group of 12 with food arriving at different times and mine not turning up at all. Finally telling them to forget it. It was a quiet night so not sure how they would cope if busy. Extremely overpriced/ overrated and would not come back again. This was a first Hard Rock experience and it will be the last. The only consolation was that they were kind enough to organise a cake for the birthday girl, other than that ..... don't bother Show less

Author: carrietw23Taipei, Taiwan
Title: Good Service
Review: Nice place to chill with good service from the staff. Staff were attentive to our request. However, the food is not that great.Show less

Author: Nylira Y
Title: Nice ambience and nice staff
Review: Had nice staff and they ask you how the food , so to make sure you enjoyed your tie there. Viewed live band as well

Author: OverseasamericanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice
Review: I like local food- as a seasoned tourist, O tend to gravitate towards any local establishmentMy kids, however, always beg for Hard Rock... I'm never disappointed - the food is consistently good- but nothing extra special.My Cobb salad was enormous enough for 2 and quite yummy. The kids are Mac-n-cheese- which is of a high standard (homemade and creamy not the freakish fake orange of box style that some restaurants serve kids.) My husbands burger was quite large and yummy - not greasy at all.One negative for us- the kids meal only comes with free soda. Since our kids don't drink soda, I asked if they would provide bottled water in its place and was told no- only sodas were included in the kids meal. In today's health awareness, that response seemed absurd and nonsensical as the waters were quite cheap- but it is the point of only offering an unhealthy option to kids that irks me and isn't standard for most American chains which usually allow for healthier substitutes.And of course the brownie sundae was Amazing and huge- we split it 4 ways and all felt we had plenty after a big meal. The service was decent. Our server conscientiously asked about nuts in the brownie and made sure they were eliminated for us. Well designed and lots to look at - a little loud but that's to be expectedNice price location on the waterfrontShow less

Author: desilvagsingapore
Title: Just ok.
Review: Went for their set lunch.Priced at Malaysian Ringgit 38 nett.Ordered Fish&Chips which turned out to be 2 pieces of oily battered fish, French fries Salad dish and a Dessert. Very small portion of Fish. Set came with Brocolli soup which was a slightly salted to my taste. The only saving grace was the Dessert which was the Brownie with Vanilla Ice cream. That was so rich and very tasty. As well as the free flowing Soft Drinks which included Sprite,Coke,Ice Lemon Tea.For the price i paid it was ok but not worth it at all going by the taste. I have got better Fish and Chips at Hard Rock Cafe other outlets around the World which i have tried and can vouch for the portion,taste and quality of it.Show less

Author: ilyarepnikovSt. Petersburg, Russia
Title: This is a must to go and see those personnel
Review: Had an Irish kiss coffee kahlua baileys and brunch next day there. On house served chilled beautiful location touched my heart for real. Cya again guys. Btw serve brunch faster please Show less

Author: vmco_mnlphManila, Philippines
Title: A reprieve
Review: The place is a welcome reprieve when you want to escape the hot sun after going around Melaka and a bit tired of the local food and looking for something familiar. Very good location, right next to the bridge and the start of Jonker St. Perfect place to hang out, have a drink, and people watch. Evening entertainment is also good. Show less

Author: NigelG407
Title: Nice Typical HRC
Review:
Visited here for lunch recently. 

Nice light airy HRC with videos and music playing. Usual menu - very tasty as usual. Memorabilia on the walls and a choice of high or low table seating. In the heart of Old Malacca.

Author: alessia2017Manila, Philippines
Title: Great service!
Review: The food here is good which should definitely be the case since it's expensive.They give large servings as well. There is a smoking area outside where you can enjoy the view of the Melaka River. The lighting inside is dim but you will be able to see well. The waiters and waitresses here are very polite and friendly. They speak English very well. But bare in mind that what you are really payong for here is the name of the establishment "Hard Rock Cafe". There are a lot of Cafes in the area that are cheaper and serves great food as well. And if you are touring Malaysia, do not miss the chance to eat authentic Malaysian food from the local restaurants.Show less

Author: JemeelRhodesPunakaiki, New Zealand
Title: It is the same all around the world
Review: Hard Rock is what it is and i've been to the hard rock in many countries. So in terms of the restaurant, staff and food, you know what you get (it's good).An extra perk was that they have seating outside looking over the river and that was really enjoyable for me. I was very happy with my visit, it's pricey for Melaka but it's cheap still as a tourist. Show less

Author: Travelnepal7Kathmandu Valley, Nepal
Title: Hard rock
Review: My first visit to hard rock and i loved it. Amazing environment... Delicious foods and service.. The atmosphere was so good i could only hangout with my friends and enjoy with them..live music is so good.. One of the best restaurants in malacca.. So try it once. Show less

Author: Abhi_sgpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Location and Ambiance win the Day
Review: Hard Rock Cafe is right at the heart of Malacca opposite the clock tower. Live music band was fun and energetic, even if not very melodious at times! Food portions looked massive and we sheepishly just finished our drinks not having the courage to order the huge dishes. Staff was attentive and fast.Show less

Author: Subin_Thakuri
Title: Nice place!
Review: Great location, we went twice to take lunch and drink. Staff are very friendly, service was very nice. we liked staying in balcony viewing the river and surrounding even it is quite hot weather. we enjoyed this place.

Author: elnino3009Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very friendly
Review: Staff were very friendly and attentive. One of them even noticed my husband was sick and wish him get well soon.Show less

Author: marjoe1003
Title: Bad value for money
Review: A way too expensive. Burger and salad were okay. Fries were cold, but they brought us new ones. Lemonade tasted very sweet and artificial.Show less

Author: Shirin R
Title: pleasant evening
Review: we went there for dinner and drinks.  it was also our sons birthday.  the whole atmosphere was pleasant right from the food  to the music  to the cake arriving.  we had a great time

Author: GoPlaces274867
Title: Hard Rock Cafe
Review: In general I'm not fan of the franchise. I was lured in by happy hour specials, but when I got there the happy hour selections were lame. I settled for a margarita. Had a nice conversation with the bar manager and left.A strength of HRC is that it's the same all over the world. Some people find comfort in that, but not me. Show less

Author: 166dimitarl
Title: Cheating in the bill! Overpriced!
