We started ordering at 22:25 h and after our question the waiter stated that our order is before 22:30 h. The bill came later... Double price! We argued! Waiter and manager were unpolite and rude! Waiter was telling lies about some expensive promotions of the lemonades we ordered. Never informed us about the higher prices! What a cheating, greedy, unpolite people! Stay away from this place! Never again!Show less

Author: Patrick LMelbourne, Australia
Title: A bit of America in Melaka
Review: Must be the heat but we really wanted to go and sit in the cool Hard Rock Cafe and have a drink. The do serve quite a bit of cocktails and we enjoyed the respite from the heat. Show less

Author: acerockollaJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: As Good As You Would Expect
Review: It's so refreshing to find a chain like this that seems to keep up the same standards that you would find in America. I have had a lot of disappointments here in Asia as things seem to have lost lots in translation. But Hard Rock is spot on. And what better place to have one, right by the historical old part of Melaka and alongside the river. The food and service were very good. A safe pair of hands.Show less

Author: Yi Ling K
Title: Heartwarming lunch
Review: We were rushing to have lunch to catch our ride back. The staff were very efficient and assured us that lunch would be served in time. They have delivered their promise and we are very thankful for them going to the extra mile!Food was tasty too, though a bit salty. The salmon was done very well and the chips were just nice! Have not experienced such great service before.Show less

Author: Rossana2005
Title: Conveniently located!
Review: Since there is a lot of walking in Melaka, e stopped to eat here as it is located right as you cross the bride, on Jonker Street.  Food was very ok, just ok.

Author: Azil181081

Review: You can find a kiss guitar although small rock shop or cafe but you find friendly atmosphere, try it and you will find one for all and all for all.

Author: LoveTravel702533
Title: Good place but close early
Review: Compare to others hard rock cafe that open till late at night, this cafe close early. View from this cafe is nice and by the Melaka river.

Author: armindo GGoa, India
Title: great food and good music
Review: the food is good and portions are quite big .the cocktails are superb and so is the ambiencethe live music is good the only complain about the place are the waiters some of them are rude with an attitude and dont know to speak proper EnglishShow less

Author: 427arpitmCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Poor Service
Review: Our waiter was very bad. He did not wish to take our order at all. It seems he is doing a favor by serving us. The place is also not that great. There a many other bars if you just walk across the river. Would not recomend this placeShow less

Author: AgentBroccoliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Attentive Waiter. Ok Food
Review: As we were there for an early dinner with a big group of ladies, we didn't get to take in the entertainment. We were self-entertaining anyway.No surprises here. Which is good, really. Pretty much like the other Hard Rock Cafes worldwide, with a slight change in the menu. Prices are on the steeper side compared to other restaurants in Melaka but no more than you would expect from a Hard Rock.Show less

Author: becky c
Title: Rude Waiter
Review: Attended by a rude waiter. He acted like a gangster when I asked to cancel a beer that dint arrived.Show less

Author: Globetrotter1978Malaysia
Title: Attentive staff
Review: I went on a Saturday evening for a nice dinner with the family. Love the ambiance, the food and the music. The staff was most attentive and food served in big portions . :) Love the mojitos. There are some cool seats just next to the river that is always popular. Show less

Author: CAMEL369
Title: Fantastic Steak and Fijitas!
Review: The service is fantastic, the steak and fijitas is fantastic! The service staff very attentive and nice, the food tasty and nice river view..( provided you are seated outside). Highly recommended!

Author: Sufiah A

Author: SalvaKumaran

Author: jackuddin
Title: Best place
Review: I going there for watching live band  and drink it's so nice place for drink I really injoying the band and  the view beside River so beautiful...i love this place

Author: Rich1800Bugis, Singapore
Title: Great Food and Entertainment
Review: Food was great and entertainment was great. However, it's a little too pricey for my liking.Ideally located at the junction to Jonker Street.Will visit again for the great live band.Show less

Author: 188helenawBatu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: My Birthday dinner
Review: Dined here for few occasions. Both food and service was great. Tonight dinner ended with an unpleasant approached from one of the crew.We finished our meal and with some balanced of beverage when this crew came over with 2 of his questions to us:1: have you order?I replied him; we completed our dinner.The crew replied: oh2: have you pay?I replied, not yet.The crew walked away after hearing my answer. Review: Just another hard rock cafe which is nice and fit for street town. Staff so nice and friendly. Feel comfortable and relax. No need rushing. No noisy from street and tourist big groups. We had lunch 4 line dishes. In 36 RM. But it isn't net price where they wrote on a sign but it's okay for good services. We're enjoy a lot and will be here again next trip.Show less

Author: AreWeSeeingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Usual HRC
Review: This HRC is any other HRC in the world.The concept is pretty same all over the places.We ordered Long Island Ice Tea - Which was not as strong as it should be Chicken Wings - Amazingly soft and fresh and tastyQuesadilla - Delicious (had pineapples so was sweet, but up to you)Show less

Author: JohnmwolfsMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Pricy, playing safe
Review: The local food served was even with a real touch of local. But -too- pricy. The theme is like anywhere else, centrally located at the start of Jonkerstreet, shopping paradise Chinatown. A 4-course lunch meal is served for RM 38Show less

Author: sahaja1Sydney
Title: Interesting exhibits and very friendly staff
Review: We had a peek and a walk around the cafe to look at the exhibits. I have never been inside a Hard Rock Cafe and I heard that the displays are incredible. Because it is early in the morning we are not ready to have a meal or drink. We asked one of the staff if we can have a look around and he said we are welcome with a smile. Inside is a small shop where you can buy souvenirs. The place has a good vibe and good to hang out at the end of the day.Show less

Author: Travelseverywhere16Senggigi, Indonesia
Title: Soooo Expensive
Review: Dont bother. Is a blot on the landscape. Way way expensive. So not needed in Malacca Old Town. Just dont do it.Show less

Author: s wMatlock, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place for refreshment
Review: We stopped over here as a respite away from the heat of the day, they serve food and drinks and when we visited there was a live band playing. Its a little bit of typically western bar in Asia and we found the air con was great.The food is good and portion size quite large so good for sharing a plate between two, its located next to the river so nice views. There is a great selection of drinks as you would expect.Show less

Author: Kuru276Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rocking Music, Delicious Food
Review: An iconic landmark in the heart of Melaka. One will never miss this place because of its strategic location: at the starting point of Jonker Walk. Lovely ambience, great rocking music and delicious food: what more can one ask for. Staff are very attentive. Price of food and drinks can be a little pricey though - could be because of the music that is provided and the 'Hard Rock' name. A nice place to hang out if you're in Melaka.Show less

Author: xxiaohao
Title: Nice Supper, Good Music, But Spoilt by Poorly Trained Bouncer
Review: After a walk through Jonker Street, the mecca of night entertainment, Hard Rock Cafe, located at the start of the street, must not be missed. On Saturdays, live music begins at 10.30PM, and this continues until 2AM. The band is pretty good and there are one to two intermissions during this duration. Order for meals will stop by 11.30PM. The food was great. Love the nachos, and the drinks. Just remember that non-alcoholic drinks will be charged an additional 10 ringgits after 10.30PM. The queue for seats at this place starts as early as 8.30am. They won't take reservations in advance and neither would call you on your cell after you put your name in their queuing list and it is your turn. If Jonker Street is a priority, leave your name on their queuing list first and go for your walk. Before you leave to visit the night market on the street, demand that you are given priority in the queue once you are back at the cafe. Just be careful with the bouncer guarding the entrance in souvenir shop leading to the cafe. Tonight, he was pretty rude. I was told that I was not allowed to access the cafe's toilet because I was not a customer. I have to detour to the toilet from the main entrance of the cafe. If this bouncer was more intelligent and diligent by finding out more about my customer status before turning me away, I would feel less awkward. But, bouncers are just bouncers. It is more fruitful talking to the right host. Except for this unhappy episode, the night was good, not great, but still not a disappointment...Show less

Author: Roberto-Singapore
Title: Nice place to chill out !!
Review:
Enjoy this place..... Just relax and don't rush.  Good to meet your friends and relax.
Nice to be here in the evening........... beat the crowd and try not to go on weekends.

Author: RCSenjaKuala Lumpur
Title: Hard Rock at its Best
Review: Had a family dinner .5 of us. Food was great with tip top service . Front line staff is friendly .Big portion for food overall as per norm Hard Rock standard. The menu also offers local cuisine . Stayed until the in house band performs and they did not dissapont. They were a a local band but the entertainment was high standard. F&B price is a bit on the high side but it was worth it with the huge portion and good taste . Recomends those who visit Melaka to try Hard Rock for a memorable visit .Show less

Author: Diana7737
Title: Average Compared to other Stores
Review: Live band was below my expectation. Hard Rock store not much selection. Staff doesnt acknowledge. Other Hard Rock will have better service.

Author: Gorm L
Title: Nice - needed to cool off
Review: After walking a day in the streets, and getting overheated, great to sit and chill - have a couple of drinks and re-energize

Author: Aang174Jakarta
Title: It is Hard Rock Cafe
Review: I don't know why, but every time we spot a Hard Rock Cafe or Hotel, most people love to take picture in front of its signWell, it was kind of a habit for most tourist? I just love taking picture of the Hard Rock Melaka from the other side of Melaka River. Quite beautiful.Show less

Author: C664HNcatherinelSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best Hardrock cafe with Awesome service staff and Liveband
Review: It was a Friday evening and my partner and I decided to chill and only wanted to have some drinks with liveband music so, we decided to give it a try. I wasn't expecting much as my previous experience in Singapore and Bali Hardrock cafe did not meet my expectation. But, the service staff are so lively and friendly to us, from the moment we step foot into the cafe till we leave. With the great ambience, crew and liveband which perks our evening, we had a memorable and awesome evening. We will definitely go back to Hardrock cafe the next time we visit Melaka.Show less

Author: eatwithky
Title: Fall short of expectations.
Review: Visited Hard rock Cafe on a Thursday Night. Always had high expectation of the place. Service was good. The crew were friendly. But was sad to hear that kitchen was closed so only drinks were available. Well maybe some light bites will be good after the kitchen close. And we were quite disappointed with the band thou. That we could not understand what the band was singing. Maybe it is just a few wrong songs for us, i guess. We left fast after 30mins. Maybe will visit again earlier or on a different night. Show less

Author: NickHtun
Title: Nice cold beer in nice cool restaurant.
Review: It is a best complement to have a nice cold beer after walking long walk in famous Jonker Street or River Walks in hot weather. Staffs are very friendly and service is fantastic.

Author: Mikey1966
Title: very upbeat service
Review: Great service, good food, well priced and cold beer ... what more would you want?  We dropped in mid afternoon with friends and had a great time.

Author: erikag596
Title: Relax & unwind
Review: With great view & ambience. Their service is great!! I also tried their local desert "Chendol" very nice (you can choose the sweetness levels too) Will visit again... 👍🏻👍🏻

Author: M V
Title: Nice Hard Rock
Review: This is a nice restaurant located right at the start of Jonkers St.   The food is very good, service is great and the drinks are excellent

Author: Bhayong
Title: Riverside
Review: Stay outside while take hot cofee and cigarate with riverside view of Malaka river. Just hundred meters from Jonker street.

Author: glburatowskiGold Coast, Australia
Title: Light lunch at Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka
Review: The waitressing staff are very friendly and obliging. Nothing is too much for them to assist you in choosing your lunch and drinks. I found their uniform of badges attractive . The setting of the cafe next to the River was grest especially at night with the coloured lights from different hotels and attractions.The cost of food was reasonable.Show less

Author: Lynn I
Title: Very nice staffs!
Review: The staffs there was educated and easy going. They are friendly and offer a great service. The food is good.

Author: steinland77
Title: Expensive
Review: Cool waiters, you know what you get when it comes to the food. Expensive, 50% more than the normal price range.Show less

Author: Robert CWoodvale
Title: Gluten-free Meleka
Review: It is often quite difficult to find a gluten-free restaurant in part of Asia. On a day trip to Meleka, south of Kuala Lumpur, we tried the Hard Rock cafe. The staff were extremely helpful in ensuring that my wife was able to enjoy a light lunch. The manager and other staff rechecked all our requests. The service was quick and I would recommend this restaurant if you require a gluten-free meal.Show less

Author: DayS-T
Title: Good food and friendly staff
Review: I came here by myself and the staff was very friendly I had a burger which was delicious. Atai who was my waiter was super friendly! I can definetley recommend this place to fellow travellers!

Author: TravellingManOzBrisbane, Australia
Title: A vibrant location
Review: Set alongside the river in Melaka, this location is central to the city's historic district. It's mosaic-tiled guitar featured outside highlights the musical entertainment within.With a vibrant atmosphere, friendly staff, & extensive Hard Rock menu this venue is a must for all fans of the brand.The long bar runs parallel to the river so you can watch the river & pedestrian traffic while enjoying a drink.A well-stocked Rock Shop is located on-site.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Ollie M
Title: Not nice food
Review: Been to many a Hard Rock Cafe but this one had appalling food. Service was slack and we were left an age to order. Show less

Author: thoonkyJohor Bahru, Johor, Malaysia
Title: in a treat for a good listening
Review: come here for dinner on our first night. like any other hard rock cafe, very classy and big portions.that also mean big money too.still for visiting foreigners, the price is decent. the most memorable is the stage live band performance by Night Rhythms. the female singer come down from the stage and singer her voice out with songs like flash light, titanium. it was an enjoyable evening for us.Show less

Author: coffeeaddict20019Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food wasn't great
Review: Went there for lunch.After visiting many other hard rock cafe this was rather disappointing!2 Grilled salmon sets,a kid's meal of chicken tenders and free flow of Iced tea,2 lemonade and a Chendol set us back MYR 190.Food was rather bland and salmon still had a fishy smell.Chendol was yummy but I has better at streetside stalls.The manager was very friendly and his customer service was excellent.The waitress in charge of our table was missing in action way too often and had to wait long for my dessert.Come on Hard Rock Melaka..I am sure you can do much more better than this!Show less

Author: chuckwowengland
Title: Located on river usual burger n beer s
Review: Most expensive hard rock in malaysia ive been to penang and kuala lumpur hard rock cafes K.L is cheapest and best of the bunch.this has best location., expensive compared to most other cafes and bars .Show less

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not just for dinner...
Review: It may be a great place for late evening music and dance. However, a normal western dinner before the music starts is nothing special. Burgers are of decent size and look appealing when served. A medium-well burger turned out to be over-well and meat was dry. Turkey bacon is not exactly my thing as it is rather dry compared to the real thing. But understood given the Halal considerations. What really disturbed us a lot were a fair number of very tiny flies. When we told the waiter he explained it was because a window was broken. Not exactly helpful but I guess nothing much they could do. Overall rather pricy despite drinks on happy hour charge. Service was ok. Location and building facing the river are great. Come here for a drinks and the music. For a dinner alone nothing extraordinary.Show less

Author: ChooMichaelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Suggest to try their Nasi Goreng and Fried Kway Teow
Review: This is our 2nd visit. We went for late dinner (10pm) on a Saturday night. Full house but was fortunate to get a table after 10 mins wait. Live band was on and the sound system is rather poor.Service is slow due to the crowd, opted Asian selection and was not disappointed. See photo. Overall Happy to have visited themSuggest go earlierShow less

Author: chara c
Title: Just no!
Review: Not worth to visit. Crowded,noisy(from people voices but more from the loud music), not suitable for couples or families, looks like a bad fame bar. It's waste of time to go there since beside is the nice river view where you can really have a better time.Show less

Author: Rob H
Title: Typical Hard Rock
Review: Not much more to say, the beer was cold, the food was as expected and the service was average at best.  Typical American Chain restaurant.

Author: Richard TPerth, Australia
Title: I found the food adequate but very overpriced for the area
Review: Typical American fare. Huge servings which leads to a lot of waste. A lot of garlic which I cannot eat due to an allergy so have to be very careful what you order and rely on the waiters knowledge of the productShow less

Author: ACDC29Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Service with Some Hiccups
Review: This was a typical HRC experience. We went there for a celebratory meal (birthday), party of 13. The service was mostly quick and on point. The food was good for what is was American Burger/Steakhouse fare - the Hickory Smoked Beef Ribs though, WOW. Unanimously the favourite dish of the night. Our fajitas took a long time to come, though our waiter was aware and kept checking. All other mains were finished when it got there and they gave us the wrong order - beef when we asked for mixed. They should have allowed us to cancel or take it off the bill. Portions are huge and prices are on the high side.We also brought our own cake for the birthday celebrant, but HRC staff neglected to do anything above that for her, which was glaringly awkward when they sang and celebrated other people's birthdays around us.Show less

Author: Dynamo1510Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice view n place to hang out
Review: 1st time been to Hard Rock Cafe Melaka and my experience there is awesome. Good hospitality and customer service. Things there are quite pricy but its worthy..one of the waiter have treat us quite good and we also make alot of jokes while we were being served and there were alot of recommendation of food variety from him.At the end of his shift, we have tipped him RM30.00 for being a good customer service..he thought we were Singaporean..but not..we were localsShow less

Author: Iwan34
Title: Always a nice place to relax and unwind...
Review: Love the ambience and service here. The staff are friendly and the food is great! Nice place to relax after a hard days work. The band performing is always good.

Author: Ana S
Title: Good Food
Review: The staff is friendly. The food is good. The restaurant open from 11.30am till midnight. We went there around 4pm. U can opt for indoor dine or outdoor to appreciate the view. They also thier own melaka hard rock store where u can purchase all their HRC merchandise. I am so loving the non alcoholic drinks and the lamb burger. Their food serving is in Big portion. So u can share with your partner. The staff help us to take picture from the outside of the restaurant. Great service Show less

Author: X974WGjohnpHerriman, Utah
Title: Will never eat here again
Review: We tried a second time believing it had to be better than our first experience as we like Hard Rock Cafes all over the world. But this one is the exception. It is terrible. Once again they messed up a simple order and once again they had to question my original request. We go to Melaka often but will never eat here again.Show less

Author: MatsO991Motala, Sweden
Title: Lunch stop!
Review: Hey, this is the right place to eat and relax. Good Rock music and descent food. Even Malayan Cuisine of course. Show less

Author: Terence M
Title: Pick up T-Shirts for Son and his friends
Review: We just picked up some shirts for our family did not stay for coffee or food, the staff treated us very nicely and politely, usual prices for the genuine articles, we rushed off to our tour as not to dealy them any longer.

Author: landseairmudWorld
Title: Great Location, Great Service...Bad Food
Review: The location is just superb and you will not miss it as it is smack at the beginning of jonker walk. Service is friendly and warm. Prices here are seriously high. RM60++ for a burger and RM50++ for a cocktail which is regular sized. I am in the US now and it is cheaper to have a meal and drinks(alcohol) here despite the conversion rate. This place is good for a strictly 1 time visit. The Italian burger which we ordered was mediocre at best, the fries was re fried and warm to cold by the time it got to our table. The burger patty was not seasoned(or chef doesn't know how to make good patties). Positive notes were certainly the service and ambience.Show less

Author: John BWatford, United Kingdom
Title: Good Value Western type food
Review: The Hard Rock café is in a good position, It is very clean with a good variety of food. The best value is at lunchtime where they offer a 3 course set meal that is good value. here are some Malaysian dishes but in the main western.Show less

Author: ManarY98
Title: Yummy salad!
Review:
We had one time dinner there. It was big restaurant, clean.
Staff were friendly and attentive. Service was very good.
The Cobb salad was very yummy and filling. Fajita was delicious.

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Location
Review: Hard Rock Cafe means you're capitulating. Not that there's anything wrong with that. We all do it. At some point many of us western types crave the safe haven of our normal food and drink. I craved a real bar with real bartenders in a western setting. This is that. Great location actually. Overlooking Jonker Street and it's spot right on the river. I rarely desire such diversion but I must say this is one of the most well located I've seen. No surprises here. Just the facts Show less

Author: Nguyen G
Title: Big disappoinment
Review: We visited Melaka for our first time and our son insisted to have dinner at Hard Rock Cafe since he had very much enjoyed Hard Rock Cafe in Saigon.We came in in excitement since the location was so good and the ambient so lively. We ordered our foods and drinks and then came our disappointment.We ordered nachos for starter and burgers for main course. Thanks to the up-sales skill of the lovely waitress we were convinced to add chicken to nachos and cheese to our burgers. After a while, nachos came along with classic burger for my wife, but no chicken added to nachos nor cheese to burger. We were pretty hungry so we decided to let it go with chicken but asked to add cheese to the burger for my wife. The waitress took the burger away and came back in few minutes with two slices of cheese laying on the burger, not melted. We asked her to get it cooked properly, and the burger came back after several minutes, with cheese melted but cold buns.Some minutes later came the legendary burger for my son. The turkey bacons were so hard (over fried I guessed) that he had to put them aside. He later said that if he had known about the bacons he would have gone for a classic burger.Last came my Italian burger, and again no cheese added. The croquette were warm outside but quite cold inside (maybe their signature cooking?). The meat was hard and dry (over grilled?) and not juicy at all. A good thing indeed happened while I was trying to chew my burger. The manager came to our table, apologized for the mess-up and promised to fix things in the kitchen right away. We accepted his apology but will definitely not come back.Show less

Author: Pieter DDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Nice but pricy
Review: Not expected to see a HRC in Melaka. It wont disappoint as it is a typical HRC, honouring the chain! Service is friendly, choice of food and drinks is great (except for the draught beer) but it is all sooo expensive. I bet they are suffering from the presence of Sids around the corner where you can save 30-50% on drinks!!The band was ok, just at time of my visit there were only few guests..So if you wanna be safe for food and drinks AND have money to spend, this is the place for you. They have a nice balcony/terrace overlooking the river too!If you just want to buy your shirt or memorabilia you can just go to the shop and eat and drink elsewhere....Show less

Author: herwanderlustlensSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka beside of the Malacca River (best for night river view)
Review: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka beside of the Malacca River, alcohol drink and snack with cousins around 10pm, enjoy liveband, best for night river view.San Shu Gong sells various local delicacies which sales foods and or souvenirs is just fews foots step from Hard Rock Cafe Melaka ;)Show less

Author: rkigervaron
Title: Average
Review: Good service and nice location and locale-- pretty reasonable value too-- but food was decidedly average

Author: Jay552013Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good value for money, but can do better
Review: Good food, reasobaly good service, but questionable value for money. Had a late lunch when the place was practically empty, yet meals took awhile to arrive.Show less

Author: GerboiseGourmande
Title: Overpriced
Review: The Hard Rock Cafe Malacca experience was kinda mitigated.The decor is nice and the Clock Tower place/river/Jonker Street surroundings are beautiful.It all started with a nice and well served plate of HRC Nachos, topped with the usual Cheddar/Monterey/jalapeño/red bean/sour cream and guacamole extra. Priced around RM40.Then followed by a burger, the Original Legendary Burger. The bun was nothing special, the turkey bacon wasn't crispy but really hard (chewey, 90 yo turkey? Fried too long?), the beef was almost raw (how can they manage to have a steak grilled to the point it look nice and brown on the outside and totally raw _I mean "tartare raw"_ and cold on the inside?) while I asked it medium. Nice fries. Priced around RM60.I'm used to even higher prices in my home country so I'm ok with releasing RM100-120 for a quality burger. I however feel sorry for the locals who think they are offering themselves a treat by going out to Hard Rock Cafe Malacca and ordering a RM60 burger that's nothing special. I think it's way overpriced for what you get in your plate.Show less

Author: CarlaM5612
Title: 2016 Christmas Eve Dinner
Review:
My reservation was promptly replied to via email.

I was pleasantly surprised by the generous portions & quality of our mains and sides.

My family of 12 enjoyed our dinner thoroughly with good service from all the staff.

Most definitely will come back.

Author: iamjohnnyThailand
Title: No Good Vibe, Many Staff but all ''too busy''
Review: Thought of checking out this venue after the last visit a few years ago. Didn't have a good vibe here. Many staff but all busy talking to each other, not really friendly services. The food was average, too. A good PR needed to make this place ALIVE and visitors feel good.Show less

Author: maciejbosakKrakow, Poland
Title: Not recommended
Review: Hard Rock Cafe in MelakaLocated in the heart of the tourist area.Not recommended at all!Super high prices!Trans-sexual waiters/receptionists who try ti being touchy visitors on the way in... sick.Quite bad experience. Avoid it.Go local!Show less

Author: Professional-PilgrimAlberta, Canada
Title: Our meal was so bad, we got it for free.
Review: We ordered the chicken on skewers. After 5-10 minutes (!) our waiter came to tell us that they had no chicken! We accepted the beef, but it was so chewy as to be inedible. After we gave up, and pushed our plates away, the waiter asked how we had enjoyed our meal. I said, "I would not give this meat to a dog." The waiter went away, then returned to tell us that the manager would not charge us for the meal.Show less

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Hard POP and unhealthy food
Review: After discuss with the friends...we decided go to this place and was very dissapointed. The music is lauzy...no properly in a hard rock cafe. The food was expensive and very low quality. No recomendable to nobody.Show less

Author: Catjlyn
Title: Good food but overpriced and annoying staff
Review:
After travelling in Malaysia for 6 weeks it was time for some good old western food (sometimes you need a break from the local food)
We thought we would try Hard Rock Cafe as we knew we would get good food and the food did...More

Author: PeggyT753
Title: Nice atmosphere eating place
Review: You cannot miss this place as it is just along the river at the bridge and directly in front of Jonker Street & H&M and opposite the Dutch Square. The best is to go on Sat night as they have song. The menu are localised...More

Author: 82agness
Title: Birthday celebration @ Hard Rock
Review: Visited Melaka many times but 1st time dining at Hard Rock. Atmosphere was great, staff were very friendly and ever-ready to assist you. The Live Band was very entertaining and food portions were huge! It's definitely worth a visit if you're at Jonker area!

Author: LifeTruth
Title: Good Food Good service
Review: The ambiance is good, and so is the service. We went in a group, they try to accommodate our seating arrangements, and they were patient in waiting to take our orders

Author: Bhoyritch
Title: Cocktails on a hot afternoon
Review:
As expected from Hard Rock worldwide, a great cocktail menu, great service and I guess good food. 

I can safely say the cocktails were off expectation and service excellent too. Great seats outside overlooking river and red square. 

Music as always very good and I...More

Author: mortenstenj
Title: Good, Hard Rock food with central location
Review:
Located in the junction of Jonker street and the river, Hard Rock Cafe delivers tasty food and cool staff. 
Convenient location and clean restrooms.

Author: adrianole
Title: Hard Rock guarantee
Review: If you have been to a Hard Rock Cafe anywhere in the world you will recognise the great vibes, friendly staff and good food available here. We opted for lunch on my daughter's insistence and we left satisfied. Western size potions and some local options...More

Author: LisaO1868
Title: Xmas
Review: Dining at HRC Melaka was plesantly memorable with the cafe decorated in Xmas theme during our visit. I would also like to compliment their good service and cozy atmosphere which my family and myself fully enjoyed the night away.

Author: giraybozkaya
Title: Hard rock
Review: Hard Rock Cafe in Malacca is near Malacca river. It is just accross the Stadthuys and very near to Jonker street. Like every Hard Rock Cafe, it is a wonderful place with it's ambience, music and food.

Author: Dibyne
Title: With affordable meals and merchandise
Review: I never thought that there's hard rock cafe in this never been heard city for the majority of asians. I was surprised with the price of their set meal, its affordable compared to hard rock cafe in other countries. Also, the merchandise/ souvenir items are...More

Author: loekmann
Title: turn back hard rock
Review: I came here to accompany my friends hunting Hard Rock souvenirs. It's a great store & resto using ancient building.

Author: sundaesandicecreamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Superb
Review: As any other hard rock cafe , this is similar. the service is good, tip top, friendly service and caring waiter/waitress. this hard rock is by far the spacious hard rock cafe i went to. if you are a first timer, i suggest you buy lesser meals (if there are 4 people, preferably 2 meals) as their portion is very big, unless you are a big eater then okay. the price is acceptable considering the size and taste of the meal. it is really worth it. if you are a muslim and is worried about them selling alcohol, dont worry. we've asked the workers, and they assured that the glasses used for alcoholic drinks and normal drinks are separated and never combined. do note that we only asked this from malaysia's hard rock so if youre going to other countries' be sure to ask them again. Show less

Author: sunnytraveller2015Tavistock, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place to chill!
Review: Having never been to a Hard Rock Cafe before, we were a little unsure of what to expect. However, we were really surprised at the welcome we received and ambience of this one in Melaka. It's position is brilliant - right next to the bridge which crosses between Jonker Street and the historic district, with a balcony overlooking the river and the Dutch buildings. The air conditioning was very welcome after the heat and humidity outside. The food and drink was very good, and the seating very comfortable.Show less

Author: marcellor613
Title: Great place to hang out with live music
Review: Good service they are fast as always as hardcork cafe service type. Small compare to other hard rock you may had been in other country thus is still have the great touch of hard rock. Good food and nice drinks.

Author: y_sharadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best location, Nice food..
Review: The place of this cafe is at amazing place and it's right there at the main attraction point of Melacca. I visited A famosa & museum and after that we got reenergised ourself by having hearty lunch. The atmosphere is cool and you will feel isolated from crowd for a while. Good was good though it's quite expensive.Show less

Author: ezhondaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Usual Western Dishes
Review: After coming fr KL,we went to HRC Melaka to redeem our appetizer. Food as usual were good, servers are friendly. The merchandise is also very nice but since no size 4xl I stopped buying already. The place is so strategic is at the start of Jonker Street......Show less

Author: Michael O
Title: Lunch deal was pretty good.
Review:
Three course lunch for 35R is pretty good. First course Caesar Salad, choice of 3 mains (I had a burger) & chocolate brownie for desert plus soft drink.
The food was good, the service is good & the place is very cool.

Author: busconiWenatchee, Washington
Title: Small But Nice
Review: Right on the river, this Hard Rock Cafe may be smaller in size than others, but it makes up for it with the location. Regular HRC food and decor that you come to expect at any HRC you visit. Grabbed two pins at the shop to add to my collection...that makes 103 pins from all over the world. Service was responsive and friendly. Food was good. Afterwards we took a few steps down to the river walkway and walked off some of the weight we put on!!!Show less

Author: Robert d
Title: Gteat place in a top location
Review: Like many others of the HRCS this one is a good place to meet fellow travellers and revellers. Food and music are ghe usual fare and the outlet is a bit more slanted towards a local clientele but it's still worth a visit and it sits smack on the river at Jonker's in viewing distance of the Dutch church, old Town Hall and loads of museums.Show less

Author: CHRISLL8Singapore, Singapore
Title: Star service from Ron (young Chinese man with specs)
Review: We had a family dinner of 5 families celebrating a padawan's 8th birthday - superb & fantastic service. Great food & great ambience.Was pleasantly surprised the passionate & friendly Ron was only working with HRC for a year plus - kudos for his go getter attitude !Show less

Author: meamesKuala Lumpur
Title: Lousy service
Review: We had a lousy experience with the customer service / food here on 10 Dec night:1) made a table reservation via email (confirmed by HRC) but when we arrived on time, staff manning the door said no such reservation. Instead of letting us in while they sort out a table for us (many empty tables & staff confirmed there are tables), he didn't want to let us in first. So, we ladies stood at the door looking like fools while staff was finding out if a table was available near the stage (as we asked for in the email). Then, staff said no table near the stage. We insisted that we have proof (email) we're entitled to such a table and would complain online how lousy HRC is. After talking to his manager, then only we were led to a table near the stage, apparently it was reserved for others. 2) food: chicken quesadilla + jumbo combo were good but seafood pasta was bad- not fresh and the pasta was undercooked (harder than al dente). For RM45, the pasta portion was shockingly small.3) drinks: the server told us that the Cornor's stout a set of 3 pints for RM45 promotion was all night long. When we wanted to order again around 10.45pm, another staff said the promotion is not available when the live band starts playing (10.30pm). We put it to him that it means the other staff lied to us earlier. Then, this staff went to ask his manager and came back to me to say OK one last set with the promo price that we could order. But thumbs up to one petite lady staff (red hair) who rendered us good and friendly service. Be that as it may, we probably won't return. Show less

Author: SYL2028Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Always nice place to dine
Review: First time dine in Hard Rock Cafe Malacca. It is much spacious than Hard Rock KL. We had great time having dinner here. The waitress is friendly and the food is ok.A recommendation place to dine before take a walk to Jonker Street or to have chill beer after the walk in Jonker Street. Show less

Author: nisanurain
Title: Ordinary
Review:
Standard ordinary hard rock branding.

The plus point is the river cruise.

Quite spacious instead of the location.

Author: Maxism8
Title: Great place to chill out after walking in the hot sun
Review: The set lunch is very worth. Comes with free flow of drinks. The waitress is cheerful and attentive too.

Author: DevilmakerMalaysia
Title: Worst customer service ever
Review: Came in happily with my family and welcomed by a very extremely rude staff...He was soooo impatient and treated us as we were chinese.....Sad to say that this staff was racist as F..... we came in and he treated us very badly and another malay family came in and he was soo polite and smilling..... After a while we met a staff who was very friendly and polite, she is IsmaShow less

Author: pugsrule2874Singapore
Title: Halloween fun
Review: Staff got into the spirit of Halloween and dressed up especially the guys in baju kurongs, wigs and heels who were a hoot! Menu and service is the HRC standard. However, the band was not. Was glad to see some local food offered too but didn't get to try it.Show less

Author: lwperth
Title: Welcoming
Review: It a good place to chill after a day of sight seeing in Melaka. Staffs were friendly & welcoming. The food & drinks were good but didn't get a chance to see a band performing.

Author: HotMama1009
Title: Good Place
Review: My favorite place for to have my lunch, dinner and all. Good food with very very friendly staff nice music and live band very enjoyable . Use to have my family birthday party here.

Author: Angie L
Title: No HARD ROCK music??!!
Review: No rocking kinda music in Hard Rock during my visit. Though you are celebrating the festival of lights. The music in other language should be rocking the floor too. Not putting classical all the way...OMG.

Author: Afida R
Title: Gathering Raya with friends
Review: Been there for gathering Hari Raya with my husband bikers friend. The staff was friendly. The service was good and fast 👍👍👍 . The live band was super cool.

Author: coachlesMalaysia
Title: It does exactly what is says on the tin!
Review: If you go to a Hard Rock establishment you pretty much know what you're going to get. Expensive compared to local eateries but a western menu that will appeal to a lot of people.Portions are generous and the atmosphere is, well 'rock and roll' as you'd expect. If you want it loud, this is the place!It has a terrace overlooking the river which has a great ambience, but it's the smoking area so that put us right off. Butts on the floor, general fog, not a nice environment. Which is a shame because it has a great view.Show less

Author: 264muhammadhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Consistency
Review: Consistency is the KEY word!!! I have said it before and I will say it again!!! Malacca, KL, Pattaya, HCM, Bali, Penang, Rome, Venezia, Manchester, Sydney and finally Singapore!!! Their Beef Fajitas has been and will always be our family favourite food!!! Keep up the good work. I was there on 18th Nov and it has an Indian Cultural Event. So all Hard Rock staffs dressed in Indian outfit with the sarees and all. It's great to see this culture still alive and kicking!!! Mind you that I am a Malay-Muslim and I very much in support of these cultural engaging event with other race and religion!!!Show less

Author: mk_steven_rKuala Lumpur
Title: Trying to rip us off during the public holiday!
Review: We went to HRC on one of malaysia public holiday, we wanted to have our dinner here. At the door, i was asked do you have a guest list, i said no. Then the security said i must wait, then the door staff girl told me i need to pay a cover charge to enter. But i said i wanted to have my dinner, why do i need to pay cover charge. The staff insisted that we need to pay, and hesitated when we asked if we could speak to supervisor. Then we agreed to pay and entered inside, later then we spoke to one of the staff on counter and she told us dont need to pay cover charge if you want to have dinner here. Later we ordered our food and had a good time.To HRC malacca:1. Please treat your customers with respect, your food & drinks are not cheap, we deserve some respect!2. Don't try to rip us off with cover charge, we are not here just for a free live band!3. Stop telling people you don't have a table where as there was some table at al-fresco area and you let MOTORIST sit and drink a coke and don't let us to have dinner.Show less

Author: najimudeen
Title: Hard Rock cafe in Swiss Garden Hotel
Review: Hard Rock cafe in Swiss Garden hotel Melak is an ideal place to relax, wine and dine in Melaka. Vibrant place with live musci

Author: Ian S
Title: Dining plus shopping
Review: Bad material used on the item bought for HRC standard. Just a cuople of days wearing and the item plated tarnished very badly. With the price i guess it is just not right to be valued with the material used. But dining experience wise is great with great servers and all.. Show less

Author: SabrinBedi
Title: Nice
Review: If you want some good live music then its a good place.  There is a H&M right across, so if your partner wants to shop and you don't, this is the place for you..

Author: Nicholas A S
Title: Cool Place to Hang Out!
Review: Typical HR café. Enjoyed it the most! This one is special as it's located next to Sungai Melaka and Jonker Street. Happening place to be!

Author: Martin A
Title: Average band
Review:
Had a few beers after dinner,expensive for Malacca
The band was average to say the least
The staff were friendly and service was good
Not many options for A Tuesday evening

Author: Parvin S
Title: delicious and friendly staff.
Review: I enjoy having lunch there with a caring and friendly staff. a big screen at the end of the restaurant had show music.

Author: gordonk166Mississauga, Canada
Title: Out of place with everything else Jonker St so close
Review: Needed some air conditioning for an hour so we popped in here for an hour. The AC was my only plus. This was a trimmed down HRCafe to other I have seen in Canada and USA. The young staff are upbeat. The liquor like all Malaysia is expensive compared to any where else in the world. If you really do not like street food give thus a try, but it did seem out of place for this prime location to be about a culture that is not Malaysian. The AC was not as cool as I had hoped. Fun resumed when we went back out to night market and walking street.Show less

Author: 686amarkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Slow service, tasteless food
Review: It took a long time for our order of drinks to be taken, and a long time for them to come. The same problem with our dinner order. Food was mediocre. Mixed drinks were ok too. Overall, nothing special to write about. Show less

Author: roryjdoyleKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good but expensive
Review: Good restaurant and service but overpriced for Malacca. Average food. You pay extra for the hard rock name..Show less

Author: DenHaagTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great location, great food and awesome service
Review: This place has opened since I was last in Melaka more than three years ago and as I was with someone who had never been to a Hard Rock before, we went. The location close to Dutch Square and alongside the river is about as good as it gets. They have a number of tables facing the river for those people that would rather sit outside. There are plenty of fans to keep you cool. Inside seemed way too cold though. The food was standard HRC with an Asian twist. It's as good as I've had anywhere else in the world. Yes it's a little pricey but worth every Ringgit. The staff were super attentive, very friendly and always willing to help. The beer selection was pretty standard Malaysian and I wish there was something a little different. The wifi worked well and they have live music too. Ideal for anyone craving aWestern style dish. I would not hesitate to return.Show less

Author: RockstonesAsia
Title: Better choice out there
Review: There are better choices of western food in Malacca that you may consider. I will not consider going back there againShow less

Author: kaiyinc
Title: Was a glamorous and yet relax night
Review: I was there after my business appointment. I really enjoy the band and drinks after work.  Keep it up Hard Rock Melaka !

Author: 637sueellenh
Title: Spacious
Review: I was just happy with the spacious place where I can really enjoy my meal and the live band comfortably..... friendly and helpful staffs..... the local band was ok and overall I enjoy my diner there

Author: JenileeRSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Band, good food & drinks, friendly service!
Review: My friend and I visited Hard Rock Cafe Melaka on Friday night at around 10.30pm for late night dinner and it was excellent! Band were fantastic and played for a long time with short breaks. Food was very good and drinks good too. Nice atmosphere. Waiting staff were friendly and helpful and we had a great night! Perfect location right by the river and Jonker Walk. Would definitely return and recommend!Show less

Author: naza93
Title: The Band was so friendly
Review: Great band! they're so friendly and sporting.. the place also very spacious compared to KL and the location is amazing beside the river.. Really love this place

Author: scubadude9Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Music, Good Food & Good Service
Review: Had a blast bringing my family and friends over for a dinner, we were seated right next to the souvenir shop, easy excess to toilet and out. Food and pricing were reasonable. Thoroughly enjoy the music and people there. Will definitely visit again HRC Melaka !!Show less

Author: travellingMe07
Title: Recent Visit
Review: Decided to visit HRC after a day out in the sun. Chips, dessert and cocktails were all great. One of the server's named Najib was on hand to assist us with all our orders and offered recommendations. Definitely worth a visit if you are on Jonker Street.Show less

Author: E B
Title: Melaka Hard Rock Cafe very poor
Review: Melaka Hard Rock Cafe does not meet the high quality of the franchise. The food was lacking in flavour and appeared to be reheated food. It tasted stale and not fresh. The juices were quite good but that's it. Melaka Hard Rock Cafe have let down the world wide famous brand. We were so disappointed, we have always been a big fan of the Cafe but now we are questioning the cafe's credibility.Show less

Author: naomido91
Title: 3 course lunch recommendation
Review: I went for lunch here on Tuesday and they have a set 3 course lunch (you can make a decision out of 3 mains) for 35 ringgit. It was very delicious a specially the Cajun chicken. Definitely can recommend this for lunch. The other prices are really expensive so if it wasn't for this deal I would not have gone there.Show less

Author: SoniaJane96
Title: Chill Night
Review: no dress code so we're glad as we weren't really dressed up. Had to wait in line to enter due to busy night but other than that the music, food and drinks were great.

Author: VikingRaider_10
Title: Have a chilled out Beer.
Review:
Great atmosphere, good music and really chilled selection of beers served by friendly waiters.
Most importantly the toilets are spotlessly clean!.

Author: Phua_33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great For Large Group
Review: Love the decor, good bbq ribs, good tender bbq chicken, good chips, good baked beans, fantastic pulled pork. The food don't disappoint. The mojito was sublime. The staff were 5stars, attentive and friendly. However, music is not good enough to make the ambience and atmosphere perfect for hard rock cafe.Show less

Author: Douglas N
Title: Nice scenery and service.
Review: Very nice view and scenery yet filled with people during the weekends and would need reservations, food is normal though and you shouldn't expect much from the food.

Author: joykoo
Title: Good cocktail and dinner location
Review:
We were there in early evening before Jonker Street market starts. It is in a good location with Jonker at its door step.
The service and food at Hard Rock are fantastic

Author: Grandrovers
Title: Expensive place to eat and drink
Review: Over friendly staff, service was slow, one person behind bar and six or seven serving, so added to slow service. Food ok nothing special. Would not hurry back.

Author: danta83
Title: Rock n Roll
Review: Great as always. The Melaka venue is spacious with good outdoor area on the riverfront. Food and drinks are excellent complimented by ace music.

Author: Aimee AManila
Title: Old Reliable Restaurant Chain
Review: We arrived at Malacca from the KL airport on an early afternoon, and right after we checked in at our hotel on Heeren Street we went around the city to as far as the mall area to change money. This and an early morning flight left us so exhausted, and all we wanted was good food in a relaxing place. Hard Rock Cafe was right at the junction of the river, Christchurch and Jonker Street and a stone's throw away to Heeren Street where our hotel is. We opted for Hard Rock which we were familiar with and knew served good food. The resto has on its menu both international and some local food choices. We tried the char kway teow, sate, seafood pasta and cendol and everything was up to par. Service was excellent and the young service personnel were very congenial and patient in explaining the local menu to us.Hard Rock Cafe, the old reliable restaurant chain, never fails.Show less

Author: davidcM4210AZCardiff, United Kingdom
Title: Long waits
Review: On entering hard rock I was greeted by friendly staff however after over 36 minutes of waiting around to receive a beverage after ordering I started to get a little bit disappointed, not the service I expected.The food was good and the deserts were nice however on coming to settle the bill with a group of 10 food items were wrong and we were over charged, the end result was settled and all bills charged correctly, this did need correcting and be and became rather exhausting as it felt like they were taking advantage of our kind nature. Show less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing has changed
Review: The food and drinks are overpriced, the service is extremely slow and the toilets are disgusting. What a shame for the Hard Rock brand. Things haven’t changed much since I was last here a couple of years ago. The only positives are the ambiance and the really friendly gentleman who welcomed and ushered us to our tables.Show less

Author: AnnChen1202Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Seafood Char Kway Tiao
Review: The staff were friendly and helpful. Though their English is not so good, they try their best to explain to the customers. The food taste not bad, especially the Jumbo Platter and the Seafood Char Kway Tiao.Show less

Author: F7142UOjamest
Title: Lunch
Review: Visited Hard Rock a couple of times mid-day - great place to relax and enjoy cool air and a clean restroom as well as a snack or lunch while wandering Jonker street in Malaka.

Author: Journey536141
Title: Dinner
Review:
Great place and friendly staffs.
Great foods. 
Great music.
Service is good.
But the seats for customer not enough during peak day. I had to wait almost 30min to "check in".

Author: janejale123Vancouver, Canada
Title: it was ok
Review: The service was not terrible but the food had hair in it. Not my style, they would not take the meal back and claimed that it was lemon grass.Show less

Author: NeilP118Kirkcaldy, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food, Good Atmosphere
Review: If you are in town and you fancy something other than rice; like a dirty big burger then go here. Quiet during mid day periods but quickly gets busy in the evening. Go early or go home disappointed. Nice to see a good multi culteral place enjoyed by all.Staff have always been good for me. Ready to help.Show less

Author: john w
Title: Great staff
Review:
Nice and cold after the heat and humidity, typical hard rock, huge serves, fun staff and reasonable prices.
We ordered the apple cobbler to share and could not finish it, way too much food.

Author: RikaRosli
Title: Best hard rock i went with the OCEAN LINE live band playing
Review: We didnt purchase food but only drinks. Service staff was friendly to approach and helpful. Ambiance was nice. We had fun at hard rock. Good music and people around. Music was good.I would recommend everyone to go here. Will definitely comeback.

Author: Khalid ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice
Review: After failing to get to the place the last time around, decided to try again. This time we managed to see the place early... Thanks to the missus.Carpark was easily accessible. Place cosy with nice view of the Art Gallery. My steak was nice and juicy... needs a bit of sauce though. My kids enjoyed the BBQ Chicjen, Lancashire burger and mac n cheese. However I feel a difference between the food here and the one in KL. Its better in KL, not by a far margin though.The people, fantastic. Always making sure that the food is being enjoyed and so on. The atmosphere... able to make me enjoy our food.Will definitely come back...Show less

Author: merylyrl
Title: Good place to chill
Review: Enjoy the drink, music and live band. Good place to chill and relax at night after roaming in the Bandaraya during the day.

Author: dannytanny
Title: Pricey burger
Review: Went there for dinner and ordered their famous burger. Taste is average but pricing is high. Place is pretty good though.

Author: Patilashok
Title: Happening place
Review: Good that we went at right time before live band resumes at 10.30pm & last front table was available. Food, environment, staff & band was lovely.

Author: mikeazzo
Title: Great food and service
Review: Really surprised to see this place ok melacca but a welcome break from Asian food. The nachos were amazing both the chicken and beef. Really needed some western food and they had some cool memorabilia too as always. Pricey shop.

Author: Tensai T
Title: Outstanding
Review: Celebrated our anniversary and my birthday in this cafe with my wife. The staff was very accomodating and helpful. I must say the overall experience dining in this place was out standing. Kudos to Anwar and Suri for going the extra mile service (I hope i get their names correctly :o). I reccomend to everyone visiting Melaka to try Hard Rock Cafe Melaka. Show less

Author: Stuart R
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: The food is appetising, the drinks are good.Is somewhat expensive, however there are special deals which are good value for money.As always the Rock Shop merchandise is way overpriced.Has car park beneath which is handy and open to all at a cost.Location is central and convenient.Show less

Author: heatherrjollyEdzell, United Kingdom
Title: a great place to get out of the heat
Review: We saw the Hard Rock Cafe whilst on the boat tr and decided to visit. We really wanted to get out of the intense heat and we were not disappointed. We had happy hour drinks in fabulous surroundings and the atmosphere was great. We will certainly go back for some food.Show less

Author: MatSallKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It's another Hard Rock Cafe!
Review: It does add a bit of life to a town with little nightlife other than a few karaoke bars, overpriced discos, comfy but crowded tourist pubs and multiple coffee shops. During the week it is bearable.. weekends it is overcrowded and there is a queue to get in. The cover charge is restrictive if some of you only take soft drinks and service is slow when busy. Getting somewhere to sit is nearly as hard as finding somewhere to park your car within 20 mins walk (and then remembering where you left it when you leave). Mid week is easier and much nicer ... the band is usually OK as you would expect from HRC or any of the hotel bars in town. Usually too load to hear anyone more than 3 inches away, but thats what you go there for. Its good for the occasional change to the other (quieter) places like Geographer... but only to get the T-shirt.Show less

Author: 682saray
Title: Ok but not the best!
Review: Band perform in the dark till end the show. Smoking are not permitted in the pub only outside. Nothing to compare with Hard Rock Penang. Band not good at all.

Author: JossosLeiden, The Netherlands
Title: Keep on Rocking
Review: Great HRC in Melaka! Great friendly staf which carry the great and hilarious HRC spirit.Food is from a good HRC standard. This is definitively one of the better HRC's I have ever visited from food point of view but also from personel point of view.Keep the spirit rocking Melaka HRC! Thanks!Show less

Author: SantikeyMarket
Title: Love the place
Review:
This visit bring me with very nostalgic impression.  

I love the place. The entrance was superb. 

The food so good. The burger was delicious. 

Must come here when visit Melaka

Author: plaintruthinessFort Lauderdale, Florida
Title: A Nicer Hard Rock
Review: We arrived in Melaka City via train, bus and taxi and we run into a Hard Rock Cafe! This HRC is pretty new and shiny, with soaring ceilings. It's one of the nicest ones I've been in.I had a classic medium rare American burger and fries after going 3 weeks without beef. The beef was probably Australian, but good. You can't go wrong with ordering burgers here.The waiters were ok and always around to wave down. The music wasn't too loud and I was able to recharge my phone in a nearby outlet.Show less

Author: pactskKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Early Birthday Celebration
Review: It was my first time to dine in Hark Rock though I was a member for many years as I usually only got the shop than restaurant. The food is pretty good. I ordered the salmon, very good but I wish the portion can be slightly bigger. What I like the most is the attentive of the staffs. They are very aware of the flow of customers and provide immediate service. Show less

Author: Rakhee Y
Title: Confused waiters
Review: Overall nice place and location. Price is the usual. Band was very average. Waiters were confused when I asked to settle the bill earlier and i had to ask three different waiters to try to settle it. Not professionally at all.

Author: Ibrahim1024Singapore, Singapore
Title: remarkable service and impressive ambiance
Review: we had dinner and our service staff who attended our table name Zuki was remarkable service staff and indeed a very professional, he arrange every single details we requested and I must say, I was impress since my friend is proposing marriage, the manager keep returning to our table checking if everything goes well unfortunately the guy from the reception who refer for our table was making black face when we request to change our table.Over-all, very very well over-whelmed satisfied with their food, ambience, the band and service.we will definitely recommend and be back again very soon.Kudos to all!Show less

Author: AnneLily2013
Title: Good chill place
Review: Staff here are friendly and attentive. Food are good, and drinks are cheap for happy hour promotion.  Overall good experience after a few visit across the years.

Author: chriswright700Helston, United Kingdom
Title: Sadly dissatisfied
Review: Went to hard rock cafe at about 7.15 pm told we could not enter as a private party was on we had to go back at 9.pm.Got there at 9.30.told there was no tables so used my priority seating and went in to see 8 empty tables grrr.Then ordered food wife's burger was cold.Overall not pleased.Show less

Author: AlZ114
Title: One of the best HRC
Review: Been to quite a number of HRC around the world and Melaka has what it call one of the best HRC in the world.Great ambience and decor with hard rocking band.

Author: itzmetanvi
Title: Cafe by the river!
Review: Like all the Hard Rock Cafe's this one has almost same ambience and decor though this one is besides the Malaccan River.

Author: SingaporeBob
Title: Great Ambience!
Review: Pricey for Malacca but good strong airconditioning, efficient staff, great ambience and possibly the nicest toilets in the area. I liked their cheesy potato peel dish.

Author: sherwin_pillaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Need I say more?
Review: I still am shocked that Malacca has a Hard Rock Cafe. Other than that, it's locale is good. On the Malacca River, at one end of Jonker, walking distance from the central heart of hotels. Midway between tourist attractions so one can have a pit stop to cool down, internally and externally. Show less

Author: pharmaherb
Title: A needed fix
Review: It is always a pleasure to drop in a Hard Rock café. Be it a drink or a full course meal, the experience is always great.

Author: BushymartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cold beer and air conditioning
Review: Dropped in for a beer while walking around jonker st.Really nice room. Staff were excellent The beer was very cold and fresh, they have a good selection of beers on tap.The room was very cool thanks to good air conditioningThe menu looked great even though we didn't eat.I don't normally mention toilets but it's hard find clean public toilets in malaysia so the toilets here were very clean Show less

Author: SantawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia

If you walk all the way to the end of Jonker Walk towards the direction of the Clock Tower or the Stadhuys building (landmark) you will definitely pass by hereGet a seat out in the open just next to the Melaka River..beautiful night viewShow less

Review: The environment is so cosy and nice. If you are not a alcohol person, please try the homemade strawberry lemonade. The lemonade is so refreshing. We order a the rome world tour burger, its consists of 8oz patty. The proportion of the burger is enough for two persons. Furthermore, the hard rock shop is just beside the cafe. You can buy some lovely souvenir and if you ate a hard rock pin collector, you gonna love this shop because they have a lot of hard rock melaka pin.Show less

Author: Kandravi
Title: Best service by the guy serving in the open seating area by the river
Review: Awesome service. Great food. Though expensive, the portions are big. Nice location by the river. Good interiors too.

Author: 88gaian

Author: willyfoxelviajeroPonte da Barca, Portugal
Title: It s a H.Rock Cafe, 100%, same reliability as rest of world.

I may say, on behalf staff there, there was one misunderstanding when ordering, and staff solved the incident very professionally and with very good customer service. Could not resist to shop there as well some merchandising.Show less

Author: EthelV45
Title: Cool place to chillax
Review: The service is top notch and the cute waiter boy is super friendly. Food was great and delicious too. It made our last night in Malacca very memorable too since there was a live band too.

Author: ritaling8

Review: Ambience is cool n rustic. Lots of different drinks but food so so only. Prices on the high end. Can try for first timer as one never been to any Hard Rock Cafe yet.

Author: Worth W
Title: Great place to beat the heat

Food is quite good and reasonably priced. Lots of local rock and pop music, very clean restrooms, and wonderfully cool inside.Show less

Review: Its a real disappointed to experience the poor service.from Hard Rock cafe.We went at midnight 12 and wanted to have a chilled night out..We queue and the staff say we have to order the drink first and then find your own table... She told us that we have to hold our drinks and wait for the seat.. LolWe r there to have a chilled out and paying not a cheap price and we need to look for the table ourself...Quite a dissapointment..Show less

Author: IyasS3
Title: Nice place , excellent service and kind staff
Review: It's very nice , the view is awesome, the food is fantastic, and for me the staff at Hard Rock Melaka are professional and nice , one of the best Hard Rock Cafe's !

Author: Fuwa CKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Staff are extremely helpful and prompt. Went there at night and was seated outdoor, which is quite peaceful, great view and less noise. No smoking allowed here. The food is excellent. Big portion (American size). A bit pricey but this is Hard Rock right, so it's expected. Would suggest everyone to go at night and please make reservation to avoid disappointment. Show less

Author: BuyimfaizMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Chill view, great crew
Review: situated at riverside, this is the "hottest" & fame cafe best ever in its branch in Malaysia compare to Penang, Langkawi & KL.The unquestionable friendly staff & also musics plyed entertain each age level of visitor. Buffet Ramadhan in this year 2016 is superb & really combining various local food.Cant say much just double thumbs upShow less

Author: Hacb86
Title: Epic portions
Review: Really enjoyed the food here. Burger specials were delicious (as was the brownie) and were epic in size. Really satisfying and makes up for the expectedly high prices. The featured band was also a nice touch to the atmosphere.

Author: Ctan1965Singapore, Singapore
Title: Rock band rainy evening meal
Review: We arrived somewhat in the middle of dinner time meaning like near 8pm. We must have brought the crowd in with us. Cos we were the only guests there. We took the first table and had excellent service. I bought the Anniversary Pins for Rm300 at 60 each and got 1 free. They did have another offer at rm 350 for something else half priced. Back to the service as I said, was friendly and fast. The drinks came, 1 of the coke was completely flat and was immediately changed. We had many drinks of margaritas frozen and Heineken beers, all the service personnel was Muslim and I'm very grateful that they served with real enthusiasm and great smiles. Kudos to the management and the team. Our starters were well presented but perhaps could be cooked better. Well we all know we don't come hard rock for Superb food. The food well generally just a tad over cooked but still managed to look golden brown. The Caesar salad was the best. Our burgers were generally ok with the patties dry on the inside. I know what a good burger is suppose to be like. Over all we further had Proseco Italian sparkling. That was value and serviced with ice bucket. The live band was entertaining and sings well, from Bali I heard. The rain came at about 915pm and we start to get a little more crowded. Over fun place and more effort on meals preparation needed. Show less

Author: Rima KSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice
Review: Place was well set up.Food portion was big& taste was ok.Service level was slow&staff need to be reminded to bring us our requested extra cutleries&condiments.Show less

Author: Malaysian_LizDurham, United Kingdom
Title: Great night out
Review: This is a great place to visit whilst in Melaka. It has a great atmosphere and the service really is second to none. The waiters are super friendly and really well trained. Live music too. The food was pretty good; husband and nephew both had pulled chicken which they thought was fab. I had the tandoori chicken burger which I was a little disappointed with as it was a bit bland. Still, a great night out overall.Show less

Author: Nur H
Title: Good service
Review: We ordered the legendary burger. Done to perfection.  Staff were very obliging to our orders.  Nice ambience. Quick and friendly service.

Author: Yujin LSingapore, Singapore

Review: Food was ok. Most items were out of stock at lunch.Had to settle for the burgers but it was ok. Great big portions.Show less

Author: ate75
Title: Small place
Review: When i go to Jonker strèet i pass this place but i'm not intrest because the interior n decoration was very old n very small

Author: yannoma

Review: in the middle of happenings and the crowded streets, not so busy though, food was good but as all Hard Rock cafes expensive. Nothing to loose if you do not go.

Author: LhilljonesAberdeenshire, United Kingdom

Review: This is a very pretty Hard Rock Cafe and is clean and central in town. Service and food good though like other hard rock cafes it is not cheap. Show less

We had the Kimchi Korean Burger with Sriracha and it was amazing. Also, chilli Chimichurri friend with spicy mayo. Yummy!Show less

Author: wendyy436
Title: Too bad not much crowd
Review: Service and food are great, however it's not much people here dung Saturday night. I wonder if the song choice not great enough or why. Singers are singing their lung out but instruments seem taking more limelight from the vocals

Author: J_Yang00
Title: I'll be back
Review: You'll not missed Hard Rock Cafe if you're at Jonker's street.  Love the set-up, love the usual hard rock warm services from the staff, love the outdoor river view. Although the menu spread is good, the food is just average.

Author: sbrady123London, United Kingdom
Title: Hard Rock without the ROCK
Review: My partner and I came here last night for the evening for a couple of bottles of wine, some nachos and to listen to the music. It started off well on arrival. Guitars from Kiss and Aerosmith on the wall, a jacket from The Beatles and a drum set from Van Halen. Rock and Roll!Sadly, this is where the rock ended. The reason people go to a Hard Rock Cafe, or the reason they do outside Malaysia perhaps, is for the Rock music. Both live and played by the DJ. In the four hours we spent there, I didn't hear anything that you'd expect in a Hard Rock. We really couldn't understand it. I started writing down some of the songs being played, as it was really puzzling me! So the DJ, amongst other stuff of the same variety, played Sean Paul, Mis-Teeq, Jennifer Lopez, Ja Rule, Fifth Harmony, Nelly and Beyonce. What?!Next came the band, T-Rex. Sadly, although they had an OK sound, they weren't a rock band like their namesakes. Don't get me wrong, they were lovely people and we spoke to them at the end and they were great. They weren't bad musicians. But they played Adele (twice), Taylor swift, Mark Ronson, Beyonce, Sam smith, Ellie Goulding, Carley Rae Jepson and Katy Perry!This is the Hard ROCK cafe. We had a lovely evening, but the place doesn't fit the brand. It was disappointing to hear this kind of music given the reason we went there in the first place. I checked to see if one of their memorabilia was Jennifer Lopez's hair brush on the way out!On a side note, the wine we had was nice (served at room temperature which was great), but the nachos were slightly disappointing. There were a lot of them, but need more dips and lots more cheese. GIVE ME SOME ROCK!Show less

Author: MarinDamanikMacksville, Australia
Title: Great ambience
Review: Not much you could find in Melaka during evening. Hard Rock cafe is always best choice to spend in any city you visit. I was only 2 nights in Melaka and those 2 nights was well spent in Hard Rock. I love the home band, T-Rex Band is a real rocker & entertainer. And the service: this is the first Pub where I was recognised when I came 2 days in a row. The waiter remember me & the food & drink I ordered the previous night! Awesome :)Show less

Author: docr99
Title: amazing atmosphere
Review: Nice crowded happening place just next to river Malacca with amazing atmosphere. Inside place is done up nicely, food is superb & crowd very friendly. Vegetarians may have problem as there is very limited choice.

Author: MchylinsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Friendly and well organised staff, could have more choices for alcohol
Review: Just came here for drinks and sat outside on the balcony overlooking the river. The establishment is very shiny and well organised with friendly waiters ready to take your order asap. Unfortunately there wasn't much choice for drinks in the liqueur and cocktail section (no Aperol, Pimm's, Campari, etc.) and the price was a little bit steep compared to other areas with cocktails starting at RM 50. Show less

Author: Ease JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Saviour..!
Review: After a few hours of touring Malacca, you will be hot, thirsty, hungry & the need for the loo!That's when me & my missus decided, "Let's take the whole package & do it at Hard Rock Cafe"!The food are always great as usual. Service is excellent. Clean toilets & it's AIR CONDITIONED!!! Trust me, after a few hours touring in Malacca City Centre, you would just wanna sit back & re-charge. Review: The service was excellent, the staff were very friendly and helpful. Enjoyed the music. Excellent ambience. Food was well prepared and tasty.

The ambient is good, restaurant is next to the Malaka river near Jonker street, good location. Show less

Author: Akmal R
Title: Hard Rock Cafe
Review: It was a great atmosphere, food proportion is huge,a western ala-carte manu can be shared with at least 2 person

Author: RowAzlandMasjid Tanah, Malaysia
Title: Just what you would expect from any Hard Rock Cafe
Review: I only come for the nachos and the occasional burger. I would recommend the Ceasar Salad, but its pretty normal to me. The shaved instead of grated parmesan adds an air of expensiveness to it. But that's about it. Since the only rating I could possibly give is either "Average" or "Very Good", I chose the latter only because it was closer to "Good" than "Average". My Yay Reasons: The waiters are friendly and helpful. Burgers are decent. Alfresco Dining by the river. (Not always a bonus. Especially when the stench through the gaps of your forks mid-Burger. My Nay Reasons:Not the best choice of live bands so far. I don't come every night. Every other month or so. Never have I ever heard a band worth being on that stage so far. Its good for special occasions, just not the kinds that involves making a toast. Not at night, at least.They have a no kids rule after 11.30. Even so, I think kids being there is just berries. Maybe they just prefer kids stick to their bed time. If that's the case, I support this rule!Show less
