Author: RudieVen
Title: Rocking good deals here
Review: What an awesome place. Great vibe and decor and great friendly service. Food is awesome. Parking is a bit of an issue if the small underground lot is full so be prepared to tackle the crowds and the heat to get here.

Author: Amarjeet123
Title: Family dinner in Melaka
Review: Location was near the Jonker street. The food was great  and was also complimented with lively music. Service was good. Nice place to spend the evening with the family. One place that i will visit again.

Author: Gregory WMankato, Minnesota
Title: Been There Done That
Review: If you have seen one Hard Rock you have seen them all. Sadly, this one does not blend in with the rest of UNESCO area though the location by the river and China town is prime for people gawking. The food is the same ol same ol. Save your ringgit and eat some place traditional unless of course it's western burgers you are wanting to consume.Show less

Author: eyedream1
Title: Burger lunch
Review: American colleague needed a burger after couple of weeks travelling. Always good and excellent iced tea. Nice location too.

Author: yhengmondJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good Food
Review: We been there last december 2015 with my friends. Location is just opposite the Jonker street, Crowded is Weekends. Have live bank ( really good band ). Food is mouth watering and delicious, drinks quiet expensive but Worth. The deco is fantastic of course with a rock concept, staff very accommodating and polite. Will definitely come back here on our next visit in Melaka.Show less

Author: AdesitravellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and excellent service
Review: We were taking a cruise that had a stop over in Melaka.After the awful food on the cruise, we were thrilled to see the Hard Rock Cafe while on a shore excursion and immediately went in for lunch.We were seated promptly and the staff were very friendly. The restaurant itself was immaculately maintained as were the washrooms.We had the chicken tenders, the classic burger and their very large brownie.All the food was delicious and the brownie was big enough for the three of us to share.What stood out was the service at this venue and this visit remained the highlight of our holiday.Show less

Author: jason l
Title: Terrible food, friendly staff but messed up food deliver
Review: had dinner here. the jumbo starter came late after main dishes. well, terrible food i forced to abondon vy eating them. yes i talking the jumbo starter. onion ring super hard, fried chicken "hard like rock", bbq chicken came "wrong" i ordered BBQ favor bit turns out XXX wrong favor that is extremely sour. biscuit was OK. will i come back for food? NO WAY NOT EVEN FREE. will i come back for drinks? Maybe. Show less

Author: DutchCariocaRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: High Singapore prices, live music starting too late
Review: The place looks nice and very centrally located between Jonker Walk and The Stadhuys. Food is good, consistent with the worldwide brand. Having visited Hardrock Cafe before, the idea is to share (part) of your dinner with live music on a Saturday night. Unfortunately live band only started at 22:30 and big video screen pulled up at 21:30. Then it becomes just a western bar. Paying MYR 415 for a family of 4, only eating hamburgers as mains and 4 beers, that is very steep in Melaka. Expectations were higher.Show less

Author: mbaasSingapore
Title: Good Drinks, Okay Food, but Great Location
Review: Hard Rock cafe is always a bit of a hit and miss for us. It's never our first port of call in a new city but occasionally Hard Rock cafe is located in such iconic buildings that we do find ourselves there at some point. In cities such as Amsterdam, Singapore or New York we find Hard Rock Cafe awful, in other cities such as Bangalore or Mumbai they're surprisingly excellent. We would probably argue the same for Melaka. Located right in the middle of the city it is a great place to cool down, have a drink, and enjoy the music (often live). Moreover the restaurant offers great views of what's going on outside. Food is similar to what Hard Rock offers around the world, the same goes for the drinks. Show less

Author: Yasmina2311
Title: Fun and lively
Review: Really fun with great live music, staff are very friendly and add to the great atmosphere! Only downside is it's expensive but then again that is expected from a Hard Rock Cafe

Author: k7cq
Title: Bring your ear plugs
Review: We had to sit outside because the live band that evening was extremely loud. The service was superb as well as all the food we had. It was just great. Overall, we had a great time and would revisit in the future.

Author: Samandaiwen
Title: Best place for Saturday night
Review: I was there with my wife to have dinner and enjoy the live band. It was so good and they really can sing well.

Author: HappyTravelerAbm
Title: Musical
Review: Went there Saturday night and it was crowded. Had to sit outside or wait to sit inside. Lively band. Gift shop was nice. Friendly staff.

Author: Cluis67
Title: It is what it is!
Review: If you want a cold beer, air con and a burger then this is for you......the atmosphere is lively but music can be really loud. But then this is the Hard Rock Cafe! Service is a bit hit and miss....

Author: Anusha80
Title: Good
Review: Food and staffs as what you would expect from a regular hard rock. Band not so nice at the time we went. Overall nice experience with my friends.

Author: lvoonjian8888Seremban, Malaysia
Title: Luxury atmosphere with excellent customer service
Review: Just celebrate my birthday with my gf last week at here. As usual, the interior design of this cafe is nice, high ceiling, cool atmosphere with vintage decoration. Every single staff will be welcome you with a great smile once you step in the cafe. We served by a service attendant called KD. He delivered excellent customer service and very helpful. Although the food and drinks are a bit pricey but definitely worth it. You pay for the environment and the customer service while they served wonderful food too. It's a great place either to hang out with friends or family on the weekends or couples dating. Highly recommended! Show less

Author: Greg ASydney, Australia
Title: Great stopover
Review: We called in for a cold drink after walking all over Melaka in extreme heat and humidity. The air conditioning was superb, and the beer was cold, although expensive.....that didn't matter as it was beautiful, and I convinced myself that half the cost of the beer was to pay for the air cond. Great friendly staff. A worthwhile stopover.Show less

Author: RuffusAdam
Title: Exclusive place for luxury tourist
Review: This is okay for luxury tourist to enjoy the beautiful scenery of melacca river with musicion playing a song. For hardrock tahirt seekers, they do sell hardrock Malacca shirt in there. Just dont park your car overthere as it was at an expensive rate unless you are really need to as It is difficult to find a parking space around the area.Show less

Author: PaulC582St. Boswells, United Kingdom
Title: Rockbox Winner!
Review: Food was good, although our burgers were not warm enough. The service was outstanding as we were well looked after by a number of different waiters but especially by Rowan who was very friendly and attentive. Great music too with dj followed by a live band. Show less

Author: winnyiv
Title: Friendly and Awesome Staff
Review:
Speechless. Just come and enjoy the moment.
U won't regret.
My colleague and myself really had a wonderful time today during of lunch hours.

Author: PhuongNgocV
Title: Best live music ever
Review: We already have had a fantastic night at Hard Rock Cafe Melaka. The music band T-Rex played many rock songs and UK-UK songs with their full passion. I aslo love three main vocals of this band as well as the musicians. The surround sound system at Hard Rock Cafe was set up very good to deliver dynamic sound. In my opinion, this is the best place in Melaka to enjoy amazing music and drink some draft beers with fresh feeling.Show less

Author: 101FUNtravelSan Diego, California
Title: Hate to Admit it...
Review: Under normal circumstances I would never choose a chain restaurant over a local one, let alone an American one in a foreign country! But I really hate to admit this… I succumbed to the lure of sitting with “full on” air conditioning… at the Hard Rock Café. Show less

Author: Hyeong83
Title: Best pulled lamb burger in town!!
Review: First time dining here and ordered pulled lamb burger. It is so deliciously cooked and worth trying. Hard Rock Cafe just smacked right at the entrance of Jonker Street. Nice life band and nice place to chilled out.

Author: mingsect
Title: average food, great location, great service
Review:
went on a weekday nite
place was pretty empty
service was good
food was average, potion was big as usual
price in the high side 
took the outside seat ( great view of the river)

Author: abbyx2015
Title: Nice place to hang out for drinks
Review: This is one of my favorite places in Malacca.  I love the music, the drinks and the staffs were extremely helpful and friendly. I will definitely come back again.

Author: mclalor
Title: Top bar
Review: Lovely bar but very expensive for average travellers.Typical Hard Rock, good music, interesting items on display.

Author: Yuu M
Title: Cool
Review: Been here with my bae. And we love it. The drinks, the foods, the songs, the atmosphere. Everything are good.

Author: annacar101Taunton, United Kingdom
Title: We liked it here!
Review: We liked this place so much that we ate here three times in the 24 hours we spent in Melaka. We had two lovely lunches here and a dinner. The dinner didn't quite live up to the standard of the lunches unfortunately but that was because neither of us were very keen on the pulled lamb we had on our meat combo's. There was too much much barbecue sauce on it for our tastes, it drowned it rather. We also felt that the portion of citrus coleslaw that came with the meals was far too small, we would have liked more of it as it was really nice. Having said that, we couldn't fault the lunches we had. In particular, the Chop House Salad was superb. Simply the best and most delicious salad I have ever tasted! Show less

Author: giokerq
Title: Different city, same story
Review: The usual deal: good music, good food, great staff, nice position. But to be honest, way too pricey. For two burgers and two beers you spend more than 150 ringgit. That's too much for a place like Melaka. I can't complain about anything, so I still suggest this place. Just be aware that you might spend more than what you are expecting.Show less

Author: 140maneeratp
Title: August
Review: Nice place and nice band . Im very happy to come here. If you want to relax you must try to come here got nice food and good drink. I love you all at hardrock cafe Melaka them so friendly and good take care all customers . Sure I will come here again and again and again Show less

Author: Bernard CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst Hard Rock Cafe experience
Review: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka is the worst I ever tried of this famous chain. The beef rib was the toughest I have ever eaten while the seafood marinara was dry and lack favour. Oh yeah, a word of advice to other patrons, apply some mosquitos repellent before you visit this restaurant.Show less

Author: SHAM6090
Title: FIRST TIME EXPERIENCE IN HARD ROCK
Review:
This was my first experience at Hard Rock. The service was excellent, food was good, music was awesome
Love the environment .

Author: celine_sernlinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Could be better
Review: My husband and I were at Hard Rock on March 21st. We had baked potatoes, a salad (no meat), a burger, a long island iced tea, and a southern rock. The bill was RM274. Bit much? I thought so too. The Long Island Iced Tea and Southern Rock were Rm45 each. I ordered it thinking it was going to be at a certain portion size. Turned out, it was smaller than the one served at my hotel bar and double the price. Apart from that, we had an excellent server named Rowan. He was the only one there doing actual work there the whole night. The rest were standing around the bar talking to one another. 2 staff were even flirtatious with one another. It was only when I think we tipped Rowan that they started getting something done. Not entirely happy with this kind of service. Social loafing at its best. Wouldn't mind going back if the price is lower and the service improves!Show less

Author: andylee1969
Title: Great place to dine
Review: Our family have patronised Hard Rock Café Melaka twice during our last 2 visits to Melaka.  Good food with good service.

Author: carolinafzsdKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Standard
Review: It has the very typical hard rock cafe drink/food menu. Comparing to the local restaurants it is quite expensive. We had a great Sunday's night. The band playing was very good and we had a good fun. Show less

Author: Rebecca MBanbury, United Kingdom
Title: Looks silly in this place of interest
Review: Out of context but a good shaded spotbto take a breather. The history around it is much more interestingShow less

Author: ChooMichaelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to have lunch
Review: The outlet is located at the entrance of the tourist attraction (Jonker Street). As the weather is very hot, this is a good place to take a lunch break before exploring the area furtherLocal dishes like fried rice and Char Kway Teow is in the menu. There is also set lunchesShow less

Author: mas1503
Title: Good food
Review: Good food with good entertainment. Located near to jonker street. Nice view at night with live band show

Author: RobieBernardo
Title: Good location
Review: Food is alright, serving size is average bordering on expensive. If you are on a budget and hungry you might get disappointed.

Author: 922warrendSingapore, Singapore
Title: It's what you would expect
Review: Need reliable, fast food and trained waiters doing it the HRC way? Then you won't be disappointed. Always worried about people reviewing who are disappointed by the concept. It is what it is, the clue is in the name (and the onion rings and mac & cheese are unnecessarily good)! Show less

Author: ThomasFromEarthKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What..???
Review: This was a real bummer... I don't know how they got the 'hard rock cafe' name but that sure is NOT what it is. Author: LovelySR

Review: My parents and their friends went in for a rest while I do my tour along Jonker street. The food was great! Service was wonderful while we did a surprise birthday celebration for one of our members. Thank you for the cooperation and help!

Author: Rudi PCentral Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Like the place, like the food and staff very friendly. Only problem is difficult parking and seating on weekends but overall is good and will come back againShow less

Author: hazda
Title: Cool by the riverside
Review: Very pleasant. Air- con lovely after the heat outside. Right by the river, looking across to Dutch Square. Good for people watching. Very helpful staff. Wifi available.

Author: ldtc2Hoboken, New Jersey
Title: Really???
Review: We could not believe there was a Hard Rock Cafe in Malaka. As we passed it, and we were hungry - we did not eat there because there were so many other places of interest. But out of curiosity we went back later and had a burger which was good. We didn't order anything else.Show less

Author: WarwickshireMarakesh
Title: Unusual to find a Hard Rock Cafe in old Melaka
Review: We went here for a drink. A local rock band were doing a sound test. Very bid and cool inside backing onto the river. There were tables outside overlooking the river. As well as the usual fast Ammerican cuisine it served some local food.

Author: Akram D
Title: Good food but carefull of their "valet" SCAM
Review: I went here to celebrate my wife's birthday, at about 8. Went to park at the parking lot (basement) but I was stopped at the gate by one of the staff, saying that the parking is full, only left for valet! And it was not the first time happened. My last visit here was also like this, but I decided to go somewhere else let time because I have bad experiences with valet parking. So this time, I decided to park at the nearby parking and proceed with the dinner. When at their dining area, it was actually EMPTY.. 1/4 filled tables only. So how on earth will the parking be full and only left with valet parking only? They only say that to just charge you extra! So BEWARE OF THE GUYS AT THE PARKING AREA! Show less

Author: Jordan M
Title: Good food but managers unable to deal with complaints properly
Review: My boyfriend and I went to the Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka to enjoy a nice dinner and some live music. We had the bruschetta as an appetizer - absolutely delicious! When our main dishes were brought out, (I ordered the ultimate burger with onion rings instead of fries) they had forgotten my onion rings and had to go back to fix it. When they brought the plate back with onion rings, I was a little surprised to see only 4 onion rings on the plate, considering subbing fries for onion rings is an 8 ringgit charge (kind of pricey). The burger was lovely, but as I started to eat my onion rings, I noticed a charcoal black clump of extra fried batter with a large hair wrapped around it under the onion rings.I told my server that I wasn't impressed and he tried to tell me that it had to do with the bbq sauce and how the burger was cooked. Not only was there no bbq sauce anywhere in my meal, he also didn't even offer to involve his manager. I asked to speak to the manager so the kitchen manager came over. I asked him why the charcoal batter was on my plate to begin with, especially with a hair around it. Again, he tried to convince me that it had something to do with the grill and bbq sauce, and said the hair was a piece of lemongrass from a lemongrass sauce they have in the kitchen.I told him I wasn't an idiot and I know the difference between a long hair and lemongrass, but he still refused to do anything about it.Overall we left the restaurant unhappy because nothing was done to remedy the situation. The manager did not apologize, admit they made a mistake or offer to take care of anything on our bill.As a manager in a casual fine dining restaurant, I expected more from someone in a similar position - especially in a restaurant like the Hard Rock Cafe. Show less

Author: Mogana91Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delightful night
Review: My friend and I were looking for a place to have dinner and opted to try out the dinner at HRC. Considering my previous experience at HRC KL i was quite hesitant to enter the premise. I was very doubtful and cynical up till the moment I entered. One distinct difference I noticed with HRC KL and HRC Melaka was that HRC Melaka staffs and workers are really friendly and try to make you feel comfortable the moment you set foot there. Slowlly my resistance crumbled and throughout the night we enjoyed great food, wonderful drinks and better view as it overlooks the river. My friend ordered the hickory smoked pulled lamb and I chose the fish and chips and for starters we had chicken tenders. The portion is definitely huge as we were facing difficulties to finish the food. The better part of the night continued with the band that was playing there. Definitely one of the best live-band I've heard in recent times. This HRC - Melaka is definitely a must go, even if not for the food but at least for the ambience, view, drinks and also the band. Compared to HRC KL the place is huge and reminds you of a classy dining area with a nostalgic touch of Rock. Till next time again HRC Melaka. Kudos to the staff and also the live band :)Show less

Author: 881gillIpoh, Malaysia

Review: Friendly and efficient staff, good fruit cocktails and club sandwich ( more mayonnaise please !) and cool atmosphère, with powerfull aircon. Not cheap thoughShow less

Author: Gilbert BChengdu, China

After walking up and down Jonker Street it really felt like a haven of peace and tranquility !Show less

Author: Cassfu
Title: Band starts at 930pm
Review: Went there for a quick dinner around 8pm. We had the chicken quesadilla, Cobb salad and Nyonya laksa. Food is ok. Service was prompt as only three tables were seated at that time.Didn't stay for the band. The server told us the band starts at 930pm. Show less

Author: IronJammerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great location

But the Indonesian band performing during the Chinese New Year season really sucked. The singers could not speak English well and would play old, mouldy and depressing songs like 'Temple of the King' and 'Soldier of Fortune' on a Saturday night. Horrible.Show less

Author: Melissa C
Title: Nice venue for live music and great service
Review: Hard Rock service rarely fails and this time it was great again! Friendly bar staff and waiters, food was excellent as was the drinks. Shooters selection is not varied here unfortunately, mostly the recognisable stuff. Live band is excellent!

Author: MichelS206
Title: Good Food mixing both worlds
Review: we went there with friends and were really able to get local food and also very good burgers and ceasar salad

Author: DaveandDariaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia

We ordered food, which wasn't the best to be honest. Especially at the price charged. Maybe it gets better later with the live band.Show less

Author: barryl542London, United Kingdom
Title: Air conditioned, staff are pleasant, food reasonable quality
Review: Air conditioned, staff are pleasant, food reasonable quality.If you need a break and are craving Western food or drink. This classic Hard Rock Cafe is a pretty good choice. It is a classic design and layout, but with the huge advantage of just being across the river from the main attractions of Malacca - the Dutch square and church buildings.You can sit inside and savior the air conditioning, or sit outside to have a good view of the river, both enjoyable.Show less

Author: alimilesLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Great atmosphere and good staff
Review: Stumbled across the Hard Rock Cafe on the way back from Chinatown to our hotel and went for a couple of drinks. There happened to be a band on when we arrived which created a nice atmosphere. Author: piperandco

Review: I only stopped in for a drink, but the staff were so much fun. It's in a great central location right on the river

Author: helloasia
Title: Good but could have been better
Review: The food was average.. Had a nachos and a macaroni cheese and a mojito . Cuustomer service could be improved.

Author: heinzalbert

Review:
As usual in all Hard Rock Cafes good service great atmosphere very good food
and always a reliable place to come to all over the world. Great drinks and a long happy hour.

Author: IsabelleH113
Title: Die hard HRC fan hugely disappointed in service
Review: As a collector of HRC glasses from around the world, the opportunity to both visit the UNESCO site in Melaka and add to my collection was too good to miss. Author: Geoff BBasingstoke, United Kingdom
Title: The prices put me off
Review: Firstly, I have to say that we didn't eat or drink at the Hard Rock, for reasons explained below, so please don't take this as a review of the food quality.The Hard Rock used to be a respected brand. We went into the Hard Rock Melaka out of desperation, having tried in vain to find a riverside cafe to get a coffee or a beer. There was a big sign outside promoting happy hour, so we sat down and looked at the menu. The drinks prices still seemed pretty steep, given that this was happy hour. I didn't fancy a Carlsberg (the only beer on offer at happy hour), so I looked to see what other beers they had. The main one seemed to be an alleged British beer called "Connors"; the pump was emblazoned with a Union Jack. Perhaps this should have been "Conner's", since - as far as I can tell, being something of a beer 'nerd', and having since Googled the name - there is NO British brewery called Connors. Rather, there is a "Connor’s Stout", brewed by Carlsberg in Malaysia and not available in the UK, so the Union Jack is misleading. Anyway, faced with a potential bill of around £7.20 for a pint of beer that seemed to be not what it claimed to be, and not particularly attracted to anything else on the overpriced menu, we left, and finally found what we were looking for at the 1673, just along Jonker Street. The Geographers' a bit further along, is also a good option if you fancy a decent beer at a reasonable price. (See reviews). Both offer a better selection of reputable beers, at lower prices, than the Hard Rock, and the food in both places is also cheaper.Show less

Author: 0_Gyrfalcon_0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average Margarita
Review: We was there yesterday at 13.40 hrs. The Happy hour was on. Specific type beers was pay 1 for 2. My frozen Margarita was 41 RM. The waiter said it discount from 65 RM. It wasn't that good. Lack of fresh squeeze lime juice, lack of Tequila and couldn't taste any cointreau in it. Once is done. My hubby Carlsberg was OK. It was a wedding party there to entertaining us. The price for those 2 drinks were 90 RM. EDC machine at the bar had trouble with my hubby credit card, later to mine cc also. Either cashier was incompetent or machine failure at the bar. Show less

Author: yannick707Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Author: DarhicrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Western food in Melaka
Review: Western foodies should love this outlet. Large and generous portions. Great food and good music into the night. Good service. Parking is tough.Show less

Author: LaurenceHay45Melaka, Malaysia
Title: SNOBBISH CLUB MANAGER
Review: Bought RM 2,500.00 worth of vouchers and went there with my group of customers in the night to drink and listen to the band. The decoration is not too bad especially with the replica of items from famous celebrity. The Philippine Band on that night is ok. What piss me & my group off is the club manager who were there on that night & he did not even come to say hello or acknowledge us!!! I see that he only entertain his lawyer's friend who only drink beers. A few of my friends who were also there and spending quite a big amount on liquor, I notice that the club manager also did not acknowledge them. In the first place Hard Rock Cafe should not have been in The Heart of The Heritage Area. The drinks & beverage is expensive ( not that people cannot afford ) & the food is just ordinary BUT THE PRICE IS EXHORBITANT!!!. Do not & will not recommend my friends or customers there. Show less

Author: Alan-HoldenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Who knew?
Review: I was last in Malacca 7 years ago and the site of HRC was a car park. So happy to see this place thriving in what was a waste of prime real estate in an up coming town.The usual HRC food on the menu for not much more than being charged for lesser quality elsewhere in Melaka. Downside is the cost of drinks. Happy hour 2 for one is still more expensive than other local bars. Band tonight started off with lots of slow rock to cater for the Chinese & Japanese tourists in town but once they had left the play list got a lot more rockier.Lunchtime service was excruciatingly slow considering it was mostly empty but no issues with the evening crew. To top it off, where else can you listen to live rock with view of a UNESCO world heritage site?Show less

Author: ztig65Tromso, Norway
Title: Great place, good food
Review: I haven't been visiting HR Cafes too much when I've been traveling around. Dropped in an evening for a snack and a beer.Big airy place. Live music when I visited. Food was good and service was highly professional.A bit pricey though, but definitely worth a visit.Show less

Author: Andi D
Title: Great location

Don't you love being with such people - makes you feel at home!Check out the shredded lamb burger, was SO GOOD!Early Dec2015 was there, had company lunch. Author: WoombyeBernieWoombye

We liked it as a half way place after being out all day, hang there for happy hour, regain your strength in time to go out in the cool of the evening.Show less

Author: mikomiow
Title: look small but full
Review: on my birthday my boyfriend decided bring me to hard rock cafe of melaka for our dinner. We order Twisted Mac, Chicken & Cheese and Hickory-Smoked Barbecue Combo.when the foods here really look like small dish but after finish it feel really full. the price also reasonable. the environment very good ,some song will be play at this cafe. It is nice place for chill and dining.Show less

Author: MisterdarkboyPeterborough, United Kingdom
Title: A great venue
Review: i have been to many Hardrock cafe's but this one is unique as its in a heritage building and has very sympathetic interior decoration that works well with Melaka's history. We did jonka street in the heat so we stopped here for a well deserved pint. the staff were friendly and service was fast! i will be back!Show less

Author: Shreya P
Title: Best to unwind in the evening after sightseeing
Review:
Food is excellent with excellent music and service.
You can also walk along the river side for a after dinner walk

Author: PhilipW141Newtownards, United Kingdom
Title: Easy to miss
Review: You have to look to see this place-really blends into the local scenery.Good service of usual fast food but served without delay.A request for mustard generated a new supply of good stuff rather than the pusillanimous affair so often provided.This place ticks all the HRC boxesShow less

Author: AshishGuptasfo
Title: Same as every other Hard Rock
Review: Located steps from the red church this Hard Rock Cafe is no different than other anywhere.  The service was friendly and efficient.  The food was filling and good.  We got to hear some great music playing.

Author: Ann S
Title: Chill-out after sight-seeing!
Review: Not different then any other Hard Rock, it's a good place to spend some after shopping-roaming time in hot sun in Malacca. Mostly tourists and staff is very friendly. Great spot, indoors, outdoor sitting, good for b'days and special events too. Recommended yes!

Author: Leonard S
Title: As we all know, Hard Rock it is!
Review: Hard Rock Cafe.. What else to say? It's really a great place to hang out. Lots of tourist from many countries. Food and drinks just the right place to chill. Especially it is located by side of Melaka River. What a very chillin' situation. But the Q, it's quite long, you might want to come earlier during evening, because the later at night, the longer the Q will be. It's a nice experience hanging out at this place, I bought myself a shirt too, as we all know, for different places Hard Rock have different merchandise. Good for collection.Show less

Author: Jedai79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Place!
Review: Saw Hard Rock Cafe, Malacca from afar when we arrived on 17 Dec 2015, didn't go in for a drink or two until 18 Dec night. Opened in 2013. Nice ambience. We had a few drinks and chatted with the friendly staff. The place was crowded on a Fri night and we were seated at the bar counter. I had Mango-Berry Cooler and Berrilicious. Both are nice but I like Mango-Berry Cooler more. My partner had alcoholic drinks. If you wanna chill out after becoming sweaty walking through the crowds that throng Jonker Walk on Fridays and weekends, head for Hard Rock Cafe. Enjoy! Show less

Author: KinWaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Place to party and chill out
Review: If you are a hard core Hard Rock Cafe fan, it is a great place to visit. They offer decent food and a good selection of drinks from alcoholic to non-alcoholic. There will be a Band playing after 9.30pm and I enjoy the music. Great place to relax and chill at night in Melacca.Show less

Author: KahHui
Title: Always crowded
Review:
Got to Q for a while before getting proper seats. Early reservation is needed. Big screen playing MTVs of the 80s.
It was ok, nice food and dedicated staff

Author: WanikCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Solid, no surprise
Review: Was spending the day in Melaka with my family coming from KL.After a long day of walking and visiting the historic center, we decided to finish with a drink at the Hard Rock cafe. Not specifically big fan of it but this one is very well placed over the river at the end of the famous Jonker street and in front of the "red place". The place is brand new and everything buy typical from Melaka of course but very solid place for a nice Hard Rock Cafe exeperienceShow less

Author: alethea20Singapore
Title: Was ok...
Review: Staff was friendly, food was standard as the other Hard Rock cafes but their merchandise were disappointing. The range and sizes were limited.Show less

Author: edwintcs
Title: At its finest
Review: The first landmark you will see before entering Jonker Street, great hospitality, delicious food, sitting by the river is the best at night as the river is lighted up creatively, a definite bonus to enjoy great meal. Live band is brilliant too, really enjoyed!

Author: Ronnie C
Title: Hard rock cafe.
Review: Beautifully lighted in the nite. Is located along the river. There is a Wind Mill opposite this Hard Rock Cafe. Tbe Wind Mill is beautifully decorated lightings and beautiful flowers all round. Take a picture of this WindMill with The Rock Cafe as back drop. Simply beautifulShow less

Author: ShaKLKL
Title: Rock & Roll
Review: Had a great dinner with family. The local band was great and we were singing along too. The service good too. Parked below.Show less

Author: Shasani
Title: Great food
Review: Visited here and the place is awesome with live band.. the food is tasty too and the awesome friendly customer service. Worth the money. Can shop inside the cafe toi..

Author: Kristinah87Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good hang out place...
Review: I went there recently in early December. It was a Saturday night, so each of us had to pay RM40 inclusive of a glass of drink that can be chosen from the menu at the entrance as cover charge. According to the waiter, usually if we want to enter the cafe after 1030pm on Saturday night, we need to pay the cover charge but this is only valid for Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka. No charges/entrane fee during day time.I went there with my dad and sister. We just wanted to hang out and listen to the music. A nice environment to hang out but not to talk because its really noisy inside, the food is nice and the price are within the normal range for this type of cafe/restaurant. You can also enjoy a nice view if you sit outside.This was our first visit during night time. I went there before during day time and 1 of the occasion was during my sister's 21st birthday celebration. The staff were very helpful and friendly with my surprise birthday plan. I really appreciate their effort. Will definately keep visiting the cafe whenever I have the opportunity. A must visit place if you are nearby the area.Show less

Author: Ms_Hs_Msgs_YTMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food and great company
Review: Zuki and Brian made my visit to Hard Rock all the more lovely with their warm service and friendly smiles. The food was great and the staff made it an effort to make sure i made the best out of the offers available at the time. Special shout out to zuki who went the extra mile to accommodate a customer - bringing that glass of water to accompany my finner without me asking was a good move, small but it made a big impact tq for cheering up a tired lady at the end of a tough day with your lovely company and good mood ☺Show less

Author: gunders74
Title: Superb food and great service
Review:
The nachos with salsa and guacamole was great. 
For dessert we had the apple pie/cake and the I think it was the hot fudge brownie - it was so delicious. 
Also very good drinks.

Author: Tony RHobart, Australia
Title: Ear splitting way to get cool
Review: My wife and I went here primarily because it is air conditioned and the crowds were oppressive. We needed sanctuary. The good news was the rapid and effective service, the air con and the lemonade drink my wife enjoyed. The bad news was the noise and the poor quality of the coffee. A disappointing visit.Show less

Author: Eric_loves_tripsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lots of nightlife and music.. Enjoy!
Review: Like all hard rock... Live band and burgers are the constant... After a fruitful day of shopping and walking around the bustling jonker street.. Unwind at hard rock with a nice drink and live music... Do plan to spend a night off for a great time~~Show less

Author: Travelfather59Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Big portions average in taste
Review: We went there with some friends. I had the fish n chips.... ordered vegetables instead of chips. The fish was fresh however i found the batter too salty. Had to dig into the fish and omit the batter. Unfortunate. The others had classic burger...the response was also at the average. The satay and the vegetarian burger was good. We had the juices and did not mind price. Its HRC after all. The service was excellent. We were constantly attended to. Maybe next time we will try the meats.Show less

Author: YenLeanne
Title: Gooodddd.
Review: I really like tis place because has many performances such as singer performance,disco,and others. The environment also best and let my friends and I very enjoy.

Author: DolphaniaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: AWESOME BAND & EXCELLENT WAITER
Review: Visited it twice during our recent Melaka trip. [1st visit]It was more to visit the shop and purchase our pins but we ended up having a drink and a plate of spicy anchovies. IT was delicious! At first we had trouble getting the attention of the crew to place our orders as they seemed more interested in singing their hearts out with the piped in music. This made me very annoyed. Once the entire evening crew came in, things changed. Everyone became more attentive, more helpful etc. That was their saving point i would say. One of the guys (sorry I cant remember his name) was good and encouraged us to sign up for HR rewards and explained the benefits. I walked out onto the "patio" area and was greeted by Izz, A lovely young lad who answered my questions and recommended we come back for the live band. [2nd Visit]We decided to end our Friday Night at Hard Rock with snacks, drinks and check out the band. We werent planning to stay that long, but the band DRIZZLE WITH D.N.A were simply AMAZING!! The best band in any hard rock i've been in so far. We ended up staying till their last set. Service side: We got Izz as our server. He is attentive, helpful etc. Keep up the good work. Even when we paid, he recommended us to go complete the survey online. Thank you for a lovely evening. We will be back again soon as the band is only playing there till end of January 2016. **NOTE: This Hard Rock is located in the heritage section of Melaka. Smoking is prohibited within any heritage areas in Melaka, So please be mindful, or you could end up with a fine. (Melaka has non smoking zones all over...so heads up)Show less

Author: Nazimah I
Title: The best
Review: The building was next to a river.  Loved it!  They have varieties of items in the shop and the prices were normal.  Their restaurant was awesome!

Author: Abhishek_Banginwar
Title: Nice place at good location
Review: This HRC like any other HRC offers good drinks and food. In addition to it, it is located at Riverside giving nice view and it is also beside jonkers street.

Author: 841krisbBrisbane, Australia
Title: Expensive compared to local places.
Review: In a great location, but very expensive compared to other locations in the area. Beautiful views of the Melaka river, and good rest spot between Chinatown and the European side of Mekala. I would advise strongly to try some local eats unless you're desperate for some Western food. Show less

Author: Faizal2885
Title: Just another HRC
Review: Just visit in the weekend and we feel that nothing much to expect with, its just another HRC. The food and drink are just nice and not so bad actually.

Author: Lizkeith68Southend-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Just another HRC
Review: We are avid HRC followers, having clocked up almost 40 cafes around the world, this was a bit disappointing, it lacked any atmosphere especially in the staff, but at least we got our shot glass to add to our collectionShow less

Author: Mohamedzein86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place for a western night
Review: Burgers are amazing. Steak was awful (it smelled strongly). staff are friendly. Music is loud (not very suitable for children). after 11:30 they don't allow children to stay Show less

Author: JemimaBond
Title: Great band n good vibes
Review: The only place for solid bands, and great sporting staff. Food and drinks are reasonable as it includes entertainment. My go to in melaka.

Author: Aria L
Title: Another T-shirt from HRC
Review: Yes, My wife really enjoy to see HRC, she very interesting with new design for t-shirt, At HRC Melaka have a nice place near the river across the tourist area.

Author: Elmar R
Title: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka
Review: October 2015 . This is a very nice Restaurant inside and outside . The Music is great , the Staff very friendly and the Food was good . I ordered Nasi Goreng and i was happy with it . The Price is OK for it

Author: FanazmiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Just another HRC.
Review: Having been to numerous HRC all over the world, it comes as no surprise that this HRC is no different from the rest. Rest assured of the food quality, it's as expected of a typical HRC. Homogeneous is the word that best describes it.Location-wise, it is strategically located at the start of Jonkers Walk, very prominent and hard to miss. Interior, is again, typical HRC setup, you see one, you see them all. The staff was nice and the waiter that attended to my group was attentive and professional.Overall a nice place to chill and have a meal (if you are a tourist).Show less

Author: David DParis, France
Title: Pay Out The Nose
Review: I walked in on Halloween afternoon to see if they had something going that night and I had a pint of Carlsberg beer that cost me 38.00 Ringgit! Don't drink there, the prices are not fare. The service is good but you will lose a weeks wages in the process. Carlsberg cost less than 10 cents a pint to make, don't do it.Show less

Author: 205loucCorby, United Kingdom
Title: Everything you expect
Review: A good spot on the river. Lovely staff who were helpful and friendly. Typical good food and drink - as you would expect. As far as memorabilia goes better than other HR cafes we have visited in SE Asia. They like Muse - they played them every other song - good job we do too. Main meal for four with two soft drinks and two beers at 380rm (£60) Typical HR prices but four times the amount of a local meal... The price you pay for a little bit of the norm on another continent. Show less

Author: 3kidsinoneroomDoha, Qatar
Title: Same country, worlds apart
Review: We arrived in Melaka for one night during a month in Malaysia which included visit to the HRC in Penang and KL. this was by far the worst of the 3.The location is good, the welcome was ok and we sat down quite far away from the stage as no other seats closer were available (some large work groups drinking mainly bottles of water used most space near the stage). The drinks service was slow but we compensated by ordering early on all drinks after the first. We asked for a menu with 25 minutes to go before the kitchen closed, we know that as we checked with the waiter and informed him to come back for our order. When we were ready to order and eventually got the guys attention another table came available and we decided to move with the assistance of the same waiter who said our order would be taken at the new table instead. We eventually had to wave down another person who took our order in full (a few minutes before the kitchen closure), he returned a few minutes later to inform us the kitchen had refused as they were closed- after some debate about the intention to order food being informed and the instruction that the order would be taken at the new table and then the order being taken only to be declined afterwards - we left very annoyed.While sitting for a few drinks before this happened, we had noticed that the staff were often in an area behind some swing doors and when a particular person (I guess the duty manager as he was checking on till receipts) came around they suddenly appeared and made themselves look busy but showed very little attention to the customers and more to themselves and the manager. There was certainly much less of a team feel about this place than other Hard Rock Cafes and less of a clear management presence.All in all, very disappointed in this example of the Hard Rock brand.(The band were quite enjoyable, although the singer was more of a 'look at me' than listen to me.)Show less

Author: zaram760
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Great food with great services ! The bartender soo friendlyyyy. Live band also great. Will definitely come back!

Author: ara rSungai Buloh, Malaysia
Title: Delicious and good service !
Review: Located near busy jonker walk .The nanchos and fish &chips is very delicious. The staff very friendly and im very enjoyed the ambience,food and the live band, so it was worth the money !! I think this service is much more better than hard rock KL. Will definitely come again! Show less

Author: RhiannonS14Victor Harbor, Australia
Title: Hard Rock never dissapoints
Review: Food typically Hard Rock and didn't disappoint. Staff very friendly and remembered us each day. The night band "Naqita" was the reason we attended Malacca in the first place and would recommend seeing these guy's perform any day. Hard Rock is definitely worth the visit if you are in town. Minor thing, not a lot of music memorabilia and would have liked to see a bigger selection of Hard Rock gear but that didn't disappoint the experience. Will return.Show less

Author: Brian EMelbourne, Australia
Title: Welcome relief from the local food and heat
Review: Melaka can get a little overcrowded and with the heat can overload the senses for a period. A welcome cool and clean escape is the Hard Rock. Ideally positioned by the river and adjacent the clock tower near the main square area this Hard Rock works. Service was excellent, the meal good (Mexican) and the happy hour just topped it of wonderfully.Show less

Author: s12796Alice Springs, Australia
Title: Another Edition of Hard Rock
Review: Another edition from the same franchisee in KL and KK. So far it was good. Different place different setup. The centre stage can be seen easily and clear. Friendly staff and nice food. I'm not disappointed with the western food here. Best things is, this cafe is near to other Malacca attractions.Show less

Author: farahevans
Title: everything is PERFECT
Review: The price quite expensive but their food were incredible.Humble and best service.Good location beside the Jonker Street market.

Author: nellielimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice location
Review: Nice location in Jonker Walk by the Malacca River, this outlet seems always packed with long queues during peak hours. Food served here is Tex-Mex but there are some Malaysian favourites which have been included in the menu. A live band entertains guests at night and that is when the cafe really wakes up. We stopped for a drink and to purchase memorabilia.Show less

Author: BTtxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad Customer Service with double standard practice
Review: This would be my 3rd visit to HRC Melaka if I was allowed to entered. However, sadly, I was denied access due to full house on Saturday. Before my trip, I have contacted HRC Melaka for reservation, but I was told that HRC Melaka doesn't practice reservation on weekends and I can walk in directly. I am surprised by the reply, because a week before my trip to Melaka, I was at HRC Penang and I did managed to get a reservation on weekend, same time. I arrived at HRC Melaka but it was full house, and I told the staff that I'm willing to wait or they can put me on the waiting list as I was queuing up at the door step. To my another surprise, they told me that I cannot queue there and they are not going to put me on the waiting list either. They told the same to other patrons which to everyone were practically shocked. No waiting list, no queue. Meaning, everyone inside will be stuck inside HRC and not allow to come out? I ended up bought 2 shirts from the Rock Shop but didn't get my dinner on that night. I was very upset buy the customer service and the double standard practice. My previous 2 visits to HRC Melaka have no issue as I always traveled on the weekends. I hope this is not a new rule set by HRC elsewhere. Show less

Author: MaxKingdomDhahran, Saudi Arabia
Title: Great, familiar food in central Melaka!
Review: My wife and I were walking all around Melaka as all visitors, here, do. There were other, more local dining options, but we opted to have a late lunch at Hard Rock Café Melaka. It was my wife's first time at a Hard Rock Café, and my first time in years. FOOD. Excellent as always. We started with an appetizer I hadn't eaten in years - nachos. Yummy! We enjoyed our meal and the air-conditioned environment, an anomaly at restaurants in this area.Show less

Author: Rsn M
Title: It is Rocking awesome
Review: Congrats, General Manager Anderson K.Selva for maintaining a superb outlets with succulent burgers and servings. A fantastic place to relax and chill.Thanks for personally entertaining each of your guests regaedless of their status while  making them feel at home with the hospitality and friendliness.

Author: norhafizi
Title: Best cafe in town
Review:
Nice place,nice view,nice food,nice live band and friendly staff 
But one think cant smoking in the cafe,the hard rock shop offer you a choice of collection ..

Author: Jayakaran M
Title: Hard Rock smack in the middle of history!
Review:
Unique, very airy but very little dancing! Food is good in some parts, average in others. The service here is excellent!
And the music is the best in Melaka!

Author: Diana I
Title: Good Music and Food.
Review: It's always nice to see a Hard Rock in a far away country.  It is a guaranteed good hamburger , drinks and music.

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Best, most happening hang out joint in Melaka
Review: Definitely a must visit cafe in Melaka, Hard Rock Cafe definitely a world-class establishment.The ambiance is just too awesome, environment is really pleasing.Food - top of the class with a reasonable price.Service is superb and staff are friendly.Visit at the night - you get a live band performance, even the lighting in this place gives off the posh cafe feel.Dr.Ruben KumarMalaysiaShow less

Author: Ching teng L
Title: Place to cold down .. Cheers !
Review: Its a great place to cold you down after a hot day shopping during weekend. Friendly staff and great service. Must get some cocktails during happy hour price..strong taste upon request compare with others outlet.

Author: angela Joyce S
Title: Amaretto is here!!!
Review: Hard rock really rocks! They have my favorite amaretto..and not to mention the price of the drink was so affordable (amaretto rm18 per glass) ...i will surely come back and bring bunch of my amaretto buddies here! Cheers!

Author: aliakberhabibKarachi, Pakistan
Title: Average is an overstatement
Review: The decor and ambience of the restaurant is top notch as was expected and the staff is also good. However the food didn't live up to the hype. Ordered the Mushroom Burger and specified it to be medium, but was served a well-done burger and upon pointing out that to the waiter, was told that it's how medium is done at the restaurant. The taste was also not something to talk about and pretty ordinary.Another thing I noted was that the music playing at the time of my visit was nowhere near the genre the cafe is based upon. Pop Rock Cafe sounds more like it..Show less

Author: Hepzibah TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Thumbs up all the way!
Review: I applaud the warmth service that the team showed.But I am not surprised because my family and I experienced it how Suresh lead the team by example. He was passing by our table and noticed my daughter found she kept drinking her water after ate one spoonful of her fried rice. He asked why she did that. She told him she found her fried rice way too spicy for her. Without hesitating he told her he would replace her fried rice with the non-spicy one.My char kwey tiauw was superb. Too bad it didnt have the beef at that time. The bbq sauce doesn't go well with the chicken. From the first person who greeted us at the door to Isma who took our order and delivered the food to us was warm and sincere and Ejon who presented the bill.....everyone was warm.My son told me that he really love everyone at HRC Melaka. Again, leadership makes a BIG difference. Leader should lead by example. I wish Suresh and the team all the best.Show less

Author: HerrSuman
Title: Good break after long walk along Jonkers street
Review: Hard Rock Cafe is located just beside the Melaka river ... And has same spirit as HRC usually have ... Nice place to have a drink .. Sir back and relax

Author: TheodoraThwinSingapore
Title: Good place for young hearts
Review: They have live band after 8pm. Oh yea its very entertaining but noisy.. The staffs are watching you if you dont order drinks... :PShow less

Author: dannywhwmalaysia
Title: No worth at all..
Review: have dinner here on a weekend break. a so called male hostess was so ridiculous rude to us as we requested to smoke & he show us outside. when I query him there a 'no smoking' sign, he just simply informed that if I smoke & get caught by health authority it will not be their responsibility. So if I ate some food & get poison also not their responsibility I think since he's so arrogant the way he inform me! food was really not worth the price. fish & chip where the flour skin were 12 mm thick! My partner ordered a Cesar salad..OMG..the bowl of salad only have green color. does the chef know how to garnish the food they prepared? should watch more Astro TLC channel.Show less

Author: jackier1901Kent, United Kingdom
Title: Over priced poor service
Review: Asked to get a table just for a drink, seemed like this was the first time anyone had ever asked this. The waiter didn't know what malibu was and struggled with taking all very basic drink orders, we said we'd go to the bar instead. Service at the bar was fine for me(wine and a coke) but people I was with struggled to get the right order and we're slapped with bill for two drinks instead of one when requesting a double spirit mixer. Also the staff as well as being short, and under trained the became unprofessional when a fight broke out in the kitchen and lasted 10 minutes all the wait staff rushed to get involved but none diffusing it until some one separated the screaming match. Far too much hard work for a quick drink if you ask me. Avoid!!!!Show less

Author: EnZZZo
Title: It's another hard rock.
Review: Went there for a beer and nachos in the afternoon to escape the hot afternoon sun. Staffs are ok and food is typical hard rock. I probably won't have my main meals there as there are so much food to be had in Melaka.

Author: nnvzhr
Title: Dinner
Review: Had my birthday dinner few weeks ago with my family, food was bland . My NY steak was served cold and its a bit hard to chew. Our waiter , Ajip was the best! He knows how to entertain my 3 kids. As a regular customer i hope HRC will improve on your foods qualityShow less

Author: Alisha P
Title: Great American Food
Review: Great food and great prices!  Staff was great and accommodating to dietary concerns.  Just what you would expect from Hard Rock.

Author: MissKris555
Title: In the Red Square Heart!
Review: Great staff, nice dining area!  Lots of merch in the RockShop.  Fun local dessert, Cendol!  Would have been fun to be able to trade pins with staff, however.

Author: TaniaKansilSouth Tangerang, Indonesia
Title: Unique identifier for a reservation
Review: One thing that I found unique from Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka is the way they took a reservation. Instead of writing the person's name, they gave an empty CD box of famous singers/group to the guests.Whatever singer/group assign to us, would be our identifier. Got lucky that I got my fave singer, Maroon 5. So, when this name was called, I knew that it was my turn to get a table :-)Don't forget to return that CD box to the waiter.Taste wise, the food was good (tried that mc cheese with chicken & one of the burgers).For sure the portion were quite big. So suggesting to have the food for sharing, especially when we still want to enjoy the dessert.»TKShow less

Author: Anthony E
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: As with all Hard Rock Cafes, this is a great place with a great atmosphere. Live music was great and the drinks were delicious. The staff were friendly and the guys in the shop were delicious

Author: Douglas K
Title: Hard rock
Review: The Hard Rock Café is very up market compared to the surrounding shops in Jonker Street. It is very well maintained and is in a prime location

Author: UKsam101London, United Kingdom
Title: Absolute rip off
Review: I came here with my girlfriend for drinks and to listen to the live band (who were average at best)Luckily, the bill was brought over after one round of drinks and I was shocked to see that 2 soda waters and pint of Carslberg came to 82 RM! 18.90 for a small soda water is ridiculous and upon questioning the price I was told that a premium rate is charged once the band comes on! not to mention the 10% service charge which is also added onto your bill! The service we received was poor and it would be nice to decide for yourself whether you'd like to leave a tip or not.Show less

Author: bluecurrantsingapore
Title: Mixed feelings about this. I had high hopes.
Review: After years of hearing raving reviews about the Malacca branch, it looked like a birthday celebration at HR was in order. Made reservations ahead of the day for my dad's birthday.Our hostess showed us to our table swiftly. We were given menus but were left alone for the next 15 minutes. We had to flag down a bustling waiter but was told he wasn't our server and that he'd get him for us. 5 minutes later, the same waiter came back saying our server was busy so he'd just take the orders from us. How are servers assigned tables when they can't manage the crowd size? Anyway, we placed our orders, most of us had burgers. SOOOOO excited!Artichoke dip was pleasant, don't remember what else we ordered but since we all got burgers, I'll talk about the burgers. So, on the menu, and based on the price, they marketed it as great quality meat right? But when I ordered a medium rare, they advised against it. Whatever, medium well it is. The burger was not real meat, i don't know what it was but its texture was off. Tender, sure but it did not bite off or chew like quality ground meat. Perhaps there was filler in the meat and lots of it. 3 of us couldn't finish our burgers, not that they were big, but they just didn't seem right. For the love of god, stay away from the burgers. Get something else... like the fajitas that every table seemed to be getting! It's a guarantee you'd walk out of the place smelling like food with all that good ol fajita scent wafting from every table. The ambience was almost there. Great lighting and deco. They need to turn up the AC though. And the music, I think it was 90's boybands night. No where close to any rock music. So weird, I laughed at every song selection. Will I go again? Maybe. But only if I really, really have to. Think this branch can really step it up.Show less

Author: Patrick LMelbourne, Australia
Title: Hard Rock in Malacca
Review: A quintessential Hard Rock restaurant and bar with all that comes with it wherever you are and whenever you are in a Hard Rock Cafe.The food is typical Hard Rock fare with a Malaysian twist and the bar doesn't disappoint either. Worth a visit whenever you see The Hard Rock Cafe.Show less

Author: TravellinMan0052Kuala Lumpur
Title: Wow ....
Review: We did not go to the Hard Rock Cafe Malacca by accident. We pre-arranged to go there... not by car but by boat !! We stopped by the cafe when we were doing a Malacca River cruise during the late evening. What an experience it was. The atmosphere is not much different from the other Hard Rock cafe but you can sit along the side bench and have your food while at the same time enjoying the night view with colorful dancing lights and the decorated boats cruising by.Show less

Author: contact91
Title: Rocking time at Hard Rock
Review: Been to Hard Rock Café and stayed the night there. Foods and live band performing till 1am when I left. Weekends need reservation and souvenirs for sales as well. For those who loved to rock.

Author: VittorioB956Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Vero good
Review: Yesterday we had lunch in this amazing restaurant. The prices are correct if compared to the high standards of other similar restaurants. Please do non compare it with street food prices cause the quality is not the same. The staff was also very kind and helpful and speck a good english! Try the big salads and the desserts. You won't be disappointed!Show less

Author: Flesh81Coffs Harbour, Australia
Title: The usual "Hard Rock" fare
Review: If your a fan of the food/drink chain then this is for you. The prices are the same here as you will get in L.A , Sydney , Bangkok or anywhere else. So bring you money with you, there are no cheap eats here.Show less

Author: Abhijeet_MehrotraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mixed view
Review: Service was patchy, they asked us to it in the smoking area while we were with a kid. Slammed them and they got it. Service changed and was good since then.Show less

Author: MimathRebecq Rognon, Belgium
Title: I like it!
Review: After a long journey in Asia it is always pleasant to go back for a diner to western food. The Hard Rock has many choices on the menu. Good and fresh food and also good to have the option between the inside, well decorated, in pure Hard Rock style, and the peaceful view on the river.The only negative is the lack of attention from the staff although they are all very polite and dedicated.Show less

Author: Sarah-Jane F
Title: Always great food and service
Review:
This Hard Rock Cafe is easy to find.  It's located right next to the entrance of Chinatown.  

Excellent service and of course excellent food.

Author: FizaRazali
Title: Spacious, Friendly, Delicious
Review: Some Hard Rock outlets may be small and stuffy, but this particular outlet is very spacious! There are indoor and outdoor settings (facing the Melaka River) and the staffs are super friendly too.

Author: Jerry L
Title: Drinks at Hard Rock Cafe
Review: I liked the river view, which was a nice break from the hustle and bustle of Jonker Street. But the loud "Happy birthdays" from the staff was disconcerting.

Author: Jonesmeister
Title: Great view on the red square
Review: What you can expect form a Hard Rock café: the food is ok, big portions though. On the outside terrace you have a great view on the red square.

Author: MatthiasG1292
Title: HRC is HRC - sowas Great Place to stay
Review: Stop complaining about the price- I guess that all who go there know that before, right?!? And they have happy hour offers as well...You get value for the money, food is fresh and really fine, beer is cold, service always available and atmosphere is just great for music lovers!Just too noisy if you wanna have a relaxed chat inside while having dinner.Live band is delivering well balanced and good rock cover songs.So food 5 and noise 3, which leaves me at 4 for restaurant and a 5 for location and bar!So pending what you do makes 4 or 5!!Show less

Author: an0nym0usguyJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Don't come if you are not ready for your most expensive western meal
Review: There wasn't anything food below RM28 at one glance, nasi lemak priced at RM29 (ARE YOU DUCKING KIDDING ME, I just decided not to eat anything and convinced the rest to leave)The price is too steep for the location, I can't imagine the price in such a placeSure I was rude when I didn't respond when the waiter asked me whether I wanted to eat and or drink, but you can't just throw the coaster rudely (no we are not playing poker)well at least the waitress still sent us off politelyITS FINE, I CAN GET BETTER THINGS TO EAT OUTSIDE IN MELAKA and better western food elsewhere in a similar environmentShow less

Author: Veronica M
Title: Very expensive restaurant
Review:
We stopped there for dessert and drinks and the prices were outrageous
The service was excellent as the place was almost empty
The location is great because they have a terrace overlooking the river.
They should really adjust their prices to Malaysian prices!

Author: LobnaGherCairo Governorate, Egypt
Title: River view at night plus music is magic.. but pricey
Review: Sitting by the river at night and listening to the band music is perfect. Service is cool. However, its a quite pricey. Guess around 28RM to drink juice or something. Not sure about the food prices as i was not interested in dining.But going there for a drink is cool.Show less

Author: hsienhuitSingapore, Singapore
Title: An expensive place to chill near Jonker Street
Review: We came here for dinner after arriving as it was a familiar and comfortable brand which offered air conditioned comfort after the long ride. The menu is pretty much the same as in any Hard Rock Cafe with perhaps a few dishes which are unique to the location such as Nasi Lemak. I must admit that by Hard Rock standards, the prices are very reasonable and the service is top class with attentive waiters always on hand. They have live music after 10.30 but others along Jonker Street such as Geographers Cafe and Bistro Year 1673 do so as well. After visiting other establishments along Jonker and elsewhere, we did not come back for the rest of our trip but that has more to do with us wishing to savour the local fare than because of anything bad about the place.Show less

Author: JulianF584
Title: Why go hard rock when you can have local food
Review:
I went to the rock shop...restaurant was quite empty at the time.

Evenings are normally packed with good music.

I didn't try the food..

Author: Jean KGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Not like it used to be
Review: We were very disappointed. The waiter was over attentive and wouldn't leave us alone. We were charged £8 a glass of wine when it was pointed out that it was two for the price of one, but not warned that they had to be the same colour. The food was average but expensive. The videos were mostly of modern pop, not what we expected, and far too explicit and violent for our taste. Not the place to take children, though there were some. Shan't be going again.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food
Review: Was here last weekend, luckily got a table outside to dine as it was quite full when we reached Saturday evening, Sitting outside during evening you can hear deafening of birds sounds, but the server will warn you before that, for us no issues. Food was excellent , no complaints. Lots of choices in the outlet store for souvenirs.Show less

Author: robertdives88
Title: Great place
Review: A very cool place in the heart of a very historical place. Perfect for us to enjoy the views and foods. Worth the trip. Go on the weekend for the night market, its excellent.

Author: ernichanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Nice place to chill out in malacca, slightly too loud music from a local band, rather expensive drinks, asahi was rm26 for a half pint, but the location and the decor can't be beat, well worth the visit....a little piece of Americana smack dab in the middle of historic Melaka Show less

Author: magnumsueBirr, Ireland
Title: Don't bother
Review: What a waste most expensive meal in Melaka food not great burger ok Turkey rasher???? Shrivelled and dry our server hadn't a clue.... Staff badly need training what a let down to the hard rock brand.We always try to do a Hard Rock Cafe on our travels...think it's time time to rethink if this is what their new restaurants are like.Show less

Author: NeftonVaz
Title: Amazing Place
Review: Great ambience, great food, great music, great drinks! Loved my visit to Malaysia and the night spent at HR was the highlight, nice view with good parking space. Ate the 10 ounce burger and it was tasty upto the last bite

Author: cicaaaaak
Title: Awesome!
Review: Had an awesome time here! Always love Hard Rock anywhere i go. Delicious food, wonderful service and of course, the souvenir shop is a must go for everyone! Great collectibles in every hard rock!

Author: meiwoo
Title: Hard Rock
Review: Soft interiors at Hard Rock. Sitting in the open along the riverside is a great experience. Staff very accommodating and introduce good food and accede to your requests.

Author: Nadelle_6
Title: Always delicious food and friendly staff
Review:
Every time I'm in Melaka I have dinner at this place.
The food is always good and the service is excellent.
Very good position in the centre of the city and few minutes from most of the hotels and shopping streets.

Author: AnkitSetya
Title: Amazing Live Band
Review: This place is probably the best of the Melaka area. With the Amazing Live band playing who make you immerse in thier music. we had to visit three times for three days in a row.

Author: TettyfromJakartaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Expensive compared to the area
Review: Had some starter platter and some drinks while listening to Live music. This is the only outstanding spot during weekday nights in Malaka old town. Located right in front of Red Church and along river side. Take seat outside if you smoke and enjoy watching boats passing Malaka river cruise. It's very expensive (as usual Hard Rock Cafe) compared to other cafes around. Well you pay for the brand rather than the food/drink itself. It will close quite early at 11:00pm during weekday.Show less

Author: Ian H
Title: Delicious food and friendly ambience.
Review: Food is super duper delicious. However, price is quite steep. If you are not planning to shop in Melaka, then spend it at this cafe. You wouldn't regret. Show less

Author: SmasKimMacau, China
Title: Love the shop!
Review: I was there after lunch with my kids, but we just went to the shop to try to find some T-shirts with Malacca on it, but the ones we liked were the same as the Kuala Lumpur ones we had bought the day before.They had a kind of vest done with a scarf, very interesting! A different way that made me want the scarf.The staff was nice and the cafe looked nice, clean and fresh, just by the river. We had just finished lunch and were going back to KL before dinner, so we had no chance to eat there. Next time for sure!Show less

Author: Putriput
Title: The best hard rock ever!
Review:
I ordered Laksa (i know, my mistake :D), and unfortunately i think it is too salty to me. 
Lovely the Ambience, not too smookey. Good place and very friendly staff. Overall, i love the place.

Author: Jmcdeguia
Title: Friendly Staff
Review: Went here in the middle of the afternoon cause its too hot outside jeez, we order a tequila, fries and tacos which is not bad at all. Reasonable price and friendly staff :)

Author: rusher8989Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Place Melaka River
Review: Find the burger is quite pricing but the place is quite nice especially when you choose to sit outside and view the melaka river. Friendly staff and clean restaurant.Show less

Author: elfin27
Title: Perfect shelter from the heat!
Review: We were walking around the old quarters of Malacca under the late afternoon heat and it was really getting to us ... so this was a welcome refuge ... had some white wine and finger foods .. and awesome service staff on hand!

Author: Ben11101Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Awesome band, Yummy food.
Review: Nice place. If you want luxuries, pls go to this place. It has good malay food, Chinese food, and western food. You want to go to this place. Awesome service. Buffet every other Tuesday, and your children don't need to worry at all. There is a band every day. From Monday to Friday, the band comes at 10pm. On Saturday to Sunday,the band comes at 11pm. If you want food in Melaka,here is the place you should be!Show less

Author: eezieThe Hague
Title: Enjoyable meal
Review: Had an enjoyable and quiet lunch since it's a Monday. Service staff Mr Yusri was friendly and accommodated our various allergy requests. The food was nice tasty and well presented. We had ala carte and also the set lunch menu which is very reasonable - 3 course with free flow cola for rm25. Location is smack in the middle of the historic city area and has a nice atmosphere by the river. Had their yummy milk shake and the brownie fudge. A la carte price slightly on high side though but ok for a treat once in a while.Show less

Author: AllyC09
Title: Warm and Friendly
Review:
The ambience is never lesser vs others HRC! This is brilliant and the services were warm and friendly (attentive too). 

Did not expect anything lesser from HRC! Keep up the good job!

Author: farreyzKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service sucks
Review: Ordered for two mocktail n jug of beer... Mocktail come without straw n beer without glasses... I working on service line also n i know that mocktail should come with straw n beer come with a glasses.... Ask for 20 minutes n glasses come how about straw? Its just 10 feet from my table... Is it so far? Malay people dont have money? Its come directly to my mind...Show less

Author: world84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Hard Rock Cafe . Rocking staff with rocking attitude
Review: 2nd time here . Tried the signature Melaka ice tea and it's really sexy . Our server Chris is really rock . Thumbs up to U bro . Pls keep up your good rocking attitude . Will come and visit your and the rockers @ Hard Rock Cafe Melaka . I love u guys .Show less

Author: carmencsh
Title: Good chillout place
Review: Location is great.  I was here as my client invited us for a dinner event which held here. The seats by the riverside is nice on a not so hot night

Author: Farreyz C
Title: Great environmental but service is so slow
Review: 1st step show everything.... Host busy chit chatting.... 'free seating' thats all... Order for a jug of beer n two mocktail... Jug come without glasses n mocktail without straw... Waiting for 20 minutes n asking for few times... Not sure not lucky day of bad service...Show less

Author: cinzibellaFlorida
Title: Hard Rock a must if you collect their pins!!
Review: My husband and I have visited Hard Rock cafés all over the world, first, they are consistent in the quality of their food, second, they are again consistent with the quality of service, last but not least, their gift shop carries pins that we collect and a t-shirt or two that, although pricey, well, it's what it is!We have collected pins for nearly 29 years, we will stop at any Hard Rock Cafe just for that!!Now, granted we just stopped for beers in the early afternoon and a snack, we found the Satay to be pretty darn good, the server was so polite and very caring to cater or needs, the place was pretty empty at that time of the afternoon.We came back that evening just to see the band, really not much to do but the night market, which didn't really impress us, we had dinner elsewhere and came back for drinks and music.Yes, the drinks are very expensive, more so than KL, but management can prove me wrong, but, it is Malacca, as pointed out, they are pricing according to the area and quite frankly, the GST, recently into effect, really hit alcohol hard, so, pace yourself or pay...Overall, I really enjoyed the place, clean, comfortable, great service and great music!We will come back!Show less

Author: BubblyRinaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great ambience, food and service!
Review: The ambience is just great with delicious food and great service! I will like to give my shout out and thumbs up to Zuqi who was our host for our lunch! Zuqi has a great product knowledge, friendly, excellent service and attentive.The Roasted Lamb Ribs is a must to try and The Big Cheese Burger! It's superb!Will definitely dine in again at HRC Melaka!!Show less

Author: Rebecca SStreaky Bay, Australia
Title: Western food in Asia - very over priced
Review: It was a bad idea to seek western food in Asia probably - but we felt like a burger.The food was over priced by Australian standards - the most expensive burger I've had! The food was average - the service was swift and friendly - the drinks very expensive. The chips were soggy and obviously pre cooked and then kept warm. Servings were big but relatively tasteless.  Show less

Author: nnvzhr
Title: Great foods, great ambience and friendly staff
Review: I was there last night ( april 12 ) for my husband's birthday dinner , along with my 3 kids aged below 4. I must say i am very happy with their service. Food was really good , my server Ms Sabrina was friendly and the manager Mr Edmund See who handle my reservation take things really serious by calling me few hours before the dinner to confirm the big surprise for my husband. Makes their customer feels very important , especially when it comes from the HRC itself. Will definately dine in here againShow less

Author: Trisno WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good For Lunch
Review: If you are thinking of dining in HardRock at reasonably low price, go for its Lunch!Only RM25 nett per pax comes with Salad/Soup, Main Course, Scoop of Ice Cream, and free flow soft drink. Ala carte menu is available throughout the day at regular price. 4-7pm for happy hour house draft beer.Located just right at the centre of Malacca, next to the river, hence you can dine by the River :) You won't overlook this restaurant for sure.Show less

Author: Jeanette W
Title: Amazing place
Review: Spent two great evenings here staff are fantastic! Friendly and welcoming and really love what they do, food was excellent with large portions, well presented.Staff quickly serve you and drinks are refilled regularly, these people know what theyre doing and run a very good bar.Band was worth waiting for with a wide range of music, they had the place rocking in no time.Well recommended for a great night with amazing staff.Show less

Author: Tanaka GTokyo
Title: Great service!
Review: We loved our dinner ! The staff was very friendly! They actualy told us about the offers of the day , took our pictures and made sure we enjoyed our stay.Yummy food! Good drinks! We love happy hour!My kids kept talking about it for a while…Show less

Author: JoaoMenesesMachado
Title: Strange rock on historical place
Review: At first time we can ask what is doing hard rock cafe at Melaka (Unesco world heritage place). Unfortunately in Melaka there is not many places where to go at night. There is live music every day

Author: Bryan_Kam
Title: Good Food, Good Service, Good Prices
Review: Love the service here. Staff celebrated the birthdays of 2 customers from different tables. Food was good and reasonably priced (for restaurant standards) and drinks were great too! Will definitely visit on my next trip to Melaka.

Author: NandyPengarahPretoria, South Africa
Title: A Welcome (Overpriced) Break from the Humidity
Review: Melaka seems a strange place for a HRC, seeing as it's small and out of the way.We went here partly because we love HRC and partly because we wanted a nice cool drink. Given the heat and humidity outside, the air con and friendly atmosphere is welcome.
