We didn't eat here - only drinks - but have to say that 2 cocktails and a beer was excruciatingly expensive... even for Malaysia. If you love HRC then come here by all means but there's not much in the way of value for money to be had.Show less

Author: 84Melanie84
Title: Sit overlooking the river.
Review: Sit over looking the river with a nice cold beer and all you'd expect from a Hard Rock Cafe. Not exactly a way to immerse yourself into the culture here but you know what you're getting.

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Rocking Good Time!
Review: Spotted the Hard Rock on our earlier walk about and returned in the evening...handy location next to the waterway opposite from the red buildings in Dutch Square.Big open building inside with a great atmosphere and option to sit outside on a terrace overlooking the water...chose to remain inside.Usual HR menu with an added selection of local dishes...drinks, food & service all very good and background music was just right.A very good live band appeared at 10pm and we were pleasantly surprised at how good they were covering some old classics. The music in their break however finished us off as it was too loud and too much bass otherwise we would have stayed for the second session.Good chance we will return before we leave Melaka as the food was really good...handy taxi stand just outside the door.Show less

Author: Lauren D
Title: Great night!
Review: Went here on a thursday night, which we never knew would have a live band on! the atmosphere was fantastic and the live singers sang a wide range of songs which we throughly enjoyed! the food was great, would highly recommend the mac n cheese with a twist! we've always loved hard rock cafe's and this one has exceeded our expectations :) Show less

Author: Sandy_Gates
Title: spacious
Review:
pretty spacious for a hard rock.Good crowd and good band.
Nice and comfortable seating.Friendly staff.Could have kept the rest rooms little cleaner.

Author: azamin99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Service
Review: By now, we know already this not really local food joint...like me, people come to relax, drink, unwind...was there at 10pm, just for the music..the local band was ok, i enjoyed my time there..ordered cappucino n mineral water..guess what..! 500ml mineral water at rm12..its 6 times more expensive than RON97...they must hv cracked the solid rock to get that water..reeeealll mineral, U know what i mean yeaaa..! LoL..Show less

Author: KaCe23
Title: One of the best decorated Hard Rock Cafe
Review: It's very spacious and nicely decorated. I went there on a Saturday night, the live band and the sound system was impressive. It has a beautiful river view if you prefer to sit outdoors. A must visit in Melaka if you're not tight on budget.

Author: JaiswarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome place
Review: Its a nice place to be after long hours of work, you may have difficulties finding parking space during weekend.Nearby parking spots may cost up to Rm 19 for 4 hours, if you are a local you may park along the streets but there is the risk of get summons.Visitors need to walk in, in groups to actually get a seat at table, if u come in alone they will request you to sit at the bar.I suggest early reservation to get the seats, the spot next to river is usually reserved. Hard Rock Melaka Badge costs RM 50 and Fridge magnets is Rm70.The band dont usually start on time.Overall awesome place.....A night with 4 friends came up to RM887 including tax and service charge.Show less

Author: avice269uk
Title: Good food and service
Review: Great experience of the chef....food was good follow the standard..I come when Chinese new year time it so full of people dine in ..thank to art arm chef""u are rock the day""...I enjoy my holiday ...the food and service are vary good ....see next year keeps it "rock " all the timeShow less

Author: MiMiMohamedSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Rock Star!
Review: We ordered Nanchos for our entrée and Fish & Chips, Texan Lamb, BBQ Lamb Sandwich and Salmon for our main courses. And oh my god!! The food came and the servings were super huge. Nevertheless, we still had room for dessert. A Mud Pie for the four of us to enjoy. We truly enjoyed the ambience, food and the live band. Thank you Zuqi for your finest service!!Show less

Author: AinulSakinahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love Love Love the service!
Review: I had went here last Friday night, came around 8pm and left at 2am. Stayed because of the excellent service and the super efficient and friendly staff! also loved the live band. Didn't really had much to eat, just the potato skins and nachos but they were good. Will definitely come again.Show less

Author: ViVi M
Title: Expensive but fun
Review: Fortunately some rich friends took us there one night where they caused the bubbly to flow. The music, dancing and venue was very nice and glitzy.

Author: NgSP80
Title: eat at hard rock
Review:
hard rock, as usual high expenses place...
food is so so only...
actually the environment also so so...
depend on individual on the rating...

Author: DoreeseWKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Ambiance with Live Music
Review: Located near to the busy Jonker Walk , unless you have a reservation , be prepared to wait a little before you get a table.We were lucky to get a table within < 30 minutes , as we waited at the bar for table .The live music is awesome, as I love band performance . The food is just average, nothing much to shout about , but it was a lovely place to hang out, getting out of the “historical” food & mood of Melaka.The staffs are really great , our server, Eddie , was great in ensuring we had a good time, so it was worth the money ! Just that it is not the average price restaurantShow less

Author: world84
Title: rocking cafe and staff
Review: i was there last week together with my bros . food are extremely delicious and service is really good . better than hard rock cafe Singapore, KL and London. well done HR CAFE MELAKA . i love u so much

Author: DarwintaffRockingham, Australia
Title: Great location
Review: I think the best think about the cafe is its location. Look the staff were good, attentive & tried hard. The food was ok, nothing to write home about but nothing to complain about either. A little pricey maybe but I just think it's a little out of place in Melaka. Overall it was clean and the service was fine, just an odd place to find a Hard Rock Cafe. Show less

Author: travelplaces87
Title: Nice Environment, Average Food
Review: Been there with my girlfriend. Nice environment and nice performances. Food is average, but portion is big ! Good if you are very hungry and quality is not your top piority.

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Good Place To Chill Out
Review: Like all Hard Rock Cafe,This is the place for Fans of Hard Rock Cafe to Dine and Drink.Try the BBQ ribs or if you like something simple,fish and chips with a glass of beer should suffice

Author: takashi2233Tokyo, Japan
Title: Awsome experience in Hard Rock Cafe Melaka
Review: We have a long way holiday from Japan to Malaysia. After we visited Kuala Lumpur we visited Malacca. During the 1st night we went to Hard Rock Cafe Malacca to have our 1st dinner at Malacca. We had a nice greeting by all the worker. The waiter who served us is Raymond. We surprised that he can speak a little of Japanese by explaining what is the food in the menu. Not too good but we still got the point. Besides that he also suggested us something special like the burger we didn't try before. He also be nice and care about us. Most important is he have a responsibility on us. We got a nice experience during 1st night in Malacca. We will come back if we got the chance. Gambateh!Show less

Author: pinoytraveller2Luzon, Philippines
Title: As Good as Other Hard Rock Cafes
Review: This review is quite late. I visited Hard Rok Cafe Melaka together with my sister during our one day tour in Melaka. After walking around Jonker Street we were feeling tired and hungry and it was good to see the presence of Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka. Good place to get a quick bite and some refreshing drinks.Show less

Author: Paulus_WBLeusden, The Netherlands
Title: why do people go here?
Review: You get what you expect: interior like Bangkok, Delhi, Jakarta, etc. Good but overpriced cold beer. Nice staff, even singing and swinging, but the place lacks atmosphere. If you dont like surprises, go here. If you like a nice place, go somewhere else. There are plenty at walking distance!Show less

Author: BBJJLTSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Pleasant Treat!
Review: Had lunch at Hard Rock Café Melaka which is located just right outside of Jonker Street. I was surprised to see this Asia delight in the menu - Curry Laska (yellow noodles in rich spicy coconut based soup with sliced fish cakes; prawns and bean sprouts etc. topped with chilli paste. Ohhh...it's one of the best I had ever eaten in Malaysia or even Singapore! And strangely, best matched with the local cocktail recommended by the bartender - a three-layered milk tea that taste like bubble tea but without the pearls. Dumbs up indeed!Show less

Author: sambi2015Tasmania, Australia
Title: Was missing home
Review: We went to hard rock as we had been in Malaysia for over a week and we were missing home food. Hard rock did not disappoint! The service was exceptional with every single server speaking fluent English. They were always checking in and making sure we knew about the night life in the cafe! The food was exceptional!Show less

Author: sandchildkage89
Title: Melaka hard rock cafe is super awesome!
Review: Went off on Friday night for Mimi's birthday celebration, we had a warm welcome by the all the crews. Special thanks to Mr Raymond! You rock! Will definitely be here again if we get the chance!  😀

Author: mariop79
Title: nice restaurant with a beautiful outdoor seating
Review:
what we liked
- friendly waiter and waitress
- nice food
- nice outdoor seating

what we dont like
- nothing ...everything just perfect

Author: PinXun
Title: Cheap beer during happy hour
Review: A great place to sit down for a drink especially during happy hours as their beer tower is only RM68 if I am not wrong.

Author: OcinIcaBatu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: nice food.
Review: nice food! i love almost everything in the menu. but not suitable to bring baby a long due to loud music played. but overall everything was ok. Show less

Author: tunawhiskas
Title: Your usual Hard Rock
Review: It is located across the Red Square, quite centrally located. Drinks were ok however the service is a little slow... And pretty hard to get their staff's attention at times. Was there on a Thursday night and the band was not bad.

Author: eboman77Tiel, The Netherlands
Title: Hard Rock same as others, but bad service
Review: Although an empty restaurant, after the order not much attention from staff, pretty expensive even with happy hour, which they try to sell as much as possible. Wanted 2 beers, staff brings 4 beers.Show less

Author: simplyCarol396Palawan Island, Philippines
Title: Truly rocks!
Review: We accidentally came across the place while we were touring around the area and still full from our last meal. So instead of dining we end up in their Souvenir Shop. Fortunately, it was during Halloween and the whole Hard Rock staff wore their Halloween costume! As always, their personnel were very accommodating and helpful. We've been collecting Hard Rock's souvenir items ever since we stayed in one of their hotels in our previous travels. Since then, every time we travel to a different country we always go to Hard Rock and always end up buying shirts, pins, mugs, accessories and anything that fancies us. Hard Rock has its own theme used in their souvenirs for every country and it reflects the country's image and major attractions. Piece of advice, if you see anything that catches your attention in one of their souvenir shops, buy it immediately so you won't regret later because you'll never find the same product in their other outlets particularly in different countries.The Hard Rock Cafe in Melaka is centrally located. Near to Jonker Street and riverside. Don't miss this place when you are in Melaka!Show less

Author: DOHAJO
Title: Hard Rock Happenings!
Review: All of what you would expect from a Hard Rock can be found in Malacca too! It is located right on the River across from Red Square. Very centrally located.

Author: HPSP123
Title: Standard Hard Rock fare
Review: Stopped for dinner one evening and enjoyed having the meal with 80s rock music playing in the background. Servers were friendly and drinks and the meals were delivered without any delay. Enjoyed the well prepared meal. Nice job, Hard Rock.

Author: WanZaidi
Title: Friendly staff
Review: My title says it all, as these are the main criteria whenever you dine(in a Restaurant) or shop(at a shopping complex) or stay (in a hotel room ) .. keep up the good job ! :-)

Author: Valerie037South Australia
Title: Nothing Special
Review: Stopped for lunch on a rainy day in Melaka. Meals came out at different times some finished before others even got their meals. Staff friendly and reasonably attentive, but when we asked for extra sour cream for nachos way too much trouble. Serves are large and we thought expensive.Show less

Author: JohnawardforeverParis, France
Title: Good on the terrace with a burger and beer
Review: Well nothing new in the sky, good burger and good fried onions with ice cream on the terrace ...simple and goodA bit costly...but clean and safeGood service alsoSafe choice...for no adventure people...View is good thus worth to have a beer there also...lazy to go on local terrace...Show less

Author: AzmythKL
Title: Returned a year later, and this time around I'm impressed!
Review: So, I returned to this place after a year. And boy, I had a good time here with my friends! I was quite disappointed during the first visit- right after it was opened.But much has changed. The staff they have now are much more friendly and warm. That just made the whole experience an even more memorable one.Loved the song selection and we loved Thomas very much, guys! He made almost got us to stay for a third tower!If this is the atmosphere and it continues, it would be awesome. P/s : keep the tower promo going! ;)Show less

Author: 687ankurpSingapore
Title: Fantastic
Review: I am not a huge fan of HRCs, was pretty surprised to fund a massive restaurant right opposite Christ Church which is the main tourist attraction at Melaka, it was raining outside so we thought might help to have a quick coffee. We ended up staying there for over 2 hours and our 2 yr old wouldn't stop dancing and we had to literally pull her out of the restaurant. Being a veggie it is always hard for me to find food in such joints but was pleasantly surprised to have a number of options including amazing nachos, spring rolls and they even had veggie burgers. Staff was very hospitable and gave our two year old balloons, crayons, caps etc that made her day. Music was lovely as usual. Didn't expect this in Melaka. Show less

Author: RogerCKHJohor, Malaysia
Title: Hard Rock~~
Review: On the eve of Christmas, surprisingly waiting time was only 10 mins at about 1900-2000hrs for 4 adults and 2 childs. We were asked is we ok to seat outdoor but was given indoor seat near to stage, that's good for family with childs. Food is good and the drink. My childs was excited as they got the goodies bag for the Christmas eve. Too bad the band performance was at 2200hrs but we were told at 2100hrs. Staffs service with smile !!Show less

Author: mikelarry70
Title: rocking by the river
Review: arguably one of the best hrc in asia. located at the beginning of jonker street. nice decor and besides a river as well. great for chilling out by the river..must come!

Author: Jackho1985Palmerston, Australia
Title: Long live Hard Rock
Review: I have now had dinner at Hard Rock cafe twice and both times have been great. I ended up there the first time as it was the day before pay day and I only had cards to pay for dinner. The two meals that I have had so far have both been delicious, the first was a chicken and chips type meal with a very tasty smoky flavored sauce on the chicken and it came with sides of coleslaw and some nice beans. Second time round I had eating like a king all day and opted for something lighter, a Chicken Caesar salad. The salad was nice but I have certainly had better.Service on both occasions was excellent and the staff can generally spare time for a chat or to answer questions, they certainly try to keep customers happy. The young lady who served me on the first night was named Ruby and she did a wonderful job and was up for a chat and even a bit of get to know you sort of conversation. I suppose I went back the second time hoping for the same great service from Ruby but it was her night off.Being Australian I had two pints of beer on both visits during a sort of happy hour period which meant buy one get on free. Prices are really quite good considering this is a world famous international franchise, I think the most I payed was 150 Ringgit and that was for the lovely half chicken chips with smoky sauce along with two pints, a long island ice tea and a donation to a charity of around 15 Ringgit. That also included a 10% surcharge for using the MasterCard. The second time round I offered a tip of 15 Ringgit to the fellow who served me but he recommended the donation which I had given the first time rather than tipping him, that is rare in this day and age but perhaps its in their code of conduct or policies. The view is quite nice being situated by the river, it can be noisy especially around dawn when a flock of many different birds come in to feed and drink from the trees and river but I do not know anyone who gets upset by bird noise (unless their really hungover).Certainly very good, the Caesar Salad with no bacon has brought them down from excellent. Show less

Author: alvinjwongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Music at Hard Rock!!
Review: Le Familia went to Hard Rock just for some chilling and good music (which also to surprise our mom for her birthday). A typical view of Hard Rock at night with loud rock music by awesome band. Can't remember their name but I believe they played on the night of 12th October. Price wise which I have no complain about because its Hard Rock. But could not complain because the person who served us was good, fast which made our experience there feeling great. Can't remember who though. :) Keep on rocking!!Show less

Author: JodieG925Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Rock On in Malacca
Review: Stopped in here for a drink... the service was exceptional... the restaurant was immaculate... the views fantastic as it was opposite the famous Christ Church Malacca on the river.... Although we did not eat... the food that came out for others looked yummy and portion sizes large...Show less

Author: Chrys64
Title: Typical of a Hard Rock!
Review: There isn't anything special about Melaka's Hard Rock coffee but if you fancy a western style food break during your stay, you can go there.

Title: Hard Rock Melaka
Review: Travelers should visit for the experienced at Malacca Hard Rock - it located just next river(newly cleaned upriver) and the outlet was newly built up. Excellent experienced with good service and souvenir collections can be purchase.

Author: Mynameisrick
Title: Great place
Review: Nice.ambiance..great place to entertain urself :) good food..and good service too..Credit to Najib one of the server for his good service...Thumbs up

Author: AishalloydKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mind the verrry big portions, share it all out!
Review: Was here last weekend with the family, overall great food selection. Price dearer than your regular chillis or Fridays but hey, it's HRC! Ordered nachos, couple of steaks, and we couldn't finish these between the four of us. The staff should've said something - a lot of food wasted as we a not familiar with the portions. Nachos is literally almost half a kg!!! Other than that, attentive friendly service, prompt and brisk at clearing tables. Wonderful service, great ambience, would Visit again definitely!Show less

Author: karennem
Title: Absolutely Awesome
Review: A gorgeous restaurant with great food, exactly what is the norm for Hard Rock. On this visit, the staff went out of their way after my MIL fell down some stairs outside. They bought water, a chair, got us a cab as we were on a cruise and made sure she was ok. Even after returning home and emailing The Head Office, and the cafe itself, we were told how concerned the staff were. It was great to receive such service and kindness in an awful situation. Make a point of going. It's awesome. Show less

Author: NinaTomStandish, United Kingdom
Title: It's a Hard Rock Cafe
Review: So it serves the usual fayre and some local specialities. We popped in for a quick drink and snack; we would have happily eaten more here had we had the appetite (or budget!). Was busy, good atmosphere, and showing the football. Nice spot by the river if you want to sit outside. Show less

Author: Bzh56
Title: Nice place
Review: Nice staff with a nice location . Thet serve the regular Hard Rock cafe menu and have the Kronenboug 1664 blanche on tap.

Author: Karen_theaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent!
Review: First time visit melacca and my boyfriend suggested to go hard rock cafe since out hotel is quiet near. I was impressed by the service of your server, Mr. Joseph. I visited hard rock cafe on 24 oct for dinner. Accidentally spilled my beer a bit on the table and Mr. Joseph respond very fast to help us. Thank you so much for being so helpful! And the compliments for the chef too. The food was excellent! ☺️ Show less

Author: Brucie13Cuijk, The Netherlands
Title: Awesome!
Review: What a great place! Super location on the river bank. We had a great dinner here. Very good nasi goreng!!! Spicy. Great staff!!! And when we were there there was a very good band. Traded pins with many staff members. That was fun! Thanks you guys.Show less

Author: SunitfennThiruvananthapuram (Trivandrum), India
Title: Rocked ....
Review: HRC Maleka rocked....When we visited on the 27th of October, 2014... A rock band from the Philipines was performing. They blew us away with some of their numbers... To say the least, we ended up spending our 2nd night too at the cafe, just to rock with the band.... The service was simply brilliant and when we turned up the next evening too.... We were treated like visiting Royalty . To say the least.... Hard Rock Cafe Maleka and the Band, rocked out holiday Show less

Author: VinaSoepieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food was mediocre but environment was as expected
Review: Just like any other HRCs I've visited, the environment was lively as expected. though there weren't any live band or performance when I was there (guess it was too early), but I enjoyed the music and friendliness of the staff. Food was just ok to me, nothing special.Show less

Author: Milinda1981Colombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Must go if you are in Malacca
Review: If you want a place to hangout and relax, this is where you should go. They have a awesome band and the ambiance is very nice. If you go at the happy hour before 9.00 pm you'll get drinks at 50% off rates. And the place is just at the Jonker walk so you can plan your Jonker walk along with thisShow less

Author: Twogirls_7
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food
Review: Spent very enjoyable evening here on our first night in Melaka as our son really likes the Hard Rock Cafe. Food up to the usual good standard. Service excellent, wine expensive but happy hour beer was great. Will be back.

Author: boo_tofuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Back for another Rockin' Good Time!
Review: We have somehow made Hard Rock Cafe Melaka a 'must-visit' place for dinner every time we find ourselves in Melaka for our brief holidays. This time round, the Cafe exceeded our expectation. We were in Melaka for a holiday and decided to have dinner here as a 'closure' to our already memorable holiday. The service this time was excellent as we were met and served by a very enthusiastic and friendly gentleman named Thomas. Thomas indeed represents the spirit of "Love All Serve All" of this famous chain. We were indeed well taken care of!The food was also good too!We had a chance to also enjoy the band (forgot their name) who were really entertaining.Thank you once again Hard Rock Melaka - and indeed, we will return.Show less

Author: angeliuswings
Title: Amazing
Review: We were looking for a nightlife to chill with friend and we felt on this amazing place with XTRADINARY MUSIC ,nice wine selection...so proud to be here now let rock...yeahhhhhhh

Author: WarmlyAndCoPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: Is ok but over price
Review: We would like to experience the live band, unfortunately we chose a wrong night as they did not have any live music on due is the day of remembrance of MH17. The restaurant was quite quiet, consider was 11pm on Friday. The waiter was very friendly and chatting with us with attention. He even bring some Hard Rock Café badge and cocktail sticks when we said our children that at home (our rarely night out) would like the cocktail sticks that come with the cocktail. It was a nice though and surprise for the children.The prices of the drinks were slightly more expensive than a few pub/Bristol along Melaka River and Jonker Street. It was a treat for us but not a frequent visit place.Show less

Author: Pang0113
Title: Excellent service with stunning band
Review: Most atractive cafe after walking for an hour looking for a place to chill out in the evening. They have the best service ever by Hafiz that really make my day. People that celebrate birthday will get a awsome birthday song from the band and wishes from everyone. For sure that this will not be my last visit here. Love the service, the band and the enviroment.Show less

Author: Felix CBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Awesome experience!
Review: Happy with the my experience with Hard Rock Cafe Malacca! The food was great, coupled with wonderful customer service! Have been in Malaysia for couple of months since I live in UK. Seldom come across any cafe with such good service!! However, I would say that the hygienic level in the toilet could be improved further. Anyway, still amazed. Felix Saw.Show less

Author: yemz M
Title: A must try burger
Review: For the burger lovers should try their burger..Highly recomended..and of coz theres a price to pay for it..Overall nice place to eat and hangout with friends..Show less

Author: ms_swanz
Title: Chilling in the afternoon
Review: We came here on a weekday (Tuesday) and we had the place all to ourselves. They have ikan bilis and hotdog on the menu? haha.. anyways, we had a nice time chilling at the place after a walk along jonker street..

Author: 894stephV
Title: Everything we wanted
Review: Spent 2 hours walking around in the heat. Saw free wifi and aircon walked straight in. We felt like chicken sandwiches so this satisfied and provided a cooling down area.

Author: Codeblue79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great service
Review: As usual, HRC is always a pit stop for us whenever we go out traveling. This time was Melaka, a world Unesco Heritage city in Malaysia. After a long tiring walk, we had a wonderful meal here. Service was wonderful, in a nutshell, it was worthwhile. Will come back if ever in Melaka. Thumbs up. Show less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Great burger
Review: Went there twice. Great place and location. Limited parking below the restaurant and if that is full,the nearby streets would be difficult to get a parking space especially if you go at peak times. The place is closed too children after 10 as they closed the diner section. Great decor, great view of the river and the stadhuys and a famosa fort. The service was great, but generally be prepared to pay for all these. In fact, I think it is one of the more expensive restaurants around town but the servings was big. We had the legendary burger which was very good. The chocolate fudge was also great. However the chicken sandwich was a let down. The drinks were great but if you are a non alcohol consumer, a coke sets you back by 7 ringgit.Show less

Author: Russell1979Dubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Great Service, Food and the band
Review: Pit stop for some drinks in the evening, liked the band so stayed on for a lot more rounds. the service was excellent, the food was pretty goods like the burgers a lot. Ended up coming the next day as well. Melaka being a small city, don't miss having a few rounds here, this HRC was among the best ive been to compared to some other cities.Show less

Author: Nicholas KMalaysia
Title: Good food & service
Review: Stopped here for late dinner at 2030 hrs, weekday, 5 pax.Staff were very attentive and helpful, offered us a booth seat for easier access and lower seats, as one of my family members requires this provision. Took our order quick and offered good advice on portion size/sharing (although we would later find it was still over-estimated).Food - ordered the 10oz burger, and fellow diners ordered a mixture of sandwich, mushroom swiss burger and salad to share. The portions are quite big, and we soon realised that we could have ordered 3 mains instead of 4 to be shared between the 4 of us.The 10oz burger was good, patty medium done with plenty of flavour and good consistent texture. Rest of the burger ingredients were fresh too. Fries were normal chunky cut, and cooked well. The quality of the food justifies the slightly higher price, and the ambience with nice decor is what you are paying for.We left just before the band for the night started playing, but you can expect the sound mix to be pretty spot on.Well worth a visit if you're looking for good western food in Melaka.Show less

Author: MadkathDerry, United Kingdom
Title: Surprisingly good
Review: Not the sort of place that we'd normally eat, but during Hari raya we found a lot of places closed, so reluctantly we tried HRC. We were pleasantly surprised by the excellent service we received and the delicious food, and all within a stones throw of Jonker street and Dutch square. Show less

Author: Redfella83
Title: Was just here for drinks
Review: Prices are a bit higher than the rest of down though happy hour is pretty good, really friendly staff.

Author: Kenyukai7Jersey, United Kingdom
Title: As Rocking as ever!
Review: I am a big fan of Hard Rock, I like the way the restaurants are set up and the fact that you always get good food and great music. This one was just as good as the many others we have visited.The service was also very good.Show less

Author: Ronald YSingapore
Title: Attentive Staff and Nice Food
Review: As I stood for a little more than 3 seconds outside the door simply browsing at the menu, I could see at the corner of my eye that the staff inside had sprang into action. Before I knew it, he came out to greet us and asked if we would like to come in for a drink.... well.... Nice atmosphere, great food, very attentive staff and what's more to say about HRC in Asia? They are generally of high standards.Show less

Author: MZW1730Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Nice surprise & excellent service
Review: was in Melaka for hari raya holiday recently. we were walking along jonker street and suddenly saw HRC. it was our wedding anniversary and the waiter attended to us worked our a surprise to my wife.food was good and standard HRC in KL.very attentive staffs.Show less

Author: ALR0609
Title: Standard HRC
Review: Pretty standard HRC, meaning it's good but not great. Nice decorations, nice environment to just chill. Especially in the evening when it's not too hot to sit on the verandah overlooking the melaka river, and with a view of the stadhuys.

Author: patcheahGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: A little bit dissappointed
Review: Overall the dinning experience was a bit disappointing. When we ask the waitress to take our order, she respond quite rudely that she is not taking any order and it is someone else doing it.I was surprise that HRC Melaka do not offer happy hour as Penang and KL does. Some of the food is not offered in Melaka but it does in Penang and KL.Show less

Author: GraceLuis87Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good..
Review: Whenever i travel with my family and friends if I see Hard Rock Cafe I must go and have a dinner there..HRC Melaka located in the middle of jonker street and easy to find..this place quite peaceful and silent,maybe because it's still new..but this place is nice because it's located near the Melaka river and good place to hangout with family and friends..Show less

Author: Gee_P_75Singapore, Singapore
Title: when you are looking for a safe bet
Review: location - at the beginning of Jonker Streetpremise - big and cooling in the heat of Malacca! nice and clean.staff - mostly polite, only 1 of the serve staff came across as rude and in your face but out of the 6 that served our table, that 1 guy wont make it worse.crowd - families mainly for lunch.food - good!! loved every mouth of the burgers!verdict - what's not to like Hard Rock Cafe? everywhere you go, it's quite good globally!? :)the only downer was that one of the waiting staff had to condone a rude and arrogant guest - that sight was more disturbing than bad food! but kudos to the waiting staff!Show less

Author: TKSuper368Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill out !
Review: There was a cover charge for Sat night but front desk let us in since we are tourists from Singapore. The ambience was great with live band. Food was alright.The main attraction is the location which is at the entrance to Jonker street, service staff is attentive, and great band !Although price is above average but this is what you pay for a great place !Show less

Author: ReccaHuang
Title: Good Food , Good Music
Review: Food was great. You can't go wrong with the Mushroom Swiss Burger. Also, wifi was a zillion time better than what i had at the Hotel.

Author: Hafizh PSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good food and staff
Review: The food here was delicious and the staff were very courteous - A place i would recommend - a Hard Rock Cafe which wouldn't make you feel home-sickShow less

Author: MaiMiniShah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Cool place to hang out with friends in Melaka
Review: Superb location....with river view....located above the very famous nasi ayam shop.....great place to be....especially with frens.....life music and super nice ambient.....food is expensive compare to most of surrounded restaurant but nothing compares to its location and ambient....at the end it's worth the money and fun place to be.......I always like nachos....my fave...and one more thingzzzz.....u can park under the restaurant.....so no hassle at all..... for a cost of course.....Show less

Author: tulipanmoradoPolaris, Montana
Title: Just as good as it should be!!
Review: Great atmosphere just like any other HRC!! The live band was very good when I was there. Oh not forgetting the mouth watering chocolate sundae that melt you heart!! Must have!! Worth spending some time here if you can afford (as you know the price range in HRC are not cheap)Show less

Author: lulur520Brighton, England, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing band and delicious food
Review: We had just arrived in Malaka and not quite got our bearings yet so decided to seek western food and Hard ROck more than obliged. The food was fantastic as in all hard rocks. My only gripe was that the happy hour prices (by one get one free) were actually increased from the usual menu so it was not bogof just get the second one cheaper. The real highlight of our evening was the band-they were outstanding. We will be returning for drinks just to see the band again-amazing voices,atmosphere and taking a wide range of requests. They even took time to come an say hi and shake our hands during their break.superstars.Show less

Author: Jeff HMorristown, New Jersey
Title: Escape for Westerners
Review: Food was great and restaurant air conditioned! Live music a few nights per week and it was actually pretty good. Overall good value for your money and a great spot for some drinks and dinner and it is right on the river! Beautiful at night!Show less

Author: BlaiseJOngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Attentive Service, Good Burgers
Review: I had to visit Hard Rock in Melaka to sample its ambiance, food and service. Upon arrival we were ushered in immediately and asked whether we wanted outdoor sitting or indoor. With the kids in tow we opted for the cool indoor sitting. Waiters were pleasant and they had good food and drink recommendations. Our orders were centered around the burgers and they were certainly delicious, each portion is enough for 2 adults unless you have a massive appetite. We were had an early dinner around 7pm on a week day so I am not really sure how are the weekend and late evening crowds. Good restaurant for the kids as they were given crayons and take away kids menu's that provided some entertainment while the grown ups chatted away. Definitely, worth a visit even though its a bit pricey...With quality and comfort comes a price worth paying.Show less

Author: THEVOICE15Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Burger is really Legendary!
Review: One of the best burgers I have ever had - Legendary Burger 10oz. Juicy; tasty and filling! Love the fried onion ring and crispy bacon on the burger. Great service; excellent food and the music! And, the location is excellent - just right outside Jonker Street. Hence, a good place to chill after the shopping!Show less

Author: John MDallas, Texas
Title: There is a Hard Rock in Melaka
Review: I have been coming to Melaka on business for several years and was happy and surprised to see the Hard Rock here. They have a really great location in the city and it's always fun to visit a Hard Rock wherever I go. I do enjoy the local food but sometimes you just want something to remind you of home. The Hard Rock does that with great service and some good food selections. Go - you'll enjoy the food, the people, and the atmosphere.Show less

Author: Poliwhirl
Title: Huge portions
Review: Busy restaurant, no reservations so you wait if its busy. Huge portions, not cheap, live music later in the evening (saturday). Nice experience.

Author: BubblezzzSingapore
Title: Not a bad spot to chill out
Review: Good escape from the heat and standard fare to be expected from most Hard Rock chains. Service was decent with reasonably attentive staff. What I found a little awkward: Our server kept patting my husband on his back a few and reached out to shake our hands as we left. I am sure this must be management implemented so I don't blame the guy in the least. But it was weird. Management: Please reconsider this touching and hand shaking policy. I can only guess that is supposed to make us feel more welcomed but it's back firing... I don't expect to be friends with my waiter and I'm sure all the hand shaking is not the most sanitary considering his responsibility is food service.Show less

Author: Mork0707
Title: Nice
Review:
The location is at the heart of major tourists spots. Food quality is at par with other hard rock cafes.

We went there for the souvenirs as we were ardent collector of HRC t-shirts, guitar pins and short glasses.

Author: FlemingC21
Title: Nice place to hang out
Review:
Nice place to chill out and relax after visited night market.
First drink charge 40rm.
There is a live band. Entertaining.

Author: AnneFlowersSingapore, Singapore
Title: Happy to see a Hardrock cafe at Jonker street
Review: Great place to get a drink after tiring out from Jonker Walk. The service staff was friendly and cocktails were good. A great reprieve after a walk in the sun! Show less

Author: HermitOSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad
Review: Service is good, food is good, ambience is good. Sat at the balcony and the view is beautiful. Singer is not really good. Show less

Author: EricOngMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Keep Rocking
Review: What can you expect from a Hard Rock except for some good rocking time? Ambiance here definitely above and beyond. It is just the place where you can let your hair down, sip a beer, and tune in to the classic rock and rolls!Menu wise is quite straightforward, typical dishes that you can expect from a Hard Rock. Service is good as the waiters and waitresses are ever ready to please you.Show less

Author: AT29erKuala Lumpur
Title: Not a name expected to be found in the city's historic quarter
Review: Brilliantly located at the edge of Jonker, next to the river and overlooking the Stadhuys. Standard HRC fare, with some local dishes thrown in. Not as smokey and loud like the ones in KL and Penang - giving it a family restaurant feel, which really isn't a bad thing. Our server had very obvious BO, something which the manager should have picked up and addressed. Overall, a rockin' dining experience. Show less

Author: Jasmine PDurban, South Africa
Title: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka, Malaysia
Review: Enjoyed a lovely boat ride along the river taking us to Hard Rock Cafe. Great ambience and environment. Food was delicious - largest onion rings I have ever seen! Food also came quickly considering there were 15 of us. Staff were super, friendly and jovial. Lovely experience, high recommend.Show less

Author: SuperGastSouth Pole
Title: Nice but also an expensive place
Review: The prices for alcoholic drinks are high and more comparable to hotel prices then other café's. Actually I can only remember a few places in KL which charges the same.Had a bit of finger food which was tasty, but nothing great either.Décor is nice though. Staff is very friendly and the service is on an average speed.Worth checking out if you haven't. But don't bother going all the way to Melaka for HR either.Show less

Author: PravinKumarKLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: Waited for quite some time as the place was crowded (which was not a problem at all). Nice environment and with friendly staffs. Drinks were good. Food on the other hand is overrated, it was rather taste less. Wouldn't recommend to have your dinner over here, as it would be nice to hang out.Show less

Author: June08ngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Escape from Crowded Jonker Street!
Review: If you are ever in Melaka on a public holiday or weekend you will know how busy and crowded the famous Jonker Street is !To seek refuge - zip into the Hard Rock Cafe which is located at the end of Jonker Street facing the famous Dutch Stradhuys building to chill out . Menu fare is standard as can be expected from any Hard Rock Cafe across the world . We had the usual burgers , mixed platter and desserts of brownie and ice cream.However do step out into their balcony which has a lovely view of the river and Stradhuys . Nice ambience for dining in the evening outdoors if you don't mind the occasional mosquitos!Show less

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: good music with a lovely view to chill...
Review: Headed here to have some drinks and chill during the afternoon. They have a good selection of beers on tap or bottle however rather pricey. Guess you are paying for being in Hard Rock.Sat outside overlooking the river. Nice view, breezy and great to watch the world go by. Ended up spending 3 hours and lots of pints.Service is reasonable. Décor is typical Hard Rock. Can't speak about the food as we never tried anything. Would recommend a stop just to enjoy the HR experience.Show less

Author: Shenz643Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Terrible
Review: The food is really horrible and the service is rock bottom. We have ordered grilled chicken with gravy sauce and the gravy is tasteless (NO SALT). This was highlighted to the waiter but he showed little or NO understanding of their food served. Furthermore, the manager explained the food is served according to western taste and it may not suit to our asian palate. Then why open a restaurant in MELAKA?! GO AND OPEN in the WESTERN COUNTRY! Further, she pointed out to us the PURPOSE why they put the SALT on the table and expects us to adjust to taste. I was floored when she said she cant do anything about the taste. Only when we further express our frustration, only she agreed to change the dish to another, which was equally bad . I could not believe this is the quality of food and service served at Hard Rock Cafe. I am VERY DISAPPOINTED and I will NEVER got there again. I will not recommend this place to anyone. RIDICULOUS.Show less

Author: Karends1101Cairns, Australia
Title: A must if you enjoy live music
Review: I don't usually bother with Hard Rock Cafes these days, but we were lured in by the live music signs outside. After having a drink and something to eat on the balcony, overlooking the river, we went inside when the band started. They were a group of seasoned musos playing well-known rock and roll songs. They were all very talented and got the audience involved; they were having fun, and the crowd had fun with them. My husband, a drummer, really got into it! A good way to spend a few hours in the evening.Show less

Author: kjell mSubic, Philippines
Title: As good as normal
Review: After having a bad lunch earlier today here in Melaka we was agree to eat at HRC here as we know what we will get, even it is more expensive the our lunch bistro. Good service and food as usual. Now we have been in all HRC in Malaysia incl. HRH at Penang, and this here is the best HRC in MY(HRC KK is only a shop)Show less

Author: Brenda72_11Sur Masirah, Oman
Title: perfect location, friendliest staff
Review: The location of this place is perfect, just across the bridge in front of the Stadthuys. Inside it's nice and cool, and although a large room and amazing high ceiling it still gives the feeling of a home. Very very friendly staff.Show less

Author: XYTravellerAsia
Title: Food and service have lots of room for improvement
Review: We had 5 starters/salad and 6 mains. We had to request several times before everyone had their utensils. Plastic bowls for kids came in wet, some even have a pool of water in it. Were given 6 inch bread and butter plate since we are sharing the orders which in my opinion is way too small (3 pcs of nacho is all it can carry). We wanted the Caesar salad with grilled salmon and ended up with just plain Caesar salad.Show less

Author: Kimberly BCairo, Egypt
Title: Bad service
Review: This restaurant was not our first choice, but when the rain started to fall, we decided to go for it. There was one kind of confusion with our water order, and the beer my husband ordered never arrived. Our food arrived at all different times and based on the condition of the French fries when the food did arrive, I am pretty sure that the food was sitting around for a bit too. It was hard to find our server to get anything. Th cost of the food suddenly seems high when half of it is unpalletable and no one checking on quality. If it had been busy in the restaurant perhaps I could understand. But, it was not busy at all. The burger and the satay were good though. Had the service been better, I am certain our experience would have been as well. Perhaps if we stayed in Melaka longer we would have returned.Show less

Author: HanifflaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Another Hard Rock experience in the Ancient City of Melaka, Malaysia.
Review: Good atmosphere with good generous food though the price is relatively high! For an experience, it's always interesting to enjoy the dinner and evening with great local band. The service is generally satisfying except that on that evening at about 8pm, they have ran out of beef ribs!! A big cheer to this cafe overall.Show less

Author: Djmegena
Title: Very bad experience
Review: I've been on a tuesday evening with my girlfriend. Looking for something to eat but unfortunatelly at 23 the kitchen was closed (on internet website opening hour for restaurant it's till 1am daily...), we decide to take some snacks but also those were not available (finished french fries ???). Ok after a annoing strong push of the waiter to buy more drinks, we ask for the payment, and without notice they didn't give back the change (aprox 20% of the total) and we had to search the waiter to get our change.... I've been in many many Hard Rock around the world, and this is definitely the worst experience i had in Hard Rock. Show less

Author: piggiewiggieIsle of Wight, United Kingdom
Title: wow
Review: Went here several times in the sort while I was in Malacca. Food was very good. The staff were friendly and polite. The atmosphere was good. Situated just off the bridge near Jonker Street and opposite the tourist office it is nicely placed. With live music at night.Show less

Author: dino1963Singapore
Title: Great food
Review: Went to HRC Melaka with my family of four (2 young kids) during my one night stay at Puri Hotel. The staff are all very friendly and tried to assist in anyway. There are 2 sections, one being indoor with air-con and another outdoor, which has a beautiful river view. Although its non-smoking restaurant, we saw people smoking at the outdoor sitting. It really does not bother me at all. We knew that the portion was big and orders 2 portion only; beef steak and macaroni cheese. My kids love the food and we manage to finish all. Prices are naturally high but better compared to Singapore HRC. The live band come around 9pm and was told it’s a local band. It was really fantastic and truly enjoyed it as it was playing oldies songs. Yeah … my kids naturally don’t understand the songs as their favorite is K pop.Show less

Author: ghostriverKlang, Malaysia
Title: Disappointment visit to HRC
Review: I and my wife decided to spend our night live at Melaka by enjoying live band at Hard Rock Café. I’ve already been to few of HRC, so when they open their outlet in Melaka, I don’t want to miss the opportunity to visit the new HRCPARKINGIt’s quite difficult to find parking in Melaka. If you want to go to HRC Melaka, you can park under the HRC. Secure parking. I reached here around 9.30 pm and left at 1 am. My parking fee is RM25 – after get HRC stamp on the parking coupon. FOODBig portion and deliciousSTAFFFriendly and helpfulENVIRONMENTLike normal Hard Rock Café and it is free smoking zonePRICEStandard price for foods. Restaurant price. Drinking Water (not mineral water) for RM15. Please judge it by yourself if this is reasonable or not. LIVE BANDLive band start at 10pm. When I and my wife came here, they just have new band from Indonesia performed here. For music selection, I only can give 2 star. Only few rock song were performed by them. Most of it pop song with rock music. Totally disappointed on their live band performance. This time I feel like I was sitting in “Pop Rock Café”, not Hard Rock Café. Sound of the music instrument are too laud until overwhelm the singer voice especially the drum sound.Show less

Author: syamilmsc
Title: Enjoyable night....
Review: Dropped by for dinner and drinks. Staffs were pretty friendly and attentive, in line with hrc's hospitality and service standards. Food quality and taste, the same as all the other hrc I have been to. Band played good music. All in all, an enjoyable night.... :)Show less

Author: VinodN30
Title: Expensive.
Review: It was just way too expensive. Walk a little ahead and you'll get a Beer for RM16 instead of the RM32, with a river view to go with it. Just too pricy. Show less

Author: GerritS980
Title: Overpriced
Review: Nice location and venue with pleasant service but price of a cup of coffee exorbitant. Paying the bill feels unreal in Malayan terms. Expensie in Euro terms and very expensive for the location.Show less

Author: Catherine DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner
Review: The food here is so and so.portions are big .okay for a price that you pay.macaroni is good for starters."main course is good.Show less

Author: kingkongerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food!
Review: Superb Mac & Cheese! Must Try!! Really delicious! Big portion as well. Good service & river view. Although not so cheap compared to local streets food in Melaka but definitely worth a try if opting for a dressier night out chilling with cocktails or beers with a view.Show less

Author: JulieH5292
Title: Not bad
Review: The salmon sauce on top of it taste really nice. And the beef burger really taste great! Plan to celebrate birthday at HRC, how about birthday song :-/?Show less

Author: tontotaylorLightwater, United Kingdom
Title: Well it's Another Hard Rock Cafe
Review: Well there is not really a lot to say. It's another Hard Rock Cafe in another City. View whilst sitting outside is good, looking across the river. Service is as usual spot on as is the food. Show less

Author: rizzzlSingapore
Title: Love All, Serve All?
Review: A day trip on 27 October to Malacca included lunch at HRC. The NY steak was superb but the service crew left much to be desired. Not as attentive and did not follow-up on the patrons as other HRC we went to before. Especially when there were less than 10 tables full. Perhaps it was a lazy, rainy Sunday afternoon for all....Show less

Author: LoveTheTropicsSydneySydney
Title: Great Location and Excellent Service
Review: As HRCs go this one is quite unique. L:ocated right on the Melaka River, it is an outstanding oasis on a hot day.Only had a drink here and enjoyed the aircon, but the rock memorabilia was better than many HRCs.As a building, it is a but out of place, being a new building in a neighbourhood of 15th to 19 century buildings - but they have managed to merge it in well.Service is attentive and prices reasonable.Show less

Author: wordtraveller13London, United Kingdom
Title: Have had better else where
Review: When I am travelling I try stick to local food but every now and then we crave 'western' food. It was an average, generic burger and chicken tendons. It was quite expensive too, but I guess that's the Hard Rock price. If you are looking for an amazing burger go to the Baboon House.Show less

Author: ShellywUKSeoul, South Korea
Title: Great Atmosphere, service and location
Review: We are been to quite a few HRC around the world and we were pretty impressed here. We were celebrating my husbands birthday and this was the perfect place to celebrate with our friends. The atmosphere, service were excellent.The 4 points instead of 5 is because I thought the food could be better, they should go to Baboon House down the road, now thats what a burger should taste like!We will be back for sure when we are back in MelakaShow less

Author: MusicaltjSingapore, Singapore
Title: Another great Hard Rock Cafe
Review: I have visited Hard Rock cafe's around the world and this was on par with what i have come to expect from this chain. The food was excellent and cheaper in comparison to other HRC i have been to! The cocktails we had were very nice and the service was very accommodating and swift. It was also my friends birthday and all the staff went out of their way to sing happy birthday and make our experience a little more special. One small tip, dont sit too close to the tree near the bridge on the balcony at night - the birds are noisy! (The servers warned us about this however so listen to them when they tell you haha!)Show less

Author: Blackmark1Brisbane, Australia
Title: Pity about the nachos!
Review: Family outingFriendly staff, good for Malaysian standards but are clearly not managed well as they seem to have their own little conversations going on that distracts them occasionally.Atmosphere and outdoor views excellent.Kids loved it.Food was good except the nachos. Worst nachos ever. Big does not make up for lack of quality ingredients.RM45 for a large nachos with little other than corn chips covered in cheese that tasted like sliced processed cheese. I have no words to explain how bad it tasted. & the salsa on the side was too thick to use in the smallest container ever seen.It's already expensive so just charge me RM10 more and do it properly or don't do it at allOther than that the atmosphere was well worth it.Best BBQ chicken ever said my son.Show less

Author: gfbkim
Title: Common comparison
Review: I've read the reviews and had to say that comparing a five star hotel and two star is like and apple and an orange..HRC Melaka has made a landmark in Melaka and a place not only for the rich but also for others..It is a once a while place for some and an every week occasion for some..Service and staff is absolutely friendly and accommodating ..furthermore the place comes with full live band.We cant expect less but more from HRC..The set lunch is reasonable and sometimes is more than enough for one.Am sure that HRC will also try to cater for more and to improve on other areas to make it an elite place to be for all...Show less

Author: AzmythKL
Title: Not impressed
Review: Stopped in Malacca on our way back from Johore just to check this one out and well..wasnt impressed. at all. ushered very nicely and that's about it. the bar tenders were having their own good time and making more noise than anyone else there. food and drinks were good-would have been really upset if they werent! and since malacca is a smoke free zone you will not be allowed to smoke inside. which can be a lil frustrating as you gotta come out just to take a puff-even then you're expected to smoke at their little designated area-with policemen keeping an eye on you. wasnt a very comfortable experience altogether. would i go back? nah.Show less

Author: PriscillaGorillaCanberra, Australia
Title: Loads of fun and a great place to relax and have a cocktail
Review: We called in here on our way from mass at St Francis Xavier (we were headed to Jonker Walk) and ended up staying for hours! It was a pit stop because I needed the bathroom and Hard Rock seemed like a safe bet. Many, many margaritas and an icecream sundae with a candle in it (it was my birthday) later we eventually cabbed it back to our hotel. The hospitality was great. Manager Suresh and his staff (including the lovely Sabrina and Joseph) were extremely friendly and gave us lots of information about the area and some great tips about things to see. We did eat some starters which were great. Fabulous atmosphere, great management, loved the staff. Will definitely visit again.Show less

Author: iamblu0885Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice drink and relax place
Review: They have a nice drink and a nice view when you sit outside or at the bar counter. Its kinda crowded, hard to get a table.Show less

Author: MoChehab53Orlando, Florida
Title: Hard Rock Cafe in Malacca
Review: The place opened in 2013 and is still new. It sits on the river, near Dutch square. It is typical Hard Rock cafe, food is typical and expected. Not too great but ok if you run out of food choices around, which was our case. Service needs improvement.Show less

Author: HanermanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The staff (including kitchen) need training
Review: Such excellent potential falling short is disappointing. The serving staff is mainly very inexperienced and seemingly unable to think for themselves. Their attitude, however, is excellent and hopefully they improve. The food is pretty hit and miss, although you can never go wrong with the burgers there. Too bad it's halal as well, but I suppose that's Malaysia Show less

Author: Marg22Ashburton, New Zealand
Title: Cool cafe - A wlecome break from the heat
Review: We have recently visited Hard Rock Café in Malacca and enjoyed and greatly enjoyed the food.It is a well appointed café by the river in the centre of town and serves a reasonable variety of food. Their service was good and staff very helpful with directions.Show less

Author: hv_subang
Title: Not like the others...
Review: Had a late afternoon meal at the Hard Rock and entrance, restaurant, memorabilia and guest service was very ordinary.

Author: NazdemMurrumbeena, Australia
Title: Great food you won't be disappointed
Review: We came here for lunch and my partner had a burger and I had the chicken Fajitas. Part of the hard rock chain so you just expect the food to be quite good and yes it did live up to expectations. My fajitas were fresh and very generous serving. My partner wasn't initially happy with his burger so they took it back and quickly replaced it. We were very happy about the service. We were so impressed we even came back for dinner where I had CHar Kway Teo, that also impressed! Service is good, food is great also. The only thing I would like to add though is we sat outside for dinner and there were no smoking signs everywhere yet they allow people to smoke and say "at your own risk" never in my life have we heard or seen anything more ridiculous. If you have signs stating no smoking then everyone should abide by the rules and you as a restaurant should enforce this aswell. Not only are other customers feeling uncomfortable and making their dining experience unpleasant but you are also showing that you don't care about these laws and don't care to do anything about it. The easy option, just to forget about it and let arrogant customers and tourists abuse the law.Show less

Author: vicchiam93
Title: Rocking experience
Review: I went for a drink with my friends during this trip to malacca,definitely recommend this place for their nice band DV8,but there is a slight problem,there are still kids at night past 10.30pm dancing in front,while there are some vulgarity in the songs sang. Btw the cocktail performance was stunning,its really up to my expectation. Great collection displaying, Bruce Springsteen and Beatles jacket,Aerosmith and van halen's guitar.Show less

Author: TelarisExplorerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rocking' Melaka
Review: I was there for 2 night straight having coffee with my cousin and friends. It's not a cheaper place for hang out but that night, HRC offered 50% for coffee and tea. Located just beside Melaka river which you can see few cruise and red clock tower from HRC. Interior was nice and spacious and the music played by experience rock band, so far it was a cozy place to chill and hang out with friends. As for the HRC staff very friendly and the service was good.Show less

Author: JeffreyLimGMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to escape the crowded street!
Review: They may not have the cheapest beer in Malacca, but they definitely the best ambiance for a drink! I was exploring Jonker Street and looking for a cafe or quiet place to have a drink until I came to Hard Rock. Their warm and friendly staffs helps you to forget the crowded and busy street of Jonker Walk.I personally recommend you to get the high table at outdoor. Although there's no air-con or fan, the view across the river and famous Malacca Red House is definitely worth it.Show less

Author: SunriseSkiSingapore
Title: Best Hamburger in a very long time
Review: Hot day, lots of traffic, walking around dusty crowded streets with three kids, hungry and thirsty. And there it is, the Hard Rock Cafe. Climbing up the few steps at the entrance, being warmly welcome, doors opened and you enter a mix of church, concert hall and museum. A large room, cool temperature, calm and quiet, some rock music playing not too loud, and you are transported into another place and time. OK, if you are not into rock nostalgia of the 60's, 70's and 80's, then you still must go to this place. The hamburgers were the best in such a long time, from the meat all the way to the bun. Waiting time went by very fast also for the kids, they were immediately taken care of with drawing and play material and cold drinks. The staff, all of them, attentive and fast.Show less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful decor
Review: As my title says, I am not shouting about the service/food/drinks as much as I should as I didn't think the service was fantastic for Hard Rock's standards. I was here for drinks with friends and the only thing that stood out for me was the interior - it has been beautifully designed, truly classic Hard Rock. The staff who attended to us wasn't very well versed with the drinks. I would assume an establishment like this would have trained its staff well to be able to answer basic questions about their drinks list. It was an ok experience - nothing to shout about. The drinks were not all that fantastic either, with the exception of the long island which a couple of my friends had. My pomegranate martini took forever to arrive and when it did, I felt it tasted more like pomegranate juice as opposed to alcohol. And of course, the drinks were pricey which I suppose is normal for Hard Rock's standards, but it should be worth what we pay for.Show less

Author: lostpatrolasiaGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Not So Hot
Review: Very expensive.I had the large burger tasted of old grease.And the fries were soggy.Outrageous prices for beer.Stick to the Chinese Coffee Shops in futureShow less

Author: Danny YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Staff should be more attentive.
Review: Food was below par compared to the other HRC that we've been to. We ordered the Salmon and the fish is overcooked. Cheeseburger tasted rather bland and the bun was not toasted.The Pulled chicken sandwich was however quite nice.When all our main course was served we wanted to add on a order of chicken satay. Told one of the staff about it, he nodded, replied 'sure no problem' and went away. After we finished our meal and waited for another 15 minutes more, we check with another staff, she said we already got all our meal (except desserts) and when we asked about the extra order, she went away and checked with the kitchen. Only to come back 10 minutes later to tell us that 'no more chicken satay'. Didn't even say sorry. We were surprised that the staff just now did not come to inform us and we waited there like a fool. Staff could be more attentive instead of joking around with other staff and talking to each other laughing out loud.Felt so turned off by the level of service from the staff, we cancelled our order of desserts, pay for the bills and heads back to hotel.Show less

Author: JoanneLeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Dissapointed.
Review: First impression of the place was good. Comfortable dining area overlooking the infamous Dutch Square.Staff quickly usher us to table, hand us menu and went off. Another staff came and introduce herself as our server and went off again. It wasn't a really busy night, it was us, another table of four diners, and another table for six diners having meal. Some guest was sitting at bar table outside having couple of drinks.The server came back after went missing for 10 minutes and we waved at her to come take our order. The food was nothing to shout about. The chicken legendary burger that we ordered was a total disappointment. The chicken was too dry and tasted bland, the onion ring in the burger was soggy and the fries was quite cold, not even warm. The Mac and cheese was quite diluted and the macaroni is overcooked.We also had the Nachos and the Chocolate Fudge Brownies. The brownies tasted really good tho.After we had our meal and decided to have the bill, we waved at one of the crew. He looked our way, and looked away. We look for the attention of other staff but everybody ignored us. Few minutes later a staff came out with a sundae and a candle. Well apparently one of the guest is celebrating his birthday here so all staff was singing happy birthday to the guest and ignored us who only wants to pay the bill and attempting to do so for 15 minutes. IMHO, you want to sing birthday song to the guest then by all means please go ahead, but you don't ignore the other guest who just wants to settle the bill and have been trying to do so even before you want to sing your birthday song. This is unacceptable customer service and I seriously did not expect it from a reputable restaurant like HRC.And the staff came later with bill and we hand him the credit card. So just when I thought we can pay for the meal and get out from here, he was chit chatting was laughing away with the one who's charging the card at the counter. And it took another 10 minutes, unbelievable!All in all a very disappointing visit, such a great place with so much potential, what a shame. =(Show less

Author: eYeLeNePenang
Title: HRC by the river
Review: Did not eat there but went there with friends to hangout and for drinks. Cover charge was RM40 for a list of drinks. The waiters were really good and attentive.The band was really good and the atmosphere was really nice. Crowd was quite passive for a HRC and we went after a wedding dinner!The view out from HRC was really good as it is by the river.Show less

Author: walkin_ez
Title: As HRC Could Ever Be
Review: Comparing to HRC in Singapore, here has better service, the waitress was really tentative and order came quite reasonably quick. The setup is more open which makes it a great place to chill come with larger group. However the ceiling could do better like what they did in Beijing, artistic painting of the greats and legend singers. Definitely meeting up the expectation, a must drop for Melaka visitors.Show less

Author: BL_LeoPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great dining experience by the river
Review: Located very near to Jonker Street and 3 minutes walk from my hotel... went here for dinner after evening stroll along Jonker Walk on Friday. Initially we wanted to sit by the river but thinking of the smell of the river, we changed our plan and chose to sit inside the restaurant. Service was attentive and food was served fast, true to their Hard Rock spirit. Show less

Author: Wish_t0_travel_m0reSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice but very expensive
Review: As a vegetarian I am glad to see that they have something for me. But do check with the waiter/waitress on what you can or can't eat. They can make special arrangements for you. The ambience was great and food was nice and came in big proportion too.But dinning here is our last option as it's really expensive...Show less

Author: peterktanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, waiter could be more attentive
Review: It's been a while since I stepped into a Hard Rock Café anywhere - mainly because I'm not overly fond of American food. But I was delighted to see the Malaccan dish, the assam pedas fish offered - which was delightful. The apple cobbler was good though it was strangely salty (was it salty caramel or salty cream? I couldn't tell). My wife asked the waitress for milk for her tea. The milk never came though. It should have been brought automatically.Show less

Author: KiansoonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food
Review: Hard Rock Cafe Melaka (or Malacca) opens in January 2013. It is not hard to find since it is right at the beginning of Jonker Street, a popular tourist area. Be sure to make use of their happy hour where it is 1 for 1 drinks.Food is delicious and price is reasonable. Be careful not to order too much though, the portions are really big. Staff are conversant in English and very friendly. Free Wifi is available on request.Live bands starts from 2200hrs till 0100hrs.Show less

Author: Woon29Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place and great staff.
Review: We were glad to come to Hard Rock Cafe after walking through the humid and crowded Jonker's Street. We were given a CD cover and informed that our table will be ready when they call out the artist's name. We found it very interesting. The service staff were all very helpful and attentive. Food was great.Show less

Author: DirtyErnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best bar in Malacca
Review: Just had a great night at HRC. We managed to get four seats at the bar together. Looking through the bar and out onto the river, what a view of the historical fort and church! Friendly and fun staff kept our glasses full. We all ordered standard HR fare, the food was very consistent with the other Rocks. Great, festive atmosphere on a busy night.Other then the many techno and KTV clubs in Melaka Raya, few hotel lobby bars, or the small places around Jonker's historical area, this is the only real bar with R&R music, in Melaka. Keep up the good work, guys and gals.Show less

Author: euphmagDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Decent Hard Rock Cafe
Review: We went in for a drink. As with most Hard Rock Cafes drinks are very expensive. I had a Long Island iced tea which was predominately ice, it was okay I guess. The staff were friendly and they had live music on later in the evening but we didn't stay to watch it. It looked like a cool building and as always has some cool memorabilia. Show less

Author: fendi rJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Hard Music in the River
Review: Excellent live band with nice staff plus perfect location, this place is recommended to chill you up. Only the food not really delicious. The live band performance started from 10pm till 01am. If you order food or snack, you can have a table in the middle. This place was opened just one month before we came, so everything was very clean and nice.Show less

Author: coco_kutingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chilled beer in a hot afternoon
Review: We loved the coldness of our beers, and the crispiness of the wedges. The young male staff was very accommodating, we asked for money changer, taxi, etc and he answered willingly :-)Show less

Author: 2013Nick1808Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great place but not so great location.
Review: We have a Hard Rock Cafe all over the world and now a Hard Rock Cafe in Malacca. The food and drinks are that which are expected of Hard Rock Cafes all over the world but this new joint in Malacca though it's strategically located - right in the heart of the old city of Malacca. Coming by way of the famous Clock Tower, walk up the bridge across the Malacca River and turn right into the narrow one way street. At the corner is the famous chicken rice ball shop, just a very short distance away, on your right is the new Malacca Hard Rock Cafe situated on the spot of a former market.Parking is available if you are driving but I would advise you to leave your car somewhere else (recommended parking is near the parking area close to St. Francis Xavier Church at the Central Police Station). Perhaps, it may be a good idea to walk around Jonker Walk first and when the legs get wobbly and the throats yearns for a cool drink, then head for Hard Rock Cafe to unwind.Show less

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Not a Hard Rock
Review: I am a supporter of Hard Rock and if the city I visit has a Hard Rock, I will definitely go for a drink or snack.Alas, the hostess asked me twice whether I am drinking or eating, informed me if drinking, cover charge RM40. Well, we expected to pay especially on a weekend. The gin is so diluted and served in a small tumbler, very unlike Hard Rock standards.For a historical town like Melaka, hope the Management do something to improve the value for money. Tourists do not like to be ripped off.Hope on my next visit, it can be betterShow less

Author: Ruzana AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, good entertainment!
Review: We had Salmon Teriyaki, Salmon Grill and Steak. Portions were big, and really tasty. When we arrived, there was a queue for table and were told to wait abt 20-30mins. We took our time to browse the merchandise at the Hard Rock shop. To our suprise, our table was ready just about 5mins after our arrival.NRG band was playing for the 1st night. The song selection was great, except for the 2nd set....the songs too mellow for me (maybe due to the requests from guests). The female singer is not as good as the male singers.I've been to many Hard Rock Cafe in other part of the world. But Melaka has one of the nicest set-up. It has a family friendly environment, and right at the middle of the tourist centre in Melaka. Show less

Author: BabaMama01KL
Title: I'll take my $ elswhere..
Review: Our family of 2 adults and 5 kids went there looking for a decent supper. Parking is at basement...opt for valet and you'll get some discount off if HRC stamp your parking ticket. It was 10.30 pm after an hour waiting for our table. Since we already had dinner..we ordered 4 kids meal and jumbo gumbo which was a big mistake. Apparently, there is this chap (could be the same guy from 'autotripper' review May 2013) came around the table next to us...telling his story about this jumbo gumbo. He makes the acclaimed 'enough to share food' is a ' distasteful' menu As a local tourist..I feel ashamed with the local attitude.Most of their younger staff seems professional enough. A bit un balance compared to this guy. For the price with the experience...some areas are certainly lacking.Show less

Author: UnderpaidSamuraiSingapore, Singapore
Title: The Chef(s) Need A Performance Review, Right Away
Review: I really liked this place. It's by the river, at the foot of the entrance to Jonker Street. After a busy morning of river cruises and lots of walking, I decided to take my family in so we could cool down with a beer.Although there were no tables indoors, the service staff managed to get us a table in 10 mins which I really appreciate. The deco inside is great and there's lots of memoribilia and walking space.However, the food was poor. And that's an understatement.I had the New York Sirloin Steak which was tasteless and I had to get tobasco sauce so it could be palatable. And my wife had the nasi goreng, which again was tasteless. I find this quite incredible.Show less

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Not the best...
Review: Being locals we thought that it would be wise to let the restaurant 'warm up' after its opening in January so this was our first visit. So all went well getting there. Seats were available for our family and our 3 year old was given a high chair after we requested for one. He was given an entertainment pack too so that made the first half our easy for us! (TQ)The orders were taken and our drinks and food arrived within not much waiting time. I must add that they were rather full! Thumbs up to that!Food presentation was ok; As expected. Food quality however I must say can be improved. Our guest had nasi goreng which she claims was good. The mac & cheese portion was a wee bit smaller than I recall. (I last had it at HRC Penang). The fries were overdone. The burger was dry and tasteless. Although it could've been our fault because my husband requested to omit cheese and onions... Not sure that should make a huge difference tho.Bill payment was smooth. Oh and the people are nice and friendly! That's a wonderful point and I cannot miss out! Anyhow, overall ok. Nothing to shout about besides being Hard Rock Cafe :) Might be back...Show less

Author: autotripperUSA
Title: Mismanaged
Review: This was our first Hard Rock Cafe experience. We ate dinner here and came back the next day for a drink by the bar, before our driver was scheduled to pick us up. At dinner, the restaurant was very busy. We did not wait very long for a table, but it was a rather long time before we were approached to order drinks, and then way too long before our food order was taken. We did not receive our drinks until after our food arrived. In any restaurant, that is unacceptable, but in the hot humid climate of Malaysia, it is ridiculous. Oh, and a while after our food order was taken, another server came over and wanted to take our order. They seemed to have plenty of friendly willing employees, but no organization. We soon realized that the servers were not assigned to seat sections, but would just go around arbitrarily taking orders from any table. The food we finally received was just OK. The next problem was getting someone to bring us our bill. Another very long wait. We resolved not to eat there again during our visit.
