But the next day, with an hour to kill waiting for our driver, and that very hot climate I mentioned, we figured (hoped?) 60 minutes would be sufficient to order drinks, consume them, and pay the bill. The restaurant was only half full that afternoon, and we sat at one of the high top tables next to the bar. We were hopeful that this experience would be better than the night before because we noticed a man rushing around in an authoritative manner, ordering employees around, although not actually doing any work. His presence made no difference in the quality of the service. It was still extremely difficult to get someone to take our order. They were all running around looking very busy. A polite young man finally stopped and we ordered our drinks. Twenty minutes passed and we still did not have them. We could see the bartender and was filling drink orders very intently, but I think it was too much for 1 bartender. As soon as we received our drinks, we started asking for our bill, because we now realized that was going to be another eternity and our driver was due soon. Employees promised to bring the bill, but it never came. Finally we looked up the prices on the menu, added a gratuity (even though we probably should not have), and handed the cash to a nearby server (who looked very bewildered), and left.Show less

Author: Debbie ABangkok, Thailand
Title: A1 Service
Review: We went for lunch and were expecting the normal service you get when in asia which can be lacking compared to western service standards. There was 7 of us including two children, the youngest one was provided with some canyons and a colouring sheet while we waited, which was no long. The first meals out were the children's meals the first time I have ever seen this happen, and I have lived in asia for over 12 months. The food portions were very generous and very tasty. We did have to send one meal back as it was undercooked, but the manager keep advising us during the further cooking how long it would be, he even provide us with a free coffee while we waited. The children were even treat to some balloon art by one of the staff. We were very pleasantly surprised, keep up the great work, nice to see service can be done in asia.Show less

Author: Oratory1Singapore, Singapore
Title: one of the best hard rocks
Review: we had a drink here for my birthday. It's small compared to other hard rocks. The food menu is the same everywhere. But the view is fantastic overlooking the river with the historical buildings in the background. We had a seat at the bar which adds to the experience of the evening. It is well worth a visit here.Show less

Author: amperre
Title: Good food as always
Review: Goood food as always! I found my Hard Rock favorites and where happy! The service was great. You findHard Rock in the beginning of China Town. The pricesare higher than other restaurants, but worth it!

Author: mark c
Title: Burgers and Balloons
Review: new, funky,great location, good service and a waiter making balloon flowers to amuse our daughters whilst waiting for the food. HR style food isnt my favourite but the service makes for a great lunch.

Author: Denstrip
Title: Fun Place
Review: Make sure you are there early as there is always a line up to get in. Great place to sit and enjoy the atmosphere, well worth just sitting at the bar to have a drink even if you don't want a meal.

Author: IcebergMelting
Title: Great Place to have A drink!
Review: A mixed of the old and the new architecture. Different kind of Hard Rock Cafe! The bar and the terrace sitting, looking over the Melaka River was great.

Author: tenby50Coolum Beach, Australia
Title: Non smoking not enforced
Review: We went to this HRC in April 2013 and when we entered we were asked whether we would like to sit inside or outside, we asked were patrons allowed to smoke outside and were advised that it wa a non smoking establishment which we were very pleased about. Halfway through our meal we noticed a patron smoking just 15 meters away, enough for the smoke to reach our table. I summoned our waiter and asked what he was to do about this. I saw him speak with the smoker and he returned a couple of minutes later to advise us that he is a regular customer and there was nothing he could do about this. A few minutes after this absurd statement the manager (name withheld but available) approached us stating that he could not do anything about it. We left shortly after this, my wife could not finish her meal and I paid but made sure I had a word with the manager and to get his business card as we were staying at Casa Del Rio the owners of the HRC. Once he knew I was going to speak with the hotel manage he offered to pay our males which was too late as we had paid. So don't eat here if you wish to be smoke free. I hope they learn from our experience.Show less

Author: Salahuddin79
Title: Lunch at Hard Rock Melaka
Review: Love it! The Ambience, the food, the service are excellent! I think Hard Rock Melaka is better than KL!

Author: SuunytimesEssex
Title: Tasteless and bland
Review: This has only been open a couple of weeks when we went and very busy. We only went as we try and go to Hard Rocks all over the world. This one was the worst, food was tasteless and bland, it was also very expensive. I would not recommend.Show less

Author: boo_tofuKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rocking times at Hard Rock Cafe Melaka
Review: Dined here for a treat. Really strategically located, nice facade that suits the area and great service! Food price a bit expensive though....Show less

Author: CLM81Suva, Fiji
Title: Disappointing
Review: I normally really enjoy visiting Hard Rock cafes, and was looking forward to going to this one in Melaka as it is newly opened. Sadly, the service we received was nowhere near the standard I have come to expect of Hard Rock Cafes. The waitress taking our order was interupted by another waiter whilst taking our order, so she just walked away without saying anything to us and I then watched her standing at the bar conversing with other staff. I had to call her back over to finish taking our order. I thought I would try one of the Asian dishes on offer and ordered the Nasi Goreng which in my opinion was way too spicy. I don't mind a bit of spice but I couldn't even eat this - there were big chunks of chilii all the way through it - I've had Nasi Goreng plenty of times before in other restaurants and it's never been served that spicy. We asked for our bill and after 5 minutes the waiter that had taken away our credit card came back and asked if we had gotten our card back yet. We said no, then he disappeared again for another 5 minutes. We saw him walking back towards our table and tried to get his attention - he noticed and clearly he had forgotten us because as soon as he saw us he turned straight back towards the cashier desk and retrieved our card back for us. I would not bother going back to this venue.Show less

Author: AshleyNicholasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good, clean, efficient, friendly and fun
Review: I went with my family for lunch. It has a good view over the river if you're looking for a meal or drink with a view. It was a hot day so we sat inside in the aircon which was a nice cool escape from the heat. The restaurant was very clean which was a nice change to walking around some of the dusty tourist roads of Melaka. The menu was fairly extensive, the portions generous and the food quality perfectly acceptable and tasty. They had a kids menu for the children with some variety. The staff were friendly and fun and we had a good enjoyable lunch.Show less

Author: WorldBreezeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Went there,saw it,bought the T-shirt;But the only thing rocking was the babies in their pushchairs!
Review: We went here on a weekend trip to Melaka. The Hard Rock Cafe is indeed in a nice location, but appears somewhat out-of-place in this historical area. We thought we'd give it a try, after all It was hot outside and we were hungry....!Having first been to the Rock Shop, we went into the restaurant to have our lunch. The first impressions were that it was a nice spacious,clean place . However, I soon noticed that the Melaka HRC has followed after the KL cafe since its refurb a few years ago.... ie: Rather than being a 'Hard Rock' cafe for adults, couples and drinkers.... it is actually more like a MacDonalds: Dozens of noisy kids running around with balloons, even babies in pushchairs... I kept thinking that at any time, someone will appear dressed in a giant guitar or burger costume and start dancing gangnam style with the kiddies!The staff seem to have been completely thrown that we had entered via the shop rather than by the main entrance, as we sat at the table for around 10 minutes, completely ignored, before waving down a passing member of staff and requesting a food menu. The staff member walked all the way to the main door to get menus,handed them to us, and then immediately walked off again without even asking if we would like a drink while we decided on our meals......Nobody returned to take our order, so we waved down another member of staff who took our food (and ,finally,drinks).There was a member of staff who appeared to be employed solely to poke his head out of various doorways and shout 'rock and roll' in a stupid voice every now again. This was just annoying and retareded, especially when people were trying to be served but being ignored.The food came in good time:- Twisted mac,chicken & cheese, and a bacon cheeseburger. Both were almost the same as we would have got in HRC KL, though the sauce on the mac cheese was somewhat more watery.. The beer and lemondade were nice and cold . Everything was the same sky-high westernised prices as KL. At no point did anyone return to ask if we wanted another drink, even though our glasses remained empty for some considerable time and many staff walked past.... nobody asked if we had enjoyed our meal, or if we wanted dessert....so we asked for the bill, and left, almost tripping over a dozen children who were running around with balloons.The open-plan concept really doesnt do this place any favours. WIth all the kids running about, It just makes it look like a giant 'play barn' rather than a bar/restaurant.Went there,saw it,bought the T-shirt;But the only thing rocking was the babies in their pushchairs! May give this place another try if it decides to grow up....Show less

Author: TravelBulletinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Impressive But Nothing Big Deal
Review: Everything was as expected from that I expected them to do at Hard Rock cafes around the world. Been to a few and yes, their service here is on par with the rest. Staffs are very friendly and totally bring out the feeling of dining at Hard Rock Cafe.Food prices are above average but drinks are way over pricey. I would say, this is in Melaka and thus, the price should be lower. If you are in KL or SIngapore, then that's a whole different story.Didn't stay on for the band though.Overall, it is a good experience there and would definitely be back for more.Show less

Author: damiantehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Spacious with great staffs
Review: Went there on 4/4/13 after group meeting and was amazed of the ambience. The mixture of old building with new renovation just was the perfect blend. Staffs were friendly and courteous from the begining. Food portion was as usual large but still tasty. From the previous reviews, I believe they have improved. But what blew my mind was the band. Crazy good. Especially when they sang Bohemian Rhapsody. OMG! By that song alone, it is worth the trip again. Go check it outShow less

Author: boskiIsland of Malta, Malta
Title: Still in training/no atmosphere/ staff too cool for the customers
Review: We couldnt wait to try the Hard Rock, especially to try the cocktails and hear some musicIts very new of course which is great and as previously mentioned the location is unbeatable There are dozens of staff all dressed up with many Hard Rock badges most of them spent the time looking at themselves in the mirror and not attending to customers !!!The drinks we ordered were not cold- which is pretty bad in Melaka which is steaming hotWe had to help ourselves as staff were busy talking to each other, they seem keen but are still very obviously in training and are not sure what kind of service and flexibility to provide their customersIts expensive for Malaysia and thankfully the food was good in quantity and quality Would we go back - yes probably if in melaka as there is not alot of choice to eat out There is no atmosphere its a huge big shed of a room would get overbearing at nightShow less

Author: manasicajeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed and left wondering why HRC has invaded Melaka
Review: Disappointed with this HRC outlet… I always order the Nachos at HRC and the version served in Melaka was drowning in fake, liquid, fluorescent cheese.On the brightside, the staff here are some of the friendliest you’ll ever meet, and the location is inspired… right at the start of Jonker market and on the river facing the iconic Dutch Square and Christ Church. And our kids loved everything they ate.I’m a fan of HRC and make a point to visit when staying in a new city. But there is something unsettling about the appearance of HRC in Melaka. Melaka has managed to retain a certain “heritage village on the river” vibe, and I’m seriously afraid for the town now that American megachains have arrived. Don’t get me wrong… I do enjoy a good American megachain. But I just feel like this isn’t the place.Show less

Author: xiaoye lSingapore, Singapore
Title: New kid on the block
Review: Hardrock Cafe Melaka opened a few months ago. Adds some new element into rustic Malacca. Drinks are pretty expensive compared to other shops nearby. Hurricane with a take home glass is more than M$100. Food comes in big portion, can share for small eater. Unable to log into the free Wifi. Live music starts at 11pm. Closes at 2am.Show less

Author: BrendaM608Glasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Need to change food suppliers!
Review: Liked: busiest eaterie in Malaka mid-week. Good staff and service. Disliked: quality of food - very average - nut the manager made up for it by offering free drinks..Show less

Author: foodlover0981Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Nothing Hard Rock about that cafe
Review: The place is brand new and looks good, however the drinks are obscenely overpriced. If you want to show off your big wallet, good place for you. If you want to have a beer with friends, there's plenty other places in that area that won't rip you off.Show less

Author: RJCF1
Title: Great location
Review: Great location with good service. The location is right on Jonkers Walk, right in the centre of things. Cold draft beer and good selection of food. Worth a visit

Author: ThetravelsofjMalaysia
Title: Great little cafe/bar in the heart of Jonker
Review: We popped in for a pizza and some beers and were pleasantly surprised. Attentive staff, beautifully restored building plus fans and open concept keep the cafe cool.All in a great stop for western food and relaxed atmosphere. We will return next time we are in Melaka. Show less

Author: MalathiShriya
Title: unfriendly staff
Review: we were a group of 7.  understand cmco restrictions.   what we cannot understand is the staff trying her best to discourage us from waiting for a table

Author: sheila1026109
Title: Ordinary
Review: Ordinary food. Poor service. Like most cafe In The area, the focus on decor but not taste. I recommend to go to the shop opposite. Looks like better options

Author: Shuddho G
Title: Decent
Review: Location is quite central so they get a constant flow of tourists therefore no dearth of business and that could be a reason that they are a bit higher priced than the competition.

Author: lolarahmanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It's aight
Review: The restaurant is very clean.Food is not terrible but not great either. It is an OK place for a drink and people watching, not to have a culinary experience. Plenty of vegetarian options though the pizza was a bit chewy, maybe the dough was slightly undercooked or they used sa special type of flour. Show less

Author: WatsonMark25Aberdeen, United Kingdom
Title: You get what you pay for!
Review: Effectively a standard pub-restaurant but is it definitely worth a stop if your hungry. The prices are okay, if not marginally inflated for the travelling tourist.I imagine it's probably busier and more lively outside of the 'Corona Season' but still nice nonetheless.I'd recommend the Sambal Chicken Pizza - though I'd have wanted more spice in it.Show less

Author: Lily V
Title: Trip after MCO
Review: Geographer Melaka probably needs to update their menu and its presentation, it looks a bit grimy and tattered, but the service on 26/7 Sunday is excellent. Attentive and alert, he made the difference.

Author: wanwannnnnnn
Title: Live Band... Drinks.. Relax
Review: It's a nice place to stop by to have some drinks.. snacks.. and music... very relax and refreshing...

Author: PflanzenschuetzerDormagen, Germany
Title: Lovely stop!
Review: After the long walk along Jonker Walk, it is a good time to have a rest and have a beer at the Geographer Cafe. It is located close to the end of Jonker Walk. Our last vist here was 13 year ago.A laid-back bar feel with a young, friendly staff, tables along the open front and side make it the perfect spot to watch the world go by whilst enjoying a drink. Varied menu with good range of snacks and meals. Not the cheapest, but a great ambience - we loved it.Show less

Author: Curtis B
Title: okay
Review: Nice place for people watching but a bit over priced in my opinion.  Good location and good service on the other hand

Author: Jim BHove
Title: Loved the spring rolls
Review: A lovely little cafe with a good selection of alcoholic and soft drinks. I tried the sour plum which was excellent and very refreshing after walking around malala. Had some of their spring rolls which where excellent and veggie satay which was also very good. Good service and good prices.Show less

Author: Richard C H
Title: Great choice of food at reasonable prices
Review: My wife and I visited this restaurant twice during our stay. My wife is not keen on all of the Asian dishes, so she was able to order something different e.g. pizza.  The choice of drinks (particularly the cocktails) was also very good

Author: tatsianak848
Title: Nice pizza and cakes
Review:
This place is really nice. 
First time I try tomato soup and spring rolls.  It was good.  But next time I try pizza and chocolate banana homemade cake and I'm following in love with it.

Author: passportbob1
Title: Refreshing stop
Review: Good corner location to watch the world and enjoy Tom yum in a coconut with a Tiger beer close to it. Like the building. Only thing missing was Jimmy Buffet at the neighboring table.

Author: Angela SWigan, United Kingdom
Title: Great “People Watching” place
Review: Situated on corner of busy Jonker Street, means a great place to watch people coming and going from this busy, vibrant area. We ordered drinks, before 8pm there are buy 3 for 2 offers which we took advantage of on two nights. Food is served and looked ok for pub grub but we didn’t eat here so can’t comment on food. Resident musicians on both nights was a nice surprise too.Show less

Author: hxhxhx
Title: Quick stop
Review: They provide some local delights, but i was only there for drinks. The drinks are average. The place is rather packed and quite warm.

Author: 47huwg
Title: Nice drinks- poor service
Review: Good place for drinks and people waching- shame about disaffected waiting staff who dont care and show it.

Author: MasterspyWest Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: It’s only a cafe and not a restaurant.
Review: Our travel agent put this establishment on their list of recommendations but despite its location in the heart of the busy Jonker Street the food and service was very disappointing. I had a chicken and cashew nut dish which had bits of chicken floating in some sort of liquid. Service was slow and the waiter managed to get everything wrong with our order. For those that like a 2nd rate noisy band and cheap meal this is this place to go but overall I would avoid. Show less

Author: 8MikeM
Title: Good food, prices and service
Review: The menu is varied, the prices are cheap to average.   We both enjoyed food were would not normally eat. Service was solid

Author: maeltoshio
Title: Just Ok
Review: Nice place to hang out with friends while listening to the live music performance..the menu is most of vegetarian and healthy dishes..for taste wise just ok...No harm to try

Author: bmhamzahPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice place but food average
Review: We stumble to.this place when we walking at night market..We decided to give it a try since there's a lot customer patronise this place..Food wise just ok and some of the food tasteless..Maybe doesn't suit my palate..I only give 2 bubbles for the food..for the ambience and live music 4bubblesShow less

Author: syabilazman
Title: A great place to hang out
Review: A great place to hang out with friends while listening to the music..Its very popular place in jonker.food wise just ok..overall ok.i love the live music performance.

Author: kandilistkKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent & transactional
Review: Decided to come here for beers after spending the day walking Jonker Street and visiting nearby tourist attractions and definitely thought that the place was decent. Awesome live performance at the cafe. However, felt that the service was pretty transactional. Other than that, nothing much to rave about.Show less

Author: mbk09Norwich, United Kingdom
Title: Casual dining and drinking in the heart of Melaka
Review: We visited here a few times during our stay in Melaka - twice in the afternoon for a couple of cooling pints after exploring and once in the evening for dinner and drinks. A laid-back bar feel with a young, friendly staff, tables along the open front and side make it the perfect spot to watch the world go by whilst enjoying a drink. Varied menu with good range of snacks and meals. Not the cheapest, but a great ambience - we loved it.Show less

Author: MarkS960Singapore, Singapore
Title: Geographer Melaka
Review: After the long walk along Jonker Walk, it is a good time to have a rest and have a drink at the Geographer Cafe. It is located close to the end of Jonker Walk. The coffee and refreshments are reasonably priced. The place can be quite crowded at times. Food and drinks including alcohol are available at the Cafe.Show less

Author: ck kSingapore
Title: Drink n Supper at the Geog.
Review: After dinner, we had a walk around Jonker, This was a Saturday and boy was it bustling. The walk sort of tire us out and made us longing for a drink, Saw the Geog Cafe and decided to stop there for a drink. This was about 9pm. There was a 2-pc band playing and whippin gout oldies which was good by me. The cafe was mostly packed and many patrons came for t he food. Seeing the delish stuff being plated out before u, we decided to order some tapas and it was great. Overall, nice pit-stop if you were in the vicinity.Show less

Author: kirank461
Title: Good place for people watching and food!
Review: Layed back cafe. Usually crowded on weekends. They have a live band with good choice of beer n cocktail. Must try their hand tosed pizza.

Author: DJEBA
Title: Day Visit to Melaka
Review:
Great place for site seeing and shopping.

Must visit place is cafe on jonker street for Beer break and chill.

You can shop at outlets around jonker street ..

Please  carry ringits since weekends hard to  find money changers

Author: SaumSudhir
Title: Overrated and doesn’t match up to the hype!
Review: The food was tasty but not worth the high prices. And the ambience wasn’t nearly as nice as reviews led us to believe. The service was fairly slow and it was a struggle to capture the attention of the servers even when it wasn’t that busy. The bathrooms inside were absolutely disgusting!Show less

Author: SavvyHippie
Title: Literally best place ever!
Review: Literally best place ever! Best staff, cuisine, timeliness and presentation. I am so so impressed. It felt like we were in the US with the amazing quick and knowledgeable staff and amazing cuisine

Author: Lisa122019
Title: Chicken satay is very yummy.
Review: Chicken satay is very yummy. Just a short distance from Central Market with an extensive menu. Highly recommend.

Author: ask_away68Netherlands
Title: Overpriced
Review: I went to this place because they offered many vegetarian and vegan options. But what you get is not really worth the price. The vegetable curry was spicy but could use a bit salt and there was more sauce than vegetables. My husband ordered a chicken dish that he couldn't remember the name but it was chicken tossed around in some sort of "ketchupy" sauce and nothing else. The quantity was also very small.Show less

Author: keefeloke
Title: Wonderful as always
Review: This is the place I always come back to when I’m in Melaka. Great food drinks ambience service and prices too. There’s also a live band,

Author: CathTor
Title: Runaway from the heat
Review: Cozy restaurant to rest our tiring feet and keep us from the heat outside. Clean toilet . The friendly crews always greet us with warm smile

Author: cwbush83Armidale, Australia
Title: Fun bar/restaurant
Review: With live music and a fun atmosphere, Geographer’s seems more like a place to hang out and drink than to have a meal. The food we had was good, admittedly, but it was arguably the least appetising meal we had in Malacca. Given how high the city sets the bar, however, this isn’t exactly damning. Worth a look for the ambiance and if you’re missing western food. Show less

Author: Rabbits13Sydney, Australia
Title: Great restaurant in Jonker Street
Review: We visited Melaka on our cruise and after doing the touristy things in the old town, we wandered down Jonker Street looking for something to eat.We found Geographer Cafe where we ate chicken satays, pineapple rice and cold beverages.Thoroughly enjoyed our meal, service was very good and we did not have to wait too long for our meal given that it was very busy at the time. Service was warm and friendly and attendant kept us informed of how long our meal would be served.Strongly recommend for lunch.Show less

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed!
Review: I could still remember more than ten years ago, when I first visited this restaurant or cafe, it s was really a very friendly place to be. This time round, I left the place disappointed. The services were cold. No smiles, no acknowledgement of our orders, no apologies, etc.The pizza that we ordered was still good. My ayam masak Merah was disastrous. I told the waitress to bring back to the chef as the chicken had a very stale taste to it, like those of uncooked chicken. Don’t get me wrong, the chicken was definitely cooked. Either the chicken was not fresh or it had been left at room temperature for too long before it was cooked. Why I knew it because I enjoy cooking and knew how to cook. After which the server came back to tell me that the dish was just cooked and the chicken was delivered today. Honestly, it can be delivered today but did not guarantee it’s freshness. Secondly, if the chicken was not fresh, even eating it right after cooking would have that foul taste. Though the waitress was kind enough to ask if I wanted a change to other dishes, I was pretty affected by the foul taste and politely rejected the offer. However, no apologies was given.With all fairness, the rest of the dishes like the spaghetti and fish and chips were ok. But the coldness in the servers attitude and the chicken really left me with great disappointment. It can be due to the fact that I always trusted them to deliver.Show less

Author: GeraldineA246
Title: Relaxing
Review: Lovely place to relax at.  A little pricy for drinks but overall a nice place to unwind at night after a long hot day.

Author: RKTH
Title: Halfway house in Jonker
Review: Sid’s Pub is at the entrance whereas this drinking hole is right in the middle of Jonker Walk popular for drinkers after or midway through a crowded hot and sweaty stroll along Melaka most famous need-to-visit-if-in-Melaka night market

Author: Bitterballenbruid
Title: Ok food
Review: Had the Nasi Lemak and chicken sate. Both ok. Nasi Lemak is supposed to be the best in Malacca but I’ve had better! Quite big portions so pretty good value. Wine 20 RM per glass. Beer 32 RM for 3 at happy hour (before 9pm).

Author: NixnawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good decent food and drinks
Review: We went for a Tuesday lunch. Ordered spaghetti and a satay nasi goreng. Food is normal. When we reached about 1pm there was still live music. Music ended about 2pm. I guess the place will be lovely for a night's out.Ordered a watermelon juice drink and a gula melaka layer tea. Two main courses, two drinks and a slice of choco banana cake costs about RM 70+. Strongly recommend the choc banana cake! Yums! Staff is friendly. Requested for baby chair for my 7mo but the staff came back with the baby chair but however he suggested not using it as its not safe for a 7mo since the chair does not come with safety belt and also the separator for left/right legs, meaning the young child may slid down the chair. Show less

Author: PatrickF581
Title: Good food, good price.
Review: This restaurant has a huge menu. We stuck to traditional Malaysian cuisine. Was nice and pretty cheap. Food came out pretty slow, but apparently a large group was dining upstairs.

Author: RandolphCarter1919Australia
Title: Relaxing Cafe
Review: Stopped in here twice on out travels to cool down. Very friendly staff, and even when their wifi wasn't walking Calvin let us hotspot to his phone. Cold beer and quickly served snacks, we even watched a live solo band one night which was excellent Watched an awesome rain storm clear out the weekends markets one night, quite interesting to watch.Show less

Author: Randy EHonolulu, Hawaii
Title: A great little spot on busy Jonker Walk in Melaka
Review: The greatest thing about this place, for me, was that about half of their menu is vegetaraian. Just be careful and look to see what items are in the dish you order, as they seem to think Chicken is vegetarian. But there are many items that are completely vegetarian, and some are offered with Tempeh. There are also Vegan options. They have a full bar. Prices are extremely fair, to good, and the staff are wonderful young people. Very nice and very helpful. Service is good.Show less

Author: Foody2017Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Nice to sit and watch the world go by
Review: We visited for lunch. Staff were very friendly and welcoming. Food was plentiful and tasty however, we found it a little dearer than some other restaurants within the area. It offers local cuisine and also some western food. Varied menu. They offer vegetarian but I’m unsure as to if the menu had vegan options. Best checking this beforehand. It had a good vibe and I’d definitely return and recommend. Show less

Author: Gwendolo1
Title: Great place to spend the night out
Review: Lively atmosphere, menu goes from western to asian dished at reasonable prices. Live music available, good cocktails and wines at decent prices and genuine service.

Author: 871francesca
Title: Lovely cafe inside and out
Review: Great decor and lovely, wholesome food. We had the veg curry with brown rice and chicken satay which was all delicious.

Author: DunreyLiLiverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Good place to watch the world go by
Review: Situated on a street corner in the busy Jonkers Street area of town this is a great place to grab a drink or a bite to eat and to watch the world go by. The Geographers Cafe has a good range of drinks and an interesting menu with plenty of veggie options. It is reasonably priced and has friendly attentive staff who see to your every need.Show less

Author: 487michelle
Title: Great food
Review:
We had dinner on a Friday night.
Food was excellent, service good and music ok.
Great choice of food and very tasty.
Would recommend.

Author: Woodfordl
Title: Good food in a great location
Review: Busy but good food and great for people watching, worth a visit for some local cuisine right in the middle of the action

Author: Morrell
Title: OK Just
Review: Loud music and average food sums up our visit here. Maybe it was a bad day for the staff but we weren’t certain why we walked so far to come here.

Author: cathykoh
Title: Service bad
Review: Give thumbup for performers. Front service damn bad.. NEED TO IMPROVE! THROW MENU THERE NO SMILE. RUDE.

Author: ckk757
Title: Must go
Review: Every time I am in Melaka. Don't know why . Maybe because it breathes adventure and colonialism. Or the world food and the beer menu. Its conveniently located in Jonker walk. You can sit inside or out and watch the tourists parade. Opposite the street they opened a new part for food.Show less

Author: 118pgg
Title: Cozy Place for Drinks
Review:
Love the place. Cozy area. Lots of seats available. Only sad thing is no live band as I visited on Tuesday. 

Variety of drinks offered.

Author: Suus119
Title: Great food, nice atmosphere
Review: Great meal, they have a variety of Asian and western food. Tasted really good, atmosphere was great and not expensive.

Author: Lovetotravel6365
Title: People watching
Review: Great spot for a beer or two and watch the buzz of the Jonker Street Market at weekends. Simple meals and good choices for vegetarians.

Author: Adventurers049
Title: Excellent
Review:
A fantastic restaurant right in the centre of all the action.
The food is very good, the service friendly and quick.
When the roads are closed on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights, they also set up tables on the street.
Great place to enjoy!

Author: Kapsb10New Delhi, India
Title: Charming place
Review: A godsend for the itinerant vegetarian in Melaka. Charming ambience, hardworking musicians. If you order a drink then you'll be asked to pay the bill before the kot is issued.The veg Satay is recommended, my partner was not excited by the chicken Satay. The was cold. The bebolah tempeh was intriguing. Should read the menu as some vegetarian dishes had egg.Show less

Author: AprilflameKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A great spot for a simple meal
Review: We had dinner here a few times over the last 2 visits to Melaka. The most recent in July. The selection is good with food ranging from pizza to local fares such as tempeh. Quality of food and service is consistent. Price is reasonable for what you get and being in the heart of a tourist spot. Great for travellers with children. Show less

Author: sanggarikrishnan17
Title: The best place to Chill Out!
Review: This cafe is definitely a must-visit when you are at Jonker Street.. The food is good.. Should try the Aglio Olio.. The crispy garlic and the sauce were awesome! Loved the live band.. It was a great experience..Highly recommended to solo travellers!

Author: Christophe1971
Title: Very good
Review: Good restaurant, good place, good service ! Pizza, pasta, asian food, cocktails and very nice located

Author: APisME95
Title: A mishap and average food
Review: food was average, atmosphere was nice (on a street corner with outside seating). The staff was very nice and friendly, especially after there was a mishap with my food (I’ll spare the details). Should be 2 stars, but the staff redeemed a star.

Author: ATravesy
Title: Bustling bar
Review: Great bar right in the centre of Jonkers Street market, quick service, great vibe, cheap drinks live entertainment.

Author: AgC767Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice cafe
Review: This cafe is at a prominent location at Jonker. Nice decor and atmosphere. Food is good with a variety Asian and Western dishes. I was here 1 hour after opening and they have ran out of Kaya Toast! That was a bit disappointing. Service is a little slow as they are a bit short-handed but we didn't mind as we were travelling to escape the city life.Show less

Author: pirdmn
Title: Good coffee and juice
Review:
We had an iced coffee and juice there, was not the best we had around but it was still good for the price we paid ! 
The bar itself is quite pretty tho
Would recommend if you are close by and want a quick drink

Author: Bronwyn H
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Good to settle down for a cold drink here on a hot day in Melaka. They also serve nice dishes like typical Asian cuisine but also pizza. Didn’t have the chance to try but looked good!

Author: ivanchan666
Title: Nice place to chill at night
Review: This is a nice place to chill with beer along Jonker Street Night Market. There is live band at night on Saturday night.

Author: DietmarGruber
Title: Nice and friendly!
Review: Very nice Cafe in Chinatown, meeting for alot of people. Good cafe, good food. Friendly and gently armosphere!

Author: 957virginiad
Title: Lovely
Review:
The cafe is a landmark in Jonker Street.
Full of character with friendly staff and an amazing array of well priced food this is an oasis in the midst of thee bustle.
In the evenings there is entertainment and beer & wine is available.

Author: paulcI3784VB
Title: Back again
Review: Called in to Malacca and lunched at Geography.  Hasn’t changed since last visit 6 years ago, still a great place to relax, enjoy a drink and meal and watch the world pass by. Lovely smiling waitress Hwee Minn is the best!

Author: Tripforyou23
Title: Decent food, a little expensive, vegetarian options
Review: The food was pretty good, but nothing really special. It was a little expensive compared to other places with better food, but it has a very convenient location and is not a bad place to eat. They do have a vegetarian page in their menu so it's good for a mix of omnis and veggies. Show less

Author: EnglishgaboutSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Watch the world go by
Review: Jonkers Walk continues to draw many many visitors especially on the weekends when the market is opened. Geographer Cafe is a wonderful place to sit and watch the world go by. I leave friends and visitors to fight the crowds while I sit with a cold beer. In a Muslim country there are fewer restaurants serving alcohol so this is a welcome place to stop for Westerners. The food is quite good too. In the evenings there is a pretty singer to add to the attraction.Show less

Author: Katie MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing location.
Review: Geographer cafe an amazing spot to watch the world go by on Jonkers street. A place we always stop to eat when we are in Malaka, unfortunately I think it will be our last. The quality of the service was unfortunately well below par. Serving staff inattentive and unknowledgeable about the food and when it came the food was nowhere near the standard it used to be. Still a nice place to sit but far nicer places to eat. Show less

Author: Selestina G
Title: It was our wedding anniversary
Review: The restaurant food was good ... the only thing was the whole time Chinese song was played .. and many foreigners and local Malaysian was sitting around ... as wen we spoke to the manager a guy tht is plum and specky he said tht the boss never allowed to play English or any other songs ... this is a international bar and I don’t understand why only Chinese song been played and also we r customers tht pay for the service and this place was a good place 5 years back ...I always come to geographer since 8 years ... now the service has lacked and no customer service and lack of pr as well .. and I’m very sure tht the owner of geographer won’t allow this coz he is a customer oriented person.. as I belief ..Show less

Author: emiZaraZ
Title: Nice place to hang out
Review:
nice place to hang out in the evenings for some crowd watching.
Good location near jonker to take a break after all the walking too!

Author: RoelandBJ
Title: Nice place on Jonker Street
Review: We searched for a nice place to eat at Jonker Street. It’s not that hot inside and the foot is great!

Author: sunnet1234
Title: Good vibes!
Review: Go for the good vibes! Great music atmosphere. The meeting place of all walks at Jonker! Food is nothing special though. Service could be more proactive.

Author: TerryandSian
Title: Extensive menu and draught beer!
Review: Nice friendly restaurant, with good selection of food and drinks, on the corner of Jonker Street.  Great vibe with chilled out music.

Author: darshana c
Title: Cafe highly overrated
Review: As a vegetarian I didn’t much enjoy the food here. Yes it does have ample opts but nothing flavorful. Service also not good

Author: salmantarik123
Title: Amazing Ambiance with great food and drinks
Review: i visited Malacca seven times and all the time I had my lunch and dinner at Geographer cafe . great choices of dishes and drinks. Beautiful decor and ambiance . Located at Jonker street . Without geographer Cafe I cant Imagine Jonker street .

Author: thumbseekHong Kong, China
Title: Satay & Pizza!
Review: Wandered around here after a stroll around the Jonkers Street market. Could be that we were really hungry, but can’t remember having chicken satay this good before! Succulent, juicy, spiced just right! Had satay on the side with the fried rice, and then ordered some more satay. And then some more! Started with Pizza. Chicken sambal; which was a great topping. But surprised how good the crust was. They’ve been trained by an Italian! Show less

Author: boon248Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place to chill
Review: This pub cum restaurant is a good place to chill.You can come here for their drinks & finger food if you are not hungry after a long day hunting for Melaka delights! Otherwise, you can have a decent meal with your cold beer.Service was commendable and looking for a table was quite challenging for a big group at the main place....Enjoyed the ambience and music there. Do come early for their happy hours promotion and a "good" table if you are chilling with a big group of friends. Cheers!!!Show less

Author: 615trinal
Title: Nice Cafe for hangout
Review: Nice place hang out , we like the environment , good for.kids as well.  The seat is limited but the have some additional.seat.

Author: Traveller8354
Title: A has been
Review: This place is fast becoming deserted except for foreign tourist. Expensive and poor service. Been good before but standards fallen.

Author: chlorobs19
Title: Great for chilled drinks
Review: We came here for food and drinks on two occasions and did enjoy our meals but really enjoyed the live music and drinks we had after. Really nice, sociable vibes where we stayed for one drink after another feeling very comfortable and not wanting to leave! Great service and decent prices.Show less

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Sour Plum & Lime juice drink
Review: Stopped here whilst exploring Melaka and we both had a Sour Plum & Lime juice drink which were 14 RM each - very very refreshing and enjoyed it so much so that we are going back for another tomorrow!! Recommend as a nice alternative and rehydrating drink if you are exploring around the Jonker Street area. Show less

Author: ElsaCLNew York City, New York
Title: Mr. Thang Lian Khual’s superb pizza👍😋
Review: Mr. Thang Lian Khual (pictures attached to give him credit) makes delicious pizza from scratch. We watched him knead the dough and spread the ingredients meticulously (emphasis added on the last word)! This is the most noteworthy.Mr. Khual’s pizza is thin-crusted with sufficient and balanced portions of tomato sauce and cheese. It is cooked perfectly in the oven with parts of the crust crunchy.One pizza is filling for one person.Their lychee syrup watermelon drink is refreshing and tasty.Our friend was satisfied with two vegetarian dishes, one with rice and the other a noodle soup, that she had for our first lunch and second lunch at Geographer Cafe, respectively.We went back to have pizza - Margherita (attached is a picture of the almost consumed fine pizza) and Hawaiian chicken - again two days in a row!!!When in Melaka, enjoy Mr. Khual’s pizza at Geographer Cafe.Show less

Author: yo_w97
Title: Nice food
Review:
Good vibe cafe. A lot of tourists.
You can get local dishes here but it is quite more expensive than other places.

Author: F8167KNsimonw
Title: Nice cafe for a coffee!
Review: Nice location, with a colonial French feel. Open and airy. Good espresso!  Would definitely stop off for another one next time I visit

Author: 248francescae
Title: Love this place!
Review: Spent 3 nights in Malacca and came here every day. With wanting to eat vegetarian myself and my boyfriend were in vegetarian paradise. The food is so tasty with amazing flavour. The staff are very friendly, give it a try if your visiting Malacca.

Author: SIE YAN CCanterbury, United Kingdom
Title: Pleasant surprises
Review: The decor sets the tone for a relaxing dining experience. Piped old classics in both English and Chinese songs combined with live performances was the order of the night and they did not disappoint. The menu is refreshing with many choices for differing food preferences. The chicken satay is among the best we have ever tasted with the meat so tender and well marinated and the accompanying sauce is very authentic. We had salad with a twist showing the chef has put a careful thought on not just food preparation but also presentation. Will we recommend to friends and family? HELL, 100% YES! Will we return? In a heartbeat.Show less

Author: Kathryn D
Title: Nice atmosphere - pleasant breeze through the open windows
Review: Would have liked to stay longer - just a very quick coffee and then back to our tour bus.  Relatively quiet during the day as regards people, but expect it is extremely busy in the evenings.

Author: hopepest
Title: Lovely place
Review:
Lovely place to chill even on a weekday. Just have a seat and kick back. Happy hour - 3 pints for the price of 2 at RM60++. 
A plus would be that they have a lavatory... Definitely needed after 3 pints.

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful music, delicious food
Review: Used to come here a number of times and enjoy every time. If you love the golden oldies this place is a must. Remember to put on your dancing shoes too. However, this visit we noticed a change. Our usual singer Don Beins wasn’t performing. Huge disappointment for our family...The food is great too. Nice home made pizzas and sandwiches are nice as well. This place offers a very nice ambiance for big or small groups alike.Show less

Author: capsicum0620Thailand
Title: Just had a couple of drinks
Review: Nightlife in Melaka after 9pm is that of a Siberian graveyard, and few are the places where one can still enjoy a drink in a lively atmosphere. The Geo Café is one of them.True.., you'll find here no trace of Malaysian authenticity, nor of genuine local food (for what it's worth..) or even of microbrews. This is a place for locals who want to show off and for visitors who grew tired of the gloomy ambiance of the surrounding bars (not to mention the fried rice and oversweet chicken diet).Geo Café and its team of young waiters do the job. We didn't try the food (we knew better) but the drinks, service and atmosphere did not fail us.Prices are not cheap, but it's everywhere the case in Malaysia when alcohol is served.Show less

Author: FelixMW87
Title: Good Coffee and nice Service
Review: We had very good coffee here today and enjoyed the surrounding environment and very kind service. Prices are fair but of course you pay a little more as it‘s directly in the tourist district.

Author: AngAhSin
Title: Nice chill out place along Jonker St
Review: After a long up and down "shopping" along Jonker St, we stopped here for a Asahi beer, relax while listening to the singing by the resident lady singer and the customers.

Author: isra wNonthaburi, Thailand
Title: Good place for take a rest after long traveling in Malaysia
Review: I spent my last time at this place on Friday's night it's a good place for relaxing with beautiful life music from two different musician at the both side of the place have some favorite drinks looking at the people who were in the bar and walking through Jonker street make me feel refreshed before going to bed and ready to start the next coming day..... Sincerely recommend!Show less

Author: World2c0England, United Kingdom
Title: Drinks stop
Review: Great location on Jonker Street to stop and enjoy cold drinks and a break during a day of exploring Malacca. Someone recommended the lime and sour plum juice so had to try it and it was delicious. Beer good too! Sitting outside was a great spot for people watching!Show less

Author: Scott B
Title: Excellent Staff
Review: I spent several pleasant hours here while my partner was having a massage. While I didn’t eat and the wine selection consisted of, I kid you not, white or red that being said the staff were fabulous and the live entertainment was great.

Author: tommomelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Service was slow and a little inattentive
Review: After doing a lot of walking at the Jonker Street Market I decided to rest, and sit outside on a bar stool and a high table whilst my wife shopped nearby. I had a tiger beer and she joined me for a drink a little later and had a mocktail.Two musicians were playing. One was a male and one a female who alternated during the night.I found the service a little inattentive and despite the waiter and waitresses not being extremely busy they were not attentive and it was difficuilt at times to attract their attention.Show less

Author: poonam05
Title: Chilling place
Review: Nice to chill here on a Saturday night. Plus live singing here is such an entertainment. Would come here again.

Author: Peppau
Title: Good coffee
Review: In a corner of Jonker Wall.Cold bier and nyonya cuisine.Very good coffee.It is such a nice place on the terrace as in the interior.

Author: tryph0820Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not a place to drink and chill
Review: Felt like this place is overrated... i just didnt like the ambiance and food. Went here for drinks and snacks, around 11pm. Plan was to end the night here. Ordered 1 platter (tempeh, chicken) paired with cocktail drink, geographer delight. The food was lousy and dry, really unappetizing. Drink was unenjoyable. Chairs were inconvenient. Music was kind of nice, though... the sitting uncle was singing live with his piano. This place was so disappointing after reading so many good reviews. End up we only finish our drinks (cos sayang), food we barely touch it. Find another place to chill. Show less

Author: mpmilestogo
Title: Beer good. Food so so
Review: I was not impressed with the loud music and the fact that their signature rice dish did not look anything like the menu. Only two satay? Really? Nicest thing is the beer and the location.

Author: rosalindholt32
Title: Great place to hang out
Review: Had a great sandwich and drink quick service and interesting place lots on the menu friendly service and cheap

Author: Martin BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Always loved this Bar / Restaurant, but getting pricy !!
Review: I have been visiting this bar / restaurant regularly whilst in Malaka for the last 15 years or so. Have always loved its ambience, live music and interesting décor. But most of all loved its location on Jonker Walk making it a prime spot for having a drink whilst "people watching", this is especially true on Friday and Saturday nights when Jonker Walk is turned into a night market and the street is heaving with people, the Geographer Café is located right in the thick of the action and thus very popular.Although the service has remained good,the choice of drinks good, the building well maintained and the music still excellent it has become somewhat pricy. Indeed probably one of the priciest places in this part of Melaka, sadly this means that the days spending hours and hours at this bar watching the world go by are over, still however the perfect place for a late afternoon or evening drink or three.Show less

Author: stevekyneNew Taipei, Taiwan
Title: Lots to like, but too pricey
Review: Lots to like about the Geographer. The staff are pretty good, the decor is eclectic, the menu interesting, and the music is awesome. Someone has really put some thought into the selection of music, and it’s like no other mix we’ve heard anywhere is Malaysia.The only downside is the prices, which are high. Show less

Author: malabarflyGravesend, United Kingdom
Title: A great place to sit with a drink or eat while watching the world go by
Review: This is ideally situated in the middle of Jonker Street on the corner of the side road of Jalan Hang Lekira. It has plenty of outside tables and as such is a good place to sit and watch the street life of Jonker Street, particularly when the night market is buzzing on a Friday, Saturday and Sunday evening. They have a decent menu of main dishes if you want to eat, both English and Malay dishes plus a good selection of vegetarian options, or you can have something lighter such as satay, spring rolls and so on or simply sit with a drink and watch the people pass by in Jonker Street. It is generally crowded, particularly at weekends and tables are close together. I wouldn’t describe it as ‘fine dining’ but the food we had was good and reasonably priced for the location and sort of place it is (beer 16 MYR, satay 15MYR, spring rolls 11 MYR), although more expensive that the smaller and more local restaurants.It’s a lively central spot, if a little touristy, and has live music in the evening (particularly at weekends).Show less

Author: M2910OGsteven
Title: Missed Order
Review: I was disappointed with service provided,as the staff missed out my wife order. While waited quite long time,asked for the food ,say will check.still waited . When asked then only claims that they missed the order. So when u go place order make sure u snap a picture and set reminder ,so that at least we can reorder again. Very frustrated Show less

Author: Derry MCounty Donegal, Ireland
Title: Quite simply a truly great place
Review: I spent 6 days in Melaka last December-2018-and had most of my meals at this restaurant/cafe.It was,quite simply,the best.It's a great place for dinner,sitting at a table and people watching, but it's also good for coffee and cake.The staff were very friendly and remembered me after my first visit.The food is excellent and freshly -prepared.Service was prompt..worth a return visit...Definitely worth 10 out of10.Show less

Author: chuppa_rustamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good cafe
Review: One of the good fine dining cafes in Melaka. Offers a good mix of options, esp. Vegetarian options.Potion size of non local food is small though. Also, is expensive compared to other cafes in Melaka but the food is good and tasty. Also, it is on Jonker Street!Show less

Author: 630johank
Title: Rustic food, great vantage
Review: We visited Geographers Cafe on a Friday evening during the most hectic hours of Jonker Walk; the food was good (not great) and the people-watching was great.

Author: YauKuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Drinks
Review: Perfect location and suitably eclectic for a great drink very well served by helpful staff, There was Cooper's beer, the best Stout / Porter I have ever had; the colour of Guinness but smoother and with a great taste more like a mild bitterThere is food but we did not try it.Show less

Author: JourneyGlobe
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: Good food, sound & location. Easy to find at Jonker Street. Ideal for a drink or a little bite during the day.

Author: diewald024
Title: poor asian food
Review: Ramen and curry noodles were average, not quite worth the price. Pineapple fried rice tasted plain and unappetizing. Took forever to come as well, considering it was just fried rice. No idea whether of not the western dishes are any better, but honestly the asian dishes were very meh.Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Relaxing Cafe
Review: Located in the busy street of Jonker Walk a corner old shop lot converted to a nice and cozy cafe. Choice of high table, bench or marble table top but crowded most of the time. Live music with a singer bringing you to the past memory time with oldies. Also nice music to make you want to go down to the floor to dance to the tunes. The beers are cold and nice. A great place to have a cold beer after the walk along the historic culture street.Show less

Author: 563imret
Title: A gem
Review: Very nice relaxed place fir drinks an food . Often live music.  If you enjoy bar style dining, sitting outside enjoying either several small dishes to share or a regular plate meal. Visit this place! You Will not regret

Author: neilhassallLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good Western food
Review: There isn't much open on Jonker Street late at night when the night market isn't on so Geographer Cafe is a welcome respite - we stopped in for food around 9pm one evening and opted for the vegetarian / margherita pizza and some chilli spaghetti - both were very good (around 18 MYR each), with quick and friendly service. Drinks are quite expensive though and about 4x more than nearby places (e..g coke is 8 MYR and a small beer 24 MYR). They also had live entertainment several times when we walked past most nights.Show less

Author: desilvag
Title: Relaxing atmosphere
Review: Great Pizza. Vegetarian food available.Very reasonably priced. Very crowded during week-ends. Live band.

Author: Charchit ALondon, United Kingdom
Title: Vegetarian food is only ok!
Review: We came here reading reviews about good vegetarian food, but I have to say that the food was only ok. Writing the review to tell the readers that there are much better vegetarian cafes available in Melakka. This cafe might not disappoint the meat lovers, but the restaurant was only ok both in terms of options and flavours for vegetarians.Show less

Author: Aldert V
Title: Hoegaarden on draught
Review: We went several times to this cafe during our short stay in Melaka. It is on Jonker street and it has a New Orleans - Cuba type of atmosphere. It had Hoegaarden as draught beer, superb! Definitely worth a visit

Author: anafD9203DM
Title: Great environment and good food
Review: I’ve been to this restaurant several times and I’ve never been disappointed. The service is good and the food has good quality. There’s free WiFi as well. It’s good that it’s in a central place with a lot of things to do at night

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: 100% tourist venue in a 100% tourist setting......
Review: Located right on Jonker Walk about mid way, in a prime corner spot. More of a pub than a restaurant, but it has a good vibe, and is not too noisy. The menu looks huge, but there is not much really to it - mostly pub style items, with a Melaka twist. At least half is vegetarian, and i suspect vegans could eat well here if they are careful. I had a drink and a snack, as there was nothing on the menu that really appealed to my dinner time appetite, and moved along. What I had was good, reasonably priced, although the service was a bit “unpolished”. Show less

Author: johnnye201
Title: Disappointing
Review: Overpriced food without any flavour. It's not Western, nor is it Asian. Our supposedly "Thai" chicken was dry as a bone, the crust was rock-hard and covered in what seemed to be off-the-shelf, rather than home-made, sauce that didn't taste like anything in Thailand at all. The meal had a side consisting of a European-style vegetable salad in mayonnaise, of all things. The "Geographer curry" wasn't anything to write home, either. The rice was overcooked and it didn't have any taste at all.The cocktails were all right, and the music was very good, which saves the place from getting one star from me.If you just want drinks, it might be all right but there are dozens of better (and cheaper) places as far as food is concerned. Show less

Author: TheFoodguyMorristown, New Jersey
Title: Oasis on a busy corner
Review: It’s a bar, it’s a casual restaurant and it’s popular with a good staff.Stopped in yesterday during happy hour... 3 drafts special . No food specials but had an appy plate with sate ( no peanut sauce) veg roll and spring roll. Thought a little expensive as it was quite small but tasty. Guess you pay for location.Every time we walked by there were customers and it was recommended by our hotel and taxi driver.Show less

Author: Jood07United Kingdom
Title: Mediocre
Review: The menu didn't look too bad, not great, but one or two veggie options in a country that is obsessed with eating dead chickens, was worth a try.The tables spill out onto the street so you can usually find somewhere at around 7 - 7.30pm. The service was reasonably quick but the food mediocre, so much so I can't even remember what we ordered. The big turn off for us was the volume of the music which was beyond loud. I know this is a strange notion in the age when everyone has their eyes fixed to their mobile phones, but we, as a family, like to actually talk to each other during a meal.Would not recommend.Show less

Author: LiBjork
Title: Beautiful building
Review:
Good bar in a very nice building. Extensive menus and good selection of cocktails. Unfortunately when we were there, there was a woman “singing” which made the visit quite unpleasant because she could not sing.

Otherwise good place!

Author: anotsoyoung1
Title: Great food and wonderful cocktails
Review: Enjoyed a quite meal and a lovely cocktail at the Geographer Café. Great atmosphere in this renovated old building in the heart of the Jonker walk in Melaka.

Author: maxmagar
Title: Cosy restaurant serving delicious food
Review: It may look like a tourist kind of restaurant but if you give it a try, you‘ll be surprised by the quality of the food. On top, the staff is super kind and friendly. Good place for dinner.

Author: steffanaa
Title: review
Review: we really liked this place! has some very good food, especially the Curry Rice (for vegetarians)! yammm

Author: Kempli24Buderim, Australia
Title: Great service and food
Review: When walking the streets of Jonker and Harmony on a hot day, full of tourists from a cruise, Geographer Cafe looked inviting from the street. Calvin our waiter, was quick to serve us and the food, although a little pricy, was delicious. We ordered what I call Nasi Goreng, a huge plate of satays and rice and my daughter ordered the pasta with garlic and chilli. Both dishes a winner Show less

Author: aidanc321Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Staff
Review: This is a thriving cafe / bar / restaurant in a prime location on Jonkers street. Ask to sit upstairs if you can - quieter and cooler. The food varies a bit (from ok to very good) - stuck with anything described as local and you won’t be disappointed! Beer was cold and cheap during happy hour. Cocktails were a bit average but the staff were excellent and the atmosphere was great - especially with live music most nights. Definitely worth a visit!Show less

Author: Mitsu P
Title: Casual brunch
Review: Great atmosphere, good food ,vegetarian are welcome. It was my first meal in malacca and very enthused to find that warm place and nice place.

Author: satanbug
Title: Supposed to have been a famous film set
Review: Chinese websites suggested we visit but when the staff themselves warn you off different menu items, you suspect the worst. We shared a few spring rolls and Tiger beer for over $50 Ringots. Expensive and average. Enjoy.....

Author: Leslie3663
Title: Loosing it's shine
Review: Loosing it's shine after so many years.  Used to be a great place for live music and chill, but nothing much anymore.  Many other choice along the river.

Author: phoebet546
Title: Good that it closes late!
Review: Went on a weekday and was pleasantly surprised they close at 1am. It was not too busy or quiet; just the right amount of crowd. Ordered the banana chocolate cake. Taste wise it was alright but size was rather small. I like the setup and the Christmas decoration and the choice of Christmas carols playing at the background. Show less

Author: colin1201
Title: Come here if you want to get away from the chaos of Jonker Street
Review:
Chill relaxed atmosphere.
Has vegetarian options.

I liked the fact that the food was not heavily salted.
Lots of fusion options too

Prices were competitive.

Author: Jlmtd
Title: Food & Drink
Review:
Typical Westerners haunt, can be noisy if stuck between the music in this cafe and the one competing across the street.
Excellent hand-made pizzas.

Author: David SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Perfectly located with a distinctive atmosphere
Review: If you are staying in the historic centre of Melaka it's hard to miss this café - we must have walked past it a dozen or so times during our stay. Visited it twice, the first time just for drinks after strolling along Jonker Street looking at the night market. It was pretty full and the waiting staff were struggling to cope with orders, but the place felt welcoming with some reasonable live music. On the second occasion we had lunch and it was much quieter. The menu is a mix of local and Western cuisine and we enjoyed what we ordered. This is not the place to go for authentic Malaysian cuisine (and you are likely to come across quite a few fellow tourists) but I still rather liked it.Show less

Author: rosalyndej
Title: Great lunch place with lovely cold beer!
Review: We had lunch here at the Geographer and really enjoyed the food, beer was beautifully cold and the service was good too. A good variety on the menu and buzzy atmosphere, recommended.

Author: RFO01
Title: Passing by as was not packed as normal
Review:
20 mins for order to be taken 
20 mins for drink to arrive 
20 mins for change to arrive 

Just because I’m a lone traveller my custom as anyone else’s! 

Got the feeling if you weren’t spending in a big group was interested

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Nice Little Cafe at Jonker Street
Review: This is the first time we dined in here. We always see many people and the cafe were always crowded. We never thought they served food (thinking it was pub only) before this. There were so many varieties of food to choose from. All food ordered were good but the most importantly, the service and the hospitality was great!Show less

Author: 913jetlChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Amazing location in the center of Jonker street
Review: Nice location to sit on the middle of the Jonker street. Expecially on the freaking hot weather and you grab a beer and sit inside the cafe and having a break. Their services are good and it is very cooling inside. However the foods are just so-so compare to the others cafe. It is provided varieties of food choices and also vegetarian foods. But their taste just cant attract me to visit for second time. But if you wan to grab a beer or have a rest? it is a good place to go.Show less

Author: HonisoiquimalypenseDerby, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location, average food.
Review: This cafe and its little sister opposite suit on a busy corner on Jonker Street. It is usually well frequented but its small cafe across the rad is usually quieter. Found the service was a tad chaotic and the food average. It seemed strange to me that they did not sell Tiger beer by the pint!Still, it is worth a visit.Show less

Author: tboseKolkata (Calcutta), India
Title: Geographer Cafe- must eat when in Melaka
Review: Iconic resto in Melaka, placed strategically on the midst of Jonker Walk, when you are tired & hot and are longinggg for a beer/ drinks or some grub you need. We were there on a Sunday afternoon, after walking around Melaka doing touristy stuff. We ordered a Ramen & a chicken satay/ fried rice combo, with some chilled beer. The satay/ fried rice combo was a hit, but my ramen could be better!!Show less

Author: ViatorcoloniaeCologne
Title: Iconic eatery
Review: Centrally located on Maleka's Jonker Street, the iconic Geographér (so iconic they spell it with an accented é) attracts by virtue of its unique tropical greenery on the outside and the ecclectic decor inside which seems to bring together at least six centuries of history.As in the past, the restaurant/café/bar lures people of all nationalities and offers menus accordingly - many fusing east/west tastes: (we ate deliciously Malay-spiced soja balls served with a best-in-class original Italian tomato sauce). It was so good, we couldn't resist coming back after our Jonker shopping spree to sample the excellent cheese cake, washed down with a strong and authentic Italian cappuccino.Service is friendly, welcoming and efficient - and smiling.The Geographér serves a wide range of drinks (including a broad assortment of beers) and is so popular it's opened a sister branch opposite.In a city with a lot of history but few attractions, the Geographér almost alone justifies a trip. Viator ColoniaeShow less

Author: virus777
Title: Ice Cold Beer
Review: Definitely a place to stop for an Ice Cold Beer during your walk in Jonker Street on a Hot and Humid afternoon. Nice chill out place at night

Author: KarthikS24
Title: Happening bar in jonker street!
Review: I am pretty sure this is the most happening bar in jonker street. The drinks and desserts here are very good. Prices are not so high. There is live band as well. The service as very good.  A must go!

Author: YaseLisaWellington, New Zealand
Title: Really nice place to eat and chill!
Review: First of all i really like the music they played! First some salsa, latin and then jazz. We wanted a light dinner and ordered some snacks. And coconut juice. All was so delicious. The spring rolls and the naan with curry! Specially the wedges are so crunchy. Had here my best potatoe wedges ever!Show less

Author: gioniaontourZurich, Switzerland
Title: First dinner in Melaka
Review: We spent our first dinner in Melaka in this nice restaurant in central Jonker Walk. Menu is maybe a bit too vaste, including a range of dishes going from malay food to malay "pizza". We tried some malay food, which was fine. Friendly staff. Improvement suggestion: the live singer was a bit too loud and not always on pitch :)Show less

Author: javiercard2017Bilbao, Spain
Title: Yummy!
Review: We had lunch here and the food was really yummy and tasty. Staff were helpful and advised us on what to choose from the menu. Drinks were also so satisfying. When we were having lunch there was a live singing lady, entertaining the guests. A good choice indeed.Show less

Author: stmani
Title: Bday treat
Review: Was almost closing time when my friends n I went here. Had some drinks n snacks. Love the curried tempe , fermented soya bean slices . N the music . You should try it !

Author: rzinger
Title: Diverse menu, cold beer, great people watching!
Review: Had the brown rice curry and cashew chicken. Both were flavorful and not heavy. Watermelon mojito was fantastic and it’s hard to argue with cold Asahi. Good people watching. Friendly staff.

Author: Meow94Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Will sure come back for it!!!
Review: This is one of the best cafe in Jonker Walk. We ordered for fried rice, honey mustard chicken chop, aglio olio and pizza. We went there on weekdays so the restaurant wasn't crowded. However if you go on weekend it would be crowded and merrier. Hari Kumar, the waiter there was very good and very friendly. When we asked about the food, he recommened us some of the best selling there. Plus, the drinks selection was way too many I really had a hard time to make a choice. Ended up ordering Beers and Singapore sling. Your singapore sling bomb!!! I'll come back for it!! The restaurant do serve alcoholic drinks but no pork no lard. Bonus, kuah satay is good!!! Show less

Author: paeds88
Title: Convenient location. Good bar.
Review: Good variety of beers & cocktails. Right in the middle of Malacca's famous Jonker Street. Packed full of tourists. Service can be a bit slow on weekends as it's usually full.

Author: jeffchia88
Title: Crowded but music sucks
Review: A very noisy joint especially when the singer can't sing. Service is fine. Not a place to sit and talk.

Author: juleskarz
Title: Quick lunch
Review:
We had a quick lunch with our young kids. Overall it's an average cafe that served it's purpose. 

We love their Crème brûlée.

Author: susanaalicanteAlicante
Title: Good cocktails!
Review: Have been here for cocktails a few times with friends and they are always good, decided to go for lunch one day but was very dissapointed. The chips were burnt and hard which you only had to look at to realize, the chicken in cheese sauce was average. The salad looked lovely but the walnuts on it tasted of goats cheese and yet they were on the other side of the plate which leads me to wonder - recycled from someone else?? Anyway would go back for the cocktails but not bother with the food.Show less

Author: popeye1423Singapore, Singapore
Title: Just a regular cafe
Review: Food is so so only. We had fried rice, nasi goreng... not great. In fact there are better food along Jonker.Good location as it's in the middle of Jonker and you can rest your tired feet, get a beer and chill and watch the world go by.Show less

Author: Carolyn C
Title: Nice place for a catch up with friends and family
Review: This is a nice place with good environment to catch up with your friends and family. There are both vegetarian and non vegetarian food served in this place.

Author: AndrewU_11
Title: Tasty food
Review: The food was good and the menu varied. Staff were helpful and friendly and the building created a nice setting. As I recall the meal was well priced.

Author: WiekeIGroningen, Groningen, Netherlands
Title: Nice café but expect slow service
Review: Café has a great atmosphere, mainly because of it's great location. Nice place to drink a beer or two although it is not the cheapest place in town. It's a good place to observe people during the night market in the weekends. They had some nice live music. It was very busy and so service was very, very slow. But we had time, so it didn't really bother us. Dit not try the food. Show less

Author: nelizzaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Time for improvement
Review: Foods and drinks here are the same price as Kuala Lumpur in which we think it is slightly too much for a small town. Most of the servers here are either busy drinking behind the bars or too busy looking around at the pedestrian passing by. You really have to catch them when they are close to you. My pesto pasta was a bit dry and the Thai Mango chicken sauce was too littleShow less

Author: Meander817893
Title: Bad attitude staffs
Review: We were there for a jug of draught beer, we already had a couple of snack which is dry squid. We wanted to have a little chili sauce to eat with our snack and the staff said NO, because we didn't order any food to have chili sauce to eat with. One of their staff even asked me "CHILI SAUCE FOR WHAT". The weather was so hot that we suddenly crosses over this and what they gave me was very disappointed. I gave them one 1 star for the bad attitude of their staff. I couldnt have any complain if they answered me in another way.Show less

Author: TheGreatWhiteG
Title: Respite on Jonker Street
Review: This little cafe is friendly and chic, serving “off street” food and drink at a reasonable price. The place was clean and accepts credit cards

Author: Jaxx86Gillingham, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely place for food and drinks
Review: We had dinner here- the Mango Thai Chicken and the Jonkers Fried Rice, with a jug of beer for 110MYR (about £20), which was really good value. The food was delicious and there was a large selection of dishes and drinks on the menu. We returned the following day for a mid-afternoon snack of some satay, which was also great. I would recommend the Geographer's Cafe as a really nice, lively place to eat or just for drinks. Show less

Author: Natalie SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Watch the world go by with great food, drink and music
Review: This is a very popular and lovely place to hang out, grab a bite to eat, have a few drinks and listen to some live music. It's on a corner along Jonker Street so also a fab place to sit and watch the world go by.Show less

Author: carolinewH35FF
Title: Would not go again
Review: This is some sort of healthy eating place I think. We tried something called sempeh and it wasn't very nice. Service was slow and the toilet disgusting. Would not go again

Author: Denise_0121Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nice decorated restaurant.
Review: Get to try different local coffee from 13 states in malaysia. Big breakfast set is good but I think is a bit overpriced RM26 without drinks included. The cold drinks are good. Laksa mee is the signature and taste good with the chilli flakes. The chicken ponteh was very disappointed, blend taste and so oily as you can see a 2mm oil on the top layer and it's actually affecting the taste of the ponteh. But the traditional nyonya ponteh suppose to taste better with pork. Nice place to take photos as this shop has very nice and unique decor and also it's a huge restaurant.Show less

Author: pamela cTaranaki Region, New Zealand
Title: First time ever
Review: We had visited the Geographers in Kuala Lumpa and enjoyed it and mistakenly thought we would have a similar experience in Malaca but sadly this was not so. The meal took ages to arrive despite the quiet period, the meals were served separately and I had finished mine ages before my husbands arrived and this was the very first time in my life that I refused to pay for a drink I was served. The supposedly fresh coconut water was served in the nut but it was very very watery and sour, when told this the chef simply shrugged and dismissed us. Will not be returning and sadly this experience deterred us from visiting other Geographer establishments on our travelsShow less

Author: Christopher V
Title: Food Egh at Best
Review: As the title says, food was egh at best. Only went here because basically nothing else was open on a Monday evening (fair given this is really a weekend getaway for those in KL). It wasn't horrible, just not good.

Author: FizahRomanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over price and food just average
Review: We went dinner here for first time, first of all my experience at this bar just pretty average, music was loud, during that time almost was dinner time,I did ordered fish & chips, and the price was RM28.00, with 2 fillet fish, 1 brocoli, carrot and bit of fries, I don’t see the value for this price, it should be RM18.00 reasonable.Which is not, some more my order came with hair on it, I was returned my food and denied to pay and their ok with that, my partner ordered pizza, but his lucky his food quiet nice.Overall, expensive! CleanlinessShow less

Author: EcoWarriorSalisbury, United Kingdom
Title: Sorry to say, a little bit overrated
Review: We went here for dinner with our Intrepid group and had high expectations. However although the service was good, the food was slightly mediocre and therefore seemed slightly expensive compared to other food in Malaysia. We also went to the jazz night the next evening, and that was good - talented musician.Show less

Author: 31hanl
Title: Cosmopolitan cafe in the midst of heritage
Review:
Nice cafe with nice coffees. The local coffee with biscuits is interesting.

Can get with busy and you should get there early!

Author: Digi-Dish
Title: Exceelnt bar & restaurant
Review: Nice and cosy restaurant. No "haute cuisine" but high quality and fresh pub style dinner. With "fusion"all around then world menu.

Author: peterlee94
Title: Music band
