Review: Classical bistro cafe located right in Jonker Street. Musical band is available during the night time offering customers a pleasure experience while dining and drinking. Nice foods and drinks especially for local favorites and the cakes.

Author: cchow34
Title: Worst restaurant I’ve ever been
Review: The staffs were very rude. The food came late and it tasted horrible. Food was also very expensive. This place is super overrated !

Author: ch00sen1
Title: Nice ambience
Review: The food is normal but drinks a recommendable. The ambience is nice inside outside could be noisy coz its in tigjt smack of jonker street. Their beers are the best.

Author: kjayneSanta Barbara, California
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Great atmosphere but: bar needs help, weak drinks. I had sub par Pina Colada, partner had a G&T that was weak and came with lemon, not lime.Positives: good ‘Geographic Platter’ that we split. Good music, wonderful classic building oozes charm, good location to watch the action of Friday night Jonkers marketShow less

Author: thilaks
Title: Nice ambience but crowded.
Review:
Food is good but bit pricey for the fried rice.
Fruit juice are fresh without added sugar.

Need to improve on service as need to wait long to be served,

Overall is ok.

Author: bobN6078XO
Title: Nice
Review:
We stopped here for lunch. Glad we did.
Pizza was actually good. The pineapple fried rice was good.
The chicken satay was overcooked and dry.

Author: AudreyfbySingapore, Singapore
Title: Service good, food average.
Review: The aglio olio was very tasty. Most importantly, the staff Benjamin was very thoughtful and polite. Service was great! Enjoyed my lunch here! We drank ice chocolate and since the Coco was bitter. Benjamin ensure that we tasted it and gotten us sugar water if it was too bitter to our tasting. He was going the extra mile with his service.Downside was the food serving is small and the serving time was long.The satay meat is tough and dry.Show less

Author: DarthNathan
Title: Key landmark but could improve
Review: The taste has dropped somewhat since I was here last (abt 5 yrs ago). The place is crowded and the wait for food is long. Value isn't exactly there. What they have got going for them is their location - but not much else. Not a single item was outstanding. I think the Geographer needs to be more than just a name.Show less

Author: Ray AGosford, Australia
Title: Like a Movie Set
Review: This cafe is a bit like an old movie set. You can just imagine an old drunk in a sweaty white suit sitting in a back room swilling gin and being approached by Indiana Jones asking him to fly a plane.The food was ok..drinks a bit pricey..recommend The sour plum juice...very refreshing...an interesting place to visitShow less

Author: Patrick SPetaling Jaya
Title: Jonker Street's Popular Stop
Review: In the middle of all the tourism madness, Geographer is an oasis. Food is not only good but has a wide choice on the menu. And the beers are cold for the gents tired and hot from the shopping! The service staff are friendly and the ambience is my parsonal fave. Just watch the world go by... Show less

Author: hynw1
Title: My favorite cafe in Melaka for the past five years BUT...
Review: I've been visiting the Geographic cafe every year for the past five years starting from.It used to be my favorite cafe and restaurant in Melaka, but not this time. Even the menu is still the same, I strongly believe that the chief has changed and the manager, too. Food was not evenly cooked, dry pasta, and especially the chips that came with beer. It's not fully cooked and thus it contains down hard particles that almost broke my tooth. Anyways, I will visit this place next year and I hope it will meet my expectations. Show less

Author: 155thihasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place for western food in jonker street
Review: One of the good places to offer western menus for food. We had a dinner and lunch there on our second visit to Melaka. The atmosphere of the restaurant is nice. They have both outdoor and indoor air con seating. The menu is not extensive but they cover from western to Asian and local food and beverages. The taste is good with reasonable prices. We watched a live performance during the dinner and it was enjoyable. Staff are friendly and always moving around fast. Some food may have to wait long due to the crowd but it’s not that long wait. Would definitely visit again next time. Show less

Author: FrancGuedes
Title: Light dinner
Review: A well situated restaurant on Joncker Street with some very good light food as sandwich and toast. Perfect for some light and “more conventional” food.

Author: servaasa
Title: Great for a drink, not for food
Review: Centrally located in Jonker street a great spot to have a drink and enjoy the atmosphere. Not recommend the food as it takes a long time and poor price/quality (too expensive for what you get).

Author: Ahlan1311
Title: Nice place to chill
Review:
Nice place to chill.... with live music till 1am.
Guinness at Rm$24.5 per pint. Tried the pizza not bad. Staff is attentive as well.

Author: BiteAroundTheWorld
Title: Must visit!
Review: We have eaten so many meals here because it’s so delicious, loads of great Malaysian veggie options which is exactly what we wanted!!

Author: GogogoC
Title: Food hunt
Review: Kind of disappointed, in fact the taste of the tomyam is very flat beside of the plating by pouring the soup in a green coconut nothing to wow about. Apple pie with ice-cream is another disappointment. Kitchen sandwich is ok but I will not recommend if you really want to go for good food. Location is good in heart of busy Jonker Street, ambiance is nice, coffee is ok but quite pricey. Show less

Author: nobodeeThe Netherlands
Title: Excellent Place!
Review: This place has been one of my favorites when I visit Melaka. When I arrived and requested to be seated upstairs, one of the waiter told me the area is closed, but I am welcomed to look around. When I told him my favorite seat is up there, and we were there for beer, he opened the area (which was empty when we went up), and I found my favorite seat.The beer tastes the same, of course, but the setting is great in this place, and +1 for the guy who opened the upstairs for us. Something quaint about the place, and I like looking out the windows from the second floor, and observe the Jonker Street.Food is decent enough, though I can't say they are memorable, but the location, and the decor are definintely memorable.Show less

Author: Jia764539
Title: Chill place for drinks with live band at night
Review: Chill place for drinks with live band at night. Went there for drinks at night. The drinks was affordable not cheap but price was okay. Didn't try their food there. Their live band was good. The place was pretty crowded at night.

Author: catherinemac24
Title: Place to people watch
Review: Centrally locates about half way down Jonker St, it’s the perfect cool location to people watch. Plenty of seating and good service. Food nothing special but decent range and lovely atmosphere.

Author: Elyn L
Title: Soothing ambience
Review: A place where many foreigners love to hang out in Malacca Jonker Street. A cafe which always fulls house during the weekends and countdown nights. Pricey...

Author: kimlkimfd
Title: Spaghetti is good
Review:
A place to chill and to have good food :) 
Tried their tomyum and spaghetti and they were pretty awesome !

Author: 987reginah
Title: Yummy Plum drink
Review: Came here for their refreshing Sour Plum and lime drink. Also had a cup of beer and a bottle of Sommersby. Total RM 43.  I found this rather expensive if not for the central location and needed a respite from the scorching sun.

Author: OnAir753362
Title: Pizza!
Review: Great pizza, a pizza that everyone can finish not to big perfectly good and such nice atmosphere had a good time

Author: Myke28KL
Title: Just an Average Cafe
Review: Went for brunch on Raya, food was served slow, with only 3 service staffs. It was packed by noon. Food was only average with high price tags. A very simple Fried Rice with 2 sticks of satay cost MYR 19.50. Ordered a Long Black, to our surprise, it cost MYR 13.00 instead of MYR 9.00 as shown on the menu. We were told price adjusted because of Public Holiday! We do enjoyed the music played but would never return to this overrated Cafe.Show less

Author: mikeleesl54Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Trip to Geographer by the busy Jonker walk
Review: This café provides a good environment for a cool beer and listen to live country and western music performed by the live guitarist. .. I think his name is Don. It is a good place to rest after a walk along the Jonker wlak stalls especially on Fri, Sat and Sun.Show less

Author: Gianna I
Title: Very nice!
Review: We went there in the evening. Everyone was so friendly and the drinks were priced reasonably! Lovely place!

Author: Vickychchbrett
Title: great vibe
Review: Great music and atmosphere. Foodwas ok once it arrived. Drinks  were tasty and well made. Place to be at night.

Author: Paul N
Title: Islands in the stream
Review: Food was average but father and daughter Karaoke machine were brilliant. They are on every Fri and Sat night. BUT dont ask for Suspicious Minds - 'not rock enough'

Author: miikkkeee
Title: Tasteless on jonker
Review: The place has lots of good reviews not sure why from my experience. Maybe I ordered wrong but food was tasteless and overpriced for what it was.

Author: munkeat95
Title: Food and water
Review:
Hong mustang Chicken add garlic too bad ,other chicken chop bad also 
Spegati agiolio it’s ok 
I won’t come next time 
Water normal 
Price normal
鸡扒累普通，来喝酒可以
价钱合理，环境可以
只是厨师出来的食物非吃普通
白开水一定要一瓶
我不会再来这里吃了

Author: MoonByrneManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Really good food!
Review: We ate here 3 times during our time in Melaka. Each time the food and service was excellent, they have a lot of really good vegetarian options!Their award winning ramen is so good my boyfriend had it every time we went, their curry tempeh is absolutely delicious too! I tried a few pasta dishes which were tasty and their garlic bread is probably the best I have had in Asia! Highly recommend this restaurant! Show less

Author: Siambuddhas
Title: live music
Review: Chill off with family here for some beer.... it will be great if they put more mist spray fans around as its rather warm during the night.... we sat across on the other side ... cheers...worth visiting

Author: Linda H
Title: Good music, shame about food
Review: Always a shame when you look forward to good food based on fab pictures...only to be disappointed with quality. Service was great though

Author: linfameSingapore, Singapore
Title: refreshing change
Review: having gone on a good hunt for chendol , nonya and Chinese food we chanced upon this cafe we stayed at the Puri hotel and tis a 3 minute walk from there it was more of a late night snack Took a short nap at 6 pm and found ourselves hungry by 10 .. malaccanRestaurants close early hence a pizza was a great alternative andChange .. so was the atmosphere Trendy modern .. there was live music too .. now that woke us up ,. Show less

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: nice place/over-priced
Review: This place has been here for years...nice decor and great streetside vantage point.. Food is good, although not remarkable.Service is quick at first...menu right away, Can I take your order? before having a chance to open the menu...and then, a long wait for food and getting a second drink is impossible unless you make a spectacle of yourself.Show less

Author: mikesierraBourne, United Kingdom
Title: Great Little Cafe
Review: Located on a corner half-way along Jonker Street, the principal street of Chinatown, this is an excellent little cafe. Beer is 15 Ringgits (3 GBP) and fruit drinks 7.5 Ringgits (1.5 GBP). For a snack try the excellent spring rolls at 10 Ringgits for 4 (2 GBP). Highly recommended and great stop off in your tour of Chinatown.Show less

Author: MatSallKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: the magnet for tourists - prices higher than Kuala Lumpur
Review: Whilst this is a great location to chill out during a stroll down Jonker Walk, the owners milk the tourists with prices higher than many outlets in Kuala Lumpur. Geared to make money from tourists at weekends, like so much of Melaka has to do in order to survive the remaining 5 weekdays!Show less

Author: shareenadean
Title: Great atmosphere in the middle of Jonker Walk
Review: Lovely cafe, strategic location but with average foods and its a bit of expensive. It is suitable for a date.

Author: Ash YPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent vegetarian cuisine
Review: Geographers is always packed in the late afternoons, but you would do well to stop by for a quick bite before you continue your trek in historic Jonker. The brown rice/brown noodles curry mee is always a favorite whenever we're there, accompanied by the house-style fried tempeh. The menu is extensive, to be fair we've not had the opportunity to really exhaust it, but what dishes we've had, we've all loved. It's a cosy little corner you shouldn't miss.Show less

Author: Csaba FBudapest, Hungary
Title: Good espresso
Review: If you are like me, for whom espresso is the number one thing that is missed while travelling in Asia, you will also appreciate this café. Great quality coffee, nice service, and the terrace is also a very nice place to sit. Also, reasonably priced.A note for smokers: the entire Jonker street is non-smoking, although you may, very rarely, see some locals including some shop owners smoking in the street, it is forbidden, although I didn't see a single sign saying the hole street was non-smoking. (The waitress said I could smoke at my own risk, so I didn't).Show less

Author: GRB-hsbsb
Title: Looked Good
Review: The interior was good and the restaurant busy, so it had some atmosphere. We had Pongteh Chicken and Ayam Masak Merah. The former being the best of the two dishes, although not spicy. It was okay.

Author: breathe-thetravelMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Average touristy bar
Review: I was taken here in a group tour for dinner (but we each paid for our meals). Food choices for vegetarians lacked sorely in protein so I chose nasi lemak (vege option) - could hardly tell it was coconut rice and the “tempeh” was crisp like little chips. I have never come across that before. I was surprised being a restaurant with nice tables, aircon here and there (but with fans on and the doors open, such a waste of energy) that the toilets were all squat for females, the ground was all wet inside, and there was no toilet paper provided. I guess they have a few options for Western plates and that’s why it’s popular, but really, I would not go if it was my choice. So many other real Malay food around, why would you pay double the amount for food that tastes half as good?Show less

Author: Choon HSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ambience is good.
Review: I like the relaxing ambience and its interior decor. Every time I come to Jonker Street I will have a cuppa here. Each and every corner is a good spot for camera shooting. It has air-con and non air-con seats but the weather there is always so warm and humid so I always select air-con seat. It has happy hour promotion at 4 pm for beer lovers. Its mushroom soup is really nice, my friend always orders this whenever she is there.Show less

Author: VincentKKL
Title: One of my favourite place
Review: One of my favourite place after a day walking around Malacca. Good environment and really calm at Geographer

Author: Jennifer D
Title: Hot flat beer!
Review: I know the Malaysian people do not drink alcohol but if they are involved with tourism they need to provide cold beer to tourists. We would have stayed longer but one warm flat beer is more than enough!

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: decent spot...
Review: Been coming here for years & it hasn't changed much. Now the only live music spot (not counting Hard Rock) after Ringo was taken over by them. Great over the weekends to wind down, have some drinks & people watch. Does get really crowded so either come early or wait for seats to free up. Prices are on the high side but expected as its a touristy area. Service is a hit & miss. Decent drinks menu. Try the Irish coffee which is a great pick me upper.Show less

Author: MadeleineD375
Title: Afternoon drink
Review: We didn't hat dinner or lunch but we had a drink that was really nice. Directly in front of the joker street, the terrasse allows you to enjoy the rhythm of the city.

Author: PipPaul W
Title: Expensive
Review:
Had a beer here whilst watching the world go by on Jonker Street.
Was our most expensive whilst in Melacca

Author: sgrene
Title: Great food and vibes
Review: Great atmosphere and good people watching while enjoying yummy food. I have been there a few times over the years and like it a lot

Author: PeterC7505
Title: Very good food and location
Review: Located on jonker street, a bar and restaurant.Great spot to relax after seeing night market.Good value food esp.fruit rojak or tofu. Prices good value for quality of food.Go there often.

Author: real_bsycJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good food, live band, crowd at Jonker Street Night Market
Review: Went there on Sunday night during Jonker Street Night Marketing where people are selling various goods/foods along the street. I have done searching and found this cafe attracted me. Since I missed rice a lot, I ordered "Jonker Street Fried Rice" and "Melaka Ice Coffee" to keep me awaken through the night. It took quite long to serve the food, but it's all paid off. Very tasteful of fried rice, served with an egg on top, two satays and salads. The Ice Coffee is very nice too. Then, there is live band by a female vocal sang beautifully. Before the live band starts, they play old chinese songs instrumentally, so unique compared to the old colonial building.Th Geographer cafe also has extended place across the street in case more crowd coming, right next to Christina Ee Chendol. Show less

Author: margaretwV9936MISydney, Australia
Title: Busy and friendly restaurant
Review: I recently had a late lunch at Geographer Café on a Monday afternoon. The menu was easy to read and many items were accompanied by a photograph so I knew what I would be eating. I chose grilled chicken on skewers with sate sauce together with freshly squeezed lime and sour plum juice. Delicious! Although busy, the café was not crowded and the service was timely and efficient. Unlike Sunday when I noticed the café was packed with patrons enjoying everything that Jonker Street has to offer. It appeared that Geographer Café probably catered more to Occidental tastes as there were many Europeans sitting in the café. The staff I met were pleasant and helpful. I would recommend.Geographer Cafe for a meal or even for a coffee while watching the world go by.Show less

Author: VinaTravelerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but Quite Expensive!
Review: Ordered Pasta Aglio E' Olio and Coffee here in Geographer Cafe during my travel to Malacca! The Pasta was served not in a big portion so, quite upset since, I thought it will be enough for me. It taste good but not the best. The coffee they served is in a tiny cup but as a coffee lover and tasted a lot of coffee- I am not very impressed. Their price is also a bit high compared to some restaurants/ cafe I tried in Malaysia. To come back to eat? NO. But, to come back to drink? Yes! since, I love to hang-out at their cafe.Show less

Author: tanujaav1
Title: bad food,good service
Review: We ordered pasta and vegetarian nasi lemak. The pasta was terrible,probably the worst pasta that I have ate and it was under the chef recommendation.My friends nasi lemak was nothing great too.We were surprised for a good restaurant like this to have such a horrible food.Show less

Author: fqtravellernd
Title: Away from heat and rain and all things crowded
Review:
Good location.. good place to hide away from the hide or rain or even the crowds. 
Food and drinks are ok.. the music and dancing makes it a fun place to be around in the evenings.

Author: GavinJ594Aboyne, United Kingdom
Title: Meh.....
Review: Not good, not bad but a good choice if you are foreign, newish in town and want a pizza or some foreigner-friendly / benign place to eat and catch up on your emails. There are better places but this place would not be out of place in and UK high-street.Show less

Author: gregoryz123
Title: Good Food, Good Service
Review: Enjoyed our time at Geographer. Large menu with tons of options for meat and non meat eaters. Good drinks. Chilled vibe and space. Not much else to say!

Author: 683philipt
Title: Great location
Review: We were advised to go here by our driver and although the service was a bit offhand , we enjoyed a beer and some pizza, while watching the people walking up and down Jonker Street

Author: snworb
Title: Casual
Review: Casual popular restaurant on Jonker. Above average food and drinks reasonably priced. Grab a table on the outside sidewalk and listen to Elvis Presley blasting from the inside sound system

Author: cy_sgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place to chill along Jonker Street
Review: My wife and I recently had a light supper and drinks at the Geographer Cafe on a Saturday night, during our short visit to Malacca. The Geographer was located in close proximity to the hotel we were staying at (Courtyard at Heeren - barely a 2 minute walk away) and we frequently passed the Geographer during our walks along Jonker Street.The Geographer is located somewhere in the middle of Jonker Street and is at a prominent corner shophouse that intersects with Jalan Hang Lekir. As long as you stroll down Jonker Street, you will definitely not miss it. It's open from early (for breakfast) till late (for supper/ drinks) and always has a decent crowd - more so in the evenings.It has a nice unique ambience for a meal or drinks. It's a fusion between a Western bar with Asian/ Malaysian/ Balinese influences. Food-wise, we ordered a bar side of satay which came with chunky chicken pieces. It was decent but given that this is Malacca, you could easily find cheaper (and possibly better) satay at any of the street stalls or coffee shops. The Geographer is worth a visit if you're looking for a place to chill over beer. They also have a live musician on Saturday evenings (at least on the evening that we were there). Prices are reasonable and the food and drinks variety is extensive.Show less

Author: lisa bManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious food and great service
Review: Had lunch here and it was delicious, we shared some dishes. Good choices for veggies and healthy stuff. Only negative is the music was a little too loud - i feel old now I've written that but in a bar it's fine but you usually want to chat over lunch. Will be back thos evening for more food!Show less

Author: enncleNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Jonker rice😀👍
Review: My partner and I stumbled upon this place while out and about in Melaka. Food was tasty hot and tasty. Staff very friendly and welcoming. Great knowledge of menu. Noodles and spicy chicken/tomato curry was excellent too. Visited 2 times while visiting Melaka . Nearly forgot called late evening for banana chocolate cake too. Delish Show less

Author: stepheng878Washington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Couples last minute trip
Review: We are American so the menu certainly tends to trend itself in that direction. It’s got a great atmosphere and they played live music by various artists including Johnny Cash. The food was slightly above average. Overall it’s a good atmosphere and built for western culture for sure but if that’s what you are looking for it’s in a great location.Show less

Author: intrepid2458
Title: Very nice atmosphere but prefer food in KL branch
Review: Had high expectations as we love the KL branch and we certainly enjoyed our visit. The food is good but I think KL branch still has the edge on Malacca branch. Would return though without a doubt.

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Dinner on jonkerwalk
Review: This is a very popular restaurant cafe at jonkerwalk. You at almost anytime see tourists sitting here for a drink or a meal. Food is relatively good. I had a satay pizza which didn't disappoint me except that it could have been a bit bigger.

Author: AmmyY14
Title: Normal bar
Review: We saw quite some blogs or news about this cafe when they recommend cocunut tomyum soup. We got abit disappointed with it :<

Author: Gavskii
Title: Bit of a disappointment
Review: Place looks great and there were a lot of diners so we took a chance on this place despite the awful music they were playing... bad choice. Very average food and service...

Author: Lawrence188
Title: Geographer Cafe Melaka
Review: This restaurant have a nice atmosphere to have food and drinks. The food price is mid range. You can sit by the side walk or in air con comfort. Good place to unwind.

Author: iegf
Title: Chilled pit stop
Review: Nice comfortable place to stop and relax after walking around Jonker street. Watch the world go by with some good food and a cold beer.

Author: Dave C
Title: Very cool location great atmosphere
Review: Loved seating watching the world go by, lovely place to chill cool off on a hot day. Nice soft drinks wines and beers.

Author: HSeeingtheworldWelwyn, United Kingdom
Title: Pleasant enough but nothing special
Review: We stopped to look at the menu as we walked by. The seating was comfortable enough and there was room to sit downWe had the cashew nut chicken which was very bland and the Thai Mango Chicken, which was the better of the two dishes.Service was pleasant and promptIncluding drinks the bill came to less than £20, so I should not be expecting too much, but over here I have had better food for the same or lessWe would not rush backShow less

Author: Mahesh B
Title: Nice place to dine
Review: I visited geographer café for lunch and dinner in the same day and the place does not disappoint. the menu has a good mix for people keen on drinking and eating. evening time has good music and live performance on certain days.

Author: RatnamR11
Title: Cool place to hangout
Review: A cool place to hangout with friends after walking around Jonker street. They have great selection of beer and wine.

Author: SG0412Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Savior for vegetarians
Review: I was in Melaka with few friends over a weekend and this place turned out to be a savior for me since I was the only vegetarian in a group of 8.Surprisingly this place has quite a number of options to choose from for vegetarians in a place like Melaka. I visited the place twice in a span of 1.5 days for lunch and dinner. During lunch we ordered Hamilition (I hope I spelled it correctly) pasta which had a tangy taste and I would rate it average to good, pesto pasta which was tasty but a little dry and Jonker fried rice which was average. For drinks we ordered a coconut water, cappuccino and mocha which were all good. During dinner, I ordered a spicy pineapple fried rice without egg which turned out to be really bland and not spicy at all. 3 of my friends ordered Ramen soup which was bland again and none of them really loved it. Drinks included a beer, watermelon juice and sour plum juice and they were all good specially the sour plum juice. I'm rating this place a 3 because of the ambience and the number of options for vegetarians but food is average. Show less

Author: CharmaineL297Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love the pizza and free crackers but not the beer
Review: The title says it all. The pizza was great, the free crackers which came along with a jug of beer tasted great too. However, the beer (Carlsberg) tasted bad. Not sure why since I'm not a beer expert but it didn't taste like the Carlsberg I tried before.Show less

Author: Howard B
Title: Happening place
Review: Geographer Cafe seems to be the hippest place on Jonker Street. The music is great, the drinks are cold and the service is excellent. If you are hungry step inside the restaurant because the food is good and the prices are very reasonable.

Author: Alicja K
Title: Great place for a quick bite
Review: This was one of the few places open early for breakfast (before 10am). Good selection of mainly Malaysian food with some western choices. Average prices.

Author: 645paml
Title: Great place 👍
Review:
Good eaterie for vegetarians. I enjoyed Tom yam coconut soup and the veggie rolls were very yummy too. 
Excellent Mojito here 👍

Author: Jane BNewton Abbot, United Kingdom
Title: Our favourite eating place
Review: We spent 5 days in Malacca and having quickly discovered the Geographer we ate there most days. The food choice is good and the flavours amazing. They use the best of ingredients and create their own sauces. We loved the warmly spiced curries, washed down with draft Tiger beer. Awesome! We even got nostalgic at the choice of streamed music: Cohen, Buena Vista Social Club and much more. Live music at the weekend. The young bar staff are so helpful and friendly. Show less

Author: RP18_UKBerkshire, United Kingdom
Title: Nice cafe/restaurant
Review: Good location for people watching and great menu. Mix of western and Asian food plus two pages of veg options which was a nice change! Food was reasonably priced but alcoholic drinks seemed a bit expensive. Their homemade cakes are really nice too. Overall would be happy to come back :)Show less

Author: TracyannethiagaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food
Review: The food here was so good and tasty. I would highly recommend their kampung fried rice and iced latte. First time dinning here and so satisfied. It’s at the Jonker Street so after u pump in that fuel u can happily go walk the street and shop. Show less

Author: SG80_11
Title: Nothing really special
Review: The food was nothing special, their menu was quite limited and i considered it overpriced. Just went there as there was almost the only place open in jonker street at a thursday night and it had music. The service was also nothing really special.

Author: hanitau
Title: JKCM
Review: The place is nice and it is a cool place to hang out with friends & family. The poached apple is really very2 good & tasty. Recommended to try it.

Author: edouardreizian
Title: Nice place to unwind
Review: Very cozy, been with some friends had a drink and chatted ... nice variety of drink and even beer menu which i so cool.

Author: Alan CSiem Reap, Cambodia
Title: Chicken and cashew nuts ... without the chicken...or the cashew nuts
Review: I wrote a review some time ago about a restaurant in Battambang, Cambodia which resulted in a 1* nightmare over chicken cashew nuts. There must be something about me and that particular dish because it followed me to the Geographer cafe in Melaka. I would expect chicken and cashew nuts to have more than 6 cashew nuts (Yes, I counted them. I do appreciate that's a bit sad) and [2] three shoelace thin strips of chicken, the rest masquerading as equally thin strips of mushroom. The remainder of the dish was padded out with thick drippy chunks of bland vegetables; an utterly tasteless and poor value meal. This appears to be a restaurant living on its name -certainly not the quality of its food. Better get your act together because there have been a few reviews cropping up recently saying the same thing. You might have nice decor but that's not why people go there.From now on, chicken cashew nuts is permanently off my menu.Show less

Author: 425adityal
Title: Poor food
Review: The cafe used to be fantastic when we visited a few years back but during this visit the food was below average. The bread with curry was under baked and rather stale and tasteless.

Author: anshuman m
Title: The happening cafe at Melaka
Review: The menu is excellent. It doesnot only offer western and local cuisine for non vegetarians,surprisingly it offers a large varieties of Veg food also. The drinks a moderately priced, the food is tasty and the atmosphere is very pleasant.A must visit place.

Author: emptysea56Fredericksburg, Texas
Title: Excellent, Largely Vegetarian Cafe
Review: My wife and I visited Melaka on a recent cruise, and decided to stroll down Jonker Walk after an excursion. Good choice...the Chinatown shops are great. We stopped in the Geographer Café for lunch. Another good choice...the Nasi Lemak I had here was one of the best that I experienced in Malaysia. They use brown rice, which is a bit unusual but was a really interesting change from the norm, However, what made it special was the chili, with a very nice balance of a bit of heat with flavor. I guess that the comments about crowds are restricted to the evening. We had no problem getting a table. It was very relaxing and relatively quiet, even though directly on Jonker Walk. Highly recommended! Prices are very reasonable. Lunch for the 2 of us was 42 RM (about $10).Show less

Author: Colin ABrisbane, Queensland, Australia
Title: Asian Brunch
Review: Brunch this morning consisted of good Lavazza coffee, Jonker fried rice and Mee Goreng. They only do a breakfast on the weekend and I am not sure if it’s a Western style of breakfast. My wife enjoyed her Jonker Fried Rice- as good as at the sister restaurant in Pentaling St KL but my noodles were a bit bland. Like the atmosphere in this old expanded shophouse ( which has even expanded across the road!) even if the music is a little too loud. Service good and staff very pleasant. Show less

Author: 48gerbenp
Title: Middle of Jonker street
Review: Nice place in the middle of jonker street although a little bit overpriced, but for that you have Nice life music and a great view

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Cool Cafe
Review: Crowded as it is a popular cafe. Geographer Cafe in Jonker Walk,  Melaka. Nice to have our beer in open air on the street. Live music to entertain you. A cool place to relax and enjoy your beer and the jazz music...cheers.

Author: mo_baniHannover, Germany
Title: Excellent food, amazing atmosphere
Review: I searched for a nice restaurant to eat lunch. This was perfect! The atmosphere is amazing, you get a feeling of holiday. The food is gorgeous, I'm a vegetarian and there is so much to eat!It was understaffed, so I had to call their attention. But they were always smiling and helpful! I wished I had there also dinner with some cocktails...Show less

Author: ThriftyAlwinLee
Title: Expensive drinks
Review: Really expensive place for drinks. Went in the morning. Seem like the cafe is more happening at night.

Author: jaja136Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Check your change!!
Review: We went there yesterday for drinks after walking about the old town. The banana chocolate cake tasted and looked very similar the one sold at secret recipe. I gave the attendant a 100 ringgit note to pay for the bill which was less than rm40 (because that was the only note i had in my purse). I was shortchaged because the cashier mistook it for a 50 ringgit note. The mistake was rectified but we had to wait for awhile in front of the cashier who was an angry man and shouted "it was a 50ringgit note!!". If you feel you cannot avoid this place, please make sure you have adequate change to pay for your food, or clarify with the attendant CLEARLY that this is the amount you have given. And count your change properly too. It has now entered my list of a no-go for food in Melaka. Show less

Author: richardandkidsBeverley, United Kingdom
Title: Not sure what people expect
Review: Hey it's a busy cafe in a tourist hot spot! The food is fine, the service was fine and the place is quite nice really. It is a bit pricey, the toilets were not at all good and the outside seats are virtually in the traffic, I could have easily changed the music in some cars from my stool. It's a nice cafe, no more no less. Show less

Author: KennyLCCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Old is gold, good live music and drinks
Review: The live music here is one of the oldies featuring the likes of Paul Anka, Frank Sinatra, Kenny Rogers, The Hollies and more. It’s a good place to just drink whether alone or with friends to enjoy the live music. Chatting is not encouraged here as the music can get too loud but hey, we are all there for good music so let’s just sit back with drink in hand, relax and enjoy. Show less

Author: NCNGSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Foods really bad
Review: We came for lunch and the foods are really bad, no wonder no crowds at all. Chicken chop, nasi lemak, curry noodle etc none were good and pricey, it did not worth the price we paid as the taste was awful. The service are good, but the foods...I am really disappointed of it.Show less

Author: MartinM1725
Title: Shocking experience
Review: Sat down to the nearly half empty street side area and ordered. Took 20 minutes and 2 further requests to get our 2 bottles of beer.20 minutes later I my airline quality Jonker fried rice came and no sign of my partners fried rice dish( were not talking anything complicated here). The couple beside us didn’t receive any food despite being there before us so they got up and left! My partners food never came so we decided to leave! I also saw 2 other couple loose patients and tap out!Waiting staff were walking around bumping into like zombies, carrying plates of food around bumping into each other like they didn’t know what it was. When paying I asked what was so slow in the kitchen and was told that the staff were very busy and a bit tired! I’ve travelled to over 50 countries and this is by far the worst restaurant service I’ve everexperienced. The staff were as useful as a chocolate tea pot, the food was poor. I have read some of the other reviews and I cant understand how it was so bad! I would never recommend this place to anyone. Whoever owns this tourist clap trap should be ashamed of themselves and go into a new line of business or pull their finger out and get their restaurant running. It’s funny that even after reading all the great reviews the place could be so so awful. Maybe it was just a bad day for them or maybe not, Who knows.Show less

Author: Stefan1985
Title: Good place!
Review:
Nice place to eat and drink. Menu is ok, enough choice. Air blowers everywhere! Prices are reasonable.
Jonkers fried rice with sate is good, only ask for extra sate's if you're hungry

Author: planetseb
Title: Great location, good food, good service!
Review: We ate three times, each time trying something different - except...  I had the Coconut Thai soup all three times - it was superbly delicious!

Author: joycel929
Title: Nice history & ambience
Review: Live bands play at night & there is a nice history to the place & great place for interaction. We always come here for a cold beer in the afternoon to escape the heat and the crowds

Author: artnolaJeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Nice atmosphere, ok food
Review: I stopped here and had the chicken satay- too much curry and the dipping sauce was just ok. The Tom yum soup in the coconut was good. But it was quite busy and the servers seemed overwhelmed. I just got up and paid at the bar. Show less

Author: gracep1572
Title: Nice cafe
Review:
Nice cafe with nice food! Try their satay and unexpectedly taste really good! Better than kajang satay 

Tomyum soup was nice although small portion serve inside coconut

Strategic place, located right at the middle of jonker street!

Author: 779mareep
Title: Best Moijto in town
Review: Very tasty Moijto. The Ginger Moijto is the best. Tasty snack food as well and nice place to hang out.

Author: HongYawJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not up to its name
Review: Geographer cafe is no where close to what the reviews says. The food are nothing special (not even great), not even authetic, servings are small, pricing are expensive even for a cafe standard.Despite its strategic location, do visit other eateries or cafe for a better value for money.The staffs maybe friendly, but service are just not there. Just spend the money at any other local eateries.Show less

Author: HelenMRyan
Title: Bad food, slow service
Review: I thought the cafe looked cute so we went in. My checked TripAdvisor reviews and they were mixed. But we were hungry and tired, and I thought, "How bad could it be?" We had three separate dishes and none of them were good. We didn't finish our meals. Service was very slow. I asked for the bill and it didn't come. I had to go find someone to ask again. I'm sure there are better places than this. If you are coming for a drink and to hang out, maybe it's nice. Good ambiance. But I would skip it for meals.Show less

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Can't believe the ratings!
Review: This is the place we went to for our first dinner and we were utterly disappointed with the services and food. Though the satay sauce was good, the rest of the items like the jonker fried rice, pineapple fried rice, and the local coffee were disappointing.The service was not up to expectation as well. When I first entered with 6 adults and 4 kids, they told me that they could only give us two tables (the one which seats 4) and I told them I have ten. I suggested that I take maybe two high seats right beside the tables and they were reluctant as the table can seat 6. But when we visited, there are ample tables around if there is going to be new patrons coming. The service is non existence as we kept asking for cutleries for the kids and also the side plates!I agree that the restaurant is nostalgic with nice decor and live band. But the service and the food seems way out from the reviews that I have gotten here!Show less

Author: SurfingWildBandung, Indonesia
Title: Amazing Place to Hang Out
Review: Possibly the single most cool hangout in the Jonker Street area. Lots of people keep popping in and out,mostly foreigners who just want to hangout, chat and eat and drink. We only stopped here briefly for a drink but next time we will spend more time here. Really a very cool place indeed.rShow less

Author: 552WendyH552
Title: Great coffee
Review: Stopped for a coffee and ended up having coffee. Meal was very very good. Spring rolls both sorts were especially good. Satan’s were also very good.

Author: terribthoriumPaderborn, Germany
Title: The right spot at the right time
Review: After a long day walking through Melaka, I was looking for a good place to seal the day on a busy Saturday evening during school holidays. The Geographer was already very crowded, but the menu was promising as they not just serve classic continental dishes but also local food and some specials I needed to try. I fully committed to some of their Curry dishes. Ramen, Veggie Curry with Naan and Tempeh that I can just recommend as they are as good as promoted by them. In addition, it is placed right at the center of busy Jonker street and you will find any kind of people sitting here which makes it a great atmosphere and a lot to chat about. COnsidering this, prices for most of the meals and drinks are highly reasonable.Show less

Author: HippygoneYuppieSydney, Australia
Title: The Geographer is one of our favourites
Review: My daughter and I were so excited to return to the Geographer after our first visit 2 years ago. It did not disappoint and we had a couple of delicious vegan meals there whilst in Melaka. It has a varied menu but also offers a number of delicious vegetarian and vegan options.We highly recommend a meal there!Show less

Author: martinhW7937GEChapel-en-le-Frith, United Kingdom
Title: Busy Cafe.
Review: The Geographer Cafe is situated on Jonker Street at one of its busiest junctions. The menu consists of the usual local cuisine,snacks,coffee etc & is moderately priced. It is quite airy & very convenient for local shops. The staff are friendly but usually very busy as the Cafe has a high turnover of clientele passing through. Recommended for shoppers who want a drink & perhaps a bitter to eat for half an hour.Show less

Author: henryccs
Title: Good environment to chill
Review: Hood environment to chill out when visiting jonker Street. Have a cool beverage and enjoy the atmosphere while looking the local and tourists roam around the street especially weekend nights

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: This joint is pretty cool
Review: Go here if your mood is kind of nostalgic with a dash of bohemia. The menu is quite varied, and food generally good and moderate in quantity. Decor is somewhere like where you would want to meet Indiana Jones. Good to hang out with friends. They have live jazz music sessions on some nights, I think, The general area is also always buzzing, so nice spot to watch Melaka walk by. I didn't get the chance to pull out my cigar as I was there for lunch.Show less

Author: Jessisaw
Title: Wide and varied menu
Review: I enjoyed the relaxed atmosphere of eating at The Geographer. The wait staff were good at giving recommendations. The menu has a range of Western and local food and can be modified according to your needs. The yogurt cheesecake was horrible!

Author: LizzyLeetonLeeton, Australia
Title: A nice relaxing place for a meal and beer
Review: We dropped in here feeling a little hot from our walking and ended up staying for a few beers and dinner. The staff were friendly and relaxed and there was just a nice atmosphere to the place. We sat on a kerbside table and enjoyed watching the people walking past as we ate dinner which was fine without being exceptional. Recommend this place.Show less

Author: Andrea S
Title: Nice, but...
Review: ....one of these restaurants which are trendy and have an excellent location, or maybe they are trendy because of the excellent location, but although the ambience is really nice, the food is not. It's okay. I tried several times, but nothing really tasty. For delicious food you'll find plenty of other restaurants. Show less

Author: KayaOtah
Title: Centre of Jonker
Review:
Decor: simple cafe with nice fountain 
Food: innovative, such as the tomyum soup in coconut
Price: slightly pricey in Jonker 
Service: seems rather uninterested, except those at the bar and cashier who are MUCH MUCH welcoming and friendlier 
Wifi: yes

Author: huthaman
Title: Nice poached apple with ice cream
Review: Our favourite, it is yummylicious. It is served hot with ice cream topping. Take a break from the scorching sun and chill yourself with this excellent dessert.

Author: J S
Title: Great food
Review: Great food in a perfect location for watching the world go by, reasonably priced, good vegetarian selection - I recommend the curry dish nice and spicy!

Author: Aliice C
Title: Pizza smell good and taste good
Review: Good pizza smell so good , the place is at almost end of Jo key street. With life band music good for cheer up for the day

Author: jm0312
Title: nice place to get out of the hot sun
Review:
nice local kopi with cracker. quiet in the day time but busy in the night with a live band on Friday night. people standing on the streets.
kids enjoy the sandwiches and cake

Author: 107andytKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Sit on the street
Review: Came here on a saturday night, seating on the street or in the main restaurant looked buzzy and fun. We were sat in the cafe side opposite - atmosphere was dead. Service was slow for an 'average' cocktail, beer/coconuts etc were quick. If you come here, make sure you are on the street, much better for people watching or feeling part of the joker st buzz.Show less

Author: AdammikaeelJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Lunch
Review: To start, the service was decent despite getting one drink wrong. When my fork fell on the floor, the waiter provided a new one without me asking.The location is great, as is the look of the restaurant.However, the food was really bad. Absolutely bland and somewhat unpleasant. It was difficult to eat such terrible food. We had the Nasi Impian, and a signature noodle soup/curry. Had to force them down so as not to waste.The drinks were expensive.Its sad because the place looks great, and it is popular.We will not return nor would we recommend eating here.Show less

Author: imshirleythong
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: Geographer cafe is a nice place to chill at night. We came on weekday thus it was not so crowded. One thing to complain was there were mosquitoes.

Author: GiulellaZurich, Switzerland
Title: Good food and nice place
Review: We stopped by this place under suggestion of a friend who was here some months ago. Good choice, it is on the main street of Melaka, we sat outside and had a lovely dinner: tempeh, rice with spinach and mushrooms, ramen. I would definitely come back if I come back to Melaka. Show less

Author: tonynannb
Title: Great safe cafe
Review: We have been here a few times and been great satays and pizza are good  nice place just to sit has a aircon inside area as well as outside sitting staff are friendly  and prompt on a busy corner after 8 evening nice live music

Author: alistair15
Title: Comfortable place for food and drinks
Review: A cosy and relaxing place for you to enjoy after a day trip in the hot sun of Melaka. Decent food and services.

Author: Janbroviz
Title: Good place to hangout with nice music
Review: Enjoy a cold beers with the gang, centrally of Jonker walk. Staff are friendly. We're enjoy with live music and met a new friends here!!! Great place to chill out :0

Author: GTCSomesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Only proper bar in Malacca.
Review: It's my first visit to Geographer Cafe. I went on 5th Oct and 6th Oct 2017 at a different time. Quick service. Not crowded. Windy because of the fans installed. Music playing through speaker. Had beer for RM$23 a pint. Really nothing much to comment, it's a good place to just sit down for a while to chill. In the evening, there is live band. I didn't try any food.Show less

Author: purplebackpackSingapore, Singapore
Title: Victim of its own success. Terrible service and not good food.
Review: Came here last year. Raved about it and this time, brought some friends along. Such a turnaround. The food was ok only, the service is terrible this time. We were not the only ones complaining, a few tables around us, have the same problem: slow service, food came warm, and last one, it didn't come at all but was in the bill. Can you believe it?We were very patient in waiting, we only started bugging the service staff after half hour of waiting, for each serving. Imagine how long our dinner took..So, sorry for this honest but bad review. Won't be coming back here again, but will visit Melaka again for sure.Show less

Author: Lollybelle85London, United Kingdom
Title: Good for people watching
Review: I went to the Geographer on a Saturday night so it was very busy as Jonker street market was taking place, and this therefore made it a perfect place to people watch. The drinks were reasonably priced and service was quick. My only criticism is that the live music in the bar was far too loud... you were not able to talk to the person sat next to you. But it is worth a visit - great location Show less

Author: Yamuna G
Title: VERY GOOD!
Review: Nice ambiance. Child friendly too. Their food definitely good. Must try their Satay Pizza! Their Rojak was gd too! Overall Delicious! One of restaurant close late.

Author: 768AmyCTainan, Taiwan
Title: Dinner
Review: Came here for dinner as it was a Monday night , only a few tables. Food and service was oaky, nothing very fancy that you MUST visit. However the location was at the corner, it's good to stop by for a drink and see people Show less

Author: DJLengYein
Title: Centre of the jonker street
Review:
Its here for ages
Food are ok
Price are averagely high but affordable for foreigners
When im tired of walking i will stop by n have a coconut

Author: Fransiska N
Title: Delicious 😋
Review: Nice cool cafe in Malacca...menu filled with variety of Asian food and some western food choices...I love the fresh veggie spring rolls...we’ve been to this cafe atleast 4 times now and the menu always leaves me spoilt for choice every time😋

Author: cats674Singapore
Title: Good place to chill
Review: The Geographer Cafe is situated in the middle of Jonker Walk, so it's a convenient place to take a break from all the walking in the harsh heat. We visited in late afternoon on a Saturday for some beer. The place was not too packed, mostly tourists like us who want to rest their tired feet and rehydrate. The staff are friendly, always smiling and helpful. The interior is a renovated shop house, playing jazzy music. I wish we had gone there to have a meal because the food menu looked quite good, especially their curry, but we had just finished a late lunch and it was too early for dinner. Will try their food next time. Unfortunately, the ladies restroom is not so great....it's the type you have to pour water yourself from a bucket to flush....wasn't very clean and that kind ruined my visit. But otherwise, we enjoyed the good beer break. Show less

Author: appuchin
Title: Go even if you are not hungry.
Review: It's one of the best coffee shops I have seen in Malaysia. It has a rustic feel to it and the food is amazing. You may not want to skip it if you are in Melaka.

Author: johnfA3861TA
Title: Break
Review: Nice relaxing place. Can be crowded but tables are arranged to maximise privacy.Had the pasta, tasted good. Life music starts at 8 pm but the tables would be completely taken up by 7.30 pm. So come early for a relaxing meal and good music. Yeah, they have good selection of alcohol as well. Cheers!Show less

Author: Huishan824
Title: Good relax
Review:
Price ok
Environment ok
Location inside Jonker street
Staff friendly and nice
Many drinks can choose 
Many tourist visit

Author: mjpeter2017
Title: Chill & Relax
Review: The restaurant located in jonker street ityself...Good place to relax after long walk in hot sun in jonker..The restaurant serve fresh coconut juice.

Author: MAKANRANGERS
Title: Good food & ambience
Review:
Delicious food, cozy and soothing music. One can spend the whole night here, chill and people watching.
Tried their nasi impian, coconut tomyum and vege fried rice. Nicely cooked.
Staffs are attentive and polite.

Author: telur1
Title: great place to take a break after walking
Review: if you're looking for a place to rest and relax after walking Jonker, this is the place to go . Great beers and cocktails selections, nice atmosphere and good live music after 9. only one thing , service is bit slow only

Author: ilyarepnikov
Title: Nice and atmospheric
Review: Had a brunch there. Kitchen is very decent. Nothing special tho except geographer punch drink and amazingly mild hearted music 🎶

Author: Pranav N
Title: Lack of options brings you here
Review: Melaka surprisingly has fewer options to eat than you can imagine. Not that this one is great, but has a great combination of location, atmosphere, and decent food.

Author: Rachel_PRLSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lots of Vegan & Vegetarian selection
Review: We walked past this place while walking along Jonker Street. The cafe is full with many foreign tourists, and we were about to look for another option but we saw there is another shop lot opposite which is almost empty and cooler and yet still belongs to Geographer. So we decidedly to give it a try.Surprisingly there are 2 full pages of choices for vegan & vegetarian. We ordered a mozzarella pizza, vegies satay & veg bitter gourd soup bee hoon along with some drinks. The pizza is freshly make in the open kitchen next to us, and it is reasonably good. Veggie satay is made from monkey head mushroom and very tasty. The bee hoon soup is average.Overall we like the ambience & wide selection for vegetarian.Show less

Author: IanHullEngland
Title: Hmm : /
Review: Visited last night during the Friday night market on Jonker Street.. Service was chaotic and food bland. Cafe is nicely designed and in a great location but is perhaps a victim of its popularity...or we caught it at a bad time.

Author: Christine B
Title: Tourist hangout
Review: It's a nice place, overpriced compared to other places close by and there is always a crowd of western tourists who seem to dominate.  If you want respite from Asian/Malaysian cuisine this might suit you.  Best thing is their fruit juices - orange and lime.

Author: freetoliveSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great atmosphere,nice cafe in Jonker Street
Review: Great atmosphere, nice local food, strong WiFi and great coffee makes for a successful cafe. They have a great selection of beer and wine too. If you can get a table outside, you can people watch while sipping a cold beer in the humid Melaka weather.Will go again.Show less

Author: YzTengC
Title: Poor service
Review: I know that in weekend many people will visit this place... less workers and slow service with poor manners...food is not that good and price considering high... coconut cost rm8+ but without meat

Author: younger873
Title: Hot and hungry
Review: A nice vibrant cafe with good food and good beer selection, looks straight onto Jonker street so good to sit back relax and watch the world go by.. stumbled across this when looking for somewhere to eat and I am not disappointed

Author: mvwijland
Title: Very nice establishment
Review: The geographer is a really nice bar/restaurant. They serve nice food (pizza for my kid). The bar has great assortment of cocktails (and mocktails). We visited twice.

Author: sl0wm0Singapore, Singapore
Title: good food and drinks at affordable prices
Review: the food is quite good and the prices are affordable specially for a Singaporean in Malaysia.the place gets quite crowded in the evening given that it is just off joncker street, so make sure you get there early or are happy to wait for 15-30 min.the staff is prompt and friendly and the clientele chilled out. The music was not too loud was a mix of old school rock and pop.definitely one of the more chilled out places to hang...Show less

Author: Sandesh B
Title: Really Really Bad Service!
Review: Staff very rude! Food quality is just average. Non-smoking so not very convenient. Will definitely not come back.

Author: Omega T
Title: Cool off
Review: A cafe serves food and drink located in the old city by the corner, the traffic could be bad from day and night, A mixture of asian and foreigners patronising and sit back and relax while walking back to & froth from a day strolling.

Author: X2653GRmarcd
Title: Place to be
Review: As European tourist this is the place to be in Melaka. We went several times there for lunch and to have a drink. Music in the evenings. Good food en good service

Author: DanteRobin
Title: GOOD FOOD
Review:
All drinks and meals very good and reasonably priced.  Music on at nights and buzzing!!.
Lunch time for families but night time very busy not for young ones.

Author: gnoriep74
Title: Nice Ambience
Review: I ate dinner here a few times. The sour plum lime juice is nice and the place has a nice ambience. It's a cafe and you can find some local food on their menu too. Nice for dinner along Jonker street.

Author: marcelveeneman
Title: Centrally situated, local restaurant
Review: Situated at a busy crossroad you'll find geographers cafe. Two outlets on either side of the street. Local food tastes good and is affordable.

Author: zen_nav
Title: Great place to eat
Review:
Great cafe/restaurant, wide choice of food to suit most tasks including a range of local and western dishes. 
Seating both outside and inside(air conditioned). 
Nice place for a quick bite in a friendly atmosphere.

Author: ericamcquadeAdelaide, Australia
Title: Good food good service
Review: We stopped in here for a cold drink after it was recommended by our taxi driver . The cafe has a really relaxed feel about it and our fruit shakes were good , so we returned later for a meal . Good food , friendly ,efficient service and the staff are helpful . The following day we had coffee at the cafe and it was the best coffee I have drunk since arriving in Malaysia . The toilets are also very clean . Show less

Author: Ken P
Title: Lively Bar with Live Music
Review: This is a nice bar with good service and live singers which has plenty of atmosphere. Wish we had eaten here after a poor meal nearby. Well worth going to to be entertained.

Author: Graeme L
Title: Quick lunch
Review: We stopped and had wanted pizza but that was only served from 3.30 pm so we opted for a fried rice dish as well as some spring rolls.  While the service was adequate the food was tasty.

Author: Jeff M
Title: Wonderful Oasis
Review: Always nice to have a meal here. Nice settings in a pre-war shoplot. Friendly service. Live music, western and local fare with great variety of refreshments.

Author: Andy C
Title: A bohemian cafe with kitsch decoration
Review: Along with the the pioneering loony planet Cafe, this is one of the oldest bohemian hangout in Melaka Situated at the foot of the bunga raya bridge instead of the touristic enclave of jonker walk.. this is definitely the spot to see the pulse real melaka.. Show less

Author: Jo S
Title: Pretty good
Review: A good vibe, good menu and good food. This is a popular place in Melaka, both locals and visitors alike. We enjoyed our one meal there.

Author: Patrick L
Title: Dinner snacks & drinks
Review:
This is a cafe that's perfectly located right in the middle of Jonker Street. 

After walking and eating and shopping in the heat and humidity the Geographer Cafe is the place to take a break for a drink if not more food.

Author: crowley44
Title: Late night drinks and snacks
Review: I thought the place was pretty over rated although it is often packed and hard to get seats. Drinks and snacks were expensive as compared to other joints along the same street though it tasted average. Service was slow and so-so.

Author: T S
Title: Great Flavors
Review: Ordered two Malay dishes and we were very pleased. The background music at this restaurant is enjoyable. Even though it was very busy during our visit, the service was outstanding and our food was delivered quickly. Will definitely eat there again.

Author: catherinelee800Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Terrible food, even worse service
Review: My family and I visited Melaka many times and have seen this place very crowded. However, we never it before. This time we decided to try. It was awful. We ordered a pesto pasta, naan bread, pi neapple fried rice and chicken satay. The rice was tasteless, the naan bread was too dry, the satay peanut sauce was diluted and pasta was so plain. What a dissapointment!!!!! The service was bad too. When we asked for extra culinary because we were sharing , they took so long. They don't serve water and bottled water is RM3.80. What a rip off!Show less

Author: wahliao
Title: Large menu. Good vibe.
Review: Nice relaxing place for a beer and food. Was open late on Monday night when many other places on Jonker Street were closed. They even had a live band.

Author: benwolf223
Title: good hangout
Review: It's a good place to hangout, the drinks are good and the sandwiches isn't that bad. Appreciate the good service provided at the cafe.

Author: Angelo442014
Title: Excellent restaurant for food and see the happenings on Jonker Street
Review:
Good selection of food and beers.  Ideal location to sit and watch the happenings on Jonker Street.

The service and staff are very friendly.

Author: chriswithac17Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place to have a cold one when in jonker
Review: Beers were good, service was okay. Nice friendly crowd. It has a very cool ambiance. No complaints. Do note, if you're coming to jonker just to have a few cold ones, the traffic and parking and walking from the parking to the bar might be a hassle though. If you're already in jonker and want to have a few cold ones, this is the place.Show less

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No much hype...
Review: Although along the Jonker Street, this is the one cafe serving alcohol drinks stands out among other since it is located in a very spot on premise, which tourists will just hop in very easily. We were there when the sky was very windy indicating the rain was coming. Ordered beers and desert.. but they forgot the beer order... need to constantly remind them.. this was not a good sign... they have live band with some good music.. quite crowded but it was just a normal cafe cum bar.... no big deal.. as I said, their location is good, so lots of tourist having a break there.When a heavy rain came, all patrons at the verandah just ran into the cafe.. even we sat inside, we felt rain just splashing in.... wow!!!Just a place to sit and rest...Show less

Author: XimeyJuanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Less than spected
Review: The best is the location. Then it's what they charge. More expensive beer, happy hour with options too limited. On the sidewalk, I asked if I could smoke and the waiter said, "This is a smoke-free area. You can smoke in your house." 5 minutes later someone lit a cigar inside the room and no one said anything, so I turned on mine hehe. We didn't try the food because it was obvious that it would not be good enough and overpriced. Thank you TripAdvisor.Show less

Author: danielpF5940HD
Title: Terrible
Review: I am not normally one to share my restaurant opinions with random strangers such as yourself. However, after dining at the Geographer Cafe I felt moved to share my experience in the hope of preventing others from feeling similar disappointment. After 3 weeks of delicious Malaysian food I unfortunately stumbled upon this highly rated trip advisor establishment. Quite simply, it sucked. The pizza (which I only ordered since the rest of the menu looked so nauseating) most closely resembled a cheese encrusted slice of cardboard. The chicken satay (almost impossible to mess up) was completely flavorless and everything lacked in salt, pepper or any other spice found on these wonderful islands.Therefore I beg you to please spent your time in Malacca/Melaka? at any food establishment other than this one. This town has quite a lot of good food and I can assure you that at least 99% of them are better than this.Show less

Author: RobertP7785
Title: A magnet for young tourists
Review: Crowded with tourists drinking overpriced beer.  Food looked ordinary, but having sampled the beer I didn't eat there.

Author: Thipa R
Title: Chilling out.
Review: Food here is good. Very comfy and can't beat the location. Good place to hang out after walking along Jonker Street.

Author: Kelly L
Title: Really disappointed!!
Review: We are here for lunch during our trip to Melaka. We expected more due to the good reviews and we're happy to get vegetarian food but we were disappointed. The rice was cooked horrible and was stodgy and the tempeh was awful. We have just spent a month in Indonesia and loved tempeh so we were excited to have it but it was rock hard and tasteless. I had to force myself to finish the dish. My partner had a veggie curry that he said was okay. The service was really good and the staff are friendly so maybe it is better for a drink in the evening rather than food?! Show less

Author: RajS3065
Title: A rip of restaurant
Review: My first visit to this place was on the 25th of June 2017, which was the first day of Hari Raya.My wife had been here before and said they also had nice vegetarian food, so we decided to go here for a meal.The place was packed with people from all folks and was a busy day with the public holiday.I would say that this place needs a lot of improvement.1. Services - the waiter/ waitress need to be more alert on the customers who coming in. Orders need to be taken on time and dispatched to the kitchen. They remember to send the food but forget to provide cutlery. They except the customer to take it themselves. On this day even though the place was swamped with customers the owner should manage his/her ground staffs well.2. Food - I do not know what is so great about the food here but the are jsut ripping of customers. I dont mind paying a high price for my food, but please ensure you provide quality and food worth the money. I.e. Jonker Fried rice which cost RM19.50, is just nasi goreng kosong. Come on la atleast u can have some chicken or fish cake in it. If you are more focused to server the foreigners then might as well put a sign your outlet is for foreigners.The aglio olio spagettie is for a kid to eat with a price tag of RM18.00I will never recommend anyone to go to this place since it is just a rip of outlet.Show less

Author: snehavaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: European feel in melaka
Review: Absolutely loved the outside seating at night and the food , fairly priced , sitting outside on the street in the buzzing jonker street it's an ideal spot to soak in the liveliness around and have ur food and drinks. Service is quick and food is good.Show less

Author: CP GReading, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to hang out!
Review: Great atmosphere especially during evening. It is right at the middle of jonker street, and very famous in this area. If you are looking for good food, this is not the place. you can easily find an authentic local food around this area. But if you are looking for have a couple pint of beers, this is the place! I would say the price is above average from local tourist point of view.Show less

Author: 88Eunice
Title: Do not order the juices
Review: The Juices were diluted and tasteless. We tried the satay, wasnt that fantastic either. The smell from the drains at night was bad too.  and nice to sit and chill at night.

Author: FrankchescaBournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Nice food and imported beers
Review: If imported beers are your thing, this place is not to be missed. Great mix of western and Asian food on the menu. Cake looks divine (but I was on a diet). Busy on the weekends and good to observe the people milling around the market on Jonker Street. Very quiet during the week but still good.Show less

Author: 445kieransHunchy, Australia
Title: Friendly Staff
Review: I visited this cafe four times during my eight day stay in Melaka.On 3 occasions I stopped to enjoy a cold drink and on one occasion I also enjoyed a dish of ayam masak merah. On all four occasions I found the staff to be very friendly and attentive to my needs. The drinks were cold and reasonably priced. There was a selection of Asian and Western food available. The Tom yum soup served in a coconut was very popular. The setting is tropical and comfortable. There is an air conditioned area available inside if needed. The position along Jonker Street is ideal for those needing some time out to cool down and relax.Show less

Author: lololol999008
Title: Good place to chill, not the best for good
Review: Atmosphere is good. But the food is quite disappointing. Plain and normal. If u are going for good, Hawkers next door is better

Author: arvinAWD
Title: Nice place to chill out
Review: They serve a wide range of food and beverages. Prices are marked for tourists. Great ambience and laid back. Good place to chill out with good food and a chilled beer.

Author: greatestguy
Title: Lovely place to chill!
Review: Love the environment...after a tiring walk along jongker street its a superb place to chill and its awesome life band with old jazz songs will make u really relax..nice food and drinks ..cocktails etc... a must try place!

Author: simonkI295EZ
Title: You will not miss this place
Review: The restaurant just located in the middle of Jonker Street, you will never miss this place from any direction to Jonker Street.

Author: minchangBrisbane, Australia
Title: Relaxing in a cozy environment
Review: We visited Melaka in a weeknight, so there were not many tourists around at night. I loved the atmosphere here, with old songs by Nirvana and good decoration. We ordered cocktail and staff were very friendly and helpful. The cocktail is not too good, but the nice setting made up for it.TIP: Don't drink old-fashioned cocktail. It lacks aromatic flavor.Show less

Author: woosyx
Title: Not even close to authentic
Review: Food at best is mediocre. Very disappointing...Ordered the lontong, a local vegetarian dish, gravy was diluted, dish tasted bland, not fragrant. Ambience was alright for a drink. If you have no where else to go. We were there because it was raining rather heavily, and a lot of shops were closed.Show less

Author: BigGreenDot
Title: Great vegan & vegetarian options!
Review: Loved the ambience and location. Drinks a bit expensive. Curry tempe and the banana chocolate cake were superb!

Author: mikebD1481XB
Title: Melaka Vacation
Review: We came to Melaka with our family from the US.  We were looking for an option that had some variety of food and could handle our large group.  Food was good, service was fine, and prices were acceptable.  Would recommend for others.

Author: 3egg
Title: interesting meal
Review: At first wanted to order some western style food, as "geographer cafe" gives the feel westernise..hahaha.. but ended up ordered Lontong, something very local.Taste was good, like it. next return with friends / family will definitely order this again for them to try, and I will try something else.. haha!I like the environment too, perfect for chillax for the night, especially after the jonker night market (only on Friday and Saturday night)... thumbs up.Show less

Author: ShiminWongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Utter disappointment
Review: Mostly importantly, the service was bad, the staff were unattentive and prone to ignoring requests. My friends & I ordered a tower of Asahi and when we took the first sip, it doesn't taste like Asahi at all! We suspected it was Carlsberg and approached the staff to highlight the problem. Surprisingly, they verified and told us that it is Asahi. We then ordered a pint of Carlsberg and found that it taste exactly the same. We tried approaching the staff again and we were again ignored and none dare to come to us. It was no longer about the difference in cost, but the integrity of the business.Being at the hub of jonker street where thousands of tourists swing by, I am really disappointed on how this service could be tolerated in such a tourist destination. I've attached the receipts and the colour of the beer, good beer drinkers can be the judge. Show less

Author: BobJBruce90Woking, United Kingdom
Title: Hub of Jonkers Street.
Review: This bar is ideally placed to watch the world go by be it locals on scooters or tourists trying to work out which way to go. The beers are always cold and the snacks tasty. It's also just round the corner from most of the Jonckers Street art etc.Show less

Author: tomandrachWinnipeg, Canada
Title: Not as Expected
Review: As a fairly highly rated TripAdvisor restaurant in Melaka we had reasonable expectations for both food and service- neither were good.The cashew chicken was dry and a bit rubbery and we sent back one of the other dishes as it was deep fried chicken that had been terribly overlooked - they made us pay for it in spite of the fact it was inedible.The beverages on the other hand were served icy cold and hit the spot.Perhaps we caught them on a bad day but we certainly wouldn't return.Show less

Author: 1strangerthings1
Title: GUINNESS ON TAP
Review: A great pint and the foods pretty good also.On a Saturday and Monday there is usually alive performer singing all in all a good night though as Saturday is market night it can get pretty busy, so grabbing a seat can be difficult though they put plenty of extra tables outside and they also bought over a bar across the street Show less

Author: MarkS960
Title: Geographer Cafe Melaka
Review: This place is at the corner of Jonker Street. The place is cozy with great architecture. Very busy at night during weekends. Great to sit down and have a drink or order a meal.

Author: Prameela_Rajaratnan
Title: Thirst quencher
Review: We visited on a very hot day. By the time i walked down Jonkers street, I was deadbeat.AND there was Geographer beckoning me...it was a quaint lil cafe and very friendly. I enjoyed my drink of chilled beer while the others had their jiuces.

Author: sebastian a
Title: Best place to hangout....
Review: It's the best place to and out with ur friends even ur family...great food....awesome drink and heart great atmosphere....a truly 5 start place...

Author: 217geraldinesLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Colonial atmosphere. A Must.
Review: Wow..did I love this place. A real Post colonial French feel, [ O.K. the French weren't here, but ]with the polished wood, the huge columns, tropical architecture, A place has a feel or it does not. This has got it for me, wonderful. I felt i was in equatorial Africa, it lets the mind wonder with adventure...What ever food they served would be all fine by me....This place is what makes Malaka worth the visit.Show less

Author: coolabhi08Mumbai, India
Title: Amazing authentic veggie food!!
Review: This place on a corner on Jonker Street serves great authentic local vegetarian food. We tried the Ramen soup, tomato soup and veg rojak - which is a traditional Indian Malay delicacy. The food was great, so was the ambience. We went on a weekday afternoon so was not as crowded. However during nights and on weekends it gets pretty crowded. A must visit, especially for veggie food. Show less

Author: Caspari H
Title: A cozy place to hangout
Review: Being situated along Jonker Street, thi place offers customers a relaxing place to have food and drink after spending time window shopping ad sight seeing the souveniersshops and other attraction located nearby Jonker Street.

Author: TheRedEyeSingapore
Title: Vegetarian Chickitarian Malay!
Review: Don't let the location at the corner of the night market nightmare called Jonker Street put you off.A nicely renovated corner property, we guess about 15-20 years ago, you get both indoor and outdoor seating.The Vegetarian come Chickitarian menu is of some surprise. Including fruit/veg satays!However, the resulting dishes are tasty and surprisingly authentic. The vegetarian Tom Yum Soup served in a fresh coconut deserves a special call out.Show less

Author: khguan
Title: Good place to chill
Review: This place is located along Jonker Street and easy to spot. It will be very crowded on weekend nights as there will be a night market along the streets. You can have some local foods and alcoholic drinks here.Best time to come here chill is on weekdays when there is no crowd at all. If you like the live performance, come on weekend nights.Show less

Author: Keratine
Title: What a fabulous evening!
Review: The crowning glory of our two nights in Malacca ... Nadia, her Dad and the band provided us with such amazing entertainment! Her personality and performance stole our hearts! We will be back!

Author: AreWeSeeingSingapore, Singapore
Title: This place is AWESOME
Review: This is right in the middle of Jonker Walk Night Market, its a big place with live music.This is a non smoking place and you can smoke at you riskThe drinks are fairly priced (Long Island Ice Tea - 38 MYR same in HRC is 52 MYR)Jack Daniels - 15 MYR with mixer.Waiter serving us was amazing and served very well (Sorry I missed his name but a guy wearing bandanna)Show less

Author: very-sunnyLodz, Poland
Title: Popular spot with colonial charm
Review: I was tempted by the name that I like a lot and its location . Excellent spot to observe a life passing on the main street. There is a colonial charm in the building and its surrounding. On weekends they have music live in the evening and then it gets full. I just enjoyed my Easter breakfast . Staff is nice and good speaking English . Show less

Author: Pereppo
Title: Nice historic stop
Review: A nice place to stop for a drink or some food in the middle of Jonker Street. Food is not the best in town but it is ok and price is fairly low. Free wi fi, although with slow connection.

Author: Chrislcc
