Title: Charming restaurant
Review: A café cum pub with great variety of food options including local and vegetarian food. The food is decent with reasonable price. We were quite happy with the excellent service and the nice ambience. Recommend for those who like to try local delights.

Author: Badariyah
Title: Great restaurant to relax
Review: This is a great place to relax after a long walk in Jonker area. You can enjoy delicious food & fresh fruit juice. At night this place is more lively with some wonderful music.

Author: svangoh
Title: Relaxing
Review: I personally like this place. for the ambiance. Its located in the middle of Jonker street. Visit here in the afternoon for a rest after long walk, come again later tonight just to find it was so crowded with no table at all.

Author: Travelseverywhere16
Title: Lunch
Review: We had lunch here. It was very nice. Best Naan bread ever. They have good wifi too. Cheap too. Great fresh juice. Veggie curry was very good for vegetarians.

Author: zhimingandchunjiaoChina
Title: Terrible service bad bad bad
Review: Came here on 1st May around 14:00.The restaurant was not even fullService is terribleService staff had that kind of "unhappy face"When I raised up my hand to get the bill ,the Chinese lady ignore me once, I had to waive my hand in front of her to get it doneWhen she get the bill to me, she threw it on the tableWe ordered Veggie rollWaited for damn long, until main course is finished, the veggie roll is yet to arrivedAsked for a few times but NO BODY CARES!Will never come again and will never recommend this restaurant to othersShow less

Author: paulandc0
Title: Sipping a drink to good live music.
Review: Lady singers were enjoying themselves on stage and we enjoyed them. Cocktails are good and reasonably priced. Being open space to the street makes it all even nicer.  We did not try the food. Service was OK.

Author: Gorm L
Title: Nice location, and very busy
Review: On the corner in the mist of all the buzz. Reasonable priced, - a tad slow in service, as they are somewhat understaffed, - but staff is friendly, - but almost running in an attempt to cope.

Author: Adrian D
Title: waited 30 minutes for drinks
Review: I really don't know why this place is rated so highly,very bad service the waitresses seemed overwhelmed with the crowd,drinks were overpriced and took a really long time to come,this place is all hype, will not be coming back

Author: KanikaSarin
Title: Good food and ambience
Review: We enjoyed our lunch at Geographer's cafe a lot. Good food, good music...a very lively place. They also have a good range of vegatarian options.

Author: Saanthi P
Title: Come for the ambiance but not the food
Review:
Disappointing for a top rated restaurant at Jonker Walk. Disinterested waiters and very plain tasted food. 
However if you are into ambiance and live music then this is the place.

Author: T00ts10
Title: Revisited twice
Review: A relaxed open air cafe for lunch or supper, high and low tables.  Good Ramen Curry and Georgraphers Sate and Spring Roll selection.  Live music in the evening. Friendly service

Author: strannikny
Title: Open air seating on Jonker street
Review: Good Place to enjoy your food and a drink while observing the crowds at the busy market open every weekend on Jonker street.

Author: Yap H
Title: Food is not authentic !
Review: As a local in Malaysia, I don't find the food here is authentic. Ordered a fried rice with satay, the fried rice do not have any taste and the Satay sauce is not made up of peanut. Quite disappointed with those food and the price.

Author: wesleyh532
Title: 2 thumbs up!
Review: Must try spot in Melaka, excellent food and reasonable price. The ambience is just perfect for the historical city.

Author: Mikey1966Brisbane, Australia
Title: Disinterested service ...
Review: We dropped in there for a snack and a cold drink at about 6.30pm on a Friday night. The night markets in Jonker St were just kicking off. The cafe itself was not very busy at this time. We'd been recommended to go by a restaurant owner in Singapore. Service was very slow, and provided in a very dis-interested manner. I ordered the naan bread with vege curry. Curry was OK at best and the naan bread was not fresh at all - more like the highly processed type you would buy in a supermarket. Overall, nothing special and would not bother to return.Show less

Author: marcelv776The Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Terrible service - serving cold food
Review: After a friend of mine recommended the place, we went there for lunch and a drink. It all seemed ok but once we ordered the food it took forever to arrive. As somewhat usual in Asia, both dishes were served with 15 minutes between them, not allowing us to eat together. Worst thing was that the food was cold and the staff didn't care. A request for condiments was completely ignored twice. When talking to the manager about it he complained about the poor staff and how no one wanted to work at the place. He even asked me to write a complaint. I hope this helps both travelers and him.Show less

Author: CorneVanZylJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Very Very Poor Service!
Review: We came with high expectations on a Friday night. We were told that they are busy and the food will take 30min. We were okay with that. After 1 hour, people who arrived long after us received their food. The more we asked, nothing happened. No apologies and no one cared. After 1.5 hours we cancelled our orders and went for street food. Not recommended at all!! Don't waist your time or money!Show less

Author: Oskarbella13Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible service- disappointing!
Review: We came to Geographer Cafe around 7:30pm to have dinner. There were 6 of us.the waiter told us that it'll take at least half an hour for the food to come. We were fine with that and ordered our drinks. An hour and more drinks later..food not arrived even though they arrived on other tables!Staff didn't bother to apologise and even ask if we want to cancel our orders. We came here with high expectations but really felt let down by the staff nonchalant answers and can't be bothered attitude!Will not return or recommend this restaurant. Disappointing!Show less

Author: luispaisbernardo
Title: Tiger stop
Review: Good place to have a couple of draught Tigers in between strolls. We didn't try the food. Good service.

Author: Camberleyannie
Title: Trendy. Good for snacks and pre dinner drinks
Review: We had some lovely nibbles with our drinks. Service a bit slow though and not quite the usual local friendly standard.

Author: cathydelCairns, Australia
Title: Wonderful entertainment & tasty food.
Review: Not much else happening on Jonkers Lane on a Monday night so we went in here and enjoyed it a lot. The singer was excellent and her back up 3 piece band was also great entertainment. Lots of chicken, pizza and pasta dishes on offer but not much for meat lovers. No bottled wine - only by the glass. Ok but not great. Our satay chicken pizza and nyonya chicken were nice. Good atmosphere and busy, friendly staff. Nice place. Show less

Author: KevinM10004
Title: Kinda average
Review: Not much to say. I had a couple of beers while listening to a below average "band". The staff are pleasant and the beers reasonably priced. It was well placed for watching the slow moving crowds of the night market.

Author: kdbuwaldaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience average food
Review: Conveniently located on the corner of Jonker Street with a large outside terrace. Ordered dinner. Fresh coconuts arrived warm at our table and did not taste fresh at all. Nasi Lemak was sticky and the boiled egg that was included was of questionable quality, greenish of colour and with egg white that was solid like plastic. Sate was ok but meat tasted somewhat mushy. Mango chicken arrived cold. Staff was very friendly but the food really let them down.Show less

Author: geraldchan
Title: great place to chill
Review: one of the popular tourist spots to chill, while the streets are packed with tourists jostling up and down. food is decent, service could be more responsive, tables are a little dirty

Author: calg93London, United Kingdom
Title: Food doesn't come out together
Review: Food was ok but my girlfriends pasta came out 10 minutes before my fried rice. Not that hard for it to come out together. Also staff are very slow had to go up and ask for the bill then go up to the bar and ask for my change and during my meal had to go up and ask for a fork. Show less

Author: Xbrit2004Songkhla, Thailand
Title: A "Must Do" Stop on Jonker Walk
Review: I have made The Geographer a regular stop any time I go to Jonker walk. It's a Restaurant/Bar right in the heart of Jonker street with tall tables and barstools easily accessible from the street. The ideal stop for a cold beer on a hot afternoon because of the numerous fans and water-mist cooled air around the entire perimiter of the bar. Prices are reasonable for the area and the excellent music they play makes it worth the small premium they charge over the cheapest bars.The selection of beers is diverse and includes such favorites as Saporo (Japanese) and Tsing Tao (Chinese). The food menu is also diverse and well presented as are the snacks. For the newcomers to Asia who can't deal with the heat there is even an Air-Conditioned room in the back.This is an ideal stop for people watchers and music lovers but may get very crowded on weekend evenings. It's also a favorite with international tourists. Enjoy!Show less

Author: Thewildplanet
Title: A good place to chill out
Review:
Nice cafe in the middle of Jonkers Walk.  Offers vegetarian food which is actually very nice.
 
Food is good.  Good location.  Nice ambience.

Author: AS145
Title: Decent tourist spot
Review: Well located place catering primarily for Western tourists, which is also open mid week. Had a decent nasi goreng-style dish here, but the sate was a bit dry. Comfortable but a little over-priced.

Author: IanBStokeonTrentStoke On Trent
Title: Great food
Review: This is a great little cafe in the old quarter of Melacca and is a great spot both for a meal or just to sit with a beer and watch the world go by. We had a geographers curry which was a vegetarian laksa style dish, and a chicken satay. Both were deliciously spicy and full of flavour - great, but if you want bland go somewhere else.Highly recommended.Show less

Author: Goky T
Title: Good food, nice location ,walking street
Review: Good food nice location near walking street ..went there with freinds on vacation we drop by for a dinner lot of people with live music. place are nice clean chic and chill.

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Place To Relax
Review: Located in the heart of Jonker Walk, a nice set up joint to have my beer and some bites. Enjoy the crowd walking pass Jonker Walk and life music to entertain you. Many steet food hawkers near by for foodies. Nice place to hangout for the nite after a long walk along the cultural street. Can be quite pack and fullhouse sometimes...but nice to graba stool with high table to have your beer...cheers.Show less

Author: Z4763BQnicholaswBildeston
Title: Disappointing pizza
Review: We only ordered a pizza to share as we were not that hungry. It came on a ready made base and lacked flavour. I just expected a little more for the price you pay. Other food looked good I would just stay clear of the pizza.Show less

Author: Bee123_13
Title: Very charming in jonker street
Review:
Good atmosphere in the cosy restaurant. The food was very good and also the service. 
The best restaurant in town

Author: EdAdni
Title: Good
Review:
Food was not the best ever but still OK. 
Staff was very nice and friendly
We were there on a monday night, where there is a live Jazz concert, which was very nice.

Author: PostcardsFromPDBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Chinese New Year lunch
Review: We came here for lunch on the Saturday of Chinese New Year, and throughly enjoyed the food. Very tasty and arrived promptly. The vegetable curry was particularly good - spicy for those who like it. Reasonably priced and good portion. Service was a little slow, with a number of staff present but not on the ball, but still ok. Would happily eat here again.Show less

Author: Anthony CBurlington, Vermont
Title: European Bar in the Heart of Melaka
Review: The Geographer Cafe is a cool restaurant/bar on a corner street of Jonker Street! Nice food, beverage selection and atmosphere...definitively a Western restaurant with Western prices. Great place to sit outdoors and people watch during the evenings. Friendly staff too! Neat decorations indoors! Would definitely go back to eat!Show less

Author: chuckwowengland
Title: Good location, beer n pizzas n asian foods
Review: A busy popular corner sited bar with food good selection of foods .asian fusion eiropean, and satay pizzas a bit different, upstairs is best but thats only open at weekends as i tried several times and was told no not open , beers standard islam country price i.e. Expensive beers from£3 small bottle Show less

Author: billwE5939DI
Title: Superb food in atmospheric setting.
Review: Went there twice today.. Once for breakfast.. toast butter and local spread.. with super coffee.. All delicious.. Then back later for crispy Thai Chicken for 17R. Best meal I have had in Malacca so far.. Oh ..and the ginger beer set everything off.. Just enjoy!!

Author: felix cChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Recommended if you've watched the movie
Review: If you've watched the movie summer mo mo tea by actor Richie Ren, Actress Sammy, then u must visit. It's the famous cafe in the movie. The food is surprisingly good and local presented in a very neat way. We had nasi lemak, rojak, curry, and it all taste great! They serve beer as well. We initially sit at the original cafe but it's a bit dark inside and we hated mosquitos. So we requested for another table to sit. The waiter asked us whether we want to sit at their new premises just opposite the street (or lane). We took it and it was nice, no mosquitos and a bit more lighten up. We enjoy the food and the view of pedestrian passing by, and it was pretty cooling as well, away from the heat.It also has a lot of options for vegetarian.Show less

Author: alichow2017Hong Kong, China
Title: A cosy cafe with great food and ambience!
Review: I went there for a late lunch. The menu had quite a number of choices and their cakes looked yummy. I ended up ordered a dish of Malay style coconut flavoured rice with vegetables and a local drink. The food was great and it was a relaxing place to spend a lazy hour. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: AnneDickieWimborne Minster, United Kingdom
Title: Popular bar/restaurant on Jonker Walk
Review: Having read reviews of the Geographer Café prior to our Melaka visit we made a beeline for this hugely popular bar in the middle of Jonker Walk on our first evening in the city. Great for a few beers before heading off to a restaurant. Staff attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: ipionetKelowna, Canada
Title: Fun place for a drink in rain storm
Review: Nice little street-side bar. Was pouring rain and needed shelter in a down pour. Had a few beers during the evening and staff attentive and communicated very well compared to some of the other places where decent English is not available. Also take Visa which can be handy when you blow all your money shopping on Jonkers street earlier in the day!Show less

Author: Me JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food, overstretched staff on Saturday nights
Review: We came for food Saturday night and were very happy with the service - and the food was great. We had the local fare as always, and loved every dish. However, when we came back to listen to their live music later, staff was overstretched. It took us a good 10-15 minutes to order our beer, although (in addition to the restaurant staff) there were 3-4 beer promotion in tight dresses running around (serving one beer at the time - that's probably all they could balance wearing their heels). Music was not the jazz that we had expected but the mellow "smooth operator" and "Hotel California" and other mainstream junk on synthesizer that was not knocking us of our chairs. But mainstream is probably all you can offer on your busiest night a week. At least they had good voices. Don't bother testing the wine! I never figured out why restaurant owners don't just ask someone who knows about wine for advice what house wine to select.... (maybe that's a business model - test wines for restaurant owners to help them select decent wines by the glass?)Show less

Author: Roland DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food
Review: This venue was sold to us by a couple we met in our travels. Thanks for the recommendation Helen and Rob. It did not have live music, as anticipated, although it does on certain nights (when I suspect eating inside may be quite noisy). But the food was really good. I had a delicious nasi impian, which was rice cooked with various vegetables and served with vegetarian sate. Any non-meat eaters will be well-served here. I also had a glass of Carlsberg (which was no cheaper than in the U.K. - why is beer so expensive in Malaysia compared with other Asian countries?) and a small bottle of water. The total bill came to 34.70 ringette, which is about £7. This seemed slightly cheaper than other "western style" restaurants. The food was far better than the other place we had an evening meal. The restaurant is about two thirds down Jonker Street, attractively decorated with internal and external seating and an annex across the road. The service was OK.Show less

Author: grayinasia
Title: Nice looking restaurant
Review: Food variable depending on taste, drinks better had a great marguerita. Staff friendly helpful. Place is easy to find and open much of the day

Author: AntwasthereMelton Mowbray, United Kingdom
Title: Just what we wanted
Review: Went to have a look at the street market last night and decided to eat here.We had quite a big lunch so only wanted one course each.She had TomYam soup which was served in a coconut complete with its husk. She said it was the best she has ever had and she nearly always has Tom Yam if it's on a menu.I had spicy veggie rice with egg and bean sprouts which was lovely.Would have given it 5 rating if the service had been a bit more attentive - I had nearly finished my veggie rice but had to ask where her soup was - which then came very quickly! and had to ask for drinks and had to ask for a sweet.Quite a busy place though not many locals eating here when we were there.Show less

Author: 325alistairmSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good place for a drink or quick lunch
Review: Stopped off here for a spot of lunch. Food was decent and the staff pretty efficient. I had chicken satay and whilst not the best I've had (to be honest I wasn't expecting it to be) it was very tasty. Think this would be a fun place for a drink in the evenings or to go with friends. Show less

Author: PeteRobbo8502Sandwich, United Kingdom
Title: Great atmosphere in a unique eatery
Review: Now this is definitely a characterful and memorable place to have a meal at any time of day. The decor is wonderful, with colourful and evocative pictures and furnishings throughout and the place always seems to be very busy, which enables a lively and energetic vibe at all times.The menu is wide and one can enjoy a meal from a selection of eastern and western dishes, accompanied by a generous range of cocktails and other beverages. The Geographer is on the corner of Melaka's main drag, Jonkers Street and it's a must visit for those of you on a trip to this historical small city. The staff are very friendly and the quality of the food is very good at a more than reasonable price right across the menu.Yes, very nice indeed and provides a lasting, romantic memory of the old colonial world.Show less

Author: JuF-BG
Title: Lovely unique coffee shop/restaurant
Review: Had coffee in this lovely little restaurant. Good choice of coffees. Liked the atmosphere so much that we took friends for dinner in the evening. Good home-cooked food

Author: AngSiongHuatMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Abit noisy, abit sweating all fun
Review: Let's be frank, Malaysia is definitely not the best place to have an al fresco style of anything (dining, bar and what not)But that being said, aside from the sweat, the atmosphere was awesome, the crowd + plus those patroning jonker street was fantastic.And a little sweat ain't gonna do much harm when they start rolling out score of fantastic mix of oldies and contemporary songWell recommended.Show less

Author: Gareth BHavant, United Kingdom
Title: A great cafe in Malacca on Jonker Street
Review: Well in my note about Malacca I mention this cafe. I must say they were welcoming, friendly and the cafe was a joy. It maybe on Jonker Street though they are there to provide a service willingly.We only wanted a snack and we ordered favoured water, not for me, a glass of house red and a chicken curry dish. It was served nicely and the food was delicious. If only we were staying longer we would eat there again.Show less

Author: Happyholidayer7Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: Love it here
Review: This time we were determined to stop here. We were on a cruise and only had a short time but this was a must. This time we had something to eat, even though we had had lunch on board. It was quiet when we arrived around 2.30 but soon got busier. The food was tasty and the Long Island as good as last time. The cocktail list was extensive. When I ordered the Long Island she asked if I realised this was in the section marked killer cocktails! We were last here 7 years ago and spent longer in Malacca so we're able to visit in the evening. The atmosphere was fantastic, with a live singer. I still remember the lovely evening, hence our determination to revisit. I highly recommend this place.Show less

Author: cheapbutfussy
Title: reliable, friendly, good live music
Review: the food is all it says it is - local flavours for western organic and health trends. a useful place to come back to.

Author: gallangpho2bloger242Singapore, Singapore
Title: Food are good
Review: The food here are good compare with some restaurants around. We had spaghetti and fried rice but I like the Pineapple Fried rice they server. It has a little bit sour and sweet but fresh of the pineapple mixed with rice, egg and vegetable.The location is also good.Worth to comeShow less

Author: puriris
Title: Great views of the street
Review: It is a melting  pot where you can sit quietly or with friends. Nobody cares. Many gluten free and alternative meals available. Nice one.

Author: gosiaw838
Title: Very touristy, but good coffee
Review: As in the title :) just tourists sitting there, but the coffee was lovely, and the menu extensive. A bit pricey, but it's in the main street (Yonker Walk). My tip for the people running this place: change the music! People don't want to listen to Elvis when they visit Melaka, really! Show less

Author: MatsO991
Title: First hit
Review: Good place for thirsty tourists. Have a jug of Tiger and relax. Good athmosphere and friendly staff!

Author: EmilyF2646
Title: Cheap cocktails and liquors
Review: Read many reviews saying that this place had a variety of cocktails and liquors. Decided to try this place during my last visit to Melaka and I was surprised to see the list of alcohols that they have! Most which I haven't heard of. Other than their variety of alcohols, the prices were cheap too! You could ask for a glass of liquor and just pay RM15 for it! Show less

Author: KulenMountainKouple
Title: Big, but just okay
Review: food just okay. Their curry dishes seem to all use the same base. The upside of this place is that it's big and you can get a table any time despite it being in the middle of busy Jonker St. Wouldn't go back for food, just drinks or coffee. Show less

Author: iamonpreeyaPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Don't order any traditional foods here
Review: I have ordered satay, spaghetti and watermelon juice. The only dish that I can eat was spaghetti. The cumin in satay sauce is too strong. The watermelon juice taste just like water. The waiters and waitresses are slow response maybe there were a lot of people at the time that I been there.Show less

Author: Tripwarriors_comChofu, Japan
Title: It's OK for tourists - but staff are blur and music too loud
Review: I could only stay here for a while as the music too loud. Staff was slow and would deliver the items to the wrong tables.However, this cafe is on a nice corner and good for watching the tourists walk buy - ifyou can stand the noise.Show less

Author: ontspan2016
Title: Music &  looks
Review:
Not a bad place to spend some time. It does frequently get hit by waves of visitors. In between waves it's even worth taking a detour for,  in order to drop by.

BTW  Please add espresso machiato  to the menu ;-)

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Weighing in
Review: Ok, I've been holed up around the corner from Jonker Street for almost two weeks. I'm not a big eater here but I've been here six or seven times. Certainly we all understand the value of being at a well kept, up to date open air venue on the best corner in town, don't we? Good, let's move on... The beer is cold and on tap. Same price pretty much everywhere. It's not cheap, it's Malaysia. The chairs are a nice touch. Remember, we're in SE Asia and plastic chairs and stools abound. The staff is friendly and not overbearing. They remember me whenever I pass. The food is good and what I haven't tried looked good too. Even tried the pizza. It's good. Is it Cross Bay Boulevard in Howard Beach good? Let's all just calm down. This isn't Little Italy. The food is fine, the weather is hot, you're on the best corner on Jonker Street, and it's a good thing!Show less

Author: 674jerrywThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Great cafe
Review: This is a great cafe on a corner location on Jonker street where you could sit the whole day and watch people pass by. The coffee is great and the food menu is limited but the focus is on fresh ingredients. We had the nasi goreng which was nice. Recommended for it's location, atmosphere, location, coffee and fresh food. I went there for lunch but I could imagine it's a nice place for a beer in the evening as well.Show less

Author: JemK_ima
Title: Nice spot for diner
Review: Great food, and ambience. The place was the packed when we visited the jonker market. Quite popular with tourists.

Author: radicalrhodium
Title: Great ambience with not so interesting food
Review: Situated in the middle of jonker walk you could chillout at this nice restaurant yet you have a chance to enjoy the happening of jonker walk. Ambience was good but overall food quality is below average.

Author: albatross-549Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food
Review: Good food and service , but at times the music is too loud . Problem with parking is there especially on weekends. Food is well prepared and an average amount of variety is there , somewhat on the expensive side . Good change so can visit off and on ...Show less

Author: bbjorn_c
Title: Disappointing food, not enough staff
Review: Nice atmosphere, but disappointing food. We ordered chicken with cashew nuts which was tasteless and the tiny portion of chicken was dry and hard. Aglio olio spaghetti was equally tasteless and served nearly cold. They did not have enough personnel around so they were running around stressed and couldn't keep up with customer requests to place orders and to pay the bill. Of course some people got impatient and angry.Show less

Author: KJO74
Title: Very nice spot
Review: Nice range of beer, including my favourite so top marks. We had a nice meal, both traditional and western. Best bit about the night was the singer, she was wonderful and her range of songs was unbelievable. Get there a bit early to avoid being seated on the road.Show less

Author: 725mariahi
Title: Cool..
Review: Along Jonker Street...you can never miss it.. Cool friendly environment. Good place to chill out for drinks with live music..

Author: rkigervaron
Title: Pretty good
Review: Nice place good service with average food... reasonable value.  Overall not quite 4 stars but better than average

Author: Happytummyy
Title: Nice chill place at the Corner of Jonker Street
Review: Service good with nice environment. No MSG, min. Microwave used. Love their effort to make delicious food more healthy. Plus there is a 2 live band in the evenings.Good place to sit around and chill with great company and good live music. Nice place to chill after rushing through the night market's crowd :)Try their veggie roll! It's yum!Show less

Author: MohdAdamKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Food was good but having a live jazz performance was awesome!
Review: You can't miss this place, it is very well located in the heart of the main activities in Malacca. Its always lively with many customers and service was ok too. We were not disappointed with meal but we were really there for the Jazz performance which to us was the highlight.. And they have been putting up live Jazz performances for years.. Be sure to check out whats on, and enjoy. Show less

Author: KiwiFlashpackers
Title: Nice place to sit and watch
Review:
Great place in Jonker Street to watch the world go by....

Friendly staff and free WIFI.

We recommend the chicken satay sticks. The beer is a good price at happy hour.

Author: b0bnw8London, United Kingdom
Title: Great place for a short break while sightseeing
Review: In the middle of busy touristy area in Melaka, Geographer Cafe is just a great place for a short break while sightseeing, and is nto trying to be much more.Though the service could be somewhat more professional, it is neither slow nor inattentive, just somewhat "pedestrian" and inexperienced. The food is very tasty, authentic and made from fresh produce. The overall atmosphere is quite relaxing, though at moments very busy. We would not mind coming back again.Show less

Author: AKDutAnchorage, Alaska
Title: Perfect Restaurant for Melaka Meals
Review: The Geographer cafe is a landmark restaurant in old town Melaka. It has great ambience and an even better menu featuring a full range of Malay, Thai, Indian, vegetarian and halal food choices... Portions are just right and the flavor not too spicy for most palates :)The Geo has a great selection of juices and other beverages... you won't leave thirsty!Overall, if you are looking for a place to enjoy delicious local cuisine in a great location, the Geographer can't be beaten!Show less

Author: yanamohamedSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonable Pricing
Review: Wide menu selection, there's even a vegetarian option! Food quality is acceptable and I enjoyed all the food a lot. Though staff is not knowledgable, as she need to keep checking with another staff when we have some query, she is polite and friendly! We have no issue with her being inexperience. Anyway all of us were ever inexperience when we just start on a job :-).Show less

Author: ulkery2014
Title: Amazing
Review: We went to Geographer Cafe for dinner. We tried  some Malaysian dishes and all of them were really amazing. The service quality is high, presentations are great, everybody is very friendly. Highly recommended.

Author: sweetlou27
Title: EXTENSIVE MENU & GOOD PRICES
Review: Good location in the popular Jonker Street area with much night life. Pasta was excellent. Nice place to watch the nightlife since they have outdoor seating.

Author: Professional-PilgrimAlberta, Canada
Title: One of the best restaurants in Malaysia
Review: We enjoyed our first meal here that we returned for another one. Each time, we went to the small annex that is across the road from the main restaurant. It is less crowded, quieter, and the service excellent. The food is brought across the road, but arrives just as fast as if you are in the main restaurant. There are toilets and a wash basin in the back, so you can clean up before your meal. We loved all of the following dishes: mushroom soup, cashew nut chicken, curry rice, curry ramen, banana chocolate + ice cream. The Somersby cider and Tiger beer were, of course, also good. If you are interested, ask to go upstairs to see the cafe souvenirs; they have some really nice T-shirts for sale at reasonable prices.Show less

Author: CharlieNorthWales
Title: Avoid
Review: We learnt that it was not possible to amend a dish slightly for dietary purposes, and when it arrived the few pieces of chicken were were rubbery and the food was left uneaten. Try the Melting Pot nearby, much better

Author: ecossegeo
Title: Nice lively spot
Review:
Good service, nice polite staff, sometimes can be over helpful.
Good mid range prices for drinks and food, large portions.
Decor is nice, seating is a little cramped.
Definitely a must when visiting Melaka.
Try the Plum Cocktail...excellent.

Author: CatjlynBradley Stoke, United Kingdom
Title: Overpriced ok service
Review: Right on Jonker street this place is definitely hiking up the prices due to its locationIt isn't the most comfortable in Melaka and certainly not the cheapest but due to its location it is always going to get good tradeThe service was slow and staff were a bit surly and kept bumping into our table without ever apologisingBasically it is a bar on jonker street that has managed to get itself a name and charges a lot for that reasonShow less

Author: Dolny5Phoenix, Arizona
Title: Late afternoon snack
Review: We visited around 3pm after a 4 hour car ride from Singapore. It was a nice spot to get a drink, cool off, and try some satay. My sister ordered the curry noodles and couldn't decide if she loved them or hated them. My brother-in-law finished them off with no problem. FREE wifi to enjoy (just ask the server for the password).Show less

Author: timd503
Title: Lunch with friends
Review: Tasty foods in a very charming atmosphere.   While I was not impressed with the veggie curry and naan,the other items I tasted were great.

Author: Jason C
Title: Enjoyable
Review: Who want to get a drink during a trip!? Me! This is definitely a good place to enjoy yourself in the local bar!

Author: Road20yearsQuebec, Canada
Title: Relaxing
Review: It seems to be the place in the center; they have a large choice of sitting from outside to inside with AC. The place is clean, the service is professional, the musique is great...Just perfect to relax. There is a large menu with a good variety including vegetarian choices. Meeting friends would be the placeShow less

Author: Tessa E
Title: Very good
Review: Nice food, nice staff, good location. Music not the best and a bit on the loud side but all in all, good vibe

Author: TeresaO399Singapore, Singapore
Title: A great respite from a busy Jonker junction
Review: A wonderful cafe, pub and restaurant all rolled into one. Superb place to chill both indoors or al fresco to watch the shoppers go by the busy Jonker junction. Menu has both local and western fare and taste delicious. Drinks are aplenty both alcohol and non alcohol based and a great cafe type selection of hot drinks too. We ate at this place twice and another time for drinks. Ambience, deco and music all good too. Understandably service will be slow when crowded :) Show less

Author: HelenI27
Title: Good for vegetarians
Review:
Great choices of local cuisine for vegetarians. Nice ambience, prices not bad considering its on jonkers walk.

Great for a nice dinner out.

Author: chichinycNew York City, New York
Title: Open Late with good vibes
Review: Very few places to eat of you're interested in eating after 9pm and don't want an entirely Hard Rock Cafe experience. We tried to find other places but kept coming back to this place after circling for a while. Food is good (though not amazing) and they have sufficient vegetarian offerings. Music is a little too loud. (Sometimes people want to talk at meals.) But the staff was sweet and we enjoyed ending up their nightly. Sign the guest book. Show less

Author: MajaM1973
Title: Very good food
Review: Although we arrived late in the evening (past 10:30 pm), we had a great service and delicious food. We shall come again. Highly recommended.

Author: Nick TSidmouth, United Kingdom
Title: Good food, good buzz, great music
Review: The old quarter in Malacca has plenty of restaurants, but the Geographer has got to be one of the best. It's an all day and evening cafe and restaurant, part open to the street, part indoors with aircon. The menu is varied, and reasonably priced. Drinks are OK. The service is friendly and reasonably efficient. They have live music several nights per week; when we were there it was a modern jazz trio with a very good singer.Show less

Author: Shii L
Title: Famous restaurant.
Review: Crowded and packs. Very lively when night . Food is good and good place for a beer and hangout… but nit for a conversation hangout.

Author: Krasen18Sydney, Australia
Title: Great place for drinks - worse place for food
Review: This is my second time to visit this café. The environment is good and they serve great drinks. If you want to have a jolly time just for drinks, then one can't miss this place. However, the food served in this place is extremely bad. Avoid ordering any food. We went there as a family and we ordered few dishes - tom yam, satay, fried rice, black pepper chicken and all the dishes were really bad and tasteless. Its very interesting given that within the vicinity there are many great hawker stalls and if proper food can't be served they might as well outsource the food division to the hawkers nearby. Very disappointing and won't recommend this place!Show less

Author: Crystalmountains1Sydney, Australia
Title: Stands the test of time..
Review: I have had three trips to malacca since 2006 and always revisit this iconic cafe .. great vibes and bohemian atmosphere.. friendly staff and delicious goods.. great on a steamy night to sit back under whirling rattan fans and enjoy a cold beer... a must if you visit the old Jonkers street area of Malacca.. this remnant of the spice routeShow less

Author: donnamb112Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good location, local, western and veggie foods
Review: This was our second visit to Geographer Cafe. The location (on Jonker street) is very central to the activity of the night market. The menu is reasonably priced and the menu offers local fare (cafe style), western dishes (such as pasta and fish & chips) and also a fairly big range of vegetarian options. The food isn't outstanding but is good.The decor is rustic and this corner shophouse is a nice place to visit. The service is OK and for the location the prices are reasonable.Note: the lighting inside is quite dim and we found there were a lot of mosquitos inside. It may be better to sit in the outdoor seating.Show less

Author: trvkakiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Busy place but understaffed
Review: This restaurant has great business even after 2pm on a Friday afternoon, however, the entire restaurant is only staffed by a manager and two waiters where it is very much evident that they could not cope with the volume of the business. They did tried their best though.Their food was average but they have long vegetarian menu which suits well for my inlaws.Show less

Author: kaleon
Title: Very disappointing visit
Review: Came here as it is always busy and were extremly disappointed by food, drinks and also service. I can not understand why this place is so popular. Everything was below average and overprized.

Author: seastream2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average at max
Review: The service in this restaurant is OK but that's about it. My husbands chicken with veggies and rice was so bland that after huge amount of salt and extra-request of sambal, the portion reached a point where it was even worth eating.Like in many places in Melakka, dishes come on different times. My husband had finished his when I finally got mine (pasta Pesto, very average and a tiny portion), which was kind of odd as our dishes were so simple, but what can you do. I wouldn't go back.Show less

Author: ChiangT15
Title: Bad Service. Long waiting time
Review: Today is not a very busy day compared to weekend. Cake and drink are served 5minutes after order. It took us around 40 to wait for the jonker fried rice to arrive, sadly it still doesnt. We asked the waiter how long left, and she simply reply on the way but we still didnt get the food anytime soon. So we cancel the food and call for the bill and then only they serve the rice and asked us if we still want. Bad service as I saw alot of other table that come later than me have been served with their food except for me. The waiter should have tell if needed to wait that long for a simple fried rice. I honestly thought the fried rice was caught in the traffic jam when the waiter told me its 'on the way' lol.Show less

Author: minstrel78Bury St. Edmunds, United Kingdom
Title: The best!
Review: We ate here a few times as it was one of the few places that we could bother agree on. The staff were friendly and helpful, through food is absolutely amazing so cheap. Please if ur in the area go and have a meal here. We loved it. Show less

Author: Momotei
Title: Ok
Review: The cafe is at corner. Nice location surrounded by a lot of people and restaurants. It's western style and serve food, beers and coffees. Nice to sit and relax

Author: Wayne SPerth, Australia
Title: Cruisey place to watch the world go by.
Review: Being on a corner of Jonker Street this is a good spot to kick back after wandering the markets. Beers are cold and the foods pretty good with a wide range on offer. Staff were very good when we were there. They also had live music in the evening which helped to make it a great night out.Show less

Author: lowhngDunedin, New Zealand
Title: Bad service, good atmosphere
Review: Located in the busy street of jonker it's a nice place with cool air conditioning. However the service was way too slow for a weekday. I waited around 45 minutes for my bowl of Ramen which tasted bland (tho the mushroom in it is okay). My friends have already finish eating and the table came layer than us got served and my Ramen was still missing in action. Told lady waitress and she say many people order is long. Guess she just don't give a fk and look uninterested to attend. 10 minutes after that told a guy waiter and another 5 minute later my Ramen finally arrived. As said it tasted bland and was probably the easiest dish to prepare as its just noodles in soup. There was a live band on the day too and it's kind of nice. Show less

Author: Sharpshark
Title: Nice Pit Stop after a hot afternoon stroll
Review: Friendly staff, interesting menu and unique ambience. The local options are probably better than the western ones!

Author: ConstantC25
Title: Nice ambiance average food
Review: You have a choice of dining in aircon comfort or in the open. Decor, cleanliness and overall dining experience is good and clean toilets as well.The food is just average although I must say the fresh coconut is rather refreshing and lovely.If you are tired from the hot walks up and down Jonker, you may want to just chill out here and have a nice drink.Show less

Author: sunnytraveller2015
Title: Brilliant Food!
Review: We ate here twice during our four-day stay in Melaka - the food was amazing.  It's a really laid-back bar situated on a corner opening onto the street so you can watch 'the world go by'.

Author: OpaQLas Vegas, Nevada
Title: Good Music; Bland, Pricey Nasi Lemak
Review: Nice place, looked stand out at Jonker Night Market. Good music entertainment from the band; the singer had a really beautiful voice.We had Nasi Lemak and it was bland, very disappointing. The Nasi Lemak from the street vendor nearby tasted much better and much cheaper. Show less

Author: PinkzenjoyHyderabad, India
Title: Nice Cafe in the midst of Jonker Street
Review: Very quirky decor. Maps almost everywhere. The food was okay. This is a vegetarian place so not really my taste but the Ramen was good and filling though am not a fan of soya chunks in the ramen. Quantity was a lot. Overall seems a good place to hangout.Show less

Author: taikuanl
Title: Alternative
Review:
It is an escape in the forever busy honker street night market during weekends.

Food quality wise is above average but it offers alternative choices from the usual street foods.
Pineapple fried rice is better than its appearance.

Author: 886arianes
Title: Simple and chilling
Review: Located in the middle of Junker Street. Nice place for snacks, people watching and enjoying the old town's atmosphere. Food OK, not overwhelming.

Author: MarkMcG1956
Title: Escape the madding crowd
Review:
Called in here for a drink on two nights to escape the crowd on corner of Jonker street.

Just sat and watched the world go by in a clean bar with attentitive staff. Lots of people eating and listening to the local singer.

Author: mossiecCounty Wicklow, Ireland
Title: Cool spot to get away from the heat
Review: Visited the Geographer cafe during our recent two day stay in Malacca. Just off Jonker Street. Very cool spot. We had our 3 kids with us and we were all openly welcomed. Cool looking decor and spotlessly clean. We only stayed for a quick drink but the place was packed with people having good looking food. Worth a visit. Show less

Author: 772alexisySingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill at Jonker
Review: We had our dinner here. Ordered honey mustard chicken and chickencello. Both are good! The sour plum drink is fantastic too. I had two cups in a day. There is live music every friday and saturday at 830pm. Usually by then the cafe is full of people. So should consider going there earlier. Its along Jonker and you cant miss it. Sitting there to people watch is great. Jonker is always full of people. Show less

Author: JoParfitt
Title: Our third trip
Review: I like the Geographer at any time of day for its location, decent food, nice staff and the way you can watch the world go by.

Author: bris528
Title: Great food and atmosphere
Review: Perfect place to people watch while enjoying a good drink and local food. Had a good selection of alcoholic and non alcoholic drinks, and both local and western food, all for a reasonable price. Great for all religions- doesn't serve beef or pork. Definitely recommend!

Author: leoninto
Title: Live music at night
Review: Went here after walking a long time through jonker walk. The food was so so, nothing special but the singers were great. Beers are typical bar prices, not cheap.

Author: busconiWenatchee, Washington
Title: Good Little Spot
Review: Great little spot for watching life go by on Jonker Street. We stopped for a quick drink and a small bite to eat. They make probably the very best Mojito's I've had anywhere...there very best. I had the Pesto Pasta and my wife the Chicken Satay with peanut sauce.....all very good. Service was efficient and friendly. We sat outside and could still hear the entertainer inside singing. We love Geographers and come here whenever we visit Melaka. Great little spotShow less

Author: travelnibby
Title: Excellent service, but....
Review: Waiters were very friendly and welcoming but not as well informed about their menu. Still, it's a lovely spot for a drink and the food smelled amazing!

Author: Mildayil
Title: Expensive
Review: Like the rest of Malacca, alcohol is over priced.  We were here on a weekday and it was very quiet.  Very clean and attractive place yes.. but we aren't liking these prices for a street corner pub.

Author: HotMama1009
Title: Good Choice
Review: Variety food and good food. Quick service friendly staff. Convenient place .just love and enjoy the vegetarian food

Author: ramnathcrishnan12
Title: Good evening hangout
Review: Food is great - multi cuisine. Good cocktails too. May have a live band over weekends - not sure tho. Excellent service and good ambience. In Jonker street. Will not disappoint you.

Author: 93kurtlMolong, Australia
Title: Excellent place for a beer
Review: We sat outside just after a hot day was just about done for a beer. The table staff were very friendly and we ended up staying far too long after meeting some nice people there. Had a great time as the beers were ice cold and the food was delicious. Show less

Author: kuepper
Title: Good choice
Review: Nice corner bar cum restaurant. Good spread of choice on the menu including interesting vegetarian options. Quick BC and efficient service.

Author: benwolf223
Title: best place to hang out and relax
Review: This cafe is filled with not only locals but foreigners as well. Good choice for travellers everywhere. no regrets at all.

Author: anthony aBendigo
Title: Lunch
Review: Went with my wife for lunch. Food was ok but overpriced. Given the amount of other cafes that are around I think you can get better value at other places. Drinks are at the high end as well. Service was poor they seemed more interested in mucking about with each other than serving you. Won't be back. Show less

Author: 89shivbJaipur, India
Title: Nice ambiance and a nice corner to hang out ...
Review: This is the busiest place on the Jonker street , post 10 PM at night !! Lively music , food optins are limited but reasonably good , has a laid back and casual charm both during the day and at night...however , i wish , they maintain and clean their toilets a bit better. Coffee lovers can taste some good stuff during the day and the prices are over all quite reasonable ...I would recommend Geographer Cafe as a decent and a lively hang out place in the laid out town of Melaka ..Show less

Author: AnfieldYNWA
Title: Nice Place To Visit!!!
Review: Visited the place with wife and friends while avoiding the rain and waiting for the night market to open. Good service and atmosphere.

Author: MarianM2225
Title: nice ambience nice food
Review: had lunch and dinner a couple of times. nice food, nice service and good ambient inside and outside. it's at a corner facing the jonker street so when it's weekend it may be busy right out of the cafe doorstep. But that's the fun and different about the cafe on the popular street. Most important is the good service, good food and for those who loves drinking it's also a place for it with the music to accompany you for a nice evening.Show less

Author: Pavel H
Title: Nightlife center
Review: I had only one opinion with this place. It was on a friday night when night market on Jonker Street was happening. This corner bar was the busiest place around till 12 oclock. I liked the service, tower beer, and music. People were dancing and having fun. Good atmosphere. I would recomend this place...Show less

Author: JamesKMTan
Title: Cafe in heart of history
Review: This very well known cafe is located right in the heart of Jonker street area. It is nice and cooling. Food price is a bit on the high side.

Author: 722kingManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Well below average
Review: While the food wasn't terrible it was probably the worst we had in Melaka, considering the price I'd have expected the best. Two mains, one starter and two small waters cost around 50 RM. I wouldn't go back for food if it were 10RM.The setting is quite nice but with their alcohol prices I'm amazed anyone would drink there. Show less

Author: safiralazuardy
Title: Food is good
Review:
The food was good and worth the price, location is a bit hidden but easily found by google map!
Pretty at night, never been there in daylight.

Author: Stella L
Title: Live music cafe
Review:
Located at the Jonker street, you will not miss it. 
They are open for lunch and dinner. The cafe comes alive at night with live music - great songs, great vocal.

Author: HPWu
Title: Not suitable for family with young children
Review: It is located along Jonker Street. Easy to find but it's too crowded. Good place to have a snack and rest.

Author: raymondp604
Title: Jazz nights monday
Review: Music was ok if a bit bland but pleasant enough. Drinks were cold and snacks hit the spot. Not a bad time in what otherwise would have been a quiet night.

Author: Ann_Shotiga
Title: Place for hanging out and photography
Review: Nicest decorated restaurant on Jonker street , good for meetings friends in cozy atmosphere. Signature drink is Calamansi sour plum juice which is not really delightful. Street foods from street vendors are much more interesting according to both price and taste.

Author: Alexandra A
Title: Great choice of fresh juce and good local food
Review: But the service is a little bit slow and they forgot to bring one dish from the order. However squid was really spicy and tasty and my personal recomendation is to order otak-otak here.

Author: Notch1204
Title: READ ME
Review: Excellent "fall back" when you're not daring to take it up with the local food. Friendly staff, fair prices, and surprisingly good choice of food (including reasonable choice of veggie food).

Author: Nightswimmer45
Title: The geographer curry was so yummy!
Review: We came to this place two nights in a row. Just off the lively Jonker Street night market, it's a nice place for a chilled out beer. The food is also pretty good. The geographer curry was delicious... I'm quite keen to have the recipe!

Author: 213stephenlAdelaide, Australia
Title: Best place to Hang Out after work
Review: Enjoying myself with nice ambient and fast service, good food.I had the best Guinness draught in town.You should go across the street and look at the new GeographerCafé Lite, feel yourself and immerse yourself in the heritage architecture and enjoy the relaxing environment of the new GeographerCafé Lite.Show less

Author: Celine C
Title: Cosy atmosphere
Review: The restaurant is situated within Jonker Street and it has very cosy atmosphere at night. Don't miss their Coconut Tom Yum as the coconut water brings a different and refreshing taste to the Tom yum soup.

Author: R6511QXdavidcBandar Penawar, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to chill watch the world goes by
Review: This place became famous after it was featured in a movie starring Richie Ren. I visited the place in the year after the movie was out, the cafe continued to play the movie in its premise.I only visited it during the night on weekends when the roads were closed, stalls filled the streets and became very busy with people soon.Sipping a cold beer at the 2nd floor, looking down at crowded streets, sometimes hearing people bargaining and shouting price reductions was an interesting experience. Food doesn't really stand out and appeal to me in the cafe... it's just normal. Show less

Author: artsoun
Title: Good when not busy
Review: We went twice there. Once in the evening, good service, two really nice and refreshing drinks and good apple pie with ice cream.We came back at night, during the night market and it was raining. It was busier so the staff couldn't breathe. We waited like 20min just to order a dessert, had to call them to order and clean the table. The ice cream was good though. Show less

Author: MirkoSpino
Title: Good local
Review: Not a long list of dishes. But all Malaysian-flavored. The location and the dining room are cool, staff nice and fast service.

Author: IvyK200Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: I was there at a rainy night with few friends. The jonker street had only left few stalls opening. When we were quite disappointed for that and we found this cafe!Good place for chit chatting with friends and loved one and enjoy the heat of Malacca City!Show less

Author: letskayak66
Title: Great location to people watch
Review: Stopped in for a drink and snacks while we rest our feet. We ordered the spring rolls, a martini and a beer. The wait staff were friendly and price point was good.

Author: Prabs68
Title: Yummy!
Review: Wow. We loved this place, the food was divine. I had ramen soup with tofu, lemongrass, rice cubes......gorgeous! Also we had mango chicken, very good. Great value, ambience and cooling under all the fans, it was a hot night!

Author: zeebaHanBanTiverton, United Kingdom
Title: One of my favourite places in the world!
Review: We stayed in Malacca for 4 days and ended up spending at least a couple hours a day in this bar watching the world go by.My boyfriend and I are NOT creatures of habit so it was completely out of character for us, but we simply fell in love with this place and finally really wound down here.The cocktails are very reasonably priced and well made, the food is cheap but very good.Even the upstairs has an 'open' feel with a great view of the street below.We had no problems with the service, but it was the afternoon-we did walk past again in the evening and it had a singer so it was packed, I imagine as with all busy bars service can be quite difficult, but that's the price you pay for atmosphere. This place isn't perfect, but it has a ton of character which I personally prefer to perfection.Like I said, one of my favourite places in the world.Show less

Author: fongpen1
Title: Average food
Review:
Pub style cafe, serve beer and local food
Live band performance night time
Food quality - average
Just located at center of jonker street
Plenty of vegetarian food

Author: courcouAthens, Greece
Title: A great place
Review: Believe it or not, we had some of the greatest pesto spaghetti! The used a very special type of basil that has a citrus aroma, and the effect on the pasta was spectacular. Also the mojito was very good. And a last remark: the man's public toilettes were the cleanest ones I have visited for years!Show less

Author: KennyKueh
Title: Unfriendly staff
Review: Visited the "famous" cafe in Melaka at night, the food was nice, Environment is good but the hospitality is very poor.I do remember the time was around 10pm. When we walk in, no staff entertaining us, I'm very sure that night wasn't that busy, we wait for about 10 minutes, a male staff bring us to the table that haven't been "clean" I suppose, after we sit for around 15 minutes then we get the Menu and the waiter just inform us that kitchen close, why can't the waiter tell us at first? We wasted our time just to know that your kitchen is closed? We have no choice so we just order some simple snack and drink, when the food is serve, the waiter not serving us the plates and some tableware, as a customer we still need to ask from the waiter, why a simple steps can't be done as a "famous" cafe? Worst part is when the food are serve, the waiter ask for the payment before we start our meal, does he look down on us as we dress very casual? Why can't he wait until we finish our meal? While we are eating, the waiters stand beside us to watch the television show. Er... please la, show some respect to the customer.Anyway, recommended for the food and environment but seriously do something to improve your hospitality.Thank you.Show less

Author: NavindranR5
Title: Nice but pricey!
Review: Geographer is a beautiful cafe be it during the day or at night. Good for meals and drinks, it's located in the heart of Joker Street. A must visit at least once while in Melaka. However, it's pricey. There are many cafes around that charges much less. A bucket of 5 small Heineken beers costs about RM90. Go for the visit but I would recommend jumping to other places too. Show less

Author: WingecarribeeCanberra, Australia
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Nice place to hang out for a meal or drinks in the old town area of Melaka. Appears to be one of the hip places though there are other smaller nice bars and cafes also offering live music and atmosphere. Geographer might be a little overrated as the meal I had there was okay but not outstanding and the cocktails were served in an odd glass (like ice chocolate or beer glass; not very classy) and were less impressive in taste than had elsewhere. Having said that it has a pleasant atmosphere and there was a singer on the Friday night I passed by and probably on weekends. Friendly service.Show less

Author: MrJLim
Title: A noisy cafe a night
Review: A place where is good for cheer up with lots tourist and atmosphere. But the band is too noisy. Especially with the singer that is not singing but jist screaming.

Author: PaulNock
Title: Great location and atmosphere restaurant but more pricey .
Review: Along JONKER so great for the night market atmosphere. Live music some nights too and great place to sit and watch world go by. Food nothing special though and we found it over priced compared to the excellent competition.

Author: BalGill81Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Vege on the menu!
Review: Being Vegetarian for couple of weeks in a year, it isn't so easy for me to find a vege place that can cater for both me and my non veg other half. So when I saw vege items on the menu, I was pretty excited. Service was good, food was yummy and it was nice to get out of the hot sun into the cool air-conditioning of the cafe just opposite the main geographer cafe(next to Christina ee's)Show less

Author: Tsb_foodhunter
Title: Only for turist
Review: The localization is good.just in the middle jonker walk but the food is no nice nothing special here. Only think in the turist people and in is money.The place looks like oldfasioned. Need paint the walls and clean with effort.Price is very expensive about drinks and the food no real asean. Is a place that mix the asean flavour but in the "turistic" way. The staff is slow and some of them dont no work in f&b. Sure i never come back.Only good if you need drink something under the malaysian hot and dont know another place to go. BadShow less

Author: Priyanka SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food at a great location
Review: We went for a quick lunch to Geographer café. Good service and food. It was a very hot afternoon s we enjoyed the citrus cooler, sour plum juice and beer, followed by fries, tom yam soup and thai mango chicken with rice. All the items were tasty and fresh. Service was prompt as well. Given the superb location of the café, folks could consider visiting it while walking along Jonker street.Show less

Author: evieleeyi
Title: Not bad.
Review: Good looking, taste not bad. Service not bad. Just a bit pricy for me. Environment is good too. Everything still need to improve slowly .

Author: ErikHK28
Title: Good for a beer while enjoying the Night Market.
Review: The title says it mainly. A good beer selection including the Belgium Leffe Brune. The asmosphere is nice as well. Didn't try the food so this review is purely based on a late. afternoon drink.

Author: 207aur_lienm
Title: Good place to have a drink
Review:
I like to go there with my friends to have a drink

There is a live singer in evening 

They have imported beers which are quite good

Author: Anuar OAlmaty
Title: Nice and inexpensive place to dine in on Junker walk
Review: This place is really popular among tourists. It serves veggie and non-veggie meals and has drinks both alcoholic and non-alcoholic. I liked food for it was tasty, modest price and also I liked it because the place was clean, didn't have sewer smells from outside and because it has unique pleasant design.Waiters were very friendly and food was served really fast. For 2 of us the bill was $15. Its good for single person, for couples, for big or small companies.Show less

Author: LSwart1
Title: Just not that great
Review: We have been to this restaurant a couple of times over the years and the food just isn't great anymore. The location is nice because it is in Jonker street.

Author: 696janisj
Title: Fabulous place on Jonkers Walk
Review: Every time we come here we pay a visit to enjoy great selection of tap beers and food. Wifi is here so kids are busy, while adults can enjoy their conversations and drink. Highly recommend to all Visiting here.

Author: adityavt
Title: Lively and Friendly
Review: Lively place ..great food and music. Place to end your day after day full of sightseeing. Staff is friendly and prices are reasonable. Located right in the heart of night market at Jonkers street.

Author: Douglas N
Title: A very nice place to chill the night
Review: A good place to chill the night out while enjoying the life of jonker and seeing the bustling jonker walk.

Author: moderntraveler16
Title: Good ambience, good food
Review: Good location, good ambience, live band during weekends, and vegetarian options, good for entertaining groups with special diets.

Author: ETGero
Title: Good food good atmosphere
Review: A great feed, air con or not air con. No one smoking! Good prices and ambience! Worth the visit. A good variety of Malay and western food but we enjoyed the Malay!

Author: Michelle P
Title: Not great
Review: Service was pretty bad, food just ok, location good. Wrong drink was served, mains came before starter, didn't have the first starter I wanted - who runs out of tofu? Service overall was a big problem

Author: judithkrishnan
Title: Great place to spend New Years Eve
Review: The atmosphere here on a Friday and Saturday night is amazing I've also spent New Year Eve what a buss this place has I must say my best NYE I've ever had would be here and I'm 52 years old

Author: 273fem
Title: Mr and Mrs Mellor
Review: On our two days visit in Melaka we visited this Cafe 3 times! We like the atmosphere.  We enjoyed the food and the casualness of the place. It's nice to sit and have a drink and watched people passed by. A good value for money.

Author: danta83
Title: Great for a Drink
Review: Had a pit stop here whilst going through the busy night market. This cafe has a great buzz about it and the Guinness is excellent. Didn't try the food but what came out of the kitchen looked excellent.

Author: FannyL1697
Title: Nice environment
Review: Very happening and i love the singer with her father.... good place for gathering and drinks. Food also good which is mixed with Asian cuisine as well. Cocktails are fantastic.

Author: 114terrysShifnal, United Kingdom
Title: Good Food
Review: This is a good place to have a meal and drinks whilst watching the world go by, we had a meal on Friday night during a visit to Jonkers street night market, there was also live music on at the Geographer. I would recommend Both market visit and meal. If you like live music there was also a busker playing by the clock tower opposite The Hard Rock Cafe, quite an entertainer. Show less

Author: CarlD687Antwerp, Belgium
Title: A bit over-rated
Review: The quality of food (or service) was not bad at all, and also the location and the atmosphere was all right.But I would recommend the place only to those who prefer a more western approach to food. If you want local food you can get it better and cheaper elsewhere.Show less

Author: RubySong
Title: nice retro songs at convenient location
Review: nice simple and practical setting. but crowded. seats are without back rest. not good for those who want to seat back and relax listening to songs and some cocktails.

Author: F7142UOjamest
Title: Lunch at Geographer Cafe
Review: We stopped briefly for a cool place, free Wifi, and lunch. Had a great selection of drinks and local food. Recommended highly if you're walking down Jonker Street.

Author: shemin61Singapore, Singapore
Title: Jonker walk pitstop!
Review: Located somewhere in the middle of Jonker street, the Geographer café is a perfect place to chill and take a break before braving the crowd in the night market for round 2. It is crowded from people resting and just ordering a drink. Service was slow as it was 9pm and it was full house (we went for dinner).We ordered Asian food, tastes average. Sharing platter of satay and spring rolls. Ayam masak merah with rice and mango thai chicken with rice. I would say I’ve tasted better renditions of this elsewhere. Maybe we should have ordered other cuisines there. Music is old nostalgic Chinese 90s or even earlier opera-like songs. Will recommend others to try other dishes or just go there for beer.Show less

Author: HKinsey
Title: Good vegetarian food
Review: A reasonable choice of meals for vegetarians. Good ambience, pleasant service, definitely recommended

Author: HamentRPhuket, Thailand
Title: Great cafe bar, very popular too.
Review: I went here for a few drinks on the recommendation of TripAdvisor and I was not disappointed. It's conveniently located in the cultural centre of town, lots to see around on foot. The crowd here was a very good mix of younger and mature crowd. Loads for expats/foreigners.It was really busy for a weekday and staff were working hard to serve food and drinks. A lot of people were dining and plenty like me enjoying a few drinks after the day.They have an inside area where the band plays, it sounded to be a jazz & oldies evening whilst I was there (perfect chilling out music). Good hangout joint!Show less

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Simplicity Could Be The Best Policy
Review: This is not the sort of place you should be celebrating your anniversary or a candle light dinner. If you want to blend in with the locals and enjoy good retro music by a live singer then by all means do visit this joint.Their beverages regardless whether its alcoholic or non alcoholic are reasonably priced as compared to other bistro of the same standard in Melaka. Food is slightly over priced though. Relaxing ambience and good for chit chat with fellow friends or relatives. If you need moments of silence and privacy they have an upper floor.This is not the best bistro I have ever visited but I do enjoy the location of this joint. It is located at the heart of Jonker Street . Hence, I am able to enjoy the historical architectures while giving a toast to the simple things in life. They are in operation daily but it is best to visit on Fridays and Saturdays because those are the only days they have live music performancesShow less

Author: Zingg H
Title: Restaurant is rather run down
Review:
One of the oldest restaurant in Jonker's street. Very commercialised lots of tourists
Management should renovate and do some paint work on their stools tables etc
Looks run down and dirty

Author: TyngPC
Title: Good Espresso
Review:
Had a dopio espresso here & was pleasantly surprised with the quality. It came with a little chocolate chips cookie. The staff members were friendly too.

1 thing they could improve is to provide a small glass of water for the coffee.

Author: al_review365Singapore, Singapore
Title: Over rated and long waiting time
Review: I have always seen crowd in this cafe therefore thought should give it a try when we had the chance to get a table. The taste of the food is ok but the waiting time for food to be served specially for western menu was way too long. We were told waiting time was 30minutes but after other food was served, and others on the same table finished the food, the fish and chips still not delivered. The waiter whom we checked with said give the kitchen another 2mintues but the food is delivered only after another 30mintues later. While the food taste is ok, but the waiting time is way too long if you plan to have food there. Even getting the bill took us 30minutes to settle. Show less

Author: julia_cayat_phils
Title: Cafe for a cold drinks along jalan heng jabat
Review:
If you want to grab a cold drinks while on a hunt for a perfect souvenir along Jonker street, this cafe is the best place.
Order may take longer time to be served during peak hours.

Author: CarlosCazorla
Title: Good atmosphere.
Review: It's a good spot for a drink or two while enjoying the people passing by. The staff is friendly and the location very convenient and central

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Was The best around 15 yrs back...
Review: It was one the best place in Melaka to hang out 15 yrs back. At that time service was excellent, food was great, the service was superb. And price was reasonable. But lately it become opposite of above and there are much better places. The price now become extremely highShow less

Author: carimakanman
Title: Geograper Cafe
Review: A place to unwind in the evening with friends. Recently, they have added another shop in close proximity to allow more patrons to patronize them.

Author: alicedowLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good vegan options, nice food and atmosphere
Review: There is a whole vegetarian menu section. Ingredients listed, and a symbol for dishes with egg in - therefore it is easy for vegans and vegetarians to eat well here. The food is good, portions fair. I had the veggie curry and it was delicious (see pic). Love that they have brown rice especially for a healthier/more filling option. Staff are professional. Recommend a visit! Nice atmosphere at night.Show less

Author: nikkaaah
Title: Extremely disappointing
Review: Their best seller (curry ramen) was bland, their Joker Fried Rice was equally bland and came with only two small sticks of satay, and they ran out of rum for our cocktails. They didn't even tell us that they were out of rum until we called their attention to the fact that the cocktails tasted like juice only.Show less

Author: travbro
Title: Nice Kangkung Fried Rice
Review: Just a short RnR with my wife and son, had a nice brewed latte and jonker fried rice however the kangkung fried rice was above the rest with its taste. Many has given positive reviews and same goes for me too.

Author: 985chanc
Title: Overrated Cafe
Review: Nice decor aside, staff were unattentive and they serve beer that were either not fresh or watered down. enough said.

Author: J_fleur84Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Good veggie options and reasonable cocktails
Review: We enjoyed this place so much we came back twice! The cafe occupies a good spot in Melaka and is decorated really well.I really liked the vegetarian options, and the fact that I could enjoy satay! We also had some laksa which was very cheap at MR9 and MR18, and nothing was left on the plate. It did make me smile that our cocktails cost more than our food (at MR22) but the margarita packed a good punch!Show less

Author: Farah S
Title: The best coconut tomyam soup ever!
Review: Went here for dinner with hubs. Loving the historical and classic ambience, especially during the jazz night. It offers an almost-romantic feeling but without the fancy table setting. Nevertheless, it is a nice place to have your dinner and chill.The one thing I love most about this cafe is the coconut tomyum soup. The tomyum soup is served inside the coconut shell, with the coconut flesh, and it tasted surprisingly good. At first I thought it tasted weird but after a few slurps, I just realized that I actually was loving it. The rest was quite good but not as good as the soup mentioned.Definitely coming back for more!Show less

Author: travelingbunnehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great place for coffee and chill
Review: Well, great place for a break from shopping. Give ur feet a break to sit down and have a cup of coffee. On Saturday night there was live music so had a nice break. Waitress are friendly and very apologetic when they were busy rushing about. Show less

Author: MAKANRANGERSKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Popular place for tourist,reasonable price food
Review: You wont miss this place along Jonker Street and it is very popular hunt place for food and drinks. Food are reasonable and portion is small. Won't be the place for food if your are hungry with a large family.Ordered bittergourd noodles and lontong. Food is tasty,price is decent and portion is reasonable. Staffs are attentive.Live band where you can request for songs.Overcrowded at times.Show less

Author: Sima0502
Title: Good food, nice atmosphere
Review: We came in late but they still served us food without issues. The menu is a good mix of local and western dishes and the quality is very good. Nice music and lively atmosphere.

Author: Loh W
Title: Right ambience & nostalgic in a right corner ...drinking oasis with good bites
Review: Music, food and service even if one come alone, the feel is real and the food very meaning....A must drop in, day or evening and watch the people go by, beer in hand and the multi-culture patrons.....

Author: SreeAndGayaMumbai, India
Title: Cool place to hang out, good food
Review: We had heard a lot about this cafe and had to visit it. Must say that it didn't disappoint. The decor is colonial and they have both indoor and outdoor seating. They also have an air cooled area indoors. We ate the vegetarian ramen noodles and had cold coffee. The ramen bowl was huge and I had trouble finishing it. It was very good and the service was also very quick. Restaurant also had free wifi.Show less

Author: Stuart R
Title: Worth a visit
Review:
Good selection of food and drinks.
Lots of dishes are vegetarian, for non-vegetarians' this limits the choice.
Rather expensive.
Good atmosphere and location.
Service could be better.

Author: Vincenttan913
Title: Bar in jonker street.
Review: Bar with music and chairs to be rest after you tired of walking jonker street. Beers are available .

Author: ThomBushSingapore
Title: The perfect Jonkers watering hole
Review: We have been going to the Geographers for many years and always enjoy the ambience and variety of visitors from all over the world. Food and drink are good, staff are friendly and located on a corner makes it the perfect place to just sit and watch the world go by!Show less

Author: verbijsterd
Title: Tasty veggie food
Review: We were a bit sceptical at first due to the slightly touristy look of the menu, but the veggie food was simply very tasty, the atmosphere good and the staff friendly. Can't go wrong!

Author: Simon MClitheroe, United Kingdom
Title: Good service, mixed food
Review: This is kind of bar come cafe. The food menu is reasonable but the actual food is a bit mixed. The fish and chips was good but the Mango Thai Chicken a bit of a let down (not much dry chicken with a lot of coating)The staff were friendly enoughShow less

Author: CrazyKumar
Title: Good Live Music in Jonker Center
Review: It is right on the center of Jonker walk, nice ambience...jazz music by local artist until 11 PM, she was quite passionate in singing. Food was ok, drinks were slightly high priced, but that comes with music I guess.

Author: Harry_Einis
Title: Good, reliable, travellers cafe & bar.
Review: Popular with travellers.  Good place to stop for lunch or drinks when walking around Jonkers.  Evenings there is sometimes relaxed live music. Food & drinks all of decent quality.

Author: Mairi Clare D
Title: Great food and service
Review: We were a mix of vegan, vegetarian and meat eaters and all managed to find a delicious selection of food, all served with a smile

Author: Rakhee Y
Title: Vegetarian galore!!
Review: I love this restaurant. i love the fact that i can order tons of vegetarian food and get my wine at the same time. YUMMY VEGETARIAN curry ramen mee, satay, fragrant rice!!The waiter was so good with kids and my kids were not one bit cranky there even thought it was dinner time. Will definitely be coming back here whenever I am in MelakaShow less

Author: SingaporeBobSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Location, Poor Service, Average Overpriced Food
Review: Visited for lunch on a hot day with 2 friends.When we arrived, no one bothered to attend to us. Had to go in and ask for a table. The waiter seemed disinterested. Tried their Jonker Fried Rice. Food was overpriced for Malacca but I guess you pay a premium for the location as it's smack in the middle of Jonker Street. Fried rice was disappointingly average and we've had better from hawker stalls. Satay was bland.The place seemed understaffed and it was rather difficult to get someone to attend to us even for the bill. Went to pay at the counter instead.We are Asians.
