Noticed that the unfriendly waiter seemed to be rather more enthusiastic attending to the Caucasian group beside our table. Angling for tips perhaps? I may be just being oversensitive but it would explain the different reviews on this page.It's a decently air-conditioned place in a good location for people watching (not much else really) and would be a wonderful respite if you happen to be Caucasian, accustomed to higher costs of living and want to sample possibly subpar local food in a safe and controlled sort of environment. Otherwise, my suggestion would be to go to one of the many other cafes around the area.Show less

Author: Ruby37Lancashire
Title: Geographers visit the cafe
Review: 24 of us visited here on a Geographical study tour if Malaysia to celebrate one of our group's birthdays. The atmosphere was amazing, the staff were very helpful, if somewhat slow. However, this didn't really matter as we were there for the evening. We enjoyed a ginger mojito and chicken with cashew nuts. We started downstairs but once a party had left from upstairs we went up and had it to ourselves. One of our group played the piano for the bar. They sold a range of t shirts and bananas which a lot of us bought. They also had a very interesting guest book to write in. A must, even if you are not a geographer! Show less

Author: MikeyP1385Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly staff
Review: Had food and drinks here on a couple of occasions during a 3 fay trip to Melaka. The staff are super friendly and the service is great. The Wifi wasn't great but we didn't mind that. The food was quick as delicious, I'd recommend the Jonker Nash Goreng. They had a live band on a couple of nights and the singer was really good singing a mix of classics and modern pop. Really good atmosphere! Show less

Author: Ice4myBatu Caves, Malaysia
Title: A place for love song
Review: In Melaka, we also enjoy the rest and relax session in here.The staff here is friendly and helpful, they always proactive to offer help. (Keep going)The environment is great and enjoying. Cozy and comfort to sitting here listening the singer singing the love song.Show less

Author: SoonEnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated, and nothing special
Review: Passes by and saw many people in the cafe, so just wanted to take a try, order nyonya laksa that their so called signature dish, the taste was bad, too oily, no curry or coconut taste. I even try the "tempeh" and it also really bad, tasteless and nothing to dip in. Show less

Author: 721fanw
Title: great food and beer
Review: Great western food with a good portion of local flavor, Enjoyed the food and beer there! Also a great place for kids to eat~

Author: willyfoxelviajeroPonte da Barca, Portugal
Title: Best for transportation solutions
Review: Despite are promoted as long distance buses resellers, with good feedback, also provide good solutions for long distance taxi. Took them and totally reliable. It s a cafe/rest walking distance from all main attractions at city center. Did not take any food or drinks there, despite was invited when doing trip arrangements.Show less

Author: admiren
Title: Good Place
Review: This a good place . Good food and nice music. A bit congested. and thus slows down service.Overall a good place and a must visit

Author: pclee88
Title: Melacca trips
Review: This is a nice place to have your dinner after the walk at Jonker street. Provided with different style of Malaysian local and western foods. Recommended because taste good. The price is a bit expensive compare to other local food.

Author: zakiaNorwaynorway
Title: A great singer n performer
Review: We usually go to Ringos whenever we are in Melaka but it is closed this time so we tried Geographer cafe and regret that it was on our last nite in Melaka that we was there. The singer that was performing was a local malaysian girl named Nadia and she was a very good versatile singer, she is also a good entertainer as she managed to get the audience to sing along and dance too....felt like we were at a private party.....n everyone was having a great time....Show less

Author: 7Critic777Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Could be better
Review: The food is average and not too pricey. The service could be more attentive. It probably has the best location in the town - on the ever popular Tourist spot of Jonker Street. It good for people watchers to sit and relax over a cool beer. It has only recently been updated but is totally spoiled by the state of the toilets which are pretty appalling. Please spend some of your profits to improve themShow less

Author: Vibhav C
Title: Excellent food but problem with service
Review: The food and drinks were excellent at the cafe but I cannot give full rank because of the service delay I faced. I waited for my food for more than an hour which affected my plan ahead. This was not even peak hours. They can do better with the service. I will definitely come here again.Show less

Author: Worth W
Title: Great view of Jonkers Street activity
Review: This is an indoor and outdoor cafe with a great selection of traditional Malaysian food as well as a wide range of beer. I eat here often when I am teaching in Melaka.

Author: MrNicTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded with live band
Review: The place is really crowded and lovely with a live band. You have will have walk for a while before you reach this cafe. Probably one for the most prominent and happening cafe here. Rest your tired legs after a long day. Unwind with your choice of drink and sit back (if you find a seat) and enjoy the music. Afterwards continue to explore the rest of jonker street. Show less

Author: I5abellaMoruya, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere, friendly staff.
Review: I stopped in to escape the madness of Friday night Jonker walk and have a quiet drink. Went back several times after that for a pre-dinner drink and some people-watching. Friendly and enthusiastic staff make it a real pleasure. I don't think the drinks are expensive. I had a G&T for RM18 and a Mojito for RM30. I didn't eat there so can't comment on the food but the atmosphere is great.Show less

Author: quahsaychuan
Title: nice cafe but not the food
Review: Frankly speaking, the food is so so,nothing to shout about, though it is a nice cafe, because of the location, ambient and services,the three stars are for that not for the food. If u r looking for nice food, this is not the place.

Author: Mark_BeeblebroxPapakura, New Zealand
Title: Looks good, but some dishes not more than so-so
Review: Geographer was our mid-week late evening hang-out, quiet, a few Western types sitting nursing beers. We had fries (okay) and satay (a bit sweet) and juices. I suspect the satay chicken was braised or marinated in gula melaka, Much is made of gula melaka in the place of its birth, it's in jars and plastic wraps in just about every foodie place and even makes its way into coffees at some kopitiam - but this was a jarringly sweet note when we expected a savoury taste. The satay sauce was thin and a bit watery. Would go back, but would choose differently from the menu or just get a beer and sit and people-watch - being a corner site on Jonkers makes the Geographer great for that!Show less

Author: Leong W
Title: nice environment especially extreme hot outside
Review: The beer here wasn't cheap. Guess it is because it's 1 of the important tourism spot in Malaysia. You don't pay for the food and beverage only, you pay for the environment too.

Author: qiwen21Segamat, Malaysia
Title: In the heart of Jonker Street
Review: This cafe is easily spotted in Jonker Street if you're there. The live music and band there is good. They have a variety of Asian and Western food of choice here. They are exceptionally good. I once ordered the satay as part of my cravings, and it surprised me! A vast choice of alcoholic beverages as well. Good ambience and not too noisy for the crowd and live music.Show less

Author: MegahYang
Title: after a long walk, this is a good place to chill and listen to french jazz
Review: after a long, hot day walking in melaka, we really need a place to rest. This is that perfect spot that we found. i ordered ayam ponteh and it was not a disappointment.

Author: barwilly
Title: Great ambiance, food and service
Review: Three of us had a late lunch here yesterday. We sat inside as it was we had been walking in the heat. Our food was delicious and the service very good. The cafe scene is very competitive in Melaka and we chose a good place.

Author: mathelaciEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place, good service, live music, average food!
Review: Had dinner for the second time at this place. We were not disappointed. The service is good, the restaurant is nice there was éven live music. The good however is average. There is a huge selection of both Asian and European dishes. It's a safe choice if you are not to adventurous and are worried about "local" restaurants! Show less

Author: duag27Hong Kong, China
Title: Bar with a heart of gold
Review: If you ever read those English novels where a bar is often portrayed as a character and plays a big role in moving the story forward as things just happen around it. It is a great meeting place for people and you know everyone. You can spend hours sipping your drink under a whirring roof fan and look at the busy street outside where life plays a real life scene every moment. The crowd , the crackle , the exuberance , the smell of food , kids screaming and the business which were once the normal day occurrence but now so rare are in abundance at geographers cafe in jonker street. When you have nothing to do , go to this cafe and enjoy. Show less

Author: Bee4Singapore
Title: A very popular streetside watering hole.
Review: Many friends recommended me to try out this place and I was not disappointed. As restaurants and drinking places go in Melaka this is one of the most popular with tourists and a few locals. I like sitting on stools/chairs near the roadside , enjoying a cold beer, and watching the world go by. Very busy at night especially when the street markets are operating along the adjacent street.Show less

Author: Kgreen97
Title: Great cocktails
Review: Only went for cocktails but they were so good for the price, such nice professional cocktails we weren't expecting so for the price!

Author: Sea Way TJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Day: Restaurant; Night: Pub
Review: I understand most of the patron prefer to go to GC during the night time for some beer. However, beer is not something I like. I prefer the culture and the taste of it. Therefore I prefer to go during daytime.The food here are meant for vegan for some health reason. However, it's nice. Show less

Author: Naoji WAlexandria, Virginia
Title: Nice place
Review: This is a relaxing open air restaurant and bar that has live performances. It was fun to sit there and watch all the people go by while drinking an assortment of beers from all over the world. The restaurant is very cozy and the wait staff are very attentive to your needs.Show less

Author: DarbukaVantaa, Finland
Title: Great spot for eating and relaxing
Review: We had early lunch today with cold Asahi's. Their meny is very good from western food to Malay, Nonya, Indian etc. In one place. If you are a bit scary eater this can be your place. Tasty food well done and good music. Price level is also budget friendly. After lunch go to see Baba Nonya museum!Show less

Author: WeiDa_Tan
Title: An interesting visit
Review:
Located along Joncker, this cafe is a great place for you to sit back and relax while you watch the crowd roll by.

I'd suggest visiting in the evening though given its popularity, it'd be quite the long shot landing a table.

Author: PHILIPPE P
Title: charming
Review: located in Jonkers street on a corner , probally the best Cafe in Jonkers street and  / of Melaka heritage center.

Author: HanermanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Decent but expensive food
Review: I used to live 5 minutes from this restaurant, and have ate/drank their several times. The food is overpriced and fairly mediocre, but does have a nice mix of western and local. In the evening it is one of the more happening lounge/restaurants and draws a pretty good crowd.Show less

Author: wizzy423
Title: Drinks good , food not bad
Review: It's a good place to chill for weekends . Mostly full tourist and foriegns who came to visit lovely nasi lemak  melaka

Author: WimYogyaPemuteran, Indonesia
Title: Quite disappointing
Review: The place looks nice for a couple of drinks, but our dinner there was quite disappointing. My partner (a chef) had a few questions about the tastelessness of the food and the 2 students-waiters had no answers. Nor did they try to get them from the kitchen. And when my partner suddenly sat on the floor after a chair leg broke off, a light giggle was the only response. The amputated leg was removed and he was given another chair. No manager showing up to apologize for this embarrassing incident.Show less

Author: ChinDerrick
Title: Nice Decorated Cafe
Review: Geographer Cafe Served Local And Western Food With Plenty Of Choices But A Little Pricey.The Environment Was Nice And Enjoyable,A Good Place To Chill Out With Friends~

Author: jah1993
Title: Dissapointing food
Review: Quite a nice atmosphere but food was really dull and lacked flavour. Dissapointing considering the price, you can get a much tastier meal for less around the city.

Author: AndyD729
Title: Andy Kelli
Review: Great position pretty good staff.  toilets  ordinary but in Asia about as good as it gets. Not cheap food wise and food very ordinary. Beer cold and wine ok. Would go back for drink but not to eat

Author: wynsumWorld
Title: Nice Spot for a Beer at Jonker Street
Review: Cosy ambience converted from an old shop house. We ordered some simple local food, all taste good and not too expensive. It is located at the middle of Jonker Street, so a good spot to take a break with some cold beer in the heat.I would suggest not to rerun the video of their guests (or maybe owners?) dancing at the ground floor. I am sorry but I fail to appreciate. I prefer watching news report which they showed on another telly behind me. On the other hand, I did enjoy the other video showing the conversion of this shop house. It is far more interesting.Show less

Author: LhilljonesAberdeenshire, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location but toilets disgusting
Review: Fabulous looking little eaterie so stopped for lunch as in heart of jonker street. Food was ok - nothing special. Service not brilliant as had to fetch own napkins then ask for cutlery. Just a bit lacking in style really. The massive downside was the ladies toilet. One toilet only and was the hole in the ground sort which is ok if used to it but it was really really dirty and no toilet roll. Why oh why can't restaurants just keep a toilet clean and supplied with basic essentials. Hideous.Show less

Author: WilliamT3248
Title: Always my choice
Review: Every time I back to my lovely hometown this is my top 3 place to go. Great food great beer and lovely staff always.

Author: Nk485kuala lumpur
Title: Pricey Decent Food
Review: This cafe is located in a very convenient location in Jonker Street. They have a good variety of food which includes rice, noodles, pasta, salads, etc which incorporates local and Western flavours. Their drinks notably the sour plum juice, Mojitos and Margaritha are worth trying, especially the former. Among the rice dishes, the Nasi Goreng Kampung is superb but quite spicy, would not recommend to those with digestive issues. Upon recommendation, we tried the Jonker Fried Rice but found it to be quite bland. At night, there is a live band consisting of father-daughter duo whoShow less

Author: AnthSydneySydney, Australia
Title: Poor quality food
Review: Good spot for people watching particularly when the night market is on. Nice outside setting and pleasant staff but the food quality of the Malaysian dishes was really quite poor - a very small quantity of fatty chicken in our chicken dish and the ramen noodles were also disappointing. Have drinks only here. Show less

Author: egle_LT
Title: You wouldn't expect such a great food in the middle of tourist street
Review:
Make sure you try Coconut Tomyum and fresh spring rolls! Loved it!
Great food, friendly stuff, salsa on Sundays too! :) Very happy and happening spot.

Author: BackpackWarriorSingapore
Title: Improve on the food and drinks and it will be perfect
Review: (1)Location: Right smack in the middle of Jonker, cannot be that bad for a tourist, I guess...(2)Ambience: Cosy place to hang out with friends for a beer. Second level is air-conditioned with a view to Jonker street.(3)Crowd: Well, mostly tourist, of course...I don't see why locals would hang out at a over-croweded pasar malam over a weekend...(4)F&B: We ordered draft beers and it was good (how bad can a beer be??). Some of my friends ordered fresh coconuts and the found the coconut juice bland and very sour. The satay was an epic failure. Not that the taste was bad, but to call this satay in Malaysia is kinda weird...maybe feels more like a shashlik?(5)Service: Quite ok. They did not charge us for the coconuts that were not satisfactory. For some reason, they did not open up the air-conditioned 2nd level during the hot Saturday afternoon when I would not mind hopping in for a beer.(6)Would I go back?: Yes, but just for a beer to chill out with friends and rest my legs.Show less

Author: noxthotInnsbruck, Austria
Title: Food below average / poor. Prices above average
Review: Food was quite bad (we ordered three dishes, two of them were marked as chef recommendations). Almost any food stand does a lot better and is much cheaper.Meals are overpriced.Three waiters in the same room didn't manage to take an order (the cafe was almost empty inside) without being called.Furnishing was nice. In the evening you may happen to listen to live music and probably the cafe is good for having drinks (we didn't try).Show less

Author: MalcolmM1947Richmond-upon-Thames, United Kingdom
Title: Quick day time visit
Review: After a few days without a European type coffee were looking for a quick fix of decent caffeine. We saw Geographer Cafe and went in just before lunch time and found a table. Very quick service in a very genial laid back atmosphere. we sat by the street and watched the world go by for 20 minutes or so. The menu looked very comprehensive and we would have stayed and had such if we had not had another appointment. Nextt time we'll go for a proper meal.Show less

Author: travelerKolkata
Title: Restorated heritage cafe on Jonkers Street
Review: The cafe and restaurant is located at the popular Jonkers street. The building has been tastefully restored. We sat on the first floor and got a good view of the crowd on Jonkers Street. The service was good.

Author: aldrinkaiser
Title: Good Chillout Place
Review: After a hot tropical walks, this place is good for refreshment. We went there late a night so we only avail alcoholic beverages nonetheless the atmosphere is cool and historical. Must visit

Author: Juliana T
Title: Great place to have coffee breaks!
Review: Went there somewhere in the afternoon. The place had a kind of casual lazy atmosphere perfect for drinking a cup of coffee and people watch in cool comfort.

Author: ArulklKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice little place to spend an afternoon for beers
Review: We stopped by to have a few beers on a Sunday afternoon. Another small busy little cafe with a variety of local and continental dishes. They also have a few vegetarian dishes that are quire yummy.Nothing spectacular but not a bad place to spend a lazy afternoon knocking back some beers. Apparently there is a jazz bar at night but we didn't have a chance to return at night to experience it.Show less

Author: Sulaidahlan S
Title: Live band place to go*", @#$_
Review: Monday is my bored day in Melaka, my friend from Penang drive me to Jonkerwalk.  Once we stop at Geographer OMG got live band. So since that happen my monday with Geographer for Live Band with tempe goreng.

Author: Raymon1
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: Great food, great atmosphere, great service.. at very reasonable price. Highly recommended!. We've been here twice and can't wait for the next visit

Author: ArMini J
Title: Drinks
Review: Variety of drinks alcohol to non alcohol ... Located central of yonker street ... Around 6pm they will request u to pay earlier .. Wen my food was not even there .. Rather weird .. But all around service was acceptable .. Noisy said since its in the middle of the yonker ..Show less

Author: MrKellyK68
Title: Great enviroment & foods.
Review: I've been there with my friend last night. the aglio spaghetti was very delicious. And for overall we pay, the price very affordable..

Author: thuseUppsala, Sweden
Title: Great jazz night
Review: I cannot comment on their food and drinks but on the atmosphere. I came here with a sole purpose of listening to live jazz performance and Geographer didn't turn me down.The cafe's got a great jazz band that plays every Monday nights. Yeah, Monday nights, when it's kind of hard to find live music performance in town. The vocalist sings beautifully. Other members of the band play pretty well too. They've been playing here for several years already.Overall, Geographer would be a nice place for you to sit down and chill out after a day exploring the lovely Melaka. Show less

Author: Bansal71
Title: Happening place, good ambience
Review: Right in the heart of Jonkers street with good food and drinks, live music, with sitting options outside for smokers and inside too. Good ambience, nice staff

Author: FrannyFranzl
Title: Touristy but well arranged
Review: Good food and drinks, live music, nice inside and outside sitting options, good to sit and soak in the atmosphere of Jonker Street, thus lots of tourists around

Author: Peter MPattaya
Title: My main refuelling station in Melaka
Review: I have eaten here three times during my stay in Melaka, partly because it is convenient for my hotel but I also like its arty decor, laid back ambience and friendly staff. Most important of all, the food is tasty. I tried the vegetarian Nasi Lemak which gave my taste buds some pleasant surprises. I've also found the spaghetti to be decent. At each meal I've had the sour plum juice drink which arrives in a glass tankard and tastes better than it sounds - a bit like lime juice, refreshing. I have no hesitation in recommending this place.Show less

Author: karenc8157
Title: The environment was nice !
Review: The environment was nice, it is more like a cafe (remonded for the people who like to take photo). The food was so so. I was there at weekdays so there were not that much of people and therefore the upstairs was only for taking photograph. The women toilet is having electric lock so the women who want to get in have to get password from the cashier.Show less

Author: Kring1947
Title: Taking a
Review: This resto has a perfect to location to rest or take a breather from walking along Jonker St. It is a corner restaurant. The place has aircon and non aircon areas. This is a good place to have a drink and if you are hungry you can order meals as well. We just went there to drink but we saw a lot of customers ordering full meals.There is free wifi so it is also a good place to upload your photos to social media or check emails.Show less

Author: chaseenamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill out
Review: Our third visit. They serve western and local food, with great selection of drinks and beverages. I like their sour plum lime juice best, as it was very refreshing.Great Wifi reception. They have bands playing, however unsure of the music as we were there only in the afternoons and early evening. Ambience was comfy and the air conditioning cum additional fans were a great respite as the weather can be very humid and scorching hot. Show less

Author: Derek4501
Title: Nice place!
Review:
A great place to relax after a stroll through a very busy Jonker street on a Saterday night. 
They got lovely food, try the satay, and fresh fruit juices, try the sour plum juice.

Author: Joop000
Title: Great singer!
Review: We were just there this past Saturday night. We stopped by for a drink because of the live music. The singer had a really strong beautiful voice. The menu also looked good with several vegetarian options- too bad we had our dinner already. Next time.

Author: purplebackpackSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quality Food, Ambience, Great Service and nice live music
Review: We came to Melaka to celebrate our anniversary and found this great cafe to remember the day. The food was really nice, fresh and flavorful . What was a pleasant surprise was, we thought it would be just like another western style cafe and the usual fare. The menu was extensive.The music segment came later, so hang around if you have already finished eating. The beers came nicely chilled, which was a welcome treat from such a hot day.One would enjoy just chilling out here even without the evening music. It has a nice vibe and the service is good, despite the crowd.Show less

Author: Gary DBusselton, Australia
Title: Fresh food, Rustic setting...friendly staff
Review: Happened past here on a Thursday night...after 8pm. Jonker St was very subdued, but this place was open and running. Enthusiastic efficient staff, gave us their recommendations off what was an extensive menu. Enjoyed Geographer cocktail, cold beer & juices. Rainforest slad was massive, and the bride loved the Allio Spaghetti. Satayu was tender, but slightly unusual...The local Fried Rice was very filling. Worth a visitShow less

Author: Narvin S
Title: Where else would you get a live performer singing awesome songs with some natural tone
Review: It was indeed an awesome experience, a very geographical cafe indeed in the heart of jonker street Malacca. With awesome, dishes, snacks and beverages to go with it. Not to mention that cool performer and her well sung songs till about half past midnight. The weather was good so the atmosphere was quite natural. Of course you could choose to sit outside or inside or even upstairs depending on your liking. Don't be surprised if you happen to meet a celebrity there. Its a great place to hang and take the load off. Quite peaceful and relaxing. Food and drinks were good and also with fairly reasonable rates. Of course the main coarse dishes are not available during late hours and you only get snacks and drinks. its more of a bistro mixed with a classic town cafe. And even the food is about the mixture between those two. Of course you could grab a cold beer and some scotch whiskey, which is not available in your typical cafe; i would highly recommend this place. Don't be surprised, it ain't no Bar..Show less

Author: pieroparlati
Title: Great place
Review: Great place for a bucket of Tiger and a bite to eat. Good food and good service. Live music in the evenings.

Author: MS-75-TAMumbai, India
Title: Great place to hang around ....
Review: The place is super with great ambiance and good food. We were a large group and the food satisfied all the taste buds.... Local, international or asian. The location is so convenient....on the jonker street.The service is top class and the portions are plentiful. The portion size is good. We felt the drinks are overpriced as well the cocktails were nothing spectacular. Show less

Author: Ashdey
Title: Nice relaxing environment with great food and music
Review:
Excellent location - heart of Jonker street with band music and great food. Most importantly, few vegetarian options which is very important for us. 
We always dine here when we come to Melaka

Author: vsladeckova
Title: melaka
Review: Good atmosphere, nice food, excellent service! We have eaten  local cuisine, very tasty , fresh , complete experience.

Author: Qurban B
Title: Disappointed with food
Review: Not exciting food. Overrated. Too touristic. I would recommend if only to grab a drink but not so much to sit and have dinner. Like any touristic place with interesting title, it can attract but then don't be disappointed as local food is better just opposite the street at Nyonya kitchen. Show less

Author: sightofthetravel
Title: Birthday celebration trip
Review: Great place to grill n relax....the staff is attentive always polite and food is good .....cocktails drinks can be stronger ...lol...but definitely a must visit when in melaka.

Author: faridology
Title: Average food, great Ambience
Review: This place was over promoted and over exploded from the start which would have been fine if the food was good. However, it wasn't. Ambience was good, service was ok and we enjoyed ourselves. The fries (French fries) were outstanding. The Virginia Mary without the celery was not. Good for one time but won't come again unless for coffee and snacks. Show less

Author: Adthey
Title: Nice place to rest
Review: We went into this place on a Saturday night to take a break from the market below. They have a broad drink and food selection. They also have a band downstairs, which I didn't see because we were sitting upstairs, but could feel in my seats because the vibrations were transmitted through the structure. They should do something about that. Show less

Author: Arkdsz
Title: So so food. Overpriced drinks
Review: Food is so so. Their vegetarian ramen curry was a joke. Noodles were totally overcooked. Vegetarian Nasi Lemak was better though - little greasy but way better than the ramen. Paid around 20myr (5$) for both. What I hated was that them adding 6% tax and 6% service tax to the bill. Would be better to include those in the prices but Nasi Lemak wouldn't be 7,90 anymore... Just a very bad habit in some places to exclude taxes and this is one of these places.Show less

Author: Moon1215Europe
Title: Only for drinks!
Review: Food was rubbish ! Just have a drink but that's about it. Because its situated on Jonker St itself most people tend to stop in for a drink and something to eat because it isnt a coffee shop. However the food was terrible and a place we will never want to have a meat at.Show less

Author: sizekaJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Jazz not everyday
Review: We visited this restaurant because of a promotion we came across suggesting there is Jazz during dinner. When we got there it turned out there was no Jazz that Sunday evening. Watch out, it's not Jazz evening everyday. I wouldn't go there for food cause it's not great. For cocktails and Jazz certainly recommended.Show less

Author: Mochilero22
Title: Funky Place
Review:
Nice atmosphere - but really folks? 
Almost US $2 for a coconut - in the tropics! ... gimme a break guys! 

Otherwise place us nice, good vibe, live music, plenty of people, but unfortunately price point wise - not a great deal!

Author: bobbiet2014
Title: Nothing Special
Review: Came here expecting something really good. But meal was only mediocre. Think there must be better out there. Restaurant was busy so had a good lively atmosphere.

Author: MykingfuGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Great vibe, great drinks, great variety.
Review: This is a great place to sit for a drink and always seems busy, so they must be doing something right. I was impressed by the variety of food on offer, and although many reviews say it is average, I really enjoyed our meal. There can often be a wait for food, or even to be seated due to the fact that it is often so busy.Show less

Author: varshap529Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place!
Review: We visited the Geographer's cafe almost everyday we stayed in Malacca. Super friendly staff and great food. They had an impressive vegetarian menu in addition to several options for meat lovers. Right on Jonker street, the musical performances at night were entertaining without being loud. A must visit if you are in Malacca. Happening place indeed!Show less

Author: Hendra S
Title: Greet place
Review: the place is nice, but the food it,s not ok, you can eat satay, but don,t eat friedrice because not recomended, if you want drink this place it,s nice, this place it,s richie ren movie summer time

Author: kchyi
Title: Nice environment
Review: Have tried their mocktail and spegetti, not bad. What I love most about the cafe is their theme, decorations etc. The staffs are quite helpful, we six friends enjoyed our lunch there.

Author: k7cqPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great location and music
Review: The location is in the heart of Jonker's street. This is a casual place for food and drink. We enjoyed a live Jazz band on Monday evening. They were outstanding. The food was not that good to be honest. We would limit our visits to drinks and entertainment only.Show less

Author: meyxtineSingapore
Title: Great location; Need better customer service
Review: We stopped by to have some snacks & drinks but were told that food will take at least 30 min so we did not order any food. Fair enough since it was a public holiday & the cafe was packed. Customer service was not good - the waiters saw us waving at them but we were ignored until finally one came to take our orders. We ordered a cold beer & a glass of watermelon juice. The juice cost RM10 but was very much diluted. With so many cafes around this area, we might not be trying this one out again any sooner.Show less

Author: KateM54Queensland
Title: Great food
Review: We visited twice because their spring rolls were so good. Fresh and full of veggies. Drinks were cold; we didn't dine when live music was playing, but walked past when the place was jumping and it seemed to be where you go if you want music. Central location, quick service, great prices. Show less

Author: Geraldine TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill
Review: Like most reviews said, great place to chill after a long sweaty day! Do try to get here before 830pm though, cause thats when throngs of people come in for the live music. Another tip is to sit outside since its cooler and you can also listen to the live music from the bar opposite. Recommend the fries!Show less

Author: tripDTraveler
Title: Great place
Review: We visit this place whenever we go to Melaka and we are never disappointed. The location, the food, and the staff are outstanding. One of the best hotels for western and local cuisine around.

Author: ctwtjlyj1566
Title: Excellent
Review: Had a drink, great environment, great performances by Ms Nadia and her father, Mr Abid  (outstanding performance). Would definitely visit again

Author: DoraKLP
Title: A place for chill out
Review: Been there a few times. There is live band on Fridays , Saturdays and Mondays evening. Food like Satay, German beer was good, while we sit there enjoy live band performance

Author: 473arashn
Title: Nice place, nice food.
Review: The food is delicious, the price is reasonable and the service is good. Also the live music is nice and the atmosphere is friendly.

Author: LondonFoodLover909
Title: Service not great, bland ramen
Review: Had to flag the waiters down repeatedly. Were ignored for quite a while when we sat down.Veggie ramen was basically just water- even after adding A LOT of salt it was still nearly tasteless. Cocktail very weak.However, my partner LOVED his crispy fried bean curd. Better vegetarian selection than most places in meaty Melaka. Show less

Author: DylanAndrewMartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Terrific Taproom on a Thirsty Thoroughfare
Review: The Geographer Cafe is one of those great finds you make that leaves a lasting impression and becomes one of those fond memories you always talk about when you reminisce your travels. Whether you're looking to mix and mingle with travellers from all corners of the globe or just sit pensively in a quiet corner at a blue shuttered-window balcony watching the world collide, the Geographer can cater to any mood. It offers a far more unique experience than the garish and replicated offerings of the Hard Rock cafe up the road. While not lauded for their food menu, what they have to offer is great if you're looking to get out of the heat of the day and refuel. Sit downstairs under the mist spray.Show less

Author: aihua1331
Title: Draft beers and mojito
Review: Love the popular draft beers such as tiger, hoegaarden, stout etc. I love the mojito.  The ginger and the classic are very nice. At weekends, there will be a live band from 830pm onwards.  The chicken wings is nice too.

Author: HoHenryKuala Lumpur
Title: Drink hole to watch the world go by
Review: This restaurant cum pub is situated at the corner along Jonker Street. Favorite place to sit with a glass of cold beer to watch the world go by. Tourists from many parts of the world will visit Jonker Street and a good way to pass a hot afternoon with a glass of cold beer. Food is good too.Show less

Author: 841idar
Title: Great place
Review: Great place to relax and have a bite. One of the rare bars which are open and lively later in the night.

Author: Karen BSurrey, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely atmosphere!
Review: We arrived early and they opened up especially just for coffee! Of course as soon as we were seen others arrived too! A lovely way to start the day. We came back for dinner and had a great meal. Really interesting reading about the history on the screen. A lovely place to soak in the atmosphere!Show less

Author: mclalor
Title: Ok for a quick drink
Review: Well situated abd good for a quick beer. Didn't eat there so can't comment on food but it seemed very noisy and washroom facilities very poor standard.

Author: Bluebunny2046
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Every weekend this cafe full of people, some time very difficult to get a seat. Normally after walk at Jonker, will grab a drink at here.

Author: giokerq
Title: Good for a beer
Review: Situated in Jonker street, it offers a big selection of international cocktails, beers, and some local and western dishes. There is also live music. However, the quality of the cocktails was only average, and they were definitely overpriced. Better go with just some beers.

Author: phouska
Title: European place
Review: This place has a sufficient offer however lacks a bit of a local touch and atmosphere.  Food is good but nothing you would come back for next time. Its just a european hangout with everything that goes with it.

Author: Yuu M
Title: Fantastic cafe
Review: Been here on weekend and it's very crowded. Nice drink and good food. Try to come on weekday night for a more quiet time

Author: Tonphai_3020Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Great atmosphere and delicious food
Review: After our trip in Melaka whole day. We are looking for a nice restaurant . Grographer Cafe is first choise because there are have live music and varity of food. I ordered Veg spring roll, Satay,Ramen Curry everything was good we love here so much and hope to come back again.Show less

Author: Sudesh77Hong Kong, China
Title: Good music and great chill out place
Review: Yup, it's all about the music here. Great music and very good performers, especially during the weekends. It's been around for 10 years now, but still doing well. Busy even on a weekday. Food is nothing to shout about, as they are attempting to serve Melakan cuisine with a diff touch - healthy options. Err...doesn't work too well I'm afraid. The only big bar on the street, but it's a good one I must say. Show less

Author: consumption888London, United Kingdom
Title: Unauthentic food
Review: Ambience was nice, and service was okay. Would come here for a drink, but definitely not the food. The food makes the place a bit of a tourist trap, is unauthentic (coming from a Malaysian), and expensive. Also why is the ladies toilets locked with a PIN code and the men's isn't, bit sexist? Could also do with toilet paper (had to use my own pocket tissue).Show less

Author: 745thomasm
Title: Decent food in midst of china town
Review: Food was OK but nothing special. Service not that food, we had to ask for every order ourselves. Atmosphere ok but we visited during night market so was pretty noisy.

Author: AgaTheBlueTiger
Title: Great plate-forme evening drinks
Review: It's a very nice chill out place. The list of drinks, moktails and beers is decent. Food is also available. Its such a nice corner shop where you sit and observe the town life. Like a cat.

Author: DrMcavalaniMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Friendly n very accomodative n good food too
Review: Celebrated a family member birthday there not long ago. Had a fabulous time there. We had them make vegetarian dishes which was very tasty despite not being on the menu. Very accomodative staff indeed. Ambience is nice n staff very friendly esp with the kids. Nice place to b with loved one n family.Show less

Author: 946willgToronto, Canada
Title: Good Asian Pub Fare
Review: Overall it was an ok experience. The menu selection and my dishes were good, I think this restaurant falls down a bit on service and cleanliness. The wait staff were very friendly and eager to help but it seemed like they were under trained. I had to direct them twice to take my empty dishes away. The plates and drinks came out in a rather peculiar order as well. The tables could also do with a good scrub. I'd probably come back here. Show less

Author: turco48Iskenderun, Turkey
Title: jazz music in tropical town
Review: in the middle of Jonker street,very popular cafe with delicious and fresh food with asian flavor, large variety of wine selection,and beers, but most important : live jazz music on monday !! accidentally i met the owner,Mr. Tseng, whose management concept created this very popular bistro.if you visit one day Malacca, don't miss it..!Show less

Author: carolinafzsd
Title: Well located
Review: It is a okish place to have a drink. We stopped here during the night market walk. The staff is a little slow but the beer was cold. The toilet was not to clean and it requires password to enter.

Author: andyfromsouthamptonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quirky little place
Review: I like the bohemian and the different, and this is certainly something you do not find in Europe or Singapore. The whole cafe is rainforest themed, with accompanying plants and steam spray to increase humidity. Would certainly recommend. The drinks are a bit more expensive than the other cafes but it is on jonker street. Staff pleasant but not very proactive Show less

Author: 494marionp
Title: Great Bar
Review: Was there sat night, the lady singing was awesome, great menu selection and drinks too. Relaxing atmosphere.

Author: emSherwoodBrisbane, Australia
Title: Best place in Jonkers
Review: We looked around at the menus and decided to eat at Geographers. The fact that there were plenty of people eating there was a good sign. The food and prices were good and the service also good. The previous evening there had been a singer there. I'd recommend Geographers. No problems.Show less

Author: Stephen HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lively great locale for people watching.Probably more happening at night.
Review: Fun lively spot for drinks and food on the corner of tourist action. Food is pleasant with an electic menu rather than memorable cuisine while staff are pleasant but slow . Tourist prices and popular with backpackers.more atmosphere than substance as the old shop house is charmingLooks more fun with music at night.Show less

Author: samthomasleeNuremberg, Germany
Title: Geographer
Review: Location is great, staff are friendly, singer very enthusiastic but overall feel the place is living off its celebrity rather than doing anything new or trying hard to be better & the food really underwhelming. Overall very disappointed (based on recommendations to come here & high expectation). Show less

Author: Sparklesorbet
Title: Excellent vegetarian options
Review: Went here for dinner, lovely chilled atmosphere and music. Really excellent vegetarian options, especially the veggie satay and curry. Would definitely go back - highly recommend.

Author: 751sharonw
Title: Good place for a coffee or beer & to people watch
Review: We stopped here a few times during our stay to catch our breath & have a drink. The coffee was good and the beers were cold. Reasonably priced. Good place to people watch.

Author: silje2016Oslo, Norway
Title: Good place
Review: The food is very good and it is really cheap! The downside is that the service is not good. They have plenty of waiters, but you have to try many times to get in contact with any of them. But all in all, definetly go there!Show less

Author: AHM73
Title: Stop in if in Jonker Street
Review:
Good food. Cold beer. Funky vibe. 
Staff tend to talk to each other too much and not look to serve, but they are friendly. Would only go when in Jonker Street.

Author: 714sebastianm
Title: Excelent!!
Review: I came to Melaka by my self and I took breakfast, lunch and dinner here, so much better than the other restaurants. Vegetarian food awesome.

Author: ReddotzSingapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: I always visit geographer cafe for sour plum drink whenever I go jonker because it was really good and this time I especially brought my family to try it. It used to be a big tall mug but this time it shrank in size for the same price. Felt cheated and not worth the price. Moreover, we found something dirty sticking on the lime, after informing the service staff he changed the drink to a new one. Shouldn't have brought my family to geographer cafe. A mistake. A visit to geographer cafe for sour plum drink used to be a must in my travel itinerary but not anymore.Show less

Author: Kiru19Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to hangout
Review: Ordered the Jonker's fried rice and Asahi Beer.Food was good, satisfied with the price.There is a pretty girl with a pretty voice doing live music.Seating places are not in the same crowd as the people who walk in Jonker Street, which is a good thing. You don't want that crowd and noise while you eat and enjoy your drink.80% customers are foreigners with one purpose of chilling.Recommended place in Jonker Street.Show less

Author: pugdoggy5Liverpool, United Kingdom
Title: Good location for a time out
Review: This chilled destination is on the corner of Jonkers Street and provided a welcome oasis from the hustle bustle of the area. Service was good and quick. The menu was interesting with lots of appealing choices whether you wanted a full meal or a snack. Lots of drinks choices too. Food was tasty and portions were reasonable. There are cheaper places but we didn't have a problem with the price we paid. Show less

Author: anibYorkshireyorkshire
Title: Looks good, slow service
Review: The Geographer looked promising so we went for a drink and dinner. Its a nice place for a drink and there was live music, but oh dear the service was slow. We waited a while for someone to take our order, a shared starter and two main courses. One main (not very hot) and the starter came together, the second main course came about 10 minutes later when we reminded them that we were missing a meal! And it wasn't even that busy. Staff were very inattentive, food was average. Perhaps somewhere to have a drink and enjoy the music, couldn't really recommend the food.Show less

Author: talismanicLondon, United Kingdom
Title: PEOPLE WATCHING HEAVEN
Review: The Geographer Cafe is located on a prominent corner site along the ever-popular Jonker Street and is thus perfect for people watching while enjoying a coffee or beer. The Cafe has an interesting food menu too with local favourites, dishes from other parts of SE Asia, as well as some Western and vegetarian items. The Asian choices I had during my week in Malacca were all good and very tasty. There are some desserts too, but I did not try any as I had no room left. The Cafe also has wines, cocktails and other drinks including a range of beers including draught beer; there is also a happy hour which is good. The staff are attentive and helpful and the service is quick. Overall, one of the best places to eat or drink in old Malacca.Show less

Author: Selinawongg
Title: Good Vibes
Review: Stopped by for a drink. Had a very good live band. The singer was superb. Place was pretty crowded, hence why we decided to check it out. Right by Jonker street. Nothing special but nothing wrong with it either.

Author: JoolesgunSingapore
Title: Great spot for lunch, dinner or a drink!
Review: We had lunch here on the first day of our trip. It has a just interesting and eclectic feel to it. The food was great as were the drinks. Its a great place to chill out while coming up with a game plan for the trip. Show less

Author: Suhana M
Title: Healthy nasi lemak with a quaint ambiance
Review: Based on the reviews on Tripadvisor, we tried to have breakfast here. The healthy nasi lemak (brown rice) was delicious and a breath of fresh air but wasnt to keen on the coffee.. Strategic location to feel that Melaka vibe!

Author: barileetravelingOsaka, Japan
Title: Great ambiance, decent food, tourist prices
Review: This place is a beehive of tourists, thanks to its attractive decor, great ambiance and western feel. The service is good but not great, while the food was pretty good. Some of the menus need to be retired - parts of it were so worn down, we couldn't read some pages. The prices are expectedly higher than local restaurants but you're paying for the atmosphere. Would be a nice place to chill with other travelers who aren't comfortable with more local restaurants. Show less

Author: Frans_12255060Broadbeach, Australia
Title: Great location & satay
Review: The Geographer Café occupies a nice corner site on a road leading into Jonker Street--as a result, its a great place for people watching, with many tables facing out into the street. If satay is a good test in Malaysia, with everyone doing it, this Café passes with flying colours--very tender generous pieces of chicken and very tasty peanut sauce--we had two serves they were so good. Also had a nonya chicken dish, which was a bit bland. Beer & wine were nice & cold, & service was friendly albeit a bit dis organised--when it got busy, you could wait a long time for service. We didn't much like having to pay drink by drink, but I guess the few who skip without paying have spoilt it for the honest majority. The PA screeching with Edith Piaf or some other French singer just seemed out of place--plenty of noise and life in the street. All in all, pleasant but not spectacularShow less

Author: travelkeedaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice spot but food can be better
Review: You can visit this place more for the experience rather than the food. The place has the old world charm housed inside a colonial bungalow. The drinks are fine but the food is just okay.I would say, good to stop here for one meal or a few drinks or late night coffee.Show less

Author: Ganesh SSydney, Australia
Title: Good for a cold beverage after a hot day sight seeing.
Review: Its a nice relaxed pub with over plan sitting facing the street. A great place to have a cold beer or cocktail and people watch.The premises is looking very tired and can do with a major renovation especially the toilets.The menus are falling apart and look tatty.Overall a cool place to relax after a hot day sight seeing.Show less

Author: Jeroen2134
Title: Nice food - good servi
Review:
Nicely situated at heart of jonkerstreet. Nice flavored sate. Recommend jonker fried rice as dish.
Espresso is lavaza and very good prepared. Also the fruit shakes are good- although a lot of ice. But staff is also prepared to leave the ice cubes out.

Author: Helen572
Title: Good place to eat and drink
Review: This is a good place for decent food. We ate lunch here and had beer and wine. Prices not bad for this touristy part of town. Gets quite busy.

Author: Eric451112
Title: Fine music
Review: Four kinds of draught beer and good music (blues and r&r), tasty food. Try the delicious fruit rujak!!

Author: SpotMike
Title: Disappointinf
Review: Average food - poor, slow service - food slow to arrive and comes at different times - hair in my chicken - very loud, bad music - squat toilet.

Author: Anna B
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went here for lunch one day while in Melaka, as it had been recommended on multiple sites...really not sure why?Service was embarrassingly poor. We had to find the menu ourselves after sitting there for a good 4-5 minutes. They weren't even busy and staff were just 'hanging out'. It seemed like the staff were more like patrons?! Food was fine, but nothing to rave over. Let me put it this way, if I went back to Melaka, I would keep walking and eat/drink somewhere else.The weather was stinking hot and the don't have sufficient air con/fans to keep you cool in the peak of the heat.I live in Vietnam, so my expectations of service aren't as high as they were when I was in Australia/NZ but this was really disappointing considering how many sites/books tell you to check out this cafe.Show less

Author: Melissa CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Escape the madness of Jonker!
Review: The only bar to escape the madness and pointlessness of the market. Service is a little slow (we drink fast, maybe?) but beers are fresh so no problems there. The live music is a plus and the singer is very competent so overall an enjoyable evening. Show less

Author: Rajan SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Spot
Review: Didn't eat there this time around. Had food there before and remember it to be good. This time just stopped for drinks and to watch the world go by. An excellent spot right in the heart of Jonker Street, on a very busy corner. Live music too. The Geographer and the bar across the street seem to have a very good arrangement where their live performers take it in turns to do a couple of numbers each. Service was reasonable considering how busy it gets. Sometimes difficult to get someone's attention and there were a good number of new staff, not too sure of themselves. Ultimately well worth the visit. And you'll be back.Show less

Author: wanderlustKDEDublin, Ireland
Title: Not for families or budgets
Review: The decor here was nice, the menu was ok, nothing very exciting but the drinks were really expensive. The food took a really long time to come to the point where we had to ask if they had forgotten us as the kids were starving and people who came after us had been served. Coincidentally the food came a couple minutes later. We were all still left hungry after the meal which wasnt very filling considering the price. I wouldn't recommend this for a family as its a bit uptight and service is slow. It seemed like the place you'd come for a slow drink rather than the food if you could bear the prices!Show less

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Busy cafe and bar in the midst of things
Review: Melaka does not have many places that serve as cocktail bars as well as cafes. Elsewhere it would be very average, but here it does not have much competition, and enjoys a great location on Jonkers Street. It is cosy, and great for people watching.It is a very laid back place, the staff are helpful, don't rush you, and most speak pretty good English.We dropped in on several occasions. We had fresh juices. They have some quirky combinations, but they are not cheap. Another time we came for a light lunch. They have a very varied menu, a combination of local and Western food, including salads, and many vegetarian options. We tried the chicken satay, and the rojak, both were lovely, but a bit dearer than elsewhere. Finally, we visited for drinks. The have some sort of happy hour, but it is actually quite limited, and complicated. The cocktail menu was good, both classic and more modern concoctions. I don't remember exactly which cocktails I tried, they were good but not great. They also have clean toilets, a bonus, when you are in this tourist area and need to go. Overall, given the limited choices, this is a great little place with good vibes.Show less

Author: garyb310
Title: Great Bistro Style Bar in "Beautiful Malaka"
Review:
Great Bar/ Restaurant in Jonker Street Malaka.
Great choice of reasonable priced food and beer.
Worth a visit

Author: Rick NSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not too bad
Review: Visited the place during breakfast of the 1st day of Chinese New Year. A lot of eating places were close but this one was open, and very willing to serve customers. Choices were quite limited, at least for breakfast. I had egg sandwich while my wife had the Jonker fried rice. The food was not too bad, but there was really nothing to shout about. All in all, the experience was not bad nor was it that good.Show less

Author: Terence H
Title: Improvement please.
Review:
Not bad. But too crowded. 
Not suitable for groups bigger than six (6) as the room space is too small, imo. 
The menu provided is torn on some pages and wordings on the menu cannot be read.

Author: DaveandDaria
Title: Great little bar!
Review: Read about this place online and went to check it out. Food ok, beer good, service pretty fast. Recommended.

Author: chrismE5291OENottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Average at best
Review: No great shakes, reading all the reviews made me give this cafe a go, it's just that a cafe and a average one at that, the food and beer are very expensive compared to other places on the same street, wasn't for me and I won't go backShow less

Author: BKLau
Title: Slow service for average food
Review: Slow service for average food. Not worth the heat, wait and price. Looks better in photos than reality. Suggest trying other outlets.

Author: alimilesLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Slow service and mediocre food
Review: Walking around Chinatown in Melaka, we spotted what looked like a nice place for a drink and a bite to eat. At first we sat in the bar area and had a drink which took a long time to get, however the atmosphere seemed relaxed and the music good. Whenever we tried to flag down a waiter to remind him we hadn't received our orders, we were made to wait while they prioritised other customers. Upon receiving the food we ordered, the portions were very small and the food was ok but nothing great, there was also long gaps between receiving all the dishes. When my friend went to the bathroom, there was sick in the sink and toilet and the toilet was generally poorly maintained. I would say this venue is fine for a couple of drinks given its convenience and location and in fairness has a nice atmosphere, but service is poor and good isn't great. Show less

Author: jamesonn2013Singapore, Singapore
Title: Vegetarian Food - Jonker Street Melaka
Review: Came to Geographer for the Vegetarian food. Was here the third time on 09-02-2016. The environment is cozy, especially on the 2nd Floor. The windows opens view to the busy Jonker street. Tried the Curry Ramen , Tempek(fried soyo bean pie) and the refreshing Plum Juice. Show less

Author: jameson n
Title: Vegetarian food
Review:
Geographer cafe serve good vegetarian food. They have curry ramen, nasi lemak(coconut rice) , tempek(fried soyo bean cake) . Sour 
Plum juice ìs refleshing.

Author: clare a
Title: special cafe
Review:
Friends and I dined at the Geographer in October last year and my son and I had
dined there previously. Both time were great with good food, prompt service and friendly staff. Also a great atmosphere.

Author: Dhruv PSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing food, great variety, cool ambience, friendly staff
Review: Came here twice in my 2 day Malacca trip because the food was so good! They had lot of options for my vegetarian friends as well. The drinks were a bit too expensive (relative to other bars) but very strong! Live music was of a high standard and service was good.A must visit if you're in MalaccaShow less

Author: nathandulceSingapore, Singapore
Title: Outstanding!
Review: Drinks are somewhat affordable, and on some days, there are live bands performing. The food is quite good as well, and the servers are very attentive. What draws me to this place is that they have an airconditioned interior, which is perfect for the hot afternoons, and the patio area outside is just right for the evenings.Show less

Author: Rachel M
Title: good vegetarian meal
Review: Good food decently priced for a tourist spot. Service fairly slow but it was a busy weekend so probably a bit overwhelmed.

Author: Dicky333Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty Food
Review: Stopped here for a quick bite to eat - food was extremely tasty with great flavours.The band played music I the background an ideal place to have a beer and watch the hustle of Jonker St.Only comment the beers were expensive compared to other bars in the surround area.Show less

Author: 97PaulSHermanus, South Africa
Title: Terrible and very over rated
Review: This place is clearly resting on its accolades. We had Malacca Coffee which was awful. It was not hot, and they brought it with powdered coffee whitener. After that the mango curry with cashews was almost stone cold, and was a tiny portion. Don't go it's not worth it.Show less

Author: Marty1340Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quick bite...
Review: Dropped in for a quick bite and to rest a little after walking for what seemed miles around Melaka and Jonker Street. Grabbed some great food at reasonable prices and a really well earned Guinness or two to re-hydrate :-) There are loads of food places here but this was quick service with a smile and nice and simple, could image sitting there for an hour or two but sadly we had to move on for more sight seeing :-)Show less

Author: snen15Chiba Prefecture, Japan
Title: A good drop by.
Review: Location is convenient (center on the Jonker Street). Clean, relaxing and nice service with a variety of menu. Local food served here is well-refined, and "attract" appetites. We visited twice (repeater). Ordered Satay, Fresh Vegetable Egg Role, Tempeh Curry, and could not stop to order "Geo`s Curry Ramen" with 3 glasses of Gin tonic, a Bloody Mary and a bottle of mineral water - total MYR 125 was "reasonable" I think. Observing travellers was a fun, too.Show less

Author: melaniaekasari
Title: Cute little cafe
Review: It is a nice little cafe in the corner of the street, the waiters and waitresses are very nice. I ordered nasi lemak and chicken wings to eat but i have to say the food wasn't that tasty. What i like about this place is, they have some choices of liquors and cocktails, it's a nice place to just sit down, relax, and drink with ur squad Show less

Author: June SPaphos, Cyprus
Title: Lovely Little Place
Review: Loved this place, stopped off for a coffee in the afternoon and liked it so much, went back for dinner. Very busy at night with a lively atmosphere and live music. Food was excellent and good choice. Very buzzy place and would definitely recommend a visit.Only reason I didn't give this an excellent rating was due to the toilets which were squats with no western toilet available. You won't be disappointed with the Geographer.Show less

Author: garlic1927Bournemouth, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to chill out
Review: On Jonkers about half way up. Located on a corner. Top tip go upstairs and get a seat by the shuttered windows and watch the world go by. They have amazing fruit juices which you can have on their own or blend. Good satay. Great sauce. Prices reasonable. Good chilling music. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: Lalitha5645Batu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: Good food in a relaxed setting
Review: Jonker Street is a very crowded street, bustling with tourists. After walking through the milling crowds, Geographer Cafe came up as a welcome place to sit down and relax. And of course, since it was lunch time, we had a good lunch too. There were quite a few vegetarian options - ramen noodles, spring rolls, sandwiches, to name a few. We tried some mocktails, and they were tasty. The place had good ambience, and the food served is suitable both for Westerners as well as Asians.Show less

Author: Martyn PLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Fine for tourists
Review: Let's be clear: this is not somewhere for the locals to eat and drink. We went three times - once to hear the live music, once to get a much-needed decent coffee and once because it is one of the very few places to serve wine. It's good, but not Melakan.Show less

Author: monicag719Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delightful Lunch
Review: The Nasi Goreng Kampung and Geographer are in a class of their own.Brimming with chunks of marinated chicken and prawns and veg.Do try the Tom Yam in Coconut...a spicy smooth seafood broth fragranced by the juice of the coconut its served in.Chicken Satay is well marinated and for vegans, the fresh spring rolls are great..To finish have the Melaka coffee.Service is prompt and friendly. A great spot to chill at in the midst of Jonkers.Show less

Author: SuziiQ
Title: Yummy food
Review: Had a few meals there, very yummy food. Catered well for our kids. There were 3 families with 5 kids between us. Very reasonably priced.

Author: Erin F
Title: Good place to hangout and chillax
Review: We had a pleasant time hanging out with a bottle of beer ;) the food was decent and environment relaxing

Author: yannick707
Title: Hello...service?
Review: Waited so long for the service guys...not even a smile from them. Satay was good! But guys, serve with a smile

Author: 463alaa
Title: Delicious
Review: Wanted to try local food and light meal, we tried chicken nyonya and it was delicious. Very nice location and view. I recommend it for international and local food. Very helpful and friendly staff

Author: Sia65Singapore, Singapore
Title: Ok....
Review: First of all, don't buy the one-bite durian puff across the road and then bring it to the cafe to go with your drinks. The waiters will tell you off. They reasoned that some guests get put off with the smell. Fair enough. Don't take out the local snacks you bought from the food shop across the road too. No outside food allowed. Fair enough too. Nothing fantastic about the drinks. Nice ambience and good place to people watch. That's about it. Show less

Author: Caroline1952London, United Kingdom
Title: Great spot to stop off on Jonker Street in Melaka!
Review: The staff are very nice and we've heard some very good jazz singing - the lovely Nadia with her band (her father on keyboard) is very engaging!Also the prices for G&T, wine and beer are very reasonable for Melaka. Unlike many places you pay the price on the menu so you don't get surprises! (Hard Rock Cafe and Bamboo Hut Bistro for example add 16% on the prices on the menu!!!)Show less

Author: ztig65Tromso, Norway
Title: Good place to hang out and eat
Review: This place is located on a street corner on Jonker Street. It's a good place for people watching.Had dinner there, delicious food. Well made and good taste. Ordered an Irish Coffee for dessert. It came in a cocktail glass, a little bit coffee and a lot of Irish... Strong but good.Service was good and price level normal. They also have a guestbook where you can leave a comment. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: Teresa R
Title: Welcoming
Review: Great bar with buzzing atmosphere, live music and friendly staff. Extensive food menu and drinks all very reasonably priced.Just off Jonker Street so in a happening area.

Author: HP8_11Sydney
Title: Good environment and music
Review: The food is not exciting but fine for a simple meal, particularly if you want to eat light. However we really liked the place itself which was inviting, had good music ( not live when we were there), and reasonable wine by the glass. It was a good place to relax for a while. They have an air conditioned area but we ate outside in the greenery. Service was prompt.Show less

Author: Geoff BBasingstoke, United Kingdom
Title: Pleasant stop for drinks and entertainment
Review: We were walking through the night market in Jonker Street (enormous amounts of cheap tourist rubbish, but quite good fun for people-watching) when we heard the sound of live music coming from a street-corner bar. The performer turned out to be a young Muslim woman in a headscarf, playing an electric guitar and singing, accompanied by MIDI tracks on a keyboard. It was refreshing to see and hear a Muslim woman expressing herself artistically in this way, so (in the interests of refreshment), we sat down and ordered some drinks. These were reasonably priced by Malaysian standards (I had a pint of Asahi and a Leffe Brune, my wife had the ‘sour plum’ juice, all of which were delicious) and we listened as the girl sang a selection that ranged from ‘Dancing Queen’ by Abba to ‘Dummy’ by the Cranberries (still very pertinent given recent events, and great to hear from a Muslim woman). The food on the menu seemed good value, and what we saw being served looked tasty, but we were still full from our lunch at the Peramakan and couldn’t eat anything. The place had a nice, friendly atmosphere, and we enjoyed our brief visit. It’s well-located to step out of the chaos of the weekend street market and watch the world go by.Show less

Author: Alan-HoldenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Vehicle friendly
Review: Back to Geographer after 7 years. Not much has changed but the menu seems to stray a bit far toward vegetarian. I'd like to see a few more meat dishes back on offer.Miss my musician friend Mr. Burns who sadly passed away, but the duo playing were good enough to enhance the atmosphere.Show less

Author: aliceawesomeandrewsGöteborg
Title: Nice location but pretty poor food
Review: I ate lunch here, I spotted it from Jonker Street so the location is really good and you can sit and watch people on the street which is nice. The food is pretty poor for the price you pay though, I ordered a vegetable curry with naan but it wasn't much and the naan was not the real deal like in Indian restaurants. So I say, if you go here, don't eat but have a beer or a fresh juice and enjoy the streetlife from a bar chair :) Show less

Author: Kimberly G
Title: Geographer Cafe
Review: Very relaxing and nice place with music and enjoy dinner. Value for money. This is the 2nd time came here for dinner. Would recommended this place to travellers.

Author: louisa_koch
Title: Nice atmosphere but bad surprise
Review: Was eating here and found a caterpillar in my veggie curry. That happens. I got part of my dish newly served but there was nothing else. No refund no real sorry. Still staff is nice and the location is great.

Author: AusDonnySydney, Australia
Title: Curry Ramen!
Review: We came here on our first night in Melaka after a night bus trip from KL.I got the curry ramen which was amazing! It was like a laksa with ramen and a perfect mix with melaka culture. I came back again the night after and the other dishes were also very good and value for moneyShow less

Author: soapy23Singapore
Title: Nice pasta but no warm water?
Review: Nice pasta - both aglio olio and pesto - reasonably priced too. However when I asked for warm water after my cup of local melaka coffee (which was good too), waiter checked and said they only mineral water was offered. I'd have gladly paid for warm water.Show less

Author: TonyD33Poole, United Kingdom
Title: Great place
Review: I loved this place. The food was excellent - be it lunch time or evening and there was live music in the evening. The location is on a corner and you can sit effectively outside and still hear the music with a breeze and be inside with the party.Very helpful staff as well. We went twice, but I wish we had discovered it earlier as I would have been even more - great place.Show less

Author: heyitsemily
Title: Great ambiance average food
Review: The location and the building itself is great . They provide live music and the service are great . The food are alright not consider wow tasty or delicious but not too bad either . 5 stars for everything else besides the food .

Author: deki_mandela
Title: Start your Melaka tour here
Review: Very relaxed, almost bohemical atmosphere, good food, very good and fast service. Love this place! .

Author: Alain PVancouver, Canada
Title: Great atmosphere, good food
Review: Not many choices of restaurants we could find in Melaka. This one offered a nice ambiance and very tasty food and drinks. We ate there 3 nights in a row and had the Asian specialties every time, except for the desert when we had the banana chocolate cake. Very tasty! . The main dishes could be a little bit more though.Show less

Author: W1971ACcindysPortland, Oregon
Title: Food looked good
Review: I ordered a watermelon juice and added my own vodka from my flask (backpacker budget). The ambiance was great and it was perfectly located for people watching. They had terrific wifi and the food that came out looked incredible. It wasn't in my budget but for most people who are backpacking for a year it is very affordable.Show less

Author: aurfeiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to chill
Review: Right smack in the middle of Jonker Street, this is the only western food joint (other than Hard Rock Cafe just outside of Jonker Street) along the stretches of the two streets. Nicely setup, with as much nostalgic and historical decoration retained to the restaurant, it fits nicely to the overall theme of Jonker Street. Food is not too bad, nice place to rest your feet after excessive walking and to have a chilled drink... and the prices are more reasonable than expected, not tourist prices :PShow less

Author: nins0000
Title: Classic colombia ambience
Review: The food is not bad. The quality is reseved especially the black pepper chicken chop. A must try pesto pasta and make it spicy! yummm..

Author: Leonard S
Title: It's more for western tourists, I guess?
Review: I found this cafe while walking around at day, so came back later at night to try this cafe, it's more for western tourists I guess, since the foods were a bit strange in taste for me. It's quite noisy and just ok to chillin' and hang out with friends, meet some strangers. Atmoshere was quite nice to do that. Something that western people like to do.Show less

Author: Tee C
Title: Sit and relax in the evening
Review: Food was good drink were nice and excellent location I came here for beer and stay in evening it good experience for Melaka here you will see people walk around listen to nice music and feel the old town atmosphere

Author: Teo Y
Title: Poor coffee quality. A tourist trap
Review: The initial excitement to try out its coffee and other drinks turned out to be the worst decision of my life. Lousy coffee taste and the coconut I ordered could not have tasted worse. This cafe can only scam the western tourist,but not me. I would rather spend my money visiting the zoo than this cafe. My first and last visit. I urge travellers to try out other cafes in the vicinity rather than this cafe. Show less

Author: lillyjo6363Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Dinner cum supper
Review: Menu of food was quite limited with most being vegetarian dishes. We ordered satay, which tasted rather different from the conventional ones as the sauce had a sour-ish taste to it. The rice dishes was served with brown rice. Service was average and food took a bit of time to arrive. The deco in this cafe had a rustic look to it decorated with old memorabilia.Show less

Author: Leufar
Title: Decent food but noisy/not comfortable place
Review:
Asian food was ok and cocktails were excellent.
But live music was very very loud and the table for 4 was very small (size of a table for 2)

Author: djupriadi
Title: enjoy the athmosphere
Review:
accidentally visit while walking around Jonker street. The food is quite OK. Forget name of the drink that I choose, it is a good one. 
Friday night and Saturday night are crowded.

Author: stef_nsy
Title: It is supr nice!
Review: I really love the food and environment there. The food is nice and not expensive, the singer has a good voice. Everything is good, but u may need to fo early on weekend to get a seat. It is free sitting.

Author: StandardU
Title: Good place to chill out
Review: Good place to chill out for drinks. Had good time with colleagues. The place would be nice during the weekdays when Jonker street is closed

Author: Dez L
Title: Not a bad place to chill
Review: Happen to walk pass this place and decided to sit down for a ice cold ice. Was ushered in by their staff and was promptly served. The ambience of this place is quite cool especially on their level 2. I was told that there was a Chinese movie film there in the early 2000s for there rustic feel! Movie title 夏日嬷嬷茶。This cafe have live band performance when i was there on a Friday night. The songs sung were okay just that i felt that its high time for them to change their speakers. The projection from the damage speakers actually drove my friends and i away.Didnt have the chance to taste their food as we have ate too much along Jonker Street. May go back and try if i were to go back to Malacca.Show less

Author: edwintcs
Title: All good
Review: The foods' option is very limited but drinks they serves are marvellous. Cocktails, beers, even juices are great. Had a very lovely time as it was really relaxing, and fun.

Author: bcampbell2015
Title: So-so
Review: The food was average with limited choices on the menu. Good vegetarian options but my meal lacked flavour. The tom yam soup was very disappointing. The live music was too loud to carry on a conversation at our table.

Author: charlottei2015
Title: Good for a drink on a hot day
Review: Good cocktails. Cold beer. A wide arrange of food (nothing spectacular but yum). A nice escape from crowds on Jonker St, to sit under fans and watch everyone go by. Staff are pretty good.

Author: Caroline T
Title: OK for a drink or two
Review: We had a drink as a pit stop from shopping. The usual cafe style setting and menu. We had kids with us and they were quite tolerant, leaving us alone. Good location to just rest and recharge and people watch.

Author: 447iwi
Title: Average
Review:
We ordered the Ramen, Satay, Spring Roll and Salad.

Nothing to crow about. All tasted very average.

The satay sauce is a disappointment.

It looks like the sauces or broth all taste similar. They all tasted somewhat  tangy. 

The cucumber juice is bitter.

Author: happyjiin
Title: Great place to chill
Review:
Like the live music there and the ambient. Crowded at night, good service. 
Cool place to chill, have dinner and drinks with friends, family or even alone.

Author: BakesieLas Vegas, Nevada
Title: High expectations
Review: We came here based on the great reviews. The food was good but nothing we would return to. The employees were very nice and the service was good. We had the lemon fish, sour plum drink, Geographer salad and creamy tomato soup. Maybe we ordered the wrong things?Show less

Author: AxelledodemanSweden
Title: Nice spot for a cold drink
Review: In the middle of the city this bar is a cool place to have a drink during the day or at night. It is mostly for tourist, it is a bit more expensive than other place but it is relax and the live music is good. Show less

Author: MezzapazzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good vibes, mediocre food
Review: The cafe has good vibes and crowd but it is a place for drinks more than food.The food is mediocre, was not impressed with the flavours or selection. We had expected a wider selection of local food and for the food to pack a punch with the good reviews we've heard. Tourists formed the maid crowd. The cafe is a nice place to hang out for drinks and listening to a live band at night and it is very crowded in the night time.Show less

Author: VTik
Title: Nice chill out place but overpriced compared to the surrounding offerings
Review:
Had a late evening dinner here. 

Pro:
Nice ambiance. Good chill out place
Good spread for vegetarians

Con:
Pricy for the quality (& quantity) of the food served
Not really attentive staff
Mosquito!  Arrggghhh!

Author: Silent88
