Title: My Experience In Geographer Cafe, Malacca
Review: Nice restaurant for dining and beer session after work or during leisure times.Maintain old building structure with unique decorations. Strongly recommended restaurant if you  are around Jonker Street, Malacca!

Author: Fpchong
Title: One good tourist attraction in Jonker Street
Review: Good place to hang out (better than HRC@Melaka) if you are going to Melaka.  But will be over crowded with tourist during the weekend.

Author: zqgoh001Singapore
Title: Good place to hang out with friends
Review: One of the shooting scene for Chinese movie - Summer Holiday 2000 (summer mo mo cha) was done here. If you go up to level 2, you will be able to see the pictures hanging on the wall. I think is a good place to hang out with friends, listen to live music and drink mojito :) note that we are allow to bring in outside food. Show less

Author: YenLeanne
Title: good service!
Review: Nice environment and good service.The food also very tasty and delicious.Each part of geographer cafe have its story.

Author: Orange_le_VoyageurPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere, nice food
Review: The atmosphere was superb, it has a slight retro feel to it, and a great place for some drinks at night, filled with people. The food there was good too, suitable for some chilling time when you need a rest or a place to meet new friends.Show less

Author: Alvinppy
Title: Sunday Breakfast is of OK standard
Review: Had a chance to visit the place on Sunday morning after visiting the Sunday Flea market nearby. Disappointed with the quality of the food although the service was good.

Author: 841krisbBrisbane, Australia
Title: Great location
Review: The staff were very friendly and the menu had well priced authentic food. We also managed to score free novelty mugs with our beer. The food arrived quickly and was nice. The staff were very grateful when receiving tips, so make sure you're generous if they give you good service. A little bit for you is a lot for them!Show less

Author: Fred C
Title: Overpriced, poor service
Review: My wife and i just stopped in for a drink. Not busy at all and i can see why. Service is slow. Drinks overpriced. My wife's bloody mary was laden w/salt on the rim (never seen that before) and was one of the worst ever. Go to bistro 1673 for cheaper happy hour and better service.Show less

Author: DolphaniaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mixed Feelings
Review: `Cafe looks nice and cozy. We decided to stop for a drink while walking around jonkers walk on Friday Night. Drinks and snacks were served...and then moments later the bill was shoved in our faces...which suprised us as we felt they were chasing us away. When questioned why the bill is presented when we did not request for it...we were simply informed that "we do it this way during weekends". I take it that there has been cases where patrons just run away without paying their bills, but a little politeness and courtesy would be great. Inform the patrons nicely that payment will be required once the food/drinks is served. Not all of us are criminals and cheaters so please dont treat all of us that way.Show less

Author: HayuningT
Title: Coffee shop
Review:
Good place...good food..good coffee
Unique decoration and cozy place...realy enjoyed our break time at Geographer Cafe.
Spring rolls, coffee and fried tofu was delicious

Author: Lizkeith68
Title: Ok for a quick drink
Review: Stopped by on our way to Jonker street market, there was live music and a buzz to the place, prices about average for the area, didn't really give us a reason to return.

Author: lynbirch
Title: A great bar with heaps of atmosphere
Review: Get there early for dinner as it was so busy when we were there we just opted for a couple of pre-dinner drinks.  Fantastic location in Jonker Street, feels like you could be in New Orleans.  Well worth a visit.

Author: 889lisai
Title: Cocktails and food
Review: Superb organic food with lots of vegetarian options.  The restaurant is at the back and the front is open onto jonker street where you can listen to the live music whilst watching the world go by.  Food was very good value for the quality

Author: BombaxFlower
Title: Seems like a Bar, but its a great restaurant
Review: Fabulous soups and great tofu dishes to suit my vegetarian daughter, but a great range of choices also accommodated the carnivores in the family. The bar faces the street, but inside its a very pleasant/charming restaurant.

Author: Heather44
Title: Air con
Review: The food was fine, the best bit was that it was easy to find and had the air con I so needed and that particular time. The staff were also very helpful. Pleasant place to sit and relax in the busy Jonker St area.

Author: JoyFirstColorado Springs, Colorado
Title: SUCKS -WILL NEVER COME AGAIN
Review: Food taste lousy. We ordered rice curry, no meat. Spaghetti Napolitan taste odd, rojak will grade 2 out of 5. Service, the girl who attend to us was helpful and deligent . The men are lazy, and reluctant; Manager included. Safe your money and choose other place who appreciate your visit!Show less

Author: ditchnapper
Title: Great combination bar and resto, hang out on the corner
Review: This sits on the corner that forms the center of old Melaka, and offers variety of good food, and great cocktails.  You can sit on the veranda and watch all the travelers  pass, or inside in the AC.  Good atmosphere and service.

Author: SakthiJane
Title: Nice place to chill after long walk...
Review: Really nice to sit here in the noon after a long walk at Jonker Street... take a break if you can... price is also reasonable... havent trief the food though...

Author: AussieMan84
Title: Grwst vibe and live music
Review: We stumbled across this by accident but a good place to eat and drink . Listen to dome live music was great

Author: 577priss
Title: Overrated!
Review:
It seems like any other cafe located along the Jonker walk. Their menu seems to be quite on the pricy end however it seems to be on the must visit place in Malacca. 
At time's you might probably have to ask to be attended too.

Author: Deep8611
Title: Nice place
Review: Chill concept and open air. A lot of people chill here. No smoking policy thou but its still nice. Relax back after a tired shopping at jonker street

Author: Beejay1948
Title: Style over substance
Review: I was recommended to visit the Geographer Cafe however, I was a bit disappointed. The staff were friendly enough but kind of disinterested. It was dearer than other cafes I visited during my stay in Melaka. It was OK but not outstanding.

Author: 205loucCorby, United Kingdom
Title: a decent place
Review: We visited at 3pm so it was all quiet and full of people on laptops drinking coffee. We had some chicken bites and fries, veggie curry and a chicken with cashew. All good. It wasn't enough to bring us back again fir another meal or beer with so many other places to visit, but it's worth a visit. When we passed by at night it looked a lively place to visit. Show less

Author: GH803
Title: Attractive from the outside, disappointed inside
Review: Nice staff, good atmosphere but food clearly below average. Tasteless sagas, plain fried rice and overlooked eggs. Pass...

Author: Catherinetas
Title: Good spot for people watching
Review: Relaxed boozy feel, corner location makes for good people watching. Menu covers most dietary preferences, meals are filling but not particularly exciting. We dined here early evening on a Tuesday and a Wednesday when everything nearby had already closed.

Author: eunice c
Title: Nice place to rest & relax but could do better.
Review: Was there with a few friends for some drinks after dinner. we loved the idea of sitting on a high chair sipping beers but absolutely hated the leaking that's happening above us. While we understand the need for water mist fans in this hot and humid weather in Melaka but i think they need to ensure that water does not leak out from their pipes. It's not a pleasant sight or experience for customers. Other than that, good service and reasonably priced beers.Show less

Author: Shankar S
Title: Good restaurant with Vegetation food
Review: Awesome restaurant with good vegetation food. You would not be disappointed. The only thing methionine is the service is not that great. The servers seem to just hang around without making eye contact and checking if anything is needed. Just call them as and when you need anything. No disappointments. Show less

Author: Kat537Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Poor food, not too clean
Review: We ended up eating here as there were very few restaurants open on Jonker Street on a week night.I was decidedly underwhelmed with the dish I had, which was gloopy and tasteless, though my friend enjoyed her satay.The place wasn't too clean, with dirty menus, dripping air con and toilets I decided to give a miss. Show less

Author: Simon M
Title: Jonker Street walk
Review: Visited at the weekend and stopped here for a rest and a cocktail. Was tempted by their coconut Tom Yam soup which was excellent and came served in a coconut shell, their Margarita was also very good. The building is located on a busy corner off Jonker St and has an interesting and eclectic mix of decoration. Service was excellent and fare not expensive. Ask for Wi Fi code.Show less

Author: Patrick H
Title: Looks inviting, but bad food.
Review: Quite cheap beer, but food is really substandard. Worst chicken satay I've ever eaten. Staff are friendly though.

Author: ErsatzExpatLondon
Title: One of our favourite places to eat in Malaysia
Review: Friendly staff and an excellent menu at reasonable prices in a beautifully restored and atmospheric building. The only downside is the live music so make sure to visit when the artists are not playing (unless, of course, you like live music in which case it would be right up your street). Show less

Author: Ganesh S
Title: Awful filthy over priced street cafe.
Review:
Awful food and over priced.
The restaurant is filthy and stay away from the disgusting shocking toilets.
The menu folders are filthy and torn.
It used to be a great spot years ago but no longer.
Head to Dataran Phalawan Mall for meals.

Author: mstracytSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Hype of the Street
Review: The food was good. The service a little slow and inattentive, but of course there are many tables for them to wait - lack of well trained staffs.Hype of the street. The live band was not so good though, the opposite bar has a better live band going on.Overall, great place to chill for a beer and enjoy the environment.They have passcode for the toilet. For safety I guess. Find that really considerate for ladies but troublesome because in that hectic environment you got to find a waiter to ask for the passcode.Show less

Author: Suzy S
Title: Nice cafe
Review: Nice cafe although a bit touristy and more expensive than a number of other local restaurants   Food was quite good and the service was excellent

Author: Alantanhm
Title: Recommended by Trip Advisor
Review:
Cafe with Good ambient and up to trend decorations.
Good meeting place with friends for drinking.
Certain foods in the menu is similar with Veggie Planet.
Sound system need to improve. 
Staff's customer service need to improve.
Good location. Except parking place is very limited.

Author: chemapch
Title: Nice place great food
Review:
Amazing curries in a wonderful environment.
Import and local beers.
Live music at night.
Very nice people as well.
Chema Peña

Author: JasoncpsPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Poor from every aspect
Review: We order 2 mains, 2 drinks and 1 appetizer.The service men decided that he would memorize them, I guess it was protocol?He did not repeat our order and thus he forgot our main course.Beer served with the cap still on and it was warm. Food was tasteless, very much below expectation.Show less

Author: cprsjo
Title: Weak cocktail
Review: Ordered the 2 special cocktail🍸 on their menu. It was weak and not as good as what we expect. service was average and looks like they're ynderstaffed..

Author: LTym
Title: Chilling
Review: A place to sit and relaxing after a tiring walk around jonker street . Live performance during night time .Food is just ok .

Author: Samuel CIskandar Puteri, Malaysia
Title: Great place to hang out
Review: The Geographer Cafe has a reputation for being a great place to hang out and it lives up to that reputation. It has a very chilled atmosphere, with a great location on a corner of Jonker Street. Live music varies in quality, often from neighbouring cafes and bars, but is usually an interesting dated mix (which seems all to come from a common Malacca play list).The food is tasty, if not always the highest quality, and the variety is good, if not excellent. Worth a visit, enjoyable, but not somewhere I am going to rave about.Show less

Author: annettenboDoncaster, England, United Kingdom
Title: Afternoon break from the sun
Review: A nice bar and well positioned on the corner of Jonkers perfect setting to sit in the shade and watch the world go by on a sunny afternoon or busy weekend evening. Straight across from Ringos Classic Cafe so you can have a mini pub crawl and enjoy the Live music in both premises - which is timed so they do not compete with each other. The only down side to this venue for me was sadly the toilet which has a coded lock so only customers can use the facility - unfortunately it was very dirty an untidy I could understand this if it was late on a busy weekend night but it was only midday.Show less

Author: VvdBergUtrecht Province, The Netherlands
Title: alright
Review: Me and my friend were there last weekend. We had the feeling that the waiter was never looking our way even when we tried to get attention. So we had to wait a long time before someone came by to take our order. Also it took quite a while before we had our lunch, although it wasn't that full in the restaurant.The food was good.Show less

Author: ViVi MCanberra, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere and sour plum juice
Review: This is a great place for a bit of the more sophisticated type of dining. It is the best place for sour plum juice, so cold and soooo refreshing! It is right in the middle of the weekend market action. There is often very good entertainment there as well.Show less

Author: geelongexpat
Title: Great Food
Review: This was pretty much the only restaurant in the tourist part of Melaka that was busy on Wednesday night. Deservedly so as the food here is splendid and the service here was brisk and friendly. I'm so glad I popped in here to eat.

Author: Flamingofly
Title: Fantastic Asian vegetarian food
Review: Just THE most tasty Asian food - does western food too, but not so good. The Asian vegetarian food is the best around. Lovely atmosphere and fabulous staff.

Author: SmillaRyde
Title: Not to be missed!
Review: During our weekend visit we ended up eating at Geographer's 3 times - that's how good this place is. Being a vegetarian I was so pleased with all the choices I had.

Author: DIYtravel1
Title: Classic expat cafe
Review: With the expat prices come expat service, standards & music. Great atmosphere & mix of locals & expats. A green & leafy oasis from the humidity & hustle of Jonker Street.

Author: CinciMythSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent hangout to "people watch" during night market
Review: We discovered this bar during our first visit to Jonker's Night Market on a Saturday. What caught our eye, to be honest, was the second storey of the cafe. The main floor was already full with tables spilling into the street but when we went up, it was empty. My family immediately took over the tables beside the window and began to "people watch". We ordered Guinness on tap and it came properly chilled. We ordered mostly Thai food (Tom Yum soup, mango thai chicken, satay) but also tried their Jonker rice and spicy potato wedges. The adults ranked the Tom Yum soup best while the children preferred the spicy potato wedges. The service was attentive and prompt despite the very busy downstairs. We would definitely go back to Geographer Cafe for the ambience and the food. An excellent place to enjoy the Night Market especially if it is your first time!Show less

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: The chinese words inscribed on the cafe's pillar reads: Geography student
Review: As a disclaimer, i did not patronise this place as i found it as i was about to leave Melaka- but am still leaving it a review because of how nice and friendly the staff were when i was asking for directions early this morning. Geography cafe is an interesting concept. It is a cafe and bistro that also serves drinks at night. The ventilation of this place is wonderful as there are fans that spray water out of them. I walked past here late at night. The price is fine for a bar/cafe. It would make a good place to have a drink or two on a weekday, when Jonker street is quiet and lifeless at night. I haven't found the link between geography and this eatery after a glimpse at the menu, though. Maybe i haven't looked hard enough. You would have to sit in and experience the place yourself!Show less

Author: lynnlyn09
Title: Nice
Review: Nice place to chill. Food can be better. Worth trying out thou. U will see many people chilling at night

Author: sterretjeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great hangout spot!
Review: We've been here twice on 2 trips and the standard of food and atmosphere here has remained the same.Really chill place to relax and end the day with some nice dinner and beers. Although music can be abit loud, always still possible to chill and speak abit.we've tried couple of dishes and they always never fail to disappoint. fried rice is simple but delish! Satay is yummy, thai chicken/ lime fish and cashew nut chicken dish was good! Will recommend this cafe as an end of day stop. :)Show less

Author: HerrSuman
Title: Nice break in mid of Jonker's Street
Review:
Visited this place for drink and light dinner ... Food was ok .. And drinks were modestly price .. Live music was good ... 

But it closed earlier than other places

Author: joeyting82
Title: Good place to sit back and relax
Review: A strategic place for visitors to have a sit & sip of drinks after long walk on the streets. They offer varieties of drinks and liquors. The foods also many variety. But the service a bit slow.

Author: apwithaneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great veggie menu!
Review: Here's an interesting fact... Veggie Planet and Geographer's Cafe are owned by the same company or person... They're both the top places for a vegetarian to eat in Malacca. The menus are very similar right almost identical down to the pictures. Veggie Plant however doesn't serve alcohol and has no meat. The food in both places is very good, probably one of our best meals in Malacca. Definitely worth a visit, especially if you're vegetarian. The best part of both locations is the SERVICE. They're so nice and polite. Highly recommended from that aspect. You can try most of the traditional Malacca cuisine in a vegetarian format at the one location. Show less

Author: SHCollinsLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Consistent affordable quality
Review: It's actually (in our opinion) relatively difficult to find somewhere in Meleka that combines consistency with an affordable price, such is the impact of the UNESCO status on inflating prices at average places. However Geographers was consistent and affordable. It was authentic, serving a good selection of Malay dishes, but they were well presented and made with good ingredients. We visited on a weekday late afternoon, when it was relatively quiet. I think it is more of a bar on weekend evenings, so bear that in mind, but it was pleasant at 5pm on a Thursday.Show less

Author: JohanaRosli
Title: This is the place you should hangout at
Review: There are quite a few drinking place but I guess everyone prefers to drink here. It offers great beers and cocktails

Author: Кристина КSofia
Title: Love it
Review: Loved the atmosphere and the food. We stopped for a quick bite in the afternoon and then came for proper dinner and cocktails. Some nights they also have live music. The food is very good and also the staff makes the visit a really pleasant one.Show less

Author: Angelo1975
Title: People watching
Review: Nice spot on the corner of Jonkerstreet and Jalan Hang Lekir. Perfect spot for people watching and a quick bite to eat. Food is okay. Good place for drinks. If you're looking for good locale fare, look elsewhere.

Author: meimei16Brisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent Food but Loud
Review: If you're visiting Melaka / Melaca, this cafe is a must! Although they do a wide variety of food, the food is superb. The music is sometimes very loud so just ask to turn it down. Great for adults, tourists with family and young children or just friends. It is situated on Jonker Walk and easily accessible. Excellent quality of food and such a huge range of drinks. Show less

Author: Wally SGalle, Sri Lanka
Title: G & T anyone?
Review: This is where the tourists hang out; an afternoon - evening bar that is better known for it's alcoholic beverages than anything else on the menu. As there are so few places to get a wide range of drinks, this is a 'must have place in the Old TownShow less

Author: Charmaine W
Title: Great Hanging Out Place =)
Review: Bumped into this place in the middle of Jonker's Street. I was here during Friday night, it was a huge crowd due to the night market along the Jonker's Street and there's come the good food and drinks and even music. =) There was an indonesian jazz & soul band playing at the time. The price of the alcohol is slightly higher but still acceptable despite that it is located in the tourist attraction hot spot. Overall, it is a must place to chill and relax with your friends or lovers. =)Show less

Author: Stefan W
Title: Classic
Review: Good place for just hanging out and meeting new people. Sometimes God live music. Travelers, couples and some curious locals.

Author: edyfarhanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great crowd with 'Live Band' at its best !
Review: I wanted to come to this place for a very long time since it is smack in the middle of Jonker's Street. The crowd the groove of people came for entertainment in this area is electric since its one of the best places in Malacca town that actually has everything from good food to drinks and music. There was an indonesian jazz & soul band playing at the time. The staff was helpful however our food order was a little late due to miscommunication but it was fixed right after. Overall, a must place to chill and relax to your best fav songs.Show less

Author: Mei G
Title: pricy n not worth it
Review: Nasi lemak here is not the traditional Malaysia style, rice not nice n wierd taste of sambal, watermelon price rm10,a bit pricy

Author: Jian Chen T
Title: Normal
Review: The best place for everyone to stay during the hot sun afternoon,like seriously..However, the foods are ordinary and somehow not tasty for my opinion. The beers and cocktails are worth to order.

Author: UKsam101
Title: Good value and good music
Review:
Drinks are responsibly priced and enjoyed listening to live music. There was a young girl playing the guitar and singing on Friday evening, she was really good. 
Didn't try the food but the menu looked good.
Nice bar and definitely worth a visit.

Author: teapot106
Title: Nice place to escape the heat
Review: Nice resturant.  A welcome relief from the heat, I had Nasi Lemak which was really nice. The staff were friendly.

Author: 750michelp
Title: Very nice
Review:
Great place. Service is quick an good. On the menu is western an eastern food. We are there 2 times. Both times the food was great.

Would eat there again without hesitation.

Author: Darren_C_Thomas
Title: Great place to eat for a family
Review: The Geographer's Cafe is located on historic Jonker Street and offers diners a mix of cuisines. It has a very relaxed feel, is quite good value and offers meals for children

Author: TheRealAlvinLim
Title: Chill here!
Review: Is a must to just order a leffe brune, sit down, relax! Just look at the crowd outside the bar..and laugh. Hahahahaaha. Always have had a good time killing time at This place.

Author: Mazza281
Title: Only just
Review: Fairly ordinary meal.  We had eaten there 12 months ago and enjoyed.  Sate very dry.  Trouble finding the vegetables in my veg curry

Author: yunaldoc
Title: Hang out but not for taste goers
Review: Atmosphere is not bad for a hang out. Food wise was pretty average. Ordered fresh coconut juice but it was not cold. Fried rice was warm, not served hot. Good wifi strength. Price is decent.

Author: Bengikoksaloglu
Title: Good quality fresh food
Review: Very nice place, good decoration, good quality fresh food, staff is very friendly. We enjoyed being there, just off jonker street , great location to watch walking by people too. I recomend.

Author: spud1001
Title: great spot to watch the world go by
Review: Good place to hang out and watch the world go by, cold beers and pleasant food. Good music on a couple of occasions we were there

Author: ausietraveller2015
Title: Nice cold Beer
Review: Great place to call into day or night for a nice cold drink, gets very busy.  Food is quite good, especailly the rice paper rolls.  Has interesting artwork and rememberilia on the the walls, sfaff good.

Author: verdas2015
Title: Dessert were very tasty!
Review:
We only ate a dessert here but wow the desserts were great. We had the chocolate banana pie and the Melaka ice cream special. Both very tasty. 

The menu looked very good. The service was good. It was a bit warm inside..

Author: angel_anne78
Title: Interesting place indeed
Review: Really like the ambiance and the apple pie I had was really good. Apart from that, it's strategic location makes it the perfect place to hide away from the blazing Melaka sun.

Author: N_K112Asia
Title: Love the menu, poor bathroom hygiene.
Review: I went there on my first day of the trip for a coffee break. I had a slice of chocolate banana cake and a cup of cappuccino. The price wasn't too bad. I went back at night on the same day for dinner and I had a pesto pasta which is very simple and tasty. While I was having dinner, I saw a mice came from outside of the restaurant. The area is quite congested and it is possible that the mice came from other restaurants.Tasty food but poor toilet hygiene.Show less

Author: Gerald CTexas
Title: A great place to relax.
Review: On a recent trip to Melaka we used this cafe as a link-up point. On weekdays there are plenty of seats available. In the early afternoon I had an excellent cup of coffee. Then, later in the day after walking through the streets I went back before the meeting time and drank a couple of ice cold beers. The fans provide a breeze and it was very comfortable despite the hot, humid conditions of the day. Also, it is a great place to people watch. My only issue was getting prompt service. I had to track the waitress down each time I wanted her (she was very friendly when she came to the table).Show less

Author: Emma MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wouldn't Come Here Again
Review: Before coming to Malacca, I checked out online for places to eat and Malacca is quite well known for good food. Many websites recommended this place for me to go and I did but was utterly disappointed with my meal. And I was not the only one. Both my traveling companion were disappointed too. The meals were bland and the portion didn't seem to match the price. At least the staff were nice and the ambiance was lovely.Show less

Author: docr99
Title: Nice place to hang out
Review: Go on weekends. Happening place with live music. Little crowded but very good food & drinks. Lot of choice if you are vegetarian. You have choice to sit inside or in shade or even in open.

Author: AustraLa
Title: Nice spot!
Review: I had a nicely prepared margarita and the food was ok, but the atmosphere was great! We were sitting upstairs, overlooking the night market, and it just felt right.

Author: johannc385
Title: Terrible food!
Review:
It looks nice from outside, it is well located but the food is terrible, if you want to eat something nice it is a definite NoGo!
Perhaps coffee or a beer would do

Author: Finlay9411Sydney, Australia
Title: Quick drink, friendly, good music
Review: Dropped in here on our way back from dinner to the hotel with our 2 young children. Well-located in the action on Jonkers Street. A mixture of outdoor and open indoor seating with views out over the street Friendly service with a nice band playing. All good.Show less

Author: rynnintransit
Title: Erm
Review: Yeah. Average food and my god, crappy, affected, lousy music. Come if you don't value your ears and aren't actually interested in immersing yourself in the local culture. This caters absolutely to tourists in fisherman pants and matted hair.

Author: spatel1895
Title: Great food, good music and excellent service.
Review: Complete satisfaction so we kept going back again and again! The service was a treat as they even helped recharge our phones. Their prices are reasonable and really good food.

Author: UbudNomadMijas, Spain
Title: Feels like the place to be.
Review: On busy Jonker Street, which is mostly Chinese this western style restaurant and bar has a distinctly colonial feel. It is a nicely restored old building and feels authentic. But the food is a little over priced, given there are cheap and good Chinese restaurants nearby. However for range of drinks and cocktails this is the place.Show less

Author: KazuhikoAlex
Title: Simple but yet comfortable ambiance with slightly pricey foods and drinks
Review: It was located right center in the jonker street, their drinks and food are average, nothing much about it, geographer was more on chilling out with friends and family to have a drink where you could enjoy their live band too.

Author: jreuringsGroningen, The Netherlands
Title: Nice terrace, pricey average food
Review: Geographers is right in the tourist centre and a nice spot on the corner to sit and relaxThe drinks and food are expensive but not better than averageThe wifi was not working but thats only a minor detailThe live music sounded more like an audition of Malaysia got TalentBut I am afraid she is not going to the 2nd roundSo nice to relax and have drinkFor good food go somewhere elseNBWhy focus on smoking free Chinatown, make it carfree first!!Show less

Author: toto29940
Title: Having a drink
Review: Worse cocktails I have ever been drinking in my life. First time I can't even drink a tenth of my cocktail. Really horrible ! Don't go there

Author: Elif P
Title: Average fodd, nice ambiance
Review: Food is adapted to western taste. We loved the ambiance. People chatting, laughing and having fun. Nice location.

Author: FrennieB
Title: Best Coconut Milk Tom Yam ever
Review: The Coconut Milk Tom Yam is a must try when you visit this cafe. It is sour yet spicy with the aroma of coconut milk mixed together in the soup. Excellent!

Author: Veronica M
Title: Average food and average service
Review: After reading great reviews we decided to try this place for lunch. The food has nothing special, flavorless and not that fresh. The only good point is the great location where're you can look at the street activities

Author: jonathan H
Title: Great in the day, even better at night
Review: Great food and drinks a great colonial decor restaurant. Get there early in the evenings as it fills up fast. Live music was great.

Author: ElenaCassandra
Title: Shocking
Review: Staff were helpful but that's the only good thing about this place.Food and drinks were awful. Having spent previous days in Ipoh and eating food cooked in small food stalls, we were appalled to discover that on actually going to a café/restaurant and not eating on the streets was even worse. We waited ages to be served. When food arrived, it lacked flavour and lack of ingredients. Even the chips were bad! Drinks were poor too. Iced coffee was average, tasted better throughout Ipoh. An hour after eating, we experienced bad stomach aches and later on during the night experienced diarrhoea and vomiting. So in recommending to others, I wouldn't. The place might look good and if you're going for a drink, you can sit and watch and take in Jonker Street but please whatever you do - do NOT eat there!Show less

Author: kiml558
Title: Nice place for drinks
Review: Stopped by on a weekday afternoon. It's a cool place to rest your feet and have some drinks and food. I had the satay but it was not spectacularly memorable, meat was a little dry. This place is a little pricey though.

Author: JulianF584
Title: Nice location to stop and chill, but...
Review: It's located smack in jonker street and is probably the only pub and café around that location (unless you want to walk 10-15mins down the road to hard rock)To be honest it's just another cafe/bar but the good thing is the area is smoking free so it's a nice place to chill and let your feet get some restIn the evenings there is a band for further chilling mood...Apart from that, and your feet will.let you, no need to stop cos its nothing special....Show less

Author: BulutruzgarIstanbul, Turkey
Title: Good music but avoid the greasy food.
Review: I went there with a friend of mine to have dinner, the food that we ordered was both greasy so we didn't eat it. The waiter didnt even bother to ask whether there was something wrong with it or not. Yet the live music was good.Show less

Author: e78n11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Entertaining
Review: The place is a biggest chill out pub, cafe, restaurant into 1 along jonker walk. Selection of drink and food was good. Can try out the local food as well. During the day is pretty hot to sit around since Melaka is known to have hot weather. When night fall the place transfer to a mini pub with live music sang by the musicians. Pretty entertaining to chill and sit around listening to music and people watching after walking around jonker street. Is a worth try :)Show less

Author: SantawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Classical and relaxing
Review: A nice place to unwind and relax after a long hard day. All sorts of beer available here. Try the chicken wings, delicious. On some evenings, they even have a solo band playing and crooning great oldies to guest.Parking here is a problem. Although lots are available, it's never enough. Advise to park further down and walk all the way in. Easy to find. Just walk along Jonker Street and you'll be able to see it. Big signboard.Show less

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good place to cool down
Review: It's a great place to cool yourself down after a hot walk in Jonker Walk, get some beer and enjoy the atmosphere. A bit cramp but still manageable. Food taste was just average, the satay was dried unfortunately and sauce lack of taste. Just go for drinks.Show less

Author: CassnuGold Coast, Australia
Title: Nice place to stop for a drink, but don't expect food anytime soon
Review: We stopped for a drink after walking around the market and were intending to have dinner. However, there were only two staff and full tables and we were told food would take at least an hour - no way. We gave up on that idea and just enjoyed our drinks and the atmosphere.Show less

Author: SBandSB
Title: Great stop on a hot day
Review: Called in 2 days in a row to cool down and get a drink and bite to eat.  Staff pleasant and food nice.  Nice to sit under spray mist and fan on a hot humid day.

Author: Hightea9
Title: Lovely atmosphere
Review: Great location on the corner where you can watch the world go by along Jonker Walk. The chicken satay is good as are the rice paper rolls. All washed down with a refreshing Geographer non alcoholic similarly named cocktail.

Author: theotheone
Title: Chilling place
Review: Is not difficult to look for this place -old yellow corner building- and is good to chill at this place especially at night where I can take a few pint of beer while enjoying the great music there, very relaxing place.

Author: AileenleeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not that great food
Review: Went there for lunch. The staff was not observant and we found our own tables and had to call the staff to give us menus. Service was slow as the staffs were busy and running around. The food was slightly on a higher price (for a local) and the quality was not there. The food had a reasonable portion. I tried the curry ramen which lacks the oomph I was looking for. They actually just put in the normal 'yellow noodles' and called it ramen. It was very ordinary and seems to be lacking something in my opinion. It is quite tasteless and is neither spicy or thick or delicious.I also tried the Jonker fried rice which is very normal. The fried rice had an overall better taste than the curry noodle.It had an egg on the rice and came with 2 sticks of satay and a blop of salad. Satay and salad was okay tasting. Nothing great nothing bad. The ambience is ok, it can get quite hot if you sit outside in the afternoon even though they have many fans running. I had the asam juice drink (green color) which is very expensive than the normal ones you can get by the street, The size of the juice was surprisingly big. I also tried the Melacca local coffee which is nothing to brag about. Just the normal black coffee. Overall, the food was just okay with nothing to brag about. Maybe the drinks might fare better, however I did not order any alcoholic drinks to try there.Show less

Author: PrijacBrussels, Belgium
Title: good place
Review: this cafe is located at the heart of Jonker Street. It is just at the perfect place where you wanna wait for your friends or to rest your tired legs. I dont usually dine here, I do more drinking here. Drinking while looking at the crowds gives me a very special feeling and emotion. I like the live music and, of course, the atmosphere!! **THUMBS UP**Show less

Author: Sandy_Gates
Title: nice ambience and crowd to go with
Review:
right at the street,where u can park urself for some grub and drinks.
Attentive but super busy waiters. Vegetarian options available on the menu.
Try the Budaborg Ginger beer.Liked it.I don't get that at many places in Malaysia.

Author: khaosk9Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: The night life of Jonker Street.
Review: This lovely little bar is just the place to go for night life. The Geographer Cafe are located in the Jonker Street. Been hanging out here every night when I was holidaying in Jonker street. Everything are good in here, people, drinks, foods,services...I love Jonker street so much. If you like the live band, I recommend to sit at those tables that are beside the windows. The live band are also performing for the opposite cafe. They will shuffle between two cafes and perform for 30 minutes. If you take the seats near to the window or outdoor, you can still watch the live band even they have moved to the opposite cafe or just wait for their return in 30 mins either. :)Show less

Author: Gary_TLCChatswood, Australia
Title: Trendy Cafe with Very Ordinary food
Review: By Brother in law described this as a must visit place in Maleka. Yes the place is great for a drink and listen to live music, however the Chicken sate we ordered was described by all as the worst they had ever experienced, with comments like how could they get something so simple so wrong. It was so bad nothing else was ordered and we decided to leave. Show less

Author: celiagle
Title: Great drinking place
Review: Visited Geographer Cafe at night during the night market. It's very happening and there is live band in the cafe. The place is full with people gathering. Nice place to have a drink and relax after a tiring day.

Author: AnkitSetya
Title: Great food location and live Band
Review: We visiited this place twice and has amazing food , location , crowd and great live band.Located on Jonker street. This place was the only one which was open after 9 pm and had been visited by lots of tourist even on weekday

Author: IlleG
Title: Best curry laksa ever!
Review: Great place. I enjoyed König Ludwig Weissbier, and the best curry laksa ever! This is their signature dish, and it is heavenly. Vegetarian, too, which I would not even have noticed! Also the ambience is nice, and the location - perfect!

Author: JBF_62
Title: watch the world go by.......
Review: Spent late afternoons, early evenings at The Geographer supping a sundowner while watching 'the world' go about its business.  Great staff; enjoyable menu; super location for taking in the atmosphere of old town Melaka.

Author: shirrrrly
Title: Not bad!
Review: Tried the Tom Yam Coconut of theirs and enjoyed the taste of it . Too bad it only have a small portion of vegetables in it. The mocktails are nice though. The price range are fairly affordable. Strategic and nice place to hang out.

Author: billdublinCounty Dublin, Ireland
Title: Popular but poor
Review: Some things in life can't be explained; the popularity of this restaurant is one of those things. The location is good but the food, wine by the glass and service leave a lot to be desired. The chicken and cashew nuts had a sauce more suited to a down-market Sunday roast. The poorly chosen (their choice) house white wine is served in glasses that are too small and the wine is not adequately chilled. Perhaps it was made popular by estate agents who preach - location, location, location! It might be good for a beer and an opportunity to watch the world go.Show less

Author: nomadsk
Title: Good food..
Review: Love d ambience n food here..Live music can make u sit there for hours..Good service n pick your table early on weekends..Must visit..

Author: Alex_Lim_WJ
Title: Overrated
Review: I visited this cafe due to the fact that it was on the top ten list to visit in Melaka. Staff was friendly, environment and atmosphere was good. However the food was totally overrated, normal tasting and sour coconut juice. Was pretty disappointed with the food and drink. Show less

Author: cailindeas2013Hong Kong, China
Title: Good ambience
Review: This is a popular tourist attraction and the food is adjusted accordingly. I enjoyed my meal but the portions were a bit small. My friend (male) was still hungry after eating his! The service was excellent and the waiters very friendly and smiley. The restaurant does have a nice ambience and the décor is pleasing. However I did think the music was too loud ( we sat inside).It's a nice place to chill and enjoy a glass of wine or your beverage of choice. The prices are about mid range. If you want to try authentic Mayay/Nyonya food then this is not the place to go.Show less

Author: Tony T
Title: The best bar in the plot.
Review:
Great place to eat and drink whether you fancy a beer or coffe or something more exotic.
Good atmosphere, there was live music on the evenings we went.  The service is good.

Author: Sue T
Title: A cafe with a view
Review: If you like people watching this is a must. Situated on a corner - watch the day go by. Great staff, good food and variety of drinks.  Great music - particularly jazz nights.

Author: narsclawKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Slow service & Overpriced
Review: After walking back and forth along Jonker St, looking for halal food, we finally gave up and settled for Geographer as it was the closest result we got from Google. Understood that it was the Labour day weekend and the crowd was madness but their service was super slow, staff were aplenty but they seemed to choose to look the other way, had to ask different waiters multiple times on whether the food was coming. We had waited a good 40 minutes for merely chicken wings and a plate of Aglio Olio. When we were about to give up and leave, finally the ridiculously small bowl consisting of 2 measly chicken wings, correction, it was one part chicken wing and its pair drummet was served to us. Bear in mind, this costs RM10. I was shocked and appalled. The least they could do was to indicate in the menu that was the amount of chicken that would be served for that price. Waited another 15 mins or so then the pasta was served to us. Thankfully the food tasted decent enough to curb our growing disappointment. Had to wait some more to get the bill, if we had left without paying, I'm sure no one would have noticed but we were better than that. Show less

Author: Michelle_esePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: So so
Review: Ambience is nice but for food wise, I wouldn't say there was anything impressive. It was a mix of local and western food, which, personally any other restaurant in malacca can serve that sort of dishes. Not a must-go even if it's your first time in malacca Show less

Author: Dnyan_DSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded
Review: Good place.. Great food. However it's always crowded. Staff is also good, however they got the order wrong. In all fairness, we ordered multiple times. Getting a table was a pain. They also have seating on the first floor, however they didn't open that even though the ground floor was full. Show less

Author: nikt w
Title: Pretty Good
Review: Has good enough selection of vegetarian food.Taste is there, creativity with food choice is there. Easy to find and a place to meet travellers.

Author: Tina E
Title: good food
Review: friendly staff, good food, sometimes to croweded and the jazz band is very good. makes sure you come early, otherwise it hard to get a nice seats

Author: Asian_Wanderer888München, Deutschland
Title: Great choice in Melaka
Review: I stopped at the Geographer's Cafe every day during my visit to Melaka. It is centrally located and has a great selection of food and drinks, friendly service and great staff. Tested a few vegetarian dishes like Curry Ramen and the Fragrant Rice, which were both very good. It's located along the main tourist mile, so there is a lot of traffic, both cars and pedestrians, but that actually adds to the local feeling here.Show less

Author: Devayani T
Title: A quiet nest of relaxation in the middle of bustling Jonker Street
Review: We literally stumbled upon this restaurant as we were walking up and down Jonker's Walk. Tired from the sweltering sun and bogged down by the shopping bags, we decided to take a chance with this cafe, and just loved it. The staff are extremely friendly, and the food is outstanding; and of course, great value for moneyShow less

Author: ebiniSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food
Review: I went there one morning, and I was the only customer at that time. The staff was friendly and I ordered really fast, but the food took 30 min to come. I ordered a local coffee and that wasnt great. It has good looks and reasonably chargedShow less

Author: Jonathan NKo Samui, Thailand
Title: Really good.
Review: Excellent watering hole where the drink is fairly priced and the food very tasty .Sit at a table near the street and watch the world go by and this being Melaka where the pedestrians travel faster than the motorists.Several healthy menu options and vegetarians dishes.Show less

Author: jane c
Title: Good food at Geographer Cafe
Review: A great place to eat. The coconut was delicious as was the food we all ate. The cafe has good ambience and it was a nice experience eating there although we couldnt eat in the restaurant as it was full.

Author: gpriyesh
Title: Place with great atmosphere
Review: We went here after the night shopping @ Jonker street. Place was lively with live music. Great atmosphere, good food, good service and value for money.

Author: romeom663Bristol, United Kingdom
Title: A Fun Place to be
Review: An excellent location, with a fantastic atmosphere and great live entertainment.Ok, a gourmet restaurant it's not, but the service was friendly and prompt and the food was goodMost definatly a place to meet friends, kick back, watch the world go by relax.Remember you;re in Junker Street, Melaka.Show less

Author: Sue Yuan HSingapore, Singapore
Title: Shucks, I didn't try the coffee
Review: When I saw the cafe, I didn't realise it was a popular attraction till Trip Advisor's listing. Well, it seemed like the cafe to be as it was full house. The cafe is small so it's cosy. As it was full house and I didn't have the patience to wait, I trudged on and decided to have a cold Chendol dessert instead!Show less

Author: Fizzy543
Title: Left alot to be desired
Review: While it was in the heart of the town and the outside was lovely the choice and mixture of food was not amazing. One thing that needs improving soso it is better for western tourists is to install a toilet /abday. Apart from that the atmosphere seemed good enough and with improvements will be fantastic.Show less

Author: juliemL4943APCyprus
Title: Great for beers & people watching
Review: We visited this place a couple of times during our trip both during the day and evening.There is a good selection of food and the staff are happy to bring extra chilli & soy sauce if you want a bit more spice.The bar has a good atmosphere and the staff are very friendly and helpful even when the place was packed.The young lady who was singing on the sunday afternoon was very good and added to that lazy sunday feeling.We stopped for a beer and a snack after shopping and it was very enjoyable.It may not be the cheapest place but I think it is worth the money.The food is tasty and the beers are cold so not a bad place to while away some time.Show less

Author: 794susieh
Title: Nice cold beer
Review:
Food was great - I had great. Lovely and relaxing atmosphere 
Well needed after walking about so much

Author: WanderInTandemNew York City, New York
Title: Bit pricey, but great food
Review: The price is the only downside here, as it can be a bit high. The food we had was really very good, but the beers and overall price were higher than anywhere else we ate in Melaka. 14MR for a Tiger beer vs. 9 or 10RM’s at other bars. Eating here during the Jonkers street fair is nice for people watching, live music was great too. But had we known the fair had a whole side street dedicated to food we would of done that instead. Still, no regret. Great spot!Show less

Author: Chris GLondon
Title: Great vibe
Review: Cafe/bar that's been around for yonks with a great location on Jonker's Walk. Yes it is very touristy, and yes it's a little pricey but it has a really great vibe, especially Friday and Saturday nights when they shut the road to traffic and the bar spills out onto the pavement and the live music starts.As numerous people have pointed out the food is either western, or westernised Asian. You're not going to get anything authentic, but with so many places to eat amazing food in Melaka why would you be eating here anyway? Just grab cold beer or glass of wine and chill.Show less

Author: Hannah B
Title: Mediocre
Review: Found the food to lack flavour and the juices too watery. There is an extensive menu which is good in terms of catering to various tastes, but it definitely lacked quality.

Author: Freddy_FruitbatSheffield, United Kingdom
Title: Friendly bar good food
Review: This is a reasonable bar in the heart of Jonker Street, the beer is cold and cheap-ish and the food is a mix of western fare and also some local dishes that have been adapted for tourist palates. A good bet if you don't want anything too challenging for an evening meal.Show less

Author: Rebecca S
Title: something for everyone
Review: adults loved the signature dishes and the kids loved the spaghetti - very enjoyable in a relaxed environment

Author: Lateehs5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Quaint location
Review: A cafe that is nestled in the midst of hustle & bustle of Jonker St. Nice & quiet ambience whether you visit in the day or night. Relatively good selection of beverages; alcoholic & non.. A place where you can easily while away your day. Definitely a place to return to.. Show less

Author: MartyDownunderCanberra, Australia
Title: Trendy Tourist place
Review: We Had lunch here and I was not that impressed . It seems like just another upmarket trendy tourist place, the type that the more you pay the less you get. Catering to Tourist who like Western food (even if disguised as Asian ) and hip Malays / Singaporeans who think spaghetti is so cool . It look like it could get better at night with at least some jazz to make it worth while .Would not recommend for foor as many other much less expensive alternatives.Show less

Author: gumshoe7Johannesburg, South Africa
Title: Disappointed
Review: Came here for coffee and a quick bite. We were disappointed. Neither coffee nor fruit juices were nice, and the food was by far (!) the worst we had in Malacca. Service was kind but slow.This may be a nice place for jazz night, but as a cafe or restaurant, it fell far short.Show less

Author: themysiukeni
Title: Too Young Coconut
Review:
I ordered a real coconut drink, served directly from its shell.
It's not sweet as the coconut is too young to be cut and served

Author: HongKongNoodles
Title: Very good!
Review:
Actually we went there because Geographer Cafe was the first one we found that serves sate - and it was very good!!
Background music, friendly and helpful waiters and good drinks/juices! Prices are good too. Definitely recommend this place!

Author: JoaoMenesesMachado
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: I choose this bar/restaurant to take dinner. It is in Jonker Street, amazing building and nice staff and good food.

Author: AlexvonwDoha, Qatar
Title: Good service, generic food
Review: This cafe is a very safe option if you aren't feeling very adventurous. The service is very good and the wait staff all spoke excellent English. The food was good but not spicy or particularly authentic. My kids ate pasta which made them happy. It is not particularly cheap, but as it is right on Jonker St that is to be expected.Show less

Author: KiwiinBrightonBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Good lunch
Review: We had lunch here. My wife had a tasty veggie Nasi Lemak and I had the mango Thai chicken. I did have to wait a long time for my meal and my wife had finished her meal by the time it arrived. I also tried a sour plum lime drink which was extremely tasty. We also had a tea coming to a reasonable 44 ringget. The decor was good with a lot of outside places to eat and watch the world pass by. If you found the review useful please hit helpful. Show less

Author: MalcolmA02Scotland, United Kingdom
Title: Touristy but not bad either.
Review: As others have mentioned this is a bit of a tourist hangout, but heh that's not always a bad thing. It's well located and whilst a bit pricier than other places it's still not too bad value-wise. We sampled some of the food and it's one of the few places that does one of my favourites, tempeh. We had some 'ramen' that were pretty decent and flavoursome. It has some outside seating an an AC section. The tolilets could be better. I don't have a problem that they're non-western but they could be a bit cleaner. All in all I'd say it's better than average and qualifies for 'good', just not sure if I'd say 'very good'.Show less

Author: kelvinkoh
Title: Stopover
Review: Had a stopover at the Geographer's cafe as we were walking along Jonker Street. Nice deco and very friendly staff. It was a hot afternoon and cooled down with a nice glass of gula meleka tea!

Author: 777neilBangkok, Thailand
Title: Average. Very average.
Review: A well-known cafe in this World Heritage city, the Geographer is tastefully furnished, well staffed, clean and neat. The service was great, the food, average. In this city you are spoilt for choice for food. What I liked most was the decor. Least, the Lorong soup which had an oily layer and for a vegetarian staple was a touch disappointing.Show less

Author: clairmontjeff
Title: Located in old, remodled building
Review: Nice atmosphere, service was good, food was ok, though nothing special.  Had the Jonker Fried Rice with an ice local coffee. Open for breakfast through dinner.

Author: kdsydney
Title: Great place to sit and watch the world go by.
Review: Great food, reasonably priced drinks and a relaxed atmosphere. After a long day of sight seeing it was nice to find a place to sit, have a drink and relax. We went back a number of times during our stay in Melaka.

Author: Lauren D
Title: Recommended and would definitely return!
Review: We got recommended this place from a friend, as he was completely right. you can just sit and watch the world go by whilst having a good priced drink! located on a corner with a great atmosphere. would definitely recommend to sit and relax :)

Author: Christian SMenlo Park, California
Title: Looking for really good coffee in Asia - go there!
Review: We are coffee addicts and we know what good coffee looks and tastes like. In Malacca, this was one of the greatest coffees we had (cappucchino, espresso, iced latte etc.). Ask them to give you the sugar separately, so you can add (or leave it) as you feel.Show less

Author: GRANDPAckingPhuket, Thailand
Title: I looked at ther prices and walked away
Review: For me, the Geographer typifies Jonker Walk. A rip off / tourist trap. They want MYR14 for a small bottle of beer (you can get cans for MYR8 just around the corner)... and MYR6.90 (they're MYR2 almost everywhere else) for a soft drink. In fairness they've got a nice little area at the front that opens onto Jonker Walk for those who like to watch the world go by. But, at those prices, I'll watch from somewhere else.Show less

Author: vallaboer
Title: Good food to reasonable price
Review:
We had many meals at the Geographer. Nice food, varied meny and good location.
Always a lot of people here, popularitet restaurant.

Author: emnoer
Title: Yummy foods.! Recommended
Review: I love the place, the menu, the staffs, the surroundings, the location at Jonker Walk, everything except the music is too loud. That's all. Been here for three times in a row and never get bored.

Author: TMandFJMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Perfect break, cold drinks, nice vibe
Review: We didn't try the food but we dropped by for a break and some refreshments. Their sour plum juice was perfect for that, the atmosphere pleasant, the service friendly and fast. They have a fan cooled open area as well as an air conditioned indoor area. In short; good break from a hot afternoon walk.Show less

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The standard has dropped
Review: What a difference from my last time here. Service was really, really slow and the wait staff were running around like headless chicken. We had to call them a few times before we could place our orders. We understand it was a busy time, but they only had 3 staff working which was obviously insufficient manpower, considering how busy they were. Shame, as I really liked this place.Show less

Author: CanisterGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good, fun bar in the middle of Jonker's
Review: For me, this is still one of the more entertaining spots to hang out, have a few drinks and generally while the time away right in the middle of one of the liveliest parts of town. Lack of lively options in town mean we have ended up here almost every single time during our 5+ trips to Melaka. Really comes alive after dark with some decent music and usually a packed crowd, though lunch/afternoons are still not too bad.Drinks are the mainstay and they serve the usual range for any bar worth its salt, though stick to beers & house-pours rather and don't expect much from the cocktails. Food is fairly hit and miss - the fresh veggie spring rolls are still amongst the best out there, but beyond that you should assume its a place that does decent bar food, not restaurant meals.Service is just ok - at peak hours, you have to work to get someone's attention but when you do get hold of someone, staff are generally friendly. By Melaka's low service standards, Geographer's is pretty decent.Show less

Author: tontotaylorLightwater, United Kingdom
Title: Typical Tourist Restaurant.
Review: This is your typical tourist restaurants smack bang in the middle of the tourist district. Good selection of wines, beers and spirits all at Tourist Prices. Reasonably menu serving a fair selection of both Asian and European dishes, again all at tourist prices. Live music is average, nothing offensive, but nothing outstanding. Good place to either and watch the 1000s of tourists!! Service really does need to be sharper.Show less

Author: BJLoguePerth, Australia
Title: The toilets were disgusting.
Review: This Cafe/Bar is in the heart of Jonker Street, which comes alive on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights due to the night markets. We went during the week and it still had a lot of customers. We didn't eat there and only had tiger beer (in a bucket) and it wasn't served very cold. I then had to visit the restrooms.............the two cubicles were both squat toilets, the first one (ladies) was filled with excrement, the second one (men and ladies) was completely blocked with toilet tissue, the third was men only and I didn't even look in that one, For a place that draws a crowd I would have expected more. We had been to very small bars along the canal where they had better toilet facilities and could only hold no more than 20 people. I cannot recommend this place.Show less

Author: maggief201
Title: Fun night out.
Review: We spend lots of fun nights in this cafe bar. The drink n food is reasonably price and fantastic atmosphere. Music everywhere. Fun fun fun.

Author: traveller24by7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Enjoy good food in Melaka at Geographer Cafe
Review: 3rd visit to this restaurant and it doesn't disappoint. The staff is busy yes, especially on weekends, but go for the food as Melaka is known for it. The café is not too big but has outdoor as well as indoor seating. On certain days of the week and weekends, enjoy live music by the lovely band.This is a place I will visit whenever I am in Melaka..!!Show less

Author: JoeSimcock
Title: Tasty food, nice restaurant
Review: Stumbled upon this cafe on jonker walk; ate our evening meal here. Friendly staff and clean tables. Food is a reasonable price, good taste and average portion size. Would eat here again.

Author: lemonwguitar
Title: Not my type
Review: The ambience was alright. However the food had this spice in it that i did not like. And it is rather expensive in comparison. however still very popular among tourists.

Author: SabriMarcCalgary, Canada
Title: Always busy, always good
Review: Good drinks, excellent location, good food, and very very nice service! It was the second time we stopped here to have drinks. Their drinks menu is huge and their food is eclectic. Like the Cafe' s name says, it is from all over the world. My mom ( we are Italians) ordered a pasta dish, and I was quite sceptical about it, but she said the pasta was cooked al dente and it was not bad at all. Thus, big thumbs up for this cafe'Show less

Author: briliantf
Title: Nice place to chill out
Review: Nice location, nice drinks, good place. The music was too loud, but it was fine. We like our drinks.

Author: johnofklKuala Lumpur
Title: Bad service, wont go near it, ever
Review: We were told to sit in the non air-conditioned area on a hot afternoon, even though there were plenty of seats in the air-conditioned area. The excuse was that we were a group of 5 people but the available table was for 7. The waitress had a terrible attitude too.Show less

Author: Nepali_Kancha
Title: Very expat friendly bar
Review: This is a very expat friendly bar where you can cool down after eating at the hawkers stalls before you end you day. Well prices drinks and food were plus.

Author: prutyi
Title: Nice athmosphere
Review:
We just stopped at this place and had a few beers with my husband.
The location is excellent, you can see the crowd on Jonker street. The place has a nice vibe, and the stuff was very friendly.

Author: SebastianP33Barcelona, Spain
Title: Nice bar!!!
Review: This is a very nice bar and restaurant, good service and good wifi. But very expensive for bag packers like me 16 ringgit for a small rice, and 6,90 ringgit for a coke!!!. Was too much!!!. Food it was very nice but small dishes in my opinion!!Anyway good deal if you need a good wifi !!!!Show less

Author: abizzyb
Title: Excellent
Review: Ate here twice, excellent for food, drink and everything. Very reasonably priced, good position of Jonger Street and two mins walk from Hotel Puri. Highly recommend it.

Author: Laure WCergy, France
Title: Amazing place
Review: We had such an amazing time there ! The food was delicious and cheap. The music was awesome and the people very kind. Great location too. The only downside was that we had to wait for quite a long time after we asked to pay. Would definitly go back!Show less

Author: Lana_Turianska
Title: Love it
Review: Soups were so good! xx Live music band and singing local girl made very Malaccan atmosphere. We enjoyed!

Author: Roger S
Title: Beer and curry
Review: A great little spot to have a beer, a curry and to sit and watch the Jonker Street world go by. Good value although they impose a mandatory 10% service charge.

Author: Leesa DJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Just OK
Review: we stopped here for a quick lunch. I ordered the chicken with cashews and my husband ordered the fried rice. The food was just okay, a bit bland, needed a big hit of chilli. Maybe because it's a tourist place. Wouldn't eat there again. Plus the music was too loud to speak to each other.Show less

Author: GodfreyLeeTokyo Prefecture, Japan
Title: Great spot at midnight
Review: It is good place to take a rest after you finish shopping at night market around. Beyond the Street is another cafe named Ringo, two of them served live music and thank God they are very good. The singer in Geographer Cafe that night could sing Adele song, english, chinese, malaysian songs and her voice is so great. Show less

Author: justaname10Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good place to chill out
Review: I been here many times. Recently was last Sunday. The food here are not bad,reasonable price,service also not bad. I like the musicia here, an old man whom play a good song always and humour. The atmosphere also not bad,suitable to stop awhile when you are walking along the jonker street in a hot day. various of choice of beer.Recommended!Show less

Author: HopeLui
Title: Great place to relax and hang out
Review: This is a great place to just sit down, relax and avoid the heat. You can find a variety of food and drinks here, and at night there is live music that garners a great crowd.

Author: 3KellsKimberly, Idaho
Title: so lush -- great ambience, great food!!
Review: The lush palms and shrubs surrounding the cafe makes this cafe stand out! It looks like a green oasis in the heat and humidity. It looks so cool and inviting. You want to linger in the dark interior and chill over a tall icy drink.The preserved plum & lime juice cooler was most refreshing,The fried-herbed rice was absolutely delicious. The vegetarian Tom-yam was wimpy though. It looked great served in a green coconut but you couldn't easily get to it since the opening was so small. But to suck Tom-Yam soup with a straw would be dangerous. The spiciness can cause one to choke. Thumbs up for ambience and the quality of the food! Polite servers speaks decent English. Somewhat pricey but worth it!Show less

Author: Efisko
Title: Nice place
Review: Good European music, athmosphere, nice local food, reasonable prices. You can find all kind of drinks. No smoking open area.

Author: Chinadream
Title: Loud music
Review: Went there to take shelter from the noon sun. Had coffee and music was loud. I feel like some some in phuket (you will understand what I mean).

Author: SorinBuCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: lively place
Review: Geographer Cafe seems to attract the internationals, probably over 75% of the people I have seen there looking like they were tourists or expats. A nice ambience, with live music and a happy crowd. It smells like party in the air. Prices are higher than the average of the places I have tried around, but not much higher.Show less

Author: tak90
Title: Good food and lively atmosphere
Review: Geographer cafe is on the corner of a busy street in Chinatown. There is a varied menu and the people watching is great. Service was attentive and friendly.

Author: ungkuraadKuala Lumpur, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: worst service,bad experience
Review: went to this place last week at noon.went with 16 of my family members..i guess ''US" being local have 2nd hand treatment....staffs didn't help us to seat us down....angrily pushed us away on the table issue( best part?they are not even busy!".Didn't want to take order...the best part again?the one that is rude is the foreign staff...what a joke!what we did after 20 minutes when didn't get attention...funny because we are 16 people(hard to be missed)...we LEFT!u don't want our money,we don't want your arrogance service...there's plenty of cafes around...posted in their fb and get no reply....Show less

Author: W_hy27
Title: Average
Review: Good food and atmosphere over here. Staff were attentive to us. Just the time of delivering the food was slightly slower than expected.

Author: CHRISTOPHER L
Title: One of the best Cafe in Malacca
Review: If you were to hit this cafe during the weekends, you can enjoy the ambiance and the sight of people at the same time. The food there is great as well. :) I love the atmosphere.

Author: Kuan Wah P
Title: Far too crowded to my comfort
Review: I used to walk pass GC whenever I am in Malacca, at times dropped in but I increasingly find this place to have become almost impossible to enjoy oneself. Crowded, noisy and to me - lost its original charm. Good for business, I guess.

Author: MarTravels16Redhill, United Kingdom
Title: Not a good impression
Review: All of our family of four where hungry hence we decided to try and eat and have a drink at the geographer cafe.Staff where too busy too seat anyone meaning we had to find our own table. All the tables where full so we got stuck next to a sewage drain FULL of mosquitos.We where all bitten alive before we could even get a chance to read the menu.Unfortunately we had to get up and leave as the service appeared overwhelmed by the amount of customers. Not a great start to our short weekend getaway.Be careful before deciding to settle here.Show less

Author: scbethesdaBethesda, Maryland
Title: Welcome change
Review: GC has a cool global vibe amidst the distinctly Malaccan surrounding. We went there for a quick lunch and enjoyed the cool air conditioning and eclectic mix of non alcoholic drinks - both were welcome respite for the warmth and humidity outside. We were pleasantly surprised by the food. Lots of choices both Asian and Western. We ordered mostly Asian dishes and they were delicious. The service was a bit slow but friendly. Over the relaxed lunch we enjoyed the casual ambience of the place. The Cafe has live jazz some evenings and seating upstairs that overlooks Jonker street. Should be fun to catch that if you can.Definitely worth a visit. A welcome break from the frenetic activity outside whilst still in the thick of things.Show less

Author: Wendell D
Title: Nice atmosphere for food or drinks on Jonker St
Review: This corner restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor dining. We had a pleasant dinner at an open-air table just off the street. The food was very good. Service was a bit slow, but there's not a lot that's fast-paced in this pictureque port town.

Author: JohnawardforeverParis, France
Title: Good option for the evening in melacca
Review: Well, the food is ok and prices are not too crazy, in the evening you ll appreciate the music, the area, and colonial spirit.The service is not fantastic, but the french white wine is good, and inside it is family friendly.On top, a nice band came on stage to sing some jazzy musicVegetables nems are good, and chicken mango too, satay nice also.Bean curve were not goodA mix of backpacker,family,music,drinks and nice decoShow less

Author: NeilOakshottMontreal, Canada
Title: Well positioned, with good food
Review: This is one of those western-oriented pub/bar/restaurants that every self-respecting traveller/South-East Asian city has. Eclectic surroundings, slightly backpacker/ex-pat vibe and they serve decent food, they have wine, service is quirky, hip and young and the music could always be turned down a bit more. I imagine at night it heaves with people and rightly so. At lunch there's probably always some old Ernest Hemingway type bloke looking moody and literate. There was when we were there.It's also one of the few places slap dab on the main drag in the middle of the old city where you can watch what seems to be entire population of Singapore drive their Beamers up and down all day clearly looking for non-existent parking spots.Show less

Author: VLKJSingapore, Singapore
Title: A chillax place along a chillax street
Review: After going through the night market, you probably want to have a place to chill out. This is the only street that I could have a few pubs serving drinks at 11pm. There is performance to entertain you. I like sitting around there having my drink to enjoy the night and making new friends!Show less

Author: KakashiHatake
Title: Poor service, small portions
Review: Portions small for the price. They forgot my order, and when i tried to tell one of the senior waitresses, she showed me her palm and walked away. She never came back to me even after she finished what she was doing.

Author: ReddotzSingapore
Title: the place to chill and relax
Review: Geographer has a great ambiance. It is naturally in our itinerary whenever we are in Jonker. We like to go there for a drink in the afternoon and the cold and refreshing calamansi and plum drink is always very welcoming especially if the weather is hot and humid. We prefer the second level as it is usually quieter however it is not always open.Show less

Author: petalbearBallarat, Australia
Title: Quaint little place
Review: On a recent trip to Melaka, we stumbled across this place whilst looking for another place and I'm we did. We wanted to try the local fare and this place did provide. I was very happy with my laksa which was a little different compared to the local curry laksa but very nice. We also shared a dessert at the which had Gula Melaka and essential had local food elements. I loved it so much and will definitely come back for it if I come to Melaka. The service was very good and the staff were very attentive to serving us. They were good to call us a cab at the end of our meal! All in all I enjoyed my meal there and would recommend travellers to visit.Show less

Author: Ivy Y
Title: Nice
Review: It is famous due to a movie which took their scenes there. The food is nice with slightly higher prices compared to other cafe. However, the service is good and I like the environment so much.

Author: 24AlbertonGuangzhou, China
Title: Top Place
Review: Good Food.Good Music.Fantastic Ambience.Go for BreakfastGo for LunchGo for Dinner and stay all night. Don't be afraid to try a little Latin Dance with the locals.Try to get a street side table, when the Geographer musicians take a break then Ringo at the opposite café starts playing in turn, you get great music from both sides. The beer at Ringo's is cheaper but the food at the Geographer is good.Show less

Author: Bluebirdflying2014Bangkok, Thailand
Title: good in every aspect
Review: The cafe is in a very good location, with very efficient staff there. And I have the sour plum drink every day there for the 5 days we stay in Melaka. The food there is quite nice too. I think the price there is quite reasonable, since Malaysia is expensive(that's not reasonable), you have to expect the same price as in Europe most time.It's nice to just sit there to watch the people passing by. Melaka can be the hottest destination for Malaysian people to spend their holiday, so there are a lot of people on weekends and holidays.Show less

Author: 80shabti
Title: Geographer's cafe
Review: A pretty neat cafe! We took a break here after a long walk along Jonker Street. The gula Melaka tea (iced) is to -die- for!

Author: MontanaCyclist
Title: Bad prices, bad food; good scene
Review: Eat here: never. Drink here: if someone else is buying. Meet "local" girls here: if you want to end up on a Locked Up Abroad episode explaining how you lost your savings to a Thai crime ring.

Author: Ivan SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rustic yet cosy place to watch the world go by
Review: Visited Geographer Cafe a couple of times for a drink since it is situated in a corner shop smack in the middle of Jonker Walk. After night fall, the cafe exudes a rustic ambience where one can sit, chill-out over a beer and watch the world pass-by. Time stands still for that moment in time.Show less

Author: AafiaSydney, Canada
Title: A Fun Place to Eat
Review: While eating in this pre-war shop house on Jonker Street, you can easily imagine yourself living in an earlier era. We ate at Geographer Cafe twice: lunch and dinner. In the evening, the restaurant had a great atmosphere with live music. We sat outside where we could people watch and listen to the music. We enjoyed the Tom Yam Coconut Soup in a coconut, very tasty but fairly spicy and grilled lemon fish that was excellent. For lunch, we ate inside, for a little respite from the heat. The veggie sandwich and fish and chips were okay. We also had the curried vegetables and naan that was more like a soup than anything else. The service was friendly and efficient.Show less

Author: VivienneCameronSingapore
Title: Manager refused to do anything about shaky table
Review: We had ordered two beers and were seated at the tall bar tables located outside of the bar, and minutes after ordering our drinks, the table was unstable and caused both our beers to spill. We explained to the manager about the shaky table, and even demonstrated to him how our drinks had spilt, but all he offered was his sympathy as we had already footed the bill immediately after getting our drinks. He said there was no way they could issue us new beers even though the table was indeed unstable. All he could do was fix the table and we could reorder our drinks. I guess they don't really care much if we return / if we would be recommending this place to others but just a warning for those visiting, stay away from those tall tables situated outside the cafe, they're unstable as hell and not worth a ruined night for bad service.Show less

Author: Jillian L
Title: Beer oasis
Review: Nothing really special about this place except that it is a welcome respite in the middle of sweltering jonker street

Author: A D
Title: Only had drinks
Review: this bar / restaurant  sits on a corner that is perfect for people watching while having a bucket of cold beer.  Friday, Saturday and Sunday the street fills up with hundred of venders selling everything you can imagine

Author: travelalot002Albury, Australia
Title: Great place for a meal ,cool drink or just chill out
Review: Had a great meal and plenty of cold beers waiting for a storm to pass over . We were amazed to find bundaberg ginger beer on the drinks list as we come from Australia . The meal was great and the music and atmosphere was great.Show less

Author: Broken8San Ignacio
Title: Not what we expected
Review: The geographer cafe was listed on nearly every website for Melaka we looked at. Overall,the food was pretty mediocre -- everything we had seemed to be missing something. Okay, but not great. The local vendors we went to had the same things, were way better and at a fraction of the price. Show less

Author: Katyyy21Winchester, United Kingdom
Title: Enjoyed a good lunch!
