Review: We stopped here for lunch and really liked that we were able to watch the traffic and people passing by in the street! Wasn't bothered by noise, good fans and water coolers to help in the heat and we found the staff very helpful! Drinks were a little more expensive than we are used to in Asia but we thought the food was great and worth the extra £1 or 2. We have been travelling in Asia for nearly 5 weeks and it was by the far best western food I've had in our time away - others were very sweet and nasty but this was fresh and had genuinely good flavours. Price wise I paid 12.90 RM for a pasta dish (roughly £2.35/ $3.70) which is a couple more than you may pay elsewhere but compare it to home (England) and its still great value! My boyfriend had one of the more expensive meals on the menu (15RM) and he thought it was well worth it.Basically, I think people have been a little harsh on this place review wise and I would definitely go back!!!Show less

Author: tsashi
Title: Nice place to hang out, literally
Review: Located at the busy corner of the Jonker street, this is a perfect place to catch a bottle of cold beer on hot days or a cup of hot coffee at night. Serves good selection of western and local foods. Take your time

Author: Clinton S
Title: Western foods and great ambience
Review: A place not to miss if you're in Melaka. Nice place to relax and they offer a lot of western foods. There are also local cuisine and the service are not bad. Place are a bit crowded but overall everything is great.

Author: M B
Title: Great for young people
Review: This is a great place for young people to gather. The coffee was just OK, but the music was good and it was obviously very popular. Get there early (6pm) to grab a table on Fridays and Saturdays when they have live music.

Author: Jackho1985Palmerston, Australia
Title: Nice spot for lunch or dinner
Review: I have been twice now and both times have been enjoyed. I had my first lunch and beer in Malacca here, lunch was fried rice for the first visit and today I had already had lunch else where so just had some chicken satays, both were tasty. One my first visit to the Cafe the constant nearby traffic was annoying me and there were some fumes from all the vehicles, I found myself thinking why not close this street and Jonker Street to all vehicles during peak times. Traffic was still near constant today but it did not worry me (I must have adjusted).Price is okay but somewhat expensive for Malaysia. Show less

Author: umangga82
Title: nice cafe but to open to road side
Review: nice cafe where you can chillout with friend talk about sosial life see people walking cars passby but to open for a couple to hang around

Author: miguelelrt
Title: good food and drinks
Review:
The food are quite good and the drink even better! In the middle of the famous jonker walk is a wonderful location. That's why everything is overpriced..
The staff is friendly but inattentive and our two menus came unfortunately not on the same time.

Author: Bill T
Title: Good pit stop
Review: I think everyone eventually stops at the Geographer's Café when on Jonker Street for a cold drink, and maybe a snack.  It's a western bar on a Jonker Street corner, and looks clean, inviting, and is a pleasant escape from the weather.

Author: NanthiniBalakumaranIpoh, Malaysia
Title: A good place to chill out
Review: It's a nice place away from the hustle and bustle, maybe on weekends might be too busy. Otherwise on weekdays it's a good place to have a meal and share a chat with a friend or even a bunch of your favorite people. Food is good and not too pricey.Show less

Author: LisaMarieSykesMajorca, Spain
Title: Poor draught beer, hit and miss wifi, expensive
Review: The place had a nice atmosphere and friendly staff. The location on Jonker Street is excellent.It's very expensive though. The draught beer was really bad and really over-priced. Even the wifi didn't work half the time.I definitely would not recommend it.I normally avoid places recommended in Lonely Planet because they are often poor value for money. This place was no exception. (We went in to escape the sudden rain).Show less

Author: Susan DPerth, Australia
Title: Nice for a short break
Review: I stopped off at this café a few times just for a short break to rest my weary feet. I sat just inside the entrance and had a good view of the crowds passing by on the footpath.The first time I only wanted a snack and so ordered an egg sandwich which was fresh and hit the spot. Every other time I was just hot and thirsty and, as I don't drink alcohol, ordered a ginger beer with ice.The service I received was quick and friendly.All in all I found this café to be a pleasant place to rest my feet with a snack or drink and watch the world go by.Show less

Author: chrisel d
Title: relaxing with drinks overlooking the very busy jonker street
Review: after walking on the busy and crowded jonker street if u want to relax with some drinks and look at the crowd passing by,then this is the place to go to,because in melaka not every good place serves alcohol,here our drinks came very quickly,we tried our usual favourites of potato wedges and chicken wings,it took some time for them to get it to us but they were served hot and crispy,dusted with some local spices,they tasted a little different,which we liked,wings were juicy as well,they had a live band which added to the charm of the already popular cafe,was nicely decorated for christmas,we asked the staff for the location of few other famous restaurants and he very kindly gave the information and what dishes we should be trying.wish we could have spent some more time here but melaka has so much to offer,maybe nextime :0)Show less

Author: FeTHEricoCoron, Philippines
Title: Good dinners
Review: We ate here twice, both times for dinner. The main reason is because it s very clear what s vegetarian and what s not, and shouldn t be that hard should it? I m not a vegetarian but my gf here in Melaka is struggling everywhere else. The food is good even though the price is more than double compared to the other small restaurant where only i can eat and where no english is spoken. So thanks a lot to the geographer for giving us a choice!Show less

Author: Raelene L
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: We had a great afternoon sesh that went on to become a night sesh :) great food. Food and drinks were not cheap by Malaysian standards, but we still had a great time.

Author: Vivienne CSouthport, Australia
Title: Lunch
Review: Food here is prepared to a high standard and caters for all nationalities. Has something for everyone.The atmosphere and decor are very appealing. A variety of seating eg stools, casual tables, more formal tables. Continuous TV screen showing a variety of clips. I enjoyed the one depicting the birth and refurbishment of the cafe.Show less

Author: Twogirls_7Rickmansworth
Title: Great food and live jazz
Review: We ate here on Monday evening where there is live jazz from Nadia and Beloved Father. This was lovely mix of western jazz and Malaysian jazz songs and kept us there for longer than we had planned. The cafe is very atmospheric with a lot of foliage outside. Food was great, we had vegetable curry to share to start with which was very tasty. I had Mango chicken and my husband had cashew nut chicken both of which were delicious. Wine was expensive to us Brits but then it is expensive everywhere here. Lovely evening and would recommend.Show less

Author: gourmetkinglondon
Title: Great place to hand out at weekends
Review: When the sun has set and the market is on at weekends this place is perfect to chill out with a glass of wine and a few beers.  Good music and a great atmosphere makes for an enjoyable evening.

Author: michaelwhittallSt. George, Bermuda
Title: Great hang out place
Review: A landmark in Melaka, this cafe is a meeting point for visitors and in a great location on Jonkers. Great coffee and wine by the glass (not usually available). Staff were very friendly but service a little haphazard. We used it for a break during sightseeing but did not eat there. It is not really known as a restaurant and there are good restaurants all around. But is has a good atmosphere and live music at weekends when it gets pretty crowded.Show less

Author: ValEqHKYork, United Kingdom
Title: Good atmosphere
Review: Stepped in attracted by the live music. Lively belted out. Very pleasant greeting from the waiter and my coffee appeared very quickly. Delicious coffee. I actually wanted a fresh coconut but it was off the menu. They seem to have a good selection of drinks. Don't expect too much. It's a down home sort of place but they also do vegetarian food and it's non MSG. Show less

Author: rowduhPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: best place to chill
Review: We went there Friday night so the place was a bit packed. Nice place to hang out and chill, they have a wide selection of drinks plus there's a duo playing showband music until 12. Good thing is you can also enjoy the music played by the resident singer on the bar across, Ringo's Antique Shop. Show less

Author: heng77Asia
Title: Poor Nasi lemak
Review: Nasi lemak is horrible. Serve with veg without chicken wings is really bad. The rice and sambal is not nice at all. Coconut drink is tasteless. I suspect they reuse the coconut shell. The shell is empty for the 4 of us. Show less

Author: 1FynnSingapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Food was not bad but the service was very poor. Clearly the restaurant is understaffed on a weekend afternoon. We had to self-help with the menu. Portion of the food was rather small. We ordered desserts but order was not keyed in. Music was way too loud with mediocre sound quality blasting in the cafe. Bar counter was filled with beverages waiting to be cleared. Will give the cafe a miss.Show less

Author: John MDallas, Texas
Title: Great Place to Eat & Watch
Review: The Geographer is a great place to stop and visit on a warm day (well they're all warm) and get out of the sun and under a fan. The food and the service are quite good and the view along Jonker street makes for some great visuals as all the people come by. Get a bucket of beer and some of the local food and enjoy your day - or your evening.Show less

Author: beyondseh_Singapore
Title: attentive staff and awesome coffee
Review: my friends and i came here for just a short while, to take a break from the scorching hot weather and to wait for other friends who were having lunch.we only came here to order coffee but damn, it was good. we had hot white flat coffee, iced cuppucino and ice cafe latte. even though we only ordered drinks, the staff still treats us pleasantly equal as others who ordered more. orders were taken swiftly and served promptly. most importantly, the coffee weren't too expensive and was made well.Show less

Author: Val T
Title: Excellent
Review: Was looking for a pace to eat & stumbled on Geographer Cafe.  The food was good as was the service.  Would recommend.

Author: Mynameisrick
Title: Dissapointed
Review: 3 dishes i order they dont have that day..1 st of all.why can u tell.me wht are the dishws that u dont serve that day..Lousy service.Arrogant waiter...

Author: Sunflower913
Title: Relax
Review: Place you can hang out with friends for beer and chat .. Yummy snack and friendly staff .. Great environment ..

Author: marijke123456Zemst, Belgium
Title: Don’t go here if you are hungry
Review: After walking around for a while in the nice (but very touristy) Malacca, we ended up here for dinner. We were unimpressed. The pasta tasted very good, but I wonder if the portion was big enough to feed a child. The second thing ordered was curry with naan: ok curry, terrible naan (actually I don’t think you can call the bread they serve naan). The apple pie with ice cream was no pie: the apple syrup is served separately. The flavor was ok, but would not order it again. The amount of food you get for the price is not enough (and some of it not that good), therefore only two stars.Show less

Author: Sieh FSingapore, Singapore
Title: Grumpy Staff
Review: Well, all and all the experience wasn't fantastic. Grumpy staff unwilling to serve, half-hearted whenever we tried to request or place our order. Not attentive at all, we need to repeat at least 3 times before we get what we wanted as during the placing of order, the staff wasn't even giving you his fullest attention. That basically sums up my whole experience there. In the end, only had a drink and left.Show less

Author: Audry721
Title: geo grapher caffe!!!
Review: nice place for cocktails or dinner with live music !! the atmosphere is nice where a jazz band play every Monday from 8.30 pm to 12 pm. the prices are good!!!

Author: junecasaKuala Lipis, Malaysia
Title: Good location but poor service
Review: We had our lunch here and there were 10 of us. Each of us ordered different food and drinks. But only mine was watermelon juice. The watermelon that I ordered was not fresh and taste wired. I let my husband tried a bit, was same. Hence, I brought the drinks to a waitress and she brought me to show to a barista/ manager at the drinks counter. The superior at the counter say nothing and just pour the juice to another small cup and try, then he answered me: ok ah, nothing wrong with this. I irks him is not fresh the fruit and really weird the taste and can I change another glass same juice? I didn't ask for others, just the same. If the taste is still the same, then I accept it. And the juice I only drinks a bit. But the guy pour again my juice and try and told me with an unsatisfied face and voice: this is our local watermelon, the taste is like that and gave me back the juice which left half glass after he pour out twice. I was angry but say nothing. And just took back my half glass juice and left it on my table. But me and my friends all decided won't come back again to this cafe. Show less

Author: 1_OrangMelaka
Title: The Cafe - Unique Of Jonker
Review:
Get relax and enjoy the songs with your drink while admiring the busy pedestrians. The ambience is very natural of Jonker Walk, an old street once bullock-carts transported goods to and fro the godown on Quayside.

Get to the Geographer!

Author: 598MarieMChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Tasty Tempeh and Other Offerings
Review: We read the reviews and took a chance and we were glad we did. It was a Wednesday evening and the places we wanted to dine at were closed.We had Malay food NOT Western as we made a pact to eat local food only. We found the service and food good to average. The alcohol prices were higher than we expected so we chose nonalcoholic drinks.The staff was cordial but not overly friendly. I would eat here again. Show less

Author: Sean MNottingham, England, United Kingdom
Title: Was recommended to us and was just fine.
Review: This restaurant serves a fusion of western and asian foods. It has a very trendy clientele and stands on a corner in the tourist area of Melaka. It looked like it was a meeting place for artists and would not have been out of place on the west bank. The food was OK - interesting mixtures of ideas and would appeal to a fashionable palate as long as they weren't looking for a particularly substantial meal. Service was very slow and a bit haphazard - but I got the impression that the majority of diners were there for the relaxed ambience (not just to eat and move on) so the unhurried waiting may have been perfectly in character.It was OK - I think the insects got a more substantial meal out of me than I did from the food (it is open to the street) - but it all tasted fine. The artistic presentation was clearly important to the chef and too many calories might have been distracting for someone like me with an unsophisticated Bri(u)tish metabolism.Show less

Author: nyenyedzi
Title: Poor
Review: Indifferent staff who couldn't be bothered to say hello or goodbye. Very overrated food, and certainly not worth what I paid. Curry was bland with soggy vegetables. Full of tourists taking photos.

Author: NatalieAWCSingapore
Title: Terrible experience!!!!!!
Review: UNFRIENDLY & UNPROFESSIONAL staffs - the waiters just simply said "NO" to answer customer question. My family and i went to this Restaurant for having some lunch before we left Malacca, but this terrible lunch had given us a nightmare because of the UNPROFESSIONAL WAITER did not answer our question seriously. As my Father is allergy to Cashew Nuts, so we ask the waiter is there any food or ingredient that contain cashew nuts in our ordered food, and the waiter answer us "No". We trust the waiter and of course my Father ate that food and subsequently went into hospital. After that i call and clarify with the Restaurant Manager, the manager said the curry is actually mix with cashew nuts paste. This drive us crazy why their waiter gave us a wrong answer!!! Obviously the stupid waiter did not think and check properly before gave us his answer!!! This is totally Unprofessional and Unacceptable. Fortunately there is a nearby Putra Hospital and my Father was stable with the emergency injection. This allergy causing my Father unable to breath and talk, we can't imagine what will happen to my Father if we are late for another 10 minutes. So Everyone, my advice is please think again before You entering this Restaurant!!!Show less

Author: Oiane S
Title: cozy, green and healthy
Review: Very healthy dishes, organic, glutamato free, special salt, fresh juices, excellent option to eat tasty and healthy.

Author: Arial X
Title: Overall okay
Review: Came here few times already but maybe today many people so the service not so good. When we ordering the waiter remind us that we need to wait 45mins for the food to be served. When the food is served my jonker fried rice is cold, the chicken chop taste not so good. Music is just too loud, when billing they take a quite long time to bring us the bill. So for me, overall okay. Maybe today cafe ia very fullShow less

Author: RichardChiaBSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Poor Food and Service
Review: Saw review rated very high. Came into the pub there is no one serving us. But you have look for your own sit. All the waiters all ignored you when asked for order. After a few try. Then they came to take order. Poor service. Food is cold. Very disappointing. Show less

Author: Sue_idah
Title: Cool place to hangout.
Review: In the dark of the night and the dead streets, this place liven the mood. Good drinks and nice music and nothing dodgy. Very relaxed place to go. ;) highly recommended.

Author: Peter_dR_NZHamilton, New Zealand
Title: Great food
Review: Granted, the service here is not top notch. It can be quite a challenge to even get a hold of some menues, and the food does take quite a while as well after being ordered. Still, the food is great, the coffee is great, and there really is quite a variety of things to try here. The place itself is picturesque and there is usually a very friendly and relaxed vibe. Recommended.Show less

Author: stellayapJohor, Malaysia
Title: poor service
Review: Starting it gaves me good feeling because of its heritage building, awesome live band and nice ambience but it is soon turn to be bad because of the poor service. We had been waiting for so long to wait the waiter provide us menu. Call for few times to place order but just ask us wait. And finally when we get to call a waiter to order they told us the kitchen just close. It is absolutely very disappointed. Show less

Author: ChoonfongJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Delightful Euro/Local Dishes
Review: Has a good range of western and local dishes on offer with fresh seafood quite popular with the guests. Spicy local fare are also available at reasonable prices. Choice of seating on ground or first floor. Alcoholic drinks are pricey due to local tax and live music available most nights. Popular with many Caucasian tourists visiting this historic cityShow less

Author: Bret DPortsmouth, United Kingdom
Title: The beating heart of Jonker Street.
Review: When my girlfriend and I arrived we were greeted with a restaurant somehow making sense of a truly chaotic atmosphere. I would recommend this place just for that atmosphere. Sitting at a window seat upstairs, as downstairs was packed, we were able to dine whilst looking looking onto the crowded spectacle below. The food was simple but excellent and the prices reasonable. Unfortunately, my girlfriend and I were only in Melaka for one night. If we had more time we would have returned.Show less

Author: Sakon_m
Title: Outstanding!
Review: we went there during an off-peak day, so it was rather quiet. However, the atmostphere of the restaurant was good, heard that there are often live band playing opposite the shop lot. must come back next time.

Author: emahsieh
Title: A place just for having a look
Review: We came to here because of introduction on the travel book.  This building is famous for its history.  Unfortunately the service and beverage were not as good as its great history.  We were disappointed.

Author: mike_steberPerth, Australia
Title: Was so good went back two more times
Review: The atmosphere was good - even at lunchtime and the location was perfect for watching people go by. As I have to eat gluten free it had been hard to find a place that would cater but this cafe had no problems explaining what dishes I could eat. For lunch I had the Geographers Curry Rice (13.90 RM) and then for dinner had the Nasi Impian (15.90 RM). Both dishes tasted fantastic and were very healthy. Drinks were pricey - we had the Somersby Apple Cider which were 19RM each but this is understandable as they are imported. Highly recommend eating here if you are in Melaka.Show less

Author: YukisnowberryKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food!
Review: Me and my friends stopped by here for lunch and the food here taste great with lots of variety to choose from. We're satisfied with our food. But it was totally crowded when we visit because of the festive season. The drinks here are a little pricey but other than that its alright.Show less

Author: barve
Title: Can't even get a cocktail right
Review: I wasn't impressed with this place at all. I ordered the simplest of cocktails possible - vodka with tonic, and they couldn't even get that right. A thimble-full of vodka with a full can of tonic is what I got.

Author: Olivia WSt. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Loved it
Review: I really loved the geographer cafe, my family and I ended up dining a number of times! It has a great location in the middle of lively Jonker Street, a good atmosphere with fantastic food and drinks. I would particularly recommend the chicken satay and tom yam soup, which is delightfully served in a coconut!Show less

Author: Yulia_99
Title: nice
Review:
The location is good, the prices are average. The atmosphere is cool,a bit of retro..
We ordered some local dishes and werent at all disappointed!!

Author: GnemLim
Title: Quite good but got mosquitoes
Review:
Good design and good view if you sit at balcony or first floor.
Be careful that I was attacked by mosquitoes while i sat on 2nd floor.

Author: Anne B
Title: Great restaurant
Review: We were in a group of 10. Everybody ordered something different from the local noodle dish to fish and chips and all the dishes were excellent. Compliments to the chef for preparing such a varied menu and doing them all well.

Author: LivBradPerth, Australia
Title: Cocktails great, service terrible
Review: We sat here after we'd run around the night market. It was quite busy but the service was slow and you had to hunt for a waiter to order. Also tracking someone down for the bill was a mission.Cocktails were really good and very pretty too. Satay was some of the best.Show less

Author: AllyBangkokBangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice Place
Review: We stopped here for a drink and to listen to some music.The staff were very good music not as good as the previous two nights which sounded better from where were sitting just across in another bar which also has live music. This is a popular place in Melaka and very busy Friday and Saturday quieter on Sunday evening. It is on a corner of Jonkers Street where you can sit and enjoy a drink and watch the world go by.Show less

Author: 431hbGeneva, Switzerland
Title: Abysmal service on sat night.
Review: No one to seat us, staff were indifferent at best. One person in our party of 3 got her order only after 45 minutes, after the rest of us had finished eating. We tried asking for an ETA on her order a few times (it's a lot easier to deal with a delay or make alternate plans if you know what the situation is), but were basically ignored/ told to wait. Was told by one staff member that it's because their business has such peaks and valleys that they're severely understaffed during peak hours. And it looks like a lot of the staff are inexperienced/have no idea how to handle peak periods. Food was middling - not too bad, not too good. Would've been ok with decent service, but in this case - a waste of money. If you're planning to give it a try, be prepared to wait and likely be disappointed.Show less

Author: Anna B
Title: The chocolate banana cake is great
Review: Stopped here for a coffee and a cake... And the chocolate banana cake is an absolute winner! Very nice the menu looked interesting and reasonably priced and the inside air conditioning was a a welcome reprieve from the heat outside.

Author: Kathy WSydney, Australia
Title: Great Rendezvous Point!
Review: An excellent location in the old area of Melaka. You can enjoy street dining/indoor/air con/upstairs (observation deck)/ live music in the evening/eclectic music otherwise....good food options were the vege rolls and the spring rolls - and the Geographer Special (lunch), drinks were well priced...but do check your expectations with the 'cheaply priced' cocktails. With our group, all were delicious, but some not as expected...eg a 'Grasshopper' with lots of piped cream in a martini glass - but the pina colada certainly passed muster - and hey....the prices are soo good, all can be forgiven! There's a great beer selection, and the staff are friendly even when challenged by tourists. Recommended to meet/try/share/enjoy!Show less

Author: mj18_12
Title: Cool place to rest and relax
Review: Nice music, cool environment, away from the scorching heat and crowd outside. Many choices of food, good customer service. Minus: washroom was not so clean

Author: intorox61Perth, Australia
Title: Great location for a drink but the food is foul.
Review: Fantastic watering hole for people watching and perhaps listening to jazz. We had a meal there as well but it was horrible. The vegetable curry and naan bread entree had a bowl of watery tasteless curry. The rice curry arrived cold and as a result was pretty much inedible. The ramen soup was passable, some interesting ingredients including nice noodles but hardly any taste. With so many better food options in town, I'd have a pre-dinner drink here and find a decent restaurant. Show less

Author: Fiona LNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: The best cafe bar on Jonker Street
Review: I travelled to Malacca with my friend for a couple of days and this became a regular place to eat and drink. We had some wonderful meals, very different and well cooked. Our favourite spot was the corner window upstairs where we could watch the hustle and bustle of the night market whilst sipping an ice cold beer. On Saturday night there was live music downstairs, a mixture of female singer with a bit of karaoke thrown in. Definitely recommended.Show less

Author: wesley5Melbourne
Title: Exactly what we needed
Review: After travelling with a child through Malaysia for few days, the menu at the cafe was exactly what we needed. My husband and I could enjoy the Malaysian style cooking whilst our daughter could partake in a once in a trip chicken bits and chips ! Everyone once in a while when travelling needs a bit of comfort food and this was hers tonight. The service was quick and cheerful and reasonable in price. Whilst it is a good place for backpackers to relax and view the scene, they will be back in 20 years time with their children ! Trust me ,!Show less

Author: bentong66Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great spot for people watching!
Review: Our favourite cafe-bar in Malacca. Food is excellent, the beers icy cold, and its corner, double-story in the heart of Jonker Street means you have a myriad of wonderful views. Pick your spot, settle back and watch the world go by. On Saturday evenings the Jonker Street flea market is literally at their doorstep, so you can pop out to do a spot of shopping or pick up some local food favourites. But don't miss the spring rolls here.Live music in the evenings and a great, great vibe.Show less

Author: HedgiebunnySingapore, Singapore
Title: Finally a bar stop!
Review: Jonker street is filled with shops but finding a bar is not easy. Good pit stop for a draft beer (not very cheap tho). Still, a good place to rest my legs on a Sunday night after the night market. Oh, there was a decent live singer too.Show less

Author: May_and_timSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must write this!
Review: I have been coming here on and of for five years. I met my fiancé here. The beer is good, the food is halal and there is rarely a queue. In the heat of the Melaka day, it is a welcome stop; in the warmth of he Melaka night, it is a lively haunt.But it could be so much more. Try to get served and you'll be told to 'wait', the waiters have no knowledge of what has sold out until 5 minutes after it is ordered and do not know what is in their dishes. When you have waited 30 minutes for a dish, everyone else has finished and you cancel the missing dish, you're shouted at for wanting your food too quickly!If the mgmt read this, I know you make a lot of money, I know you are popular, but you could be so much better and enjoyable...Show less

Author: SingaSomers
Title: Great place for an afternoon beer
Review:
Called in here for a cold beer after a hot afternoon of sightseeing, and I'm glad I did.

There is a good variety of cold beer and tasty snacks/meals on offer. The chicken satay was excellent.

There is also free internet. Ticks all the boxes!

Author: Gerd M
Title: nice place to rest
Review: this cafe is a nice place to rest from the tough sight seeing tour. I had a hot cappuccino and a cheesecake. both was OK, quick and friendly service. nothing to complain.

Author: Allycat32
Title: Good decor
Review: Nice friendly place and great ambience. We didn't try the meals but did have dessert which was not good at all. Their cafe latte was also bad. However, its got a great atmosphere, decor and nice place to unwind. Good live music.

Author: Rachelkx
Title: Nice food! great ambience
Review: Food is great. their potatoes are done very nicely. great place to relax, with air con, in hot hot Melaka.

Author: drmarkfUnited Kingdom
Title: Good laid-back atmosphere
Review: We spent a couple of evenings here: the first time there was decent live music in the enclosed area. The staff are welcoming and the place has a nicely chilled atmosphere.The food is fresh and spicy - based on what we ate we'd recommend sticking with vegetarian choices (which were excellent), since my chicken dish was a bit overcooked. The daily-changing soups are particularly good.As well as the usual local and international drinks choices there's a nice range of bottled weissbiers, although not surprisingly they're not cheap.Show less

Author: Pony71
Title: Great food…Great Hangout
Review: We found this place to be friendly..the food was great - in fact we visited this cafe on numerous times…Enjoy.

Author: Lara MWellington, New Zealand
Title: Our favourite in Melaka
Review: What a find to turn the corner from our hotel Puri & find the Geographer, a mix of east meets west with fantastic friendly staff, excellent food & drinks & a cool relaxed atmosphere, we returned again & again, the decor is welcoming, well thought out & comfortable, an oasis from the heat & bustle of Melaka.Show less

Author: Thrumptonpie
Title: Buzzy Place
Review: There's a real buzz about the place and the resident singer did a good rendition of Happy Birthday for our friend

Author: Shyamala_shenoy
Title: Very good food .. Good music ,, best for dinner..
Review:
Went there twice ! Expensive when compared to the street food ofcourse ..  
2 dishes with soup n drinks can cost you approx 35-50 RM 
Nice music in the night ! 
Loved the place

Author: deapuni
Title: nice interior
Review:
it reminds me of the most cafe in pnomh penh, cambodia. 
the no MSG sign is attract us to give it a try. but the food taste is average. 
overall, its a great place to stop by.

Author: EileenMulga
Title: Great location, food and service
Review: Great location on Jonker Street, very good food and service. The only downside was the over-loud music which made it impossible to talk.

Author: GTH275
Title: Fun Place
Review: We just stopped here a beer, but it was a great place to stop! The food that was coming out to the other tables looked amazing. Fun place to people watch!

Author: Yaussie
Title: Geographer Cafe
Review: Our favorite meal in Melaka! Food was good, service was very slow and chaotic. The restaurant seems to always be crowded, so the slow service was not surprising.

Author: carrotp2014
Title: delicious curry laksa
Review: im not a curry laksa lover... but their signature curry laksa make me couldnt stop eating!! the environment is nice and relaxing :) would like to visit once come to Malacca.

Author: rubyctravel
Title: Very nice ambiance, healthy good
Review: The food menu here focus on healthy food and fusion in local and western food. It has a very nice internal ambiance and music, it is a great place to spend time with partners or catch up with friends.

Author: SalhaladinHobart, Australia
Title: Avoid if possible
Review: Attempted twice to get a meal and or drinks - the first time the service was so slow we left and on the second was told 'we are busy and you will just have to wait' fair enough but individual was grumpy - I got the feeling the café was on of those places expats, and tourists visit because they like to be seen there and will put up with the terrible service because of it - there are plently of better cafes - so my recommendation is unless there are less than 4 people there avoid it.Show less

Author: travelhoneybeeKL
Title: good location
Review: famous bar & cafe on busy jonker street. tourist area price, a glass of draught beer (300ml) and a cocktail - approx RM35. it is nice to chill out in middle of pm. wifi is fast.nothing much special to write here....just had drinks this time, no comments for food. drinks are average, service was a but slow although it was non peak time.Show less

Author: LeeSummerSingapore, Singapore
Title: For drinks is OK but food....
Review: Heard about few recommanded dishes like tom yum soup in the coconut and curry ramen. We were there about 12 plus to have lunch and wanting to try the food but was told only open at 1pm for lunch due breakfast time was too busy and kitchen do not have time to prepare for lunch. So we went back at 1pm for lunch and ordered, curry ramen. fried rice, tom yum bee hoon soup instead of tom yum coconut due kitchen not able to prepare and vegetarian spring roll. The place is full of people for lunch as well, finally we foods come and can't wait to try the foods but to our disappointment, the vegetarian spring roll, fried rice and tom yum bee hoon taste so-so, nothing wow as for the curry ramen, noodle is noodle, soup is soup and vegetable is vegetable.The cafe is an icon in jonker Street with the paint of yellow wall, the atmosphere is good for drink at night and there is also live band, adding some colour to the night in Jonker street.Show less

Author: SMW977London, United Kingdom
Title: Good cafe in central Melaka
Review: Stopped here for lunch after reading other reviews on Tripadvisor.The cafe is nicely decorated and in particular nice and cool inside. It is clearly leans to western tastes so don't expect a typical Malaysian cafe experience. Food was good and priced as to be expected in such a place. The service wasn't bad but as is often the case in Malaysia it could be a little more attentive and speedy.Show less

Author: MagneticFriendQueensland
Title: Interesting place to eat
Review: We ate lunch here 2 days in a row. We liked it for it's atmosphere, cooling fans and fascinating decor. The stack of yellowing National Geographic magazines were a perfect match for this old world cafe. You can have western style food if you feel the need, but the rice and noodle dishes were great and very generous.Show less

Author: chriseC5286SC
Title: Pleasant evening meal in good location
Review: Excellent location, reasonable menu and an enjoyable dinner! Plenty of seating both inside and out. good music on Sunday evening.

Author: sammieraeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing to write home about
Review: I was honestly not impressed at all by the service rendered in this cafe. One would think that with the prices they charge, their service would be better. After a long drive and arriving in Melaka at 8pm, we were ravenous. We ordered drinks and food. The drinks arrived promptly and we were all in good spirits. The food arrived about half an hour later (at least my friend's did), mine didn't arrive for another half an hour. I was more annoyed because the other table, who came later than us, has already received their food. The live music was good, so that helped soothe my spirits. I tucked in. After finishing, we called for the bill. It took ages to come. We had to ask the waiters repeatedly for the bill. Granted it was a long weekend, so it was packed, but there is no excuse to keep your guests waiting with no explanation or apology whatsoever. The bill came, and this was when I really got annoyed. I paid with my credit card, and had to wait for almost half an hour, before the credit card slip got to me. Again, this was after us asking the waiters thrice for my credit card slip.The management seriously needs to rethink their customer service.Show less

Author: TheJakartaBandung, Indonesia
Title: the meal takes forever to arrive, one two waiters are rude
Review: firstly, it was okay. we got a seat right when we entered the cafe. which was a blessing because my family is starving and already past our dinner time (8ish pm last night). the ambience was good, I like the fact it was prohibited to smoke, drink was fast.but then.. the satay arrived after 1/2 hour. the nasi lemak came 15 minutes after that but it was something that we ordered later.now the jonker fried rice, which I assume their specialties, took 1 hour to arrive. that was... after the 3rd time we asked. and it was supposed to be a dinner to my 3 year old girl.yes we were raising our tone when we ask the order to a waiter. it is after all an hour for a fried rice.but then he (the waiter) made a scene by replying "are you made at me. I can cancel your order" in a bossy way. that was rude. same thing with another waiter that deliver the fried rice, when I asked why did it take so long,she just replied "sorry the kitchen was busy" then left us in nano second.oh really, kitchen was busy.why the man from our left table who arrived 40minutes after me got his fried rice at the same time.Show less

Author: arai33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not impressed
Review: Was there in the evening and there were plenty of mosquitos which marred my visit! Plus service was rather slow and the staff there including the manager had no concept of what is an extra shot of espresso in my Cappuccino despite selling an extensive array of gourmet coffee. Guess what, they charged me for the full price of a cup of espresso. Hmm... I made some noise to the staff whom served me and he insisted all is in place and even brought over the menu and pointed out to me that a cup of espresso is like say RM7 and he's perfectly correct. So my cup of coffee perhaps became like an exorbitant $15. I went over to check with the manager and was given like a dirty look suggesting that it was me whom was ignorant... Hmm... Oh well... I'm definitely not going to come back here after this experience. Show less

Author: Tim092Calgary, Canada
Title: Jonkers street restaurant good variety
Review: We were lucky to find this restaurant on Jonkers street on the corner. Great place to people watch. They had a variety of different foods and the chicken we had was delicious! They also serve wine and beer which can sometime be a problem in some restaurantsShow less

Author: MalRiley
Title: "Luvly"
Review: Found this by accident as it was about to rain. Good food, interesting music and atmosphere. A good place to watch the world go by on 'bonkers street'. We will be back again!

Author: Ian H
Title: Great food, service and vibe.
Review: Came here 3 times in 2 days. Really nice vegetarian food which was great because it's hard to find in the Chicken Rice capital of Malaysia! Try the banana chocolate cake and the sour plum juice.

Author: TorAusStavanger, Norway
Title: Great place!
Review: Attentive staff, great food and brilliant location!They have a lot of vegetarian food here but don't let it scare you off as the taste is so good!Location is great in the top/middle of jonker walk. Nice place for a lunch and late night dinner.Live music in the evenings and the street is filled with people.I'll be back!Show less

Author: SarahLim
Title: Great Chill Out Place in a hot afternoon
Review: Great place with wifi for a good chill out. The sour plum and lime drink was served in a huge and tall glass. The cappuccino is great too.

Author: Calmac84
Title: Small portions.
Review: Service was polite. Food was very good but you dont get a lot for your money!!nice atmosphere tho.worth a visit if your not starving and have a lil extra cash to burn.

Author: Rainne_TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Just average - but do drop by in the evening!
Review: On the first night in Malacca, we passed by Geographer cafe and was impressed by a lady singing with the live band there. The cafe looked packed, with a lot of onlookers standing around, enjoying the music. We figured this may be a good place to drop by the next day, as the cafe looked really too full for that night.Next day, we decided to have a late lunch at Geographer cafe, and I ordered their Jonker fried rice. The dish took about 20 to 30 minutes to arrive, and my partner had long since finished his watermelon juice. The food was average - not something that we expect after a long wait. The place was not exactly packed, just small groups of patrons sitting in the air-conditioned part of the cafe, wanting to escape from the heat. But the waiting staff looked harried, often as if they were way too busy for you. I won't say their service is bad or rude, just indifferent and.... busy. They just looked too busy to care about their patrons. At that point, I was a little regretful for not waiting till evening before trying out the cafe.Nevertheless, their sour plum juice is nice, as with their watermelon juice.Do try to drop by in the evening when the live music starts. I think that will jack up the ambience by notches. You'll probably be far too engrossed in the performance than to realise your dinner has taken 30 minutes or more to reach your table.Show less

Author: SalsaAramSan Francisco, California
Title: Excellent atmosphere, yummy food, and wonderful staff!
Review: After walking around for a while, we decided to grab a bite to eat.We love Malaysian food and we decided, on New Year's Day, to start being vegetarian.This is somewhat difficult in China because we can't speak Mandarin and there is so much meat in the food in most restaurants.However, in Malaysia, where English is a primary language, it is quite simple.We walked into the Geographer Cafe and thought it looked like a good place to have a nosh.So, we ordered up some vegetarian spring rolls and some other Malaysian food that was delicious.As we looked around the place, we noticed how it was a "world traveler" kind of cafe and we asked to go upstairs and into the closed areas of the restaurant.The staff smiled and agreed.We really enjoyed checking out this place and definitely recommend stopping by if you ever get a chance.Heck, they even had an tango floor upstairs!Show less

Author: chin2020Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good location, but nothing special...
Review: Stopped over at this place during a walk around Jonker. The place looked inviting, so dropped in for a drink to refresh.Though the place was not packed, service was poor. A few waiters were walking around but not taking orders - had to flag one of them down to take our orders.The group of us ordered coffees and beers. Beer was warm, though it was put into an ice bucket! Who, in their right mind, would serve warm beer? When we requested for ice cubes, it came in a small bucket, but without anything to scoop it with.Credit goes to a pleasant trainee female waiter who made the situation more bearable.Would not go there again.Show less

Author: Dedee3
Title: Ok
Review:
Not stunning but ok, had better food in town.
Juices are really good and espresso is one of the best I had. Definitely better as a café than as restaurant

Author: lianaros83
Title: delicious and yummy
Review:
a beautiful,large customer waitter friendly,i love the food here,,most delicious and i love 
CASWENUT CHICKEN best cuisine of malaysia......i will come again

Author: Anitachris
Title: The places aorund were much better!
Review: Nicely branded and marketed - place has a good vibe. But the food was a let-down. BIG time! Slow service too... though I can overlook that since the place seemed to be the kind where ppl relaxed over food, and didn't just eat and leave in a hurry. Would not go here again.Show less

Author: Craig C
Title: Nice looking but kind of average
Review: No real big complaints here. We visited as a tour group and that of course can slow things down, so am not sure how this place would do if we arrived just as a couple. The food was decent enough and the place nice looking.

Author: rachelstravels09Port Douglas, Australia
Title: Nothing special
Review: I've been here twice now, should have learnt after the first time.On my first visit I had the chef recommended noodle ramen soup. The noodles were like spaghetti and the soup didn't have much flavour. The second time I had the melacca straits salad which wasn't a salad at all, more like a vegetarian satay dish. This was ok.However, both occasions I had the fresh veggie spring rolls which are amazing! Highly recommend those!The drinks are pricey, I had a cocktail which wasn't great.You even have to pay for tap water here.Staff are hit and miss, some were great and some ignored you.The only reason why I gave this a 3 star and not 2 is because of the spring rolls and location. The music could do with being turned down a bit during the day too!Far better food around.Show less

Author: Marc_B999
Title: MSG free food
Review: I just had a beer and a simple snack here, but was impressed with the large offer of Vegetarian food, plus they advocate MSG free cooking. Thumbs up! Besides -- this is a great place for people watching on Jonker's walk...

Author: SlatedoggMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Avoid like the plague!
Review: Malaysia is a place just bursting with great food from every corner of the globe, so if you want something good to eat at a fair price it shouldn't be hard. I had read the reviews for geographer cafe prior to going there and dismissed the bad ones as people being a bit picky. I have worked in customer service for 8 years so I'm normally lenient when it comes to the staff in stores or restaurants, but my god. ONE AND A HALF Hours! after we initially ordered, my wife lost her rag and went to complain. The time was 1pm on a Saturday afternoon and the cafe was not even at half capacity. There seemed to be two people taking orders and one person standing behind the bar doing very little. Someone took our order after fifteen minutes (fine if you are busy) then it took a further twenty minutes for our two iced coffees to arrive. We then sat for fifty minutes or so while everyone around us was brought food (albeit very slowly) and we appeared to be invisible. The final straw was when someone on the table behind us who had only been there for about twenty minutes was served the exact thing my wife ordered. We decided to complain and ask if our food was even coming because at this point we would prefer to just leave. The waitress my wife spoke to said in quite an accusing tone "you haven't even ordered anything". Well why do we have knives and forks in front of us and why are there empty glasses on out table. She shrugged and we left having not paid for the drinks we didn't order or drink in the hour and a half we wasted in this average looking overpriced cafe. We then went to restauran saranavan for a South indian meal and we're served amazing food immediately which cost a quarter of the geographers cafe. Actual geographers should use a map and find somewhere decent to eat instead. Show less

Author: Sprattle
Title: Worst service ever!
Review: We waited for an hour an a half for our food to eventually be told in an aggressive way we never ordered any food!

Author: SueannematthewsCanberra, Australia
Title: More More Tea? - Yes Please
Review: Whilst the Geographer cafe is not the cheapest restaurant in Malacca, it's atmosphere and service are outstanding. With an extensive drinks list, including the delicious More More Tea mock tail, and a superb menu of local favourites and western dishes, there is something for everyone. We had satay sticks with rice cubes, chicken with cashew, Thai mango chicken, and malacca vanilla sundae - all exceptional in flavour, presentation and service. Highly recommended, oh and if you are a beer drinker there are a range of beers in a beer tower for 99rm, enough to keep you hydrated on a hot day, or to share with mates over a meal.Show less

Author: SV SMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great place to take a break
Review: Needed a place to take a quick lunch while showing Melaka to visitors. The Geographer turned out to be just right. Conveniently located, interesting and tasty food (vegetarians well taken care of), reasonable prices, good range of beverages, friendly service... the music was a tad loud for lunchtime, but perhaps that's the atmosphere the management want to create.All in all, very satisfied.Show less

Author: fovant
Title: Too slow
Review: 10am opening time, took 25 mins to bring toast and coffee! Really? Toast and coffee in a restaurant that has just opened and 4 customers, utterly ridiculous

Author: rerny86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Only for drinking
Review: Well this place seems to be one of the happening places around Jonker Street. Was here for Xmas eve with my girl and friends. Great atmosphere, a lively place to enjoy oneself while having your fav drink. But seriously, this place is strictly for that only. If you have any thoughts of dining here, then probably you should consider that. The worst pasta that i ever had was here! Thought probably only I was unlucky with my food, but my girl's fish & chips tasted equally bad. Same goes for another friend whereby she did not enjoy her dinner at all.If you're willing to give an exemption for the food, then it's indeed a nice place to hang out.Show less

Author: helloasia
Title: Good Food and Drinks
Review: The food here was good except for that it took a while for the food to arrive but because it was quite crowded. The  band was not bad and the music played were mostly eighties music. Will definitely be back soon.

Author: mssc17
Title: Great atmosphere and food
Review: We went to Geographer for some food after a long walk on Jonkers Street and the place was buzzing ! Good food and quick service plus the karaoke was good too.

Author: Kimberly BCairo, Egypt
Title: Great end to our night
Review: After a busy evening strolling through the night market, we stopped off at the Geographer for dinner and drinks. The atmosphere was fantastic and we were surprised to get a set. The service was very slow and we had to get someone to come to our table. We noticed other tables doing the same. The food was good, but, everything was served at different times. I was done by the time my husband got his meal. The restaurant was very busy, loud and the live music was nice. Would go there again. I cannot say this is the best place for kids, although ours had a good time. Full of westerners and tourists.Show less

Author: Paul24101964Adelaide, Australia
Title: Great food and service
Review: We found this cafe in jonkers street mallacca and in total went there 3 times during our time there. The fresh juices were amazing as were the cold rolls which were made fresh. I had a tom yum in coconut which was very delicous. This would be my number one place whilst in Malacca and often was hard to get a seat. The staff were friendly and always managed to explain what different dishes were. The food came out quickly and overall not too expensive. The pictures on the wall showed the before and after restoration photos and a brief history. The music was great and not too loud. Definitely my number one choice hereShow less

Author: PagetenSingapore
Title: Nice Place to Relax
Review: The Geographer was always crowded when I'm at Jonker Walk. This time round, since I went on a Thursday, there was no one there and my friends and I decided that we will give it a try. It's a nice place to sit and chill. The whole place is quaint and friendly. Not only that my friends really like the tempeh (soy bean cake) with curry.Show less

Author: dsanch910
Title: Don't bother with the food
Review: The only thing this place has going for it is its excellent location on Jonkers Street.  Perhaps it is best for people watching and having a drink.  Other than that, the food was lousy, and the service was not much better.

Author: RozKiwiAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Nice ice cream sundae with a local twist
Review: I stopped here for a delicious ice cream sundae with a local twist (local cane sugar syrup). The food coming to other tables all looked good too. One really good thing about their menu was that they listed ingredients in their dishes (unusual in this part of the world) - but great for those of us who need to know what we are eating.Show less

Author: AustraliaAthena
Title: Delicious food in great location
Review: Having spent the morning walking around Melaka, we were hot and hungry. Geographer has an inviting ambience, and a quirky mix of Western and Asian food. The service was quick, and the portion sizes were good. The local food is recommended.

Author: DaudRay
Title: Great place to eat
Review: We had seen lots of people hanging out eating & drinking here on each of our visits to Malacca.  Today we came at lunchtime--appreciated the cooling fans & mist machines, the food was very good and the service matched.  We'll definitely try this place again.

Author: Andrew BBangkok, Thailand
Title: decent food would happily revisit
Review: Dined with three friends about 8 o'clock in the evening by which time the place was full of Western tourists and we had difficulty finding a table. Place seems a bit run down and in need of refurbishment. Had a number of dishes including the Thai chicken and cashew nuts and Thai mango fish all of which were more than adequate and I would happily come again. We had a jug of beer in the happy hour which finishes at 8 o'clock at 40 ringgits which I thought was a bit expensive. The total bill was a modest 120 ringgits. Service was a bit on the slow side but the restaurant was busy.Show less

Author: Miguel S
Title: Jonker street malacca
Review: Very nice place to eat and drink. Recommend for drink lovers. Very cheap drinks. Open till 1:00am. Come early otherwise will be crowded.

Author: EmmaG230Manchester, United Kingdom
Title: A good, reliable favourite
Review: Visited the Geographer Cafe twice on my 36hr visit to Melacca. The first time I was blown away by their vegetarian Tom Yum soup which really was spot on in spice and flavour. The next night I went for their Nasi Lemak - not the typical dish I had come to expect but tasty and well presented nonetheless. Happy hour for beer is very reasonable but bear in mind when you order a glass of wine, you are served a thimble. Really impressed with the polite, friendly and attentive staff here, something that seems to be a rarity in SE Asia. Would happily recommend this place to friends, good reliable food and always busy (that's a good enough sign for me!). Show less

Author: Chiara_sg
Title: Best Dinning area in Malacca
Review: I bought some friends here , I visit this dinning cum drinking place everytime I visit Malacca, just like the location, very centrallised, at the centre of Joner street, they offer full range of dinning and the drinks are quite reasonable.

Author: LorettaT652
Title: Great venue!
Review: Great atmosphere.Beer tasted good after walking around Malaca! Enjoyed the satay along with the music! Good spot and very friendly staff!

Author: ImBrightonBrighton, United Kingdom
Title: Great place: A must stop to unwind
Review: Had a great day strolling around Melaka and wondered past The Geographer. Had a great drink. Very attentive service. Food looked good to. Does a wide range of vegie food too. (Not vegie my self but thought would make note). This old Conner shop house has been well renovated and is sympathetic to the area. Have take all the other comments on board but it's still a good watering hole!!! Just take the time to let it soak in.Show less

Author: younggreynomadsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Slow and lacked service
Review: Food took almost one hour to arrive. Given that it was satays and tempe for two we felt this was a bit long.Staff were not interested in following up our requests and were not busy. In fact we saw one couple cancel their order for this reasonThe tempe was over cooked and had no flavour, satays were a little betterPity but could not recommend the Geographer.Show less

Author: tosouthamericaLondon, Canada
Title: Terrible service - they need to train their staff.
Review: Located in tourist central with tourist prices, would expect decent service and an decent overpriced meal. The food was acceptable, not good but far from the bad. The service is just terrible. After speaking to the management no resolution was offered except a verbal apology, with an excuse that the server who provided terrible service was from "another" country and needed training. Shouldn't the staff be train prior to working here? The management simply doesn't care. Will not return and will take my business elsewhere.Show less

Author: u0010072
Title: Great cafe bar L
Review: Perfect location for watching the world with good food and good entertainment on Jonker Walk. The bar across the street (Ringo's) will also add to the ambience at night. Well worth a visit!

Author: LoveTheTropicsSydneySydney
Title: Really Trendy but poor service
Review: This bar/restaurant is in the centre of popular Jonkers Walk - and should be the best place in Melaka but the staff just aren't up to their jobs.We arrived here for drinks and dinner but the service was really slow and inattentive. The live music on Saturday night was a nice touch but watching staff standing around talking and chatting with each other when patrons have empty glasses and are ready to spend more money - is a crime that any bar/restaurant owner would hate to see.The drink service was so bad that we left before ordering food and we ate elsewhereShow less

Author: HeleddC
Title: Lovely place.
Review: Great food and a great atmosphere. A laid back feel and quality food! Visited here with family and friends and arrived late from KL. Glad that this place was open. A varied and interesting menu. Would definitely recommend a visit here.

Author: ShellywUK
Title: Lovely food and great service
Review: We ate in here a couple of time and the food is really good.  It's an excellent location to watch the world go by and the happy hour has really good deals.  We will be back!

Author: Steve THong Kong, China
Title: Vert Nice
Review: We just stopped in for a drink on a hot afternoon having walked around the Jonker Street area. Airy, spacious and open the food that was being served looked good but we had already had a huge breakfast in KL.The Calamansi juice with sour plum was a superb cooling drink. It came in a very large glass with lots of ice and was very refreshing. Those who had ordered other drinks, re-ordered the calamansi juice and were converted.Show less

Author: skogs1
Title: great veggie food
Review: Great to find this place, with its good choice of veggie food. I loved the curry ramen, and just chilling out over a post-meal beer watching the world walk (and drive) by. The service was good too.

Author: Victoria900Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great variety of vegetarian food!
Review: It's a consolation to be able to find really delicious vegetarian in the midst of Jonker Street. Such that we came back for it twice in a row. Love the salad options and vegetarian chicken rice with stewed soup. The service crew was polite and helpful, unlike what some of the travellers had reviewed about. We came here for dinner and the live music and singing were a great accompaniment to end off the night. Highly recommended! Show less

Author: lianlicSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place to chill
Review: Live music, great company, awesome beer to finish off the night once you have shopped the whole stretch of Jonker street night market (which happens from Fri - Sun). It's situated at a corner lot in the middle of Jonker street.Great place to chill out after a long day.Show less

Title: A small haven amidst the chaos!
Review: After 2 rounds up and down Jonker, this is a nice place to chill. It's more for the ambience, rather than anything else.You can relax, watch people go by, listen to live bands either from inside or the ones outside..Food wise...I reserve my comments. Portions are huge and satisfying. However in terms of taste is only so-so compared to the price you pay. The satay was nice, but the peanut sauce had a funny taste. Probably too much tamarind and sugar. And the mango thai rice had a weird combo of mayo salad. Hmmm...even the beer was not so consistent.Oh well...it's still an experience to try!Show less

Author: Alvinseow
Title: Average only
Review: After shopping at the night market, decided to go for a drink with my brother. Ordered a satay and some drinks to chillax. The foods are average only. The cafe have live singing performance, you can order songs too! Nice ambience too.

Author: Tou Boon L
Title: Nice ambience, okay food
Review: You can't miss Geographer Cafe - it's at a corner lot along Jonker Street. Nice ambience. Great if you are looking for a cozy place to take a break. Food is not bad.

Author: orangegenie
Title: good drink spot
Review: Easy to stumble on this place if you're around Joker area.  Worth stopping for an evening drink and the foods pretty good too.

Author: Carynkuan
Title: Good for hanging out in Melaka
Review: Nice live band. Food okay but rather expensive . Cocktail is good while hanging out with friends plus the nice heritage surroundings.

Author: Olitrav
Title: Faux Malaysian cuisine for the tourists served with an awful house band on the side
Review: We are here last night and it was most disappointing. The food is definitely aimed solely at the crowd of tourists ambling down Jonker St. We ordered chicken satay, a cashew curry and a dish that described itself as mango chicken. The chicken in the satay was fine but the sauce was awful. The cashew curry was bland and the mango chicken was essentially sweet chilli sauce with a few pieces of mango thrown in for good measure. I do believe that the ingredients here are good but the execution is poor.Their draft beer is quite good but the house keyboard and singer duo were terrible, we contemplated hanging around for drinks afterwards but left to go and see a guy put his finger through a coconut which was far more entertaining.Show less

Author: Tasfamily2013Launceston, Australia
Title: Basic food, good service and and atmosphere.
Review: Two adults and two kids aged 10 and 8. Satay sticks were OK, a little dry and sauce wasn't the greatest we've had. I liked the tofu and sesame fried squares. I had cashew and chicken with rice - tasted great for me but my husband was disappointed. He ordered a straits salad...nothing more than grated vegetables with a sauce (a variation of satay sauce) - husband very disappointed. Kids had wedges...can't go wrong there! Lemon iced tea was good. We wouldn't rave about it but it was good service, good atmosphere and a little over priced for what was presented.Show less

Author: YukieLilyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: The food is so-so.It did not pack a punch for me.Probably because of they ran out of skewed chicken meat (satay) during my visit.The pasta definitely taste horrible but my partner says that it's ok, just a little too oily.Well, I might still go back to sample the satay.Please do share with me if any of you have tried some good food in this cafe.By the way, the service is between average to poor.Show less

Author: KLOysterMan
Title: Decent little bar for a stop off
Review:
This place is fine for a few afternoon beers and a snack...satays and vegetarian spring rolls were good.

Seating is a lot of rickety bar stools. 

Fine for a few drinks and to take in the h

Author: Akash AMumbai, India
Title: Highly recommended by Tripadvisor .. but I would not re-visit
Review: We went there as my friends were looking for good Vegetarian options and there were good recommendations on Tripadvisor . We ordered Local Vegetarian stuff which none of us could eat. The rice was so coconuty and this was not mentioned anywhere in the menu. The asam pedas was probably the worst we ever had - both the vegetarian as well as the one with fish. The highlight was the pesto pasta which we ordered after being disappointed with the asian dishes. This was no better and even the fast food versions of pasta shops make it better. There were mosquitoes in the indoor area and when we asked for a solution for it, the waiter said that we could sit outside which we didnt as it was about to rain and it did. We asked for a bigger table as our plates could not fit on the table they provided but the waiter didnt seem to understand. So I went to the bar counter and asked them to sort this which they eventually did. Guess, service does not come naturally to them . To my surprise, the place is packed with people ( mostly expats or tourists I guess )... They need some serious re-visiting in the dishes that they send out of the kitchen. I would recommend the quaint little cafes / local joints right across the street for a much more delectable meal.Show less

Author: PiliPala_83
Title: Good lunch option
Review:
We visited Geograhper for lunch. It was a good option as we were in the area.

The food was reasonably priced and we couldn't complain for the price.

Service was fast and friendly.

Author: RaggedTrouseredPhilaLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Expat Trap.
Review: Caters for expats wanting a beer. Overpriced, inedible food. Could be any pub anywhere in the world catering for westerners too scared to try local food in a local cafe. Drunks were in there when I visited. Who wants pizza and chips in Melaka? I went with unadventurous people yearning for home and looking down on the locals. They loved it here. You will too if you would prefer to be in South London. If you're like me and go to places to experience differences and at a reasonable price, don't come here.Show less

Author: NehaBishnoi
Title: great food options
Review: This cafe is right in heart fo Jonkers Street and provides you the indoor and outdoor seating options. The menu has vast variety of food options taking you through many cuisines. The food is not very expensive.

Author: CismasiuR
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Average food, nice atmosphere through Live music singer of "oldies but goldies" songs. Food pictures in the menu are impressive comparing with the food served, so it is better to consult the stuff before any choice!

Author: MatzeRoseneeRugen Island, Germany
Title: Very warm atmosphere
Review: For our first evening out in Malacca this was the perfect place. Good food with an organic twist, reasonable prices for foodand drinks. And a great live jazz band (every Monday from 8 to midnight)! Two advices: if you order sour plume juice be sure drink it not too slowly (when all the sugar has dissolved it becomesIncredibly sweet) and secondly the cocktails are not really worth the price at least not the Mojito I've had (hardly any alcohol in it, though big glasses). Next time we order local beers or wine, they are less expensive.Show less

Author: FerrisXLAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Great place to relax in between of sightseeing and/or rainshowers.
Review: We enjoyed the food, drinks, live music and the friendly staff.The Geographer Cafe is ideally located in Melaka's old town and has a very nice atmosphere. It might be a little pricey by Malaysian standards, but we did not find it exaggerated and we had a really good time here.Show less

Author: PinkyJane88
Title: Good ambience
Review: Average food, drinks slightly expensive but nice ambience. Live singer till late nite but the singer is not as good as the singer opposite them, Ringo's Classic Cafe.

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ..2nd visit here...measly portion,poor service and expensive...
Review: ..decided to bring hubby to sample some local delicacies,and we had coffee and satay.....sad to say this time round the service was dissapointing,the place was noisy and warm..the food arrived and the "satay" portion were rather small.....am thoroughly dissapointed,and may not even step back here again..the service and food portion have not remained the same,and theres a compromise.Show less

Author: Maria DWaterford, Waterford, Ireland
Title: Very expensive
Review: I am from Ireland and have been living in Meleka for the past three months. I visited the Geoghrapher with friends and family recently, namely because it was reviewed on trip advisor. I can honestly say that the prices charged are way over the top. The food is average and again over priced. If you explore some of the streets off the beaten path you will get much better value for money and a truly Asian atmosphere and experience.Show less

Author: TorassaThe Netherlands
Title: Great location to watch the world go by
Review: We visit this restaurant every time we stay in Melacca, because it is situated right in the centre of town and is the best location in town to sit down, relax and watch all tourists passing by.Yes the food is average, yes the service is not great, the coffee is terrible and the chairs are really uncomfortable, but that all is compensated by the great location and good atmosphere in the evenings during the evening market.Show less

Author: Suria BJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice place, but bad service and average food
Review: The location is indeed very nice, but the food is just average and the service was bad... Maybe if you just want to have a drink and chill out, it is okay, but I wouldn't recommend eating there since you will most probably spend a lot of time waiting...Show less

Author: Higgey
Title: Good place to relax
Review: Good food, nice drinks and mocktails (cocktails without alcohol) are served. Don't miss when you are around! Take the chance for a stop during night market! Enjoy the scenery!

Author: FloopertLincoln, UK
Title: A great place to hang out
Review: Really surprisingly good food, great wifi, good coffee. Terrible service (in the sense that you need to get someone's attention for everything, not that they were rude in any way) but that suited me fine as I was in no hurry and really wanted somewhere to sit and people watch for extended periods with wifi and coffee - I figured if they weren't in a hurry then I didn't need to be!Show less

Author: yanadira
Title: Cool hangout place
Review: Came there on a weekday night. The amount of crowd was ok, not too packed. Crowd was mostly tourists. Had only drinks there. Price was average. Check out the toilet, u need to enter a passcode. That was a first for me

Author: Rebecca TPulborough, United Kingdom
Title: Amazing vegetarian options
Review: I love this place, so sad I only tried it on my last day! they have an amazing choice of vegetarian options, which really can be quite rare, and it is HEALTHY! When you're travelling you can get so sick of eating fried everything, white rice, white bread... So it really is refreshing to eat here. Great staff, great atmosphere and reasonable prices. Would definitely recommend. :) enjoy! Show less

Author: Ashvin pPune, India
Title: A cafe to chill
Review: Geographers cafe is a convenient corner cafe in the Jonker street, Melaka. One can easily spend an hour or two over drinks and food. the cafe comes live in the evening with live performances and good music. the food was amazing and so was the ambience. the best day to vist is saturday when the jonkers walk is active.Show less

Author: AdrajsingaporeSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: For Evening Live Music over Dinner & Drinks
Review: Don't go during the day. Grab your seats around 7PM, grab dinner, wait until the live music starts at around 8.30PM and then drink on. The restaurant bang opposite it plays live music too that you can enjoy. The 2 retaurants are clever enough to alternate their live music sessions (every 30 min or so). If it's packed, expect the service to be slow. But then again, what's the rush! You're here to chill out in Melaka.Show less

Author: VancouverNomad7777Vancouver, Canada
Title: Not my cup of tea but great location
Review: Good location in the hussle of bussle of Jonker street and makes for and easy choice to sit and have a drink and people watch. Not impressed by the food but good selection of beers albeit pricy. Gave a two as the service was just brutal - super slow on all aspects (cleaning table, taking orders, bringing drinks and etc) and messed up the order and took no accountability for it; did not correct their mistake and even charged us for the item! We also found the waiter/manager quite rude and argumentative.You get the impression that repeat clientele is not the focus here.Show less

Author: Sharon T
Title: Tasteless food,poor service
Review: We went to this place to have a quick lunch,but unlucky we wasted more than 2 hours there with their poor service.Can't cancelled the bill due to payment done after ordered.Most of the foods that show in the menu are not in supply..poor,slow  service..

Author: 192RoseMCanton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: It is in the middle of Jonker street and tourist central
Review: I would say average food in a western tourist environment. Ideal location if you are suddenly hungry and tired and want to order something familiar.Would suggest considering something outside the mayhem if looking for a eating experience instead of a place to rest your feet and fill your tummy.Atmosphere nice and relaxed. Services slightly slow , but friendlyShow less

Author: KLD72Uppsala, Sweden
Title: Overall good food, a little expensive
Review: The Geographer Cafe is a fun place to go for lunch. We noticed that other diners had ordered plum juice, which was very good. The spring rolls were excellent, served with peanut sauce. The tom yum soup was served in a coconut and very good. The vegetarian noodles (a house specialty) did not taste good, which was unfortunate since everything else was very good. The restaurant was extremely busy with large groups, which was surprising since we came in for a late lunch. Because it was so busy it took a while until we could order. The food was more expensive than we were used to on our trip in Malaysia, but several dishes were memorable.Show less

Author: 219alanlShrewsbury, United Kingdom
Title: Nice place to chill out and people watch
Review: We stopped off for a quick bite to eat and ended up enjoying a couple of beers, Waiters were attentive even though the place was busy at lunch, the place had a nice atmosphere, served good international food and had a huge choice of beverages available. It ticked all the right boxes, would definitely recommend, good job guys.Show less

Author: FivouMontreal, Canada
Title: good food, good place, poor service
Review: I went to the Geographer Cafe for lunch time, and it wasn't so busy. I had to wait around 10 minutes to have someone to take my order, and at the end, after asking for the bill, I had to wait around 30 minutes, plus 10 minutes to have my change back! The poor service is sad, because so place is really nice, good music ( and some french music!! why? even me french I didn't know them!!)and the food is really good. But for people who really like to eat, it can be not enough on the plate! For me it was all good!If you are on the terrace, you will be on so many pictures of all the Asian people who take the building in picture (famous building on commercials and movies).The prices are more expensive than what you can find in other place in the city!Show less

Author: ptydukeFlorida
Title: Nice Corner Bar /Restaurant
Review: I stopped in for lunch. The menu covered all the basics. The chicken Satay was tasty and the fresh lime juice was quite refreshing. Everything that I saw around me looked very appetizing. Waiters were attentive. It was always busy everytime I walked by. Its located on a busy corner on Jonker Street so it is a great spot for peoplewatching.Show less

Author: ssihra
Title: A great nostalgic place
Review: Beautiful restaurant, nice place and ambience. The food and drinks were awesome. The music takes u too a different world. It is just awesome place to hang out and have fun.

Author: MEM2121
Title: refreshing
Review: Nice malay and european food. Many types of beer (even from Belgium!). Modern building, nice night life.

Author: Mchelly803Petaling, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: nice food,nice view,nice environment~
Review: went there for my valentine's day celebration with my hubby..we went on second floor.For me second floor is more suitable for family gathering since it is more quite compared to downstair. the service is very good,waiter and waitress are friendly.and they even offer me a photo-taking-service ^^ and personally i love their popiah.Show less

Author: IllkaG
Title: Fabulous nasi goreng
Review: The cafe is great. The wait staff are really friendly and kind. We enjoyed having a beer, some fried rice and satay here. The satay has a strong lemon grass flavour and is yummy.

Author: Christian FPerth, Australia
Title: Geographers cafe…better left off the map
Review: Myself and my wife ended up here after struggling to find any local eateries open. We ordered the Thai mango fish and Thai mango chicken. It was pretty much impossible to tell what was Thai about it, deep fried pieces of fish and meat in a sweet chilli sauce, certainly no mango involved! It could have just been deep fried cardboard as you couldn't tell which was chicken or fish and accompanied by a 'salad' again disappointingly bland, the best thing about it was the boiled rice! We should have been aware things weren't all that good as the tables around us when we got there had lots of food left on the plates and the couple sat next to us had to repeatedly ask for their food and weren't impressed by what they got. All in all not a good experience, certainly shouldn't be deemed a tourist attraction!
