Strangely enough this being the only meal we didn't share I've since had a dose of food poisoning following our visit :(Show less

Author: johnm53376Hobart, Australia
Title: Not as good as it looks
Review: This place is strategically located on Jonkers Street and automatically attracts the expat crowd because of its décor. It is OK for a beer and a stare but there are plenty of better places to go for food nearby such as the malay portugese food at Eleven Bistro just down the side street and Baboon House for the best burgers around. The music is often unnecessarily loud and makes a conversation a real chore. So all in all not really the go but as stated fair enough for a coldie!Show less

Author: Sunil2108Singapore, Singapore
Title: Terrible Service
Review: I was super exited to visit this cafe based on Trip advisor reviews et al but when i visited there last week with my family i was terribly disappointed with the quality of service. We were 4 adults and a kid firstly I am not sure if the cafe was understaffed on that day when we entered i asked almost 5 people if they have a table for 4 and they kept sending me up, outside, inside and still i did not get a table until i got hold of one guy who got me a table for 3 and we manged for sometime and got a proper table but it was frustrating. Well even for a minute if i gave them the benefit of doubt on the table thingy for that day saying it was crowed et al, the service was absolutely crappy. We ordered for few drinks and food and it took eternity for them to serve and involved quite a few visits to the main counter to check if our order is taken or not and finally we got it but the food tasted awfully bad and they missed couple of our orders as well which we finally cancelled. The only good thing was the music band was decent and it was reasonably priced. However i am sure i will not visit this place again as you dont want cheap food/beer and cheap service....Not recommend for families for sure!!Show less

Author: Evangelina LAnnandale, Virginia
Title: Great food, great service
Review: I was traveling through Malaysia last year and ended up in Melaka. I stumbled across the Geographer Cafe and took a chance. It ended up being a great decision.The building is full of charm; an old Chinese building that retained so much of it's past glory. It's also perfectly located on Jonker Street. The tables and decoration were just exquisite and really fit into the them of the restaurant. I ordered a tom yam and a mango rice dish which was just excellent. Then the manager (Mark I believe) came over and asked me if everything was OK. Such great service! I definitely would come back here again if I ever make it back to Melaka. Yes, it's very full but that's because the atmosphere and the food is so great.Show less

Author: HappyFeet25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great beer selection
Review: Nice place to hangout in the evening on a weekend. Do grab a table on the street when Jonker is closed for the night market. I did that and enjoyed a nice ice cold beer people watching and soaking in the atmosphere of Jonker Street. Food was ok for the price. A light dinner and 2 beers cost me about 65 ringgit which is fair for a touristy place like Jonker Street.Show less

Author: Chris101111
Title: Good to experience
Review: Bistro with music in the middle of Jonker Street, great spring rolls and a nice cold beer to watch the people traffic pass by. Great stop on a hot day.

Author: Tim H
Title: Great music bistro
Review: Liked the vibe, the decor, the staff and the setting. Food was good but wasn't too impressed by the prices (over- inflated). Nevertheless and great place for a coffee, a beer, a snack and fflr watching people passing on Jonker Street.

Author: Luc68
Title: good food, nice space
Review: you'll have a great meal and a great place to rewind and relax. Watch the world pass by, while you sip your drink.

Author: Christopher KSingapore
Title: For tourist to see tourists?
Review: Located in middle of jonker street @ weekends ... you see hordes of tourists itching their way through the crowded night markets .. if this is what you're looking forward to .. then perhaps its the ultimate venue for chill and beer .. personally would prefer to take a walk down towards the jetty quay for pubs along the river and watch some sunsetShow less

Author: Wish_t0_travel_m0reSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food and ambience
Review: I was searching for vegetarian food in Melaka and this is the only cafe shown on the map that provides vegetarian and non-vegetarian. It is located in the middle of the Jonker Street. The cafe has aircon and non-aircon area. They have a corner for live band performance too. Nice food and ambience. Slightly pricy. Show less

Author: Heather_Anne_BrownWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Jonker Street Delight
Review: Set right in the heart of Jonkers street this is simply the best place for a cold drink and to watch the world go by. Grap a table next to the pavement and order a cold beer or lime juice and just relax.We enjoyed a great Tom Yam soup, satay and the fresh spring rolls are delicious – full of sesame seeds. I have them every visit.The prices are a little above others in Jonkers street but this restaurant has location, location, location!Show less

Author: voyager52Newport Beach, California
Title: Location location location
Review: Perfect place to enjoy the Jonker Market scene with a cold pitcher and good food. We just snacked with spring rolls and veggie rolls and watched the crowds wander in front of us. Perfect way to enjoy the street scene. The service was good but they never rushed us.Show less

Author: Kotuku20
Title: Nice place
Review: This is a great place to just sit down with a bucket of cold tigers and watch the day go by. Music and atmosphere were good and the staff were attentive without being annoying.

Author: balibari
Title: Nice pub / restaurant with a terrasse
Review: Nice place for food, drinks and cocktails. Drinks are rather expensive if you compare with other drinking places in Melaka, but you have good quality drinks for your money.

Author: Travelicious_KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Love this place
Review: This was our first stop once we got to Jonker Street and we loved every minute of our time here. Although it was a hot day, the place is cooling with good ventilation. It's an open cafe, but the air conditioning keeps you cool and the best thing to go with this is a nice chilled beer or cider! The staff were also very friendly and attentive. Too bad we didn't get the opportunity to go back for one last beer before leaving Malacca.Show less

Author: RoscoeHR
Title: Great place for a drink
Review: Set right in the heart of things this is an open aired oasis in the tropical heat of midday Melaka. Solid food, with their own unique twists. There is a note on the menu explaining their philosophy on food, lots of vegetarian, no beef and no pork.It's the joint to go after you have had a wonder and feel like a refreshment. Show less

Author: KlokaniPattaya, Thailand
Title: Jonker Street watering hole
Review: You wont find another place like this in Jonker street. Nice street corner under cover outdoor seating, a nice place to sit and relax after battling the markets. The beer is cold, the staff friendly and attentive and the atmosphere is just right. Beware the live entertainment though, can be pretty bad. Other than that, I don't think you can go wrong.Show less

Author: mark cWest Yorkshire, United Kingdom
Title: superb food, cold beer, quirky building and awesome value
Review: Halfway down Jonkers Street this famous cafe is just perfect for a relaxing meal or beer.for my wife and 3 and year old Satay, popiah, spring rolls, lovely chips and a small curry shared with a few cold beers was just 100 RM (20 quid). The building is lovely, the music was cool and the service Malaysian. Friendly and sporadic. Overall though, a great place to watch the world go by.Show less

Author: ThibautT_13Kortrijk, Belgium
Title: Food wasn't nice
Review: We had lunch here and the food ( Chicken cashew nuts with rice) was really disappointing. The chicken was very dry, the sauce was tasteless and the riced was really overcooked. I'm not a difficult eater (have been eating in SE Asia as a backpacker for the last 5 months), but this dish was really one of the worst I've had! For the price we've paid, you would expect a better quality dish. On the other hand, the service was good and quick. I can imagine this is a good place to drink (looks nice) but the food wasn't good. My girlfriend had a sandwich and that was OK but nothing special.Show less

Author: ChlvaKuala Lumpur
Title: Poor hospitality and not child friendly.
Review: It was my 1st visit to Jonker Street with my friend and our families. After tired walking up and down of Jonker Street, we wanted to have some drink and our kids wanted to eat ice cream. We decided to drop by at Geographer Café, but we were very disappointed with service that was rendered to us. 1. My 3yrs kid was holding the salt bottled and the waitress who took our order just grabbed the bottle from my kid’s hand.2. They billed us and we paid for the drinks and ice cream. But they did not serve the ice cream until we ask them.3.The same waitress was putting long face during the whole evening.4.And the worse to come...my friend’s 2yrs son wanted to go to toilet. They mopped the floor and he had to step and go to toilet. The same waitress told my friend in a very rude manner to control his kid.I think she have problem with kids. If they don't like kids they should just put notice that kids are not allowed. We have complaint to the Cafe manager and she was defending her worker. So if you are planning to go this place, please don't bring along your kids. And also please remind them your order otherwise you will pay but would not get your order.Show less

Author: Bettens1976
Title: Nice spot
Review: We went for lunch. The food was good and the service diligent. We had spring rolls, chicken satay, fried rice and chicken wings, with beer and coconut juice for drinks. The music was good (western music) and nice atmosphere.

Author: BelindaCarvalho
Title: MO-JI-TOs
Review: Dine there and had a couple of drinks, they have the excellent mojitos in town! Good enviroment :) Just the service was a bit slow

Author: Jaidey123
Title: Cool place with live music
Review: Beer is a tad expensive, but this is the case all over Malaysia with high tax on alcohol. However the live music is great, staff are nice and it's right on Jonker Street next to the night market.

Author: vicbruinSan Jose, California
Title: Tourists watching tourists
Review: The Geographer's Cafe must be mentioned in just about every tourist's book and has become a tourist attraction itself. Quite a lot of tourists indeed, most, it seems, sitting in the outside area enjoying the sunny weather (or the rain!) and watching other tourists pass by. The ambiance was quite joyous, but the food experience not that much. Lots of choices, but not tasty at all. I had nonya curry chicken and it was so so. Very slow (and unenthusiastic) service. Live music in some evenings. If you must, sit outside, order a drink and some fried egg rolls, and enjoy the people watching.Show less

Author: EenilanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The lovely place
Review: Geographer Cafe is a must place to be when you are visiting Melaka. It is place which so awesome to be and also excellent place for a great Rock n roll Music. I was there for my friend's birthday on March. Despite they are so busy and full house they managed to arrange a small birthday cake for my friend shart at 12am and sing a birthdsay song. That was simply amazing of them.The food in geographer bar are more to western and local dishes. Nice and great food. You also can get some delicates from the night market which will be every Friday till Sunday to eat with your drinks. Definitely it is a must place for me to go when I am in Melaka again.Show less

Author: JomtienJimmyJomtien
Title: Wonderful Atmosphere
Review: We arrived at this restaurant at approximately 7.30 pm and stayed until 11.30 pm. The atmosphere was absolutely brilliant mainly because, luckily, we went on a Monday evening when a first class jazz/standard singer and her band were playing. The hours just flew by and we visited again the next evening and although there was no live act, the background music was very acceptable. The food was good. The only down side was that some of the seating was backless stools which can become uncomfortable after 4 hours!!!Show less

Author: vd1914
Title: Good food, slow service
Review: The food is good, but some items on the menu are clearly overpriced and not worth ordering - their vegetable soup comes in such a small bowl that I thought it was a joke.Another downside is that you may have to wait for a looong time for your food, even when the restaurant isn't full. Slow cook or lazy staff?Show less

Author: ReytaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good Food, Good Atmosphere, and Worthy
Review: Within only 2 days stays at Melaka, I had dinner and lunch there.Place was good, food was tasty, price was very affordable, and people were kind.Though their service a lil' bit slow (I guess due to many of customers) and they only have 2 restrooms (queue can be quite long), I like the scenery.Their homemade slice cake was delicious, banana and yoghurt.Show less

Author: Suunytimes
Title: Great location and good food
Review: Loved it here, great place to have a beer and people watch, went back in evening meal, food really good and reasonably priced.

Author: PLPKNMexico, Missouri
Title: Surprisingly enjoyable!
Review: We didn't really fancy this place as it looked really 'western' and touristy but thought we'd give it a try on our last day and were pleasantly surprised - both our meals were delicious and the fresh spring rolls are awesome!Decent happy hour on buckets of Tiger and plenty of people watching to be done too!Show less

Author: SidFiddlerMacclesfield, United Kingdom
Title: Style over substance
Review: the building looks impressive from the street with tables outside filled with tourists you cant help being drawn in. inside the dark wooden floor creates a modern clean first impression.4 of us went for lunch and tried the jonker fried rice (chicken satay and fried rice), mango Thai chicken and Asam pedas (mackerel in spicy sauce with rice).The Asam pedas was ok, there was no sign of mango with the thai chicken & the sauce uninspiring and the satay was terrible - the peanut sauce tasting more like candy floss! The portions were small (fortunately?!) particularly for the relatively high price. Even the drinks (fresh juice) didnt have the flavour and sweetness normally experienced in Malaysia. By far the worst meal we have had in Malaysia. Fortunately there are plenty of great places to eat in the rest of Jonker street and beyond.Show less

Author: alexsfish
Title: Always A Favourite
Review: The place to see, to observe, and be entertained with the live band, the beverages and the sights around the night market.

Author: boskiIsland of Malta, Malta
Title: Its OK - possible over rated
Review: This place has the potential to be so much better than it is, it has the central location and the old world charm, I would not say its spotless and comfortable, its a bit rough around the edges The staff seem to be lethargic - from start of visit to the end- maybe its too hot for them!!!We had drinks only taking the advice from other travellers that the food was not so great What a shame we would have spent alot more time there if we could have been assured of a better timeShow less

Author: BradJill THong Kong, China
Title: Geographer Cafe - Nice stop for drinks and a break from the heat!
Review: We had a lunch at the Geographer Cafe just off Jonker Street during our recent trip to Malacca, repeating a visit we made here 7 or 8 years ago. The cafe is well designed and decorated, offering a nice environment for those seeking a drink or meal. There is mist being sprayed, fans to help cool you off and its all shade so you can get out of the sun. As for lunch, we tried the Veg. Nasi Lemak (RM6.90), Jonker Fried Rice (RM13.50) and the Tempeh Curry (RM5.50) as they were each listed as chef specialities. All dishes were just ok, being a bit blander than we prefer. Would have enjoyed a bit more spice or at least a side of chili sauce or oil to perk up the dishes a bit. In the end, the food wasn't bad but not great either, just standard meals (rating 3 of 5). For drinks, we had a very good Sour Plum LIme (RM9.90) and a nice cup of Malacca Coffee (RM3), both were pretty good (rating 3.5 of 5). In the end, the drinks were better than the food. The atmosphere was enjoyable, making this a fun place to stop if its too hot or you need a break while on Jonker Street. We'd definitely come back for a drink stop at Geographers Cafe but would probably take our meals elsewhere next time.Show less

Author: QuaySmithTravellers
Title: Good for lunch
Review: Decided against dinner here the previous evening. We returned for a simple lunch the following day. It was decent without being spectacular. The menu is pretty limited and I'm not sure I'd go for anything other than a drink in the evening.

Author: edithBE
Title: Nice café to have your breakfast
Review:
Nice café with a terrace outside! Staff a bit slow, but you will have a great choice of different coffees and breakfast possibilities.
However a bit overpriced!

Author: rotten03Berkeley, California
Title: Awful food good place for a beer
Review: The first thing you will notice when you arrive is everyone beers, no one has food. That's because the food is awful. They could not get Nasi Lamak correct, what chance is there for the Western food? My wife got Curry soup and I got curry fried rice. Both dishes were possibly the worst thing I have ever put in my mouth. Go for the location and go for the beer but for God's Sakes don't order food. It's so bad it's offensive.Show less

Author: Kerry W
Title: comfortable for western travellers
Review: This is a place which has local and western food. Great range of drinks and good price. Very good location to watch people.

Author: wolejko-wolejszoBerlin, Germany
Title: Great spot to meet international people
Review: This spot is a traveller spot like you can see in the name. They serve great food and have excellent WiFi here. They have different areas down- and upstairs. You can sit here work, look at crossing people on the JonkerStreet. Must Been Place. Sometimes the music is horrible. One day they played Elvis all over so take your earphones with you to switch. But the most days it was ok.Show less

Author: Tania MManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Full of tourists, but great satay!
Review: We went here because we saw good reviews online. I dont know what the big deal is - an average cafe catering for tourists. We ordered some beer and cocktails (made v well, though slightly pricey at 18-28 rgt each). We had some satay which was really nice and recommended. The service is average - for instance, I waited for the toilets for 10 minutes before finding out that a code was needed. Even then, it was a squat toilet (only a urinal for men, no toilet). You can use the loo for 30 cents if you dont dine. There are several tvs around the venue with a video of people dancing in the bar at night (badly!) on a loop. The outdoor parts face the roads but are in the shade which is good for cooling down in the heat.Overall, glad had a nice time but nothing out of the ordinary!Show less

Author: John L
Title: At least it is open...
Review:
Jonkers on a wendesday night seems quite dead! The geographer isopen great musique great selection of drinks and the food was also very good. Service was friendly and efficient by malay standards.
Really just sit down listen and enjoy...relax!

Author: willjones6
Title: Great Cafe
Review:
Perfect location.  Good food and cold beers.
Fun place to stop in and meet people from all over the world.

Author: MarcinBujoKatowice, Poland
Title: Great Food;)
Review: Me and my Lovely wife stayed in Melaka for 3 days,and been eating in Geographer Cafe almost everyday,food was very tasty,we have tried spring rolls,both fresh and the cook ones,chicken satay,NASI LEMAK,and few another's dishes,all of them were delicious!!!Place it's self is in heart of China Town,and the nice look inside,i know is sound wierd actually reminds us of some places in South America:) they played Latin music,when we were there,we really liked that ;)))One small minus is that we been waiting for food for while,but from other side,they prepared everything fresh;)B.u.J.o xxx ;()Show less

Author: Leilanijane
Title: Took forever to get one dish (but it was yummy!)
Review: It wasn't that busy when we came here for lunch and yet the one dish we ordered took AGES to get to us. However, the food (cashew nut chicken) was really tasty.

Author: Linda T
Title: Don't Bother Eating There
Review: We stopped there for lunch. Ordered the Straits Malacca Salad (or similar in name) and chicken satay. The salad dressing and peanut satay sauce were the same. The sauces were bland and tasteless. The salad itself would have been good with a good salad dressing. The chicken satay was dry and also bland and tasteless. I cook better satay using packaged spices. There were many people in the restaurant and that's why we decided to eat there. In hindsight, if we had paid attention the people were all tourists, that should have been our clue. Do not waste your money!!! The Night Market (Friday - Sunday nights) was far superior and cheaper.Show less

Author: flyingbear76Singapore, Singapore
Title: Just an average place...
Review: Guess what, I was there 3 times in a day but I'm unable to give a great review... Only a average one. The place is great because of it location. Located at the center of Jonker Street, and you just keep passing by. They provide free usage of internet thru wifi. I must agree they have a great selection of alcohol which i like.You can have a choice of western, Mediterranean and Asian food but average taste with average price. Slow service, maybe they are short of stuff like many other places. Show less

Author: phuketexpat35asia
Title: good hangout for beer/food
Review: food is a bit westernised i think, but really tasty none the less and no worries of a dodgy stomach! its very central to the bars at the w/e and is the place to people watch for sureShow less

Author: shriikantMumbai, India
Title: live music, great atmosphere, good not great food
Review: This cafe is right on Jonker Street. Came here after reading recommendations on tripadvisor and lonely planet. They play live music which is quite average. The food is average too. It is a nice place to have drinks though. They have all international beers and Tiger beer, decent range of juices and smoothies. The atmosphere is quite nice as it is semi open air with view of the street. In the night, they put tables right on the street !Show less

Author: jpk186240Penzance, United Kingdom
Title: The worst meal
Review: We were on our first night in Melaka and wandered into Jonker Street only to find everything was closed, including restaurants - except for Geographer's Cafe, so ended up having to eat here. Didn't look promising since it tries to be a western type bar/cafe which is exactly not what we came to Malaysia to experience. However, ordered vegetarian mee hoon. The portion was pathetically small, very boring looking with a bit ot lettuce as garnish!!! very un- Malaysian, and half way through we realised there was some very gristly meat in the dish too. The whole thing was flavourless - even with meat in it! Grim. To top it all, the cost of that plate was more than double any other meal we had during the whole holiday, so felt decidedly ripped off. I showed the waiter the meat in the dish, and he didn't seem interested, nor did he offer to reduce the bill, and I was too tired to argue about it. Geographer Cafe experience was the only bad one we had throughout our holiday. Cannot understand why there are so many good reviews of this place.Show less

Author: Jurgen COostende Belgium
Title: Nice place for (only) a drink
Review: We had some drinks and small food at this place. The drinks (juices) were excellent. I did not order any beer but they are serving some good international beers as well (Leffe, Weissbeer, Hoegaarden).But the food had no tast; the satay and the sauce was not so good, the tempeh had no tast. Only the springrolls were acceptable.But you get a lot of food for your money. We had a bill of 70RM and we had one Sprite, four juices and four plates of finger food (tempeh, a soup, spring rolls and satay).Good music being played from both the band in this bar as the band from the opposite bar.So I would recommand the place only to have a drink and chill out in the evening.Show less

Author: Smollett
Title: Relaxing
Review: Cool place to hang out on a hot day. Spring rolls veggie style are first rate coupled with tempeh. Quench your thirst with a tall glass of sour plum juice.

Author: david_s82german_in_singapore
Title: Top for people watching
Review: This Cafe located right smack in the centre of Jonker Walk is perfect for people watching at night when the streets come alive. The live band is pretty awful, but thankfully the live band in the bar across the street is great and the two cafe's swap 'airtime' every half hour or so.. Show less

Author: louse09Ireland
Title: Nothing to write home about!
Review: Very busy there and I think there are too many tables squashed to the outdoor seating area. I ordered spring rolls but was told they were 'finished.' it was only 4.30pm! I had the fresh vegetable rolls which were good; tasty and different. I also had the pesto pasta which is not pesto at all! Yes, it's spaghetti and yes it's green but it's definitely not pesto! I think it was a parsley type sauce. We shared some wedges which were good and had two ok-ish fruit juices. A pleasant enough experience but nothing fantastic.Show less

Author: ClerkenwellLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Useful pit stop in the middle of Jonkers
Review: We inadvertantly ended up here on three occasions during our weekend in Melaka. It is in the middle on Jokers, so it set up perfectly to serve you a cool Heiniken when you are bored of shopping and people watching.There is an international menu. They have a number of local dishes too. I had sate and my partner had soup; both very acceptible without earning any awards.Show less

Author: IcedNyior
Title: Place to rest your feet at Jonker
Review: Stopped by here for a drink after walking around Jonker. Had a few cocktails and beers with mates. Its location is nice for people watching but it can get a bit noisy

Author: Arthur M
Title: Great place for a drink, a snack or a meal
Review: Great atmosphere in this totally restored old building where you can enjoy food or a drink and watch the world go by.  Staff were sometimes busy, but were always helpful and friendly

Author: Ryan T
Title: Foreign workers woes
Review: Went there for a drink.. Ordered a jug... Later wanted to check the waiter to where can change order.. Ask about the promotion tower that was available... The waiter seem not to understand what we were trying to tell them... The communication was very poor. By the time he understands us the jug were already half ready... The waiter should promote their promotion tower instead of taking orders...Show less

Author: Sharp-LifeHornsea, United Kingdom
Title: reasonable, fun and consistent
Review: enjoyed eating here and returned 3 times! The staff were nice, we enjoyed the food with lots of choice. Cheapest ( good) bottle of wine we've had eating out in Malaysia! Satay was excellent and the vegetarian curry very tasty! Would recommend for morning coffee, afternoon happy hour and light evening dinner.Show less

Author: Buck1957
Title: Great location to watch the world go by
Review: Vegetarians will love the location and choice of dishes available .Service with a smile by the fantastic staff nothing is too much .Fantastic mojitos. We had to visit it once a day at least.

Author: jetsetqueen54321Sydney
Title: good atmosphere
Review: went there mainly becoz nothing else is open at night on the entire jonker Street!!! starving and had to go to this place. it was ok. service attentive. price a bit expensive. food tasted so so. if i manage to find something else I probably wouldn't have eaten at this geographer cafe. but its not bad. just not extremely fantastic. Show less

Author: arianna47Vienna, Austria
Title: good vegetarian food in a lovely spot
Review: the geographer is located on the corner of the busy old city in melaka. good location to watch people. they have several vegetarian dishes, which is not that easy to find here and they're well made and tasty. maybe better to go when it's not too busy, otherwise they may forget your order:-)....Show less

Author: Kalai_holiday_junkie
Title: wide selection
Review: The selection of dishes was varied from thai, chinese, and Malay. The price was also resonable but you could get the same dishes on Jonker street at the fraction of the cost.

Author: Mark M
Title: Food is better quality than the service
Review: Good food with decent pricing. You have to flag down the wait staff whenever you need something, including your main dish in the event that they forget or the kitchen gets backed up.

Author: Raji77Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Good food and great service
Review: The food here is very good and the prices are reasonable. We were weary from our sight seeing around the area and ready for a big meal. I had a very tasty vegetarian laksa and some really good chicken satay. The location is great to watch the busy Jonker Street activity while you have your meal.Show less

Author: mc_nex
Title: Great place to chill
Review: Great place to have a drink and chill out. There is a live band at night, nice oldies song. Drinks are great, lots of choices, from juices to selection of international beers

Author: SherylFrancesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Place for Drinks
Review: The Mojito was excellent and the beer selection was pretty good. It was a great place to be at on a Saturday night to people watch. But look out for the one-man band who mumbles the songs and pretends to play the guitar - he was awful. The computer plays all the songs and he just acts like he is singing. A customer requested to sing Hotel California, she took the mike and she did a pretty good job. So in short, thumbs up for drinks, service and ambience. Thumbs down if u want great vocals to entertain.Show less

Author: Wonderland LSingapore
Title: 2nd times visited but still love here!
Review: Love the ambience with live band, aunties are dancing for entertaining the guests, location is great too!We ordered the Mojito but could have the lycee Mojito will be great! Love the satay sauce which made with pineapple and feeling very refreshing.The vegetable salad rolls are the plus to enhance health life!Overall: eat.drink.listen!Show less

Author: fleecemeCoromandel Peninsula, New Zealand
Title: A bit of the norm !!
Review: A bit of the norm if that what by our looking for, all types of food and beer/cocktails, the price is slightly higher than most cafes but this is well situated on Jonker Street and has a real nice vibe about it, the staff and service are good. Kilkenny and Guinness on tap!Show less

Author: Robyn MSherwood Park, Canada
Title: Awesome Salads!!
Review: After travelling for a few months and feeling like I couldn't eat out any more, I came across Geographer's. I am a vegetarian and majorly craving raw veggies, and I fed my craving here!! Awesome variety; I had a hard time choosing. Everything I got was great, the service was good, the music was loud.Show less

Author: Alan-HoldenPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Heart of the town
Review: I have been here several times and always had a good time. Beer is cheap enough and plentiful. Live music, though, is the main reason I come here. Burns and his band are great.I've been noticing a few bad reviews about the food here and somewhat have to agree. The quality and taste are not what they could/should be and I was quite disappointed at the recently advertised Christmas set dinner; Fresh Garden salad seems to be a plate of lettuce, and Fish and Chips is hardly seasonal.Show less

Author: SH12345_12
Title: good place, best location
Review: we had dinner here and were just in the middle of the Night Market, perfect for watching people and having a very nice meal at very reasonable prices

Author: residentwphnom penh
Title: Great locaation & building
Review: Not sure if this is a fair revue as some of the drunken & noisy self centered English preppy kid customers made it a bit of a nightmare! The location is fab for people watching & atmospheer, food was good but is not explained very well on the menu. Staff were not doing a great job & then we actually had to ask for our change...they EXPECTED to keep it a as tip..not impressed I am in the Service Industry myself...tips are earned!Show less

Author: astra
Title: Good food and atmosphere
Review: We ate here twice. The food is very good and the drinks are great. Good value for money meal. It is located on a corner so grab a table near the street to watch the passing traffic.

Author: LoveLuxury2Kirton in Lindsey, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, ok food
Review: Great place to people watch and soak up the atmosphere. That is the prime reason for going hereHave been twice - service is variable. Our dishes arrived several minutes apart even though we only ordered 2. Had to ask for our coffees twice before they arrived. Service is pretty slow. Food is reasonable and very cheap.The live music was awful - out of tune and poor quality. The live band from the Ringo Bar across the way is much better. Fortunately they alternated sets so you could here the good stuff.Show less

Author: Guni88
Title: Nice atmosphere...food so so
Review: Nice atmosphere but if u r looking for a cooling place. U may forget about it. The air con is not working well. We thought outside is warm, inside is worst. Hot n stuffy. Food wise so so. Nothing great. Show less

Author: LostpatrolPenrith, United Kingdom
Title: Waiters
Review: Watch out for the waiters when paying your bill.They are concealing any notes in your change beneath the receipt in the hope you will just take or leave any coins.This happened to me three times last night even when I pointed it out I was on to them.Show less

Author: LIM C
Title: That's I call Melaka !
Review:
Just groove with the music and the atmosphere once you are there!
The singer from the pub opposite is better and you have both by just pay for one! Must visit Jonker Street and stop by either these 2 friendly pubs in Melaka!

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: The food is just so-so
Review: The place has a nice and happening location at a corner of Jonker Street. Looks quite cosy and inviting, especially with the Christmas trees up and music playing. Been there several times; it's OK for drinks and as a meeting place but the food is pretty average.Show less

Author: SurreyGirl27Addlestone, United Kingdom
Title: WOW
Review: The best chicken satay I expetrienced in malaysia, the peanut sauce woudl be marketable in its own right. Sit downstairs during the day and make the time to read all the souvenirs and signs on the wall. well worth having a dinner upstairs in the evening poverviewing Jonker Street. Fabulous staff and so helpful with their recommendations of where to go. One small critiism is the bathroom need updating and stocks replenshing (take loo roll!)Show less

Author: SamST80Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great place to chill
Review: We caame across this cafe while walking along jonker street... its the perfect place just to chill and relax after a tiring day of walking...you can just sit down and just watch the world pass by...its a corner cafe along jonker street....music all night long... You will like it if you like oldies.. Found a very nice butter pineapple tart store just opposite geographer... Cute cube shape...though its expensive.. Luckily its only for my personal consumption...:DShow less

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Bad service
Review: Came here after massage , it was in the afternoon at 5 pm , Monday . The waiter was slow and we call them they don't acknowledge us , we got to stand up and call the waiter to serve us drinks , it wasn't busy that day .. I know this place would be crowded during evening time as it's situated in a good location in jonker street . This place you can smoke as Melaka is declared smoke free .. If the authorities caught you smoking on this street you would be fine rm 500. Overall just had some glasses of beer to chill and people watch . Show less

Author: Roberto-Singapore
Title: Relaxing evening........
Review:
The music is nice and the patrons are friendly.
Atmosphere is good and really relaxing just for a drink and watching people along this busy street on a weekend !

Author: Islandgal09Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: I have been to Geographer's many times and unfortunately was very disappointed with the service and the "live band"I have always felt that the food is good at this joint coupled with the atmosphere. Last Saturday I was there with a friend and was not happy with the service we received. We ordered food and drinks, my friend had 3 beers... one hour into our time there, the waiter came with the bill. We were surprised as we had not call for the bill and were enjoying our conversation. The comment from the waiter was its Cash on Delivery on Friday and Saturday?? Like I said we were already there an hour, it felt that they were rushing us out of the place. I called the supervisor and he repeated the same thing... By the way there were many empty tables in the room behind the glass door.The resident band was also disappointing, the singer at least. I think retirement is beckoning for him. He was off beat ,used a computer for the background music, attempted to play the keyboard and was mumbling most of the words. Boring!!We paid for the bill after the rude encounter with the wait staff and went across the road to Ringo cafe. Ringo was superb, his quality of music. He actually plays the guitar and sings!! True to the word live band! Ringo is only open on Fri & Saturday.Show less

Author: AquaMaria68Singapore
Title: Inconsistent
Review: We came here for brunch at about 11am. Not many options for brunch so ended up ordering satay, curry and rojak. The food was okay, coffee was quite good but warm, not hot.We decided to come back in the evening to have Apple Pie a la Mode for dessert on our way back from an Indian restaurant. The girl that served me could not get her head around a gin & tonic - she kept asking me what the mixer was... ummm, it's tonic! The drink took 15 minutes to arrive because she had to go and ask someone who finally worked it out!Meanwhile we waited more than 45 minutes for two Apple Pies. When they finally arrived it was a disgusting concoction of apple pieces floating in a runny apple puree in a glass. On top of the glass was a piece of microwaved store-bought roti. The waitress then proceeded to upturn the glass and tip the whole mess onto the plate. It was served with a knife and a spoon - not a spoon and fork as is correct for dessert. The roti was not cooked and it was soggy and fatty. There was an overdose of cinnamon in the apple and the apple pieces were not cooked properly.This would rate as one of the worst desserts I have ever been served in my life. My advice - stick to local food and forget about Apple Pie at The Geographer.Show less

Author: Ben SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Ended up eating here several times!
Review: This felt to us like the nicest bar and restaurant in Melaka - good service (although not all waiters poke good English) and a good theme to the place, with lots of greenery and water features. Food was good, beer was great, and it has a lovely chilled out atmosphere.Show less

Author: davidh136London, United Kingdom
Title: It's for tourists
Review: But having said that, the choices in Malake are pretty limited. It's a prime location on the corner, and good for beers and cocktails etc. and does ok juices too. Haven't eaten there and probably won't do either, but been twice for drinks. A little pricey for Malaysia, but still affordable and as I said, choices are thin here.Show less

Author: LilleePilleePerth, Australia
Title: No apple pie!
Review: A very busy restaurant on Jonker Street. We were eager to try the apple pie after reading a recommendation in Lonely Planet - only to be told that they had run out at 1 pm! My husband asked for the Lime - Plum drink - that too had run out. Oh well settled for coconut juice - in the shell and some icecream to cool down. Service was fairly prompt, lots of interesting dishes coming out, and the cleanliness didn't seem an issue.Show less

Author: Lynda F
Title: Good location
Review: The location of this cafe is excellent but the food and drinks are overpriced.  It is worth sitting here for a drink on a Friday or Saturday night just to people watch but there are many better places to eat.

Author: Calkel_1999Singapore
Title: The most prominent hangout at Jonker area
Review: Good ol bar set in the old street. It is either here or along the river. The alley was closed due to Oktoberfest. So i believed that this place has always been earmarked for this festival.Will return and be there earlier. Closed abt 0030hr on Friday.Show less

Author: manasicajeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Something for everyone
Review: A lot of choices for the whole family. Our three kids can be fussy eaters, but we found something delicious for each of them... plus the adults had very nice meals with local flavour.The location is fantastic, right in the heart of buzzing Melaka... and the building is nice too. Show less

Author: Drew BMandurah
Title: great little pub
Review: Right on the corner where you can sit and have quiet drink whilst the better half wanders the shops and then meet up for a quick bite. The street at the side closes at night and they set up eating areas so no probems finding something to eat.Show less

Author: t83ahlu
Title: nice decoration cafe & restaurant at a good corner in Jonker Street~
Review:
nice atmosphere & design cafe,if u go on weekday ll be nice than weekend~
I like it's old decoration.
sometimes still meet live band,enjoy beer together in a great environment~

Author: Geoff WSydney, Australia
Title: Slow down and watch
Review: A great place to sit and watch the world go bye – particularly if your wife is shopping on Jonker Street. I visited this bar / cafe last year and I am sorry to say the food is going down hill. That aside, I did enjoy just sitting and watching and unlike some other reviewers I never had a problem getting service.Show less

Author: idurdag
Title: Good vegetarian options
Review: Food was good, many waiters but noone looking at customers....Many vegetarian options. It was shady and seating was outside which was a good angle for people watching.

Author: crazylass
Title: Touristy but great Margarita!
Review: Great location to sit and watch the world go by, and good cocktails with prompt service. A bit loud at the weekend, as locals belting out karaoke hits plays on loudspeakers round the bar.

Author: sharonjaneliauSelangor
Title: More ice than juice!
Review: I've been to Melaka so many times and I know that this place is always packed, so just recently I managed to sit down after walking around jongker street night market and ordered a simple 'Mix Juice' from their menu with my buddy to quench our thirsts. Once placing our orders I reminded the waiter for less ice in both our drinks.When the drinks served, I could only taste water and once we drank half, we noticed the ice covers 80% of the glass... Before we left we decided to address the matter to the staff and unfortunately the staff find it hard to understand and I feel doesn't give a damn about QC at all. We were given a complimentary juice to compensate for their mistake.However when we were leaving, a floor manager came and started to harass us by saying 'you're not allowed to complain after you finish the drinks... you need to complain before that' - (if we don't drink it, how can we know how it taste? how do we know how much ice they put in?). He added 'It's normal for us to put so much ice in our juice...' ' there's so many people to serve here...' (what the??) - I felt as we were accused for addressing the issue.Even though it's just a simple juice, they already failed in so many ways... can't imagine myself going back there again... such a pity.Show less

Author: Matthew F
Title: Great atmosphere, bad food
Review: Great location. Great vibe. But the service was terrible, and the food the height of mediocrity. We ordered four menu items. Only two arrived. The imported "German" fries were tasty but oil-logged and soggy. (And the ketchup wasn't Heinz, but some kind of spoiled-tasting local witch's brew.) The mango Thai chicken tasted more like mango Thai fish... and communicating that it needed to be sent back proved quite a chore. All in all: AVOID. Show less

Author: GordieReidMelbourne, Australia
Title: Food quality has gone way down
Review: This was my 4th visit to Malacca and dining at the Geographer's. First was 2008, then 09, 11 and now August 2012. I think they must have a new chef as the food quality is now quite lousy in comparison. I always order the Fragrant Rice dish which used to be exactly that, fragrant and with lots of various things on the plate. This time the rice was not fragrant at all. It was pale yellow and no hint of the spices they used. The sides with it were dried up bits of cucumber and the beancurd skin was oily and tastless. My partner ordered the Assam Pedas Fish and being a Malaysian, he thought the fish was tiny,old and the okra was very old too. The other gripe was the music. It was so loud this time. We always sit inside so I know the music level. It was lunch time so loud music while trying to chat was too much. We asked the waitress if it could be turned down and she replied "The boss likes it loud because noisy outside". In my opinion and based on several previous visits, the Geographer's cafe has had its day. The new look menu reflected its lesser quality. The attitude with the music was too much too. There are other places in the area with a similar ambience so Geographer's need to lift their game and return to the quality of food they were well known for.Show less

Author: shobieeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food so-so, atmosphere, perfect!
Review: It's a pretty big cafe in Jonker, can't miss it. The ambience here at night is pretty awesome. You have live music and the food's alrite, nothing to shout about. But the service is good, prices are average, and most of all, i liked the 'chill out' factor this place had. Yea, i'd go back there in an instant. Show less

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ...delicious,mouth watering generous portions of goodness....
Review: ...was at this cafe with parents last month after our trip to Seremban,and happened to drop by here for lunch/tea...though we have been past this cafe so many times it always appeared crowded and we never had a fair chance to dine there,at least now i know why :o)Anyhow,i had coffee and cheesecake which was the ultimate perfection tho i wud have preffered more variety of cakes to indulge in,mum had some noodles and dad had something called Straits of Melaka which was "gado-gado" and it came in a huge portion.I had ordered chicken "satay" too and beleive me it was the best meaty delight i have ever had.The portions were huge and we cudn't finish even if we kept stuffing ourselves there was some left behind.Nevertheless,it was a sumptious meal and every item was tasty and delicious,definitely worth visiting and chowing down here.Hope to drop by again and enjoy another meal here the next time i visit,till then the mouthwatering goodies will have to wait for me.Please visit this place,and make sure you're starving so that you can keep eating to your brim and no food is wasted.Its a sure treat guarantee all the way for food lovers!!Show less

Author: chingching70Singapore, Singapore
Title: relax place
Review: This restaurant is located along Jonker Street, they provided nice vegetarian food. It is nice and cool to sit upstair watching people walking along the night market on Saturday night.It is a very relaxing place to drink and listen to their live band. The negative about this cafe is their server is very slow. Overall still a good place to mingle around.Show less

Author: Eryza I
Title: Halal food! :)
Review: i'm glad to found this restaurant because it's kind of hard for me to find halal food at jonker walk area because that place wasn't familiar for me. The food was awesome! it also have unique interior decoration~ must visit! eating and chillin'~ :)

Author: 850tommCloghran, Ireland
Title: World-beating vegetarian food but patchy service
Review: It is unusual to find a non-vegie restaurant serving great veggie food but this place is a wonder. Truly some of the best food I have ever eaten. I had the Lontong, a glutinous rice in a curry soup with perfecrly cooked vegetables. I had the tempeh with curry leaves on the side and am still savouring the taste. This is very obviously a tourist restaurant, live music, high tables at the street where you can watch life go by. That said it is far from typical in terms of the quality of both the food and the entertainment, a Chinese singer with a great voice. Downside was that my wife's food was extremely slow in coming. My wife's glares notwithstanding the atmosphere was sparkling.Show less

Author: pixie-alex
Title: It is a very relaxing place
Review: I love this place. The food is nice and the beer is cool and cheap and it is in the middle of the town. Easy breeeezy

Author: vzeraphinal
Title: A reminder of the States
Review: Situated along Jonker Walk, it's perfect for people watching on weekends when the night market opens. It's a sound reminder of like places in the US.Tried the coconut Tom Yum soup as the picture was interesting. It turned out lukewarm, average tasting and not spicy enough. We were rather disappointed. My sister was disappointed with the organic coconut juice as it was not chilled and it did not taste fresh. My father was disappointed with the frozen margarita as it tasted diluted and had too much salt on the rims. Felt that it wasn't value for money. Had the organic peppermint tea, my mother and I enjoyed it very much. The iced version was not sweet at all. We recommend this, especially when you're tired out from all that walking and jostling in the heat. Iced water is chargeable at 50 cents per glass by the way so either go for their drinks or bring your own water bottles.Service was pretty good actually. We were carrying too many bags of foodstuff, the waiter offered us extra stools to hold up our bags. He even told us that we were allowed to order the fried radish cake from the guy in front of our seats and consume it at our table (located on the sidewalk). Very nice of him.Would come back for teabreak and to people watch. Show less

Author: deekay99
Title: Great Colonial feel
Review:
We sat for an iced coffeee a few times. Reasonably priced. Great corner location. You could watch the world go by.
Busy at night.

Author: Vaidehi2012San Francisco, California
Title: Think Twice
Review: Went to this place with family on a Tuesday afternoon, at 1:30 pm. Placed our orders and waited and waited and ..... We got our drinks in 10 minutes, but our food never came and we waited for more than an hour. Though we were told that they were busy and we will have to wait for 30 minutes when we first went in, the worst part was our order was completely forgotten by the server who took our order and it was never passed down to the kitchen! We asked three waiters and finally a talk with the lady at the cashiers brought our appetizer to our table. We then had to wait another 20 minutes before we were served with insipid tempeh, FROZEN naan and vegetable curry!! Verdict: There are definitely better places to go. I recommend this place only if you want a drink. Positive point is its location, but there are other excellent, inexpensive options, with tastier food and much, much better service.Show less

Author: BabyGenie88
Title: Nice environment, food is ok
Review: tried the chicken chop and the coconut drinks. the environment is good and the location is strategic since it is in the middle of the jonker street. take a cup of drink and watching the street view, quite relaxing~

Author: HongKongDayzee
Title: Delicious food but so-so service
Review: Although the restaurant was quite busy, the service was fair, only because I probably expected friendlier faces and smiles. The food was good and well presented. Restaurants in such a prime location must be careful not to get too relaxed with service standards.

Author: Bethany W
Title: Good food - be prepared to wait
Review: Some excellent vegetarian dishes of Malaysian favorites.  The atmosphere is fun, and there is a good beer selection.  Service was really, really slow.

Author: Witte_Aap
Title: Great atmosphere, but overpriced
Review: The atmosphere is great with live music on Monday night. I don't quite understand why the music is inside while everybody logically sits outside. Interesting place with quality food and drinks, but overpriced and overrun with tourists.

Author: Michael Z
Title: Popular Tourist restaurant For Westerners
Review: Loud music, expensive beer, crowded and there are few locals.  Typical west-style tourist food - Pass it up for a local Malaysian or Chinese reataurant unless you want a cold beer.

Author: EileenaLeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wifii has been down since March 2011
Review: Nice place to people watch. Overpriced drinks.Wifii is non-existent even tho it reflects full-bar on my iPhone. It's been down since Mar 2012, fix it please!Show less

Author: whowesit
Title: A great place to people watch.
Review: This is a great meeting place with reliable service. It opens early and is open until late.

Author: peteandchris46Hartlepool
Title: Poor service, very expensive
Review: Visited the Geographer on a lunchtime. Although it wasn't particularly busy, plenty of spare tables etc, we sat at our table for 15 minutes before being served, despite two visits to the bar trying to place our order. In the end we just settled for a very expensive Guinness and a soft drink. Menu for both food and drink looks very expensive. The place gives you the impression of a tourist trap. Don't think we will be using it again when we retune to Malacca.Show less

Author: FairyFarinaKL
Title: Friendly and Reasonably Price Cafe
Review: I visited this cafe on Monday night. Based on the website, Monday night was a Jazz night so I want to have my dinner whilst listening to a Jazz band. I thought it would be a lovely combination.I arrived around 6.45pm, a little bit too early as the show only starts at 8pm. I ordered portugese fish set and geographers cocktail. Both are lovely and the portugese fish was spicy! I had to order a sweet desert to subside the explosion in my mouth so I ordered vanilla ice cream with gula melaka. It was really really nice!As the performance started, I ordered fruity calamari and a few more drinks. The price of the drink menu is so cheap. However, I must say that the fried calamari was cut too thin and it turns to be more like a squid cracker.The next day I came back to have dinner again and this time I ordered bee hoon tom yum. It came in a huge bowl and it is full of vegies. Tho its delicious, I just couldn't finish it.I will surely return to this cafe whenever I'm in MalaccaShow less

Author: Cookiemonster171Knutsford, United Kingdom
Title: Nice cafe but squat toilets
Review: Lovely cafe for simple food and people watching. Serves draft Guinness. The girls weren't too fond of the squat toilets though.Show less

Author: 927MarcoBVillach, Austria
Title: A must-to-see pub in Melaka
Review: I’m a foreigner passing by Melaka from time to time in business trip and Melaka doesn’t offer that munch in the evening. The Geographer is a nice place for a beer and chatting with friends. I know it also works as restaurant but I never tried it. I assume it is closed from Sunday to Wednesday, but on Thursday the atmosphere is very nice and during the weekends it offer some live music shows.Show less

Author: Tebay2
Title: Good all around
Review: We stumbled upon this place after checking into our hotel. We are vegans and were happy to find a place with a veggie menu. Food, service and location are all great! Tom yam soup and fragrant rice were both good. There is night market Friday, Saturday and Sunday night make for good people watching.Show less

Author: Bill AArlington, Virginia
Title: Nice "Americanized" cafe
Review: You gotta have a love/hate feeling about places like this (and all tourist destinations have them) where the local cuisine has been repackaged just enough to be "easy" and comfortable to Western tourists. These places are always slightly more expensive but feel enough like home that they are subconsciously attractive. Geographer Cafe is no exception. Wonderful American "oldies" are played quite loudly from midday until late a night. Simple menu designed not to really challenge unadventurous, tourist palates but still give the illusion of being overseas. That said, I confess I had a nice latte and chicken sate here, but resisted the urge to keep playing it safe and happily ventured to other places (like Nancy's).Show less

Author: mrandmrsc2006
Title: busy cafe
Review: Nice little cafe but overpriced food ok but not wonderful entertainment at night ok

Author: AmascCambodia
Title: Popular bar and restaurant
Review: First impressions are great, Geographer is situated in a lovely building which has been beautifully adapted. Cool jazz plays in the background and there is a choice of indoor or outdoor seating. The staff are pretty attentive and the menu is interesting both in terms of what's on offer and what's written about the food. Food and drinks arrive promptly and are both pretty good, the broth in the curry ramen was amongst the best noodle accompaniments I've had. There's only one real complaint, the music. Not the style or the volume, just the recording. We visited twice and passed many times and it got to the stage where we could predict what the next song was going to be.Show less

Author: KLMysticKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good & healthy vegetarian food options!
Review: I visited this rest as their website shows that they've a vegetarian friendly menu & indeed personally for me the food was nice & price reasonable considering it was smack in the middle of so called tourist traps area i.e. Jonker Street. I had the Veggie Ramen, Veggie Rolls, Tom Yam rice vermicelli.Show less

Author: Dolphinjc75
Title: Nice Chillout w Live Band on Weekends
Review: I love to just sit by and have a drink with the live band performance ...

Author: Guelph_Dawn
Title: Good, healthy food
Review: Great place to eat lunch on Jonker Street.  The AC is a nice escape from the heat.  Lots of choices for food - focus on healthy food (no MSG, whole wheat noodles, etc).  They have a baby chair - yay!  Good fresh juice too.

Author: Globetrottergirls
Title: Excellent vegetarian options
Review: One of the few restaurants in Melaka that have a varied and good menu for vegetarians. Delicious Malaysian dishes - both non-veg and veg. Also great dessert and cake options - highly recommended!

Author: travelnbluesNSW
Title: Touristy, but good
Review: Yes, it's mostly tourists who eat here, but it's still good, if not slightly overpriced. It has a good vibe to it...good music, good people-watching location, just a good ambience. The food was good which was a plus and I could have easily just spent a few hours watching the world go by as the Latino music played in the background. If you're looking for cheap, go somewhere else...if you're looking for somewhere with a bit of character and good food, come here.Show less

Author: Gunnerdo
Title: Tourist cafe,
Review: This place is good for a cold drink, but they don't take a lot of care with the food. There are better places ( smaller) in the area with better product.

Author: Aberdeengirl
Title: An enjoyable experience
Review: Good location on a corner along Jonkers St. Lovely staff. Interesting menu of local foods. Good cocktails. Nice toilet which can be a problem in Malaysia! Great price. I think there may be music some evenings but not when we were there.

Author: Rosieapple123
Title: Great Restaurant/cafe
Review: The food was amazing in here, as a vegetarian i struggled in malaysia a little so was very happy to come across this place that had a fab selection of veggie and non veggie dishes! Great value highly recommend.

Author: Nbichick
Title: A touch of Class
Review: Lovely setting, caring and smiling service and a menu devised by somebody who really knows their food. No MSG, no saturated fats, only sea salt ; a good cross section for meat eaters and vegetarians alike.A pretty good selection of beers too - although Malaysian beer prices do rather sour the taste !Show less

Author: MelindaL893
Title: Best coffee
Review: Staff were kind enough to make me a great coffee before they were really open! We ate there twice. Good people watching location, fab food

Author: lordsidcup
Title: Good for a cocktail
Review: Popular with the tourists and always quite lively. Even open on tuesdays when almost everywhere is closed! Enjoyed their house cocktail same prices as anywhere else and food seems pretty good too.

Author: StephanessityKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My second home
Review: I love this place! The place was painted in a warmth earth yellow with some unpolished and seasonal edge and corners which reflects the gracious old charm ambient. Hanging out here always makes me feel back in the years. The place enhance it further by their selection of songs. They play cool jazz, smooth jazz, bossa nova, classical oldies, sometime doowoop, etc During the weekends starting at 9pm there will be an old local chap doing solo live on oldies and open for requested song (if he can deliver), that's where middle age couples will dance salsa or tango in the room and the crowd will be cheering. Saturday and Sunday will be the best time to visit. If prefer to have a little bit of quite, alone or private time. Try out the upstairs tables where you can have a window peak at the Jonker street and less crowd. If you aren't those dance club person, would like to just chill or spend quality time with your closest ones with nice tunes and ambient, this is the place.Show less

Author: TanWS_OM
Title: Terrible service
Review: Tried to get a seat but was told to go upstairs. No one heeded us so we left. Really poor service.

Author: love2cookandtravel
Title: best drinks and music venue
Review: We were staying just around the corner and this became our local!!! Extremely comfy and friendly local it is too

Author: tgwwgtTravelHermanus, South Africa
Title: Loved it, great music and great ambience
Review: The Geographer is situated on a busy corner of Jonker street. It is open sided allowing views of the street. It is decorated in shades of ochre and has great jazz on tap all day. We stopped n for something to drink and ended up sitting for about an hour or two just absorbing the atmosphere, watching the people and enjoying the beer, The service was good and clientele varied. I've been there before on a Sunday morning for breakfast of toast and kaya jam. Sitting at the counter looking onto the side street, I enjoyed watching the Sunday morning bric-brac market unfold while eatingShow less

Author: SwedenThomas
Title: Nice bar in good location
Review: Good location at Jonker Walk, terrible live music, better across the street.

Author: Billy W
Title: Good Coffee
Review: really good coffee and fresh spring rolls, also try some of their special health soups.

Author: BazSingaporeEngland, United Kingdom
Title: An unexpected but very welcome find.
Review: I was traveling with someone who was very fussy indeed over food so this place was ideal. Established in the late 90"s evidently, short but decent menu, no MSG or use of preservatives and appears to have won various awards. We had a local curry dish, nodles and fresh spring rolls - all good. A clean, very well organised place with a wide selection of beers - I even got as pint of Kilkenny so I rest my case and it wasn't an expensive place. You can sit inside or outside and it's good for people watching. Wouldn't hesitate to return.Show less

Author: tessamum
Title: Great asian fusion food
Review: Good menu showing a mix of asian and european dishes which meant we could experiment without too much risk

Author: Enoc123
Title: No pesto pasta next time!
Review: The fresh spring rolls are AMAZING!! for starters.. Then we had the pasta with pesto - huge disappointment. Tasted like liquorice, in a bad way. Atmosphere very nice though with live music! Staff very friendly!

Author: Yakida
Title: Nice atmosphere
Review: Nice atmosphere with a lot of foreign travellers and some good German beers on sale.

Author: prettyjacqui
Title: Great food!
Review:
our Geographer experiece made our Malacca trip extra wonderful. the food is amazingly delish! i can eat their satay forever!

their local iced coffee is bitter sweet making it perfectly right. 

we had our dinner over candle lights. it was a night to cherish!

Author: elizabethmavrickFremantle, Australia
Title: Very convenient, great food and service
Review: Many places in Melaka were disappointing after reading rave write ups, the Geographer Cafe lives up to its reviews. The satays are the best even though a little chicken skin is always left in the middle of them and the Jonkers rice is fantastic. Cold beers and a great selection of cocktails and mocktails. Great location and the service was great every time we went back, which we did quite a few times. The veggie rolls were amazing and sooo fresh. Well done and please keep it up.Show less

Author: KEGillesenVinterbro, Norway
Title: Good restaurant in nice area with live jazz
Review: We went here on several occations during our 6 days in Melaka, conviniently because it was just around the corner from our Courtyard@Heeren Hotel.The restaurant is easily available from the street, and it feels nice as soon as you enter. They have a rich menu with anything one can dream of. We never had any problems to find food for our children aged 3 and 5. We also enjoyed the elegant and friendly service by the staff.Food tastes very good and portions are large. We ate for less than 70 RM for the four of us.Geographer Cafe has live music including jazz several nights a week.Show less

Author: Sating-aa
Title: Cheers!
Review: Drink up and loosen your sore leg muscles from the day's sightseeing with good range od drinks and snacks. The place is always packed though.

Author: Zeeneeshri RPort Dickson, Malaysia
Title: A delight for vegetarians
Review: Being vegetarian, we have a handful of choices to eat in Melaka. But hubby and I never miss going to Geographer. He loves the friend tempeh side dish, and I love the Coconut Tom Yam. Both are excellently prepared, and most of the time worthy of seconds. Show less

Author: sacred21
Title: Nice place to hangout
Review: Nice place to hangout after dinner to have drinks and watch the crowd

Author: manorekhas
Title: FANTASTIC!!!!!
Review:
we stayed in hotel puri...its its just a few rows away....
this place has a fantastic ambience....im speachless...i don know wat else to say....its a must to visit here!!!! really really nice...

Author: LeChatEnVacancesBrienz, Switzerland
Title: Good Place to Chill Out w/ Cosy Ambiance & Nice Music ~ Skip the Mediocre Food & Enjoy the Drinks instead
Review: The Geographer Cafe occupies a historic, double-storied shophouse @ the junction of Jalan Hang Jebat & Jalan Hang Lekir. We visited on a Thursday Night before 8pm & the place was fairly quiet with just a few other tables of diners. We suspect it could get really packed on weekends or whenever they have 'live' entertainment which is usually from 8:30pm till midnight. They have Special Themed Events like Jazz Music on Mondays, Literary Reading/ Storytelling on Tuesdays, Acoustic Music on Thursdays and Dance Music from a 'Live' Band on Weekends (Fri~Sun). The Cafe aims to serve healthy food so there's no MSG & no red meat on the menu which offers a vast selection of both Asian & Western fare. There's a good variety of Pure Vegetarian dishes specially prepared in a separate kitchen (according to our waiter). Service was rather slow... Though it was not busy, we had to wait quite a while for our drinks to be served & even longer before our food was finally brought to the table (about 20~30 mins after placing our orders). The Grilled Lemon Fish was so sour that my partner simply couldn't stomach it, he's not a fussy eater & hates to waste food but he left half the fish uneaten on his plate so you could imagine just how unpalatable it was... Vegetarian Ramen was edible but far from tasty. We felt the food here was mediocre but we only tried these 2 menu items, perhaps their other dishes might be more satisfying...Though the food was disappointing, we really enjoyed our drinks here. The Organic Coconut was cool & refreshing while the 'Cinderella' Mocktail tasted so good that we were tempted to order another. Btw, my partner asked for some water to wash down the sour taste of the lemon fish & when the bill came, we realized the Cafe actually charged us for the glass of water too! Considering the fact that Melaka has plenty of Cheap & Good F&B options, the Geographer Cafe does seem to charge slightly higher prices compared to most local establishments. We would most likely visit again just for its Ambiance, Music & Drinks but would definitely prefer to eat elsewhere.Show less

Author: sleepyinsomniac
Title: lovely satay!
Review: The prices are a little above average than what you would pay if you ate at a hawker but for its place right smack in the middle of Jonker Street, it's pretty good.  The satay was delicious too!

Author: SharonLowSHKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Bistro time
Review: The chillax and most famous bistro in town <3 You'll never get a seat right after 930pm every saturday and sunday~ Covered classical english songs by a Portuguese singer~ Celebrate my friend's birthday with full of joys, provided the best service, best cocktails, mocktails, shooters and others~ It's heaven :D Show less

Author: CareFreeBluesN London
Title: well worth a visit
Review: great food and service .good for vegetarians . Good choice on menuShow less

Author: DanielT83Sao Paulo, SP
Title: Good food and ambiance. Horrible service.
Review: The setup is great. Soups and fried rice were very well done and tasty. One of us ordered chicken that wasn't cooked through properly. The vegetable soup is terrible. Sevice is horrendous. Some meals came out in five minutes while others took over 30. Show less

Author: davpay22London, United Kingdom
Title: Nice Atmosphere...
Review: Great position on the corner of the food street and halfway down Jonker.We went to the Geographer twice for coffee, which was great (their cake not so great) and once for a beer on Saturday night, very lively then but relaxed in the day and mid week. Good mix of westerners and Malaysians, the staff and good but it is a little pricier than other places.Show less

Author: crystalicangel
Title: Cafe
Review: Nice place to chill and relax with friends and family. Cold beverages and melaka delicacy are available here..

Author: Nina-NF
Title: beautifully decorated
Review: When in Jonker Street and need to chill out, make a stop at Geographer Cafe.

Author: Joanne Lkuala lumpur
Title: have fun and be merry
Review: great location and alcohol is decently priced. some were seen dancing on the street and having lots of fun. live music was on until 12ish-1amShow less

Author: jan jBeachmere, Australia
Title: Sit and watch the world go by
Review: Very popular spot for people watching with tables and chairs out on the busy pavement. I'm sure they had all the usual varieties of drinks - certainly the glasses of wine I drank were cold and delicious and my husband enjoyed his beers. Show less

Author: gnurkOdense, Denmark
Title: Very overrated
Review: Design 9/10, food looks 8/10, food taste: 6/10, location 4/10 service. Service outside categorie. Ate twice (don't ask why we came back, probably the easy location). On both occassions we had to wait one hour before being brought our food.Show less

Author: waterfall9999Orlando, Florida
Title: A Nice Casual Place with Great Vegetarian Food
Review: Though we were only in Melaka for 24-hrs, we went twice. They have both inside and outside seating. The menu is varied (includes many non vegetarian items as well) and the vegetation menu is quite good.We tried the bean curd appetizer. It had fresh fruit, bean curd skin, cucumber, sprouts and a very tasty sauce...yum. The next day I ha the Georgrapher Curry. Everything was fresh and authentic.The restaurant is located along Jonker Street so it is a lot of fun to sit and watch the people traffic while enjoying a pitcher of beer (carlsberg or tiger)Show less

Author: Gilza
Title: Excellent food.
Review: The Geographer is a great little Cafe/bar.  Great food. Cheap. Kung Po chicken was great.

Author: hcbradleySkipton, United Kingdom
Title: Good for Vegetarians
Review: Plenty of choice for vegetarians. Service not good, and none of meals arrived at the same time. The last meal arrived half an hour after the first one. having said that the food was good, when we eventually got it. Music played very loud.Show less

Author: denny58Brisbane, Australia
Title: poor service
Review: this was a very loooong wait for just a small order. over half an hour for a basket of chips and 3 drinks!!!Show less

Author: Peterjames0Stockport, United Kingdom
Title: Nice location but a rip off
Review: Thought the set up was pretty good but £6 for a pint of beer is taking the p***. I can understand that it is a prime location but let's be honest we are not talking Kings Road, Chelsea rates.Wouldn't go backShow less

Author: A380ManchesterUKManchester UK
Title: Ideal place for a drink / light meal and a sit down watching the world go by
Review: The café is situated approx half way down Jonkers St, on the left as you approach from the river end. It occupies a corner position on a ‘T’ junction on Jonkers St/Jalan Hang Jebat.Its open sided aspect allows seating both inside, and on the pavement immediately outside the café.It is an ideal venue for a drink or light meal from the inexpensive menu.Our first visit saw us have a couple of juices and a shared satay (6 sticks) for RM19.80On our second visit we had a jug of Tiger beer (two and a half pints), chicken and cashew nut and a local Nyonya chicken dish with rice for RM70.80.Portions were more than adequate and whilst we had to wait approx 30 mins for the food to arrive, it was presented hot and tasty.A torrential downpour for thirty minutes while we were eating provided plenty of people watching fun.A selection of cakes and coffees are on offer as wellMalaccas famous night market is held on Fridays and Saturday evenings. This café is right in the middle of the action and was good for soaking up the atmosphere over a beer.Toilets were not the best, but at least they were free to customers. Only oddity about them was the male toilet which contained a urinal only.Great café to sit and watch the world go by whilst having a drink or light meal.Show less

Author: marukodessSingapore, Singapore
Title: overrated
Review: only because this place looks good and it's in the middle of chinatown does not mean it's good. re-hashed random asian food cooked in a westernized place, this place can as well be the biggest villain for everyone who travels only to check out the local foods like me!Show less

Author: jesus phong kong
Title: Typical touting and overcharging restaurant of touristic spots
Review: The food is so so and way too expensive for what it is. The worse is that the service is really bad and ruins the little atmosphere of the restaurant. They lied about the size of the beer, braught the dishes one by one and with 20 minutes of interval between each!! They just dont care of the food or service, since they know their customers are tourists who may never come back to melaka. Avoid this place!Show less

Author: Deb255115Wellington, New Zealand
Title: Very cool place with great ambience
Review: We just stopped for a drink - I had a pina colada and husband a non alcoholic cocktail. The staff were efficient and friendly and the location was great to watch passers by and see what was going on in the street. Loved the ambience, decor and music. A great place to stop and bide away some time.Show less

Author: daphnedexplorerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice ambience in the evening
Review: I just had dessert and it was so-so. But I still recommend it as it's nice to people watch on a relatively cool evening.Show less

Author: caseylcyHong Kong, China
Title: rest here
Review: good place to have a drink, fries and salad, just to relaxi came here at night on weekday, jonker street was not that busy, it was great to take a rest here after biking in the cityenjoy! Show less

Author: HB001Wilson, Australia
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Live music provided on the nights we were there: a guy playing jazz/easy listening. good food, good vibe and very cheap beer. Fun, central for the markets on the weekend and we're pretty sure it was open during the day (not all of the restaurants in Malaysia open earlier in the day but rather stay open for the very late nights)Show less

Author: Cliff6108Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent cafe to have a drink and watch the world go by!
Review: Quaint cafe with the perfect ambience! Either on the ground floor or first floor.Show less

Author: magictravelblogKoh Tao, Thailand
Title: To be honest, the Geographer Cafe’s food was to die for.
Review: Half way down Jonker Street in Melaka, you can find a very fancy cafe, Geographer Cafe. Be warned, this is a cafe based at the western tourists who visit Melaka. On this day, we needed some Western comforting…You know you are in an expensive restaurant when the price of the drinks are almost the same price as a main meal you can have down at a local Malay restaurant. To be honest, the Geographer Cafe’s food was to die for.We ordered the tempeh bites as a snack, Andrew had the famous Geographer Curry Ramen, and I had the Geographer Tom Yam Coconut Soup. All very delicious.The Geographer Cafe promote healthy living through their food. They prefer their food without the use of MSG and only offer white meat for meals (no red meat at all).www.magictravelblog.comShow less

Author: Kimmozieto
Title: Good place to hang out at night
Review: It's a corner shop at Jonker street. You can get food and beer here. Good place to hang out . There's  also life band at night.

Author: Boeing734Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Poor, unfriendly service and cold food
Review: My friend's rice took a while to arrive and was stone-cold. There was no apology from the waiter, instead he was rather rude and off-hand, he claimed that warm rice was not available.
