Eventually warm rice did arrive but by this time we had all been waiting ,a long time for our food which was mediocre at best. The hole-in-the-ground toilet was unhygienic, even by Malaysian standards. This should be addressed, especially with the high prices charged by this establishment.On a positive note, the location is great and the old, historic building is beautiful. The younger, trainee waiters were nice & friendly.Show less

Author: OtsoKa
Title: vege rolls to die for
Review: This cosy cafe and restaurant is a perfect place to hang out and watch the Chinatown street life. Good for beer and their vege rolls or Summer rolls were something not to forget, best I´ve ever had.

Author: eightysixxxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great rest stop right in the middle of Jonker Walk
Review: Came here the two evenings I was in Malacca. Really good place to have a cold drink and rest your legs. Especially when you've spent the day exploring and want a place to relax and watch the weekend Jonker Walk night market appear before your eyes.Food is unexpectedly cheap for a (cafe that is really a) pub. Great variety in the food menu with local and international dishes that reflected the local cuisine with tempeh, laksa, etc. Had some calamari, fries, and an apple salad—they weren't mindblowing but good for a light snack. Beers were reasonably priced, with an afternoon and early evening happy hour that includes deals for pints, jugs and buckets.Service was great. The staff were really pleasant, unobstrusive and always around when you want them.Show less

Author: Weeble WLos Angeles, California
Title: Nice location, good food with a good price
Review: I hesitated the first time I went to Geographer because I thought it must be expensive being that it's right on Jonker Walk and looks a bit touristy. However the prices are modest, I had an amazing vegetarian rice curry for RM 9. Very good food and a perfect location to people watch while sipping on a Guiness from a sidewalk table. Show less

Author: SH-BahrainMelbourne, Australia
Title: Better than expected
Review: We stopped at the geographer to rest after fighting our way through the crowed market. We really only wanted a light bite but we ended going back the next day because it was really good. My husband had chicken satay which was delicious and I had vegetable rolls which were fresh and tasty. I recommend it....Show less

Author: wolf1437
Title: Great place to rest your feet
Review: Location that you will not missed walking along Jonker street, great stop for food and drink. Live music and night and patrons dancing. Attentive staff and beer-lady that make sure you glass were always filled.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: drinks and people watch...
Review: Not too keen on their food since we have so many varieties along Jonker Street but the Geographer Cafe is a great place to wind down, have some cold beers and people watch. The live music helps as well. Weekends are a riot here with Geographer and their competitor Ringo directly across taking turns providing live music. Service is so so and pricing is average. Best advise is to get some munchies along Jonker street, find a suitable seat, order your drinks and chill.Show less

Author: andrewleesg
Title: Service SUCKS!
Review: Unbelievable! Even by local standards. Waited 10 min for a cup of coffee... Guy said he forgot. No big deal... Then we ordered food... 15 min later, wifes food arrives - cold! Asked about my food. Guy says `yea yea, on the way`15 min later, I ask the waiter again... He said. 'oh I forgot... You wait another 10 min' I said forget it, let me see the manager. Manager takes his time then finally comes over. Tells me its my fault cause the order wasnot clear! So I paid for the coffee and wife's food and left.Place is a joke. Dont give a damn cause another tourist will take your place.No reason to spend your hard earned money in a ---- hole like this.Show less

Author: mantajoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Have a cool drink after a hot sunny shopping along jonker
Review: We had chicken rice ball for lunch and then continue for a cool drink at geographer cafe for some fruit juice and coconut drink.This cafe is famous in a hong kong movie "Summer Holidays" visited by Richie Ren and Sammi Cheng. Visit at this cafe can feel a little heritage of the peranakan mansion located along the jonker street.Tips : A glass of juice or drinks is between RM3 to RM7 (menu subject to change by the cafe management). Have a seat/table on level 1 for a peranakan mansion feel. During my pre wedding photos, I really wanted to take some photos at this place.Show less

Author: MarleneMay
Title: The best I went at Malaysia
Review: I really liked this nice place in Melaka. U think it was the best i went in Malaysia. This because of the combination of great food, location, nice people and a really good price.

Author: SaskiavanderGrijp
Title: nice staff and admosphere but small portions for high price
Review:
nice setting and lovely staff. 
We where just very disappointed that we left very hungry after eating an expensive pasta and satay dish. No value for money at all!! Portions are too small. 
Taste was good though but not special.

Author: Cassell28Warwick, United Kingdom
Title: Great place to sit and people watch
Review: Good drinks selection and not too pricey for alcohol as you can find in Malaysia (38 ringgit for a pitcher). Great position on the junction to sit and people watch as people work their way through the Jonker night market. Food menu looked a little drab compared to other places but didn't eat here so can't say too much.Show less

Author: JuledanWindsor and Maidenhead, United Kingdom
Title: Go here for a drink, food is better elsewhere in town
Review: Like other people already wrote this cafe serve some really good drinks. The interior is good and during the weekends its packed with people. However we were slightly disappointed by the food. It's average and feels it's tuned down in spices to please tourists. Furhermore it is a bit pricey fo what it delivers.Show less

Author: eddieontherunAugsburg, Germany
Title: Best bar in Melala
Review: This place has the best coffee, great fries, cold beer, airy and cool tunes....but despite the vast amount of waiters swanning around they seemed far more interested in clinging to the bar or chatting amongst themselves instead of asking if we would like more refreshments....would have ordered more cocktails?!?! Overall the best bar thoughShow less

Author: Santana_32
Title: Relax and watch  - ice cold beer included.
Review: After a walk through history and several stops including dry wonton, laksa and cabrol, stop and enjoy a nice cold drink. Patio cooled by mist blown fans easily transports you back to a bygone era. Enjoy and watch the facinating world go by!

Author: BetsyHKHong Kong, China
Title: Great atmosphere, mediocre food
Review: This is a wonderful place to have a drink and watch the world go by. I'd eat somewhere else though - with so many fascinating choices in Melaka, our very mediocre meal made us sorry we stayed for dinner. Chicken tandoori, calamari, laksa, satay, pesto pasta and apple pie were not up to par. Perhaps a case of trying to offer too many types of cuisine and doing none well.Show less

Author: MinirenniZurich, Switzerland
Title: Lovely Cafe and Bar
Review: It's a nice cafe and bar. They serve nice food and drinks. So we found the prices where on the higher end. The service is very good. A convenient place to do a stop while sightseeing.As most of the restaurants and cafes it's right at the street, so I wouldn't recommend it for families with young children.Show less

Author: JVP_007
Title: Good place to chill
Review: We had good German beer and something to munch after tiring ourselves walking at the night market. Great location, nice ambience, good music, live band playing at night, not sure if it’s on weekend only, but we were there on a Saturday night.

Author: LondonLorraine
Title: great bar/cafe in wonderful location
Review: Geographer's is great for coffee or beer while people watching. I went back again and again. But not so good for food,and many better local options. Staff are great and always friendly.

Author: Minkamonka
Title: Great location for people watching
Review: Stopped by for a beer/two and a snack and ended up eating more and having dessert. Nice place, friendly staff and good music. Well worth trying. Great for sitting and watching the world go by! Recommended

Author: jonniepalmer
Title: Just had a drink
Review: Yeah good service and location for a stop in out of the heat.  Good coffee too!

Author: nasi_ayam_search
Title: for tourists, not 'real' Melaka
Review: an average place - fine food, cold beer, etc. Boring.

Author: ShinitoLondon, United Kingdom
Title: The best of our Malaysia trip!
Review: What a fantastic restaurant not just in the beautiful UNESCO town - Malacca but I dare to say its the best Cafe/Restaurant we have ever been in Malaysia! We were delighted that we went to Malacca and found this lovely cafe being housed in a pre-war building which has been really well-restored and magically enchanted into a stunning living architecture by a local architect. We met the owner and fascinated by their intention of saving the heritage and culture which eventually turned into a motivation in giving birth to this lovely cafe since 10 years ago, they did it, and did it big! From a quiet old street to lively (sometimes it could be too congested with people during weekend) area, it was a big transformation, and a really meaningful one indeed! Well done Geographer, we will be back!Show less

Author: Greg SMelbourne, Australia
Title: Geographer Cafe - a pleasant oasis.
Review: In Jonker Walk Chinatown, at corner of Jalan Hang Jebat, Geographer Cafe is ideal for day, or night, eating and drinking. Downstairs is very open and breezy, with sidewalk seating. Upstairs is eclectic and cool. Staff are attentive, pleasant and efficient. Food is very good, at reasonable prices. A great meeting place, one of the best in Melaka.Show less

Author: SingaporeRoland
Title: Perfect place to chill out.
Review: One of the best pub I been to in malaysia. Perfect setting with value for money food and drinks.  Good for even a solo or group outing.

Author: KmlMf
Title: Nice restaurant in Old town Malacca
Review: Great service, food, setting, location & value for money. For sure will go there again next time :)

Author: Pinkpower
Title: Good vegetarian options here
Review: For our family of mostly vegetarians, this place was fantastic. There were very tasty vegetarian dishes like nasi lemak, curry rice and lontong at reasonable prices. Highly recommended!

Author: zalbetrippin
Title: Yummy!
Review: Love the chicken rice ball!Hope to come back soon when inter-state travel is allowed! The fish is good too!

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Chicken rice ball, my foot!!
Review: We came here because Trip Advisor rated this as a too chicken rice ball place in Penang.The staff who met us at the entrance was loud and uncouth. You are asked to give your order, the staff then offers a few additional add-ons.We were shocked by the sight of five miserable rice balls served on a tea plate. How are we expected to eat them with the chicken without spilling the food onto the table. So we asked for a more normal place that is 3x larger than the tea plate.When the chicken rice and veg we ordered was served, I asked for the usual accompanying soup. The response..."don't have. Soup all used to make the chicken rice!!" Really??When it came to food tasting...The Verdict...steamed chicken was ok, not exactly succulent not very tasty. But the chicken rice balls were simply AWFUL!!1. Poor quality rice used2. Texture was sticky, wet and clumpy3. There was no chicken taste in the rice.Advice...give this place a miss. I am sure there is much better chicken rice than what is dished out here.Show less

Author: PflanzenschuetzerDormagen, Germany
Title: Checked Off 'Must Do' in Melakka
Review: We went to this place as somebody in our hotel recommended it. It is within walking distance from Stadhuys and busy Jonker street.The dining area does not have aircon but it's well ventilated with many fans. Tables are spread reasonably apart. Half chicken, 15 rice balls fed us well. Don't expect to sit here on hours, but a great place to have a quick and very tasty, professionally made meal.Show less

Author: TaufikN78
Title: Chicken is better than the rice
Review: Very simple eating here. only need to tell how many person to eat, want vegetables or not and what to drink. no menu book to see. the chicken and the juicy is very good. the rice somewhat dried.

Author: superscottyStratford-upon-Avon, United Kingdom
Title: the joy of specialising
Review: waiting in the queue to get in the waitresses approach you for you order. o the day i went the extent of the options was rice or rice balls, do you want a side of cabbage and tea or soft drink.thoughtful and cool wooden panels decorate the walls. food was great. clean simple flavours and lovely spicy sauce on the side.brilliant value and not surprising its super popular. well worth a visit. located near city end of Jonker Walk.Show less

Author: Benz_HerlambangJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Hyped - Crowded - Quite worth it
Review: Famous Chicken Rice Ball around Melacca City. Visited around 2 PM during Christmas holiday season and it was crowded. Queueing was not long, and we ordered while queueing. Got 10 rice ball per table only so we add regular rice (1.5RM each - as per Dec 2019). Chicken was good, tender and juicy. We added cabbage that was also good. Spent 49.5 for 5 person. Good to try. Fast service. If you come in group more than 4 person then they will use plastic plate for you.Show less

Author: jiewen22
Title: After so many years and so
Review:
After so many years and so many times we had the chicken rice there.. the quality always maintained!!
So nice and satisfying!!

Author: Almyhappy
Title: Singapore has better
Review:
Don't bother...chicken too tough, rice too soft and taste average...
Singapore still have the best chicken rice

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Excellent Hainanese Chicken Rice
Review: The Rice Balls accompanied with the Chicken and Chilli Sauce were so nice that was worth visiting. It was also an opportunity to visit a Jonker traditional old house which is so long! The Q was long during lunch time.The service was fast and the rice balls fragrant. There are limited drinks and mostly instant or packaged. They served the meal with plastic plates which were not eco friendly and not recycled. There must lots of plastic garbage at the end of the day.Do try if you are around Jonker Walk...Show less

Author: Lugosi915
Title: Loved the meal
Review: One of my fav restaurant in Melaka, always return when i visit here. They serve single portion meal for Solo traveler compared to some other similar restaurant in Melaka, in which i really appreciated. Rice ball was normal but the Steamed Chicken was nice.

Author: RandolphCarter1919Australia
Title: Only one dish on the menu
Review: We had seen people lining up here everyday but we couldn't be bothered in the heat. We skipped breakfast one day and got here just after 11 and we got let straight in though it filled up fast. The girl at the door said we only have one dish available, chicken rice balls and chicken, we didn't care as this is what this place is famous for. They were excellent, served very quickly and were freshly made and cooked, highly recommended if in Jonkers.Show less

Author: Cfarr96
Title: Worth the wait
Review: Waited a little while but glad we did. Really delicious meal with a quick service. Would recommend!..

Author: Wranglerdarles
Title: Lovely breakfast
Review:
We met with friends at this restaurant for the classic chicken and rice breakfast. The food was delicious and plentiful and the service was wonderful.
Lovely place to eat with lovely food and service.

Author: 855jesst
Title: Best chicken rice
Review:
Love the rice and the tender tasty chicken!  

I am not sure what time they open but they will close at around 3pm.

The service is quick and staff are efficient and friendly. A must visit if you come to Malacca!!

Author: MattNHTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent small chicken rice balls
Review: The rice balls are not huge. Those who love rice. You need more than 5 rice balls. I had 6 and after the meal is just nice. And of course you can order more. The rice is really “soak up the chicken”. And the chicken is really tender. Ordered a plate of cabbage and personally I loved vege. The price is reasonable.Show less

Author: paulynyyyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Lunch with Fast Service
Review: We didn't need to wait for long as it was a weekday. Had ordered our food while lining up and the staff asked us to order 2 pax meal for 3 persons. After seated, the food came - chicken with 10 balls of rice and vegetables. Nice authentic Melaka chicken which left me full. Reasonable lunch.Show less

Author: Melanie_YeohSemenyih, Malaysia
Title: Chicken is the winner
Review: Give it a try if you are on Jonker Street. Nothing fancy, everything was alright. The chicken was served with a side of liver. Try the assam fish too. I personally prefer the normal rice over the rice balls. We went on a Wednesday for brunch, no crowd at all. The owner needs to do something with the paper cups they used to serve drinks like tea. Most of them were leaking and I don't think or I hope they don't recycle using these paper cups, please.Show less

Author: Joyce T
Title: Great chicken rice ball with assam fish
Review: The Assam fish goes perfectly well with the chicken rice ball. The chicken rice comes with the liver and innards as well.

Author: siokjinKajang, Malaysia
Title: surprisingly good and was lucky to beat the queue
Review: went there for an early lunch at about 12 noon before the crowd came pouring in. waited just 5-10 minutes to be seated. there were 4 of us, but ordered a set for 5. we were not big eaters, but was told that a set for 4 will not fill us up good.it was all good, we managed to finish it up in 30 minutes. serving time was quick, and the chicken and rice ball were above average. I was quite full at that time, but still managed to stuffed quite a few rice balls.The only thing is that we have to order before sitting down, and am not sure if we could still add on later at the table. Price wise, it was about RM15 per person and have a good full tummy.Would probably go again, but am sure that there are better ones out there. will keep searching and sharing!Show less

Author: guangyic2016
Title: One of the better ones in Melaka
Review: Very good chicken rice. It was so good that we went twice. First time we tried ball and second time normal loose rice. For first time travellers, you could try the rice ball for novelty sake, but the loose rice definitely taste much better hands down.Chicken texture is smooth and sauce is fragrant with hint of sesame oil.Chilli is quite good and goes very well with the chicken. Ordered together with a plate of stir fried cabbage to offset the oilyness. Service is also quite good, despite the relentless queues. The interior of the restaurant is suprisingly huge so waiting times are not that long. Do come early in the morning as its the best time to avoid crowds.Show less

Author: RicochanNew York
Title: Checked Off 'Must Do' in Malacca
Review: After reading all sorts of Malacca tour guides, I had to try chicken rice balls. We came to Hoe Kee on a Saturday at around 11:30 AM - no queue. 2 people worth of chicken rice balls with a cabbage plate and ice tea. All of them were delicious. Very easy to order.Show less

Author: dilysqSingapore, Singapore
Title: Definitely worth a visit!
Review: Visited the store on a wednesday morning, slightly before they opened. There was no queue, probably because it's a weekday, and it's not the holiday season for malaysia. Read many reviews that mentioned the minimum order was 10 chicken rice ball. However, upon being seated, the staff suggested a portion of chicken (7.50 per portion) and 5 rice balls first (RM 0.30 each), and told me to order more if i wanted (note: I was alone).There were helpful signs at fr he door about the pricing. It was probably to simplify ordering for the masses, since it was actually possible to order any number of rice balls desired. Drinks were offered as well, and I had their cold herbal tea (Rm1.70) The portion of chicken to the recommended 5 rice balls was well matched in terms of rice to chicken ratio. The store was fairly ventilated when fans. Each table was "equipped" with a bottle of dark sauce and their chilli. Food didn't take more than 5 minutes to come, which is great. Chicken was served cool (it's not meant to be hot) and was slightly on the salty side because of the soy sauce. They have the option for "loose rice" as well, if mushy rice balls is not your thing. Definitely worth it to get up a little early to have this chicken rice, as a long queue seemed to form in the afternoon (photo taken at about 12 noon). Definitely recommend and will visit again to my next trip to malacca. Show less

Author: Rebecca TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Enjoyable Lunch
Review: We were there on a Friday afternoon at about 1.30pm and there was a queue. The queue looked long but after the big groups were seated, the queue started to move quickly. Also, if you are a group of 2 or 4, you are likely to get seated first than the big groups. My family of 2 adults, 2 children and 1 infant with stroller were comfortably seated after a 15 min wait.The dining area does not have aircon (like the many other places in Melaka) but it's well ventilated with many fans. Tables are spread reasonably apart.Half chicken, 15 rice balls fed us well. If the adults are big eaters, you may need to add extra rice balls. The food is good and served quickly, we had an enjoyable time trying out this local delicacy. In my opinion, Hoe Kee is cheaper and nicer than AFamosa. Give it a try!Show less

Author: Travel_forYes
Title: Above Average
Review: Normal chicken rice but the price is quite expensive. Can try out their Asam Fish Head, the Asam soup is sweet and sour, nice!

Author: herbertsmith241065Melbourne, Australia
Title: Half steamed chicken and 6 chicken rice balls
Review: Dropped in here for a quick Makan: not too bad but not great. Perhaps over rated: not quite hainanese style but similar and to be fair they didn’t claim to be hainanese but just the usual steamed chicken. One half chicken for 22 ringgit is great for 3 people. Chicken was tender but not super tender like hainanese, so it’s good for the price. Had the usual fresh coconut drink which came in its original shell as you would always expect in the tropics.Show less

Author: KongYLan
Title: Good Cosy Place for Chicken Rice Balls
Review: Conveniently located on Jonker Walk, this place is less touristy than expected. Considered clean, airy and reasonably priced. The service is relatively good also for a local coffee shop. Happy with our lunch there.

Author: MorgozBrisbane, Australia
Title: Delicious
Review: We went to here for lunch while in Melaka, the restaurant was very busy and we had to wait for a table which we ended up sharing with another person.We ordered the Chicken Rice Balls and they were delicious.The staff were very friendly and efficient, even though they were busy you don’t have to wait long for your meal.Show less

Author: Irene Y
Title: Yummy!
Review: Heard about it so much that 1st things to do when reach Malacca is eat chicken rice, the chicken meat was soft and tender. Simply love the taste

Author: GWfoodieszone
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Melaka is famous for Chicken Rice Ball, this was my 1st trying this restaurant. To me they are almost similar but the Assam fish was really outstanding.

Author: wesleywaisiu
Title: Just average, not worth to queue for it.
Review: The chicken rice ball is famous in Melaka, and this restaurant is one of the most famous. However, the chicken taste and the rice ball just taste average. And you can only order base on the number of people you have, not that flexible.

Author: puspanathanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lunch a nostalgic experience
Review: The last time I had chicken rice balls in Jonker Street was about 30 years ago in a tiny shop. Today was a total fast food experience. Mind you, you have to queue to get a table. But we were through our lunch within 30 minutes. Service is extremely fast. The chicken rice balls are very unique. You don’t get them every where. They have a slightly rich taste. You only get steamed chicken with the rice. You can also order side dishes like fried cabbage and Assam fish head. The chicken was soft and juicy. Overall a very good meal. Worth the queues. Reasonable prices. A whole chicken with two side dishes and 20 rice balls for 4 people came to RM80 only. Show less

Author: ETwTAustin, Texas
Title: Good steamed hainam chicken
Review: We went to this place as our driver recommended it. It is within walking distance from Stadhuys and busy Jonker street.Service is on and off mark but we were here on a weekday so it was not that busy. We have hainam chicken, rice balls and ikan asam pedas (spicy sour fish). We asked for white rice to eat with the fish. Everything is quite delicious with the ginger spicy hot sauce (should be on your table. If not, should ask from the server as this sauce is definitely a must try)Overall, we will go back for more as Kedai Kopi Chung Wah is closed when we were there.Show less

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Quick snack
Review: We dined here for a brunch snack and had chicken rice balls for one shared between us. The bill was around 9.50 RM and the food was tasty - 6 rice balls and around the equivalent of a breast of chicken. I think the next size up is a quarter chicken for 15 RM but who knows as there’s no menu and you just tell the lady how hungry you are!!Show less

Author: J0e1982
Title: Tasty chicken rice
Review:
I really love their rice n chicken instated of others shop along jongker street.

Price was reasonable too.

Need to go early on weekend and it run out very fast

Author: TaiGoh
Title: Good steamed chicken and Assam fish
Review: Steamed chicken is good as expected, did not disappoint but no wow factor either. Assam fish was suprisingly good. Chicken rice balls were abit cold.

Author: monotoy
Title: The rice balls were very tasty indeed
Review: Something I cook myself at times, I thought the chicken was moist and tasty, and the rice balls were succulent with chicken broth. Don't expect to sit here on hours, but a great place to have a quick and very tasty, professionally made meal.

Author: rachelfV1625YH
Title: Would not recommend it!
Review: They restrict your rice purchase to 5 rice balls per pax! And not only that, they do not have roasted chicken!!! Horrible. I do not recommend this anymore!

Author: Janebondfood
Title: Horrible place to bring your family
Review: Came here with my family for the first time, 4 people and a child and I was told they have a maximum of 30 rice balls to a chicken and the rice balls are small. Pathetic. If you travel all the way for this, it ain’t worth it.Show less

Author: kyleandpatricia2016
Title: Cheap, decent quality food
Review: The chicken and rice balls were just ok. The sauce they were served with was quite good. The food was pretty cheap.

Author: yaoqinxEngland, United Kingdom
Title: Good chicken rice
Review: The hot sale food is chicken, which tasted soft and a little bit sweet. It is very friendly to people who cannot eat spicy. They also serve other food. The price is considered cheap. However, this is a very busy restaurant. You probably need to wait in the queue for some time.Show less

Author: C5508WKwilliamlMacau, China
Title: Average chicken rice ball, nothing to shout about
Review: Brought a friend from abroad to experience the food in Malacca and I chose Hoe Kee as it has always been my choice chicken rice ball restaurant in town. Sadly I was disappointed with the quality since the last time when I was here. Tourist boom surely was not a good thing for How Kee as compared a few years back, the chicken rice ball was much smaller and sadly, was served plain cold and I was told if I were to have a refill of rice, only normal rice will be served, not the rice balls. I’m not complaining nor I have a strict preference for “rice balls”, but as its’ own namesake, not having rice balls as refills feels like a sin! The chicken was plain and quite chewy and not as tender as it used to be. It may have been the last time I’ve visited this food joint here.Show less

Author: dudeman8
Title: There Are Few Better
Review:
It is so fun to enjoy fish ball soup along with chicken rice. Oh, it is an oasis on a steamy Meleka shopping day.

We always have soup and some fresh Malaysian vegetables. Have an iced tea and chill.

Author: masspjm
Title: Rice Ball Place
Review: Wanted to try the famous rice balls in Melaka and found this eatery by recommendation. Chicken was moist and tasty with hot sauce. Rice balls were just rice balls. I am glad we tried them but didn’t really see anything special about the whole thing.

Author: LynnC2551
Title: Chicken rice ball
Review: long q when we reach. waited abot 15 mins but luckily they have a good system in place ie take order while queuing so that when we finally got our table..the food came within few minutes. however, the chicken and rice ball taste was so-so only. because it is rice ball so the rice needs to be sticky and soft. therefore if you don’t like sticky feel this may not be something for you. Show less

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Busy Hainanese Chicken Emporium
Review: Located on the Jonker Walk, about 50 metres from the bridge. I came early (about 10:00 AM) to beat the line up, and the joint was already half full. I was seated immediately, ordered Chinese tea, chicken and rice balls, which arrived less than three minutes later. The rice balls were not as good as I expected (In fact, I prefer the loose rice with chicken like in Singapore, with a bowl soup on side), but the chicken was excellent, hot, very juicy, and very tender. The sauce on it was sparse and a bit boring, so I had to load up with sambal and soya. The tea was luke warm, served in a paper cup, but the price was right! All in all a pretty good breakfast for MYR 10, made even better by the efficient, prompt and friendly service! No wonder they are lined up all day!Show less

Author: melmeleatsSingapore
Title: Very tender and moist chicken!
Review: Many tourists flock to Restoran Chung Wah because it's right at the start of Jonker Walk just opposite H&m but most don't notice that Hoe Kee is just a few minutes down the same street and offers the same dishes at a good price too. I loved the tender and moist chicken that was just amazing. Id eat this over and over again when im back! Not really a big fan of the chicken rice ball though as it was a bit too wet and mushy for me. This one is really a preference issue though :) For a 2 pax portion, we got 10 chicken rice balls ( 5 each) and 1/4 chicken for RM19.Show less

Author: musashi777Adelaide, Australia
Title: The Best Chicken Rice Ball meal in Malacca
Review: After being invited to lunch at Hoe Kee by a local foodie friend, we will never eat anywhere else in Malacca for an authentic, delicious Chicken Rice Ball meal. There’s always a queue which is not surprising after tasting the food but service is quick once seated. The chicken rice ball looks and tastes amazing and they still hand-roll theirs, unlike some other chain restaurants which use machines. The chicken tastes amazing and is texturally perfect, the sauce is also spot-on. Their Assam fish is to die for too. We were pleasantly surprised at the relatively cheap price and this will be a meal we will talk about for a long time!Show less

Author: Kmlock
Title: Chicken rice ball melaka.
Review: Chicken rice ball at hoe kee chicken rice shop and the chung wah coffee shop was still the best. The way chicken rice ball shall be eaten with the chilli sauce pour on top the rice ball. Put chicken along the rice ball with chilli sauce then eat. It's look a bit disgusting but that's the way it should be. Rice shall use fragrant rice. My chicken rice shop rice ball was totally flat.Show less

Author: ReinaJ27
Title: Tasty Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Located very close with the entrance of Jonker Street. Their chicken rice ball very tasty so does the steamed chicken. Come early as they sold out quite fast.

Author: donovanSY
Title: Nice
Review: Long queue to seating inside traditional hall where tables and seats are. Not pricy and chicken was firm, Chili good and sweet sauce special. Pleasant experience overall.

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Marvelous Meal
Review: A visit to Malacca is not complete without having a Chicken Rice Ball meal. Took our friends from China for brunch at the Hoe Kee Chicken Rice Ball Cafe. We were early to get a table. The crowd of tourists poured in pretty quickly. Nice chichen rice in authentic ball shaped. Nice steam chichen, asam fish and vegie. Goes well with liang teh.Show less

Author: TakMengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth Special Mention
Review: The Restaurant was located just across the bridge linking the clock tower and Jonker Walk. It was housed in a large traditional building. There was a perennial line outside the entrance. A staff took the orders and guests were quickly led to their tables.We were a party of 5. We ordered a whole chicken, a large plate of vegetables, 25 tiny rice balls and tea. The chicken was tender and the vegetables were delicious. The rice balls were tasty and compacted just right (not too hard).The fabulous meal cost an undemanding RM 65.Show less

Author: tlee45
Title: Tasty chicken rice ball in Melaca
Review: Boneless chicken with larger rice ball, a simple recipe but provided a relatively tastful chicken in the town. Without a grand entrance but good food. Price is also very reasonable.

Author: Tigerlily752
Title: First time trying the dish!
Review: We went here after it being recommended by a local lady, it was our first time trying the dish! Service was good, the chicken and rice was very tasty and the chilli sauce was delicious. All in all good experience would recommend.

Author: Enochmingo
Title: Melacca Hainanese Chicken Rice Ball
Review: The customer service is good, the people will order the suitable portion based on the number of customers. However, few meals are excluded from the menu already. Taste normal but if you are first time visit to Melacca, it still worth to have a try.

Author: KY G
Title: One of the first few pioneers of chicken rice balls according to the locals
Review: Very long queue although they have got a big shop. Food was great and nice as expected despite the waiting time.

Author: MilkplumSydney, Australia
Title: Chicken rice is better loose
Review: Chicken - pretty tasty, tender and the chilli sauce delicious.Rice balls - served at room temperature, very compacted so it lost its texture and just very, very average.Atmosphere- ok. Service - efficient but unfriendly You only get 5 balls per person which isn’t enough in my opinion!I think I prefer chicken rice from Singapore!Show less

Author: gerallau
Title: Well organised
Review: Food is ordered while you queue at the entrance. Soon as you enter, your food follows in no time! Have tried other Chicken Rice Ball shops but this is the best so far. Do try their Assam Fish. You will definitely go for more!

Author: jsipalayNegros Occidental, Philippines
Title: best chicken rice ball
Review: tried this place that was recommended by a friend, there was a long line waiting for a table and finally after a short wait we were seated and our order of chicken rice balls was served, service was fast and so was the table turnover as it was basically place your order while waiting for a table, get served, you eat and then leave haha but the chicken was very delicious and definitely worth coming back for.Show less

Author: Lisa CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mediocre food
Review: 6 of us went for lunch around 12:30pm on a Thursday. Queued for about 10 minutes during which a lady came to take our order. Felt rushed. The steamed chicken was average although the Assam fish was quite fresh. We also had the rice ball. I prefer the normal rice as they are less dry and hard. Overall, I don’t understand the hype. It’s no different from any chicken I can get from the shops in KL.Show less

Author: AndyLSth
Title: Interesting presentation and delicious
Review: Interesting that the chicken rice was shaped into small balls. The chicken is perfectly cook, meat was soft, juicy and delicious with the chili sauce. Good and friendly service. Recommended!

Author: ThuyGaBi
Title: Nice place
Review: I went there with my husband and 18 month old daughter. They even have special chair for her,which was great. The food is quite good.

Author: E1245ZXannec
Title: First experience and will be the last one
Review: It was long queue but I must say is not worth the wait. Rice balls and the chicken is not tasty, chillies is not spicy...

Author: annelouiset233
Title: Delicious
Review: I had the classic chicken rice balls. Simple and cheap but still incredibly good! I went there early so no queue

Author: benxxxSingapore
Title: Beware of scam black shop
Review: My old folks still lives in Melaka but I live in oversea. I comes back every year 1-3 times.I always go Chung Wah but when Chung Wah was closed, I was forced to eat at this Hoe Kee shop many times since many years ago. Now Chung Wah no longer operate due to government tax non paid problems.This Hoe Kee shop is not real authentic Hainanese Chicken Rice and concentrates mainly on tourist buses. All the tourist guides and drivers get commissions and free meals from them.This are my experiences from many times in this shop. The shop will ask their Indonesian maids to serve you. They will serve you soups or dishes that you did not order. They also will pretend and serve you whole chicken when you actually ordered half chicken. When you pay, they will pretend with lots of arguments and lies. They will ignore your words and forced you to pay for everything even you did not eat.This shop is very expensive and not as good as many shops in melaka. But if you happens to be there, you will be hungry and too tired to walk further. So we are always forced to be cheated.After so many times cheated, I decided not to eat at this black shop anymore. They never change and never stop scam customers! For your information do not eat in this area because the food here all are too expensive and non are good. All the good stuffs never located in this 10km area anymore.Show less

Author: SamuelOngKajang, Malaysia
Title: Taste Dropped over the years
Review: I have been her few years back and the taste have dropped significantly. With the long queue we are able to eat within 15 minutes all because of its efficient workers. You would need to order before entering to speed the process. The rice was not fragrant as I expected it to be and also the chicken was not marinated well. BUT if you are trying it for the first time I would say its a good experience. Price for each rice ball is RM0.30 and they MIGHT LIMIT you on how many you could have due to the over demand. Overall it is a overrated chicken rice ball for a local.Show less

Author: CeciltongSingapore
Title: Don't be put off by the long queues
Review: Don't be put off by the long queues if you want to eat at one of the better chicken rice ball restaurants in Melaka. The staff is very efficient and so the customer turnover is quite quick. I would recommend choosing the rice ball/loose rice combination with the chicken. The assam fish is nice but it doesn't go well with chicken rice.Show less

Author: WJK29
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Locally famous and must-try delicacy. Have a lunch here and taste the chicken rice balls. Overall the meal is good. However, avoid visiting during peak hour as there will be long waiting queue

Author: Teddy W
Title: Good Food, Bad Service
Review: The food is better compared with Famosa Rice Ball. Their steamed chicken is not very greasy. Their price also reasonable and food service was fast.Unfortunately, the auntie manager was very rude.We visited on Sunday morning, with a few queue. The auntie said, there was only 2 package availabe, for 2 persons or 3 persons. When we asked, what was the package contains, she just gave us hard sigh and leave us. She come back a few second and ask again what we want to order with grumpy face. Because we were 3 person, so we ordered package for 3 persons, without knowing what we order.This auntie was very rude, she yelled and barking orders all the time to her waitresses. All the waitress work with tight face and no smile at all.As mentioned before, their food was good (but not special) and their price was reasonable. For a first time visitor, don't try to explore the menu and just enjoy what they offer.Show less

Author: Eileena_2005
Title: First time try
Review:
Came here for lunch cuz the other one we wanted to go was closed.
Have to queue for quite some time.
The food was just okay, not quite special.

Author: Nina_MostMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good service
Review: Lady who did explain to us what they have on menus 10 am in morning, was very helpful. As she did suggested we did order 2 pax chicken rice ball and cabbage. Chicken was very nice but rice balls have had rice taste only. With 2 coke and soya extra charge we paid RM 25.75 which is very good. They will charge you 6% GST.Service was fast and good.Show less

Author: dsyb70
Title: There are better place to try
Review:
Came here and try but it's really disappointing. 

I went another shop yesterday and my whole family mentioned that that place was nicer.

Not worth

Author: PhamKen13Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Ok
Review: I went there at 10a.m so only us :)) rice ball was famous so I tried it. Actually, it was not special, just rice to be rolled into ball. But u can try it if u go there first time. Price can be acceptable. The table was clean, maybe bc I was the first custome :))Show less

Author: Relax761799
Title: A must eat food in Malacca but maybe not this..
Review: It seems overrated online. Tried the chicken rice ball, nothing really great about it. Other places even nicer n better especially the chicken, the meat texture not tender at all.

Author: love2cookandtravelBrisbane, Australia
Title: Yum Chicken Rice
Review: Have gone to this restaurant each time we've been to Melaka & just love it. Have the chicken, plain rice and this time some veggies...mostly cabbage. Can't fault it. So simple but so delicious. Also had some Chinese tea which goes perfectlyLeft so full and imo for quite a reasonable priceShow less

Author: cnirving
Title: Chicken rice balls... better than it sounds
Review:
Friendly, helpful service coupled with fresh and tasty food all at a reasonable price.
Can’t go wrong!

Author: Alice SSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Familiar Comfort Food
Review: Arrived Malacca slightly after 12.30 pm. Tired and hungry, I asked my way to this restaurant. Wanted to fill my stomach first before heading to the hotel. The place was quite packed but no queue. I was directed to a small table. A young guy came to take my order. I asked for a quarter chicken and some rice balls. The guy was afraid that I might not be able to finish a quarter chicken, kept saying "Quarter chicken is for 2 persons". He went on to suggest that I should order just a thigh instead. I was looking forward to trying the rice balls - my first time eating them. The food came really fast. The chicken was smooth and tender, but nothing very special, as chicken rice is a very common dish in this part of the world. I was quite disappointed with the rice balls. I think I still prefer the rice in its loose form (just a personal preference). As for drinks/dessert, I had a coconut from Thailand. It came with a straw and a table spoon. The straw was for drinking the coconut juice and the spoon was for scrapping the coconut from its shell. The table spoon was too big, difficult to manoeuvre it inside the whole coconut. I asked for a smaller spoon but they did not have any. Restaurant should provide a proper spoon for scrapping/eating coconut.Show less

Author: SufenKe
Title: Nice place to eat!
Review: The shop itself is crowded but the staff will guide you to seats, rice ball is a must try, you can order more side dishes as the rice balls are small, maybe 10 rice balls is equal to one plate of normal chicken rice.

Author: 474ooil
Title: Not good
Review: Not worth the queue, running down in their food, other chicken rice shop will be more better choices

Author: SohyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not sure if worth the queue
Review: Reasonable good but not fantastic. Chicken skin is smooth but the meat is a little chewy. Chicken rice balls are tasty. Because there were only 2 of us, we could not order other dishes. To be fair, they are quite organised and the queue moved pretty fast so the wait was not that bad. Service is prompt and food came pretty quickly.Show less

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: All sold out at 2pm for lunch
Review: Came here for Tuesday lunch time , service was fast , food arrive fast , we had the chicken rice ball , chicken with bone and the other plate chicken without bone and vegetables, the rice ball was so so , prefer the fluffy normal rice , chicken was so so .. it was just average . Show less

Author: artnola
Title: Yummy authentic chicken rice
Review: I went right as they opened and had chicken rice for breakfast.  There was no queue- every other time I passed there was a line outside.

Author: Wenxi CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy!
Review: Hoe Kee Chicken Rice is one of the popular chicken rice shop in Melaka for Hainanese Chicken Rice Balls. Had passed by Hoe Kee a few times but it was always closed and I had never gotten the chance to enjoy their Chicken Rice even though there are a few players out there like Famosa, Chung Wah etc about 100m apart in Jonker Street. Hoe Kee is easy to locate as it is just located right next to San Shu Gong Shop (if you are looking for Malacca traditional biscuits, candies and stuff you should know where it is).Even looking at the queues, we did not surrender the idea of having their chicken rice. We joined the queues and not soon after, we got our seats. Service was impeccable and perfect team work was seen in the restaurant.While in the queue, we were looking into the kitchen observing staff preparing the orders and at the same time deciding what we should order. We noticed that many had ordered their cabbages and Asam Fish Head.Since it is very crowded, some exceptions were made up front but Hoe Kee, example, taking away service is not available and during busy times, they may not have enough rice ball, thus they will serve loose rice too.Throughout the session of queuing and dining, this uncle had never stopped concentrating on his continuous chopping of chicken.Menus were all pasted along the corridor and had gave us a good average calculation of how much we can spend in a meal.For chicken rice balls and meat, this menu serves a very good guide base on how many one should order.And if you have specific chicken portion and parts to order, this menu is quite handy to you.Orders were make during our queue and even for big groups, I would say the staff did a very good job by allocating seats well. As soon as we sat in, orders came. Communications are efficiently and fluently pass down to servers and kitchen.I love its interior as it had portray a very traditional feel like those ancient Chinese shows we watched through the television programs. It looked like a walk back into the olden dynasty but in our modern clothing.Before the dishes arrived, we took some chilli and black sauce. Chilli was fiery but come with a tad of sweetness within.Loose rice was fluffy and fragrant, my perfect craving on and empty stomach.Loose Rice - RM 1.50Comparing the Rice Balls to the loose rice, they are stickier and packed with lesser fragrant. According to the chart written by the restaurant, the guide for 1 pax will be 5 rice balls. Each rice ball is small like Ping Pong size.Rice Ball - RM 4.50 (15 Balls)There are no other vegetables except for the small plate of Beijing Cabbages with carrots. It tastes sweet and ordinary if you want to have some greens. The portion paid is based on the number of pax you ordered.Beijing Cabbage - RM 3.00 (Portion for 2 Pax)We ordered half a poached chicken to share among 3. It was drenched and soaked up with fragrant light soy sauce, delectable with crunchy cucumber slices. Chicken was succulent and taste was to die for.Half Chicken - RM 22.50Being in Malacca for a few times, having chicken rice balls is a must have in my meals but beating the crowds, queuing up for the staples food of Malacca can be time consuming too. Unlike Famosa, there is only one Hoe Kee Chicken Rice shop, I guess queues are inevitable. However, I'm glad that we do not have to make advance reservations like those Nyonya Restaurant to enjoy such chicken rice meal.Show less

Author: SolomonsGuildSingapore, Singapore
Title: Super Delicious But Super Long Queue!
Review: We heard about this shop on our 1st day of visiting Malacca and decided to have lunch there...The chicken rice stall is located in a very old house with wooden beams and doors... throughout the place were articles of their history, media coverage and Chinese sayings... Although the premise is huge, the queue is longer! After 30 minutes of waiting in the heat, we decided to come the next day...We came early the next day for brunch instead and people have already started to queue and when we arrived, the queue was literary out the door at 11.00am!Whilst standing in the queue, take note to read all the notices posted on the wall... As this stall is exceptionally busy and of the long queue daily, everything has to be done relatively quickly... Hence their notices are about not having enough rice balls and may have to be loose rice, deciding on your beverages before hand etc... In other words, no frills, thrills or spills!We ordered 30 rice balls (15 per plate and based on number of persons, we are a family of 6), 1 whole chicken and a plate of vegetables...Food arrived and though presentation wise nothing to brag about, the taste of the dishes were great!The only thing to look out for when eating the chicken is to be careful of small bones and splinters...This is because of the way the chicken was chopped, bones and all... In other words the chicken will not be deboned and you eat them as is...Pricewise was relatively ok. For what we ordered, it came to MY76.00 (~S$25)All in all, an interesting place... the rice ball experience and the historical aspect of the place made it a well worth visit... though be early! Show less

Author: CklsqSingapore
Title: Average
Review: Went there for breakfast at 9.30am in the morning. There wasn't a crowd and we were able to get seats immediately.The meal was 18.90 RM for 2 people in total excluding drinks. It comes with a plate of chicken with 10 rice balls. Meal came promptly around 5-7mins later. They gave quite a generous portion of chicken serving. The chicken was quite tender and easy to eat. Overall, it was quite a good experience.Show less

Author: 559tany
Title: Super crowded
Review: Super crowded even at late 2pm on a friday. They had limited rice ball for sale as well so we had to take the half half portion of loose rice and rice balls. Tasted alright not mindblowing.

Author: nsujeet
Title: Chicken rice & Fish curry
Review: I eat chicken rice and fish curry for breakfast. And had ice tea. I just happen to find this restaurant, as there were huge queue outside and i was passing by.

Author: cianathannia
Title: So delicious!!!
Review: Love it! Like it so much! Good taste. Affordable price (8 persons = RM84 only!) A liiiiiittle bit dissappointed with the service, but it's okay :)

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: STANDARDS DROP.
Review: The standards seems to have dropped of late, besides being slightly more expensive than I recalled. It is now below par as compared to WEE NAM KEE HAINANESE CHICKEN RICE located in Singapore.Unlike previous experiences, we walked in instead of having to queue, during the weekends. Surprise surprise!Nevertheless, a must try for those who had not.Show less

Author: Sightseer712565
Title: Not worth the trouble
Review: Chicken is overcooked and too salty. The que is too long and it is definetely over rated. You are eating in a rush as they just want more business.

Author: teh s
Title: Yummy lunch
Review: Our family of 9 came here early for brunch. Great idea because we managed to beat the lunch crowd. There is a proper queuing system with staff taking order so that your food may arrive promptly when you are seated. They serve 2 types of chicken rice - the ball and loose rice. Although the ball rice is Malacca signature, we prefer the flavour of the loose chicken rice. This is serve with steam chicken. You may have side orders of vegetables. Service is very prompt and the staff friendly. Show less

Author: kumyokekKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fragrant Rice
Review: Good choice for Hainanese Chicken Rice. Queue for tables but since we were early there was table available.Rice ball was limited to 20 for our group of 4. If extra rice needed, it will not be in ball form. Chicken is good too. You can have quarter, half or whole chicken or if you are not sure just tell the waiter chicken portion for how many pax.Just love the yummy fragrant rice.Show less

Author: sassyguyKuala Lumpur
Title: Nice chicken ball rice
Review: Nice chicken ball rice meal here again. But they seem to limit number of rice balls for every table which is a damper if you are here just to have those rice balls. Beware of long queues during holidays especially since the next door Chung wah famous chicken rice balls seems to have ended operating recently.Show less

Author: Kim T
Title: Chicken rice is satisfying
Review: Even adventurous travellers and children sometimes need comfort food, and chicken rice hits the spot. Right on Jonker St you know Hoe Kee has earned its spot and its queues. We had a great late lunch of chicken rice/ rice balls for 4, bottled water and a couple of beers for RM62. Good value (given the location) and we'd come again. Show less

Author: copycalebKlang, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated
Review: I don't understand why people queue for this. I have had way better chicken rice balls outside of Melaka. You can try heading to the Klang Valley and you'll be surprised how bad this one is compared to the ones found over there. I used to frequent Chung Wah and thought it was the best in Melaka but even that has dropped in standards, and is currently closed without notice. Hoe Kee's chicken was bland, the rice was very normal. You can get authentic Hainanese chicken rice (not in ball form though) that is so fragrant and flavorful you can eat it plates of it without the chicken. Try Kedai Nasi Dan Ayam along Petaling Street and then you will know what real Hainan chicken rice tastes like. This will be my last visit to Hoe Kee.Show less

Author: princessapple3
Title: Yummy fish head curry and chicken rice ball
Review: The place is on famous Jonker Street. We love fish head curry and we had to order more. Rice ball with chicken was good. Food isn't too expensive and good service.

Author: AlvinO179
Title: HOE kee
Review: First time morning 930am having this Nice chicken rice and best Asam fish.. abit long q but worth it

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Special Malacca Chicken Rice
Review: Chicken rice ball is only available in Malacca. Famous & well known to tourists. The outlet in jonker street is always crowded

Author: baymax88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Bagus!
Review: First time trying after 2nd failed trip this year to try Chung Wah chicken rice ball. A trip to Hoe Kee will not make you feel the trip is wasted. Despite there was a long Q, it is pretty fast moving. You can have some putu piring while waiting lol. In my previous trip to Jonker street in July 2017, failed to get to eat Chung Wah chicken rice ball and did this time. I presume the place has been closed, but unsure of it's permanent or temporarily.Reason to why I was 'a little fixated' on having that was because when I first tried about 3-4 years ago, it was quite good so sticking to it on my second trip to malacca would be a safer choice. However Hoe Kee did not fail me, it's presentation is definitely much neater and nicer than Chung Wah. I had also tried formosa chicken in my July trip this year but it was disappointing to say. I will definitely want to try Hoe Kee assam fish the next round because it looks yummilicious!Show less

Author: GanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome asam fish
Review: Must be one of the most affordable restaurants in Jonker street. There is a never ending q daily at lunch time. Excellent chicken rice balls, awesome asam fish. Unfortunately, the much heard of well boiled soup was not on the menu when we were there. Really a good excuse to go again.Show less

Author: teoa460
Title: Tourist attraction chicken rice
Review: Come here for the atmosphere . there are many good chicken rice elsewhere but this place delivers the jonker street melaka experience

Author: Lanilynn001Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Title: Lovely authentic food experience
Review: Recommended by our tour guide, we visited this place for lunch during our day trip to Melaka. The food was great and the experience was priceless. We loved trying something new and different (wooden stools instead of chairs and low round tables). we enjoyed it and it was a good value for money.Show less

Author: LimJoey1996Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food with good customer service but have to queue
Review: Good customer service. The staff will immediately change the spoon once we inform them the spoon is dirty and say sorry to us. Chicken rice ball and chicken breast taste nice. Need to queue about 30 minutes to 1 hour but its worth to queue. Want to try their Asam fish but it already sold out. Will go to try next time. Price also cheap. Inside the shop also not too hot although the whether in Melaka very hot.Show less

Author: Arthur Elfin CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Average coffee shop
Review: Lunch at Hoe Kee Chicken Rice @ Jonker WalkAmbience:It was a local coffee shop and very much an "eat and go" unpretentious place. There was a queue but we got a seat in less than 5 min. The staff took our orders before showing us our seats. Efficiently handled. The sign at the entrance said they didn't have enough experienced staff to knead the rice into rice balls but we were served rice balls eventually - quite weird. Food:a. The soya sauce chicken was rather tender. It was definitely kampung chicken aka non-GMO so meat was lean. b. The chicken rice balls were OK but lacked fragrance. They weren't really warm either. We were given 10 balls each about the size of a ping pong ball. c. The chilli sauce, while spicy, was rather diluted. They used vinegar instead of lime, and definitely not hand-pounded. Was hoping for ginger sauce but none.d. The cabbage dish was quite plain and nothing really special about it. Price:SGD 8 (include 2 teas) and the portion was sufficient for 2. Overall verdict: Not bad but nothing to rave about.Show less

Author: YzTengC
Title: Fast service
Review: I think not necessary to try it because it just normal and not so tasty... oily chicken meat , chicken rice make to be a rice ball and taste just so-so ... price considering high and other chicken rice shops are tasty than this

Author: Winson_ChuaRongsenSingapore
Title: Fantastic Assam Fish
Review: Went for lunch and ordered 3pax set, added assam fish. The assam fish is fresh and the gravy is amazing (balance of both spicy and sour). Chicken and rice is ok. The rice does not have a strong garlic smell. So if you are the type who prefer strong garlic smell, you might not like the rice here.Show less

Author: AnuvatC
Title: very popular chicken rice ball
Review: If you are in Melaka or Malacca, you have to try Hainanese chicken rice ball. It's kinda unique here. Basically it's just Hainanese chicken rice that's well known in Singapore or Malaysia but they make normal chicken rice into rice ball. Why? I don't know. taste? I prefer normal rice which they serve here too. Their chicken is good. Also Assam fish is good too. Another good thing is the ambient. Very nice Chinese style inn like in Chinese movies.Show less

Author: 134teresaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fast Food as it should be.
Review: The waitresses who work here are friendly efficient and full of life. We had our meal consumed within 20 minutes without feeling rushed. We ate our shredded juicy chicken breast with the best tasty rice balls and a dollop of hot chili sauce. The restaurant was packed with satisfied customers of all ages. It definitely is a must and do not be put off by the cue as I said this is fast food at it's best and you don't have to wait long. Show less

Author: thefamilycatBirmingham, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious Chicken Rice with Generous portions
Review: Arrived around 1.30pm and was fortunate enough to be seated immediately. Lady who took our order was knowledgeable and recommended a few variations of dishes. She also spoke mandarin and hokkien which made it easy for us to converse as we are from Kuching :) We chose a mixture of chicken rice and chicken rice balls. The dish arrived with half a chicken on one plate and two plates of rice (one normal plate and one ball plate) The place was cool even though the temperature was blazing at 35°C which made the meal relaxing. The chilli and dark soy sauce compliments the chicken rice very well. Will definitely return in the near future. Show less

Author: salini01Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Best chicken rice ball everrrrrr
Review: I have tried most of the chicken rice ball in Melaka and this is THE BEST! Rice is full of aroma and the chicken is so soft. This place is always crowded but on weekdays, it's a bit okay. I visited this place on a Friday and I had to wait about 5 minutes only. Avoid weekends and school holidays, queue is pretty long and the place can be very packed.Show less

Author: 27Vivien77
Title: Nice chicken rice balls!
Review: If you like something a little different, the chicken rice here has chicken served with rice balls. I liked it! At times, there is a long queue - chicken in soy sauce is tender and the chilli goes well with it. Worth a visit!

Author: June C
Title: Tender Chicken Meat!
Review: We were lucky to get a table before the restaurant was closed for the day (in the evening)! The staff were very friendly. The chicken meat was tender and the rice balls were fragrant. The serving was ample for 2 persons and the price was reasonable. Show less

Author: T SJupiter, Florida
Title: Not Enjoyable
Review: Decided to go at 9am since there is always a long queue at this restaurant. After eating there, I have no idea why there is a queue. The chicken is tough and flavourless. The rice balls were dry. The only saving grace was the homemade garlic chili sauce. Would definitely not go back.For what it is worth, I have never given a restaurant in Malaysia a "poor" rating. The food is usually outstanding.Show less

Author: Patrick L
Title: Chicken Rice Balls in Malacca
Review:
Had a great meal of the round kind. 

This is about the original chicken rice in a ball form. The chicken is done well with the soya sauce. 

Pity we were a little late and there wasn't anymore assam fish, gizzards etc ...

Author: nonikuliner
Title: Outstanding chicken rice ball
Review: Delicious and authentic food. Always crowded. The service is fast and relatively nice. Located very strategicly at jonker street, close to the bridge (the river and hardrock cafe). Just try. You can not go wrong.

Author: Rain HSingapore, Singapore
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: This restaurant located along the Jonker street. you probably won't miss it during the day time. Long queue is expected. This taste better than the other chicken rice ball i ate before. The chicken is not as tender compare to some chicken rice, but is good for me. if you like asam fish, give it a try. i like this.Show less

Author: sarasasihBali, Indonesia
Title: Great Chicken Rice Ball from The Chinatown
Review: We found this place in Melaka. This place was quite full when we were there for lunch. They served Chinese food such as chicken rice ball, Hainan rice, steamed fish or chicken, etc. The meals tasted great with such an affordable price. And they have package menu as well. The place looks like an old Chinese restaurant, it's still feel so authentic after all. But this place is quite hot as they still using ceiling fan instead of AC for their restaurant.Show less

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: BEST CHICKEN RICE.
Review: GREAT CHEAP FOOD. Everypne should try it at least once. have been eating here for more than 15 years, and quality is still that good. Though they seldom give out chicken rice balls due to overwhelming demand.Chicken however, pales in comparison with CHONG WAH RESTAURANT, but still beats all others hands down.Show less

Author: FairyKoPortland, Maine
Title: Try the Hainan Chicken Rice in a BALL way!
Review: Chicken rice can be found anywhere but not in a BALL way. It was my first time trying the Hainan chicken rice ball. I have to say it was really tasty and reasonably priced - the steamed white chicken was fresh and the rice was full of flavor and oily as the way it should be. Probably the best Hainan chicken rice I've ever tried. Highly recommend! Show less

Author: KiddySing
Title: Probably the best chicken rice in Malacca
Review: Probably the best in Malacca. Very tender chicken with generous portions. Price reasonable. Hygiene not the best but maybe that adds to the flavour!

Author: cheeriblue
Title: Lunch at Hoe Kee
Review: I don't find the chicken rice very fantastic.  There is not much meat on the chicken and the rice is not very fragrant.  But the asam fish is nice.

Author: Varun KCairnlea
Title: Hainanese chicken and rice balls!!!!
Review: My freind who has family in malaysia knew of all the great places to eat and he had visited this shop before and spoke highly of it. I don't like hainanese chicken to be honest compared to most other food options but I have full trust in my mates food repertoire and he never failed to disappoint. When we got there, we were lucky as there wasn't much of a line and sat straight down and the hainanese chicken I had in this shop wad one of my top foods I had in my time in malaysia, that was including my time in penang. Its unreal the chicken is full of flavour and is super juicy and it is something that is a must try. Some of the reviews on here are surprisingly disappointing. People that are complaining about the service. You are in a third world country and in any third world country the food does the talking not the service. There is a line there and it is there for a purpose it's the hainanese chicken and rice balls, you would be stupid to order other things make the best of the specialties of the restaurant. Show less

Author: KlCarmenKL
Title: One for the experience
Review: The ambiance is cosy with old style setting including the furniture. The establishment seems to be quite an attraction with the media clippings mounted on the walls. The lady which served us was really friendly and fluent in multi language. We ordered the standard fare of chicken rice ball and assam fish ( which you can even opt for head or tail) In view that none of us is proficient enough to do the fish head justice we went for the tail portion. The bill came to RM 40.30 for 4 ladies who dont eat much .I wont say it is pricey as the whole site is rather touristy. No service charge but with GST 6%Hint :There are queue on some days so come early if you can or come at odd hours.Show less

Author: Tang L
Title: Love the Ambience
Review: Having chicken rice balls in an old capitan days house... the asam fish was good, providing additional flavor to the tongue on top of the much sought after chicken rice balls.

Author: Alvin HSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must Try Local Delicacy
Review: The signature dish here is of course the Hainanese chicken served with rice balls. Other than the chicken, they also serve other dishes, which we have ordered Asam fish, cabbage and black bean soup. In my opinion, the rice balls are unique and the chopped chicken served in light soya sauce is nice. The chili sauce also tastes good. However being from Singapore (which hosts numerous Hainanese chicken rice stalls and restaurants too), the expectation of chicken rice quality is high and Hoe Kee still pales in comparison to some of the famous stalls in Singapore, in terms of fragrance of the rice and tenderness of the chicken meat. Nevertheless, the Hainanese chicken with rice balls is still a must-try dish when in Malacca.Show less

Author: 543kft
Title: normal
Review: Not much choice. But fish is better than chicken. Probably we have chicken almost everyday in China, we felt not special.

Author: Christopher MSydney, Australia
Title: Local delicacies at their most local
Review: There is one dish on the menu Hainanese Chicken and Rice Balls. If you don't like that, don't go there. Pretty simple really.This place is crowded, noisy and runs at a breakneck pace. There is almost always a queue of locals and visitors outside waiting to get a seat, so that's testimony to the reputation of the food.Try it once. It would be a shame to miss out.Show less

Author: NickHtun
Title: Nice Chicken & Fish Head
Review: It is a restaurant with no long queue but reasonable taste of Chicken and Fish Head. But not much variety to choose from.

Author: ChowF36
Title: Overrated, Unfriendly Tourist Trap
Review: Lots of chicken breast for half chicken!  Owner very rude when being questioned.  Would not recommend!

Author: Zivasbin
Title: Highly recommended
Review: The food is great. Don't forget to try asam fish. Located in Jonker street, worth a visit. Service is very good and efficient.

Author: debs_ngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food!
Review: This has always been my favourite place to dine when it comes to chicken rice ball. The chicken is tender and fresh. The rice balls are well done and they taste really good if you drizzle them with chilli sauce (mixed with dark sauce). They also serve a variety of side dishes including assam fish, fried cabbage and soup. I've tried the black bean soup and simply love it. This places gives me a very homely feeling The service is excellent. Even though there is always a long line outside the restaurant, they make you sure get a table really quickly. It's one of my 'must visit' places when I visit Melaka! Show less

Author: GardenCafeInKemaman
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: This is another place to have the Malacca chicken rice ball. Surprisingly this place is huge with good and fast service.

Author: arwen_tripMiri, Malaysia
Title: Good try n experience
Review: My first time eating at Hoe Kee. Long Q but not as long as Chung hwa which is few doors down. Selected them because review said the chicken is nicer then Chung hwa. Service is fast n friendly. They come with some default set menu and recommendation of serving. I have 4 adults with 2 little toddlers. Ordered 4 person portion the rice is not enuff. So we top up further. Taste wise I think it's ok. Not particular very very nice. So better set ur expectation right. :) however at least after eat not very thirsty. it's good experience to eat the famous famous chicken rice. :) the rice ball is a bit cold. My family doesnt quite like it ( tradition old pple lol). Price is reasonable. Very nice setting. The antique architecture. Show less

Author: Johnstanno
Title: Okay
Review: Queue around 10mins to get a seat. Rice balls are nice... chicken so so. I had better chicken rice in Singapore.

Author: Anthony CBurlington, Vermont
Title: Best Chicken n' Rice in Melaka!
Review: Great portions of really tasty chicken and rice! Awesome portion sizes to keep you full as you venture out and explore the city. It's very crowded and the lines can get long. Appears to be a must-do when visiting. Melaka has some really nice restaurants and street food vendors, but the food here was awesome! Definitely recommend!Show less

Author: AgnesK172
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Chicken here is of a nice size n juicy. Rice ball is delicious. Chillie plus the sweet sauce makes it all a happy dish. Just a little thought from me to you (who are reading this). Try to eat the rice ball as a whole. I feel it is more flavourful this way. i think. Overall, a very enjoyable meal for both of us. Show less

Author: Domchong
Title: Lunch at Jonker
Review: Went there for lunch. Chicken rice ball is tasty. Chicken smooth and yummy. Have not tried other chicken rice ball yet. So this restaurant tasted good to me.

Author: Mokkey8Hong Kong, China
Title: Decent chicken rice ball
Review: There are a number of chicken rice ball restaurants in Malacca, particularly on/off Jonker Street.Didn't have a queue (unlike Chung Hwa which consistently has a long queue) so we came in here.Chicken ball rice was good but the chicken itself was okay - not as good as other establishments For this visit to Malacca, not having to queue up in the heat was way I chose Hoe KeeShow less

Author: Kim Yong L
Title: Definitely OVERRATED
Review:
The food is definitely not worth the queue!
The chicken rice taste really bad!!
The service is really poor as well!

Not recommended!!
We won't be back!

Author: Vic_hlh
Title: Overrated
Review: Me and my family go there at 29/1/2017. Queue up 45 minutes for dine in. They do not provide any vegetables that day due to not enough manpower. The chicken rice ball and asam fish are really disappointed. Any of the chicken rice stall at Selangor and WP area that I had, the taste is much more better than here. Feel that this is a place that for tourist only, local people might know the better place.Show less

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Still the better chicken rice around
Review: While this is not the best chicken rice in Malacca, it is most certainly not one of the worse. Of the top 3 competing giants along Jonker Street (Hoe Kee, Chung Hwa & Famosa), Hoe Kee still comes out the winner - quick and friendly service, spacious & airy interior, larger seating capacity.Go for the loose chicken rice which will likely taste fresher than the chicken rice balls which was most likely prepared much earlier in advance to speed up the serving process. Parking is limited along Jonker Street, so look for one in the parallel street behind Jonker even if it means you'll have to walk a little more.Show less

Author: Katz2by2
Title: Okay
Review: This restaurant closes at 3pm and the lunch line up starts at 11am! We joined the line and enjoyed pretty good chicken rice. Good prices. Loud and abrasive service. Nice atmosphere. A good lunch overall.

Author: KLCLCCSingapore
Title: Definitely OVERRATED!!!!!!!
Review: I went with my friends few days ago as my friend insisted to go and try it out!!The chicken rice balls taste really bad!!!!!We had the first bite and we stopped eating the chicken rice balls. Don't queue, it is definitely not worth your time. My friends were really disappointed and we had to go to another restaurant to have our lunch.Show less

Author: nunes2016Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Nice try
Review: I ordered chicken with rice ball, spicy fish stew and stir-fry cabbage. The chicken was really good; tender and juicy. However, riceball was too moisted. I prefered the original rice more. I arrived around 11 on weekday so there was not much crowded. It was on jonker street near the river.Show less

Author: Hwy257
Title: Original taste
Review: Maybe the taste is the original one... different taste with chicken rice in singapore or different place, but good enough and unique for me. Overall it's great. You must try rice ball and asam pedas fish in here...

Author: PeggyT753
Title: Most Delicious Chicken Rice in Melaka
Review: This is truly the famous Melaka Rice Ball place. There are many in Melaka but Hoe Kee is the authentic MUST eat chicken rice place. Don't be bluff by the red Famosa Rice Ball shop that you see here and there. No others can beat Hoe Kee. The waiter and waitress are helpful. If you do not know what to order, let them recommend to you. Apart from chicken rice, please order the delicious Assam fish too. You may want to order a fresh coconut to go with it. The pricing is value for money.Show less

Author: seuleun88
Title: Fresh and Juicy!
Review: The chicken was fresh and juicy, though it was not as tender as I expect; the rice ball was fluffy, the cabbage was good. I wish to try their asam fish head in my next visit! I actually visited the restaurant in a Thursday morning so there was no queue. We got to enjoy the chicken rice slowly and steadily without afraid of keeping others to wait under the Sun!Show less

Author: 713sinpPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Worth the queue
Review: The queue can be long but the experience and food is worth the wait. This restaurant is housed in an antique prewar Chinese courthouse hence the interior design exudes a warm ancient Chinese feel. The chicken rice balls were tasty and fluffy- a must try! The steamed chicken served today was a tad salty with too much soy and sesame sauce, and the Hainanese Chili sauce was lacking the lime juice /vinegar. We didn't order the stir-fried cabbage or assam fish. For drinks, their eight treasures herbal tea (ba bao herbal tea) was heavenly with tangy hints of boiled orange peel in it. Strong point of this restaurant is that it is opened till 4pm, but do come earlier to avoid disappointment (sold out food) Show less

Author: jyeongllSingapore, Singapore
Title: Long Queue serving Light Fluffy Rice Balls
Review: When you enter Jonker street, you will first spot Kedai Kopi Chung Wah - the other famed chicken rice ball shop with a long queue. As you walk past Sam Shu Gong shop, there it is, Hoe Kee Hainanese Chicken Rice Ball shop, with a relatively long queue too.The challenge is queuing next to the moving cars, lorries, and motorbikes who will not hesitate to cut into the standing space when they can - so queuing can be treacherous at times. The other uncomfortable part is queuing under the sun. Thankfully, the queue I was in on a Tuesday noon around 12.40pm lasted only 20 minutes. But when seated, the wait was another 20minutes, so in total about 40minutes.The chicken arrived tender, tasty as expected. And the chicken rice balls were light and fluffy, unlike those in farmosa.Overall, I guess, if they improve the queuing situation, it would be a better dining experience.Show less

Author: Lee_family_219053Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Chicken Rice, Ball and Assam Fish Curry
Review: Was in Malacca for a family outing. Heard many different chicken rice ball shops but was recommended by a local to eat here as the other ones with long queue is over-rated and standard has dropped.Not to be disappointed after a short wait were seated awaiting our order. The menu was posted at the door and order was taken before seated. Clear pricing and fast turn around. Order is on per person basis.
