Yes, the queue can get long, but if you go just a bit early (the first time we went for a late breakfast at about 11am) or a bit later (2nd time at about 2pm and there was a queue but it went really fast - only 15 min) it is fine. And so what you share a table, that makes part of the experience and all the places do the same anyway. I'd much rather share a table than have to wait twice as long in the queue to sit down to eat. And both times the service was fine (much better than Chung Wah) - in fact the second day the lassie recognised us and was really happy we came back. Oh course, we're no experts and in fact the first time we ever had chicken rice was in Melaka, but for us, the Hoe Kee is the best. And now, I make it at home - of course can't make the rice balls, but you can get the seasoning mix for the rice in Chinese supermarkets (yes, even in Dundee!) and it comes out really nice.Show less

Author: cynmaine
Title: not so good
Review: the service was bad.  the waitress was not friendly.  Queue so long and get this service. Food was average only. dont expect too high

Author: theprincesswSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: There was a really long queue on this shop and if you are bit late, you will just have bear being served by anything that they still have left. So better come a bit earlier. Food is so-so though, just as how chicken rice should taste like. Nothing special. As for the atmosphere: very busy, eat-pay-go, chop-chop-eat-quick-there's-a-long-line-outside, and you'll often have to share your table with other people. Service? Well, you just have to be grateful with the fact that you finally got a table, now you expect service?Show less

Author: 628Michelle
Title: You Will Never Say No To Rice !!!
Review: if you think you do not like rice , then you will have to think twice when you are at Hoe Kee Chicken Rice Ball !

Author: tanmalaysia_11Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great rice ball
Review: Hoe Kee chicken rice restaurant is certainly very popular here at Jonker street. Always a queue outside, and in weekend, you may have to wait for half an hour to get in. Well, chicken rice--- the chicken-- is the same every where in Malaysia (almost), the uinique food here is the rice ball, very special, very nice. It was hand-made and very different from rice ball from other Chicken Rice Ball restaurants.Show less

Author: SforSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice chicken rice
Review: We tried chung wah chicken rice many times and decided to try Hoe Kee this time round.We found that Hoe Kee Chicken is comparable to chung wah chicken. Hoe kee's chicken rice is tastier than chung wah and lesser queue as hoe kee's sitting capacity is double of Chung wah.I personally feel that Hoe Kee is tastier but their chilli is not nice - sour and not spicy.If i were to eat chicken rice again in Malacca, I think i will go to chung Wah cos chilli is very important to me. Chung Wah's chilli is spicier and not sour.Do consider Hoe Kee if you are looking for chicken rice.Show less

Author: eblissSingapore
Title: Nice food but long queue
Review: We went past it at around 1pm, the queue is so long that it is on the road itself. When we went back at around 4+pm, we managed to get in pretty fast.Assam Fish Head - fishy smell, Assam sauce is thick and fantastic, a bit spicyChicken - the meat is rubbery, most likely those kampong chickens, must have done enough exercises running around all day.Rice - We did not try the rice balls because we had it before and don't find it nice. The rice this time is fragrant, better than the rice balls.Vegetables - bland cabbage with a few strips of carrots.We did not get to try out the black beans soup because it ran out.Show less

Author: joey9010Singapore, Singapore
Title: food is very nice!
Review: their rice is very nice! it's very famous resturant in Melaka. if you want to try this resturant for lunch or dinner, you should go earlier than the time. unless you have to wait! when I finished lunch there is a long que and it's around 1pm or 2pm!Show less

Author: Jhawk2820Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average taste.
Review: Tried the chicken rice balls, but don't really like the texture as it kind of soft. Their normal chicken rice is not bad.Nothing fantastic about their chicken. It a bit dry and bland.Probably due to the good review, expected better quality food.Bottle soya bean drink is rich and nice, too bad, barely drink out of stock on the time of visit.Show less

Author: peggy_teo
Title: Nothing too special
Review: I've been to this restaurant a few times previously and I felt that the taste seems getting not as good as compared to the previous times I had. And we have to queue for it.

Author: HowlEra
Title: Nice chicken rice ball!
Review: The rice was softer than that in Singapore and service was fast despite the huge crowds.

Author: jojoliaSingapore, Singapore
Title: The long queue seems to be a misconception.
Review: My review and comparison is base on chicken rice I had tried in other places, and not among the stalls in Malacca especially along Jonker street.There's a few stalls of chicken rice balls along Jonker. Somehow misinterpreting my friend's direction to a stall he finds the best tasting, I ended up in Hoe Kee.First time eating rice ball, and personally I do not like soft and sticky rice.The normal rice lacks the fragrance that chicken rice should have.The meat was kind of chewy and chilli not as good.Show less

Author: Yukari F
Title: Best chicken rice I've ever had
Review: The chicken is soft and tasty. But the rice ball is the best!

Author: RetiredTraveller
Title: "Die die must try" chicken rice balls & soup
Review: The small chicken rice ball is aroumatic & tasty. The white steamed chicken is tender & not oily/fatty. The home cooked black bean & chicken feet soup at RM1 a bowl is cheap but delicious. It's so good that I order a second helping.

Author: kefaloveJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice restaurant, ok food.
Review: The restaurant style like the one that you saw at Kungfu film. Very nice & cozy. We love to see it, meanwhile the food is kinda funny to see the riceball. I found out singapore chicken rice is still more delicious, KL Bukit bintang chicken is better also. But come to eat here, you won't dissppoint anyway. 2 ppl (1 plates of chicken, 1 plates of rice ball & a vegetables) costs RM 16.Show less

Author: ambiga tPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Alternative place to eat chicken rice balls
Review: We went there after tryin Chung Wa's chicken rice balls. The rice balls were bigger and taste ok. The chickens were tender and easy to chew. The rice balls only cost MYR0.20 per ball and its not too small. The cabbage is not highly recommended because there was nothing special about but do order if u want to add vegetables to your rice. However, during weekends they serve normal chicken rice with rice balls. Price was MYR16 including drinks. Try going after 4pm to avoid the queue.Show less

Author: CarolynnAng5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: Chicken rice ball (or at least chicken rice) is like one of those must eat dishes when one visits Melaka. We did the same! Our original intention was to eat at the other stall (Chung Wah Restaurant) but it was already closed (at 3pm) so we ended up at Hoe Kee. As it was already past 4pm there was no long queue but still very crowded. Melaka is a very humid and hot place so we wanted a cool drink and seating places. However we were (8 of us) stopped at the entrance. Little did we realise that we were to order our food in advance at entrance before we can be seated. So this was really a thumbs down for us, as the server kept rambling on marketing their dishes like asam fish, etc which we thought it was too much for us for 2 reasons, one we were there for snacks and little bites not a large standard meal, two, we were rushed to make immediate decision which go against with our travel intention (relax, eat, drink and enjoy!).So we requested that we leave 2 persons with the server to continue the ordering while the rest of us sit down and wait at our table. Unhappily and with sour face, the server said ok. We did not use (or see) any menu so it might be challenging for someone who is new to such dishes and you might just be shoved with those dishes which you might not intend to order as a result. So just ask more questions but not be hurried by the server. The place was amazingly crowded even at late afternoon. The environment is nice and airy. We are disappointed by the "Herbal Tea" we ordered (see picture) which did not taste like one. Unfortunately we started eating the food before pictures of the food can be taken :-) we order both rice ball and normal rice. The chicken rice ball was so-so. Most of us prefer the normal chicken rice as it was more fragrant than the ball. If you have not tried before, you can try it -- it is not terrible. But if you have tasted better chicken rice elsewhere, you might not find this place that fantastic. Generally I would say the food is average but nothing to shout about.Show less

Author: Hwee Chong CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent chicken rice
Review: My wife and I love Hoe Kee Chicken Rice Ball. It is always our first restaurant stop whenever we visit Malacca. The chicken is consistently good, and has a different, bouncier texture compared to the smoother, more tender version common in Singapore.Rice ball goes well with this kampung chicken texture, though I have to say the rice ball is not consistently good on every visit. Overall It is a decent interpretation of this very common Asian dish and definitely worth a try for first-timers.Show less

Author: daniellee78
Title: A big nono for the Assam fish
Review: Took us 25 minutes to que and end up sharing a table with another couple.. Steam chicken was excellent as the meat was tender , wish the rice ball was a bit bigger though BUT the Assam fish was a big letdown and expensive too. Lastly the chilli sauce could do some improvement too.. Will give it a try if the queue is not too long..Show less

Author: n8210Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I still don't get it
Review: The first time I tried this shop's chicken rice, I was not surprised. Nothing special. Luckily back in 6-7 years ago, one working afternoon, there was hardly much crowd. Just a 5 min wait and we can get a seat. That was my first experience. This time round in 2011, long queues and still the same quality. I just don't get it. Why the long queues? I love chicken rice. I used to eat chicken rice for the whole 2 years as lunch when I was in high school. Parents had to work and I couldn't cook. Now, I live across the street to 2 chicken rice shops, and they both beat the Melaka chicken rice any time of the day!! I give it a "No go".Show less

Author: LegalbeaglebaysJakarta, Indonesia
Title: The best chicken rice ever!
Review: Everytime I go to Melaka, this place is a must! The chicken rice ball itself actually is nothing to write home about, however the chicken and its garlic chili sauce is really out of this world. The meat is very tender and delicious. Compared to other food stall in Melaka this place is not cheap, but acceptable. When you decide to visit this restaurant, make sure you also order the Liang Teh Peng for your drink. it made great combination with the food. I tried other chicken rice ball stall in Melaka, but for me, Hoe Kee is the best.Show less

Author: EnqvistlimPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Best in Jonker Street
Review: among the many chicken rice shop in Jonker street, i personally this Hoe Kee is the best as it has the most tender soft chicken and rice ball is tasty as well, sour and spicy curry fish is a must to try. visit our review here http://tasteiest.blogspot.com/2011/05/hoe-kee-chicken-rice-at-melaka.htmlShow less

Author: missduhrSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hoe Kee's chicken is good, but chicken rice balls are way overrated
Review: Let me state for the record that I LOVE chicken rice. If I could eat only one dish every day for the rest of my life, it would be chicken rice. But I have discovered that I am not a fan of chicken rice balls. I don't like the texture, I don't like how the rice just clumps together and feels gooey/mushy on the palate. I tried Hoe Kee because when you're in Malacca, you just have to have the chicken rice balls and you have to try them either at Hoe Kee or Chung Wah. But the queues at Chung Wah were too long and I wasn't prepared to wait for my turn in the hot sun. Hoe Kee's steamed chicken was actually quite good. Even though we were given breast meat, it was tender and tasty. The rice balls however were just not my thing. Give me normal rice any day.Apart from that, service here is efficient and food magically appears on your table almost as soon as they take your order. Hoe Kee is also quite a pleasant place to dine in, there are fans everywhere to keep customers cool, and they also serve vegies and assam fish alongside the chicken.Show less

Author: dotnahSingapore
Title: Chicken tasty Rice ball so-so
Review: We went at 2pm, queue was not too long and we were served after 10 mins. The choice is quite limited. After we said we are not eating the Fish head, we are left with just stean chicken, rice ball, and one type of boiled veg. The chicken is tender and tasty. As it was the first time we tried rice ball, I think loose rice is still preferred. The chilli sauce is mixed way too thin. For those who wants to try Malacca Chicken Rice, this restaurant would not dissappoint. However, I think Singapore version is still better. At least there are more choice of side-dishes and the chilli sauce not so runny.Show less

Author: JuledanWindsor and Maidenhead, United Kingdom
Title: should visit when you're in Melaka
Review: On our first day in Melaka we had lunch in this restaurant. There was a long que so it took some time before we could enter. The food we had (riceball with chicken and veggies) was very good. It's a busy place so if you want to visit be sure to come in time.Show less

Author: smiling_mangoSingapore
Title: Worth the try if it's your first visit to Melacca
Review: Read alot about it's good reviews and personally witness the long queues forming during lunch time, so decided to give it a try. Much later, we figured that the customers at the long queue are mostly tourist.Staff were obviously well trained with foreign tourist. A guy serving us speaks relatively good English. Concluded that we were tourist, and it's our 1st time patronizing their restaurant, he promptly gave some recommendation.Read some raves about their Assam fish, so decided to order it too. This he seemed alittle reluctant, where he mumble something like "... we will show you the fish first. If you don't want it's ok". Chicken - nice and tenderRice ball - An interesting way of eating rice. However, we are very used to splashing chilli and/or other sauces onto the rice. With the balls, we could only dip. Oh, beware when you eat it, mine had a strip of metal gauze in it. Cabbage - Cheap and tasty. Assam Fish - Not very fresh. Figured it's But the Assam sauce was succulent. Lots of ladies finger and tomatos. On the whole, it's an interesting way of eating chicken rice. But there are really lots of food to eat in Melacca. If you miss this, you only miss an experience.Show less

Author: hste-leeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Assam Fish head a must in Hoe Kee!!
Review: First of all, try the chicken rice in Melaka if you don't mind the soggy rice balls, otherwise forget about going into one. If you are used to the typical hainanese chicken rice where yellow skin chickens and nice textured rice are served and presented in an appetizing way, you will find chicken rice in Melaka a let down! Hoe Kee is no different from the rest, namely Chung Wah & Famosa Chicken Rice Ball. The interior of Hoe Kee is nicely done. Very clean and comfortable. Service is pretty fast too. Took them less than 10 mins to serve our order but by using styrofoam plates was a put off and to use them in an authentic restaurant is certainly a BIG NO!! Talk about saving the planet? Apart from all that, the price is reasonable. Will definitely come back for the Assam Fish Head which is yummy but not the chicken rice!!Worth a try!!Show less

Author: Actuarial_MathSingapore
Title: Hoe Kee is Over-rated. Her balls are hard and not Fragrant, and Chicken Hard and not Tasty.
Review: Hoe Kee's chicken rice balls are over-rated. I tried it on 2 occasions over 3 years apart, and I still come to the concusion that Hoe Kee's chicke rice balls are hard and not fragrant. Her chickens are also hard and not tasty. I tried Hoe Kee's because some guide books recommended her as the best. These authors are non-Chinese, and hence, they may not have the palate of typical Chinese who eats chicken rice all his life. Also, I tried Hoe Kee's because Chung Wah was not open for dinner.Show less

Author: g0_f0r_itSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth a try
Review: Chicken rice ball is quite good. Black bean soup was excellent. We liked the herbal tea too. Setting is unique. No air-conditioning but there are fans. You need to order before you sit down. And they will show you the bill soon after you have finished eating. Personally, we prefer not to eat off styrofoam plates though.We later heard that the tiny coffee shop just opposite also serves excellent chicken rice balls. We saw long queues forming outside this older and tiny coffee shop.Show less

Author: DKTCJOHORJohor
Title: great taste,must try!
Review: This shop has a nice ambience, u are like living in a baba and nyonya house with the big hall in the middle. The food is consider worth a visit with tender chicken and the rice ball is indeed better than the other popular shop. The waitress is very friendly and polite. Remember to go early as they close quite early or the food will finish fast. It is better to have it for lunch.Try their herbal drink too!Less than RM20 for 2 adults and 2 kids is more than enough!Show less

Author: H9501ZMrosea
Title: worst service ever seen
Review: Since the patron were not allowed to dine in, my family and I was waiting for a long time to place an order to take a away. There were many assistance hanging around but refuse to assist the patrons. Most of them are not friendly at all. They give you the impression that you are troubling them. We will never go to this place ever again..Show less

Author: sheila1026109
Title: Chettinad
Review: Authentic chettinad. Taste is good if you can overlook hygiene. Takeaway maybe but cleaner handling. All good spicy.

Author: sheila1026109
Title: Chettinad
Review: Good chettinad food. Authentic. Good and fast service. Wide variety of food. Fish cutlet and lamb is the best.

Author: jamjam12345
Title: Worth a visit for traditional South Indian food
Review: Fantastic experience eating like the locals. We enjoyed all four meals we ordered!! The staff were really nice and explained the menu and gave us recommendations. We had the chicken masala which was my favourite! The banana leaf meal was also a highlight!

Author: Singyew19
Title: Authentic South India banana leaf
Review: Ordered Banana leaf rice with fish curry on top and it did not disappoint. The curry was smooth and flavourful while the vegetable side dishes has been cooked perfectly so it was an overall such a satisfying and scrumptious meal! However, the extra dishes that we ordered was a bit too expensive for such a small portion. Would recommend to just try the banana leaf as that's the star player. Show less

Author: ssinaya3Singapore, Singapore
Title: Poor standard of food
Review: Just had lunch here. Went there eagerly looking fwd to having some great south Indian fare. Was really disappointed. The service was not really that great. We had the briyani, prawns, mutton, egg, fish, veges. Really sub par. The food was also cold. This was the first time in my life, I left Indian food unfinished. The mutton was not too bad. Everything else lacked punch and flavour. And it cost ard $50 ringgit for 2. Not too cheap I think. This shop can't compete with the ones in Singapore or KL. The chettinad food in this restaurant is the poorest I have tried. Won't eat here again. Show less

Author: Alok N
Title: Less than what was expected
Review: Reading on the internet, I was thinking they have some good Indian food, but it was disappointing to find they are just a local restaurant where they don't have proper Indian food. Just ok ... nothing special.

Author: MarcoP7096
Title: Excellent lunch
Review: Had lunch with colleagues and it was very good. Great experience for someone from europe. Ordering might be difficult if not local with indian culture.

Author: munisxc
Title: Truly chetinnad king
Review: Its my personal opinion after had indian meal in several country, they are truly chtinnad king. Nice nice and enjoyable meal i had there.This is my second visit alot of improvements with their food taste.Dont forget to try sathukudi juice.

Author: Stephenchu1230
Title: It's average
Review: I love Indian food and in melaka there are a few good ones. This is average. I have no idea how people write their review etc.

Author: tim r
Title: Interesting
Review:
The menu didn't help us much,but we somehow managed to get things we didn't order,but ate none the less.
Food was ok,mango lassi  was amazing,value was superb.

Author: vegtraVadodara, India
Title: Best South Indian Food In Melaka
Review: We visited this lovely place 3 times during our two day visit to Melaka. We like test of food so much that we continuously visit it for 3 meals. The authentic test of south Indian thali was awesome. Actually much better then South Indian Restaurants in India also. Because Owner, Staff & cooks were from South India in this restaurant. Test of The main and most Imp Item " Sambhar and coconut chutney" was so delicious. You will get thali in traditional Banana leaf. with unlimited serving. Dosa, Voda and Coffee were also very very good. This is the most Popular Indian food restaurant in entire Meleka. The staff was very very helpful, delivery time is very less. Place is always full with Indian people. This place is in "little India" Area of Melaka and is at walk able distance from Jonker Street which is main centre of Melaka.Show less

Author: LTTrang
Title: It's not cheap
Review: I ordered Chicken Masala (6RM on menu), drink (not remember name, 2.6 RM on menu). They brought me chicken in bowl rice on banana leaf, and some sauce. The food was so so, too much for me. The final bill is 14.5RM, don't know why, too tired for asking, and they don't speak English. Paid, never come back.Show less

Author: Adrian P
Title: In need of good food
Review: Cheap, very friendly and yummy food. Well worth the money and the mango lassi was amazing. Lamb biryani was so tender and they keep bringing condiments .

Author: amitjain1512Singapore, Singapore
Title: tasty, clean , cheap,..indian food for all
Review: if u want simple indian food, just head here. nice place, good service, clean, tasty indian food, cheap cheap prices. family of 4 and you would be hard pressed to spend upto MYR 30..i enjoed the afternoon sapad the most. the onion curry was too good.Show less

Author: hatchvieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The third time is lucky!
Review: The restaurant lives up to its reputation. They serve authentic tasty meals, prices are just affordable off course but for me personally, the staff! Friendly, caring and generous,,Great enough. One day I ordered takeaway papads for 1RM but they got me a heaps of papads, like for 10RM! Another day I found lemon rice in the menu but they didn’t served it at that time. I asked them desperately and revisited the next day but still they didn’t have. The day after next, persistent-me showed up again...Finally they were ready and made me feel so special. Looking forward to coming back to the lovely place someday soon!Show less

Author: Varad_G
Title: Best TamilNadu cuisine close to the most visited church square
Review: Walk-able distance to the Stadthuys, Christ Church, River Cruise, Clock Tower,... you are the at the most central location of Melaka in no time. Can't get any better TamilNadu food in the proximity and is worth the money.

Author: Lynns98816
Title: Authentic Indian food
Review: Because of our curiosity, we went to this restaurant for lunch. It was our firat experience eating Indian food. We were quite surprise when the food was coming. The food, with strong taste, was very delicious and the portion was large enough. We tried ice 3 layers tea and we found that it was good enough.The price is not cheap enough but if you compare with other Indian restaurants, the price is not as expensive as other Indian restaurants. Show less

Author: munisxc
Title: Fresh juice, dont miss
Review: Hi i went here to try their freshly made fruit jus.Its really best and fresh.Dears don't miss sathukudi juice which only can get in india but now can get in malacca(maybe limited time only).Fruit jus price about RM8 percup.

Author: suavetravel
Title: Authentic India in The Heart of Historical of Malacca.
Review: In the heart of Malacca lies Little India. A stroll along Jalan Bendahara is an infused experience of charming India in old setting Malacca. And Saravanna offers a gastronomical delight of India cuisines and delicacies. A must see and must try in a UNESCO World Heritage city.Show less

Author: JarevuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good meal but check your bill
Review: We had an awesome meal with variety for 5 adults. Authentic and tasty on a banana leaf. We had chicken masala, mutton mysore and fish cutlet along with rice, 3 veg n choice of gravy. Chicken curry was really nice. Very fulfilling meal. Only concern was they used an electronic card for us to pay. They put our order into a card n we bring the card to pay. The cashier taps the card n we pay the amount. Many customers just pay and go. My husband asked for the bill as he thought it was expensive then realized we were overcharged for 2 items which we did not eat at all. We would have taken it for an honest mistake if the server did not come to reconfirm the items we had before issuing us the card. Show less

Author: Debaprasad B
Title: A great Indian treat !!!
Review: Went with my Indian friend for Lunch. Good to see maintaining the same traditional flavor and taste in this  South Indian Cooking. Lots of variety and price is affordable. Very friendly staff.Neat and clean.

Author: 196meeraa
Title: Fast service !
Review: Been to Saravanan Restaurant plenty time the food is good, service is fast as I can see they always want to have fast turnover.Best South Indian restaurant in little India Melaka.

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Great flavours
Review: We came to this venue one night for dinner around 8pm. It was quite busy with diners and mainly locals so that was a good sign. The menu is in Malay and whilst there are pictures, they don’t tie back to menu names.Our waiter helped us order, which was helpful. By the time we ordered there was only one chicken dish left, the chicken masala, so best you get there early if you want a large choice of menu items. We ended up having the Chicken masala for rm6, the roti canai masala for rm3 , an extra Chapati for rm 1.5 and a Sirup bandung drink for rm2.5. Both dishes had an abundance of flavour and were delicious to eat. We also sampled one of their sweets for rm1.6 on our way out and that was also tasty. All in all a good value and flavourful meal.Show less

Author: 833anandv
Title: good food good service
Review: food was good and service was nice. friendly staff who took good care of us including my 3 year old kid who was given special attention..

Author: Thiagarajah AShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Popular South Indian RESTAURANT
Review: I have visited Saravanna a couple of times during my trips through Melaka.There is a variety of south indian food and well cooked. Can be spicy for those who are not used to Indian food.Overall their spread is tasty and there is good crowd for lunch. The restaurant serves local mutton on saturdays only. However, to me their mutton was not to my expected level.It is not a high end restaurant . Hence if you seek a fine dining place there is one next door.I would say their Indian sweets (like ladoos) are of expected quality.Do,note that this restaurant is on a busy tourist street. There are other restaurants, if you care to explore, some along the lanes, that serve good south indian food.Show less

Author: BoyD230Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious food
Review: The fish sambal sotong mutton chicken tahu sambal all are delicious. They use local chicken and goat not sheep. Their vegetables all fresh especially their bittergourd fried. Can last 2 days still fresh. I even packed food from them to bring home to singapore still fresh . Hats off hope they maintain their standard. Show less

Author: R HMunich, Germany
Title: Great food in a welcoming place
Review: We found this place around lunchtime and were seated by helpful staff. They helped us through the dishes and the options for the banana leaf lunch. I must confess I am not sure what most of it was, but it was all delicious and I'm sorry we only found this place on our last day!Show less

Author: Soink_85Mersing, Malaysia
Title: Unexpected!
Review: Walked in the restaurant at around 10.30am for breakfast. Place was crowded yet the manager was courteous enough to squeeze a place for the three of us.Despite the crowd, our food was served promptly. We savored the following:1) Thosai with 3 types of Chutney - Nice and crispy with complementing sauce2) Pure bread - Freshly made with tasty potato gravy (the gravy was infused with dhall which made it more mouth watering3) Chicken varuval - One of its kind with the right spiciness!My wife enjoyed their milk tea which she claimed to be extra thick and delicious..Show less

Author: AusVVGold Coast, Australia
Title: Good food and good value
Review: We ate here regularly because the food was very good and the staff were helpful. We found it was very good value for money. Always clean and tidy. Very busy Sunday morning as lots of locals eat there and we had to share a table but we met a lovely couple from Singapore as a result.Show less

Author: Joshua S
Title: Good selection for lunch
Review: For lunch, there are a wide variety to choose from. I dont think it is too pricy though. Services and cleanliness could be much better. Food is a spicier than usual. I prefer it to be like that too

Author: raven781
Title: Savvadi Banana Leaf
Review: I always like the  banana leaf foods in this restaurant though little pircey but no compromise on the quality.

Author: loveDCAWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: Delicious Indian sweets
Review: We just ate at some of the hawker stalls and were looking for something sweet to finish off the evening. The front of this restaurant had a bunch of Indian sweets on display and the folks behind the counter were helpful in making suggestions — all were delicious. We also enjoyed relaxing in the large dining room. Show less

Author: jaypalm77Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Banana Leaf Curry!
Review: We ventured out of our hotel 1825 Gallery hotel to find a late breakfast. I remember reading a review about Restoran Saravana and found it almost at our doorstep. The service provided was great, English speaking host who made recommendations. We were famished so ordered quite a lot. Two banana leaf Curry’s both chicken, one a buriyani rice. Ordered a cheese dosai and couldn’t turn down a roti Chennai!!! Miss the flavours of North Indian cuisine, all the sides and dips and gravies!! Reminds me of my childhood living in Singapore.This was an awesome stop for breakfast. A must for any Indian foodie! Show less

Author: kuummssSingapore
Title: Still thinking about the delicious Lunch :-)
Review: Really looking forward for my next trip only for this great South Indian banana leaf vegetarian meals.Frankly, my child liked the Samabar & had twice, never saw him like this asking for the next day lunch as well. When I compared with KL & Penang, food in Melaka was great. Lost but not the least, curd with pickles & curries, definitely a must try option.Show less

Author: Prasad_Nadkarni
Title: Excellent location and good food
Review: We tried this restaurant for lunch during our recent trip to Melaka. We tried the banana leaf meal and the service was excellent.

Author: tirayoungawesomeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: soft roti canai telur!
Review: we’re searching for good restaurant for breakky and saw this on trip advisor and decided to give it a try! i ordered roti canai telur and my partner choose roti murtabak ayam! but be aware if u cant take spicy just go for ROTI CANAI KOSONG, cause he cant finish all the murtabak ayam and its for 2 ppl! and spicy!!!! but overall is okay and good! will come here again Show less

Author: BoyD230
Title: delicious food
Review: delicious food mutton chicken fish sotong and tahu sambal simply love it would recommend everybody to eat there. there's a aircon dining also.

Author: ChiariyeesPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious
Review: I had the banana leaves there twice, I quite like it.The roti masala is good! If you like something spicy. Quite filling too.The masala tea was average for me, though. As I prefer stronger spice.Another thing I don't fancy for most Indian restaurants in Melaka:they like to serve some cold beverages in takeaway plastic cup, and rasam in paper cup even if you dine in.Show less

Author: Emily O
Title: So yummy!
Review: Fresh, tasty, vegi and clean, this authentic canteen is a must visit. Friendly and helpful staff, not to mention its also very easy on your pocket! Great experience.

Author: muniswaran m
Title: Overpriced!!!!
Review: Ok,their taste is really Good a must try place,service not bad.Authetic south Indian food but over priced.Make sure check price before order food.

Author: Matt SWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: The best South Indian food in Malacca
Review: I had the pleasure of living in Malacca for 3 years, so this review is based on my experiences over the last 3 years, rather than one specific visit.In summary, it was my favourite restaurant for South Indian food in Malacca.It is a very basic restaurant, with a vast amount of food to choose from, either from the menu, or from the buffet type area. As far as I know, it is open all day, but lunch time is probably the time to go (although it can be very busy).My choice was always the banana leaf curry with either chicken or fish curry. Unfortunately for me, they don't sell beer - but despite this drawback, it was one of my favourite places to eat lunch in Malacca.Show less

Author: dani g
Title: Very friendly service followed by very nice food
Review: We have read the comments on this restaurant amd were not very much surprised about the food. We can confirm all the good comments about the tastyness of the dishes. They were very nice and we would come back anytime again. The service was very good and very friendly. We felt very much welcome.Show less

Author: paulcL1777JKSingapore, Singapore
Title: Southern Indian Comfort
Review: The food was fantastic . It'll be the only place to have your favorite South Indian dishes. The mutton curry was spicy but the meat just slides off the bone. The fish cakes were an added incentive to the dhal and rice served on banana leaves. All this plus the fantastic service from staff makes you feel so welcome you would want to come back for more . A shout out to Mr Saravanan who made our visit worthwhile. Will definitely be back soon. Show less

Author: MidoriH73
Title: Nice Indian Food On Banana Leaf
Review: Me and friend eat at the restaurant. Banana leaf rice is very good with all the curries. I try the manggo lassi is very good.

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Beautiful Taste
Review: Yummy variety of sweets. Delicious chutneys. I had the chapati, lovely potato gravy. My friend has paper tosai and it was fabulously done. I saw people eating banana leaf rice; must be good. Their masala tea wasn't to my liking unfortunately as I like my tea with more spices. Place is small and cramped. Crowd was good. That shows off the quality of the food. I will be back, for sure!Show less

Author: ekta p
Title: Good Indian veg food and chai!
Review: Roti canai was really good. The staff especially made fresh for us and even got us hot indian fritters for snacks. The Indian tea was pretty close. Enjoyed eating here.

Author: Carson L
Title: Cill out
Review: Saravana restoran in a indian food the roti  canai is amazing with a fish cuŕy and the rest of the food mix awsome And the admosefere is amazing

Author: cathydelCairns, Australia
Title: OK but not great.
Review: We sought this place out after other reviewers' positive comments but unfortunately we were disappointed with the food and the lack of helpful service. The manager spoke English and was very quick to seat us and offer suggestions for lunch. He didn't return. We battled to order watermelon juices (no alcohol available)' mutton Marsala and the banana leaf mutton dish with rice from our waiter. Sauces were tasty and the Marsala mutton was delicious but the bits of bone throughout both dishes made it hard to eat and enjoy with any confidence. No napkins provided. We had to ask for bowls and forks and spoons. Attention focussed on locals and not very welcoming for foreigners. Not really impressed with this place. Show less

Author: coffeeaddict20019Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food but bad customer service
Review: Went for lunch after some recommendations from the local.Ordered 2 banana leave meals,mutton ,fried fish,thosai and 3 drinks which came up to MYR 68.Banana leave meal was delicious and so was the thosai.Mutton was very tender and kicked in the right blend of spices.Fried fish was extremely crispy but way too salty.Waiters were slow to take order,and kept forgetting the dishes we ordered.Asked for fish curry 3 times and did not come.Food was placed with a thud.Will I go back?Nope!Good services is a must for meShow less

Author: Caspari H
Title: Suitable for vegetatarians and non-vegetarians
Review: This place offers a variety of South indian dishes which caters to vegetarians and non-vegetarians. The service is fast and the food prices is reasonable. However it is quitye difficult to get parking around this place.

Author: JiaYee82
Title: Great Indian breakfast
Review: Excellent tosai, poori, roti, idly with great chutneys and Indian coffee (dark with condensed milk). Another great suggestion from our local hosts. (Don't bother with the Nasi Lemak...plain and unexciting by comparison with the others.

Author: john s
Title: Authentic south indian food
Review: One if the best in town .slightly spicy. The street it self is all owned by indian .you can get all sorts of merchandise. Cloth. Spices.  Sari ect

Author: SrivalliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good meal
Review: When we were searching for Indian vegetarian meal options in Melaka,this restaurant was our best option for light dinner.The ambience is not very nice and it is little crowded .one major plus point is wide variety of vegetarian meal options and Very good taste of items as wellShow less

Author: shamini82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The BEST Chettinad Indian food ever!!!
Review: We came here on our first day we arrived in Melaka! We really fell in love with the food here! It's so awesome tasting and service excellence! We returned here the next day to have our second round of banana leaf lunch! It's yummy and we are definitely gonna recommend this place to all our family and friends! Well done Show less

Author: GypsytwitchersMaldon, Australia
Title: Yummy with No Frills
Review: Had the banana leaf vegetarian set meal.. it all comes with no negotiation... tried to get a roti bread with it but only got blank looks (my problem as I don't speak Hindi). Very tasty but not very spicy (had expected a spicy hot meal... perhaps they dumb it down for the tourists). Will be going again as we did enjoy the meal. Show less

Author: VRia
Title: WOW !!
Review:
Good meals, especially their dinner and breakfast.We went there as family.
Therefore we ordered puri, thosai, masala thosai, onion uthappam,fluffy idli,roti canai,masala tea, coffee and etc...Trust me all of these items were good.Their curries and chutneys were good too.Worth eating here.

Author: Anbalagan R
Title: Mutton masala
Review:
Perfect mixture of masala and mutton make it exotic taste of indian food with exelent service. With multiple choice of
 vegeterian and non vegeterian availability make it perfect place to dine in.

Author: Venod S
Title: Delicious and Nice service
Review: Im a vegetarian and quite hard to find food. But in this restaurant they understand my diet and serve quite a tasty veg food. They also serve nice non veg food.. overall the one of the best indian food at melaka.. A MUST VISIT!!

Author: loanng1046Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
Title: Amazing rotis and friendly staff
Review: We were the only foreigners who showed up around 11pm at this casual Indian canteen. We were on the hunt for the next cheap eats in Melaka and decided to go here among several others that were open late. Although we were nervous toorder because some of the waitstaff didn't speak english but a'las an English menu came out. I got the roti masala filled with potatoes and other vegetables - it was served in a silver tray with other sides that included yellow lentils, yogurt and another dish I didn't know was was spicy. The filling was my favorite part - pure comfort food. When we paid each roti meal was about$1.5! I was shocked and pleased. During our stay in Melaka, I went here every day and on my last day even went there twice! I had to fit in the banana leaf meal which is highly recommended. Rice, vegetables, lentil crackers and lentils are scooped and served directly on a banana leaf for your eating pleasure. No plate needed and you just dive in with your hands -- my favorite way to eat.Show less

Author: EatLoveFamily
Title: Excellent Food and Service
Review: A must visit in Melaka ! Great Indian food with great service! Came both for breakfast and lunch and was highly satisfied.

Author: diveenjoker
Title: Excellent indian food
Review: Had a breakfast here . The dishes were good and the service was pretty fast . Worth a try here .  The curry taste good . Not too oily . A good indian food .

Author: donaldgerardn
Title: Great place for breakfast
Review: Our usual place for breakfast and we come weekly. Price are reasonable ... Lunch is filled with lots of selection for Banana Leaf Rice.

Author: MagAcdc
Title: Nice food, good service
Review: In went there with family of 4. We had banana rice thali and it was delicious. The staff there are very efficient even though the restaurant was pack with patrons. We enjoy the food there and I would love to go back there again.

Author: KJJ19Sydney, Australia
Title: Loved the food !!!!
Review: My family and I loved it so much we had dinner, breakfast the next day, followed by lunch and tea, then dinner again. It was much to the staff's amazement and amusement that we kept turning up here for all our meals. Try everything your stomach can handle. We tried the tosai, fried fish (our favourite), thali, roti canai/partha, teh tarik, nescafe tarik, the list goes on and on. The cuisine is South Indian Food. Loved it, loved it!!!!! Totally recommend this place.Show less

Author: sassylady2016
Title: Great food
Review: Great flavours all fresh and really tasty basic restaurant nothing fancy but good value and great food would recommend it.

Author: winwahpressw
Title: Salah warna restaurant
Review: Average food ! Not as nice as I thought. If you found the food not so nice , pls mix curries by yourself . Chic, fish, beef etc

Author: itsmypoint
Title: Exceed expectations
Review: Food was fantastic. Briyani was the highlight. Service was fast. The only downfall was temperature was a bit warm.

Author: Rosemary6015
Title: Worth visiting again
Review: I have had my breakfast and dinner at this place for signature Indian dishes like the banana leaf rice and tosai. The curries were nice and aromatic. it's worth for mouth savoring experiences.

Author: Ashok PMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Hot stuff
Review: This is a typical South Indian "banana leaf" restaurant. Forget ambience. You will sit elbow to elbow with strangers and eat spicy food with your hands. Try the mutton varuval or boneless chicken if you're into spice. If not biriyani is pretty good - they use long grain rice as they should. Show less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Best Indian Food in town
Review: Love to come here eat tosai and capati. Their service quite fast, nice food with reasonable price. Here will be quite hot if you dine in in afternoon time.

Author: nesadiana82Melaka, Malaysia
Title: IM VERY FUSSY ABOUT FOOD TASTE
Review: Here the food such as mix rice , poori , tosai...and etc very nice but goreng 2 normal...however im fussy bout food im satisfied with their food..so if u come down to melaka pls visit this shop..im in melaka if i hungry i ll go there and eat mostlyShow less

Author: Shahul Hameed S
Title: Nice food, fast services, reasonable price
Review: We went there for breakfast. While most of the meal is only available after 4 pm, they still do have a great variety of food and the serving time was fast enough. The price was also very much reasonable.

Author: najimudeen
Title: Saravana Restaurant
Review: This is an Indian restaurant. Vegetarian and non vegetarian dishes are served at very reasonable price.

Author: 276JAMESBangkok, Thailand
Title: Great local indian food and culture
Review: I ate here a few times during my stay in Melaka. The food is delicious and cheap: curries, bread, rice, tandoori, fruit shakes and lassis. I liked the taste of everything I tried. It's quite cheap too, you can get a big meal for less than 20 ringit.Show less

Author: chong s
Title: Too hot inside the shop
Review: The food is nice. Typical Indian food. For those who like it will enjoy it, especially the banana leaf rice. However the ambient is just too hot. Won't feel comfortable to eat inside. After eating entire shirt will sting with the odor of the food. From far people would know that u just gone there. Another thing is: the parking is so inconvenient. Not easy to get a parking. For me, NO more second try. Show less

Author: cnaren1980Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: You will be happy with the food, cleanliness and price
Review: We went here for breakfast, and oh my, the food was really, really good. Especially the sambar and chutney, they were fantastic. Highlights were toti canai, idli, vadai, and masala tea. And the price was cheap.Looking at the crowd, I suppose other food were really good as well.This place is highly recommended. There is also another shop with the same name, so make sure you don't end up in the wrong shop. The shop that I am recommending is beside Devibala Homedecor, this is on the main road itself.Show less

Author: mokshagurl
Title: THE BEST BANANALEAF IN TOWN
Review: This is always our favorite and must Indian restaurant in melaka..their banana leaf rice with yogurt,mutton varuval,fried fish and vegetables is perfect blend of authentic chetinad food..awesome food with fast service,even though it was crowded..and the price is reasonable tooo..

Author: Logeswarannaykk... M
Title: Banana leaf lunch
Review: Delicious food! Eventhough crowded the waiter try to act fast to avoid disappointment. Overall recommended... :-)

Author: HansiZhai
Title: North & South
Review: Lovely selection of northern and southern Indian delights.   We had the most crispy roti chanai/prata, thosai and so so many delicious side curries.   Well worth the wait.

Author: SheenaStReichertshofen, Germany
Title: Bananaleaf for Brunch
Review: Came here for brunch, and was served quickly on banana leaf. In comparison to Johor Bahru, the Service is colder and less friendly. There are constantly People pushin around and asking you to move aside as they serve. Tight space.Food was good. Always ask for it hot, otherwise you might have already cold crab or prawns served. Most of the Curries are kept hot.Ask also for Bru coffee with cow milk. Extremely tasty!Though it is a Restaurant, Germans should not confuse this with homestyle Restaurants. The atmosphere is for locals, and the cleanliness Level is not to be expected to on par with german Restaurants.Nevertheless, the Food was excellent, Drinks good, and I had no Problems with tummy aches thereafter! Safe!Show less

Author: sreeyoga
Title: South Indian Restaurant in Melaka
Review: I had breakfast. Idly was soft and nice. Two varieties of tasty chutneys to compliment . Tosai was nice too. Not sour or dry. Tried the boneless chicken varuval and chicken podiumas. Something you should not miss.

Author: Jeffery M
Title: Banana   leaf rice
Review:
I love Indian banana rice.
Usually   overeat. 
This restaurant  serves good Indian dishes. Tasty too, keep it up.
Only setback  is the  toilet, need improvement

Author: kingleo1008
Title: Delicious food and excellent service
Review: Decided to try this restaurant based on a friend's recommendation. No regrets. Food was delicious, service was fast and efficient. However, food was slightly pricey.

Author: Niran RKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Chettinad Food - Too spicy for me
Review: It is a great place for Breakfast. Thosai and Chutneys are great. However, their curries are rather too over spicy. Since it is Chettinad food, it is , apparently, supposed to be so. It is mainly frequented by the local population rather than out of towners. Show less

Author: Nagesh K
Title: So so only
Review: Frankly speaking, the food is in optimum taste only. They can do even better to compete with their neighbour. Would say OK....

Author: GiacosaCarloSan Miguel de Tucuman, Argentina
Title: Overpriced for what you get
Review: If you are a tourist then more likely you are going to be overcharged. We ended up paying sambal of rice at 5 Ringits when all over melacca it costs 1.5. The food was good , although not spicy for them means spicy as much as possible for westerners. For the same amount of money you can have plenty of other options in the city Show less

Author: Gunaseelan K
Title: Superb
Review: Thosai there a must try. I would recommend ghee thosai,  masala thosai n rawa thosai.   Aunthetic indian food n taste . clean.  And like the fact that food being served fast.  Don't forget tea 🍵 in cows milk.

Author: ShadowFaxDocSingapore, Singapore
Title: South Indian food at its best!
Review: Great food! Period! The price hits a sweet spot :) loved their dosai and mini tiffin set. Also liked their vegetarian mock mutton/chicken curry( totally surprised :)) tried their lunch meals on my last day in Melaka .. And should say the sambar and vegetable fries were very close to what I had in kaaraikoodi. Koodos Saravanna! Last but not the least their service rocks! Very friendly staff and management:) will definitely eat again the next time I visit Melaka ! A must visit if ya around little india in Melaka !Show less

Author: womullan
Title: So good I had two
Review: Paper tosai then masala... Mutton curry also very good. Nice fresh juice. As Ranpal said great value.

Author: raniSpain
Title: Delicious fast and excellent value
Review: We fancied a change from rice so came here for tosai, mutton curry and fish sambal all delicious with fresh juices and the bill only came to 29RM! Would go back but we are leaving!

Author: mikelarry70
Title: awesome indian food
Review: one of the best banana leaf authentic indian food. dry mutton is definitely a must. will come back again REAL soon...

Author: J0fino
Title: Delicious!
Review: Really quick service, best banana leaf in town! Try their ice lemon tea as well. It's a bit crowded, but the food is worth it

Author: Alalatuk
Title: One of The Best Banana Leaf Rice
Review: When we first moved to Melaka, our friends recommended this restaurant to us. It's been more than 5 yrs now..and I have to say this is one the best restaurants serving traditional indian delicacies in Melaka. I always admire their banana leaf rice. A lot of choices for side dishes apart from main dishes. Both vegetarian and non vegetarian delicacies available. Normal banana leaf rice will be served with 3 types of vegetables, appalam, acar, moore chilli, rasam and 3 types of gravy. You can choose to have it with chicken, prawn, fish or mutton if you are non vegetarian. They do serve roti canai, thosai, idli, poori and fried stuff. It is definitely a place to satisfy your crave for Indian food. Waiters were all friendly and attentive. Price of food is affordable. Will keep on coming for wonderful taste of Indian. Show less

Author: MattSim0nKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Hangout Place
Review: Very good location. Easy to find parking spots nearby. Typical Indian Muslim food. Quite tasty and does not let you down. Efficient service typical of this type of restaurant with lots of waiting staff. Orders came in a flash and you don't have to wait too long for your food and drinks. My only comment was the sinks are located too far away at the back of the restaurant near the washrooms. Mamak food is best enjoyed with your hands rather than using cutleries and it's a hassle to walk all the way back to wash your hands.Show less

Author: TamatiMcAuckland
Title: Super Spicey Joint
Review: Great place to get an authentic taste of indo-malay cuisune. The the roti canai and tostas were delicious served with a firey dahl. The meat dishes were tender spicey and flavoursome. The staff members were friendly and willing to explain the menu to us in english. Good range of Indian sweets to try with a cup of massala chai. A big meal for two cost less than 25 rm.This would have been an easy 5/5 save for the fact that they dont serve beer!Show less

Author: Exsaudi MJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Love it
Review: First time we discovered this restaurant by accident while we cruise melaka city at night We don't have any experience with india food but the owner and the waiter help us to get to know about their foodOn our last night in Melaka we closed by having dinner in this restaurant... Is the best Indian restaurantShow less

Author: robinchina2004
Title: Delicious Food
Review: This little treasure has the most delicious curries I have tasted for quite a while. We had all vegetarian dishes laid out on banana leaves and all of them tasted exquisite. We highly recommend giving this restaurant a try.

Author: SlatedoggMiddlesbrough, United Kingdom
Title: Great Indian banana leaf meal
Review: In Malaysia there is pretty much every type of food imaginable and my wife and I love curries. We had previously been recommended a restaurant in KL for a banana leaf curry experience and were really impressed. We stumbled across this place and it is amazing. The food is delicious, we had all vegetarian food, 4 side dishes, 2 curries, 2 drinks, 2 specialties (tomato tofu and incredible tandoori chicken), poppadoms, and a mountain of white rice. This was all for 24 RM, which is about £4! You couldn't get two portions of rice for that in England. I would have paid three times that amount and still been happy, definitely going back!Show less

Author: BeatriceD1020
Title: Tasty Indian food &value for money!
Review: My family and I were scouting for a good meal and we came across this restaurant. ..surprisingly it was so satisfying. ..and the Price was very reasonable.

Author: Mr_Mrs_StephensSydney, Australia
Title: Biryani Sunday
Review: Got the tip on this place from a local - Sunday is Biryani day!Don't worry if that's not your thing as there was a short list of other sauces available for topping some steamed rice (all vegetarian).Only drawbacks I can think of are really part of the charm - served on leaves, not plates, only locals but a good mix of Malays and Indians, difficult to understand the waiters until you 'tune-in' to the indian accents.Show less

Author: Mary ZBerlin, Germany
Title: Amazing food for a great value!
Review: We ordered Banana Leaf.The food was amazing and a lot to close a hungry stomach. You get 3 veggies with it and 2 different curry-sauces. The price is really cheap and the restaurant seems to be very clean. Just for the food I would give 5 stars, but since the service is just average...Recommendation: Try Banana leaf and add mutton masala...Show less

Author: Andy LPerth, Australia
Title: Best Vegi Mee Goreng in Town
Review: Went to this place after reading reviews on this site and was definitely not disappointed. The place doesn't look much from the outside (or the inside) really, but you know the old saying don't judge a book by it's cover. I found the best vegetarian mee goreng I had all week and it only cost just over $1, need I say more. Show less

Author: Venu G
Title: ideal for south indian food
Review: sarvana offers good and tasty south indian meals including dosa idli vada etc and steaming hot cofee. place is slightly congested otherwise good place to meet your palate.

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very tasty Indian Food
Review: Although this is a small restaurant it does offer a wide variety of Indian food. Be you a meat eater or 'veggie' there is plenty on offer to tempt you.Also available are a variety of Indian 'sweets' as well as home made Samosas and Onion Pakora.We had banana leaf - with rice and three veggie dishes, dhall, Onion Pakora, a boneless chicken dish and two bottles of water. A very satisfying and tasty meal. Cost for two people RM 15 - just under 3 quid!This place is just 1 min walk from Selvams. If its a Friday, go to Selvams for their 10 curry lunch special. If its any other day, then go to Saravanna. Saravanna should be on everyone's 'Must Visit' listShow less

Author: bellemindSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good, Spicy Chettinadu Food
Review: If you are looking for delicious and spicy Indian food in Melaka, this is the place to go. A small restaurant but has a range of food items to satisfy any cravings you have. They have south Indian vegetarian and non vegetarian meals, roti Chennai, Dosa, Idli etc. We had lunch and tea there and simply loved everything that we tasted! Their Roti Chennai is crispy and the gravy is very nice. In fact all their gravy is thick and delicious. Even their fried okra is very good. I had Lassi there and till today can't forget the taste of the cold, thick, salty drink which was simply superb ...yum. I am definitely going Melaka again and one of the reason is this restaurant.Show less

Author: Tvignes
Title: Good food
Review: Small yet delicious food served in quite a funny way as I tried hot tiffin that comes with small cute masala tosai, uthapam, vadai n etc

Author: sitagliptinMalaysia
Title: ..flaming curries,spicy food and fiery rasam...
Review: ..everything is flaming hot here,am not sure what masala they use or if they grind their own.....hubby and i had banana leaf meals and couldn't finish it off,the curry was flaming spicy and just burns and burns after that....the "rasam" just sets ur taste buds on fire and after that everything is flaming for a good one hour...be warned!!..we had "mutton varuval" and it was cheapo compressed meat and it was thin layers of this and that and cartilage,tendons and tasted like "masala rubbish!!!"...fish curry was a saviour though,cudn't trace any trace of MSG so it must be original all the way......am still at work the next day and still suffering from a "fire in the belly" syndrome and 3 visits to the loo.....be warned,even hubby the spice king had issues he told me in the car on our journey back,that he cudn't handle the spices and curry himself!!...am done with banana leaf meals at this place,its just tooo fiery hot...Show less

Author: 192RoseMCanton of Geneva, Switzerland
Title: It is a 7 minute walk from the tourist area
Review: Looks like a small cafe- seat very basic - but well worth it for the food and service. The food is inexpensive and delicious. The waiter was very patient with us as we muddled our way through the menu and made our choice. Had I had more time I would have returned here. Certainly worth while leaving the mayhem of the tourist area for excellent food and a fraction of the cost.Show less

Author: KiwisnowbirdsWellington, New Zealand
Title: Great Banana Leaf Restaurant
Review: A treasured find in Melaka, this place is a local favourite and is always full by 8pm. The food is cheap, filling and very good. The mutton curry is just one item that is excellent but you can also eat vegetarian if you choose. They make a really mean lassi as well. Many of the staff speak very good English and are more than willing to assit if you are unsure of what to order. Eat with fingers or fork and spoon.Show less

Author: OmnomnomnivoreMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good and cheap
Review: I'm a local and never heard of this place before I found it on TripAdvisor. So, I went there the next day. I ordered the banana leaf rice as many said was good. However, I thought it was so-so (can't compare to the one I had in Penang). Mutton curry was good. Best part? It's very cheap.Show less

Author: itchyfinsMelbourne
Title: Fantastic menu and banana leaf lunch
Review: This place is always busy with the locals, always a sign of a good restaurant! The food is excellent and cheap. The menu is enormous so you could come here every day for a month and still not eat everything, besides that, the banana leaf dishes change every day.Show less

Author: yogesht49
Title: Best Vegetarian Lunch
Review: One of the best vegetarian lunch we ever had in Melaka. Place is opposite Putra Medical Centre or rather beside . Great variety , friendly staff and fast service . Prices are very reasonable . Must try !!!!

Author: micaela vEmu Park, Australia
Title: Don't miss this if you like Indian food
Review: Generous helpings of Biriani served on a banana leaf, 3 vegetable side dishes and a meat dish of your choice, papadams and a small jar of soup for 10 Ringets. And it is all absolutely delicious.What more do you want? The restaurant is in Jalan Bendahara which is about a 5 minutes walk from Jonker Street.Show less

Author: DelonixRSingapore, Singapore
Title: First rate food and bargain bin prices
Review: This restaurant is almost directly opposite The Majestic hotel, so if you're staying at this property, this little eatery is a must-try. The place serves up a variety of Indian fare, and we had both the egg and eggless roti canais, complemented by communal gravy containers that you helped yourself to. Food was great and very cheap (just MY$8 for two adults). The eatery though like many local restaurants might be a little gritty looking to persons unused to street-side dining in South-East Asia, but the food's worth it.Show less

Author: Xtreme26Vendee, France
Title: just love this place.....
Review: While my girld friend and i were staying at tonys guest house ( really nice place as well) in malaka, we red in the note book of this hostel few comment of bacpackers advicing this place !!! Then we gave a try and it was just awesome, the food was really good, well served and so cheap , the massala tea was perfect, the staff were really nice, and there was no westerrn customers ( thats a good sign)!! So, we went back every days, including for breakfast just before leaving malaka!!!! if you come to malaka, don t miss it !!!!!Show less

Author: seawifePerth, Australia
Title: A great find!
Review: We were taken here by our taxi driver (a Malay Indian) and from the outside we wondered what we were getting (we've eaten at the Golden Chetty in Yangon so we're not wimps), as like others, we found we were the only westerners in there. I too think that's usually a good indication. Our driver ordered for us, only asking us whether we could take spicy (we can) and if we wanted mutton as well as chicken. The banana leaves were placed in front of us, then came the sambals, rice, and spoonfuls of curries, plus papadoms and chutney. It was magnificent. We drank iced water (it's quite safe to drink the water in Malaysia) and ate with our fingers, and paid the princely sum of 31 ringgit ($10 Australian dollars) for all three of us!Oh, and it's got a western style toilet as well, and plenty of soap and water.Show less

Author: GregandGuylaineBelleville, Canada
Title: Great food and good value...
Review: My wife and I went here for lunch after discovering that the place we originally intended to go was full. A happy accident indeed. Located in India town, the place is just far enough off the main drag to qualify as a hidden gem. My wife had the vegetarian banana leaf special while I had the chicken banana leaf special. We each had a small bottle of water with the meal and a Masala tea each afterwards. Portions were very generous and the food was very good. We were the only non-Indian clients which I often take as a very good sign. Service was good and the total for everything was only 16 Ringgit. A great deal.Show less

Author: DM62London, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic and very cheap south indian food
Review: We stumbled across this restaurant not really intending to eat south indian food. However, we were glad we did. It is very local although only just 100m from St Francis Xavier Church and the tourist trail. Its is like a cafe with high turnover and we were the only tourists in there. I believe it is vegetarian and specialises in dosas. We went for a masala dosa which was the best I have had and then we each had a thali meal which included a wide selection of small curries, rice, dips and breads. Absolutely gorgeous and the bill was only 16MR ($5 USD) inc drinks. Thoroughly recommended.Show less

Author: Honestyofcouse
Title: FIRST and DEFINITELY LAST TIME!!!!
Review: As a local Malaccan, I was curious to see a long queue everytime I passed by this restaurant for years. Due to the long queue, I thought someday, I could give it a try. Then came this time where we passed by and there was no queue. Out of curiosity, me and my family decided to give it a try.We came before 6pm and was told that we could only be sitted when the full amount of our guests arrived although there were vacant tables. Since this was during late evening, the sun was blazing at us while we as customers had to patiently line up at the corridor. While lining up, we were hurried several times by the waitress to place our orders. We ordered a few dishes that we were comfortable with and the waitress asked us "you're not going to order crab?" Since it was our first time, we thought no harm giving it a try and placed an order for one crab. The waitress then mentioned that minimum order was two crabs and the price range would be at RM100+. We proceeded to order.As we waited, priority was given to other customers lining up behind us simply because they had their full number of guests while the waitress apologetically assured us that once our guests arrived we will be sitted. We then told the waitress that our guests would arrive in 5 - 10 minutes of which the waitress brush it OFF.When our guests arrived, we immediately told the waitress that our guests have arrived. We were then shocked to get her response. She just told us COLDLY and TARTLY that all the tables are full and we had to WAIT INDEFINITELY. Part of our guests were senior citizens of which we requested that they be sitted first. The COLD HEARTLESS waitress just yelled for someone to bring a chair but IT NEVER CAME. After waiting for about 20 more minutes in addition to the first 30 minutes that we waited, we were finally sitted. Earlier while ordering, the waitress told us that once we are sitted our order will be prepared. We'll, IT WAS ONE BIG LIE. We were only served intermittently approximately 40 minutes after being sitted. While waiting, we observed that there were 2 main types of treatment given to the customers (we have tried to make reservations however we were told it is only walk-in). Some customers had to wait indefinitely like we did for our food while some customers had VIP treatment where they were ushered in and lead upstairs straight away and we observed that the food was served to them first while we waited waited indefinitely for our food. We highlighted to the owner about the long wait however he TURNED A DEAF EAR. After the long wait, the waitress had the audacity to inform nicely that "you're food is being prepared now".In terms of the DISHES, it is COMPLETELY OVERATED. There IS NOTHING SPECIAL about it.Upon paying the bill, we clarified with the owner on the minimum number of crab order as we observed that there is order for one crab and that we were told the minimum order was 2 crabs. The owner immediately replied that at the point that we ordered, the available crabs were medium size so the minimum order is 2 crabs while 30 minutes later the bigger crabs arrived and therefore the minimum order is 1 crab. Upon checking the bill, we were charged RM200+ for 2 crabs instead of the RM100+ as claimed by the waitress.Overall, this was a terrible and stressful dining esperience. I'm never stepping in ever again and will STRONGLY NOT RECOMMEND it to anyone.Show less

Author: ShiaMaryKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: We decided to try out this place after reading the above average reviews, especially the cheese bee hoon. I must say the dishes looked better than they taste. The 'cheese' bee hoon was below my expectations. Apart from the saltiness, there was not much taste. The honey pork ribs was the best among the 4 dishes that we ordered. Chilli garam fish was rather flat too. Salted egg tofu was also not up to par. Overall, didn't hit the spot. Show less

Author: 88marvel2015Kuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: First Time
Review: Went there after doing a googgle searched. Was surprised to see the long queue of people waiting We actually try to book in advance through the phone but was told that we have to there to do booking on the spot. We waited for more than an hour and finally got in. The place was very narrowly space and very humid and noisy.We order the food, especially the signature cheese mee hoon, the butter milk and cheese crab steam prawns etc. They are quite tasty and with good aroma too. In fact love most of the dishes. For seafood lovers, this place have quite a varities of choices. Overall quite satisfied with the food but not the service and surroundings, not to forget the waiting time.RegardsShow less

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Still as good
Review: Came over during for reunion dinner and ordered their signature dish like cheese mee hoon and sweet vineger. All tasted good. This place is usually crowded so best to come earlier. Reservations is not required as they do it on first come first served basis

Author: AlvinLahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dinner with Friends
Review: Went there on a Saturday night with 3 friends and a kid. You must really make a reservation at least 2-3 weeks in advance if you want to eat there. Ordered too much food which I was surprised the order taker did not advice against. I would say the food has its up and down.1) Chessy Prawn Bee hoon - V. Good2) Sweet Vinegar Gui Hua Fish - Old school taste - Good3) Crispy Honey Pork - Not nice - too dry for my taste4) Vietnam style Pork Belly - average.5) Salted egg yolk beancurd - average and too little salted egg yolk.6) Fried squid with garlic - Good7) Fried Chicken with Ginger - not nice.. taste was bland.Because they are very crowded, they tend to clear your plates very fast in bid that you would leave as soon as possible. I do not think I will visit again.Show less

Author: MelindaO133
Title: Good place for seafood dinner
Review: My family will definitely drop by Tong Sheng  for dinner whenever we visit malacca. I love most of the dishes there especially the crab and the prawn bee hoon.

Author: Passenger828550
Title: Great experience
Review: The food quality and standard , I would say is normal not that fantastic but the cost of the food will give you a BIG surprise , they have a minimum order of crab and the price was so expensive which I felt they overcharge and not worth to go back again , there many better restaurant there and price are much more reasonable and lower which is value for the price you pay.Show less

Author: petay1
Title: No system
Review: The waiting time is too long. In our case, we have a baby with us. The waiting time is so long that the baby become so cranky. And the crab that we waited for took more than 2 hrs to come. Very disappointed.

Author: dennissimbk
Title: Great food
Review:
Food was great especially the river prawns with bee Hoon cooked in cheese. 
Remember not to over order as everything seems good.

Author: MattNHTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon but can’t be too much
Review: Location is not difficult to find and the food is ok and reasonable price. Prepared to wait for an hour. We had cheese Bee hoon, egg otak, green dragon vege (directs translate to mandarin), tofu with minced pork and ginger chicken.The cheese prawn bee hoon is really Unami but after a while. It’s a bit too much. To be honest, I think the bee hoon and chicken are the only dishes worth eating.Show less

Author: SWC8
Title: Love at 1st try
Review: Cheese bee hoon with big headed prawn.First mouth, every mouth .... wow...wow...wow. Just could not stop eating. The cheese is just right and not overpowering.Crab with cream sauce is also good. But pricing is on the high side. 1 kg for small crab is about MYR 200.Show less

Author: Joyce T
Title: Great Cheese Bee Hoon
Review: Go on a weekday before 530pm (their opening hours), so as the cut the queue. The Cheese Bee Hoon is the best, fried rice with real crab meat. Fried Toufu with Pork floss has interesting taste too.

Author: eweleeongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good seafood dinner
Review: First thing i saw was a queue outside of a row of shophouses... largely means good food. Locals haunt this place mostly.Staff very friendly and starts taking orders while you’re in the queue... proactive... ha ha.Restaurant located just beside Mahkota Medical Centre. Location quite good, away from heavy traffic. Dinner time quite full.Specialty is Cheesy Prawn Beehoon and milk crabs. Yummy. The food quality is very good and the prices are a bit expensive but worth the taste.I would highly recommend this place if you’re in Malacca and yearning for seafood.Happy eatingShow less

Author: KelvinN345
Title: Good seafood here
Review: We ordered their milky crab and cheesy prawn beehoon - both tasted fresh and excellent. This is value for money, we will come back again!

Author: hweelingg2015
Title: Awesome Dinner
Review: Loved the cheese prawn bee Hoon, baked squid with garlic. The French bean dish was good. Had to wait about 1.5 hours on a Saturday evening but it was all worth it. One of the best Chinese restaurants in Malacca.

Author: Ricky-indo777Bali, Indonesia
Title: Worth Long queue tong sheng
Review: Tong sheng restaurant was one of the famous sea food restaurant at malacca city.Just 2 minutes from mahkota medical centre by foot.The taste of chilli crab and steam fish at this restaurant was blowing mind, so delicious and yummy.But the queue at this restaurant was so long just because delicious food what they cook make people still want to queue.Tong Sheng = delicous chili crab = Long queueShow less

Author: Suelowst
Title: Cheesy Prawn Noodles
Review: There was so much hype about their cheesy prawn noodles so had to go and try it out. very dissapointing. You can hardly taste the cheese. The seating in the restaurant is also very messy. However, the owner's wife, a lady from Bentong, was very friendly.Show less

Author: Flyn1170
Title: Excellent!
Review:
Was an excellent dinner. Every dish was good. The cheese beehoon, crab, pork rib, chicken... every dish was just so good. 

You need to book way in advance otherwise be prepared to wait a long while for the table.

Author: Lawrence S
Title: Cheese beehoon
Review: This restaurant is famous for its cheese beehoon, unique and can't be found anywhere else. The wait can easily be 30-45 minutes.

Author: v1esssJakarta, Indonesia
Title: One of the best resto in malaka
Review: If you come to malaka ,you must try this resto.This is third times we enjoy ou dinner in here.Better to come earlier(5.30-6 pm)if u dont want to queque but totaly worthied with the taste .The price totaly reasonable .But if order crab you must spent more money .Show less

Author: Tommy_Sanghee_Jeong
Title: Excellent by both taste and price!!!
Review: Compared to the situation of my country, Korea, this restaurant must be one of the most recommedable seafood restaurant in Melaka. I loved the foods here worth of visiting this restaurant twice. The same satisfaction regardless of wasted time in the long que. Milk butter crab and Bee Hoon Prawn are very delicious.Show less

Author: k2papaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated and overpriced tourist trap
Review: Went Tong Sheng for dinner at around 8 pm on a weekend at a friend’s recommendation. Queue was very long and we waited almost an hour before we had our table!!! Tried the cheese mee hoon and the milk crab, supposedly the must-have dishes. Also ordered some other vege dishes and sides. Was very disappointed that after such a long wait, the food only tasted average. May be it is a matter of personal taste, but we definitely prefer the Chilli crabs and White Pepper Crabs in Singapore. Overall, not a good dining experience due to the long waiting time and lack of service. Also felt that the dishes were overpriced and not worth the wait. Show less

Author: thidamirod
Title: Extremely expensive.Not worth.Real waste of money.Normal tasty.
Review: EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE & NOT WORTH IT. visited again after 2 years. Queue still long which gives visitors great impression about the restaurant. Order for 3 person : 2 medium size black pepper crab- RM234.00 + sweetsour pork- RM12.00+ lemon fish - RM45.00 + Vege-RM10.00+ 3 Rice+ 3 skyjuice + 1 jelly lime juice and total RM312.73. Not sure how the charges for crab. Overly priced and overrated. Can get better n tastier food at normal restaurants with cheaper price.Show less

Author: Helen0830
Title: Food is subject to personal preference
Review: Thank god we have booked the table as it is very crowded. Order fresh milk crab and cheese mee hun. Personally more prefer the fresh milk crab but my Boyfriend don’t like it that much. As for the cheese mee hun, feel that it is overrated. Overall roughly three hundred ringgit Malaysia. It is better to make a booking otherwise you might really have to wait for nearly two hours just to be seated.Show less

Author: JoshuaT1845
Title: Fantastic crabs
Review: Tried the milk crab dish. It was fantastic. Worth the wait. The cheese prawn beehoon was also very good. A must try when you visit this eatery.

Author: Ch BMontpellier, France
Title: Very efficiënt delicious Chinese food.
Review: We went there on a thuisday evening, very busy ! We waited for 30 minutes to get our table. Then we waited an other 10 minutes at our table to get the pre-ordered (in the waiting list) food. A huge plate with 2 crabs arrived at our table. We also had orderend white rice, scallops with garlic and soda's. ALCOHOL is not served at this restaurant. The food was really delicious. This is a must-visit when visiting Malaka. Cash only restaurant !!Show less

Author: GanLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cheese prawn meehun
Review: We phoned earlier to reserve a place and the moment we reach the restaurant we were led to our table. The food came 10 minutes after we have ordered.
