The signature dish of cheese prawn meehun was delicious. We kept on drinking the irresistible soup. The steamed otak otak and eggs was well done. We were very impressed with the signboard of the shop, so colourful and attractiveShow less

Author: M1411818830
Title: No cards acceptance
Review: Seriously! The owner must consider to accept cards or other ewallets for payment instead of only cash! You cannot expect the diners have enough cash to dine. Utterly disappointed.

Author: WilsonWSAngSingapore, Singapore
Title: 1st in the Queue!
Review: The last time we came here, we reached around 5pm and seated around 8pm. This time we came a little earlier around 4.45pm and was first in the queue. The star dishes here were crab and prawn beehoon. The Crab dish was as good as we had remembered. The shop requires every crab order to be at least 2 crabs. it’s disappointing we can’t try different flavours. dishes portion was generous and taste good. The price wasn’t the cheapest but considering the quality of the dish, it was certainly value for money. Show less

Author: wileensSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reservations a must
Review: Reservations are a must if you wish to skip the walk-in queue. We tried calling a few times till someone picked up and accepted our reservation, albeit 2 hours later than our intended timing.Our party of 6 ordered the famous milk crab and cheese beehoon, crispy pork, hokkien noodles, otah steamed egg and some vegetables.The crowd fav is the crispy pork fried with dried chilli. A must order!The signature milk crab was not bad; the sauce tasted like a sweeter version of Thai green curry and we got toasted bread pieces to mop up the sauce with. The cheese beehoon was okay, just that the sauce was a little on the watery side. The seafood was fresh.Show less

Author: dannyteng22
Title: Must Try when visit Malaka
Review:
One of the best seafood restaurant in Taman Melaka Raya. Nearby the hotels, night life and shopping areas.
Suggest either place a booking in advance, or start queue before 5.30pm.

Author: Gordon3004
Title: Good food but Long wait for seatings
Review:
The food is good and servings are large which is good for families and friends.

Warning the queue for a table in like 2 hours for the weekends.

Author: Travellover0773Singapore, Singapore
Title: Mouth watering cheese BeeHoon
Review: This restaurant was highly recommended to me by a friend. I have been warned about the long queue as it was really so famous with its cheese beehoon. Went to the restaurant at about 7.30pm and waited for almost 45 minutes to get a table for 3. It was a weekend.Unfortunately, 3 of us couldn’t finish too much food. We had the cheese beehoon which was really good. If it was not because of the gravy is fattening, I would have ordered a second serving. Overall, all the dishes were really tasty with reasonable price. Must try when you are in MELAKA. Go for early dinner, eat as much as you can before heading to the night market for a stroll.Show less

Author: Mary B
Title: Famous restaurant in Melaka
Review: Was recommended by friends to go to this place for the Chessy Prawn with Rice Vermicelli and it was delicious.   We had a 8 course dinner and it was good food.

Author: Teekay_GohKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food must queue and wait
Review: This place is a must whenever I come to Malacca. Sometimes you still got to wait for half an hour to one hour to get a place even when you come at 5.30pm during their opening time.The milky cheese MeeHoon is a must to have!Show less

Author: Josephine T
Title: One of the best
Review: We were there before 5.15pm and there was a long queue and the restaurant was filled with people. We joined the q and waited till 7pm to have a seat. Luckily the staff took our order while we were in the q. Thus once seated, our food came rather quickly. We ordered the Cheese Bee Hoon, Milk Crab, Garlic Scallop, Holick Prawn, Squid, Vegetable, 2 rice and 5 Jelly lime and spend total of RM525 inclusive of 6% service tax.The most costly is the crab which cost RM270. My group of 5 gives a big thumbs up and enjoyed all the dishes and we will be back again.Show less

Author: virus777Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy
Review: Booked 2 weeks in advance for table of 10 and only managed to get a 8.30pm slot. We had their famous Cheese Bee Hoon (9/10), Milk Crab (9/10), Squid (9.5/10), some vegetables and a pork dish. My friends were very impressed by the food taste and quality. Everyone ask for name cards and all of us left as a very happy and satisfied customer. And not forgetting it comes with good and polite service staff.Show less

Author: skyeliz
Title: Dinner at a Local Zi-char Restaurant
Review: First time visiting Restoran Tong Sheng after receiving recommendation from a relative to visit them for their famous cheesy prawn beehoon. Queued for about 20 mins before we were seated (maybe because its a weekday and off-peak period) so it is slightly faster. The cheesy prawn beehoon was yummy. Prawn was fresh. Will visit again!Show less

Author: louislele6880
Title: best seafood restaurant
Review: The crab bee hoon and the milk crab were super delicious. the sotong with egg was also good. you have to make reservation if you are going to patronize the shop. btw the restaurant is a no air-condition shop.

Author: enjoyoverseastrip
Title: Tong Sheng Restaurant
Review: Restoran Tong Sheng MalaccaWe heard of this need to queue early restaurant that all talk about. It was a normal non aircon type of coffeeshop. After grabbing there we manage to be in the queue for about 15 persons ahead of us. It was a friday night and the order taker was rather impatient whilst taking our orders but we managed to be seated 15 minutes later.We ordered the famous cheese beehoon big head prawns and the taste is pretty normal. Prices are a bit above average.Show less

Author: Texan CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Long Queues- otherwise
Review: Lucky for the friends recommendation, we had two nights of dinner here.Each dinner cost us RM$580+ (first night, we had 5 main dishes). The second night, we were not to miss the large Prawns milk with Cheeze (cheezy) Beehoon.Served in a hugh plate, filled in the middle of liquid Cheeze/milky.We cleared most of every plate. Our lucky visits at specific timing of 7pm (bookings of 8pm) & 5.30pm needs no queue. Many tourist & visitors stood in line since its opening hours for dinner for at least one whole hour under the very hot afternoon. We took pictures of customer within the shop holding up an umbrella while she picks up a pair of chop sticks with the other eating the Cheezy prawns.Some of us lamented, why no airconditioning.Show less

Author: Terry W
Title: Gem of Melaka
Review: Hidden in a dark corner near the the beach, well known by the local, couple of famous dishes, always packed with tourists and local

Author: MR_BiRD1Singapore, Singapore
Title: It has gotten alot more expensive
Review: Last visited 4 years ago. One of my main reasons to make the long drive to Melaka is Tong Sheng.Made a 5.30pm reservation and arrived on time. As there were only 2 of us, we only ordered 3 dishes.Cheese Bee Hun - legit good.Milk crab - minimum order of 2 crabs, still as good as 4 yrs ago.Horlick prawns - didnt feel as good as the other time. It felt like they tweaked the recipe.Food is generally still good.But prices have gone up quite abit. Our crab was 125rm per kg. Total bill was about $290rm for 3 dishes.Service is non-existant. Make a reservation else be prepared to queue for a long long time.Cant give them a 5-starsShow less

Author: AdinDNA
Title: Good for gathering
Review: Nice place to bring the whole family for just hang out or formal family gathering. Good food, and healthy green tea provided.

Author: LilianasoebiJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Fresh and Tasty Seafood. Fully booked table
Review: We had : Cheese Prawn Meehun (8 out of 10. The prawns were huge)Fried Fresh Squid with Garlic (9 out of 10)Fresh milk crab (9 out of 10) even the smallest portion is super bigThe seafood is fresh and the taste is unusually delicious.When we came at 8 pm on Tuesday, the tables were full. We must wait for a while.Btw, it is close on monday.Show less

Author: SingaporelonegrangerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic flavours
Review: It better be good as we booked 3 days in advance and was given the undesirable 5.30pm slot. I was wrong, it was not good, it was fantastic!The cheese prawn meehum sounded dubious but I was wowed by the lobster-sized prawns. So succulent, so scrumptious, with well balanced flavours. The fresh milk crab was also well executed. It was spicy but what wonderful flavours! Somehow the dairy products worked well in these 2 dishes. The garlic squid was another winner. Beautifully seared on the outside and full of garlic goodness. We enjoyed the Four King vegetable dish, which surprisingly was not a run of the mill vegetable dish.Reservations are recommended as the long queues are notorious. If you love seafood, this is an obligatory stop on any visit to Malacca.Show less

Author: Sheila Lian Cho... K
Title: crabby  power
Review: i am not  a cheeze fan.. but this dish  is  so good.. i will only eat cheeze in this  at  tong sheng.. hahah   non jelak at all.

Author: kohcw11
Title: Good food but long Q best to order in advance for take away or reserve a table
Review: The Q is always there and my advice is to order take away and eat at the hotel as you do not need to squeeze with ppl in the queue or at the restaurant seats sweating away while waiting for food to be served.

Author: Road53852
Title: Overrated
Review: Food was ok but not worth a 3-5 hr wait. Customer service and queue management was terrible. We started queuing from 5pm, got seats at 7.30. Be prepared to wait another hour for food to be served. Even if your orders are taken when you are in the queue, the waitresses will only inform you at the very last minute that some dishes ordered were already sold out. We had to order plain rice for the kids first and even that took 10-15 mins to be served. If you can't get in for the first seating, suggest to give up. Not recommended for young children. Unlikely to revisit, unless you have nothing better to do and a lot of time to while. Show less

Author: blueneutronSingapore, Singapore
Title: Sumptuous Food but Q was Crazy
Review: Queued for 4h since 515pm on a weekday and finally got dinner served around 930pm. Tried messaging for table reservation but to no avail - full house.Food is still as sumptuous and good but service has dipped - slow and not as attentive to the table crowdShow less

Author: 458carahNottinghamshire, United Kingdom
Title: Really great food!
Review: The food here was brilliant and also very reasonable. Be aware though that you should get there early as it gets very busy and people oftern queue up down the street to go. You also get charged for the nuts and chillis on the table when you arrive and the cold napkins afterwards... neither of which you are asked if you want, however it’s not that much and the great food makes this worth it.Show less

Author: lebamlovefood
Title: nice food
Review: went to queue as was intro by friends …. did a take away and it was a delicacy … every mouthful was so watery ... now think of it i cant wait go back there again .... powerful! only thing is the wait was a bit long but for those who have patience enough ... worth the waitShow less

Author: JingpeiSingapore, Singapore
Title: local zichar that everyone likes
Review: be prepared to queue and wait if you are coming. we were very full from our food hunt for the day but couldn't miss this stop. only picked a few small dishes and had to have the signature cheese bee hoon. it's tasty and I understand how peoplle compare it to the HK version. but I must say it is vastly different, having tried both. The HK version is thicker and more sinful, uses lobster/ crayfish, while this gives a lighter and milder taste, with prawns as the main feature. the famed fresh milk crabs is beyond us, next time perhaps. Show less

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very Unique Delicious food and very crowded.
Review: This is a marvellous restaurant to have food. The food is so good I could go there every night. Recommended dishes -Cheesy Prawn Meehun, Crab in milk sauce, Fried Fresh Squid with Garlic, Crispy Honey Sauce Pork, Fried Sea Cucumber with Onion. Note that crab prices are seasonal.You will need to book early by phone in order to get a table. Go there as a group of six people if you want to try most of the food. If you a couple, just order the Cheesy Prawn Meehun. The service is good and prompt.You can go there by Car, Taxi or Grab or walk over if you are staying nearby. Just do be alert if you are walking in the evenings, take the lighted paths.Show less

Author: StevenNgTP
Title: Good food ... Worth the wait?
Review: This is a much of a must go place in Malacca ... Therefore don't expect that you'll be able to walk in & get a table. Queued almost 1.5hrs to get a table for 16 paxs. The cheese bee hoon was very much sought after & to top it off most dishes were good & above normal zi char standard. My favourite was the thinly sliced vietnamese pork.For those with kids, do note that there are chilli padi in some of the dishes. You may want to take them out before the kids eat. Have tried to ask them not to put chilli, but got rejected as the cooks were too busy to take note of exceptational.Yes, this is still a place to eat when you are there in Malacca if you don't mind the crazy queue. Alternatively what I heard is that you can call & book your tables at least 2 weeks in advance.Show less

Author: Cheeps21
Title: Popular place, good food
Review: We had to wait for 20min when we arrived at 9.30am on a wee day. The cheese prawn bee hoon, grilled squid were also excellent, prices can be quite high for locals.

Author: Steven SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Famous cheese Mehun and creamy butter Crab!
Review: After numerous times of passing by where each and every time there is crowd in Q. We decided to give it a try on Rest.Tong ShengLucky enough the be the last one customer on the first batch ( the Q start 4:45 pm where the shop only open.After nearly 100mins of waiting time for the cooking, finally served and everyone was happy GHL’s Highly recommended:Cheese MihunCrab (RM120 /kh)Show less

Author: JansenWAHo
Title: Birthday - Shirley
Review: Ordered 5 dishes; signature Cheese Prawn Mihun, Green Vegetable small Cabbage, Steam Eggs, Fried Fresh Squid with Garlic and Pork Belly Vietnam Style; excellent taste quality, Mihun doesn't taste cheesy so it's to my liking. Overall, very good.

Author: NiXilGav
Title: Been visiting for about 10 years
Review: My family and I have been eating here for a long time. Through out the years, we've seen the place get busier and busier as more and more Singaporeans find out about the place. Service has never been their forte but this is essentially a zi char coffee shop so please adjust your expectations abit. The lady boss however is quite nice, I normally make a reservation through her when I go there.Cheese bee hoon, Milk crabs, sweet vinegar fish are 3 items you have to have when you're there. Everything else there is good too but as with everything, it is open to interpretation.It's a busy place, so plan in advance to go there or make plans to wait. Especially over the weekends. If you make a reservation, please note they only take 5.30pm and 8.30pm reservations. That's why if you rock up without a reservation at 5ish, you'll have to wait till 8ish for a table (when the 1st lot from the 5.30pm leaves). Show less

Author: yihshin_senKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Spent 3 hours of wait to get rid of your curiousity!
Review: We had been in the queue for nearly 3 hours (6.15pm to 8.30pm, and another half an hour of wait for the food to be served).The signature cheese mihun is not as expected, no cheese aroma but more like milk/butter mihun.Food is above average, but I would say definitely not up to an distinctive ROI for the second time for another round of 3 hours wait (Gauge your level of desire).Value is fair, pay for what you get but be mindful the price presented for seafood is by weightage.Show less

Author: 9357MarkYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Finally get to try this place
Review: Heard so much about Tong Sheng from all our friends who frequent Melaka and we finally got to eat dinner there on 18 may. We tried the house specials like cheese bee Hoon with prawns, deep fried fish, crispy thin pork slices, deep fried tofu cubes with pork gods and we had crabs down in chilli gravy and the second in creamy sauce with a Thai food tinge (lemon grass) and butter (I Guess). The crabs were of good size and it was very fresh. It’s really tasted fantastic. The place reminds me of restoran Lee at air keroh on the way out from Melaka to the NS highway. Except Tong Sheng is right smack in town and being just 10 min walk from hattan hotel really helps. There was a Long queue of customers waiting for a table. The customers are a combination of tourist and locals. We will come back again and reservations is recommended. Show less

Author: mikep553St. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: Don't look any further, eat here you won't regret it!
Review: If you think your Malaysia trip has been full of incredible, unbeatable taste sensations.. well this place beats them all!The cheesy prawn mee noodle might sound odd but is honestly one of the best things I've ever tasted.The butter curry scallops were soooo good and the crispy honey pork was delicious. I'm so impressed, almost speechless The place may be a bit of a walk but Grabs are cheap and you won't regret it..Btw.. it's very popular with the locals so there may be a short wait to get seated, for us it was less than 5 mins..Show less

Author: Karine V
Title: Good but service not so well
Review: We've been there, because we have seen a lot of people in. Lot of choices on the menu, my friend asked for the size and price of the crabes for 1 person, and they hardly answered, made no effort and we didn't understand : so they served her a so big plate of crabes she had to pay 45$! It was too big, and they didn't want to understand us. By the way, it was good. My praws omelette too, but that's all. We asked for beers (not on the menu) and they brought us soda cans, not what we expected.Show less

Author: 901stanleyl
Title: Consistent good food
Review:
Manage to reserve dinner on Sunday evening. 

The food is consistent and delicious as per my last visit 

Price is reasonable as well.

Author: CupidJChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Can't miss it if you go to Melaka
Review: It's heard the average queue is 1-2 hours, which made me kind of hesitant go or not. After tasted their signature dishes, cheese lobster noodles & curry crab, I have to day luckily my friends urged me to insist on the waiting. It's the place I'll go back if I return the trip in Melaka next time.Show less

Author: chanseyt17Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummm.... go early to beat the queues
Review: We had the cheesy prawn bihun, squid with garlic, ginger chicken cubes, a veggie dish, as well as drinks. Total bill was ~RM108 which was very affordable! Prawn bihun dish was good without being too cloying, you get two huge split into halves... While all dishes were good, my favourite was the fried squid..We left stuffed as we obviously over ordered... anyway we visited on a Thursday evening, walked in at about 515pm and there were already 5-6 other tables. Noticed most tables had reserved signs on. For those who intend to stay at Hatten hotel, the restaurant is just a 10-15mins walk away, just ask hotel staff for directions.Show less

Author: tifyCKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Dinner in Malacca
Review: Had never tried Chinese cuisine during our trip in Malacca. If you looking for something filling, delicious chinese cuisine at reasonable price. Had some of their recommended dishes, cheesy mee hoon is a Must, fried fish fillets with special sauce was nicely presented, the fillet was fresh and crispy, grilled squid with sauce was crunchy, fried pork belly was ok. We didn’t try their crabs but was recommended by most reviewers. Five of us had six dishes, total damage RM222.We went for late dinner at 9.30pm, no queues but almost full house. Food was served fast.Recommended if you are bored with Malacca local food.Show less

Author: spc2008London uk
Title: Very Tasty Food!
Review: It was unfortunate I only found this restaurant on my recent trip to Melaka, even though I have been to this city visiting my now late in laws for the past decades!! All those missed opportunities!!If you want a table without waiting get there before 6pm, otherwise you'll have to join the queue of people that will quickly forms once the 20 or so tables has been taken up.I came here twice on the last 2 days of my last visit and tried different food, to me they were very good for the price they charged. The service could be better, but certainly acceptable considering they seemed to be mostly 'part time students'. I have no hesitation in recommending this restaurant.Show less

Author: Siang Teng LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cheesy Prawn Bee Hoon is good really
Review: For those who intend to stay at Hatten Hotel or Estadia, this is good news. The restaurant is within walking distance from the hotel. The must order is the Cheesy Prawn Bee Hoon dish which most believe Tong Sheng is the pioneer. However, don’t take thing for granted. The restaurant is packed and you must make advance booking to avoid disappointment. Some say this restaurant is over rated but I find them ok. The crab dish may be pricey but the rest are above average in terms of taste and price. Don’t expect too much from their service.Show less

Author: ErikW1787
Title: Antrian nya cukup melelahkan
Review: Cheese prawn beehoonNot too strong taste of cheese. Very big prawn.Cheese prawn beehoon is quite popular menu in malacca and this restaurant is quite popular. U can see from the queue to get the table. Waiting list is about 30min-1.5 hourScore 9/10Sweet vinegar gui hua fishVery crispy yet tender inside. The sauce is perfect, taste like sweet and sour dish but better. Very good dish and awsome display. The meat is cutted but still intact with the skin.Score 9/10Suggestion for the restaurant, please provide chair for the queueShow less

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Overrated
Review:
Food was average and service was really poor!
Staff are rude and unfriendly! 

Food prices are overpriced! 
Not worth the visit at all!

Author: Elje66Belgium
Title: Nothing to shout about, expected it to taste better, big disappointment
Review: Drove pass the restaurant a few times & saw the long que. Thought a must try before I return to Belgium. Went there just before 5:30 pm on a Wednesday was 1st customer & ordered their signature cheesy prawn beehoon. The bill was RM37,10 excluding drinks. I wouldn’t recommend it to anyone, too pricy for Malaccan standard & really nothing special about the taste. More for S’poreans & tourists Show less

Author: Tiffany_travellerSingapore, Singapore
Title: A great crab adventure
Review: We had 4 crabs among 4 people. Yes, that's how much we love crabs. We ordered them made in two styles - one in the signature milk crab and the other steamed crab - cos we figured that if you can't get steamed crabs right, it means your ingredients aren't fresh. And I'm happy to report that it exceeded our expectations. Prices aren't cheap but if you go hungry, you'll be rewarded.Show less

Author: charhugkiss
Title: Overrated
Review: Queued for one hour with the heavy rain, one hour of cooking.  The signature crab and cheese bee hoon were overrated and overpriced.  I rather go to jb for seafood rather than travelling all the way there.   Not worth the wait !

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Good food but kinda expensive
Review: Ordered signature crab they are selling at RM130/kg more expensive than Jb restaurant. The crab meat is solid n meaty the size is big too. Their beehoon is just ok. Prawn doesn't seem so fresh. Bill came at RM240 just for the crab n prawn beehoon RM35. Still consider expensive and both crab I guess is only weight 1.6kg not even close to 1.8kgShow less

Author: sharon9700
Review: Excellent Excellent Excellent. Love their signature dishes to the max. Go early as the queue is always very very long . Good food are worth the queue 😋

Author: ThriftyAlwinLeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive food and overated
Review: Saw the queue on new year's eve and thought should try it out. went on new year's day and still needed to queue. With much anticipation, we ordered the dishes and their signature prawn cheese beehoon.Food was quite bland and takes very long to serve. unlike other Zhi char where the dishes are served in quick succession, we had to wait for quite long before our next dish came. We didn't order the crab as we were out of budget but it looks good as every other table has ordered it. Recommendation is to skip the queue here, go opposite the road and have the best nyonya cuisine you ever tastedShow less

Author: 494edmunde
Title: V good crab meal
Review:
6 of us ordered the cheesy beehoon and crab meal.  They were delicious.  
Only bug bear was the queue. 
After so long in biz.  They should not Look into ways to shorten the queue so that people can have an enjoyable meal.

Author: bakupaku
Title: Make reservation; horrible queue
Review: The cheese prawn bee hoon was special. I like the crabs with milk, but beware that it was slightly spicy. The crabs were fresh, and the meat was sweet n juicy. We went to the restaurant to order and pay deposit, then collected at 11pm.

Author: ArosubSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated , not worth the Q time...
Review: This came highly recommended by friends and Hotel.Cheesy beehoon : nothing special. Beehoon was soft .Black pepper crab : crab was firm but this got to be the worst black pepper crab that I ever had!Milk crab: crab was firm again , not bad but so-so.Deep fried squid : only this was nice.Overall, not worth the Q .Show less

Author: howf2017Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Arrived early around 4:30pm plus and was surprised that the queue wasn't that long (there were 4 paxs ahead of us). Good thing is that it started early for business (normally 5:30pm), hence did not waited for long. Ordered 2 of their signature dishes; Cheese Bee Hoon and Sweet Vinegar Cui Hua Fish.Didn't try their Crab as there is a minimum order of 2 crabs(RM120 per kg). Strictly my opinion...Beehoon do not have that cheesey taste, kinda of using powder cheese, however the beehoon was soft to my liking. Fried fish, nothing to rave about except it is boneless, good for kids and senior. Reasonably price but won't be back as it overrated. Show less

Author: simplytravelandeat
Title: Full marks for the cheese bee hoon
Review:
Amazing creation using western ingredients blending well with a traditional Asian bee hoon.

The cheese bee hoon really deserved the long wait. It's a must try! 

Just order take away and come back to collect later to avoid the super long queue!

Author: Jacky84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Signature cheese bee hoon
Review: This restaurant has been highly recommended by my girl friend and even though we doesn't get to reserve the seat on that day, we still proceed and queue for almost 2 hrs to be seated. The restaurant is already very crowded and a long queue is formed outside. The waiter has provided a menu for us to order first before allocate a seat to us. We have ordered the signature cheese bee hoon, prawn, fried pork and tou fu. The food serving is slow though and the place is hot due to no aircon. The cheese bee hoon especially, very unique and delicious, we have ordered a medium and still craving for it. The other dishes is good as well except for the tou fu, have a very fulfilling dinner. Highly recommended to try and best to reserve first before going.Show less

Author: HaddyTaY
Title: Nice Food
Review: This restaurant offer nice foods. My favourite is the "cheesy prawn beehoon". Very tastety and nice. But this restaurant has a very long queue. It took me1 hr in queue, another half an hour waiting for my food to be served. Worth for waiting!! And definitely I will return again.Show less

Author: singaporeatouristSingapore, Singapore
Title: long queue but good food
Review: if you can spend some time to queue, the food is pretty good. I was super impressed with the cheese beehoon the first time I was here but second time round, it was still good but just not as Wow. what wowed us was the crab (very juicy), fried squid and salted egg toufu.Show less

Author: pteo66Singapore, Singapore
Title: DELICIOUS MEATY CRABS!
Review: Cheese beehoon is the popular item but I found it unimpressive. Rather my favourite is the crabs! They do not serve large crabs like Singapore as sizes are mostly 1kg+. Price is MYR120/kg and min is two crabs per dish. The signature fresh milk crab is yummilicious! Do not get deceived by the name. It has a blend of flavours - sour, little spicy, garlic... Huge selection - salt baked, pepper, salted egg (I personally prefer Singapore's salted egg crabs), sweet & sour etc!The rave about this restaurant is, the crabs! The boss makes an effort to select meaty crabs, does not deep fry the crabs when cooking which means the meat is not sticking to the shell! The place is only opened for dinner from 5.30pm and closes later on Saturday nights to cater to the crowd. There is a special kampong chicken on the menu where you have to pre-order a day before. Did not get to try it as it was 15th of the month (gregorian calendar) where the market is closed. Street Parking is available right outside the restaurantTong Sheng (yes not nonya food) is one of the main reason why I would consider driving to Melaka again!Show less

Author: Sir_Iron_LongswordLangkawi, Malaysia
Title: Great food but very long queue!
Review: I queued for 1 hour and 5 mins. I thought it was very long until I read reviews online where some queued for 3 hours or more. After getting my seat, I has to wait another 20 mins before my food arrived. So be prepared to give yourself 1.5 hours of waiting before getting to eat. Lol. The cheesy prawn mihun was definitely worth the queue. The guihua fish was alright. Nothing to scream about. Overall I think it's worth the queue for the first time. I don't think I will do it again. Maybe only if I'm really craving for the cheesy prawn mihun!Show less

Author: IvyNg88
Title: Yummy food
Review:
Wonderful mee hoon ! 
Good place to gather with friends and family 
Price is reasonable , beer also reasonably priced

Author: clairew_12611Singapore, Singapore
Title: Be prepared to queue and wait...
Review: This place is extremely popular for the cheese bee hoon that comes with a few prawns. The small order only comes with 1 prawn. 4 of us ordered the medium. The sauce and bee hoon is nice but there aren't that many prawns. The signature crabs and sweet/sour fish were excellent and we really enjoyed. Can try to make reservations before going. When we left at 10pm there was still a long queue...Show less

Author: YoonLiang LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Say no to the queue.
Review: Guys. It's not worth your time. Seriously. It's all the fame. Please go to aunt fatso for the same signature dish. The place is cramp and hot and rowdy and messy. I swear that I have tried both Tong sheng and aunt fatso and the later offer aircon sitting and is better staff. The food. Exactly the same. It's a family turned feud and went separate ways and hence 2 restaurants offering similar food. Any nice food served in a messy and rowdy environment with totally change your mood and taste. Show less

Author: danwhwKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Price & waiting time ridiculously
Review: Used to go this place 7 years ago but today visited again &.. People are flocking there lining up even the place not open yet! And I think mostly are Singaporean lining up as I've to join the crowd. After waited bout 1 hour plus finally my turn to have a table. Ordered a few dishes plus the most famous butter crab. The taste still the same but 2 crabs cost 200 plus! I think they only interested to earn sing dollar than rm. I've also ordered a hokkien mee but I've doubt of the taste as the best hokkien mee still in KL & I'm right when the mee arrived. They cooked it too fast that the taste didn't went into the mee. Also when they busy, most of others fried items are unavailable ie. Fried rice, fried meehon. Only hokkien mee & white rice! Show less

Author: alvissp
Title: Long queue, worth the first try
Review: Walking distance from jonker street, but crazy queue! Open from 530pm, but my friends and I only went at 9pm. Queued for 1 hour plus and got seated at 10plus pm. Ordered the 1. Fresh milk crabs (min 2, seasonal price), 2. Deep fried cuttlefish (seasonal price), 3. Cheesy prawn bee Hoon (famous recommended signature), 4. Beancurd and 5. Some bean vegetables. The total bill came up to $420rm which was way below our expectations (based on some reviews we saw online). The signature food was interesting with unique taste that my friends and I have not tasted before. Will recommend to try once, or more than once if you manage to come during a day without queue. Otherwise it's ok to give this a miss. Show less

Author: Celestar989Singapore, Singapore
Title: Over-rated
Review: Together with other fellow diners, many of them first timers including myself, we braved the long queue to dine at this restaurant after reading many good reviews on TripAdvisor. Ordered their signature dishes as recommended, unfortunately, I think the food is just over-rated. Their signature milk crabs was way too sweet, it felt more like a dessert dish. The sauce was crap and it doesn't go well with the crabs at all. It is better to stick to the usual flavors such as black pepper crabs. Do note that this restaurant has a policy of minimum 2 crabs per order with each crab costing about RM120. So if you are just a party of 2, I suggest to skip the crabs as you wont be able to finish them unless you have a huge appetite. The other signature dish cheese prawn bee hoon was alright thankfully, didn't taste anything like cheese at all. However, I do agree with some other reviewers that you may get sick of the sauce if the dish is cold. A medium size bee hoon dish cost about RM70. While this dish is still acceptable, I do not think it is worth to queue for more than 45mins for this.Show less

Author: FoodReviewerSGUK
Title: Excellent Cheese Beehoon
Review: Excellent Cheese Beehoon. But be prepared to wait due to the long queue. But it will be worth the wait.

Author: PKYeoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A Must TRY restaurant when you're in town
Review: The BEST Cheesy prawn beehoon and the 'yam kok' crabs definitely a must try dishes. Avoid weekends if you don't book for a table as you may have to Q for hours before your turn. Weekdays is the best time to visit. A great restaurant indeed!Show less

Author: reciag2016
Title: cheesy prawn Beehoon & crabs - must try dishes
Review: This cheesy prawn beehoon is fantastic, crabs are fresh and tasty!! Worth the trip down, will come again! 👍👍👍

Author: JGOH25
Title: Long wait
Review: this place serves good cheese beehoon. But be warned and prepared to wait for 1-2 hours for a table.

Author: MikayleLimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food!
Review: Really great cheese bee Hoon! Ordered a few other dishes and it was all not bad. They have this rojak chicken which was rather unique. Give it a try when your there! However, please make sure to finish the cheese bee Hoon and not wait for other dishes to come. Because once it turns cold it becomes disgusting.Aside to that, I was there before the opening hours and there was already a Long queue formed outside the stall. When they open their doors they started letting people with reservations in first and it filled up the whole place. Thus people like us without reservations are still standing there and waiting. So if your gonna visit the stall, make sure you make a reservation with them first. If not be prepared to wait for at least an hour!Show less

Author: Moodee C
Title: Be prepared to pay
Review: The locals tell me they don't patron Tong Sheng for the simple fact that its mainly for tourists (=overpriced). No doubt the food is good, but be prepared to queue for long... and pay. Cheese crab bee hoon for 2 pax (small) came with only 1 prawn. We wanted only 1 crab to share between 2 of us but was told minimum order was 2 crabs! Ended up paying RM245 for crabs that we couldn't finish. Exavagrant meal considering local fare is only RM5-6. Show less

Author: SLimKimC
Title: Great food!
Review: Love the food at Tong Sheng! Glad it is a 5-minute walk from Estadia Hotel. Our group of 8 had dinner there the 2 nights we were in Melaka. Don't miss their Cheese Prawn Meehun, Fried Fresh Squid with Garlic, Sweet Vinegar Gui Hua Fish...

Author: tadboonMiri, Malaysia
Title: Not worth for the wait
Review: This is just a hype.. Poor service, expensive, some waiter r not friendly & the they don't answer to reservations! So u must WAIT. Most important, the cheese bihun doesn't taste good at all, broth flavor is boring & no cheese... I suggest u guys try other restaurant... don't waste ur time & money at hereShow less

Author: Jim Angie TSingapore, Singapore
Title: weight of crab charged was suspicious
Review: The best Cheese Bee Hoon in Malacca that I have tried. However, we were very suspicious of the weight of the crab that we were billed. Not once but all the time that we dine there, it is a great turned off and I have since stopped dining here. overall the food is good but be prepared to Q.Show less

Author: hiiong888Singapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonably priced seafood with good taste
Review: Queing time is about 1 hour during our visit.We order the following dishes:1. Fresh Milk CrabThe crab quite fresh and taste sweet, a little bit sour and spicy. Rich flavour in the gravy match with toasted bun. Not really suitable for children as a little bit spicy. This is my favourite dish during our visit.2. Cheese Prawn BeehoonThe prean quite fresh and the cheese and milk in gravy not too thick. This dish not spicy.3. Prawn BallJust an ordinary prawn ball served with mayonise. Taste ok.4. Fried Tofu with flossMy lest favourite dish during our visit this time. Taste so so. And the dish could easily found anywhere.Total damage for the food and drinks less than RM 300. The price quite reasonable.Service staff quite friendly and efficient.Show less

Author: danwhwKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Price & waiting time ridiculously
Review: Used to go this place 7 years ago but today visited again &.. People are flocking there lining up even the place not open yet! Picture that I've took its 5.15pm as can noticed the sun bout to set. And I think mostly are Singaporean lining up as I've to join the crowd. After waited bout 1 hour plus finally my turn to have a table. Ordered a few dishes plus the most famous butter crab. The taste still the same but 2 crabs cost 200 plus! I think they only interested to earn sing dollar than rm. I've also ordered a hokkien mee but I've doubt of the taste as the best hokkien mee still in KL & I'm right when the mee arrived. They cooked it too fast that the taste didn't went into the mee. Also when they busy, most of others fried items are unavailable ie. Fried rice, fried meehon. Only hokkien mee & white rice! Show less

Author: TakoTakoSingapore
Title: The bee hoon is simply delicious!
Review: We were not able to make an advance reservation as it was a last minute trip. It was a PH and we reached at 5.30pm. But because it was a PH weekend, we queued for 3 hrs and finally got a table at 8.30pm. Food was served quite fast as the items we ordered were the popular ones. TA did not fail us, the cheesy prawn beehoon wins hands down. It's so much better than the one we ate opposite at another zi char restaurant. We didn't take the milky crabs (also recommended) as my friends don't really eat it (minimum amt to order is 1kg).Bottom line, make reservation before going. They are open for reservations 1 mth in advance.Show less

Author: SamEng527
Title: Must eat!
Review: Thanks trip advisor!!! Thanks for the recommendation. We waited for about fifteen mins but worth waiting! I love the crab and meehoon here! Awesome! Will definitely come back again!

Author: MrGoh
Title: Good Food
Review: The food is fresh and delicious. Price is reasonable. Enjoyed the big prawn bee boon especially. Crab is so-so. But all other dishes are yummy!

Author: QuatoKuatoSingapore
Title: #1 restarant in Melaka, but.....
Review: Easily the best meal i had in Melaka! Pricing was affordable. Food was nice. Portion were really big! The only downside is that, we ordered their signature crab dish for just the 2 of us. They prepared 2 large crabs! It was totally unnecessary as they should know the 2 of us definitely wont be able to finish sure a large serving. The crabs are 2 times the price of all other dishes i ordered, combined.if there is only 2 diners, please just cook 1 crab.Show less

Author: FloAChewSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummilicious Fresh Milk Crab
Review: The milk crab was so delicious. It was spicy, tangy and sweet - well balanced flavours. I could not stop slurping up the gravy. Becareful of the green chillies though! I preferred it to their popular cheese beehoon which I found too rich & 'jelak'. The sweet vinegar gui ha fish is also very nice. Overall food is good at this place. Must make reservation or go before it opens to avoid the long queue and waiting time. Show less

Author: Pinkydevil
Title: Nice but slightly overrated
Review: Crab and cheese prawn bee hoon is nice but kind of overrated it's  not extremely great but worth a try if you have the time to Q.

Author: HappiMummiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Supper
Review: They did not take my reservation over the phone and asked me to walk in at around 5:30.I was there around 5:20pm - oh my goodness, nothing prepared me for the queue. There are at least 30 groups of potential diners ahead of my groups. Then came a coach to drop off tourists - they were given priority. Hence, we were left queuing outside while the tour group make their way in. We gave up as the wait is estimated to be 1 hour. We had dinner somewhere else and when we came back to check on the queue - the group that was behind me was still in the queue. So if you really wants to eat this, please be prepared to wait.Anyway, I went back to Tong Sheng at 10pm and ordered the Cheesy Prawn Bee Hoon to take away. The place is still pack and the wait for my order was 30mins. I can't recommend other food as I order are the cheesy prawn bee hoon- it was more like a broth with milky flavor. We enjoyed our supper and may consider going back there again if the queue is more manageable. Show less

Author: Thomas606Singapore, Singapore
Title: Cheese Prawn Mee Hoon
Review: We had our dinner at the restaurant. It will be good if you give them a call. 50% of the tables are reserved. If not, you may need to walk-in and try your luck. The cheese prawn mee hoon and fresh milk crab were good. You can also try their sweet vinegar fish. You can only order your food with the lady order. Be patient with your order. It is a tad expensive for the locals. You can only order smaller serving if you have fewer people. A good place to try some unique local delights! Show less

Author: yliktat
Title: 1 time is enough
Review: Queue at 6.15pm and got a table at 9.20pm then get to eat at 9.55pm. Food is warm only, if it is hot will taste nicer. Over priced for Malaysia market. Will not go back to that crazy queue again!

Author: KhooyeoSingapore
Title: Late dinner
Review: Joined the queue at 8.15pm, got our table at 9.45pm and ate our late dinner at 10pm. The cheese prawn beehoon is a must try if you come here. The milk crabs were very fresh and the sauce is very special, it tasted like lime and green chilies added to the milk. The tamarind pork and deep fried fish is also nice. Will come back again if the queue is not that long.Show less

Author: Geraldine S
Title: Yummy
Review: We arrived at 4.30 but didn't get a table till 6.30 and food arrived at 7pm. Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon - very tasty but the prawn doesn't have much meat considering we order the medium size portion for only 4 of us. Salted Egg Tofu - very fragrant, a must to orderFour King Veggie - good, the fried silver bait give an extra crunchDeep Fried Squid with Garlic - nice but not a must orderSalted Egg Crab - not to my expectation, didn't manage to finish it. Brought to back, tasted better when eaten cold the next day. I would recommend this place only if you have time to wait. Show less

Author: Jessietlh
Title: Unfriendly
Review: Expected long queue, but was disgusted by the unfriendliness. Not interested in good customer reviews obviously.

Author: momo231
Title: Great Cheese Mee Hoon
Review:
Visited Tong Sheng 3 times.

Never disappoint us.

Due to the good business, please reserve to avoid long queue. 

Must try cheese prawn mee hoon

Author: 225matthewnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great milk crab
Review: We ordered a variety and some hits and misses.The hokkien mee was well fried with pieces of lard. The cheese bee hoon which was a signature was a letdown for me as I was expecting more cheesy taste. Sliced pork and fried cuttlefish were excellent especially the latter. Otah in steamed egg neither complement each other was a puzzle. The highlight for milk crab which I believe it a base of condensed milk, chili, lime. A plethora of taste but very interesting. This is one dish that i will return for. Show less

Author: beauandmelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantabulous cheese prawn beehoon
Review: Not a lover of beehoon.. but the cheese prawn beehoon blew my mind. Its creamy, salty and prawny. The milk crab was very fresh, though i couldnt grasp the concept of a milky sourish spiced sauce. Even a simple plate of vegetables tasted great.Managed to reserve a table via phone 2 weeks in advance. Waited 30 mins to order. (Can only order via lady boss) Food came 15 mins after ordering. Will definately visit again.Show less

Author: Dolphinjc75
Title: GREAT and YUMMY!!
Review: Very Nice Zhi Char food, famous for their Cheese Prawn Beehoon and Milk Crabs. Most of their dishes are yummy! Though its not really cheap, but the food is really good! Worth the Q and wait!

Author: rachellin8Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wow, it was not 'jelak'!
Review: We were surprised that the restaurant does not have any queue when we arrived before 6pm on a Thursday evening. But the host took quite a while to take our order. We ordered the signature cheesy prawn bee hoon and wow, it was not 'jelak' as I imagined. We love it. Some other dishes we tried include the stir fry Xiao Bai cai and bitter gourd fried egg. Both were equally good. Show less

Author: Jiu Mu XSingapore, Singapore
Title: Interesting n tasty food
Review: 7 of us arrived at the restaurant about 6pm and there were already 6 families in the queue. We waited for about half an hour to be seated. It was a simple coffee shop restaurant. Staff were polite and efficient. Order was taken promptly and food arrived quite fast too.We ordered their signature cheesey prawn bee hoon, horlick prawns, rojak pork, mixed veg and fried french beans. At first, we were a bit worried that the bee hoon might have overpowering cheese smell. Fortunately, there wasnt. Food was well cooked and tasty.We paid about S$70 for the meal which i feel is reasonable.Show less

Author: copyrabbitSingapore, Singapore
Title: Long Queue!
Review: I have arrived at 5.50pm and there is a queue. Waited for about an hour for the table. It's quite a small restaurant with limited tables. The food is nice. Especially the recommended dish on the fried fish is superb! However the recommended dish on the fried prawns were quite disappointing. The price is slightly on the high side for a place like this.Show less

Author: FrancisphxSingapore
Title: Fantasic Cheesy Prawn Mee Hun
Review: Ordered the Cheesy Prawn Mee Hun (RM35) and Salted Egg Crabs which we have to order a minimum of 2 crabs (RM149.50). Fantastic place to have your dinner but do come early to avoid waiting for close to one hour plus.. Felt the crabs were way too expensive though.Show less

Author: kAkaLowSingapore, Singapore
Title: good food
Review: reached at about 5.30pm and the restaurant is already full with a bit of queue. well, it was worth queueing as the crabs were fresh and good.i personally liked the cheese prawn meehun the most, not really a fan of their fresh milk crabs though (personal feel), but it is one of the signature dish and is quite popular to people who visits this restaurant.Show less

Author: NeoETSingapore, Singapore
Title: Be early and worth trying
Review: Went to the restaurant before 5 to be the first batch of diners. The service is not something to look forward to but the cheese bee hoon and milk crab is excellent. Worth trying but slightly more expensive than other seafood restaurants. However, ordered 2 crabs but one of it was not very fresh.Show less

Author: SWShanC
Title: Worth queueing
Review: Like many review said, it's worth the queue. The cheese prawn meehun is delicious. Many other dishes are great too. We tried the fried French bean, claypot tofu and butter oat prawn. Delicious!

Author: 1mightymouseFootscray, Australia
Title: OMG
Review: we arrived at 930pm on the last day of chinese new year to find a queue. although we were all starving, we decided to wait. i am so glad we did as we have the most unbelievable meal!we had crispy deep fried butter oat prawns with garam masala and curry leaves; succulent and meaty fresh gigantic milk crabs; pungent dried prawns with very slender pea shoots; garlic steamed red snapper although slightly overcooked was very tasty; stired fried glass lettuce and soupy claypot bean curd with tofu, carrot, brocolli, mushroom. once we started eating we all swooned in delight.Show less

Author: UnderBigHillGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Worth the Queue!
Review: I noticed that this restaurant get mixed review in Tripadvisor. I think whoever wish to come to this restaurant must set the expectation right: everyday, there's a long queue in front of this restaurant. Don't come here with an empty stomach. 1 to 2 hours wait is normal here. We arrived in Restoran Tong Sheng around 6:20pm during weekday. We were very lucky to take the last table. After that, we start to see the long queue forming outside. We ordered five dishes and everything they served is wonderful. We love their signature dishes: creamy fresh milk crab, and the cheese shrimp beehon. The Garlic baked squid is very popular among us too. Even as simple as the fried "Sabah vege" is delicious. Their Otak-otak steamed egg is unique but relatively not as impressive as the other 4 dishes that we ordered. Still good though.Show less

Author: Bernycec
Title: rude service and exp !
Review: Their service was very rude. We been waited for 2.5 hrs and the owner told us that their restaurant is not fast food. customer should expect to wait without getting know the timing. Their crab is 1kg = rm128. according to the boss, 1 crab is 1kg and cost rm128. I doubt the crab is weight 1kg as the size is small.my singaporean friends has encountered rm 1k ++ for 7 ppl dining in that restaurant. Show less

Author: DonJYLoveToTravelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place for local delicacies - seafood and chinese cuisine
Review: One of the must try local food for seafood and Chinese cuisine.Recommended dishes - cheese prawn meehoon, cuttle fish with garlic and minced pork beancurd. See our posted photos.Must go during non-peak hrs e.g opens at 5.30pm, reach there by 5.20pm to avoid dinner crowd during weekdays. We went during weekday Wedneday and crowd comes at around 5.45pm.Not hard to find. The restaurant is non-aircon and faces the main road. If you are staying in Hatten Hotel, its just 10 mins walk away.Show less

Author: colink987Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice seafood but long wait
Review: Be prepared to queue for your table. This is my only advice to all who intend to try this seafood restaurant. Forget about service when they can't even cope with the orders. The food is nice, fortunately. This will probably be my one-time-is-enough restaurant. There are simply too many food choices in Maleka to pick and the long queue just doesn't seems worth it.Show less

Author: WilsonWSAngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent meal but nightmare waiting time.
Review: The restaurant opens at 5.30pm and we were there on a Sunday evening at 5.15am. The queue was long and we decided to be patient and wait for the food as it was recommended by some friends and locals.We got seated at about 8pm and the food start coming out real quick as we pre ordered while queuing.Totally worth the wait, food was excellent but a bit on the sweeter size with special mention to the signature milky crab dish, signature rice noodle with prawn and the semi retired master chef's signature hokkien mee. We didn't want to waste the effort of our queue and decided to splurge on the food and order most of the dishes we fancy.One thing to note is the crab must order minimum 2 so it came up to be around 150RM for 2 crab of about 1.4-1.5kg total. Including beer the bill came out to be around 353RM for the 2 of us. Totally worth it!Show less

Author: BorneoJessieKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Reasonably price, good food.
Review: It was midweek and early - around 6 pm when we turned up at this place. There was no queues and we were shown a table for two straight away.We didn't ordered their signature dishes which surprised the lady who took our order. Instead we ordered the Cod, Shrimps in Salted egg, Rojak Pork and Asparagus with scallops. The service was quick and the food was tasty and well cooked. I could see why they are pulling in the crowds.Show less

Author: LifeTraveler02Melbourne, Australia
Title: Poor behavior & inflexible. Bad attitude
Review: I don't care if the food is any good. Much before that comes basic humility and behavior which will make people feel good about spending money to visit your restaurant. These guys don't have it & couldn't care less. After standing in queue for more than 45 minutes, when we placed the order, we were told most of the dishes we wanted are not available. We then asked if a few other dishes were available & the answer was very indifferent. We asked if a simple thing like fried rice could be made(which was also on the menu). They flatly refused saying that they had only plain rice & could not prepare any fried rice. It was like take it or leave it. We left !Your business is good now, people queue to eat. Show some respect, because if you don't, you will start losing more & more customers like me & face more of such reviews. Develop a better attitude !Show less

Author: EatLoveFamily
Title: Great seafood place !
Review: Visited for dinner and was amaze with quality of crab they've served . Had they're famous Cheesy Prawn Meehun as starters and taste really good ! A must try seafood place !

Author: RetiredTraveller
Title: Popular Seafood Restaurant
Review: The seafood served in this popilar Maacca seafood restaurant is very good (eg lobster fried white beehoon, black pepper crabs, seafood fried rice). The prices are moderate. However the place is extremely crowded during Malaysian public holidays & pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid more than 1 hour queue for drop-in diners.Show less

Author: AnnChen1202Singapore, Singapore
Title: Try their signature dishes - Cheese Prawns Bee Hoon and Milk Crabs
Review: Do make a reservation instead of walk in unless you are prepared to Queue for more than an hour. Only one person is taking the orders, but she does do it fast. But dont expect service from this restaurant as they are too busy to provide one. Food are not bad and consider decent for the food they serve. Worth visiting it if you are visiting Malacca for the first time.Show less

Author: grumpychow2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy yummy but long wait
Review: Cheesy prawn noodles n Thai style milk crab... Deadly combination but the 2 must eat at tong Sheng. Cheesy prawn noodle has beehoon cooked al dente and flavourful as it soaks up the freshness of the succulent crayfish. Slurp up every last drop of the gravy. Milk crab is a must for crab lovers n something not found in Singapore. Mop up the sweet n spicy gravy with little bits of toast crotons tong Sheng is famous n so the queue is long long...their website says that they are closed one day in the week but it may vary. To avoid disappointment, call to check. Queues start at about 4.30pm so do get there early. Otherwise be patient. Show less

Author: BimmerboxerSingapore
Title: Why one must read reviews!!
Review: I am submitting a review on the famed Tong Sheng Seafood Restaurant in Melaka though I did not dine there.Past reviews showed this to be one of the culinary favs and advised early booking.With a group of 5, off peak and on a weekday night, taking a short stroll from our hotel, we aimed to try out Tong Sheng.We did not get a table, there was a queue, and whilst we waited, we glimpsed at the mouth watering dishes being served to the diners. The tables that were empty had a 'reserved' sign on them. We finally succumbed to our hunger pangs and found another place to dine, most unsatisfactorily as we were missing out on Tong Sheng.Looks like I have to make another trip soon.....Show less

Author: VeldsparSingapore, Singapore
Title: Long Wait, but worth it.
Review: The locals queue very determinedly for this restaurant, a couple of streets down from the pair of megamalls here.It takes reservations, but the place takes calls only from 2-5pm, or after 11pm, and we sadly couldn't get through on the phone when we tried.We joined the queue and waited two hours. The food also takes maybe another 30-40 minutes to prepare after your orders are submitted (they thankfully take your orders when you hit the head of the queue).The food was worth the wait.We tried the cheesy prawn bee hoon, fresh milk crabs, Horlick prawn balls, and salted egg tofu beancurd, ginger chicken, together with cod, which was in season.The food was fresh, and the cooks really know their stuff. Everything came out fragrant, tasty and amazingly well done.If you're into trying local food and seafood, and you don't mind a wait, join the locals. This restaurant is well worth the wait.Show less

Author: cblow86549
Title: hell of a wait
Review: food is reasonably good but be prepared to wait.there's a perpetual queue all the time esp.on a weekend & public holidays.their signature dish seems to be the cheese beehoon(rice vermicelli)

Author: XavierTan
Title: Go For The Crabs And Prawns
Review:
The signature dishes are their cheese prawn beehoon and butter crab. These are the must order dishes. 

Other dishes are decent, but don't waste your tummy space on those! 

Reservations are strongly recommended

Author: Maggie T
Title: Great dinner with friends
Review: We reserved a table at 730pm and food was served quite fast. Portion was great and delicious. We couldn't stop for taking photo after starting .

Author: D19650311Bangkok, Krung Thep, Thailand
Title: Good food but waited over 1 hour for first course
Review: Went there without reservation. Got. Table after 5 min. but waited 1 hour for first 2 courses and another 10 minutes for 3+4. With 2 people we could not order crab as its min. 2 crabs per order. Food was done nice . Taste was good and unique. Chef definitely prepared the meal diligently. Would I go back ? Yes with friends and larger group. Just annoying to wait too long so bring time. Seating and rest of place just standard as with all places in this category.Show less

Author: medsp3cSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good dinner
Review: Tong Sheng serves good food and at pretty decent quantity too! All of the dishes are good and there is nothing to complain about. The only downside is that there is a minimum order of 2 crabs, which is a lot for 1 or 2 persons.Tong Sheng is a rather popular spot for dinner, so make a reservation in advance!Show less

Author: elynntriJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice delicious meal
Review: There is a long queue when we arrive at the restaurant. However, it was worth waiting as the food is delicious. The fried cheese bee hoon is nice and the crab is also nice. Overall, most of the food is nice. Probably, it is better to make a reservation before going to the restaurant.Show less

Author: Lina_TanSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Seafood !!!
Review: Luckily we made reservations as there was already a queue at 6pm. The restaurant was packed and we had to wait for our food.We had the Cheese Prawn Beehoon, Fresh Milk Crab, Fried Garlic with Scallops, Fried Sabah vegetables and the Fried Sea Cucumber with Onions.The Cheese Prawn Beehoon was a winner - everyone love the richness of the sauce. The Fresh Milk crabs had some Thai sweet and sour flavouring which is really nice with the bread. The Sabah vegetable was crunchy and really nice.Highly recommended if you love seafood ! Don't forget to make reservation first.Show less

Author: Edith CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unique signature dish
Review: We found the cheesy crab bee hoon unique in taste. However the serving is very small for 2. There is only 1 big prawns. So we are not sure there their small is only meant for one pax. Another signature dish was the steam tofu with salted egg. Hardly detect any salted egg, beside the tofu was nice and smooth, this dish was quite bland. The Vietnamese pork belly was a disappointment, it was salty and sweet and the meat was hard. The asparagus was old and the scallop that came with it was chewy. The fresh milk crab has a sourish and spicy taste to it. Min order must be two crabs. Though we did not like the sauce but the crabs were really good. Fresh and firm meat texture. Go early to avoid crowd.Show less

Author: poppymartini
Title: Cheesy Bee Hoon is YUM
Review: love the zi char spread. but its a long wait. have to be patient. pricing is reasonable. The deep-steam fish is very good.

Author: onenah
Title: Crabilicious
Review:
Crab was delicious and fresh. River prawn dish had special flavor but the prawn itself was a bit soggy. If you like seafood you surely will like this. Service was curt but efficient. 
Be prepared to queue for a table.

Author: krazeecFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Good food and service
Review: The restaurant is noisy, crowded and hot. But the food makes up for all of that. The signature cheesy prawn with rice vermicelli dish was a bit disappointing, but the vegetables were well cooked and the tofu with salted egg was superb. The crabs we ordered were very fresh. Service was quick and attentive. All in all a very satisfying dinner. Show less

Author: Caren L
Title: Cheesy Prawn meehoon
Review: Our first try on their signature cheesy prawn meehoon. Something special to me, taste is not bad. There are 5 of us and we order 5 dishes. If you like garlic, then you will like their food cause almost all dishes cooked with lots of garlic.The restaurant open at 5.30pm but people already start queuing before it open. We arrived there around 5.20pm and we are so lucky to get the last table without reservation. All table inside are reserved, only 4 tables out side the corridor is for the people without reservation only.So REMEBER, make reservation before you go. If not you will have to queued for at least 45 minutes for a table. This the time we observed from the queue will waiting for our food to serve.Show less

Author: 802darrenl
Title: Superb seafood
Review: Super super long queue. Waited around one hour. The seafoods were so fresh. Cheesy prawn meehoon so yummy. Crab so big. A bit pricey. No choice tourist spot.

Author: Weeling CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fresh seafood at reasonable price
Review: Saw a post on Facebook about Tong Seng and since it is near the city centre, we decided to take a walk and try it out. When we were near the restaurant, we were surprised by the queue! There were about 10 people in the line already and the wait will be about at least 30 minutes. Then we found out that a reservation is a norm for this restaurant, a couple of days in advance preferably. Attached the name card for anyone who is interested. Go on an empty stomach! The crab, prawn and scallops are fresh and nicely cooked! Show less

Author: rhclimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food BUT be prepared to wait
Review: It was my first time to eat at this restaurant and I was not disappointed. The only trouble was the VERY long wait. We queued for more than an hour to get a table and then waited another three quarters of an hour for the food. The cheese beehoon with lobster was excellent. The gravy NUST be slurped to the end. The crabs were great also. The flesh was firm and the taste was good. The string beans dish was good as well. The other dishes tasted alright but that was because we were too full already. If you are prepared to queue for an hour or more, then go for it.Show less

Author: JamesKwok
Title: Yummy Food
Review: Great food. Must try the milk crab and cheese noodle. Be prepared to queue though. I waited 1.5hrs. But overall, it is worth it.

Author: Chin-PinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Definitely not worth the 2-hour wait
Review: Was on holiday with husband and two children aged 11&14. Read all the great reviews on tripadvisor and decided to check it out.We reached the restaurant on time for our reservation and were seated. The time was 6.40.The food came at 8.30! My children were starving and my husband and I were also very hungry. However, we decided that the long wait would be worth it if the food was good. There were other families that came after us. They were so desperate because of the wait that when a lady came into the restaurant with packets of guava, everyone jumped to buy it just to fill their stomachs.Unfortunately, the food was average. We ordered the cheesy beehoon, ginger chicken cubes, deep fried sweet and sour fish,fried garlic squid and braised tofu with minced pork. The food was not up to the expectations we had of the restaurant that had so many good reviews. The tofu was basically swimming in watery gravy and the presentation was awful. The ginger chicken was too hard and overcooked. The cheesy beehoon was good but nothing special. The fish was only ok. The only good dish was the garlic squid which took 2-hours and 20mins to come.Overall, at the end of the dinner, we all agreed that the food was only average and DEFINITELY not worth the 2-hour wait.Show less

Author: lydiaSingaporesingapore
Title: Nice food
Review: We went on Sunday late afternoon. Lucky we had a reservation as we see a snake quene outside the restaurant. Ordered the signature cheese prawn bee hoon. Very unique and gosh, it came Ina very big plate which can be shared with 5 -6 people. Ordered ceral prawns and 2 type of crabs (chilli and their signature milk) but I find it so so. We had also veg dish and few others. Total bill which I found expensive as the crab price was about same as my country. Very near to Novotel hotel where I stayed, be sure to make reservation. Enjoy the bee hoon dish. Show less

Author: Rororo97
Title: Cheese prawn bee hoon
Review: wanted to have dinner there but the q was too long hence we ate at another place for dinner . at 1045 pm went to take away cheese prawn bee  hoon for supper RM70 for medium size plus gst 6% about RM 74

Author: 493Lynette
Title: make reservations before you go!
Review: my must order is the cheese prawn bee hoon, fried gui hua fish, fried sotong. you just can't find food fresh and well cooked like this in Singapore. the cheese prawn bee hoon does not make you feel overwhelmed or "jek lat".

Author: Irene H
Title: Not worth waiting for 2.5 hours!
Review: Nothing to shout about. Food is just ordinary except the cheese prawn beehoon is something special but wouldn't go back again just for it. It's better to pre-book before going. Many tried their crabs but with kids we didn't order it.

Author: Janicelouis
Title: the cheezy prawn bihun was awesome
Review:
weekend and ph full as usual.  the food was delicious and the price was okay.  
ordered 2 crabs, cheezy prawn bihun, rojak chicken chop, gui hua fish and 1 vege priced RM 270 plus. strongly recommended.

Author: FengliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food but long wait
Review: Recommended by a friend. So went to try it out. Shop open at 5.30pm but 5pm the queue already start coming in. Though we are in the first 10, but still have to wait for the second round table. After you got your seat, another wait of 30 mins for your food to be served. Order the popular cheese prawn mee, guihua fish, fresh milk crab and garlic sotong. Food is fresh and tasty. Cost about ringgit 300. But the wait is too long. Will only consider if I m in the first 5 queue. Total spent about 4 hours to take 1 meal. Show less

Author: jyowppKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food - not worth the long wait
Review: Waited close to two hours to get a seat. Unfortunately, the food did not really meet my expectations. Could easily get much better food in a number of restaurants in Kuala Lumpur. Only the cheesy Meehoon is a little special. The rest are merely very mediocre food. The restaurants is extremely hot and uncomfortable and had to wait very long for a seat and for my food. This will be the last time for me at this restaurant.Show less

Author: singler4
Title: extremely rude,zero hospitality, very arrogant staffs and owners daughter very stuckup but food is good
Review: - took 3 waiters to bring a drink- local staff's doesn't even bother to stop and respond even if they walked pass by beside u and heard u calling.. only the foreign staffs are humble and friendly enough to attend u.some local staffs did stop and attend, but he just hear your order and forget about it..waited 20 minutes for my drink..at last,had to call the foreign staff..- owners daughter at the cashier counter extremely rude, u ask her anything , she replies u in very stuck up manner...- food is good.. taste really good..Show less

Author: 1john316Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Restaurant to go for Seafood
Review: A good restaurant always attracts crowds. This restaurant is one of them. It is very popular because the food is excellent. Be prepared to wait for 30-45 minutes. This restaurant has many signature dishes. The cheezy prawn mee hoon is one of them which we ordered for dinner and it was delicious. No wonder that it was on almost every table. The garlic sotong (cuttlefish) was also delicious. Other signature dishes include crabs done in various options - pepper, milk, chilli, etc. My advice is to make reservations and go early.Show less

Author: EveT205
Title: The fresh milk crab is really good, the rest are very average
Review: We ordered crabs, fried me Sua, fried eggs and veggie. Only the crabs are good, very meaty and fresh. We areinterested to try their cheesy prawns bee Hoon in our next trip

Author: Marcus NKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Watch your staff
Review: Hi peeps, this is one of the restaurant that can found around Straits Hotel, I have totally no complaints on their food quality and taste, two thumbs up for the chef while it was a terrible experience with the front line staff no body come and serve for the first 15mins making me and my friends look like dumbtards. The funniest part we had to call for them to notice our existences, Bad explanation and impatience with our ordering session and again we need to call numerous of times for their waiter "foreign worker" to help us with refill of hot water and ice thus showing us their black faces. Ughhh.Show less

Author: SnoopyJasSingapore
Title: Yummy Local ZiChar and seafood ...
Review: Must make reservation otherwise be prepared to queue for hous. Made reservation and upon ordering food still have to wait for almost 45 mins before food arrives. Love the gui hua fish - deep fried crispy outside, tender inside and so fresh. had also order the milk crab, which is unique but acquire taste, crab was fresh. veg has the wok aroma. Must order the cheese prawn bee hoon, that was one of our favorite, the cheese wasnt overpowering and goes well with the big prawn and bee hoon. the steam toufu/egg nothing fancy thou. the list goes on.. service erm dont expect too much cos they are so crowded but food is worth all that is not so good...hope you will enjoy it as much as we do :)Show less

Author: Fonglin
Title: Excellent food
Review: Had dinner several times here and never fails to please.  Love their signature cheese bee hoon with crabs and garlic scallops

Author: propertyw201
Title: Cheese Prawn Noodle are great taste. All others so - so
Review: Cheese Prawn Noodle are great taste. All others so - so. It is walking distance from Novotel Melaka or Strait Hotel.

Author: 652RobertSSurabaya, Indonesia
Title: Unique Cuisine
Review: I was informed by the taxi driver that this restaurant is a must visit restaurant in Melaka. I just ordered the cheesy prawn meehun ad i came alone. The chesse makes it somehow unique but the taste is just average.There are many delicious looking dishes but i have no space to put in, maybe next time.The waiting time in this place is rather heavy, so dont come here if you are in a hurryShow less

Author: CChanHKHong Kong
Title: Not good at all!
Review: This restaurant seems to be a famous one for eating seafood. I'd tried their most famous Prawn Mee Hoon, it's really a great disappointment. Please refer to the attached photo, not only one 'prawn' is there. It's cut into 2 half, but those 2 half aren't belonged to the same 'prawn'. You can see one half head is bigger than the other half. No cheese taste at all.We want to order crab, but the waiter said we needed to order at least 2. So, forget about it. The food quality, service and the dining environment do not justify for the price. Don't recommend.Show less

Author: Shaun KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Delicious :)
Review: It's best to arrive about 5pm and start queueing. By 515, the queue gets longer and longer. One of the places where I will bring my friend for food even the queue is long. We had special friend prawns, Cheesy Prawn Mee Hoon (Unique taste), Crabs, Scallops, bean curd. The meal is good and excellent. Unfortunately that day, they don't sell cheese steamboat.Show less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Crowded with LONNNNNGGGG Queue
Review: Better come here before 5.30pm to avoid long queue and long wait for your dishes to arrive. Must order cheese noodle prawn / crab. Remember come early. Very CROWDED.

Author: tingx2
Title: Super gd find!!:)
Review: Everything we ordered was nice! Highly satisfying meal. Must try their specialty dish, cheese bee Hoon crayfish!!! I will give it many likes! Very crowded.

Author: JoeyJoe91
Title: A must visit for dinner
Review: Busy restaurant, reserve advance to avoid the long queue.. went for dinner with family.. the cheese noodle prawn is delicious with a few other side dishes.. recommended to visit

Author: Chris QSingapore, Singapore
Title: Go early
Review: If you are thinking of visiting this place, do two things. 1. Make a reservation 2. Reach before 530pm. It is hard to imagine how long one will need to wait to get a table and for food to arrive if he didn't do that two things. Ordering is done by a lady. So wave frantically to get her attention too. Anyway, I went for the cheese beehoon. So here are the reviews. 1. Cheese beehoon. It is not bad. But I couldn't taste much cheese in there. The only hint of cheese was the colour. There was too much fried onions and it overpowered everything. 2. Salted egg tofu. Mediocre. Not much taste of salted egg too.3. Garlic squid. Quite difficult to go wrong with a squid and lots of garlic eh? 4. Vietnamese pork. Kinda salty but it is still considered tasty. 5. Vinegar fish. I think this will be my favourite. The fish was fried nicely and it is easy to eat with no bones. Paid 200rm for four pax. We Left pretty satisfied. Show less

Author: 383sharonlSingapore
Title: Unhygienic restaurant, not worth waiting
Review: We queued for almost an hour and waited for 30 mins for the food to be served. We ordered the prawn mee hoon which was nice but nothing unique. We also ordered pork rib, ginger cube chicken, egg omelette, French bean. While biting my chicken, I found crab shell in my chicken. We did not order crab but I have crab shell on my chicken so I feed back to the lady boss. Instead of apologizing, she questioned me to show proof. So I showed her the crab shell on my plate. She took the evidence and went to the kitchen. Came back to cashier didn't even apologize but tell me the shell looks cooked. So maybe after the food was served on the table the crab shell accidentally drop inside. That's her explanation. No sorry. Still very proud of her poor hygiene restaurant. By the way, she is too snobbish pissing off one customer after another as I sit near the counter. I will not go back for sure.Show less

Author: jia hui kSingapore, Singapore
Title: Expect to Q for good food
Review: This place opens at 5.30 but the queue starts at 5. We were there at 5.15 and had to be on 2nd seating and were still 6th in line. Did get to sit til almost 6.30pm. However , it was really worth the wait. The cheese beehoon, butter crab, garlic squid and horlicks prawn are DA BOMBS. The seafood are amazingly fresh! Everything was finger licking good. So do come early and get your seats cos the queue is never ending.Show less

Author: Bk CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overprized milky crab n overprized prawn bee hoon prawn
Review: Disappointed with their two signiture dishes (milk crabs n cheese prawn noodle) that we ordered.Overcharged two medium size crabs.Which we can get lower prize in Singapore.Ordered medium size cheese bee hoon. Only two fresh big head fresh water prawn In the bee hoonWas charges total RM$280 for these two pathetic dishes.It would be my first n last visit......Wonder why the long queue?????Show less

Author: alexo273
Title: Very unique!
Review:
The food is indeed very unique and different! 
Be prepare to line in queue for at least half and hour if you are lucky.
The food is good and nice, recommended and go for it.
Price is reasonable with 5 pax. Below 500 RM.

Author: ChanKWSingapore, Singapore
Title: Be ready to Queue for your food
Review: I did not know of this Restaurant until my friend who happened to be holidaying Malacca strongly recommended me to their famous Butter Prawn Bee Hoon and crab. But be prepared to wait for at least an hour for your food to serve. As the restoran only open at 5 pm, we were there 4.45pm expecting to be the first few to reach there. But it was not to be. Already a long queue was already formed. Come 5pm, when they welcome customer into their restoran, my family of 4 could not find a place in the restoran. But instead was ushered to sit at a table along the corridor outside the restoran. The heat from the sunset could be felt till almost 6pm when our first dish, the famous Butter prawn fried Bee Hoon was served. The dish was unique and savory. We simply loved it. We also ordered a few other dishes to go along with it. The Kwee Hwa Fish (fried fish) was nice. However, we were disappointed that the live crabs did not arrived at the restoran in time that day and we missed laying our hands on the crabs. One caution is not to order the fried slice pork with dried chilli. Its seemed to be fried pig skin rather than pork (lots of fats).Staffs are friendly.Show less

Author: menglee
