Title: CROWDED, Long Queue but BURP.
Review: Will recommend the Butter Prawn Bee Hoon and Crabs. Staying in any of the nearby hotels depending on you budget. There's take out. Staying and Straits Hotel and Suites is recommended because it has a kitchen space if you book the premier suites.

Author: JoyceAw40Singapore, Singapore
Title: Indeed something different
Review: We went there specially for their cheese prawn bee hoon and their milky crab. After knowing such good reviews and my friends said is a must try place in Melaka.Indeed this place the queue started to form around 6pm. They allow making reservation so if you have a big group good to call them in advance to make reservation. That is what we did but make sure you reach there early not later than your reservation time because they will cancel your reservation. The timing that we wanted were fully booked so no choice we have to make it early at 530pm.It also take awhile for the lady boss to come to you to take your order. By the time the food served was almost 630pm.For the price it was a bit costly but when you converted into SGD, I don't think you can get such nice and fresh food in Singapore. The cheese prawn bee hoon was very nice. The cheese taste was not that strong so for those who don't like cheese don't worry. Same as the milky crab, at first we thought we will taste of milk and have no intend to order. But the boss told us no and is their best dishes. It turn out to be so nice and tasty. It taste different from our crab noodle. The taste of the food it all depend of individual. We have to base on our likeness. Sometime after a long wait you might have no mood to eat or really taste it food. For us, if anything long queue we will ask do we really want to try. We must have a positive think then you will be able taste it out with positive thinking. Overall we enjoyed the food, just that during sunset you will need to enjoy the sun at the same time enjoy your food.Remember to avoid the queue, make reservation. Good thing they allow reservation.Show less

Author: PatL900
Title: Great seafood
Review: We went there to try their cheese prawn mihun and also tried other seafood. So good!!  Very crowded. And didn't know there would be a line up on a week night.

Author: Ideas_6622Singapore, Singapore
Title: Some Can, Some Cannot
Review: We make a mistake when we reached there on a Friday evening at 5.20pm. There was about 15 families queuing ahead of me and all the tables in it, are fully occupied. At 5.50pm, nothing was served to the customers except drinks. Since we travelled a 210km distance to try this place, we won't mind the queue versus the good food which is lying ahead of us.6.20pm, 7.20pm, 8.20pm and finally it was my turn to be the next one to get into the Restaurant. We placed our order at 8.45pm and finally when dinner is serve, it was 9.15pm. So if you can't wait, don't waste your time there.We have the traditional bee hoon and other dishes and also the famous crabs there. Trust me, the bee hoon is tasty and worth the price of RM$33 (small), RM$66 (medium) or RM$99 (large) BUT not the crabs. You can get it at the same price back home.This is my first time that I gave a negative remark about a place and if you really want to save the time on queueing, make sure you start waiting and be there from 4.30pm onwardsShow less

Author: jessiehenglimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crab Bee Hoon FTW
Review: This is the 3rd or 4th time going there as we love the seafood! However, due to its popularity, we didn't expect that the queue was so long to wait even at 6pm! We arrived at 6pm, waited for almost 1.5hr before being served our food. They serve the food by table, so make sure you order all your dishes beforehand. If you forgot to order something, you got to wait very long for it. The Crab Bee Hoon is really the best! Show less

Author: nic070770Singapore, Singapore
Title: Expensive but fresh and big
Review: We ordered their famous cheesy prawn noodles (tasted really great, I can finish all the gravy!) and their milk crab (unique but greasy after eaten a period of time), but the waiter said we need to order at least 1kg which is two crabs to be cooked so it's quite big portion for two of us and it cost RM154 for two crabs but it's fresh and big. I will come back again next time and will bring more people to eat their chessy prawn noodles and try other flavours of crabs such as salted egg and curry, and also their seafood fried rice and other dishes.(P.S. the restaurant's name is exactly the same as my Chinese name)Show less

Author: canberra421Singapore, Singapore
Title: Really nice signature dishes! But Qs are pretty long...
Review: its 2 streets away from Novotel Melaka, but we still drove there. Lucky to find space to park but the Q was there. as we were prepared to wait, we join the Q and it took us 45mins to get a table, and another 15mins wait for the food. There were 6 signature dishes and we took 3 of them. They are really nice. Must eat for the Cheesy Prawn Bee hoon.Show less

Author: soapwater16
Title: Worth a visit..
Review: First time. Cheese beehoon and marmite ribs are yummy. Hubby said 八宝凉茶 tasted weird. Haha. Didn't need to wait too long as we came rather late, almost 0930pm. Will come again next time we visit malacca.

Author: XtineeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not much service
Review: The creamy butter crabs are nice but not cheap. 3 crabs costs RM200 and they are nor big ones. Queue is very long need to reserve even on a weekday Ordering is a chore, which includes much waiting.Slice fish mee hoon is nice and portion is big, seeing some other tables ordering their fried noodle dishes which looks good Show less

Author: XuJR88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Long waiting. Slow in serving. Medicore food
Review: Waited 1 hour STANDING in line. When finally seated waited another hour for the food to be serve, really a test of patience. After 2 hour waiting the crab finally arrive. Instead of serving man tou, they serve toasted bread to dip into the sauce. And if you order crab. A minimum of 2 crabs must be ordered. Was too pissed on the waiting to enjoy the food. Just want to get out there ASAP! Be warn! There's of mosquito too!Show less

Author: Anon YKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Horrible food
Review: We waited in line for an hour with a promise of amazing noodles and crabs.After an hour and a half our food finally arrives. And to our dismay, the prawns in our so called "must have" cheesy prawn noodle was not fresh and then sauce was diluted to the point that we could barely taste a thing.Then once we almost finish our meal, the piece de resistance arrive, our fresh milk crabs. The taste itself was neither here nor there and they couldnt even give us proper Man Tau. They freaking served us toast bread to dip into the sauce. You would expect in an establishment such as this that it would have properly cooked food along with its respective condements but Nooooo!!!Lastly, the price of the food. For 3 mud crabs we payed a total of rm190++ for 3 crabs... that is price we would pay back in kl...but atleast in kl it would have been tasty and we would have been served Man Tau. All in all a meal for the 3 of us cost us a total of RM450++ which by the cost more that my suite room for the night. Show less

Author: Traveller31177
Title: Delicious food with affordable price
Review: This restaurant starts open from 6pm. It is highly recommended to come to this place 15 minutes before opening hence you will be in queue about 5-10 people.This restaurant serves good quality of food and affordable price .

Author: suchadav2015Bangkok, Thailand
Title: Good food, clean and clean restaurants, friendly staff
Review: My company went there for our dinner and I asked the restaurant to arrange the food as in a set per 10 people. The dining is clean and the food is good. The staff nicely serve us. The location is at the centre as well. All of us had a wonderful time there. Thanks to you!Show less

Author: Shanying WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Famous seafood stall in Melaka
Review: This stall is famous for their cheese prawn mee hoon and cheese steamboat. Expect long queues during dinner time. They're not opened for lunch though. Food is alright but considered pricey.Tried their signature stir fried cheese crab and the cheese prawn mee hoon. It's something that you won't see commonly.It's between walking distance from Hatten Hotel and a few other hotels nearby.Show less

Author: blueneutronSingapore, Singapore
Title: Love live till we ate 2 nights in a row
Review: We always eat here whenever we come Malacca. This trip, i brought my parents to Tong Sheng & ordered the signature dishes - cheese prawn bee hoon and milky crab! Fragrant and finger licking good!My parents asked us to return for round 2 next day. This time we tried Gui Hua Vinegar Fish, Horlicks Prawns, Golden Dust Beancurd, Honey Pork and of course cheese prawn bee hoon again! Cheese taste is not strong; hence suitable for people who dont like cheese tooShow less

Author: Alison L
Title: Bad
Review: Rude staff, cannot organize the queue, annoying customer that cannot get themselves in the queue and standing around my table, staring at me, knocking on my table, the staff cannot be bother when i voice up my unhappiness. When my food is ready, and ate it in a very uncomfortable space, those uncle sit on my table telling their own group of friends that he is sitting there because I don't mind, which I mind alot! The staff there cannot even get them to wait for another table and allow him to sit and disturb me eating. Didn't even finish my food, out of the gross, paid and leave immediately. The food was normal, overrated. The serving spoon is totally dirty which have dry vegetables on it. Can't be bother to ask to change a new one, just wish to leave as soon as possible. I won't visit here again. Show less

Author: alanyewwai33Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Restaurant must visit in Melaka
Review: I went there on 24/09/15 after I search the review in TripAdvisor, the restaurant famous one is Crab and Cheese Prawn mihun I like the most, the price is average not too expensive, We ordered 4 dishes overall the food is delicious worth of money. one of the restaurant must try in Melaka. Yummy...Show less

Author: JoanneLeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Crabs were great, other dishes were average
Review: Like mentioned in most reviews, be prepared to queue as this place is always crowded and super difficult to make reservation. Beware if you have toddles/ elderly as this place is always packed and very stuffy.The buttermilk crabs were yummy (minimum 2 crabs per order). Other dishes were okay, portion were slightly small. Do order the rojak chicken. You have the option of either pork or chicken but do go for the chicken. Chicken is way yummier.Show less

Author: NDCYC
Title: Yummy Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon
Review:
Make a booking or go early
Their cheese prawn bee hoon is to die for
If you have only 2 person, order cheese crab and the cheese prawn bee hoon, pair with some yummy mango juice. 
Happy tummy for the evening

Author: RT2014KLKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty and special food at reasonable price
Review: We as a group of 6 adults and 3 children had ordered 6 kinds of yummy food with mango juice and Chrysanthemum herb tea at about RM150 (USD36). The food which we ordered were 1) Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon (rice noodle): The soup is creamy and is rich with prawn flavor. Unlike Carbonara spaghetti, the soup is thinner and it won't make you feel greasy. 2) Meat Floss Bean-curds: Fried bean-curds dressing with mayonnaise and meat floss. The combination of the taste from meat floss and fried bean-curds is wonderful. 3) Rojak (Malaysian style of veggies+fruit salad with local dressing) Chicken Chop: You may feel greasy if you are having only chicken chop. However, this dish serve you the chicken chop with veggies and fruit which will cheer your taste buds up. 4) Rojak Pork Chop: It is similar with Rojak Chicken Chop. Thus, you are advised to order either one to reserve your stomach for other dishes. 5) Otak-otak (grilled fish cake made of fish meat mixed with spices) Fried Egg 6) Sweet Vinegar Gui Hua Fish: The fish is crisply fried dressing with sweet vinegar sauce. We arrived at the restaurant around 7 pm without any reservation; thus, we had to queue for about 30 minutes. In order to avoid long queue, kindly make your reservation before you go especially during weekends. Also, it will be more worthy to go in a group of 8-12 people so that you are able to order more food to try and to pay lesser by dividing the bill later!!Show less

Author: FromKluangMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: One of the best foods in Melaka
Review: This restaurant very good business on Friday, Sat and Sunday.Normally we will make booking for weekend. If no booking you have to queue very long.They only serve dinner starting from 5.30pm.Recommend disk;1. Cheesy prawn mee hon.2. Slide pork - Vietnamese3. Milk crab4. BBQ squid 5. Sweet vinegar fish6. Hokkien noodle.Show less

Author: FriendsOfPeasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty food but not worth the queue
Review: We heard how bad the queue could get so we decided to be there 10mins before opening time (1730hr). We managed to get a small table for 2. 10mins later, there were at least 15 people queueing outside. We had the fresh milk crab and the cheesy prawn bee hoon. Tasty but I wouldn't queue more than 15mins just to eat here. There are many other good food places around.Show less

Author: SantawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Crowded, Long Wait
Review: Located in Taman Melaka Raya at 377 Taman Melaka Raya 6, 06-2867811 or 017 6317811As u can see the wait here is long. I thought that by coming at 5.30 pm, it would be empty and business would have just started. Boy was I wrong. This place is crowded.I had to call to order or for someone to take my order a few times. Kept on reminding the Indonesian waiters who gave me that rude staring looks until a young Chinese woman came to take the orders.Their signature dishes which you must order when here are1) Fresh Crab milk2) Cheese prawn mee hoon3) fried fresh squid with garlic4) delicious fat hokkien meeAnyway look through their menu which is also available in English and anything with a thumbs up sign is their best sellersSuggest you call the number above to book before coming. Trouble finding this place ?? Use Waze. It will bring u right in front by just typing the restaurant name.Show less

Author: Ah T
Title: Nice cheesy prawn mee hon, though the queue is long.
Review: Juicy and big prawn.. but for me the main character here is not the prawa but the thick broth that you will always ask for more.

Author: Flyer227437
Title: 645pm q to 815pm start eating worth?
Review: We started queuing at 645pm. Reached our turn at approximately 750pm. Ordered and started eating at 815pm. Famous prawn beehoon was good and fire used to cook was strong enough hence could taste the "huo3 hou2". Taste bears a little similarity to Zi char hor fun. Milk crab was fresh. Horlick prawn was a little disappointing. Prawn A little tough. No surprise in taste though I had hoped that it tasted different.Gui hua fish is good for kids and those who also enjoy sweet and sour taste pork ribs. Overall, satisfied with the food served. But really queuing for 1hr is quite tiring. Show less

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Still The Best
Review: Must Try the creamy prawn beehoon. A die for. They are famous for their Crabs and other dishes too. The cod fish comes in two different version of light soya sauce and dark ones. Good for large families

Author: YennyT4
Title: Delicious food but not the customer services and where the prices tag?
Review: I will give 3stars out of 5stars! Food is really delicious but the Chinese lack of customer service! The malay who work in here kinda approachable but not the chinese workers. I wonder is they proud of their restaurant being so busy or heng till customer service is important also forgot!!!Not to mention they like dont really wanna answer your question. No price tag at the menu and some only got chinese word. For me dunno how to read chinese only can depend on my mom. Plus no price tag is a no no for Singaporean. Ask more like feel I kinda irritating consumer. They also should learn patient and listen to my question before assuming know what i am asking1st i ask 1 crab how heavy. And the chinese waitress keep saying minimum must order 2 crabs and around 1kg plus...so my question is 1 crab is how heavy? And she keep say they dont serve 1 crab. OF COZ I KNOW LAAAA BUT I WANNA KNOW HOW BIG UR 1 CRAB IS! 500Gram or not more den 800gram 1 crab! So i can how how big is the crab and might wanna order 3 instead of 2 if it is a small crab! Since she not really friendly and approachable. Forget it! Ask more will only piss me off. In Singapore we can choose our own crab or they will show us EVEN THE RESTAURANT ARE BUSY LIKE HELL TOO.. How heavy the crabs we selected also will show it infront of us.. So this customer service and no price tag i wanna minus their stars. Food - delicious!!! Maybe I never eat before cheese prawns bee hoon and fresh milk crab. The gravy i must say 4 stars out of 5 (minus for a bit salty maybe use to less salt and oil). The crab not that very very fresh but still ok.Price - for that two dishes. Prawn is Small size and 2crabs, I think is reasonable for that price but that is becoz i from Singapore. I do not know how the local thinkLocation - is at Melaka raya. Near the shopping malls and the famous hotels. If tourists, they can walk here.May wanna try again but if the service still Suxxx the second time I come visit, i may not come again! Tips: dont go at weekend, is super crowded! I went on weekday. Although is crowded but i got my seat within 5minShow less

Author: Glen_CheeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Cheese Steamboat and Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon
Review: These are the following great food we had on 14 Feb 2015.1. Milk Crabs (very good), also tried the curry crabs previously (very good)\2. Chicken Rojak (good and unusual dish)3. Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon (best of the best)4. Cheese Steam boat (unusual and extremely tasty soup)5. Wine Chicken (strong taste and very good)Highly recommended and one of our favorites.Show less

Author: kmquek
Title: The Cheesy Prawn and Rice Vermicelli is delicious
Review: The house Cheesy Prawn with Rice Vermicelli is delicious. Everyone enjoyed themselves here and the food here is really good. Instead of prawns they used crayfish but no matter, just the Cheesy sauce and Rice Vermicelli is good enough.

Author: PinXunSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the queue
Review: Always best to make a reservation way before and be punctual as they will give up your seats if you are more than 15 mins late. If not prepare to queue even more than an hour during peak hours like dinner.A must to try here is the cheesy prawn meehoon and the crabs!Show less

Author: TheArcticStarSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent food , especially the Cheese Prawn Beehoon
Review: Tong Sheng Restoran is located along Jalan Melaka Raya 6, between Jonker Walk and Hatten Square. We withstood the long queue and finally got to try the famous Cheese Prawn BeeHoon, an inspiration from Hong Kong's famous cheese crayfish ee mian (noodles). The beehoon was awesome - rich in cheese flavor but not overwhelming!They have many interesting food items, not limiting to Rojak Pork Chop, Otah Omelet etc. The other interesting item we tried was the Rojak Pork Chop - spicy and rich in flavor.Service is efficient and the location is easy to find. We ordered three food items and paid just about SGD$35.00 so it was definitely well worth it.For full review and photographs, please feel free to visit:http://thearcticstar.blogspot.sg/2014/12/maneuvering-malaysia-malacca-trip.htmlShow less

Author: gnileew
Title: Nice food but my whole family got food poisoning after that 😰
Review: I cant deny that the food served at tong sheng is nice. But now i seriously doubt their hygiene and cleaniness. After having dinner there on 21st dec, my whole famil suffered from food poisoning. We recalled that there was no water supply that evening (toilet cant flush and no water to wash hand) and the lady boss explained to us after our dinner that the nearby water pipe had burst and there wasnt sufficent water in the restaurant. We are guessing that tong sheng did not practice food hygiene becoz of it. If you are considering dining there, kindly check with the boss whether they are experiencing any shortage of water. We were only informed after our meal sigh, if we knew prior to ordering we would not have dine there that evening.Show less

Author: PTCCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious !
Review: Easy to find car park. Prices are quite reasonable and the food is delicious !Prices are quite reasonable. Need to be early as if you are late, you need to queque up. Non air cond restaurant. The cheesy bee hoon with prawn is quite special.The honey pork fried strips is highly recommended.Show less

Author: Seahlydia
Title: enjoyed the seafood there
Review: prices are reasonable. and you must try the cheese bee hoon that everyone raved about. the prawns and crabs are very fresh. i visited at 6pm so the dinner crowd were not in yet.

Author: DannyCSW
Title: One of the best seafood restaurant
Review: Ordered egg york pan fried Crab is was excellent, and also try some of their main dishes and all the food is above average.

Author: thinksg
Title: Food is good
Review:
I must admit that I did not try on any of the signature dish as my wife is allergic to eggs. 

Order their 桂花鱼。It was excellent. Their fried honeyed pork strips and black pepper crabs were just normal. Nothing to shout about.

Author: jills914
Title: Totally overrated and a tourist trap
Review: Read the reviews and decided to give it a try. It was totally overrated, food is at best average. Tried the signature cheese prawn bee hoon and it was a total letdown with just two half pieces of prawn. Also ordered Salt baked crabs, it was made up of big and small pieces of crab, meaning coming from different crabs, and it was not fresh at all. Ordered a steam cod fish and it was very fishy, garnishes were added to mask the smell. Don't waste your money and carbs on this place. Forget about queuing up for the food. Ask locals where they would rather go.Show less

Author: boonkheonglawrenceh
Title: Good food with decent price
Review: Nice seafood restaurant with decent price. Must try dish will be the big Prawn Meehon with cheese sause

Author: Kevin BSingapore, Singapore
Title: Whats the hype?
Review: Just an ordinary road side shophouse restaurant with no air conditioning and hoards of people.Could not bring myself to eat a second mouthful of their fried beehoon (fried vermicelli) xin zhou chao mi fen. Doesn't taste like it.Their signature cheesy prawn beehoon is slightly better but still average.Show less

Author: PinXun
Title: CRABBY
Review: this place have to reserve in advance if not you have to queue for quite awhile. A must to try is their signature cheesy prawn mee hoon and their milk crab. both thumbs up!

Author: ivyjr
Title: Highly recommended
Review: Cheezy Bee Hoon is really yummy.. The rest of the speciality is equally good! Open only in the evening. Minimum wait time is about an hour. Highly recommended. $$$

Author: weiminn2018Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fusion Zi Car
Review: Not many Chinese restaurants dare to experiment but this chef is good. River prawns with cheese noodles, milk crab, fried fish in chrysanthemum presentation, bbqed squid are some dishes to order.Noisy and cramped seating with long waiting time. Go early, before 6 to get a table Show less

Author: JOng256Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food!!!
Review: Restaurant was located very near to Mahkota Parade. But have to book in advance to avoid disappointment! We ordered 9 dishes including 5 of their top specialties (which was featured on the huge sign board in the restaurant). Of all the dishes, my favourite was cheese prawn bee hoon. The taste of the cheese was just right, not too strong. Absolutely delicious! The squid was cook to perfect....soft and tender! Everything was cooked to my taste.... except the crabs. I don't really like the milky taste though my family love it! The prices were reasonable too!. We paid about RM500 for a total of 9 dishes for 8 adults! Show less

Author: jessiehenglimSingapore, Singapore
Title: The food is still great!
Review: My 2nd visit to Tong Sheng this year and it's really still very good. However, the Cheesy Prawn Bee Hoon wasn't as cheesy as what we had the last time at the beginning of the year. We also ordered their Hokkien Mee but it was a disappointment as it was a little bland. We thought it would be good as the chef started his business from hokkien mee, but unfortunately, that was the wrong choice. We had the Garlic Squids which is very yummy and some pork ribs. Overall, still worth to come but must call to reserve to avoid waiting! After you order, they serve the food to you all at one go!Show less

Author: baccus60Penang, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: My first visit to this restaurant. The cheese was lost in its signature dish, the Cheese Beehoon, and it was a little too soupy for my liking. Rather pricey at RM25 for a small portion with only one udang galah (freshwater prawn) cut in half. The scallops were nice and garlicky (RM16), the lemon chicken was tender, not too sour but tangy enough (RM10). The pork was delicious, the pork belly slices fried to a crisp and coated with honey in a mix of dried chilli, onions and capsicum (RM15). Sambal Asparagus with Prawns may seem expensive at RM20 for a small portion, but taking into consideration the escalating price of prawns today, I'd say this dish was quite reasonably priced. At least the prawns were large! Together with a soft drink and the standard plate of peanuts, the total bill came up to RM89.60 for the three of us. Having no government tax or service charge was a plus for customers. Would I go to Tong Sheng again? Yes, but I won't be ordering the Cheese Beehoon again! Tip: Make a reservation. We were there at 6.30pm an hour after it opened and it was already crowded. Before 7.30pm, there were no more seats and people were queuing...and, all this on a weekday, too.Show less

Author: ahkeeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Taste with a difference
Review: Most of the dishes served here are different from the usual in most restaurant. The cheese beehoon is a must try which was also my first time and it was delicious. Other dishes are just as good.A very popular place so be prepared to face a large crowd if you intent to go at normal dining hours.Show less

Author: blueneutron
Title: Best Local Zi Cha in Melaka
Review: Food is so good that we returned a second night. See my food pics. Tong Sheng only opens for dinner-530pm to 11pm. So go early or you have to queue

Author: Angiedimsum164
Title: Cheese bee hoon
Review: Worth trying cheese bee hoon but It is not so cheesy and more of a milky style... besides this dish, they have other dishes like cheese steamboat, seacumber, crabs etc...place is pretty crowded so you either go early or late..  reasonably price so worth eating

Author: FelixH374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Incredible food at reasonable prices
Review: Not the best ambiance but this place serves incredible food at very reasonable prices. 4 of us had 5 dishes - steamed cod with ginger & scallions ; Claypot tofu , ginger chicken, king pork ribs , chye sim in garlic plus 3 large bottles of Asahi beer .... Cost S$55!! Show less

Author: johnshin
Title: I'm back
Review:
This is the 2nd time i visit this restaurant, the foods still very delicious.

Lucky i call for reserve table on 8.30pm. we saw long queue outside restaurant when we arrived.

The price are resonable, don't miss the signature dish "Cheese Prawn Meehun".

Author: UnderBigHillGeorge Town, Malaysia
Title: Worth Waiting
Review: We reserved a table for 11 at 7pm, and the food was finally served at 8:15pm. According to the waitress, there was only one chef on the day we visited. I'm not sure if on normal days the food could serve faster or not. Their signature dish "Cheese Prawn Meehun" is nice. The sauce is delicious.The Rojak Pork Chop is a pleasant surprise. I love the freshness of the fruit which go very well with the deep fried pork chop.My personal favorite is the "Fresh Milk Crab". The crabs are very fresh and the sauce is unique and tasty. They served toasted bread together with the crab so that you can dip the toasted bread into the sauce. We love it!Show less

Author: SantawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious.. you must try.
Review: This small establishment is located in Melaka Raya after the Mahkota Medical Center, take a left turn and 1st junction on the right you'll be able to see it. There is a road divider that prevents you from making a right turn so you'll have to drive forward a little and turn right from there.The Prawn Chee Bee Hoon (Rice Vermicelli) is delicious and is one of the signature dishes there. Have it with a nice glass of Asahi beer if you drink and it's fantastic.Look up to the walls and you'll be able to see their other recommended signature dishes. There was a fish dish on the wall which I didn't find too tasty. Too sweet for our liking and the skin was too hard to munch on.Better to call in for reservation if you can. 017-631 7811. Closed on Mondays.Show less

Author: eileeno948Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: The food here is just average. Nothing great.. On top of that, very long wait. We waited for almost an hour for the food. Signature dish, cheese prawn bee hoon was so-so. Bitter gourd soup were tasteless. But their deep fried fish is recommendable. Fresh fish meat and fried to perfection. Fried vege is normal too. Don't come when you are extremely hungry. Show less

Author: chongs162
Title: Average
Review: average food but friendy service, although they are very busy. better booking before going...

Author: 633ElizabethHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic and tasty food!
Review: We ordered the cheese fried bee hoon, sambal asparagus, hotpot with cheesy soup, fried fish (no bone) in honey, sliced pork belly & soup for our family of 2 adults and 4 kids. I must say - the cheese fried bee hoon was fantastically delicious. There was just a teenie tiny hint of cheese taste but the sauce was just so good!! The boneless fish in honey was easy to eat and I loved it. The hotpot with cheese was unique and the broth was just right. Prices are reasonable. However the place gets really crowded at about 6 pm onwards. We were very thankful we got there earlier. I'll definitely return to this place. Thumbs up!!!Show less

Author: SmileForYou
Title: Juicy crabs!
Review: The milky crabs are TDF. Nothing spectacular with the cheese prawn beehoon. Next time will try the deep fried squid.

Author: DaveChoongPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Worth for future visit!
Review: We ordered some of their signature dish like Sweet Vinegar Gui Hua Fish, Deep fried Squid, Cheese Prawn noodles etc. Both fish and cheese prawn noodles are my favorite while only the squid bit soggy (perhaps frying time too long?) not able to try their Milk Crab as only 3 of us but already 5 dishes on the table. Definitely i will come again!Do reach early or better to make reservation. When i were there during weekdays, the restaurant almost fully occupy!Show less

Author: aries0028Singapore, Singapore
Title: oh wow... Creative, Innovative and Delicious
Review: A short 8min walk from the Hatten Hotel, this open air "Coffee Shop" restaurant packs a mean meal that requires reservations and an empty stomach. Recommended by a friend, it's Cheese Bee Hoon and Milk Crab are its signature dishes that almost every table had.The dishes are unusual by any standard, especially the Shao Xin Hua Diao Chicken fried with vinegar and ginger, which almost tasted like "confinement's 猪腿醋". And if only.The Garlic Squid (some call it Sotong) was fresh and the garlic sprinkles added an aromatic flavor to its already crunchy and crispy texture.The Cheese Bee Hoon with medium sized prawns was not heavy nor was it pasta-like cheesy. It was simply a light, simple and heartwarming dish that best eaten hot (it coagulates once cooled). The other signature dish, the Milk Crab was omg-interesting. It had a citrusy gravy which helped break down the milk which otherwise would have been a very filling dish.I would recommend you give the Beans with Dried Shrimp and Belacan a miss cause, while that was also good, it failed to live up to the other dishes that surpassed on creativity, innovation and delicious-ness. But do make reservations! We went on Friday and the place was packed. And try not to fault the service people; many of them are not from Malaysia and their expressions sometimes can come across as rude and can't-be-bothered. We narrowed it down to "communication breakdown" and didn't let them affect our delight with the food. The restaurant is closed on every fortnight-Monday, so certainly best to call before heading down.Show less

Author: LeeSummerSingapore, Singapore
Title: 2nd visit
Review: This is the 2nd visit after 1st visit is at last year Oct. We ordered the signature dishes - Cheese Prawn Mee Hoon, Fresh Milk Crab , Special Beancurds and Gui Hua Fried Eggs. 2 dishes will like to strongly recommand, the cheese prawn mee hoon gravy is not creamy and is light, people do not like cheese can also take this dish as the dish is not cheesy and do not have the cheese pungent smell. The fresh milk crab, sauce is tasty and goes well with dipping the bread in it, the crab is fresh as well. Is good to make reservation before going, the restuarant open at 5.30pm and my reservation is at 6.00pm, the resturant is almost full and there is people without reservation waiting for seat.Show less

Author: jessiehenglimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy food!
Review: The place was a 5min walk from my hotel and you had to a booking to get a place. Once there.. We ordered the signature dishes and it was all very good! We loved the cheese prawn bee hoon the best! Go try when in Malacca!Show less

Author: seabreezesblowSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing cheesy about this place
Review: The signature dish - beehoon with crayfish in cheese gravy - is one of a kind. It's like fish head noodle soup but much better. The gravy was creamy but you don't get "jelak" (feel stuffed), and whole fried shallots and soft lettuce add to the combination of tastes and textures in the mouth. Only downside is that there's a lounge on the same row, so people smoke and there are lots of butts near the entrance of this non-air conditioned but well-ventilated place. Show less

Author: sarahhobartHobart, Australia
Title: Must try signature dish
Review: This restaurant is only open at night, I think until around11pm. I had originally planned to go in the early evening after reading some other reviews. However, we were running late one evening so we decided to go to Tong Sheng a day earlier than planned because it was already 7.30pm and they open until late. They are easy to find, just drive along the main road, and you will see the bright neon lights and big name board, turn left and into the side road, they are parallel to the main road.I think we got lucky. When we got there the place was full, and another couple were waiting in front of us. I heard a waitress tell them they could either sit at the only table left outside, or inside at a table close to the kitchen. They chose outside and she led them off, so I thought "yes, last table is ours ! ". However, when I asked another lady ( the boss ) for a table she told me they were full, no tables available. I told her what the other lady had said, and pointed towards her, and we were reluctantly shown to the last table. We had to wait for them to clear the table, but were just happy to get in.Menu is in English and Chinese, with some photos on the sideCheesy Prawn Meehoon - first dish to come out MUST TRY dish here. The best thing we ate there. Reminded me of a Lobster with Yee Mein and Cheese Sauce I had many years ago in Hong Kong. There is no outright cheese taste, but it gives a great flavour to the gravy/soup. We ordered a small, and got two crayfish/large prawns, so there isn't much prawn per se, but the beauty of this dish is the gravy. There was some lettuce at the bottom of the dish to make the whole thing look bigger. I ended up practically drinking most of the gravy because it was just that good.Garlic Fried Cos Lettuce - tasteless and disappointing, should have ordered another vegetable dish, didn't realise there would be so much lettuce in the Meehoon dishPai Gu Wang - Emperor Spare Ribs - very nicely done, no bones, soft and tender, flavourful sauceKong Pao Chicken - nicely done, one of the better versions I've triedBlack Pepper Crab - had to wait for this dish to come out after we had finished all the other dishes. Minimum crab order is 2 crabs. Price was RM 80 per kg, which was worth it. The crabs were meaty and fresh and wonderfully done. The black pepper sauce was very nice and thick, coating all the crab pieces. We got all out hands and faces full of sauce, bring wet wipes !!Show less

Author: Lum9672
Title: Nice
Review: The food taste is good. It just a bit sweet for me. Please try the cheese noodle with prawn, it is good. The price is reasonable.

Author: Geochong
Title: try the cheese meehoon
Review: impressed by the cheese prawn meehoon it's a signature dish. We tried the fried fish in a sweet vinegar sauce - that is also recommend. The soy sauce is quite unique.

Author: KiaRioSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average Taste
Review: We were craving for crabs ( despite having black pepper crabs @ Jumbo East Coast last week :).. decided to give this a try after the postive reviews.The cheese bee hoon was nice.. refreshing taste. cost me RM25 for a small portion. Crab wise we went for the highly recommended Fresh milk crab.. Tasted sourish ( Boss had pre empted us). Crabs were relatively fresh but the taste/style of cooking doesnt go down well with me . 2 Crabs ( weighing +/- 1KG cost us RM104. Overall it was a nice experience to have tried this store.Show less

Author: KayeriserSingapore, Singapore
Title: A restaurant to remember for this Malacca getaway
Review: Heeding the advice from fellow reviewers, we went to Tong Sheng around 5.15pm as we did not make any reservations. Waited for awhile as they were preparing to open at 5.30pm. We were the first few customers and they place was thronged with crowd within the next half an hour! We ordered cheese bee hoon, crab meat omelette, sambal kang kong & steam toufu with salted egg. All the dishes were superb. Especially the bee hoon which has a strong "wok hei" and the cheesy taste is not too overpowering. It was truly irresistible that we ordered a 2nd plate thereafter. Do try the soy sauce placed on the tables. The chopped chilli complements the soy sauce. Thinking the sauce could be a secret recipe, we asked the lady boss if the sauce is for sale. To our surprise, it is!!! We learnt from the lady boss that Tong Sheng is only opened for dinner. If you are coming in big groups, do make reservation. Otherwise, go early like we do.Show less

Author: TetSan
Title: Overrated? May be its a busy day?
Review:
The restaurant was full on this evening of 1st June 2013. 

Not as good as expected even we ordered their special dishes.

Author: Lee220288Singapore, Singapore
Title: Cheeze BeeHoon with Steam Prawns and Black Noodles
Review: Food there was good, fresh and delicious~ It is too hot inside the restaurant. It is so bad that the whole restaurant went black out just before our dinner ended. Went there on a Monday evening, it was not crowed but customers keep coming in. Recommendable place for good food with olden days atmosphere~Show less

Author: Alex FSingapore
Title: Fantastic Cheese Bee Hoon and Pork Rib
Review: We had a very good meal at this restaurant. The cheese bee hoon is fantastic. We ordered another portion because it was so good. The pork rib is also very tasty. We had to walk to big round to find the restaurant though. Go there early as it is almost always full house. The lady boss told me better make reservation. Better not to order beer. Not only it is not chilled, there is no proper beer glass. And it cost 4x the price outside.Show less

Author: setenajPerth, Australia
Title: Loved the food, reasonably priced
Review: We ate at Restoran Tong Shen on a Saturday night when we were staying at the Holiday Inn. We'd had a good meal at the Straits Restaurant on the jetty behind the hotel, but were having difficulties finding another Asian restaurant nearby that was open, looked good and didn't leave pre-cooked food in trays at room temp - not something I like to risk for meat dishes. We found Tong Shen about 500m down the main road and it turned out to be a good choice.We hadn't booked but managed to get a table right at the front, from other reviews we might have been lucky there. We had asparagus with prawns and sambal, fragrant lemon chicken, crab omelette and rice - plus a large bottle of beer - for about RM65. All the food was tasty and good, I thought it was good value too. We would have liked to try the whole crab dishes but there was a minimum order of 1kg and that would have been too much for the two of us - maybe we should have ordered one anyway and asked for a doggy bag! The crab looked delicious and other diners were obviously enjoying every mouthful.The only negative was that a couple at the next table smoked most of the time we were there - unpleasant when it drifted over our table. They gave us a bit more space when things quietened down which helped, but it did detract from the meal. We saw no smoking signs in other restaurants in Melaka, it would have been good here too.There were no other westerners in the restaurant which probably explains why they initially gave us plates, spoons and forks rather than the chopsticks and bowls everyone else got. It made us smile, because we eat with chopsticks regularly at home, in fact our younger son learned to eat with chopsticks before he ate with a knife and fork!Show less

Author: biofreshKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: DINNER WITH FAMILY ON CNY
Review: This is a very happening place for food and I love their food as it was delicious. But one sad incident is they are too crowded and their are situation of miss delivery of foods orders.Price is on the upper side....well what the hake, as lonf as the food is good, the prices is ok to me.Food serving are fast and that make them crowded. Booking needed but lucky me I am VIPs there and easily to secure a table during walk in.Show less

Author: Weijiang
Title: Great food, great price.
Review: The food was really tasty. Price was very good, and I would rather visit this restaurant rather than overrated and overpriced places like Bei Zhan.

Author: Winnie800Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!
Review: Every time when I come to Melaka sure will visit this place. A variety choice of dishes to be choose and also different type of steamboat soup. The restaurant operate from 5pm-11pm. I suggest that go before 6pm or after 9pm unless you willing to wait up to a hour. Reasonable pricing. Location is very strategic as it just nearby the Mahkota medical centre and by the main road.Show less

Author: dino1963Singapore
Title: As Good as Before
Review: Back on 2nd time. The choices and food is a as good as before. I wonder why the rating for this place is so low. We called earlier to make reservation. We took the cheese prawn, bean curd, salted egg sotong ... Will come back again.Show less

Author: AMNH
Title: A variety of dishes
Review: I was impressed by the range of dishes offered.  Most importantly, I love the range of methods that they do crabs - from milk to black paper to salted yolk.  As this is a very popular restaurant, making table reservation early will prevent disappointment.

Author: MoltonBrownCow
Title: Surprising find
Review: The food was deliciously local and it is very affordable. The portions are huge though. All the food which i ordered were yummy. Worth a try!

Author: LGohMelaka
Title: Much Ado about  nOTHING
Review: Food not great. Too much hype about the ceesy prawn noodles. Better to go to the Fatty Lee Crab ...I think that is the name. It is a restaurant near to Renaissance Hotel.

Author: Bong360Singapore, Singapore
Title: Dee-Lee-Cious...
Review: Went there 2weekends ago when we were in Malacca for a short getaway. Food was delicious, especially the Cheese Beehoon, Gui Hwa Fish, Pepper Crabs. We were only 2, so we could not order much, but we went 2 nights in a row for the food and to sample other dishes. Definitely recommended for anyone who goes to Malacca. Be prepared to wait though, but it's worth it.Show less

Author: dino1963Singapore
Title: Yummy yummy
Review: Went to Melaka last week with my sis & family. She found this place from friends and must say its is very crowded. We had to wait 15 mins for a table and 45 mins for the food to arrive. We wanted to order the cheese steamboat but had run out, but we tried the milk crab and was super, as well as the salted egg clay fish. There were 7 of us and cost about $190.Show less

Author: Amey1963
Title: Best  Hokkian Mee in town.
Review: Yummy Yummy.  Best Hokkian  Mee (Big Noodle) in Town. Reasonable price with good services from the staff. Go early about 6pm.Close on Monday.Walking distance from Mahkota Parade. famous among local.

Author: ganadelineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Scrumptious food rewarded only for the patient ones
Review: We discovered this restaurant while driving around wondering what to eat for dinner besides the usual haunts that we would go.The restaurant was packed with diners although it was near 9 pm while we were driving past n thought the food had to be good to have such a crowd at this hour. We parked on the roadside near the restaurant - it's actually a unit among a row of shophouses. It wasn't easy to look for an empty table. The staff was extremely busy and I had to take the menu myself from the cashier after waiting for 15 mins.A staff however quickly took our order n he recommended milk crabs as it is one of their signature dishes. The crabs cost RM70 per kilo which is rather reasonable. We ordered 2 more dishes like veg and hot plate tofu. Then the waiting started....... diners were still waiting for their dishes to arrive even before we made our orders. The clientale is a good mix of mainly locals n some tourists. Nobody seemed to be complaining about the long wait. But I must say the wait was rather agonizing n tiresome especially if you are hungry. When our food finally arrived about 40 mins later, we tucked in. The crabs were huge and looked really awesome, swimming in a pool of milky sauce. The sauce is both sweet n sour and the milky taste is not overpowering at all......quite a good balance of taste. The crabs were rather fresh and the meat was fleshy n firm. It's a good dish n did not dissappoint. The veg n hot plate dish were well done too. Halfway through eating, our next table of a family of 6 were finally served although they came earlier than us. One of the children was already sleeping at the table! They had steamboat......what it baffled me was why did it take so long to serve steamboat as they are cooked at the table by the diners themselves n not by the chef which of course required waiting. The long wait by that family was uncalled for. Apparently prompt service is definitely lacking in this restaurant n they seemed understaffed. The lady boss told me that she only had a chef working and the rest are assistants cooks. That explained the long wait.We will return to this restaurant again but we vow to come early and hope to have a better dining experience in terms of service.Show less

Author: CarolynnAng5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Hidden Local Treasure
Review: This was actually our 2nd visit (both were for dinner). The first visit we were there at almost 10pm and it was still quite crowded. We chanced upon this place during our first visit and fell in love with their food. So our 2nd visit to Malacca, we make sure we visit it, and quite sure will do that for every Malacca trip. The chinese name is 东昇园海鲜家. The place is so popular that sometimes you have to wait for your table to be ready, especially during dinner time and weekends. This place looks and feels local but the you would not regret having the food there. So if you want something local and reasonable price, go for this. This is a typical seafood Zhi Cha (煮炒）yet with those great signature dishes, they make this place different!. I think some people go there for steamboat, but the seafood and cooked dishes are just heavenly! I was not able to take most pictures as we all walloped up the food the moment they arrived! Try the milk crab! (we call it the milk crab - it is one of their signature dishes). The lobster bee hoon is just fantastic. Just remember don't order too large sizes as you would order many dishes and you won't be able to finish them all. The crabs are delicious. This restaurant is not too far from Makota shopping area. parking is pretty easy and free (I think so, please check again).Show less

Author: Charles T
Title: Nice looking restaurant but lacks warmth
Review:
Both the exterior and interior of this high end restaurant look attractive.

The food taste is good as well, although somewhat pricey.

What is lacking is a more attentive and warmer service level.

Author: puspanathanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: This my second visit there.
Review: This my second visit there. Really love this place. The decor and ambiance is great. Very clean place. The choice of food to is good. The service is very prompt. Less than a couple of minutes they take your orders. The food started arriving in less than 15 minutes. The quality of the food is superb. Really good tastes. You can make reservations. Do give it a try. Show less

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Friends' Favourite Restaurant
Review: Each time my friend visited Melaka, her favourite restaurant will be Bei Zhan. Our order always include Mixed Vegetables in Curry Gravy. We also love the environment of the restaurant, spacious, huge and tall ceiling. The staff are efficient and food are ready within half hour. My favourite drink is always the Fresh Soya Bean Milk. Prices of food can be on the high side for simple food. Overall a nice ambience to dine and entertain family and friendsShow less

Author: pkh_travels
Title: Bei Zhan
Review: Went to Bei Zhan for Chinese New Year dinner with whole Melaka relatives. Service was good and friendly. Food was hot, tasty and delicious. Must visit and try.

Author: TDR26
Title: Great food!!
Review: Great food!! Busy Chinese restaurant in Malacca so try and book when possible. Too many dishes to name and nothing was bad!

Author: MMXBN
Title: Delicious and affordable!
Review: We visited on a weekday night and it was pretty empty. Staff were attentive and food was served promptly. Assam fish is a must try!!! Super delicious and the gravy is great to go with rice. Worth a try!

Author: Paul MStubbington, United Kingdom
Title: A pleasant Sunfdsy lunch with family
Review: For once no need to book as Sunday lunch time is a quiet time.booking is essential at any other time due to popularity with MalakaiansThe restaurant is clean and airy with high ceilings and large fans.Parking is easy outside the restaurant\The staff were very helpful in helping us to wade through the large menu.Our food did not take long to be served and it was well presented and hot, with sufficient of each dish to allow all to enjoy.Show less

Author: Judy H
Title: Scrumptious food
Review:
Wonderful Chinese Melakan food. Service excellent and helpful.the braised pork belly with buns were great as was pork with fungi.
Definitely well worth a visit.

Author: chom CPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good if visit is smooth but bad attitude of owner
Review: We were happy with all the dishes, but service is not prompt as staff is overwhelmed. But what was unacceptable is the attitude of the owner who is in charge of the payment. We had a vegetarian in our midst. After paying I noticed the fried egg with black fungus was billed as "fried pork with black fungus". I wanted to confirm whether pork oil was used. It was the condescending and tone he replied in and the irritable look he had that was a total put off. Hey i had not even checked whther the price of an egg dish differed from a meat dish. After reading other reviews here, I noted there were a few comments about his attitude too. After relating this incident to one of us who is a local, she told me of an incident where he had cancelled their booking without informing despite the fact that they had called ahead to inform them that of the late arrival. If your visit here is smooth you would find this a good place. But if it is not smooth, good luck! I seldom write a review unless it is good. The only reason I bother this time is for the owner to learn so that noone else get such treatment again. Show less

Author: 401agnesl
Title: delicious food
Review: Good service. Nice environment. Clean toilet..all is good. Food portion is big and yummy. Will go again in future. This restaurant also serve vegetarian food.

Author: Christopher_SNZSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Amazing Assam Fish and a Peach Gum!
Review: Came here for lunch on recommendation by our driver, was not disappointed with the line up of food.We ordered the stir fried potato leaf, ginger chicken and salted fish pork. The highlight item was the assam fish - excellent for Southeast Asian standards!They also have an unusual item on the menu - peach gum. It is a Chinese traditional dessert, but ironically you don't see it anymore in many parts of Asia. Worth a try just for the experience. Show less

Author: shmnme
Title: Very remarkable food!
Review: Food ordered were tasty and leave a lasting impression. Had the tilapia with Assam, tofu with Napoli sauce, crispy spinach with pumpkin and bitter gourd soup

Author: EYeoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Consistent and good
Review: I’ve eaten here numerous times. It's one of the standard restaurants I patronise whenever I'm in Melaka. Over the years, the food has been consistently delicious. Hard to recommend any particular dishes as I've tried many and have never been disappointed. Have noticed that the prices are creeping up though.Show less

Author: neris2912Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very good but avoid when very busy
Review: Bei Zhan is one of the most popular places in Melaka for Chinese food because it is known for serving good food, a nice clean air-conditoned environment, prompt service and very reasonable prices. I visited them again recently and they have definitely maintained their standards. I especially liked their fried mee sua, tofu in tomato sauce and deep fried spinach with pumpkin. The last dish was a great hit with my kids who usually hate to eat their vegetables, and they kept asking for more! The only dish which was quite ordinary was the eggplant with mince meat. Main downside to our visit was that we had to wait almost 1 hour for our food. The wait was understandable because we were there on a sat night, and they were full house, and also had a wedding dinner on the ground floor. I wished they had told us that we would have to wait a long time when we placed our orders. If i had known, we probably would have eaten somewhere else and come back another day. My advice is to either go very early or very late if you are planning to eat there on a weekend. Otherwise, be prepared to wait.Show less

Author: Clement Yi Chen... CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Always love coming back here
Review: Been to Bei Zhan restaurant a number of times and I still love coming back here despite the plethora of food options when you're in Melaka. Good ambience, servers are prompt and the food good as well. You should try the Mongolian Lamb Rack. The lamb is tender on the inside and nice crisp bits on the outside. A little gamey so if you don't like such tastes, then order something else (there are many other food items for selection as well). You should pair this with the black pepper sauce, which is awesome. If you have not been here before, you should at least do so once. The only downside is that it is located further away from the hotels; walking will take you close to 30mins (or more) so taking a taxi or private hire would be the best way to get to the restaurant (usually about a 10mins drive)Show less

Author: goh_ginny
Title: Good for group gatherings
Review: We went there for dinner in a big group and service was fast as the food was pre-ordered. Food was tasty and authentic. No complaints. Worth another visit

Author: aileen22ang
Title: Better service than Teo Soon Loong Seafood
Review: Thanks to Teo Soon Loong for the wonderful rejection that we found a better restaurant with better service and yummy shark’s fin soup. Although on the pricey side but we are more than willing to pay the same kind of money for better service!

Author: AndyLHLimSingapore
Title: Grand Restaurant but Value for Money
Review: A must to order is the Suckling pig. Other tasty dish is the Pattaya chicken, curry fish head and the lotus vegetable. 2 tables for 20 persons only cost RM1500 in total. Wow!

Author: Tang L
Title: Classic authentic Chinese cuisines
Review:
1. Variety of Chinese cuisines; from simple noodles to classic complicated Chinese dishes. 
2. Suitable place for elders and huge group. 
3. Slightly expensive, but you pay for the food quality, tastes, environment and excellent services. 
4. Parking is plenty.

Author: jeffreyboseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Chinese Cuisine in Melaka
Review: We will visit this restaurant for a Chinese meal whenever we visit Melaka. Their range is quite extensive and the food never disappoints. Service as usual is friendly and very FAST! Prices are very reasonable for the quality and taste of food. Parking is readily available in front of the restaurant. We enjoyed an excellent 1kg steamed garoupa and tried a new dish, crispy spinach with pumpkin. The Marmite chicken was nicely done and not too salty. Looking forward to the next visit!Show less

Author: adriankoh1981Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated and overcrowded
Review: We had dinner at Bei Zhan, having reserved a table at 7:30pm on Saturday. The restaurant was packed and service was in chaos. We joined several tables in long waits before we were attended to. Tired of waiting, we took our orders ourselves. Our food arrived 90mins after we walked in. The steam fish arrived in a tepid stock, and was not fresh. The signature fried rice was mushy and lacking flavour. Having seen the crowd, we didn’t expect much from the quality of food, and even then it fell short of expectations. The sweet and sour pork and spinach dish were mediocre offerings. Avoid this restaurant unless you want the novelty of Bei Zhan, which has quite a long history in Malacca. There are many other restaurants in the area that are far worth your time. Show less

Author: trvkakiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Probably overrated
Review: This place is frequented by Singaporeans and is a nice and clean restaurant.There are lots of parking lots around the restaurant so a parking lot is relatively easy to find.However, the food was probably overrated and quite average and not worth the detour here. Whether a Chinese restaurant is up to the mark could very much be tell by how tasty their stir fried vegetable dish is. Over here, the fried Kang Kong used was old Kang kong and hence texture was tough. The belachan sauce being used was also not fragrant enough to bring out the essence of this dish.Show less

Author: mea97tnh
Title: Hugh and stylish Chinese Restaurant with nostalgic interior design
Review: Hugh and stylish Chinese Restaurant with nostalgic interior design. Food are delicious and not too costly, service is great and fast.

Author: DavidGpangPangbourne, United Kingdom
Title: My favourite meal on a 3 day trip to Melaka
Review: A lovely cool restaurant (it was hot and humid outside!). We walked through the door and the 'whiteness' of the interior struck me at once. Very helpful waitress who advised us we were ordering too much! Had a really tasty and enjoyable meal - if it wasn't for the fact that I live over 8,000 miles or 13,000 km away I'd eat here more often!Show less

Author: baristakelly
Title: Chinese style Dinner in Melaka
Review:
Steamed fish was good, the rest above average. Service slow but organised, clean and airy place. 
For 3 pax, 4 dishes bills cost MYR300++

Author: Danny KKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful dinner, grand ambience
Review: This restaurant has grown into a landmark of its own in the Kota Laksamana area in Malacca.With a striking posture in plain white at one of the intersections, it cannot be missed & it looks even grander with all the lightings at night. They have a moderate spread of Chinese dishes in their menu which they cook very well including the steamed cod fish, stewed pork belly with mantou and other seafood & vegetable dishes.No complaints with their service & pricing is also surprisingly reasonable. Corkage charges for those with BYO drinks are also reasonably low. No hesitation to recommend dining in this restaurant.Show less

Author: SohyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best meal of our Trip to Melaka
Review: My Brother in law recommended the restaurant and we drove past it a few times. Looks really nice on the outside and for fear of Long queue, we called and made a reservation on a Saturday night. To our surprise, the restaurant is huge and has several levels. They are Super efficient and seated us on the 2nd floor. 5 of us out of our company of 13 people arrived, while the other 8 were caught in standstill traffic jam for 1 hour just because they made a wrong turn.The restaurant staff was quite cool about it. We pre ordered their suckling pig as we were afraid that would ran out before the others arrived. When it became clear that the wait would be Long, we ordered the food and asked them to only serve when the others arrived. The restaurant was really nice and did not chase us, unlike some other diva restaurants that need to keep customers flowing. They served us 1 noodle dish first to keep the 5 of us from starving, and my boys said that was the best dish of the night... hahaha.Well when the rest arrived, the restaurant promptly served the rest of the food that we ordered and everyone agreed that the taste, presentation and quality was Super!Worth mentioning is their crispy sucking pig! Crispy and not oily. And loved their crispy spinach with pumpkin mash. The crisp of vegetable is nicely blended with the smooth pumpkin mash. The Vietnam river prawn was not that great. Big headed type so it’s good for those who love chewing on prawn heads. But all the other dishes were great. Their Hor fun ran out and we ordered mee suah instead. That was rated best by the starving boys, great food with lots of wok hey!Show less

Author: imagine6572
Title: Fresh colonial-style decor and yummy
Review: Really enjoyed our lunch here.  Some interesting dishes like oyster mushrooms fried in peanut butter batter and vegetables with crispy duck sausage.  Recommend.

Author: mengzai
Title: Roasted pig and dishes
Review: Roasted pig is OK. Ordered sweet and sour chicken. Fried egg with prawn.  Steam sotong. Other dishes was below average on taste and presentation. Will try out other place when back to Malacca.

Author: Robbie OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Suckling Pig is the star
Review: My family had been before to have the suckling pig and I can see why they came back ... the suckling pig was worth every cent ( we went back the next day as a entree / pre dinner ) ... l crunchy and tasty ... I also like the Kung poa chicken and the Mongolian black pepper lamb ... Hor fun was also a favourite of the family ... most other dishes were good as well. It would be good if they had a bigger selection of drinks but that’s about it.Show less

Author: Shants71Melbourne, Australia
Title: Great Suckling Pig
Review: I first went to this restaurants some 5-6 years ago. This re-visit revives a great memory of good quality food. The suckling pig is great for those who like this dish. Alright - it was so good, we went back a second night just for the dish!The ambience is nice and calm - not frenzied like what some Chinese restaurants can be. Show less

Author: 58gayathrij
Title: Good food
Review: Firstly mst say the place was so clean white and green classy flooring...the food was great...worth the price...

Author: jeffreyvietJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good Food
Review: I looked up T A and came here on 10 Nov. It was unfortunate that they do not have a fish for 2 persons so I was recommended cod fish (slice) steamed Hongkong style. It was good and fresh. Sweet potatoe leaves were cooked to perfection. Braised tofu with minced meat was delicious. Bitter gourd soup was good too. Overall dining experience was good with fast serviceShow less

Author: Wanlin28
Title: Disappointing service and food
Review: My family visited Bei Zhang many years ago and had fond memeories of the restaurant as one that served quality Chinese food. Our recent visit to the restaurant turned out to be a disappointment. Service was terrible. The food was underwhelming and overpriced. With so many food options available in Malacca, we definitely will not return to the restaurant again.Show less

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food.
Review: When we decided to try this restaurant, we were surprised that the ground floor dining was completely empty. However when we entered, we were directed to the second storey, of which we we surprised by the crowd. Place was bustling with diners and staff serving. Crowd was still coming in by the time we took our table.Obviously, the restaurant has troubled getting enough staff if both floors are opened for business, and henceforth catered more for LOCALS.Food was fast, and good and price-wise, we had a pleasant surprise, of which it was VERY reasonably priced.Will come again.Show less

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Food but very crowded
Review: The food here is excellent. It is very fresh and tasty. The restaurant has seating on 3 floors but is packed so make sure to call and book. You may need to wait a while for the food but let me tell you it is worth the wait. A must go for dinner place if you are visiting Malacca.Show less

Author: Joanna_CF
Title: Overpriced average food
Review: Food was average, you can definitely find better. Place is big with a lot of tables available. Service average, ample parking, no reservation required. However, food is expensive for the place

Author: MakananginBugHong Kong, China
Title: Never fails to please if you know what to order
Review: We have always had good experiences with the dishes here, except for this last time. I always enjoy a good steamed fish. While I asked for what fish was available for steaming, I was not told that the garoupa is frozen and not swimming. If one wanted a fresh fish (thus, swimming) one should choose "soon hock" or "telapia".Otherwise, this place has a wide selection of freshly prepared food. One of the old time favourites is the Yam Ring Chicken with Cashew Nuts.The other thing which is different and good here is the fresh green apple juice which is mixed with potatoes. It is really tasty and with the blended potatoes, there is more substance to your apple juice, rather than just it's "watery" consistency.Show less

Author: marvin_ngrw
Title: Great Choice！
Review: Reasonable price, good for family reunion, delicious food and great service! You must try the yam dessert after your meals. Most of the dishes are very tasty especially the claypot salted fish with pork. Good for lunch and dinner! Well recommended.

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Average food and overpriced!
Review:
The owner and staff was very unfriendly. 
Food was average and owner had bad attitude. 
It also took a long time for our food to be served.

Author: FootballLover456
Title: Bad service and overpriced food
Review: I had very bad experience at this restaurant. The boss and staff's service is not good and the food is normal, nothing special. However, the prices of the food are very expensive.

Author: Winnie_L_123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Taste good and serve fast
Review: From the outlook of the restaurant, we thought the bill going to be high but surprisingly it was not. Anyway, it also depends what you order. We order total of 4 dishes - sweet and sour fish slice, hong shao taufu, fried vege with pumpkin and salted egg chicken with rice and it only cost less than RM100.00. I will back again to try other dishes in future.Show less

Author: DavidOKPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome food!
Review: Bro Zhan's menu has some pretty unique non traditional Chinese dishes to please the palates. Ordered 7 dishes for a group of 6. And I must say that all of them are simply delicious. Loved the lucky roasted piglet, spinach tofu in neopolitan sauce, hor fun, black fungus with egg, salted egg chicken and prawn and the orh ni. The roasted piglet is simply put off this world; just nice mix of crispiness and meat with nice plum sauce without being too sour or oily, unique neopolitan sauce that goes oh so well with the tofu, awesome hor fun with nice wok hei fragrance and taste to it. Only complaint, is the lack of alcoholic drink selection. Only one choice of beer available! Will definitely be back again in the not so distant future.Show less

Author: Siang Teng LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, reasonable pricing
Review: This restaurant has been expanding very fast due to its good food and reasonable pricing policy. They have moved to a spacious new premises. The ambient is good and clean. We went there in the afternoon without booking and it was not very crowded. I am not sure about the situation at night. I think advance booking is advisable. The food is good and service is efficient. You can just go on the web to check their menu and you will realise how reasonable are their prices.Show less

Author: Paul M
Title: A large airy restaurant that was full but managed to fit in a party of 6
Review: The quietly efficient staff took our order soon after we were seated.The meal arrived soon and was enjoyed by all.

Author: PinJoueCentral Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Good Food and Great Service
Review: The selection of food is superb here.They also offers vegetarian selection.I especially lovecthe braised sea cucumber and the stir fry black fungus with minced pork.The service staff here is attentive and very accomodating to adhoc requests.They will try their best to fullfill if possible.That make a great difference.Show less

Author: ziwei kKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Delicious food, good service & beautiful decoration for CNY
Review: I went for my family dinner during the Chinese New Year Eve, I am impress about the service quality and the taste of the food, it was delicious and the service was really good. The decoration were also creative, we cannot stop taking photos at the decoration. Show less

Author: CharmaineL297
Title: Good food and nice simple interior, just too noisy
Review: The title says it all. They have some pretty special dishes. Whatever dish you order, the food is definitely yummyyy!! Simple and nice interior, air conditioned restaurant, but too noisy during peak hours.

Author: 875rajag
Title: Good Food..
Review: We were hosted for the second time at this Chinese Restaurant serving a mixture of “Malaysian Chinese affair”! Nice Aircon atmosphere. Good service. Medium spicy food. We enjoyed..

Author: 140angelinak
Title: Good decent malaysian chinese food
Review: 1st time visit, ordered the set for 7 peoples. Good quality food. Loves the assam fish and the prawn.

Author: jade2367
Title: Dinner
Review: The braised abalone is worth eating, cost RM$108 for whole abalone, broccoli and mushroom. Birds nest soup with ginseng is tasty @ RM$35 and the Sharksfin soup cost RM$35 too.

Author: JTCruz69Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Chinese Restaurant
Review: The ambience and decor is good. Wait staff doesn’t speak English very well. Very wide choices of dishes. Ordered the Assam Pedas fish, pork belly, Tauhu mango salad, Kuey Tew soup. All dishes came out well. Prices of dishes and portions listed properly. Would recommend for eating for any occasions. Show less

Author: wendys_hy279
Title: Great Chinese food
Review: My first visit to Bei Zhan was good. A must to order for future trips are curry vegetables, lamb and their homemade tofu! As it was a big group, can't comment on their service since we have pre-ordered the dishes but the restaurant was filled with other customers. Worth visiting again! Show less

Author: Celestar989Singapore, Singapore
Title: Back for a 2nd time
Review: Came back to dine at this restaurant after 3 years. While majority of the dishes are good, they do served up lousy ones too. One example of a lousy dish I tried at Bei Zhan was their steamed hong kong style grouper. Fish was overcooked and the soya sauce was of a poor quality. Would avoid this dish in future. Some better tasting dishes that are worth ordering include sweet and sour pork, sambal kang kong, homemade bean curd just to name a few. Overall, this restaurant is one of the better Chinese restaurant in Melaka that is worth considering.Show less

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Chinese Cantonese food
Review: Very authentic Cantonese cuisine. Love the steam soon hock fish in soy sauce. The noodles mee suaw is good!

Author: LuvAlice
Title: Great food with reasonable price
Review:
The fried chicken with salted egg
Pork in marmite sauce
Oyster omelette 
Kang kong sambal

Love the 1st 2 dishes. Assessible if one drive as many lots available for parking. Clean and huge restaurant.

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Quality delicious Chinese food
Review: It's a must visit restaurant for those visitors to melaka.We have been patronizing this restaurant since way back when they were located in Taman melaka raya. They managed to maintain the quality of food but prices have increased a fair bit.Our favourite used to be the fried garlic chicken wings. We also enjoy their minced meat tofu, sweet sour fish fillet, salad prawns, curry vegetables, stewed pork with mantou, Claypot salted fish and streaky pork, Asam fish among others.Usually we will be there about 6pm for dinner to avoid the crowd. Service is quick and we can see the crowd coming in after we finished ours.Show less

Author: happypeople888Singapore
Title: White & Clean !
Review: First impression of the restaurant was very clean, bright and posh. It feels like the food will comes with a price. To our surprise, the price is reasonable. Love their style of serving the Chinese wine with plum. Ordered a few dishes and wasn't a disappointment.Show less

Author: JESLYN1990Puchong, Malaysia
Title: Bad Attitude and bad services
Review: The attitude of the boss is very bad and the food is so-so.We order the food and wait for 50 minutes already but the food also haven't ready to serve. We ask for the food but the boss is direct come to curse us without confirm what was happen and told us the food you want is just order only. After check is their staff key-in wrong order but the boss come and say if you still want need to wait again. If not, just cancel the order and go away without any apologize.Show less

Author: IchigoKurosaki55
Title: So-so
Review: Above Average Tze char that's over popular with SG .. nonetheless it's still a good restaurant to go too. the place is huge so no worries of queuing

Author: updoc1Yokohama, Japan
Title: Not disappointed!
Review: Searched for decent place to eat on Tripadvisor. Was wary of usual inconsistent standards on reviews. However, this was a most pleasant surprise! 6 of us had the asam patin fish (superb!), an egg omelette, braised beancurd with bean stick, braised pork with buns (could have been slightly more tender, but good all the same), fried brinjals (good!) and fried rice (excellent!). Everything cost < RM200. The restaurant even gave us a 9% discount (when most restaurants charge more around the Lunar New Year season). We waited about half an hour for the food, but it was totally worth it. Would return in a flash.Show less

Author: yapjiayingChiang Mai, Thailand
Title: Great Chinese Cuisine
Review: The restaurant is renovated with a modern twist, preserving what was historic and special before. The food are very fresh and very nice. The Assam Prawns I had was also delicious, with the shells peeled, so no fuss to eat! The seafood are all very fresh given that Melaka is a seaport itself. The service was prompt as well. Overall it is wonderful!Show less

Author: patmossgJohor, Malaysia
Title: Special Chinese Food
Review: As we make last leg of our food binge trip up north and then down south, we have decided to go spartan on our usual pit stop at Beizhan. We just go basic on hor fun and fried rice. Hor fun had a tinge of burnt smell but the fried rice is interesting with a scattering of wolfberries. The garlic chicken wings were good as usual but they stopped selling their homemade kaya - which was a shame.Show less

Author: Travelfather59Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Outstanding Chinese Cuisine
Review: 14 of us had dinner at this place. Food served was outstanding. we had their Gong Bau Chicken, Salted Fish Pork, Marmite Pork, Sweet Sour Chicken (the best I have had) a range of vegetables and fried lamb with black pepper sauce. The lamb with black pepper sauce was heavenly and will recommend this dish as a must order. Service was very good as all the wait staff communicate very well. This was a very pleasant experience and we look forward to our next visit to melaka. We almost skipped this restaurant as we passed by and the ground floor of this place was empty. however the restaurant operates upstairs and it was packed. We were glad that we stopped and enquired about this place.Show less

Author: Bot M
Title: Average Chinese Food
Review: We went here for Christmas dinner. The service was prompt even with a fast filling restaurant. The food was ok / average. We ordered the endives in garlic ( pretty basic but ok ), honey chicken ( ok ), bittergourd omelette ( bad ) and the braised bean curd ( very good ). It came up to RM 135 including soft drinks. An average dining experience. Show less

Author: KhidSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best Chinese restaurants in Melaka
Review: I travelled to Melaka a total of about 4 times this year and this restaurant is a MUST on our list each time. As foodies, we love and appreciate great food with great value for money. Our bill each time is about RM400 and above but it is money well spent. Service is as good as the food but have to go early to avoid the crowd during lunch or dinner peak if you did not make any reservation. I will let the photographs speak for themselves.Show less

Author: Andrew KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing food!!
Review: During the December holidays, my family drove over from Singapore to malacca for a short vacation. When we saw good review from this restaurant on TripAdvisor, we decided to check it out. The food was AMAZING. You have to try the Vietnam-style river prawn. It is mildly spicy and the chili is the best I have ever tasted. The bread that came with it was hand-baked and soft and fluffy.
