The only problem was the waiting time. But with the kind of food they served, it is definitely understandable.Judah Kang11 years oldShow less

Author: Swee-ChengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good chinese food with nice ambience
Review: I was recommended Bei Zhan by my friend. Together with my three friends we had our lunch at Bei Zhan in our recent trip to Melaka on 24/10/2016.We were impressed by the clean and bright modern decor of the restaurant. It has high ceiling which gives a spacious and comfortable feeling. It is certainly a pleasant place to have one's meal. The menu is quite extensive with great choices of chinese food. We ordered four dishes and were pleased with all the food. They were tasty & well cooked and reasonably priced. We especially loved the hor fun. The spicy sambal ladies fingers were delicious too.The staff is polite and their service is prompt and efficient.We were indeed very pleased with our dinning experience at Bei Zhan.Show less

Author: Cheryl TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bei Zhan Restaurant - Grandpa's 80th Birthday celebration
Review: I had a good time with my extended family when we visited the restaurant. My immediate family members and I had to drive up from Singapore and though the roads were jammed and traffic was heavy, entering the restaurant brought smiles to our faces. The decorations were simple and nice. Temperature indoor was good. But all in all, the food was better! We were greeted with hot food which was served promptly by the service staff present. I dealt with Ms Tang who helped make the necessary arrangements since I was physically in Singapore and couldn't go to the restaurant to confirm the menu. Price was considered reasonable too.Show less

Author: andy b
Title: Roasted suckling pig
Review: Through the introduction of friends, went there just for the suckling pig which was really worth the money! It also offers a wide range of chinese food which is also not bad

Author: Sightsee575641
Title: Chinese food
Review: The foods are great. I love the ambience with great foods. The waiter is nice and polite. The location is also strategic.

Author: carimakanman
Title: Bei Zhan Restaurant
Review: Nice food served; ala carte or set meals. Mainly Chinese food cooking and even home cooked dishes are obtainable. Restaurant setting is great which makes dining comfortable and cosy. Food are served quite quickly.

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Colonial Chinese Dining Experience
Review: I have heard a few of my peers giving remarks that this restaurant is an example of Chinese Fine Dining so I need to provide my insights as well. To put things into my perspective I would say this food joint does provide a tasty and historical experience as the restaurant has been renovated from a typical looking Chinese design to a much larger building with a mixture of Chinese and Dutch architecture hence it brings back the feeling of dining during the colonial days.This restaurant is not catered for fine dining but they do offer a wide range of food selections in their menu ranging from affordable to "high class" pricing . It depends if you're ordering merely mushrooms and scallops or with abalone. If you are going for expensive ingredients then you should be able to pay the price.My personal favorite dish would be the Yin Yang FishShow less

Author: Jack C
Title: Average dinner
Review:
Ordered claypot bacon with salted fish- poor taste, salted fish wasn't done properly and the after taste was rather bad.
Fried chicken wings with fried garlic was average...
Food quality need improvement, otherwise i wont go again

Author: emily_nslSingapore, Singapore
Title: Suckling Pig is a awesome and value for money
Review: Recommended by locals, be sure to make reservations if you are heading there. Even though they have a huge capacity with 2 levels, they may have special occasions where they hosts local weddings. We ordered salted egg chicken, soft shell crab and a couple of other dishes and enjoyed the dinner! They have a special apple and potato drink that we didn't get to try.Show less

Author: laosiz
Title: Suckling pig
Review:
The suckling pig is really worth going for. The rest of the dishes is not that good. The toufoo was swimming in source. The stew  Pork leg was a little dry. 
Just go for the suckling pig.

Author: sdlovetotravel
Title: Tasty meal
Review: Had wonderful lunch with family here, their pork dishes are very tasty. Plenty of parking available outside of the restaurants. It can get busy, do try to book in advance. Price would not be in the low side.

Author: Candice L
Title: Roast Suckling Pig
Review: Went there specifically for the Roast Suckling Pig and it was well worth the trip! Only downside is that they only had 1 size and even with 4 adults, we could not finish the dish and ended up packing it home which you have to pay for the container for the take away.Show less

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: One of the best Chinese Restaurant in Melaka revisited
Review: Revisited this restaurant after one year to celebrate my Mom's birthday. Parking was realively easy to get (right in front of the restaurant). We were welcomed at the entrance by a friendly staff ang he gladly accompanied us to the table. The restaurant ambiance has remained the same over the past year and it's a refreshing experience. The menu is extensive enough, they offer a broad variety of set food catering for groups. The food came in no time, service was quick as well. The staff are attentive to your every need. Food portion is good, befitting with the price we are paying. Everything was tip-top, the fish and prawns are fresh (unlike in some places where the fish is mushy or the prawns is rubbery). Even though the closing time approached, we were not rushed away and we managed to cut cake for my Mom. Pricing is super reasonable and we will definitely visit again to celebrate any special occasions here.Show less

Author: dreamcraft2001
Title: Over Hype Now
Review: This place use to be delicious chinese food at reasonable price. After moving, they up the price but standard of cooking has diminish.

Author: MummyBluesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful place for big family/friends gathering
Review: Traveling in a big group & looking for a place to eat together in Malacca can be a daunting task (since most places like in Jonker Street have small tables). It was a refreshing change (cool aircon, high ceiling, white & bright interior) when we entered this restaurant. Plenty of parking in front of this restaurant. We ordered their set lunch for 6 pax while my other companion ordered from their Ala carte menu. The portion was generous & every dish tasted wonderful. We loved their Curry Fish head!This place is definitely a place I would recommend to friends & family. Show less

Author: Tragedy65
Title: Not a pork knuckle
Review: Our pre-ordered set meal comprised of 2 types of chicken fillet, seaweed tofu, mixed vegetables, fish slices with spring onions and lamb knuckle, which we initially thought it was pork knuckle.  The dishes were cleaned in a matter of minutes!

Author: 493LynetteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Nice
Review: we ordered sweet and sour fish, suckling pig, sharks' fin soup, fried mian xian, and some stir fried kailan with garlic. everything tasted fresh, delicious and satisfying. Service was alright, but we did not like the chinese guy who was standing at the reception, because he made a snide remark about Singaporeans. Good to make a reservation before going to avoid disappointment (because they cater for wedding dinners too).Show less

Author: LuoCJJurong East, Singapore
Title: Good price, quick service
Review: It felt like mass feeding. We ordered a set meal for 6 and the dishes came fast and furious. The curry fish was good and fresh. The crabmeat egg omelette was a disappointment - dry and all shredded - you could hardly taste anything. Very good price for the whole set lunch too.Show less

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A refreshed view
Review: Been here many years ago. It was a CNY family reunion dinner and it was horrible. However, we were suppose to have a family lunch here and my uncle who is also a fussy eater suggested here. With hesitation ... I agree and even asked my Aunty who had that same horrible dinner with me. I guess things changed ... Was surprised at the food served. The pork with the bun was lovely. The best was the fish head curry ! A must try. Impressed with it and look forward to coming back. Sorry no picture. Show less

Author: Fonglin
Title: Portions too big for 2 persons
Review: I went with a friend and we called a few dishes to go with rice.  The portions were too big although we had specifically enquired and told them there were only 2 of us.

Author: StephenSC26416Queensland, Australia
Title: Very good environment with good air-con
Review: A nice restaurant to dine in the hot and humid weather of Melaka because the air-con is cool enough here even when it is a full house . Big restaurant ( compare with other in Melaka ) with high ceiling and reasonable quality Chinese food at a reasonable price ! Show less

Author: lilian_sg7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Chinese food
Review: If you are really interested to eat here, it would be good to make reservations in advance as it is a popular dining spot. I loved the spinach with pumpkin. It is cooked till crispy and the spinach reminds me of crunchy seaweed. The codfish was delicious too although expensive, in comparison to the other dishes. Unfortunately, their signature roast duck was not available on that day.Show less

Author: MrGoh
Title: Super Yummy
Review: The food is super yummy. Service is good and the place is so classy. Never fail to impress everybody I brought here. Keep up the excellent standard.

Author: DoraKLPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Place for Dinner
Review: Recommend by a Friend. We were there around 5:20pm and they let us in even they start their business at 5:30pm. Environment was okay - clean. Food taste delicious especially the Seaweed soup and the chicken (got 4 votes - since there is only 4 of us ;) compare to the rest whereby some of the got 2 or 1 vote)We didn't wait long for our food as we are the 1st customer. We noticed the crowd start coming in around 5:45pm in group of 4 people or even group of 10 people. So if you don't want to wait to long for your food. Be there early. I have also posted their name card and you can call for reservations. The only downside is that it is not near any tourist attraction area. Mainly those who come over has a car. We don't see taxi passing by, so it is best to make some transport arrangement to bring you there and pick you up if you don't have a car. Show less

Author: Kho2317Beijing, China
Title: A Must Stop in Melaka!
Review: Been to this restaurant multiple times as its a SOP to pay a visit here for its good food and ambience. One of the nicer eatery that offer subtly "atas" Chinese dining for reasonable prices. Highly recommend for families and friends as well as to bring business associates for a wholesome dining experience. The fact that many locals patronize this place prove that it's quality of food is undisputed. Two thumbs up! Show less

Author: AloSingapore
Title: Cheap n Good food
Review: Had a dinner here. The food I order taste well and the price is reasonable. Highly recommended to eat here if you want good Chinese food in Malacca. Be prepare to see crowded at time. Will come again on my next trip here.

Author: szeweieng
Title: Great chinese dishes
Review: During my university days, my parents will bring me here for lunch time. The dishes are great and pricing very reasonable. The place is wide. So i never run out of table seats. Highly recommended restaurant for chinese dishes with family.

Author: globaltrotter2015
Title: Very nice meal
Review: This is my first time here and I'm glad that the food is very delicious. Service was good too! I will come again.

Author: keecheng
Title: Average Food
Review: Having lunch with friends travelling to Melaka. Ordered set lunch that come with 8 dishes. Roasted piglet is nice. portion too small for 10 pax. pricing above medium range.

Author: sralls
Title: Nice Chinese meal
Review: A very large and clean restaurant that serves nice Chinese food. They have plenty of staff so the service is good. It is easy to find as it's located on the corner.

Author: RickandTatianaWangaratta, Australia
Title: A surprise of the nicest sort
Review: On a trip to Melaka from KL we stopped into this place for a quick dinner before the bus trip home.From the outside it seemed very new and inside was an enormous space physically, with lots of tables, and at 6 pm on a Monday night our group was outnumbered by the staff who were mostly Nepalese.Our group of 13 ordered a number of dishes which came promptly and which were universally tasty and excellent. Of special mention were a tofu dish, tempura mushrooms, peppered pork, crispy battered grouper and chicken with fried garlic.The staff were very attentive.A great place to try if you are in Melaka.Show less

Author: Jasminetck
Title: Nice food and reasonable priced
Review:
Restaurant has a cozy ambience. Food was great and not too expensive. 

We ordered the  recommended curry fish head which came in a big portion. Roast duck and claypot pork dish was awesome too!

Defiantly worth a try.

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Nice Chinese dinner in Melaka town
Review: Visited this restaurant multiple times for the past 2 years (about 8-12 visits)Food here is superb, delicious, affordable and good value for money.Great to go in a big group as well.2nd floor upper hall available for functions.Parking can be difficult at times in front of this restaurant.Highly recommend this place for a nice dinner with a good ambience.Dr.Ruben KumarMalaysiaShow less

Author: francoise r
Title: Dinner
Review: It is a very nice place, all is white and look very modern. Very good staff and excellent Chinese food.

Author: jenscwernerMarkt Schwaben, Germany
Title: Family Restaurant with good Chinese Food
Review: Bei Zhan Restaurant is not a cosy small place for a private 'dinner for two'. The two huge ballroom-type rooms can cope with 200+ people each. The tables for 8-10 persons come with a large 'Lazy Susan' spinning platter and the noise level in the large room reminds one on the students days in the canteen. The kitchen must be really efficient as you don't have to wait long for your dishes. The many waiters are busy but responsive. Quality and taste of the food is good, typically Chinese-Malay with all its 'specialities'. A good choice if you dine out with your entire family. Show less

Author: FromKluang
Title: Certain foods is good
Review:
This is an average restaurant.
Certain food is good at this restaurant like;

1. Curry fish head
2. Pork belly with yam 
3. Chicken with slice garlic

Author: wong mSingapore, Singapore
Title: A visit to Bei Zhan Restaurant
Review: the location is a little way out of the main belt where the happenning places are - it is at Taman Kota Laksamana- however the food is really excellent - the lamb dish was outstanding but the rest - the veggies / pork was also just as good No wonder they have such a great following and a queue of customers Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Slightly above average
Review: Went over for a quick dinner recently and found the best dish was the black fungus and fried chicken dishes. The lotus soup was simply unappealing as it was just too bland. Other dishes shown on my photos tasted slightly above average and the bill comes up to RM179 which is ok for meShow less

Author: Arjan d
Title: Average restaurant
Review: Restaurant wasn't bad but not great either. When we were there a lot of the menu was not available anymore. What we got was an average meal and not really worth the trip. And it was a bit pricey too.

Author: Niran R
Title: Great Restaurant for out of towners to try
Review: Their Hor Fun, Fried Oyster  Mushrooms with Macademia nuts and Marmite Pork are a great treat for three. (probably a bit too much) There are other great dishes too but did not have time to check it out. You are assured of quality.

Author: tryings
Title: Bei Zhan lunch
Review: great food! even the toilet wash basin design is unique and cleanliness excellent. Available wifi was also great, even outside the door of the restaurant. service was also prompt although the restaurant was full during our lunch. When we asked to pack some of our dessert for the driver who did not join us, they willingly obliged, and changed the packing upon request.Show less

Author: MaySingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food but disappointed with......
Review: We went to Bei Zhan for dinner on a Sunday after reading the reviews for TA! The restaurant is spacious and clean.The dishes came in generous portion and all were very tasty.The best dish was the roasted suckling pig. The size of the suckling pick is not too huge and we really enjoyed it.The disappointment was....when we were done with the dinner, we needed the restaurant to help us call our taxi driver to come and fetch us. (Do note that Bei Zhan will not be too accessible if you do not drive.) The man sitting near the extrance which we suspect is the boss was not helpful at all. He scolded us for requesting that and asked if we didn't have a phone ourselves. We were very shocked by his attitude. We are not locals and thought that they could at least help us call. Even if he was unwilling to do so, there was no need for him to shout at us.This left a bitter taste to our almost perfect dinner in Malaka.So do remember if you are going without own transport to prebook your taxi to bring you back to your hotel.Show less

Author: edwinlycSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good and reasonable chinese food
Review: My family and I had a great lunch in this restaurant. I mentioned reasonable given the environment, the service and the price to pay.. I personally felt is okay.We ordered fish, pork, vege, roast duck, soup for 6 people and bill comes up to MYR120. Not too expensive but won't say it is cheap either.. I will definitely come back again with my family.+ point: They have free wi-fi too..Show less

Author: Keith LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food
Review: This Chinese restaurant is in a 2 storey shophouse building. It shifted to this current location a few years back. The decor is new and more modern and has very high ceiling which gives it a grander feel.Food is the best around that area. Though not very cheap, or slightly more expensive than the normal Melaka food, the food is much better and fresher than other restaurants. Their "Yuan Yang" codfish dish for example is a 2 piece cod fish weight about 500g(one steamed and one pan fried) going for about RM110. Though slightly on the expensive end, it tasted fantastic and I recommend all to try it. For 4 persons, a budget of RM200 is more than enough, but also depending how many dishes and how many seafood dishes you order.Address is No. 43 Jalan Kota Laksamana 2/17, Taman Kota Laksamana Seksyen 2, 75200 Malacca Town, Malacca, MalaysiaShow less

Author: MrGoh
Title: Very very nice
Review: Lovely lovely lunch. Every dish is perfect. We enjoyed the lunch very much. Surely will be back for more! The lamb cutlet is the best. Must try!!!

Author: kathymyint
Title: Good food, good service, a little expensive
Review: The food and service were no question. Well decorated air- conditioned building. Been there for many time, almost all dishes were of good quality and taste.

Author: J_YC_WeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, Good Service, Good Environment
Review: Personally, I love to cook and have very strict standard for food. I have to say the dishes we order are outstanding in taste. Even after we had a late heavy breakfast and still went for dessert 10 minutes before reaching the resturant (i.e. very full), we still find the food very nice. There is free WiFi in the resturant, toilet is clean, enviornment is clean. See the photos we took.Show less

Author: CodyYewSingapore, Singapore
Title: Waaaaaay overpriced
Review: just visited this restaurant on 15 March. My table of 6 adults have been on a food trail around malacca restaurants, so we kinda knew the prices.The suckling pig we ordered was RM 188++, which was an acceptable price given that a famous nearby restaurant was selling it around that price albeit tastier.What was truly shocking and unacceptable, was the special prawns. When I ate at this restaurant 9 months ago, I was charged rm30++ per prawn, as it was supposedly the low season. (Price indicated on menu is "market price").This time, I was charged rm199++ for six prawns. Yes they were big prawns, but to charge the same exorbitant price now and 9months ago means it is not truly the market price is it?It was also very disappointing that the restaurant had run out of many items on the menu. The lame excuse was that they had too many patrons the night before and the restaurant didn't have time to replenish even basic items like vegetables!If u wish to try this restaurant, AVOID the special prawns. In my bill of rm650, two-thirds went to the suckling pig and the 6 prawns!Show less

Author: KM_SGPSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice, clean restaurant with good services
Review: Generally, this is a great choice of restaurant to go if you need cool comfort of air-conditioned environment with relatively good food at reasonable price. Abundant parking lots available if you drive and it is only about 5 mins drive from Dataran Pahlawan. With the exception of roast duck, all the dishes that we ordered were quite tasty. The steamed cod fish (420g for RM92.40) was really soft, fresh and cooked just right. They probably need to improve their cooking skills for the roast duck, which we felt had really tough meat. They also chopped-up our order for half a duck (RM30) into too big pieces. We finished-off the tasty kang kong belacan (RM8) and the fried vegetables with garlic (RM8). The deep fried salad prawns (RM32) was also quite delicious.Show less

Author: Neil912Singapore, Singapore
Title: CNY Menu Over Pricing
Review: Chinese New Year menu extremely over pricing. Food quality no longer as good as last time we had at old shop. Overall restaurant outlook is good but the quality of food does not match the price and not really worth to dine in here compare to other restaurants in Melaka Raya. My guests were not very happy with the dining experiences at all. Hope they could improve the quality of food.Show less

Author: soonimm t
Title: Fantastic and reasonably priced
Review: Good value. Good location with ample parking. Nice interior space exterior. Must try the steamed red tilapia excellent !!

Author: lipitaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fair choice, esp if you're looking for clean environment
Review: Food here is Teochew style (I think) so appears to be somewhat different tastewise than the usual Melaka fare. I had lunch here, service was fast. Food quality was good. Value was likewise fair. I did enjoy the traditional teochew deserts. The other attraction is the eating environment is clean and the restaurant, airy. Pleasant place for a meal.Show less

Author: David HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Very Good Dinner
Review: There were 4 of us for dinner. We did not have one the set menus' as it was later in the evening. We found the food very tasty and reasonably priced. The portions were generous and we did not finish everything. We especially enjoyed the omelette, spicy egg plant and the pork belly.Restaurant is well known in Melaka as providing good food and reservation is ually required. We were lucky as it was late on a Monday evening.Show less

Author: Jenny W
Title: Rude Boss
Review: We were there for a family NYE dinner and was served the fried rice first before even the suckling pig was out.When I took this up with the man at the front who appears to be the 'boss' I was told in very offhand manner that this was normal as extra dishes ordered in addition to fixed menu are cooked first. What is the logic of this? When I objected to this he proceeded to shake his had and walk away.The evening was salvaged by our waiting staff.I would not be returning again.Show less

Author: Celestar989Singapore, Singapore
Title: Slightly Above Average Food and Reasonably Priced
Review: Had the opportunity to try out this restaurant on Christmas Day after recommendation from friends. Location is about 5-10mins drive from Equatorial Hotel depending on traffic. Was there at about noon so there was no need to wait for an empty table. Ordered some of their specialities such as cod fish, sharks fin, sweet and sour pork, etc. Overall I would rate the food as slightly above average and reasonably priced.Show less

Author: YLShia
Title: poor tasting food
Review: I visited the restaurant yesterday. The place is very clean and nice.  But the food is a total disappointment. The servers are friendly but the person taking the order was so arrogant that it made the whole experience very unpleasant.

Author: 9357MarkYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Staple Chinese Dishes
Review: We usually make this a standard pit stop for dinner meal at Bei Zhan every time we visit Malacca. Its a place where you can find staple Chinese dishes at reasonable prices in a very comfortable air conditioned and spacious environment. We were there during Christmas night and were ushered to the second floor as the ground floor was fully booked. We did not know there was a second level and it was spacious. Though it was Xmas dinner time with a lot more customers, service was good and efficient as usual. The there is the set menu but I recommend the ala carte. This latest visit, our kids opted for cereal prawns (de-shelled) and the cereal is deep fried quackeoats with green and red chilli padi bits - very simple and yummy. My favourite is the black fungus and scrambled eggs. is the The next table ordered a pork knuckle which looked quite good - guess we'll try that our next visit:)Show less

Author: sheosrai
Title: Good food
Review: The food is good and the service fast and polite.  I think this restaurant is quite popular.  The fried char kway teow was delicious!

Author: EnZZZo
Title: one of the "classier" chinese restaurant
Review: Food is pretty good but nothing out of the extraordinary and reasonable price. Nice big place which is prominent if you were to drive along laksamana area. Bright and comfortable setting. service is good.

Author: deszpicable
Title: Good food, great atmosphere
Review: A relatively upscale family restaurant that never fails to satisfy me! The soya milk is a must-have!

Author: ahleongsanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good and Interesting dishes
Review: We had roast duck porridge, fried egg with fungus, emperor vegetables and steamed fish. All are well cooked and the outstanding dish is the fried egg with fungus. Tasted like a local fried rice dish but fragrant. The porridge is tasty and the roast duck meat is just right for the porridge. Will be back when we go Malacca again. Show less

Author: hunnybunx
Title: Satisfactory meal with quick service
Review: Had an enjoyable dinner here  with my mom and a friend during my visit. Some hits and misses but generally, it's a good dining option outside the tourist belt. Prompt and attentive wait staff was refreshing :)

Author: Ponnifer
Title: Loved the food
Review:
The food at Bei Zhan was excellent, service was fast too (well they have a lot of staff).

The fried spinach with pumpkin is a must try and a must eat!

Author: weiminn2018
Title: Easy to please
Review:
This restaurant is our go to place for good food.  More spacious than before and still serving good food.

Must tries:  river prawns in noodles, 3 layer belly pork with yam, fried kangkong tofu claypot.

Author: Janicia SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the price and visit!
Review: Went early for dinner at about 6pm - the place was empty. But don't be wrong, the crowd comes in from 7pm onwards for the good food!One of the dishes that caught my eye was spinch with pumpkin sauce. A very good choice I would say -something you will hardly find in Singapore restaurant - just that tid bit oily. Food was good overall, with fish, chicken, bird nest (2 only), vegetables - total to about 6 dishes that only chalked up to about 400ringgit for a family of 9.Heard the boss is a little arrogant, but the food is worth it.Show less

Author: baccus60Penang, Malaysia
Title: Good food reasonably priced
Review: When in Malacca, I like to bring my overseas guests to Bei Zhan for Chinese food. The food's good and it doesn't burn a hole in my pocket! Last night, the four of us had Braised Pork Belly with steamed buns, Crispy Spinach with Pumpkin (highly recommended), Steamed Grouper in Soy Sauce (this cost half the total bill at RM124 per kg - our fish came up to a little over a kg but it did not disappoint and my guests thoroughly enjoyed the dish), Fried Abalone Mushroom with macadamia nuts (nice and crispy, highly recommended), Lotus root and fresh fruit for dessert. Service was good, food came out fast and overall, an enjoyable meal.Show less

Author: karlkohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value for money set meal
Review: We ordered the chef recommended set meal for 10 pax which cost rm$499++.We had suckling pig, grilled lamb, steam patin fish, roasted duck, tofu, scrambled egg with minced chicken, prawns, vegetables. The food were fresh and deliciously prepared. We highly recommend the suckling pig and the lamb. The lamb was moist and tender whereas the pig is lean and the crackling is light and crispy. The duck was also good.We have been to this restaurant numerous time for ala-carte menu and the food is always fresh and delicious. Show less

Author: 106susantMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Food served too long
Review: After we order the food there is a lot of customers just reach but our food are served after those customers that come later than us. The customer beside us are came later than us but after they finish their dinner our food are not yet served finish to us. This is our first time to tis restaurant, we feel very disappointed with the service and food.Show less

Author: Choonfong
Title: Quality Banquet Food
Review: Top restaurant for genuine Chinese cuisine and fine dining. Really good value for business meals and private functions/parties. Good food with splendid service and clean surroundings and function rooms

Author: Seth517Singapore, Singapore
Title: Will return
Review: Havent been here for years and it seems to be doing better than ever. The options are plentiful and the food is considered to be very good. But I would not say its something you need to do repeat visits for. If you havent been here, you would probably have no regrets.Show less

Author: Patrick LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent service, ambience and food!
Review: Went to try Bei Zhan upon recommendation from relatives. Wasn't hard to find the place and was impressed by the high ceiling, clean and posh ambience. There were a lot of attentive service staff there to take care of my family. As we were deciding on what to order, we started to munch on the provided peanuts and all of us were delighted by the peanuts. It was very nice and had a very nice seasoning. We asked for more after the children savaged the 2 plates on offer. We settled on the 6 person set meal on offer (RM148 only) plus another sweet & sour fish for the kids. Actually wanted to order more, but the staff warned us that we might want to wait till the food arrives. Thankfully we heeded her advice because the portions were BIG!The steam fish came with a yellow looking sauce that did not look very appetising, but buy were we wrong! The fish (tilapia) was excellent. The sauce increased our appetite and the fish was so fresh! The set meal consists of roast duck, prawn omelette, chicken dices w/ ginger, mixed veg, whole steam fish and spinach tofu. My family struggled to finish the food although my dad and I were big eaters. We were very impressed by the generous portions, affordable prices and attentive services. We went there on a weekday evening and it got full pretty fast by dinner time. Definitely one of the highlights of my trip to Malacca. Saliviating just thinking of the delicious meal there.Show less

Author: AIRENSingapore
Title: Great servings
Review: Good Points:Good Location, hard to miss at traffic junctionWalking distance about 15-20 mins from Jonker StreetMainly Chinese Food, best to go along with rice as dishes on slightly saltyWashroom is cleanMenu is available in English with PicturesBad PointsOnly accept Credit Card for payment above RM50Limited seats Have to call in to make table reservation, no email address providedOrdered4 dishes, 1 rice and 1 soya bean drink => Total RM35 (Good for 3 pax servings)Check out my awesome photos!Show less

Author: DarlingSunshineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard Dropped; no longer my No.1 choice restaurant
Review: Would recommend to those who have never visited. Thus no comparisons. Good for those with younger children. Restaurant is clean and air-conditioned.Service is good as before but felt kinda strange when the staff watch you eat. Menu have changed quite a bit from the last time. Food was served quickly but not as tasty as before. A little disappointed thou with the fare.Usually, we would dine there at least 2 - 3 times during our visit to Malacca. But this trip, it was the 1st & probably the last.Show less

Author: PaulofSydneySydney, Australia
Title: Safe choice
Review: If you want a decent Chinese food, clean and comfy, this is a safe choice. They have been around for a long time and have built quite a reputation.The only gripes I have are that the food is much more expensive now and not as good as I remembered them. It would probably have been my no. 1 pick for Chinese restaurant in Melaka previously but no longer now. I would still rate it top 5 though.Show less

Author: Doug SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Splendid chinese restaurant food!
Review: We ordered the kong ba bao, omelette, curry prawns, assam fish fillet and the tofu (with spinach?). The tofu was very unique and surprisingly good, served on a platter of tomato sauce. The rest of the food were very decent as well and I'll definitely be back. To avoid crowds, go on weekdays. There are plenty of parking lots available and almost impossible to miss. The shopfront is white entirely.Show less

Author: kevyeohSingapore, Singapore
Title: worth the 20min walk from Jonker Street!
Review: Ok, we were abit crazy to walk from Jonker Street as it was so difficult to get a cab. What I suggest is, please book a cab so that it pick you up after you finished dinner.The food is superb! Will come back again, but next time will book a cab!Show less

Author: Mfamilysgp
Title: Good Value! Excellent Food
Review: A must visit place whenever I visit Melaka. Food is delicious and the price is really affordable given the quality of the food.

Author: robbenter
Title: Not what it used to be.
Review: This was such a great restaurant back in the day (old location), then they expanded, and finally then relocated. Bring back the great taste, It was so goooood, that we didn’t mind the crazy reservations it took for us to get a table.

Author: Sandy WMilton Keynes, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food, a real find!
Review: This restaurant was recommended to us by the concierge at the Hatten Hotel. My husband particularly likes Chinese food and says it was one of the best meals he has ever had. The service was very helpful and the food arrived very quickly. Everything was delicious and fresh, lovely vegetables. We don't know how the prices compare to other restaurants in Malacca, but we were delighted with the whole experience..Show less

Author: EricOngMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Best Chinese restaurant in town
Review: This restaurant will always be a special place for me and my spouse. We had our engagement luncheon here and have always since come back occasionally. The food is excellent with much to choose from. Price is reasonable too except they offer exquisite dishes such as abalone, shark fins, expansive garupas which will cost a fortune. Show less

Author: AT29er
Title: Recommended
Review: Huge variety of dishes, prompt service, reasonable prices and clean toilets - the last often an overlooked consideration.

Author: LTC_SGDSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fusion Food
Review: We order curry fish, the serving recommended us instead of the fish head (800 gms). Too much for 2 of us. Nothing very special of the curry. But the 2 vegetarian dishes were excellent. The lily bulbs hazelnuts and the vegetables well blanched. Not overcooked and the green crunchy. Recommend to those don't like too much meaty dishes. The soya bean drink deserve good rating. My wife being a diabetic don't like drink with sugar syrup. Here they serve unsweetened yet the soya bean flavor comes good. 3 dishes and 2 drinks amount to RM55. Very reasonable. Place convenient to local but a bit out of the way for those come from cruises. However I must specially thank the owner who go the way out to send us to the jetty, when we can't hail a taxi to get back. Many thank to him.Show less

Author: tpLong
Title: Service
Review: We chosen this restaurant due to the food remain good standard and it serves vegetarian food as well.  However, the services need to be improved.  The staff who answered our reservation and the taking our order were not showing his/her hospitality and friendliness.

Author: LapiLittle India, Singapore
Title: Food was good. Now disappointing
Review: Have not been to Bei Zhan in Melaka for the last 5 years. Finally return the the city of heritage and decided to go back to one of my favorite restaurants.I5 years ago, my favorite restaurant that gives good tasting home cook style Chinese food. Almost the way my grandma cooks it.My favorite dishes have most disappeared and now left with the usual commercial dishes that you can get anywhere.Had 6 dishes for this reviewFried Mee Sua - a bit too oily for my liking.Pork chops in sweet and sour sauce- tender and rather tastySteam fish- fresh and goodFried black fungus with egg- oily and saltyFried fu Yong egg- oily. Too oilyPossibly won't return again as I would enjoy my other restaurant in Klebang Kecil.Show less

Author: luicbee
Title: Average
Review:
1-have to wait for very long before food served.
2- pricing is expensive for Melaka, ok in KL.
3-nice cold environment
4-food- taste ok

Author: Lee SMelaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Price of food
Review: The price of food here is usually quite expensive. I feel the price charge is more expensive when compare to other eateries. This is especially so for fishes. Price for fried vegetable is also costly. I hope the operator can adjust a little bit the price charged so that moreeople will go. They have to remember this if they charge cheaper then more people will go as such the business will be better.Show less

Author: HengS86
Title: Good foods and place
Review: I having dinner with my sisters and sister's friend,we order set dinner for Dinner . The foods nice and the price is reasonable. I will come again.

Author: SingaporeRonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food...locals eat here too
Review: My 2nd visit...this time together with our Malacca relatives.Excellent selection of dishes, great ambience & wonderful company made for a nice dinner.We had the signature dishes and more...good stuffAs with most chinese dinners, more people more dishes...you get to taste a wide variety of food.Otherwise, the restaurant has smaller set menus.Show less

Author: chianghans
Title: BEI ZHAN RESTAURANT - MALACCA
Review: This is one of the better Chinese cuisine restaurant in Malacca. Nice ambience, clean and airy. Good service and great food. Best of all, the price is reasonable.

Author: ChrisOwensTrainer
Title: Good food.
Review:
I ate here last night and the food was very nice.
The staff were extremely helpful and I got chatting to some nice people in the restaurant!
Worth paying a visit to!!

Author: 1john316Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food in Nice Ambience
Review: Patronized this restaurant many times over the years. Our last visit was August 2013. I like the spaciousness, the ambience and the deco of this restaurant. Parking is not a problem. Service is good. Our favourite dishes are kong bak with steamed buns, Bei Zhan's signature fried rice, smoked duck, cereal prawns, Bei Zhan's signature tofu. Our favourite drinks are veggie and pineapple fruit juice and soya bean juice which is very smooth and not so sweet. The prices are very reasonable. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: RelakjackSG
Title: Excellent food, although a tad pricey
Review: The restaurant is situated a short (3-5 minutes) drive away from the big malls at Makohta. First impression as you walk into the restaurant is that it is quite well appointed, and they seem to do a very good trade on the set menus. Service was quick and efficient, and waitstaff were friendly and helpful. The set that we ordered was very good value for money, particularly the fish that came with the set. It was fresh, and larger than we expected, and very well cooked. In fact, everything was so good that we actually had some dishes which would have been nice on their own, but somehow paled in comparison to the rest. Worthy of special mention would be the pumpkin and spinach, the omelette with tomato and shrimp floss, and the signature bean curd. I guess the best endorsement is that we went back a couple of days later to try some of the other dishes, and we were certainly not disappointed!Show less

Author: Hanerman
Title: Great food!!
Review: The chefs know their trade for sure. Everything we have has there is perfectly prepared although I would not call it a fine dining atmosphere or service.

Author: 2013Review
Title: For Chinese cuisine in Melaka
Review: You get good food and a variety of choice. The atmosphere is nice and cosy. The staff are efficient and courteous. I find the restaurant a bit pricey.

Author: NewwitSGP
Title: I had wonderful Chinese style lunch at reasonable price here
Review: My family of eight, all discerning diners, ate at this place. Their set meals for 5 and 8 people are reasonably priced and it includes a steamed fish main dish. We've added three more dishes and a fried meehoon (a kind of rice noodles) that the staff recommended. Most if not all the dishes are done very well and all of us enjoyed the wonderful lunch that works out to be less than USD 60 in total, imagine per person at less than USD 8 each, oh my god. Air-conditioned, clean restaurant that is almost like a 4 star hotel restaurant, unthinkable but true. It's packed so advice if you call ahead to book at least a couple of hours ahead.Show less

Author: TetSan
Title: Great ambiance.
Review:
I like the restaurant lightning and decoration. 

Size of the Set dinner is satisfactory for family with majority of elder and female members.

Cooking is unique. 

We enjoyed the dinner very much. We will be back.

Author: lala_TuiMalacca
Title: Not comparable to 3 years ago's Bei Zhan
Review: Kind of dissappointed with the food and services in this restaurant during my recent 2 visits- Mar and April 2013. The captain whom took orders was so impatient and unfriendly. food quality was poor, the manner the dishes had been prepared as it it was Chinese fast food....precooked..etc. You can see flies flying around. I had bad experience when asking for bill. The cashier was horribly unfriendly and arrogant. I heard the chief has been changed and not the same as the original address. the same experience when I visted there again with colleagues a month later.Show less

Author: Roberto-SingaporeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Best ever suckling pig !!
Review: We had dinner last week at this restaurant and it was really packed ! Fortunately for us, we had a reservation and the 10 of us was comfortably seated. The "soon Hock" was very nicely prepared and although a bit expensive, it is worth the price.Next was the suckling pig that was on promotional offer.........only RM$138. The skin is so crispy and very well done. Practically polished every single piece ! Sweet potatoes leaves was tender and yummy. We decided on fried rice and it was a right choice.Fried chicken was beautiful too. The "orr-nee" is simply delicious!!We had a total of 8 dishes and we enjoyed every single dish !Show less

Author: xiaoye lSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value for money.
Review: Was recommened this restaurant by my friend. Hence, was expecting it to be really good. Howevere, It was not as good as I have expected. Ordered a kong bak with buns, winter melon soup, sweet and sour pork, tapioca leaves, assam fish and lotus roots with nuts.Soup was catonese style, sweet and not oily. Kong bak does not melts in the mouth and were stingy with herbs/spices. Sweet and sour pork was average. Assam fish was fried, but the sauce was tangy and spicy.Do call to reserve a table. Popular with the locals.Show less

Author: khimsiusingapore
Title: Average Food
Review: I was told by a colleague that this place is a must-try. But we found that the food in general was okay but not great. There were no memorable dishes that we felt we must come back for. I may try again after reading other reviews.Show less

Author: satoyurikosingapore
Title: Great Chinese food in Melaka!
Review: Had wonderful suckling pig at RM188! This is a really good price.I also enjoyed the fried kway teow, oyster egg, kangkong, braised meat, fried rice etc.Non-oily and great tasting Chinese food with wonderful ambience and good service ... and of course with a reasonable price tag.Show less

Author: makanaginSingapore
Title: Excellent Food At Reasonable Price
Review: Visited this place 3 times already. My last visit in Jan 2013. This place never fail to impress me each time I visit it. The ambience is nice - white coloured walls with high ceilings and very spacious. There was nice decor during our last visit. The Kong Bak was par excellence - the meat is very tender with just a small layer fat. Goes extremely well with the buns. I understand that the buns are made in house - very soft. One small inconvinience - the meat came is one large chunk. Required a little effort to portion the meat out. Would have been good if they had sliced the meat for easy consumption.Our next dish was the cod fish done 2 ways (steamed and fried). Fish was fresh and cooked just right with great gravy to go with the rice. We also ordered lotus roots fried with a variety of nuts - nice dish and good value for money. For desserts, we had yam with jinko nuts (or nee) - not too sweet and the serving portion was just right for one person. There were 3 of us and the bill came up to RM101 - reasonable for good food in a nice ambience.Show less

Author: jolee25Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Probably the best standalone restaurant in Melaka
Review: Very generous portions, menu was quite good, quite nice decor and very attentive service. Came here for a quiet family celebration and was not disappointed. Restaurant looks great from the outside especially, easy to spot and fairly close to the shopping belt in Dataran Pahlawan.Would recommend it if you are tired of eating in hotels all the time.Show less

Author: Jolice2000
Title: Over Priced Fish
Review: Ambience decor like a church, very white and high ceiling. Quite posh I thought. Mongolian BBQ Lamb was good, Fish was overpriced (RM120/kg), Kong Ba (Braised Pork Meat) melts in your mouth and was a great match with the steam bun accompanied.

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Consistantly great every time!
Review: My family's favorite dining spot. The food is good and qualities is very consistent. A must try is the Steamed Cod Fish...yummy!Food always arrived within a max of fifteen minutes waiting time. No matter how crowded they are!Only point is that sometimes the crowd gets a little too noisy. But it's not the restaurant to be blamed huh ;)Overall I would give two thumbs up for Bei Zhan!! Keep it up!Show less

Author: choosyguest
Title: Good Food, Affordable, Very Good Service
Review: No comment, just have to go there and try it. Superb Food and service.

Author: gsylwcmelaka
Title: ideal restaurent for lunch and dinner
Review: short waiting time to be served, as such you get your food fast especially when you are hungry, waiting is a torture. spacious enviroment. can phone in for reservation to avoid disappointment. food is clean and well presented. assistance are young and energectic and polite to take orders quick and serve quick. price is reasonable. location not diffcult to find. spacious parking.Show less

Author: FionalingSingapore
Title: Wide menu, great taste, good price.
Review: First brought to Bei Zhan by a local friend. One will first be impressed by the white architecture and high ceiling, ambience is pretty good. One would also appreciate the air-conditioning since Malacca is usally very hot & humid.Their menu is quite impressive, with alot of choices, and i have to say the price is very affordable or even lower than what i would expect to pay to eat at a restaurant like this.Food here is generally delicious, what i really liked was the Creamy pumpkin with fried spinach. Yam paste dessert is also a dish not to be missed.Show less

Author: JoMiSG
Title: Value for money
Review: Loved the Kong Bak Pau & the Fried Chicken with Pumpkin Sauce (must pre-order)

Author: cttclaire
Title: A restaurant worth visiting...
Review: Reasonable restaurant price... Salad prawn and sweet & sour "古老肉 Ko Lo Yuk" not bad. But do not at Chinese New Year, special menu & costly.

Author: Meepley
Title: Pretty much like normal "tze char"
Review: Visited due to the hype. Found dishes so so only. It's a simple big air con hall with high ceiling, clean and cooling after coming in fr the hot weather outside.

Author: Terry_eight
Title: Fantastic. Must go to Chinese restaurant
Review:
We would go back just to dine there again. 
Great Value, Great Service, Great meal.

Author: 628Michelle
Title: A Meal at Your Comfort
Review: you will be enchanted by the setting , the food , you will always want to come back for more !

Author: eblissSingapore
Title: Class restaurant in Melaka, worth a visit or two
Review: Parking space is a bit limited if you drive there, go early. The restaurant gets pretty busy fast.Maybe it is during Christmas time when we were there. The blaring Christmas carols spoils the atmosphere. The waiters are attentive.We were discouraged from ordering most of the Chef recommended dishes because there were only two of us and the portions are pretty big.The Pu-Er tea is pretty tasteless. Quite disappointed with it.Assam Fish Head (RM48) - Big portion, some scales left on the fish, slight fishy smell.Braised Pork with Yam (RM20) - smells heavenly. The pork is slightly tough, yam is soft and melts in your mouth.Mixed fruits desert (RM10) - fresh and sweet.We were given papaya, honeydew and watermelon. Will I be back? Yes, to try other dishes.Show less

Author: kamaleaswaryk
Title: Worst
Review: The food was not even close to nyonya style dishes. The taste was worst. Worst nyonya restaurant. And was extremely expensive. Not worth

Author: sy3717Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Very lucky to have tasted these authentic Nyonya cuisines in this cozy restaurant. Warm and friendly atmosphere. Packed with food eaters. The dishes we loved most were the Taufu satay sauce, sambal chicken and sambal ikan bilis petai. Chicken spring roll and lady fingers with fresh chilli sauce nice. Only Pong Teh chicken wasn't taste good. The red beans in the Cendol had burnt taste.Show less

Author: Rinster2211
Title: Good non -pork Nonya restaurant
Review: Ate here by chance after our first choice restaurant was closed. It's actually non -pork (though not halal) based restaurant. Dishes were good (chicken ponteh. Sayur lose. Chap chye. Petai). Chendol was amazing. Lots of local Malaysians dine here.  Walking distance to Hatten Hotel.

Author: sham1123Kajang, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Nyonya Food
Review: Amazing cendol..Never tasted this type of cendol in my entire life..Their cendol is a Must try!!The chicken rendang also was superb..Asam pedas fish just okay.Bt i personally felt the price was abit expensive n they charged for the wet tissue as well..Maybe this is my first to baba nyonya restaurant jst y i felt its slightly over priced..However the food was awesome so price doesn't matter..Show less

Author: priscillalala
Title: Delicious local lunch
Review:
Nyonya kitchen, wonderful taste of malaysian food!
Try fried calamri, prawn with pineapple (spicy but fantastic!).
Homemade lemon juice
Toilets very clean

Author: AngelaL4986
Title: Social
Review:
Good n delicious food. Service was good as staff was attentive. Pricing was reasonable.However I felt that 
the sambal balacan should not be chargeable.

Author: simonhughes0705Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Nyonya Experience
Review: Went back to Makko on a visit back in Malacca.Once again the food was excellent, conforming that this is by far my favourite Noyonya experience in Malacca.We had the prawns and rendang which were great, however the whole fish stole the show.Be ready for a wee wait if you do a walk-in, however the food is outstanding and worth the effort.Show less

Author: jiewen22
Title: Excellent nyonya food!
Review:
Excellent nyonya food!
Damn great lemak nanas prawn!!!
Every dishes also nice
Cendol is fantastic 
Definitely visit again!!!

Speedy food serving!!

Author: EdypangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Nyonya Restaurant.
Review: Went there just as they opened for business after which was packed with waiting guests.We had Ayam Buan Keluak, Ngor Hiang and fried cod fish with chilli.All the dishes was very good. Ayam Buan Keluak could do better if the buan keluak be minced with some meat. Ngor Hiang was best.Competition for Nyonya food have keen in Melaka as there are more and more Nyonya restaurant opening up.Hope they will improve with more of their taste and dishes.  Note: Best to make a reservation or go there early.Show less

Author: AAdrivesingapore
Title: Yummy local cuisine!
Review: We enjoyed our meal!Ordered a slew of local dishes and all are delicious. The beef rendang is tender and the rendang is very fragrant. The chicken rendang, a different kind of rendang but good too. Even a simple egg omelette was cooked with care that it turned out fluffy and tastily seasoned.The highlight is the eggplant! Fried/grilled till crisp on the outside and inside is the moist n soft eggplant....paired with the sambal chillie .The dessert, chendol at 4.80RM is a steal for it’s deliciousness.By the way, the starter (crackers) is for sale at 11RM for a big pack! We took home 2 packs It’s value for $!Show less

Author: ccfchew_23Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Decent nyonya food and dessert
Review: Came here with a few friends and had lunch.We had fish, omelets, ladyfingers and squid and the food was quite good. It is definitely spicy so depending on your taste buds one may need to order the right dishes.We had the sago melaka and vendor for dessert and these were also good.Service was quick and prompt. Good solid food.Show less

Author: plimtc
Title: Wonderful nyonya food and friendly staff!
Review: Every visit to Melaka in the past 10 years or so, I will drop by here for a meal or two. Tried almost every dish in their menu and they are all great...and my favourite is the chendol!

Author: 901stanleyl
Title: Consistent taste
Review:
Makko is one of my return place for nyonya craving for my multiple trips to Malacca.

Consistent taste after so many years.

Try to reserve to avoid wasting time  to queue during meal peak hour

Author: liemei_tan
Title: Must try peranakan resto
Review: I would highly recommend this restaurant, especially their cendols. When we went, there was long queue, but the service is quite fast. Their sotong is worth to try as well

Author: Judy H
Title: Nyonya at its best
Review: Makko is up there for some of the best nyonya food in Melaka. The fried eggplant was the best we have eaten. Service is friendly and helpful. Simply excellent.

Author: CowSenseSingapore, Singapore
Title: A popular Nonya restaurant in Melaka
Review: I have made at least ten trips to Melaka in the last 15 years. Each time I go there I would make it a point to visit the Nyonya Makko Restaurant which is not far from the Hatten hotel.The restaurant is crowded during lunch time and the queue is endless. The best dishes served here are the beef rendang, chicken rendang, the chilly eggplant and prawn omelette. The cendol is also very tasty and is a good dessert to end your meal. This is a typical Nyonya restaurant which Melaka is famous for. Even the best Nonya restaurant in Singapore cannot beat this Melaka restaurant.Show less

Author: Dolphinjc75Singapore, Singapore
Title: Service and Quality of Food Getting Worst
Review: Pardon me, but I would like to feedback that the service from this Nonya restaurant is really terrible. The quality of food is also getting worst, and the prices of the dishes kept increasing which is getting quite unreasonable .... I should stop patronising this Nonya restaurant. I have been patronising Makko for the last 10 yrs, and without fail each time when I was in Malacca with different groups of friends or family.Show less

Author: Hanny8888
Title: Yummy and spicy nyonya food
Review: Asam pedas fish is fresh and tasty, but please expect it to be super spicy 😃. Sambal shrimps fried vege and salted Vege duck soup is authentic and yummy

Author: ericthianMiri, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Food tour at malacca
Review: Today I go dinner at nyonya makko restaurant.i order the pineapple prawns is nice .sambal patai too spicy and a lot of chilli and rendang beef too spicy and a lot of chilli.over roll the food is not enough ingredients and aroma of spices . Price for prawn is expensive. The restaurant is old .there really need a lot of nyonya inspiration on service and food。今天我去nyonya makko restaurant吃飯。我訂的菠蘿蝦很好吃.ssaal patai太辣了，很多辣椒和rendang牛肉太辛辣和很多辣椒。滾過食物是不夠的成分和香料的香氣。對蝦的價格很貴。餐廳很舊。在服務和食物方面真的需要很多nyonya靈感。Show less

Author: ExploreSmallTowns
Title: Great Desserts
Review:
Family Dinner on a weekday night, restaurant was busy but not crowded. We loved the ngoh hiang and really great desserts - chendol and sago gula melaka. The other food items were ok but not really outstanding. 
Can we come just for dessert?

Author: K1980RUstevec
Title: Best Chendol
Review: We have visit Makko since 5 years ago and they have still maintained the standard of the dishes and the chendol is definitely one of best we have tasted. Highly recommend to go with the dessert even if you are full

Author: goh_ginnySingapore, Singapore
Title: Came here for the chendol
Review: It is a crowded place at mealtimes and we just wanted the chendol. Waited for some to get a table, only to be told that if we just order dessert, we cant have it there and have to do a takeaway. Chendol is good but i wish they made this rule clear at the entrance so we wouldnt have wasted time waiting for a table.Show less

Author: Martin FSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice simple and reasonably cheap meal
Review: Having been to Makko Nyonya before, my wife and I stopped by about 12:10 and were ushered to a table available straightaway - as there was a waitress as we entered. We went for the simple stuff - ayam buah keluak, petai sotong, tahu with gravvy, belachan kangkong and they were served fast. The food was nice and it cost about RM75 which is reasonably priced. As we sat and ate, we noticed the crowd getting larger and the staff rushing about. Reading other reviews, I guess when you come at peak timings, the staff can't help you and/or greet you. Anyway, they seem to have a constant flow of people coming in so they need not be customer oriented. My point, avoid peak timings, don't expect too much from the staff and if too pack, better go other places as there are many abound and taste about similar.Show less

Author: Grace2310
Title: Expensive! The foods taste average
Review: We ordered the nyonya asam fish which i feel is average only and it costs rm100...expensive! This place is overrated. Will never visit again.

Author: strawberrygirl26Singapore, Singapore
Title: Horrendous Service - Avoid at all cost!
Review: Very very bad service and attitude. We went there at 12.10pm, stood at the door while all the service staffs at the counter stared at us. It was our first time there. I walked to the counter and told them we wanted table of 3, and they told us to fill up the form with a blank face. I said, “Should’ve told us, we stood there at the door.” The old aged waitress with long straight black hair said “you didn’t ask!” Is that the protocol of a restaurant? To ask what is the procedure before we can actually be seated? Mind them; we are paying customers. What sort of attitude is this. Nonetheless, we walked out due to the horrible, terrible, horrendous attitudes of these waitresses. Cottage Spices located opposite is a much better choice with impeccable services and have a much better atmosphere and vibes.Show less

Author: krishymal
Title: Soooo Good!
Review: Try the Sambal Belachan Ikan, Ayam Rendang and Sayur Lodeh. I particularly enjoyed the chendol dessert here!

Author: May_75_30
Title: Arrogant service, will never enter the shop again!!
Review: I've make a booking for a table at 7pm but we happen to reach the restaurant at 6:45pm.So when enter the shop no one approach us and i went to the front desk to ask. The staff pointed at the clock say now only 6:45pm and continue doing her work. What a arrogant and rude attitude!! Never even say can we just wait a while or offer us to come back at 7pm! Completely don't have customer service and i found this is unacceptable.Show less

Author: Clement N
Title: Expensive, food average
Review:
lunch with family, ordered 5 dishes, Food served is fast. Cendoi is ok, 

The pontei is hard, not tasteful, worst than last time. The chicken meat is hard

Not happy !

Author: ilettuceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local cuisine, yum!
Review: I came right before they opened for lunch and was easily able to get a table. Food was good, including the tapioca chips which they also sold separately. The cincalok omelette and loh bak was good. However, the prawns used was not so fresh - that's my only complaint.Show less

Author: Nickhiewtravel
Title: Makko Nyonya Restaurant
Review: Peranakan nyonya at its best taste..surprisingly a full house on a sunday . Food so authentic and good . Queue outside restaurant to wait for table.

Author: OhWhySquaredKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Asam Fish was a rip off
Review: Came here bcz it was recommended on the internet but it was a disappointment.1) They served keropok on the table before the food came without telling us we will be charged for it. But OK, it was only RM 1.50, fine.2) We ordered the asam fish cz it was recommended online only to be dumbfounded when the bill came. Cz the fish was priced at freaking Rm50! (P/s:price wasn't noted on the menu as it was "seasonal*, waiter did not tell us, neither did we ask) I wouldnt mind paying rm50 if food was good but it didn't live up to my expectations at all. (P/s:ambience of the restaurant was average too) The fish tasted average like regular home cooked food and was basically flooded with diluted asam gravy, totally not worth paying rm50 for. In their defense, the rest of the dishes was priced reasonably, just the fish (*God why oh why*)3) Staff could be more friendly.Show less

Author: Avin126
Title: The service is very bad
Review: The foods was good but the service is very poor, we have left food on the table and the waiter didn't not ask us weather we still want to eat our food and she straight away clear all our foods! That's a very bad manner from the waiter! Show less

Author: onghm6950
Title: Mouth-watering cuisine
Review: I had tried a few Nyonya cuisine restaurants and I think this is the best. The food is not too oily and not too salty. Eating the food reminds me of my mom’s cooking.

Author: 944angiepSingapore, Singapore
Title: Makko and Nancy both good and comparable
Review: We had the opportunity to try out Makko and Nancy. Both places serve very good Nyonya fare. We liked makko’s Buah Keluak a little more as it is a little more sour, making it more appetizing. cendol was good, and comparable to Nancy’s. Both places are hands down better than Jonker 88’s cendol. Show less

Author: edtyeo2016Singapore, Singapore
Title: Classic Comfort Food
Review: Peranakans and Perankan food lovers are very particular about their food. Many have their own styles depending on how their grandparents or parents used to make their food. Hence, it is not surprising to see different people having very different opinions on the same food being served. For me, Makko represents the kind of Nonya flavour that should be familiar to most people. I like it that their dishes are more flavourful and more complexthan others yet retaining that classic home-cooked flavour.The keropok (crackers) which they serve while you wait for yr meal to arrive is an attraction in itself. They sell them by the bags too.All in all, this is my go to place food Nonya food in Melaka. I prefer to go on weekdays as it is less crowded. Show less

Author: Texan CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Nyonya Choice
Review: We must admit to having visited & tasted from other Nyonya restaurants here in Malacca. Out of novelty, we try Makko & not disappointed.The Assam fish was fresh but still lacks a punch. If only pineapple juice or pieces are cooked with it should alter the taste to be a lot more Nyonya tasting.Our six dishes covers, assam fish, anchovies with smelly beans, chicken Pong teh, chincharlok eggs, toufu & top up with Chendol.The bill came to RM220, but it was the taste we prefer.The cooking style & taste could still much improve.Show less

Author: PrincessSarah18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average at best
Review: Had a dinner here based on recommendations hyped at it. Food was bit pricey and standard was ok. beef rendang was hard and nanas prawn was not well cooked. service was also bit cold due to the crowds. Will not return to eat here as there are better options around.Show less

Author: StevenC5145
Title: Delicious dinner at Makko Melaka
Review: Had a great Nyonya dinner with friends at Makko Melaka. Is a full house but service is good. Recommend to try the Gula Melaka Chendol dessert,  it go along well after dinner. Food price acceptable.

Author: snuffboxdudeShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Over priced yet normal standard food
Review: Went here since was passing by this area for early dinner.The shop was gloomy and crowded , despite that we decided to try.We ordered petai Ikan bilis ( I counted there was like 11 petai with tiny ikan bilis),thn the fish masak lemak ( 2 slices of tenggiri with no pineapple) and sotong kunyit 10 small ring sized pieces with its tentacles),With 2 Limau ( cordial) and 1 Cendol.The food was very average and I didn’t really feel fascinated to make it worse the portion was too small.Was disappointed because yesterday we ate in a 5 star restaurant the similar food with rm 24 cheaper thn today here.The staffs are very moody.Maybe they are tired.But my companion thought they were rude and racist coz when the whites comes in they treat them differently, when we Asians go they are diff.But one lady with glasses and cute sized she was the only one smiling.Finally my bill came to RM 100.50.The only thing I enjoyed was cendol.Just came here to try their food but I think it’s not worth the price I paid.It’s tourist attracting place that is why.At the end this is my own opinion based on my experience.Maybe others have diff opinion.Show less

Author: ChrisLee146Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the hype
Review: Was recommend by 1 of our friend, so to say foods were great. Well, definitely not worth hype. We ordered pong teh, udang lemang nanas and paku belacan. Pong teh was just so so. Paku belacan OK but not to say very nice. Prawn was the worst. All the prawns were not fresh. Such a high volume store can serve rotten prawn. The only nice about the food was the crackers. Don't expect smile or service from any of the staff here. No greeting, no smile. I as if owe each 1 of them money.If I am to Melaka again or if anyone ask me, I will not recommend anyone to come here. I believe there are more other better service and taste nyonya food out there. Show less

Author: Vince-HelenaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Must Try
Review: One cannot come to Malacca and not eat peranakan food. Came by on our first day in Malacca on recommendation by friends. We arrived at the restaurant at11.40 am and there was a queue already. We went inside to the counter and wrote our name on a wait list. Please remember to do this if you want to eat there otherwise you will be waiting till probably late when everyone had their fill. Once the table is is almost ready, they will come out and call for you to make your order. You can use a unique name as there are many Tom, Dick and Harry in this world and you don't want to argue with another guy with the same name on who they are calling. In fact, there was someone calling himself Han Solo there.Once you have ordered, you will wait a very short while for them to collect payment from the previous gust and clean the table and you will be seated. Food comes pretty quick after sitting down.We loved the Udang Nanas ( pineapple prawn) and Ngoh Hiang (5 spice meat roll) there. A must have is the chendol, one of the better ones we have tried while in Malacca. All ingredients were fresh.Will come back again on our next visit to Malacca.Show less

Author: s0778
Title: Returning for More
Review:
Food is excellent, still maintaining its standard since my last visit to the restaurant 2 years ago. Be prepare for a long Q as they don't take reservation but it is worth the wait.
Will return.

Author: Shyangwen
Title: Super expensive for overated food
Review: We both ordered 3 dishes which are Assam fish, telur dadar cincalok and sambal petai ikan bilis.1.Average fish with bad and watery Assam sauce2.Minimum petai and very small ikan bilis. 3. Egg was okay, I mean how can an egg dish go bad.And two iced water for rm108. 70Summary, I would not ever come back.Show less

Author: lksmikeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Another Nyonya restaurant worth trying
Review: A queue start from 1130am and it gets crowded by lunch time. We were lucky to get a table. Food was good and we spend Rm129 for a Assam fish, omelette, belacan keledek, wuxiang, rendang chicken, salted veg soup and top off with cendol. The staff will clear your empty plates promptly, it means that we need to make way after we finished our food. There was a crowd waiting as we step out from the restaurant.Show less

Author: TCWJFKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Expensive & average foods
Review: Always found that many people queueing, just think to try out how delicious of the food.But we are disappointed after tried it. We order Pongteh chicken, mutton, chilli fish and mixed Vege.Mixed Vege was ready cooked and over cooked, Pongteh Chicken and mutton just normal (ready cooked), chilli fish is expensive, RM45 just 2 small cut slice of fish. Conclusion, not really worthy. Don’t know why still have so many people queueing️Show less

Author: happydevo55Portland, Oregon
Title: Bad food and bad business practice ripping customers off
Review: Food was not too good and really do not like business tactics here. We ordered a squid dish, kang kong, a shrimp omelette, rice, a spring roll, a beer and an ice tea. When we sat down they brought some prawn chips to the table without asking and they also tried to give us wet towels toward the end which we told them we did not need. When we got out bill there were charges for the towels and the chips. I do not go back to restaurants like this where they try to rip off the patrons, even if the food was good, but in this case the food was very poor quality. The omelette was so greasy we did not even eat more than one bite. The spring roll was also greasy and mushy. The rice was not fresh. The squid was overcooked, and the kang kong was fishy tasting (and yes we like fish sauce). The total bill for a bad lunch was 86.50 MYR. I did not argue with them - I speak with reviews and return business. Bad business practices do not deserve business.Show less

Author: ongboon18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good and tasty food
Review: A queue start from 545pm and it get crowded by 6pm which the door will be opened for dinner. Best to call in for reservation. We were lucky to get a table. Food was good and we spend rm217 for a Assam fish, omelette, chapchai, wuxiang, salted veg soup and top off with cendol for 2A and 2C. Fish is the cost us rm 68 but it’s fresh. The staff will clear your empty plates promptly so it imply that we need to make way after we finished our food. There was a crowd waiting as we step out from the restaurant. Show less

Author: Rejoice2014Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food at Reasonable price
Review: We finally managed to dine at this super crowded restaurant. We were there for the past 2 to 3 years. It was forever crowded. Hint, go for early lunch. Around 1130am. No q and food was served quickly.We love the pineapple prawn, chap chai and pong tenh (bean paste chicken) & chendol. Mouth watering! Service was good considering that it is a super crowded weekend.Show less

Author: 18bsr
Title: Udang Masak Lemak
Review: This restaurant was recommended by the hotel staff. We had our dinner at 8pm on Friday, it was still quite crowded. Service was fast. We order 6 dishes plus 1 chendol for 3 of us. Ayam Buah Keluak and Rendang Beef was disappointing. Ngor Hiang, Kerabu Bendih and chendol was ok. Their Chap Chai and Udang Masak Lemak was fantastic. We will go back again, especially for their Udang Masak Lemak.Show less

Author: VRia
Title: PLEASE DONT GO HERE !!!
Review: We regret eating lunch here.They claim its nyonya restaurant but the taste of the food is hopeless.I bet there are other restaurant's there which has good taste.Totally no value for money.Seriously sucks.

Author: darrenlimkbSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice authentic nyonya crusine
Review: This is a must try if you are visiting melaka. It had simple restaurant layout but offer really delicious food. I will say value for the money. Do remember to buy a few packs of the prawn crackers back. Its really great too. However do call to make reservation if possible especially for dinner, the crowd can be overwhelming! Show less

Author: HedyTan
Title: Satisfying home cooked meal
Review: We had all the typical Peranakan dishes. My favourite was the fish otah. Its not overly spicy and has generous chunks of fish in it . We ended our meal with a must have chendol and it did not disappoint us.

Author: thilaksKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average food but bit pricey
Review: No too great but just ok.Foods : Pre-cook and served immediately. Maybe the egg is cooked on the spot.Price : I feel expensive for the food that you could find in any mamak stall nearby.Taste : OKBetter reserve as we waited outside for 30 minutes to get table.Show less

Author: WilbertWPH
Title: Good Nyona food
Review: Ordered Asam fish and curry chicken with 'çhap chye' , Otah, and other typical nyona dishes. Delicious, Good nyona food and reasonably priced..

Author: Sally1138Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Leisure Holidays
Review: Since our hotel is nearby, we managed to find this restaurant around the corner. The place was quite crowded when we reached there. But since there is an empty table for a family, a waitress directed us to be seated and told us to make our order & will move us to the next table when the other couple left. Waitress is friendly and food served is also good. I ordered two veggie , pong Teh chicken & otak 2, and the price was not more than RM50.00. The fried eggplant dipped with the sambal sauce was also very delicious. Highly recommended for those who enjoyed Nyonya food in M’cca.Show less

Author: wkbtanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated!
Review: What’s the Q for? Nonya food looks like it’s hurriedly cooked & served. The ayam in the B Keluark dish is plain white & not marinated. Service is below standard & feels like they’re trying to get rid of us to fill up their cash register!There are other good nonya food around this food haven area so skip this one!We won’t be back for sure!Show less

Author: JUDYLEE2003Kuching, Malaysia
Title: A Taste Of Nyonya
Review: I dont really like nyonya food but since my family decided this place on our trip to Malacca, I am not disappointed. I love the asam prawns and the ngo hiang or spring rolls, I certainly recommend these 2 dish. Even though we came on a week day, there's already a crowd so I suggest you make a reservation first. The food arrived fast which is good.Show less

Author: Peter SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Nyonya Restaurant!
Review: Ten of us had lunch there last Sunday. Didn't make any reservation but luckily we arrived before 12pm and, as it had been raining, managed to get one of their big table.The food was just as good as my last visit more than a year ago. Some must-trys are their ngoh hiang, ayam buah keluak, Babi ponteh, steamed fish in pineapple sauce and sambal kangkong. Many others to suit all taste buds. They have only 2 desserts... chendol and sago gula melaka...both was good. Not cheap but good authentic nyonya food which I would recommend for all to try when in Malacca. Best to call and book a day or two earlier, especially on weekends and holidays.Show less

Author: anaestVancouver, Canada
Title: Authentic nyonya cuisine
Review: Melaka was my home town before we moved and this was one of my favourite earring places long time ago. I revisited with my mother recently after atmost ten years. The food was as good as I remember, although the restaurant itself seem slightly dated and could do with a facelift.We had Assam prawn which was very fresh, cooked with the shellls as all Assam prawn should be, and finger licking good. The kangkung belacan was spicy and not over cooked ( very easy to over cook this vegetables ). The fish head was not the type of fish we preferred but it was what it had. The curry gravy of the fish head curry was really nice, just enough coconut, the fish head was fresh but not meaty - that is just the type of fish it is, can not be helped.Portion was big for two persons and the price reasonable. It has not let me down after these years.Show less

Author: DJBadgerShipston on Stour, United Kingdom
Title: Peranakan pleasure
Review: This is a traditional, unpretentious Peranakan restaurant where you can get food unavailable in other parts of Malaysia. It's low key, relaxed and serves largely to knowledgeable locals. Selection of local dishes all well received and our Malaysian hosts recommended well. Price for 4 was RM102 - astoundingly good value. Be careful, because it closes at 2115, with last orders well before - so plan this in if you're ambling down Jonkers Street in the evening.Show less

Author: rosselinetTangerang, Indonesia
Title: Old school peranakan restaurant
Review: Fantastic vintage decor and delicious peranakan dishes that would take you back to your childhood or the old days like a time machine. Recommended dishes are the nanas or pineapple curry dishes and the cendol dessert. Definitely a must-visit when you’re in the old town of Melaka.Show less

Author: Eric Cham W
Title: Expensive & food is so so
