We find the food here better than some of the more popular and featured nyonya restaurants in Malacca. The service staff, comprising mostly middle aged ladies, are efficient and friendly. They are happy to tell you more about the dishes if you ask them. Very good value for money.Show less

Author: schnecki95Goettingen, Germany
Title: Simple but delicious
Review: It‘s a simple restaurant but the food was very delicious and the staff very friendly. We had to wait quite some time until the food arrived but since the juices were tasty as well it didn‘t bother us. The food is cheap. You can only sit inside. We would recommend going there! :)Show less

Author: TourleaderasiaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very tasty food
Review: We ordered several dishes, like okra, omelet, aubergine, springrolls, fried rice..and Kangkung...it was served in about 20minutes.very tasty! You can choose, how spicy you want it, and portions are, s,m or large..They also serve beer..Its not halal (they serve pork).Prices are not cheap for locals, but for Westeners very reasonable! It was full with Chinese guests.They have a toilet too..Show less

Author: irmalynsf
Title: Melacca tour
Review: Our lunch in this resto was part ot  our Melacca tour. The food took time to cook but was worth the wait....there were 5 different dishes with rice and house tea

Author: Robin CInvercargill, New Zealand
Title: Surprise delight
Review: We were walking through bylanes near Jonker street . Decided to visit this restaurant . We ordered nongya laksa , eggplant dish , pork rolls . We were pleasantly surprised . Laksa was fantastic , so was the rolls . A little sweet lady who served us were friendly and welcoming. Price was very reasonable.Show less

Author: Aimz-n-edzTauranga, New Zealand
Title: Lovely laksa
Review: Visited here not knowing anything about the restaurant and was very pleasantly surprised apart from having charming and attentive staff the food was fantastic we had the laksa which was delicious looking at the food everyone else was eating this seemed to be a concencous. Lovely fresh squeezed juices alsoShow less

Author: sohvilSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best nyonya food!
Review: Great authentic food at reasonable prices! 111RM for 5 dishes (including a whole fish) for my family of 5, service was great and the food was absolutely delicious! If you’re eating at this stretch of road, pick our kitchen! This was recommended to us by a local so you can trust what the locals, not tourists, eat!Show less

Author: CharleneT418
Title: Delicious Nyonya food. Lovely owner & staffs
Review: Love the pork buah keluak and chap chai! Friendly aunties and very cosy place to have lunch. Will definitely visit this restaurant again!

Author: LengL54
Title: Our kitchen Nyonya Restaurant Melaka
Review: My friend and I went to this restaurant for the first time yesterday and had the best Nyonya meal in a long time. We ordered the cinchaluk omelette, sambal udang petai and the steamed okra/lady's fingers. The sambal spiciness was just right- a bit of kick but doesn't numb your tongue. The cinchaluk omelette was crisp but fluffy and not too salty. The okra was fresh and the accompanying pounded sambal chilli was like the type my mum used to make.We felt so happy and satisfied after the meal.The waitress Mrs Gan is a warm and friendly lady who made us feel like we've just been invited to her own home for lunch instead of being in a restaurant. All praise to the chef who's done a marvelous job cooking the mealI'll definitely recommend this place to anyone who's looking for a delicious mealShow less

Author: GarrickouWuhan, China
Title: Excellent Nyonya restaurant
Review: The food is excellent. You hace to try the pork with the special nut. The Pai Tee are very good.The shrimp cooked in the coconut milk and pinaple is very tasty and the eggplants are cooked in the sweet sauce. The staff is very nice, specially a grand ma who will serve you and explain to you all meals. We definitely recommend this restaurant. Show less

Author: lihyenno
Title: What a gem!! Kudos to a 8-month old restaurant
Review: Melaka has lots of institutional Penarakan restaurants. Thinking that the market is pretty saturated, we took the risk of trying out "Our Kitchen", a 8-month old establishment.Wow, it certainly suffers no stage fright, and has served up its rendition of Penarakan food. We had Buah Keluak chicken, ngoh hiang, chin-jiak-lok omelette, chap-chai mixed vegetable and balachant egg plant. All was freshly cooked upon ordering, and executed to perfection.The total bill for 3 was MYR 94, including soup, Chendol and tea. Bravo. Strongly recommended, as it's tasty, representing the quintessential Melaka food heritage, and good value-for-money.Show less

Author: Spencer N
Title: Excellent service and food!
Review: We tried the Sambal Prawns, omelette, sambal fish and a few other dishes. Food is tasty! Service was quick. The staff actually even asked if we enjoyed the food or how we thought they could improve after the meal!

Author: Pretticila
Title: Delicious nyonya dishes
Review: Comfortable with Air-conditioned and clean eating place. The staffs are friendly and polite. This is my 2nd return to this restuarant. I missed almost all the Nyonya dishes here.

Author: Lawrence188Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Nyonya food
Review: This is a nice restaurant and near Jonker Street. Ordered pork ribs buah keluak and it is very nice. The Chef demonstrate how to eat the buah keluak. Pork ponteh is also very nice. Asam fish is also nice. Big n cosy eating area as it is in a old house and it is very long.Show less

Author: 391sashadKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worst service ever!!!
Review: We just got back from lunch- ordered chicken and pork and waited for 40 minutes patiently for the food to arrive. The chicken got served, which was all bones, no meat. The pork, they kindly served to another table. So at the end of the day, we had to share a plate of 4 small chicken pieces between the two of us, as waiting for the other dish would mean another 40 minutes.They are in complete disarray, running around like headless chicken, messing up simple orders. A Chinese family of 6, who arrived later than us, got served promptly, while we were waiting forever for our food. Maybe they don’t like to serve Indians - I don’t know.I usually don’t post negative reviews- but these guys really need to get their act in order. There are many similar restaurants around, which am sure, serves equally good food - what a waste of our time and lunch at this place. Show less

Author: spaggiaEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food. Very affordable.
Review: This restaurant was suggested to us by our guide on our day trip to Malaka. It doesn’t look much from outside and it’s in a side street just off the mains street but it’s really good. A large array of foods were brought to us chicken and fish dishes and vegetable spring rolls and lots of rice. We would not have gone ourselves so happy to have been encouraged to try it. Lovely elderly lady servesShe has little English but is charming and helped us understand names of dishes. Just along from this Restaurant is a foot massage place. Had the best reflexology foot massage in my life for £6. It’s on the same side as the restaurant! Show less

Author: wingkien2017
Title: Superb
Review: Simple deco but the food is good and tasty. Love the otak otak and the lemak squid with pineapple. Recommended and will be back for sure.

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very Tasty
Review: Nyonya cuisine is quite unique and has some special flavours. Though we did not try any of the nyonya dishes - there was only two of us and we wanted a light lunch.I had the laksa and my wife had the hokkien mee. Both very good indeed.Enjoyable surroundings in one of the heritage old time shophouses. Fair prices.Very good.Show less

Author: yllynn17Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Extremely satisfying!
Review: Hidden just off a junction in Jonker street, my family and I had an incredibly delicious nyonya meal here! The assam fish, eggplant, omelette and kacang botol are highly recommended dishes (I can still taste them as I type this). I'm not a huge fan of cendol, but the cendol here hit the right spot. Do drop by for reasonably priced authentic nyonya food with great service. Will come definitely be back Show less

Author: Gan O
Title: Excellent
Review: Great service and friendly staff.. serving delicious food as well... especially the rendang chicken and asam fish.. strongly recommend

Author: Ciara B
Title: Yum yum yum:)
Review: We visited Our Kitchen for the first time after hearing good things from family. The service was excellent, the staff were friendly and the food was scrumptious. We would particularly recommend the Cendol, Sago Gula Melaka, Terung Tempara and pork ribs Keluak. The pork ribs are cooked with a nut called Buah Keluak, which is really unusual. If you’re lucky, one of the waiters will teach you how to eat it in true Nyonya style!Show less

Author: augustines2016Genting Highlands, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Nyonya Cuisine
Review: One day trip to Malacca with my husband is the most memorable moment we had by having that delicious Nyonya food at Our Kitchen Rest. The taste of that sour slice pork, and crispy fried fish with sambal is perfectly cooked and well platting. Its 10/10. Great services by all the Mdm Gan generation make us both feel like home. The Cendol that we hd as the last course was very yummy coz the taste of sweetness is just fine due to we cant take too much sweetness. Fr sure, we will be back again to Malaysia and going to Malacca fr this food again. Great!!! Merci. Show less

Author: Billie J
Title: Great food and beer!
Review: Fantastic staff service. Nice ambient with adherence to SOP. Food was excellent. The difference was the personalised staff service provided. Well done to the service team and also the kitchen team for delicious food. Especially the KEBAB & TIKKA PLATTER!

Author: triprexy
Title: Poor food
Review: The bar was closed so I cannot comment. I ordered chicken vindaloo, the others biryani. Unfortunately having had Indian curries all over the world. This was the worst I can remember. Small cubes of chicken in a pathetic sauce that was rather tasteless and not spicy at all. The biryanis were not fragrant, were dry and very average. We could have got much better food for a third of the price and have had a beer with it too. Not recommended.Show less

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Hidden Gems of Indian Cuisine
Review: Decided to give a try after my recommended best Combo Briyani in town and the Fish Masala and truly it was. The trio Naan, Palak Paneer, Combo Briyani, Fish Masala and Chicken Pakora taste delicious, reasonable portion and price. The captain was very accommodating to us and recommended the dishes which we were perplexed to choose from the menu. This kind of service and recommending the outlet's signature dishes, suits to guest palette are no longer practised in a hotel at present but other standing F&B outlets and Rock Bottom does so I am very happy and proud of them. Keep going RB and I will definitely pitstop there to try the Chettinadu Chicken Pizza and Burger varieties. My appreciation and gratitude goes to Rock Bottom's Service and Culinary teams. Show less

Author: gotomix2011Taoyuan, Taiwan
Title: Awesome indian
Review: The indian food is great, but ask the great staff for advice especially for level of heat, especially if you are not accustomed to super spicy food. Almost everything is spicy, so ask for "not spicy" and it will be plenty spicy. Ask for recommendations and the staff will mix it right for you. Show less

Author: ZirfNur-Sultan, Kazakhstan
Title: Great ambience, terrible food
Review: We were looking for an Indian place with decent setup. TripAdvisor's suggestion was Rock Bottom and it was super close to our hotel.Good-looking pub with awesome dancing music from 90 and 00s. Very positive with excellent stuff. Unfortunately the food was really bad: paneer was like a rubber, chicken was dry and old, bloody Mary was watery. Naan, biryani and beer was ok, so go carboloading)))Show less

Author: RossR908
Title: Nice bar and grill
Review: Had lunch here. Both of us had the salmon steak sandwich which was well cooked and presented. Prices above the mid range but not too high. Happy to recommend.

Author: Melchua523
Title: Gathering Corner
Review: Yummy meals,excellent selections of drinks, good music and friendly staffs too. Best place for meeting up with friends n music are not too loud.

Author: Oskarbella13
Title: Rugby World Cup finals
Review: Great bar and restaurant! Went with friends to watch the finals - big screen tv- seats were great! Beer promo was great value and food was awesome! A must visit. And they also have a live band playing inside the restaurant

Author: Bally DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of my favourite hangouts in Bangsar because they have a secret (Read below)
Review: One of my favourite hangouts in Bangsar because they have a secret (Read below)Every single Rock Bottom you go to, be it in Johor, Melaka, Kuala Lumpur or Genting you are going to sum up in one word "Brilliant" why? because of consistency! Each place has all the listed below with the secret I mentioned on the subject:Great drinks (Beers, cocktails, whiskey you name it)Friendly staffGreat food (The secret recipe to the most tastiest Briyani served in a bar)Great ambienceGreat musicI love food, and the briyani in Rock Bottom is by far the best briyani I have tasted in any restobars I have been. And the funny thing is, It taste the same!If you want to catch a game, or early mid day drinks with your friends, choose any one of the Rock Bottoms. Super Thumbs Up!Show less

Author: DunreyLi
Title: Good Indian Food
Review: We chose Rock Bottom because they advertised North Indian Cuisine, which is just what we fancied after three weeks of eating Indonesian and Malaysian Food.  The food was great, staff were friendly and attentive and overall it was good value for money.

Author: sumianand8902
Title: Love it
Review: I love the ambience here, the variety of drinks and food. They have live band on the day I went (Saturday). Their live band is good too.

Author: KishioreKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: good & drinks not parallel to price
Review: The pizza was good although my taste bud could clearly say it was all about your MSG.Ordered Sangria, ohh..it was a lousy jar i must say, we left them half jar, it was that lousy.. I only enjoyed your life band & Rock Bottom, that was a good strategy but i again think your price will need revision else you will close down soon when Uncle Don opens there !! trust your customers !Show less

Author: arban
Title: too expensive and target for tourist only
Review: Too pricey unless you can use with euro and Singapore dollar. Not worth at all. soon will replaced another BAR owner. hehehe This Restoration previously was labodega somehow the price still good by the time.

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Quick dinner
Review: Dropped by for dinner. Had pizzas, burgers steak and pasta. Heard about the great Indian cuisine but did not give it a try. Overall the food was alright and as expected. Our total bill came up to RM400+ for 4 adults and 4 children. Not too bad as we had a beer tower as well. Next time we come back I will try the Indian dishes. Show less

Author: Kiara19Seattle, Washington
Title: Vegetarians beware!
Review: We used to rave about the food at Rock Bottom Melaka and were regular customers here right since the day it opened. The staff used to be friendly and provided good service as well. However, there seems to be a grave concern in the way the kitchen is functioning in this place. Yesterday I visited this place for lunch with a friend and being a vegetarian, I ordered the dishes I usually did here - Garlic Naan, Puri, Aloo bhojpuri, and a Paneer dish. We were almost done eating, when we were shocked to find a piece of meat in the vegetarian Aloo bhojpuri dish. We brought this to the notice of the staff, who immediately took the piece of meat with them, took it to the kitchen to talk to the cook I guess, then came back and apologised. We were so appalled by what had happened, however the damage was done and there was nothing that could be done to undo or reverse it. The damage control they tried to do was, they dint charge us for that ONE dish, but made us pay for the rest of the food. I am vegetarian for personal reasons, but can one imagine what would have happened to someone who was allergic to certain foods and the dietary requests were not implemented and they ended up in the hospital ?! If people were vegetarian for religious reasons, consuming meat like this would be a major transgression and offensive to their faith. This restaurant says they are halal, but who knows what is being done in the kitchen and what the customers are being served ? Who knows how many times this may have happened in the past and gone unnoticed by the patrons, especially since one cannot even see what they are being served or what they are eating considering the dim lighting in the evenings in this place. I will never visit this place again, since my trust in them is completely destroyed. Kitchen sanitation and food separation is so important in the restaurant business since customers place their blind trust that the food they are being served is clean and authentic (it should be what they say it is, for example, vegetarian or halal or sea-food free etc), and customers have no way of verifying it first hand. Let our experience serve as a warning to those who care for what they are being fed in this restaurant. Wishing them good luck to fix their kitchen and cook, but I am not taking anymore chances here.Show less

Limited seats and tables. 
This restaurant serves authentic and hard-to-find teochew foods; to name few the oyster noodles, fish maw soup, yam dessert and etc.

Author: neethaochaPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: nice food
Review: went May with family for dinner, supposed to go somewhere else but since too may people there end up coming here, the staff was friendly, they welcomed us assist us with the menu since its mostly in Chinese, food was served fast, well plated and taste was good too, price was reasonable, overall we enjoyed our dinner hereShow less

Author: EatnEatnEat
Title: Horrible service & food! A slaughtering house for tourists
Review: I went with a group of friends on 1st june during school holidays and made reservation vis what’s app in advance. The food was way below expectations. Those good reviews I believe are orchestrated to boost sales and they are not genuine. This restaurant used to be good when they were at the old small stall. The lady who took our order is also owner as this is a family business. We ordered a suckling pig in advance and she kept insisting we order fish, sea cucumber, sharks fin etc. we also made a mistake and didn’t ask prices for those under market price category. The food came and much to our disappointment. They were either very oily, bland and flat. Some were just normal. Not a single dish wowed us. Food so lousy that we didn’t bother to take photos and Bill was $2549 ringgit! Will never ever ever ever come back again! Rubbish placeShow less

Author: avanhanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Teochew Fare found in Melaka
Review: One of the few Teochew food found in Melaka which deserves a visit if you are there. Their signature dish of oyster noodles (photo attached) is worth trying. We enjoyed their prawn and pork roll given that their fillings were very well done as compared to others we have tasted elsewhere. The braised duck (photo attached) was good too. You don't want to miss the Or Nee dessert which every Teochews will die for (Chinese yam paste with ginkgo nuts), tasted just nice with less oil noted.The restaurant used to be at Jonker Street few years back when the place was small and a bit untidy as like most Chinese restaurants in those small little lanes all over the world). However the current location was really nice and neat and well air-conditioned. You need to make reservation on weekends to avoid disappointments as it is very popular with the locals.Show less

Author: Wally-SingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch at Teo Soon Loong
Review: We went as a group of 36 adults and 5 children for lunch just before our bus ride back to Singapore. The standard of the dishes, which we ordered at the time of reservation was very good.The steamed fish, ngoh hiang, teochew fried noodles, steamed prawns and other dishes were very good. Prices are a little steep though, but you're paying for the convenience of having a meal without fuss.A note to aileen22ang, I think the 4 empty tables were reserved for our group and another group that had just arrived before us. From what I observed, the restaurant is not a very large one and there are limited tables available, so very sorry.Show less

Author: aileen22angSingapore, Singapore
Title: ZERO star if that is an option under TripAdvisor
Review: Worst attitude staff ever. Blatantly rejected customers with no reservations made. It was lunch time and numerous empty tables available but was rudely turned off just because “NO RESERVATIONS” was made . They probably will not know how to serve a table WITHOUT a phone reservation Show less

Author: gwenlyn89
Title: Worse Service Ever
Review: The service provided is real bad. Staff are rude. They will sound to you and ask you to leave fast. Food ain't that good. I can say normal only. Food are pricey.

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Love the Teochew food here
Review:
Love the Teochew food here
Braised teochew duck, Fried oyster noodles, Teochew fried noodles, ngoh hiang, yam paste.

Author: LeoChengHiang
Title: A much waited Teochew food but so much disappointment
Review: A visit to malacca especially for the much anticipated Teochew food brings nothing but disappointment. I ate at this restaurant when they were at the old place. It was so memorable. But today when I visited this same restaurant, they have already moved to a new and bigger place. However the food no longer taste the same. It was very disappointing. Nothing was good except the yam paste. We ordered allSmall portions but it came in large portions. The suckling pig was so oily, the fish maw soup taste weird and everything taste really horrible. And I was shocked when the bill came! It’s so EXPENSIVE! I advise allSingaporeans not to come to Teo Soon Loong anymore . Don’t be fooled by all the reviews and ratings. They are not true and it’s not worth it at all. The prices are meant for tourists and locals won’t come here. Don’t be suckers !!!Show less

Author: FeiHinTingTing
Title: Yummy lunch
Review: Service is good. When order the foods, owner will give a lot of useful recommendation. Love the noodle and the desserts. Will definitely come back again whenever possible in future.

Author: RowdyMonsterKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Didn’t get to eat, told to wait as we didn’t make any reservations
Review: I can’t review about the food but I can say that I’m not impressed; four of us took a Grab to this restaurant; and being Malaysians, it didn’t cross our minds that we had to make a reservation first. So imagine our frustration when we were told to wait outside for an hour or more as we didn’t make any reservations. Instead of waiting, we walked around and found New Lagoon restaurant instead. Show less

Author: bhavani3001
Title: Delicious lunch
Review: Good service and delicious food. We had the fried rice and the belacan vegetables. Teochew fish stew was also good. Prawn rolls were fantastic.Very nice ambience, too.

Author: musashi777
Title: Delicious Teochew cuisine
Review: We enjoyed every dish that was ordered and discovered a couple of new things including oyster noodles & a leafy vegetable dish! Generous servings, food was served in good time and staff were courteous. Highly recommended.

Author: Pat CSingapore
Title: Pushy Sales Pitch Lead Us To Over Order Dishes For Our Lunch For 5 Pax
Review: The suckling pig was mouth-wateringly superb. The crackling was perfectly done. The not-more-than-3-mths old piglet was wonderfully tender. The marinade was an amazing blend of delightful tastes.The black sauce noodle with oysters - did not excite. It was passable... but only just.The spring roll with an entire full prawn was a celebration of freshness, texture and taste. It came accompanied by some deep fried wanton-looking dumpling which the hostess pushed hard for us to have. These dumplings, dumped on us, were lousy.Next was our nightmare dish. Soon kueh looking steamed dumplings in a black sauce.Both, the sauce and the dumpling, are best forgotten. We complained that when we last had it, there was no black sauce to spoil the dish. After passing the complain to several persons, one guy came and defended the dish no end - although he saw the uneated dumplings on the serving dish.The veggie greens we ordered were 'ok' .... but nothing to crow about.The pork rib bitter gourd dish, pushed hard by the hostess, was a disappointment. It came seemingly with the gravy watered down. Terrible.The wined chicken dish was an entire wash out. Also strongly recommended by the hostess, it tasted of wine and only wine. Haaiiizzzze.The ornee dessert lacked the yam bite. Its main feature was the yam flour powder strong after taste. And the chef must have been hoarding the sugar since our ornee came across as not sweet.My take on the experience. The outlet should ask if we wanted the dish sauced or have the sauce separately plated. They should ask if we want the dessert less or extra sweet.My tip is decide on the dishes yourself and not let the hostess run riot in recommending your dishes beyound the limits of your group's appetite.To play safe, order in moderation. Wait for the dishes to be served to familar yourself with portion size. Good Luck.For me, I won't hazard another visit. There are umpteen good eateries in Malacca after all..Show less

Author: Michael LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good and authentic Teochew cuisine
Review: Teo Soon Loong Seafood Restaurant serves very good and authentic Teochew food. As there were 2 of us, we had only 3 dishes - their famous braised noodles, braised duck and bitter gourd fried with egg. All 3 dishes, and the dessert (we had yam paste with gingko nuts and pumpkin - or nee) were excellent. We took a peek at some of the dishes other patrons were enjoying and they all looked delicious. The service staff led by their two supervisors were very attentive, helpful and efficient. The restaurant is very popular with locals, so reservation is highly recommended especially if you have big groups. Price is a little higher than other Chinese restaurants in Malacca, but we think it is well worth it. This was easily the best meal we had in our short vacation to Malacca. We will certainly be back the next time we visit Malacca.Show less

Author: bernardf0033Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Something worth trying
Review: If you are longing for a oyster noodles, you came to the right place. Don't miss this opportunity if you happen to be at melaka. Pls check out thier opening hour. I would suggest to book for a table before you go. Also try out the sweet yam dessert. Show less

Author: ngnyokfong
Title: Seafood place
Review:
Seafood place, fresh steam fish, big steam prawns, oyster sauce noodles, mee

Good and professional service, never force to order too much

Author: KaruTAJurong, Singapore
Title: Teochew Fare
Review: Visited the old spot years back. Wanted to revisit & try out in the current location. Greeted by the one of the ‘boss’ who asked why didn’t we reserve a table... not sure if it was meant to be a joke. Good thing there’s still a table for my family. Waited a good 15mins for our orders to be taken. Seemed like only the ‘boss’ & ‘lady boss’ were the only ones taking order & they are always busy moving in & out of kitchen. The other staff are only allowed to serve the dishes. Not sure why. The dishes took another 45mins to arrive. Good thing the standards were still upheld. The signature oyster noodles & yam paste were good!!This would have been a 5 stars if they can better manage work flow & develop their service staff. Otherwise, reserve ahead & visit when you have time for 2+ hour meal.Show less

Author: lionfishSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Team dinner
Review: We came for a team dinner on a friday evening around 8pm+, so there was a slight wait of 20mins due to the evening crowd. Ordered oyster noodles (with 2nd round as it was so good that it wasn't enough for 9 of us), fried white kway teow, 1/4 braised duck as they ran out of ducks, ngoh hiong / heh zhor platter, kong bar pau, egg and vege (for our vegetarian colleague) and orh nee for dessert. We had to cancel our fish maw soup order as we were too full.Overall great food if you don't mind the noisiness. Restaurant has aircon.Show less

Author: jennyharjitk
Title: Family Trip
Review: We came to this restaurant for dinner. One of the young guy was not so friendly as he told us next time called for booking first regardless you are coming from Singapore or KL, which we don’t know that reservations has to be done at first. We are a family of 4 Adults + 3 Child. We order medium size green vegetable, prawn rolls & Oyster noodle, follow by small size of clay pot chicken, bitter gourd pork & fry glass noddles with Chinese tea & a small plate of peanuts. I found that Prawn rolls was very nice, chicken was a bit salty & nothing so special about the Oyster noodles as recommended by many people. Total price is RM177.85, which I think is expensive per pax cost RM25.40 compare to portion of foods are so less. I don’t think will come again and many good restaurants with bigger portions or good price to offer here. Show less

Author: stephenieganSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food chasers
Review: First go @ this restaurant. Heard from some friends that the oyster mee Sua is good. Decide should give a go @ it. The suckling pig cost Rm250. Worth it cos Super good. The dishes were recommended by the staff and they served us well. Must go try! Price is highly affordable. Don’t miss this the next time you step into MalaccaShow less

Author: Tang0Brav0Singapore, Singapore
Title: @Return2Malacca Eat at Teochew Seafood
Review: If you crave for high quality, great service, fantastic tasting Teochew style seafood - go to Teo Soon Loong. It only has about 10 tables and kept deliberately small by its fifth generation owner to maintain high quality. Family members serve as cooks (his father and brother) while those more articulate work in the front of house. Order the steamed pomfret fish which was caught by its own fishing vessel to maintain freshness. The fried prawn ball / prawn roll goes well with a beer. Bitter gourd with pork was very succulent. Simply wok fried green vegetables (could not remember the name) was great. For something different try the oysters in dark sauce noodle - with a dash of vinegar it made a great appetizer. Finish off with traditional Teochew yam paste desert which is not cloyingly sweet with no regrets. You will not get any sticker shock. Phone ahead for reservations. I almost regret sharing this but good things must share...Show less

Author: MR_BiRD1Singapore, Singapore
Title: Pleasantly surprised with the service
Review: I reached slightly to 2pm on a Friday and was half expecting to be turned away as the lunch hour is until 2.30pmA young lady who i think is the lady boss greeted us and say they are still opened and don't worry.Recommended us some dishes like their signature oyster noodle, ngoh hiang, prawn roll & orh nee. Food was legit and affordable. The prawn roll rocks and the orh nee is not overly sweet and you will not feel sick eating too much of it.This is the part where it will contradict some of the reviews here that have some complaints about their service.The same lady asked where we were going after our meal and we mentioned about walking to Jonker st. She told us that it is a very long walk (thats true) and suggested to use grab taxi instead, we tried getting a grab to no avail. She then offered to call a grab for us using her own mobile phone and when it was accepted we thank her and waited outside for the grab to arrive. She call us back in the restaurant to wait in the aircon for the grab, telling us its too hot out there, meanwhile her staff is cleaning up and closing the place.Hows that for service?Show less

Author: Tan M
Title: Good Teochew Food
Review: Have visited this restaurant three times and have never been disappointed. Must try the steam promfret fish and the Ngoh-Hiang. The place is always packed so advance reservation is highly recommended.

Author: Twintowers
Title: Teochew cuisine dinner
Review:
Typical authentic Teochew cuisine.
I love the oyster mee and the 'chim choe'.
Also a must eat is their 'Or Nee' - soo yummylicious!

Author: ChongSeng
Title: Understaffed
Review: The food’s ok but the restaurant’s severely staffed. It took forever for us to be seated even though we had booking earlier and the food took forever to arrive.

Author: Lisa C
Title: Good food
Review: We (4 adults and 2 kids) ordered their specialty steamed promfret, braised duck, prawn spring roll, oysters noodles, minced pork taufu and yam paste dessert. Overall the food was good. Would recommend this place.

Author: Sally T
Title: Good Teochew food
Review: The service was very good. Food was on the whole tasty and reasonable. Loved the prawn rolls and yam paste best.

Author: Matzhuang
Title: Good food, decent prices!
Review:
Dinner was good, prices were decent for the quality. We came in a big group and were able to order a variety of dishes in smaller portions. 

Do make prior booking because we saw a queue when we were there!

Author: mona l
Title: Teochew Food
Review: Food is nice and a good balance of flavors. Love the yam paste. Not overly sweet. We also had the oyster noodles, Qing long vegetables which were absolutely yummy, and braised pork ribs with bitter gourd.

Author: arsenalrulz18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Horrid Service and average food
Review: Was there last weekend and will never return again- we had 3 tables ( came as a big group)- our table was mainly children -least no. of adults.I had to ask the wait staff at least 3 -4 times for the dishes to be served- our counterparts at the other 2 tables already had all of their food served and were almost finishing their food when our table had our first dish.When we feedback to the wait staff, no apologies- just the comment that : " if you want good food, you'll have to wait' .Come on- their food isn't that great to begin with and there is totally 0 customer service.BAD BAD BAD please avoidShow less

Author: SGEugeneSingapore
Title: Traditional Teochew food
Review: Come not alone but in bigger group. This will allow you to order more dishes to try, Since the early days in small house style restaurant, it has grown to a nice big restaurant but still the crowd is something to deal with. This is normal for many wanting a taste of the traditional teochew food. Show less

Author: HappiMummi
Title: Dinner
Review:
This is our first visit there since they moved to the new location. 

Food is still good but the suckling pig was a tad disappointing. 

Service - At least we get our food served and tea refilled. No complain - don’t expect 5 stars attention.

Author: LindaL834Singapore, Singapore
Title: Suckling pig -Thumbs up
Review: We booked a piglet 3 days in advanced but arrived an hour late for our reservation. The staff held onto the table for us and served the piglet promptly upon our arrival, amongst other dishes we ordered. Yam paste, braised duck and oyster noodles etc. Great food and even better prices... new location has ample parking Show less

Author: 26hoy
Title: Pricey and poor manners service crew
Review: Crew was terrible lack of patience taking orders and keep promoting that seafood that we are not going to try ..just not today. He was stunned and black face shown.

Author: AnnieL3007Singapore, Singapore
Title: Pricey Restaurant
Review: Ordered Oyster noodle, Omelette, Sweet and Sour pork, Ngoh Hiang, Vegetable and Yam Paste and some drinks which cost like RM300Oyster noodle is nice, the rest average. I am a super big fan of yam paste, for that, I must say the taste is right and nice but the texture is not so thick, still abit watery. Show less

Author: cu3974Singapore, Singapore
Title: Prefer the old shophouse location
Review: The food taste almost the same but with the old owner it just seemed nicer. Roast suckling pig was very very good and still highly recommended, as with the steamed fish (promfet) for us, oyster noodles. We also had excellent salted egg squid, tapioca leaves, and ngoh hiang. Sweet sour pork not too bad. The yam paste is still one of the best. would have given 5 stars if not for some hiccups. Soup came last and with reminder they churned it out really fast i think, and was very salty. Service staff looked inexperience. RM 1036 for 2 tables of 10 each (1 suckling pig divided into 2 halves). Still i will recommend this place purely for the nostalgia i had from the original shop. Show less

Author: Jo22luvTravelSingapore, Singapore
Title: TOP #1 Must try Chinese restaurant in Malacca
Review: The food is so good and value for money. Signature dish oysters noodle is uniquely tasty, prawn rolls, braised bittergourd with pork ribs, ginger honey chicken r just so delicious. We pre-ordered their piglet and it’s heavenly crispy & yummy. Service is good, the young Chef also boss is friendly and he personally takes the order at every table. Reserve a table in advance to avoid waiting.  keep up the good food. We will surely visit again.Show less

Author: SoGohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Teochew Restaurant
Review: Best Teochew restaurant in Malacca. Order at least 3 days in advance if you want to have the roast suckling pig. Oyster noodles is a must-order. Steamed pomfret is fresh so it doesn’t need anything fancy. Traditional Teochew food here. Not fancy. Not instagrammable but totally delicious.Show less

Author: Julienne L
Title: Just keep calm and move on to better places!
Review: Visited TSL when they were at the old location back in 2011 and it was one of the best meal we ever had. Fast forward to 2018, and despite mixed reviews, our family decided to go back to the newer location. Alas, service is not only slow, but the attitude of was slow and the standard of the food is no longer as good as back then.1. Sulky service - We had placed an advance order of the suckling pig, and was looking forward to it being the starter; alas it was served to us as the third last dish. And that was after a few rounds of chasing, which was received with negative attitude by the daughter in law who said we didn’t inform her personally. Really? If one has placed advance order for suckling pig, shouldn’t the restaurant be the one who serve it to the guests without having to be told?2. Mixed up of dishes - Oyster noodle and fried rice came first before the other dishes. Size of the order was also mixed up. After informing the son and daughter in law who seem to be in charge now, we were shown some attitude as she said we should have inform them directly, not their servers... hmmm.3. Quality of food and pricing - The steam pomfret was good but for 180RM, it better be. The suckling pig, after all the wait and hype was underwhelming for 250RM.Overall, while the place is now bigger and has a nicer seating ambience, the kitchen does not seemed to be able to cope as it is still one chef cooking for a much bigger group now, resulting in slower service and frustrated customers.Will I recommend this place again? Nah... there are so many other options available in Melaka now. Even the locals agreed! So just keep calm, and move on.Show less

Author: GraceN1010
Title: Family dinner
Review: Waited a bit for the table even though appointment was made. But the service staff was friendly and quick wit. Food was nice, I like the oyster noodles, and orh nee.. overall, good place to visit as long as you don’t mind the wait.

Author: gideon_fooZhongzheng District, Taipei
Title: Standard had dropped
Review: I was so excited to go back to this restaurant since it’s old place at Jonker Street. Despite the poorer reviews lately, I decided to give it a try as I missed the roast suckling pig. The pig was still delicious but kinda small. Sad to say, the oyster noodles and or ni were poorly done. The oyster noodles had a fishy smell, and the or ni’s portion was small and too dry. Felt embarrassed cause I highly recommended my friends that restaurant. Won’t visit again. Sad that good food usually deteriorate after shifting of location and renovation. Show less

Author: ysl_juniorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Teochow food!
Review: Dinner time is busy. We called to make booking and still have to wait a while. We ordered a few dishes and most of it turned out really well. Somehow only the adults enjoy it. The kids don't really fancy Teochew dishes.The shop is located at some new shoplots, and parking is ample.Show less

Author: CasChen
Title: Lunch
Review: Had lunch there and the restaurant is quiet on a friday.   The teochew food is average and nothing to rave about.  Price is expensive as we have rm 650 for a group of 8 persons.  The braised duck is over cooked.  steamed fish is good

Author: oztraderPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Teow Chew Dinner
Review: Used to be my favourite restaurant in Melaka, now they moved to this new premises. The place is well decorated, very clean and services is good.Foodwise, maybe i still think of that cramp little old shop that they cooked infront of the shop.We ordered most of the dishes we love but few of the dishes dint live up to my expectation.The steam Teow Chew pomfret was not up to the standard, it tasted frozen fish.The braise duck is still tasty and tender, braise sauce is impressive.The prawn rolls, softshell crabs are good but is pretty common in tastes.The 豆根with cabbage is ok.The oyster noodle is delicious with very balance taste, the sambal that goes with it is pretty nice.But hardly find few pieces of oysters. Arrr..Kind of disappointed maybe still expecting it to be like om the old shop.Show less

Author: JiggyKikiMalaysia
Title: Acceptable dine
Review: Went for dinner. Set-up is typical chinese wedding style and comfortable. Service abd food came fast so there was no long wait. Ordered the curry prawn and was not blown away. Instead it's a wee perplexing. Fusion of thai and indian. The oster noodle is a generous portion. More than enough for 2. Meant to be eaten with vinegar else it's tasteless. Do give the qing loong vege a try. It is fresh and crunchy, really nice. Price point, it an upper middle range.Show less

Author: JasmineLWT
Title: Terrible lunch
Review: The worst sweet and sour pork we ever had. Teochew style steam fish was fresh but tasteless. Oyster and braised noodles were so so only. Expensive and not worth. Will not come again.

Author: lavend3rmistSingapore
Title: Great oyster noodles
Review: I haven't been to melaka for a few years and the last time I visited this restaurant was still at their old place. This new place is way cleaner and more spacious than the previous place so I was lucky that I could still walk in without reservation on a Sat lunch time. They only allow fixed sitting at 12pm and 1.30pm.I was craving to have their oyster noodles again and wasn't disappointed. Didn't get the teochew steamed fish this time but saw many other patrons ordering fish. The wu xiang roll is also very good and crispy without feeling oily on the outer skin. Would still be back again the next time i'm in melaka! Show less

Author: KoolBlueSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average at best
Review: After reading some rave reviews about this place, our family decided to give this place a try. Having tried great Teochew cuisine over the years, the food here is average at best. Plus given the prices they charge, the quality of food certainly disappoints. For the amount we spent here, we could get much better quality food elsewhere. The other thing that puzzled us is that we were not allowed to add on to our orders once we have placed our orders at the beginning. Overall a very average experience in a highly rated place. Show less

Author: adsimsfKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Will Return Again
Review: Good Teo Chew food. The staffs were friendly and service was good. The dishes recommended by the waiter was excellent and the portion were just nice. The waiter will stop you to order too much unlike some other restaurant(s). Will definitely return when I go to Melaka again.Show less

Author: CindyL3890
Title: GOOD TEO CHEW FOOD
Review: Nice food, great service, friendly staff. Original teo chew taste! Must try signature oyster noodle. I had taste the best suckling pig ever!

Author: SexyStern
Title: Horrible Experience
Review: This is my first time visited this restaurant and one word to describe, disgusting. I have waited for 35 minutes until I was served for the first dish, for the fact that few tables beside me came later than me have already been served. The food is nothing more than dining in a hawker stall. The portion is small and it is extremely expensive. Feels like day light robbery.Show less

Author: archmage
Title: Another Boring Chinese Restaurant
Review: Please add this to your list of yet another Chinese Restaurant. I attended a function last month and in due course ended up here for dinner. Dishes were run of the mill. Wouldn't recommend it. There are much more inspiring restaurants in Melaka.

Author: Robin C
Title: Excellent Value and Quality
Review: When we walked in the staff said they were full as reservations are made one week in advance. However they told us to wait for the next available table. The boss however gave us an unoccupied table after 5 minutes. We ordered a whole Roast Suckling Pig, Steam Pomfret, Braised Duck and other dishes. Prices were very very reasonable. Quality of the food was excellent. The suckling pig was very crispy and tasty while the pomfret was very fresh.Anyone who enjoys Teochew cuisine must try this restaurant when in Melaka. Please remember to book in advance.Show less

Author: Mcflick89Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great authentic teochew food!
Review: Place was very crowded! But we were lucky to get a seats for a group of 7! Ordered all the recommended dishes by the restaurant. Super love the traditional teochew prawn roll. However, do note that you must place all your orders at one go. They do not allow additional orders after which. Overall experience was good. Should come! Show less

Author: HarvardCatCatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Over rated and rather pricey teochew fare
Review: Went there with a big party of 10. We made reservation and also preordered a suckling pig. We waited for about 30 minutes before we got seated. The suckling pig was served very quickly but I was quite disappointed with it. The dish was oily and the texture was chewy more than crispy. It was also rather pricey at MYR300. We ordered their signature and other popular dishes including steam promfret, bitter gourd with pork, egg omelette, oyster noodles, nor hiong, etc. The steam promfret (MYR120) was quite tough and the dish was served lukewarm. The other dishes were also mediocre at best. The yam dessert tasted weird as they addd spring onion oil. Overall, I find the place is over rated and pricey (our bill came up to MYR 700+, twice the price of a typical meal we paid at other restaurants). Will not recommend this place. There are definitely better and cheaper options in Melaka. Show less

Author: VoothSingapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Wanted to try since we saw a few posts but went there late at about 9pm. They mentioned last order was over and asked us to come back and offered to take our order in advance and so we did. Went back at lunch and was promptly seated, service was good. However, to me the food was overrated. We had the steamed pomfret which was ok, their signature braised duck, which was nicely braised but the portion was small and bony. Other dishes we had were stir fried vegetables, prawn roll (hay zhou) and their oyster noodles and all were just average. I would not go again if I'm in Malacca.Show less

Author: erikag596
Title: Get together
Review: I like the chicken wine soup the most! The location is easy to locate & easy to find parking too. Comfortable with air-con. Serving time is fast. Staff is polite & friendly.

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fantastic Teo Chew restaurant
Review: It was a splendid meal. We ordered favourites such as oyster fried mee, stewed duck and orh nee and all were outstanding. The service was also very good, although they were packed for the night. The two of us spent less than 90 ringgit for the meal. Show less

Author: meaningremissionSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Craving for Tiow Chiu cuisine
Review: This restaurant has since moved to a new place from the famous old shop in Jonker street. A much nicer and cleaner restaurant but the taste have changed, not as tasty has before where it was operated by the old uncle. Apparently, it's now run by his grandchildren. Still miss the old cooking. They still serve some of the old dishes but somehow, the taste has deteriorated. Sounds the same but doesn't taste the same.Show less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Suckling Pig
Review: Had dinner with a few dinner associates and their wives in this restaurant and to my surprise I found the food in this restaurant excellent. This restaurant was before this located somewhere near to Jonker area but has since moved to this location.One of the best roast piglet I have eaten and it is a must is here. Another all time favorite and you must have is the oyster noodles which has been brought down from father to son.Among the other dishes we had was steamed bun with braised pork slices & yam, oyster omelette, stir-fried spinach, pork trotter and pork roll. All these we average in taste.But I do love the dessert which is yam paste with ginkgo nuts, which again is a must try in this restaurant.Just for the roast piglet, oyster noodles and the yam paste with ginkgo nuts dessert, I would give this restaurant a 5.Show less

Author: ahliang9981
Title: Great restaurant
Review: Service is great! Food is good n authentic Chinese Teochew style. Remember booking is a "MUST"! Walk-in on weekends will disappoint.

Author: Silver_MimiTawau, Malaysia
Title: Best Chinese food in Melaka
Review: I have been a fan of this restaurant since my first visit to their old little shop 10 years ago. I had my dinner there tonight at their new address and the food were extremely delicious , especially the bitter gourd braised with pork ribs. This dish was simple but comforting . I can gobble down 2 bowls of rice with just the gravy from this dish. Their signature oyster noodles were so savoury that I slurped down every bit of the dark soy sauce from the plate. The staffs were polite and efficient, especially the enthusiastic son of the chef/ boss. I would recommend this place to those who would like to have delicious decent Chinese food in Melaka with affordable price tags. To avoid disappointment , please call to make an appointment as this place is usually fully booked. Show less

Author: Ernest K
Title: Best Teo Chew Restr.
Review: Nice Teo Chew Restr. Good Service. Please book in advance as they are always pack. Specialize in Suckling pig(good) Oyster mee, steam fish..etc. A must to try when you are in malacca.

Author: Olivia S
Title: Food and more food
Review: We had an excellent meal with our girlfriends. We went there early at 12pm so we were the first customers. The waiters and waitress were young and was helpful. We liked the noodles, steamed fish and the dessert. Good food and a clean place. Will be back! Show less

Author: Mouse-PrincessSingapore
Title: Surprise if that is the best in Meleka
Review: I was invited to Meleka for wedding dinner n my host booked this restaurant for our lunch. He said this is the best Teochew restaurant so maybe my expectation was too high, kind of disappointed after I tried the food. All the food were average. I only like the yam paste dessert....one of the best I Hv tried. Their specialty black noodle with vinegar taste ok too. The fish was well cocked but not tasty ... Show less

Author: cin9y
Title: suckling pig!
Review: Chinese resturant. need to call in in advance if you would like to try the suckling pig! food was good.

Author: Patric01
Title: Nice Chinese Teo Chew Restaurant
Review: This is a pretty nice restaurant for having lunch or dinner.  Their bitter gourd with pork ribs, fried egg and bee hun are nice and enjoyable.  Their tao co sambal is very good as well as suckling pig (must pre order).

Author: Bluejamzz
Title: Good food but booking is a must to avoid disappointment
Review: After hearing good reviews, finally got a booking and went to try. Place is not that big but spacious road outside with plenty of parking.  Overall satisfying meal with all meals an above average rating imho.  Great for family dining

Author: RaymondHoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Same classic Teochew cusine in brand new location
Review: Teo Soon Loon Chan Kadai Makan has moved from 55 Jalan Hang Kasturi to 42 & 44 Jalan KPKS 1, Kompleks Perniagaan Kota Syahbandar with air-conditioning and can now cater to 20 tables. The steamed Tao Cheoh Pomfret, Oh Luak Oysters, Coffee Pork Ribs, Ngo Hiang, Glass Lettuce, Foo Yong Omelette, S.P. Buns and Oh Nee Yam Dessert tastes just deliciously same. Total bill for 11 of us with 4 Carlsberg & 1 Guinness came to MYR538.10Show less

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Lacking of the Wow Factor
Review: I visited this restaurant with my family early this year. I was told by my dad that this eatery has been around for decades from father passed down to his son. I was told the cooking used to be way better back in those days when this was just a small restaurant near Jonker Street. Based on my taste buds the food tasted fine but nothing to shout about as their dishes are in lack of the Wow Factor. The owner who happens to be Chef greeted us and he explained to us briefly about his dishes sounding really proud of his cooking skills. In my opinion the cooking capabilities of the chef should be at our discretion to evaluate.Lack of space hence the need to ensure guests book tables and arrive in a timely manner. Retro posters of old advertisements and old Chinese celebrities can be seen pasted unto their walls which is somehow a good effort to relinquish the dull looking interior by bringing in the old school feeling.Place seems clean and service is not too slow even during a full house. Overall , its a good place to try out Teochew food but nothing spectacular.Show less

Author: XavierTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Teochew Food To Go Back For
Review: The food at this place has been consistently good over the years. Steamed fish, bittergourd with pork ribs, oyster noodles and braised duck are the dishes we order every time, and they never disappoint. The special chilli paste is absolutely delicious too. Service is very friendly and efficient. This is definitely one of the better Chinese restaurants in Malacca.Show less

Author: auntiedorisIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Lost the Magic of Homely Restaurant
Review: We had very good experiences during our 5 days stay in Melaka two years ago. The food was fantastic and the young man was friendly. He was all the time ready to share local good food. His hospitality and friendliness would always made you very comfortable in that small and old outlet. We went there yesterday but the whole atmosphere had gone. He was there busy with mobile phone and could not bother to look at his guests. The food standard had dropped tremendously.Show less

Author: XYZP-SGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good suckling pig but had better teochew food elsewhere
Review: Suckling pig was good, requires advance reservation; just as well as you need to reserve a table too. It's prepared in anticipation of your arrival so it's served almost immediately after you placed your order for other dishes.Braised cabbage with sea asparagus was good, heard the bitter gourd with pork ribs were good was well but that was sold out.The signature oyster noodles were disappointing. Miserably small oysters that didn't taste fresh, noodles tasteless. I say leave the black noodles to the Hokkiens, teochews do kway teow (unfortunately I heard TSL's chai por kway teow is mediocre).Also had ngoh hiang, braised duck, orh nee, chai por omelette, all were decent but none was outstanding.Disappointed with braised duck because teochews are the best in braised duck, sadly not here.Chai por omelette was delicious but taste more like carrot omelette instead.Overall, a decent meal but there's much better teochew restaurants in SG (albeit costlier). Nonetheless, at RM250 for the crispy suckling pig, this would warrant a return visit.Show less

Author: shanrysetia alam, klang valley
Title: Best restaurant experience
Review: Food -thumbs up! Service - double thumbs up!! Suckling pig, oyster noodles, steamed fish etc all yummilicious. And service needs special mention. As a Malaysian having eaten in so many Chinese restaurants, this is the best I've seen. The staff is pleasant, attentive, more than willing to answer any questions even if it means checking with the chef several times about the contents of each dish - absolutely excellent!!! I'm chronically allergic to crustaceans & most restaurants I've been to barely give a cursory response to my questions on the food content. This was a breath of fresh air indeed.Show less

Author: DominicY35
Title: Lost the Magic after moving to New Location
Review: Having very great experience from their original old outlet at Jonker Street, we were looking forward to dining at their new place. Proved to be a utter disappointment.Food standard was way below what it used to be. Oyster Noodle and braised duck was bland, no "Wok Hei" whatsoever. Left with a bitter taste and disappointment. They have lost their nostalgic Teochew touch to their cooking.Will not be back.Show less

Author: WarrenH750
Title: Teochew food without a soul: clean venue, good service but bland taste
Review: We had great expectation for the restaurant and were very happy to grab the last table of the night when we called for reservation. It has moved out of Jonker Street to a new development that is a bit hard to reach for tourists.We were disappointed by the pared down menu, a renowned seafood restaurant without soon hok fish and grouper, no fresh prawn but only pomfret! It lacks the other signature Teochew dishes such as cold crabs, marinated goose etc. either.It makes wonder if it has been acquired by a PE fund such as L Capital ...Show less

Author: carroth2016Singapore
Title: Good ole Teo Soon Loong Restaurant
Review: Simple good teochew food. 6 adults. We ordered 8 dishes - Oyster mee sua, braised sea cucumber, stewed duck, fish maw seafood soup, minced pork spring roll (ngo hiang) , BBQ pork ribs, yam paste dessert, rice and drinks. Total cost M$334.10 inclusive of gst .The sea cucumber dish is a must-order dish. Value for money, cost M$169 (abt S$56). It is braised to the right texture - soft but firmed. Served whole (abt 9inch long n 4.5inch wide), so you have to cut into a few pieces yourself. Definitely good quality sea cucumber as it has soft spikes on the outer surface. Closed on every Monday. Tel no: (I) 06-2880209 and (II) 012-6035464. No 42844, Japan KPKSI, Komplex Perniagaan Kota Syahbandar, 75200, Melaka. GPS coordinates - E:102'13'55.9'/N:2'11'50.5'. Opposite 707 Hotel. Opening hours: 12pm-2.30pm; 6pm-9.30pm.Show less

Author: wildfloweredSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great find
Review: They've moved somewhat out of the city and are now a little hard to get to unless you have a car. But on the upside, they are now much bigger and parking is a breeze. Still serving the same great hearty food at reasonable prices. Reservations recommended, especially on weekends.Show less

Author: Panda6551Singapore, Singapore
Title: Simple and Yummy
Review: They use to be a small "hole in the wall" restaurant at the Jonker Street area. This is a welcome change. Lots of parking space.We had the oyster noodle and mee sua, which was tasty and felt like it was braised. The oyster omelette was fully, the kong bak pau with yam was glorious. Not too much fat on the pork meat and the sauce was just right. We also had the teow chew money bag as starter.Meal ended with yam paste desert. Divine !Need to book to avoid disappointment. GPS co-ordinates E: 102'13'55.9' N:2'11'50.5'Show less

Author: Jeremy_C_MH
Title: 'Destined' to return here .... hmmmm
Review:
After a tapas restaurant goofed up our reservations, we somehow ended back here.
 
Still ok, the local veg is still great, as was the  bittergourd & pork.

But the kong pa pau standard was really dropping in quality :(

Author: kennlaicPuchong, Malaysia
Title: If you love with TeoChew foods - must try !
Review: General -: @ 19/06/2016 - friendly staff & boss - good foods , environment , clean Price -: - reasonable price Weekends & holidays -: - must do booking to avoid long waiting Q up .Note -: - * not sure why the setting for beverage counter set next to toilet entry position ??? - * personal prefer the wash basin bottom park be coved or not put any cleaning tools.. Show less

Author: greenestbubbles
Title: Fantastic Teo Chew food
Review: The food was delicious and the portions are good for sharing. Just make sure youake a reservation earlier as they are filled up pretty fast. Reservations can be made via whatsapp which is pretty cool.

Author: Phelino C
Title: Nice Ambiance, Reasonable Quality
Review: The location is strategic as its located outside of the usually congested melaka raya area. The food was good with some unique dishes. Its recommended to make reservations before arriving as it gets pretty packed especially during weekends.

Author: donovanSYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simply amazing
Review: First visited this restaurant when they were located near Jonker street. It was a quaint lovely old place then and now its in a sparking new complex further from town.The food still taste amazing, the oyster noodles, the suckling pig, the yam desert, the steamed fish-promfet were simply amazing. Not too salty and not too sweet or heavy.Standards did not drop with the location shift.Cannot wait to visit this place again.Bookings especially during Jun or December when hordes of travelers visit this Meleka is a must.Show less

Author: E5711HHandytSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the price.
Review: I placed a reservation 2 weeks before arrival and ordered a suckling pig. Upon arrival, there was a promotion menu of RM850 which included the suckling pig and a few items which I wanted to order originally. So I took the promotion package which is nett price and included the tea and service charge. Firstly, the suckling pig texture was jus not right. The skin was crispy, but when you take a bite of it, the fats and meat could not be detached from the skin. They whole piece remain chewy in your mouth. The steam pomfret is over cooked. And it is lukewarm when served. And some of the shell of the prawns stuck to the meat when shelling. The recommended oyster noodle was blend. I asked to replace one dish with the duck which taste ok, no wow factor. The rest of the dishes taste just ordinary. For this price, I seriously would not recommend. Show less

Author: huiling16Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Teo Chew food in Malacca
Review: The food is one of the finest Teoh Chew restaurant I have tasted. And parking is so much easier. Strongly suggest to call and reserve before you go there: it is fully booked even in week days. I craving of the oyster noodles with black sauce even better when you add vinegar, . the fish we had is really fresh and nice, we order traditional Teo Chew stewed duck and I found it finger licking good and ending with the yam paste with fresh gingko nuts.Show less

Author: Esther8833
Title: great taste ever
Review:
enjoy the great meal with "home" taste... something different from the others .. 
miss the oyster mee soooooooo much...

Author: edwinlycSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food at reasonable price
Review: Enjoyed the meals and service is good. We had our lunch at the restaurant. Do note the last order for lunch is 2.30pm. I do advice to call and reserved the table if you are going in a big group. Our group felt the orh nee portion is quite small for a group sharing but it is delicious. Show less

Author: Robin CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good service, nice ambient
Review: The service from the staff is good. Friendly and welcoming. We observed that they are attentive to diners' need during our dinner there. This provide a positive dining experience as a first time customer.As for the dishes, it didn't leave me a strong impression, just average in my opinion. I'll return again or recommend this restaurant as long as their service is good.Show less

Author: tweensong
Title: great taste but pricey
Review: Quite nice Teochew's food delights, they provide a good environment but the price consider little high......

Author: Brendan Yong-Ke... P
Title: Melaka 2016 SAS old boys reunion
Review: Best Teochew restaurant in the world! Food was simply fantabulous. Thanks to our Melaka friends Hau and Alex for introducing.

Author: Jeremy_C_MHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad la - a near yearly visit
Review: Usual black noodles is good.Salted egg squid is really nice.The kong bak pau was cold !!! - had to reject it - it subsequently caused someone in the family the runs. The fish was really good - cleaned it out !! And the veg - nice and fresh ! Show less

Author: PatYKC
Title: Amazing PIG !!!!
Review:
The suckling pig was and is one of the best I ever had ! Not sure how much it is as my cousin paid for it but it was good. 
There's a pic that paints a thousand words. Enjoy this place !

Author: Sia65Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing special..
Review: My first visit to this restaurant. Felt that the food is not that fantastic. Probably over-rated. Waiters were too enthusiastic. After first waiter took our order, poured our drinks or checked if the Teapot was empty. Another would come within 1 minute to check again. It's quite disruptive for conversations.Show less

Author: MyLittleLife
Title: Authentic teo chew cuisine
Review: Went there recently for granny's bday celebration. A great place for family dining. Food was very nice.excellent customer service!staff are helpful and very responsive. Thumbs up!

Author: Chow Hock SSingapore
Title: Not as good as I thought it should.
Review: This is new site for the restaurant, The decoration is not upscale enough, and does not fit into a laid back type of Melaka restaurant. It is still a popular restaurant among the locals. Reservation is required. When you enter the restaurant, all the staff ( yes, it is all) will greet you loudly to make you feel welcome. But this will happen to all guests entering or leaving the restaurant. As such, you may not have peace of mind to dine. The dishes are not great or special. The waiter can't wait to clear the dishes whenever you are almost to consume each dish. Price is reasonable. Show less

Author: RichardChiaB
Title: Not as good as at Jonker
Review:
Ordered the oyster noodle but no oyster today. Replaced by Brai noodles. Too dry.
Ngo Huang and Pomfret fish. Total bill RM $118.

Author: XiangLi12Macau, China
Title: Not nice, bad service, not worth your money!
Review: We ordered suckling pig which was too dry and it's not me alone who felt that way. I thought it was my problem but everyone on the table also complained the same thing. The other dishes were not up to standard also. We ordered steam fish which was NOT fresh! Service provided was very bad! I remember one waiter who can't wait to just serve all the dishes at one time, like telling us to FASTER EAT AND LEAVE! They even keep looking at you when you eat! Very rude! They didnt mind to hear your request at all, we ask for the dishes to be served a little slower but they didnt care! Total price was so expensive even though we ordered just a few dishes. I can say any chinese restaurant is far far better than this one!Show less

Author: dickwanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: 1st visit to the restaurant. Called 2 days before to make booking for a table. Also pre-ordered a roast suckling pig. After submitting details received a Whatsapp message for confirmation and also the full menu and directions to the place. Very efficient indeed. The pig was really yummy; crispy skin and succulent meat but not at all oily. Other dishes also tasted good and the yam paste dessert deserves special mention. Price, in my opinion, is reasonable for the standard of food served. Staff were very attentive and friendly.Show less

Author: tenglenglim
Title: Very value for $$!
Review:
Had roast suckling pig, 6 dishes and yam paste. Coated around 600+ RM. For the group of 12 persons, it worked out to be $10+ per person. It was definitely worth the money.

The promfret is a must! It was very fresh!

Author: Faeza A
Title: Yummy Chicken Rice
Review: If you like the Bukit Bintang Chicken Rice, then you must try this one for sure! Really love love love the steamed chicken, so juicy and tender plus its Halal. Must try!

Author: neversaydontPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: If u are looking for better
Review: If u are looking for better hygienic place to dine in. Yes I think this is one of the best choice in Melaka. Personally the food to me is better than average but somehow I can eat peacefully instead of worrying some of the staff that do not follow SOP at this moment.So I would recommend you guys to have a “safe” meal here instead of the taste itself.Show less

Author: mushroom001
Title: good dinner
Review: takeaway is much faster as there's a long queue during main meal time. the taste is okay. the rice ball is really nice.

Author: MizSally24
Title: Authentic chicken rice in town
Review: If you want to eat chicken rice balls with tender steamed or roasted chicken, this is the place. Avoid dining peak hours, come early or later to savour the chicken rice.

Author: creaboulait13
Title: Good lunch place that kids will love
Review:
Unique twist to the usual chicken rice. Plenty of nyonya dishes to choose from too, if you are not a fan of chicken.

Good SOP in place during COVID. Recommended!

Author: mohdoqbaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over the years same fantastic taste and quality
Review: Whenever we visit to Melaka, its complete with out having a meal at this place. I love the food and the humbleness of the owner. In this struggling RMCO time he greats us with a smile and I hope he keeps this establishment open for years to come. The chicken rice balls are yummy as always and both steam and roasted chicken are superb. And who can resit the spicy asam pedas fish and umami of fishball soup.Show less

Author: penangbatu
Title: The manager was hostile and arrogant!
Review:
The manager was hostile and very rude to us! This is unacceptable behavior to tourists to Malacca.The food was fine but really spoilt by the service and attitude!
i do not recommend if you are a tourist.

Author: KLbizTravellerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food - too much hype
Review: Overall, the food & service was good. However, I would not list it as one of the "Greats". I would recommend trying it at off peak hours as the queues can be long. Honestly, you could get equally good chicken rice at other places minus the hassle of queing and squeezing into tables with strangers. But hey, that's all part of street eating in Melaka for your instagrammable moments... : )Show less

Author: OctopauloMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Sumptuous HALAL chicken rice
Review: When you’re in town with friends and family with non-pork preference, please go to Ee Ji Ban; where I always found to be reasonable at their price and especially their impeccable service etiquette that you don’t wanna miss during your Malacca hectic traffic, EJB is the place to chill you down with sumptuous chicken riceShow less

Author: Larriechan
Title: Worst Chicken Rice Ever
Review: Came to this place after seeing long queues during lunch hour outside the place. Decided to give it a try and oh my the taste is so bad. Portion is small and taste is mediocre. Don’t understand what the hype is about.The chicken taste like it was roasted for just 5 mins. Seriously a normal chicken rice stall in Singapore will beat it hands down.Price is so so portion is small too. Come to this place if you want to be disappointed. You will be so much more satisfied skipping two meals here and having one proper one in one of chicken rice chains in Singapore.Show less

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Nice chicken rice balls
Review:
Nice chicken rice balls and dishes. 

Both roasted and steamed chicken are very nice. Meat is tender and not too fat. 

Garlic Kang Kong is nice too.

Author: Cadenza88
Title: Returned visit
Review: Went back again with family the second time. The first visit was couple of years back. Still tasted good and worth the time in the queue. The kids love it!

Author: manhattan64Hong Kong, China
Title: Popular Local Joint for Chicken Rice Ball
Review: This place is recommended by a nice young lady selling ice cream on Jonker Walk. We saw the place is fully packed and with 1 table available so we were lucky not have to wait. The fish balls in the soup was tasty and bouncy. The steamed chicken was tender, the Assam Mackerel Fish was excellent and we love the sauce. Since it’s a Halal restaurant so no alcohol beverages at all.Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Hainanese Chicken Rice
Review: What they are good at is the authentic Hainanese style chicken rice: rice steamed with chicken stock, and steamed or roasted chicken. If you are on a budget then the basic chicken rice dishes suffice. Thats where the reasonable price commensurates.Above that, when you start ordering other supplementary dishes in the menu, the value for money drops and the whole affair becomes a tad pricey for what you get. The portions for the supplementary dishes are small for the price you pay. They have not factored in taxes in the prices either so be forewarned. Show less

Author: Misz SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bad service, disappointing quality. Terrible and overpriced food.
Review: Visited just because the hype of it but very disappointed with the service and quality of food. Ordered chicken balls, roasted chicken and sotong salted chili with petai. Total failure. The sotong chili small size cost rm23 comes with small slices of sotong totally overpriced. To make things worse I witnessed w my own eyes the restaurant manager asked a person to leave as she just want to sit there with her friend as she is vegetarian. He insisted that the restaurant is for serious diner who must order complete set of rice no less. For me it's a total turn off and will not come again and will not recommend for others to come.Show less

Author: Nur I
Title: The best rice-ball in town
Review: Nicely done food, roasted chicken was amazing. Fast service. Had a great time with family. Definitely coming back.

Author: tinkikuttih
Title: Nice delicious chicken rice
Review: Want to try something new. Try their chicken rice ball. Halal certified. Fast service. Staff are nice and friendly. Yummy delicious food to try.

Author: vikneshbmwPort Dickson, Malaysia
Title: The worse chicken rice ball in melaka . Don't go.
Review: This shop previously is the famous chicken rice ball shop. . But nowdays the worse . The chicken is tasteless, rice ball not hot at all ,its chill . And the price like eating gold. . Very small portion. Terrible shop. Not even have place to sit relax and eat becouz ppl are q to come thia shop. Im sure all of them are new to this shop. . Please avoid this shop. You giys can fine more better rice ball shops in melaka city and jonker. Show less

Author: neenakady
Title: Nice Food. Friendly Host.
Review: Visited Melaka over the weekend. Went there at night, for take away, queue was short. The host, 1 gentleman suggested a perfect potion for us to order for a family of 6pax. Food was generally great. So the next day, we came back but to dine in. Queue was long, but the wait was not. When we finally got a table, 3 babychairs was already place. We order 3 potions for kids meal, whole chicken for us adults, and about 40 riceball. As we can only order once, hence we tried to order much, but the Sir is experienced enough to tell us to cut on the kids and order altogether-Whole chicken, riceballs and our other order. Well to be fair, orders like riceballs, can drinks, or anything which has already been prepare, you can order it umpteen times. But those that requires cooking/preparation on the spot, you can only order it once. And thanks for the suggestion else we have lots of wastage. Food overall was great. Nothing to complain. Riceball is nice. Kids love it! Our 2 and 3 years old girls sat down and eat silently enjoying her chicken and riceball especially, which us rare. Chicken is good. We had roasted ones. So its crispy and delicious. Loving it! Chilli, can do better, a bit watery and mild spicy. So for a person who loves spicy tangy chilli like me, you will find the chilli so-so. Ambience, quite ventilated, not airconitioned but not hot either. Queue and wait time is well controlled. Service is fast and efficient. Would definitely come back when i visit melaka again.Show less

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: Eat fast and go
Review: This famous eating place is supposed to be so popular and busy such that you must be a serious diner who eats fast before you are welcomed there. No additional orders once you have placed your order. So if you realise the serving was smaller than expected, eat, go out and come in as a new customer if you want to order more..Also, no drinking without eating or hanging about. Fast, fast, fast..others want your seats!! Nothing great. Place is lacking in ventilation and suffocating, so rightly so you should eat fast. Naaah..not for me. Eating is an experience and a journey, where no matter how nice the food, you would not enjoy it like this. Even if it was to fill your belly, you need not take this route.Show less

Author: KelvinN345Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very disappointed with quality
Review: We visited this with long queues for lunch on a Sat afternoon. The rice was small and moist, very poor quality. The chilli was the worst part, watery and tasteless. We called the mixed half chicken for RM28, this is the only redeeming factor, taste alright but average only. The rice ball is over rated and so expensive! No more visits for us!Show less

Author: BeenConned2019
Title: xtremely xpensive.
Review: The small size rice ball priced at RM0.40 each is really truly and shockingly expensive. The chicken is also much pricer than most restaurants selling the same food. Just because its the only halal restaurant, the owner is taking advantage by selling at exorbitant price. This is clearly cheating the customers. The authorities should take action against this unscupulous seller.Show less

Author: TJLim
Title: Nice Rice Balls and Chicken
Review: Rice balls and boiled white chicken were quite tasty as usual. Chilly was good. U have to wait and share table if necessary. 2 of us had 20 rice balls as the balls were really small.
