Author: ElmolitaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice food but long wait , can only order once
Review: This restaurant is Halal so it attracts many customers. But the Queue can get really crazy for such a small joint. The rice balls are small fishball sized and delicious. Chicken wise is also not bad. Overall the food standard is good. Just that the queue can kill.Show less

Author: WBtravelingJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Had to do takeaway because i ordered too small in qty.
Review: I come in 2 person, ordered only those in the picture, just curious and wanted to try it, at that moment we've already eaten so we cant eat much anymore, the owner said we cant sit down if we only order those items (5ball, 1set roasted chicken). from the overall taste it was ok but not that amazing.Show less

Author: auraee
Title: overrated
Review: This chicken rice shop is overrated, the soup we order tasteless and also the rice and chicken i dont think is delicious. There are other options better than this.

Author: Angelin C
Title: Not bad food
Review: The boss was friendly and approachable but not the staff there. Food consider not bad for a halal chicken rice. Chicken is soft and moist, chilli is good! Rice can be more fragrant, more like oily rice. Recommended for halal friends!

Author: Van TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but v. crowded
Review: We aimed to avoid the crowd by getting lunch there about 1.45pm. Had to wait about 15 minutes to be seated ... and about 25 minutes before the food came.The chicken rice balls were small ... almost bite size which was good but suggests you need to order more. The chicken was also succulent and tender ... though not outstanding, taking into account the competition. The fried fish was a bit of a ripoff ... the wait staff had recommended it but we didn't find it exceptional -- the price maybe; it was more expensive than the chicken.One note is that they didn't allow/encourage adding to your initial order. I guess something about camping on a seat -- but its a little odd it seemed to not allow ordering more rice balls or chicken.All told its a better bet to eat here than in the Jonker Street Chicken rice ball shops wait wise ... it seems like a tourist trap at teh Jonker Street Chicken rice shops there ... Show less

Author: andrewong2024Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not hype and worth the queue!
Review: I’m from Singapore and chicken rice is one of our national dish so this chicken rice from EeJiBan is really above decent level. Especially in Melaka where there are many rice ball restaurants with most just serving as tourist traps, this was really good. Queue was fast especially if you have lesser ppl. So if you’re in a big group, you likely have to wait longer for a table. The chicken both roasted and boiled tasted succulent. But the boiled one was more tender. Rice ball wise, was fragrant but mainly novelty. I will go for the usual rice serving the next time I’m there. Show less

Author: IwanYoeliantoJakarta, Indonesia
Title: DELICIOUS AND GREAT HALAL FOOD
Review: Coincidencely, my hotel is very near to this shop. I tried before and ordered single portion. The taste is delicious, second time anf more i ordered half roasted chicken, boild chicken and many more. The chicken inside is very juicy and fully cooked. The vegetables are not too salty. Omelette is damn good. They are known and adjust their taste which menu should be salty and not too salty. Food is absolutely healthy. They make not too oily but still keep the quality. Price is consider average exclude service and government tax. If you take away order plain or chicken rice need to additional pay 0.50 cent the plastic box (microwave passes quality). So as my experience, for those people need have to be double rice to eat for 1 person, i suggest tell them the double rice combine together in 1 food container so you may save another 0.50 cent to separate.Show less

Author: naphthys
Title: Love the chicken rice and rice balls
Review: The chicken rice and the rice balls are so delicious. We had to come back twice to satisfy our craving for this. The chicken was roasted and so tender with the right amount of seasoning. Yummy

Author: RyanAng77Singapore
Title: Not too bad
Review: Had a chance to visit this restaurant after hearing so much about it. We ordered half a chicken, vegetables, fried eggs and of course, the rice balls.We felt that while the food is not too bad, it wasn’t anything special. I’ve eaten lots of chicken rice from Singapore and Malaysia, and I’ll rate this as above average. Be prepared to wait too because the queue is long.Show less

Author: mdabdillahSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice but pricey!
Review: The roasted chicken is tender and juicy and skin is crispy. Chicken rice is fragrant. The much anticipated chicken rice ball is just tasteless. Don't think it's made from chicken rice. Probably from normal white rice. You will have to order separate chicken and rice. It doesn't come in sets. And it does not include soup as well. Had to purchase fish ball soup for our meal. Great marketing strategy! Food prices a bit pricey for a chicken rice restaurant but prices for drinks are moderately priced. Went once for the experience but won't be coming again if i come back to Malacca. My sincerest opinion. Show less

Author: PhangKT
Title: More than just chicken rice ball on menu
Review: Tasty and fresh food. Service is fast and staff is patient and welcoming. I ordered children /sampling portion with 5 rice ball n chicken so that I could try other dishes on menu.

Author: Lynn F
Title: Love the drink!
Review: In love with Pure Honey Lemon cold drinks served in hot sunny day. Tried rice balls, roasted chicken and the soup. Delicious.

Author: goh_ginnySingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty but crowded
Review: We went there for a late lunch and it was still filled with people. Ordered a whole chicken, chilli kangkong, fried egg, fishball soup plys rice and drinks for 6 and it amounted to less than RM120. Value for money and tasty meal. Come here to eat each time we visit melaka.Show less

Author: megaz2017
Title: not as seen on tv
Review: stepped inside this because of their big advertisement infront of the resto. they were on tv. it should be nice. i was wrong. the rice and chickens were tasteless. the omelette ok. the homemade barley was the only 1 become the nicest thing among those.

Author: vivianTismeSingapore, Singapore
Review: 1️⃣My 1st time having chicken rice ball & it's not bad2️⃣I went with my mother,so it's only the 2 of us & we got the seat quite fast even though we were behind the queue(have to share the table with others that is oso alone or just 2-3 pax group)but if U have a big group probably have to wait quite awhile to get seats3️⃣Compulsory to order 1 plate chicken for each pax but serving is small so ordering 1 plate chicken each pax is alrightShow less

Author: sauber182
Title: Chicken Rice Ball tasteful.
Review:
All is well. Everything here was perfect. The rice, the chicken, the vegetables, the soups, the drinks, the sitting place (which you don’t need to worry). 

The things you need to do is eat till full and go back with happy tummy.

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: A pleasant surprise
Review: Ask someone to name a typical Melaka food and even a Singaporean will likely suggest chicken ball rice. (otherwise also known as chicken rice ball): fragrant chicken rice you know and love shaped into cute little golf ball sizes. In the entire state of Melaka, only one is halal certified – Ee Ji Ban.Although I’m generally not a fan of halal Chinese food, I was pleasantly surpised and impressed with the excellent flavor and texture of the rice and dishes. It was busy and almost full when we arrived for dinner which we took to be a good sign. In addition to chicken rice balls, the menu offers nyonya delicacies. The sambal sotong (squid cooked in chili paste) is a crowd-pleaser if you fancy something with extra heat.It is official, and who knew it: halal chicken rice ball is a thing. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…Show less

Author: ShuhadatulainZ
Title: Suitable for diet peeps!
Review:
Yummy chicken rice and suitable for diet people which we only can eat two balls and it's enough!

But it quite expensive compare to normal chicken rice, and why not for the experience!

Author: ecnyew
Title: Excellent place for Halal Chicken Rice ball in Melaka
Review:
The food is great and very affordable. However, parking is difficult especially during weekends. Service is excellent, fast and efficient staffs to serves us timely.
Will definitely come again.

Author: Silviauput9Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great Rice Ball
Review: Its not easy to find halal chicken rice ball in melaka. Been walk in the jonker street, and so far its not halal. Then i search and find this one. Though its not near jonker street, but the food is great. The chicken rice ball is delicious. Combining with the boiled / rosted chicken, big smile dont forget to put some chilis to make more delicious.Show less

Author: sanjay nPenang, Malaysia
Title: One of the top ranks
Review: EeJiBan is a restaurant that I will never miss each time I come to Malacca, chicken rice balls mated with tender roasted chicken, fish ball soup, belacan vegetables and of course the asam pedas fish is excellent. Waiting time can vary depending on when you are there, if peak season then it takes longer hours waiting for your table. On the pricing, it is on the higher end for chicken rice but I felt it's ok as I come as tourist but might hurt your pocket if you are a frequent customer ( also depend on what you choose). Setback that I will say is the space..might Need to upgrade the restaurant as it feels cramped sometimesShow less

Author: Zmil1008Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Chicken Rice Ball in Melaka
Review: Very efficient in serving customers, while waiting on que we can have a look at the menu and decide on what we want to eat. But a bit confused as you order chicken rice set but no soup together, you need to pay for the soup separately we also not satisfied with the chicken portion. Anyhow it's Sambal udang petai really captivating us away.Show less

Author: IzzahAfifahismail
Title: So so
Review: The rice ball and fish ball soup quite salty to my taste. Went there last Sunday before 12pm and quite surprised coz there was no long queue. If you want to go here better avoid during lunch hour.

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Chicken riceballs
Review:
Tried both the fried and steamed chicken, stir fried vegetables, fishball soup, egg omelette. 

All the dishes are pretty good. Fishball Soup tastes great too.

Author: andrewmikaelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Having Lunch
Review: 6.November.2018Tuesday 2PMMelaka is a food paradise in Malaysia..Name it Assam Pedas,Coconut shake,Kuih Keria Antarabangsa,Roti John,Putu Piring Generasi Warisan keTiga,Baba Nyonya food,BBQ fish etc...But this time around i wanted to try very famous Chicken Rice Ball Ee Jii Ban.The rice full of aroma and testy (nice smell),Roasted chicken was testy and delicious,nyonya chilli salted cuttlefish & prawn was very delicious (recommended) and Baby Kailan with soya sauce was not disappointed.The environment of restaurant is clean,tidy and cool (very good air conditioner) even you seat at outside the shop.While you in Melaka this one you much go and try!Taxi Mpv KLYou Private Tour Guide In KLShow less

Author: kenengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazingly tender and fragrant roasted chicken
Review: The roasted chicken was amazing. Fragrant and tender. Half chicken for 4 was at RM24. The chicken rice ball was the size of fish ball. Can try but I am not a fan of clumpy rice. Baby kailan was nice. Ordered other dishes like savory chilli prawn and cuttlefish. Probably deserve a 6/10. Verdict go for chicken and vegetables. Rest were forgettable. Btw restaurant is halal certified so can get quite crowded.Show less

Author: hakimali85Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Chicken Rice in ball shape
Review: Very unique food. instead of chicken rice on the plate, the rice is shaped into balls. the food is nice and the place always packed.unfortunately the food didnt go well with my taste. but surely a restaurant where you need to vosit at least one time.Show less

Author: RinaN285
Title: Not so good for me
Review:
The rice and roasted chicken is tasteless.. Dont think to come again.. I think
 overrated by people..

Author: Julian WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good place to try Malacca chicken rice ball
Review: This is a friendly restaurant to try the famous Malacca chicken rice ball. There is always a queue at anytime of the day, worst especially during meal time. So just proceed to get a queue position and wait. The rice ball is much better than those that I had tried, it is fragrance and soft. the condiments is perfect. The dishes that you can order along with the rice balls are equally delicious. The balls are rather small so a plate of 20 for 3 adults is a good start. The two hosts speak good English so language is not a problem.Show less

Author: izulianaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious chicken rice & roasted chicken
Review: We just pass by the shop and see the halal logo. We decided to try since they offer baba nyonya type of food. We ordered chicken rice ball, chicken rice, roasted chicken, sotong sambal salted, fish ball soup & baby kailan. For us, chicken rice & roasted chicken is good. Will come back again.Show less

Author: mafmSel_mlysiasel,mlysia
Title: Halal chicken rice ball
Review: Went to taste the famous chicken rice ball and it’s halal . It’s packed with customers and we have to sit and wait for our turn in the hot humid weather but the boss and the workers are working efficiently and got table to all of us in acceptable time. The place is cleanThe taste is good, not greatThe chicken ball is softThe roast chicken is better than the steam Show less

Author: cu3974Singapore, Singapore
Title: So so only
Review: Ordered half roast half white chicken, prawn omelette, sambal salted sotong with petai, tapioca leaves with garlic. And rice balls of course.Roast chicken was not too bad. But white was terribly plain, and texture was boring. The rice balls were ok but very small. An adult will need about 10. Veg was ok and probably the best dish here. Sambal sotong was extremely disappointing. As for the prawn omelette, it's hard to get that wrong right? In short, an overrated place, it's probably crowded due to its good location. Our bill was 160rm for a party of 4 adults and 2 children. Show less

Author: Karen_Goh1
Title: Not too bad
Review:
Taste is not too bad. But regretted ordering their sambal seafood platter. Too expensive and prawns are small de shelled. 
Their garlic fried tapioca leaf was good though. Rice ball not very fragrant. Price is ok except for that sambal seafood !!!

Author: agoh69Singapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing chicken rice ball
Review: Disappointed with the chicken rice and the meat. I think it is overrated by many. The rice not even fragrant and meat was blend, quite tasteless ! Both fried and steamed chicken. Ordered few other dishes like petai prawn with sambal, fried egg prawn omelette , fried fish with sambal and drinks. The price is not cheap and we spent rm180 for 1 roast Chicken and half boiled chicken, egg omelette, petai prawn and 2 slices of batang fish! Service is so so and luckily we came off leak time, else the queue is not worth to even try. They don’t even offer you free soup for chicken rice.. won’t come back ! Show less

Author: 602sitihajar
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Worth to try the rice ball if you feel bored to have the normal chicken rice. You can have it with chilly salted prawn and chicken grilled. The kailan also is served fresh. Opsss dont forget to order the cincalok omelette as well. Worth spending👍🏻👍🏻

Author: 701zulh
Title: Not up to the mark
Review: Went to this restaurant for dinner with friend following suggestions from others. We ordered half roasted chicken with their famous rice balls. The rice was nice and tasty. But the chicken just OK. Their soy sauce is just a normal bottle's salted soy sauce. And the chilli sauce was not up to the mark. I have tasted better in other places.Show less

Author: SiambuddhasSingapore, Singapore
Title: used to be
Review: it was used to be nice..but somehow maybe that day we went and tasted not as before... i ate here 3 times and 3rd was the worst feels and taste ...so seems like we are not going back anymore and rather stay in jonker street side for their chicken rice instead of a long long walk....if worse...just come back to SG and there are tons of Chicken rice around...Show less

Author: astridpramudyaBangkalan, Indonesia
Title: Halal chicken rice ball
Review: At the beginning of my food search, i want a halal chicken ball in melaka since many unhalal food in there. they have a halal certification.Food : must try chicken rice ball, very deliciousLocation : right after dataran palawan go straight, turn right after the second starbucks, it was loacated on the left. i went there by walk for about 20 minutes from quay side hotelprice : affordable food in a low priceShow less

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Can give it a try
Review: Since is halal therefore is Malay styles cooking. I mean the BBQ chicken is not typical chinese style if u have try Chinese n malay styles before u know what I mean. Taste ok. Assam fish is small n expensive. Not many customer when I'm there no queue at all. I don't understand why still take so long to chop the chicken that is ready to serve. Show less

Author: Keyvira
Title: One of Halal Chicken Rice Ball in Malacca
Review: For Moslem traveller, you'd better try this Eejiban Chicken Rice Ball, because it has halal certificate. and try their famous chicken rice ball. my favourite was roasted chicken and rice ball, because I like the crispyness from roasted chicken skin. the soup is also nice.

Author: KeMo916
Title: cute rice ball
Review: had some rice ball with chicken, but eventually filling my tank with a plate of rice in the end. the small rice balls seem cant get my tank to be filled up. overall the food was ok

Author: mathyoocylSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not sure what's the hype
Review: Not sure why there are long queues now as a few years ago when I visited there wasn't much people visiting this place. There was a queue for lunch but no queue for dinner at 6pm on CNY day 1 (16 Feb 2018).Food is average - wont say that its very good or anything. Show less

Author: maryamabelKlang, Malaysia
Title: Delicious steam chicken
Review: The place was crowded, and we have to wait for some time for our food. But the staff was warm and accommodating, working with urgency. The chicken rice ball and steamed chicken were delicious and suited our palate. But the price is a bit on the steep side. The table seems old and dirty, ought to change to a new one.Show less

Author: nork210Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: foodPon
Review: viral food and i try it. the mark i can give only so-so. price quit expensive. i love to try nasi ayam and if i compare nasi ayam all the malaysia. i love nasi ayam at teluk intan. just small gerai but server the best nasi ayam. Show less

Author: Catherinas L
Title: Delicious
Review: The food is very nice. Each rice ball RM0.40. I wondering why they didnt split ginger sauce with chili sauce. They mixed it up.. hmm.. I dont really like the "mixed sauce". Overall it is very good.

Author: Gideon_LamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Crowded but chicken rice ball was quite nice
Review: When I went there with my friends, the place was really crowded. I think it was because it was not only Sunday but that the food was good. When i tasted it, the chicken rice ball was quite nice. The chicken tasted good too. The food was served really quickly too. Recommended for people who wants to try chicken rice ball.Show less

Author: weheng
Title: Succulent chicken
Review: We always see a long queue at this shop and finally tried it one day.  We had roast and steamed chicken and the chicken is so juicy and succulent.  Taste is good.

Author: MademoiselleMidJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: So-so
Review: Went in at around 11am on a Friday noon and was practically empty but did took some time for my 3 sets to be ready. Ordered the balls with chicken and some fishball soup. Each plate of 10 rice balls (adult portion) with some slices of chicken at RM9 was slightly too expensive in my opinion. Rice was slightly bland (probably prefer normal chicken rice) and so was the roasted chicken. My taste bud seemed to prefer the steamed chicken option though. Ee Ji Ban should consider increasing flavor of the rice and probably more spices for the roasted chicken. I would say it was an ok experience.Show less

Author: zacandmeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointed .... lost its nobility
Review: Not my first time to this place. Usually, the food is ok, acceptable but this time, the quality and quantity have dropped tremendously.The chicken rice ball has got smaller in size and very dry. It tasted plain too. The non-ball chicken rice tasted like plain steam rice. I had to re-confirmed if they have given me the order correct. The place was very crowded. The queue for late lunch was about half an hour. The staffs and the owner were attentive but service was slow due to shortage of manpower. It was posted on the wall that they have a shortage of manpower, therefore, waiting time is longer and shop closes on Thursday.Show less

Author: ClaraW93Singapore, Singapore
Title: I guess this is not my ball of rice...
Review: We have so many friends recommended the chicken rice ball, I guess it is fun to look at, but I prefer my rice to be light and fluffy rather than hard and chewy. The unique selling point of this is the rice ball, but take that away it is just normal chick rice. It is not to my taste.Show less

Author: 634dinisSerpong, Indonesia
Title: Cold food, so so taste
Review: We waited quite sometime until the food comes. We thought they need time to cook the food. But then its stone cold! And other table who came after us got the food early. Quite disappointed.Food taste fine but overrated. Quite bland in my taste. Portion adequate, 1/2 chicken for 2-3 people. Place small but homy.Show less

Author: mandywzhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth every penny
Review: Need to queue but it was pretty fast so we didnt have to wait that long. It was my first time here & i do feel like coming here again next time!Price, food & service are fine to me. I personally had 10 rice balls & I love the boiled chicken. Thank you!Show less

Author: Charles T
Title: Not the best for Chicken Rice ball
Review: This is not a worthwhile place to visit as the food is generally mediocre and for what they charge it is not good value. There are many other places to try Chicken Rice ball and we suggest that you go to these others/

Author: Weemeister
Title: Good lunch stop
Review: There was a queue when we arrived at 1.20pm on a Saturday. We were 4th in line n waited 5 min. They were efficient and cleared tables quickly. Love the chicken rice balls though it was not exactly the most fragrant. The steamed chicken was tender n mild in flavour. I qualify to say that I'm used to more flavourful chicken doused in soya sauce and sesame oil. The chilli was mild too . It's great when you've had very rich food as is abounding in Melaka. I've not tried the other well known A' Farmosa, so no comparison.Show less

Author: EricJohn
Title: Great food and friendly staffs
Review: Loved the food and excellent friendly staff. They have many variety dishes to try which is great especially spicy squid and roasted

Author: terrociJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Must try chicken Rice Ball.. cheap but delicious
Review: The price range is friendly for backpackers. Usually, the queue of this place is very long, but luckily I was just wait around 10 minutes. I was order roasted chicken, rice ball, fish ball soup. The rice ball is very tasty, unique, little bit salty, and also has soft teksture. this place is suitable as a lunch place before ur walking around in malaccaShow less

Author: elesen123Kuala Lumpur
Title: Won't come again
Review: The chicken portion (rm9 with 10 rice balls) was so small that there wasn't enough to finish the 10 rice balls with. Luckily we ordered other dishes. The rice balls were salty, so the mouthful was even saltier with dishes added. It gave me a too-rich feeling and felt 'muak' quickly. The 'rules' set seem cocky - the food was below average anyway. Only go if you need halal chicken rice ballsShow less

Author: Sara A
Title: Yummy
Review: Be prepared to queue if coming during weekends. Closed on Thursday. Yummy chicken rice ball. And most importantly it is HALAL. We ordered chicken rice ball, 1/2 roasted chicken, fish ball soup & cili garam sotong. Total bill was rm65 for 2 pax.

Author: cats674Singapore
Title: Great chicken rice balls!
Review: The chicken rice balls here have more taste and the rice grains can be felt more than the Famosa chicken rice balls. The roast chicken was the best we have had so far.The lemon juice was delicious too. There is always a queue, but the wait time is not as long as anticipated. The staff are quick and the customers generally understand that this is not the place to linger after your meal, so the turn over is fast. We only waited less than 10 minutes for lunch on a Sunday a little before 1PM. Show less

Author: JohanNg_1991
Title: Great Chicken Rice Balls
Review:
Chicken rice balls were good, rather flavorful as compared to a lot other stalls I been to. 

Chicken was great too, especially roasted chicken. Personally prefer that over the white chicken. 

There was a proper queue system in place, so that

Author: favoured77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Halal Chicken Rice Ball experience
Review: We've had chicken rice ball in other shops in Melaka. This is the first time we had a "Halal" chicken rice ball experience! You see different races in the restaurant - all enjoying the chicken rice ball.Admittedly, it may not be the best chicken rice ball but it's not bad too - worth trying. You can order other dishes in addition to chicken and rice balls and the other dishes are tasty and delicious too.There are photos of celebrities and you can videos of celebrities paying a visit to the restaurant for chicken rice ball being played all the time.Show less

Author: Racefield2013Zwolle, The Netherlands
Title: Something special for a European having chicken rice balls
Review: I like to share my experience as a Dutch Guy having Chicken rice balls.First of all: I didn't know it. I went here with my girlfriend and two friends from Kuala Lumpur and they showed me this place. The food is very tasty and and the chicken rice balls are rice balls with a chicken flavor instead of a bowl of steamed rice.We've ordered this with several side dishes like chicken, omelette, shrimp with bitter beans and vegetables. Delicious !! And fast and friendly service. The restaurant is not that big, looks more like a local cafe, is simple but clean. One thing to mention: As this is a very popular place everyone has to queue at the door. The guy which manage the tables has a very good memory, He notice only numbers of waiting people in his notebook (no names) and rather fast he organize a table. Impressive. Good experience for me and nice for you to to as well.Show less

Author: szotdogsMelbourne, Australia
Title: My only chicken ball rice experience was a good one
Review: Since this was around the cornrer from my hotel I had wanted to visit but was put off by the queues. On my last day I decided to give it a go and thankfully as a solo traveller I didn't have to wait too long to be seated. This meant sitting with others at a table but that's OK. Now for the chicken ball rice. There have been other places where I could barely detect any chicken flavour in the rice, but not here. As I had been eating a lot that day I only had a very small set, but it was very enjoyable.In hindsight I wish I'd had more, but my waistline probably doesn't regret it!Show less

Author: QuatoKuato
Title: Tasty Food
Review: Food is very tasty. Quality of food has been consistent, for about a year apart. Service was pretty quick. The only down side is they only allow you to order the rice balls in multiples of 5.

Author: yswonders
Title: A different experience to chicken rice
Review: Join in the fun for the balls - a different way to eat chicken rice. Pretty delicious, both rice and chicken but when compared to some other solid chicken rice joint (without the drum up ball type rice), it does not measure up. Also got to queue for table though the management of the line was pretty efficient.Show less

Author: theresasg17Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Chicken Rice Ball
Review: The chicken rice ball was good. For the Rice, I ordered quantity was very small per person. Price wise it is quite pricey. I ordered the sambal prawn with petai was 42 ringgit. Small quantity and not vey fresh. Average standard for the other dishes. Be prepared to queue during lunch time for at least 30 - 60 minutes. Ambience average coffee shop. Dont expect much for the dining area. Eat quickly and go type.Show less

Author: johnxavier
Title: EeJiBan Chicken Rice Ball Halal
Review: I think the Chicken rice ball is overrated.The taste was very average.Compared to the chicken rice in Singapore.

Author: Amirah A
Title: Delicious
Review:
Recommended. Avoid visit at noon on weekends as it will be flooding with people. I would definitely come again. 

The rice ball is a bit saltier than regular rice. But it is still delicious.

Author: Stratovector
Title: The normal rice is much better than the rice ball
Review: I'm not sure about others, I just like the normal rice they serve than the rice ball. The rice ball is a bit saltier.

Author: daniellim76
Title: Halal chicken rice ball
Review: Is a halala chicken rice ball restaurant. They do serve chicken rice (not the ball). Rice is nice and chicken are nicely cook..

Author: Lukiutari
Title: Yummy Chicken Rice Ball
Review:
The only halal chicken rice ball reataurant that I know in Melacca. 
Been our favorite "makan place" everytime we go there. 
Usually will be very crowded with, but the wait is worth it.

Author: Indonesian-Jetset
Title: Some things different about Chicken Rice.
Review: Chicken Rice Ball is a special culinary food that is found in Melaka. When we visit Melaka, we must try this. EeJiBan is very close to our hotel, so we tried it... and we like it...

Author: VelestrynSingapore, Singapore
Title: Try it if you've not tried it before
Review: I've not had chicken rice ball before, so i just wanted a taste of it. We got the kids set to share (5 chicken rice balls at 8RM). The size is good if you just want to sample. The white steamed chicken was soft and tender (just like our Singapore's chicken rice, especially with the chili sauce). The rice ball was mushy, but i can't comment much on it since i've got no comparison.Show less

Author: KiddySing
Title: Fairly ok chicken rice and rice balls
Review: Not bad quality. The chicken was tender and tasty. Chilli was good. Portions small, so order more if you have a bit appetite. Service was efficient and pleasant.

Author: JustinlyhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: No choice
Review: We stumble at this restaurant when there were no other restaurant available during lunch hour.. everywhere full and crowded. We entered the restaurant, waited for more than five minutes, no one come to service, after ordered simple two individual plate chicken rice, took more than five minutes waiting. The food portion was so little, tiny and pathetic !So..come to this restaurant when you have no other choice.Show less

Author: 234keet
Title: Brilliant food but wee bit pricey
Review:
Party of 6 adults and 1child. Had quite a fair bit of orderings , great food, fantastic services and easy to park. But a bit pricey. The whole chicken cost rm50 and sambal prawn rm49. 

Other than price, will definitely be back for more

Author: Tino898Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Chicken Ball Rice
Review: We have 8 person, we order half mix chicken. Asam fish, sambal petai, egg and 2 vege dishes. We want to reserve our stomach space to go for 2nd round satey celup. The chicken rice ball is 40cent per piece. It is nice until you can take it plainly. It come with 10 pieces per order. We order 40 pieces. Overall the food is yummy. We enjoy so much and sure will come again.Show less

Author: youke_worldwideSingapore
Title: Efficient and good
Review: This place is use to handling crowds so the way the staff handle a table, clean it and move onto the next party is great. So my initial apprehensions of not coming because of their legendary queues were unfounded. The rice balls were small and compact so we had just enough without eating too much and we had both chicken done both ways so it was all excellent. Show less

Author: minchang
Title: Delicious chicken rice ball
Review: We ordered both boiled & roasted chicken. The chicken is normal, but the rice ball is really impressive. It has full-flavored taste. I can eat it without chicken.

Author: GTti_72Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to really shout about
Review: There's quite a few places offering this now and most of them are crowded. We were fairly early at this place and still had to wait a few minutes for a table. Most of the staff could speak English fairly well (due to the frequent Singapore tourists I guess) and speedily took our order.We ordered a whole chicken with half steamed and half roasted. The roasted chicken arrived first, followed by the rice balls. We had to chase the order for the steamed chicken before it arrived. Surprisingly, soup is an option which makes it an incomplete chicken rice meal. Nothing is free in this world as they say....Apart from the novelty of the balls, nothing really stood out. So unless you're a big fan of chicken rice balls, maybe try the other outlets instead.Show less

Author: HamizahH11
Title: Terrible and Really Really Not Worth It
Review: The chicken is very very small its like shrinking. The portion for a pax is very very little, even for rm5 its not worth it. The portion is like for rm2 only. The chicken is tasteless. I also ordered sambal masin udang petai. The price is rm25 but the portion is very very little eventho with the small udang you can actually count how many udang on the plate. I dont understand whats with the hype of this restaurant but the price is so not worth with the food. The udang sambal taste so-so only. Same goes with omelette cencalok. Rm20 but very small omelette and you only can taste a bit of cencalok only. The restaurant looks like a normal chicken rice restaurant but when you see the price and the portion and also the taste, its better for you to go The Chicken Rice Shop. Save money and save your taste buds! An honest review! Show less

Author: zsukiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the visit
Review: Wanted to try the hyped Chicken Rice Ball in Malacca. Went with my family and ordered a few dishes including half chicken, some rice balls, prawns with petai, fishball soup and stir fried green vegetables. This place is a halal restaurant. Everything was really tasty but I didn't enjoy the rice balls too much. I felt maybe it was better to order the normal chicken rice. The service was really good. The place was quite simple, traditional and clean. Show less

Author: kwok3124
Title: very simple food i don know y have 4 STAR i will never com i again😓😓😓
Review: so simple n expensive😓 i will don com again my daughter don wan eat she say not yummy le...😨😨😨 the chicken very simple,the rice banyak lembek everting not delicious😨

Author: JianCheng777
Title: Bad service and terrible food
Review: The waiter don't want to take our order and pretend busying at the first place.The chicken meat just tasteless,about RM7 for kid portion,that chicken rice very very expensive even is for tourist area.

Author: LovelynlaiKuching, Malaysia
Title: Good chicken rice
Review: This place serve halal chicken rice. The chicken is tender and the rice is fragrance. The chicken ball soup is nice too. The owner promotes its fried squid with chili flakes but I didn't try as I was alone. Do come when it's not peak hour. You will have to queue up to get a seat during lunch or dinner time, one line for sitting down another one for take away.Show less

Author: pjayacob
Title: Delicious but overpriced
Review: It's already queuing when i'm arrived at 10 am.  I'm in love with the flavor and dishes.  It is very delicious but OVERPRICED!  The staff is efficient and fast service even a lot of people.

Author: christine c
Title: Best Halal Chicken Rice Ball in Melaka
Review: Staffs very friendly though the shop were very crowded with the dinners....very systematic...impressive...quite rare in Melaka...looks like a long Q...but they were very efficient...clears crowd very quickly.

Author: Nurain Syakirah M
Title: Average food.
Review:
It's overrated, there's nothing extraordinary about the taste or anything except the fact that it is rice ball instead of rice.
But still happy with the service! :)
And for its price, there is no harm trying

Author: Selva1964
Title: Chicken Rice Ball Restaurant Near Novotel Melaka
Review: This restaurant offer both traditional and rice ball chicken rice. They offer halal food. This restaurant offers chicken rice and other limited local dishes but only chicken rice worth eating here.Taste average.Pricing average.Customer service average. Restaurant condition and cleanliness also average.

Author: doraemonger
Title: Overrated
Review: Don't think it's really that nice as claimed. Ordered 3 individual chicken rice and a bowl of fishball soup. Rice balls were soggy and no fragrance. Chicken were slightly on the tough side and soup was quite salty. Price is acceptable.

Author: SWShanC
Title: Overrated
Review: Overrated. I enjoyed the cincalok omelette, kids liked the fish ball soup. But the rice balls are too soggy and the sotong petai is disappointing...

Author: tiaidrus
Title: Amazing Chicken Rice Balls, Soup and Service!
Review: We were lucky to reach EeJiBan in time, the crowd thickened just a few minutes after. We were greeted by a helpful staff who knew the menu at the top of her head and made good suggestions. Needless to say we enjoyed our lunch, the chicken rice balls were really good, topped with the roasted chicken and the tasty soup. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: foodfelineKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great-tasting food and informative staff
Review: We chose this particular restaurant as it is the only halal chicken rice ball restaurant that we know in Melaka. Luckily we managed to get a table without waiting. Although we initially had trouble ordering as we had not been to such a restaurant before, the staff taking our order gave great suggestions on what we should order. The food came swiftly and they were delicious, unlike in some chicken rice restaurants. We ordered the soup that we didn't order at first as they were a bit dry to be eaten without the soup. The fishball soup came rather late but when it did arrive, we enjoyed it as it had the perfect saltiness that was to our liking. I also enjoyed the homemade chrysanthemum drink. Overall, it was memorable experience and I would definitely re-visit should I have the chance.Show less

Author: iamonpreeya
Title: Chicken Rice ball
Review: It is just like an ordinary chicken rice. However, it is interesting to eat with rice ball. Since we are here in melaka, we should try for once. The soup is not bad. The recommend dish is squid chilli.

Author: keltzar
Title: Over-rated
Review: I thought this place was over-rated. The chicken wasn't particularly tasty... the chilli was so-so ... and the rice too moist.

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Good chicken rice, convenient location
Review: This restaurant was just a row away from Straits Hotels & Suites where I was putting up a couple of nights. From the facade, one can really tell how commercialised it is, with the extra large lighted signage, but then again, is there anything left in Malacca that isn't already commercialised?The wait staff was very light on their feet and, attentive and friendly. The owner was equally attentive and chipped in whenever his staff was occupied. We ordered a serving of chicken rice balls with steamed chicken drumstick and a serving of loose chicken rice with steamed chicken thigh.The steamed chicken was moist and succulent. However the rice balls were dry and a tad hard which could only mean that the rice balls were made a lot earlier than it was served whereas the loose chicken rice was a lot fresher. I would recommend to forgo the rice balls and go for the loose rice instead, as it is just a gimmick and nothing else.Overall, the chicken rice was tasty and definitely worth a repeated visit. Price wise, typical of Malacca's over inflated standards so nothing unusual.Show less

Author: AppleCheeseStick
Title: Not the best chicken rice ball
Review: Rice ball are stiff and tasteless, but the chicken are good. Be sure to try their chinchalok omelette!

Author: fidal2014
Title: Halal peranakan food!
Review: Im so glad i came here because im a moslem. I ordered chicken rice ball (5 pcs/person) and prawn asam pedas. Its so tasty! I regret i didn't order much. 😂

Author: lucy123115
Title: Good Chicken Rice Ball to escape from the crowd
Review: The chicken ball rice is sticky, nicely flavoured and soft in texture.Chicken and soup served were delicious. It is still crowded but fortunately we needed not queue. A very good option of chicken rice to avoid the crowd elsewhere

Author: Shahrel Reza M
Title: Great Halal food
Review: Great food..Awesome staff..very friendly and very alert on your needs..such as you need additional rice balls...or a tooth pick...we'll be back!

Author: harrykay17Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummylicious Rice Balls
Review: There was a long Q when I arrived. I almost gave up but thankfully I endured the Q and the heat amidst the warm afternoon. The staffs were super friendly; the boy who took charge of the Q, the lady who took our order, the staffs who served our foods and the boss himself. I was so amused by their good service despite the busy times. I ordered the chicken rice balls, roasted chicken, prawn omelette, fishball soup and prawn & sotong sambal. Oh my goodness, the rice balls were superb and beyond words! I had 10 without realising cos its too good. the other dishes were good too except for the sambal prawn/sotong which was pretty tasteless. Overall, their service and food quality are fantastic. Thumbs up! I'll be back again the next time I come to Melaka!Show less

Author: Sangmegi11Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Tasty Halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: A local taxi driver told me this restaurant was tasty and halal. I came here the next day for lunch, the staff was kind and explain the food one by one as she knows I was not familiar with either malacca local food or chinese. I tried chicken rice ball package for 1-2 persons. I got 10 rice ball with roasted chicken, the taste was good. I think the chicken taste is similar with roasted chicken in Hainan Rice Package in my country. I also ordered Tofu Seaweed Soup, and the taste was amazing. It likes Miyokguk (Korean Cuisine) that i loved. Worth to try the taste.Show less

Author: DibooLoveSingapore, Singapore
Title: The riceballs were tasty!
Review: A few mins away frm our hotel & this place is a must to try! The rice balls were soo tasty that my toddler had 4 of them...! Reasonably priced with choices of squid, fishes and whatnots as side orders...soup was tasty too..! Place is a bit small and advisable to come early and avoid the dinner crowd...Recommended!!Show less

Author: summerkopiteaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth trying
Review: Service from waiting to serving us was great. We had chicken rice balls, half chicken (mixed white and roasted), assam pedas fish, sambal kangkong, stir-fry kailan & prawn omelettewe didnt enjoy the rice balls maybe coz we are not used to the texture. the fish & stir-fry kailan is must try..Show less

Author: hanchiny
Title: You can give it a miss!!
Review: Nothing special about their chicken rice ball. Chicken rice are not great. I can find a better one in KL or Singapore.

Author: Liyana I
Title: Good service
Review: Our first time eating rice balls. Service was awesome. We had rice balls, half chicken, sambal prawn, fish ball soup and some vege and the taste of the food is awesome. It's halal too.

Author: TJLim
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Chicken was nice and juicy. There are many other zhi cha dishes available. Tried the small rice balls which tasted better than the plated rice. Fried Kang Kong was a little spicy. Chinchalok omelette was also salty. Otherwise food there was good.

Author: TehFarahaini
Title: HALAL chicken rice balls!
Review: Food is delicious! please try the squid as well (although quite spicy, it is still amazing). finding a car park is a bit difficult but it's worth it. the owner & staff is also very friendly

Author: claudiachaiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not bad
Review: Service was fast and the food was not bad. However, the rice ball is not as flavourful. Ordered 1/2 chicken and the serving was relatively ok for 2 of us. Find it a little hard to eat due to the bones, however the chicken was cook through and is extremely tender, even the breast meat. Other dishes like the fish ball soup and the stir fried lettuce wasn't very good.Show less

Author: LeeCheah
Title: 1st time and will sure come again!!
Review: Hoooochiak!! Nice and very good!! Will surely come again and recommend to my frenz and family! Worthy.

Author: NorazahI6
Title: The popular rice shops
Review: Delicious and little bit different from another country only in malaca a chicken rice like a fish ball so unique

Author: syafawati a
Title: Nice to try
Review: The services are good however the space is not enough to cover the customers that waiting to eat. The rice is nice but the portion of the chicken is too small. Overall is delicious even we have to take away because too long to wait for our turn.. huhu.. Show less

Author: Echolee
Title: Nice halal chicken rice
Review: This is one of the few nice halal food I have tried in melaka. Had roast chicken , garlic veg and herbal soup. Chicken is tender and tasty. I love the veg ( cai dan). If only the chilli is more spicy it will be excellent.Show less

Author: cbyy88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice and tasty
Review: The chicken was roasted nicely with enough of taste and oil seasoned around it. The rice balls are average, perhaps too bland and tiny for some. Food was averagely ok. Just could not bear with all the rules set around the restaurant, such as serviettes will be charged if you waste it and also they have minimum orders per customers for their rice balls and chicken.Show less

Author: chefrevival04Selangor, Malaysia
Title: First time eat chicken rice ball
Review: This is my time here. Seek this location in Facebook & using Waze application to the restaurant. This restaurant served local Chinese dishes. The popular menu was Chicken Rice ball served with choices of rested or steam chicken. I ordered chicken rice ball with a mix of roasted and steam chicken. Rice was aromatic same goes with chicken. They served with tangy chilly sauce. I also order chilly and salt squid. The price quiet expensive but the taste and the quality of food was superb.Show less

Author: gilanghendra
Title: Melaka short trip
Review:
Taste of the food was good. We try mix chicken, which is steam and roasted..its good because the food is HALAL..
The restaurant will be full of visitor during lunch time..

Author: ThomasSoySingapore, Singapore
Title: Rubbish hype
Review: The shop has all kinds of photo of TV guests from all over the world doing food shows there, but either they're all lairs or the standard dropped overnight.The rice is too stick and tasteless. The chicken serving is so small not even my cat will get full. Menu is messy and needs lots of work.Only thing is service is good, menu is explained, and order served quickly.Show less

Author: charlenec140
Title: Nice halal chicken rice
Review: Wanted to try the famous Jonker Street chicken rice balls but it closes early. TripAdvisor recommended EeJiBan which is near our hotel. As this is our first time trying chicken rice balls, it's interesting to have rice in shape of balls. Steamed chicken is silky smooth and smoked/grilled chicken has thin & less fatty which is good! Price and portion are reasonable. Worth a tryShow less

Author: simple_guest14Malaysia
Title: Overrated.. rm2 toilet??!!
Review: Just average.. Nothing special.. The only extra is that the menu is halal.. It's hard to get halal chicken rice ball in Melaka. There is one in Jonker Walk ( Mamee Jonker House ). Staff is friendly. But the policies..?? RM2 for non customers to use toilet?? Not that friendly.. Suria KLCC toilet is RM2. Come on..Show less

Author: Racheljess W
Title: Delicious and price reasonable
Review: Good service, good location,  walking distance from few shopping malls and hotels eg.  Mahkota Parade, Dataran Pahlawan, Hatten Hotel, Novatel hotel, Equatorial hotel

Author: Cin_Fab_JJSingapore, Singapore
Title: good service
Review: we were driven away by the owner of amy heritage to dine here (pls read my review on amy heritage to find out more). and by chance this was quite a nice location to dine. airy n spacious. food were delectable too. we ordered a plate of chicken rice balls and 3 plates of chicken rice, vegetables, half a plate of roasted and white chicken n fishball soup. good Show less

Author: uncle_sim123
Title: Nice Roast Chic
Review: 10 mins walk from Hatten or Equitorial Hotel. Boss is very efficient in grabing customer. Roast chicken is nice. Half Chicken + Rice Ball + Drink for 3 person, cost around rm$35.

Author: karyen
Title: Mini Chicken Rice Ball
Review: We came here for brunch. There are other dishes like fish balls, omelette, veggie etc besides chicken dishes. The food is really satisfying. The kids love it.

Author: foryouformeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonably priced and tasty!
Review: Visited the place with my friends. We googled for halal chicken rice ball and found Ee Ji Ban. It could be easily located and we walked from hatten hotel. We were there on a weekday evening and it was not too crowded. Service was fast and food was good. We ordered steamed fish, half a chicken, 10 chicken rice balls each, kailan and omelette. It came up to about 120 RM which was very reasonable.Show less

Author: AileenChuaKampung Subang Baru, Malaysia
Title: Better than Jonker Walk
Review: My family love the chicken rice balls in Malacca. It is our must-have food whenever we come here. This is the first time we tried Ee Ji Ban. First impression was that it was better than those we had at Jonker Walk. There was poster on the restaurant and reminded us to put parking coupon. It was needed even on a Sunday. Dun let parking summon spoilt your day.Show less

Author: HappyWindHappy
Title: Opens at night around 9pm
Review:
Comfort food you can find away from jonker street. 
Priced at tourist rate.  
Spicy level: high
Must try: chili squid with petai

Author: wyanaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty dishes - don't over order!
Review: This is our last pit stop in Melaka after checking out of the hotel. We arrived about 1.30pm on a weekday, thus it is not easy to find a parking spot. Plus, you will need to get the parking coupon. We ordered the prawn+squid chilli, cencaluk omelette, fishball soup, veggie and roasted chicken. The waitress suggested each of us to take 5 chicken rice balls each (usual portion for 1 person). This is our first time here and we really love the chilli dish and the omelette. The 5 chicken rice ball at first looks to little for 1 person, but after the food sinks in, we began to feel thank god we didn't order so much. Show less

Author: Nor I
Title: Small Portion, nice taste - only tried chicken rice ball
Review:
First time here. Portion is small. 5 rice balls.
I am not a fan of mushy rice, they will have to be mushy to be turned into balls. 
Roasted and steamed chicken were nice.

Author: heatherrjollyEdzell, United Kingdom
Title: Family lunch
Review: We had just arrived in Malacca and were staying at the Novotel. A member of staff recommended this restaurant for lunch and we were not disappointed. We had the chicken rice and a prawn dish and both were excellent. The restaurant is very local and does not look up to much but the food was very good. The staff were very friendly and we did not have yo wait long for our meal.Show less

Author: wendy n
Title: Affordable (:
Review: We went for the two kinds of rice, one being the rice balls and another normal rice. I'll prefer the normal one as I like my rice to have a more springy texture. All the side dishes were really good and the chili goes really well with the rice. Will definitely revisit! (:Show less

Author: NicolaP942Auckland, New Zealand
Title: Lit up our taste buds
Review: After reading reviews about food in Malacca, rice balls were on my list. We were walking looking for a place to drink and I saw the sign for rice balls so we decided to try this restaurant. We definitely got lucky as I read the sign on the wall explaining how the restaurant came about. Firstly the staff are super friendly and helpful. The food was so tasty which was a little bit of a surprise as the rice balls look bland but they were delicious. We had roast chicken with them that was so juicy and the sauce it was in was lovely. This restaurant also does great Nyonya dishes so we also had a plate of kangkung in sambal and a prawn dish. I was very impressed. Also the restaurant was really clean Show less

Author: serenac499
Title: No line on Monday evening
Review: My first chicken rice balls with roasted chicken and love it. The single servings are relatively small compared to most Singapore chicken rice. Just have to order more I suppose 😊

Author: Mirage O
Title: Excellent restaurant for halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Great dining experience. Well-worth the taxi-ride from our hotel. Good food, clean and fast service.

Author: faez18
Title: Halal Chicken Rice Balls!
Review: Bought a 10 rice balls chicken rice with roasted and steamed chicken to go. With soup and chilli. Sambal Salted Prawn. Fragrant n flavourful chicken rice balls. Delicious chilli and soup. A must try! Halal!!

Author: Vpei
Title: quick lunch
Review:
Good things is - at least no need to queue long for food.
The famous sotong is good, slightly salty but in small portion only.

Author: Amelia T
Title: Nice place to eat
Review:
I love the food especially ikan asam pedas and chicken rice ball :)
The vegetables also taste good
Recommended for lunch or dinner

Author: sunbabe_9
Title: Yummy chicken rice
Review: Good and reasonably priced chicken rice. Restaurant is clean too. Fast service. I personally prefer normal chic rice to the chic rice balls.

Author: JenanimeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty little balls of chicken rice with juicy roast chicken! :)
Review: This place is great for some cheap and cheerful tasty chicken rice balls. I came here by myself so ordered the individual chicken rice ball set (you get 5 rice balls with steamed or roast chicken for 6MYR). When I was given the choice of steamed or roast chicken I decided to go with the roasted option and it did not disappoint as it was succulent and juicy. The portion size was a little on the small side but was ok for what you pay for.The texture of the rice balls was excellent and had a nice chewiness to it. Flavourwise, it tastes the exact same as any Hainanese chicken rice. The chilli sauce that was served along with the meal was quite good and I enjoyed dipping the chicken into it for a delicious spicy kick. The chicken also comes with slices of vinegared cucumber to cleanse your palate.Be prepared to queue like I did as this place is extremely busy during lunchtimes. I did not have to wait long though as the turnover rate at this place is very quick. This does mean that the service is somewhat abrupt but efficient. The restaurant had a newspaper clipping that claimed Ee Ji Ban was the best chicken rice ball place in town. While I am not too sure if it is indeed the best chicken rice ball place in Malacca as I only tried the rice balls at this particular restaurant, I have to say the food was pretty decent! :)Show less

Author: 266Ann
Title: Nice chicken rice balls
Review: Saw a queue and joined in.  To my surprise, it was good and the service was fast.  Chicken rice was good.

Author: Syazwani MBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: It was my first time visiting Melaka and from what I googled, Melaka not only famous for their baba nyonya cuisine but also their Chicken Rice Ball! The place is not so hard to find, just use Waze then you'll find the place! What I love here is their unique chicken rice served in ball! So adorable and if I'm not mistaken its around 0.30rm per ball. Sorry if I got the info wrong :) hehe I ordered the half pieces chicken for 20+rm and it's half steamed chicken and half roasted. The rice ball was however too soft for my liking but it was alright, something new. The chicken on the other hand were really soft, tender and juicy! Also, flavourful. They also have other range of foods on the menu but I didn't get to try them as my main reason was to only try their chicken rice ball. Love it although its just like those ordinary chicken rice but I will definitely come back here the next time I visit Melaka.Show less

Author: EdwinLauSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Chicken Rice
Review: Prefer the chicken rice here, rather then the famous ones in Jonker.The chicken was meatier and more tender, and you do not need to queue.Not a fan of the balls... but there is always a plate of rice option.Will dine here again if I stay nearby the next time round.Good valueShow less

Author: aylsont
Title: Soft and tender
Review:
Tried the chicken rice ball as it was near our hotel.
The chicken meat was soft and tender and juicy.
Tried Farmosa at Jonker Street, the meat was hard and dry. 
Will definitely visit again on my next trip.

Author: MummyBluesSingapore, Singapore
Title: "Ping Pong" size chicken rice ball!!!
Review: The must try food in Malacca are Nyonya Cuisine, Satay Celup, Cendol & Chicken Rice Ball.For the last one, there are many places to choose from (which include super-long queue under hot sun). Since we are around the area, my family decided to try Ee Ji Ban 一级棒 (so happy to see there wasn't a queue when we arrived). Ordered half steam chicken, 10 rice balls, conventional chicken rice & some dishes. When the rice ball arrived, I was shocked to see they were no bigger than ping-pong balls. No wonder they are selling it for 30cents/ball. Haa! Personally I don't quite like the taste of "mash rice" + can't quite taste the fragrance. The normal rice cost RM1.80. For RM22, the portion of the chicken was acceptable and the chicken tasted juicy although some parts can be too oily. As for the other dishes, I must say it can be quite expensive in local standard. A plate of Fried Omelette with prawn (small serving with a few prawns) cost RM10. The herbal tonic soup which they promote at RM4 is just herbal flavored soup ... we can't find any ingredient or herb in it. In short, it was just an ordinary meal with some high priced dishes. Won't be in my must-go list for Malacca. Show less

Author: 315marlinaa
Title: Good but will not come back
Review:
Well. The chicken rice was average. We ordered the other food too, and it was ok. The food there was pricey! 
But the staff were helpful.

Author: Mfamilysgp
Title: Good!
Review: Always had Farmosa Chicken Rice Ball but tried this as I was staying nearby. Food is good and affordable.

Author: 159serenet
Title: Service is good
Review: I would rate the food as normal but the waitress was very helpful in recommending and give advise for their food and food portion.

Author: iamjosiah
Title: Excellent chicken and Belachan
Review:
The chicken was juicy and well cooked. The food was decent. The food came really quickly and it was good food with good company.

The sweet potato leaves with Belachan was amazing! Recommended

Author: wittythejames
Title: Delicious
Review: Good, delicious and many choices of sambal foods. The chicken rice really tasty, not too oily. The rice ball at RM0.30 per pcs.

Author: rajamanusingapore
Title: be prepared to wait during lunch hours
Review: chicken rice ball rice is their main draw but you may have to wait for a table during the lunch hour. we had to wait for nearly 30 minutes even for take away.the service process is orderly.you select your choice and pay up and a receipt is issued to you and your order will be filled in accordance with the queue.the huge crowds waiting for a table are a testimony to their quality of the food and reasonable prices and this restaurant does pull crowds. lunch starts early. by eleven in the morning crowds start pouring in.Show less

Author: Mohanarasan R
Title: Tasty...
Review: This place was recommended to us by the locals. The plus point about this place compared to other chicken rice ball places in Melaka is that it opens at night. Comparing the quality of food served to the other chicken rice ball shops, they are right up there. Service is great too. A must try is the prawn sambal which adds some contrast to the generally pale looking chicken rice balls and the chicken itself. In terms of taste, it compliments the tinge of sourness in the chicken rice with some much needed spice (if you are the type that like spicy food).Show less

Author: travelling2day
Title: Good Food
Review: I ate here twice, the chicken and rice, as well as the rice balls. I found it very fresh and tasty. The staff are always smiling and attentive, which is the reason I went back a second time.

Author: ButtermilkHoHo
Title: The best chicken rice ball
Review: Fast service, food excellent. Will definitely come back again and again. Keep up the good work. Price is ok. I love ee ji ban chicken rice ball

Author: bella w
Title: good try
Review:
had lunch tried both balls n plain rice! prefer the plain thou...
had brown n white chicken, not bad. but the veg is great had the burnt wok taste which is the right heat.

Author: Moniek d
Title: Best chicken rice balls!
Review: We have been a couple of times in Melaka and we always eat here a couple times during out visit. They have the best chicken rice balls.

Author: Vincybaby
Title: Chicken rice or zhi char?
Review: Not really a pure chicken rice stall... With a lot of other zhi char food to come along... Pricing almost the same as Singapore zhi char how ever the quantity is lesser... Overall taste i would say so so only, not that fantastic... I would say, it's overrated....Show less

Author: micthz-micthz
Title: my 1st chicken rice ball
Review: Its Near with our hotel imperial heritage . 5min walk from our hotel . food was good, they also have sotong samabl and kangkong sambal , not so friendly staff but service okay .

Author: Tan L
Title: Chicken Rice Ball
Review: Recommended by my driver, first time having chicken rice in this interesting presentation - rice balls. Though rice balls are too sticky for my personal liking still overall food is tasty & generous portion. Though we were a big group of 9 we Q and waited for abt 10mins and we were seated. Staff were attentive and friendly too!Show less

Author: weilynn82Singapore, Singapore
Title: Once you pop, you cant stop!
Review: At 1st we ordered 10 rice balls for 2. But one bite and I quickly ordered 10 more! So moist, so delicious! Chicken was yummy too. Big Boss kinda fierce but thats probably why the standard is very good. Came back again on our last day in Melaka. Craving it as I type this :) Show less

Author: Shaf_Khaleed
Title: Great food & Unique style
Review: Great taste! We hear this place from our friends. Fast serve and good service. Their have their own style for serving. THE RICE BALL! easy to eat. You must try this kind of food.

Author: mengzai
Title: chicken rice  for brunch
Review: Ordered 1 whole steam chicken. meat texture was so so. suspect frozen chicken was used instead of fresh chicken. rice texture was soft. personally prefer hard texture rice.

Author: laikaum
Title: Expensive
Review:
The foods are considered as average, not really very good nor too bad but it's a bit pricey after considered the food portion. 
The service is good and fast.

Author: Rudi P
Title: Good but expensive
Review:
The chicken rice was OK but can find similar in Melaka with less price. Probably because of the location nearby Hatten, Straits Hotel and Novotel. 
The good thing is that it serve halal food

Author: SanjayRaphael
Title: Good food
Review: Halal chicken rice balls in Melaka. A good visit. People were friendly and service was fast. Food was acceptable. Can improve on presentation though. Besides that inwould give a 8/10

Author: HO DKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Melaka Chicken Rice ball
Review: This Ee Ji Ban restaurant served not only chicken rice ball & steam or roasted chicken at Melaka Raya. They also have other dishes like prawn sambal, curry fish, vegetables, etc. but it is not cheap. Also have 6% GST included. Environment wise, it is just a normal coffee shop but sitting outside would be pleasant.Show less

Author: Shahul Hameed SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Taste, Pricey
Review: We went here after hearing all the hypes about from this place. Apart from the chicken rice and comes in ball shape, I would say, there is nothing much to it (comparing only the things that I ordered). The chicken was just ok, the garam dy chili squid was just ok. it was not too delicious or whatsoever. The price also was way to expensive for the kind of food that we ordered and the serving size. Maybe for first timer who never ate chicken rice ball (like I was), it would be worth to go. but I would definitely not go here again.Show less

Author: 276JAMES
Title: Great food at low prices
Review: I had chicken rice ball, green vegetable in oyster sauce and tea. It was all delicious and cost about 17 ringit. Service staff were friendly and helpful.

Author: Daniel W
Title: 20% Surcharge
Review:
Dear Travellers, please be careful of this chicken rice ball restaurant at Melaka Raya! 

During festive season especially Chinese New Year they will surcharge additional 20% to your bill without any notice.

Author: leemishaelSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Not the best but still delicious for Halal
Review: This is a good alternative for Halal chicken rice balls. I've had the one at Jonkers (the one at the corner of the street right at the end) and several others and this one is considerably good. I would say the soup & white chicken is EXTREMELY Chinese - considering its Halal. Most of the Halal Chicken Rice shops I've been too is not even close to authenticity. The rice balls costs RM1.50 for a plate of 5 balls. They also have chicken rice on a plate for RM1.80.Half a chicken was about RM22 if not mistaken. Also there is no soup and has to be ordered separately. The fish ball soup is EXTREMELY good. Must have. They also have several Nyonya dishes on the menu and several kinds of stir fry vegetables. I parked opposite Novotel (400m or less) and walked a bit as it was impossible to find a parking space on a Sunday. But the restaurant wasn't packed with people at all and that was around 4pm++. Remember to get the parking coupons coz you've got to pay all 7days a week in Melaka. The Chinese drugstore opposite Novotel & Straits Hotel sells them. Show less

Author: Natasha E
Title: Nothing Special
Review: So decided to give it a try.. we requested for a take away & the waiting time is about 10-15mins.. we came at about 8.30pm on a weekend.Served by Indonesian ladies I believe, who were kind and politeSo we ordered:1) 10pcs Rice Balls with Chicken (RM7.50+/-)2) Sambal Kangkung (RM6.00+/-)3) Kailan With Oyster Sauce (RM6.00+/-)So far, our review on this,The rice balls are cold as so are the chickensAlil bland for our taste and hard..Could be extremely better maybe if we dine in.But still taste wise ●5/10●The veggies are alright as they are stirred fried upon order so it stays warm and fresh. Taste wise not bad.. Not salty at all which is good.. ●7/10●My review:Will i come again to try it? - NoWill i recommend? - For the first timer YesHalal meal? - Halal Certified RestaurantValue for $$$? - RM20 (SGD6.55) is acceptable for this amountValue for taste? - Not so.. I have tasted better.Hope this helps!! :) Show less

Author: jefferyjay84
Title: Expensive chicken rice
Review: I order one set of chicken with rice, I scare the chicken not enough for me...so that I request add on more chicken...only the chicken... and the last is drinks... the taste not bad...but when I payment that was so expensive...

Author: Zieymaa H
Title: I'm lovin it
Review: The best chicken rice ball that I ever had ! Everytime I go to Malacca, I will came by for the rice ball because my niece love it !

Author: Erudouin
Title: Best chicken rice ball
Review: Best chicken rice ball i've ever eaten, fast response, fast serving, great location. Close from Mahkota Medical Centre

Author: Ling101028
Title: Chicken Rice is the best!
Review: I  would think you can forget about ordering other Fish or Prawn dishes. They are just so-so in taste but quite expensive.

Author: MizSally24
Title: Lovely Halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: My family enjoyed our visit. There was a long queue but that didn't deter us from savoring the food. The place is great and the food is a must try if you visit Melacca town. The restaurant also provide clean toilet too.

Author: MarinaMYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good location, good service, good food
Review: We took a day trip to Melaka for jalan-jalan cari makan and our first stop was Ee Ji Ban because it opens as early as 9 am. We arrived at 10 am on a Tuesday so no long queues. The restaurant is quite small but we found a table for us and since it was our first time we ordered the mixed chicken (1/2 chicken grilled and steamed - i love them both). We also ordered stir fried romaine lettuce and fishball soup. I love the chicken rice balls. I didn't overat because the size is just right. I get to eat more chicken and the soup is light. The chili is very hot. But it just complements the whole dish. Service was good. The waiters are very polite and very knowledgable about the menu. They are able to suggest the portion for you. Only we didn't go with their suggestion because we still had a long list of Malaka food to try. The best part is it is halal. And there haven't been many halal chicken rice balls restaurants before this. I think there was only one. Definitely must try. And i will definitely make my way there again. Show less

Author: hooiseongt
Title: Chicken Rice Balls
Review: Near to hotel, the queues were long. Chicken Rice Balls is nice! Chicken, normal chicken rice & others like fish ball are just average..

Author: Actuarial_MathSingapore
Title: 2nd Best Chicken Rice Balls in Melaka
Review: As this coffeeshop was just downstairs of our hotel, we decided to try it. The queues were always long. There was no air con in the coffeeshop too in the sweltering Melaka weather, so we decided a take away.The rice balls and chicken were 2nd best in Melaka. The rice balls were above average in taste. The chicken was small in size and slightly hard.The best chicken rice balls is still served at Chung Wah Kedai Kopi at Jonker Walk. See my review on Chung Wah Kedai Kopi.Show less

Author: 131pangp
Title: Decent rice balls chicken rice
Review: It only the rice been rolled on as a hard ball. Really nothing special. But as to compares with Zhong Hua , of cos no way. Personally I felt this is normal chicken rice lah.. Nothing really fantastic or nice. Hmm if u want some real nice solid chicken rice Chilli, shld try Zhong Hua. Ee ji ban -- so so only lah. That my thoughts. You can give it a try...Show less

Author: ashieeeeeeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Will definitely be back again
Review: Always thought that chicken rice balls are just overhyped chicken rice rolled into balls, what's the big deal you know. But the chicken rice balls here are really small and cute and nice. Actually had a better experience taking away, as the chicken rice balls will have just the right amount of sauce on them as they are packed together with the chicken, so that they are not too dry. We only tried the white chicken the 3 times we've been here. The white chicken is super delicious; just the right amount of oiliness, and it's so smooth as well. Stuck to the safe and reliable Fishball soup on our 1st two visits, but decided to give the tonic soup a try on our 3rd visit. Would highly recommend both soups, though I'm more much more in love with the tonic soup now. Love the hot white coffee here, and I have to say I'm not even a regular coffee drinker. The lemon water/juice is a refreshing end to our meal as well. Love the service here. Even though it is popular and we've seen big groups arrive without reservation, boss and lady boss really work seamlessly with their workers, who are fast and efficient, and at the same time polite and always offering a pleasant smile. Keep up the good work!Show less

Author: sza1968Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Over-rated and Over-hyped.
Review: It is essentially chicken rice where the rice has been shaped into balls. You order the number of rice balls you want. Chicken and everything else areseparate.The rice was hard. Hardly flavourful. Chicken - nothing special.The place is cramped. Parking is a nightmareI won't recommend. Best to stick to the usual chicken rice. Try once for the novelty.Show less

Author: mikeylawsh72
Title: Good food,service n price
Review: 2 of us had quarter chicken (roasted n steamed), prawn omelette, green veg, a plate of chic rice, 10 balls of chic rice . we paid rm38.00. Omelette is 10.00. Iced Chinese tea is rm0.90 per glass. The staff n boss r friendly . they will suggest the right portion of dishes for us. The young boss would go around checking our order n food. He even personallt thanked us when we left the shop. He made us feel that customers r valued by him n workers. They r other dishes worth trying if u go in groups. The dishes are halal.it s working distance fr fenix hotel.Show less

Author: carmenc555
Title: Food average , good service
Review: Packed with many ppl during lunch time. Food was served on 10 mins after ordering. I found the rice balls tasted quite plain (nothing special). 20's rice ball RM6, medium size vege RM13, Omellete RM8, fishball soup RM7 , 1/2 roasted chicken RM22 , chicken rice x 3 RM5.40 & drinks × 4 RM6.6. & i'll rate the service at 4.5/5 Show less

Author: ainurAFIFAH
Title: Good eating experience.Affordable.Fast
Review: Not going to lie, it tastes similar to other kinds of chicken rice. But the chicken rice balls is a nice experience because you can swallow the whole thing.

Author: Paik Ling HPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: I loved this so much that I ate this 2 days in a row!
Review: We stumbled upon this restaurant because it was just a 3min walk from where we stayed (Hatten Hotel). I love the fact that the chicken rice ball is not overly oily and soggy and the kampung chicken is not tough. The chilli sauce is a tad too watery for me but tasted good never theless. Asam fish is not bad although the portions were too small, likewise the fishball soup. I had this 2 days in a row, so that says everything! Service is first class as well. Will definitely return here for my chicken rice ball fix.Show less

Author: jojoccbSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lunch
Review: We order veg, half chicken w mini rice ball. Kids love the rice ball to bits. I luv my chicken rice chilli spicy. So chilli at ee ji ban wld be perfect for me if the chilli have more *kick* (spicy)Otherwise its perfect for my family. Show less

Author: salimjacquelina
Title: Halal chicken rice ball
Review: Wow, all dishes that I tried so far r yummylicious, moreover it is a halal restaurant that ever out on TV programme called Jalan Jalan cari Makan.....so head toward the place for Muslims traveller,,,

Author: Saiful R
Title: delicious
Review: one of the best chicken rice in town with good price and fast service. Halal restaurant and Muslim friendly.

Author: Etieqa SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty rice balls
Review: Within 5 minutes the young owner managed to find us a seat. Thumbs up!We ordered a mix and match of chickens (steam & roasted), stir-fried lettuce and seaweed tofu soup. Each dish is seasoned well so they're really tasty. Rice balls will come in 5 for a single plate. If you are in Melaka, do stop by here. It's definitely worth the trip. Another +1 is, it's Halal ;)Show less

Author: FanazmiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ee Ji Ban Revisited.
Review: This is the must visit restaurant for me whenever we're in Melaka. It's the only Halal Chicken Rice Ball shop that I am aware of in Melaka. It's now easier to locate the restaurant as there are prominent sign all over the roads leading to the location.Food standards is still the same, price-wise.....it has gone up since my last visit in 2014. The whole novelty of this place is the chicken rice balls, order more than what you think you can eat..........Recommend to order the vegetables dishes, very nicely done and tasty. Also the Salted Chilli Squid.Show less

Author: jtsh12Malaysia
Title: Decent chicken ball rice
Review: I came here as it is halal and we had some Muslim friends in our midst. It serves decent chicken rice ball and chicken, not exceptionally great. There are better shops like the one in Jonker Street but if you can't stand the queue this is quite an acceptable alternativeShow less

Author: mikeismael
Title: Good Halal Chicken Rice Balls
Review: We had dinner here and ordered Chicken Rice, Sambal Salted Squid, baby Kailam and Prawn omelette. Food was good for the price we paid for. Recommended to all Chicken Rice lovers.

Author: Tat YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Huge disappointment
Review: Read reviews about this place and have seen it before. Looked a bit dodgy but we sat down and ordered the chicken with the rice balls. I found the balls tasteless and the chicken was spartan at best with portions so sparse it looked more like appetizers. I also ordered a seaweed tofu soup which has about zero flavor. The baby gailan came smothered in garlic but was passable. There has to be better options but it was within walking distance of our hotel. I had to have another meal later that evening.Show less

Author: BTtxKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: More than just an ordinary chicken rice
Review: Famous for it's chicken rice resembling a ping pong ball. Many food bloggers and celebrities have introduced this shop at world class food channel and news. The salt chili squid/fish is a must try, nd of course the roasted chicken as well. If you want to try out at this shop, either go before 1pm or after 2pm. Else, the seats are limited and need to queue for a table. Must try!Show less

Author: JWTSGSingapore
Title: Nice place for chicken rice balls! Much nicer than Formosa on Jonker
Review: Ee Ji Ban is on a row of shophouses across the road from the main mall. It is in one of the lanes and is quite easy to find. The chicken rice balls are very nice. We went on a weekend at a non-peak period in the middle of haze season and the place still manages to be busy. Worth it to make a tripShow less

Author: buzzybee2212
Title: Yummy food
