Author: Myratravelog
Title: Cosy and instagrammable cafe.
Review: Such a nice ambiance for an outing with friends. If you want to escape a busy cafe in melaka during weekends, this is the place to go for. And not to mention instagrammable worthy!

Author: Afeeqzainudeen
Title: Tasty food, nice environment and friendly staff
Review: went here with my friend to celebrate my birthday. I love the interior design. Its definitely a very cosy place to chill with your friends! The staff also very friendly and the food is tasty. Will come back again :)

Author: Samantha_Y0213
Title: Nice environment, Good food!
Review: Had a great lunchtime with colleague. Nice environment, Good food! Friendly staff. Definitely will come back here~

Author: 569joaocZurich, Switzerland
Title: Great “Bica” (expresso coffee)
Review: Very nice ambience and great expresso! Service is nice and friendly although they got our order wrong (but they immediately offer to switch it).Show less

Author: Deborahannelee
Title: Boyfriend’s suprises birthday celebration
Review: First time visiting Rosa Hotel. Fell in love with their decoration,theme & their friendly staff. This birthday celebration would not be wonderful if it wasn’t for the staff name Maria. She listen & recommended me what was best for the birthday celebration. For the whole time i was there I couldn’t stop mesmerising❤️Show less

Author: PetrinaJ_12
Title: Bad service
Review: Arrived at 10:30am for coffee but the staff did not want to serve until 11:00am. Mind you, opening time is written as 7:30am.

Author: pohmun1129
Title: TERRIBLE FOODS
Review: We had our birthday dinner and the foods make me truly disappointed. We ordered a mushroom soup and the soup is cold and tasted really bad. Otherwise, the others foods did not taste good but quite expensive. We are really disappointed.

Author: ChristianL5374
Title: Bica & Co Experience
Review: We had a great lunch at this cafe. The place was relaxing with instagrammable posts. We will visit again this cafe. Show less

Author: mrrhodelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great cafe experience
Review: Unique and delicious. Not ordinary menu you can find in Melaka. Staff are friendly and helpful. Atmosphere is a big plus. We’ll be back here definitely.Show less

Author: Joeparker_ukManchester, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible food and terrible new menu
Review: We turned up for lunch only to be told that all the previous food they served that’s shown in other pictures on TA, no longer exists. The menu changed in Jan 2018 and now included a bunch of pre-made sandwiches and pies. Nothing else. The food was terrible and where there should have been actual chicken, there were just flecks of an indistinguishable meat. Lettuce was brown and gone off and staff not particularly helpful or apologetic. A real shame because the decor is lovely. Don’t go.Show less

Author: Gloria W
Title: Nice Atmosphere
Review: The environment atmosphere was good and relaxed.The food was nice, espeacially the cookies was very delicious. Besides, the toilet was clean. The workers are some friendly and helpful. I will recommand this hotel to my friend.Show less

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Not too impressed
Review: Went there for brunch one day but the food was really a let down. As I sat there admiring the deco and taking in the serene ambience, my palate was telling me this must be it!Sobs..sobs..The Catalina chicken was so plain I wish I had my economy rice at my friendly neighbourhood that day...Chicken chop schnitzel, however a big piece should have come with some sides like mashed potatoes or chips. Food are reasonably priced but drinks were a bit on the high. Overall good experience. BTW parking are available that's the good about this place too.Show less

Author: CheeChinT
Title: My Review
Review: Great design in & outdoor, very cozy place, one of the best cafes in Melaka city, friendly & pleasant looking staffs. Yet to taste the food but heard it is good though.

Author: AisyahRafidyShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Coffee sesh
Review: Hot beverage to suit ur caffeine needs. Variety of delectable cookies and cakes for ur sweet tooth w affordable price. The cafe interior is too die for. The ambience is nice and welcoming. Show less

Author: imran d
Title: One of the kind, must try their Seared Ginger Salmon
Review: As a travel photographer, im looking for a unique and rare places to stay, try new food and authentic taste. This cafe is feel like home, their crews like your family. Always smile, friendly and just ask them your preference Chicken, Beef, Fish, Pasta. They always suggest you with something amazing for your taste buds. Trust your sense and enjoy the rustic ambiance!Will come againKeep it up Bica & CoShow less

Author: Muhammad A
Title: Vacation
Review: One of the cozy cafe and delicious cuisines. Really love the place. Really recommend to those who visiting Melaka. Really satisfiedShow less

Author: VinothP50
Title: That breakfast though!
Review: Love the breakfast I had! Them fresh eggs and that orange juice, fresh out of the farm!!!! Definitely coming again very soon!!Show less

Author: MayPhingP
Title: Rustic cafe
Review: I stayed at Rosa Malacca and I love their breakfast very much! Especially Egg Benedict, it makes my day during my staycation. Not just breakfast, I would say they have the best roasted chicken in Melaka as the price is reasonable and really juicy and yummy! And they have my favourite drinks where I find it very hard in other cafe or restaurant which is Pink Grape Fruits. Definitely will recommend more friends to come and to chill, relax and celebration too!Show less

Author: BSKumar26
Title: Great Taste, nice ambiance
Review: Many choices, good service. If you plan to visit Melaka, this is a place alternative you must try other thn local food.

Author: Shazana A
Title: Reasonable and tasty
Review: It was a wonderful experience dining at Bica. We had half a roasted chicken cooked with sous vide technique with Rm24. Tasty and staff is also very kind and attentive. I will come again bcoz the deco & ambiance is so beautiful and rustic.

Author: phoebet546
Title: Nice ambience, lousy food, pricey
Review: When we first stepped in, we saw a wedding photo shoot taking place on d ground floor entrance.The cafe is situated on the 2nd floor.Deco is pretty nice. Feels rustic and cozy. They have an outdoor dining area but it is too warm in the afternoon.The piping is a huge turn off. You can hear water being flushed from the pipes above. The lighting are a bit too harsh as it shines directly to the tables. Food is pricey. A glass of fresh juice is RM18. A piece of cookie is about RM8. The salted egg pasta is a huge disappointment!! Do not order. There is no salted egg in it.Music selection is a mood kill. Maybe try to freshen up your play list with Spotify.Show less

Author: NivlaMil
Title: Cozy Peranakan Restaurant with ample parking space
Review:
The Peranakan food here is exquisite, not crowded & cozy. 
We love the Kurau fish chili garam, Lemak Nenas, Pongteh, Steamed Ocra & Cincalok Omelette...you must also try the Nyonya Cendol !!!

Author: PY1965Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food continues to be good as before
Review: I lost count of the number of times we patronised this place. We have been having at least one meal here each time we are in Malacca for the past few years. The dishes continue to looks delicious and taste good too. It is a bit pricier but it is worth it. Keep it up!Show less

Author: Gabriella HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious
Review: Delicious food in a gorgeous quirky setting. Go early to beat the crowd or make a reservation. Everything we had was delicious but really recommend the pineapple prawn and pie tie. The lemongrass tea is also yummy and served in a gorgeous metal flask. Everything about our meal was perfect. If we ever visit Malacca again we will be back!Show less

Author: laksa88
Title: Food was Yummy!
Review: Delicious food especially the babi chilli garam. Friendly staff and good service. Food was served fast. Would come again.

Author: FannyY167
Title: Superb lunch
Review: As time for lunch about to close, the restaurant was very helpful to settle us and order with food. Great service given also.

Author: karencek1129
Title: Good food for dinner!
Review: We went there after a friend recommended. Good ambience, menu with lots of choices & price is just average Reservation is advisable.

Author: Wam7822
Title: Wonderful lunch
Review: The food is delicious especially you order their signature dishes like fish chilli Garam, chicken chilli garam, itek Tim soup and not forgetting their chendol.The service is good and the lady boss is very nice.Make sure you need to reserve your table as it is very crowded.Highly recommended, will go again next time.Show less

Author: XYTravellerAsia
Title: Yummy!
Review: It's advisable to book in advance if you would like to dine at this place. The lady who took our orders is honest and recommended dishes suitable for kids. We had 2 portions of the babi chili garam cos it was so good that it ran out in no time. Their smoked kampung chicken is also a must try. The deep fried fish(orh ngor/Indian threadfin) is well made (expensive). Rest of the dishes were good too: Udang nanas, lady's finger, pie tee, chap chye, kai lan. Will definitely come back again.Show less

Author: sue966966
Title: GOOD FOOD ! YUMMY !!
Review: Come back here again for the food.. we have ordered babi cili garam and fish are my all time favourite as always.. yummy yummy ..we dont have to wait long for the food to serve and the service is good too.. will be back soon again definitely ..Show less

Author: bobeebobeeipoh
Title: Lovely dinner
Review: Went back again after my last few years visit. Surprisingly the food is still great as before! I love how friendly they are especially the captain. The service is awesome and she is very helpful in suggesting the food. My most favorite is Kurau Chili Garam and of course their chendol too. It’s thick and flavory. The deco is exquisite and maintained even after several years they operated. Definitely will come back again next time! Thank you SamFu and keep it up your good work!Show less

Author: Kelvintaysc
Title: Atrocious attitude
Review: Food was recommended by close friend. Came here the first time and food was good, today returned due to the food, but the WORST service I've ever experienced! Simply atrocious! Showed us the meanest gestures when we wanted to order food! Never ever coming back again, never recommending.Show less

Author: DeathsDragon95Hinckley, United Kingdom
Title: Ok
Review: We decided to try this place as we thought it was good and had to book a table in advance. The restaurant is in the hotel and the hotel entrance is nice.We were taken straight to our table, the place was empty when we arrived as they had just opened, but while we were there the place filled up and was quite busy. We ordered drinks which we had a wine however the wine wasn't very good so wouldn't say have the wine.We ordered a few different dishes, a sharing starter and a few different mains which some rice etc. We thought that the food would come out like normal for instance get the starter first then after that was finished the mains however they brought out some of the mains first and the starter then everything. They wouldn't hold the food due to it already being cooked so we had to have everything together which was ok but cramped for the size of table and all the dishes on the table. The food was ok, quite nice, the menu was an ok size and an ok selection to choose. Overall the staff were mainly friendly, the food was ok, it is quite expensive, the decor is good with being modern. The place seemed clean. This restaurant is worth a try for the food if you can book a table.Show less

Author: Jeyjey05Rawang, Malaysia, Asia
Title: Mediocre food
Review: We went there after a friend recommended. Food that we ordered were just nice. Babi cili garam was definitely worth it. Others were juz normal. Nothing exceptional. Other than that.. It had good ambience. Good place to hv a meal in peace. Price was average (maybe Coz we din choose fish). Please book before going. Show less

Author: Makan28Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious
Review: We were invited to this restaurant for lunch by good family friends, and we were not disappointed. The Deep fried fish was the best dish and so was the pork pong Teh. The okra with sambal belachan was nice too. The duck was fine - just needed more cooking so the meat was softer. Chendol was delicious. We will certainly revisit when back in Malacca Show less

Author: samnatkarenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mostly Hits but some misses
Review: The place was recommended to us by a local. There were some hits such as the chilli pork which was really good in my opinion and the fried chilli fish is really well fried and the fish was fresh. However, the chap chai and omelette is not that good. Everyone of us felt really thirsty after the meal which only meant that msg was used quite liberally to make the food taste better. Show less

Author: Wally-SingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Room for improvement
Review: I'm not sure why this place merits anything above 3 bubbles. Our group of 36 adults and 5 children went for lunch there on the recommendation of some friends. Personally, I found that the food was a little below the standards of other Nonya restaurants with a 4 bubble rating. And as compared to other places the prices were not really that cheap.I wouldn't recommend this restaurant if you're looking for anything special.Show less

Author: Thomasong1980
Title: Overrated
Review: If you have tasted good Peranakan food , forget about expecting much from here. We had the chilli pork which was quite oily . The chapcai was mediocre. The only good comfort was the sambal chilli which you must order from the side menu. Skip the chendol.Show less

Author: JM712Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Could be better
Review: Tried this restaurant on adhoc basis after reading various reviews that it is recommended. Order a few of their signature dish. They were good but I think it could be better or I have tasted better elsewhere. If you come on weekends please make sure you make an advanced booking as tables are next to none unless you are lucky. Show less

Author: Aungloo
Title: Best Nyonya food in town
Review: Recommended by a local friend.. I visited it during CNY and the food are exceptionally good. The restaurant feels pleasant and radiant with it's decorations.I ordered some of its popular dishes such as pon teh, jenak fish and babi chili garam and my favourite was on each of its signature dish Babi chili garam.The price is fairly reasonable and I would definitely recommend my friends to this restaurant and I surely will come back tooShow less

Author: KnightLiow83
Title: Nice food
Review: I have tried so many nyonya cuisine in Melaka, but never had this kind of great experience in samFu. They are so helpful in suggesting the menu, with the price shown, i think it is worth every single money spent since the food is so great. Totally recommended.Show less

Author: CiciGraceMoretz
Title: Great food with great interior
Review: Worth the money. Decent food preparation. The waitress lady is very helpful in suggesting food. Definitely will come back again soon!

Author: CapriowongDurian Tunggal, Malaysia
Title: Nice food good environment
Review: Nice food good environment with free packing ,only local person know this local nyonya foodNice food good environment with free packing ,only local person know this local nyonya foodNice food good environment with free packing ,only local person know this local nyonya foodNice food good environment with free packing ,only local person know this local nyonya foodMust tryShow less

Author: Torpleen
Title: Overpriced
Review: We ordered 4 dishes , one of it was fish , and the rest are just chicken and mixed vegetables , but we had to pay 275 myr for 4 dishes , the mixed vegetables cost 40+ myr and it tasts horrible . The lady who served us was really impatient and charged us for beverages that wasn't even served and didn't even apologize for that . The only good thing is the ambience and the interior design .Show less

Author: CanmoreFunkyDudeCanmore, Canada
Title: Not great for groups of less than four!
Review: Malays like to eat out in large groups, and this is reflected in the way some restaurant’s menus are designed, and how they operate. I showed up at this eatery early, knowing that they get busy later, to try some Nyonya food. I wasn’t made very welcome as a solo guest, and was given the small round table right in front of the door where I suspect they usually stack their menus. The server wasn’t very interested in helping me find a dish on the menu suitable for a single customer, and steered me to a chicken and pork pong the, which turned out to be the least appetizing or inspired pong the I have ever eaten. After being jostled by other guests entering the establishment for half an hour, I gave up on the the place, asked for my bill and left. MYR 45, for pong teh, small dish of sambal, and a drink. I didn’t bother to tip, feeling that my money would make me happier and be more welcome elsewhere. Show less

Author: EneeliSingapore, Singapore
Title: Locally recommended, great Nyonya food
Review: You know the food is great when a local recommends the place! Hidden away inside the Mimosa Hotel, the SamFu restaurant features old style Nyonya cooking. It's usually packed during meal times so you are advised to call ahead and make a reservation. Some of the best Peranakan food I ever tried is here (e.g. rendang). The service is good as well.Show less

Author: Mike_Wong75Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice atmosphere and good food !
Review: Initially, my worry was the availability of the car parking space around this place as this was my first time visiting this restaurant for dinner. It was finally a relief when I arrived where it has a number of outdoor car parks within the Mimosa hotel compound. The restaurant is located on the ground floor of Mimosa Hotel towards the back of the hotel. I was fascinated with the atmosphere of the restaurant. In the menu, there was a mix of the peranakan food and local dishes selection. I ordered Babi Chilli Garam (a signature dish recommended by the owner), Chap Chai (Nyonya Mixed Vegetables), Cinchaluk Omelette, Chicken Rendang (recommended by owner as well) and a jar of Lemongrass Ginger drink. The food was tasty, good recommendation by the owner. The Babi Chilli Garam was cooked using marinated pork slices with dried chillies, it was very fragrant and unique. The Chicken Rendang is not a peranakan dish (we have had enough Pongteh Chicken and Buak Keluak Chicken during this trip), surprisingly it was very good and authethic. Appetizer Acar was sourly appetizing. Unfortunately, the Chap Chai was a little bland compared to other Chap Chai I tasted in this trip, so not recommended. The ginger lemon grass was specially prepared and served in an unique Chinese tranditional thermo-flask.Show less

Author: Wee Kiat PKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A quaint restaurant with great food.
Review: What struck me the most was the arty atmosphere when i entered the restaurant. The entrance is framed by a mural and the entrance is located at the side of the mimosa hotel. The decor made it feel like i had gone back in time and the place was crowded. I recommend calling ahead to make reservations. Especially for dinner. There is a huge painting of a woman in a chinese outfit on the main wall. Samfu serves peranakan food, which is the food of the straits chinese (chinese who migrated to melaka centuries ago) and i would say that peranakan food is the taste of melaka. The service was efficient, so we got our food quickly. The food was delicious and went very well with beer. The food at Samfu is very good by any standard.Show less

Author: bunnyespresso
Title: Average food, Terrible Service
Review: Went to try out the peranakan food with my friends from KL. Food taste average. Asked the waitress for the wifi password, she came back with a paper and threw it on the table. It ruined my mood. Unpleasant dining experience.

Author: becksangel7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average tasting, nice atmosphere
Review: Located behind Mimosa hotel, you have to call and book in advance especially if you intend to visit on a weekend. With 5 adults & 3 kids, we had 6 dishes. Babi chilli garam, chicken & pork pong teh, itik tim soup, onion omellete, steamed ocra and chap chye, rice & 2 bottles of drinking water (surprised this was charged at RM3 per bottle) came to a total of RM177.50. Worth trying the baby chilli garam but the rest were so-so, i've tasted better in other restaurants in Melaka. Paintings on the wall and the restaurant setup was nice.Show less

Author: danielcY6181JZJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Praises all round
Review: Our party of about 40 old schoolmates and teachers came for lunch after a reunion dinner the night before. The food was pre ordered and was served very quickly. We had practically all their signature dishes and there were praises all round for the serving size and taste of dishes. More importantly, pork is served here giving a better authenticity to the peranakan genre. The finale of a huge serving of cendol with finely shaved ice and a generous amount of gula melaka made this a really memorable outing. Show less

Author: JUDYLEE2003
Title: A Taste Of Nyonya
Review: This restuarant is located within Hotel Mimosa. We went on a week day so is less crowded. The place has a touch of nyonya heritage.  The food are average to me and you can refer to the photos of the menu we order..

Author: TravelCQHong Kong, China
Title: Great food. Nice atmosphere
Review: Had a great dinner here with a bottle of their rm88 house red. Lots of pork on the menu, very tasty preparation. It did not have some of the typical Nyonya dishes I know and others I didn't know so overall it felt to me like not eating Nyonya food but a great Chinese restaurant. Clientele is kinda Malaysian Singapore Chinese people, mostly in big family table. Did not see any westerners or Indian. Show less

Author: 911tclCyberjaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Nyonya cuisine
Review: This restaurant serves excellent Nyonya cuisine. From pongteh to prawn curry to lor bak, every dish is a masterpiece! The sambal belacan is excellent. Would definitely recommend repeats visits and reservations ahead of dining is required as the restaurant operates at capacity most of the time.Show less

Author: polomeimeiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Peranakan food
Review: Setting aside the kitschy decor, fortunately the food doesn't disappoint. We ordered so many dishes and the flavours were robust and authentic. We all love the fish cooked in sweet sauce, lady's finger, otak and prawn with pineapples (udang masak nanas). To finish off the meal, we ordered chendol. Again there was no scrimping of gula melaka and coconut. A big triumph of a meal!Show less

Author: puresecretsShinjuku, Japan
Title: Delicious
Review: We visited here as recommended by a local malaccan. The experience and food did not disappoint at all. I am a fan of spicy food so I was very much delighted to see the chili and spice in the meals. However the spice level may be a little high for the average eater. Keep it up. Enjoyed it. Show less

Author: ChangBoris
Title: Very lovely...
Review: This is a very authentic Baba Nyonya restaurant both in terms of dexor and food. The moment you step in, it gives you that warm homely feeling. Food is good and service too.

Author: Henry WPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Top Non-Halal Nyonya Restaurant in town
Review: Situated in the Mimosa Hotel, lots of parking space, easy to find.Good Nyonya food becomes great Nyonya food when they offer it with Non-halal ingredients.Ngor hiong lor Bak, pong teh pork belly, pineapple gulai prawn, okra Nyonya style, the list goes on...Definitely top of the Melaka foodie bucket list.Show less

Author: ritzr2017
Title: Decent Food
Review: Portions were good and taste was authentic. Luved the flavours. Nicely furnished and service was ok. A lot of the dishes were crossed out as unavailable. This place lacks variety. They are expensive.

Author: lohcm26
Title: Good authentic nyonya food
Review: We had an enjoyable and delicious lunch despite reaching there at almost 2.30pm, they are very nice to accommodate us. It's the best nyonya food so far in Melaka compared to the more established one around.

Author: neris2912Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious peranakan food
Review: Great food in a very pleasant environment. We had the chicken and pork pongteh, chap chai, spring rolls, ngoh hiang, itek tim soup, chendol and hot lemongrass and ginger drink My kids especially liked the pongteh as the sauce went very well with rice and the leaf man tou. I wasn't too impressed with the chap chai as it was not as tender and flavourful as others I have had, although my wife said that it tasted much better with belachan. The spring rolls included bamboo shoots which I am not fond of but I am sure there are others who like it. My favourite dish was the ngoh hiang which was probably one of the nicest I have ever tasted. The lemon grass drink was went very well with the food. All in all a very delicious meal with very reasonable prices. I will definitely visit them again to try other dishes. Show less

Author: aukenn
Title: Great Ambient
Review: The food was great and taste was peranakan original. Most of the dishes came out really well. The lemon grass tea was really refreshing.

Author: WongK1365
Title: Real authentic nonya food!
Review: Very tasty and flavorsome. Had 4 dishes for dinner, all excellent. 2 thick slabs of fish cutlets fried to perfection, crispy on outside but flesh is still soft on inside. Enough for 4 hungry foodies. Petai, babi ponteh and their achar is to die for. Though all four dishes were spiced and chilli dishes, there were subtle differences in their taste. Heavenly.Verdict? Excellent food experience. Restorant Nonya Suan, shame on you for a fake nonya food experience.Show less

Author: pingpingjoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food Is Slightly Above Average But Rude And Arrogant Owners!
Review: We came here because we've tasted a good handful of Nyonya restaurants in Malacca and were looking for a different restaurant to try. Overall, the food is not too bad - we ordered mostly the signature dishes. Worth highlighting are the pongteh chicken (or pork), cili garam pork and lemak nenas prawns. It's not the best Nyonya food but if you've pretty much explored a few other Nyonya restaurants and would like to try a new one, you can give this a go. It is pricier as well. A word of caution though, the owners (or the captains) are rude, arrogant and obnoxious! It's quite off putting and unnecessary. No wonder this place didn't make it to the list of top places to try. A good dining experience should not only leave the Customers bellyful but an enjoyable memory too but you can only get the former here, unfortunately.Show less

Author: Rachel E
Title: Good but expensive!
Review: The food was not too bad here. Small portions so you can order a lot to share, which means you can try more types of food. A glass of water cost RM1. So bring your own plain water. I came with my family and the 5 of us ordered 5 dishes with rice. The bill came to RM226.30. Free WiFi and fast service. Show less

Author: Resh_8
Title: Lovely restaurant
Review: Delicious nyonya food in a lovely setting. We were glad we had a reservation as the place was full and there was already a queue. It was a great place to start off our Melaka trip after a 3hr drive.

Author: cath_Spore
Title: Nyonya food!
Review: Real delicious food! I have been to malacca very often but this is the first time to this restaurant! Great find.

Author: donovanSYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Perenakan food
Review: Must make appointment as I believe most tables are reserved. Located on the ground floor of Mimosa Hotel and has a small parking lot for about 15 cars.Have visited many Perenakan restaurants in Meleka but always return to this one when in Meleka. Dont miss the lemongrass tea and the Babi Chili Garam.Show less

Author: TootteeeKL
Title: Bad Customer Service
Review: We heard the food is good here. So, we decided that we should pay a visit to try.The service crew that took our order was quite unprofessional(rude). We were 5 and ordered 4 dished and 1 started. The service crew said we ordered too less, saying that the dishes are small and most of what we ordered are snack portion. We decided to add more as the service crew told us that it will be a long wait if we top up later. Ended up we have too much food and the dishes were out very quickly so as other tables.I am very doubtful about the honesty of the staffs in this restaurant. Food is good but would not recommend. There are many good nyonya restaurant in Malacca with better service.Show less

Author: ysl_juniorKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the best Nyonya Restaurant!
Review: Samfu is located inside Mimosa Hotel. Limited parking available, maybe 20-25 parking lots only. If you are heading there, search/look out for Mimosa Hotel.We called to make a booking and the only available dinner slot was 8.30pm. But, they called us at around 7pm to inform that we can we can go earlier. We ordered almost 10 dishes and every dishes turned out really good. We really like the babi cili garam (spicy pork slices), steamed ladies fingers, achar and pongteh chicken.Some special dishes require pre-order. So, do call up and enquire.Show less

Author: Neil912Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Food
Review: The sambal fish very nice. Udang superb. Sambal petail yummy. Overall dining experience is nice. I realised the food quality is better in weekday. Weekend standard a bit out of taste especially the udang nenas and cendol. I hope they continue maintain good status and pricing a bit high. Average dining per person is around RM40 to RM50. However the ambience is beautiful. Show less

Author: Alvin NKuching, Malaysia
Title: World of Suzy Wong plus Peranakan Chinese
Review: A Peranakan-Chinese restaurant that serves good good food. Must trys are the chicken rendang, babi chilli garam and sambal petai with anchovies. Generally, Peranakan food is quite good in Melaka but this one is definitely one notch above. For drinks, recommended is the lemon grass hot tea.Show less

Author: mayjayneKuala Lumpur
Title: Not The Best...
Review: We dined here, but found the food mediocre - not really the best of Peranakan food I have tasted. The Babi Chilli Garam was not bad but super spicy - all you could taste was the chilly actually (for a person like me who love spicy food). As mentioned by another reviewer, the Cincalok Omelette tasted just like any plain omelette. Otak-Otak and Eggplant dish were just 'so-so' in taste. The only dish worth recommending was the Sambal Prawn. If anything, the service made up for the food, and the Peranakan décor was not bad.Show less

Author: angelzoelam
Title: Peranakan food
Review: the best Peraknakan food i ever had especially the ayam pongteh and the babi chilli garam is my favourite. love the home mad belacan. portion of the food was just nice. nice decorations and fast serving of the foods.

Author: MommyYo
Title: Two Thumbs up!
Review: We enjoyed our authentic Peranakan dinner at Samfu on the 23rd of September, especially their Ayam Pongteh which went well with their home made sambal belacan. The Babi Garam was excellent and so was their fried fish with cili garam. Two thumbs up!

Author: Arthur Elfin CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: One of the best Peranakan restaurants
Review: Dinner at Samfu (in Hotel Mimosa).This was almost the "king of all our meals at Malacca". I said "almost" because I suspect there was quite a lot of MSG used - I'd never been any thirstier after a meal. Ambience & Service:Modern East Asian with soft lighting. The restaurant seems to cater to large groups as most of the tables sit 8 or more diners. We didn't have a reservation and initially the staff said there wasn't a table for 2. But she quickly relented for some reason and got us a table in less than 5 min. Service was prompt; the waiters were polite and food was served in 10 min.Food:a. Ordered Assam Pineapple Prawns, Chicken and Pork Ponteh, Ngoh Hiang, Nonya Chup Chai, Cincalok Omelette, Lemongrass Ginger Tea, and Chendol.b. Assam Pineapple Prawns: their speciality. The assam was lovely with plenty of pineapples and prawns. I'm not a huge fan of prawns and liked the pineapples more but the prawns were quite fresh - definitely frozen and not live (not that I wanted it anyway). b. Chicken and Pork Ponteh: The braised sauce was very flavourful. Meat was tender. The pork was more meaty than the chicken. c. Ngoh Hiang: The best I've tasted so far! Crispy, moist, and fragrant. You can actually taste the meat in it. d. Nonya Chup Chai: This was made in fermented beancurd sauce which gave it a big oomph! Lovely but would have been perfect if the cabbage had been a bit more cooked. It tasted a bit raw and hard.e. Cincalok Omelette: I'm confused about this one. It was basically an omelette served with cincalok at the side as a dip. Not too sure if this dish was meant this way because I was expecting the cincalok to be fried with the omelette.f. Lemongrass Ginger Tea: Awesome! Fragrant, light and calming. And not too sweet. Served in a traditional flask - another big plus! g. Chendol: A bit disappointing. The gula melaka tasted "commercial" and the sweetness wasn't as natural as the others I had. I'd say give it a miss.Price: SGD 52 for everything BUT the portions were huge! I'd say for 4 diners! 2 of us managed to gorge everything. Overall: Definitely good value for money and more so if there are 4 of you! The above dishes more than suffice. However, as I mentioned earlier, there might be too much MSG used. I'm still thirsty now (3 hours after dinner!).Show less

Author: unkaleongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Service, great food
Review: We arrived at the restaurant without a reservation around 7PM, during peak dinner hour. We were offered a place at the bar, which we really didn't mind. But when the manager noticed my wife was pregnant, a space was cleared and we were offered a table right by the entrance of the restaurant. The starter of acar was sour and tangy, just as all good acar's should taste like. We proceeded to order the Pongteh, Brinjals and sambal sotong. All the dishes served were excellent! The sambal that came with the Pongteh was delicious and had just the right amount of spice.Show less

Author: Lyn NAdelaide, Australia
Title: Local, authentic cuisine.
Review: While in Melaka I took advantage of sampling the local cuisine. On 3 or 4 occasions ate at SAMFU and enjoyed dishes that were part of the traditional food eaten in old Melaka. The staff were efficient and pleasant and chef Keong welcomed guests . Prices were reasonable and the food was of a high standard. I would recommend a visit when visiting this city. Show less

Author: joykooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: When we arrived at about 1pm, there was only 1 table. Service is prompt and attentive. Ambience was nice and comfortable.The food is a bit of a disappointment. The babi pongteh had a very strong pork smell and the meat is tough. Chincalok omelette was very oily. Otak otak tastes flat. Show less

Author: MickelT6
Title: Felt cheated!
Review: 2nd time there. Ordered the fried kurau again as the kids loved it. Waitress came back and said no kurau but substitute with grouper at same price $78. We received a normal grey grouper :(The petai dish $28....we could count the number of petai with our hands. There were so much more fried onions in there. First time there was end of 2016. Mum loved the babi chilli garam. Dad liked the Babi Ponteh. We all loved the fried petai. Food was tasty and savoury. Thought we had found a new Favourite Peranakan haunt. Alas, we were let down Show less

Author: Tay K
Title: Friendly staff and good Nyonya food
Review: One of my favourite nyonya restaurant in Melaka.   Fiendly staff and good service. Love all their dishes. Better have booking before you go especially on weekends and public holidays.

Author: faithgay
Title: Samfu @ mimosa hotel
Review:
Samfu will satisfy your search for good nyonya food in Malacca.
Book your table to avoid disappointment.

Author: kimiryll
Title: Reasonable Price, Cozy Environment & Friendly Staff
Review: The food is delicious and serve quite fast. Staff there are efficient and friendly. They can speak well english, chinese and cantonese. I like all the dishes except the petai with ikan bilis - basically this dish have less than 10 petai almost whole dish was covered by onion. They should named it Stir fry onion instead :/ Rememeber to make reservation!!Show less

Author: MarkS960
Title: Samfu Nyonya Restaurant
Review: One the best Nyonya Restaurant in Melaka. The nyonya dishes are great, especially the deep fried fish with sambal chilli, the lady finger, the spicy king prawns with pineapples and the other nyonya pork dishes etc. The service is efficient fast.

Author: AlmineB1
Title: Wow
Review: Introduced by Timez Hotel and seriously food here so delicious, good choice for Peranakan cuisine! Have to take their prawn masak nanas and port chili garam!

Author: svangohTanjung Pinang, Indonesia
Title: Taste so local and Heavenly
Review: I really really love the nyonya food that they serve here. Remember to book for seat before you plan to come, we were lucky cos the cashier lady allow us to have our dinner on that day even they are fully booked on 8pm that day! Foods taste wonderful, super friendly and cheap!Show less

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Highlight of the trip!
Review: Sam Fu was our favourite restaurant of the trip. The quality of food was beyond our expectation. We tried the stewed pork, chup chye and fish maw soup and they were delicious! The service was good although they were very busy for the night. As the restaurant is extremely popular, reservations are highly recommended for fridays and weekends. Show less

Author: peace20294265
Title: A mediocre restaurant
Review: There is so much rave about this restaurant so we died to try it but we were utterly disappointed with the food it was not up to our expectation of a good restaurant.

Author: AlminebayKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Nyonya cuisine
Review: Introduced by friend. And seriously the Nyonya foods here way better than others in Melaka. Been to few famous Nyonya Restaurant, but this one will be my latest favorite Nyonya restaurant so far. However, a bit princely but who's care as long the food is delicious.Show less

Author: aikichin
Title: Amazing Peranakan cuisine
Review: We were grateful that our friend from Melaka got a reservation for us. The food was simply heavenly. A bit on the pricey side but we felt the premium was well worth it for the quality of the food.

Author: KatherinaA15
Title: 食物不错， 老板热心
Review: The spicy level of the food is acceptable, price range of the food is between 28-78. Staff is approachable, the quality of the food is good.

Author: hanchiny
Title: A must try Peranakan Nonya food in Melaka
Review: This restaurant is located in Mimosa Hotel. Ample car park if you are driving. A truly authentic Nonya food. Try all their signature dish in the menu. Food reasonably price.

Author: SG2019FebTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Great food and great price
Review: I was there because my friend who visited this place few months ago gave this place 3 thumbs up. We visited many Nonya Restaurants in Melaka over a period of many many years, we used to love Seri Nyonya Peranakan Restaurant at Hotel Equatorial, but the standard dropped like an avalanche (ever since 2 years ago I stopped going there ). We made advance reservation to avoid unnecessary disappointment and all of us were very pleased with the food and the service. The waitress & waiters were very busy walking in and out and we could see walked in dinners left the restaurant when they saw the place packed with so many people.I love the salted duck soup very much and my wife love the fish maw (鱼票) soup. One of the children love the Ponteh mix with Ayam and pork (see picture) so much that she are 2 bowl of rice. The only dish that I dislike is the chili fried fish - over cooked the fish's meat became too dried. The price is very reasonable, is about SGD $11 per head ; we had fish , prawn, soups, egg , vegetables. .. l will go back again.Show less

Author: sujivahen7Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Good nonya food
Review: I m a local in Melaka n like to find the good food. This is one of the best new style nonya food in the town. Went there for few times, I quite satisfied with their food n services. They usually welcome u with a glass of Lemmon grass water, but you have pour out from an old style thermos bottle. I used to order the finger ladies, deep fried fish with sambal, mix vegetables, ponteh n lok back. Each dish compliment by different chili sambal especially the fish! Must try.Show less

Author: SJSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Repeat Visit
Review: I was introduced to this restaurant during my previous trip to Melaka in Sep 2016, and I got hooked to a dish named Babi Chilli Garam. On both occasions, I ordered take-away to bring back to my home country. I would return again for the same dish, and do hope that the standard is maintained.Show less

Author: Ganesh L
Title: Very good "Melaka Nyonya" food
Review: Friendly "home like" service. The décor was lovely. Food selection was amazing and tasty.... Fish, pork, chicken, egg....and all. The house recommended cuisine was great.

Author: shamini82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rejected upfront
Review: We went to this restaurant because it was on highly recommended list. But sadly, after a few mins of wait , no one came to us. When we asked the person in charge, she just rudely said in a loud voice "fully booked!". We don't mind if it's fully booked, but at least it can be addressed in a nice way. Some courtesy people, courtesy!Show less

Author: cherijustyneSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Nyonya food, cooked with care and precision.
Review: The restaurant is located at the ground floor of Mimosa Hotel. We stayed at Jonker Boutique Hotel and it was a short Uber ride away (or if you're up for it, probably a 10 min walk from Jonker St). Every dish was spot on - from the bowl of achar that we were served upon being seated to the dishes we ordered (Chicken Rendang, Babi Chilli Garam & Steamed Okra)We're from Singapore and although the Nyonya dishes were very unlike those we would find at home, we throughly enjoyed our meal and will definitely make the trip here when we next come to Melaka.Show less

Author: ramnathcrishnan12Mumbai, India
Title: Excellent Nyonya food
Review: Was recommended to us by a Melacan friend. Located on the GF of Mimosa hotel. Food was outstanding - very fresh and pork and fish dishes were delicious. Some dishes are spicy too, if you like a bit of zip. Decent ambience. More of a lunch place. Show less

Author: CwwsimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent nonya food!
Review: One of the best nonya food I've had for a long long time. We ordered a variety of dishes such as pineapple assam prawns, lady fingers, a chilli fried fish and my friend pre-ordered a fish curry and braised duck.Loved the pineapple assam prawns, probably the best I've ever had! The chilli fried "mak yau" fish was super fresh and tasty and the archar side dish was flavorful as well.We were less enthusiastic about the pre-ordered dishes and the dessert chendol lacked the oomph factor.Overall we were quite happy with our meal at Samfu nonya restaurant and will be back visiting next time! Show less

Author: Alphablack
Title: Very good Nyonya food in pleasant setting
Review: Despite being in the back of a hotel, this restaurant served tasty food and in huge portions. Wine and beer are also available. Worth a visit. May well need to book on Friday and Saturdays

Author: Ling L
Title: Highly recommended
Review: You can't go wrong with any of their dishes. They are closed on Monday and Tuesday. Book a table before going.

Author: myjourneybeginsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Hidden and under-rated gem!
Review: Since it is my countless visits to Melaka, I wanna try different peranakan restaurant other than the usual Nancy or Amy. I came across a blogger's recommendation and decided to try out Samfu! Well, it is way beyond my expectation! The staff are friendly. The dishes were served fast and hot. Every dish that we ordered tasted so delicious! We ordered 7 dishes for 4 pax and the staff is doubtful if we can finish all. And in fact, we did! I love their Kueh Pie Tee. Haha.. I hate to share this review because I'm so worried the food standard will drop or staff will get snobbish when Samfu gets famous or crowded. But.. I would still like to give them (especially the chef) the credit and compliments they deserve! Thumbs up!Show less

Author: telur1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: nice place

Too strong and over powering. Decor i not bad but some things were total unnecessary as it makes the place choke and have the feeling of too much thingsShow less

Author: Camanda80Singapore, Singapore

The ambience is nice and staff very friendly. Definately worth a visit if its your first time in town.Show less

Author: zeeyeng

Author: ykyong83Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner

Highly recommend to try their Kuah Lada Fish Head, babi chili, pineapple prawns and ponteh. The restaurant is a gem, hidden inside Hotel Mimosa Melaka. Show less

Author: Elaineylow
Title: One of the best nyonya cuisine
Review: One of the best nyonya food we had in Melaka. Great dining ambience coupled with delicious and fresh nyonya cuisine. Will definitely go back for more!

Author: DayleePaletaToronto, Canada
Title: Lovely and special

The food is very well prepared and the portions are huge. We went quite late so they were out of some of the dishes, but we still had an excellent meal. It’s not very expensive by North American standards, but it was definitely a treat!Show less

Author: dannytanny
Title: Average peranakan food
Review: First time here and find the food average. Service is ok but can be much better. Hopefully they can promote their signature dishes to customers. Toilet condition should be improved

Author: fOODSLOVEr668
Title: Great Meal
Review: Cozy Peranakan decoration, authentic Nyonya foods you shouldn't miss when you are in Melaka, such like Udang masak lemak with pineapple, their signature pork dish with chili flake and ayam ponteh

Author: mojiko_gkSingapore, Singapore
Review: Be mesmerized by the impressive fusion peranakan decoration, the moment you step into the restaurant. Thank you Chef Keong for his "omakase" creation! And more surprised with every dish presented ....my guests were totally blown away.... Everything was zealously perfect...colour, texture and taste were spectacular ... Highly recommended Show less

Author: nroomasHino, Japan
Title: Clean and welcoming restaurant; the food is just okay

As we, a family of three, went on Thursday evening, it wasn't crowded, and so we had no trouble getting a table.We expected to enjoy some excellent Nyonya cuisine; unfortunately they ran out of pai tee that we had wanted to try the night before at another place. Overall, I found the food there okay but nothing to rave about though the portion was generous enough to be shared by three or four people. If you are hungry and ready for some spicy dishes, you would probably give a better rating for their food.You can take away if you can't eat all you have ordered, which is a nice touch. Their "Lemon Grass with Ginger" drink, served in an old-fashioned vacuum flask to be shared, was our favorite.We had four or five dishes with a bottle of South African wine and a bottle of Tiger beer; the total price was about 300 RM, which I thought was reasonable considering the high price tags for alcoholic beverages in Malaysia. Show less

Author: Pris_ShillaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pretty Ambience & Tasty Food
Review: This restaurant is at Mimosa Hotel Melaka and i have to say, I was quite impressed for the first time try!!First impression is always the best impression! As we walked in to the restaurant we could only say "WoW"!! Very well and attractively design restaurant with its perfect quiet ambience is so welcoming. And so were those who worked there. We ordered a few items for just 2 of us. Food came and very prettily plated and i always feel, "The Food that looks good to the eye is inviting to the tummy as well"!! Awesome lovely food. Show less

Author: Bobby118
Title: So so only lah
Review: I had high expectations as I've eaten a number of baba nyonya restaurants but I'll give it 6 out of 10 for food n service lah.

Author: Becky_KWPetaling Jaya
Title: Nyonya food at its' best!
Review: If you are looking for good nyonya food in Malacca, look no more because SamFu Restaurant is THE place to go for a sumptuous meal! A good friend recommended this place to me when I told her I was coming to Malacca and wanted to eat nyonya cuisine.SamFu is located in Mimosa Hotel along Jalan Bunga Raya. When we arrived for dinner, the place was packed to the brim. Reservations is a must if you don’t want to be turned away, disappointed. They have limited car parks space, so come early. The ambience was cozy despite the noise level inside the restaurant. You can see diners who were just happily digging into their food! Didn’t know what to expect initially but when they started serving the food, our own jaws dropped. Superb presentation and food was so flavourful that my mother-in-law, who is not easily pleased, especially when it comes to nyonya cooking, was full of praise that night! The portions were generous and the pricing reasonable. The food was served quite quickly despite the crowd and the staff were brisk but friendly! Overall, a great dining experience and I would definitely recommend this to anyone who is looking for great nyonya food in Malacca.And don’t forget to order the ‘cendol’ dessert! It was surely a cut above the rest!Show less

Author: Guide2863
Title: Just What I Needed
Review: While walking around the Jonker area looking at the long queues, my good friend said "follow me". What a find !!! Good service with a friendly smile. The food what what I wanted. I had a dish I had not had for nearly 20 years. Thanks SamFuShow less

Author: BrianTong
Title: Great hidden nyonya restaurant.  Classical Deco and ambience.  Nice food and must visit if you're in Mallaca town.
Review: Been here lately and found this not crowded and over rated nyonya restaurant.   Nice ambience and food is great.  Very classical interior bring back old memories for many whom grown up in Malacca. Pay a visit the next time.

Author: Glenn_1970_12Kuala Lumpur
Title: Sumptuous dinner at SamFu in Melaka
Review: This restaurant is located in Mimosa Hotel. Not very big but has a cozy decor. Advisable to make an appointment especially for big group in weekend dinners.It was crowded when we went but since we were only a party of 3, we managed to get a table booked for us.We ordered the Chicken and Pork Pong Teh - it was very tasty. The gravy was thick and flavourful.The Prawn Nenas curry was also very delightful...strong spices with a sweet and sour flavour and the prawns were big and fresh.The Assam Jenahak Fish was OK - Not the best I have tasted.Service was very good. Polite waiters and food was delivered very fast.The overall price was also very reasonable RM150 for :Chicken and Pork Pong TehAssam Fish with 2 large pieces of Jenahak fishPrawn Nenas curryKailan with Garlic.And there were 3 of us.I will go back there for the Prawn nenas and the Pong Teh.Show less

Author: Halo2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fabulous food!!
Review: I was recommended to this place by my friend who visited a week back. I called up to reserve a table at 2.30pm which the receptionist happily obliged. When I reached there at 2.30pm I realised their opening hours for lunch was until 2.30pm and I felt apologetic intruding into their rest time. However the service staff was more than happy to serve, even though I was the last guests to arrive as the others have left. I ordered the chilli pork, chap chye, soup and kway pie teee. This had to be one of the best and most authentic nonya food I have tried. The chilli pork although fried with minced chillis was not very spicy, and even though it's fried, it was not oily at all yet the meat was so succulent and the taste very appetitsing. Many of the nonya places I've been to serve very soggy chap chye (cabbage dish) but this was nicely done without being too sourish. What can I say about the kway pie tee? It was so good I gobbled down 3 (I'm usually not a big eater). The prices I feel is reasonable for the quality. For 100rm, the portions could have fed 3-4 but myself and my husband finished all the food in no time. Show less

Author: FelixH374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Peranakan food in a funky atmosphere
Review: Great food ; nice presentations We had the pong teh - nice flavour ESP with the mixture of chicken n porkThe garam Assam fish was spicy but beautifully fried The chap chye passed muster but needed a bit more kick .... Something was missing The sambal belachan was very good Pity they didn't have any ice hence no dessert Overall good dining experience Show less

Author: QuailooZürich
Title: Really good !
Review: I guess I am not an easy to please customer. But this place I really enyoyed a lot. Needless to say the food was really excellent and plenty. So was service, atmosphere with what I think fair & reasonable pricing. I will sure to come back once returning to Melaka. Great experience !Show less

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Finally ... something nice !
Review: Being a local boy but living away from home, it is always nice to eat something that we grew up on, ie Nonya food. With so many outlets open in Melaka, it is sometimes hard to find a good one. Was told by a relative on this place and decided to try. Nothing to complain. Lovely food and delicious with nice deco and ambience. Will make this my regular haunt for Nonya food when I am back hometown during the weekends.Show less

Author: YohyohSingapore
Title: Great food with great ambience
Review: This restaurant was highly recommended by a local friend. We indeed enjoy the food and nicely decorated restaurant. Hot lemongrass tea was served in an old fashion thermos, the one with the cloth sponge stopper. Achar was served as an apertizer, just the right sweetness with a ting of vinegar. We ordered Babi Chilli Garam, Udang Masak Nanas, Chap Chye, Pie Tee, Chicken & Pork Pongteh, Jenak Chill Garam (Fried Fish) and Chendol. Overall the food was fantastic and price was reasonable too. We would definitely be back for more.Show less

Author: BrotherDragonSingapore
Title: Excellent food, good value for money
Review: A Malacca friend recommended we try this restaurant on our first night in historic Malacca. The last time I was in Malacca was in 2011 and many new eateries have since been added. This is one of them.The Samfu Restaurant is located on the ground floor of the Mimosa Hotel and if you are driving, there are ample parking lots. But you really needn't drive there if you live in the old historic quarter of Malacca. It would be within walking distance.The restaurant is tastefully set up, with touches of old and new. It is air-conditioned but isn't too cold.The menu is well presented and the food selection is quite wide. As there were only three of us, we couldn't order too many dishes. Upon consultations with restaurant manager Jenny, we ordered the following:1 Nyonya chup chye. A perennial favourite of mine but hard to get decently cooked ones in most restaurants. It is a stew of various vegetables (cabbage, lily buds, black fungus, mushrooms, tang hoon or bean vermicelli, dried strips of beancurd skin and the chef of Samfu added extras such as cauliflower, carrot, broccoli), cooked in a broth of pork, fermented soy beans (tau cheo), garlic, onion, some sugar, pepper and salt. The myriad flavours and seasoning were well balanced and the vegetables fresh and not cooked to death. 2. Udang Masak Nanas (prawns in a pineapple curry). The prawns were fresh, the meat firm not soft. The pineapple curry was excellent. Not too spicy and bursting with layers upon layers of flavourful spices plus a dash of sourness. Just this dish and a plate of hot white rice would have suffice. A tongue-swallowing dish!3. Bendi (Lady's Fingers, okra) with Sambal. Here, I thought the chef was experimenting as the sambal that topped the dark-green vegetables looked interestingly complex. Usually, one gets a simpler belachan (fermented shrimp paste) dip or a dollop of sambal. As you can see in the photo it has fried shallot and onion rings, perhaps even slivers of lemongrass, fried garlic covering the sambal. A squeeze of lime and the dish was complete. 4. Chilli Garam Babi (pork). Another interesting dish. The pork belly meat was finely cut into small pieces and fried with another heady mixture of chillies and spices and garnished with fragrant coriander leaves. It was, however, a tad too salty for my taste, but if eaten with white rice, it's okay.Looking forward to try their other dishes on my next visit.* The chef, Keong, is not a Baba by the way, but he is an excellent cook and has picked up the nyonya recipes well. You can taste his passion in his dishes.Show less

Author: betavulgaris
Title: mouthwatering Nyonya food in beautiful surroundings
Review: I went here for lunch twice and had two wonderful experiences!The food is very fresh and tasty. Here you'll get authentic Nyonya food in a stylish restaurant, traditional with a modern take!The staff is extremely nice and helpful with recommendations on what to choose from the well put together menu. This place is not (yet?) touristy and has it's charming character. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: MKOH74
Title: Had a Very Good Dinning Experience with my family
Review:
Food was Excellent & Authentic.
Ambience was Good.  
Chef was Friendly.
Jenny who was our Service Staff was very Obliging and Helpful.
Definitely will come back again.

Author: eweleeongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good and authentic nyonya food
Review: Located in Hotel Mimosa on Jalan Bunga Raya, this new restaurant opened in early 2015.The owner of the restaurant opened this new restaurant to showcase its Nyonya traditional food. I have roots with Nyonya tradition in my family and I can attest to the taste that this is authentic Nyonya food.I had Sambal Petai Ikan Bilis, Sambal Sotong, Babi Goreng Masin and a few more traditional dishes. The quality of food is very good and fresh.The restaurant is very delicately decorated and quaint. The environment is cosy and conducive.The staff is very helpful and quick to bring the food to table. However, a fair caution to guests......the lady owner's public relations need some work and she may need to work on her EQ somewhat.Apart from that, if you are going there to enjoy the food and not for too much chit-chat....then this place is good.Happy eating.Show less

Author: JacqtanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great nonya food
Review: We had lunch at this beautifully decorated nonya restaurant. I have tried a few of the nonya restaurants highly recommended by those travel books / blogs but Samfu stands out. Beside the food, the services here are definitely better than the rest. The price is also quite reasonable. We loved the curry prawn, chilli pork and the beef rendang with mantou. This restaurant is located at Hotel Mimosa (bunga raya area). There is a car park at this hotel. Show less

Author: Samantha2805
Title: Best peranakan food from a Nonya
Review: The udang masak nenas ..... is to die for and so is the babi Belinbing is out of this world. even Aunty did not serve this dish. Chef os super friendly and staff is very attentive.

Author: Eskay97
Title: Excellent food and ambience
Review: This restaurant is located in Mimosa Hotel. The food was excellent and the ambience and service was exceptional. Must visit for business or family meals. Local beers, stout and selected wines are also available. All in all a wonderful treat.

Author: kimmeieeMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Great food with beautiful ambiance
Review: Located in Mimosa Hotel Melaka. This restaurant refurbished into a very modern yet eye catching ambiance and design. Something different from normal nyonya restaurant. Bet you couldn't get the same serving of nyonya food taste. The portian are quite large and try their mouth lady fingers too! The food makes you want to return here to try for more.Show less

Author: bobeebobeeipoh
Title: Great ambiance , decor with yummy foods !!
Review: A newly open restaurant inside a hotel name : Mimosa Hotel Melaka located at Jalan Bunga Raya (same roll with Madam King's ).We really enjoyed the delicious foods and the unique dining room decor .This restaurant is totally difference with other old style nyonya restaurant in Melaka town .Surprisingly the pricing is fair too . (thought will charges as hotel price but is not ) Highly recommended ! !Show less

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Assam fish Pedas tasted nice, but atmosphere in restaurant was too sour.
Review: The food we ordered tasted good. But, the service and atmosphere in this small and modest restaurant was cold and unfriendly.Staff seem unwilling to meet customer's need. They directed us to a table right next to the entrance. We asked for a different table and got a glum face and the silent treatment. We were early and there were no other customers.We asked for our beverage to be heated up because it was lukewarm. We were told it can't be done because the restaurant does not have a microwave. So, we requested for drink to be reheated over a stove instead. That was met with silent resistance. So we asked for a glass of hot water to mix into our beverage, so our drink is hotter. That was delivered to us, but they were not embarrassed to charge for the hot water...small amount, and it is not the money but that underscores the poor staff attitude.Throughout our meal, we felt the cold unfriendly atmosphere in this restaurant. You would think that with business generally down, owners would try harder to please customers. Not here, for sure.Pity... we will never return to such an unpleasant place where you feel the staff simply wants you to eat, pay up and leave.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Jo-AnnKYTan
Title: Crazy yummy!
Review: Tasty homecooked Nyonya food. Loved the squid masak lemak the most. This restaurant is simple and humble. Gotta go back for more!
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: mosesloh84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Authentic Nyonya Food
Review: Went there on a Sat night (around 8pm) and it was crowded. Had to wait for awhile before a table was available. It was definitely worth the wait. The Nyonya dishes were authentic and good. My favourite was the sotong lemak, and I would recommend that. Food came out quite fast and the staff always served with a smile. I didn't know the restaurant closes at 8.30pm and there were still a few customers inside. Throughout, the staff never chased anybody out, which was commendable service.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: TZTZR
Title: Home cooked taste of Nyonya food
Review: Overall we enjoyed the home cooked taste of the Nyonya dishes we had such as Gulai Lemak Nenas, Sambal Terung, Cencalok Omelette and Ikan Goreng Cili Garam. The cendol was good too.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Sherwyn KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great food but slow service
Review: We enjoyed the traditional Nyonya dishes especially the Chengdol and beef rendang. We were there at 1 plus pm on a Friday. Had to wait some 15-20 minutes. Food service was a little slow. Nevertheless, we enjoyed the food and prices were very reasonable.. Noticed there was another famous Nyonya restaurant across the road that had a very long queue.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Connector36897899830
Title: Holiday
Review: Lousy food if you compare with other restaurant. Need to share table as well. Go and try Baba Charlie for their lunch but not their spring rolls and pohpiah.

Author: Brenda_2288Singapore
Title: Delicious nyonya food
Review: We have been visiting this restaurant when go to Malacca. It serves really yummy nyonya food especially chicken ponteh, kangkong belacan and dessert chendol. It's a family business and we found the price is very reasonable for such a good quality food. It's a must to visit this restaurant when you are looking for authentic nyonya food in Malacca. Show less

Author: raoflatiff
Title: Really enjoyed this place! No pork & no lard 👍🏽
Review: Really enjoyed this place! Cosy setup family run place. Assam fish was really good, shrimp paste omelette great. Only locals were there, good sign!

Author: 333bB333Batu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: recommended place

Author: Maryworld44
Title: Nice food
Review: There are many nyonya places, this is one of the better ones, service and food is fast, the queue and system order can be improved
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: 286karingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Nonya food served
Review: Small restaurant with nice Nonya food served. Service was good too. Beef rendang was tasty and tender. Chicken wings are crispy and like their salted vegetable duck soup. Assam fish and chap chye were normal. Price was reasonable, however reckon they should give complimentary sambal chilli (chargeable).Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: brendas329Cypress, Texas
Title: Good traditional food
Review: We were visiting Melaka and unfortunately the original restaurant that we wanted to go to was closed. We therefore decided to check out Cottage Spice. We ordered a bunch of dishes to share. Overall it was good and we enjoyed our experience. The restaurant is fairly small so if there are lot of guests can be a little cramped in the seating. Please note that the restroom is a traditional hole in the ground. We therefore decided to just wash our hands and wait until we went elsewhere to use the restroom. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: HT1024Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good quality nonya food
Review: The other popular nonya joint across the road was packed so we went in to this to try. We weren't disappointed. We had curry fish head, ohtah, soya source pork. All were delicious. We went a little early around 6pm so didn't have to wait. We also didn't experience any negative service like some others.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: guangyic2016
Title: Dissapointed, not up to expectation
Review: Visiting during a peak holiday weekend, we were prepared to patiently queue up half an hour (5:30pm) before the dinner opening time (we were around 6th in line). We could also see a similarly large queue forming across the street at the other peranakan restaurant and were really looking forward to a good meal since viewing all the reviews here.As we passed 6pm, the supposed opening time, we could see the other shop already starting to let in customers. But here we were still waiting, and worst of all, we could see through the glass door that the staff were still sitting around a table and taking their time to eat their dinner and ignoring queuing customers outside. If you dont even bother to open your restaurant on time, especially when everyone outside can see what you are doing, then it frankly shows the bad attitude they have towards their customers.Finally the doors opened around 615 and started to let people in. There were limited tables (seven?) in the entire eatery so we were asked to share with other small groups (we were fine with that).Upon looking at the menu, we realised the prices were slightly higher than normal. Though eventually some portions of food were slightly larger, it was still pricey overall i would say around 20-30% higher than other similar establishments. What was disappointing was the food. We ordered lady fingers with sambal, ayam pongteh and otah. All the food tasted extremely average, especially the otah, which was almost tasteless. And we also realised the dishes in the menu seemed to be somewhat simplified (i.e. for faster service?) and did not seem to have the nuanced flavour or cooking technique that would have brought them to another level. Overall we felt it was not worth the extra price and effort to queue up for this level of service and food quality.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: PollyP31Singapore, Singapore
Title: Boycott this place
Review: We returned the next day at about 2pm for the Chendol, having waited for an hour plud for our dinner there the night before . They turned us away saying they do not serve Chendol on its own. ( this was not stated in the menu) We explained that we had to eat elsewhere first because the wait for their seat and food varies from an hour to more and my husband, recently diagnosed with kidney cancer and now with one kidney left cannot afford to wait too long as he needs meals at regular hours. My husband cannot take much of their food anyway, and only wants a bowl of their chendol again before we depart malacca that same day. We appealed and explained to the extent of begging- just one chendol and we offered to pay more but they simply refused us. This attitude of theirs, completely lacking in compassion, is the reason why we will never go back no matter how good the reviews and Chendol is.,Con: long wait for table and foodPro: Good ChendolFood: good but not exceptional that can justify the wait, price and attitude. Overall: Unwelcoming, inflexible, arrogant and disappointing.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: RupertS941
Title: Friendly and reasonable
Review: Some gave this place a bad review but I thought they were friendly and helpful. Prices I thought were reasonable. Food quality was good. But only one problem is the long waiting time for the food to arrive. Otherwise the experience was good.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: mariacox30
Title: Delicious food
Review: Cosy restaurant with delicious food. Parking can be a challenge. Come early or make appointment to avoid disappointment. Worth trying it out.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Sandy16248
Title: Not to be missed
Review: We were there twice in July 2019. Very honest and delicious nonya food. Reasonably priced too. If time permits, we would have gone back for our third helping 😁
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: nihonseowSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best
Review: Ate here twice during visit in jun19.Both times were not disappointed. Ordered assam fish,sambal brinjal, ayam pongteh,otah,salted vegetable duck soup, fried fish w/sambal and their famous chendol.Food portion aufficient for two sharing.Very fresh fish and spiciness just nice.Brinjal was well done not too oily or soggy and matched well with its sambal,a must to eat. Duck soup flavorable and meat very tender.Remember to order their chendol.Gula melaka can be given separately so one can decide the sweetness according to each taste. The coconut lemak and not too much ice shaving and the taste of pandan from the green jelly was not too overwelming.Best chendol in Malacca.Service good and prompt.However on the first visit we paid the wrong bill that was given to us. Only upon returning to the hotel then we realised all food listed in the receipt were not ours. This resulted because of table sharing. To all going to dine here,please check your bill before settling.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Van TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Honest and Authentic Nonya Fare
Review: Fair warning ... there usually is a wait to get seated -- we went there around 2PM on a Sunday and had to wait about 25 minutes just to get seated. But they warn you in advance.They also tell you how long the food would be (up to 30 minutes).. but it doesn't disappoint. Everything was authentically fried and you can tell that nothing came from a bottle, everything was fresh and very welcoming.Staff were polite -- its easy to see how they might get irascible as they are usually crowded but they do try their best to make the customer happy. We were impressed with how they accommodated our kids allergies (seafood and Soy) and did explain their limitations on some dishes -- sugggesting alternatives.Their balachan chilli was awesome but they had a paste with the fried fish that was really out of this world. If you're looking you delight and surprise your palette with something new ... try the fried fish with the paste by the side.We tried about 4 different places for Cendol in Malacca... this was the best. The portion of Cendol isn't mountainous ... but the ingredients were authentic and didn't seem to be out of a bottle. Honestly made, and very satisfying.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Leanne6015Derby, Australia
Title: Great food but get there early especially on the weekend
Review: We chose to eat her (twice) based and n previous reviews and we were glad we did. The food was delicious and one of the best beef rendang we have tried. The restaurant is small and fills up quickly so get there early to avoid waiting. Friendly and welcome ng staff. If busy you may be asked to share your table with random strangers. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Clement Yi Chen... CSingapore, Singapore

Author: AileenChua
Title: Dinner

Author: darylou
Title: Delicious and Value for Money

If u want to try Nyonya food, try , cottage spice. It's also very central.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Delicious Peranakan food
Ayam Pongteh, Ayam Buah Keluak, Nyonya Chap Chai, Chendol

Author: PrincessSarah18

Author: Chan SSingapore, Singapore

The rest must wait. When asked how long we had to wait, was told 1 hour. Walked out straightaway. Pay fr rude service? No wayShow less

Author: ttp1111Toulouse, France
Title: Better of in Bayonya Restaurant down the road
Review: We arrived, and was placed on the waiting list, while waiting outside, I served myself to the unused menus, was told that i could not have the 3 menus to look at, just the one. Since we couldn't look at their menu, we went over to Bayonya Restaurant checked out the menu there and lo and behold same items on the menu, no waiting list and such a friendly lady! food went down a treat in Bayonya Restaurant just down the road, wouldn't waste my time here, plus Bayonya Restaurant pricing was so cheap!!!!!Show less

Author: June PShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Melaka nyonya food
Review: We arrived in Melaka late due to the public holiday traffic and although this was not our first choice restaurant for nyonya food, we gave it a try because it still serve lunch until late afternoon. The others in the area closes at 2:30 pm. Fortunately, the food was good and we have no regrets. All seven dishes we ordered were tasty, especially the fried fish. The otak-otak was not too spicy and the cendol dessert not too sweet. Bit be prepared to wait a while for a table during peak hours and to share a table with other customers as the restaurant is not very big. The same applies to the other nyonya restaurants in the area like Makko and Ole Sayang. There is also limited street parking. Overall, a good food experience.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: andrewtB3261MQKuala Lumpur
Title: Very satisfying...
Review: Initially wanted to go to Nyonya Makko but there was a queue. Crossed the street to Cottage Spices, which was full, but not crowded.Ordered the assam fish head, bendi (just boiled and with sambal condiment), sambal petai prawn and ayam pongteh. Cendols for dessert.For me - all delicious, and certainly difficult to find such cooking in KL. Would come again. Setting is simple, as it seems to be with quite a few of the "family-run" restaurants around here.Price is OK, depending on how you look at it. Considering the simple setting, some may be expecting it to be less pricey (the bendi dish which is basically just boiled lady's fingers is RM 22). 4 adults (+ a 2 year old) came to a little under RM 190. For the overall experience I'm still very satisfied - as we were in Melaka for a short weekend getaway.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: C3451ZUmichaelt
Title: Our usual place to eat

Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: 9357MarkYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Team building lunch
Review: First team lunch upon arriving in Melaka. We checked into Hatten hotel and on the way in our vehicle saw the place. One team mate mentioned this place cottage spice and we googled and it’s quite well reviewed. It was 3 min walking distance from hatten hotel. We just followed the thumbs up sign in the menu and ordered the recommended dishes: curry Assam fish head, giam Chye braised duck, sambal prawns with petai, otah, tofu, Ayam pong teh, chap Chye (braised cabbage), egg omelette. All of us had some steam rice. No more space for chendol dessert as food was just delicious while we tucked into the main dishes. Very home cooked, just nice in terms of chilli spiciness. Confirm no MSG. Staff and service is ok. Not much interaction as they must be very tired of dealing with tourist and visitors (even though we are not) who needed more hand holding. Author: Wpei L

Author: Cynthia J

Author: TravellerfromSINSingapore

Author: IvanT2882

Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Dangoh

Author: NoBKs

Author: AngieTaySingapore, Singapore

A nice restaurant to visit if you are looking for home cooked peranakan food Show less

Author: Aiden Marcus L

Author: Arthur Elfin CSingapore, null, Singapore
