Author: Jasmine WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Finally good Peranakan food that's not so commercial
Review: And finally, good Peranakan food that satisfied my cravings after hunting down the 2 others ranked higher than this on Tripadvisor. I first dined at Makko which turned out slightly disappointing (and very commercial) and then to Straits Affair which was more like a tea house and quite bad nyonya laksa which tasted more like lemak with too much push for their Kuehs and tea set. I pinned my last hopes for a good Peranakan meal here and I was glad I did. After doing my research on what to order, I headed down with my order listed on a paper and promptly ordered Assam pedas (fish), chap Chye, ayam pongteh, beef rendang, lime juice and barley for drinks. The rice came in two sizes which was interesting but rather small even for its large size (we thought it was small when they served it). The cold drinks were served in tiny disposable cups which was a tad disappointing and were quite watered down. Lime juice was disappointing as the plum that came with it was not soaked long enough for the taste. But drinks and rice portion aside, the food was great. Food portion for the chap chye was disappointingly small and most of the food was actually served smaller sized than Makko. But you forgive them when you enjoy the taste of the dishes.The chap chye was cooked long enough for its sogginess and rich taste unlike at Makko which was quite "fresh" in comparison. The ayam pongteh similarly was cooked long enough for that soaked up mushroom to have flavor as well as the chicken and potato. The evidence lies in the gravy which was slightly thick with lots of bits. It was comparable to my mom's except my mom's version contains pork and this restaurant (as well as many in Melaka) does not serve pork. The beef rendang was as others say, quite awesome. Full of flavor and tender at the same time. I'd just dined at Candlenut in Singapore (1-star Michelin restaurant) a few days ago and I think this one tasted better! The beef does not have too much tendons and was cooked long enough to have the taste in every bite.The Assam pedas was charged based on size and the price range was from RM 39-68. We ordered small so was charged 39 which was reasonable. The portion was good for this. Served in a semi deep dish with gravy, eggplant, lady's finger and long beans. If you love Assam, I think you'll love this. I finished up all the gravy. I also ordered the belachan chilli which they charged for (like all others) and it was very good. Very sour and not as spicy as I thought which made you want to take more. It was flavorful and provided that extra flavor in every bit of rice you eat with. I even tried asking if they sell it which they don't. Wow, I'm even more impressed at how they take pride in their food not to become commercial like their opposite counterpart (who sells everything).While they charge you 5% of service charge, their prices are inclusive of gst. Makko's prices are exclusive if 6% gst and charge you for everything including the crackers at the start which you never ordered and the wet towels they give you which you never ask for. If I get to eat here again, I must try the sambal sotong which I saw another table order and looked so good. Our total was 119rm including another order of barley cos the cup was so small. So one less star because of the size of some dishes and drinks. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: travelnibby

Author: Cikgu
Title: Consistently good
Review: This is the third time I've been to Cottage Spices. The first visit was an alternative to Nonya Makko because Makko was closed. We did not regret that visit. This time I visited Cottage Spices for lunch. Quite easily accessible, within walking distance from Hatten Hotel, next to Fenix Hotel. Roadside parking is available. Restaurant opens at 12 for lunch. We were there early but invited to sit inside while they got ready. When we got into the restaurant, others started streaming in as well. However, they did not flip their 'CLOSED' sign until their kitchen was ready!!We ordered sambal prawn petai, chincalok omelette, kangkong belachan, sambal ladies' fingers, ayam buah keluak and itek tim for our group of 6. Unfortunately, ayam buah keluak was not ready and the itek tim was not available for the day. We ordered Ayam Kapitan as an alternative.The prawn petai was good, large prawns fried with sambal petai. The chincalok omelette was done like a typical western 3 egg omelette - very fluffy and full bodied omelette. it had onions, some chilli and a subtle taste of chincalok.The kangkong belachan was good as it was not overly spicy and salty. It tasted just right to the point that you could eat it on its own without too much rice.The ladies' fingers were freshly steamed and the young pods were crunchy and not too slimy. This was served with fresh chilli and onions and a splash of lime. Very refreshing and appetising.I expected the ayam kapitan to be dry fried like the Penang variety. However, it was similar to a non-spicy rendang, rich and tasty.We also ordered two servings of chendol to share and the server gladly provided us small bowls and 6 spoons. Thoughtful service that was friendly and efficient.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A must in Melaka
Review: Whilst in Melaka you definitely have to try traditional Nyonya food at least once, and this restaurant is one of the most popular ones to do so. We arrived at about 7.30pm on a holiday evening, the place was packed, and we were told the wait would be about half an hour. People who arrived a bit later were actually turned away, so it might be a good idea to go early or to book. That said, we arrived back at 8 and were given a table within a few minutes. The restaurant is brightly lit, reasonably comfortable, and has a nice decor, but is not fancy.The menu had quite a large choice of typical Nyonya dishes, so it is quite difficult to decide. Portions are fairly big; unless you're in a big group it is very easy to over-order.The food itself was delightful. Sweet and sour chillies were yummy, as was the excellent otak-otak 'fish cakes'. We also liked the aubergine dish (terung goreng sambal), with the aubergine cooked to a beautifully tender consistence, and carefully spiced. We had a bit of a problem with the chicken dish, ayam buah keluak. The flavours were very good, but you cannot eat the nuts, the shells are extremely hard, and it is very fiddly to extract whatever they are stuffed with. Overall, a very good, plentiful meal full of flavour, served with rice.The thing letting this place down was the service. It was chaotic, to say the least, and clearly overwhelmed. Maybe they were short staffed because of the holiday weekend?We only drank water, and we paid at total of RM85 incl a tip, a bit more than elsewhere in Melaka, but food quality is good, and of course you also pay for the name.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: saradeardear
Title: Healthy version of nonya food
Review: Less oily, healthier version and very good belachan, not very vegetarian friendly because only 2 dishes ( ladies figure and fried egg) but have vege chilli.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: AristoratnazKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Most authentic Malacca Nyonya fare
Review: Every recipe is completely accurate to Malacca style nyonya food. Some reviewers have remarked on the lack of certain "normal" nyonya dishes, but it is important to differentiate Malacca nyonya from other Straits nyonya in this restaurant. Service is prompt and the restaurant is clean. I particularly liked the otak otak (spicy fish paste) and chap chye (mixed vegetables). Do try the chicken pongteh, cincalok omelette and sambal bendih too. Price is premium, portion sizes are small. Expect to order 6-8 dishes for 4 people. For dessert, I suggest going across the street to Jeta Groves for great cendol. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: jasonwB8054DM
Title: Average fare Nonya food
Review:
Food was average and tad a little pricey in comparison with other similar cafes round the corner . 
The steam tofu (small -rm 15) , fried fish with sambal ( small-rm38) , Nonya chap chye (rm15) hardly satiates 2 persons .
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: BKLau
Title: Good Nyonya meal
Review: Good Nyonya meal in Melaka. Family style small restaurant. Not too spicy. Hope to return again soon. Suggest going early, as it opens at 18:00 for dinner, where it will be packed for weekend.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: ngkarhuiSingapore, Singapore
Title: For dinner
Review: We went there ard 730pm and the place was full. Waitress was helpful asking the 2 of us if we mind sharing the table. We were ok and she led us to the table in a short while. Menu with pictures were clear. We order a nonya assam fish head curry, nonya chap chye and fried chicken wings to go with our rice. Food portion was nice, presentation was good and we enjoyed the food.Dessert was a chendol and the sweetness was just nice. This dinner was great!Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: nic070770Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fish not fresh
Review: Specially went to Cottage Spices to try their curry fish but it's sold out so no choice to order their signature dish- Asam Pedas Curry fish but disappointingly the fish wasn't fresh at all, quite shocking because the reviews at here all said the fish is very delicious, none of the reviews said the fish isn't fresh. As we were scared and could not take it the unfresh fish smell, we don't dare to change the fish, recook it and try again so we ask whether we can change the fish to asam udang nanas (pineapple prawns) and the waiter agreed, it tasted amazingly great! Besides that, we also ordered kangkong belachan & cendol and all the dishes tasted very very nice. I will come back to this restaurant again but hope the fish is fresh and still have stock for the curry fish.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Jedai79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fish Head Curry is Nice!
Review: On 21 Dec 2015, we took 45-60 mins to search for the newly-located Nancy's Kitchen (another popular Nyonya restaurant). It was 2pm and we were told to wait for 30mins at least. After looking at the nonchalant attitude of its waitresses (the supervisor or manager was good though), we decided to eat in another Nyonya restaurant instead. Then, we recalled what we read in a small booklet on places of interest/eateries in Malacca found in our hotel and that took us to Cottage Spices. We were at Cottage Spices on 21 Dec 2015 night. Waited for 30mins. The fish head curry was delicious! We found the Chicken Pongteh, though chef's recommendation, was not as nice as the fish head curry. We had cendol and one more vegetable dish. Well, we love the fish head curry most. During the 30-40 min waiting time outside the restaurant, we literally had nothing to do, so we looked at what other customers ordered and also observed how Cottage Spices' waitresses work. At times, they ran (not walked) to clear up tables and set them up very quickly again so that next customers could occupy the tables. A marked contrast from the waitresses at Nancy's Kitchen who not only walked but walked extremely slowly to clear the tables, oblivious of the queue. Yes, we may have to queue for good food, however, the queuing time can be shortened with a team of good and hardworking waiters and waitresses. It took us 5 mins to walk from Novotel Hotel to Cottage Spices. It is located along the same stretch as Starbucks@Mahkota area. We will definitely recommend Cottage Spices for its fish head curry. Since the Ayam Pongteh (chicken) and vegetables were average, we've decided to give this restaurant 4-circle rating. We'll return to try more dishes in future and perhaps we can then give 5-circle rating if the other dishes are good too. But its convenient location and helpful, efficient, and polite staff are undoubtedly plus points. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: lydiaSingaporesingapore
Title: Home cooked food
Review: We arrived at the restaurant and waited about 20 mins to be seated as it was full. The restaurant is rather small scale which seats 3 big and 3 small tables, perhaps catering up to about max 50 pax. As they don't take reservation, so q there early especially lunch time. After we ordered, it took,about 15-20 mins for the first dish to be served. Apparently it seem to be run by family members, we see the helpers as young as 10 year old. Dishes were quite authentic but modest portion only as it seem it does not have a SML size. The chendol was disappointing as the green jelly was too frozen, gula and coconut milk not enough. We spent about MYR400 for 10A2C. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Martin BHuntingdon, United Kingdom
Title: An attempt at Nyonya food that only just works
Review: Good Nyonya food is hard to find, even in Malaysia. We went with family to Cottage Spices and the restaurant is on quite a modest size, seating perhaps 30. The service team are young, in all probability family members. The menu is illustrated and shows quite accurately what is provided. I must say that I expected to find Pie Tee, Kerabu,and Sago Gula Melaka on the menu, and was quite dis-appointed that these pretty standard Nyonya items were not offered.We chose a selection of dishes to share - Daging Rendang, Chicken Ponteh, some baked fish, a couple of Prawn dishes and a vegetable dish. The cooking was pretty accurate, although the portions sizes were modest. In particular the Chicken Ponteh was good. The drinks were typical of the cuisine - Barley Water,Soya Bean Milk were both fine. Desserts of course were very limited. I had a Cendol, which was OK - the green Cendol strips tasted as though they were still frozen.The restaurant appears not to take booking, and is run really more as a cafe, and I suspect that it works on the basis of having a high customer turnover because of the limited space. But my 88 year old auntie and my 84 year old mother in law were well received.My wife observed that it would have been nice to have some toilet paper in the toilets! All in all, I'm left with an impression of a not very professional management, but this is not unusual in this part of the worldShow less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: FriendsOfPeasSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: Previously I reviewed Makko. This trip we went to try out Cottage Spices. It's packed during the weekends but no queue outside. Service was slow but that's not really something I would grumble about if the food is worth the wait. We ordered prawn paste chicken wings, sambal kangkong, cinjalok (pardon the spelling error) omelette and otah.Small portion, poor presentation and average taste. We (4 of us) finished our meal in silence and left without trying the cendol. One thing I like about this place compared to Makko - the lighting. Makko is a little too dark for my liking. Cottage Spices is kind of like a zichar place in Singapore but the food we had 'cmi'.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: travelhoneybee
Title: delicious nyonya dishes
Review: yummylicious! we ordered their signature dishes and all are very delicious. i would definitely visit again. petsonally, nyonya chendol was very nice!
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: RrayXuMalaysia
Title: Excellent Dishes!
Review: So, me and my family had an early dinner, a few dishes at a nearby Nyonya restaurant (bad experience though) and then to this place. This place gets crowded and full easily due to limited space and tables. Nevertheless, the staffs still able to maintain a friendly service; patient and smart enough to explain to customers about the waiting time. Since we needed some time and more space for our tummy, we're ok with the waiting time and begin with a bowl of cendol. We think the Cendol is alright, gula melaka is not aromatic and sweet enough.Main dishes that we've ordered: beef rendang, aubergines/ eggplants & cincalok omelette, are truly delicious especially the beef rendang! The beef is tender and the taste of rendang is memorable. The proportion of the egg and cincalok (fermented shrimps) is well balanced. And the aubergines were stir fried with the right heat, not too soft or sloppy :dOverall, a wonderful dining experience for a rainy day :DP/S still thinking about the beef rendang :dShow less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Paik Ling HPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Home-cooked Nyonya food
Review: We walked into this restaurant without much expectations as we just wanted to get out from the rain and the kids were hungry. We were pleasantly surprised as the food that we ordered tasted really good and more importantly, did not come laden with salt or MSG. We ordered:Curry kapitanBrinjal belacanOmelleteCendol (do not miss!)Otak otak (do not miss too!)Every single dish was really good. Best part is you don't have to wait like a fool unlike the other so-called popular Peranakan restaurants.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: min29mn
Title: Delicious food
Review: Both me and my husband enjoyed the nonya food at the place. We really enjoyed the Chendol with Gula which was refreshing on a hot day. The food was tasty and reasonably priced.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: szeweiengKulai, Malaysia
Title: Awesome nyonya food
Review: During my university days, my parents used to bring me here for lunch time. The taste is great. My favorite nyonya dish will always be chicken with pong teh sauce and nyonya cendol. I will definitely drop by there again if i ever come to melaka for short trip as visitor.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Raymond-KIpoh
Title: Second Visit
Review: Food is still good, we love this place and this was our second visit for this year. Love the fried fish and sambal. Good experience, pricy but still worth it.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: ChengpopoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya dinner of authentic taste
Review: We were able to distinguish each of the 7 dishes ordered with their authentic spices! The fried fish was so fresh and the oil used was new .. Result, a wonderful taste sensation. All the vegetables were at their prime - in flavour, freshness and succulence.Okra, kang kong and brinjal. Try the pineapple prawn curry and the ik an goreng.. Can't wait to visit againShow less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Dora C
Title: Authentic Nyonya
Review: Its has been quite sometimes ago im having my dinner there with my in law. I've forgotten the dish name that we ordered, but overall is delicious and my in law would like to visit again!
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: LTym
Title: Nyonya dinner
Review: Food taste not bad. Love the sambal belacan . Drinks wise - tasteless, not Chinese tea taste, herbal drink is too dilute.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: TsogoolyrPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Ikan Cili Garam fish
Review: We were late for Makko so we went across the street to try Nyonya cuisine. To our surprise, Ayam pongteh and fish were to our liking. Cendol is excellent too. Don't order it's mixed vegetables as it is rather unreasonable at RM15 and does not taste good. No queue at this restaurant as it is way more expensive compared to Makko. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: helloothereeAustralia
Title: Bad
Review: 2 things to point out - bad service and food.A group of customers were waiting for their table to be ready, so the kids were waiting around the counter sitting on the chairs. Kids being kids they are usually rather lethargic and fidgety. This lady staff at the counter rather rudely raised her voice "if you're are waiting please wait outside, don't block the way." I figured the customers were rather pissed because they never come back. The staff may be busy and overwhelmed but I don't see why she should be raising her voice. This is the only incident because I see her being rather rude to her fellow staff.My friends and I had diarrhea and vomited after having the chap chye. The chap chye appears to be reheated because it was rather soggy and too sweet. I am not taking away the credentials of the other dishes, but the chap chye was bad. It wasn't just me alone - but my friends and I all got unwell because of it. Never going back again.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: YiWernPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Nice nyonya food... Must have cendol!!!
Review: Local colleague brought me here for dinner. Quiet and less crowded during weekday. We have sup itik tim, ikan cili garam, ayam pongteh and sambal terung. All were so good. Lastly we had cendol as dessert. To my surprise ... This is one of the best cendol I had in malacca. Really a MUST TRY for cendol. No joke. The only thing need to improve is the service speed. It is too slow to wait for the food to be serve and furthermore not much people during that time. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: fyusing
Title: Awesome food!
Review: Decided to head there with my parents again, it was our third visit.  Excellent service,delicious dishes,especially the petai prawns and asam pedas. The drink cup is a little small though.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: EdwinC79Singapore
Title: Surprisingly Good
Review: We went to 2 Peranakan Restaurants back to back.Cottage Spices and the one across the road, Makko. Cottage Spices. ok we couldn't get a table at 2 restaurant, Makko and Amy Heritage. so chance upon Cottage spices and I think we got surprisingly pleasant good food.Verdict:we think Cottage Spice's Ayam Buah Keluak's much better than Makko. Makko's more cost-friendly restaurant. we had:Ayam Buah Keluak. thick gravy, spicy and delicious. Its Buah Keluak's has been prepared well to our liking - its kernel's grind and placed back into its shell.Soton Nenas - cooked with spics and pineapple. Kang Kong Belacan - Good and not soggy. Cendol - good traditional dessert to end a wonderful lunch.  Go earlier than the usual lunch hour to ensure you get a table and not have to wait for a table.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: NelsonchowsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Home cooked goodness
Review: We ordered Ayam Pongteh, Beef Rendang, Stir Fry Mixed Veg and Ikan Cili Garam. We liked Ikan Cili Garam the most. The fish is fresh, skin is crispy and the flesh is moist. The sambal to go along with the fish is savoury and not too spicy. We always order Ayam Pongteh when in a Peranakan restaurant. This is one of the best we had but a bit pricy though.Overall the good quality is very good and worth visiting again.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: an0nym0usguyJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: I came to eat Nyonya food and I've got it
Review: Some food on the menu are meant to chop people's necks here but the overall is good if you are not too fussy about the quality and value of the foodwe waited about 20 minutes before food came but everything is cool after thatthe server is well-mannered although I noticed they just like to push the most expensive dishes out deliberately if you ask for recommendationRM120 bill for 4 pax, worth trying I guessShow less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: hsienhuitSingapore, Singapore
Title: More homecooking style than restaurant
Review: I ate here after eating at Makko's just across the road. I have to admit that this affected how I viewed the food from Cottage Spices. We ordered the Sambal Sotong Petai, Beef Rendang and Sambal Kang Kong as well as a dish of Sambal Belachan (having been warned by other reviewers, we expected to be charged for this). The atmosphere is more of a friendly coffeeshop than that of a restaurant and the table we were seated at had just been used by the owners kids for their homework. The food when it came out also reflected the family, homecooking approach to the cuisine, with large portions which we were unable to finish, and squid and beef cut in large chunks. We liked the beef rendang which was made in a very dry style with more body than the usual beef rendang. The petai and sotong in the other dish was perhaps a bit overcooked but was pretty decent. Unfortunately the sambal kang kong was very salty and hence a bit difficult to eat. All in all, decent food but nothing spectacular. The advantage Cottage Spices has over Makko is that you don't need to line up for decent Nyonya food.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Raymond-KIpohIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Home Cooked Food
Review: We just stumbled upon this restaurant while looking for some nyonya food. The food are excellent, just have a homey feeling when you taste the food. We ordered 3 dishes and finished all up. Service are prompt. Price are a bit steep but the quality is there.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: shankeramits
Title: Good Nonya food
Review:
Good quality food. Everyone in the family liked the taste. The service was excellent. 

We had few vegetarians with us and they allowed our own home food to eat.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: KL C
Title: Good nyonya food
Review: Price reasonable, customer services was good and friendly. The waitress was lack of experience to handle customer inquiry.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: edwinlycSingapore, Singapore
Title: Slightly ex food but good ambience
Review: Decided to try this place after seeing the long queue at Makko. The food is gd though the regular portion for 2 is quite ex. Ambience and air conditioning is a great welcome especially when you are eating hot and chilli food. Yes, no refill of rice and the sambal for $1.50 is not cheap either. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: shaunseowSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonably good but Ex
Review: Food is quite nice however they charged sambal belacan for RM1.50 and no free refilling of rice which cost RM1.50 each as well. Most of the peranakan restaurants dont do that. Its worth going only if u couldnt get a table at the Mako restaurant on the opposite road.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: pingying
Title: Excellent Melaka Peranakan cuisine
Review:
This restaurant serves authentic and very delicious Melaka Peranakan cuisine.
One must order ayam pongteh, bendi sambal (the sambal is too delicious), fried eggs with cincalok and itik tim.
Cendol to me is not recommended because I think they are not 100% genuine.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: What a good Nyonya food!!!
Review: When I was in Melaka, we had variety of food at Jonker Street in the afternoon and all I could say was, we were just tasting every bit of them in order to enjoy more type of food. Suddenly we thought of Nyonya cuisine which it would be great to eat in Baba Nyonya state... and this restaurant popped up when we browsed. In the beginning, we were disappointed when the shop was closed for rest from 3pm till 6pm. Left with no choice, we waited for 2 hours loitering at Pahlawan Shopping Mall. We were the first 2 groups that waiting in front of the restaurant at 6pm but the owner was still finishing their dinner and not hesitate to serve or ask us to come in first while waiting. We just waited for about 5-10 minutes but we noticed another Nyonya food restaurant, Makko which was just located opposite this restaurant, had a huge number of people waiting outside and queuing. Wow... astounding and next time must try that restaurant too.Finally, at 6:03pm, they LET us in.... hahaha. Since my kids cannot take much spicy food, we skipped the famous Asam Pedas fish... well, we had some of the below;1. Ikan Cili GaramA deep fried slice of fish served with mixed chili belacan paste. Well, the fish was fried perfectly and the meat was delicious consumed with the chili paste. Good one.2. Sambal Sotong PetaiThis is one of my favorite, the taste was astounding and even my kids that do not take too much spiciness, they loved it. Well, I just loved the petai with sambal... can't go wrong with this marvelous dish3. Chicken PongtehThis was a non-spicy nyonya dish, bundled with chicken, potato, mushroom which braised with some ingredients that gave me a very home-cooked flavor. Kids loved it.4. Lady Finger with chili pasteIt is a steamed/boiled lady finger and eaten with the mixed belacan chili paste... simple and nice.5. Otak-otakServed in huge size but somewhat, this was very normal and there was no ummph factor.Overall, Cottage Spices has not let me down and we had a very delightful Nyonya cuisine in Melaka. It is simply delicious.... Good...good!!! Happy eating...Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: yks007Singapore, null, Singapore
Title: good food
Review: We will there slightly before 6pm and when we knock on the door, they just welcome us, even though their opening hour is 6 pm. The food is good, value for money. staff is friendly. Recommend: Asam Fish head is good, Ayam Pongteh is well cooked,Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: fynazihsan
Title: Love the asam pedas, cendol & telur dada cencalok!
Review: Suupperrrbbb!!!! 😍😍 will come again! But need to early or else need to wait outside.. The  parking a bit hard to find. 👍🏼👍🏼
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: JustinlyhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not bad ! Good taste !
Review: We went to this restaurant for dinner on the second day traveling in MELAKA, we ordered the kapitan chicken,steam lady finger and cincaluk egg. The taste was very good and authentic ! We felt that it was better than the similar type of restaurant at the opposite side. Of course, we did not forget to try the cendol which was great too !We could not resist the temptation of the good taste of nyonya food and we came back the second day for lunch. We ordered the asam fish head and steamed lady finger again. Omg, the asam fish head taste awesome..! Love it very much. Hope the restaurant will maintain the food quality. We will definitely come back again.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: davekiat
Title: Have to try their Assam fish
Review: Tasty peranankan food. The Assam fish is very tasty and we finish the Assam sauce. Small restaurant with 8 tables and be prepared to wait
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Eraz7Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nonya food at its best.
Review: Great food from this cosy restaurant...The fried fish with Brinjal( egg plant ) & steamed Okra was fresh and tastyCuttlefish with Petai ( stinky beans ) was delicious Prawns with Pineapple curry - fantastic.All in all an awesome experience in gastronomical adventure.The BEST PART IS WE ONLY STUMBLED UPON WHEN BEC ANOTHER POPULAR NONYA ESTB WAS CLOSED DUR TO POWER FAILURE.COTTAGE SPICES WAS BETTER THAN MAKKO AND OLEH SAYANG ACCORDING TO MY WIFE & I.Enjoy ppl...Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: tigger2leeSeattle, Washington
Title: Great service and food
Review: We stopped here for lunch and were very impressed with our introduction to Nyonya food. The restaurant was run by a family who were very courteous and helpful. They were very accommodating when we only tried a few dishes seeing as we weren’t familiar with the cuisine. We were blown away with the spices and flavoring, especially the fried chicken and sauce. As they attempted to describe the special sauce they make in house, we were very impressed at how they made so much from scratch and to order.We so enjoyed our experience that we made it a point to come back before we left Melaka and have the chicken one last time.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Sally_TehSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simple dinner at Cottage Spices
Review: I had dinner at Cottage Spices on 1 January 2015. I tried their fried kangkong, fried fish with sambal, otah otah and chendol. I found the taste of their kangkong and otah otah too bland. I love their chendol for the nice taste of gula melaka.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: WadeGuidry
Title: Ahhh Ahhhh even double Ahhh
Review: Stopped in for a late late lunch and boy oh boy was it worth the wait.... Very very very nice food... Will I be back a big fat yes👍👍👍
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: simplytravelandeat
Title: Family style
Review: Back again for lunch and it's another great meal. This restaurant offers home cooked nyonya food run by the family. The waiting time for the food was abit long and that's because they cooked them fresh.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Hemy K
Title: Going for lunch in melaka
Review: The nyonya food in this restaurant not so bad, recommended to anyone who wants to try the origin taste of melaka food. But the price quiet expensive.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: johnofkl
Title: Fairly tasty, small portions
Review:
The food is fairly tasty. Not the best I've had but pretty okay.
The portions are not big, but that's ok because you can order more dishes and try out more things.
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: thanu85
Title: Nice savoury asam pedas
Review: Headed to jln merdeka fr another nyonya meal..had a different restaurant in mind..reached thr only to find they were closed...probably over crowded..across the road, we saw cottage spice n decided to give a try...just the nite bfr, we had asam pedas which was lousy. So we were hesitant trying asam pedas again but they had no other fish gravy..n we settled fr fish asam pedas, sotong sambal with petai n cencaluk omelette...we were so satisfied and started savouring asam pedas..sotong wasnt up to our expectation..the squad rings were too big.petai was fresh n they were generous in petai..lastly we had a bowl of cendol..ended ordering another bowl..overall food was good..im satisfied. Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: shanthi63Melaka, Malaysia
Title: tasty nyonya food....
Review: walked into this place accidentally but no regrets during my last visit to Melaka. Stayed at Equatorial Hotel. Just crossed over and voila! Place was crowded during lunch. service was okay. can't blame them. Ordered for the Deep fried fish.Costly but really tasty with the belacan paste.veggie was good too. cendol was to die for.went well with the hot weather outside.one of the waiter brought the wrong order but during payment time we were waived of the taxes with a pleasant smile from the lady owner . it was not much but the thought counts, right!Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: good tasting perenakan food...
Review: this place is run by a family and they are able to maintain the standard and the quality of their dishes. Though they are pretty slow in cooking but I seriously think that its worth the wait. However, one thing that I had noted was that the price seems to be going up. Correct me if I am wrong but still a good place to try out some nice nyonya dishes.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: janelleteohPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Nyonya Restaurant @ Melaka
Review: The atmosphere is good, the waitress is friendly, and the food is tasty. For me the price is just abit pricy. But worth for a try, Nyonya is a characteristic special in Melaka.I want to recommend the Fried fish, the fish skin is crispy and the inside is not oilly at all! This is amazing. Nicely fried. All eight of us was statisfied the food there, except the drinks and the cendol. We don't like the cendol serve there. But the Otak-Otak is amzing.Nyonya food mainly is spicy, so for those who have kids maybe need to bring own babyfood. :)Adults loves spicy but kids don't eat. But there are some (little) non-spicy food on the menu. We ordered 1chicken, 2 veges, 2 fishes, 1otak-otak, 1spicy squids, 3 cendols and drinks. Cost around RM280+Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Cynthiaxyw
Title: Nice nyonya food & best cendol
Review: Nice food and the best cendol i had in Malacca. friendly service. Not bad to give a try, price is normal. Anywhere strongly recommend the Cendol .
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: Michelle TSingapore, Singapore
Title: A nice and friendly place.
Review: After we arrived and could not get a table at Makko's we crossed the road and ate at Cottage Spices. The food was not bad. My kids loved the Nonya Chicken Wings and we all loved the Otak.Best of all the Owners were most helpful when we asked for directions.Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: BabaMama01KL
Title: Worth a try
Review: After the unpleasant experience @ Hard Rock Cafe the night before..we explore what else Malacca had to offer.The hunger after a few laps in the pool will be a big risk to try out a new place for lunch. Luckily, we found about this place through Trip Advisor review.The place is not that big..about 8 big (comfortably seats 8 adults or more) tables available.The deciduous smell of nyoya food is noticeable once you enter the place.We tried the Asam Pedas, Lemak Sotong, Kankung Belacan and Cincalok Omelette.Only Jenahak is available for the Asam Pedas. Its good but Asam Pedas lovers may have other better experience.The Lemak Sotong is our valued meal of the day. Not that spicy for kids and enough to satisfy mom and dad.Kangkung Belacan is average. Nothing to shout about.Cincalok omelette is a bit below expectation. We were hoping to find abundance of the cincalok inside but could hardly taste it.Our bill came out for MYR118 which is quite decent for a family of 4+3. Its hard to gauge really as they do not have a fix price but a range of prices for a meal.Value for money...4/5Show less
Restaurant: Cottage Spices A Taste of Melaka

Author: 3ven
Title: Enjoy the game with everyone
Review: Really enjoy the vibe last night also the game "franky ball" and also I'm enjoy the beer and the music 👍👍

Author: DorianeMrcd
Title: I'll never forget you
Review: An exceptional bar! The owners Gary and Anna are adorable. For sure you will spend a lovely evening: guitar concerts, board games, dances, karaoke. You create your own evening. I spent two weeks there and I will never forget all the people I met. One advice, try the Cup of life . If you prefer beers, Tiger are cheap as well! Thank you so much again!Show less

Author: mathieulebleuKanchanaburi, Thailand
Title: Cosy place
Review: We had a wonderful time here. Met lovely people and the two owners are gorgeous. Very good music and vibes. Jamming sessions and playing card and board games was very fun.We had a burger and a pizza and both were delicious. Beers are good value too. Go and enjoy your Melaka time here! Show less

Author: manaolana
Title: Where culture meets
Review: A place where music, harmony and happiness meet. People from around the world come together spend the evening/night and enjoy the beauty of life. A place where each soul is welcome.

Author: noodlebrosLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Great food and great people
Review: Busdriver Cafe is the brilliant place to grab a bite to eat, chill with a juice or beer and meet great people! One of the main reasons to stop by the place is to meet the wonderful owners Gary and Anna as they will provide a top quality service that will make you not want to leave ! Show less

Author: gerardoapineda
Title: Excellent experience
Review:
Great food and music, people are friendly always and you won't get bored. 
I highly Recommend it, you will want to go daily!

Author: arafaty2014
Title: Do not miss going there !
Review: This place is the reason I extended my stay in Melaka for one more night! It is the coziest with most chilled people.You never feel like a stranger, guitar never stopped playing! We sang so many songs, the people who hang there are just friendly and chilled!Anna and Gary make you feel at home, Anna even made me a pizza at 3:30 am becausw I was hungry although the kitchen closes way before that, and I am still grateful for that delicious pizza !If you are visiting Melacca, Busdriver should definitely be in your list !Show less

Author: Khaled RPerak
Title: Live artists , travelers, and yummy pizza
Review: lovely artists, music all night with other cool guests, owners and newly joined people passing from road. u see young,old, travelers, locals, nationalities. dont miss the vege pizza, crisp with soft feeling and a freshly cooked veges on top , mixed with cheese. Wish I am eating it now while writing the post from IPOH .Prices are super great (original drinks).I now have another reason to visit melacca.Thank u Gary and Anna, my new friends!Show less

Author: kaia790Wooster, Ohio
Title: Wonderful, artsy, fun, cozy place with amazing owners!
Review: Busdriver is more than just a bar/cafe.. it's an experience! Anna and Gary, the owners, are just lovely people and it's a treat to meet them - they also know plenty of drinking and card games so there's always something to do even if you come by yourself. The beers are the cheapest you can find in the city and the food is all homemade and SO delicious. They have amazing vegetarian options as well. The artwork inside and outside is all done by Anna, Gary, and their friend Kafa and gives the place a wonderful, home-y atmosphere. The music is also great and they let you play your own if you want. I miss this place so much - I would come back to Melaka just to have more time there.Show less

Author: labana2018
Title: Good Vibe, peace and love! This Bar makes you feel home in relaxing Melaka.
Review: Best Bar in Melakka. The people are lovely, the guests and the owner make you feel good from the first second.

Author: archibald88
Title: Best place I have been in Melaka
Review: Great place to meet interessting people and enjoy the night :) Super friendly host! Very tasty drinks with natural juice 👌

Author: J153x
Title: Good tunes & company!
Review:
Stumbled upon this little gem near Jonker street with some hostel folks.

Owners are lovely, so friendly! Reasonably priced beers, and good drinking games with strangers. Thanks so much for a fun night in Melaka :-) check it out travellers!

Author: Mariusz S
Title: Best place in Maleka!
Review: Three reasons to go there:1) best quality - tried the juice and drink and were delicious, made with high quality products2) cheap - much cheaper than everywhere else. 7 MYR for tiger can, 14 for cocktails3) best owner ever - very open and friendly, we played games together and had nice conversationsOverall top place to go for a drink in Maleka! We went there four days in a rowShow less

Author: Mungdog
Title: Very fun and chilled place!
Review: We went there for dinner and some drinks and enjoyed the place a lot.The food was really good, they have some vegetarian options and snacks also.It´s a very nice place to hang out, you can meet locals and other travellers and play lots of games.We had a very good time there and I would definitely go there again!Show less

Author: SlimHadjBrahim
Title: My best place in Melaka
Review:
Just come 
You will never forget this place 
Nice ambiance 
Very delicious 😋 foods    
Gary & Anna are really a great couple they will do their best to make you feeling at home 🏡

Author: ArtoMoira
Title: Great time, wonderful people !
Review: Had a great time. Passed by for a Saturday night drink outside and received a very warm welcome. Wonderful people, chilled vibe and great music. Even a bit of jamming and dancing :) A must stop-by when in Melaka!

Author: Penny_Lane97
Title: Hallo Freunde,Hallo Feinde, Hallo Individuum, Hallo Gemeinde...
Review:
Best pizza! And it's a wonderful place with wonderful humans 💚
I was sometimes in the shop and I wanna come back every time if I can.I miss the place so much and I hope other people love the place like me.

Author: Marc D
Title: Very good place, good food, good ambient.
Review: I went to take some dinner with my wife and our 2 kids. Very nice staff, very good food, good music and very affordable prices. For sure we will repeat if we come back to Melaka some day!

Author: sandra06031994
Title: Good restaurant !
Review: I really like this restaurant, good quality / price and a staff with a smile! I highly recommend it 🙏

Author: PatrickGeus
Title: Great people, great food, great vibe!
Review:
Great people, great food, great vibe!
Came across this place when I was strolling down the streets of Melakka.

Author: sze2276Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Nyonya 63
Review: Superb food, fantastic ambience and good service. Recommended by Aunty Olive from Melaka. Got to know Chef Keong who should be the owner there? All the aunties working there are so pleasant to talk to. Only 2 people dining but ordered 3 dishes which is more than enough. A little bit pricey but still worth it. Shall visit again to try other dishes which Aunty Olive recommended.Show less

Author: sweet_cindy1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Felt humiliated
Review: We were disappointed with the way we were treated. There is this chicken wing dish on their menu and we politely asked whether we could change the wing to breast meat for my daughters. We were straight away tell off by the chef, he says that “He has never come across people that doesn't eat his chicken wing!” in a very rude way! My daughter felt very sad after being told off my the chef. We did not eat and we left the place as we felt humiliated by the way we were treated.Show less

Author: Jenny YHong Kong, China
Title: Delicious Nyonya food
Review: Our driver recommended us this restaurant and after reading reviews about it, we deicded to try it. We were not disappointed.Our party had one pescaterian and one who did not like sour taste. It was going to be tough because Nyonya cuisine usually consists of tamarind paste which gives many dishes a 'sour' taste. Anyway although we couldn't really order too typical nyonya dishes, we were still very satisfied with what we ate. The top hats (kuay pie tee) for the starter were excellent. We enjoyed the fish curry and the okra was beautifully presented. My favourite was the cendol for dessert! Not to be missed! The restaurant was beautifully decorated in traditional Chinese decor with lanterns and Chinese cabinets. I love the upstair balconies around the dining room, which is typical of a Peranakan- style house. All in all a delicious lunch and a place that I would go back and recommend to my friends.Show less

Author: blastedusername
Title: Our hotel recommended this
Review: Our hotel recommended this restaurant but we hadn’t read any reviews before we went. My goodness the food was amazing! So glad we went. We were welcomed by the chef who made sure we had some recommendations as we hadn’t tried nyonyo food before. Everything was utterly delicious. By far the outstanding meal of our whole trip, can’t recommend this place highly enough. Go!Show less

Author: premgoodyHong Kong, China
Title: Excellent food and service the chef is a wonderful person too
Review: Went for lunch in this restaurant and was very glad we did that as the food was very tasty - the service was very good and the chef himself came over to the table to ensure that all dishes were prepared as per our needs - they have some special dishes which are amazingly tasteful - it’s a MUST visit restaurant for anyone visiting Melaka Malaysia Show less

Author: SGEJSingapore
Title: Do not miss this - Must Try
Review: We dined at this restaurant 2 days in a row (dinner and lunch) and were totally satisfied. We had 2 types of fish (let the waitress recommend), eggplant, calamari, vegetables.All were beautifully cooked and spiced.Their chendol is even better than a very much hyped chendol in Malacca.Certainly a MUST GO to restaurant if you are a foodie.Very reasonable price and great service.Show less

Author: moonilnam
Title: Best experience of food in melaka
Review: This restaurant is best restaurant ever in my melaka trip!We had pork, eggplant, egg ommlet and pineapple curry and curry was amazing!The place is chinese style and good mood.Even tea and desert were super amazing and fantastic!!Really recommend to visit this place and must have pineapple curry!Show less

Author: JeeKaur26Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Pleasant Surprise.
Review: It was one of our better meal experiences in Malacca, considering how commercialized and touristy Malacca has become. The restaurant is located in one of those long heritage houses on Hereen road. Service is good. The lady who took our order helped us pick the best of everything. The pineapple prawn curry was really nice. The pork dish (the most famous one) was great as well. They gave a complimentary acar which was very refreshing. Generally, it is far more authentic than many other restaurants around that area. Will certainly go back. Show less

Author: Mo211Sydney
Title: A wonderful meal
Review: Nyonya 63 is a wonderful restaurant. The food is extraordinary and the atmosphere the chef and his staff create is really special - if you have the chance to have a chat to him he is a very warm character who clearly loves what he does. Every dish we had was delicious, and they also catered for a vegetarian in the family with some great dishes. The prawn curry was fantastic, and so was the rendang. Thank you Nyonya 63!Show less

Author: patber66Malaysia
Title: Boxing Day Lunch
Review: Food were good as per recommended by the owner the only problem I think would need the owner to take his step towards training his worker, a lady waiters who accuse of us not wanting one of the dishes that we ordered and told her boss that we are the one that canceled while she did a mixed up in placing dishes that we did not order on our table and later we found out from the boss that dish she mentioned was actually on her hand that we did not know at all. After many arguments the owner came and made his stand and apologized for his worker attitude. Beware for this lady with single pony hair which is extremely rude. Overall good are delicious if you don’t mind the attitude. Have a try. Show less

Author: sam170309Adelaide Hills, Australia
Title: Good food but BAD SERVICE
Review: This is my first visit.overall food and environment are good.service wise fair,I saw one of the Chinese chubby lady shout and keep scold those waiter in very rude.I’m so disappointed with this lady.with the same person who took my orders kept asked us quickly make our decision due to she was in busy.i totally can’t accept with her attitude.I hopefully the manager or person in charge will take action for the restaurant reputation in future.Show less

Author: GigirichardSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Hidden Gem for Nonya Food
Review: This was our second visit to this restaurant. Our last trip was with a group of friends in August. We fell in love with the food. Everyone felt the dishes were excellent. Everyone raved about the fried chicken wings. It was super delicious, finger-licking yummy great. The other dishes we ordered were excellent, and the many home cooks in our group gave this restaurant a two-thumbs up, and vowed they would come back whenever they visit Malacca. Well, we did, my wife and I in Dec. Of course, we had to order the chicken wings. We also had the Ayam Buah Keluak, sweet potato leaves and chendol. Absolutely delicious. While the other dishes were excellent, my missus and I felt we should have ordered a larger plate of chicken wings and forget about the other dishes. It was that finger-licking good. The fast-food chicken and all others simply pale in comparison to Nonya 63 version.We were very surprised when Chef Kiong came out to meet us. He is very passionate about Peranakan cuisine and learnt to cook by watching his friends' moms as they cook in his early years. A testimony to his authenticity is that Nonya 63 has many regular clients, including some of Malacca's elite Peranakan families. That weekend, the restaurant was fully booked for private functions.We will certainly make another visit to this hidden gem. If you are coming for dinner, do note the Jalan Tun Tan Cheng Lock entrance is closed after 6pm. Call restaurant for advice on how to goShow less

Author: prutbc
Title: Hidden Nyonya Restaurant
Review: Brought my KL friend for lunchtime. The food was good as their customer service (^_-) and we hope to revisit for Cendol.

Author: 20arinaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A must Visit for Peranakan Cuisine
Review: Came here with a couple of friends who were in a quest to explore their roots and this restaurant came highly recommended. The Chef himself came to take our orders, and of course, we had to ask for his recommendations - which we ordered as well. The portions that arrived were just enough for our party of 3 and we enjoyed the food thoroughly. In fact, we believe that it's probably the best Peranakan fare we've had in Melaka. Making a reservation is highly recommended.Show less

Author: 960laurencecNagoya, Indonesia
Title: PeranakanFood
Review: The entrance to the place is located at the back of a long Peranankan house. Very very well design eating hall with a stage at the end where there's live band on certain nights performing. Good selection of Peranankan food. Unfortunately it apply too much MSG & oil in the cooking. Love the chandol though as its not sweet but delicious. Price reasonable. Show less

Author: tck90823
Title: Restaurant spoiled by the arrogant chef
Review: Nice restaurant with nice ambience but spoiled by the arrogant chef. Food was served quite slow and we found a fly in one of the dishes. We confronted the staff and the chef came and arrogantly told us that is was a bee instead of a fly. He was trying to treat us as a fool with such lies. Even if it is a bee in the food, it is also not acceptable. Would you accept your food being served with a bee in it? Actually, just a simply apology will do but the chef chose to give stupid excuses. His attitude towards us was also very arrogant with no sense of apology. Well, there is not only one peranakan restaurant around. We still have other choice.Show less

Author: Lim20192020
Title: Poor service
Review: The lovely ambience of this restaurant was regrettably tarnished by the chef, a rather overbearing character who seemed to think it was necessary to dictate the food choices of his patrons. We were unable to glance through the menu in peace as he kept hovering over us, insisting that we read the menu from front to back, in a certain way. When one of our party tried to order his choice of dishes, he rudely interrupted and asked to speak only to the head of the party, “so I won’t be confused and have to deal with everyone.” When another tried to order again, he began speaking in Mandarin to us- despite the fact that we could only understand English, and had informed him so from the start. All in all, we felt is was rather strange way of treating customers - one would have expected, at the very least, a level of basic courtesy from someone of his rank and position in the establishment, if nothing else. Despite the tasty food, we came away disappointed with the service, and will not be returning soon.Show less

Author: MiketwzSingapore
Title: Great food and great service
Review: Even though we made a last min reservation, the staff still manage to get us a seat and enjoy the food. The cook also came out and intro to us some food which suit our taste. Pls made reservation before coming and some dishes only available if order few days earlier. Staff are friendly and even got us a better seats. Will be back again.Show less

Author: MattNHTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good quality Nyonya with slightly expensive price
Review: Location is not hard to find and although the price is a bit expensive but the cendol is really something you don’t want to missed.We had half a fish, pork with chili, stewed chicken with buah keluak, stewed veg and butterfly pea drink. Food quality is not bad but have a wait a bit for your food.Show less

Author: swaldmey
Title: Midweek dinner for one
Review: Good food but terrible service. I came early on a quiet evening. I ordered three dishes and they all came together so I had no opportunity to enjoy the appetizers without the main course being stone cold. And I had two or three of the serving staff hovering at the table waiting to snatch the plates away. It was a lovely room - I wish I’d been given some time to appreciate it!Show less

Author: ChuaM53
Title: New Family Reunion spot
Review: My siblings and I grew up in Melaka but moved all over the place. Everytime we come back to Melaka now, we make it a point to eat here.When you come here, you have to get the Babi Chilli Garam, Petai prawn, rendang mutton. It's nice to chill outside on the courtyard after a meal. You can bring your own drinks hereShow less

Author: David S
Title: Fantastic surprise
Review: We were looking for a great place to eat and we certainly found it.  The atmosphere was terrific in the very old section iconic of Malaka.  The Lemongrass chicken was fragrant and flavorful.  Awesome must try location when visiting Malaka!

Author: tan6368
Title: Experience nyonya food
Review: I like the cincaluk egg. The taste is nice and fresh. The asam fish also nice. Not too sour. Otak- otak is fresh. Except the acar taste so so only. The rest are quite tasty.

Author: Christopher_SNZSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Hits and misses, but still value for price
Review: Had dinner here - word of advice: pre-order your dishes.Quite a number of items were sold out or based on reservation - like soups, noodle and buah keluak dishes.The food was good, with the exception of the kueh pie tee, which should be avoided at all cost!Service was brisk and the interior was gorgeous - all in all an okay experience but I'm sure they could have done better.Show less

Author: jakeflo
Title: First visit to Nonya 63
Review: Made our reservations for lunch on Friday 9th August 2019 and Mr. Kong accepted our reservations without any hesitation. We did not know the closing time and the staffs were kind enough to wait for us to finish.The food was superbly awesome and reasonably priced. Definitely will returned again for lunch and dinner.Show less

Author: Andrewong7788
Title: A Great place and a gem of a visit
Review: We found the place by happenstance and decided to gatecrash without reservation. Boy we are glad they are able to find us a table for 7. it was rather packed and bustling. The restaurant is well designed and an ambiance of new and old vibes like eating in the courtyard of a well known merchant who is your friend. A friendly Chef Keong greeted us in his seasoned gear and took our orders. He introduce us a few dishes which we gladly accept.We started first with a big flask of butterfly pea flower tea, its blue liquid goes well warm or iced. This time we steered away from the usual Nonya fair and order the very simple. We had a simple garlic kangkong, Sek bak (stewed Pork), half a chili garam fried fish, chincalok omelette, mutton curry, fried spicy eggplant. Boy it was respectfully and mostly good. Let me expound....Top of this list is the kangkong, omelette and eggplant which are so simple but at its peak. They are done well and invokes a feeling of warmth and familiarity of honest cooking. they are must try in my opinion. Next is the fish, amazing with a glaring flaw which i wished to have more of it, i do not mean the portion is small but because it is so good when you want to second portion, its gone...maybe should named it, "Gone in sixty second fish". Its crispy and fresh, serve with a insanely balance of chili sambal garam on it...Now the meat department namely mutton curry and sek bak (stewed pork platter)...this dept need some encouragement and coaxing...yes they are the usual tender and cooked well but with a word "subdued". We finished with the usual chendol dessert, it is certainly not the creamiest, strongest nor deepest BUT it is well done and balance. it is not cloying nor sinful. it is satisfying.Overall the food and place is great, it is certainly not old style religion but a fresh look at its Nonyan roots. Warmth service, bustling life and honest cooking makes this a great find and memorable meal. It is priced fair with the above combination and also comes with a deep inner court of merchandise for your shopping cravings....Show less

Author: cynfulaquariusSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated & Expensive!!!
Review: Read so many good reviews about this Nyonya restaurant and also the chef is previously from Samfu Restaurant, I decided to give it a try. Was really crowded on a Saturday lunch time, luckily I made a reservation. Seeing this crowd makes me look forward to the cuisine. We ordered asam steam fish, chicken, egg plant & chap chye. The food to us are really just ok... nothing fantastic. My mum jokingly say she can cook better. Well maybe is just our taste or standard is different.Show less

Author: tonyking8652Essen, Germany
Title: The nicest of all Nyonya restaurants we've trued
Review: This restaurant came highly recommended and didn't fail!We arrived early, and the owner/chef came to our table to advise us about his special suggestions. Two light pork items as starter, followed by a Nyonya Assam fish fillet, pineapple/spice prawns, Sweet potato leaves with yam in creamy laksa sauce, and Otak-Otakfollowed by the "pièce de résistance" the famous Nyonya Cendol with extra gula-melaka. FabulousShow less

Author: lynwenmAdelaide, Australia
Title: Affordable five star dining.
Review: My husband and I whack been travelling in Malaysia for a few weeks and so we’re keen try try the Nyonya style of cuisine found here in Malacca. We found Nyonya 63 tucked between two streets right on the heart of colonial Malacca. It’s traditional style of architecture and high ceilings meant that it was cool and spacious.On our first visit we tried a few of the dishes unfamiliar to us such as otak otak, mixed Vegetable Achar, chicken rendang, char chap chai and butterfly pea flower tea. The food and service was so exceptional that we decided to return the next day to try out some of the other dishes on the menu. This time we had beef tends here in a bao like bun, and fabulous okra. Wow! Definitely recommend this place if you want to try out fabulous good in a lovely setting without the tourist price tag sttached. Show less

Author: Samantha8tKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Superb Peranakan Meal in a Beautiful Location
Review: Superb authentic Nyonya cuisine, with great & friendly service. Don't forget to try the Nyonya steamed fish, babi cili garam (which goes great in the mantao bread from the beef rendang), dried shrimp (heh-bi) eggplant, and cendol. The butterfly pea flower drink is also super delish & refreshing! Thank you Chef Keong for the amazing meal! We will be back.Show less

Author: adrian0714Singapore, Singapore
Title: Total disappointment
Review: With many raving on here about 63, we made reservations at 1315 on July 18 with high expectations. On the contrary, the food was mediocre at best. Two of its popular dishes, pie tee and chicken buar keluak was unavailable. It was lunch and the Peranakan restaurant did not have enough of these common Peranakan dishes to go around. What does it tell you about the establishment? For those wanting to patronise, the acar isn’t worth the tag of RM1. We were so disappointed we didn’t even wanted the cendol at the end of our meal. Not going back ever.Show less

Author: sodesaBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Superb Nonya Restaurant
Review: Had a most enjoyable dinner with my wife at Nonya 63. All the dishes were excellent, but standout dishes were the Brinjal Hay Bee, Spiced Chili Garam Pork, the Fried Fish and Chendol dessert. Service was good, and the high ceilinged restaurant had a tasteful courtyard ambience. As it was a quiet night, we were fortunate to be able to have conversation with flamboyant and well traveled owner chef Keong.Strongly recommended Show less

Author: KongYLan
Title: Good Nyonya Food with Nice Ambiance
Review: Stone throw away from Jonker Walk, this is a hidden gem in Malacca for Nyonya food. Set in a beautiful stand alone building, the food offered was authentic and reasonably priced. Booking is essential as it is often full.

Author: tpLong
Title: Nyonya Food
Review: Cozy atmosphere with nice decor.  Delicious food and the restaurant can provide vegetarian items too.

Author: Michael51C
Title: Great Food and great environment!
Review: Nyonya food was part of the plan when I traveled in Melaka. Nyonya 63 didn't let me disappoint! Food and environment were traditional and excellent! Must try!

Author: FlySingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: NONYA 63 GOODEATS
Review: Recommended By CASA DEL RIO'S HOTEL Manager(Michael Que)NONYA 63 is All so YUM! OH So Delicious at Resonable cost. Spicy NonSpicy Savoury sour & Sweet velvety smoith IT'S ALL Yum! Evening & Night brings out the Romance of Jazzy dinning. WARNING!....NONYA 63 gets crowded so go or Book early! ENJOYKevin MAGNUSSINGAPOREShow less

Author: SueySingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Nyonya food
Review: Lucky to discover this restaurant as many restaurants are closed on Tuesdays. Just opened a few months ago apparently. Beautiful decor and lovely setting with the main dining tucked inside a inner hall. Chef is very personable and came to take our order and recommend dishes. All the dishes were very tasty and I especially liked the dried chili pork, pineapple prawns and the Cendol. Prices were slightly higher than other Nyonya restaurants i’ve been to in Melaka. Will be back.Show less

Author: RicoKhor
Title: Excellent Nyonya Food
Review: found this place by chance when passing by. the decor is majestic and with classic Baba Nyonya and modern designs. food is super unique. Star Fruit Pork and Asam Fish is a must. Service is impeccable and Chef Keong is very frenly who took his time to talk to his customersShow less

Author: puspanathanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: A pleasant dinner made pleasant by very helpful staff
Review: A big advice to visitors to Melaka on Mondays. Most popular places are closed on Mondays. Nyonya 63 is one of those highly recommended places that doesn’t close on Mondays. Since all the places we planned to go were closed so Nyonya 63 was a last minute cat out of the bag. We went without reservations as it was so last minute suggestion from TripAdvisor. They were fully booked but a very pleasant Ms. Hong was able to fit us in. A table for 4 at the last minute. The orders were taken very fast. The food started coming in less then 20 minutes. Chicken wings Inche Kabin came first. Very crispy and perfectly spiced. Then the Serai prawns followed by the Brinjal/ Aubergine Hay Bee and Fried fish with Siamese Somtom or mango salad. All very tasty highly fragrant. Only the omelette was a disappointment. Finally the the otak-otak ( steamed spiced fish paste and prawns) came. It was the best I have tasted. I usually don’t like fish but I enjoyed both the otak-otak and fried fish. The fish was very fresh. Show less

Author: mkongjSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Nyonya Food in Malacca
Review: The restaurant was recommended by a friend who helped us to make a reservation as there was more than 10 of us. The location of the restaurant was near Jonker Street and the decor was beautiful. We discussed the menu with the head chef who is a true blue Peranakan and he recommended his signature dishes with pride. To be honest, I was skeptical when he said his chendol is the best in Malaysia. But when I tried it, it’s indeed the best chendol I have ever tasted in Malacca. Every dish we ordered did not disappoint and I was awestruck by the amount of effort put in every dish. They served warm butterfly pea tea in a traditional flask. You can add lime and ice to your glass and see its transformation.I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who wants to try authentic Nyonya food near Jonker Street in Malacca with a nice ambience. It’s the best Nyonya food I have tasted in Malacca in my visits so far. Show less

Author: Compass538381Richmond, Canada
Title: Authentic peranakan experience
Review: My sisters and I had a wonderful dining experience at Nonya63. Everything was authentic, the food, the ambience , the service were excellent. Prices were reasonable. Especially recommend the assam fish , chap chai and otak., among others. Definitely "a must-go " for anyone who wants to enjoy quality food and have a nonya experience. Recommend to all.Show less

Author: Fairy_jess75Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Food
Review: We were recommended to this restaurant by a friend, the decoration of the place is exceptionally beautiful. Upon arriving we were greeted by friendly staff and was shown to our table. The person that took our order seems to be the head chef of the place, he is somehow seems to be quite arrogant with his words and we are not pleased with they way he interact with us. What can i say about the food, its delicious, would definitely recommend it to friends. I would have given a higher star rating if not because of the attitude of the chefShow less

Author: Bill MSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing ambience, excellent Perankan food, friendly & helpful Chef & Staff
Review: As you walk towards and into the great big house from the direction of Casa Del Rio you cannot help but be awed by the grandeous opulence of the mansion.Staff are on hand and very helpful and friendly. Chef Chee Keong himself is an extremely affable Baba who is always willing to mingle with his guests and extremely proud of his food and his endeavours.We couldn't possibly go through the entire menu in one seating so I shall highlight out top "wow" dishes. Top of the list has to be the Babi Chilli Garam. This singular dish was the favourite of the entire table. My personal WOW was the ayam buah keluak. The nut is well chosen and chock full of the delicious black "meat". The curry was infused with the keluak flavour. The otak2, kankong belachan, Achar, all superb. The chinchalok omelette has a lovely texture, moist & fluffy. Sometimes omelettes are overdone and dry. Although my friends enjoyed the chichalok flavour, I personally would have preferred there to be much much more chinchalok. But this is a personal taste and next time I'll communicate it to Chef Chee Keong.The chendol was one of the best, if not the best, you can get in Malacca. The gula Melaka was thick and oozy and generous as was the rich santan.Nonya 63 is a llittle pricier than other well-known Peranakan establishments but I would say it's well worth it just to bask in the ambience and savor the cuisine, and to chat with Chef Chee Keong.Show less

Author: jeffreyboseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Peranakan Cuisine in Old Melaka Town
Review: Located in front of the iconic Casa Del Rio is newly opened Peranakan restaurant serving traditional classics in a luxurious setting fit for a king. Chef Keong is a true, blue Baba chef trained in the purest Nonya tradition and taste who spends time chatting up patrons to ask questions and offer suggestions. We enjoyed Udang Masak Nanas, Fish curry (Garoupa), Cincalok Omelette, Chilli Garam Pork, Pork Rib Buah Keluak, Sambal Terong and washed everything down with Butterfly Pea Tea. Service was friendly and prompt. Best of all, the prices are below what we would have guessed for the lovely setting and excellent food. We will definitely be back VERY SOON!Show less

Author: EYeoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Nyonya food
Review: Nyonya 63 was a surprise find. It came recommended from someone we met in Melaka, and what a superb dinner we had! We were introduced to Chef Keong, who helped us by suggesting their house favourites and from first to last dish, everything was excellent. The restaurant is new, opened in early 2019. Decor is fresh, bright and ambience very pleasant. Pricing was very reasonable, considering the quality. It is clear that Chef Keong has a passion for nyonya cuisine and takes pride in the preparation of the dishes. The presentation of the various dishes was eclipsed only by the sublime flavours. Plenty of parking right outside the restaurant. In a city with a nyonya restaurant at every street corner, I have no hesitation recommending Nyonya 63 as a must-try.Show less

Author: TheUKHappyTravellerUK
Title: Delicious food and extremely welcoming
Review: Thank you to Chef Keong and his staff for a beautiful meal and lovely evening. A Malaysian friend recommended this restaurant and we were so glad we persisted when we thought it was closed (we were at the back door opposite the Baba and Nyonya Museum, you need to walk around to the main entrance). Chef Keong was thoughtful enough to explain his menu to us. There isn’t a huge selection because clearly a huge amount of care and attention goes into every delicious dish, but based on his recommendations we had a fantastic introduction to Peranakan food. Staff were friendly and attentive and the restaurant is in a beautiful old traditional style house. Terrific value for money too. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: pkltoddWeybridge, United Kingdom
Title: First Ever Taste of Nyonya Cooking
Review: We were invited to Nyonya 63 as guests just a couple of days or so before Chinese New Year on Feb 5th. Not only was this a first ever visit to Malacca for us, but also a first ever experience of Nyonya cuisine. Both were utterly stunning and we can't wait to reprise them both. Our host was - and is - a hugely informed person: something of a polymath in fact and consequently his telling of historical tales about the Peranakans and hence the genesis ultimately of Nyonya cuisine magnificently compounded what was a truly stunning dinner. The main dining room itself on the ground floor ( there is another room upstairs ), within what is a lovely house in a fabulous part of the city, was beautifully designed and decorated. Importantly too, it was lovely and cool on a typically balmy to muggy Malaccan night. The many courses of food which we enjoyed hugely from start to finish were presented to us all by wonderfully engaging, very friendly and hospitable members of staff. Their service was swift and constant.I'm pretty sure Nyonya 63 had only been open for a few days before we went. Either way: it is bound to be very,very successfully and enduringly open for years now ! You'll love and enjoy it when you go.Show less

Author: ian B
Title: Delicious Nyonya food.Quality cooking.
Review: We were recommended this new restaurant and it is excellent. Friendly, clean and very welcoming with a lovely menu. All explained by the chef and his staff. Delicious prawns and chicken with generous portions. Couldn’t fault it.

Author: anger1Brisbane, Australia
Title: Mr
Review: From start to end a wonderful experience. Went to book for evening meal hostess was charming @ gracious.as I am s single person sometimes presents a conundrum for restaurants.on arriving friendly greeting chef came out and explained the courses after asking my preferences.had the oral oral,lemak nenas prawns,Babi Cili.all of the dishes were a delight,well balanced spices.staff was friendly and efficient.well worth visiting.Show less

Author: DonalC741Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A delicious Nyonya experience
Review: A surprise experience, brought by local Melaka friends. 7 mains and 1 dessert. Rarely to have 7 dishes all of excellent quality. Varied from Asam fish curry to Pork knuckle, seasoned eggplant and my favorite a prawn pineapple curry. Followed this with a local dessert Cendol! Service was also efficient and friendly and nice ambiance. Recommend to try. Show less

Author: naka2312
Title: Nice Melaka Local Food
Review: We were recommended to try this local Melaka nyonya food and did not regret. Nice food and good service!

Author: doopey2601
Title: Good food and good service
Review: The food was good and the staff was friendly. We didn't wait long for our food. It has authentic nonya flavour. Will come again if I visit Malacca.

Author: Chow M
Title: Gem hidden behind a traditional costume shop
Review: We were initially attracted to the nice bag kebab displayed outside....as we walked in we suddenly saw good crowd having dinner behind...and were delighted to find out it's actually a very good nyonya restaurant. We had dinner and lunch the next day at the same place....chef makes no compromise on his quality...and the food was very good....must try for everyone...Show less

Author: mfajar1207
Title: Great dinner experience at Baba 90
Review:
Great atmosphere, amazing food (I recommend the aubergine) and friendly staff made our last dinner in Malacca memorable.
Will come back on our next trip to Malacca for sure!

Author: FBenny62
Title: Simple The Best
Review: A big thank you to Chef Chee Keong for the impeccable special arrangements done for my lovely friends.The Peranakan cuisine were indeed awesomely delicious.The guests from the Royal Family members of Solo and Johor conveyed their compliments to you for the superbly delicious food served.Show less

Author: RickHunterW
Title: Best Nonya food we ever had
Review:
Never had such good Nonya food, whether in Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Penang or other place in Malacca. 

The top notch and very friendly service complement the sumptuous food nicely. 

I will let the pictures do the talking in this case. We are truly impressed!

Author: Jennifer C

Review:

Well worth a visit. I am definitely coming back again.

Thank you Chef Chee Kheong!

Author: Sulyn92
Title: Delicious nyonya food
Review: Was recommended by friend. The foods here is very delicious. The staff here is very helpful & friendly. Highly recommend to try their cendol, it's very delicious.

Author: Justin H
Title: GREAT food and service. Would come back again!
Review: Best peranakan food I have tasted in a while. Notable favourites were the fried terung and fried ikan bakar with sambal. Very tasty! Waiters were very helpful and service was commendable. Ambience was homely and cosy. Hidden gem. Would return if I had the chance.

Author: Imansyakir
Title: Will Not Regret
Review: Baba 90 is the best peranakan food that i ever taste..come and make sure you taste all the food..😄😋😋..the service so fast n excellent, staff so friendly n good,good environment with a nice view n calm song..

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Awesome coz .... it’s good !
Review: Was told that there was a new peranakan restaurant opened. Always looking to try new place and one thing to note is that the chef used to be frm Samfu.Parking is a bit of a hassle and its pork free. No babi but still good. Nothing beats pictures of the good. So enjoy. 2 thumbs up. Show less

Author: richardo301
Title: Superb
Review: Very nice italian style restaurant. Great steaks cooked to perfection with lovely oven cooked pizzas. Staff very polite

Author: DrParthivan
