Author: jluke_118Malaysia
Title: The ribeye steak not bad with
Review: The ribeye steak not bad with balsamic brandy glaze sauce. Good service, friendly staff... pizza here also good!Show less

Author: Hz62Singapore, Singapore
Title: Birthday surprise went awry!
Review: I am very disappointed that my surprise dinner for sis birthday dinner was badly handled by the staff!I had emailed 3 times to make reservation plus bday info plus cake but the manager came over in front of my sis to ask about a cake not realising abt the surprise element The meal served was not planned out as our antipasto didn't come but was saved by the excellent soup! Then immediately after all the other course of pizza pasta plus Tbonesteak came at once which irritated my guests The staff need to be trained as well the kitchen staff to time the flow of the dinner course The restaurant must try to provide the guests request like birthday cake etc instead of totally ignoring the request which was made 3 times via email Very disappointed !Show less

Author: TomeckKyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Quite good but not really very good!
Review: There is an average menu and the mushroom soup was delicious.My wife had a cod steak. Tasty but cold as was the plate. No one warms plates in Malaysia so ask always. We were tired so forgot.My son had a pizza but not great dough or cooked in a proper pizza oven.Overall, passable. Would go and try another Italian next time in town.Show less

Author: happyklKlamath Falls, Oregon
Title: An Excellent night with Sirocco
Review: I was here on a Saturday night with my family of 7. Service was impeccable!!!!The waitress has the sweetest smiles ever and they went an extra mile to make my celebration for my Mom a warm and memorable experience.Keep up the good work and I may pay another visit to you tonight if time permits !!!Show less

Author: 570vincentdNegombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Worth the money
Review: We were there for New Year's eve and the food was delicious. The carpaccio is a bit of small portion but good and portobello mushroom was excellent. The whole seabass was perfectly cooked, even if it took a bit longer to arrive and very good beef lasagne. The service is a bit slow and desorganised but we were not in a rush. Nice menu but too heavy to carry... LolGood idea your bread self service post where you can enjoy as your wish fresh or crispy bread with olive oil, balsamic vinegar or truffle butter. Sad your tartuffo was not available... Show less

Author: jessicatant
Title: Disappointed
Review: Had a birthday dinner at sirocco yesterday, a few things to point out:1) service was slow and staff honestly didn’t register or understand what we were saying , had to ask them to refill water like a few times, even getting new cutlery, had to be asked a few times 2) the chef hat items were not available and we weren’t told at the booking had to op for other dishes, we weren’t told thAt the main meat dishes took an hour to prepare 3) the garlic bread ran out at 7.45pm and we were told there was no more, I think you guys should have enough that last till the restaurant closes or if there still is customers 4) was quite strange that the red sauce pasta’s we ordered even though different on the menu all had the same sauce , even the risotto and it was way too spicy 5) the restaurant at first couldn’t find the birthday cake and they froze the cake in the freezer ! Good points: The blue cheese pasta was great Show less

Author: Wan LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: So-so
Review: Wasn’t impressed by the food. I felt as though the food served was very similar to fast food quality. I felt the quality of the food didn’t live up to the price. Was expecting far better. The pizza was a let down. I enjoyed the soup, but the rest of our orders were so-so. A little disappointed as I brought a big group over, excited to try authentic Italian food but turned out to be unimpressive. However, the service was great. Show less

Author: puddinglow
Title: just as good
Review: food here has not gone down in standard plutheir icon Mr Jamal is just as friendly and knowledgeble. i do recommend this restaurant

Author: John T
Title: Disappointed Pasta
Review: I think the chef who cook pasta are don't know actually how to cook Italian Pasta, not mee goreng mamak. The texture of cooked pasta are poor and not worth with pricing.

Author: Rt_Hon_CriticSingapore, Singapore
Title: Missed perfection by just one dish.
Review: We returned to Sirroco restaurant after half a year (two weeks back) and can I just say it still is living up to standards. Truly one of our most favourite Italian restaurants.The service as usual was impeccable Many thanks to Jamal (he still remebered us) who made our dinner pleasant and enjoyable. He is a rare gem to find in the F&B these days! Food here generally is still tasty as usual even though the menu has changed since our last visit. We had the Minestrone; Mushroom soup; Aglio olio (with beef); Alla sirroco and the Quattro stagioni pizza.Just some memorable mentions.The Alla sirroco was extraordinary. It is a seafood special with crab, fish scallops and more. There is a hint of lemon and tangy taste. A pasta that lives up to its namesake.For the pizza, a meat lover's delight, ingedients included smoke duck, beef and chicken pepperoni. As usual the crust was the highlight. Simply oven-burnt to perfection and authentic.However regrettably... the aglio olio, once the highlight now the bane of the meal. It was dry - literally oven baked. Not a hint of olive oil. The change in menu resulted in this disappointment... The only good thing was that they were generous with beef slices. So please, I implore the restaurant to change it back to the old menu. All in all we still had a wonderful experience here at the Sirroco. Apart from the aglio olio letdown, it was still a lovely dinner, so expect us to return soon!Show less

Author: autumlyMalaysia
Title: Disappointed
Review: Dined there one night after seeing great reviews. They had a wood fire oven yet they used pre-made biscuit crust for the pizza! A smaller than average pizza size as well. Bread station lots of variety but bread was hard and stale. Pastas salty overcooked, not al dente. Risotto is like porridge. Very wet and runny. Service is the only thing good unfortunately. For the price, this is not the quality I expected at a Holiday Inn restaurant. As an IHG member who has eaten at the group’s many restaurants, this has got to be one of the worst. Show less

Author: 875rajag
Title: Super Food..
Review: We visited this restaurant on two occasions within a week. On both occasions the food was impeccable and well presented. One of our guests complained about the quality of the cod fish (why use imported fish when your surrounded by sea I fail to understand..) .. The service could be better.. Except for the head-waiter the rest were trainees.. Wine choices was acceptable too.. Show less

Author: R5874OXhannaht
Title: Delicious!
Review: We visited this restaurant on our first night in Malacca and it did not disappoint. We both had a pizza, thin base, cooked in a pizza oven and the food was excellent. The staff were incredible too, so polite and attentive, wonderful service.

Author: anakhronismosBeijing, China
Title: One great, one awful visit
Review: Great service in-house, but then walked over from our hotel to take away two pizzas for our kids. The margherita pizzas we received are shocking, with barely any cheese on them. This is incredibly disappointing, as we ate in-house a few nights ago and had a much different experience: hot, cheesy pizzas. I can only hope that this is a one-time failure, but certainly is not acceptable. If you take away, apparently, you’re not worth a standard pizza’s quantity of cheese?Show less

Author: Rt_Hon_CriticSingapore, Singapore
Title: Incredible Italian cuisine
Review: I will start off by saying the food here is just incredible!For starters, their mushroom soup is a must try. It's neither too creamy nor diluted and with the truffle oil and its aroma, the soup hits the spot.Also the oglio olio we ordered was truly one of the best we've had. The taste was on point, not too bland, not too salty. Exactly how an Italian would cook it.For pizza, we ordered the quattro stagioni pizza - a meat lover's pizza which was about 15 in wide.The pizza had a thin base - a little too soft but the crust was crispy! Toppings were not bad, beef slices & pepperoni as well as chicken ham & pepperoni.Service was outstanding. We just want to say what a pleasure it was to have Jamal around. He was very friendly and knowledgeable having been in the hotel for 10 years already! He made our dinner very enjoyable. Ultimately it was a pleasant and delicious A* dinner we had! We're bound to return so keep up the great work!Show less

Author: 724christinapCounty Dublin, Ireland
Title: Lovely Italian restaurant in the Holiday Inn
Review: We found this restaurant on Trip Advisor having arrived into Melaka late in the evening, with not many dinner options nearby. We were very surprised by how lovely it turned out to be! The menu was extensive, with good choices of pizza, pasta and other mains. We both had pasta dishes, the spaghetti vongole and another tomato based pasta - very tasty and good portion size. Prices were reasonable at around 30-40RM for mains. Complimentary bread and oil/balsamic dip a nice touch. We had a bottle of wine with us (as some restaurants in Malaysia don't serve alcohol) and we were allowed to drink it with no corkage charge, which we were very impressed with. The service was fast, and our waiter gave us some helpful tips for things to see and do in Melaka. Would definitely recommend. Show less

Author: SamuelMo18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great service, decent food
Review: This is my 3rd visit to the sirocco restaurant and I did so while staying at the holiday inn melaka.My wife and i both ordered mushroom soup and steak for dinner. I believe the restaurant is perhaps more known for it's italian cuisine such as pasta and pizzas but being a meat lover, i usually find it hard to resist meat on the menu.The mushroom soup was scented with truffle oil and was well done. My wife ordered the tenderloin while I ordered the porterhouse. Both steaks were well done- no pun intended. Overall a great experience and I must commend the service crew for being very attentive throughout the dinner. Highly recommended place for a romantic dinner.Show less

Author: Graeme M
Title: The Holiday Inn Restaurant
Review: Great service and good food at a reasonable cost.  The staff are a delight especially Jamal.  He alone will keep you entertained.

Author: Brian_Stanley2014
Title: Nice food & good service
Review: Plenty to choose from on the menu with a mix of Asian & western food. Everything was reasonably priced with the presentation & taste being very good. The service was always friendly & effecient.

Author: Abhi_sgpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing Italian Food - Understated Restaurant
Review: If you are looking for great Italian Food without caring too much about ambiance Sirocco is probably the right place. We had Penne Arabiatta, Bruschetta, Risotto, Veg Pizza and all of them were delicious. Arabiatta was a good mix of spices, thin crust pizza was tasty and risotto was smooth. And it's very very reasonably priced. The place looks very understated and ambiance could definitely be better, but food clearly stands out. It only opens for Dinner!Show less

Author: ymLee1991Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience but lousy service
Review: Went with friends for a celebration. Quiet and comfortable setting, soothing music and nice decorations. Food wise is good but price is on the high end. Portion is average, certainly not enough for big eaters. pizzas and pastas are their main. not much of a choice if you're a vegetarian or would like to have more meat for your meal. pizzas are good, oven baked and thin crusted. Service wise isn't as good as what the other review stated. It was really poor, they were either short of staff or too 'busy' to notice us. it wasn't a crowded evening, probably another 2 tables ahead of us. but whenever we request some service we would have to look high and low and even to the extend to walk around to look for a waiter to serve us. Even during payment no waiter was in sight, and the one we found after few minutes of walking around left us after leaving the bill and we had to go searching for him again later. Lots of improvement needed.Show less

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Comfort and good food
Review: After a hot day with a lot of walking we enjoyed the classy, quiet and comfortable restaurant. It was not crowded on a Sunday evening. Food was nice and within expectation. The smoked duck salad was nice, bruschetta was solid although tomatoes were not overly ripe. The pizza with bufallo mozzarella, basil and tomato was very nice. Although I prefer the thicker dough, the very thin crust was well done. The lobster pasta was nice. Tomato sauce on the sweet side and a bit too much but overall nice. Selection of red wines is limited but the Planeta from Sicily was robust. Service was very good, polite and our waiter paid high attention to details. Very pleasant. The open concept oven and cooking allows a good look into the preparing of food. The restaurant is spacious, modern, comfortable. Location at Holiday Inn on lobby level. Not exactly romantic but certainly very pleasant and good for a nice conversation too with moderate noise levels. Prices are on the higher side compared with local restaurants in town but in general ok if one compares with international restaurants. Overall always an option to consider for a change of food.Show less

Author: Wendy L
Title: Great service, good food & good ambience!
Review: First, i would like to give a thumbs up for the whole team especially Jamal. I had a pleasant birthday dinner with quality of food and nice ambience. Simple & nice decoration table. Surprise with Jamal's great voice for the birthday song! Keep up the good job!Show less

Author: Professional-Pilgrim
Title: Good place to eat, whether or not you are staying there
Review: We had several meals here, and all were good. The smoked salmon pizza and the bruchetta, for example. What was outstanding was the chicken. The serving was so copious that we shared it.

Author: LP_onlineStuttgart, Germany
Title: Delicious Italian food
Review: My partner and I arrived late in Melaka and at 9pm, our choices of restaurants for dinner are limited. We found this Italian restaurant located in Holiday Inn hotel and was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the food and ambience at a reasonable price. Paid RM300 for dinner which includes scallops for starter, a pasta and pizza for mains, and a bottle of wine accompanied with live music!Show less

Author: desmondw59
Title: Excellent Food and Hospitality
Review: Thanks to Jamal, Zabli and co. for taking good care of us, Saffri for organizing the birthday suprise, kudos to you guys. Great food to savour with your love ones.

Author: roryjdoyle
Title: Good Italian
Review: Good Italian restaurant located on the lobby level of the Holiday Inn Malacca. Good for any occasion.

Author: IvyK200Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Great service and pleasure experience!
Review: Nice food servings and friendly staff ! My friends and I were went there for a small celebration of my friend's birthday. The staff helped us decorate the table which is really lovely and also prepared a big red velvet cake for us which is really out of our expectation. A wonderful place for couple, friends for some special occasion!Show less

Author: RissIbrahim IKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Italian Food!
Review: Had a wonderful dining experience at Sirocco.. Scrumptious meal and the service was impeccable. Very friendly and helpful staff. The pastas we had that night was fantastic. Thank you to the Manager Jamal and the Supervisor Safri who suggested the deliciou dishes and Panjang for the amazing cocktails.. My first visit but definitely will be back! Thank you everyone at Sirocco Show less

Author: Weng Kee TSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food
Review: My wife and I were staying in HolidayInn and we feel lazy to go out for dinner, so we give this restaurant a try. I have tried the lasagna and pizza, both are very nice. Nice ambiance, you can even hear the live band performing at the bar next to the restaurant.Show less

Author: Cruiser672300
Title: Great customer service, good food and polite staff
Review: Food was great, nice ambience, great customer service. Both staff Mr. Jamal and Mr. Zabli were very friendly and accommodating. Although pricing is towards the higher end, the taste of the food and the ambience definitely makes this worth while.

Author: oh_aaron
Title: Best Italian restaurant in town
Review: Great pizzas and great pastas. Fantastic menu and fresh ingredients for the pizzas. Not forgetting their mushroom soup is just as good!

Author: Robert R
Title: Kudos to the Chef!
Review: I enjoyed the good service, good food and atmosphere of this restaurant.  With the dishes, drinks and deserts ordered, I could tell the chef was one that was paying attention to details.

Author: michaelaunTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Excellent candlelight Dinner.
Review: Sirocco Special thanks to Manager Safri and our super cheerful and attentive server Jamil for the great night we had at Sirocco. We were there to celebrate my wife's birthday. In knowledge of that, they have a table reserved and also beautifully decorated with crystals, candles and flowers.Not only so, the service was marvellous. Staffs were super attentive and had good knowledge about the food being served, providing recommendations when required. The food served were to our liking and way surpassed our expectations.Surprise walk in with the birthday cake was accompanied by Manager Safri's fantastic vocal. We were in awe. My wife and I are really thankful for the wonderful service provided by Jamil and Saffri for the night and am glad that we chosen to spend this special night at Sirocco. Super Value for the 4 course dinner. Show less

Author: DarbukaVantaa, Finland
Title: Late Pasta al Arrabiata, succee!
Review: Our first evening in Melacca did not turn good at all in China town. We came back to oyr trusted hotel Holiday Inn and I was lucku that kitchen was still open. I ordered quick pasta and it came hot and delicious at no time. Great taste made me happy man.Show less

Author: prognesubisMuar, Malaysia
Title: Very good dining arrangement on short notice
Review: I'm a busy executive and slightly perfectionist, and one day my lady boss asked me for a dinner as a token of appreciation; on her; on short notice. Not familiar with fine dining in Melaka, I made a quick research on romantic dining theme restaurant via Google and found this restaurant. Although I made inquiry via email 5 days prior to dining date, I made my confirmation and booked 2 days earlier, with a few VERY specific requests. I would like to thank and compliment Saffri for his prompt response to my email and has been patiently accommodating my specific requests.I was proposed a candle light dinner, and I requested for a table located secluded for less noisy ambience and more privacy, a music performance right in front of our table, and prepared me a rose flower to be presented to our table at the end of dining session.Throughout the 2 days before the dining start, Saffri has been regularly updating me with the arrangement and setup, and it has been a relief as I want the best dining experience for my boss she ever had in her entire life.Upon arriving at the restaurant, we were led to a table at the end of a corner, beautifully set up with tower of candles and ornaments on the table as well as decorated seats, just beside a curtained window. We were served by Jamal and I would like to also compliment his good and friendly service.Saffri and I were stayed connected via phone texting to communicate on starting the music performance and presentation of flower. We were entertained by a singer and a guitarist, performing my requested song; while the flower were presented to my boss at the same time.Here's my words to local readers: you do not need to travel far when you can have romantic European dining experience here.Lastly, I was actually nervous in the beginning that I have forgotten about the wine, and we ended up dining without wine that night. Perhaps management can take note in future on gently reminding patrons who have forgotten (those who requested for wine when made reservation earlier).Show less

Author: AIREN
Title: Good English and Good Food
Review:
Pros:
- Good food (Pizza is a must try) 
- Good service staff
- Nice mushroom soup
- Staff speak good english and well manners

Cons
- Do not recommend take away or room service for Pizzas. Pizza will be soggy.

Author: JasmyinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amazing staff with excellent food
Review: We were there for a simple birthday celebration. I called ahead to make a booking and mentioned that we were celebrating three people's birthday. The person at the end of the line kindly offered to prepare a small cake for us which I gratefully accepted. When we got there on Saturday, a special table with nice skirting and an ornament to make it grander was sitting on the table. It felt nice that the restaurant was thoughtful to make it a little special for us. We had an appetizer and five mains and every single dish that was made was delicious. The portions were big and definitely filling. We had the lamb (which was succulent and yummy - and I don't even like lamb that much), the beef (which was cooked to perfection), the lobster linguine (which could feed two people), the mushroom risotto (which was well seasoned and definitely a winner in my books) and a pizza (which was large enough for three to eat comfortably). At the end of our meal, Jamal, belted out the most melodious happy birthday tune with his powerful lungs while walking our complimentary cheese cake in. The service and food was amazing and the restaurant made the small little celebration we had very memorable. I would recommend this restaurant for anything really, whether it is a simple dinner when you crave good and delicious Italian food to something grander like having your family gathering here. Two thumbs up for this restaurant!Show less

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A Great Expereince
Review: My wife and I were in this historic city for a brief visit recently. While there, we decided to try this Italian restaurant located within the Holiday Inn Hotel. It was a good decision.When we walked in there were just two tables occupied. One with about 8 diners and another with just two diners. Before we left, more than eight tables were occupied and about twenty plus individuals were dining in the place.We noticed that there were three young local chefs working in the open kitchen area. They seemed intent and focused on their work.We ordered a Rack of Lamb and a Seafood Risotto. Both dishes turned out to be amazing. The service by the wait staff was relatively good but I must single out the attention to detail by the restaurant supervisor, a Mr Jamal. He noticed that the meals were unusually delayed and did request the chefs to speed it up. We too were surprised that my wife's dish was served first and I had to wait a good ten more minutes before my dish arrived. Mr. Jamal repeatedly apologized for the delay.Show less

Author: WarwickshireMarakeshWarwickshire
Title: Excellent Italian food in a friendly restaurant
Review: We were staying at the Holiday Inn and wanted to eat European food after all the Asian food we have been eating The restaurant had a pleasant ambiance with attentive wait staff. The restaurant has a real pizza oven and makes delicious pizza with a thin crust. We were impressed with the food and service. The pace is spotlessShow less

Author: Spoilt_TravellerSingapore
Title: Excellent and reliable italian food in Melaka
Review: Enjoyed dinner on two nights at the restaurant. They have very consistent food and their service staff are knowledgeable, engaging and customer oriented. We felt very welcomed there.Food quality is excellent. Ordered a medium well beef fillet which came out as it should. The cod fish and salmon were moist and honestly was excellent. Their pastas are worth trying especially the one with lobster bisque as a base. It has a richer flavour than the tomato base seafood pasta. A suggestion would be for the chefs to try making their own fresh pasta rather than to use the dried packet ones. Compliments to the chef and the service staff! It is always a joy to return for dinner!Show less

Author: jubied2016
Title: Birthday Celebration
Review: Thumbs up to Jamal for his excellent service and wonderful birthday song sang by him.Had a great dinner that night.Bravo!!

Author: Blaire_05
Title: Tortino Caldo Ciocolato!!!
Review: First of all the service was on top notch, thanks jamal and Shaherman for the exceptional service and fantastic food. Please try the dessert totrtino caldo cicolato basically is a lava cake which tastes amazing and delicious...

Author: Eclipse561
Title: Yummy
Review: I loves the Bisteca and the Manzo steaks as well as all of the pasta dishes.  Spend some time after in the lounge and get beer cheaper during happy hour

Author: DavideA572
Title: Italian name
Review: The restaurant offers a menu with many italian dishes. The result is not that much italian indeed, and it can be improved. It is located inside the hotel and for late arrivals(like mine)  remains a decent choice

Author: Lori93420
Title: Great dinner
Review: Was delightfully surprised by the good quality and taste of lasagna, spaghetti, and pizza at the sirocco restaraunt at holiday inn. Great service and reasonable prices for western style, good quality food.  Will visit again when in malacca.

Author: SamuelMo18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great dinner, great service
Review: This was my first visit to the sirocco and we came for dinner.We were the only guests when we arrived at the restaurant at that time so we enjoyed undivided attention from the staff until other guests arrived subsequently. I would like to commend the wait staff for being prompt and attentive. My water glasses were filled promptly and the staff were courteous and warm. My wife and I decided to order the porterhouse steaks despite this being an italian restaurant serving mainly pizza and pasta. The steaks turned out to be fabulous. It was cooked medium rare as ordered and the portions were huge. It was a delight seeing the kitchen staff in action from our table and the pride they take in preparing food. My wife and I had a delightful dining experience at the Sirocco. Will consider trying out other options on the menu next time. A job well done to the staff and we will be back again for sure!Show less

Author: Ken L
Title: Outside food is better
Review: Quite place, maybe outside has better food. Food are average and they even overcharged me for my food. Clearify then they revise my bill. Can skip the place.

Author: tsehweiMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic in every way
Review: We came here for our first anniversary. The fantastic food, service and ambiance made it a memorable day for both of us. The staff-in-waiting was very courteous, professional and friendly. He pulled out a chair for me and really waited on us in every sense of the word.We ordered the bolognese (RM33.02), napoletana (RM18.87) and orange juice (RM21.70). The price is what you can expect from such a restaurant, but I would say that the special occasion was worth the price. The bolognese and napoletana were delicious! We were completely satisfied after our meal. They also came in big portions, so we were able to share. The orange juice was freshly squeezed and was very refreshing. The meal also came with complimentary bread. We absolutely loved the ambiance - well-decorated, well-lit and well thought through. No complaints at all. Would definitely come back for special occasions. There were two other families at the restaurant during our visit.Show less

Author: MatthiasG1292
Title: Excellent Pizza
Review: Been there with family, stuff very nice and helpful and entertaining with our 1y kid. Pizza and lasagne was tasting fine, and the choices are really new tastings- I had my Pizza with Duck breast- been to maaaany Pizzeria, but never found that before.

Author: LouisMathews
Title: Excellent choice of food and service
Review: Good ambience with wonderful choice of food menu. staff are very pleasant and readily help explained on menu selection. my family and i had a great time at the restaurant.

Author: JooleelauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very good standard food and service
Review: Just had an early Father s day Italian dinner with my parents at Sirroco restaurant at Holiday Inn Melaka. Very pleased with the high standard of cooking : thin crusted pizza was excellent n yum. Had smoked duck salad n smoked salmom salad. Very good too.Now waiting for the molten chocolate cake . Must be yum.Definately bring my parents back here in Sept for mom s birthday.Service was very good too.Show less

Author: John M
Title: Convenient and Great Food
Review: This is the restaurant inside the Holiday Inn Melaka. Italian food and lots of options. Nice place to eat, great service, and reasonable prices.

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: Average Restaurant...
Review: Was there with my family members due to a joint promotion between Standard Chartered Credit Card and Sirocco. The atmosphere is nice....It has the open kitchen concept ie. we could see whatever the chef is doing. However, the negative part is that we would smell of food...something that is not pleasant at all.The food is ok for the price that we paid (50% off). But I would reconsider to go again due to the smell...Show less

Author: ceemohanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Nice!
Review: Have visited several times over the past few years. All trips were casual, yet quick. Drinks and bites sort of thing. Visited with The Wife on 23/4, at 1030pm. We had a sweet Nepali waitress (Tashi, I think) attend to us. There was a live band performing, not the best we've heard, but after a few beers, it didn't matter so much. A nice place to chill out, certainly worth visiting if you're staying in Holiday Inn. Show less

Author: Meanu2
Title: It's a breeze
Review: Nice room. Helpful on the ball staff. Good food especially their Sate's. A place to get a beer! We enjoyed a couple of meals in the Sirocco and were not disappointed.

Author: Odyssey554852
Title: Excellent
Review: The service was impeccable and high class. Food was good just like the price. Hotel guests pag 50% off which makes it really not an expensive dining

Author: Ronald_DassMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Awesome food and services
Review: Tried Sirocco food twice in the month of Feb. Once is during my company dinner in which my colleagues and I anonymously agreed that the dishes served that night was up to expectation. So much so that i had to bring my wife to Sirocco Restaurant to check out their Ala carte dishes. We were fortunate to have met up with The F&B head, Mr Suresh who recommended us some of their best dishes. Selection was plenty and my wife and I enjoyed the dishes we ordered. From starters, mains to dessert we were thoroughly please with the quality and taste. I must say it's one of the best Italian food you can find in Melaka. So if you're looking for a good Italian food, you can consider Sirocco. I was told that there is an on going promotion of 50% on Some of the ala carte dishes now. Will be brining my family for a treat end of this month, would love to try their pizza this time.Show less

Author: Alicia_DassMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Sirocco Valentines Day package
Review: Hubby and I tried their Valentines Day package and was impressed with their 4 course Italian menu. My main course was a cod fish and it was buttery soft and fresh. My hubby opt for beef fillet and it was cooked to perfection. Prior to my booking, i requested for a complimentary coffee and hot chocolate for after meal in which they happily obliged. So that was really nice. One of the extra perks was that they had a lucky draw and my parents whom I brought along as well, won a free night stay at Holiday Inn, Singapore! Would definitely consider Sirocco Valentine Day package next year. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: ExpatKL88Western Ireland, Ireland
Title: Entertaining!
Review: Spotted Sirocco on a visit to the Holiday Inn the day before, as we fancied an Italian dinner as an option to other venues we returned the next night to try it.Glad we did as the food was really good, pizza was spot on as was the chicken with tomato and veg....side of fries really good. House wine was pretty good too and reasonably priced for a glass..entertainment part was Jamal who served us. Great guy and service, had a real laugh over our use of the menu Italian, a great asset here.Only thing that lets the place down is the lack of imagination with the decor and lighting, i would have scored higher but it is lit up like an aircraft hangar...open kitchen concept works well though and good to see the chef and his brigade workingShow less

Author: Jeff_Ong89
Title: Terrible
Review: when I arrived with my parents, we were only the 2nd customer. They took about 2 to 3 minutes to even pass me the menu. They had only 2 waiters and 3 kitchen staff(inclusive of chef). Despite already being short handed, their waiter portrayed a horrendous knowledge of Italian cuisine / his own menu. I.e. 1. I asked the size of the pizza - he told me it is 30 by 16 centimeters (I didn't know pizzas are rectangular in shape?) 2. I asked what's the base of one of their pizza (tomato or cream)? He could not even answer my question and diverted me to take a different pizza.3. I asked him how many scallops are given in the appetizer - he could not answer and made reference to something else. 4. After having the bread, didn't even change our plates to the proper plates for us to use for our mains. 5. Took me like 5 minutes just to get their attention to get some chilli flakes for the pizza. 6. Served one of my main dish which was cod fish but when he served it, he asked who's salmon is it? (How the heck can you mix up a salmon and a cod???? Like seriously, this is Sirocco in Holiday Inn???) 7. I made specific instructions to bring out the appetizers first - they brought out my main first and then appetizers. 8. Did not proactively refill our drinks. The quality of food is only decent. But for a restaurant that charged a steep price by Malacca's standards - I expected a lot more in terms of service and ambience. Do not waste your hard earned money in this restaurant. Please. Show less

Author: Julie72G
Title: Love the Food and Service
Review: We love the food and the service. A must try is the Salmon and the Mushrooms. Jamal is an asset to the restaurant and he brightens up the restaurant. And if you are in house guest you get a 20% discount on the food.This is great offer and not to be missedShow less

Author: Boomer9193
Title: OUTSTANDING
Review: The good at the Sirocco in the formal dining and bar seating is 5 star, you wont go wrong when you eat here.

Author: kennperr
Title: Sirocco Lounge
Review:
Spent the evening sipping the wine with my wife a day before my cousins wedding. The music was great and enjoyed the company.

Service was great and the staffs were very polite. Please ensure you try the pizza, it was great

Author: Yasotha1971
Title: Excellent environment
Review:
The duty FB manager was so good. 
She served us so well too.
She kept on giving us warmth and comfort that everything was taken care of 
Great dining.

Author: Mini769
Title: amazing food
Review: Loved the cuisine and would love to visit again. great service, friendly staff and good choices. Once is definately not enough for this place.

Author: fifian
Title: Execellent food
Review: The food was great espeacially the lagsana and pizza's. If you a food lover, you should try this restaurant.

Author: 2mumies
Title: Ordinary
Review:
Leave the Italian to the Italians I say food was ok however, have had better.  
However I must say the service from the waiters was good

Author: AhmadSalehuddinRamly
Title: Breakfast
Review: Nice restaurant, friendly staff, varieties of food. A bit warm in the morning. Always pack with people...

Author: fizsue
Title: Awesome candle light dinner
Review: We had a great candle light dinner to celebrate our first anniversary. The decoration for our table was delightful, the foods was served perfectly and delicious.

Author: SweetsurayaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect
Review: Organize surprise 1st year wedding anniversary dinner for hubby. To my surprise staffs arrange very nice decorated table and cozy corner. Food and service is excellent. Singer from lounge sang beautiful song plus cake. Nice touch. Definitely will recommend if prefer good Italian food and service . Kudus for the staffs.Show less

Author: Zingg HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Average Western Food
Review: Sirocco serves Western Food with a touch of Italian. The Pizza oven baked was good.Salt Baked whole seabass had bones even after they are filleted. Staff are friendly andrestaurant not cosy. Deco too modern and does not give an Italian feeling. Ventilation not good.Show less

Author: Landy222Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cozy & Warm Birthday Dinner
Review: We had dined at Sirocco to celebrated my husband birthday.The staffs service are good, friendly & always keep smiling. The food average is good. The Manager's Henry has made a good arrangement for our dinner, specially set up very romantic deco table for us..We're really enjoyed our dinner here.Specially thanks to the supervisor( name of Jamal ?) singing a birthday song with his wonderful voice to my loves one. P/S :If you looking for light food taste, that's the good choice restaurant.Show less

Author: Jeyasingam RIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Excellent variety
Review: Good choices, quiet and good proactive services. The staff are very cordial, friendly and make you feel at home. Soiled dishes are removed quickly without been told. The chef cooks up an order quickly according to your flavor and instructions. Easy access and welcomed by a very smiling and courteous reception.Show less

Author: Smith123ji
Title: Excellence
Review: Authentic Italian food ands superb service from Jamal (manager?). Cozy place with decent decor. Must try if stay in Holiday Inn Melaka

Author: Wendy VSydney, Australia
Title: A Variety of Options
Review: We dined at Sirocco for dinner after a long day. My husband and I both enjoyed our meal. I had salmon and he had chicken. Both meals looked good and tasted good although there could have been more vegetables. The table looked good and the service was quick and efficient Mains were mainly RM 30 - RM 55 range. Pizzas were available as a cheaper option. They were cooked in a pizza iven and smelt good. There were a range of options for each course and quite a good wine selection. The coffee was excellent with this cool stiirrer whiich was actually sugar. The previous niight we had drinks at the bar which is beside the restaurant. There was live music and it was pleasnt. I do wish they would turn the big screen sports prrojection off though when the singer was singing.Show less

Author: Tanazawa
Title: Exceptional quality
Review:
Dined there with family of 4, service and food is excellent. Price reasonable and value for money. Try the oven wood pizza, the best so far amongst other Hotel.

Keep up the good quality and service.

Author: Christoph RRegensburg, Germany
Title: Decent Italian Food
Review: This Restaurant is a bit on the pricey side, but if you need some mediteranien food, after all the asian treats, this one is a good place to go. Its located in ground level of Malacca Holiday Inn hotel. Pizza and Salats are good quality, and they offer regularly rebates or special offers for hotel guests. Usually not full, no reservation requiredShow less

Author: BlaiseJOngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Attentive Staff and Quality Food
Review: The captain and his crew were so attentive to everyone's needs. Food quality was excellent and restaurants ambiance was nice.Show less

Author: onglaysanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Food
Review: Ordered 2 set meals for the friends and 2 Ala Carte for 2 vegetarians. The food was nicely portioned and pizza was wonderful. Pasta was great as well.Show less

Author: wolbert VAmsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Nice restaurant in a queer setting
Review: Although a big party was going on, the staff offered us a table for us. The soup and pizzas (vegetarian and seafood) were very well and the service is very friendly. The interior design is from the 1970s but life music made it a very nice experience.Show less

Author: IcebergMeltingKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Need to improve of the restaurant setting
Review: Not so fine dining environment. Pizza is good but other dishes are not that good. However, you can hardly find a good italian restaurant in melaka. Considering it, this place is ok. Don't expect much. Service is good. Really need to work on the interior of the restaurant.Show less

Author: Caswy
Title: Top notch service
Review: I made a reservation for my wedding anniversary. We are just there for dinner, however the restaurant took the hassle to specially set up a table with us. Their food is good and the service is excellent. My wife was very happy and satisfied with the arrangement. The effort by the restaurant made my wife smile the whole night. We will return again.Show less

Author: angelo cSingapore, Singapore
Title: italian
Review: excellent service and good food + reasonable price.A very special mention for Jamal for his very kind helpShow less

Author: renefishKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not what i expect from an italian restaurant
Review: I dined in this place with friends. I was served limp lettuce over marinated with the dressing...and they call it ceasars salad? When the soup came, i was stunned because it came on a very wide plate with a small hole where they stuffed it with something they called minestrone soup. It tasted like spaghetti bolognaise sauce in a really tiny cup. Next came the main course which was fish.... One miserable slice of sea bass, skin and meat was soft and quite tasteless. Dressing was pathetic and came with two pcs of brocolli....no presentation at all. Enough said that it did not come cheap. The only i liked was the bread and balsamic sauce in olive oil. I dont even want to mention dessertShow less

Author: EricOngMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Food, Good Environment, and Good Service!
Review: The title says it all! For food, you have got to try their freshly baked wood-fired oven pizza. Their spaghetti is delicious too! Don't worry if you can't read a single Italiano as you can always ask the staff for recommendation. They are very friendly too. Great place to dine, not too crowded, beautiful setups and just right for any occasions.Always check with their staff as sometimes they do have promotions and specialty of the month. Once, they even had Wine Buffet where you can drink all you want.All in all, highly recommended!Show less

Author: AndrewL196
Title: Thumps Up
Review: My fiancee and I are very impress & satisfy with the food here. We love Shaherman and Jamal so much! They are so friendly & lovely. We will be back again to Sirocco Restaurant. Definately!!

Author: Navin_and_Theen
Title: Hidden gem in melaka
Review: Brought my family for a birthday lunch. Beautiful surroundings, peaceful ambience. Very friendly people, our host made some great recommendations and painstakingly explained the specials. Food was delicious. Hearty vegetarian Indian food. Everyone left fully satisfied. Will definitely come again.

Author: ThisistomfromNZ
Title: Best restaurant in Melaka!!!
Review: Absolutely amazing Indian food as well as the best service we have had in this city. The style and selection of dishes was above our expectations, excellent taste cooked by Indian mothers for authenticity, and the owners of the restaurant chatted to us with interesting info about Malaysia and recommendations on where we should visit next. Superb food and atmosphere was a welcome reprieve from busy streets outside. Clean and stylish decor. We recommend this place very highly!Show less

Author: FishCatBadgerBarcelona
Title: Bad Experience
Review: We came here based on TripAdvisor reviews expecting tasty authentic Indian food. It also happened to be Valentines day so were hoping to have a good dining experience. But..We arrived the place was empty which was a slight concern. We therefore ordered the Paneer to start and some bottled water. We thought based on this we would order further plates.The food arrived within seconds, the smallest plate you have ever seen with a glass of water. We had said we wanted to share the starter but it came with one plate. The glass of water was sold to us as being free, they actually didn't have bottled water.The Paneer was tasteless and oily, despite claims of being healthy Ayurvedic cuisine. The staff were too busy on the phone to even care that we ordered the bill within seconds and left most the food! As for being better than food in India or like food in India. We have just been to India and this has not been our experience.We paid and left to go to another restaurant. Show less

Author: AnthonyS978Arles, France
Title: Didn’t try the food, waiter didn’t want to work
Review: This is the first time I write a bad review for a restaurant. We went there because of the nice things people said about it, and we really wanted to try the ‘Indian fusion’ but we were unlucky and it wasn’t obviously the right day to go.The waiter was on his phone on the terrace, he looked at us like he had hope we were going anywhere else, and asked us to go inside, which we did.I gave us the menu, not a lot of choices, with some ‘coming soon’ and others erased, so I asked him the difference between the 5 sets proposed. He answered that only 2 (!) were available, so we ordered one of each and two drinks. My girlfriend gave him the menu and he rolled his eyes like he was SO, SO BORED!It was too much for us, and we left right after. Honestly we’ve never felt so bad in a restaurant, and it’s a shame because it is really beautifully decorated, and we read nice reviews so the food must be good too.Show less

Author: KateM1981High Wycombe, United Kingdom
Title: Really good taste and value
Review: Popped in for a light lunch and the flavours were amazing. So cheap too, one banana leaf .Sal and a does set and two lime juices for 29r (£6) which was lucky as we were down to our last cash and they didn't take cards. Also be warned that there isn't any cutlery but eating with your hands isn't as daunting as you'd think. It's a basic little restaurant but the good and value is exceptional if you're looking for something different from Malaysian food. Show less

Author: MsTommasinoNew York
Title: Amazing Indian vegetarian restaurant!
Review: Wow! The food and service here is amazing! We spent 4 months in India and this food was as good or maybe even better than what we had in India. We had several items and each was fantastic, especially the banana leaf meal and paneer 65. A must try! Show less

Author: AdamRetterExeter, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic food and lovely people
Review: Genuinely one of the best Indian meals I have had. After living in India for four months, I had been away for a while and really fancied some South Indian fare. S Sihat Kafe didin't disappoint and was excellent, and honestly better than a lot of the food I had in India.The staff and cooks were super friendly too :-)Will be returning there soon!Show less

Author: YaseLisaWellington, New Zealand
Title: So tasty food, beautiful interior and friendly people!
Review: Absolut delicious tasty food!We had the bryiani set with different veggies, currys, a little cup soup and dessert. And came with a crunchy bread and tasty rice! It was just 15myr! As a side dish we tried the tofu and it was lovely! So many different flavours and to know there are no nastys like white sugar, white flour...gives you a good feeling!After our meal we even got a free 8 minutes neck and shoulder massage. Because the restaurant and massage place is owned by a lovely woman. Show less

Author: 399srin
Title: Good to try
Review: Brew coffee and masala tea was extremely superb. Their thosai set and gravies are extremely good too. Don’t miss the chance when ur there.

Author: Sadie K
Title: Cozy, healthy place in Jonker's busteling street.
Review:
What a  lovely, peaceful environment and healthy food is an added bonus.
Ancient chants in the background coupled with excellent  food cooked to perfection. 
Great customer service and very affordable yet delicious food..
definitely will visit every time I am in Melaka.

Author: Sunshine827832
Title: Good place to start your day.
Review: Dropped by here for breakfast, without any clue of the place. Surprisingly it was great. My friend tried the Gula Melaka Tosai, we was good indeed. As he don’t prefer too much of sour, this tosai really made his day. Overall their place has a harmony presence to enlighten your day. Cheers from Penangite.Show less

Author: Curious822096
Title: Best food ever
Review:
Amazing place good vibe good service and awesome food.the chutney was the best I've eaten in Malaysia.
-Mehul

Author: Companion818505
Title: Great experience!
Review: I have had one of my best time in this fabulous restaurant, where food and health are growing up together to make some delicious flavours on the banana lief. The experience of food was extremely delighted but it was even more with the meeting of a great human being, the owner of this restaurant. He is friendly, attached to defend the natural food and is passionate about all his way of living, seeing life etc... you can have a great time talking to him. Can’t wait to come back one day, for this experience of food and the Indian massage linked with the restaurant just next door. Show less

Author: SparkzJordanLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Healthy Indian food and a nice escape from busy Jonker Street!!
Review: Amazing healthy Indian food prepared with no white poisons at a very reasonable price. Located at the start of Jonker street, a nice extremely clean restaurant set back away from the noise and the busy road. I had the Ssihat Biryani set which came with a variety of sauces and vegetables to try and the rice was topped with 3 different vegetarian curries which all had outstanding flavour. A must visit for any vegetarian visiting Melaka!!Show less

Author: Angeline S
Title: Healthy...but most importantly delicious home cooked food!
Review: I would recommend this restaurant to everyone. The ambiance is a welcome distraction to the chaos outside.We had the idly and healthy dosa set. Honestly it was not only delicious but of high quality yet simple ingredients.The vadei made me want more and the coffee was yummy.I wish i had a bigger appitite ...would have had more.Both our sets cost RM 10 each.To bad we didn't take photos of our meal...was too hungry :)Have a chat with the gentleman who owns the place...it's an experience by itself.A must visit!Show less

Author: Theresa S
Title: Best food in Melacca!
Review:
Best food we had in Melacca, the Banana Leaf Meal is amazing! 13$ for a great indian meal in a neat and cozy atmosphere. The dessert was super. 
Very tidy and clean.

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Relaxing refuge with amazing food
Review: Weekends in Melaka are manic as holidaymakers descend on this town which is just a few hours drive from both KL and Singapore. As the streets fill with cars, buses and pedestrians you think there will be nowhere to go to escape the crowds. However this restaurant provides a tranquil refuge from the hustle and bustle of the outside world.Past the front counter and behind a curtain there is a beautifully decorated and peaceful space that is nicely cooled by the breeze of a number of ceiling fans. The owner is passionate about good quality, nourishing food that is made with love. He eschews the three poisons of modern food, being white sugar, white salt and white flour and instead uses alternatives that are wholesome and healing for the body. The food is vegetarian and is so good that you do not notice the absence of meat. For the dedicated carnivores, there are meat substitutes that are so similar to the animal based alternative that you can’t tell the difference. The food is full flavoured and full of texture and colour. We had the dosai set which was 10 ringgit and came with a variety of condiments as well as a small drink. We chose the masala tea, which was rich and flavourful. The owner was so enthusiastic about his food that he kept giving us extra things to try and everything he gave us was scrumptious.Double filtered water is provided at no additional charge.This restaurant was unique and a pleasant surprise for us. It has been our favourite dining experience in Melaka so far.Show less

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Different Indian Cuisine
Review: This eatery provide significant kind of Indian pure vegetarian food which slightly more choices and better than typical non-vegetarian Indian restaurant which offers vegetarian food. A Malay girl was the wiatress offer and explained to us types of food serves here as well as the Ayurvedic package treatment. Something unusual and we'd like it. The variety of dishes was good but the only letdown was the temperature which is lukewarm. For an ordinary Malaysian, banana leaf for 2 person obviously can't expect less than RM30 but I've expected more than the unimaginable price though located at Jonker Walk which is busy for tourist spot. I will come here again for breakfast which was recommended by the Malay girl.Show less

Author: Sproble
Title: Lovely food at a great price
Review: Ate here several times during my stay in Melaka. The menu is simple but the food is delicious and comes out quickly. Definitely worth a try. Staff were great too which is always nice.

Author: doraemongerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quiet
Review: Restaurant was quiet when we went for dinner. The vegetables given wasn't really what we usually had like spinach, cabbage or carrots. Was given pumpkin, lady fingers instead. Curry was more on the sour type instead of the usual spicy. Add on fish and chicken. Both tasted good. Staffs are friendly but perhaps it was quite different from the type of banana leaf rice we had so most likely won't return.Show less

Author: Belle666
Title: Beautiful and interesting food
Review: Loved this place, the food was amazing and it was a really cool experience to eat off a banana leaf! One of our favourite restaurants in Melaka. Also, its incredibly cheap!

Author: BarrancosGuaraMadrid, Spain
Title: The best restaurant in Melaka
Review: The best vegetarian restaurant in Melaka!Very healthy food, you could feel they use the very best ingredients of good quality, avoiding the use of refined products like white flour, white salt and white sugar.All the dishes are very tasty, healthy and delicious. Especially the banana leaf.Quantities are perfect. Prices are very cheap. also the breakfast is worth it to try, with the cool honey lemon with basil seeds.The service is very personal and friendly.We had dinner and breakfast four consecutive days.We totally recommend it. We'll come back there.Show less

Author: Andre GNew Zealand
Title: Delightfully Different Dining Experience
Review: I signed up to TripAdvisor just to review this place as I was that impressed.The location is super convenient in the heart of Jonker Street. The owner seems like a really nice guy, and the service was quick and attentive.The food is amazing, delicious and healthy. The premises are clean and you can see in to the kitchen as the food is prepared out front.The price is absurdly low - we paid 40 ringit for 2 x vegetarian banana leaf meals, 2 x fresh orange juices, and a delicious starter. That's something like USD$5 each, or $7NZD each.Will definitely be going back and highly recommend everybody give this place a go.Show less

Author: nickdI1361CZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unassuming yet first class
Review: Stumbled across this restaurant a few days ago and have just paid a second visit. Had the toseh set which was freshly made with three excellent chutneys. The set included a masala tea or similar all for the princely sum of M$10. For taste it compares well with the better Indian Vegetarian restaurants found in Serangoon Rd in Singapore. Don’t miss this culinary delight!Show less

Author: 640camiller
Title: Healthiest Indian food I’ve ever had!
Review:
And it’s absolutely tasty, too!  The masala chai is fantastically made, with unpasteurized milk and served piping hot.  

The owner was also very charming.  Definitely worth visiting!

Author: Bryan H
Title: Healthy, fresh food!
Review:
Cheap prices. Humorous, well-meaning staff. Food that gives you energy, doesn't make you feel lethargic. Easy to get to location. Open on Wednesday night when countless other restaurants were closed. Enjoyed our time there!

Warning: Their menu is very limited -- if that bothers you.

Author: hazelw726
Title: Amazing and authentic
Review: Great banana leaf meal in a very clean environment!! Several vegetarian curries with a huge portion of rice, so great value for money!

Author: admutum
Title: Tasty banana leaf meal
Review: Really tasty Indian banana leaf meal. We were really hungry and have to say ate a bit too much. Lots of different vegetarian dishes. My wife ordered a chicken side dish as well. The drinks were lovely as well. Food was served quite fast and was reasonably priced. My son who has autism was not very happy with the music they played but they turned it down on our request. Will definitely visit again. Show less

Author: srikanth07Singapore, Singapore
Title: Healthy and Authentic Indian food!
Review: We loved the food at Ssihat Kafe - the food is healthy and tasty too! We had the Thosai and vada meal, as well as their banana leaf biryani meal - absolutely yummy! There is no white salt, sugar, flour or artificial colouring in their food - you can enjoy the authentic flavours of Indian dishes. In addition to the great food, their staff is extremely warm and hospitable. Ssihat Kafe is yet another example that food can be healthy and tasty at the same time!Show less

Author: ShaMohaideen
Title: Authentic banana leaf meals
Review: Excellent quality food - no white sugar, salt, flour. All natural and fresh. Outstanding service and natural ambience. We truly enjoyed 3 days of meals at sihat cafe!

Author: pegasus1501Gothenburg, Sweden
Title: Love Ssihat!
Review: My first contact with the SSihat Samkkya family was the Ayurvedic massage I had with ‘Shiny’ and she was marvelous! Hot coconut oil rubbed and massaged into my head and body - I felt so good afterwards. The next day, we went to have banana leaf lunch at the restaurant located just next door. The food was delicious - so rich in taste. You can see that there is a passion that goes into sourcing the most healthy ingredients and cooking them with care.The next day we went back for a thosai breakfast - the chutneys were amazing -not just coconut but cashew nuts are used to make them. I also had a beetroot concoction that has no additives- just fruit. A good detox after all the meals I’d been having! I will definitely go back again - not just for the food (which by the way is priced so reasonably) but also for the cheerful and friendly smiles. Kudos to the management and staff. Thank you for the warmth and hospitality. Show less

Author: Aisyah S
Title: Restaurant That Promotes Healthy Melakan Indian Food.
Review: Happened to come across this place in Jonker Street at 8.15am in the morning. The tosai breakfast set was delicious, served with threee different chutneys - mint, coconut and tomato. Enjoyed the vadi and masala tea,too. The restaurant menu states: "Our food does not contain any of this: white sugar, white salt, white flour, artificial flavouring and any food colouring," Chatted with the boss Arial, a pleasant lady, who obviously has a passion for cooking. The restaurant setting is simple yet pleasant and clean. Due to the lack of time on my side, I was unable to savour their banana leaf lunch. They are also open for dinner. Will definitely visit this restaurant when I am ever back in Melaka. Show less

Author: 931jannienAlbany, Australia
Title: Healthy choice, but don’t let that ruin your visit!
Review: Travelling in Asia there is a tendency to over do the chicken and rice or Nasi Goreng. You eat it with a ‘what came with that’ in the back of you mind. Or at least I do, as I wonder just how many chickens have been eaten in this city today - where do they all come from?At Ssihat Kafe you don’t need to worry. They use all natural ingredients, locally sourced, no chemicals. They never said ‘organic’, but maybe that catch phrase hasn’t got to Malacca yet! If you order chicken, it’s a village chicken, not one raised on a feed lot fed hormones and antibiotics.Their food is fabulous! Spicy but not chilli, the textures and flavours are well matched. Eating here blends all the senses, and if you choose to eat with your fingers (I recommend it!) the delicious aromas last for hours longer!They are a healthy, gluten free, MSG free, Delight! I highly recommend this restaurant, be brave and be the first in your group to enter the premises it is heaven for you stomachs, and maybe your soul as well!Show less

Author: Marie F
Title: Best experience in Malaysia
Review: I had a wonderful time in Jay's reflexology place and Restaurant. The massage was Great. The conversation insightful and the food délicious. I would recommend this place and These People 100% !

Author: Hendrik BHeidelberg, Germany
Title: Great concept, great food
Review: We like the concept of the place - healthy food on one side , Ayurvedic massages on the other side ( don't worry that you get a massage from a men, some of them are blind). We tried both an can highly recommend S Sihat Kafe. Show less

Author: janaprevidiSanta Cruz do Sul, RS
Title: Amazing!
Review: First, the owner and the staff are super friendly!The restaurant is beautiful, very clean and cozy.The food is delicious and cheap. For MYR 10 you have a set of meal plus cold or hot drink.They only cook with selected ingredients, everyrhing is fresh, without artificial flavors, no chemicals.Try the lemonade with honey, is so good!Just the best one!Show less

Author: JeyT19
Title: The Most Sihat yet Delicious Banana Leaf Meal in Melaka.
Review: The S Sihat Kafe is by far the most health conscious indian restaurant in Melaka. All dishes are cooked using the finest of ingredients fine tuned to perfection by a team of indian housewives cooking with love ❤️ and attention to detail.A Must Try for all indian cooking lovers.The Standards are set high in this wonderful calming place to have a fulfilling meal alone or with your loved ones.Show less

Author: skymarconatoQueenstown, New Zealand
Title: Great service and delicious food!
Review: This was the best indian restaurant I tried in my life.They have a set meal on a banana leaf that is amazing. It is vegetarian, but if you want to have meat you can order on the side.The decoration and ambience was cozy and relaxing, and eating the food with you hands is a great experience.The staff is very welcoming and polite, and next door there is an Ayurvedic massage.You should definitely try it if you are in Melaka!Show less

Author: travel2findoneself
Title: Healthy, delicious, and reasonable Indian food
Review:
Delicious, healthy vegetarian food on a banana leaf...juices with no water or sugar and an Ayurvedic massage place next door...
Try the thali with several different dishes

Author: Cvapoorani L
Title: Yummylicious Indian Food
Review: We have tried Indian vegetarian food.Food served in banana leaf. The taste bringing the essence of Malayalee food. The food banana leaf platter comes with 8 dishes including sambar. Buttermilk, papadam, rasam and payasam also provided along the dish. Healthy and colourful meals.. Worth the price.Happy treats for our tummy :)Show less

Author: Departure02158618173
Title: Big No

Author: JulianChow

Review: Think this place is better than the other touristy place, you don’t have queue and wait so long. And this better more choices. Funny there’s a sibling rivalry next door which can confuse customers

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Local Cuisine
Review: Special steambot in Melaka which used satay source as the soup. All material is prepared in satay style. A bit expensive

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fading away
Review: atay celup, which literally means satay dip, can be found across Melaka and is similar to satay as the ingredients are skewered on sticks and dipped into a boiling pot of hot satay peanut gravy. One key difference though – satay celup has way more delicious and awesome variety such as enoki mushrooms wrapped in ham, crab sticks, cockles, fish balls, sausages and prawns.One of the oldest and most original satay celup restaurant Restoran Ban Lee Siang can inevitably be “overrun with tourists” at times, but it’s still a big hit with many locals too. Having seen it at its very best in my younger days, it was disappointing to have an average meal.It is a shadow of its former self. I kid you not. This is the true truth as I say it as it is…Show less

Author: Anson LPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Lok Lok with Satay Sauce
Review: There is a lot of choices and the sauce was very nice. The place was crystal clear but it was very crowded since it is famous in Malacca. When you celup the lok lok into the satay sauce, you would feel it is amazing and unbelievable combination in your life. The staffs are very friendly and it is a reasonable price for customers.Show less

Author: senfaaaMalaysia
Title: A classic hot pot in Melaka
Review: Various food ingredients could be found at this place, and the sauce was good.The senior waiter taught us to scooped some of the peanuts at the bottom of the pot, and it was tasty!Overall, it is worth visiting the restaurant, especially when it is your first time to Melaka.Show less

Author: Shereen Y
Title: One of the best in Melaka town.
Review: The place is clean with lots of choices. But try to be early (before 6:30pm) before the crowd arrives as parking will be a problem and they have limited sitting capacity.

Author: sham1123
Title: Tasty satay
Review: We have lots of choices to choose..Place was clean  and hygiene but crowded..The satay celup taste awesome n the gravy was hot n superb taste..The staff very friendly..Price was very reasonable..

Author: Tyanna2911
Title: The soup is delicious!
Review: Overall of the food is great but the place is always full house . If you are a bit late then need to queue up and waiting for the table available.

Author: bigboy61455xxx
Title: 5 stars for experience
Review: This satay place is different compared to other satay place because instead of grilling meat, you dip everything in boiling peanut sauce at the center like hotpot. It is self service and you go and grab various meats, seafood or vegetable on the stick. So basically you pay for what you eat (owner will come and count all sticks) at the end of your meal.So I guess it is even healthier than already decent grilled satay - because there is no charred carcinogens on your food). But it is a bit of learning process; how quickly your food will be edible after dipping in boiling peanut sauce. I would say, food is 4 stars but it is unique in Melaka Chinese tradition, so just do it. There could be halal (Muslim friendly) places like this minus pork in Melaka as we have no pork steamboat all across Malaysia.Show less

Author: EugeneH1963
Title: Leisurely dinner
Review: Food quality had deteriorated, food items are getting lesser each time. place less busier now and sauce more diluted.

Author: M9C8
Title: Satay celup

There are two satay celup shops beside each other and my friend who is a local recommended this one.

The peanut sauce was delicious and service was decent

Author: DeathsDragon95Hinckley, United Kingdom
Title: Ok
Review: There are two restaurants with the same name close together if not next to each other which one is the original one and the other isn't which you need to ask a local to find out.The place was very busy when we got there but we managed to get a table next to the footpath. There is a heated dish of peanut sauce in the middle of the table which is a bit spicy especially the top oil if you don't mix it as most of it sits at the bottom of the bowl. It can get hot under the table due to the fire boiling the sauce but depends on where you sit on the table maybe. The food is all on skewers in fridges which you just get a tray and put on the different skewers and take back to your table and put them in the peanut sauce to cook. The skewers are fish, seafood, meat and vegetables etc and the amount you pay is based on how many skewers you have. The food is ok and quite nice, the sauce doesn't have a strong taste of peanut which was disappointing but is slightly spicy. Some of the food was better than others. Overall the place seemed clean, the staff were ok, not sure how hygienic the sauce is as not sure that they change it after each table finished. It can get busy here so you might have to wait for a table.Show less

Author: siokjinKajang, Malaysia
Title: twas alright, good location but go early to beat the crowd

Author: wallawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Finally tried it after so many years!
Review: Been to Melaka for the past 10 years plus but first time trying this. Always hated the crowd but past by the restaurant and there was some empty tables so decided to try.First the satay sauce took quite a while to heat/boil so can slowly choose what you want to eat. Many variety to choose from so should have something for everyone.Once the sauce is boiling they will constantly come and help you stir it (to prevent it from getting burnt at the bottom). The sauce is just nice, not too hot for children, but need more peanuts.Just remember to watch how many sticks you have taken as the number can add up very fast when you are enjoying the food. Author: Junmingtan1Singapore, Singapore
Title: Unique and memorable
Review: First of all, wouldn’t recommended this place to those who are saliva conscious. If you are not, then this place is a must-try for you. The sauce is cooked on a recycling basis hence very flavourful and aromatic. That means sauce is added every time it is finishing up and it will not be change from a new cooking pot. You simply choose the food that you want from the fridges on which food do you want to eat, e.g Quail Egg, Sausage and Meatball etc... Foods are all on the stick hence easier for you to dip into the sauce and cook it. Have been eating this since young and absolutely love it since i am from Malacca. Ban Lee Siang is the only good Satay Celup place in Malacca if you ask me and you should definitely try this once in your lifetime. Show less

Author: Ipchloe
Title: Average food

Author: dizzystar1Suzhou, China

Author: elenatG5666SOSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overhyped
Review: We hired a chauffeur-drive car, Alex, to take us on this road trip and Malacca is one of our stops. Title: My family favourite 👍🏻❤️😋🤤 satay celup place in Malacca

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing like Satay Celup for a late night snack after drinks
Review: Following our session at Me and Mrs Jones cafe we decided to stop over for a Satay Celup at Ban Lee Siang. Normally satay is skewered meat barbecued on a grill. The meats are normally beef, lamb, pork or chicken. The name Satay is derived from the Chinese dialect Sah Teh meaning three pieces of meat. Celup means dipped. So it is a kind of Fondue like dish, where the sticks of meat or other food stuff are dipped into the peanut sauce. The sauce is spicy, sweet and slightly salty.Satay Celup (the last word pronounced Chelup as in the malay spelling 'h' is inherent after the C but never written, hence the joke that Coca Cola should be pronounced Chola Chola.The problem with this place is that there are two Ban Lee Siang next to each other, due to a family quarrel they split and are side by side, I was at the one on the right. Various signs in chinese within the shop tells about the sauce being original from that shop.There are sometimes only one piece, not three pieces, of meat or fish ball per stick. Charges are per stick. Basically there is a bowl of boiling spicy peanut sauce per table that one dips the satay in to cook. I do not know if the unfinished sauces are collected and served again. Many locals love the cockles but do eat it with caution by making sure it is cooked well, as cockles are found normally in mud and known to carry the Hepatitis virus or bacteria that could result in serious food poisoning. The meats are accompanied with bread and cucumber that is soaked with the gravy. Workers will go to the individual table to refill and stir the peanut sauce otherwise the sauce near the bottom will burn and stick to the bottom of the pot and this will result in a burnt taste in the sauce.Get there by car, Grab or Taxi. It can be pretty crowded as it was on the night we were at the shop.Show less

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Great to Enjoy Satay Celup Again
Review: After a lapse of about thirty years, it was great to enjoy a Satay Celup meal in Melaka. Satay Celup is enjoyed by dipping the sticks of seafood or meat into a boiling pot of satay sauce with extra dash of ground nut powder in the steamboat.The outlet we went to is in Jalan Ong Kim Swee where all three well known places are run by the same people. The place where we had our meal was at 53C along the same road.The place was three quarter full when we arrived at 7.00 pm and it looked neat and clean. The various food items were clearly displayed in four large supermarket style fridges with glass door paneling. The selection was pretty wide with various seafood items, quail's egg, meat slices etc, etc. The prices were reasonable and the owners knew how much we had taken by the sticks.........the number of sticks and the lengthof the sticks.Throughout the meal there was attentive service and overall our party of five had a jolly good meal in pleasant surroundings. Will visit that place again on our next visit to Melaka.Show less
