Review: The lotus leaf rice, chicken glutinous rice, big Pau and liusha Pau were my favourite. Dim sum are served in 2s or 3s. Har-gow and Siew Mai are average. Chicken feet and pork ribs are good.I love the environment, a very traditional old style chinese setting, reliving my childhood memory of having breakfast at a warm coffeeshop. It doesn't serve cold drinks, only hot drinks. Lotus leaf rice was sold out by 9.45am.Show less

Author: ChloeY236
Title: Cheap eats with good service
Review: It's one of the oldest dim sum places in Malacca but food is really average.  Service is great though and the atmosphere of eating dim sum is great!

Author: tmeidyanaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: The highlight is the buns!!
Review: The charsiu bun tastes very delicious. You have to practice a bit mandarin here since the servers only speak mandarin. Don't worry, you just have to take a seat and order for the buns and drink (only hot drink served btw), then a server will come with a large tray with lots of dimsum choices. Try their baikut!!Show less

Author: minchangBrisbane, Australia
Title: A traditional brunch
Review: The place serves dimsum (or timsum) in a traditional way. For me the baozi is the best However the dimsum is not served hot enough. Overall the brunch was ok. However what interests me is the way local people gather and enjoy brekkie over Chinese tea. Show less

Author: 34pangse
Title: Dim Sum breakfast
Review: Long queue before we could get a seat. Simple and traditional dim sum breakfast.  Variety of choice of dim sum. But it is warm inside the shop.  Go for the tao bao. Nice and big.  😊😊

Author: Chean Wei L
Title: Average taste and service
Review: The dim sum is okay and not really surprising. The tauke is a somehow bad-tempered and not really served us well but he is just trying his best to control the whole messy and almost-out-of-control-situation as it was quite crowded the morning my friends and I paid our visit. The paus sold out fast so we couldn't really taste them!Show less

Author: joey_7687
Title: So so
Review:
Very sad to say that the taste was so so
Don't think will return again 
However,not all were lost,the service was quick good

Author: CheeY TSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice dim sum place, very reasonable prices
Review: A nice family restaurant frequented by locals and tourists.We arrived around 930am and a nice variety of usual dim sum was still available.The porridge is worth trying too.Place is clean. Service is good.Parking is an issued and enforcement is quite rigid.If you looking for some decent dim sum at very affordable pricing, this is the place.For those who complain about serving portions, I think they would be challenged to find it elsewhere at these kind of prices.Show less

Author: debs_ngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So-so dim sum.
Review: After reading the reviews here, my fiancé and I decided to try out the food. When we arrived, we were told that some dishes were already sold out but we were fine with that. We ordered the loh mai kai and a few plates of steamed dim sum. Sad to say that the portions were really small and the taste was so-so. We will not be heading back again as it is not value for money at all. Show less

Author: doraemongerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Acceptable
Review: Been wanting to try this for a long time and finally got to try it during this trip. I think it's overrated. Some are fresh but some tasted like made from factory. The porridge texture is not very sticky but kind of watery. The pork belly bun, I tasted more of the fats than the meat so it was extremely greasy. How they calculate the price will be unknown since all the metal plates they used are exactly the same but yet different price. Tried it once will be enough.Show less

Author: PhoebeL865
Title: Reasonable Price and OK Dim Sum
Review: OK Dim Sum with a little warm atmosphere. The little boss was helpful. His staffs did not add in milk for the tea, he fixed it and then make sure my father-in-law tasted it, ok with it then only he leave our table. Quite a lovely service.Show less

Author: Daina MAsia
Title: THE PLACE to enjoy some proper and fresh dim-sum
Review: Everybody goes there in the morning until the dim-sums are finished - they are not open at all in the afternoon.Very fast service, and the food is always fresh.It is no fancy restaurant at all, but who needs fancy,when it is the authentic stuff you get?The people working there are also very nice, they explain what you need to know even if they are running around to serve everybody.I at least, am now officially really hooked on dim-sum.Show less

Author: KC_Sy
Title: Local Dim Sum
Review: Stumbled onto it for a snack. It is just one street away from Jonker and patronised by locals so it can't go wrong, I reckon. Indeed, it was a pleasant Dim Sum meal.

Author: VeleneTanWaihi, New Zealand
Title: Best dim sum for its price
Review: Arrived at 10am thinking there would be a long queue but we got our seats pretty quick. We sat on a table which we shared with another family. Drinks were quickly ordered and served. I really like their quick services as boss knows it's hot to wait outside. I have had the best lo mai kai here! Siu mai and bao are the top dishes ordered! Char siu bao was sold out at 10.30!! That shows how nice their bao was!! I think there price were very reasonable for its quality. Definitely a place for good dim sum. Show less

Author: yisiewtSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food testing
Review: Arrived at 10am . Crowded but wait wasn't long as boss assigned place to sit quite fast . Dim sum all quite nice . Food mostly salty . Lor mai Kai very nice . The buns are a bit disappointing , skin is thick . Salted egg yolk nice but not hot enough . Show less

Author: raullim7
Title: fairly average
Review: nothing fanciful.. long q etc but not worth the wait.. har gow skin is not soft and the dim sum actually wasnt hot.. the only think that caught my attention is the price, not any particular food..

Author: ZacharyMarret
Title: Excellent dim sum, very fast service
Review: Came here for breakfast on the recommendation of my guidebook and was not disapointed. Delicious dim sum, served very quickly and also very cheap. Great fast meal. Will eat there again if I go back to Melaka.

Author: AnfieldYNWA
Title: Not Too Bad!!!!
Review: Visited with wife and friends in the morning. Food not too bad and price seem fine, considering that it is in tourist area.

Author: SohH62
Title: Quite disappointed
Review: We were there early as we are worried that some of the food may be sold out. However, to our disappointment there are certainty dishes which we would like to have were not available due to they are not open on the next day, thus they did not want to prepare these dishes as they can't be kept. Some of the dishes were also not nice, especially the carrot cake, which seems to be left over night as the skin was very hard.However, not all were lost, the service was quite good and the glutinous rice was very nice.Show less

Author: choihoweboonPenang
Title: Slightly Above Average Dim Sum
Review: Being a Penangites myself, I would rate the dim sum in this restaurant at average only. But I believe it is one of the bests in Malacca. For foreigners, I would say it's good enough. But it's one convenient restaurant located very very near to Jonker Walk which is the main tourist attraction in Malacca. Price is ok.....not expensive.Show less

Author: eyecsayNew York City, New York
Title: Fluffy Goodness, Those Buns
Review: Choose a large or small pork filled bun, a drink from the drink person and dim sum, should you want, from another person who brings a tray around. I ate one large pork bun with coffee. As it was my first bun ever, i didn't know that one rolls the bun over and removes the paper before starting. A friendly couple at the next table helped me out with technique issues. Chopsticks in hand I split the bun open and juice and meat tumbled out. It was plentiful, juicy and flavorful like pulled pork bbq.  The restaurant has a lovely old interior. It's pleasant to just sit in there and look out. You could just have coffee. The shop has been passed through several generations.It's good, cheap and friendly. Yes. Go there.Show less

Author: Kk Y
Title: Food is Nice and price is Cheap
Review:
The service and food are Good. 

Just some tips. 
You need to go early to get the choice of food. If you go late some of the food will finish, but I not sure they will make it afterward or not.

Author: uncle_sim123
Title: One of the Best Dim Sum in Malacca
Review: Nearby Jonker Street. Dim Sum in small portion (2 pcs). So can try more dishes. Waiter will bring Dim Sum to your table for you to choose. Most Dim Sum are nice. Price for 4 person around rm$50.

Author: grumpychow2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place for breakfast
Review: Good place to have breakfast. Great variety of dim sum from steam, fried, buns n congee. Very old-school something not found in Singapore. Go early n pace yourself. Order eat n order again. Order too many dishes n you will feel overwhelmed. Take your time don't feel harassed by everyone n all hustle n bustle. Not too many of these restaurants left. Remember come early but not on Tuesday as they are closed. Show less

Author: 552WendyH552
Title: Locales only
Review: Wow, what a treat. Really good food, just don't be greedy, take a little at a time otherwise it will get cold. Watch for the cars pulling up for takeaways.

Author: samanthas792Singapore, Singapore
Title: experience nostalgic dim sum ambience
Review: This place is meant for non locals to experience nostalgic dim sum ambience and have a try on local dim sum taste. As a Malaysian, the taste of the dim sum is just so so. Nothing to shout about. Salted egg bun is Stew chicken feet Read abt signature items: big pau, glutinous rice, porridge. However it was sold out. Go as early 6-9am to catch the stock. Show less

Author: Iloveiloilo7iloilo
Title: Teahouse ambiance best at break of dawn
Review: I didn't know that this resto is on the tourist trail because its right in front of the mosque and on a populart street in Malacca. Very few visitors were up at the break of dawn. The flourescent lights at Long Yow Mah were still aglow when i walked in to have breakfast. I liked the fact that the locals were here going about their business--that is , having their early morning tea and dimsum in the company of friends. That for me is good reason to linger in such a traditional setting. I also enjoyed observing the coffee and tea corner with its interesting stock of various teas, teapots, teacups and even big Milo Tin cans. i think i was made to choose from two sets of dimsum--the first tray looked Indian-inspired, like servings of okra. The second, familiar chinese dumplings. Show less

Author: Yan E
Title: No manner
Review: WORST attitude so far i have seen, when the food come they just THROW to the table, they can scold the customer just with no reason

Author: JesA51
Title: Dim Sum breakfast
Review: Limited varieties, dim sum served was cold. using lipton tea bag and instant coffee tea bag. We asked for less sugar, they totally omitted the sugar. RM3 for a mouth of bun, really very very small. Place looks dirty. Over over rated. Macdonald breakfast would have been a BETTER choice.Show less

Author: alfredfangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dim sum breakfast
Review: We went quite early at 9am on a Monday, and it was already quite full. The dim sum items are not bad for the affordable price range. There's no menu here, and the wait staff will carry trays of food items for you to choose from. Tea is self-refillable too. It's a no-frill place for good dim sum if you're in the mood. Show less

Author: Brandon C
Title: Nice ambience. Food so-so. Great experience for tourists.
Review: The settings for this dim sum restaurant would be a real eye opener for someone who don't get much opportunity to dine in a near traditional dim sum set up. Round tables dot the inside with huge wooden hand crafted plaques line the walls. The tiles and open air (non-aircon) adds to the nostalgic feel of the past. Waiters moved around with trays of dim sums for your picking and are able to answer in English when asked about what each dish is about. For someone who is pretty into dim sum, there's only the steamed stuff here (except chee cheong fun). Don't expect any of the usual fried dim sum items here. Variety is limited.Overall, go for the experience (if you are looking for one) but not a place for seasoned dim sum-mers.Show less

Author: youke_worldwideSingapore
Title: Dim sum breakfast
Review: So the whole Jonker Area is empty except for this place. Bustling business and there was a queue to get in - and the turnover rate was very fast. They are famous for their big Bun's and by 8.30am there were no more. They also have their dim sum. The big bun was good but a bit salty. I liked their porridge and my partner liked their chicken glutinous rice. Their other dim sum I found to be so-so. Show less

Author: Joop000Singapore, Singapore
Title: Skip it!
Review: Went there this morning for bfast because it was listed as one of THE places to eat. Q wasn't that long BUT food was cold! How could dim sum be cold when it just comes out of the kitchen. Have had better. Would skip it and go elsewhere. Show less

Author: JackFKWKuala Lumpur
Title: Great taste of Dim Sum comes with a surprising price.
Review: This Chinese Dim Sum restaurant located just right opposite Masjid Kampung Kling(Kampung means village in Malay, Kling Village Mosque) at Jalan Tukang emas(please refer my photo on this street sign).The ambient is nice and traditional, old heritage shop comes with good aroma of dim sum, pau and Chinese tea. We reached at around 10:30am and the shop is crowded with patrons, however it's still consider fast for us to have a table for 5.Must try their Big Pau(da bao), which the size is same as ordinary pau in KL, the lotus leaf rice, lo mai kai(glutinous rice with chicken) and personally I love their lau sar pau(golden custard bun which the custard sauce is flowing out like lava from volcano) and the gee ma jou(fried sesame ball) with amazing tasty peanut filling.As a conclusion, it was a good place to start your engine(your stomach) going but due to lacking of parking space, after we finished the breakfast, my car got the saman(summon ticket) for RM100, despite the breakfast price is relatively low compare to Klang Valley.Show less

Author: JoeyJoe91
Title: Lots of choices for dim sum
Review: Had breakfast here on saturday morning.. lots of choices of dim sum here.. price is average.. very fast service and friendly staff .. the pau is a little bit small but overall is good..

Author: carine3366
Title: Food is average taste
Review: We were here quite early and most of the shops are not open yet. Hence, we decided to try the dim sum. The shop is quite clean. The food is average taste but it's quite reasonable

Author: Raymond L
Title: Good Tim sum place
Review: Stayed nearby at River Song and took a short stroll to the restaurant for breakfast. Directly opposite a big mosque and place was clean and windy, lots of ceiling fans. Food came fast, and you can select what you fancy when the staff brought trays of timsum to your table. Char siew paus was quite good. Prices was reasonable and overall, a good breakfast. Show less

Author: Jackson790908
Title: Affordable tim sum
Review: Price is reasonable. Got serve fast. Nice char Siew bao. The rest were so so. Easy located - near jonker street

Author: mydestineyKuala Lumpur
Title: Avoid the fried stuff, try the Char Siew bao,its great!
Review: Don't order those fried stuff. Kinda oily, cold and didn't look fresh. Tried Wu kok, fried carrot cake - not nice!The dim sum is so so. Not piping hot from steaming - just warm. So the skin of some of the dim sum was kinda hard.Love the char siew bao. Taste very much like the seremban siew bao fillings except that the bun is steamed. Lau sar bao (yellow creamy custard bun) also not bad ( freshly steam upon ordering)Tried the da bao also but was not a fan of this bao.Show less

Author: ongkeehongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice pau, nicer wukok
Review: The big bau was fill with tandem pork and a slice of eggs, beware of your bite as the juicy ingredient will splash out. The char siew pau also good but best is the wukok (yam burn). Is the traditional version with thick skin made of yam and fill with mixed of pork cube and bean. Show less

Author: clement-barbier4Singapore, Singapore
Title: yummy dumpling to start of a good day
Review: I went there with my girlfriend while visiting Malacca. we both love dim sum and I read good reviews. And is was not disapointed. They were lots of choices and the taste was up to my expectations. The bun are quite delicious too. I especially love the egg cream bun, perfect to finish your breakfastShow less

Author: zepapa
Title: Good taste, good service
Review: Good dim sum, quick service and reasonable price. Nice comfortable place to eat. Was a bit surprised that the kopi comes from a 3-in-1 bag but supposed that is not their specialty. Menu more limited than most dim sum restaurant but adequate for me.

Author: Vidho RMakassar, Indonesia
Title: The taste is average. But the choice is good enough.
Review: Low Yong Moh actually is a great place to breakfast. But I have to admit that the taste is average, The Big Pao is 4 RM (cheap enough for the size). the dimsum is 3-3,5 RM for one package contain of 2-3 pieces.I suggest you to order the steam dim sum only. The fried Dim Sum is so oily.Show less

Author: paraplanner15
Title: Overrated
Review: We had better dim sum in Singapore & Hong Kong than this. Food was not served fresh as outer layers of the dim sum were cold and harden. Not a good sign of freshly served dim sum - normally it should be served pipping hot from the steamer.Porridge was acceptable. Reached before 9am on Sat, we managed to find 1 table immediately. Crowds stream in from 930am - 10am onwards.Show less

Author: Casper CFlobecq, Belgium
Title: Great breakfast
Review: I visited the restaurant once, early july. We were looking for a place to have breakfast, and the hotel owner advised us this place. It was around 7.30 am, but it was already pretty busy at the restaurant. As a western tourist it was my first breakfast ever that was something completely different then I'm used to. I enjoyed everything a lot! Great food, low prices and friendly staff. Will visit again for sure!Show less

Author: Jedai79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Da Pow 大包 a MUST TRY!
Review: Good to be back (for the 大包Da Pow especially) ! Had dim sum here in 2009 and back for its 大包 (big pow). Imagine steaming hot big pow with gravy oozing out after our first bite. Fantastic experience while savouring the pow! 叉烧包char siew pow not bad. 流沙包lau sar pow should be nice too, we don't like lau sar pow so we didn't try, but we saw many customers ordering them. 虾饺Har Gow&烧卖Siew Mai are nice and they have a variety, happy trying. There was this chicken wrapped in aluminium foil, er... first day we went (18 Dec) at 11 plus am, this chicken was still available when almost ALL pows have been sold out. We didn't try this chicken wrapped in aluminium foil till 19 Dec morning. And it was COLD, not nice. Can skip the 粉肠 Fun Cheong because the skin is so thick. Even the 粉肠at Old Airport Road Hawker Centre, Singapore tasted much much better.Most importantly, when you queue up (before 11am, q for 20 mins at least; by 11am, most dim sum would have been sold out), WAIT for the staff to ask you to enter before you step foot into the coffee shop. On Dec 19, there was a "commotion", eager, hungry and tired (exhausted after queuing for 20-30 mins) customers entered coffee shop too early and our dear 40 year old plus man (高大威猛帅哥)（think he's one of the bosses) bellowed at the customers and his staff but he explained it was because he had wanted to ensure the exiting customers had cleared their bills (ie, paid up). I mean if this has happened in the 1970s or may be even 1980s, I can understand, but to experience this kind of "forceful" voice in the service industry in 2010s is unthinkable, at least in Singapore, we don't have this kind of "loud" service any more. We had similar "loud" experiences in eateries in Ipoh, end 2014 too. 4 circles overall since not all dim sums are nice and for the final shocking "LOUD" experience. Show less

Author: Dez L
Title: Great Dim Sum and Wallet friendly
Review: This restaurant is located in jonker street area. The operating concept is kind of old school but they serve very good Dim Sum n are very affordable. Once you are seated, the waiter will ask you for your order of Buns. Their Meat buns, char siew Buns, salted egg yolk bun, is a must to try. The rest of the dim sum will be going round and you can just point to whatever you need.You can order a pot of tea to go with your dim sum order. But note that the refilling of hot water is self service.I must say the their dim sum are rather fresh. Some of the dishes that they serve are prepared differently as compared to those that is served in Singapore and Hong Kong. Their Shrimp Dumpling does not contain a full shrimp but instead it contains small pieces of shrimp meat.If you happen to be around, do give them a chance. Quite worth it.Show less

Author: MWBollom
Title: Simple, diverse selection of dim sum across from Kampung Kling Mosque
Review: Sit with a great view of Kampung Kliing Mosque (my favorite place in Melaka) and enjoy a fairly wide selection of dim sum in a authentic shop house restaurant.

Author: Bruce C
Title: Quick and tasty
Review: Good selection of dim sum. Came for breakfast a couple of times. Pork buns are nice with lots of filling. One of the few places actually open early enough for breakfast in this part of town.

Author: RouYi L
Title: Affordable
Review: The food was affordable. Lotus leaf rice and siew mai was really nice and flavourful. Do not order the har gow, the skin was too thick. Service was quick and owners were attentive. Overall vibes of this restaurant was endearing. There was no queue at Friday 9am and I got my table rather quickly. Come earlier to taste the century egg porridge it was sold out the day i went. Near the key attractions of melaka so it is very convenient!Show less

Author: Samuel CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Dim Sum!!
Review: Come here as early as possible unless you wanna eat "leftovers". The items get sold out very fast and on this trip, we got here at 8:30am and there was already a queue outside, but we didn't wait long and got a small table to squeese 6 together. Yummy small portions and we ate so much that they took 5mins to tabulate the final cost. Recommendations:- 流沙包 (gooey custard pau. I really want to get this again) - har go (crystal prawn dumpling) - chicken feetfeet (it came in a herbal broth) - deep fried prawn in bean curd skin (juicy and crunchy) - siew mai (prawns for the win, but the chicken one is not bad) - century egg porridge (definitely a must have with your dim sim) Show less

Author: Christina_tankySingapore, Singapore
Title: Dim sum for Locals
Review: The big bao and lotus leaf rice are the must-try. The big bao is very juicy and if you eat with your hand, you will experience the dirtiest bao moment (in a finger licking good way). Come before 9am especially during weekends or prepare to wait. Show less

Author: Vicky75_11Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average Dim Sum
Review: Read a lot of rave on this dim sum restaurant. Ordered da bao, lor mai kai and liu sha bao and other dim sum but find all of normal standard. I like my dim sum not hot but at least warm. The dim sum here are cold and I couldn't find any century egg in the porridge!Arrived at 8.30am so did not need to queue. Try to come before 9am as queue will start to form around 8.50am. Don't think will return again.Show less

Author: ekeviny78Selangor
Title: Dim sum at Melaka
Review: Our first ever dim sum at Melaka city and it was in an old restaurant but well maintained and clean. Nearby to Jonker St. and atmosphere was pleasant. Food wise was 3.5 out 5. The cha siew pau, otak-otak and lotus leaf rice were tasty. Not much choices though... Price wise - a bit on high side but worth trying still.Show less

Author: TecaCaliPasadena, California
Title: YUMMY YUMMY YUMMY!!!
Review: We came here twice during our 3 days stay. Food was DELICIOUS and inexpensive. After reading many blog on 'Best food in Malaka' we were a little nervous about coming here because everyone said 'come early!!'. Being that we're on holiday i do not want to wake up before 10 am. but with good will, determination and hungry stomach we walked into the restaurant at 11.00 am as soon as we walked in I can hear the choir of angles. the two owners were very pleasant and friendly and showed us our table. As soon as I mentioned I'm allergic to shrimp and crab the owner said to the staff and they immediately change our menu. They brought to our table a big tray filled with delicious looking dumplings and steamed buns. I said yes to all the porks dumpling and buns because I am that kind of person. the pork belly bun was especially delicious. the lotus bean paste bun really reminded me of my childhood. beautiful flavour.Show less

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Only the Liu Sha Bao was worth eating
Review: I live to eat and naturally, by extension, critic food.As a cantonese, i LOVE dimsum. For a start, the congee was bad- watery, grainy, not flavourful The ha-gao was dry and starchy. The carrot cake was too starchy for my liking and tasteless. I'd like to go on and on, but if you are a true blue Dimsum lover, don't expect too much!For me, the Liu Sha Bao that i tried that day was the only redeemer. It was the only thing that remotely tasted good. But the staff were attentive and prompt, the service was efficient.Show less

Author: TehPeiYee
Title: Good Lotus leaf rice and big Bao
Review: We went there during weekdays, so it was not a lot of people. The Lotus leaf rice and big Bao were very nice. The Big Bao was juicy. However the other dim sums were just average. The price was reasonable.

Author: EdypangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Tasty Dim Sum
Review: Opens very early in the morning around 5.30am. Closed about 1.00pm (or all the dim sum sold out). We were there at 7.45am and were quite crowded. Have to wait for seats. There are no menu as far that I know of. Very old traditional dim sum house. There are lot of varieties of dim sum to order. Went there two days in a roll yet still love it. Is a must try restaurant. The price is very very reasonable and dim sums tasty.Show less

Author: hktraveller328Hong Kong, China
Title: indifferent "young" cashier
Review: Never for a traveller from Hong Kong, Macau or Guangzhou where excellent dim sum can be found easily. Dim Sum below standard. When I paid at the cashier, the young boy, very likely a grandson of the owner, looked the other way when he handed me the change. Message: I don't care. Show less

Author: oZcactusSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic DimSum and value for money
Review: This shop selling authentic dimsum (all hand make and well selected ingredient [according to lady boss]) and shop is run by 3rd general now which is 69 years in history. Food is very tasty and delicious, will strongly recommend to try Lotus leaf rice and Big Bao (bun)The operating hours is 5am till sold out, we visited at 845am (weekend) some dimsum already sold out. Do visit early or disappointed when all sold out.Show less

Author: MWeePhotographySingapore, Singapore
Title: Good breaky at very affordable rates
Review: Was scouting for breaky joints and came across a few review of this place. Made our way there and was not disappointed (in fact, we came back here again the following morning! This restaurant serves traditional dim sum at very affordable rates. The food comes around wave after wave and is served in small portions. Most of the dishes were piping hot, which is always a good sign in a dim sum joint. The stalwarts like the hak kaw and the siew mai were delish, the chicken feet and the herbal chicken (too small a portion though) were also very well prepared, although my favorite dish had to be the big pork bun. It was big, juicy and flavorsome. The only thing I did not like about this place was the coffee they served. It was a sachet coffee, so it did not really have the caffeine boost I was needing (although, in all honesty, no amount of coffee would have saved me for the food coma after).All in all, a really good experience. I would definitely patronize this restaurant again!Show less

Author: Ho Shu Yang D
Title: Nice Dim Sum breadfast
Review: The shop is just next to our hotel, boss is very friendly. The food is good and price is reasonable. Do come in the morning as they close around noon. 3 of us eat 15 items, we are so full, spend around RM40.

Author: WiddventurerHorfield, United Kingdom
Title: Authentic breakfast dim sum
Review: Came here for a post exercise brunch. Dim Sum is traditionally only served until late morning and this place is as authentic as you get. Huge variety of steamed good new, self refills of jasmine tea. Some of the best food we have had on our travels so far. Hint: Ask to wash your hands - you get sent into the kitchen to wash as see all the huge bamboo steamers with steam hoods and can say hello to the chef!Show less

Author: Valiant78
Title: Great local feel with the hustle and bustle
Review: Good variety of choices and just go with your heart on what appeals to you most! For non Chinese visitors, don't let the lack of a menu put you off. Be advantureous!

Author: Martita76
Title: Excellent!
Review:
Unfortunately, we found  this jewel on our last day in Melaka. All the dim sum we tried were delicious, especially the pork bao.
Easy to find, just across the Kampong Kling Mosque.

Author: Damian C
Title: Probably best in Melaka
Review: this might be the best dim sum Plc in Melaka. However, not the best we had. Pork bun was juicy but oily too. Lol. Be there as early as 8am to avoid crowd.

Author: John KJamberoo, Australia
Title: A gem of a place for Yum Cha
Review: Do not be put off by lack of menu or signs in English. When the food comes the staff can tell you what they are. The pork dumplings we delicious as were most of the dishes. WE loved it so much we went 2 days running. Hard to better this place for a Yum Cha breakfast and it will not break the bankShow less

Author: ErwinEP
Title: one of my favorite dimsum
Review: I have breakfast there three days on rows when i visited Malacca. I love their dimsums also their kopi o. my favorite was Pork Bakpao, Siomai, Hakao, Lo Ma Kai.. must try when you visit Malacca

Author: Amy B
Title: Great dim sum
Review: The restaurant has a great range of dim sum and dishes all for reasonable prices. The staff are nice and the service was really quick.

Author: drag0nb0iSingapore, Singapore
Title: Breakfast to warm the tummy
Review: Breakfast for the road trip. Was`t too hard to find but parking was slightly a problem. The selection of fried and steam dim sum is good enough for us and too small a portion that we need to keep ordering. Service was good! We din have to wait too long for piping hot baos and fired dumplings to arrive on our table.Show less

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Consistenly Good
Review: Having grown up in the neighbourhood, their bao have been consistently good for the last 30 years. Their recipe has remained as passed down through the generation. Everytime, we are back, we will have the Big Pork Bao for breakfast.They are one of the best tea house in Melaka town and has never failed in quality and taste.Will continue to visit the outlet as it is nostalgic to be sitting around savouring the pao and dim sum.Show less

Author: briliantfJakarta, Indonesia
Title: I am dying to have the pao!
Review: We planned to have breakfast at this place. When we came at 9, the place is already closed. Then we came earlier the next day, at 6am. We made it! I tried pork pao and it was delicious! We had also various dim sum and it was all just delicious! You better come in the early morning to try the most delicious dimsum and pao in MalaccaShow less

Author: hoangnganha3012
Title: Delicious!!!
Review:
Many dimsum places make the mistake of cooking it too sweet or too bland or too soft or too hard. But not this place!
Every bite takes me to heaven!
From a dimsum lover!!

Author: Leesa DJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Amazing!
Review: Having lived in Malaysia for 2 and a half years we are huge dim sum fans and often seek out small family run places in KL. I'd read about this place and couldn't wait to try it. We arrived around 9:45am Saturday morning and were warmly greeted and offered Chinese Tea and pork buns....yes please! We also had a couple of other dim sum items. The pork buns were full of meat and bursting with flavour, almost like a meal in itself. RM12 for our dim sum, pork buns and tea. Bargain compared to KL prices. We were the only westerners there but we are used to that. Thank you and keep doing what you're doing!Show less

Author: Creighton_rwLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Best dim sum in Malaysia!
Review: Early morning breakfast spot opening around 6am when little else in Melaka is open, right across form the Kampung Kling Mosque. By 8 it's packed with locals reading newspapers and drinking tea. The staff are all very friendly and helpful. They bring trays of pao and dim sum to your table and explain the options in English or Chinese. They apparently have the best pork buns in Malaysia. As with most restaurants here, it's all very good value. I had five plates of dim sum and a pot of tea for 12 RM.Show less

Author: KaiBoonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Early bird catches the worm
Review: Be sure to be early so that you can have more selection of the dimsum. I reach close to 10am and the char siew pao are sold out.Even though there is any expensive ingredient or extraordinary dimsum making skill, the dimsum are good.Don't miss it.Show less

Author: txfpc1Houston, Texas
Title: Early morning breakfast
Review: I have no idea what we ate here for breakfast. The 'owner' or boss lady was so friendly and she knew we had no idea what to order so she brought every item over to the table and explained what was in it and how to eat it. I do know that she brought us two dim sum's to eat and they were fantastic. Friendly, fast and a fun place to eat breakfast if you aren't a local.Show less

Author: Chong C
Title: very nice
Review: very nice food. esp the chicken feet. recommended.. service was friendly too..saw locals at the joint too

Author: srallsSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious way to start the day
Review: If your sick of the usual hotel fair and want some real authentic local food the tim sum here is a great start to the day. While they serve pao, steamed and fried items, I'd recommenced the steamed tim sum. While all are nice, with the tim sum they are less filling than the pao so you can eat more and try more of the different dishes they have to offer.Show less

Author: LoV55
Title: Tasteful dim sum
Review: Only place available for our early breakfast at 7am. Their most popular is the big pao but we get shocked when they sent us the pao. I thought it's bbq pao coz the size is small as it but the lady boss told us they served small size of big pao. Anyway those doesn't matter because the "big" pao really taste good n delicious!! The rest of the dim sum just so so but not bad. Highly recommended for those like to have very early breakfast n dim sum fans.Show less

Author: phyllisomg
Title: Great paos!
Review: Affordable,  good paos esp the big pork buns. Tney serve good dim sum too . Small place so be prepared to wait

Author: PinXun
Title: cheap n good dim sum
Review: a treat for the morning bird, this shop open at 7am for those early birds. cheap n good dim sum if you miss those back at home

Author: Juliet L
Title: Excellent Breakfast
Review: this is my breakfast spot whenever i'm in melaka. cheap, quick, delicious. the big bun (ta pau) is a MUST. be there before 10am during weekends otherwise the big buns run out. opens real early.

Author: Arnon PPhuket, Phuket, Thailand
Title: Averagely taste and feel not really welcome
Review: I read a review of where should we have our Dim Sum in Malacca and decided to go there. We had tried somewhere else much better & fresher. When we first entered, the ladies owner asked us in chinese but we don't understand so she speak in English asking "you speak Chinese or not?" I said no" Then she started talked Chinese to her friend the next table which sound like gossiping and say something about us and laugh. Which I found very rude and not friendly to tourist. Putting that matter aside, the food really not up to standard & lack of taste.Show less

Author: Scott B
Title: Tasty dim sum and steamed pork dumplings
Review: Went here for breakfast/brunch. Fantastic steamed pork dumplings (pao) and dim sum. The staff were very helpful in explaining what was in each tasty morsel. Could have sat eating here all day!

Author: MikeHSFOSan Francisco, California
Title: Very busy for a great reason -- it's great
Review: Our friends from Singapore wanted to take us to this dim sum restaurant in Melaka, as it's well known as one of the best (the best?) dim sum restaurants in Melaka, a city known for its great restaurants. We weren't disappointed. Very busy in the mornings with locals and tourists alike, with all the standard dim sum options available. Most of them I can't pronounce, but the barbeque pork buns were super (we had them and everything else two days in a row).They appreciate westerners as well as Chinese, and will make you feel welcome!Show less

Author: ccalcfKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: More economical to come in group of 4 and above .
Review: There are quite a few varieties of vegetarian choices and we can choose small medium or large portions. It’s most economical if we order large portions as the prices is not too big a difference.However as there was just the 2 of us, we ordered small portions which ended up not as cheap.The French beans or four season beans with Choy Poh did not have as much Choy Poh ( preserved radish ) as we would have hoped. The light brown bits were not all preseved vegetables.I heard that the curry is very good may be we may come back with a larger group.The other 2 dishes butter frog legs and pork trotters used mushrooms and soy bean sheets to create the flavours.We could not finished these 2 dishes as we were too full.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: ThiruJay
Title: Awesome Vege Food
Review: Didn't expect the vegetarian wantan mee and laksa to taste so superb. Rich with spices and we really enjoyed the varieties of food served here. Highly recommend this place and I will definitely come again. Of course price is reasonable too. Thumbs up!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: macedonboyGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Great vegetariand and vegan place
Review: This is a great place to get vegetarian food when wandering around the north bank of Heritage city of Malacca. There are so many options for Chinese style vegetarian dishes containing mock meat it boggles the mind. I only had two dishes and a taste from my friends bowl and everything was great tasting. Along with the choices, the next best thing is the prices, everything is so reasonably priced.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Constanceludwig14
Title: Tasty food
Review: I tried their laksa and mee rebus which was so nice and spicy. The staff was attentive and recommend us to try. Total only RM11 include one drink. Should go earlier to have more choices.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: YaseLisaWellington, New Zealand
Title: Amazing vegetarian/ vegan dishes!
Review: Super delicious, effortable food!If you choose small size it comes already in a really good portion!I had the lakes it cost just 4,50 in small and is so good! But be careful food come a really hot! Don't burn your tongue like I did!Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: siamakwana
Title: Excellent place.
Review: As me and my family are vegetarian, this place was a real treat. The menu was good and they was very kind and helpful staff. Would recommend the veg burger. Good for family.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: bucketlisttravellersSydney, Australia
Title: Great value tasty food
Review: This restaurant is located in a central part of Melaka and offers a variety of vegetarian dishes. Most of their menu is the same each day, but they also have daily specials of two dishes which change depending on the day of the week.We had the Mee rebus (4 ringgit) and the Chee cheong fun (3 ringgit). The chee cheong fun is a cold noodle dish which was ok. It’s not a huge dish, but for 3 rm it was decent value. The mee rebus is a more substantial dish and we enjoyed that one more. The flavour of the broth was excellent and it was served piping hot.This is an excellent choice when in Melaka. It’s great value and both vegetarians and non-vegetarians would appreciate the tastiness of the food.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: ApocalypseYanaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Perfect little breakfast spot
Review: This place is cheap, delicious and friendly. I still dream of the incredible mee rubus that I had for breakfast which was perfect to soothe my heavy head. We also had the laksa and the chicken rice which was also tasty. So many great veggie options.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Rose H
Title: Local food; really good price
Review: I have been there twice, both good experiences. You’d better go there earlier; cause it’s really popular, a lot of customers there. Sometimes some dishes are sold out during 12pm~1pm. Really good price and authentic food~
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: gosiak888Lodz, Poland
Title: Amazing vegetarian chicken rice balls
Review: Very nice and affordable vegetarian restaurant. I came both days of my stay I Melaka for lunch. I almost regretted I couldn’t stay longer in Melaka just to try more of their dishes. I was surprised that a simple dish like chicken rice balls can be that delicious. The owner speaks very good English, is very friendly and helpful. I absolutely recommend!Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Jack F
Title: Not too expensive
Review: A variety of vegetarian specialties are available here, this restaurant is one of the alternative places for you vegetarians. The selling price they offer is not too expensive.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: 719charlotteSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy vegetarian chicken rice ball and local food!
Review: This is a friendly vegetarian cafe/restaurant serving variety of delicious vegetarian local food, staff can speak English and Chinese.  Notes: Open 7am - 2pm. Rest on Sunday!  Daily available: chicken rice ball ( must try as special in Malacca and come earlier or may sold out), nyonya curry noodles, burger, wantan mee, mee rebus & etc.  Food served only once a week: hokkien fried noodles, bak kut teh, hakka yong tauhu, nasi lemak, spaghetti, duck noddles & etc.  We love the food here and the price is fair, you can choose normal or big serving. We ordered normal serving to share, so could try more variety. The food here all so yummy, we came three times already, will continue try the rest when visit malacca again.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: AmmyY14
Title: Not bad
Review: The food is good especially the laksa. Overall is good and recommend every vegan to have a try at this restaurant.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Kat_is_traveling
Title: cheap & delicious local food place
Review: it's a small place where more locals than tourists eat. Only open for breakfast and lunch - give it a try it's worth it!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: kai zen l
Title: cill out
Review: the vegetarian restoran is was very nice the food was nice the wan ton mer and the teh o hot was good and they have more variety of food  the owners mr henry an ms yen was the best  .
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Willis J
Title: Very good
Review: Good food. Good people. Happy customer. We came a little late, didnt notice that it is closed at 2pm. Chicken rice ball and nasi lemak is finished by the time we reached.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: keefenkongKota Kinabalu
Title: DELICIOUS AND FRIENDLY
Review: I had visited this restaurant 4 times. They kept the standard of taste. The foods are delicious and will make you want to come back for more. Not many tables and no aircon. However you will not regret for dining there for Breakfast or Lunch. Services are fast even Saturday morning full house. So no matter you are vegetarian o non vegetarian, please do give yourself a try. They aren't expensive at all... Try it yourself better than I describe.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: desilvagsingapore
Title: Tasty food
Review: The shop opens at 7am till 2.30pm. The dishes that i tried was the Chicken Rice Ball,Chicken Rice,Laska and Prawn Mee was very good. The top most favourite was the Chicken Rice. Very very tasty especially the chilli sauce which was so good. It gets sold out very fast. So be there early. Within walking distance to Jonker Street. I m sure that all the other dishes must be tasty as well. Definitely a must visit on all my future trips in Melaka..Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: orionstar85
Title: Service and foods so so
Review: Service very slow and bad. Food not teasty at fall. I won't come back again. Staff also not friendly.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: MarineL873
Title: Excellent vegetarian restaurant
Review: We went three times for lunch there and it was delicious every time ! A must try even for not vegetarian. Very low prices
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: ate75
Title: Clean n positive energy
Review: This veggie resto near Kuayin temple at Jonker walk around 5 minute by walk. The taste very yummy n this resto hv positive energy... deliciatos veggie ever
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: 3egg
Title: love the chicken rice ball
Review: the environment is simple, but clean.I had the chicken rice ball, and really love it. Had 2 plates for it (just because I can't have the normal ones). haha!I also had their yong tau fu, not bad I would say, but limited selection left...Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: endymionk
Title: TASTY VEGGIE DISHES IN A FRIENDLY NICE ATMOSPHERE
Review: The menu offers a variety of yummy dishes with a very competitive price. The owner of this restaurant is extremely friendly and willing to give you advice about what to order. Definitely recommend for vegetarians.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: IrishintheTropicsJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Excellent value
Review: This is the perfect place just off Jonker street to have breakfast. Not many other places in the area are open at this time. The food is delicious, well seasoned and nice heat in the spicey dishes. The Nasi Lemak and Laksa are especially good. The staff are not very friendly but then again it's not that kind of place. The value for money is superb Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Starry_Skies11
Title: Tasty vegetarian food
Review: Daily specials plus ala carte dishes available. Closed on Sundays while opening hours are from 7.30am to 2.30pm. My family tried the chicken rice balls, bak kut teh and longevity noodles.. all dishes were tasty and will definitely try when we visit Malacca again.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: saraymdezVitoria-Gasteiz, Spain
Title: Great
Review: If you want to spent little money and have very good food, this is your place. I have been here several times during my almost 3 weeks stay in Malacca, and it is my favourite restaurant in town. The most of the meals are between 3'8 and 5'5 ringgits and the taste is really good. I wanted to try Veg. Chicken Rice Balls but it was always sold out. So I decided one day to have breakfast there instead of lunch and I could get the last 3 rice balls at 9.15am so if you want to try this meal, go early! It is totally worth it. I recommend veg minced meat mee, veg chicken with rice and wan tan mee as well. Some of the meals (laksa, for example) are spicy so ask before if you prefer not spicy. The opening hours are from 7.30am to 2.30pm. It is closed on Sunday. Pity it is not open for dinner.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: CosystarSingapore
Title: Yummy Vegetarian Meal
Review: Love the chicken rice ball. They have quite alots of varieties.Opening 7.30am to 2.30pm. Actually I was there for 2 days. But it was not open. Found it by chance as our car park around there.Think is family business, staff are very friendly. Their food abit spicy.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: GypsytwitchersMaldon, Australia
Title: Great Vegetarian Meals
Review: We are vegan and we are not great fans of mock meat but we tried the meals and were pleasantly surprised as not all meals contained it. we had breakfast this morning and returned for lunch! For our taste, meals could do with some more vegetables (I would have scored 5 if they did), however we enjoyed nevertheless. taste was superb and the price is very reasonable. I highly recommend this restaurant. Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: fyniac
Title: Good cheap vegetarian eats
Review: Good for cheap vegetarian eats. 2 people, spent about 12 myr for lunch. Had the fragrance rice (ok) and the mee hoon kueh which I enjoyed more. Not somewhere to go if you're looking for a/c or nice atmosphere, but definitely if you are looking for good budget friendly vegetarian food.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Till W
Title: Excellent Vegetarian Restaurant
Review:
Chinese dishes go vegetarian. 
A local, clean and cheap place for breakfast and lunch with very friendly staff.
And I can tell that it's really hard to decide between the offered dishes.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: HPWuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Chicken Rice
Review: It was crowded. So I got no choice but to takeaway the chicken rice. It is yummy. The Google map is wrong. It should be turn to right side after the Cheng Hoon Teng. Please note that it closed at 2.30pm. Really hope that they will open in longer hours. Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: moderntraveler16Seoul, South Korea
Title: Best Asian Vegetarian food variety
Review: There is every asian dish, in vegetarian options! The mock chicken (beancurd skin) is done very deliciously, the burger is also very good (they make their own patties, and they sell out quick) There is also many other spicy or non spicy options, a must visit if you are vegetarian! Take note that they close on Mondays! ( Unless that has changed.)Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Venod S
Title: Amazing
Review: Love the food. Best veg food in melaka.. pleasent please to dine in... wonderful service.. definately will go again
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Barney1994 L
Title: Cill out
Review: I like the admosefear at the are the the best in they shop is wan ton mee an teh si and one more think is one staff is very friendly his name is Henry and the sister olso very good.
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: 346jewell
Title: Clean And Friendly
Review: Very clean restaurant. Food was not oily and taste good. The owner very friendly makes us feel like eating at home. Will visit again for sure!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: nggektinKuala Lumpur
Title: Nice & Delicious vegetarian food
Review: The vege chicken ball rice is delicious & a must try when you are around Jonker street. It is within walking distance to/from the Jonker street.Other than the above, the curry noddle also good to me. There are variety choice of meals to try here and it has local taste which I think can not get in KL/other place.Will come back again when visiting Melaka.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Risyen
Title: nice rice ball
Review: Its vegetarian chicken rice ball is better than the famous non-vegetarian one! Besides that, i also like the mee hun kuih!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Vijay T
Title: Delicious & reasonable
Review:
After reading reviews for this establishment, had to pay a visit.
Good vegetarian food, ambiance is nice & price is reasonable. What else do you want in Jonker Street?
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: SabrinaR1807
Title: A vegetarian's heaven
Review: While I was working for three weeks in Melaka, I went there everyday for lunch trying the huge variety of vegetarian dishes. Everything they serve is a delight! The daily specials are definitely worth a try! I still cannot believe how cheap they offer all those delicious meals. Plus, the people working there are really friendly and will always prepare something suitable for your own preference. Just tell them what you like. I m really happy that I had the chance to try all the typical Asian dishes that are usually made with fish or meat in a vegetarian way. Yummy! Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: leechin1101
Title: Vege Delight
Review: Healthy Vegetarian Breakfast to start off the day! This restaurant has street food vegetarian dishes/meals to choose from. Decor simple & airy environment. A good choice!!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: Sina21
Title: Best Veggi Option
Review:
Definitly worth to go if you are vegetarian and want to try typical malacca and malay food in a vegetarian version! 
So many options,  delicious food and drinks,  you can choose the size of your portion and its very cheap!  Good value for money!
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: chris sMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cheap & Good
Review: We had been patronizing this veg food outlet (after being recommended by a friend) since 2013. I did not write any review on it earlier because I felt that though the food is good, the place was a little crummy. They stopped operations for more than a month from pre-Chinese New Year 2014. We went back again last month. Much to our delight the owners have renovated the place. They did a great job with the new deco and the place is transformed into a much spacier and cleaner environment. Food wise, they serve one of the better Veg Wan Tan Mi - the noodles are springy and served with a palatable sauce. The Veg Chicken Rice Balls is their forte and the stock is practically sold out by 9 am almost daily. There are about 12 fixed fares daily along with 1 or 2 special ones each day. Their prices are at local hawkers' rates. The owners and their staff are very friendly and are always on hand to introduce their fares to new customers.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: SummerGBCopenhagen, Denmark
Title: Amazing vegetarian dishes in this street kitchen
Review: Nomen est omen - this place offers only vegetarian meals. More or less a street kitchen with some tables inside, it offers fantastic food. The meals are tasty, delicious, and different. Even carnivores could be happy, eating one of the vegetarian mince meet or fish ball dishes, which are of course meat free. A nice family is running the place, where the daughter handles the foreigners explaining the different options.Show less
Restaurant: Shui Xian Su Shi Yuan Vegetarian Food

Author: WLMokKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent "home made" Nyonya food
Review: We were a group of 6 who had gone to Malacca to buy the traditional Manek Nyonya beaded slippers in Jalan Tokong. The owner of the Manek Shop recommended Amy Heritage Nyonya Cuisine and we were not disappointed. Every dish we ordered was delicious - our favourite was the appetizer, heart of the banana plant that was tossed with onions, dried shrimps, ginger flower and coconut milk. So refreshing!! We had the opportunity to chat with owner chef Amy who was very warm & friendly. Definitely looking forward to going back very soon to taste more of Amy's delicious Nyonya cuisine.Show less

Author: JAMILEYJAAFARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Fantastic Authentic Nyoya's Halal Cuisine"
Review: Just mention the traditional cuisine of Baba and Nyonya, I definitely remember Amy Heritage Melaka Raya cuisine. I understand Untie the owner of this restaurant is still active as the main leader in the kitchen. That is why the cuisine is very unique and delicious. You can taste all kinds of authentic Baba & Nyonya cuisine and it is definitely halal. You should come try the culinary delights here.Show less

Author: Jojofamily88
Title: Very rude staff
Review: The food was acceptable, but it became unpalatable due to very rude foreign staff. Extremely rude and arrogant. I would never return to this place.

Author: ireene88
Title: Recent family dinner
Review: We thoroughly enjoyed the otak otak which has an authentic taste, would have been even better with the original ikan haruan instead of fish paste. The paitee was also excellent. We would certainly find our way back the next time we are in Melaka

Author: dewynne15
Title: Peranakan food with value for money
Review: Tried calling several times, lines were either engaged, or no one answered. Eventually managed to booked for 9 pax. Service was quite fast, price reasonable.m and it’s authentic peranakan food. We chose this because it’s one of the few peranakan place with no pork.

Author: DorisChinJurong East, Singapore
Title: Fantastic!
Review: Went on Thursday 8pm and they were almost full. Had reserved beforehand, on Wed when I called they were full. This restaurant is small, only 1 shoplot, around 10-12tables. Service was good. We were immediately shown our table and given menus. Menu had nice explanation of history of baba & Nyonya and also history of owner Amy. There were not that many dishes. My mum who has Nyonya blood, was quite sceptical and felt that the food should be so-so only.. she had previously been to another restaurant starting with “N” and did not find it anything special, she thought it would be the same. After quite a long time waiting, we were served the fish maw soup. Looks wise, it was just a clear soup with a lot of vege.. so every one thought.. hmm boring clear soup. But upon tasting, the flavors just burst out. And we were all surprised. So we looked forward to the other dishes. The otah looked ordinary and my mum said that this is the commercial type, can buy anywhere. I unwrapped it and it did look ordinary. Upon tasting, found that it was really fine and had great fragrance! Then came the tau foo and the fried chicken wings. You can tell both were you made with care - chicken should be fresh chicken wings (not frozen) and tau foo cubes were crispy in outside and still moist on the inside. Chap chai was the real surprise, instead of the normal boiled and bland tasting type, it was darker sauce and really flavorful. Can not describe, you have to try it!! Lastly, the chendol really brought us back to old days, gula Melaka was the “real” type, salty and sweet, coconut had the fragrance! Wowed us! Only thing missing for my dad was red beans, but the rest of us were really happy with the entire meal! Will be back! Show less

Author: JocLYT
Title: Disappointed
Review: Four of us dine there on 10th Nov 2019. First serving was the kueh pie tee which was delicious. Then comes the disappointment. The chap chai was tasteless. The otah is just a fish cake with otah paste. Sambal kang kong was too salty. The chendol has no red beans.Show less

Author: DeeCawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great traditional food
Review: A friend in our group brought us here, so I had no expectations of what to expect.Since we were in a large group, we ordered quite a number of dishes to share. In this way, we manged to try a large sele tion of the menu and I must say, everything was great and some were just fantastic.If I visit Melaka again, I'll definately be back here Show less

Author: Joyce T
Title: Great Nonya food with generous portions
Review: Enjoyed the nonya food here, in particular The Chicken in (rendang like) sauce, fried chicken wings, lady's fingers with chili, fish maw soup. We went at 7pm, on a weekday and managed to get seats.

Author: justina601
Title: Disappointed with service
Review: Arrived here at 1.45pm and informed ya the restaurant is closed . Totally disappointed. Travelled by e hour to get here and asked us to leave.

Author: Hamdan OKuala Lumpur Malaysia
Title: Good But Not Exceptional
Review: A friend reccommended us to try out this restaurant. We arrived early for dinner without any reservation and got a table.The staffs were attentive and immediately took our order. We ordered several dishes and were quite impressed. Good but we have had better. A clean, not too bad restaurant with an ok atmosphere.Show less

Author: chephrenchuaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great BABA food, even though I seldom eat them
Review: Our first dinner in malacca and we had a great meal, not really expecting it. We arrive about 7pm and within 20 minutes, the restaurants are FULL! so come early to avoid people waiting for your table.The food looks great but we only ate their famous BABA dishes, vegetarian curry and pongteng chicken, wonderful!! Parking is easy and lots all around, it's the number of tables that is the limit. Wanted to go back and try more dishes next day but didn't due to time constraint. will surely be back for more, they deserve a near 5 star which I seldom give.Tips : MUST TRY chendol, if you like it, as they give you the gula malacca bottle to get the sweetness you like, and they have a famous outlet at jonker street which taste horrible compare to freshly made one here.Show less

Author: ThengleSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wow! Just wow!
Review: Although not a Nonya food expert, the meal we had was incredible! The combination of tastes was amazing and the value tremendous. Amy’s was recommended by the hotel and certainly did not disappoint. It’s quite tough to get a table so you definitely need to call for a reservation - we tried two nights in a row before getting in (and only then late in the evening). The portions are also very big so be cautious and don’t over order. Service was excellent. Best meal I have had in quite some time (and we enjoyed every meal in Malacca) - absolutely guaranteed that we will revisit if/when we return. Show less

Author: chiachiangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent nonya food for first timer
Review: It is small restaurant and accept reservation. We didn’t had reservation and luckily there is a table for four. Simple restaurant and the service staff very prompt. Ordered the Ayam keluak which I think taste good. Ended with chendol which was dripped with hula Melaka. venue is far from River and closer to Dataran Palawan.Show less

Author: Sab26ess
Title: Great Food
Review: Make your reservation before heading to the place. It's always full. The food is authentic and delicious

Author: Keith o
Title: Awesome
Review: Really glad consistency and quality maintained. Many dishes cooked to order. Fantastic for Nyonya cuisine.

Author: Wally-SingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: First time having a meal here
Review: Was invited by some friends to this place which I've never been in any of my previous visits to Melaka. I expected 'the same old same old', not so. The food served was very good and their Ayam Buah Keluak and Ikan Gerang Assam gravy was really fantastic. I would put it in a glass and drink it.I may not be an expert at Nonya food, but I believe that when it comes to food, everyone has their own preferences and ideas of what the food should taste like. So no matter what others might say be it exceptional or terrible, my personal experience here is that food is above average (very good) and prices are reasonable.Show less

Author: May_75_30
Title: No 1 choice for nyonya cuisine
Review: This is the must come restaurant when we visit Malacca. We have tried many nyonya cuisine in Malacca but only Amy Heritage is our first choice. The boss and staff is friendly and polite, is different from what others experiance.

Author: VincentKKL
Title: Rude manner
Review: The boss very rude. Bad manner and attitude and will not go again. There's no point for us to be treat like this

Author: JimmyngcmKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but pricey
Review: This place offers Nyonya food. Menu have some variety but however please ask for pricing as most of the seafood’s prices are marked as “Market Price” meaning you don’t know how much it costs until you pay if you don’t ask specifically and that is hard to figure out. I ordered Assam Fish with four small fish cuts and it costs me RM50 for just that dish. Pretty pricey and I felt cheated. You could have ate this elsewhere for around RM35Show less

Author: leo g
Title: Expensive. Taste is bad
Review: Taste bad. Service bad. Price bad.all bad . Dont order shrimp with milk 50 ringgit the taste make me sick

Author: Jennifer VKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: When friends meet
Review: Enjoyed the cendol, we savoured the rich coconut milk with gula melaka. The dish of chicken cooked with "buah keluak" that we ordered was too sweet. Wonder why restaurants are so generous with sugar these days. Generous portion of fish in the "Ikan Gerang Assam" dish. We loved the tamarind rich gravy. Tried the simple steamed okra, a lovely surprise. Try the dainty pie tee.Show less

Author: RLAM88
Title: Good food and reasonable price
Review: Had dinner with friends here. Food good and price decent. Tasty but slightly small portions. Very nice Chendol.

Author: Eric8883
Title: Nice Nyonya Food
Review:
Original, Nice Taste and Unique Private Kitchen.
You must book a reservation in advance before visit this restaurant, otherwise you cant dine in, because it too much customer.

Author: Yong T
Title: Average nyonya food
Review: The food are bit sweet for me, the ambient is good .Just not the correct taste for me.maybe u can try if u want.

Author: 428peggykSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ms
Review: 1st time patronise this restaurant. Good location, along the main road, easily visible, opposite the famous polpular Tong Sheng restaurant. Nice cosy ambience. Polite staff. The food good and portion quite big. 8 persons with 7 dishes at reasonable price of ringgit 138. Can go again next time.Show less

Author: 2019hp
Title: Overrated for no reason
Review:
Food is not authentic. Staff is unpleasant and rude. Not value for money.  
This is the only regret place of visit in our melaka trip.

Author: Anna_Marie_Gan
Title: Scrumptious Nonya Lunch
Review: This is my top choice for Nonya restaurant in Malacca.  Aunty Amy is very friendly and passionate in her business.  Her dishes are very authentic and delicious.  Her pie tee, ayam bonteh, fried chicken wings etc. Very delicious.  Must order.

Author: imagine6572Balmain, Australia
Title: Generous portions, wonderful flavours
Review: There is a familiar and comforting element to the food and ambiance here. There is depth of flavour in the simple fishball and quail egg soup, freshness in the okra simply steamed and served with a bright sambal and complexity in the braised chicken. My favourite of the Malacca restaurants.Show less

Author: FarAway46140947472
Title: Prices Up but Quality Dipped
Review: Prices have also gone up but food quality has dipped. The prawns in the Udang Masak Nanas were not very fresh but prices which were fixed years ago in now "Market Price". The red beans in the chendol was replaced with sago and the ice shavings was very coarse. Still very crowded. Walk-ins without advance reservations are likely to be turned away. During my recent visit I found the place being less family run restaurant and becoming more professionally run. There are more service staff now and service is good. Show less

Author: danielcY6181JZJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Still among the top of my list in Melaka.
Review: I have always made it a point to bring my guests here when we visit Melaka. The pie tees, ayam pongteh, and udang masak lemak nenas never disappoints. The cendol is not the best in Melaka but I do not think they ever claimed it to be. Amy never fails to revel us with her Nonya stories when she can get out of the busy kitchen. Definitely recommended and will come again when I'm next here again. Show less

Author: Tang0Brav0Singapore, Singapore
Title: @Return2Malacca Nonya sedap!
Review: When another restaurant kindly volunteered that for Nonya cuisine Amy Heritage is worth a visit, we did. While some would say the food is a tad sweet or manis, this is because they do not use MSG. Food is apparently cooked to order so it tastes fresh. Strictly no pork or alcohol place. Amy has been featured on BBC and has cooked for the UN! After tasting her dishes, we can understand why. Call for reservations, as tables are limited to ensure quality. Show less

Author: Mumtan552015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average food with overrated reviews - Not recommended
Review: Restaurant was packed and without reservations many were turn away, thought I was lucky to get a table of two, ordered ayam ponteng, the chicken does not have flavour and was dry, the gravy was a disappointment - watery. The hee peow soup or fish maw soup had slithers of fish maw with several tasteless fish ball , cabbage . The soup was tasteless. The saving grace was the kueh pie tee, the pastry of thin and crispy but the fillings of juliennes of turnip was average and for restaurant standard . The dessert tai bak which is like white chendol was served with coarsely shaved ice and sugar syrup. The service staff was inconsistent in service , but must commend one of the waiter Bim, he was very attentive and prompt to act . Overall, do not find this Nyonya food authentic and is not worth the wait and price. So not recommend for people who have tasted good nyonya food.Show less

Author: findingnemo82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience environment
Review: Made advance booking and the slot is reserve for you, you can enjoy for few hours from opening till they close shop... they will not chase you out even there are people walk in with no seats...The food is nice and owner will introduce their signature menu which is delicious...Worth to revisit. Show less

Author: Squiff123
Title: Market price?!
Review: Walked out of this restaurant after an unfriendly welcome. The majority of the menu was marked “market price”. Do prices really fluctuate that much in this part of the world? To add insult to injury we had to enter into a discussion on the number of pieces of chicken we wanted in the curry. Time to make a move.......Show less

Author: Tan M
Title: Delicious Nonya Cuisine
Review:
My friends and I were very happy to enjoy the excellent food provided by Amy's Heritage.
We have tried other Nonya restaurants in Malacca but Amy really takes the top spot.

Author: linamarkisanPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Satisfying and delicious
Review: We came a day before and was told to make a reservation so we had lunch a day after. I must say it's worth coming here to taste typical Nyonya dishes, it's really delicious. Their staffs are very attentive and fast delivery. Depending what dishes you choose, it can be a bit pricey. Show less

Author: ufun
Title: Delicious nyonya restaurant
Review: have been visiting this restaurant every time we go to Melaka. Never disappoint us. Love the pie tea, cendol , chay cai. Please make reservation to avoid disappointment. Had seem many people turn away by the staff due to fully seated.

Author: kph60
Title: Authentic Nonya Food
Review: Nice authentic nonya food. Reasonably priced.Loved their ladies fingers dish. Their chendol is also very delicious.

Author: TravelChargerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Malacca Nyonya Food
Review: This restaurant has many awards and appear to serve authentic Malacca Nyonya Food, however we are slightly disappointed with the taste, not too authentic in our opinion...there are other better choices within Malacca, can do more research. However this is not crowded on weekday evenings when we visited.Show less

Author: Lisa CKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place for nyonya food
Review: We ordered sambal prawns, chicken pongteh, kangkong belacan, fried chicken wings, cencalok fried egg (although I wished they didn’t put parsley in it) and pie tee. All small portions for 4 adults and 2 kids. Food was overall good. Love their cendol too. Lunch on a weekday was quite full, so best to go around 12noon. Would definitely return in future.Show less

Author: adampeterrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unprofessional staffs!!
Review: The staffs that works here is rude and unprofessional!! It's about 8.30pm , we went in for dinner but the staffs over there keep on pushing us to order the food , saying they gonna close up at 9pm- we haven't even open up the menu !! We just walk out and we are not going back there again !! Really rude !!Show less

Author: BatmanSupermanHong Kong
Title: Average and commercialised tasting food
Review: We tried this restaurant as it is close to our hotel. It is staffed by non Peranakan and it does not seem authentic. Commercialised food. Not great but not too bad either. Service seems fast. Average menu. Nothing really worth calling out for. Just one of the many. Manis J is far better.Show less

Author: joyce777Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Authentic nyonya cuisine, must go!
Review: You must reserve before you go or you will be disappointed. Must order the famous prawns pineapple curry dish, pie tee shells, and the rest ..yum yum. Remember to buy their pineapple tarts ( very good ) and the famous cendol.I would said it’s one of the delicious nyonya eatery don’t miss it.Show less

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: The Peranakan Food was not fantastic but it was Crowded.
Review: We were quite surprised that we had to book a place and it was packed full as we understand that if you don't book you will not get a table.As a fourth generation Peranakan, who loved eating and cooking Peranakan food I am always keen to try Peranakan food. Unfortunately, very few restaurants have met my expected standards although Have eaten a very good one in Penang recommend by a prominent Peranakan lady Aunty Annie from the Peranakan museum. There are a couple of good ones in Singapore but some have left the cooking to Filipino cooks who cannot cook Peranakan food for lack of skill as Peranakan food requires skill and taste and not exact measurements as the flavours change with the quality of and taste from the ingredient bought the day’s cooking.The ambience and decor is nice at the restaurant displaying lots of Peranakan wares.The service was good with busy Amy supervising. We had ordered Hee Peow Soup - Bad choice! Each of us had a fishball, a quail egg and some fish Maw, this should be rich soup with prawns, different kinds of fish cakes, meat balls and meat. The broth was not at all rich.The Ikan Gerang Asam was sugar sweet. Ayam Buah Keluak was also sugar sweet and the Buah Keluak meat were stuck in the shell and required a lot of digging to get the meat of the Buah Keluak out. This dish is a normal highlight of a Peranakan but it was real disappointment served here.Bendi Kukus was so much different from that shown in the menu. In the menu it looked like Dried spicy prawn toppings but it was served with Sambal Chinchaluk. The Chap Chye was just like stirred fried cabbage - terrible disappointing, this dish is normally a stewed vegetable with shiitake mushroom, black fungus, dried bean curd, carrots, small slices pork belly, prawns in a broth made with fermented soya bean paste. This dish is a complete wash out better called stir fried vegetable to better meet the expectation of an ordered dish.We note that this was porkless restuarant and the likely result of the taste of the food. Peranakan food is not tasty without pork.Dishes like Liver roll or Goh Hian typical Peranakan dish were not served.The Cendol dessert was far from satisfactory as it was fairly diluted and did not have the rich taste of coconut milk with Gula Melaka.Show less

Author: JTSG16Singapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Kueh Pie Tee
Review: Went twice in 2 consecutive days but sisnt manage to get a table as the restaurant was full with advanced bookings. Bought the kueh pie tee as takeaway instead and it was the absolutely delicious! The cup was crispy and freshly fried ingredients moist and the chilli really brought the taste in the radish. Had it again the next day! Sadly the recommended chendol was a letdown. Not enough Gula Melaka and there wasn’t much ingredients. Will return next time with advance booking for a proper meal!Show less

Author: melissasO8016JANew Zealand
Title: Awful just horrible
Review: Awful food, rude, arrogant staff and horrible service. Went into the restaurant and the waiter (a foreigner) shouted at me and demanded if I brought pork into the restaurant. I had some nyonya kueh in a plastic bag which I brought to the restaurant not to eat but to keep it away from the hot sun in my car. I saw everyone was looking at me and I felt humiliated and demanded that the waiter apologise to me. He shouted even louder and tried to justify his behavior. I never felt so publicly humiliated and belittled in my life. The Chinese waitress heard the commotion and simply brushed the incident aside. She let the waiter raved and ranted. I will never go back there. If it weren’t for my guests waiting (they had ordered the food) I would have walked out. The food tasted horrible . Show less

Author: Mimivec
Title: Delicious Nyonya food
Review: It was our first time having lunch here. Found this restaurant thru tripadvisor. We ordered Ayam Tempra, otak-otak & ikan gerang asam. The prices are decent, but the food was good. Ikan Gerang Asam is one of their signature dishes. Recommended!

Author: Steven SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Nyonya Cuisine
Review: Before heading out from Malacca, one of the food that you shouldn’t missed will be Authentic Nyonya Food, hence we have decided to have lunch at Amy Heritage.Small set up but very cosy, reservation done a day earlier with no waiting time on the actual day. This is a very good arrangement.Highly recommended this absolute nice restaurant for Nyonya Food. Would be nice to call and make yourself a confirmed reservation before dropping by as most of the time, it is full! Show less

Author: poonam05
Title: Amazing food
Review: Went twice in a month cause it was just too good. The highlight for me is the fried tofu. Amazing food and good ambiance. Definitely a must visit.

Author: greenham01San Jose, California
Title: Good food, decent prices
