We ordered the fish maw soup, ayam ponteh, chap chye and assam fish (otah otah was sold out) and our children requested for fried chicken and omelette. The order took a while to arrive, but when it did, it did not disappoint. All the dishes were nicely done and were gobbled up by everyone young and old. We had chendol for dessert and that did not disppoint as well.Case to note here - Amy's will hold your reservations for about 15 minutes after which they will release it to those waiting without making a prior reservation.Show less

Author: Allantanbl
Title: Good wholesome taste. A bit on the expensive side. Owner is passionate about the food he serves.
Review: A cultural trip. The food is very peranankan. I have no preference for peranankan food but the taste is interesting.

Author: HyhengSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the worst Peranakan meal I ever had!
Review: Decided to try out Amy because of the rave I've read about it online, and it's nothing like the reviews I've read. The food was less than average and some of the dishes were served barely lukewarm. If the meal couldn't get worse, we had the privilege of a over zealous boss of the restaurant hovering over us dictating what we should order and how we should order. And it doesn't just stop there - he insisted he ran out of some dishes because they are "reserved" for the crowd the following day. When we tried to order just plain sambal petai, he first told us petai is just as expensive as prawns (was he insinuating that we were cheap?), and when we said we don't mind paying the full price but we just want plain sambal petai, he says he doesn't do that because it spoils the dish and petai is a accompaniment to the dish only. To top it off, he keeps raving his food was the best in the whole of Malacca and insisted that we drink the gravy of the curried vegetables and chicken pontang and telling us it's soooooooo special when it's really mediocre. That's really a major turnoff when all we are trying to do is to make the best of the food we have ordered. He also told us that his restaurant is booked out sometimes months or a year in advanced, but when we were there at 8 in the evening, there were only 4 tables in the restaurant. I do not know how that's being booked out.In conclusion, don't waste your time going to this place unless you are in the mood to listen to all the self praises that the boss is loading onto his "famed" restaurant.Show less

Author: SingaporeCatlover88Singapore
Title: My fourth time at this peranakan restaurant and I will still come back again and again..
Review: When in Malacca I wouldn't missed my makan for the world be it lunch or dinner at any of the peranakan restaurants that have been mushrooming all over Malacca particularly in Taman Melaka Raya. I simply take a leisurely stroll from Hatten hotel to my all-time favourite true blue peranakan Amy Heritage Nyonya Cuisine. I can't help but noticed the menu was laminated and new compared the previous one was old and looked antique enough to be sent to Malacca museum for preservation. Again the over-friendly Amy's husband passed the menu and before he could recommend the dishes; I reminded him this wasn't my first time. We ordered our best-loved ayam buah keluak, kerabu bendi (steamed lady's finger top with fresh red chillies shallots and daun limau perut) my personal favourite die die must order. For prawn we tried the sambal tumis udang with petai. We did not call in advance to make reservations which normally is a must if you do not wish to go all the way and be disappointed if the restaurant is fully-booked. We were lucky as we arrived at 6.30pm though there were already walk-in diners but most tables were reserved. Since only the two of us, he was kind enough to accomodate us with a table brought from outside the restaurant set up near the entrance.All the the three dishes served on out tables less than 15minutes. After the last time early last year we had the same food especially ayam buah keluak and the steamed bendi was still superbly good though the sambal udang prawn with petai "not soo pedas". Maybe Amy trying to tone down the spiciness of the sambal tumis. Honestly still the best nyonya food I have had in Malacca and I promised uncle Lim...I'll be back!!!Show less

Author: Daniel20122012Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good flavours
Review: The food was very flavourful and you can taste the generosity of the ingredients in the gravy and sauces. The service was friendly. But please note that you need to book in advance to have a space. I was lucky that I was there very early and they accommodated me. The rice was free flowing which was good as we can soak up the gravies and enjoy with the rice.Show less

Author: szetwinnePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good and affordable Nonya food
Review: On first impression, uncle was quite direct when talking with customer, no wonder people said he is rude. Overall he was quire helpful. Gave recommmendation, came back and check on how we like the food. Most of the tables were reserved, so they help us get a place. The food is delicious, one of the best I had in Malacca. Would come back again. Show less

Author: Jennifer WPittsburgh, Pennsylvania
Title: Amy is the best!
Review: When we arrived in Melaka, we were hungry and looking forward to trying Peranakan food, so we headed straight for Amy's. Amy's was just a short walk from the Holiday Inn and didn't look like anything special from the outside. When we walked through the door, the place was packed with locals and we had to wait for a table. We were warmly welcomed and upon taking our order, Amy's husband insisted on several other dishes that we must try. We like food, so we were all for it! The food was fantastic. My mouth is watering as I write this review! As we were finishing up our meal, I noticed a woman talking with another table. I said hello and complimented the cooking. Turns out it was Amy and she spent the next hour talking to us about her food and travel, both of which intersect often. Our meal at Amy's was the best we had in Melaka!Show less

Author: Gerald KSingapore
Title: Great food!
Review: I was recommended to try this restaurant, and went on the hunt for it. After some searching, I finally found it! It is on the same side of the road as Holiday Inn or Makota Hotel. About a 5-10 min walk from Holiday Inn. I have included a picture of their card with a map of their location.I went on a night that was not crowded, and according to the owner, it was because of pre-election rallies. The owner was very friendly and recommended us to a few dishes to try. We had pie-tee, ikan gerang asam, ayam pongteh, and kangkung kobis keledek masak titik lemak. The food was great, and tasted better than many other nonya restaurants I have tried in Meleka.The owner was also going from table to table talking to the guests and asking how the food was to their taste. He mentioned that he wanted to give 3 things to his customers - (1) good tasty food, (2) good portion of food, and (3) good price. He has certainly delivered on all 3.The little touches like having rice served in a traditional basket, and ice water with a scent of pandan (they most probably soaked pandan leaves in the water) adds to the experience of the restaurant.I will definitely be going back to Amy's on my next trip to Melaka!Show less

Author: pl55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely nonya food prepared a la minute
Review: Apart from the ayam (chicken) pongteh and the udang nanas (pineapple prawns), the other dishes we ordered such as pie tee, chap chye, fried chicken, and cincalok omelette were made to order and they were divine. The pie tee and cincalok omelette were truly outstanding along with the cendol. It was a great idea to order the food when we reserved out table so we did not have to wait long for our food at all. It was also really charming to have the owner-chef, Amy personally serve the dishes. It was really hospital of Amy's husband to provide pineapple tarts on the house and they were so wonderful we had to buy 3 bottles! Go and eat at Amy's when you get a chance before she gets more famous and make it difficult to get a table.Show less

Author: MarshallGivens
Title: No trip to Melaka would be complete without lunch or dinner at Amy's
Review:
Truly amazing, despite everything Amy has done she is still working away in the kitchen and talking to visitors. 

The food and service here is outstanding no matter what you have you will be blown away.

Author: Littlepods18
Title: Must try!
Review: This you must book in advance. The assam fish dish is a must try. All their dishes ingredients are fresh - you can just taste it! And the portion is huge for the small size one too!

Author: tsashiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not as great as expected
Review: Perhaps because we have been eating in many places in Melaka, we found the food here is nice but not different or special compared to others. Attentive owner, but other staff need some courtesy training, we were asked (rather rudely) why we came earlier than our booking time. Not that they are full at the time we arrived. Overall the food is OK, nothing to complain nor praise a lot. Quality of ingredients is evident, thus the food was considered OK. Owner was honest in explaining the food menu, so we don't end up ordering and paying for food we wouldn't like. Do watch for coconut milk infused food, if you don't like them. Limited items on the menu is another point to note.Show less

Author: ShehYPKuala Lumpur
Title: Absolutely LOUSY service.
Review: After reading all the good reviews of this restaurant, I decided to patronized this restaurant on my visit to Melaka. To my absolutely disappointment, the service was really lousy. I walked into the restaurant and sat on a the empty seat but nobody approach to pass me the menu or ask what I need for 15 minutes. When they finally pass the menu to me, I was told that I need to wait an hour for my order to be served! How ridiculous can this be? They are in the food business and don't they know that a hungry man is an angry man? I was told that there 3 table do not have their dinner served yet and mine would be after these 3 tables. 3 tables for an hour! If they know that they are so well known, why not hire more helper in the kitchen. So arrogant just because they are famous. Don't forget that without customers, they cannot be famous today.Show less

Author: Adrian BOxford
Title: Very good food; very good service
Review: The best nyonya food in Melaka:fresh-tasting and delicious; not oily or heavy. The nuts in the ayam buah keluak were not of the old and rather dried-up kind one is sometimes given in Singapore. The banana flower salad was tremendous. A lovely experience. And exceptional value for money.Show less

Author: QuaySmithTravellersAscot, United Kingdom
Title: Out of the way
Review: Lots of great reviews for this restaurant, so decided to try it out for lunch. Having read the reviews we asked Amy's husband for his advice, which was the correct approach. He suggested we start with "Top Hat" as a starter, beautifully made light pastry "hat" with light, tasty filling. The fried chicken wings and thighs were cooked to perfection, crisp on the outside, juicy meat. A result of 12 minutes slow frying. The noodles were very good too.Show less

Author: Belchua
Title: Surprise n fantastic food! Must try n good food must come with patience!!
Review: Went for lunch on 28th feb after reading many reviews on trip advisors of this restaurant. Although there were many comments on Amy's husband being rude instead I felt he was very good n friendly. He had provided us with lots of food recommendations in Teochew and he would also preempt us not to order too much in case we could not finish bcos there were so much food we would like to try. In fact, I would advice people who loves nonya food to try the food at this restaurant but only go if you have the time n patience to wait as some food requires at least 30mins of waiting time. Highly recommend the mixed vegetables in coconut curry, the chicken pongteh n the deep fried beancurd with spicy sauce. Will definitely make a trip there again when in melaka!!Show less

Author: Middlehamlass
Title: Best food we had in Malaysia
Review: We enjoyed our meal so much yesterday that we went back this evening and would return again if we were staying in Melaka. Amy has gained such recognition and has numerous awards for her cooking and rightly so, as her food is delicious. Her husband was very helpful guiding us through the menu to ensure we had a balanced meal (& didnt order too much). Excellent value at £13 for our food and soft drinks yesterday and £14 tonight for both of us!Show less

Author: ClerkenwellLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Thank you Amy
Review: We came here having read the Trip Advisor reviews. It seems that service is variable. On our visit, Amy's husband was not that helpful but, when the lady of the house attended our table, the experience improved dramatically.The restaurant is situated on a stretch of reclaimed land near the Holiday Inn. It took our taxi a few minutes to find the exact location. We booked late (9pm) and some dishes were running out so we didn't get the full selection. What we had was fresh, tasty and different to our well travelled palates. Luckily we were in a relatively large group so we sampled a large proportion of the menu. It will not disappoint,When you are in Melaka, you have to try Nyonyan cuisine. On our long-weekend here, Amy's was the best. It won't be your cheapest meal in Melaka but it will be your favourite.Show less

Author: Connoisseur2012Ampang, Malaysia
Title: A meal served with genuine pride
Review: My family and I visited the restaurant for lunch on Tuesday 5th February. Beforehand we read the review that said the owner was rude but as we could not find another restaurant open offering local cuisine we took the risk. I can only assume the person who accused the owner of being rude confused the restaurant with somewhere else. From our initial telephone call to make a booking, through giving our order, with the owner giving his recommendations to the actual service, the whole experience was as impressive as the food. In fact during our meal the owner came over to chat and showed genuine interest in our opinions on his recommendations. The "rude man" must be at another restaurant. The man here was pleasant, rightly proud of his wife's cooking and interested in his customers views.Show less

Author: makanaginSingapore
Title: Traditional Perankan Food
Review: Took a while to locate this place, but no regrets. Good traditional peranakan meal at a reasonable price. We are a party of 3. Ordered Ayam Buah Keluak, Udang nanas lemak, itek tim soup, kangkong fried chillie and kueh pie tee. For deserts we had chendol and tapeh. Udang nanas (pineapple) lemak was our favourite. The gravy was really lemak and thick (goes extremely well with the rice) with a tinge of sweet/sour taste from the nanas. The prawns were fresh but a little small. Would have been better with larger prawns. Kueh pie tee was our other favourite. The casing was thin and goes very well with the fillings. The tapeh (fermented glutinous rice) was a refreshing change. Not many places offer this nowadays.The elderly gentleman who served us was knowledgeable and would comment on our orders and make his recommendations. He can appear to be a little grumpy but when we started to talk with him, he opens up and is quite friendly. He is obviously proud and passionate about his food offerings and even explains how a dish should be eaten. Take his advise and you will enjoy your meal.The place is nice but can be a little noisy when there is a large crowd. The acoustics could be improved.Tried many Peranakan restaurants in Melaka over the years. Amy Heritage Nyonya Cuisine is certainly one of the better ones on my list.Show less

Author: Coylum
Title: Great experience
Review: We had a variety of dishes and they were all very good. The place was packed, so you should always reserve at weekends because of the Singapore crowd.

Author: thor069
Title: Worth try
Review: Only one "Rude Man" served the customer (taking order, food suggestion, giving bill). I recommend you to come early as 1130 for lunch and 1800 for dinner to avoid dissapointment for a bit slow service..Overall the food is GOOD and the "Rude Man" (as said by the other reviewer) is very NICE and FRIENDLY ;-)Show less

Author: A NKuala Lumpur
Title: Nyonya cuisine is exotic!
Review: I have been there a couple of times. Before going it appears to be a hassle as Mr Lim is a pretty tense person. He insists on knowing the time and will tell us the last order to be taken by a certain time etc. But once we arrive he is a changed person! All friendly and relaxed. The cook Amy is chatty and will recommend her signature Nyonya dishes. We love the asam fish, "jantung" salad, chicken pongteh, steamed ladies' fingers, and pi tee. Have not tried other Nyonya places in Malacca but we are happy to visit this place again, albeit having to overcome our Mr Lim again!Show less

Author: BerniechiahumphriesSingapore, Singapore
Title: SPOIL NONYA FOOD IMAGE
Review: We were at Amy Delight Restaurant 3 days ago for dinner. Owner recommeded us Ayam Pongteh, kangkong with Cabbage masak Lemak, Sambal Udang with Pedai. Shocked to see Ayam Pongteh cooked with Potatoes instead of Bamboo Shoots. Sambal Udang with Pedai looked more like Shrimps with Pedai. Nothing special about their Kobis Kangkong masak Lemak. There's wasn't any taste of Chinchalok in the Chinchalok Omelette except onions.The Portion was quite small and not presentatable and also not cheap, May be those haven't tasted real Nonya Food like from Aunty Lee Restoran nearby Portugese Settement yet will think this is good but I wouldn't mind paying abit more to get eat Authentic Nonya Food instead of eating this disgraceful so called Nonya Food. Not worth it at all.Show less

Author: Sgp_traveller74Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good for big groups but always book in advance
Review: Generally the food is above average and the prices are reflective of its quality. Located right in the heart of "downtown", it is well-positioned to attract the hungry who is staying in one of the 5star hotels in the vicinity.Do reserve well in advance as the owner has the habit of turning people away.Show less

Author: 412khimKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Nyonya Food
Review: Went there 4 days ago. The owner was friendly. He was not rude like what other claims but he was a passionate babas who love and proud of his authenticity of nyonya food. He introduced and recommended few dishes for us and there were excellent!! Pai-tee, ayam pongteh, kangkung sambal, petai prawns, kobis kangkung masak lemak, asam fish were superb. Whole family finished all the dishes even the sauce was not spared!!Cincalok omelete so so.Show less

Author: Chin-PinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good Peranakan food!!!
Review: Was there two days ago with our friends, altogether 4 adults and 3 kids. Had ayam pongteh, sambal lady's finger, petai prawns, fried calamari and sambal kangkong which were excellent. Fried chicken wings and cincalok egg were mediocre. It was food cooked and served with sincerity!! All in all a very good meal! Show less

Author: SCL091213Singapore
Title: Friendly guy,lovely food and anecdotes of ungrateful people
Review: Fantastic food and excellent curry, apparently their curry powder is home-made. Mr Lim, the owner,was friendly and welcoming even though they were fully booked that day. He took the initiative to recommend us first-timers good food and told us abt some people who rudely brushed his kind advice on ordering food, which cracked us up. AWESOME FOOD:) SUCH GOOD FOOD IS WORTH THE LONG DRIVE FROM SG:) P.S listen to his advice and you'll enjoy your meal!Show less

Author: VJKAheartTRAVELSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic nonya food
Review: This was an accidental find that I stumbled upon. Lost from finding another restaurant we decided to try this restaurant. It was a pleasant surprise! We ordered pie tee, buah keluak, chap chye n sambal udang petai. It was the best nonya food we had in Melaka! Simply loved the ayam buah keluak - very tasty! My kids loved the slight spicy sauce and chicken. If you only have time for one restaurant - try this! Reasonable prices with very authentic real unpretentious nonya food!!Show less

Author: SuyinOoi
Title: One of the best Nyonya food in town
Review: Absolutely loved the food, value for money, came in huge portions. Recommended to make reservations, you might not be lucky with getting a table without reservation.

Author: serena8313Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: food delicious but service needs improvements
Review: the food is very tasty and some dishes were pretty unique (kobis/kangkung/sweet potato masak lemak). the chef/owner amy is friendly and nice but her hubby (who takes orders) is quite snobbish and not customer oriented. he wont be happy if you dont agree with his suggestions or request for things which go against his wishes. despite this, we will still go for the food and put up with his unfriendly service cos we really enjoy her food.Show less

Author: tyxiangKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Worst service, overpriced small portion food!!
Review: One of the worst eating experience ever! There was this RUDE elderly man taking our orders. Might be amy's husband, god knows.He has all the excuses given when we gave our opinions about food or environment.Their cendol failed badly, I was given with big chunch of ice, while the classic ones come with shreded ice. He explained that it is original way of doing it, while having a photo hanging on the wall showing the shreded ice. He even tell me off that if i want shreded ice, feel free to visit other restaurant down the roads.When ask about the warm temperature, he refused to turn on additional air conditioner.All in all, food taste normally, the portion is too small for an expensive price.DO NOT VISIT THIS RESTAURANT!!!Show less

Author: HannTi_TanPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Very authentic!
Review: Amy Heritage came recommended due to the authenticity of their cuisine, and it was only 10 minutes drive from Equatorial Hotel. Their specialties included the following:- Pai Tee- Hee Peow Soup- Kangkung Kobis Keledek Masak Titik Lemak (tongue twister!)- Ikan Gerang Asam- Udang Sambal PetaiThis restaurant truly stands out from the competition in nearby Malacca Raya township and is a must-try, for those of you looking for the unique Malacca cuisine called Nyonya food!Show less

Author: Ee Guan L
Title: Food is good
Review: Pity it's Halal though, would have loved to have eaten the very good Buah Keluak with Pork Ribs instead of chicken.

Author: Alexander TMelbourne, Australia
Title: Epic.
Review: This was my second trip to Melaka and after being unable to locate the restaurant the first trip - by myself and without a SatNav in the rental car, this trip I located it - and believe me, this meal was not just worth the drive from KL to Melaka, but was actually worth the Flight from Australia.On a scale of 1 to Mariah Carey, this meal broke glasses and registered 10 in the amazing scale. I'm very aware of the amazing range of food Malaysia has to offer, especially Nyonya and Perenakan cuisine, however this meal - shared between six of us, got the vote from all of us as the best meal we may ever possibly have. Amy the owner is a beautiful person and is passionate about her culture and food and invites you to experience it through a gastronomic adventure you are unlikely to dismiss, forget - and that you are likely to savour, enjoy and lust for. We were puzzled as to what to order as everything, EVERYTHING on the menu looks delicious and I could have ordered two of, however Amy helpfully suggested many of her favourites and we were lucky enough that the market had exceptional ingredients that morning that we were about to trial several items that aren't always available. Cannot recommend this restaurant enough, it is absolutely worth the find.Show less

Author: YongT
Title: Great food, long wait.
Review: Food's good. Call in advance to make appointment and arrive early! Food is served by the table, the first to arrive / order get the food first and so on.

Author: OzgirlNswNSW
Title: The real deal
Review: Another overdue review. My long awaited trip to Malaysia was partly inspired by cooking shows. Rick Stein had visited this restaurant as had Poh (Po's Kitchen ABC TV Australia) I had also read about it in several wonderful food blogs including Grab Your Fork - lots of wonderful photos on thier blog. And yet it wasn't on TA at the time. What was the go with that? Well it seemed that while it was not on the tourist radar it was well and truly loved by foodies and locals. I was so determined to eat here that I made sure to be in Melaka when it was open and got my hotel to book 2 months in advance! We were even waiting on the doorstep when they opened up. To be honest if I was just walking past I probably keep going. There is no attempt to lure customers in with faux heritage, just a pristine, almost austere modern interior. I have heard Nyonya home makers take great pride in maintaining a spotlessly clean home and kitchen and that is evident at Amy's. Uncle was extremely welcoming and helpful in making suggestions, although we ignored his advice somewhat and ordered three dishes with "gravy" or as we would call it in Aus, curry sauce. We were very hungry and greedy! The food did not disappoint. I had the dish of our whole trip here, the prawns and pineapple curry. Beautiful balance of flavours. I could not leave any of the delicious gravy so I almost made myself sick, but in a good, food coma inducing way. We also had a nyonya delicacy, chicken with black nuts, and really enjoyed it. The flavour of the nuts is very earthy, a little like a cross between mushrooms and black olives. The top hat appetiser was also delish, very pretty and delicate but with a lovely flavour and texture. Uncle was so happy that we enjoyed the food and when we told him that we had heard great things about Amy he ushered her from the kitchen and introduced us. She then sent out a small container of a special rice dessert which is not actually on the menu. It tasted almost like rice in cointreau but we were assured the only ingredient is rice which is left to ferment. It was delicious. One plus about eating in Muslim resaturants is the opportunity to try local drinks which were really refreshing.(I will be honest, we would normally go straight for a local beer) The other thing that made Amy's the standout experience was the quality of the ingredients. Everything was of the highest grade, something which we take for granted at home and are sometimes disappointed by when we travel. We loved Melaka and would happily return. If we do I hope to find Amy still preparing fabulous food in her kitchen.Show less

Author: 78slimSydney, Australia
Title: Authentic Nyonya
Review: It took a while for us to locate the restaurant but it was certainly worth the effort. The food met all our expectations. The otak-otak was excellent, pork dish fantastic, sambal dishes of fish, prawns were great. There was this fragrance from well blended herbs and spices which was typical of Nyonya food in all the dishes . I did not rate the ayam ponteh as being very good but the rest of the group loved it. Amy was there and was very helpful in recommending dishes to suit our taste. We cannot fault the service. If we are in Malacca again, we'll definitely have another meal there..Show less

Author: sicha123Kampar, Malaysia
Title: highly recommended
Review: when we 1st reach Melaka we wanted to try a Baba Nyonya cuisine. but as a halal patrons, theres not much of a choice. a friend recommended us to Amy Heritage Nyonya Cuisine. we went there on saturday. the restaurant is full we didnt make any reservation. but lucky for us, a table for two was available. the owner is super friendly. and the food picked by him is superb. might just travel back to Melaka again just for the food :)Show less

Author: swordfish01Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food
Review: A few point to note about this Nyonya Restaurant:1) Go early, I think it can get quite full.2) Order what the boss recommends, you will not be let down.3) Business hours: 11.30am- 2.30pm and 6pm-10pm4) We were recommended with this dishes : Ayam curry, Kangkung Kobis Keledek Masak Titik Lemak, Pie Tee, Sambal Udang (Minus the Petai as we felt it kind of strong taste). All the dishes were superb in taste, you got to eat them with rice which is serve with the items. I have never tasted such tasty Nyona food, period.5) The shop area is not busy, ample parking space if you around after 6pm that is if you are driving. 6) Both husband and wife are really nice people, they came and explain in detail of the food we ordered, they made a deal with us that we pay only if we like the taste...:)7) They adjust the food portion well according to the number of people eating.8) The price was reasonable.Overall cant wait to go back again and try the balance 34 dishes yet to try.Thank you.Show less

Author: BartsinSinga
Title: Awesome Nyonya food and experience
Review: We were recommended this restaurant but were told that we would struggle to get a seat. Sure enough, the "Full House" sign was up when we arrived. After talking to Amy, she agreed to let our group of 5 in after waiting for a table to cleared and set. What a wonderful experience. We allowed Amy to recommend and select our dishes for us and all were superbly cooked and presented. Amy spend time with us explaining the dishes and her experiences. All in all, a most enjoyable evening and the highlight of our stay in Melaka. I would hightly recommend this restaurant to anyone.Show less

Author: Cliff6108
Title: True blue peranakan cuisine!
Review: Being a 5th generation peranakan from Melaka, I'm blessed with mom who is an excellent cook so I can fully recommend Aunty Amy's cuisine to all who wish to have a taste of authentic nyonya food! Aunty Amy's cuisine is just like mom's!

Author: ar_sgpWoodlands
Title: New nyonya restaurant to check out
Review: Decided to check this place out on the recommendation of some friends who had been there earlier this year. It was not easy to locate (even locals we stopped along the way were not sure where the road they were located on was). When we finally found it, they had closed! So we returned on that evening and had dinner there. They were helpful with their recommendations and even though they said that the food would take 20 minutes, it came fast. Quality of food was very good - a bit more "lemak" than some other places we had tried. It was also not as spicy - perhaps to cater to customers who are unfamiliar with nyonya food. Overall, worth checking out. Show less

Author: CeciltongSingapore
Title: Glad we found it
Review: Having heard so much about it, we managed to find it on our last trip. It is located on the same side of the road as Holiday Inn and behind (but Mahkota Medical Centre). We have eaten in several other Peranakan restaurants in Melaka in the last decade but this stands out. The ingredients are fresh and the serving are freshly cooked. This is probably because Amy was there to ensure consistency in quality. We understand that Amy and her husband would go to the market daily to get their ingredients. Even my wife, who is Peranakan and a competent cook herself, thought highly of the quality of the cooking. We had the chicken ponteh and the sambal fried fish and they were excellent. The ponteh was far superior to another we had on the same but at another restaurant. If you are there for the first time, ask Amy to recommend. Given that they are hallal, we noticed quite a number of Malay families dining at the restaurant. This could become one of our "must eat at" places on our yearly trips to Melaka.Show less

Author: allansakhoo
Title: Authentic & addictive
Review: We went for dinner on two consecutive nights just to sample the different nyonya dishes but were quite disappointed that one of the signature dishes, Buah Keluak had been sold out. We were told that a week of advance order was required. When we arrived at 7pm, the whole place was already packed and we were glad we had a reservation. The nyonya dishes were really authentic and tasty. They only cook to order so that every dish is served fresh. Their Udang Masak Lemak, Pon Teh, Chap Chai, Udang Goreng Assam and Pucuk Pisang were deliciously addictive. For dessert, the cendol is a must. Besides the great tasting food, the service is slow but it's worth the wait. If you love pineapples tarts, they keep minimum stocks, supplied by a friend. We love both Auntie & Uncle, who are always smiling no matter how busy they are!Show less

Author: Cammal_BrownBoyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Yummy Nyonya food!
Review: I stumble upon Amy's restaurant after looking for 'halal' (pork free) nyonya restaurant in Melacca via google. It is located in Taman Melaka Raya and easy to find from the main street and with the help of my Garmin gps :). There are parking lots in front of the restaurant as it is located in shoplot business area. I went there with a group of friends for lunch on a Sunday in April 2012. We reached there around 12pm so we managed to get a table for 5 of us. The restaurant has limited number of tables so its worth coming early. We ordered Pie Tee, Otak-Otak, Nyonya Chicken Curry, Kangkung Kobis Keledek Masak Titik Lemak, Udang goreng Asam, sambal belacan and off course rice. It took about 40minutes for all the food to be delivered to our table which is rather long. There were few other tables who came before us who also waited for their food for a while. The food tasted good and delicious and I would say worth the wait. The portion of the food is just nice for 5 of us. Honestly, I think they should do something to speed up their food delivery as it took quite a long time. Other than that, we were happy with the service here. The uncle who took our order gave good recommended and was very friendly.Show less

Author: Letranger90Hong Kong, China
Title: Don't go to Melaka on a Monday, when they're closed.
Review: Good Nyonya (a fusion of Chinese and Malay/Indonesian) food isn't as easy to find as it should be but the slightly challenging streets ot the reclaimed-from-the-sea estate Amy's is located in are absolutely worth navigating.The excellent manager recommended that four dishes - Udang Lemak Nenas, Telur Dadar Cincaluk, Ayam Pongteh and Chap Chye - would be enough for four of us so we could enjoy the deserts including Cendol. We couldn't resist ordering two more - Ayam Buah Keluah and Toufu Goreng. Together with desert it cost about US$10 a person!Don't go to Melaka on a Monday, when they're closed.Show less

Author: misssk
Title: Authentic, good value, delicious.
Review: Very popular among locals, the food is fantastic. The flavours are explosive, with the combination of different spices used. Some dishes can be spicy but i'm sure can be adjusted for different tastes. Don't forget dessert! Definitely worth a visit!

Author: dayangmarKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Homey
Review: at first i thought it was going to be one of those typical tourist eatery but i was so wrong. it felt so homey almost as if its just your next door kopitiam. it wasnt a full house when i went there which was great for me, and my family. eventhough we didnt know anyone there but the other customers were all smiles and talking to the owners as if they have known them a lifetime. even i had a few chats here and there and didnt feel like an outsider. maybe due to its small size dining area which makes it more intimate and cozy. food was great too and very affordable. since it has limited space u might be waiting long for a seat if you are there during peak season.Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Memories of days gone by
Review: Place offers popular Malay breakfast and brunch fare. One can get really engrossed in arrays of antiques this shop displays. Parking is difficult as its just next to the touristy Jonker Walk. Beware: parking is chargeable in Melaka town on Saturday and Sunday so be sure to have your parking coupons ready. Theres the river-walk behind the shop.Sayyid also offers unique traditional Malay house accommodation about 1km away.Show less

Author: Justalhafiz
Title: Must visit
Review: Fried rice feels like home cooked. Rustic cafe with antiques but well cleaned. A little gem in the heart of Melaka.

Author: syabilazman
Title: Best option for breakfast in jonker
Review: I like the shop concept.i have been told before they selling food they just operated the business as a antique shop..its a best option for those looking cafe run by muslim owner.overall the food nice.

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: Almost a museum
Review: Wandered in for breakfast and the place was chock full of old items and memorabilia which will rekindle fond recollections of how things looked like years ago. Food choice was limited on a basic menu and prices reasonable, so not necessarily to go there on a foodie run. More of a curiosity respite for a tourist doing the area.Show less

Author: P'zah CMalaysia
Title: Great Choice for Breakfast
Review: We went on a Public Holiday and they were open. It was already full house 30 minutes after opening. Our orders came quickly; full marks there. We had the Nasi Lemak with Fried Chicken, Lontong and toast. The Sambal is delicious, the Lontong just the right amont of everything. The deco brings you back in time. Prices were reasonable so you could order anything you wanted to eat. They are able to seat party of up to 5 so families eat here comfortably. Will totally recommend and come again.Show less

Author: iiTEBUiiSegamat, Malaysia
Title: Great place for Breakfast
Review: Went at 9am in the morning. Not too many people at the time. Food prepared quite quickly.I had the Nasi lemak with Ayam Rendang and it was one of the best Nasi Lemak experience that i have had.My friend had the Nyonya Laksa and she also was very satisfied with the taste of it.Will definitely come here again and recommed it to other people to visit this eatery.Show less

Author: 725mariahiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Thrown back to yester years cafe...
Review: Local menu but limited seats. A very friendly owner..he would just sit beside u while taking orders and chat after done eating. But what intrigue me most are the antiques !! Feeling of time travel being thrown back. A good sight esp for my kid who has never seen all those things of yester years.. Btw... tasty home cooked food.. :)Show less

Author: amirajefry
Title: HIGHLY recommended
Review: i found this cafe was full of antiques, and i feel like im being at the old time. friendly and nice Pakcik and Makcik there 😍 we just happy to be there at first place 💖

Author: Ruslena
Title: Local culinary breakfast
Review: Love this family run antique shop cum breakfast cafe. Menu is limited but it has all the local flavours. Tables are limited so come early! Opening hours 8am onwards.

Author: JosieM958
Title: Antique shop and a cafe - one treasured place
Review: The look from the outside of the shop is very subtle. Out of curiosity, I step inside of the shop and immediately mesmerized by the collections. You feel like you are transported back in the old time full of memories. I lam impressed with their selection of food, limited but prepared with full of love. I had my afternoon coffee here twice. Recommended!Show less

Author: Getaway763968
Title: a memorable breakfast at a unique cafe
Review: So impressive to spend breakfast time here and food price is cheap.  So closed to our hotel.  And  the owner and his wife so friendly and humble. When we will go to malacca again. I'll be sure to come back. To enjoy eat her laksa.

Author: Tiffany_traveller
Title: Nice homely breakfast
Review: We had breakfast here and it feels like stepping into someone living room and having a meal. Come for the mee soto!

Author: Aisyah S
Title: Satisfying Breakfast Amidst 'Antique' Ambience
Review: The cafe opens from 8am to 5pm so it is an ideal place for breakfast if you want an early start touring/browsing Melaka. Had a delicious breakfast of Melaka Nyonya Laksa (a noodle dish) and tauhu sumbat (tofu filled with cucumber slices served with chili). The couple who run the place are friendly. The memorabilias all over the shop are the owners' collection over the years. Lovely ambience to have a meal. Show less

Author: T SJupiter, Florida
Title: Delicious Afternoon Snack
Review: Stopped by around 4pm and ordered Nasi Lemak and Lorong with two teh terek. The food had great flavor and was filling.The owners are super friendly and the total bill was just over RM12. The cafe is located inside an old shop with antiques and toys. If you are in this area, don't miss itShow less

Author: Donald M
Title: Great food and friendly owners
Review: The cafe used to be an antique shop and I guess still is in a way as there's loads of cool stuff to look at which can also be bought.A real treasure shop..not just for antiques but for the great food.Soto, Lontong, Nasi Lemak are all great and at 4 to 5 MYR is very cheap.Mainly used by locals it only has a few tables but you'll always be welcomed by the friendly people who eat there..just sit at their table if there's a spare seat.Drinks are very cheap at 1.50myr for a kopi '0' iced drink.I was taken here by a local friend and we've been back numerous times.Closed on Tuesday and Wednesday... remaining days it closes around 5pmShow less

Author: Antony MGreat Malvern, United Kingdom
Title: Great find.
Review: Wandering around on our first day in Mallaka we were looking for a bite for lunch. Peeping inside we saw mixed nationality groups at tables eating in what looked like an antiques shop. The fact it was busy invited us in. Set lunch dishes, we had delicious laksa and iced lime juice. I think the laksa was 5 ringgits. We were also presented with a gratis slice of cake. Yes it's quirky, yes it's clean, and yes it's great value. The tasty food was great too. Thanks to the lovely friendly couple running this outlet.Show less

Author: HappyTravellller
Title: Breakfast must come here
Review: This is a very cool place for people who like antique. I was glad that I found this place for breakfast. Not only do they serve good n filling breakfast, they also sell antique as well from cutleries to CDs

Author: yanamohamed
Title: Tasty Food & Unique Ambience
Review: Everything is awesome about this cafe! The antique items are all such an eye opener and the food are all reasonably price and is finger licking. Do pay this cafe a visit when you are in Malacca/Jonker Street, its definitely worth your time.

Author: nurshasenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice, antique cafe
Review: We stumbled upon this place as we were looking for halal breakfast. The owner himself pointed it out to us. Quite difficult to find halal breakfast in Jonker. Food was great. Simple, local breakfast. You can choose between soto, lontong, nasi lemak, laksa. There were also popiah basah and fried noodles.Owner and his wife were really friendly. The place was welcoming. The cafe doesn't open everyday though. We were there on a Sunday.Show less

Author: HelenappleColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: Great food, friendly owner
Review: We came across this place whilst looking for a late lunch place. The decor is fabulously quirky, with numerous antique and retro objects on display, which kept one of us occupied for a long time. Food was delicious - made by the owner's wife and spot on. And very cheap. Well worth searching this place out - it's a couple of minutes off the main tourist drag so quieter and more relaxed. Show less

Author: Rockstones
Title: Great place for breakfast
Review: We chanced upon this gem on our way for breakfast. Was enjoying their antiques while waiting for our orders. Their sambal chilli for Nasi Lemak was so good. Nyonya laksa was special. Good food and great price! Highly recommended!

Author: Rebekka T
Title: Good laksa, friendly staff
Review: We were looking for a good laksa and that was what we found here. At a very reasonable price! The surroundings are just perfect, sitting in an old antique shop and the owners really friendly. We feel lucky we found this place.

Author: NashrA3
Title: Food price is reasonable too!
Review: Food is lovely, nyonya laksa, soto and nasi lemak. Food price is reasonable too! Eat and shop antiques!

Author: MrBulp
Title: Hooray!!! Happy 1st Year Anniversary Opening!!!
Review: This Sayyid Antique + Cafe are just celebrate its 1st year cafe opening & i must said that it is NO. 1 of my favourite eating to have brunch everytime im hangout at Harmony Street.. :) tips - ask for Ice Lemon Tea with "sour plum" as its not on the menu. :)Show less

Author: 359mattt
Title: Lovely place
Review: Very friendly owners, authentic nasi lemak perfectly cooked (just look at the rice). Nice sambal too!!

Author: Bee4
Title: One of the last few remaining antiques shops left.
Review: Melaka has long been famous for it's antiques and junk shops selling mainly Victoriana imported from England before Independence.  Also sell antique local furniture and Chinese porcelain.  Mostly genuine old things.

Author: NadiaCarolyn
Title: Breakfast in the past
Review: Eat and enjoy artifacts of the modern era.  Great ambience and value for money for its central location.  Friendly owner and the only breakfast area which is not crowded.

Author: Astroboy2014Melaka, Malaysia
Title: nice Asam Pedas mahyong Sedap
Review: Lovely couple serve lontong, myonya Laksa Mee soto All is the best . Must try the black tea with lychee is so nice i frequent when there for my lepak place . And also the popiah Basah is so nice yummy to eat Best time to go there from 9am to 5pmOpen from Thursday To Sundaya lot of antique collectionShow less

Author: FazillahBadarulKlang, Malaysia
Title: Purely vintage environment with good food
Review: Recently, having my breakfast with an antique items and Malaysian old song playing back to back is purely vintage experienceStrongly recommend this cafe which offer affordable price for breakfast and good environmentNasi lemak cost around RM 4, ice tea around RM 2 and must try spring roll for RM 1.80 serve with delicious home made sauceAlthough the space is quite small mixing with selling vintage item . It's neat and food taste good.Show less

Author: DKokBS
Title: Good variety
Review: Restaurant very near to Hatten Hotel. Walking distance. Nice experience to seat "on the floor" like the koreans to have a meal with family and friends. The rice wine is must try.

Author: infinityy2015
Title: Expensive but big portion
Review: All serve in very big portion. Free side dishes like kimchi,brocolli and salad etc.Pancake is quite costy compare to other korean store.The ginseng soup not so recommend because have rice inside and cause the taste ran out.

Author: sweel980
Title: Nothing change, except the price
Review: Patronising this many years, good food, good service, always enjoyable. Nothing change over the years, except the price, everytime price increase. Getting ex.

Author: laviosar
Title: Happy gather
Review: Happy gather with my besty sis and cousin.. Although just short time but its great.. Miss the time that we gather together... Awesome

Author: hyacinthp2016
Title: Excellent staff and generous serving of food!!!!!
Review: Me and my cousin like to eat and try new Korean cuisine;we’re just looking for a place to eat where it can fill our stomach. At first, we’re quiet hesitant to enter this place and we thought it’s a buffet lunch. But the server approached us with a genuine smile and guide us to our table. We just ordered a gal bi tang,steamed pork and kimchi jigae (hoping I’m correct with the spelling). But we are surprised that they even gave us something to eat before our mains and we must say that it’s really a huge portion. And they never failed us to render the service we needed. The food was really superb and delectable to our palate. Kimchi too delicious. All the food with a huge serving. I will definitely and recommend this place not for just a Korean food lover,for the food blogger and for the tourist who wants a to satisfy their tummy. Show less

Author: Meander59867734550
Title: Korean food in Malacca
Review: Very good service , i like their budae jjigae so much, foods are fresh and yummy... Will be back here again! Nice food and Nice staff! Worth to try

Author: yisiewtSingapore, Singapore
Title: Short trip
Review: One of my favorite Korean BBQ restaurant . Always visit the one in Jb Bukit Indah so wanted to try this stall . Customer service very good . Food wise not as good as the one in Indah . Free seafood pancake and steam eggs for the kids . Show less

Author: Boonology
Title: Good food, even better service!
Review: Was there for a family dinner. The food was good. But more importantly the service was superb. They gave free pancakes for the adults, and steam eggs for the kids. While these are inexpensive food items, it’s the thought and attention to details that made us happy customers.Show less

Author: marilyne2375
Title: good food
Review: good choices of food available. ample amount of side dishes. portions of main dishes are very filling. staff are very efficient, friendly and helpful

Author: EviaChiaSingapore, Singapore
Title: First and last to visit this restaurant
Review: In fact, my friend wanna try this restaurant and myself has no confident of this restaurant. At the end we tried, has a terrible experienced. We ordered Toufu soup, pancake and fried squid. Only fried squid we felt not bad, the rest of food not authentic, not nice and the worst is we saw the baby cockroach climbing to us while we eating our dinner Show less

Author: KLCLCCSingapore
Title: Kimchi fried rice spoiled our day!
Review: We went there during Valentine's day, the kimchi fried rice tasted so bad! It was not fully cooked and the taste was so terrible! Service was poor as well. I have been to DaoRae many times in Ipoh and KL and the service and food were excellent. Hope Melaka branch can improve your service and food quality.Show less

Author: 70SYT
Title: Taste better than the Bukit Indah Johor Outlet
Review: The meat for grillings taste good but the price for a bowl of rice is on the high side (RM 5). Service are fast and friendly

Author: Charles TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good value and friendly staff
Review: We enjoyed our lunch at this place and the Korean manager was very warm and welcoming. The food was served promptly and the set meals offer great value. The a la carte dishes come with complimentary side dishes served in generous portions. The shoju was good value at RM 25 per bottle.Show less

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Best Korean Food in Town
Review: Have been there for few times. The foods are nice and service is superb. Love the way they grill the pork meat on your table instead of done it in the kitchen just bring it out. Free pancake and lollipop will be provided.

Author: tomaaaaaatoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth it, will not recommend
Review: Had 3 items, bimbimbap, squid BBQ and pork BBQ. Total came up to 120rm which is pricey especially what u can get around. Squid and bimbimbap were decent, pork (said to be marinated) had no marinade whatsoever and bland, small dishes were below par as well. Will not returnShow less

Author: AsianFoodGeekSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed
Review: I was craving for Korean BBQ. I used to go to Daorae in from Penang. Love their food and service. Therefore I choose this branch in Melaka intend to get my crave fix...who knows it turned up to be the worst Korean BBQ experience I ever had. I was so surprised that the food quality here is far behind the other two other branches in Penang. The side dishes were poorly prepared, nothing was up to standard. We started our meal about 9.15pm and the lights were off at 10pm. One of the worker came to us to pass us a tea candle that can't contribute much to the darkness. We have to use the lights from our phone to light up the place to continue eating. The Korean man who was at the cashier when We walked in (whom I assumed was the branch manager) came to us about 10.25pm and said 'Sorry, we have problem. We have to close now. Sorry.' And he disappeared right after he said what he needs to say. The fact is they are supposed to close at 11pm, should at least check if we are ready to leave before forcing us to go. Left us with no choice but leave immediately. Our shoes were placed on the shoes rack, the corridor was in total darkness and all the workers were busy cleaning the floor, everywhere was flooded and no one assist us to get out from the restaurant. Again we have to use our own torchlight to find our shoes. As we walked out from the flooded restaurant, the staircase were all wet and flooded the workers were cleaning the staircase too. We have to walk cautiously and of course at our own risk down to the ground floor. Such a bad experience. There are so many other choices around this area, much regretted with my choice. Bad service, side dishes were not up to standard and poor management. I hope other Daorae brunches are keeping their standard up.Show less

Author: joeyfun81
Title: MSG beef soup & lousy cold noodle
Review: Ordered the above two and was very much disappointed. The soup was horrible. Can't drink and the beef was tough meat. The cold noodle is not cold and the staff cut like cutting for baby food. Wouldn't visit again.

Author: TorbenundSuFrankfurt, Germany
Title: Good food, friendly service, reasonable prices
Review: We went there coincidentally as we walked by searching for a nice place for dinner. We sat upstairs on low-seated BBQ-tables and ordered two BBQ-dishes and steamed rice. It was plenty of food, especially the many side-dishes (I think it were 9 or 10!) made it! Service was really friendly, quick and patient - it was our first experience with Korean cuisine and we needed some help making our choice from the menu. Would definitely come back! Show less

Author: 646tand
Title: Must have
Review: Went there for a meal overtime we visit Malacca. The meat were cooked to perfection by the staffs. They also gave us a lot of side dishes.

Author: Tigersim
Title: Pricey but there's standard
Review: Had quite a few dish. Price is way above the standard rate of malaysia. So prepare to spend a bomb here. Service was excellent. Quick and efficient. Food is tasty.

Author: MsiaRunnerMalaysia
Title: "Great food...."
Review: Had a great experience and food in Daorae. Even though this is a chain BBQ Korean restaurant, the taste in this outlet is authentic. Maybe we were lucky as we did not have any issues with the food and the service during our dinner. The Dweji Bulgogi was great and highly recommended.We must give high points to Namaju (from Nepal) who served us. He was gracious and very attentive. Good staff to keep.Show less

Author: Stanley789Singapore, null, Singapore
Title: Will skip this restaurant for awhile
Review: Been eating at Daorae @ Melaka for the last few years whenever we visit Melaka. Last visit in Dec 2016.The good:Lots of free side dishes, watermelon, etc Bbq meat wrap in lettuce and onion were great The bad:No lift, need to climb stairs Boss or manager not friendly when we pay the bill. Ginseng chicken soup not so nice. Show less

Author: JuneT502
Title: Not too fantastic
Review: Set menu think is reasonable, just came back yesterday and had hotpot soup for 2 with wife.I think ingredient portion in pot is not generous but side dishes are ok, can ask for more if need.Hotpot does not come with rice and a small bowl of rice is RM5 which I think is too highly priced.Not a must try Korean restaurant in Melaka, In Johor yes, Bornga in City Square food is much better.But the Nepalese staff are really good.I don't like the stern looking Korean boss pacing here and there at the counter while our table is just to it. Irritating pacing by the Korean boss.Show less

Author: AnfieldYNWA
Title: Worth A Visit As Food And Service Good!!!
Review: Visited the restaurant with wife and friends and were served by friendly staffs. Need to especially mention the nepal staff who had impressed all of us with his service. The food was also good. Worth a visit again!!!

Author: Karriean
Title: Pleasant Lunch
Review: Conveniently located near the Equatorial Hotel.  Went for lunch with a friend. Staff were helpful. Food and service quite good. Will go again.

Author: Goh P
Title: Authentic korean food
Review: Good variety of korean food. Lots of side dishes. Loved the ginseng chicken soup. Will be back for more.

Author: Ong P
Title: Best korean food ever tasted
Review: The staff here is extremely friendly and humorous. The food here is fabulous though it is a little too spicy for my taste. But I highly recommend it to those who like korean food.

Author: Vincybaby
Title: Nice and Wonderful Dinner
Review: First of all I wrote this review is not because they have fantastic food, but they won me over by their excellent service!We do have a wonderful time having dinner here as the staff are very helpful and friendly and furthermore the ambient is fantastic! The food there are nice and the cost of the dinner is worth it, if you rate it not only on the food but also on the ambient and excellent service!To the staffs there, keep up the good work!!!Show less

Author: Always_travelling88
Title: Good service but food is not up to standard
Review: I have no complaints about the service. The staff are courteous and friendly even when they are busy.  However, the food is definitely not Korean taste.  This is the most unappetizing Korean food that I have ever eaten. Will never go back.

Author: adenb2016
Title: Good Svc provide by them
Review: Is a must to visit this DAORAE Korean Bbq restaurant whenever we at Melaka .one of the best restaurant I never visit .Best food Best service 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

Author: Khid
Title: Short break in Malacca
Review: Went for dinner 2 nights ago. Very impressed with the exceptional customer service by the manager and the waiters who are all Nepalis. Just wished that the food matched up to the service though.

Author: angelbeanieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent awesome service!
Review: Was recommended by my friend to this place and I also did some research online. Wasn't expecting too much before we came as I read some mix reviews on TA as well. The place closes at 11pm and we popped by at 10.20pm and still being served politely. After placing our orders, we were served at least 10 diff variety of ban chan (side dishes) and our food was soon served.The staff helped to BBQ our meat (we ordered 3 types), and they changed the grill each time it turned black (without us even asking!). We were also served a complementary pancake, and the ban chan was topped up promptly every time we finish 1 of it. Towards the end of e meal we were even served fruits as dessert. Totally in love with the service, wasn't expecting so much but my visit here was totally so sooo good! Will definitely return if we pop by Malacca again. Show less

Author: KM SSingapore, Singapore
Title: Another Good Dinner at Daorae
Review: We like to have our dinner at Daorae every time we visit Malacca. The food is delicious and the price is reasonable. The stiff are polite and helpful. Recommend the marinated chicken and pork. Yummy. The crushed korean pear juice should be a suitable beverage for children and adult. Show less

Author: christy6565Hanoi, Vietnam
Title: Nice food, Excellent service
Review: We discovered this restaurant over the internet and review. As it's very close to where we stayed so we went there for lunch. The food is very nice and the staffs are very attentive. We had nice bbq pork, gimchi soup.The gimchi side dishes were also tasty. Surprisingly, we've got complimentary Korean pizza from the restaurant.Show less

Author: eylegroeg
Title: Awesome & Authentic Korean Cuisine
Review: Have u tried the Gam Ja Tang? It was awesome! Don't forget the cold noodles too :) Go for the beef BBQ becoz it tastes heavenly.

Author: tripreview777
Title: Never miss this restaurant!
Review: Good value and great waiters! Food is good quality, authentic Korean, generous portions, wide variety of kimchi and inexpensive!

Author: MAKABOBBYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: nice Korean food
Review: nice place for Korean food and the meals where great and real value for money , with nice Korean drinks the only problem about this place you have to wait to get a table but the wait was always worth it . I spent three nights eating dinner here with my family , if you love Korean food go give it a try not just Korean food but GOOD KOREAN FOODShow less

Author: heyjudes123
Title: Flavorful Korean food
Review: Very nice decor and seating, and the food itself was excellent (: Serve staff were very prompt and enthusiastic, though the waiting time for food is slightly long.

Author: HCT0915Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent service, awesome food!
Review: Been here before, was awed by their service so dropped by again. As usual, awesome service from the waiters, helping us to cook the meat, changing the metal plates frequently to prevent our meat from getting charred, attends to you almost immediately. On top of that, side dishes and cabbage get topped up unlimited times for free. Reasonable prices and in an excellent location Show less

Author: stephenmanuel
Title: Good experience
Review: Very nice layout including floor level tables or private room. Meat grilled over charcoal in the centre of the table. Attentive and dedicated servers. Great tasting food.

Author: Nicole BPorto Alegre, RS
Title: Korean Restaurant
Review: A local Malaysian chain, this Korean BBQ joint does the hot simmering plate for you to cook the meat and veggies on. Service was very attentive. The food was a bit pricey for Melaka, but not too bad of a value, We had the mixed meat platter and all the accoutrement that comes with. Kimshi was good.Show less

Author: cvoon
Title: Koran BBQ in KL and PJ
Review: There is few more branches in Petaling Jaya and Kuala Lumpur. Weekend mostly full house, advise go early. Price are reasonable and good choice for group dining.

Author: Fred C
Title: Good Beef
Review: Excellent service and delicious food.  Loved fresh veggies and kimchi. Reasonable prices. Close to Novotel and Hatten hotels.  Clean and bright decor.

Author: Tat YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointed this time around
Review: Been there in a past visit with my rice and it was all good. This time around we had all ordered a variety of soupd (chi gae). They all tasted bland though they looked fiery red. My seafood tofu soup was, sadly, the worse I've had on four continents and a dozen cities world wide. I did not think it could be screwed up. However, the pancake and fried rice were very good. Even the tea as disappointing as it lacked the true flavor of korean tea. Maybe they had a bad night but this place is surely on the higher side for Malacca restaurants. Service was excellent and can not be faulted.I'd give them another try though there are a couple of other Korean joints just 100m down the road.Show less

Author: loulou045
Title: Amazing night
Review: This restaurant is amazing  food is wonderful staff excellent and service very good , pricing also good

Author: YenlengMYKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Always good.
Review: I have been coming to Melaka once every of the past five months and today marks my fifth visit at Daorae (Melaka), and it is still as enjoyable as ever. Service was very prompt, and the staff are friendly and very helpful. Food is great, always love the grilled meat. I would say price is reasonable. Would come again next month. Show less

Author: Jayme RWortegem, Oost-Vlaanderen, Belgium
Title: Very overpriced
Review: We didn't know what platter to go for and we saw what the people were eating next to us looked nice. We asked the waiter what it was and what he suggested. He told us to get the set menu because this was a bit of everything. This was priced at 130RM, we wanted the full experience so we decided to go for it. Once they started BBQing we only got like 5 to 10 very small pieces of meat which were all of the same kind... We also ordered two bowls of rice that but those never came, we said they could cancel it at the end of the dinner. The waiter misunderstood us and brought them anyways. We ordered two tiger beers which aren't on the menu, but are apparently priced 20RM each and labelled as "Korean beers" as such. At the end of the evening the bill was 201RM, the most expensive meal we had to pay in our whole 3 weeks trip through Malaysia and we've eaten in very nice places before. This was our last evening in Malaysia and left us with a bitter taste.. Food was ok, but you can eat 10 times better and especially more for that price.Show less

Author: LeenjaymeGhent, Belgium
Title: Way too expensive for what it is
Review: Reading all the good reviews, we were so excited to try out Korean bbq for the first time. What a disappointment!The food was ok, but we ended up with a bill of 200RM for only 2 people! And I can't even say we were really full... The most expensive meal we've had during our 3 week stay in Malaysia, but unfortunately far from the best. Show less

Author: petrafs
Title: Excellent
Review: If you are looking for something different in Melaka, look no further. Great food, great service, we enjoyed every minute. The staff also very kind and helpful. Try, highly recommended.

Author: JocechuaSingapore, Singapore
Title: First try, quite a variety of foods to choose from
Review: The service is fast and friendly, we ordered meats for bbq and they would help us with the cooking of it. Side dishes comes with soup, salads, pancakes and the usual kimchi and vegetables. The ginseng chicken soup isnt that tasty and too bland, lack the taste of ginseng. Fried glass noodles is a big portion to share, too much for 2 pax. Would come back to try other dishes in the menu.Show less

Author: Littledingding
Title: Very delicious dinner and nice ambience
Review: The restaurant is located on the 2nd level! Once we were there, we were welcome by friendly and smiley staff. The food variety is good and price is reasonable. Speed of serving food is fast. Ginseng chicken soup tastes good. Must order the kimchi pancake, the taste is delicious, not too oily or dry. Restaurant setting is like a typical Korea restaurant and we can view the malacca street while enjoying our food. Show less

Author: peters457
Title: Dinner
Review: Great place and very friendly staff. Explanations and recommendations around the menu were great and helpful. Good place to go with kids. Enjoyed the good food and even asked for a second order of meat. The chef de service showed flexibility as we did not like to have tongue - we got rib-eye instead. Place to go to. Show less

Author: kiml558Singapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly staff, good spread, good price, worth visiting!
Review: Staff members are attentive and friendly, I felt very welcomed here even though I came alone. Food is tasty and much cheaper than what you'd get in Singapore. I had bbq meats (1 serving of pork belly, 1 serving of spicy chicken), about 8(!!!) other side dishes, and fruit. They changed to a clean grilling plate several times while grilling the meats, I appreciate their attention to cleanliness. The total cost was about rm70. Overall, I enjoyed a fantastic dinner with excellent service at Daorae and would love to go back again. Show less

Author: Dream549567
Title: Premium Korean BBQ & inexpensive
Review:
Dorae Korean BBQ serves top notch bbq at a fraction (50-60%) of the prices that we pay back home in SG.  
Good ambience & great service. 
This dining place provides a good alternative after lots of the local cuisine. Guarantee no regrets!

Author: KC08leong
Title: Nice place to enjoy
Review:
Good, fresh food with funny staff. I love it
We go there for families dinner, the waiter is funny and pro as i c they busy topping up for us, help to cook and always carry the smile on face. Should come again

Author: SDBGSofia, Bulgaria
Title: Add some experience to your international cuisine impressions.
Review: The restaurant is very clean and tidy. The food is interesting and tasty. The main part is prepared just in front of you on a special barbecue integrated in the table with a smoke absorber above it. I have been really curious to taste something completely new and different than european and malaysian food and I was not disappointed. The personnel is doing its job perfectly. It was a bit expensive, but in the name of the explorer's spirit, it definitely worthed.Show less

Author: NgSP80
Title: Korean food
Review:
Food there is so so...
like the BBQ meat only...
environment is good and service is not bad...
a good place for gathering with friends and family...
but prices are not cheap also...

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Very Affordable Pricing
Review: BBQ at a Korean restaurant is an experience not to be missed. Daorae Korean Restaurant has many branches in Malaysia for example in places Ipoh. The spicy noodles tasted appetizing even with a second round ordered. The staff are attentive and efficient when serving the customers.Do set aside an average of RM50 per person if you want to eat at least 2 meals. Worth my every cent spent here. Yes, one thing to note that the restaurant can get slightly warm during the afternoon so dress lightlyShow less

Author: ChinadreamSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good service
Review: Stumble upon this restaurant by mistake because Nancy's kitchen was closed and Amy's kitchen was fully booked! Instead drove around and found this place. Very apprehensive initally but it turn out that we made a wonderful choice coming here. Firstly the staff were very attentive and the korean side dishes were really tasty, especially the mango salad. They are quite generous with the servings as well. We ordered beef and pork and they were fresh and nice. We saw many caucasians and koreans coming here to dine as well. So we were quite sure we made the right choice. We spend about SGD$55 altogether for about 4 main dishes for 3 pax.Show less

Author: bizzaneianSingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome awesome n still awesome
Review: Staffs were friendlyFood were awesomeSide dishes plentiful with continuous replacement. We were careful in selection of the dishes n wasn't adventurous. .However the restaurant went the extra mile to provide extra sampling sizes(reasonable serving) of a few more extra dishes for us to try FOC!We r indeed amazed by the thoughtfulness! Show less

Author: Valerie037South Australia
Title: Slightly Overwhelming!
Review: There were so many side dishes delivered to our table, I wondered where any other food would be placed and wished we had ordered just a fraction of what we did from the menu. We ordered a beef dish, which was more fat than beef. However, the marinated pork was excellent. The staff are friendly and very helpful with cooking the meats.Show less

Author: iverkenMalacca
Title: Fantastic food + services
Review: My all time favourtie Korean BBQ restaurant in Melaka, with so many other Korean BBQ around, Daorae has proven that they can be on the top of the Korean restauran in Melaka. Located in Melaka Raya, ample of parking in front & back. The side dishes simply blow your mind and you can retake for free again! Just try it!Show less

Author: SeahlydiaSingapore
Title: Quality food and good service
Review: went with my family and a group of friends with kids. Author: dahungrycouplePorto, Portugal
Title: Just say Yes!!!! (Potentially Vegan-friendly)
Review: Melaka is a food haven in Malaysia for a number or reasons, so when you're in Melaka it's always a great idea to scarf down the local food. That said, Malaysia is not known for the healthiness of its food and visitors may desire a bit more healthier option. I lived in Melaka for three (3) years, and Daorae was ALWAYS a go-to for a delicious, savory option that provides plenty of vegetables and won't necessarily empty the wallet. Top choices are the Korean Beef Tartare (served with Korean pear), the Bibimbap and their cold noodle dishes.If you've decided to wander off the World Heritage path and find yourself over in the shopping district (Melaka Raya), Daorae is a great option. Also, they updated their menu to include a reasonable lunch set that is filling and typically costs around 18MYR. Value, flavor and service...Daorae has it all. There are other Korean options in town, but in my opinion, Daorae is the best by far.Speaking of service, the Nepalese staff are exceptionally attentive and friendly, and the floor host is top notch. His English is reasonable, so feel free to ask for recommendations as well. My friend is a strict vegan, and every time we would dine there, she needed to modify elements of the menu to suit her diet. This was NEVER a problem at Daorae (although the menu is meat heavy - it is a Korean BBQ after all), and the easiest option for modification is the Bibimbap.All in all, I almost always return to Daorae whenever I return to Melaka and recommend it highly due to its wide selection of tasty, healthy dishes...all of which are a delightful option to the rich, heavy and carb-loaded selections one will find throughout the city.Give it a try and see how it goes...Show less

Review: We love the pork ribs in korean marinade. Staff are friendly and welcoming. Good range of meats and they are very generous with the pickles and sides.

Author: wyshingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Korean BBQ in the heart of Melaka
Review: Was looking for a nice korean bbq place in Melaka and found this Jem. They only open for dinner from 530pm, so we had to wait cos we were there early. Location is right beside Hatten Hotel. Like most Korean Places they serve many side dishes. My Wife and myself had the marinated Beef rib (65rm), marinated Pork Rib (35rm) and washed it down with 2 beers + soju(25rm), prices we felt were very reasonable for the quality of the meat (and compared to the over-priced Korean restaurants in singapore). The difference between this and many others we tried in Singapore and even in Seoul was the Service, Each time we finished the side dishes, the waiters will politely come over and offer to replenish for us immediately, like most korean bbq places, the waiters will cook the meat for you over charcoal grill. Each time the meat was cooked, they will immediately change the grill as well, so it doenst look burnt. A must try if you want something other than Peranakan food in Melaka town.Show less

Author: sux2018Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good service and food, worthy of the price
Review: The location was convenient, minutes walk from Hatten hotel or Equatoria hotel. And atmosphere is excelent. Like most authentic Korean restaurant, they serve free flow of appetizer, so we just ordered main couse for each person: seasoned pork rib bbq, seasoned pork belly bbq, cold noodle, seafood noodle and beef rib soup. The bbq was served by restaurant staff, tasted good, only regreted no garlic and cucumber along with lettuce wrap. The cold noodle was a spot light, the use of wasabi instead of galic was brilliant. Seafood noodle was a bit salty and the clamp over cooked. Beef rib suop was good and my mother in law enjoyed it. The appetizers tasted even better than some main course, they had: spinach, beansprouts, bean curd (fresh, dry and deep fried), miso soup, seasoned cabage, sour radish, spring onion,  salad... we ordered some more spring onion but could finish more, becasue the restaurant owner was very hospitable and offered our kids free steamed egg and carrot pancake. And the after diner fruit (water melon) also provided. We were more than full, thanks to his kindness. The staff was also warm and nice, they  treat kids well and gave them some lollipop. All of us had a great time and very satisfied with the food and service. And our final bill was only RM138. We definitely will come again.Show less

Author: dino1963Singapore
Title: Very good quality and price
Review: This place was superb. When was in Melaka many times, we saw this place and until recently, we gave it a try as we always wanted to eat local food instead of “imported” food. Never regretted it. Yes, it’s still not purely local but the quality and price is unbeatable. The place is easy to find, just across the street to Fenix Inn. It has a large sign board that you couldn’t miss. It is on 2nd floor, spacious decoration and all the staff are friendly. We ordered ginseng chicken soup, beef and pork BBQ set. The portion is big, plus they also gave us complimentary fried carrot cake which taste fantastic. After biting the carrot cake, the taste slowly appear and you can taste the sweetness. The BBQ set comes with lots of veg and different types of kimchi, all refillable. Seeing that we are new to these stuff, the staff help us to cut and cook the food. The beef was delicious but more work needed for the pork. We also ordered 2 sakei which was very good. We are also very surprised that they allowed smoking in the air-con restaurant.Show less

What goes short of 1 star is the price for me. If only they could lower the price, then it would definitely be worth it (even more)!Oh yes, there are enough sitting space as they have two storeys. Choose whichever fits you but for me,I prefer the higher floor as it looks a little newer.Show less

Author: satoyurikosingapore
Title: Korean food with good price and good service
Review: Just reached Melaka from Singapore and was starving. Decided not to check in first and walked straight into Daorae. Loved the ambience of the restaurant - very Korean! They kept playing the Korean MVs!We ordered the beef rib, pork belly, kimchi stew and seafood pancake (about SGD $60 in total for 2 persons). They kept refilling our Korean tea and the side dishes without us telling them to do so (great service!). The staff would do the BBQ for you, so you just have to sit back and enjoy the food. The hood above the BBQ worked very well and I didn't smell like BBQ meat after I left the restaurant.Overall, food is great tasting and of reasonable price (acoording to Malaysia's standard. If you compare to Singapore's standard, I would say that this is value for money). I especially enjoyed the kimchi stew and pancake. Meat wise - I would not say that it's as good as the expensive cuts that I used to pay for in Singapore but I would say that this is really value for money.I'll eat at Daorae again at my next visit to Melaka.Show less

It is served with complimentary traditional Korean side dishes served in small bowls. The ingredients are fresh and the side dishes are delicious. Review: Located on the upper two floors of a building in front of the Equatorial Hotel, it has seating around either bbq or traditional floor seating. Serves a variety of alcoholic (beers, soju and plum wine) and non alcoholic drinks. If your driving, parking can be a little difficult on Fridays and Saturdays and the weekend gets busy for dinner early. As well as bbq, it also serves noodle and rice sets, soups and stone hotpots. Best to go with a group so that you can share a selection of dishes. I especially enjoy the special marinated pork belly and the marinated chicken bbq.Show less
