Prawn was fresh and I simply loved the aromatic spicy flavour of the curry. Bendi masala (MYR 8) was very cooked. Wife loved the okra that was firm and fresh. New order for us was the onion bhaji (MYR 7). Kind of onion fritters which were deep fried. Sweet and crispy. Garlic naan (MYR 3.80) was as good as before.Food here is good and very affordable. Though only one serving staff, service was polite and prompt. Served with porcelain utensils.Show less

We returned again in August for our 2nd meal with D'Tandoori with all 11 pax and we enjoyed the food thoroughly.Palek Paneer, Chicken Tikka Masala, Butter Chicken and Aloo Gobi were among the food we ordered, and truly deserved a thumbs-up. The restaurant ambiance albeit simple but was nice and cosy where we could enjoy our time together as a company of 11 pax without being interrupted by the other diners, or we disrupting them.Show less

Author: 194FaridehKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good but with some doubts
Review: It is a very simple Indian restaurant in its design. As though the owner had only wanted to make you "believe" it is actually a restaurant. Which is not really. The tables are small, no music, no friendly ambient. The waiter is only one person, with a somber, unfriendly face, looking down on all the customers, expecting them to know all the Indian food names, which may not be the case for everyone. The prices were high and the portion of the food, on little squarish plates is very small and devoid of any generosity. Even tbough the food was good, but the unfriendly waiter, his short replies, made in bad temper (I wonder why?) and the little liliputian food made all the wrong impressions. The tandoori was only three small pieces, without anything beside it. No onions, no lemon, no grated carrots, no spicy sauce, nothing. The nan were small, and we paid for two nans and two tandooris around 50 RM. Not worth the while. After we came out, we were still so hungry that we went to McDonalds to terminate the process of filling our poor stomachs!! It was a good restaurants, only for ghosts or liliputians! Show less

Review: Out of all the Indian restaurants I have tried in Melaka ( it is hard to find north Indian restaurants) D’Tandoori House serves the best North Indian Cuisine.Thanks to Tripadvisor through which I was able to find the restaurant.Visited this restaurant during CNY18 and was on vegan diet.Me & My wife daily visited this place and explored their food menu.Although this is a tandoori restaurant and when we say tandoori - nothing beats tandoori chicken! The service during our first visit was slow but when the food came we were overwhelmed with the taste!The service was pretty fast at our other next visits.The staff was courteous and friendly. I had a chat with the person and it was very warming to know each other.Show less

Go there with no doubt...Very affordable for the quality...Super nice service !We ll come back...Take a small jacket as depending where your table is you may be cold because of air conditioner...Show less

Author: Thipa R

Review: We decided to have our lunch here in celebration of our father's birthday.The deco as mentioned by other reviewers is nothing exciting but cosy nonetheless. Well air conditioned and clean. The waiter and the boss were very friendly. Order was taken and food was served promptly.Now on to the food!Chicken, egg and mutton briyani and palak paneer were ok. Butter chicken, tandoori chicken, cheese naan was delicious!Masala tea was yummy and fragrant!Special tandoori fried rice was mediocre.Mango lassi and carrot milk juice were so so.The bill came to RM111.00 inclusive of 5% service chargeOverall we will definitely be back!Show less

Author: gaosiyi2015Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Food and Truly Value for Money
Review: This restaurant is very near the major hotels in Melaka. It's clean though a bit basic in décor which did not matter to us as we were looking for good food. The curry chicken was really very tasty with rich curry gravy; and the garlic naan breads were very well done. We tried some Tandoori chicken but it was a bit dry, and don't try their lime juice which was just some sugared water with lime flavour. Prices of the dishes are the best I have ever seen in many places. Notwithstanding all the good points, it still does not deserve 5 stars.Show less

Author: thenomadicpearUnited Kingdom
Title: Absolutely delicious Indian food, and friendly attentive staff.
Review: This was me and my partner's favourite go-to restaurant in Melaka. Funnily enough, we also visited last year and really enjoyed this restaurant then, hence why we came back this time round! We just love the Indian food here, which is great value for the quality of food and service you get. We were drawn to the fantastic variety of Indian dishes, particularly the vegetarian options such as the Palak Paneer, Malai Kofta and Navratan Korma. They were probably among some of the best Indian curries we've ever had - the level of spiciness was spot on and we loved the texture and flavour of the sauce/gravy used! The naan was also very good. We were never disappointed! The Pakistani waiter who runs the restaurant is so friendly and lovely, and always works extremely hard to provide very quick service. There was also free Wi-Fi. We would definitely recommend this place to anyone who likes Northern Indian dishes, vegetarian and non-vegetarian alike! Keep up the good work - we'll definitely be back at some point in the future! Thanks so much for the lovely meals and hospitality :)Show less

Author: 445kieransHunchy, Australia
Title: Must Visit Indian Fare
Review: I visited this restaurant on four occasions over a one week visit. I kept going back because of the exceptional flavour and tenderness of the tandoori chicken. On one occasion I opted to also try a fish meal. While the flavours were good the fish was not fresh. Therefore I would recommend to stick with any of the chicken dishes. The Price was very cheap. I would have given this restaurant 5 stars if I didn't have the fish.Show less

Author: SanyaL82
Title: Bendi Masala!!
Review: This was my fav place when comes to naan and tandoori. Food all came with small portion so you can order quite a lot to share. Reasonable price too.

Author: oronzoddItaly
Title: real indian taste
Review: simple and tiny place for who aims to the substance of thinghs. best tandoori chicken ever, best nan, every food taste fresh and likewise homemade, which is what i look for in my trips, feeling like home even thousands miles away. the third time, i asked for a view of tandoor oven, and it alone worth a visit for a passionate of kitchen like me. that's a top notch, my opinion.Show less

Author: palani47
Title: Good food
Review: Had one dinner and two lunches there.   Neat and clean.  Good food - not oily and just the right amount of salt and sweet and the varieties of food is quite good.   Adequate size of the portions were served.  Courteous staff.

Author: ANTONY BPlymouth, United Kingdom
Title: A good find via Tripadvisor.
Review: Pretty adequately described by other reviewers. A bit plain décor inside, a good size menu with interesting dishes including a range of vegetarian dishes. Portions were a good size and ranged between RM 8 to 10. It filled up after we arrived that evening and nobody appeared to wait that long to be served. We had a very good, cheap meal there. Two bonuses were, the restaurant serves alcohol and accepts credit cards. Recommended.Show less

Author: k0hk3Singapore, Singapore
Title: It's about the food
Review: Located walking distance from Hatten Hotel, this is another good restaurant to go for Indian food. Air-conditioned with simple décor, the food here is very reasonable priced. With it arched wooden windows and door, it is a nice and cosy place to have a wonderful meal.We were there after 2pm and it was deserted. I began to wonder did we make the right choice ? There was only one wait server and probably one chef at the kitchen. Shortly after us, another 8 people came. Then another 2 people followed. Despite the crowd, the server was courteous and efficient. We ordered fish curry, palak paneer, aloo gobi, plain briyani rice, garlic naans and of course tandoori chicken. Drinks included sweet lassie for daughter, masalah tea for wife and myself – cool glass of lime juice minus sugar.Fish curry (MYR11.90) – this was the highlight of the entire meal. Fish was fresh and tasty. Tandoori chicken (MYR8.00) - was good and flavouful with the right amount of spices. This is their signature dish.Garlic naan (MYR7.00) - a little soft. Not as puffy as it should. Nevertheless, it was good. Palak paneer (MYR8.90)- The sauteed spinach was cooked right. It was not cheesy.Aloo gobi (MYR7.50) – combination of cauliflower, potatoes with various Indian spices was delightful for the palate.Plain Briyani rice (MYR3.50) - as the name says it, it was quite plain.This restaurant does not have any ‘wow’ factor to rave about. I am not complaining. I like the food. I will be back for other dishes.Show less

Author: simon mManchester, United Kingdom
Title: First impressions go a long way
Review: I have a rule of thumb when travelling to only eat in busy restaurants.On their web sight it says the restaurant opened in 1992 that's 25 years ago & my first impression was its the original décor as it looks tired & worn out.We entered at 7.30pm & left by 9pm & were the only customers for the whole duration which is always disconcerting, but I'm pleased to report there were no repercussions.Whilst what we had was ok it was not anything to email home about.Whilst I don't have anything to complain about, I also don't have anything to rave about either.Would I recommend you to this place? possibly & preferably with a few more customers in.Show less

Author: HaggisHalifax_CanadaHalifax, Canada
Title: Restaurant needs an upgrade
Review: We tried this restaurant based on trip advisor reviews and we like trying Indian food. There was only 8 customers when we arrived, the place needs a new coat of paint. We ordered Vegetable pakora, Mutton Masala, curried chicken, chilli prawns, rice and chapatis. The paroral was good, the Mutton was tasty, not all fat and bones. Chicken curry was good, the prawns tasted like tomato paste with prawns, green peppers, onions and spices added, not very good, chapatis were good. We have had Indian food all over the world, this was average.Show less

Author: stmani
Title: Triple Celebration
Review: A wide selection of North Indian veg n non-veg dishes to choose from. Starters -pakora is crunchy so have this while waiting for the main dishes to come ; veg pakora, chicken pakora , etc. The Naan bread comes in varieties so you can choose according to your taste. Jeera rice , Briyani rice with chicken or mutton , rather go for the plain as it blends well with the veg n non-veg dishes. Kulfi , a type of ice- cream with almonds is great, a must after food. Well -served and pleasant servers. Don't miss this place when you are in Melaka Raya. Conducive place for gatherings of small groups. We just had one triple celebration with family n friends on Valentine's Day cum birthday surprise for two family members. It was a first time to a few of them n they had praises for the food. We had tried most of the dishes on the menu. The price is reasonable too.Show less

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Stashed away
Review: I found this restaurant to be quite good on a recent visit. I tried the Garlic Naan and Chicken Tikka. Northern Indian and Punjabi food is not as common as Southern and always a treat. Not a full sized Naan but it was very good nonetheless. Show less

Author: 892vinnyk
Title: Satisfaction!
Review: Very good Indian food! Yummylicious.. .. butter chicken , paneer tikka , paneer palak .. some of the tastiest dishes .. you might need to wait a while but it's all worth it !

Author: lilshagee
Title: One day visit to malacca
Review: I  went Malacca with my fiance one day ago  for a business conference.We planned to have lunch here since the restaurant's ambience attract my attention.We ordered prawn briyani and chicken briyani.The food was delicious but the rice was too little...Would come here definitely next time..

Author: gad9876
Title: Indian Khana ( food )
Review: Good hospitality. Owned by a Punjabi. Quantity per serving ok. Average Food - enough to satisfy the Indian palette. The person who served was a very friendly Pakistani. Feels homely when someone can understand your 'home food' needs & conveys it in your language!

Author: Travelfather59Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Consistently very good
Review: This is my third visit to this place. This time around we had dinner at this place. We ordered their fish curry which was good. I would have preferred if the fish was not fried. The prawn fritters was excellent and of course they used very fresh prawns. We had a few vegetarian dishes which as usual was very good.Show less

Author: puddinglow
Title: fast and satisfying.
Review: delicious home cooked food with different breads . recommended for families and open for lunch and dinner. the restaurant is clean and well kept.

Author: Rajesh_Goa1Goa, India
Title: Great little Gem !!
Review: We were staying at Novotel in Melaka Raya in Apr'16.We visited the most famed Pak Putra for Dinner on our first night. We were not really happy with it, as its over hyped..No one told us about this Indian Restaurant. We just happened to noice while passing by, as this is just on the side road to Novotel.Since then, we had all our meals at this restaurant.The Chicken and Veg Biryani, Mango Lassi, Naan,etc were all reasonably good (better than Pak Putra)..at competitive prices.This restaurant definetely deserves more visits.Only negative was the service, as there is one one Service manager, cum order taker, cum waiter. However, did not affect us much as there was hardly any crowd.Keep going and keep improving.Show less

Author: Ursina E
Title: great indian dinner
Review: the naan is very tasty, you chan choose between a lot of different types. very delicious currys and paneer dishes, also a good choice for vegetarians

Author: jca911st
Title: Yummy Indian food
Review: We went to the restaurant because of the good rating - and we liked it very much. Not a particularly cosy atmosphere due to the "neon" lighting, but clean restaurant, friendly and quick staff, and - very yummy food!

Author: Puneet S
Title: No value for money
Review: This is one of the worst palak paneer I had in malaysia. Seriously think twice before visiting here. The value for money is not there. The taste is missing....it's like someone in need has to eat then come here and eat.

Author: WimYogyaPemuteran, Indonesia
Title: Five stars without a doubt
Review: This little local North-Indian restaurant really surprised us. It was walking distance from our Melaka hotel, so based upon the good reviews we decided to go there. It was the best of our 5 dinners in Melaka. Simple but charming interior, quite a big menu selection, friendly fast and adequate service (even when rush hour seemed to start just after we arrived) - and above all: fantastic food. Like often, we each ordered 1 starter, 1 main dish, 1 side dish and then shared to experience the maximum. Everything heaven! After this the bargain bill was a pleasant surprise as well: MYR 65 for 2pax, including 1 beer and 2 other drinks. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: rajamanusingapore
Title: best north indian cuisine in malacca
Review: if the authorities had decided to number their streets in some sort of order in melaka raya, it would have been so easy to find any establishment therein. readers will know what i mean.we had a little difficulty driving to this restaurant and parking can be a real problem during week ends.this resto has a fairly comprehensive menu, which includes desserts to complete your dining experience of indian food.the food is tasty and very reasonably priced. the serving size, however, is a little small, close to authentic naan and chappaties can only be found at this establishment. forget the chappaties at all other malacca restaurants and i do not want to name the restaurants we are talking about.yes you can get somewhat better tandoori items at another malacca joint but that place is not family friendly nor air conditioned for dining. the ambience is simple but adequate with some effort at resembling indian decor.Balwant singh the owner is highly charged PR person and goes around talking to diners. he is a very nice person indeed and if any uninitiated (to indian food) diner needs any assistance he is a willing advisor.the service is orderly and quick enough considering that the dishes are prepared upon order.Show less

Author: GeoffD395
Title: Nice food, but not great
Review: We ate here after a long day travelling. It was well reviewed on trip advisor. The food was OK, it was very cheap and they had beer (it wasn't on the menu, but I got it when I asked about it)

Author: Wongtracy
Title: Food is good and Price is reasonable
Review: Small quiet restaurant that serves good Indian food. Price is reasonable and we enjoyed the food. Love the mango lassi.

Author: Satya Prakash G
Title: Good indian food
Review:
I think if you are looking for good north Indian food in Melaka, You have to come here.
I tried palak panner, garlic Naan & chapatti. It taste good. The environment is good & staff are attentive.

Author: Mitzi105Brisbane, Australia
Title: Authentic and absolutely delicious.
Review: Trip Advisor reviews pointed us to this restaurant. Absolutely divine. great little place, nice decor, very friendly service and staff. Tip: the lime juice are the best we had anywhere, including Singapore. All the dishes we had that night were superb including a selection of curry dishes, garlic and plain naan bread, tandoori sticks. I admit, when the dishes came out, they looked small portions, but let me tell you they are sufficient and reasonably priced too. You won't go hungry.Thanks great feed.Show less

Author: andrewpD6881OT
Title: Superb dinner!
Review: We decided to eat here as we were staying just down the the road, We  were glad we did, the food was outstanding

Author: Ursula DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Very average Indian food
Review: Just around the corner from our hotel, we passed this restaurant every day and decided to try it as a change from local food.They have a big menu offering lots of veg and non veg dishes. The drinks we ordered, mango lassi and fresh lime soda, were both good and quickly delivered to the table.The food was less of a success. The garlic nan was extremely greasy, covered in far too much butter - not an uncommon occurrence in Malaysia. Both the chicken masala and the brinjal (aubergine) masala were very oily, and very mild despite us having requested spicy food. The Bombay aloo were terrible, totally drowned in sauce, making this a very soggy dish.Service was acceptable, and prices were on the low side, thankfully, I'd have hated to waste a lot of money on this food. I'd be hard pressed to go back.Show less

Author: Matt-ParnellBrisbane, Australia
Title: Top quality and great value.
Review: Went here for dinner and we had lime juice and 2 garlic naan and 1 plain naan with chefs chicken curry and mutton rich curry gravy.It was so tasty and delicious, the service was quick and 1 person did all the table service and was friendly and helpful.We came here from reading tripadvisor reviews and wasnt disappointed.The price is great, as this is a nice sitdown restaurant atmosphere.Highly recommend.Well worth a visit.Show less

Author: 276JAMES
Title: Delicious curry and good value for money
Review: I paid about 20 ringit for vegetable curry, naan bread and a bottle of water. The food and service were very good. I would be happy to dine here again.

Author: KapilV611
Title: Lunch at D Tandoori house ...
Review: Nice small place - when we visited it was full with nearly 20 people , one person did everything from taking orders , serving meals , doubling up as cashier .. Still pretty impressive & decent service , good Indian food

Author: naumanfarook
Title: Excellent Food!
Review:
This was my 3rd visit.
Always satisfying our taste buds.
Good service and great food!
Must Go for Quality North Indian Cuisine.

Author: cnaren1980Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food, very reasonable price
Review: We went here after reading some good reviews in TripAdvisor. This restaurant serves North Indian food.We went here for a late lunch (around 3pm), and ordered Naan, Chicken Tikka, Fish Vindaloo, Chicken Briyani, Mango Lassi, and Masala Tea. I must say that all the food we ordered were prepared on the spot, they were fresh and really tasty. We were very satisfied with the food. The restaurant was also very clean, service was good, and price was very reasonable. It is also located in the centre of Melaka town. I will definitely go here again and again and recommend others here.Show less

Author: 285sandeepk
Title: Basic Indian stuff
Review: Decent food . Ordered vegetarian dishes and the taste was good . Chapati was decent sized and tasting well . Nothing great about the briyani but nothing wrong too . Overall would return again

Author: Singapore_Scott
Title: Decent place
Review: The ambiance in this restaurant good. Clean and neat.  Food taste is OK. Not crowded. Staff is polite.

Author: Emma_CubeLondon, United Kingdom
Title: If you like to sit in a restaurant environment go here
Review: The food was good, not great, but good enough and fairly well priced for a restaurant. If you like to sit in a restaurant environment then go here. There were lots of tourists in there and this was reflected in their menu with some mild curries and some English curries. Personally I prefer the cheaper Indian canteens with the locals, so if you're after that environment don't go here! :)Show less

Author: Travelfather59Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Cozy, homely, delicious and affordable
Review: I took my family and colleagues for lunch here. A cozy little restaurant with a warm homely feel. The menu is limited but with enough choices to satisfy the the hungry vegetarian or non vegetarian. We had a choice of dishes, channa masalla, prawns, chicken briyani and a simple salad. Tasty with excellent spice flavours. This is not one of those tourist restaurant that pretends to serve authentic Indian food. This place serves authentic Indian flavours.What is even more pleasant is their pricing. Very affordable and real value for moneyyShow less

Author: Ruby T
Title: Delicious !!
Review:
Good Punjabi's food.
We love to come again. Best Indian food. 
The Chicken Tikka Masala and the tandoori chicken was very delicious. The best Indian food.

Author: SDBGSofia, Bulgaria
Title: Best tandoori chicken I nave tried in the Melaka city restaurants.
Review: I like that place very much. It is clean and tidy and you could chat with the friendly owner, while you are taking your tandoori chicken, roti naan and palak paneer, followed by a great masala tea. It is very cosy and quiet, air-conditioned restaurant and the last but not the least, it is just a few minutes away from Hatten Hotel. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: JayjoelhKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: I tried the aloo paratha, chappati and prawn masala. The aloo paratha and chappati was soft and delicious. The prawn masala was medium prepared and not too spicy. Staff was friendly. The restaurant is open daily from 11.30am - 2.30pm for lunch and will re-open again in the evening for dinner. Recommended to those who would like to try north Indian foodShow less

Author: Ming LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Punjabi food
Review: In the center of this historic Malaysian city lies this restaurant that serves authentic and delicious Punjabi food. If you are in the area and want to try something different besides the regular local fare I would highly recommend this restaurant. The chapatis and poori go very well with keema and the dhal. The chicken tikka is excellent. Don't forget to try the gulab jamun for dessert!Show less

Author: 62FoodLover
Title: Restaurant D' Tandoori House
Review: One of the best north indian restaurant !!! Reasonably price. Just loved the naan, palak panner, butter chicken, mutton masala, Will definately be there again. Had to wait for a while coz there were a few tables but was worthwhile !!! Clean

Author: Su-tourKl
Title: No taste n less quantity
Review: I went to d tandoori house after reading the reviews but unfortunately our experience os not so gud. We ordered basic veggy dishes which are like no one can willing cant make tasteless as green peas with cheese means matter paneer with dal tadka also tandoori roti n plain rice. We were 2 and the quantity the served after long time was not at all sufficient for one person with no taste at all. All the items are overpriced and having no taste. Even the person who seemed to be manager or owner or served us( same person) is very rude. Show less

Author: FplusV
Title: Best Tandoori Chicken & Cheese Naan
Review:
This restaurant has become the family's favourite place to eat in as we ate there a number of times during our stay in Malacca.

The food is consistently tasty & good, especially the Tandoori Chicken, Butter Chicken, Palak Paneer. Service too is quite fast

Author: Tan_909Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Its a place where you can experience good moghul cuisine.
Review: Even-thought we have to wait a while for the food. The quality of the food is very nice and fresh. i would recommend trying the spinach or know as palak paneer. having this with a plain naan and a piece of tandoori chicken would fill me up nicely. from what i see the restaurant is very clean in the dining area which is a good sign. the restaurant is well suited for the type of cuisine served. i have been there a numerous of times and the experience has always been pleasant. The owner is a very nice and friendly man. i cant wait for my next visit ^^.Show less

Author: sinis_13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food was nice but customer service is totally out
Review: The food was of course good but to our knowledge the customer service and mannerism towards customer has to be seriously looked upon and improved. Regardless how good the food is the real taste can be enjoy to 100% when it is served with the pleasant smile and proper communication.Show less

Author: skyaNew York City, New York
Title: Spicy and great
Review: Owner is a nice, personable guy - very willing to customize dishes if you wish. Food is authentically spicy, portions aren't too big, and the place was crowded when we arrived - before we left the whole place emptied out and filled up again - mostly with locals. Always a good sign.Show less

Author: Predator101
Title: Great experience.
Review: This was a great experience, the service was great and the food was flavorful and delicious. I had the Buttered Chicken and the Spinach & Cheese and we ordered some Chhese and Garlic Naans which are bread something like focaccia but thinner. It was a great experience overall and the prices were very fair. Show less

Author: Bobthetaff
Title: Very disappointing tasteless food and expensive
Review:
Food all tastes the same and has no heat or discernible flavour
Far too dear better food at the hawker stalls on the street at a fraction of the price

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: The nan is great!
Review: This is one of the oldest tandoori shops in Melaka, by local standards it is great. I like the food but find it pricy.

Author: saashuuSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best North Indian food at reasonable rate
Review: We were looking for an Indian restaurant and the guard at the Datawan Mall suggested us this restaurant. We were a bit skeptic initially since when we rchd there for lunch there was no1. just the waiter and the cook were watching TV. We were very hungry so we ordered Potato Parantha, Panner Masala, naan and few more dishes.Paneer Masala was simply amazing. Since we liked the food so much we went again for dinner. When we reached it was crowded. We ordered veg biryani and raita and it was simply delicious. we had to wait for a while for our food since it was only one guy taking orders and serving the entire crowd, but it was worth it cuz of the tasty food. This restaurant is very close to Equatorial and Fenix Hotel. They open at 11.30am and close at 10.30pm.Show less

Author: Vaidehi2012
Title: Good food, great service
Review: Very fast service, good food, friendly owner, clean and decent. Their aloo prata and naan were very good. This restaurant is very close to Hotell Equatorial and Hotel Hatten and the malls.

Author: 341anna
Title: Great food
Review: The food is very tasty and delicious not only that we do have many choices for each variety of food. We absolutely loved the dining atmosphere as well as the services. Would highly recommend it to anyone.

Author: ambiga tPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious North Indian food
Review: Went there for lunch and had the best potato cheese naan. Their palak paneer(spinach with cheese) is a must try. And the fresh lime juice is a thrist crunch. The decoration reflects Indian design. The service is quick and the waiter is a friendly pakistani guy. They open daily from 1130am untill 230 pm and 6pm untill 11pm. This restaurant is located near Malacca's shopping mall(Hattens Square).A must visit reataurant if you are in Malacca.Show less

Author: whereonearth07Vermont
Title: Best Indian food I've had in Malaysia
Review: I eat Indian food a lot, and this was one of the best I've had. The naan (ranging from plain to onion to vegetable) was soft and chewy and the saag paneer (spinach and homemade cheese) was excellent. My friend and I split the malai kofta for dinner and it was very good. Prices are a little higher than other places, but still very reasonable - 5-15 ringgit per dish. Definitely reccommended! Show less

Author: FoodCritic8217Malacca
Title: Best North Indian Restaurant In Malacca
Review: My dad took me 2 a restaurant in Malacca . I was whining at first coz' I wanted 2 go 2 the good old Mc Donalds . I sulked at first . But then when the food arrived , I got a big shock . The mere sight of it was already very promising . After eating the food , I can only say this . Reataurant D' Tandoori House is truly has THE BEST food in the whole of Malacca ! The naan comes in all different choices from the famous , mouthwatering onion naan 2 the appetizing potato cheese naan . The famous trademark which is the Tandoori Chicken is simply superb ! Imagine the soft tender chicken marinated in tantalizing curries then roasted 2 perfection ! The palak paneer is also extremely delicious . Chopped spinach cooked with the famous homeade cheese !  It is truly THE best restaurant I have been 2 and hope 2 go again ! P.S. I have been 2 many restaurants ...............Show less

Author: klfoodloverkuala lumpur
Title: the most authentic northern indian food
Review: One of the best if not THE BEST Tandoori food I have eaten. The tandoori chicken is so succulent and the best thing about it is, there are no artificial coloring and the meat is so tender. The palak paneer is the most unique dish I've tasted! Must recommend this dish to all! The owner himself is a testament to what good food is all about!! Service could be a bit slow but believe me, it is well worth the wait!!Show less

Author: RJCF1
Title: Worth the effort to find this cafe
Review: A great cafe worth finding. It is a bit out of the way down a side street but worth the effort to get there. Food was fresh and tasty and as a bonus there wS aur con inside. A recommended place.

Author: George C
Title: A lovely restaurant for breakfast!
Review: Ms. Ellie greets you at the door in all the COVID precautions.  The selection is thorough and the food is delicious.... coffee, cakes, omelettes, french toast and juices!  Cannot go wrong in this relaxing restaurant!

Author: 95lawrencenWindsor, United Kingdom
Title: Great Little Cafe
Review: Very relaxing spot not far from the main highlights of Old Melaka. The inside are is air conditioned which makes it an ideal lunch time place to get some relief from the heat. The food is good, and not pricy - mainly light meals (perfect for midday) and cakes and coffee for a bit later! Scrupulously clean, it's a small, friendly proprietress-run business that is worthy of success. We went there several times.Show less

Author: tpLong
Title: Cafe
Review: Home made pastry like bread, cookies, cake etc.  Coffee made by coffeee machine. Seating at bar counter. Table area no air condition.

Author: PSurretUnited Kingdom
Title: Nice coffee and cakes.
Review: Nice coffee and cakes. Really enjoyed the atmosphere there, good service, fun designs. A good place to stop whilst visiting the old part of Malacca. Note that it says closed on Tuesdays on here but just been this morning and it was open, well at least for coffee and cakes, not sure about other food, as I did not ask. Show less

Author: syabilazman
Title: great place but the food just ok
Review: the place its self really stunning..its a very small cafe..but the food below par for my personal opinion.A bit pricey for the food but ok with ambience.

Author: Wander594228Waiheke Island, New Zealand
Title: A.M.A.Z.I.N.G
Review: This place popped up as a recommend breakfast cafe in Malaka and the kids were keen for pancakes so we headed there with much anticipation. From the moment we walked in the door we knew it was a good choice. There was a beautiful selection of organic and gluten-free treats in the cabinets but the kids still insisted on pancakes and waffles (with icecream of course!). The food did not disappoint. Nor did the service. Eli (the owner/chef) took time to chat with us and gave us plenty of recommendations for other great eating spots around the city. We could not recommend this place highly enough. A must-visit place on your food-itinerary in Malaka. Thank you so much Eli, we won't forget our time with you and your AMAZING food. XShow less

Author: MiketwzSingapore
Title: Small shop worth visiting
Review: It’s a small shop a bit distance from night market but the food is sure good. The boss is also friendly, telling us to enjoy food, not to feast on food. Really have an enjoyable 3hrs time there having my coffee and food. Will be back again to try other food made personally by the boss.Show less

Author: MiketwzSingapore
Title: Nice place to have some food and rest!
Review: Although it’s a bit distance from the Jonker street but the food is nice and staffs are friendly. Manage to met their female boss chat with her. A very friendly boss and don’t have any hard selling. Intro some food to us which is just nice to fill our stomach and really appreciate the food. Will be back again with more friends and try other food as well.Show less

Author: isfarz
Title: DO NOT COME HERE!!!!
Review: why do I even bother coming here ???? I will give a negative star if that exist. I will NOT RECOMMEND this place ever. the worst cafe I have ever been to! staff are unfriendly for the prices “sky high”!! if you go here be prepared for disappointmentShow less

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Very nice place
Review: Really enjoyed our visit here... A lovely interior and exterior. Very calm and quiet vibe. Coffee was good.

Author: pamela j
Title: Good Cakes n Coffee
Review:
Must try the brownie n salted caramel cake. Both comes with a scoop of Haagen Daz ice creme. 
Load of desserts to choose from. 
Cozy cool place to chill away from the heat. 
Love the music selection.

Author: VickyK205Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great hot chocolate
Review: WEnt there after a Friend recommended it. Had breakfast there . I love hot chocolate and they do it like in many places in Europe. Melt real chocolate truffle in hot milk ! It was so, so yummy. Had scrambled eggs and a orange juice as well. The bread was home made. And all the cakes are made with butter.......a real gem of a place. Show less

Author: Sue G
Title: Breakfast
Review: A family business worth visiting! Unique twist to culinary art! Sister in law Sharon,  was great to meet, you gave us so many useful tips and suggestions for our walking tour of Melaka. Great to see your beautiful home opposite! Thankyou

Author: NTS7374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great place, good food!
Review: Read the reviews about this place and tried it out for lunch. It’s just situated on a side street off Jonker Walk so it’s not difficult to find.The wait staff here was prompt and polite and the food was delicious! The Breakfast Classic and the Mac & Cheese are 2 dishes that stands out. The portions were appropriate and the price is reasonable. However, be prepared for a 15-20min wait for the food because all the food is prepared at a small open kitchen behind the bar counter but the fact that they can produce such great tasting dishes with such a simple kitchen speaks volumes...Show less

Author: Peter AMelbourne, Australia
Title: Inspiring menu
Review: Stopped by for a mid-morning coffee and cake but will be back to try several of the more substantial menu items.Managed a cafe Cortado quite well.Edgy decor and attentive staff.Menu items are quite unique and inspired, so won’t disappoint the more adventurous/visual palate.Another one of the great micro food/drink outlets appearing in Melaka - all encouraging, as Jonker Walk morphs into a bus tourist waypoint...Show less

Author: Lwk88
Title: Chill place with great food!
Review: This is a gem, off the touristy haunts! Ambience is cool. Food is great. Especially the brownie with ice cream, which is not too sweet! Definitely will dine here again when i come by malacca

Author: 79deep2015
Title: Fantastic cinnamon French toast with ice cream and berries
Review:
I had the above , my wife had the thick butter kaya toast which was also good . 

I had the gula melaka coffee late .....also good . Highly recommend this place

Author: Jack F
Title: Prices in the middle class
Review: This restaurant is not very spacious room size, in addition to serving a variety of foods and beverages, there are also some instagramable spots. The food and drinks available are also quite tasty with prices in the middle class.

Author: Calvin LKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Gimmicky cafe
Review: I was scratching my head on ideas of where to take my mum for her bday celebration. I live around the area and have walked pass this cafe many times but it always came across to me as just another cafe with a gimmick. But this time around I thought i’d take a gamble with their menu. It didn’t disappoint. In fact, I’m extremely impressed with their simple and delish dishes. Sure they do not have a lot of space but if you book early with at least 6 pax, you could get a sit in their air conditioned dining room. But ambience aside, they also serve stunning dishes from an incredibly small kitchen. I’ll let the pictures speak for themselves but my personal favorites are the Cajun Chicken Burger and their Duck Salad. For dessert’s I’ll take the Ice cream with Cookie dough anytime! I wish for Malacca to have more of such dining place and quality! Show less

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Lunch at jonker
Review: This small restaurant is slightly of the main street of jonker. The western food and desserts they serve are very tasty and are prepared from the open kitchen behind the bar. A good place to try if you're looking for something of the beaten track.

Author: Nigel WOdense, Denmark
Title: ADORABLE
Review: We had detected this adorably one-off eatery in the Rough Guide. It's fun finding it - blink and you miss it - and so worth it. Imagine a tiny front concealed by foliage, then entering a long narrow bar area that continues into a charming courtyard filled with quirky artefacts and art. The 2 waiting staff were charming. We each ate an individual Victoria sponge fresh from the oven (some of the best sponge we'd ever tasted) with fresh berries and whipped cream on the side. Washed down with delicious berry and soda drinks. It was more than what the doctor ordered after tramping round China Town in the heat. WONDERFUL!Show less

Author: CherylYYLSingapore
Title: Cosy and great ambience!
Review: Dropped by for lunch and ordered a beef stew. They werent serving other customers (There were customers using their laptops though) and I waited for my food for quite awhile. But it was alright as I weren't in a rush. Really pleasant surprise as the serving was huge and it tasted really great! One thing was that the lighting in the cafe was a little dark and I couldn't see clearly what was I exactly eating. But I still ate it all because it was nice Show less

Author: michellelT3069LOKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great breakfast and nice ambience...cosy...❤️
Review: Located in the heart of the town.. This page is so cosy...Their food is so yummy.. I ordered 3 breakfast .. All are very delicious... Fresh salad...food are warm...The decoration of the place is well defined...But if only they can offer some kids menu will be an added advantage..Staffs are helpful and friendly..The sweet potatoes fries are so yummy I will definitely come again ..!!!!Show less

Author: MedelineK
Title: Delight my taste bud!
Review: Wonderful meal ! Taste of Salmon steak, beef stew and garlic bread are marvellous. I appreciated the efforts of chef, simple food but cook with hearts, quality of ingredients is good and food are NOT PRE COOK🖒 worth waiting !

Author: 1strangerthings1
Title: breakfast n brunch
Review:
great  breakfasts, 
good smoothies cakes n coffee
overall nice food good service sit in or outside its a small place

Author: Szilvus03
Title: Great breakfast
Review:
I had scrambled egg on the toast with mushroom and some salad on the side. It was delicious, the scrambled egg was perfect, not runny neither overcooked👌
Lots of places was closed, I am glad I found this nice spot in Melaka.

Author: Renny FBandung, Indonesia
Title: Bread not fresh, then I don't care if it's organic
Review: Came for breakkie. Toast served had some grayish layer on one of its surface,and tasted not fresh like that on old flour. We asked the kitchen staff, and she explained that it's organic bread and just been made 2 days before and it should be okay. To us it's a contrary to what we taste with our tounge, and they just don't want to be honest and fair with themselves. Food is pricey compared to other cafes on jonker area. Scrambled egg on toast cost RM 13.9, tomato soup 12,9. Show less

Author: michellebong90
Title: Great place for hanging out n relaxing
Review: Try their tasty and freshly bake cake...friendly service and hospitality...opposite is the owner's home stay, can enjoy with luxury stay experience...:)

Author: lsmei92
Title: MONEY MINDED BUSINESS
Review: Freshly baked bread and coffee may sound like a good thing but this was not the case when i dine here with a group of friends, the staff was impolite, the food- it was a total disappointment, there was nothing special about it, no authenticity or any sign of passion in the making. and the price was expensive for the portion. I will not recommend anybody to come here at all. Oh, and be aware, if u have a large group and requires a large table, make sure u bring more money to book for the bigger table. YES, THEY CHARGE FOR A TABLE, despite that use paid for food and tax already.Show less

Author: vickieplumOxford
Title: Great fro breakfast!
Review: We had breakfast here on three successive days when we stayed in Melaka, because it was such a nice place and the food was so good. It has a really nice, relaxed atmosphere and very friendly and helpful staff. There is a good choice of food for breakfast - but we kept going back for the muesli with fresh fruit, which is a really great way to start the day!Show less

Author: lamersrob
Title: Beautiful place, Bread wasn't fresh
Review: Really nice place, beautiful decorated. Muesli was nice but bread was for sure not fresh!! Tasted like it was from the day before. Therefore quite pricey, also coffee wasn't great...

Author: tealwindsingapore
Title: Amazing Scones and baked goodies
Review: My husband and i absolutely love the scones here! i was sceptical as scones are usually dry and tasteless in asia.... but my husband insist and we had some raisin butter scones. We were amazed! it was baked to perfection. soft in the inside and a bit crusty on the outside with juicy raisins. Eli bakes with love and honesty. she tries to use as natural ingredients as she can. makes her own jam and whip cream fresh. her almond and poppy seed cookies are amazing as well, melts in the mouth!Show less

Author: laurelin88Cornwall, Canada
Title: Freshly baked breads, coffee and delightful meals
Review: This is my new favorite place in Melaka. Away from the noisy Jonker Street, this gem of a cafe is easy to find (whether you parked across the river in Kampung Jawa or near the temples) A perfect place for all-day breakfast and lunch. We went there two days in a row just for coffee and desserts (they use Lavazza beans and Haagen Dazs ice cream - can't go wrong here). First part of the cafe has air conditioning. The middle section with an air well has natural light and was where scents of freshly baked bread and orange peels greeted us the first time. We love how the desserts are balanced, bursting with flavor but not overpowering with sugary sweetness. Would definitely revisit to savor the rest of the menu. Show less

Author: Marco MKathmandu, Nepal
Title: overpriced and little food
Review: My wife and I had a breakfast platter, advertised as being sufficient for 2 and containing beef bacon.The beef bacon was not bacon, but rather some sort of thin-cut sausage, and the plate was definitely not for 2 people (there was only ONE slice of toast cut in half!!!)Definitely not worth it.Show less

Author: Jude BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice cozy cafe joint
Review: We incidentally received breakfast voucher at the cafe for staying at The Stable. Finding this place was a hide and seek. Direction was clear but locating it was tough cause the front is covered with plants and greens. With that you may miss the signage. Food was superb. Welcoming staff and friendly. Choice for breaky was healthy. Other menu were delightful. They also have the garden with open ceiling in the middle. One of the must visit place for cafe hunters. Show less

Author: SarvesKKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Awesome Food!
Review: Went in starving and came out happy as a goose. No,I don't know if they are happy. I had Mac and Cheese while my friend tried the quesadilla. It was absolutely amazing. We were rather surprised as we didn't expect it to be that good. Both dishes were the best I've ever had. However,the place is a little pricey. I suppose it's alright to splurge once awhile for food that good. Service was reasonable and the place; well kept.Show less

Author: kai-elsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice Food, Decent Service.
Review: Contrary to most of the reviews that were written here which are negative ones, I must say that I had a pleasant time at the cafe. It is indeed a little hidden gem at Jonker walk and took me a while to stumble upon this cafe. I sat by the kitchen and observed how the kitchen helpers prepared the food and drinks that were ordered. Unlike the bad service that most people have encountered, the waitress that served us was decent and polite, including the kitchen helpers. Our food mashed potatoes with gruyere cheese took a while to be served as it was made upon order to ensure the freshness of the food, and upon noticing our expression, they came to inform us that it would be served shortly as it was baking in the oven. I also noticed that they were polite when a customer requested for her mocha to be changed to hot chocolate instead and they were already in the midst of preparing her order. I thought the food and service was decent and I was hoping to try their scones and baked goods (as these are freshly made daily) but unfortunately they were closed when I dropped by on Monday morning. If you ask me if I would go again, I would; as there are many interesting dishes on their menu.Show less

Author: enghongh
Title: Great food!
Review: Try the Cajun chicken burger! Well worth the wait in this little hidden gem of a coffeeshop. Staff were really attentive too. No credit card facilities though, bring cash!

Author: Troels S
Title: Friendly service and great settings
Review: A hidden gem in the middle of Melaka. Closed small 'court yard' when you walk in where you sit a long table. Please try their truffle hot chocolate :) Great service - wanted feedback in the food so the kitchen could improve.

Author: CarolynLanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Away from the hectic part of old town melaka
Review: Located in the old town area but a bit further down from most of the stores.loved the decor at the porch, it must be nice at night to have a glass of wine~dishes are alright, but you can tell that the chefs are 100% dedicated to what they are making! (open kitchen concept!) didn't get to try their dessert but they all look delicious...its a good getaway place when the sun is out there!Show less

Author: Samantha D
Title: Love the place
Review: Beautiful place to sit and relax! Staff are soo friendly and helpful... The smoke salad is wonderful. Will come back soon

Author: 615kazBrisbane, Australia
Title: A Hard to Find GEM
Review: This cafe is out of the way and can easily be over looked... I didn't even see a sign out the front. The cafe is open from 8am to 6pm, open for a scrumptous breakfast or yummie lunch. This cafe was such a surprise as it is so different from the norm in Melaka .. Charming setting offering air con area or lovely court yard area .. Very clean and inviting and the food is just delicious.. Possibly more westernised but still with tasty spices and if you're looking for fruit and salad this is the place to come .. A bit more expensive than the norm, but worth every penny... Such a lovely place !Show less

Author: Tim029Dorset, United Kingdom
Title: Little gem
Review: Unique artisan cafe with rooms to let above. A refreshing change from the usual local fare. Something not smothered in hot spicy sauce and beautifully presented. Slow down and chill out in the smart modern decor. The bread is freshly baked daily by Elle, the cafe owner. Check out the high spec contemporary rooms with heritage touches on airbnb.Show less

Author: Ron C
Title: A gem in Melaka
Review: Came across this delightful restaurant with fresh menu and pkeasant staff which we returned to on our 2nd and final day in Melaka for lunch. Not far off Jonkers street, a quiet location from the weekend crowds.

Author: wshaprMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice Western food
Review: This restaurant is introduced by a friend which we went there in a group. Please do not expect a fast service on serving the food as the owner really take some time and efforts to prepare the good food. They bake their own bread. There are 2 Nyonyas style guest rooms above the restaurant and run by the same owner. They are nicely decorated with old Malacca style but, with modern facilities. The only draw back for the restaurant is it is close by 6pm.Show less

Author: McNykeSan Francisco, California
Title: If you looking for good western / brunch in a cool space - come here!!
Review: I didn't like Malacca, but I loved this place. Had amazing healthy brunch food here. Was a nice relief from the tourist trap places of Malacca or the oily, greasy street food. Loved the French toast. Very artisan feel and great interior. yes, this place is 'relatively' expensive, but its worth it (otherwise, stick with the unhealthy street food).Thanks Eat 18 for brining some artisanal café culture to an otherwise sterile tourist trip that is Malacca.Show less

Author: Leah L
Title: A little pricey, but good food!
Review: Found this on my first morning and went every day for my breakfast muesli. Filled with oats, banana and strawberries, it was a great start to the day especially sitting outside in their front little deck! Have found other restaurants in malaysia lacking in fruit/veg dishes.My friend also said the Cajun chicken burger was lovely and filling. The waiters were very friendly and gave me books from the shelves about Malacca to read during my meal. Show less

Author: hweeying
Title: Western food
Review: Located opposit our hotel, under the same boss ie. Sharen. The restaurant is beautiful decorated. Mostly western food. Not really suit our taste because we like chinese food. The service is good. The food price is high but it's common around Jonker area.

Author: janechen_1977Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh-cooked food with cosy environment
Review: This is a cafe located in the old town of Melaka. I loved their concept with simple and fresh food using natural ingredients for customers. A must try is the hot chocolate served with chocolate truffle. I loved the roast chicken leg served with unique salad dressing too. Will definitely come back in my next visit.Show less

Author: RoulNaser
Title: Little cafe with big flavor!
Review: Love every bit of the cafe. The music was on point. The host was superb. We had Nyonya Laksa, Assam Laksa and Thai Iced Tea. They were flavorful and remind me of my late mum’s cooking. Delish! Will be coming back soon!

Author: 830shellypGrand Rapids, Michigan
Title: Warm welcome
Review: From the moment we approached the cafe the proprietor was inviting and friendly, eager to explain the cuisine. She was open to answer questions, even explain local food and places. You will feel welcome and maybe even make ne friends with other cafe visitors. We had their local breakfast, Nasi Lemak Pandan. Delicious! Show less

Author: StevenL3519
Title: Noah Art Café is a super cosy
Review: Noah Art Café is a super cosy café near Jonker street. Definitely worth going if you’re in the neighbourhood! The food is delicious, especially the Beef burger, and the service is great. We liked this place so much that we returned 3 times.

Author: arin9955
Title: Good Food Small Hidden Cafe
Review: Hidden but once found, it’s worth it. Small cafe that serves local cuisine and western food too. Friendly and good service. A nice cozy place. Food is tasty, above average and affordable. Ambience is Malacca feel. Hygiene average...

Author: azr_1959
Title: Average cafe. Can further improve.
Review: Average cafe. Can further improve on services and food quality to match with the price and for customer experience

Author: idrus2015Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great muslim cafe in Jonker Walk
Review: Situated opposite the historic Kampung Kling mosque, this Muslim cafe is popular with tourists and locals. We ordered grilled chicken, fish and chips, chicken and beef burgers.The orders were efficiently processed and we started to indulge: the grilled chicken chop was nicely done an came on a bed of carrot slivers bathed in mayonnaise, mashed potato and beansprouts.Fish and chips were generous cuts of dory fish dunked in garlic sauce. The burgers were thick and meat well done but were a challenge to finish.We could not resist the signature Musang King durian cendol for dessert: a bowl of coconut milk where a half submerged durian jutted out like an island in a sea of white; one has to trawl the coconut milk to get to the green cendol and beans. What a treat it was as we attacked the durian but less coconut milk would be better to enjoy this decadent sweetness.Service was efficient and polite, the hostess ensuring our orders came quickly despite the crowd.Show less

Author: samaniabroBangkok, Thailand
Title: Smell of Deliciousness
Review: I just arrived from Kuala Lumpur and was walking and starving as missed breakfast and lunch.When I pass by this restaurant the first thing was the smell of the food that kinda drag me in. I was so hungry and I let super nice lady in restaurant decide what I can have immediately. A bowl of CENDOL I got first following with Beef Lasagna and Mango Lassi. CENDOL: I can not explain in exact world what it tasted like, a bit from heaven? Or so. It was an amazing thing that I experienced in Melaka. Beef Lasagna: a perfect amount of food and taste that gave happiness to my mouth and soul. Mango Lassi: Rich, smooth, soothing flow that felt like a treat to myself after all day travel in rush. This cafe added as the wonderful memory of Melaka in my head. Highly recommended. Do I still need to say it? Come on..! You HAVE to try. Show less

Author: A9790ZSfrancisc
Title: Western food in Melaka
Review: Location is great.Ambience is chill and cozy.Staff are very accomodating.Food:Lamb chops : too big, good for 2Person. Sauce is good, i love it. Meat is juicy and tastyAglio : spicy but taste is perfectCarbonara: super creamy and tasty. Perfecto!!Beef burger with fries: I love the patty flame grilled with cheese,lettuce and tomatoes, i think the fries is ok but much better if its real potatoes.Show less

Author: kirinnnnn
Title: THE BEST HALAL FOOD IN JONGKER WALK, MELAKA
Review: I just tagged an Arabic Grill Chicken and Durian Crepe for my desert The chicken was nicely grilled and the meat of chicken was very soft to eat...The arabic rice was very nice and the textures is very complete delicious The desert of Durian Crepe is very delicious because you can taste a nice durian and the ice cream in the durian crepe desert.. This restaurant was a very great place to you all have a breakfast,lunch and dinner with your all family,couple and friends and other in this restaurat The food that i give is 5 stars and very niceOmgA little cute cafe and friendly staff A CUTE LITTLE CAFE AND FRIENDLY STAFFShow less

Author: nazrianis_Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Review of Noah Art Cafe
Review: It's so hard to find halal food in jonker Street. I'm stumble upon Noah Art cafe serving a next to masjid Kling. I had asam pedas pari, it's very spicy and hot, serve with rice, salted egg and sambal belacan. My favourite thai green tea. I higher recommend the food. The staf are friendly and the owner are so sweet. Keep up the good work.Show less

Author: connolcn
Title: Delicious lunch
Review: Lovely cafe serving both western and Malaysian specialities. Large portions of delicious food. Really friendly and accommodating staff. Best meal I've had so far on our trip!

Author: NaImKrabi
Title: Exceed expectation.
Review: I just followed Halal food signs and found a great homemade spaghetti and the delicious cendul durian. Love it!

Author: giko3
Title: Good food!
Review: Very nice restaurant in the center of malakka with delicious food and very nice staff! We would come back again!

Author: wendyleong520
Title: Must tried durian cendol
Review: Tried lots of times this is the first time I tried the best cendol ever. Will recommend my friend and family here next time

Author: mohdhafizz
Title: Good and will be back
Review: Had lunch here with my daughter. I ordered Nyonya Laksa and she want Aglio Olio.I cant tell you but its the best nyonya laksa I ever taste. Flavourfull and enough to make myself full.Aglio Olio also delicious and my daughter give it 6 star over 7. Lol.Recommended cafe if you happen to be in MelakaShow less

Author: AliciaN374Melbourne, Australia
Title: Beautiful food with service
Review: Beautiful food with service to match. We enjoyed our meal here so much, the only regret was not eating here more than once. The Laksa was delicious, well portioned and made with so much love. We also enjoyed the chicken and two of the house special green teas. Well prepared and throughout food. Thank you team. Alicia and Jeremy. Show less

Author: harlizab
Title: Super duper yummy & walla 😋
Review: I juz had asam laksa n d best I taste ...also the staff recommended me to try their new menu Cendol durian n I luv it ...the price is afordable fr cendol durian paste ..will sure come again & try their other menu & dessert..the best part is the only HALAL food in JONKER STREET Melaka .. Show less

Author: ainaashafinah
Title: The best Nyonya Laksa in MelakaA
Review: One the best nyonya laksa in melaka, big prawn with the thick gravy. The cafe is halal in Jonker Walk, value for money. I highly recommend this place.

Author: RatingDuoMerak, India
Title: Okay!
Review: Positives:- the staff is friendly and have the right attitude- they serve local tastes as well as western ones- good selection of drinks, ice lemon comes for free with all dishesNegatives:- a bit pricey when compared with average local prices- as it is a helal place the drinks’ menu is limited to non-alcoholic drinksShow less

Author: Nomad80442
Title: Good halal food in Jonker
Review: The place is near Masjid Kampung Kling. I had juicy chicken grilled with nice biryani rice. Also, had free ice lemon tea as set of menu. Nice staff & good service. Good food with reasonable price.

Author: Aishahexols
Title: Best Halal Food Cafe In Jonker
Review: The only halal food cafe in Joker street. I had the best Nyonya Laksa in Melaka. It was so spicy and hot. It also big. The durian crepe dessert is so creamy. I highly recommend the staff so friendly. Nice lepak place.

Author: Imahlee
Title: Food & service review
Review: We ordered 3 sets of dish :1. Beef brisket noodle - thought the portion would be more than received..the meat cooking style more like 'daging kenduri' type..suggestion to increase the volume of the noodle & maybe can make black paper type of the meat..2. Nyonya laksa - feel so worth the price..more spicy will be the best..3. Grilled chicken - so juicy..just as Malay, if can combine with rice, then jackpot..Some improvement I would like to suggest to the store :1. Install card terminal as I love cashles..easier to pay using debit/credit card..2. Only set food served here with ice lemon tea/carbonated drinks..as I am not a fan of ice lemon tea/carbonated drinks, best if they can provide ala carte price..Show less

Author: aisyamirah
Title: Such a cute n cozy cafe!
Review: We were looking for a place to celebrate bday. Was walking through d jonker streer, we passed by this cafe! Looks cute n cozy from outside. We had pasta, brownies, burger. Nice staff!! A very good service!!

Author: 623adeliaa
Title: Halal food in malaka near jonker street
Review: Oke lah. Near masjid kampung kling. But they take a longer time to serve the food. The food include free lemon tea.

Author: Csaba FBudapest, Hungary
Title: Cheap and good food
Review: A very simple place with low prices and good food / nothing special though, simply what you should expect from such a simple place. But for me it was a very good change after all the Chinese options you can find virtually everywhere else. Also, freshly made fruit juices.Show less

Author: XxbcxXLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good food
Review: My boyfriend had a beef shawarma and myself a chicken, they were both nice, however where we are from a shawarma wrap is LOADED and these weren’t so I think they should change the menu to state ‘chicken wrap’ to avoid disappointment from other customers - still tasty none the less. The chips were yummy and the beef samosas were good too. Staff also very friendly and food reasonably priced. Show less

Author: vijenus
Title: Price is reasonable however food is disappointing.
Review: Found this place under #Halalwilltravel website under 10best cafe in Melaka. Order a ice lemon tea and iced coffee. Pretty sure the iced lemon tea is just from Pokka Iced Lemon Tea just adding on ice and lemon slice. Iced Coffee seems okay for my partner. Ordered a Seafood Aglio Olio. According to thec picture provided on the menu, it seems like tomato based spaghetti instead however just gave it a shot cos I'm ultra hungry. It appeared to be Sambal Seafood Aglio Olio. As a person who can't take spicy food, it was rather disappointing but the spiciness level is just nice. Texture of the spaghetti is too hard. Not Al Dente at all. Fish was uncooked. Mentioned to the chef but nothing was done as a service recovery. Partner ordered a Grilled Chicken Chop. Overwhelming fries but too much salt too. The sauce was ok however chicken was slightly uncooked and too dry and salty. Damage: Seafood Aglio Olio : RM18Grilled Chicken Chop: RM18Iced Lemon Tea: RM3.50Iced Coffee:RM6.00OVERALL: PRICE : still reasonable TASTE: poor. Not recommendable..Will not come again.bShow less

Author: trouty96
Title: Vegetarian and vegan options at cheap price
Review: Popped in here for lunch and they had a range of vegetarian options which was a nice change! Food was nice - very pleased! Not sure why it's ££-£££ should really be cheap eats! Had three spinach samosas for 6myr!

Author: CGUrbanaIllinois
Title: Good portion sizes, just not as good any most other food in area
Review: The food just wasn't very good. It was reasonably priced. The pesto chicken was dry and very salty. The pasta was overcooked. I am not remembering the other entrees we had--not memorable.

Author: Ananas H
Title: Halal in jonker street
Review:
super coconut shake
super kapitan chicken
cozy place !
right in Front of the oldest mosque of malaysia. .

Author: eqazamanPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Dinner Meals
Review: Overall is average. The food is fine and comes together with an ice lemon tea. Somehow, you cannot choose an ice lemon tea only if you're not buying the SET Meal. The price is average for the portion served. The location is fine and next to a "Masjid".Show less

Author: Shikin J
Title: Ok-ok
Review: Quaint and cosy cafe. Western and local meal set avail. Nice atmosphere to relax. Food is satisfactory. Local taste.

Author: Florian  G
Title: Super local food
Review:
We were visiting the old Mosque in Melakka and saw this nice halal restaurant.
The local food (chicken and beef) and the ice tea were exzellent and we really can not complain on the price!
We really can recomment this place!

Author: HAFIZ ALI K
Title: Lunch at Halal food in Jonker
Review:
Holidays with friend, 2 days 1 night.. today last day at melaka, and we go famous place Jonker Walk..buy some souvenir Melaka Nyonya laksa, tasted, delicious, good combination with hot Americano
👌👌👌👌

Author: nismailm
Title: Nice little halal food joint in the heart of Jonker Walk area
Review: The cafe is located right beside Masjid Kampung Kling in the heart of Melaka old town area. Foods are reasonably priced. The best London Salt Beef around. Also a place where tourists can buy paintings or photographs from local artists.

Author: 264dennisz
Title: Try somewhere else
Review: It was not what we expected. We were graving for some 'western food'. But the bread from the panini was terrible. The pizza was very poor and had an instant bottom. Hope they improve their western cooking skills because the atmosphere was pretty ok.

Author: Chriszchyn
Title: Very bad food
Review: The food isn't good at all. So disappointed .The staff service is bad even there is not much customer . Seriously need a major food quality improve..

Author: DiscerningDoyenneMelbourne, Australia
Title: A pleasant surprise.
Review: Wandering around the back streets of Chinatown, we came across this cafe in a quiet street, opposite the mosque. With air conditioning and fans, plus a quiet frontage, it made for a nice respite from the heat. The menu was in English with pictures making selection easy. We wanted to try something traditional for lunch so skipped the wide selection of sandwiches, pasta etc. We shared nasi lemak with chicken plus a beef rending, with a lemonade and the best mango lassi I've ever had. Both dishes weren't overly spicy but very flavoursome. The cafe was simply presented with framed photos of the local area available to buy. The staff was friendly and attentive.A nice find, about 1 minute off the main Jonker street. Show less

Author: nescafeosuam
Title: snack time!
Review: located behind the masjid kampung kling . you may find this cafe to enjoy your snack time . they served from lite to heavy meals suitable for ur craving needs .

Author: shikin28Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cute Halal cafe in Jonkers Malacca
Review: Was looking for some Halal food in Jonkers Street when I spotted this cute little cafe. Serves good range of Halal local and western cuisine. The London famous Salt Beef Sandwich which was mouth-watering and tasty Beef Brisket Noodle was their speciality. A very cosy ambiance enhanced by nice selection of soothing music, makes us want to sit for long! Good service too.A must try Halal cafe for all, in the heart of Jonkers!Show less

Author: JoaoEspinha
Title: Great food and mango juice
Review:
Certainly a place to go back. The staff was friendly and the food tasty. We had the egg plant lasagna and spinach samosa. The mango juice was full on delicious creamy and fresh!
Price was ok.

Author: hjmokh
Title: Great Culture Cafe
Review: Located strategically in Jonker Street, a must visit cafe especially for tourist. Serve wide varieties of food from famous local cuisine to western & grill. For Muslim tourist this is a place to stop enjoying the halal foods with family & friends plus also can perform your prayer just in opposite Noah Art Café is Kapitan Kling Mosque. Value for money and nice crew staffs.Show less

Author: hxhxhx
Title: Yummy!
Review: The bak kut teh soup base is the herbal kind. You can choose mushrooms and other add-ons in your soup. They have several type of Chinese tea too. The service is good too. Overall this is a good place delicious traditional claypot Bak Kut teh.

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Teo Chew Style Bak Kut Teh.
Review:
Teo Chew Style Bak Kut Teh. Soup taste good. Braised pork leg is not bad too. 

Bak Kut Teh soup base is herbal type. Fried vegetables is nice.

Author: toledocupra
Title: Food was OK only
Review: Food was OK. I find the jb ones nicer. Crowd has died off. Went in the afternoon, lunch time minimal crowd

Author: Joyce TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great Bak Kut Teh
Review: You can add mushrooms and other stuff into the bak kut teh. Vegetables as well as 3 layer pork stew is great too. They serve lunch as well as dinner. Maybe breakfast too, as they run out of you tiao when we were there for lunch.Show less

Author: Sab26ess
Title: Best Bak Kut Teh
Review: I'm the 3rd generation coming to this place for Bak Kut Teh. My grandpa and daddy's favourite place. Still have the original taste and good serving. Must try.

Author: wesleywaisiu
Title: Ice breakfast with Teo Chew Bak Kut Teh
Review: The Bak Kut Teh is very special with the herbs inside. Taste very good and is a must try for breakfast in Melaka.

Author: Gyuminnie
Title: Good for breakfast and lunch.
Review:
Delicious Bak Kut Teh in Melaka. 
You can add on some side dish. Fried vegetables is available too. For rice you can chose between yam rice or white rice.

Author: IwanYoeliantoJakarta, Indonesia
Title: THE BEST TEOCHEW BAK KUT TEH
Review: Everytime when i go to Malacca (Malaysia) never try at this shop. Each time when i pass by always have a lot of customer. So this time i decided to try and yes absolutely delicious and also consider cheap for me. The meats are fresh and big portion. Only the soup i think not enough herbal so i just can taste a normal pork soup. I choose complete meats combination with plain rice also chinese tea slightly almost RM. 18. It's not an expensive causes has a lot of meats inside. Definitely when you eat this you will get full.Show less

Author: sayvonnaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Malaysian style pork rib soup in city center
Review: this restaurant was highly recommended by the taxi driver. So I went for it.by the time I got it the shop was almost 145pm and theu closed at 2pm normally.I have ordered 1 person share and asked to add pork stomach. the taste of the soup was herbal goes well with fried fitter. it is a family run restaurent and service is fast. you can ask for pork ribs, or just meat or mixed of both. I recommend foreign tourist to give this shop a try as the other shop near the hotel or mall has lesser patrons and doesn't taste so nice per local. it is your choice.. you can try both and comment..Show less

Author: chubbykittytravels
Title: Bak kut teh
Review: Soup is more herbal and not the peppery type. Can add mushrooms for rm5. Quite generous portions and can request for soup refill. Do go early as it tends to get crowded during peak lunch hour.

Author: Hiker788
Title: Nice decent bah kut teh..
Review: Always packed. Be early. once went there at about 2pm, and was told food finished. decent environment. as for the taste , i wont say its the best in town as i have eaten much more better bah kut teh.

Author: ChillaxGalSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly Auntie who takes orders
Review: We had originally ordered BKT for 2 and pork belly for 1, plus stir fry tapioca leaves. The auntie who took our order suggested we order the BKT for 1 else it's to much. We really appreciate this as we can't finish all our food since it's breakfast for us. Try to sit outside where it's cooler. The soup is good, just like any famous JB BKT soon huat or soon soon Heng. What's different is the yam rice, I can taste the mushy yam which makes the rice so fragrant.Show less

Author: Rebecca GSingapore, Singapore
Title: Still good
Review: The place looked the same, owner cum chef the same, the wife who is taking the order remain same and food is the same - damn good. The peppery soup with tinge of herb and celery still tasty with mixture of offal, pork ribs, mushrooms,etc that goes well with dough fitter, white rice and oh.. the yam rice with lots of garlic, chillies and dark black sauce, drown with cup of chinese tea. Top up with trotters, pork belly, pork front leg - all in claypot and additional veggie and bean spouts. The imperfection is the time you need to wait for refill of soup. Do arrive early like 7.30am to wait - otherwise can be a long queue.Show less

Author: slepyvonSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent brunch but super long wait
Review: Food was delicious and portion was a lot. We have a sumptuous brunch. Was supposed to be our breakfast but waited for an hour plus to get someone to take our orders. Apparently only 1 aunty taking orders and also collecting payment. Upon ordering we waited for another 30mins or so for the food to be served. Hopefully it will improve. Show less

Author: Vicente8
Title: Tasty and colorful
Review: Authentic Chinese Bak Kut Teh located at the corner of a quiet street. The place is famous with locals and Singaporeans who are expert in the matter. As waiters are running high and low, you have to voice and hijack them to place your order. You can see your dish being cooked in the open kitchen and savour the fragrances lingering around. During peak time, you may share big tables with other guests, an opportunity for nice chats the time of a lunch. Not to mention: the food is tasty, with good and consistent meat and delectable herbal soup. Portion could be a little small for big eaters. Free refill of soup and fair bill pleasantly complete the experience.Show less

Author: angely_angel
Title: Not too bad for the food
Review: Bak Kut Teh was good. But didnt have other small dishes to go along. Perhaps thats why they are good since they put all their focus on making Bak Kut Teh

Author: poseidon1430Singapore, Singapore
Title: Expected better taste
Review: Was there with family of four. Tried to order 2 clayports of bah kut teh for 2 but waiter indicated that I cannot order 2 clayport since we are a family of four. I can only order 1 clayport of bah kut teh for 4. As my family sat on a big table (no small table at that point of time), 1 clayport makes eating difficult as we will have to stretch to reach for food. After some time, I gave up trying to make my point to him. Wasnt a good experience though.Going back to the food, the taste wasnt what I had expected after eating at Shi Wang Bah Kut Teh at Batu Pahat which tasted much better or at the very least, my family members had the same thoughts. Portion was good and price is somewhat abit more pricey than the previous bah kut teh I had.Show less

Author: and12345audyt
Title: Good Taste!!!
Review: If you visit Melaka, put this place on your list because the foods are so good.Beside bakut teh, they serve vegies, cakwe, and pork leg black soup.This place is suitable for family and friends because you guys can share your foods.Service is not so good because of the restaurant is crowd when lunch time.Show less

Author: jlim76
Title: Not the malaysia bak kut teh that expected
Review: Was there for breakfast,. Very fast to find seats, not that crowded. But the taste was not what I'd expected.

Author: agnaspSingapore, Singapore
Title: Don't go near the kitchen
Review: Not too bad. We enjoyed our lunch at Teo Chew Bak Kut Teh. But always remember not to go near the kitchen...The wait was reasonable. They add soup for us twice although according the one of the waiter there is not much soup left.The price was not too expensive.Show less

Author: KiddySing
Title: Good Bak Kut Teh, service was good
Review: I thought the Bak Ku Teh here was really quite good. Excellent soup base, portion size adequate. The service was pleasant too! It was a group of 7 of us for breakfast on a weekday, so maybe that it is why it was pleasant.

Author: copyrabbit
Title: Location changed?
Review: I think they have shifted to new place. The bak kut teh taste average. However the vinegar pig trotter and the salted vegetable  is very nice.

Author: BlackBaron1976Singapore, Singapore
Title: Love the BKT and other dishes
Review: Been to the restaurant twice, and we love the authenticity of the bak kut teh and signature red-wine ginger chicken. It's nice to have BKT done with a "traditional" taste, and recommended to go with mee sua and yes, lots of dough fritters (you teow)! Restaurant owners are friendly, and overall cleanliness is a plus: it was raining the evening we visited, and certainly the whole experience provided a sense of warmth to the stomachs on a cold wet evening!Show less

Author: MK_Lai
Title: Yummy Bak Kut Teh
Review: Good place for lunch.Bak Kut Teh a pork rib dish cooked-->Here is the place, popular among local people and tourist. Super crowd during public holiday & weekend. Open from 8am until 2pm (sometime might close early)

Author: iloveperthMalaysia
Title: Authentic
Review: I am from Malacca and I love the teo chew bah kut teh here. It is served in a claypot and has a selection of pig's stomach , liver, kidney, bean curd sheets, bean curd puff, button mushrooms, baby corns, straw mushrooms and fried fritters (you tiao). They have pig's trotter too and other dishes. Prices are reasonable. Can be a bit crowded during the weekends. Show less

Author: saml452
Title: Surprisingly good BKT in Malacca
Review:
Two of us ordered a claypot "mixed" BKT to go with yam rice for breakfast. The suop is tasty, good variety of meat and mushroom etc. Particularily love the pig kidney; fresh, nicely prepared.
Recommended

Author: ongt2013Singapore, Singapore
Title: Bak Kut Teh surprise in Peranakan territory
Review: I arrived to check in my Hotel (Novotel) a bit too early , 1pm hence decided to walk out to this joint. Before even i reach this place, you can smell the aroma. Order a small claypot just to try as i had already had lunch at Auntie Lee's. This is real potent stuff and will knock you off, its really one of those top bak kut teh. I decided to come back for lunch before i head back to spore. This time i add in kidney and also ordered the dry one. Its delicious, not to be miss by bak teh lovers.Show less

Author: Jeremy_C_MHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very nice BKT!
Review: One of our favorite places in Malacca.
