They open for breakfast but will finish/close by noon/1pm i think.We ate there for breakfast recently around 845am.Tasty soup, meat just about tender and plenty vege variety to add on.If you park around there, remember you need parking coupons!!!Show less

Author: brajan
Title: Bak kut teh
Review: Seems full all the time when we pass by this restaurant, they specialized in Pork Broth Cooked in a herbal tasting broth accompanied by steam white rice

Author: MAKANRANGERS
Title: Awesome
Review:
My first time here brought by my high school friend for lunch.
The soup is light and the herbal taste is not too empowering. Love their yam rice!
Also ordered veggies and the price is reasonable.
Ladyboss is very friendly and service is fast.

Author: AIK71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Light soup with super dark saurce
Review: Found this behind another hokkien Bak Ki Yeh which is in front of novetel hotel, it's also behind the famous Tong Sheng Restuarant. Soup is not so herbal taste or smell but taste flavorful, which luckily suits my younger kids. Meat size is pretty small and after RM$70, don't feel like a meaty meal. I ordered BKT (2pax portion) pig trotter and layered meat (2 pax), 4 yam rice and 1 fried vege. So it's a bit exp but will I come again? Maybe if I happen to drive pass but will not look for it specially. Show less

Author: 1john316Singapore, Singapore
Title: Our favourite Bak Kut Teh
Review: This is our favourite Bak Kut Teh shop in Melaka. We've been patronizing this shop for many years. We like it because the soup is lighter than others and the herbal taste is not that strong. Besides the bak kut teh soup, we always order the stewed pork leg with bean curds and a dish of vegetables. Prices are reasonable.Show less

Author: Lee L
Title: Good soup food
Review:
Waited 40 mins for the bah kut teh and I say it's worth the wait. 
Had good yam rice n braised pork belly. 
Soup is very good and warm. 
Service is good.

Author: ivonnaxAsiain, Spain
Title: Pricey & A tad too salty but overall okay
Review: This is the more peppery type and less of the herbal taste. We ordered 4 pax portion for 5 adults to share and it was a bit too much. So for average eaters, 3pax portion maybe optimal for 5 adults.The soup is refillable as well as the tea. We had a portion of stir fried vege and 2 bowl of Yew Char Kway. With yam rice.The total bill was around 70++ MYR.Service is relatively fast and fuss-free. The eating place were half-full when we visited at around 10am on a Sat morning.Location is less than 5 minutes walk from Escadia Hotel, Hatten Hotel, Straits Hotel or Novotel Hotel. Open air (no A/C) with plenty of fan.Show less

Author: JoanneLeow
Title: Delicious!
Review:
Love the pork broth! So light yet flavorful. Succulent pork pieces were fresh and juicy! You can also request your preferred part of meat.
Also must try is their braised trotter. 
 
Do visit the place early as they tend to sold off everything by 2!

Author: FromKluang
Title: Better Bak Kut Teh in Malacca
Review:
This restaurant may be a better choice for you If you like to 
have Bak Kut The in Malacca.
Soup is just balance not too much herb and paper.
Pork knuckle and yam rice also very nice.
The price is very reasonable and valueable.

Author: AlfredKhoo
Title: Valuable price & normal food
Review: That was valueable , when we go there need to wait around 30 minutes but the food disappointed just normal . 2 person cost around RM 30+ , food so so

Author: JennYong
Title: One of the better Bak Kut Teh in Malacca
Review: It's my second time here and this time I brought my friends to try. Everyone love it!!We ordered the braised pork belly with pig trotter which we finished off even before the Claypot Bak Kut Teh arrived. The sauce it's cooked in was very good and not too salty or oily. Do note that they do throw in some chili bits so if you have young kids, remember to tell to omit the chili.The humongous Claypot came bubbling hot with so much ingredients. We ordered one with ribs, internal organs and extra serving of mushrooms. Most soup in Malaysia tends to be more herbal but this is a good balance. And the best part is that it's not oily.The yam rice is also very good to go with the food.Be prepared to wait at least 30mins for your food. We were late today and arrived at 12pm which is right smack in the middle of Sunday family lunch hour. So first we waited awhile for a table and then another wait for food. Show less

Author: Stoney7788Singapore, Singapore
Title: The best bak kut Teh
Review: I don't usually rave easily for this dish but this really blew my mind. Soup was awesome. Food from bak kut Teh to the pork knuckle or strip of pork meat dish was awesomeHighly recommended if you like bak kut Teh. I had even people who wasn't into bak kut teh raving after eating here!Show less

Author: Damian C
Title: Must try!!
Review:
this is our breakfast hangout whenever we arrived Melaka on the first day.
Try their pork trotter and bak kut teh and u'll not go wrong.

Author: irene lSingapore, Singapore
Title: Satisfying meal
Review: We had lunch at this place just before our coach back to Singapore, and it's satisfying, warms the stomach. The soup is not peppery type, so my child also enjoyed it. There is no menu, the auntie taking our order recommended us bak kut teh with some mushrooms, pig intestine (found 1pc in soup) and Fen Chang (also 1pc). We also had pig trotter with gravy and a plate of kailan. The vegetables vary, as what they have for the day. They had kailan, cabbage and spinach for that day. Reasonably priced, and worth the walk from hotel.Show less

Author: RaymondHoSingapore, Singapore
Title: HOR CHIAK
Review: Five of us enjoyed a large boiling hot claypot of Bak Kut Teh, side dishes of Pig's Trotters in dark soya, bowl of plate of kai lan, two plates of yu-teow and tow kee, five bowls of yam rice and a pot of Wulong for MYR160. The 20-minute lunch time queue was worth the wait. The bak kut was tender, the soup not too peppery not too herbal. Generous toppings of button and straw mushrooms. Petite lady waiter cum cashier [presumably related to owner] is polite as she takes orders and suggests menu. 2-minute walk from Beuford Hotel. Come early to avoid the lunch and dinner crowds.Show less

Author: 球 毛
Title: Nice bah kut teh
Review:
As the hotel staff suggest us. We went to teow chew bah kut teh at melaka raya. Also near with our hotel. 5 min distance.

The food was delicious and the boss also very friendly. Having a good breakfast in malacca. Reasonable price also.

Author: leo_s_CSI
Title: Nice food
Review: Nice and tasty teo chew bak kut teh not too herbal and not too much pepper. Taste is just right. Big portion and close to hattan hotel.

Author: Rebecca GSingapore, Singapore
Title: slight drop in quality
Review: The 1st time was more than 9 months, 2nd time was 6 months back but they were renovating. Just went over the week end and the place is still crowded. The soup comes in a claypot is steaming hot but the soup seems to be a bit 'thin' or I should say 'watery' and the flavour was not so strong and aromatic as before. The green veggie is good, so is the yam rice. Will still patronise the next time. Overall is still good as compared with others.Show less

Author: Doug S
Title: Quite a good bak out teh.
Review: Traditional Malaysian style bkt, full of flavourful ingredients and good vegetables side dishes. Love the yam rice and the old school charm of this place. Remember to go early, preferably in the morning!

Author: uncle_sim123Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Bak Kut Teh in Malacca
Review: 20 mins walk from Hatten Hotel or Equatorial Hotel. Go before 12pm before it sold out. Bak Kut Teh is Nice (even people like me who usually don't eat Buk Kut Teh like it). Order Stewed Pork (if you like more meat) or Pork Trotter (if you like more skin and fat). You Zhar Kway, Yam Rice and Chilli (with garlic and sweet black sauce). It is always a satisfying meal to me. All the above cost about RM$80 for 4-6 persons. Show less

Author: Lee S
Title: Food
Review: The bak kut teh of this restaurant is very good. I especially like the pork meat ball. It is very tasty.

Author: JamesTanSLSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice Bak Kut Teh (Pork Ribs Soup) being served in Melaka
Review: Having read about this place so much, we decided to walk over from our hotel (Hatten Hotel Melaka) for a breakfast.This small little restaurant was crowded with local folks from Melaka as well as tourists like ourselves.We had to wait a while for a table and even longer for our meal. We ordered a serving of their famous Bak Kut Teh and a small portion of braised pork trotters.The wait was worth it. First of all, the pork was tender (not tough like other BKT places we had tried before), the soup full of flavors and not overpowering. The dish came with some mushrooms and some celery, which made it a nice combination. The braised pork trotters was in a very nice gravy but the meat used was too fatty for my personal taste. The accompanying yam rice was nicely cooked with small chunks of yam.Show less

Author: KenaidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simple and Delicious Teo Chew Bak Ku Teh
Review: Claypot ooked ribs and celery. Soup base is brown clear but simply delicious.Special request if you want mushrooms and tau pok to come together with the simple pot of ribs with celery slices to neutralise the oiliness of pork.Also recommended will be stir fried vegetables and the braised pig trotters.All goes well with either white rice and they yam rice.Very affordable price.Shop operates from 7:30am to 2pm daily except on Monday Show less

Author: Rebecca GSingapore, Singapore
Title: delicious
Review: Upon recommendation by the hotel, we visited TeoChew Bak Kut Teh for breakfast on a Sunday morning. Crowded with the locals and do need to wait for a table (about 10 minutes), the food is delicious, good and hot, but the range is limited to pork. Rather surprise to find celery, wooden ears in the soup but rather refreshing as the aroma of both is not overpowering. Price is a bit higher than other Bak Kut Teh places. Services generally is okay except the chef cum boss who kept giving instructions in loud and sharp voice.Show less

Author: FelixH374Singapore, Singapore
Title: Different tasting Bak Kut Teh
Review: The soup was delicious with a distinct herbal flavor . The pork was tender and falling off the bone . The inoki mushrooms in the soup was a nice touch. We ordered a plate of bean sprouts with salted fish and a Claypot of pigs trotters -both were excellent . The yam rice was a good compliment .Show less

Author: Christian J
Title: One of The best
Review: For me, its officially one the best bakut teh i've ever tried. The place was so simple, me and my mom found this place incidentally while we're looking for hotels nearby.The bakut teh portion is plenty, even for a man. The taste is just feels right. The char kwe is ok.The price is higher than other foods nearby, but its still sooo worthed. (Compare with other bakut teh restaurant in melakaraya area, this one is still cheaper!)Show less

Author: John C
Title: Yummy...
Review:
Just next to La Boss Hotel.
Really yummy Bak Kut Teh, even my 4 & 6 yo loved the soup.
Served in pipping hot claypot.
Remember to order yam rice and fried fritters.

Author: Ronald WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Porky food
Review: One of the nice Ba Ku Teh in town even though it may not beat the famous Klang. It is crowded at times. So do plan before heading to the shop. Further to that, the services is quite fast and it worth the money for the foodShow less

Author: Gerald K
Title: Still great Bak Kut Teh!
Review:
Went back to Malacca for a short trip and back to Teo Chew Bak Kut Teh! This time, I went armed with a camera to take some pictures of the food.

The food is still just as good! Make sure to go there before 2:30pm.

Author: JasmyinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Awesome cooked piggies
Review: Everytime I come back to Melaka, I make it a point to go to this place to have my fill of bak kut teh. Teo chew bak kut teh is a tad bit different in the sense that the soup is garnished with celery. It has a fresh taste to it, not overtly herbalish and this place gives decent cuts. My favourite combination would be loads of mushrooms, pork ribs and meatballs (the meatballs here are homemade, hence soft, delicious and full of flavour). The highlight of my trip here every time is the stewed pork leg/trotter. This version is without the vinegar and the sauce is so yummy, I can have it with the rice just like that every single time. You can order your bak kut teh with a side of stir fried vegetables and have either white rice or yam rice (take the yam rice, it is flavourful and a dish of its own). Prices here are not on the low side (warning!). A portion for one for the bak kut teh, stir fried vegetables and stewed pork leg with three yam rice and tea to go along with cost us RM39.00. For bak kut teh, that is above average pricing but it is well worth it!This place is opened for breakfast and lunch, you might want to go there a little earlier for both sessions because this place is PACKED on the weekends!Show less

Author: paparichweeGilroy, California
Title: Probably the best Bak Kut Teh in Melaka
Review: Tried the Teo Chew Bak Kut Teh stall for the first time this morning. The location was easy to find. It was very crowded.. natural air conditioned. Fans working, warmed but the correct environment for Bak Kut Teh..We sat at a table and soon, a person came to take our order. Everything came in a claypot, piping hot..Delicious, tender ribs, mushrooms, pork loin slices, black fungus, etc. All in a claypot. We also ordered a plate of vegetables to go with the soup dish. And of course, we have Tikuanyin tea..and it goes very well with the bak kut soup.. Just awesomely delicious..The total costs came to a reasonable price for two people. Love it.. Oh, you will enjoy the boss, who cooks the bak kut teh, who turns out to be quite a noisy character. He will shout out for your when your dish is ready to be served.. And he never stop calling which means that his business is really very good..Show less

Author: 3306Singapore
Title: Not bad at all
Review: The BKT here is different from the more peppery style that I'm used to in S'pore, but it tastes nice in a different kind of way and is definitely worth a try. I think this place may be hard to find if you are driving without GPS though. There's a oldish guy who seems to be the patriach-boss-chef all rolled into one, who likes to shout orders very loudly every 20 seconds or so. Its quite interesting in an old-fashioned sort of way for the first few minutes, but it gets kinda irritating after that if you were sitting close by like us : )Show less

Author: Gerald KSingapore
Title: Best Bak Kut Teh I've tasted!
Review: When in Melaka, this is a must go to place to eat. Ever since my friend (who is native Malakan) recommended me this place, I go there every trip I take to Malaka. This is the best bak kut teh I have eaten!This place serves bak kut teh, which is a herbal spiced pork rib soup. In the clear soup, you can choose to have meat balls, pigs intestines, pork belly, in your soup too. Inside the soup, you will have some mushrooms and celery too. The pork ribs is usually eaten dipped with a mixture of chili, garlic, and thick black soya source.Apart from the pork rib soup, they also serve stewed pigs trotters, stir friend vegetables, and a choice of plain white rice or yam rice. They would also serve dough fritters (you tiao) to be eaten after you dip into the soup. This place is not air-conditioned, and is like a coffee shop setting. They start business in the morning, but would wind up at about 2:30pm, so make sure you go before that. They are not open on Mondays. I just went in September and my wife and I ate a full meal and paid only RM22 for the meal!Show less

Author: Mykayzali
Title: Good Food with Awesome View
Review: The place is clean which is very important. The food served was tasy. Definitley will patron the cafe again.

Author: Dstep83Moscow, Russia
Title: Great food and atmosphere.
Review: Probably best place to eat in Melaka. One of very few Halal restaurants in town. I must have tried all of their food and we will definitely be visiting them again soon! I love atmosphere and a river view, clean facilities, wide variety of food, quick service and friendly staff. The owner always cheerful, energetic, handsome and has a cute smile! Show less

Author: Aidi2210Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent service and quality of food
Review: We were in Melaka for a short trip and had dinner at the Dutch Harbour. Food was amazing. Ambience was spectacular! Service was good even they were short of staff. Sitting outdoors by the Riverside feels like having drinks at the riverbanks in Paris. Though opposite pubs played loud music, it didn't change the good and nice environment. Definitely will come again!Show less

Author: n00raishahs
Title: A Place To Relax After A Long Walk
Review: A nice cafe to choose to enjoy great food and Malacca River. The ambiance in the cafe itself is amazing too, a perfect choice (at least for me) to relax after a long walk. Not to forget the friendly staffs, thank you for the lovely experience.Show less

Author: 216aidaz
Title: must repeat 👍
Review: chicken chop & lamb chop : a must try menu when you visit this cafe. we were here for 2 nights in a row having  these delicious meal . we will come back again .

Author: EzriqS
Title: Awesome Food and Service
Review: Didn't expect much when I came. It came out a pleasant surprise... The service from the team was good... Ever pleasant and accommodating. And the Grilled Chicken I had was awesome... I was expecting a typical local western food where they serve the grilled chicken with black pepper sauce or mushroom sauce..But.. The ones I had was probably a butter mushroom type of sauce. It was awesome. Goes well with the chicken and the mashed potatoes... And I think there was a crispy caramelized onions as well...Anyway, it was awesome. Fully recommended...I am definitely come again...An hour drive from Seremban and back definitely worth the trip...Show less

Author: Travel47287806306
Title: Definitely coming back here
Review: Amazing environment. Friendly staffs. Awesome food. If you're into candle light dinners by the river, this is the place for you!

Author: Mummyausdeutch
Title: Average food taste and not value for money
Review: i dont recommend this place. the portion is small and not value for money. the only good is the nice river view. we ordered rib eye and pizza. rib eye was quite salty and the portions not like the picture shown in menu. pizza taste average. and one more u cannot pay by card. u kind of having high expectation when the prices are quite expensive.Show less

Author: NAH090151
Title: Tasty food
Review: Me and my partner eat nasi lemak pandan grilled lamb and grilled chicken chop. The food was good, the service was quick. The river cruise view made our night perfect 😊

Author: X8330ERkarenwSunshine Coast, Australia
Title: Eating here was lots of fun - lovely staff
Review: We really wanted to dine outside by the river so we were shown to a table. We knew the weather was unpredictable and rain was possible. Our lovely fish meals arrived, and then the rain started. We were offered to move to a table inside but we had umbrellas and decided to finish our meals under shelter. So relaxing, and a cherished memory. There is choice on the menu, the drinks were refreshing, staff were friendly and I can recommend the cafe for a night out by the river.Show less

Author: 828muhammadrizalfJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Good place for dinner
Review: The palace is located on melaka river bank,Try to have dinner dinner there, the atmosphere and scenery is great with the melaka river full of light at nightime.The food itselft is tasty, there are two set western and local (malaysia). The chicken chop set is great taste, and my wife also enjoy the asam laksa set.Price is a little bit expensive 72 RM for 2 adult and 1 babies. ( most expensive spending for food during in melaka) but it is worth it with great atmosphere and scenery you can enjoy during dinning.Show less

Author: Elena V
Title: poor menu
Review: i do not recommend this place.the food is average, portions are small and with very little side dishes. moreover it's highly overpriced compared to other nearby restaurants . it has tables with nice river view, but this doesn't make up for an otherwise deficient dining experience. they only provide soft drinks. last but not least, it was also noticeable that we were served long after the Malay clients.Show less

Author: jasree
Title: Nice place
Review: We ordered beef ribeye and grilled chicken chop, a bit pricey but taste good, we having our dinner at the table by the river while enjoying the views and river cruise boat pass thorugh, good and fast service

Author: liam302
Title: Nice for dinner
Review: Nice food, can recommend the satay.I found the service a little too leisurely but i was not in any hurry, just hungry . Beautiful location.

Author: Cepi P
Title: Good place and nice food
Review: Dinner with family..maybe u all must try the food at ducth habour cafe...arabic chic and lamb ribs very very very delicious

Author: Kana K
Title: Cat abuse by staff
Review: Tonight I visited restaurant and ordered their local Satay set meal. The beef and chicken mixed satay set(35RM). The unconfireht Muslim waitress didn’t explain but after I order a big mineral water(3.5RM) I found out from the poster that a glass of lemon tea or fuzzy drinks were free if you order a set meal!! Lack of hospitality. Already bad impression to start with. Then a friendly street tiger cat approached to me on the higher level as I sat at the lower table next to the canal. I like cats and was happy that she was around being friendly.. then a Malay looking staff trapped her abruptly and pinched at her back of neck in the air with one hand in front of me and pushed her into a straw box in their neighboring premises where I could see directly and hear the poor cat meowing to escape.:/ I asked the waitress what would happen to her then she had other waiter/cook? said the”Uncle” next door the manager of the public wc next to the place on the right hand kill and eat her:/. I was only shocked and couldn’t eat further any longer. I am sure they do very often as the trap straw box was located just in front of the door inside the premises!! And this staff who captured the cat serving without washing hands either as I saw. I feel so sad as the door seemed padlocked hearing the cat. I told them I would publish this fact to twitter and sms etc and they said ok laughing at me. Being a cat lover as a pet, experiencing this in person has let me down so much. I asked if the satay was really beef too:/ not cat meat?:/ I didn’t find this Satay particularly great, no value for the price. I will never visit here again! On top of it service charge wasWhat a shame but only a bad impression of Melaka on my first day...Show less

Author: firahjayySingapore
Title: Poor Choice of Restaurant
Review: We went last weekend on a Saturday, around 7pm. We came earlier so as to avoid the crowd. We just wanted to have a nice, quiet dinner with a lovely view. Unfortunately, one of our main dish did not turn out right. It is probably the worst Steak I've ever tried. It's tough and chewy that we had to send it back to the kitchen and ask the chef to rectify it. The chef just had to cook it again and guess what, it's worst than before. FYI, the steak costs us 48RM. Yes, 48RM gone down the drain. The other dish we ordered was an Arabic Rice with Chicken. This dish turned out just fine. No complaints at all! This dish comes in a set. So technically, we would be served with ice-cream but we were too mad, so we just left without having our desserts.While making payment, the staff informed us that their full time Chef is on leave, hence they get another person to do it, which explains why the Steak turns out tough and chewy. Honestly, if they had told us earlier, I would not have ordered the Steak and would not be disappointed at all. The least they could do is to offer us another dish when we returned the Steak back to the kitchen. I guess they don't practice any form of service recovery here. If you prefer a nice view with poor dishes, then this would be the place for you. And no, I am not returning here again. The money spent here could have been spent elsewhere that serve better food. Do not waste your time, really.Show less

Author: saira1990Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Laksa was really yummy! Only set menu at night!
Review: Generally the food is really good. We enjoyed the beef salai and deng deng. Also the assam pedas was thick and yummy! Beef samosa is really good, they are generous with the amount of meat. Price is a little on the high side. Most of the food cost minimum RM 18.Show less

Author: Kennethttt
Title: Quite some varieties
Review: A small and modest restaurant along the red shophouses. The food was not bad and service was good too. Definitely gonna go try some of their other dishes.

Author: nathaniel P
Title: Rude staff member
Review: Was looking forward to having supper at DH, after reading some awesome food reviews of the place. BUT SADLY WE NEVER ATE THERE, a very rude lady spoke to us. She has no customer service skills and needs to be kept away from customers as no amount of good food can erase the bad taste of rude and terrible customer service. Show less

Author: Nur Ashiqin A
Title: Cafe by the river
Review: If you at looking for a nice quiet dinner by the river, this is definitely one of the places to go, especially before sunset. Service is good and fast. Food is alright, but overall, a good place to visit when you are with your family or even couples. Show less

Author: helmar t
Title: Abaolutely marvellous
Review: Ambience lovely, riverview, nice part of the old rown.Staff are very friendly and helpfull. Food came fast.We ate the grilled chicken wis tasted fantastic. The salmon, also delicious. And finally the fish and chips, which as described by my daughter "was to die for".Show less

Author: Nur Farah N
Title: Dinner
Review: The foods here is so good, worth it to eat here and also good romantic view around cafe and the important here the cafe provide a good service.

Author: LynnaF6
Title: Dinnerr place
Review:
Tasty food.. relaxing ambient.. recommended place for dinner..
Tasted grilled chicken and nasi lemak.

Author: rahmanramos
Title: thank you
Review: Thank you for good service.....spaghetti carbonara sedap gila....view tepi sungai melaka menarik....mesra pelanggan...food is good....price is affordable....waitress cantik hahhaha....

Author: CarloR1722
Title: Food ok verry good pls come in visit Dutch harbour cafe
Review: The cafe beside the river is nice. The food and the staff are also good. Definitely will recommend this place to others.

Author: EffaR10
Title: Dinner
Review: Nice food and taste..hv good view malacca river and good environment..good place for dinner with special person..

Author: Tarmizi A
Title: Halal in the street
Review: Is either you want to have your dinner by the riverbank or dine in as a normal person. The food is average. My husband ordered a steak and i order a salmon. The steak taste like no flavour but the salmon was superb! The dessert also quite good not too sweet but just nice. Btw their pumpkin soup is mouth watering Show less

Author: Azzad M
Title: Nice ambience and nostalgic view
Review: Great riverside view to hang out. The food is nice and will definately revisit. The ambience is good and the riverside view brings nostalgia

Author: ammara697
Title: Great lunch by the riverside
Review: Great menu to have for lunch while enjoying watching the river cruiser passing along the river.. great laksa and nice nasi lemak

Author: Daniaist_93
Title: Bad burger
Review:
The meal served was not clean or fresh at all, the meat was smelly as well!
And relatively to such service it is considered very expensive

Author: Annebel V
Title: Good lasagne, bad lamb ribs
Review: We (me and a friend) went to the dutch harbour café. My friend ordered the lasagna which was nice but my lamb ribs were not. Very greasy and almost no meat. The price of the ribs was around 55 RM, which was too much. The lasagna was 18 RM. The staff was okay. They didn't sell beer. The desserts were nice and fresh. Show less

Author: nismailmKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lovely halal cafe with great ambiance
Review: The cafe provides both outdoor and indoor seating. Outdoor is more suited for dinner with the lights, ambiance and the river cruise boats passing by frequently at night. I had the lamb ribs while my friend had beef ribs (served with two sauces). Be careful though that the chain railing may not be suitable for small kids. Those with baby strollers should use the upper walkway so as not to disturb those eating along the lower walkway.Show less

Author: 810yannickw
Title: looks nice but wasn't tasty
Review: Probably the worst chicken satay I had. The chicken from the chicken rice was ok but the rice was also not a success.

Author: alexpilgrimHertford, United Kingdom
Title: Great food - not great service!
Review: Lovely food, lovely setting, good value for money and lovely staff - unfortunately they were very slow at bringing food (got my meal at least 5 mins before my wife). But to be honest there are worse places to be kept waiting - great views along the river to soak in the atmosphere! Show less

Author: thelastinfinite
Title: Lovely Ambience
Review: Whether it is in the day or at night, dining by the river definitely provides a unique experience especially with the French music playing softly in the background. The staff were friendly and attentive, kudos!

Author: Jasmin J
Title: Santai
Review: Dining by the river, under the hot sun where the views spectacular .. quite a choice of menu too..Easy to find.. just walk behind the old row of shops opposite Stadhuys

Author: Zaini ASingapore, Singapore
Title: Halal Restaurant - Dutch Harbour
Review: My family and I including my sister and my mother of 82 years old had an impromptu and amazing experience at Dutch and Harbour Restaurant. We were looking for a halal accredited restaurant with western flavour and was rewarded with a surprising filled menus.The staff of D&H was very friendly, easily approachable, humorous and offered excellence recommendations on the foods. My mother was very pleased and happy with the foods and drinks and complimented the staff for their prompt servicesThe restaurant has very simple decor, cosy and an ambience that is fulfilling. My daughter and niece had a great time taking photos with D&H simple decor and background and finished off their pizzaaaass with a big smile.Thank you Mr Azhar, owner of D&H Restaurant.Show less

Author: sitidelima
Title: Excellant food and service
Review:
We love it... 😊
Should try their steak and grilled chicken chop. Nice ambience... staff friendly and good service.

Author: williamkardashianKuching, Malaysia
Title: SUPER BAD SERVICE, food never came
Review: Came here for all the amazing reviews to get utterly disappointed!! We ordered nonya laksa and salmon steak. Nonya laksa was served in about 15 mins it was fine. Then it was over 40 mins and salmon steak never came. Checked multiple times they kept saying it's coming it's coming just one more minute. Next thing we know we've been sitting there like idiots for nearly one hour with no salmon steak. Got totally upset and canceled the order, only paid for nonya laksa. Asked the cashier what went wrong. He explained everything went well until the old lady waitress decided to take over our section and actually gave our food to other customer. And the old lady was the one who told us it's coming just one more minute. Had she told us she mistakenly gave it away we would've said it's okay and stayed. Instead her attitude was beyond appalling. She never admitted her mistake and didn't care angry customers were leaving because of her. If the boss is reading this please do something about her cause you got a really nice spot here, don't let it get ruined by one messed up employee. Food is good, at least for the one dish that we got to try. I bet that salmon steak would've been amazing too, had it been served. Show less

Author: Don P
Title: Amazing steak, friendly staff with great view of the Malacca River.
Review: Best steak we had in a very long time. Medium-well is really medium-well, not overcooked like we get in Bangkok where imported beef is very expensive. Salmon is good, too. None of that fishy aftertaste that we came across at other places.

Author: JohnmwolfsMaastricht, The Netherlands
Title: Location is deceiving, food mediocre
Review: Dinner set menu, 32 RM good choices including one drink, appetizer and simple dessert. They advertise with burgers. Do not even think of trying; meat was undercooked, bun dry/old. Satah meat very dry. Laksha and nasi lembak simple but ok. Location perfect, but consider taking mosquito repellant. Show less

Author: Cornishtraveller72
Title: Nice lunch, quiet spot and good value
Review: Went in for a late ish lunch mid week.  No other customers but friendly low key service and sat by river.  Food excellent (esp the soup) and a generally good place for a fair priced meal.

Author: wesleyh532
Title: 2 thumbs up!
Review: Must try spot in Melaka, excellent food and reasonable price. The ambience is just perfect for the historical city.

Author: hjmokh
Title: Great Ambience
Review: Is a must visit café whenever you in Malacca. The great ambience plus excellent food for tourist as well as locals. A wide variety of food to choose from starter, main course to desert and supported by extremely nice crew staff. Value for money and strategically located. A walking distance to Jonker street and places of interest.Show less

Author: JohnandRo
Title: Old World Charm
Review: This is a great place to get a mixture of Dutch and Melaka food. They have live music on the weekend. Great place to eat and wind down after all the shopping!

Author: muhammedm996
Title: Over price for mediocre food
Review: It's over priced for the mediocre food they served. Service was slow. Not going back there again. Neither should you.

Author: joelle-leonacha-am, thailand
Title: very nice, will defo go again
Review: had great set meals with starter, main meal, dessert and a drink for 65 ringets taxes included for 2 personsextremeley nice staff specially the lady in charge who kindly give advise on the choice of meal, all excellent foodwent there 2 nights runningthe setting is very romantic and it is lovely to watch the tour boats go by and exchange handwaves with the touristshighly recommendedShow less

Author: chuckwow
Title: River side location
Review: Nice location, opens late in morning but far range of foods european and asian choices normal prices mid range i.e 10 rm + per person .

Author: Allan2110Batu Caves, Malaysia
Title: Great Ambience, great location
Review: Because of the renovation being done on the stretch of shops near to it, you might miss the pathway leading to the restaurant.But once you are there, u will be captivated by the view.The moonlight and twinkling stars, the river view and relaxing sound of water splashing on the river bank, the smiling faces and waving tourist in the Riverboat cruises passing by etc.Sometimes there are even cultural musical being played on the riverboats and you can enjoy them by sitting at the restaurant.Ordered roast chicken and beef ribs. The beef ribs was tender and juicy, very tasty.The chicken was OK.They dont serve alcoholic beverages here, but i see some customers having wine and beers, and apparently they bring their own and no corkage was charged.Overall it was a great experience.Show less

Author: Emily7394Melaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Romantic Dinner Place
Review: We were there to celebrate belated Valentine's day. The tables are placing on the riverside with a red checker table clothe. Strong wind over there, please remind your love one to bring a shawl or put on a jacket.Ordered a combo set of chicken chop and lamp chop. Combo set comes with a pumpkin soup and a drink. Pumpkin soup is very thick and I love it so much.I had the lamb chop. It is so delicious. The lamp chop is well marinated and nice grill. The chicken chop meat is not that tender, but still not bad. The bbq sauce is nice.Brownies are rich of chocolate. Girls, sure you will like it.Will visit again! But, a soft reminder here. Great food is worth to wait. Thus, please prepare your patience for it. it may take some times to process your order. =)Just relax yourself, and enjoy the environment there!Show less

Author: RobineMariahI
Title: A quintessential Malacca experience
Review: Sitting by the river for lunch or dinner or just chilling out and having a glass of local ice coffee just off the tourist areas was for me the best way to enjoy a laid back afternoon in the middle of old Malacca.

Author: beppin14Ningbo, China
Title: So rude :(
Review: We were really looking forward to eating here but the lady was very rude and practically ignored us when we asked if it was open and if we could have a table for two. She didn't move or look at us, just asked if we were eating or drinking. When we answered that we were eating she just said "what's that?" as if we'd said the wrong thing. It was super weird and uncomfortable so we just left... Such a pity, the food looked nice and it's in a beautiful location.Show less

Author: AzaredaniKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Plenty of room for improvement
Review: Its the holiday season, and tourist can be seen looking for place to eat, and this place is one of the opportunities to dine in the afternoon. However the place can use a bit of a hype from people management. Food was okay, but their team seems to be occupied with just their own task, and not interested with the front of house, letting a single lady taking care of the cashier, but most of the time not there. Bare in mind, since Melaka is a tourist destination, hence service is essential, especially with a high price from the menu. Show less

Author: minstrel78
Title: Great meal!!!
Review: We ate here a couple of times and each time the food was great. I had the lamb shank on our last night and it was superb. The guy who serves you is very friendly and helpful. Please visit here if you can.

Author: Shall_Lina
Title: Good location
Review: We had a dinner there 1 time for traveling .they had western food and local food .the staff are friendly .

Author: lockey1967
Title: very good value
Review: Visited and impressed with the price, food that is a mix of western and asian, and the service. Will come back in the future. The setting is very good and a nice relaxed atmosphere. Love the area and outlook.

Author: Franco B
Title: Nice place
Review:
Nice quiet place with river view.
Good food ,nice staff,the don't have beer bit the owner provider for it.

Author: felish82
Title: Pay for the ambience, halal
Review: The staff was polite. Price is slightly on the high side. Nevertheless, the presentation were good. Place is clean, so is the surrounding. Nearby public toilet doesn't does not have odour. That's rare in Malaysia . You can chat all night long watching the river cruise boat passing and also the patron on the other side of the river.Show less

Author: Steveskipton
Title: Nice food in great location
Review: We had a good tasty meal of malaysian favourites sat on the riverfront tables.a nice place with friendly management. Would recommend.

Author: YaNeemo
Title: Best food in Melaka
Review:
Melaka's best food, Halal and well-cooked western and Asian menu. It's a bit unusual to perfect both, we found out that they have two chefs, one for each.

Friendly staff and delicious food, love it.

Author: Karen FLincoln, United Kingdom
Title: Very friendly staff and owner, great setting
Review: This cafe can be reached from either the main road or from the riverside. There are seats inside and a few tables outside by the river. We sat outside under and umbrella and enjoyed the view. We could have sat there all day enjoying watching the river and the people walking along the path. They have speciality drinks as well as the usual range. The coconut shake and mango lassi were particularly good. Ice creams were good too.Show less

Author: SAIF-Omani
Title: Very Good
Review: Delicious Asian Food ,  tables overlooking the river, reasonable prices. Friendly staff specially Mr. Alvin 👍

Author: N_Travel_H
Title: Hidden Gems of Jonker (Halal food)
Review: Love the restaurant so much for it's ambiance and friendly staffs. A great place to sit back and relax for couple and friends. They serve Western food & Local cuisine. The homemade Iced Lemon Tea was so delicious. Highly recommend the riverside seat!!

Author: Paul4444Perth, Australia
Title: Nothing special
Review: I had dinner here and was quite disappointed. The location is great, right beside the Melaka River. But the food was ordinary, to say the least. The set menu is very uninspiring. The following morning, I had a pretty badly upset stomach, which may well have been caused by my dinner here, but who knows? They don't mention till you get the menu that you can't buy a beer there - no alcohol at all. I wouldn't go back.Show less

Author: Hacb86
Title: APPLE CRUMBLE!!
Review: Really liked this place. To begin, prices are decent, good menu selection, and efficient service. Icing on the cake, very good burgers, great evening vibe by the canal, and absolutely delicious apple crumble...so so tasty :)

Author: CarolineMacLeod
Title: best meal in Melaka
Review: We had a fantastic meal with views to die for and a wonderfully entertaining host.  If you only have one night in Melaka make sure you spend it here!

Author: reilas
Title: Nice atmosphere!
Review: I was just walking by the river bank when I noticed the cafe. It was quite intriguing and the owner invited me in a very friendly way. Ordered one simple watermelon juice, but it was delicious!And the owner was a very funny man :)) he chatted with me about traveling and waved to the tourist boats whenever they passed by. I would come back again to try other things in their menu~Show less

Author: CCLindaCulver City, California
Title: Great food overlooking Melaka River
Review: What a fun guy our host/waiter Alvin was! Had a incredible bowl of Laksa. He ran and got us a King Fisher from a nearby store and we were set. Location is great, right over looking all the river cruises,and bars. Good for people watching and listening to the music that seems to be coming from everywhere. Going to go back and try the beef ribs. Nice set menu, if you are really hungry.Show less

Author: Phil SChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: A pleasant surprise
Review: Went out looking for dinner and came upon this cafe/restaurant.Albert (as we later found out his name was) did a great job in talking us into eating there (not that we need to much persuasion as it was a Tuesday night and not much else was open).The food was a set menu (one main ((choice of 4 I think)), one dessert (choice of two I think)), and a drink ((non alcohol)) and delightful.We asked for a beer, to which Albert obliged by walked to the local shop to get them for us.The meal was RM 57.00 total for two. In my opinion great value, and in a lovely settingI recommend you give this place a try.Show less

Author: emibakar
Title: Cozy friendly environment for friend and family
Review: Cozy friendly environment for friends and family. The food is good, the staff are friendly. You can choose to dine inside the restaurant or outside near the river.

Author: Mich1203Singapore, Singapore
Title: impressive dessert!
Review: it was late in the evening that my husband and I headed to the hotel along the river. We just wanted to have some soft and cold drinks as we were totally full at the moment. The boss introduced us some special dessert, and it was amazing that it looked full of cream and cake, but it tasted really fresh and helpful for digest. All staff there were very friendly and happy.Show less

Author: Johnwalter2016Perth, Australia
Title: Great western and asian dishes
Review: Although busy the manager erected a table on the riverside walk for our party of four. The location is great with the river boats occasionally cruising by.We all enjoyed the tasty western and asian dishes which came with an entrée and dessert and soft drink.We would reccomend this restaurant to anyone wanting to have a culinary treat in Melaka. The manager spoke perfect English and was friendly and helpful.Show less

Author: annpK7508VKSingapore
Title: Quint Restaurant
Review: It was a hot afternoon and my family chanced upon this restaurant. There was nobody in there but we needed a place to rest. Their coconut milkshake was to die for and the owner very friendly. We had drinks and cake and it was quite good. Will visit again.Show less

Author: Dave M
Title: Cheap and Cheerful
Review: Location is good, walk through from the road and sit out the back overlooking the river - particularly nice at sunset. Food is not high cuisine but basic; quality is good, quantity is good and reasonable choice.

Author: Abdul Aziz K
Title: Great Coffee
Review:
I just had coffee at this place. The captain and his staffs are friendly. Good cup of Americano.
Nice atmosphere by the river.

Author: Xeno T
Title: Not an overall good experience
Review: The front of the cafe was empty when i walk through the front door with no customers and waiters in the cafe, then i realised that most of the waiters was on the back of the cafe, it's weird as there are no servers at the front to serve customers while all of them were focus on the riverside table only. The food was come in 3 course set meal (soup, entree and dessert along with a drink). The soup is served hot and taste with the drinks (I have ice lemon tea but the tea taste is kinda weird). The rib-eyed steak was beautifully cook but the garnish is served cold. As for the dessert, the brownies and ice cream was presented well and taste good. For conclusion, this cafe gives me high and low throughout my dining experience.Show less

Author: Mamamam K
Title: Good whole coconut fresh juice
Review: Food very good, fairly good price, international menu. Very quiet, nice location by the river. Nice and helpful staff.

Author: graceeyunMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice place
Review: Went there for my Valentine's dinner. We ordered a chicken chop and quarter chicken set. Chicken chop is nice, their mashed potato is nice, but the quarter chicken is abit too dry. The environment is cozy and ambient. Too bad the riverside seating is fully occupied, if not there would be good having meal by the riverside.Show less

Author: Wavves
Title: Quite good
Review: Had nasi lemak , mango juice , and a bottle of coke . The food was ok , and mango juice was amazing. The staffs were being nice back then .

Author: charlottel537Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: Great location, thats all...
Review: Had a 'fresh' pineapple juice which I asked with NO sugar. Saw the waiter put some sirup from a bottle in it and mixing it in. This was certainly not fresh juice. When I asked him again if there was only fruit juice and no sugar in it he said yes which I know is wrong. Also, there was so much ice cubes in the glass that after five tiny sips of the juice that was it.Show less

Author: lisarosma96Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Variety of food
Review: Very satisfied with the services here. It's the best place at the riverside for a celebration which I've choose it to surprised my mom on her birthday after I did the reservation. The food are tasty and I would recommend you all nyonya laksa and chicken chop.Show less

Author: Explore39610407819
Title: Tourist Restaurant
Review: The combination menues are quite attraktive. However, the spring rolls have not been made fresh ; the same for the desserts. Most of the main dishes have been good, the mixed Satai i would recommend

Author: rosmanizaahmadKuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Tasty meal by the river
Review: I heard about this nice place by the river so I came to try with my hubby. I was taken a back by its beauty and scenery. Looks like venice . The food was great, I had a giant melaka squid (it was big!) and tasty served with coconut rice. Hubby says the steak was so tender and delicious. Alvin the manager was so friendly and took care of us. The food is halal so I highly recommend to muslims. They even gave a little gift toy for my little boy. Thats really generous of them. Prices are fair considering its a tourist area.I give it a thumbs up. Well done Dutch Habour, we love youShow less

Author: Zieymaa HPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Great location
Review: I went there with my family for dinner a day before my vacation ended. The food was great. I had the steak, which is my favourite. The view was stunning. We sat facing the Malacca river with night lamps around us. I would love to go back someday.Show less

Author: joe oKronberg im Taunus, Germany
Title: Tourist trap - stay away!
Review: We were tempted by its great location (by Melacca river) and uplifting tunes.That's where the positives end. The starter was not freshly prepared, lukewarm, doughy, contained little filling and tasteless. The mains were similarly disgusting - lukewarm, flavourless and watery. Service was pretty incompetent but they had the gall to add a 10% service charge to the bill.The whole experience reminded us of something out if Ramsey's Kitchen Nightmare - interpret as you will...Show less

Author: Leonard S
Title: Location, that's it.
Review: One thing great about this cafe is the location. It's right at the edge of Malacca River. It's nice to hang out, and sit chillin' at this cafe. But the foods are not that great, even drinks are quite pricy.

Author: 230maddykChristchurch, New Zealand
Title: Good food and friendly service.
Review: This little restaurant is lovely. Serving a range of local and 'western food' the menu is certainly eclectic. The satays I chose were superb. The meal was a little pricey (around RM30) but that is to be expected in a tourist location. Due to the poor weather, there were only 3 tables booked in the restaurant when I visited. The owner, Albert is a fabulous host and it wasn't long before we were recounting travel stories with the Singapore family seated beside us. I wish I had time to return and sit on one of the outdoor tables along the river.Show less

Author: snuffjugend
Title: Great location on the river
Review: We needed a place to eat during the manic Christmas period that strikes Malaka.  The Lamb Redang was excellent and the white fish was exceptional.  The restaurant doesn't serve alcohol, but one of the non-muslim waiters sourced some beer for our meal.

Author: Athirah J
Title: Nice view... Strategic place but not the food...
Review: I came here based on the recommendation from my friend... She know that I am The food lover.. She ask me to taste and give a feedback about the food. Whether we have similar opinion or not. The result totally the same. To get a very a very nice view... Yeahhh here is the place... My First impression through the view was like Wowwwwww.... So beautiful and I love the view.. Enjoying the river view... Beautiful surroundings.... Unfortunately the foods spoiled me. Dutch Harbour crew... Please do something because u have a very nice and strategic place that can attract local people and tourist to come. Keep it up!!Show less

Author: Lizkeith68Southend-on-Sea, United Kingdom
Title: Very good food, friendly staff and prices excellent.
Review: Have been for dinner the last two nights, it is set menu at weekends but great value for money, they serve beers but not wine, as me and my husband are used to having wine with our evening meal we asked if we could boy wine, it wasn't a problem, they even provided glasses and ice, for my white wine.Alvin at front of house is very efficient and friendly.They are situated on the riverbank, so very busy river traffic with tour boats, good location.My one criticism, which stopped me from giving 5 stars was no toilet paper or hand wipes in the toilets, both nights.We are here for a few days still so will definitely visit again to try their a large carte menu.Show less

Author: joselyn715Chicago, Illinois
Title: Monster burger
Review: We went mostly because of the monster burger challenge. I however opted for a regular burger. It's ok nothing special just "ok". The guy who served us was really polite and nice. Would probably go again to try their other menu items. We saw the food that other people ordered and it looked yummy! I did order a mango drink I think it was called a mango lassi which was amazing ! Show less

Author: RhiannonS14
Title: Incredible food and amazing service
Review: We loved this restaurant. The owner/manager of the café was extremely friendly and more than happy to share his local knowledge. Dinner here was the best we had in Malacca. Highly recommend a visit and meal.

Author: farahevans
Title: Nice view
Review:
Nice view.Humble service.Great food :D
Its better if you go for dinner because you can sit at the back facing the Malacca river with night lamps around.

Author: amirajuhan
Title: YES for the view, NO for the food and price.
Review: the view is very nice, you can enjoy the river cruise while having your dinner. but the food tastes average and the it's quite pricey.

Author: zoem882London, United Kingdom
Title: Great for a quick lunch
Review: The view of the river is lovely from the outside tables, with umbrellas to give a little relief from the sun. My husband and I stopped to have a quick lunch. The nonya laksa is incredibly tasty, and they were generous with the toppings. The manager popped by to check everything was okay which was a nice touch. Show less

Author: Lynda F
Title: Bland food
Review: Very mediocher food.  Service was ok and location good.  My husband and I only ate here once so maybe it was an off night but with so many other choices close by I wasn't willing to give it a second try.

Author: Carolyn R
Title: Personal Service and Wonderful Food
Review: Overlooking the canal this is a relaxing spot to enjoy the wonderful food. The service was excellent and the manager could not do enough for us. I had grilled white fish and it was cooked to perfection, my husband had the famous Laksa dish and having lived in Malaysia for the last six years this was one of the best. My daughter enjoyed the lasagne. The apple crumble is our recommendation. Tomorrow is our last day and we intend to treat ouselves to another apple crumble before we leave.Show less

Author: Sjakie S
Title: Slow staff
Review: We only went for a drink, the root beer was superb, the juice not freshly squeezed? And we had to wait for a long time before the bill was sent to us.

Author: Mike Kathryn RKhancoban, Australia
Title: Nice spot for relaxing meal
Review: Nice little restaurant with seating next to the river. We ordered juices and fish and chips - really nice and fresh tasting. This restaurant is also open at night with seating down closer to the river. Lovely ambience with the soft fairy lights and away from the hustle and bustle of Jonker walk. Show less

Author: 615kazBrisbane, Australia
Title: Excellent Food and Ambience
Review: We have visited Melaka twice and have spent a lot of time at this cafe. This cafe has two Street frontage, wirh one side being by the canal. You have the choice of air con comfort or a beautiful canalside table wirh soft music and a picturesque view... It has such a lovely feel about it.. Food selection is for both westeners and also traditional malaysian food.. We have only had their traditional food and it is delicios and well priced. The Manager and staff are very effecient and friendly making for a memorable night..Show less

Author: Najatusyima S
Title: So-so foods
Review: Nice views,very good service by their staffs,but the food was so so.need to uprades some menus i guess

Author: Alice R
Title: Wonderful unexpected carbonara!!
Review: We stopped at this restaurant cause we wanted to have a break from the Malaysian food, attired by the western menu option and the location on the river. When I asked for a carbonara pasta with some adjustments (I'm Italian so a bit fussy on our dishes) the owner came to me, asking better about it. Ten minutes after I've been presented the best carbonara I've seen abroad, very similar to ours at home but modified with beef meat instead of porc (cause of the local religion): I loved it, it was very tasty, the pasta had the right cook and I think I'll steal the idea. Even the local chocolate cake was awesome. They have been so kind and nice in trying to satisfay our requests...I'm impressed. I travel a lot and I rarely see places like this one. Definitely worths!Show less

Author: TrueReview94Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Pretty view isnt going to make the food better.
Review: Let's face it. Malaysian are trying to get good food by making the atmosphere better. This is what i had in mind whenever i get myself into a fancy western restaurant. Dont get me wrong, there are some western themed restaurants which served great food in a lovely environment. But the fact is that now a good number of the Malaysian western food restaurants are banking on the environment to sell their product instead of improving their dishes. I am a big fan of western food, and this fact annoys me a lot.Well today i am here in Dutch Harbour Cafe with my friends. We were greeted with a big smile and a friendly welcome. The service was efficient as they added tables immediately once they found out that there is only a table for two left. I was impressed by their patience towards my friend who has difficulty choosing her food, and had recommended some food to suit her liking. we sat by the riverside, waving towards the tourist ferries as they pass by, snap photos of the beautiful scenery. All of it was great until the food came.I was not feeling un-appetite per se, in fact, i was having a raging appetite after the workout i did few hours back. I was ready to sink my teeth into that sizzling black pepper chicken chop. However, my appetite decreases with every bite i took. The sizzling black pepper chicken was not a good pick. Firstly, the chicken was not cooked properly. There are parts of it which were overcooked and burnt. Secondly, the dish was pretty salty, and thirdly, the black pepper sauce was pretty watery. It did not taste like a black pepper chicken chop at all.Next is my friend's Nasi Lemak. It had a pretty good taste. The coconut rice was had that strong coconut milk flavour with a hint of Lemon Grass. The rice was cooked perfectly, but it would have been better if they had used white jasmine rice. The rice they used are short grain rice which might not be ideal for nasi lemak. But either way, the dish was pretty good and my friend enjoyed it. Next is the Chicken Spaghetti Bolognese, or Ragu. The taste was good, and it was served with two customary toast (other restaurants do take note! Its customary to serve spaghetti with soft bread.) The only problem is the Spaghetti sauce, which i personally like it to have more meat and thicker. But it was only RM10 so i guess its alright.All in all, i loved the environment, i loved the service, but i kind of dislike the meal. If their food is great, that nigh would be a wonderful experience for my friends and I. I am going to give it a 2.5/5. (The service and environment deserves a 0.5 of the total each.)Show less

Author: Mussarat SBirmingham, England, United Kingdom
Title: Brilliant little eatery!
Review: Tucked away in a corner out of the way, a bit quirky. It has a BRILLIANT view of the canal where you can sit and eat(like Venice!)The management are very nice and welcoming, food was great and if you can manage it there's a 'eat our massive burger' type challenge. All in all an enjoyable visit.Show less

Author: HongKongNoodlesBonn, Germany
Title: Nope.
Review: Yes, the view is good - and you're gonna pay for that. I get it. But for what we ordered, it was way too expensive!Stay away from the lamb!!! (Lamb Kuzi for 13RM) Why? Because there was not meat. It was rice, sauce and bones. Horrible. I ordered the Sate (which was pricey but good) but I got my order after my boyfriend was finished with his meal (He couldn't wait cos it took 20 minutes). So well, we wanted to eat together but that was not possible.When I complained about the bad service, the guy almost got ugly.You can go for the view, but choose your food wise. I won't ever go again.Show less

Author: coolcat72Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Unforgetable alfresco dininig by the river
Review: Watch the boat go by while enjoying your dinner with romatic french music playing in the background. The steak I had was so tender and value for money. They even gave us 2 types of sauces. My partner had gourmet burger thick chucky 200gms nicely presented on a nice burger bun. The meat patti was so meaty and juicy....no complains. We had a nice full meal and sat listening to the music all night over coffee. A thumbs up to dutch harbour for me . keep it up.Show less

Author: nazrulzulkefli
Title: Best view and food in Malaysia
Review: Brought my family to eat here. We enjoyed it so much. Only set meal for weekends but still quite a choice of 16 items western and local.. The lamb rib are to die for and satay presentation a ...wow. Service a little slow because the café was pack but acceptable. Really friendly waiters. I would highly recommend this place to my friends.Show less

Author: LJ_CanToronto, Canada
Title: Bad Start
Review: When we got there all the tables were full. Seeing that people just paid and were leaving we waited for the table, which by the time we walked over to was given away to locals. so they set us up a new one at the far end. From here we could not hear the music and were kind of forgotten. Finally we ordered, ten minutes later the waitress comes back and says they don't have what one of us want. We change the order and then receive our meals about ten minutes apart. Either eat alone or let the food get cold waiting for the other. The location is good.Show less

Author: lightsammIbiza, Spain
Title: The worst Burger on the planet!!!!!
Review: The twinkling lights and the setting is soooooo romantic that everyone gets caught on the first night!!!! .... and believe me this is soooo true!!! The burger that was served to us was full of nerves, ligaments and stomach tubes .... This is your worst nightmare on a plate!!!! One mouthful and it was impossible to swallow ..... This was made with the lowest quality meat possible ... Not fit for human consumption!!! I do not recommend to eat here but a glass of water or a watermelon shake for the twinkling lights , no problem!!!!Show less

Author: Atif G
Title: Great food by the river
Review: They have good choice of Malay and Western Food. Didn't try anything from the western menu, but the Beef Dendeng and Chicken Kapitan (from Malay menu) were both excellent choices. The restaurant is right along the river which was very nice. I had an interesting conversation with my Malay waiter and the staff was very friendly. The candles added a nice touch. Oh and the pineapple juice was nothing special so I would stay away from that, but overall a really nice experience. Show less

Author: imran i
Title: food verry nice
Review: good waiter and friendly,food nice and beutifull good quality .5star i give for dutch habour cafe in melaka by the river view..

Author: BlissyLee
Title: Lovely dine in Dutch Harbour Cafe!
Review:
Excellent location, right on river side. Candle light, cozy in the evening! Cheerful smiles from those river cruise passengers. Friendly service. Simple and delicous Asian or Western food. Don't miss the wonderful coconut shakes! 
Cheers!

Author: Ray C
Title: Lack of options
Review:
The good: Location is excellent, right on the river.
The bad: Choice restricted to either Western set menu or Asian set menu and that's it!
               No alcohol is served (FYI, not a complaint it's just that you would expect it.....)

Author: iwan1508
Title: Not Recommended at all
Review: I went there just want to hang out and bought some drinks. But then waiter always ask to buy their food which is so ridiculous. First time we can't order the drinks, but after that we can order. The food not so good and expensive.

Author: Valerie037
Title: Lovely Lunch
Review: Tiny restaurant along the riverbank with just three tables, but ever so relaxing watching the passing boats and away from the crowds in Dutch Square.  The interior was spotlessly clean, food excellent, freshly cooked and tasty.  Our waiter was friendly, prompt and efficient.

Author: alfredphuakimchaiKuching, Malaysia
Title: Not as reviewed
Review: We reached there for an early dinner ard 6pm. I guess the pictures taken in the dark looks different when compared to the real place in daylight. The inside of the cafe is a little dirty to our liking so we moved to the bck (along the river) with the hope of a better seating with better view. There's only a two or three small tables with two chairs each to a table. It's definitely not as romantic as I thought it would. Probably they have yet to laid out the tables. We ended up didnt dine there and walked to another place to eat. Show less

Author: alyaamirahMiri, Malaysia
Title: Delicuousy in Malacca.
Review: Dutch Harbour Cafe serves the best coconut shakes and western food. Besides that they also have a beautiful view by the river which is very romantic. The cafe also give a very classy and vintage vibe. Its a must place to visit and dine when you're in Malacca. As you will have a memorable and unforgetable experience in Malacca.Show less

Author: nazrulzulkefli
Title: Romantic dinner by the river
Review: We came across this nice cafe by the river. Wow .. Its like venice!. Have your dinner while watching the boats go by. My girlfriend had Laksa …nice and spicy. I had this huge Beef Ribs not bad comparable to Tony Roma. The waiters were friendly and food came short while after our soup. It was a night to remember. I highly recommend Dutch Harbour for a romantic dinner by the river.Show less

Author: Geoff EPerth, Western Australia, Australia
Title: Relaxed Eating
Review: Great atmosphere on the riverfront. Really friendly staff. Reasonable prices. This is definitely the best place to hang on the river. There is a wide choice of Malaysian and Western dishes. Good choice of fresh juices and the coconut smoothies are to die for. Catch Azhar on the weekends. He is the owner and has lots of stories to share.Show less

Author: HughwilliamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High Price but Poor Service
Review: Waited 45 minutes for 2 drinks even though the place did not seem overly busy while the waiter keep playing with his smartphone. At last, we cancelled the rest of our order. When we were leaving, we spent another 15 minutes to receive the bill. Avoid this place if ypu don't want to spoil your holiday.Show less

Author: farjaaniMannheim, Germany
Title: Nice food by the river side
Review: It's not a dutch food restaurant but a good Malay food is served in a cozy place right along the banks of river. It's a good place to go to have a romantic eve or even have a lunch or dinner with a friend. There is no pork on the menu and no alcohol is served at the place but the food tastes as goos as any other place that serves both.Show less

Author: Kat HPerth, Australia
Title: Best Laksa!
Review: Beautiful riverside location for lunch. Checkered tablecloths, watching the riverboats pass...... Apart from the ancient buildings across the water, could be very romantic Parisienne scene!Had the BEST Laksa here,hubby had the infamous burger which was enormous, and apparently really good.Thanks go to Rocky for the lovely chat!Highly recommended.Show less

Author: InstepTorquay, United Kingdom
Title: Great value, great location, friendly staff, OK food
Review: Came across this by chance and had a fixed price meal here one evening. Great riverside location with friendly staff the place could do with a little more sophistication in the menu presentation and perhaps a wider choice to offerThe value was exceptional and that together with the location might draw you back but the food needs to be better.Show less

Author: Norli85Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good service and fantastic river view.
Review: We went here for dinner and were glad to have done so. The food that we ordered was quite good and the atmosphere was really romantic. The chef was generous enough when he gave us extra mussels that were freshly caught and cooked with butter that were not included in the menu for no extra charge. This is not a lavish or luxury eatery but it is worth the price you paid. Overall, I highly recommend this place and will definitely return again if I get the chance. Show less

Author: Solrac81Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Good service and location but average food
Review: The location is very nice, next to the river. Waiters very friendly and happy. However the food was quite average. The spring rolls were taken from a tray and were cold, so not fresh at all. Meal was ok-ish but nothing special compared to other meals that I've tried in Malaysia.Show less

Author: Steve WCambridgeshire, United Kingdom
Title: Great lunch
Review: Stopped for lunch, make sure you get a table out the back, on the river side. We have a dutch breakfast, and also rendang curry - everything was good. A nice spot to watch the river and boats go by. Even saw a huge snake swimming up the river!Show less

Author: golnaz nKulaijaya District, Malaysia
Title: Good location only
Review: The location perfect, specially at night that they place tables just beside the river.But the food is average or below. For dinner you have to choice from set menu only, all set meals are expensive and at least the one I tried was not worth the price at all.Show less

Author: Topbabe
Title: Great Location at Nighttime
Review: Very cheap, good food, very very small selection, however includes three courses..does not sell alcohol. Great location at nighttime right by the river

Author: MohdReedzuan
Title: Dutch Harbour cafe is the best!
Review:
One of the most delicious meal here is laksa & satay. I love it! 
Very beautiful scene at riverside.
My family was happy for the staff because they are very friendly.

Author: zt1978Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Halal near Jonker/Melaka River
Review: The only halal place that is near Jonker that catches my buds. It was shortlisted as a place for me to try out when coming here. Was in the car when i saw it (front view), looked abit shady, like is this for real?! Then went on a river cruise then saw it from the back. OMG...i fell in love. Couples were seated on the river walk having romantic candle light dinner! It was the only place like that! Told myself gonna go b4 i go back. Went there for lunch, although didnt get to have the romantic, but at least it was facing the river. Menu was interesting, but didnt get to order the grill (only in the evening), so ordered the pizza, and local dishes, which was tasty. A place to try out for Muslims since it's hard to find historic cafe feel which is halal.Show less

Author: 943DavidCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Satu Malaysia
Review: We visited on the Malaysian National day. Just as we were fading fast we came across the Dutch Harbour cafe and grabbed a riverside table. The is a lot of variety on the menu nd prices range from Rm18 for a burger up to Rm40 for a steak. The local speciality is Malacca Laksa and is simple and tasty. It doesn't server alcohol but the milkshakes are good and the Barbican gives you a alcohol free beer experience. Try the Barbican strawberry for a beer-berry experience!Show less

Author: Cluis67Malaysia
Title: Pleasant and relaxing
Review: Found this little gem on a Saturday afternoon. Good service and tasty food. Lovely fruit juices and smoothies on offer along with both local and western cuisine. Some interesting looking desserts for those of you with a sweet tooth. Located along the riverside, away from the hustle and bustle of Jonker Street/Walk this is a must when visiting Malacca. Enjoy!Show less

Author: mrsvickyaltaieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pleasant Riverside Dining Experience
Review: We went to Melaka for the first time in January 2014 and the whole experience came as a pleasant surprise for both my husband and I. First of all, for a touristy place, visitors don't get the sense of being harassed and chased by vendors as is often the case in other places. Since we only came to visit for a day, we tried to pack in as many activities as we can in mere 24 hours. We walked from our riverside hotel to Jonker Street and took lots of photos along the way, especially of the churches and the colorful 'tuktuks'. Come dinner time, we opted to go to Dutch Harbour Café - a nice lil' restaurant we noticed during our afternoon walk. Located right by the river, this café gives you the great view and feel of a romantic riverside rendezvous - with the cruise boats gently passing by and some jazz music lulling us into some sort of Melakan enchantment. I ordered green curry chicken which was so good and had just the level of spiciness I love. Chris, my husband, ordered another chicken dish which he enjoyed as well. They serve delicious fresh lemon tea here and the brownie à la mode we had for dessert was fitting ending to the enjoyable dinner.Show less

Author: ViVi MCanberra, Australia
Title: delicious by the river
Review: During the past 3 years I have regularly holidayed in Melaka. It is a wonderfully colourful and friendly place. One of the highlights for me has been the Dutch Harbour Cafe. The staff is always very friendly and helpful, the food delicious. Whatever kind of cuisine your taste buds are craving, more than likely the Dutch Harbour Cafe will be able to satisfy them. For those who worry about safety and cleanliness, this is a good choice to have a healthy happy holiday. Of course, the location is supreme being right on the riverside on one end and on the other entrance right on a vibrant shopping area.Show less

Author: brocloveLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious laksa
Review: We came here for lunch and sat by the river in the shade which was lovely, really peaceful. The laksa was delicious (we have had a lot of laksa in Asia) and the noodles were particularly good. The fresh lemon tea was very delicious as well. Show less

Author: Choy9w2pckSegamat, Johor, Malaysia
Title: Romantic night with good food/company and view
Review: Nice food.. nice boss... ask the boss what food would he recommend. Come to this place at night and dine by the river. A night your wife/girlfriend will never forget. The night I was there with my girlfriend, there was only one table left. Though it was full house by the river, the boss managed to spend some time explaining the food he was recommending. The dessert was fantastic. Go for the satay..nicely done. Prawn sambal was good.. prawn was not over cooked. Another dished we tried was the Malacca laksa... authentic...Melaka taste. Planning another visit end of August... and this time bringing a group of friends. If weekends, better make reservations.Show less

Author: shavareeniMalaysia
Title: the best cafe by the Melaka river!
Review: The place was awesome!! the environment is absolutely stunning!! i can choose either want to seat inside the cafe or near the Melaka river... The decoration inside the Cafe is more relaxing and of course more romantic with instrumental song... in terms of food, there is no other words can describe the taste of the food.... it was absolutely amazinggggg and perfectoooo!!! Try the Chicken Lasagna its melts in your mouthhh...The cafe crew is friendly tooo!!! Just drop by and get your delicious food here,,, Dutch Harbour Cafe is Perfectooo!!!Show less

Author: Eva19920402Innsbruck, Austria
Title: Avoid this restaurant
Review: My boyfriend received a frozen pizza for the equivalent of 6euros, we could'nt eat a piece. And me...received a piece of frozen chicken and a kind of gluant rice, so disgusting. Waiting for the bill, the boss was just looking at us and waiting without a word and really didnt care about this situation. Don't waste your time and money, AVOID IT.Show less

Author: dancrisp2002Singapore, Singapore
Title: It got 1 star as you are unable to give no stars!
Review: My first piece of advice - do not go here.This is what happened to us:We were a large group - 12 people, the manager took our orders. He checked he had 12 orders for food, then checked each of our orders individually, we were raising our hands each time he said an order, to check that nothing was missing. At this point it was a bit like being at school, but generally ok.The order was checked per person a total of 3 times......The food was being served, but they only brought 9 of our main courses, this is after they checked the order 3 times, with hand raising etc.I went to see the manager, who had taken our order.....the orders had not been started, they had been "forgotten" by the kitchen...this was far from ideal.On the dinners that did arrive, one of the steaks was raw and one of the chops was al just bone and gristle - not what I would want one of the best placed restaurants in Melaka to be serving.When the 3 final dinners did arrive, which took a long time, due to the very small grill they are operating, they were not very nice either.The manager was apologetic, if not sincere, he promised us a discount and disappeared off.We had been at the restaurant for a very long time at this point, near to 3 hours....The bill arrives, with a 5% discount and 6% service charge!Added to this was the fact that the bill included 14 main courses now and yet there were only 12 of us.Back to the manager, who I think was trying to make up for the 5% discount, by charging us for 2 extra meals...so the bill had to be recalculated, this took even more time.After this, when the bill was finally correct - we paid and left somewhat disgusted.Melaka deserves better and so did we.Show less

Author: CF282
Title: Poor service, average food, nice location
Review: The location of this cafe is lovely - on the river, with pretty duo tables with candles on them etc. The food - I had pizza - was fine, small in size and average in terms of taste. The service was diabolical - we ordered a large bottle of water for two people and it came with one glass, I asked for a margherita pizza but a vegetarian was brought - and when I pointed out we had the wrong pizza brought, there was no apology. So many other nice places along the canal - do yourself a favour and avoid this one. Show less

Author: TonyMayaBali, Indonesia
Title: Avoid the wair and give it a miss
Review: Waited 1hr30mins and chased order 4 times...to then be told by the manager the order will now be cancelled by him because the kitchen had got the order wrong and could no longer make the food as it would take too long to cook. Malaka deserves better.....dont even sit down....every table had a big wait and some kind of issue. We wasted our night!!! 27th Feb 2014Show less

Author: Travel_Buff_Asia
Title: Appalling service and food quality
Review: Took 30 minutes to prepare a Malay laksa and when it arrived we found it quite inedible. The river view is nice but seating on that side is shabby. Other dishes are okay.

Author: turning-into-motherKent
Title: Location great, but that was it!
