Review: My top choice whenever I pay a visit to malacca. The sauce is unique you must give it a try. The way the meat was marinated has all the right flavor. Each stick has a little meat only so you can go for many sticks. Enjoy!Show less

Author: josephinengpy
Title: Yummy tender pork Satay
Review: Yummy yummy yummy yummy!! So tender and easily removable from the stick. Melts in your mouth with lovely pineapple sauce dip.

Author: QuakesNewYorkNew York
Title: Nice Visit Though a Slight Out of the Way
Review: Clearly a very popular satay store with loyal local and tourist diners. Go early to avoid having to wait especially since it is a bit off the main Jonker Street area (though still walkable for most). Service can be slow during crowded periods. Known for their pork satays, their peanut sauce also has a unique pineapple base as well.Show less

Author: wong mSingapore, Singapore
Title: revisited SUN MAY HIONG SATAY HOUSE
Review: I love their satay and have been revisting whenever I am in Melaka - since 1994. Then they weere located in Jonker street.The quality has been kept since these years and price since 2014 has gone up by 10 sens a stick which is almost negligable The price is standard regardless of pork / intestines / liver - 80 sens each These are the grill over a charcoal fire satay and not SATAY CELUP ( or LOK LOK ) The meats are well marinated with spices and taste great but thge sauce is what makes it good - pineapple mixed with peanut and chilli - oh excellent stuff.The trick is to go early and this place is to cater to the Brunch / Lunch crowd - after 1530 hours you probably will not find them grilling satay any more but cleaning up and calling it a day . If you go like me today ( 14 / Aug ) at around 1130 hours - hardly any customers which mean that you will get what you want and pretty quick too .It si not that they have bad service but only have a few staff mainly family members ,Thsi place only serves Satay ( pork / chicken ) and the satay inards- no other kinds of food - also not HALAL .It will not be my last visit for sureShow less

Author: Roy CSri Kembangan, Malaysia
Title: Pork Satay
Review: This place is usually opened on Thurday to Sunday. On a weekend, or long holidays, either come early or forget about it. It does gets real crowded and in the afternoon, it'll be a long queue to wait for the tables.Its good but no longer the best for me. The better taste one for me is Hai Heng but its opened at 7pm.Show less

Author: San L
Title: best of the best
Review: there's lots of good and great food in Malacca, especially satay but this is easily the best satay of all the satay!

Author: GwenneeBolton, United Kingdom
Title: Kebabs, or skewered pieces of meat/Satay!
Review: Wonderful combination of the various meats available served in skewers, with wonderful combination of sauces to dip or dunk your 'satay'. Love the spices used in preparing the sauces as well as the spiced used to season or marinate the various meats before they are baste and grilled on the gridiron.Pick your choice of accompaniments to go along with your satay. We loved them all.Show less

Author: Monie_LauKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: OK satay.
Review: is an OK satay. although they was having a lot of people with long q, but they still try to give you very good service and this is the best thing I like about them. GOOD SERVICE is a must for now a days. Hard to find good service in famous restaurant now. Foods I give 3-4 Stars only but Service I give 6 stars.Show less

Author: Nitegal80Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice sauce, bad satay
Review: After hearing good feedback on this satay stall, I decided to go down to try it. When the satays arrive, it tasted too dry & saltish. Really not to my taste. But the satay sauce is really nice .. Can taste the sourish pineapple taste inside. I don't think I will go back for satay again cause I think the Malay stalls satay tasted better.Show less

Author: YuuGotosea
Title: Great peanut gravy, average satay
Review: The place is far from the famous Jonker Street. I ate too much one afternoon and decided to walk to this place and it took me 30 mins under the hot sun.Nice restaurant for Melaka standard, I ordered 10 sticks and was served all the condiments such as: Ketupat/Lontong/Rice cake, onion, cucumber, peanut sauce (they are generous with the sauce). The satay arrived after 10 mins of waiting. Plenty of spaces, open air concept so don't expect air-con kay?The satay tasted so-so, the peanut sauce is exceptional if you like sourish-sweet-spicy taste. Service is not existance (same with other similar concept restaurant)Show less

Author: HotMama_Dev
Title: still fantastic lah!
Review: Unique satay that even children enjoy. U can ask for meat only or mixed. Mixed includes organ meats such as liver and intestines. The sauce is sweet and savoury at the same time. Must try!

Author: SingaporeRon
Title: Still my favourite
Review: Our family continues to favour their satay though we've discovered others. Over the Easter weekend, the grill was continuously busy, with the lady proprietoress serving many anxious customers.

Author: GuliWhere
Title: Malaccan version of Pinchos Morunos
Review: Malaysian satay is mostly sweet . However the ones at Sun May Hiong are like petite Pinchos Morunos infused with lemongrass and ground turmeric. A must try for those who like salty pork tapas. My first time trying yet I got hooked.

Author: kelvinkoh
Title: Fantastic Satay
Review: This place sells nothing except satay. The satay they serve you is straight off the grille - hot and fresh. Their gravy is unique with a mix of pineapple which makes it both spicy and sweet.

Author: Amy T
Title: Best Pork Satay with pineapple sauce!
Review: This is even better than satay celup .The pork satay is thick n well grilled.No fats seen.The sauce with pineapple is out of this world ! Seven of us walloped 92 sticks ! Forget about celup ...go for this !

Author: davekiatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good and unique stay sauce
Review: Girlfriend and I were on a Melaka food trail and had to try the satay here. The pork satay is grilled to perfection and is succulent. The satay sauce is special and is spicy with a little pineapple which adds to the sour taste.Will be back here again. Show less

Author: YangmayC
Title: The best pork satay!
Review: My favourite place to go everytime I'm in Melaka. The pork satay is grilled to perfection, super tender and succulent! And the peanut sauce is one of a kind! Is made of pineapple sauce with peanut. You have got to try! :)

Author: TeeCheeSengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Pork satay with less nutty pineapple sauce.
Review: We tried pork and pork small intestine satay which is good, lotong rice is fresh, the sauce is less nutty and more pineapple taste compare to usual one. The shop is smoky and warm at first while we enter @ 12noon , but it's feel ok after few minutes.Show less

Author: Jillian L
Title: Sticks of awesomeness
Review: Small delicious sticks of chicken, pork and liver that are grilled on a charcoal fire. Sauce is not as nutty as the usual satay, it's more on the sweet side but pairs well still with the grilled meats.

Author: hoon08Klang, Malaysia
Title: special
Review: The satay is quite special as never eat pork satay before.. The sauce is quite different compare to the normal satay sauce and is acceptable.. The location is quite ok but it's very hot to eat in the shop as v going in the noon... price is quite expensive as v order 25 stick of pork satay and also drinks where v cannot calculate how much is the satay cost per stick but it still can be try... Show less

Author: juzatourist
Title: For fans of pork satay
Review: If you like pork satay and pineapple satay sauce, this is the place for you. The satay is crisp outside and tender. A couple of old folks grilling the satay, very local establishment.

Author: SoonhoeLSingapore, Singapore
Title: succulent!
Review: I always eat beef, mutton or chicken satay sold by Malay stalls and rarely ever eat pork satay. So I had to try this out having read so many positive reviews. We went there after our failed chicken rice lunch at Famosa. The weather was blazing hot and we wished the restaurant had aircon. Nevertheless, there was enough fans to cool the warm air.The satay was.... succulent, unlike the drier/crispy and sometimes hard mutton/beef/chicken satay I have often taken. This was good! However, the satay sauce wasn't nutty enough and I thought there a tad too much "pineapple" in it.Overall, we were pleased even though we had taken our lunch a short while ago, we could still enjoy the satay here.Show less

Author: katrineangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Satay - non-halal
Review: The place closes at 6pm local time - and I believe they are open 10am to 6pm only after mid-week. That means, this eatery DOES NOT OPEN DAILY. Malacca is most active weekends, so I'm guessing, its not odd to just operate on certain days of the week. The satay is not spectacular. I wish I could say it was worth trying to locate this place, going around and around, with no clear idea of WHERE it is, in the blazing sun, only to find out it was not open for business. For those who still want to try this version of satay, please walk along the river-side on the side of the hotel Casa Del Mar, towards the mouth of the river. You will soon enough come across a row of shophouses on your right and the Satay House is right there. A lot of the shops operating there are wholesalers, which means, its not a row of shophouses bustling with activity.The sauce is so-so - not too sweet for me, but a little too bland for satay sauce that I know. The meat is well seasoned. The place was busy with patrons and I guess for the price you pay per stick, we shouldn't complain too much. I do prefer Kuantan's Zul Satay though...that has a punch.Another reminder, this is non-halal.Show less

Author: food_heiressMalmo, Sweden
Title: Great satay but we felt a little fleeced
Review: We read 70 sen per stick, so we ordered 30 for 2 people (RM21), and 2 cups of liang teh which the lady boss claim was home-made (it wasn't). Total cost was RM29.70, no explanation how it came about. Assuming the celup and rice was RM5 (which is ridiculous), it still leaves an odd figure of RM3.70. If they want to earn more I rather they charge me more for each stick of satay but keep it clear and transparent.Still, I will say forgive that and try it for once. It is a really nice satay and the uncle bbq-ing it is a delight. Maybe you should ask about the cost of each item before ordering.Show less

Author: 190kata
Title: Yummy ... Must try
Review:
Not the usual satay in Singapore.  This is very fulfilling and yet not sinful kind of feeling. LOL.  I especially like the peanut sauce that's made with pineapple, very tasty : )

Only one type of meat, pork.

Author: Frankie-YongMalacca
Title: Nothing much special!
Review: This is my family favourite satay place but it is normal and average for me as I have tasted many satay places in Malaysia, Indonesia and Cambodia. The only special is their peanut sauce with chunks of pineapple and it was served hot.Their satay cost RM0-80 per stick which is quite expensive for average satay price of RM0-70. Even the infamous Hj Samuri in Kajang cost RM0-70 with even more meat.For local tourist, try this if you have eaten all Melaka delicious food (satay celup, chicken rice, Nyonya cuisine etc).Show less

Author: jlnkcSingapore, Singapore
Title: The best
Review: This is one of the hardest dishes to find anywhere and sun may hiong does it the best. Been eating their satay since from previous locations till now for over 20 years and they've never disappointed. Savoury delicious moreish pork satay dipped in tangy spicy satay sauce. Introduced many friends to this place and so far none have been disappointed and they all return. It's a place I always visit when in malacca for the weekend and sometimes even more than once! Show less

Author: SingaporeRon
Title: Pork Satay
Review:
Another of our family's favourite haunts in Malacca.
Original shop was at Jonker over 15yrs ago. 
The satay is normally well grilled & served with generous helpings of the tasty sauce with belimbing.

Author: Lum9672
Title: Average
Review: Nothing special about the pork satay. I still prefer the normal chicken satay. You may try it. Maybe this is your taste:)

Author: SerenePangKL
Title: Unique satay sauce
Review: I went to had this during off peak, so there isn't crowded. We ordered only pork satay, but I don't really like it. The satay is too salty, overall nothing special for me. However, their sauce is very different from other coz they add pineapple in it. Don't put in high expectations, if not it will be ended up with disappointmentShow less

Author: Peng Boon TSingapore
Title: Very Good but Note its Opening Times
Review: We went to Sun May Hiong Satay House twice previously but it was closed because the first time was on one of its off-days and the second time was after 6 pm. There was no notice stating the days it is open and the opening hours.Sun May Hiong Satay House sells pork, chicken & intestines satays. They were very good, especially the sauce & intestine satays. My 5-year old granddaughter ate 7 sticks of satay and my 4-year old granddaughter ate 10 sticks of satay! Opens 10 am to 6 pm, Thursdays to Sundays, including public holidaysShow less

Author: Andrew KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Skinny Melaka Satay
Review: Just an average Malaysian Satay shop serving pork satay. You have a choice of skewered pork, liver and intestines which are well marinated and grilled over a smokey charcoal fire. The meat is skewered in the traditional Chinese satay style i.e. pieces of fat between the lean meat. I find the satay a wee bit too skinny to my liking, plus the dipping sauce lacks the roasted peanut taste, instead it taste more of fried onions mixed with pineapple jam; which is normally served separately and added to your liking by traditional Chinese satay style. Overall, an enjoyable meal, but nothing to rave about as viewed in the local Malaysian food guide and Food documentary on TV.Show less

Author: sabahrefugiselangor
Title: a little overrated
Review: the satay is just nice, (ntg special) didn't like the fact that they put pork meat and lard alternately on the stick rather than just meat. but it was cooked well - it wasn't burnt or anything.the sauce is good though! make sure you dip it in real good when having a huge bite! :)the service could have been better. there was only like 4 tables there when i went, the lady was standing there, we were ready to order but she was busy chatting with some other patrons there and we were ignored for minutes.overall, was just okay for me but if you have extra time, this place is okay to drop by.also, i saw a family of 5 ordering 100 sticks at one go, probably for dinner. it's definitely a local delicacy ;)p/s: if you're walking there, from the direction of JonkerStreet just go on Casa Del Rio's walkway near the river. You can have a good stroll beside the river and when you walk past the hotel, just walk on further a little and you should see the shop on your right across the street.Show less

Author: JaydcokeBalik Pulau, Malaysia
Title: A must-have every time I'm in Melaka.
Review: The satay here is grilled perfectly, leaving the meat tender but with a gentle smokiness and just a hint if charting on the edges. The sauce may not be to everyone's taste but I find the sour-sweet-spicy blend to be just the right accompaniment to the meat. I can't give an unbiased opinion of the service as I am now recognized as a frequent customer, but in all the years I've patronized them I've never had poor service. The food has also always arrived at the table in good time. And that's why I always drop by too - a guaranteed good meal time. Show less

Author: Christine LSingapore
Title: Satay Sauce you have to try
Review: The satay here is done in the traditional way. Only it's a little healthier because there is less fat in the pork satay. The sauce is the main attraction; it has plenty of mashed pineapple in it - gives it the right balance of sweet & sour, enhancing the peanut sauce. A must try! Show less

Author: SforSingapore
Title: nice satay and sauce
Review: The satays are hot and nice.  Their sauce is nice with pineapple.

Author: koo_clan
Title: Special Satay Sauce!
Review: The satay sauce has bits of pineapple in it, so quite special. Only 2 type of meat: chicken & pork, also serve pigs innards in skewers. If you are in Melaka for holiday, I think no harm to try something special, right?

Author: otyewSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice
Review: Been there for a few times but mostly during the non peak season. Price wise is not that cheap but the taste is qutie good and addictive especially the intestine. Pork satay was the best but chicken isnt. Well at RM0.60/piece for a pork, well...not the cheapest but not that bad especially the escalating price of pork.Show less

Author: pauljerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not worth the time nor money
Review: The uniqueness of this nyonya satay, I was told, is its peanut sauce which is mixed with some pineapple. It creates a sour n spicy taste. I don’t like my satay kuah to taste this sourish. The chicken, pork and innards statay here are sadly less than stellar and is nothing special.They had two shoplots and when it’s full like it was today, the service was non-existent to the extent that you wait forever for a miserable few sticks of satay, because the kitchen simply couldn’t cope. After bringing a bunch of satay which worked out to one or at most two sticks per person, we were fortunate the next bunch arrived while we were still young. I gave up after waiting an hour and eating four sticks of satay.At 60sen a stick of satay (70 sen including Chinese New year surcharge), and the satay – the size fit for a Liliputian – this is blatant daylight robbery.Not enjoyable. Seriously, you WILL be disappointed here. ([---])Show less

Author: GurmeetS253
Title: Mediocre Place, Poor Service & Average Food
Review: 1. Rude staff who just don't care about customers/diners. In fact, they don't take pride in their own work. They argue between themselves as orders often ended up at wrong table numbers. 2. Service is awful. Waited between 45 minutes to an hour before we got our first of many orders. That too after we politely prompted a staff that we had a toddler who was hungry.3. Beware of bugs/ants/mosquitos. A bug of sort ended up on one of our dishes as tables are placed under the tree. 4. There's nothing really scenic. Overated would be an understatement.5. Food is average, not fresh and unnecessarily greasy. Saw fish (fish & chips) which were fried in advance and kept. Ironically, even the pre-cooked food took forever to be served. 6. Only consolation is the live band. A couple who belted out lovely numbers to stop the (frustrated/agitated) crowd from leaving.Will strongly discourage people from visiting this overated eatery.Show less

Author: Jlym0411
Title: Very poor service attitude
Review:
👎👎劝大家，别来！不要花钱还要看服务员脸色受罪，尤其是她们的女员工，莫名其妙自己送餐送错餐桌，还对我们翻白眼，无言，食物味道还可以..... 啦
 服务态度真的需要改，上菜真心慢！！！人手不足，客人多，什么都是借口，好的餐厅不管客人多还是少，态度还是要有！！！！The servant's attitude seriously poor, so rude. Poor service is inexcusable👎

Author: pete_malaysia
Title: Chill place
Review:
Found this place thanks to google.about 30mins from the city
View of the straits obscured by a bank so it was pretty much a small lagoon view
Food was average,service decent and prices reasonable

Author: W3645CPkenh
Title: Damn slow, we have been waiting
Review: Damn slow, we have been waiting for more than an hour, not enough staffs especially the chef fails to get the food ready

Author: MartinTingtongMunich, Germany
Title: Great food, great service, nice location
Review: Since the last 20 years when I come to Melaka I visit Bert‘s Garden. The food, especially the seafood is outstanding but the Nasi Lemak, noodles and satay are also great.Not only the food is great but the service as well. Ron always gives us a warm welcome any times.The location is a bit out of Melaka in a big and nice garden directly by the seaside. You also can enjoy the sunset there.I will definitely come again!Show less

Author: LatinaSepetSandakan, Malaysia
Title: "Good food with good ambiance"
Review: The service really good even tho during my visit it was packed due to new year eve but the staff managed to handle the order accordingly. Food was fantastic well done cooked and affordable price. I just loved the atmosphere kinda peaceful and romantic and it suits for any couples to celebrate their wedding anniversary or birthday celebration. I would recommend this place to my friends and family.Show less

Author: eweleeong
Title: Very good BBQ fish and other local dishes
Review:
What can I say.... good food. It’s also a beer garden. 

The location is quite out of the way and it’s very unassuming. Far away from town. 

Prices are a bit high but the food is good. 

If you’re nearby do drop in. Happy eating.

Author: vikneshbmwPort Dickson, Malaysia
Title: Good seafood with view.
Review: I and my partner went here for first time . Unfortunately thia restaurant is huge but only few tables are facing the sea ,and most of it are reseved. But if can go on the sunset time and you wont miss the evening view of the sea. The food was good . They hv nasi lamak , western foods and alao a bar se up with good beers selections. . The price is consider ok for a tourist place like melaka . This shop located nearly ± 10 km from melaka city centre. Follow tje costal road near klebang to Sg udang. Can Waze. Can tey a day for dinner here if stay at melaka . Show less

Author: thomluv2trvl
Title: Great dining view
Review: Was at Bert's Garden for dinner with my partner. The restaurant is situated next to the sea and it was breath taking at night. Food was great and service was good. Enjoyed the ambience and the beer garden.Show less

Author: Chicken_LuxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Old changi Beach vibes
Review: Take a short coastal drive out of Malacca, passing through rustic malay kampongs, and you'll find Bert's garden in a little lane facing the lagoon. An old colonial house greets you upon arrival, pick your seafood from their chiller, order how to you want it done - grilled, fried, baked, whatever. Then order a beer from their pub and watch the sunset while you dine al fresco. Perfect island-vibes, a nice getaway from the chaos of Malacca.Food was good, but not the best you can find in Malacca. I would go here for the ambience, a nice relaxing way to catch up with your travel buddies. Show less

Author: FernR54
Title: Great seafood place by the sea
Review: Good food - pleasant ambience - away from the maddening crowds on Jonker Street. The grilled prawns were out favourite - done just right and still juicy to bite into.

Author: renzulnanakaka
Title: Do not buy the butter lobster coz ita just a gigantic FLOSS
Review: Ordered lobster for the family, was served after all dishes were served appx 30min. From the looks if it, seems like theres a lot of meat, but when we opened the shell, theres only less than 15pcs of chopped lobster meat covered in gigantic floss costing 275RM! Bullcrap...Very disappointing. Staff were very friendly, but just save your cash and buy 1kg of lobster in SG @ $55 instead.Show less

Author: Nur zailin MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: doesnt feel welcome here
Review: Came here because of the good rating & recommendations. We arrived the same time wt another group. Yes, we dont have any reservation, yet they still allow us in. The restaurant was quiet. Not so many customer, except us, the group and a few tables is occupied. We was rushed by the waiter for the order coz he said the group might make out order taking longer time to make. We are still ok wt that. After order has been made, the waiter came back to us and told us they can proceed wt our main course coz they need to proirotized the group order and asked us to changed our order. My husband went to see the manager in charge Miss Amanda ti check on this. At first, she said they cant make it. After my husband make a lot of noise that its unfair to treat customer like this, only sge agree to proceed wt our order. Feeling foolish by the her attitute, we left the restaurant and just pay for the super sweet over price ice lemon tea that they served us. Anyway, the group was just anskall group. Less than 20 pax. I dont see why they cant cater small group plus walk in customer if so many people claimed they are so good. Overall nothing good here.Show less

Author: 479juleskKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh from the ocean
Review: We have been to Malacca numerous times and Bert’s is the must go-to place for us for their fresh seafood. You can pick and choose the seafood and tell them to cook the way you want it. Custom-made seafood joint. Love the view especially sunset while enjoying the yummy seafood.Show less

Author: hyunsum
Title: Good place for seafood with sunset!!
Review: It was great dishes with beautiful sunset. The food was very fresh and tasty!!My parents from Korea(sea side) tried most of food first time but they really love those dishes. I surely come again when I come next time. Thanks Ron! We had a good memory here.Show less

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Unexpected, Mismanaged
Review: I've been to this eatery 18 years ago and at that time really an unforgettable memories. After such a long hiatus, I've visited this place and truly has changed a lot. I don't see those waves hit the shores, not much customers, menu has changed and etc. The dishes we ordered were more like a typical Malay foods and insatiable. The waiters seems reminding us the last call would be at 11.45pm from the moment we arrive till we depart. They are concerned more on when customer will depart rather than handling customer service. It's a nice place which is set in a quiet tranquil, sea view, beer garden but totally mismanage. Absolutely, the owner did not take the initiative to promote, market the place and generate revenue. It's a fantastic place to draw the crowd and could be listed one of Malacca's visited place for dining but to no avail. Hope to see some changes on my next visitShow less

Author: Mimath
Title: Good for seafood but very basic for the equipment
Review:
This is a very very basic restaurant along the sea side. Food is good but also very basic. During the day the view is rather nice. At night it losses a bit its charm as the see can't be seen anymore.
A bit expensive.

Author: rudicheu
Title: Great
Review: Great ambience. Fish was fresh but scaly af. Would have preferred a drier grilled fish but the staff said they kept the scales on to keep the fish juicy. :/ Overall worth a visit.

Author: GoPlaces110832
Title: Seafood Beer Garden
Review: Best view , sunset and lovely dinner..wide variety of food..fresh seafood. Most charming & welcoming hosts Bert & Amanda

Author: Anesh S
Title: Sea food dinner
Review: Please is nice ,love the out door seating Service way very good , food was nice But price is on high side ,care full when your order the ikan Bakar , price is by 100gSo dinner for 4 was on high side all was ok but the red snapper was over priced Rm80.10 for fish alone witch I thought over priced.Over all ok but need be careful when you order .Just day before I Had same fish was only 40.Show less

Author: MarkS960Singapore, Singapore
Title: Bert's Garden
Review: This is bit out of Melaka and you to take a taxi to get there. Very nice surrounding with the seafront reaching the restaurant. Very friendly owner (Bert) and staff. Serves a good range of seafood, nasi lemak, satays, Muar otak etc. Great to drink at the bar with Bert.Show less

Author: thiamseng sSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bert’s Garden Seafood -Food Standards Dropped
Review: This is my third time here and I am beginning to see a obvious drop in the food standard. The famed nasi lemak isn’t that good anymore and the petai with sambal tasted more like petai with ketchup and you can counted the number of petai on one hand. Kitchen send one wrong order ( long beans become lady fingers) and and one order of BBQ prawn was forgetten. This is my must go place whenever I visit Melaka. From next visit, this will no longer be a venue for dinner.Show less

Author: BalandKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hands down the best seafood I've hand in Malaysia.
Review: One of the very few places you'd use the term OH MY GOD to describe. Amazing seafood. I ate till my stomach literally almost blew up! The service was awesome, the food is beyond your imagination. The portions are well worth the price and yes it can be a bit pricey for some, but it's definitely worth every penny and I just can't wait to go back there again. If you're in Malacca, make sure you pay this place a visit. The best bar is, you can order your food at the bar (area). Really great.Show less

Author: dezzlynShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: nice place to chili
Review: last time visited was about 10years ago. still a very nice place to be for dinner. cozy with nice ambient and dinner and wine by the seaside . highlt recommended to go especially if you want to just enjoy a night out from the city. just a note ,price of food is a bit on the high side but all in all, it's still worth going . recommend the nasi lemak and the ikan bakar Show less

Author: nickyhmd
Title: Nice ambiance
Review: Went with group tour. Not sure on the price coz it is paid for. But overall food was good, service was good too.

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Dinner at sunset and seabreeze
Review: This restaurant is wel located for sun set dinners. Eating outside with a seabreeze what more is required for a nice evening out with friends. The seafood was excellent prepared, ikan bakar is was fresh and very much recomendable. The choice of music was wel chosen too. All in all we're very satisfied about this evening out Show less

Author: KiranG769
Title: Best food, great view
Review:
I visited recently Melaka City with friends and went there for dinner. We got very testy and fresh sea foods. The restaurant is with good view, good food, and great service.
I will recommend it.

Author: 56natliet
Title: Pricey even for foreigners, but food & service were good. Awesome view
Review: Love the view and ambience there. Very good service too. The only complain is the price. Food is good! But will I back here again? Maybe not for the price

Author: StajinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tourist place - good food though
Review: Tourist place, good tasty seafood though, however more expensive than other seafood places in town. Good atmosphere. Lots of potential. Should change their menu to really focus on seafood rather than "tourist / western type of food " eg. hamburgersService was good and friendly as well. Nice decor/ambiance.Show less

Author: 234keet
Title: Eat elsewhere...
Review: Mediocre food with pricey $$$ tag to it. 2 crabs costed rm150, fish rm80, 6 prawns rm70. We had a total bill of rm473 for 6 adults. Needless to say I wouldn't recommend the place to anyone and definitely forget of returning.

Author: IreneXinni
Title: Dating
Review: Nice ambience with delicious nasi lemak & otak otak.  Sunset by the sea with family member was joyful.

Author: Kristina L
Title: Great atmosphere by the sea
Review: A local friend took us to this pearl of a place. The staff and customers are happy and so friendly. Great view overlooking the sea. You can even see the fish swimming in the water. Only 10-15 minutes drive from Malacca center by car. The owners are so kind, hospitable and look after the customers. Great place! Show less

Author: MarkS960Singapore, Singapore
Title: Bert's Garden Melaka
Review: The place is away from Melaka city center and you need a cab to get unless you are driving.The place by the beach. The ambience and food are great. Prices are expensive. The satay, nasi lemak and grilled seafood are wonderful. Also the service is very good with friendly owner Betrand mixing and drinking with the customers.Show less

Author: JODJODJOD
Title: Bar & restaurant on the beach
Review: The food is very nice and clean. The place itself is nothing pretentious, but if you enjoy a good seafood dish or some chicken with pandan while drinking a cocktail with a view on the beach, it is the right place.

Author: Adrian DNilai, Malaysia
Title: Amazing seafood, great ambiance
Review: Went there yesterday,was not disappointed they serve very fresh seafood, we ordered the ikan bakar,four heavenly vegetables,black pepper crab, butter prawn and nasi lemakthe food was excellent, the only negative thing i can say about the restaurant is that it takes quite a long time for the food to come out of the kitchen but besides that this is a restaurant every seafood lover in melaka should visitShow less

Author: C3451ZUmichaeltVoesendorf, Austria
Title: Dinner @ Bert's
Review: Staffs are Friendly. Nice ambience overlooking at sea. Food are not bad, except the butter prawns & anchovies are oily. Maybe should consider cereal prawns. The grill fish is fresh but should have more sambal to spicy it up. The chill sauce should be sweet then fish sauce. Sorry Bert is my honest comments. Prices are reasonable. Show less

Author: HarryR1087
Title: Return Visit
Review: Been visiting Bert's since 1998, Glad to say that the standards have been retained, the location and the food quality have been retained.

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: One of the best nasi lemak in Malacca
Review: We both love the nasi lemak here and that just keeps us coming back for more. The nasi lemak is typical Malacca style, strong presence of santan and mildly salty. It is accompanied by a very nice sambal paste, kangkung blanched in salt water, boiled egg, crispy anchovies and peanuts. This had to be one of the best nasi lemak around in Malacca plus we get to enjoy it over some beer and a lovely view of the ocean or what is oeft of it after the land fill project.Show less

Author: Rick NSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best beachside seafood in town
Review: Whenever I'm in Malacca, it's always a must that i visit this place for seafood dinner and drinks. They have a good selection of dishes to choose from, but their grilled seafood is the best. The large prawns are grilled to perfection and are succulent and delicious. When you order grilled fish, you are given a choice of plain, with sambal or half-half. For grilled squids, ask if they got large or medium-sized squids, though the small squids are just as good. Prices are reasonable, and the staff are very friendly especially if you feel chatty about anything under the sun (or the moon as it's nighttime).Show less

Author: Rajan K
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: This was a short drive out of the city centre of Melaka - but well worth it.  The service and ambience was excellent.

Author: Pris_ShillaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fresh Seafood and a Good Service!
Review: Were there on Christmas night for dinner. Lucky thing i reserved my table a day before so remember to make reservations... just incase they might be full. They were all very friendly and speak good English and always had the courtesy to ask how is everything and if we need anything more. We ordered Seabass bakar/ bbq which is bbq'ed with some sambal and served with chilli in soy sauce, butter prawns, kung po chicken with cashew and the four seasons stir fry vege as well as rice to go with it! Was advised beforehand that the fish will take awhile as its slow grilled to perfection. I did not mind the wait for as long the food is good. After sometime the food arrives one by one. The fish was so fresh and grilled to perfection and with the "chilli kicap" it was awesome. He even thought us how we should scoop out the fish properly!! The Butter prawns was perfect and to die for! The vegetables and kung po chicken with cashew was not bad either!! We loved our food and the way it was prepared and served as everything came hot and fresh to savour!! Will return again if i am back to Melaka!! Show less

Author: sandhumSingapore, Singapore
Title: Still soooo good!
Review: It's been a while but nonetheless, a lovely evening spent at Bert's! The grilled seafood was outstanding and the beers really cold! Must try the graggo patties, grilled jumbo prawns and grilled fish! Right on the water and a beautiful balmy night! What else can you ask for? Great place to just chill, chat and reminisce, like we did!Show less

Author: puddinglow
Title: Yummy again.
Review:
as before, food is excellent with great service, the restaurant has great ambiance.
met the owner this time Ms.Amanda, she is a great on hands manager.
great place for events, good collection of wines. highly recommended for family, couples and events.

Author: dunhill2015London, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent Place To Hang Out
Review: I have been visiting this place for the past 15 years. For the past two yrs will visit about more than 20 times a yearsAmbient : Excellent, quiet, cozyFood : Excellent especially the nasi lemak, comando chip, chicken pandan, bbq fish, and many moreBeer : One of the best draft beer in Melaka compare with other locationStaff : Attentive and friendly, good command of englishClealines : Very GoodFood Freshness : ExcellentBasically all what you need not to have good food but to enjoy the foodShow less

Author: NanyangviewSingapore, Singapore
Title: A Great Place for Seafood
Review: This is a great place for tasty seafood. The food was delicious. The service was great. We order black pepper crab, fish, chicken, vegetables, beer and juices. All were very good. The setting was relaxing and comfortable, right by the water, with a good view. The price was very reasonable. The only drawback is that the place is out of the way from anywhere. It cost us 30MR to get there from Melacca Sentral. When we finished, the owner called a taxi for us as there was not any nearby. Over all, it was definitely worth the trip. If you are not in a rush while in Melacca and want to enjoy delicious seafood and a relaxing place by water, I'd highly recommend this place. The place can accommodate large crowds.Show less

Author: 999daliThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Lovely food & great wines (by the glass)
Review: The restaurant is little bit out of town but nicely situated along the sea. It's a quiet place (unless there are big groups eating) and romantic. Food is fresh prepared on the BBQ and tasted great. We had prawns, sotong, scallops and sateh. Best thing is that they sell lovely wines (also by the glass) for a very very decent price! A big plus considering the cheap wines you normally get. We enjoyed the place very much!Show less

Author: Sulaidahlan S
Title: Berts garden is my kitchen.
Review: Since in Melaka,  i try so many restaurant but im for in Love with berts garden.  The food and service is 1st class.

Author: ouiser3Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: nice food and location
Review: A really nice location next to the water. The food is really nice and tasty. We ate here 3 nights running and every meal was good. The service is excellent. The bar stocks a huge variety of drinks and has the feeling of a pub. I would recommend eating here.Show less

Author: BushymartinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ten out of ten
Review: I decided to take a quick drive down to malacca from KL and was looking for some good seafoodBerts had great reviews on here so we tried it out We ordered who grilled snapper grilled prawns, a local rice dish and a few German beers.All of the food was sensationally cooked and very delicious.Beer was icy cold and the setting setting out right on the water was perfectRon the waiters service was absolutely first class, he was very welcoming, he knew the menu really well and we followed his suggestions.His attention to detail was as good as a 6 star hotelGreat job Ron. We will be back Show less

Author: bubbles_csKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Perfect place to chill and eat good food
Review: Asian & western food ( fusion ) friendly staff , it's a simple place next to the beach , relaxing simple place , don't have to dress up , really good food , nice place to come alone or with group of friends or with kids , serves alcohol , I'm always satisfied .. Show less

Author: 5lovefood99Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice Place to Enjoy Seafood & Sea View
Review: Very Nice Environment. Restaurant setting very nice & allow you to have private function & Company Function too..Service is Good, waiter take time to recommend their menu. Even ans the question that we ask on the menu.The food is delicious.. me n my friends are all satisfy with the food recommend...Show less

Author: Alice T
Title: Sunset
Review: Wonderful sunset viewed at Bert's Garden.  Truly a place to unwind after a hard day.  A great place for bonding with friends and family.

Author: SoHengHengSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful Dinner
Review: Heard alot about this place. Finally visited tonight with my family. The place is near the seaside. Romantic, warm, cosy, quite, all in one. We arrived just nice to watch the sun set. Service is fantastic, think they are family run business. The waiter take time to recommand their menu. The food is delicious. There were 5 of us & we ordered 9 dishes. The bill came up to only RM 220. Really cheap & good. We didn't order any beer or wine. Would definitely come back again if I m in Malacca.Show less

Author: kalaiselvanvKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Place for Family Gathering
Review: I been to this place after saw many good review of Bert's Garden, I have contacted the Person in Charge, Miss Amanda and reserve a nice place, well the welcome was awesome, shes so friendly and able to give good suggestion what to eat and we went there with people of 8. Got a place with sea view and the environment was fabolous, The Crab and Ikan Bakar is a must try dish there. the taste of the food was so good and definitely its a must try sea food restaurant in Mallaca.Show less

Author: YogaiswaranK
Title: Awesome food
Review: Love the seafood, mantau, chilli chicken, paprik chicken, fried squid, butter prawns... they do serve quality food.. a must visit location

Author: MiyaGieGie
Title: Good food with Nice Enviroment
Review: Go to this restaurant if you craving for the western food, I love the chicken chop and my boyfriend love their beef burger. He said the burger even taste so much better then the burger in Hard Rock Cafe @ Sentosa Singapore.

Author: puddinglow
Title: a must for people who like seafood.
Review: Excellent food and fresh. cooked deliciously. the venue is excellent and very relaxing with the sound of the waves.

Author: D_JekyllMalaysia
Title: Our all time favourite
Review: Bert's has always been our favourite stopover for dinner whenever we are in Melaka. It has been trully consistent with their cooking and the taste quality has been well maintained for more than a decade since we first found this hidden gem. It is a beautiful open air garden brilliantly decorated and offers diners a very laid back & romantic atmosphere. Despite losing some of its ocean view to land reclamation works by the local council, it is still a remarkable place to dine or just to catch up over a pint.Our favourite has to be the nasi lemak which is a deligthful plate of fragrant rice cooked with coconut milk and accompanied by sambal, anchovies, boiled egg & boiled water spinach. The otak otak is another one of our favourite. Its freshly transported from Muar and one of the best around.The crowd favourite would be the BBQ seafood. They have a variety of fresh fish, prawns, squids, crabs & frozen lobsters. You pick the seafood and they BBQ or grill it for you. Highly recommended for couples & families seeking something different from the typical restaurants. Prices are a mildly higher than average but a good trade off for the lovely ambience.Show less

Author: rhinoflexGreater Adelaide, Australia
Title: Good food but beware!
Review: I had dinner at Bert's sometime ago with friends. The setting and ambience was nice, being by the sea and it was outdoors. The food was fine too as I remember. However, the next day, I noticed that the amount showing on my credit card receipt was in Australian dollars, and not Malaysian ringgit, which should be the case, as I believe I was transacting in the local currency. I later learnt that this is a new "service" provided by card issuers, which in itself was not a problem, except that they charge a higher conversion fee for the convenience. I also learnt that the merchant should've offered this service and only proceed if I agreed. I was not asked beforehand. So just be aware of this unsavoury practice, that's all. Otherwise, the food and service were fine.Show less

Author: Alice TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Paradise
Review: I was at Bert's Garden over the weekend and I find this place simply wonderful. It was like love at first sight. Atmosphere was great, food was good, crowd was beautiful. Crisp nice sea breeze, away from the hustle bustle of the city. Somewhere to unwind at the end of the day. A great place for couples, gathering with friends, family, even private functions. I will definitely make a come black.Show less

Author: ThebendysNewcastle upon Tyne, United Kingdom
Title: Great place
Review: We came here in November as part of our honeymoon with a friend who was local to the area and recommended it. We were not disappointed! Amanda was fantastic, she was very attentive and friendly and the food was excellent - well worth dropping by if you are in the area.Show less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Used to be a Great place to chill at night...
Review: This place used to be by the sea but reclamation has now reached here and the beachside bungalow that houses this restaurant is now seeing a huge swath of reclaimed "desert". The atmosphere is definitely affected. you no longer get to see or hear the sea. Sad as this was a great place to chill out. However, the plants and the layout of the place still makes it a great romantic atmosphere and feels real cozy despite no longer being seaside. Food was not bad. we like the Nasi lemak which was good. The curry was also not bad. But overall is a bit pricey compared to other normal restaurants. mosquitoes might be a problem but they put plenty of mosquito coils around to ward them off. A good place to have a drink after a long day. However, it is about 15 to 20 minutes from middle of town.Show less

Author: Natalieliow
Title: The seafood is so fresh ! But it's abit too pricey !
Review: Me and my boyfriend ,we ordered two crab, one prawn and a plate of nasi lemak with two water melon juice . Cost about RM 220 !! Hmm other then the shocking and not so reasonable price ! The food is delicious .. The service is ok . Show less

Author: AndreallaLee
Title: Really delicious and excellent service
Review: Service is top-notch and really attentive. Food is really delicious. We ordered a grilled red snapper and the waiter even recommended and taught us the proper way to de-bone the fish. Really attentive! Thumbs up!! Will definitely come back again when I'm in Malacca. =)

Author: robbenter
Title: Cozy Corner
Review: Food was good. Place was cozy. Haunted by regulars at the bar. Locals may complain that its a lil pricey, but you get what you pay for.

Author: Milky99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice place...
Review: When we were in Melaka, suddenly we were starving for seafood. just type Melaka seafood in google, this restaurant's name appeared with ikan bakar (BBQ fish). With no time, we straight away headed to this place from Jonker Street, just one way straight... easy to find.We reached there at 5.45pm and we were the first customer of the day.Nice environment and ambient, surrounded by some sort of Cuban music. It was located by the seaside but, due to land reclamation, the view was hampered.We ordered butter prawn, grilled siakap fish, sausage with mashed potato and some local snack. Those food were nice, only the sausage was a bit hard. No complaints for the rest.The restaurant was filled with trees & plants... we saw a monitor lizard swimming in the seaside... just beside out sitting place.. my daughters just got frightened... hahaha...Price is average, just watch what you order.Recommended place... nice food.Show less

Author: DSTSS
Title: Black Pepper Crab...yum
Review:
Go to Bert's...order the Black Pepper Crab...and french fries...and a Coke....Sit at a table next to the water....Eat the Black Pepper Crab, drink the Coke, and feed the french fries to catfish....

go home happy...

Author: Blueskyblueocea
Title: My opinion
Review: My opinions to this restaurant is the foods and services are under my expectation.I didnt have much choices the foods selections are limited and the prices is not tat cheap.But if want have a drinks or celebration this place will suitable a bit because of the decoration and environments.Show less

Author: foodlover0981Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Great place to chill with friends!
Review: Been there a few times and always satisfied! The seafood is fresh, availability depends on the supplier and what time of the year you go there. It only happened once to me that the dish wasn't available, but that was fine because there's plenty of other dishes on the menu, all of them excellent. Europeans will be thrilled to find "real" western food! Service is sometimes clumsy but always friendly and the staff will do their best to accommodate you. Music is not too loud so you can hang out and have a nice chill evening with friends, cool beer and good food. Will definitely go again!Show less

Author: csfKuching_SarawakKuching, Sarawak
Title: Too basic
Review: Went to this restaurant upon recommendation from a local. It's a distance from town, food variety poor, not much of a choice and seafood not fresh. The food serve in this restaurant is too basic to take the trouble to make the trip there. Even food serve at Jonker Walk has better options.Show less

Author: Yong9974
Title: Overhyped and over rated. Misleading menu on website.
Review: Went there on a friday nite with my girlfriend. There were only three tables occupied out of maybe twenty. Thr place was quiet. We tried to order from the menu but many items were not available. Its ridiculous..they told us they had squid only from the kitchen and not the grill, and it costs twice as much. No flower crab, and the crabs they had were small and overpriced...ten ringgit per 100g. Many options on the menu were not avail as well. In the end, we settled for buttered squid, salted egg crab, and fried long beans with belachan sambal. Buttered squid was rubbery. Probably the worst i have tasted... I could have cooked them better myself. Salted egg crab...sauce was nice but the crab was too small and the meat stuck to the shell. Long beans were overdone despite me telling the waiter to fry them lightly. Damage? 100rm for these three dishes plus two juices. They even have a 10 percent surcharge. Avoid this place or regret.Teddy from SingaporeShow less

Author: Roberto-SingaporeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Simply wonderful place.........Bert Gdn, Melaka
Review: The atmosphere, the food, the beautiful view from there and the service.......they are excellent !Pricing is reasonable too. A really nice place if you are planning an event or a party !For me, it was a wonderful night out and had a great experience ! Tried the salmon and it is so fresh & tasty..........love it !The host and crew are so friendly too. I shall return !!Show less

Author: MrRando2012Houston, Texas
Title: Great atmosphere, great food, great hosts.....
Review: Bert's is a place that we frequent at least twice a week. The atmosphere, the service, the flexibility to accomodate dietary requirements suits our needs. The seafood is always fresh. The relaxed atmosphere by the water and prompt service is something that makes our visits very pleasurable. The freshly squeezed juices made by the permament juicer are the BEST !Show less

Author: uniey_aras
Title: seafood in melaka
Review: excellent view with tasty foods...the price is reasonable and recommended to try this in melaka....i shall come here again...it is also suitable for function qnd wedding too......

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful quite night out...
Review: It's slightly away from Melaka Town, but worth the drive. The place is nicely set up with wooden furniture and it's an ALL OUTDOOR DINING. Table seating options include right beside the sea which I personally recommend. There are no fans (none required) as it can be very breezy. I do suggest bringing mosquito a repellent with you especially if you're traveling with children. The food is not much to shout about but that's only my opinion (and taste buds!) The nasi lemak is nice but I would not classify it as being the best in Melaka tho... Grilled squid was nice especially the sauce that came with it.Overall I would say its a great place to relax and unwind. Food-wise, I'll give it a 6/10Show less

Author: chyminologySingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Nice scenery and good service
Review: We travelled for about 20 to 25 mins outskirts and the view was breathtaking and could see local fishing. It was a nice change from the crowded town centre. We ordered crabs, prawns, fish, etc. Would like to say that the crabs and prawns was good but the fish was so-so. There are plenty of mozzies though the hospitable staff would light the incense under the table to help chase them away. Would have loved it if they have some live band....some ideas maybe? Our dinner was shorten by strong winds and were advised that it would soon rain. There are indoor and outdoor dining areas but we chose to make our exit as the winds made it difficult to eat, with everything flying off. It was a good experience but not good enough for me to venture far out again. And the meal cost RM1000, for 12 (including 8 bottles of beer), so I would say its kinda of over -priced?Show less

Author: CourtneyCheong
Title: nice place for dining
Review:
had a good time, enjoy the sea view and the music,
friendly owner, it is enjoyable to have dinner here,
come and enjoy, you will never be regret! :)

Author: josephinemartatanSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: hidden haven
Review: Who would have known that there is such a fabulous place in Malaysia, let alone Malacca! Its a slight way out of town, perfect for me as I was looking for a place without the tourists, and wow....its really something!Its rustic, great food and even more fabulous people! The staff are friendly, food good but what I love most was the warmth that the owners Bert and Amanda showered on me. Additionally, the customers are also fantastic!! Its such a lovely, friendly environment.....and safe too!!Bert's Garden has become the reason I visit Malacca :-)Oh I should just add that I wish the toilet can be 5 star as the place is :-pShow less

Author: jax3
Title: Superb service!
Review: Excellent food - try the commando chips with barbecued prawns. Savannah Dry for those who like cider and super atmosphere with a sea view. Fantastic service!

Author: Waterjoe_Rbg
Title: Great place to be!!!
Review: Best Restaurant & Bar in Malacca...Great food und drinks...nice owners, perfect Restaurant and nice environment!! Come there and enjoy...You can meet a lot of nice people from all over the World there...They also serve a great selection of german beer and have a great "Oktoberfest" Party...A few days back they also started to serve Pizza...Like in Italy or even better...Also they serve a big choice on Local seafood & Japanese food with high quality...Show less

Author: 11Danny
Title: Best Nasi Lemak In Melaka and Some Said Malaysia!!
Review:
Nice Atmosphere and Seafood is Fantastic Here !! 
Don't Miss it when u come to Melaka!!

Author: Simonandon
Title: Fantastic seafood, great service and beautiful sunset view, well worth a trip out of central Melaka.
Review: Well worth the trip out of central Melaka; only 15 minutes by taxi. Nice location on the coast with fantastic seafood and chilled out ambiance... Try the pepper crab washed down with a tiger beer. Seafood is fresh and on display, including the live crabs.

Author: TJYeohKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A very lucky find.
Review: I echo the stellar reviews of the other customers. Bernie’s pub is the friendly neighbourhood pub where everybody knows your name. Whether you’re with friends or alone, this is the kind of pub you can easily spend hours in. Which we did. And went back again the next night because it was that good. A perfect triumvirate of good drinks, good music and perfect hosting by the owner, Nigel. Show less

Author: LoveTravel275559
Title: Mr
Review: They made my day with all the songs and friendly entertainment. Simply that. Be there be happy and be with the host and new friends

Author: christopherL3544Jurong East, Singapore
Title: Excellent night out of fun - pool table / drinks / Karaoke
Review: It’s our first time to Bernie’s pub . Nigel was an excellent owner and bartender. They have pool table and English karaoke songs .Sing on stage , like a Star on stage ! The beers promo was very good price .Thumbs up for a night out of fun in Malacca.Show less

Author: Ezradventure
Title: Best Cocktails / mocktails in Melaka City!!!
Review: Fine cocktails / mocktails are hard to come by. They require precision in balancing between mixes, the use of optimal ingredients to ensure a flavourful finish, and generosity in quantity when required. At least for Melaka City, Nigel's mixes are hardly rivaled. Don't take my word for it. Do drop by and try for yourself. I am sure you will be impressed.P/S: They are pretty reasonably priced too!Show less

Author: WadeVagabondXiamen
Title: A friendly neighborhood bar in Melaka
Review: This is one of the best bars that I've been in over 19 years of travel. I'm not much for the tourist scene, so I try to seek out neighborhood bars that play good music, and this place is exactly what I look for. The crowd is mostly locals and the bartender Nigel gets everybody talking and getting to know each other. I had many fun nights that have lasted way too late just hanging out talking with people here. Definitely go here.Show less

Author: Voyage402766Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: You're never a stranger here
Review: This pub can make people who are "lost" feel "found" again! As soon as you enter Nigel, the owner, welcomes you like a friend who has known you a long time! If you plan on going to a pub just to grab a drink then you should be ready to get a lot more. Almost everyone who comes to the pub seems to know each other and probably meet up every night at Bernie's. And if it's your first time, by the end of the night you'll feel like you too belong to this group of people. People sing all the familiar songs on stage, there's a pool table, and the best thing about the place is that you'll talk to people in the pub and hear some amazing stories. I was in Melaka for 2 nights, and I ended up at Bernies' both the nights! If you're in Melaka don't give Bernie's a miss!Show less

Author: zaros37Singapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly Casual Atmosphere.
Review: A very nice open concept pub which gives you a the coolness of air conditioning but openness of the outdoor.Lovely host Nigel will always make you feel welcome. The regulars are friendly and there is a pool table to break the ice. Good familiar music which you can listen to or sing along.Overall a fantastic chill out place. Show less

Author: BengHockH
Title: "Must-go" pub when in Melaka for a drink or more
Review: Bernie's is a casual pub where you can meet friendly locals and the boss cum bartender cum singer (Nigel)is really someone who makes you feel comfortable to have a great night here. Drink prices are low whilst hospitality is sky-high.We have been to Melaka many times and discover this place only recently. Now it is our"must go to" place whenever we vist Melaka. It is located near to Eco Tree Hotel.From the main entrance just turn right and then left into the lane comprising a block of shophouses. Takes 3 mins walking. SamShow less

Author: birky_99
Title: Awesome "must visit" bar in Melaka
Review: Bar has re-located to No. 597, Ground Floor, Melaka Raya 10, Taman Melaka Raya, 75300 Melaka.The owner & operator of Bernie's will make you feel right at home the very minute you step into this Bar.I'm usually a lone traveller but I've never felt "alone" in this bar.The owner Nigel Rozz will introduce you to all the regular customers & instantly you will be able to feel at home.If you love to sing Karaoke, you will love this bar & it's concept.Nigel will search for your song on the internet & download it for you.Nigel himself is an awesome "singer & entertainer" & personally maintains the quality of the sound system there..He is also very particular about the cleanliness & promptness of service in his bar so you will definitely get excellent service here.The crowd is also very appreciative & responsive regardless whether you are a good singer or not.There is a 7 foot pool table in the bar if you like to shoot pool.Nigel is an excellent pool player & will give you a good game so no worries if you are a lone traveller like me.I ride my bike to Melaka every 02months & never fail to text Nigel in advance should i plan to visit Melaka.Nigel will even bother to reserve a parking lot right in front of the bar just so you will be comfortable not worrying about your ride..Please visit Bernie's if ever you visit Melaka; you will not be disappointed & will keep coming back for more...Show less

Author: richard t
Title: The Host with Most
Review: This is by far the best bar in Malacca! The owner (Nigel) is an absolute legend. In six months of travelling we literally haven't met anyone as hospitable and as friendly as Nigel. He is so generous too, he cooked us snacks and he gave us lots of free drinks over the three nights we were at his bar. (We loved his bar so much we went back every night after the first) The music he plays is great too, we had so much fun with Nigel singing on the Karaoke and playing pool together. We were also made to feel welcome by the locals too. Bernie's Pub is a little out of town (walking distance) but if you're in Malacca then this bar is a must! The world would be a much better place if we had lots more people like Nigel on it! Thanks for everything Nigel, we miss you!Richard Show less

Author: Nyakoojo
Title: A great bar and Nigel is simply the best!
Review:
A fantastic bar with great music and a really nice vibe. The owner Nigel is the most friendly man we have encountered on our six month trip and his hospitality is second to none. 
Forget Jonker Street, find Bernie's Pub. You will not be disappointed.

Author: lostagain2014St. Albans, United Kingdom
Title: The Friendliest Bar in Melaka!
Review: We found Bernie's by accident as it has moved from the location shown on here, it is now a block over. We were so lucky to find this place, Nigel the owner is most welcoming host! He showed such generosity and hospitality, we felt right at home. It's almost worth returning to Melaka just to visit this bar again! Thanks Nigel!Show less

Author: Veronica NGold Coast Australia
Title: Fabulously Friendly Bar
Review: What a wonderful experience this was, found it by accident and the owner is wonderfully friendly person. He introduced us to all the locals who made us feel very welcome and special. The owner insisted on making us some snacks as he said we looked like we hadn'nt had dinner!!Such a great place to relax and have cold drinks and have a chat. The owner's wife is also good company, and he insisted on driving us back to our Hotel. We enjoyed it so much we went back again the next evening. I would recommend this great little bar.Show less

Author: TorontoJoseToronto, Canada
Title: I wish I could give this place 6 stars! Friendliest bar owner I have ever met!
Review: I love this place! The drinks are the cheapest in town, especially when you take into account all the complimentary food and drinks.I came here every night during my three day stay because the owner makes everyone feel like family. On my first night there he literally fed me from his own dinner. He goes out of his way to introduce you to the regulars, so by the end of the first night I had friends all over town!At one point he asked me if I had musical requests, I made two suggestions but he didn't have them. By my next visit he'd downloaded the music videos for both.The owner is so friendly that he drove me to my hotel, and even went to the trouble of giving me a 30 minute tour of the city in his car. On another night he arranged to have me dropped off by a friend.If you check out my profile, you'll see that I've reviewed places in literally dozens of cities. I can without a doubt say that Nigel is the friendliest business owner I have ever met! Do yourself a favour and check out this pub! Show less

Author: Henry Groquetas de mar
Title: Great friendly bar
Review: Whilst in Melaka visited this bar on basis of previous reviews and was not disappointed . We went there in the evening for western style bar and drinks and music. Nigel the boss and staff were very welcoming and tasty free nibbles accompanied reasonable priced drinks . There was live music on with a local duo and I was able to guest appear and sing a couple of rockabilly songs ! A bit of a walk -20-25minutes from the main town but well worth it - in fact Nigel gave us a lift back to town late on .Show less

Author: amosa820
Title: Chill out place with good 80s and 90s music videos and great service
Review: If you are a lover of the old school music, look no further and this is definitely the place to chill with some cold drinks and awesome cocktails. Bernie the owner and wife is awesome and come say Hello.

Author: WhyamI
Title: Friendliest pub in Melaka
Review: I loved Bernie's bar. Owner, Bernie, is overwhelmingly friendly guy. I was also offered free local food several times by one of the regular customer Chan. Bernie also gave free bar snacks many times, ie delicious curry puffs. I also recommend to buy a 6 inch long sausage. And did I mention surprise drinks? Free of charge.  I really loved their bar music. Bernie is deejaying old western rock classics like Eagles, Scorpions, Polis, Bob Dylan and aerosmith. Music videos are also displayed on a big screen. It's nice to look at the old ones, you don't see them elsewhere anymore, and I hadn't never seen most of them. Bernies bar is at the "new district" close to the big shopping malls. That being said I didn't have any problems going there or leaving the bar. I visited the bar 3 times in a week. 2 times I walked there from dutch square, it takes about 25min to walk. 2 times leaving the bar Bernie gave me a ride where I wanted to go. Such a nice guy! One time I was there with my local french friend and he had a scooter.  Bar is also reasonably priced, and I saw only a couple of other tourists there three times I visited.Show less

Author: Jakarta_expat69Jakarta, Indonesia
Title: Friendly pub
Review: What makes this small pub so good is the friendliness of the staff that work there and the owner himself. As soon as you walk into the pub you are made to feel welcome and are introduced to other regular customers there. A definite place to visit in the evening if you are in melaka. Show less

Author: fakhermAlgiers, Algeria
Title: great place
Review: a great place to be if you pass by Melaka , the owner and the staff are just so nice...they even play the music you want listen to..they offered us welcome cocktails ..There is a billard ..in summary , if you want to spend some good time and meet people..just go there !Show less

Author: Dnyan_DSingapore, Singapore
Title: Amazing
Review: Amazing place. It's nothing that you won't find in any other bar in any other country, however, what made the bar worth it is the amazing staff. The owner is very friendly, and the place is run by him and his family. The pool table is there, so you can wile away time while having drinks. Must visit. Strike up a conversation with the owner, who's also the cook. Show less

Author: Chris GLondon
Title: Great little bar
Review: Locals bar that is more English/Irish pub vibe than trendy Malaysia bar and all the better for it. There is sometimes live music, but mostly just an excellent playlist that is not too loud to hold a conversation. There is also one of the best maintained pool tables I've ever played on at the back. Don't know a single person who doesn't like this venue.Show less

Author: 060501Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Cool place 80's 90's & County Western
Review: Never the less the best boss Nigel take cares with good music & food awesome Place and the staff like Ann and Jassy take care the Place is Clean have Pool Table And Try Mutton Carry with Roti super.. awesome one and only in Malacca Thanks to Nigel Owner...and Decent People There..Check it out Tqvm.Show less

Author: M0han717
Title: Cool place to hang out
Review: Just drove by and decided to stop over. Owner was very friendly and the place is very clean.Good food.And its so easy to get there from my hotel.

Author: nataliaandarnaudParis, France
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Very great place, we went there by accident and we didn't regret it at all. The owner Nigel is so Nice and you definetly count on him if you need some help. The price of cocktails are very correct and if you are hungry there s some food to eat.To finish, the atmosphère with t the different kind of music is relaxing, appreciate also the bob marley's songs at the end.We ll come back for sure;) Show less

Author: eskayhengMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A PLACE TO BE....
Review: A place where people gather for good music, great ambience. A warm, friendly , comforting place to be.Open concept , creating good ventilation and if you are one who dislike sitting still the whole evening, there's pool table and dart board to keep you in a jolly mood.Finger food like, sausages , nuggets and fries available during Happy hours and throughout the niteAlso available, Jessie's specialty like chicken wings, Muar Otak and mini pohpiah.A pub you should patronise if you what you are looking for is great music, great ambience , awesome company.... YOU WILL NEVER REGRET .... JUST BE THERE !!!Show less

Author: daniela hmelaka
Title: relaxing place and very nice people
Review: We got into this bar by accident and we really liked it there. They play good music and the atmosphere is very relaxing. You have a large choice of drinks and the service is very good!As we couldn't find a taxi, the owner of the bar drove us home free of charge - Thank you again a lot for that!Show less

Author: Amytraveltheworld20
Title: Price of the food
Review: The price is not value for the food. Too expensive especially the satay (6stick @RM65). The Kombucha is not really taste good.A bowl of cendol cost us RM11.00.

Author: OliviaC1728
Title: What an unexpected surprise . . . found!
Review: Delicious food with friendly services. Ideal for a meal/drink to chill and relax with great choice of oldies songs! The ambience was great and made possible with much efforts and thoughtfulness: paintings/murals on the walls by various creative artists, vast collection of vinyl records and more! Both Jason and Samantha, the managers of the cafe are exceptionally kind. Do check out their upper room with thoughtful vintage touch and an ambience that you will never want to miss out, it's truly fascinating I must say!Special shoutout to Philip too!This place is one of its kind that surprised with much unexpected finds!Show less

Author: krishyce
Title: Great Place to Hang Out
Review: Its always great to come back with these lovely and lively people. Owners are super friendly. Live bands every saturday from 8pm onwards. They also play the old songs using the Vinyl. Forget the hustle and bustle from the city.

Author: Caamoche
Title: Visit in the coffee vintage
Review: One of the manager Mic Jason, that I had the chance to meet is a very kind person. The place is very nice and the decoration is lovely.

Author: Marting197110Vienna, Austria
Title: Won‘t miss
Review: Spent 2 evenings there. The music was extraordinary, we also had a live guitar session, the meal was incredible and the staff amazing lovely.Don‘t miss to spend at least one evening there - you won‘t regret!!!!Best greetings from Austria - what a surprise that you played Falco for us!!!!Show less

Author: JoandG1
Title: Worse wine we've ever had
Review: We popped in here on way back to hotel for a glass on white wine.It was undrinkable, the worst wine we have ever had. To top it all we were charged 74RM. The lady on the table next to us also had a glass and we notice the look of discussed on her face when she took the first sip.I have no idea what any of the other drink or food is like, but do not touch the white wine Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Quaint Cafe
Review: Renovated from traditional Melaka shoplot into a quaint and cosy cafe. Nice collection of posters of the great singers of sixties and seventies. Great live music and songs with good food and nice chilled beers. One of our favourite gangouts whenever we come back to Melaka. Cheers.Show less

Author: pupena
Title: Best place to be
Review: Super positive place to visit! People there are very proactive and friendly. I liked the food there. I will remember my visit there forever. They had drums there and I had opportunity to play those.

Author: sibu2009
Title: Great vibe cafe
Review: A great little cafe with a warm, relaxed atmosphere. I visited here with my husband and 9 year old son; we were immediately welcomed, service was very good. We were particularly drawn to the live music and we were not disappointed. Great range of music in all 3 sets from Radiohead to Queen to John Denver and much in between. The atmosphere was fantastic with everyone singing along. People were invited to go up and sing if they wanted to but no pressure. So glad that the friendly atmosphere meant it was appropriate for my son who had such a great time he insisted we went back the following night. We did and it was even better. fully recommend as a place for anyone who enjoys live music in a relaxed environment.Show less

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Cool Place
Review: Nice place, good ambience friendly staffs...good musics and songs bringing you back to the seventies. Nice and tasty local food. Located in the vibrant street of Johnker Walk. We have a good drink with good entertaintment. Cheers.

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Avoid the cendol
Review: I walked in to try the cendol without checking the reviews and I wished that I had. It was over priced at RM15.90 and it wasn't good. The cendol was full of sago that was clumped together, and clearly lacking in red beans. When we checked with the staff, he replied that this is the way that their cendol is done. I should have spent my calories somewhere else. Show less

Author: mervdunia
Title: always a welcoming feel to this place
Review: I was surprised to see a few less-than-flattering comments posted here. I was first here about a year and a half ago...It was great then and remains so now. Drop in and meet the friendly brother and sister duo who run the place.

Title: Friendly service
Review: We enjoyed the food and the service. Very friendly and great service. Our food came quickly. We enjoyed the Saturday evening in the oriental cottage so lots of people in the street and a nice atmosphere on the Jonker walk

Author: stapa1
Title: Evening
Review: Nice place , nice People,  nice music.good food , cold beer . Live Music from 8 pm. Girls are singing dell.

Author: alcoholicbananadrink
Title: Daylight Robbery!
Review: This place will charge you four times more than normal, and smile as they take your money.I can get a good Cendol outside for 4 Ringgit, one bowl of Cendol was 15.90!!! Coupled with the fact we did not ask for Sago but they added it to bump up the price. Had huge lumps of unappetising Sago floating in it, with very few beans or actual cendol inside it. Way, way overpriced and clearly capitalising on Malacca's Cendol reputation.Ordered 2 bowls of Laksa with chicken strips inside. Heaven help me, the stock was more bland than water. Asked for Chili paste to add more flavour, the owner refused saying that it already has been added in. The longer I ate the more I was thinking how drain water would be more appealing. Noodles also were undercooked and hard. Contrast this to another Laksa stall just down the road, where they are generous with their fish meat, prawns and add-ons. FOR A CHEAPER PRICE. In summary, this establishment is a tourist trap. Does not, repeat, does not reflect the true essence of Malacca Cuisine. Stay away from this place where the owners are wolves predating on tourists who don't know better.Show less

Author: mr_niceguy91
Title: Lovely Place with lovely people
Review:
A very nice place with charming staff that welcomed us very hearty. The food (laksa and appetizers) was tasty and the fruit juices (passionfruit) were excellent and very refreshing.
We would definitely come back and can highly recommend this place for a visit.

Author: Wei FSingapore, Singapore
Title: WORST EXPERIENCE I HAD DURING THE WHOLE 10 DAY TRIP IN MALAYSIA, FOR GOD'S SAKE DO NOT VISIT THIS FISHY PLACE!
Review: we went to jonker street on Weds without knowing the night market only opens fri-sun. we planned to eat the street food for dinner but couldn't. so we had to find a place nearby to eat. unfortunately there weren't many open so we walked in this cafe.it seems nice enviornment, there was music, the decorations is very cultural so we had expected a good meal. our experience is very very similar to other reviewers with bad experience:1. we had to wait for more than 40mins for our food, but only one main was served, when my parents were almost finish eating their food, other food was served only. 2. i ordered 2 nyonya noodles and 1 mee goreng, when my parent's noodle came they told me it is nyonya, it is dry fried, but when the other 2 noodles were served they are the same gravy noodles which i wasn't expecting. i told them one of these noodles must be wrong becoz one of these should have been the same as the 1st nyonya noodle. the lady boss was very unsincere and dishonest, looked educated, polite but quite cunning. she told me the 2 gravy noodles are nyonya and the 1st dry noodle is mee goreng. she wouldn't admit the simple mistakes they made but just lied to get away. i told her your staff told us the first noodle is nyonya. how could it suddenly became mee goreng?
