she said she will ask the kitchen (come on, do you not even know food in your own cafe?!!!) while she was away i asked another staff which noodle is mee goreng, he obviouly knew we were having argument (it is not very big place and we were sitting near counter), he wouldn't tell us, putting on a confused look. the lady boss then returned and insisted the wet noodles are nyonya. okay, fine! i decided to take it anyway, don't want to argue more. 3. then something else came up. we ordered 2 veggie 1 chicken noodles, and there was no chicken in all 3 noodles! 1 veggie nyonya, 1 chicken nyonya, and 1 veggie mee goreng. i realised it becoz the 2 new noodles served didn't have any chicken in it, so i asked my parents if theirs have any, they said no but they were finishing it up already. when i asked the lady boss, same thing happened, without even ask details, she just put on an annoyed look as if we were difficult customers, then she denied directly. i have kids with me so i don't want to make a scene (which i would have without the kids BECAUSE THIS IS JUST RIDICULOUS!) i told her i dont mind paying for the chicken price BUT THERE IS NO CHICKEN IN YOUR NOODLE!now that i came back, i realised my strong evidence is among the 2 nyonya noodles i ordered, one is chicken, so now she is saying the 2 wet noodles are nyonya, then why is there no chicken in both of them?! you don't even have to ask if the 1st noodle has chicken or not!well i have to say it is no big deal if it really has chicken or not, even if it does it will be a few pieces, it is HER ATTITUDE that makes you feel very bad... the lady boss's behavior is exactly the same as some of the other reviewer has experienced.4. FINALLY DON"T ORDER DRINKS! we ordered apple juice and orange juice, it is 12RM per glass so it is about singapore price. when i asked if it is freshly squeezed the staff proudly and arrogantly told me YES all our juices are freshly squeezed. yes it is freshly squeezed, JUST MIXED WITH TONS OF WATER so the juices tasted like plain water filled in a cup which wasn't washed after someone drank the juice in it. it has TONS OF SUGAR at the bottom too.Show less

Author: LupaSmarandaTargu Mures, Romania
Title: Happy shock!
Review: I will try to be short! Great hospitality, I was shocked that I felt like home, even tho i was 9000 km away from it.It is a family business, and it shows, the food is amaizing, the booze has a great price and the vibe, well you feel like a part of the family. Thank you so much for the experience, I wish you all the best!If there is one place I recommend in Malaysia, that is Oriental Cottage Cafe!Show less

Author: sunnyg863Muscat, Oman
Title: Good food .. good host
Review: We are vegetarian ...and always looking for good veg joints .. the restaurant is family owned.. very friendly owners. ...best part is they are happy to customise to Ur preference and explain the ingredients .. which makes me very comfortable as vegetarian to know what goes in my dish. .. Show less

Author: James ROviedo, Spain
Title: Well worth every Ringgit!
Review: Was walking down Jonker St (very busy) and heard the band playing in a cafe - I stopped to listen and saw the place was full of happy looking people. The notice outside was offering cocktails and I thought - why not and fancied a Mojito. Saw a couple eating a great looking burger and ordered one from the very nice young lady who turned out to be the owner. Fabulous evening and a lovely place to eat and drink - I have seen the reviews from people complaining about the cost but I think they just wanted cheap eats and didn't consider the overall value for money!!My only regret was having to go home but next time I am in Malacca I will certainly go back again to Sam's Oriental Cottage Café Show less

Author: F8167KNsimonwWargrave, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulously fun night!
Review: What can I say, I had a really fun night here. On a hot evening in Melaka, I went in for one beer and stayed for food and a few more beers! A wonderfully warm atmosphere. Live music plus a great crowd singing and dancing along. It was a fun night, chatting with other guests and the owner, who was really friendly and made me feel very welcome. To some of the critical reviews on here, no it is probably not the cheapest bar in Melaka but hey, if that is your main driver maybe go somewhere else? Everything was clearly priced, I knew what I was in for so no complaints from me. Show less

Author: Chrisocaines
Title: Most enjoyable bar in Malaysia
Review: The title says it all. Super friendly owner and amazing vibe. Great home cooking that you’ll pay more for than other places, but between the hospitality and live music I think it’s more than justified.

Author: hanahoppers
Title: ORIENTAL CAFE ONE OF THE BEST HOT SPOT IN MALACCA TOWN
Review: The place where people around the world come and feel the retro and happening place to chill and party.The owner is friendlt and always treat people to feel the place like a home. Always help the tourist to find an interesting place in Malacca .

Author: capsicum0620Thailand
Title: A rip-off
Review: Don't pay attention to the owners' blabla. This place is a scam. My friend asked for a second Passion fruit Margarita, thinking the watered-down first one had been a mistake of some kind. I went for a Blue berry mojito. It turned out the BB mojito was a blend of water, ice, crushed frozen bb and ''souvenir" of rum. As for the 2nd PF margarita, it was charged us double ("you asked for a stronger drink" was the she-owner's justification.") Had I not threatened to raise a fuss, the final bill would have been 150RM.. ARE YOU KIDDING ME??). The owners are perfectly aware of it, exchanging glances with one another when I complained about the watery cocktails we had been served.If continuying to consider their customers as a bunch a stupid fools, this place is doomed.For the better.Show less

Author: F5222HKdavidc
Title: Great dinner and drinks
Review: Fantastic vegetarian laksa with cocktails. Really healthy food choices which can be balanced out with some good cocktails and beers. The staff were really friendly and welcoming.

Author: JaneB4209
Title: All that glitters is not gold
Review: Pleasant surroundings but food massively over priced. Owner super chatty, a bit much at times... Verging on pushy. Not my fave place to eat in Melaka. Never had toast in any Malay good till this experience, thumbs down from me.

Author: Scott BSydney, Australia
Title: Awesome!
Review: We were looking to get away from the heat and there is a group of licensed premises near here that all have live music. We had walked past earlier and the live band was playing an exceptional cover of a fairly obscure Deep Purple song Soldier of Fortune. I filed this and when it was drink o’clock we chose this venue and it did not disappoint. We came for one round and ending stayin until closing time. The food and drinks were great but it is the friendliness and the service that sets this place apart. If you choose to visit I can assure you wont be disappointed.Show less

Author: ElouenLGRennes, France
Title: Awesome place with awesome people
Review: Prices might look expensive compared to some other places in the city, but it's totally worth it : the cafe is adorable, you can come here to work, chill, or eat. Mojitos are very good ! There are often bands to cheer up the harmony, it's the perfect area to chill during a quiet evening.Jason and Samantha have done their absolute best to help me organize the best birthday night for my girlfriend, and I'll never be able to thank them enough, so please go there and do it on my behalf !Show less

Author: Anne SOxford, United Kingdom
Title: Superb food and friendly personal service
Review: We were one vegetarian and one vegan and as a vegan I hadn't been finding it too easy to get anything other than noodles and veg. The staff here took a personal interest and introduced us to tempeh which we enjoyed in a great meal. Great atmosphere too, with good live music and a happy clientele. Thoroughly recommend.Show less

Author: M934MYm
Title: Great atmosphere
Review: Was in Malacca as a tourist and found this wonderful cafe/restaurant. Had live music in the evening - pretty good! Food was great. Don’t remember the name, but try the starters, and there is a type of salmon-vegetable soup, which is yummy. Prices are very reasonable and the owners are great hosts!Show less

Author: leons2017
Title: Ok but overpriced food
Review: Very talkative owner, found it a bit too offensive. The food tastes good but is nothing special and for the portion size definitely overpriced. Comfortable seating areas though.

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Cool Place
Review: Nice place, good ambience friendly staffs...goog musics and songs bringing you back to the seventies. Nice and tasty local food. Located in the vibrant street of Johnker Walk. We have a good dinner with good entertaintment. Cheers.

Author: arianna0405
Title: Samantah we love you
Review:
We stayed there for new year's eve party 2018 and it was very beautiful.
Samantha and his brother took care of us and there was live music and very good vibrations.
Thank you!!! I will never forget that night in Melaka!

Author: Raymond W
Title: Beware of being scammed by friendly owners
Review: Be warned: this establishment has a sneaky way of cheating the unsuspecting traveller (see following). Can't stand being scammed.请各位注意这家饭店会骗您。(看我以下的英文解释)I ordered a Long Island Iced Tea (listed on their specials board as 15.90, along with other alcoholic cocktails). They checked with me that I knew it was an alcoholic drink which I found odd. It was a fairly watered down Long Island but given price couldn't complain. Then on paying I discovered they were charging me 38.50 under "other". They explained that the Long Island Iced Tea on the specials board wasn't an alcoholic drink (despite being listed with other alcoholic cocktails!) They hastily scribbled Long Island next to "other" under the receipt. There was no other record on any of their menus how much a Long Island Iced Tea "alcoholic" was meant to be.The Nyonya Laksa was ok (but very salty - not sure if how it's meant to be) and the Vibe of the place was ok. But be warned - sneaky traders like this may very well be skimming on things in other placesShow less

Author: Lilyonocean
Title: Great place to spend your night
Review: We came for hearing great music when we passed by the place then it turned out a right decision. Great music, friendly owner and staff. We spent our 3 nights there. Will definitely caome back if we visit Mallaca again.

Author: rosalyndej
Title: Fantastic Evening, Highly Recommended!
Review: We stopped here for our evening meal and stayed on for the live music, fantastic atmosphere and great food too.  Hostess was very entertaining and really made the place hum.  We loved it.

Author: hnnitravels
Title: lively
Review: relaxing bar with live band and friendly staff. however, price is expensive compare to riverside bar which have nearly the same ambience. would visit again though. plus, it looks completely different at day and night, didn't even recognize that it's the same cafe. overall, I had a nice time.Show less

Author: WSF2014
Title: Lively bar but slightly pricey food and drinks
Review: Ate here because the cafe we wanted was closed. Overall a good experience in terms of the atmosphere (singing was good, with song requests fulfilled!), but the food is rather pricey at 7RM for a coca cola.

Author: 960ludwNancy, France
Title: Horrible atmosphere and expensive beer!- don’t visit this place
Review: We entered the place, when the rain on Jonkerstreet begans to fall. The barlady cornered us on a table and persuade us to take a beer. We did. She came again and asked if we want to have food or wanted to join the guys on the other table for free beer! We are not for sale! We felt uncomfortable and wanted to leave the place. We asked for the bill and had to pay 38RM for 2 tiger-beer! That’s way to much! We paid and left! I recommend no to visit this place! Horrible atmosphere and expensive beer!Show less

Author: Michelle LSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Ripped off. Locals pls avoid this place
Review: Since it was late, we stumbled upon this cafe as it was still open . The lady recommended us her daily specials which was not in the menu. One laksa , one chicken burger (and only the burger itself with no sidelines ) and a nyonya teh ice caused us RM75. Please be transparent with your prices!! I didn’t get a receipt too!! Truly disappointed!! Show less

Author: rzinger
Title: Cool place with a great staff
Review: Can’t speak to the food. Beer was cold, music was entertaining, and the owners were super nice. Don’t forget to check out the vintage vinyl collection!

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: What a con! Taking tourists for a ride in Jonker Street. Avoid!
Review: Was enticed into this establishment as we were hot and looking for a cold beer. At first, the spin from the hostess was that you’d get a bucket for RM150! Wow! Clarifying that the beer was German didn’t lessen the blow; perhaps it was flown in 1st class on Lufthansa. Eventually we settled for a bucket of “large” Carlsbergs at RM75, but 5 330ml bottles arrived, which were warm! 330ml Carlsberg bottles are not BESAR or LARGE. They even had the gall to add service tax to the bill! Total RM16.50 for a small beer. That’s a total rip off in this part of the world, tourist or no tourist area. Shameful!Added to this insult we were “entertained” by a guy who was so out of tune one can only put this down to a very bad experience.I have included a picture of the menu. Outrageous prices for such a place. Don’t forget, you’ll have to add tourist (service) tax, too! If you want to be ripped off in Melaka, then this is the place for you!Show less

Author: GiuliaL1102
Title: Dynamic and brilliant!
Review: We stopped in this restaurant and we met, with pleasure, a very kind, nice and smiling staff! Many options for vegetarian and also a very good place with photos and a "music room" The staff did the best for allow us to feel good in every detail. Also the food was good (spicy ), original and the cook was very gentle to show us the all vegetarian options! Thanks! Giulia & Alberto (Nowhen )Show less

Author: Flyer815634
Title: Searching for a relaxing place
Review: It has been a while since i found a place to chill as great as here in Oriental Cottage Cafe.If you ever want to get to a place where you can sing your heart out and just chill with a beer, here it is. Plus! It is Halal... Bringing my family here the next time i visit (i have a mixed race and religion family, if you know what i mean) Highly recommended!!!Show less

Author: patcoopNijmegen, The Netherlands
Title: Great People, Food and Music
Review: Sam and Jason, the "owners" and sister and brother are really good at what they are doing. They make you feel at home, serve good food and drinks and there is Music!Good Music, Live Music, where you can even sing yourself.Jason has a great Vinyl and Music collection, he would like to show you.I would go again when I'm back in Melaka!Thank Guys, all the best with this great peaceful place on earth!Show less

Author: Pangloss51Manassas, Virginia
Title: The “ hidden gem at 96 Jonker st
Review: As a global traveler, there is always a desire to find a “ place “ to feel welcomed, “ genuinely “ to enjoy the “place” “food” “music” and “staff” serving. Often being serious absorbing new places, the Owners Sam and Jason emphasized their goal is to share a happy place with great food, music and their genuinely happy attitude service.. Learning Sam loves preparing food and seeing her customers feel happy enjoying it and Jason loves music and The oriental Cottage Cafe is the platfom for sharing his wealth of music knowledge; and connections to Malacca musicians jamming in the live bands playing there Sat, Mon and Tues night..with a local singer “ Ringo” dropping in and singing a few songs with a great resonating passionate voice. A bonus, Sam will recruit customers to get up and dance to the bands music, with Sam and Jasons Dad and sister sharing their smooth playful moves..Occassionally, their mom will be there helping with the cafe tasks... Reminding anyone fortunate to eat drink and be merry... the food is fresh and prepared when ordered... so... there will be a wait... if you want fast pre cooked processed food go elsewhere..with patience. You will be in a warm welcoming place ... with great owners, an array of music , great heartfelt cooked food.. and if you are open... a cloud of genuine happiness surrounding you!!During my week stay I visited daily... and let Sam get me out to Dance with the band music.. with bites in between of her newly created “ cheese burger “ ... being from the US ... away for extended times .. it was an enjoyable tasty treat and well crafted!! I look forward to my return to Malacca to embrace the Happiness of Oriental Cottage Cafe insulated from the crazy busy Jonker Street!!Show less

Author: Compass781430Bourg-en-Bresse, France
Title: An amazing and friendly place
Review: This cafe is very nice! It's not only a cafe but it's a place where you can find new friends and very good vibes. Owners are very friendly and peaceable, one of them be my guid (and my friend now) and showed me around the city.The oriental cafe is a very beautiful place where you can eat, drink, listen good music (not too loud so it's perfect to speak). There is a music store inside and a place to have music show, owners are passionated aboit music so don't hesitate over talking with them about it. The decoration is beautiful (with drawings and a lot of wise sentences everywhere).And it's in the middle of Melaka, so, what wish else ?I very recommend!:)Show less

Author: Maximilian B
Title: Best Café in South East Asia
Review: What an amazing local joint. We stopped in for a few drinks and ended up dancing with the incredible band (that could play any requests) and the welcoming and energetic staff! Samantha was the best Server (and dancer) we have found in all our travels yet. We will definitely be backShow less

Author: davidjameson4
Title: Grey food and atmosphere
Review:
We called while we were vistinging Jonker street. The staff were really welcoming the food was great and the music made the evening a really good night out.
Thank you to all at the bar.

Author: jonckher
Title: Great vibes, great food
Review: I have been coming to Melaka off and on over the last 20 years and watched it change into a great tourist destination. This cafe and its super friendly staff shows how service with a smile can make such a difference.

Author: James ROviedo, Spain
Title: This place is utterly amazing
Review: I arrived in Melaca and spent a short time reading reviews on places that I might enjoy. Ignoring the one or two obviously false bad reviews and taking notice of the very enthusiastic majority reviews, I decided to take a look.I was greeted with a huge smile from the lovely young lady called Sam who welcomed me to her music café.The decor inside is eclectic and just oozes charm and character. The cooling fans and comfy seating made the place a great place to stay for a while and get out of the busyness of Jonker Street.I was unsure what I wanted to eat and Sam suggested I try one of the special house dishes - Ayam Rendang Chicken Curry Nyonya and whilst waiting for that to be prepared, a dish of Top Hat Pai Tee.Service was very swift and with a fantastic selection of beers (I chose craft beers) served by a guy called Jason (a music fanatic) I was very impressed. The food was excellent and I enjoyed every bite - I think the portions are very generous and nicely presented.The live music adds to the atmosphere and I believe I stayed some while!So, one thing is for sure - a fabulous night out with great atmosphere and excellent value for money - I loved everything so much I am certainly returning as often as I can. Show less

Author: FadzEem
Title: Hungry peeps given awful foods & drinks
Review: We are happy to be in Melaka until a disaster during dinner at Jonker Street... At Oriental Cottage, 96, Jalan Hang Hebat... we had to wait for foods we ordered in this Historical City of Melaka for really long. We don't mind to wait but after the waiter reconfirmed our orders... they forgot two dishes and when we asked, we were told those two orders not in the bill!!! All drinks served after foods... drinks name on menu are basically misleading.. we are locals and we know well what we are expecting.. perhaps not the best but at least some taste.. we were basically given dishes supposed to be simple in preparing but not only it was with horrible taste and ingredients... it was just oh my, you kidding me????..the drinks... Omg.. where they learnt how to prepare ice tea from? Longkang????.. 3 fried dishes; 3 typical local drinks.. 1 cocktail; 2 tasteless and bad curry Laksa came to RM 192.72!!! I looked around and many did not finish what they ordered!Guys... AVOID THIS PLACE.. PLEASE!!!!Show less

Author: 290hyweleFujiyoshida, Japan
Title: The best place for a first experience of durian — in the world!
Review: Astonishing building filled with love and good times. Samantha and Jason are a joy. Incredible passion about food and music.The place is nicely decorated and has a lovely ambience. It's got nice comfortable chairs, too. The building itself is huge. Just the walk from the entrance to the toilet is an eye opener. Check out the record collection on the way. Samantha lays on a lovely selection of local dishes. I would recommend the noodles in coconut sauce. However, the durian shaved rice experience is absolutely not to be missed. Any tourist walking up Jonker Walk who doesn’t pop in is crazy! Enjoy ...From the Fudge ManShow less

Author: aliaslisa66Sydney, Australia
Title: Excellent little spot worth seeking out!
Review: Happened to walk past this place when going down Jonker Street. It had a great atmosphere and the staff were super fun, friendly and helpful. The food was great with lots of vege and vegan options including an amazing vegan laksa! We came back the next night for the live music and had so much fun! Everyone has such a great vibe! Definitely check it out!Show less

Author: MrL1pLeeds, United Kingdom
Title: Malaysia's best kept secret
Review: These guys are just the best. Amazing food, amazing music and most of all, amazing people. I have never met people with such passion for food and making sure you felt at home. You must try this place, Sam will make you so happy, you won't want to leave.Show less

Author: luciem872
Title: Nice surprise
Review: As we walked down the street we saw this lovely little café and the owner was right away very nice and cheerful !She explained us the food she cooks and seemed really passionate about it :)We ordered a chicken laksa and the pineapple fried rice : delicious !Great staff, they wanted to show us the famous cendol and the durian candy so we did.Great atmosphere, thanks !Show less

Author: 45maximel
Title: A wonderfull place in melaka!
Review: Come and enjoy the lovely welcoming of Samantha and Jason, sister and brother!Enjoy the vegan drink, the food, the music and the dance after the sunset!A lovely place who made me change my plan to stay my last days in Melaka instead KL ;)The you next time!Show less

Author: Steven L
Title: This bar is rocking!
Review: Nicest place in Malacca! Outstanding food and cosy place to enjoy the good things in life. Sam and Jason must be the warmest people from Malaysia, i thank you for the great evening,breakfast and friendship! Grtz Steven

Author: BelleDPPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: An indulging space.
Review: This is one of a great places in melaka. In the day time you might visiting various tourist sites in melaka, yet in the evening this is a great place to relax and indulge your soul and release the stress with the live band and various foods and drinks. People are friendly and lovely. Jason has a great taste of oldies music, go check his gallery. I'll see you all again.Show less

Author: Karmaexplorer
Title: Vegan Friendly Cafe
Review: The restaurant is run by a sister and a brother. They are very friendly. The Cafe also serves vegan drinks and foods. Check it out if you are at Jonker Street.

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: A fun place
Review: Wanna meet two people who truly love what they do? Go to this place and Samantha & Jason will take great care of you. It's long, narrow & cozy and can get a little too busy on weekends...but the food, beverage, music and friendly atmoshpere are outstandingShow less

Author: emmahJ2522GKMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Why’s a super day in cottage Jonker cafe
Review: We had a fantastic day in cafe. Good home style and very comfortable. Feeling relax and good. Serve nice aromatic nyonya salmon dishes in samba spices. We had a good brunch, BEST asam pedas !!! We liked it all. Price however considered higher, but its real good materials can see. Show less

Author: Worth W
Title: Friendliest pub/cafe on Jonker's Street!
Review: I visit Melaka on business four or five times a year, and this is my go to place for fun, friendship and food! Samantha is a serious, outstanding and creative cook and her lively spirit permeates every aspect of the establishment. Easily the best deal and most fun on Jonker's Street!!Show less

Author: maud n
Title: Loveliest people
Review: My friends and me just happened to go to this place and we loved it! The owners are the loveliest people! We've spent two great evenings here and wouldn't wanted to miss this!

Author: 189vincek
Title: The worse and most regretful decision for breakfast.
Review: My worst experience in jonker street.Price is an extreme rip-off. Selling an omelette with 2 peice of bread at RM12 and a Chicken sandwich at RM16 (and it's literally just the bread with no sides). Thier aloe vera drinks is literally water and ice and some aloe vera. It's selling at RM17 but the menu price is actually only showing RM13. Still deserve 1 star as they didn't poison us. Sorry. Please improve your menu choice and price. It's really a horrible experience.Show less

Author: TravelSabbatical2017Los Angeles, California
Title: Best night in Melaka!
Review: Oriental Cottage Cafe is such a gem! I was lured in by the live music and cool vibe but what ultimately wowed me was the service and food. As soon as I sat down, I was greeted by one of the owners, Samantha, who was cheerful and excited to explain the Nonya style cooking options to me. She is also the chef and the food is delicious!Samantha and her brother Jason have built an amazing new business that will make you feel like you are part of the family. Dancing and smiling all night long - this is the kind of place you always hope to find when on a trip so you can go again and again. Do yourself a favor and check it out! -Thanks from Sam!Show less

Author: Marika_Jose2015Kyiv (Kiev), Ukraine
Title: Fantastic atmosphere and lovely hospitality! The best cafe in Melaka!
Review: We just walked into this cafe from Jonker street on our first night in Melaka, (we did not know about this cafe before), and were absolutely amazed with the atmosphere here, it feels like lovely lounge style cafe with huge collection of music records, photos, etc. We really enjoyed the food, drinks, had lovely chats with owners and even had a dance! Beautiful music playing there too. Highly recommend!!!Show less

Author: enncle
Title: Happiness in a cafe
Review: My partner and I stumbled upon this place while on a road trip around Malaysia. Calling back at Melaka. Staff friendly welcoming. Great music, service and lots of fun. Have recommended to friends and family when visiting Melaka.

Author: cameronh811
Title: Great vibe
Review: On Jonker Street, but not so hectic and quite easy going. Good food, great service from a family run business, nice ambiance with live music.

Author: ShahriarI16
Title: Amazingly awesome
Review: It was an amazing night where we sang, ate and enjoy ourselves a ton! The owners were really hospitable and pleasant as well.

Author: 226stijnw
Title: Awesome place
Review: Lovely staff, looks really good and the food taste awesome!! Would recommend this place when you walk jonker street in Melaka

Author: Amy G
Title: Happiest place in Melaka!
Review: This is such a lovely cafe! The family that run it are so nice and accomodating and go out of their way to make you feel so at home. The food is amazing, great Asian and western food and suitable for veggies! They place great music as well and that atmosphere is so cosy! Definitely recommend to anyone who is visiting Melaka! Show less

Author: creaboulait13
Title: Good place for dinner
Review:
Save yourselves the hassle of getting harassed once you exit your vehicle, and tell them you want to eat at Stall No 10.

You can't go wrong with the Chef's Recommendation - Portuguese Baked Fish, Black Pepper Brinjal and Garlic Butter Scallops.

Author: rraihanrKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!
Review: Stall No 10 is the place to go if you are looking for amazing seafood in Melaka. The big surprise is the black pepper brinjal, I have never tasted brinjals cooked this way before and it was truly a feast! It's a must try for sure. Crab was fresh and cooked to perfection. Baked fish was also excellent although a little too spicy but it was still fantastic and i would definitely order it again if i ever visit this stall again. Show less

Author: devadoss57Port Klang, Malaysia
Title: J&J Corner Portuguese seafood
Review: This shop is located in Ujang Pasir which is the Portuguese settlement. I went with my family for dinner. This shop is number 10 stall which sells authentic Portuguese food. You can either sit inside the shop or outside and watch the sea if it is not raining. The restaurant is quite clean and the waiters were very friendly.The food is very spicy. If you dont like spicy you must inform the waiter maybe the cook can reduce the chilly. The fish was fresh. Price wise it is very reasonable.Show less

Author: 5579davinsafe
Title: a sumptuous way to end our day at Melaka
Review: i recommend their otak-otak and signature Portuguese ikan bakar. nice and friendly people. their restaurant has a nice view of the river. apart from that, they are able to cater for allergic requirements as well.

Author: thomluv2trvl
Title: Great food as usual
Review: Dine at my favourite stall number 10 in Portugese Settlement  serving seafood. The crab was meaty and delicious. Try the milk butter crab is so tummy. Will be back again soon.

Author: jiewen22Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: That’s overrated
Review: Visited this yesterday after review all the commentGo thereOrder Portuguese grill fishes, ginger clam, sambal ladies finger and butter garlic prawnSeafood not fresh.. the stingy fish so horrible- the meat so hard!!!!Superb disappointed Show less

Author: k0hk3Singapore, Singapore
Title: Simply yummy
Review: Having seafood by the sea is always a lure. J&J is located at the row of seafood restaurants in this Portuguese square. Though I have been to Melaka many times, this is the first time I visited this square at Ujong Pasir. We took a GRAB here from Dataran Pahlawan. About 12 minutes ride.Having read the good reviews, I decide to choose J&J. Right choice. We were there early about 5.30pm. Another right decision. We waited quite long for the food to arrive.Crab was on my list. Crab order requires at a minimum of two. 1kg at RM85 (seasonal price). We had the black pepper crabs (RM93.50). It was slightly charred and had the smoky flavour. It was not oily nor too peppery. The crab flesh was firm and sweet. Enjoy this dish very much.The Portuguese baked fish (RM45 – based on weight) was awesome. The red snapper was fresh and nicely baked. What stood out was the sambal sauce. Not too spicy but with the right portion of tangy sweetness. It was packed with flavours. Talking to the owner, she told me this is their home secret recipe sauce passing down from her grandparents. I also had the opportunity to meet the chef and gave a thumb-up sign.The butter garlic prawns (RM30) were infused with the aromatic and golden brown garlic. It was fresh but prawn is not big.Sambal kangkong (RM10) was acceptable. It was quite ordinary.Show less

Author: cynfulaquarius
Title: Good & reasonable price!
Review: Went during a Saturday night about 8+, not crowded. Staff was friendly to recommend us their portuguese grill fish, portuguese style chicken, kang kong & portuguese style prawn. We loved all these dishes especially the fish & prawns! Price are reasonable too. Will visit again.

Author: Travel_forYes
Title: Sunset Seafood
Review: Let’s give a chance to try out their Portuguese dinner! The mango juice served at the side stall was very nice and refresh ! Sunset view at here was nice too :) friendly staffs !

Author: yan1007
Title: Be Prepared to Wait
Review: As mentioned in most of the previous reviews, food was tasty and price was reasonable. However, one must be prepared to wait. We waited an hour for 3 dishes to appear from the kitchen. Won't recommend it if you are already starving.

Author: Adrien_SHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious, freshly prepared seafood at a very reasonable price!
Review: We contemplated about going to Portuguese settlement for dinner after hearing about it being marketed as a tourist spot in the past years and therefore food may not be authentic and may also be overpriced. However, due to the close proximity of our hotel to the location, we decided to give it a go. We had the perfect experience at J&J (stall no.10) and please read on to discover more on our thoughts!Earlier in the day, I did my research beforehand and upon reading good reviews, decided on stall no. 10 which is this J&J Corner (which I'm glad I did) because upon parking your car, you will be swamped by representatives shouting their stall names at you and asking you which stall number have you decided on. There was only a few who were most polite and friendly and were not shouting like the rest. When I said I am looking for stall no. 10, it turns out that one of the polite ones was the representative for stall no. 10 who then kindly led me to his stall.Upon seated, we ordered the mango juice which arrived promptly and was fresh and delicious (only RM3 per cup). The food menu was extensive and prices clearly written on the menu. The lady who took our order was most pleasant and patient. Fish were priced on the menu at per 100g but you can ask for the choices available on that day and they will tell you how much they cost honestly.There were 3 of us and we ordered 5 dishes in total. We ordered the Portuguese baked fish, squid fritters, butter chicken, black pepper brinjal / aubergine, stir fried green vegetables (sawi) together with plain white rice. Despite ordering the smallest size, the portions were quite generous.The fish was red snapper and it was very fresh, cooked beautifully with a delicious Portuguese sambal-like sauce which was very flavorful and not too spicy. The squid fritters were crispy and delicious. The butter chicken was fantastic as it was very creamy and sweet and the chicken fried beautifully. The black pepper brinjal was cooked in a manner we have never tasted before and we really liked it The stir fried vegetables again were cooked very well and delicious. Due to the amount of dishes we ordered (5 dishes), there was enough to eat for a family of 4 (let alone the 3 of us). We were expecting the final bill to be at a much higher cost but when the bill came, it was a surprising RM120! This has got to be one of the most affordable and reasonably priced seafood restaurant that serves fresh and deliciously prepared Portuguese style seafood. This restaurant also has a cleanliness rating of "A" that is clearly displayed on the counter.Our family has had the perfect experience dining at Portuguese Settlement with thanks to J&J stall no. 10. Needless to say the rumors about Portuguese Settlement selling overpriced food and below par tastes is false in our opinion.We are a family coming from KL who travel every now and again to Melaka for the food and will surely make it a point to stop here after this positive experience!Show less

Author: Vasantha M
Title: Seafood Village
Review: Wide range of delicious local portuguese style food especially seafood menu available jz beside coastal area.

Author: ravenzcoreDhaka City, Bangladesh
Title: Too good of a place for the food & view ❤️
Review: It's stall number 10, right by the end of Portuguese Square food court and by the children's playground. Their service ia prompt and very helpful staff. Must try the Butter Garlic Crab as it was phenomenal! So meaty and perfectly cooked. The Sweet & Sour Shrimp & Squid Fritters were okay. All and all the view of the sea watching the sunsey and having thei great food is an expwall together. I suggest to visit at 6pm as that right around the time they open and perfect time for sunset dinner. Will be visiting again for sure Show less

Author: Relax817354
Title: Seafood Portuguese style
Review: Located at the Portuguese Square at Ujong Pasir, this place is within a huge food court area facing the sea. It's a beautiful place to have dinner if it's not raining. My family and I frequented this place then and now. The popular choice for my family is the butter crab. There are others like chilli crab, salted egg crab, otak-otak, brinjal black pepper, mixed vegetable and so many more. Eat those with Uncle Joe's mango juice; you'll love it. J&J Corner is shop number 10. Choose number 10 which the last shop in that row, and next to the children's playground!Show less

Author: KY G
Title: Fresh seafood  galore at J & J portuguse settlement
Review:
Plenty of seafood stalls line up in a row. We choose J & J as it was recommend by local. Prices were very transparent and all the dishes was great and fresh. 
Will be back.

Author: Afiz4Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mango asam juice the bomb
Review: Ordered mango asam juice because of the recommendation in trip advisor! It’s indeed the best in comparison to the one at stall #1 because they used fresh mango from what I saw in the bucket plus they didn’t use any sugar unlike stall #1 and no added water only from ice. Show less

Author: jeanwang27
Title: Worst ever meal in Melaka
Review: The food took very long to serve even though there is only 3 tables when we were there. Some vegetables were served only after repeated chasers and we have already finished with out rice. The prawn is not fresh, the fried chicken wings and squid fritters were fried till it’s too dry. The sambal Kangkung uses lousy dried shrimps which were smelly. Should not visit this restaurant at all! Show less

Author: doraemongerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonable pricing
Review: Well, before we parked our car, people start to surround us like hooligans. Immediately told them we want to go to no. 10, they left and left 1 staff to lead us there.Price was reasonable, ordered 6 dishes in all with 2 mango juice and 1 watermelon juice. Total bill: slightly over RM100. Their Portuguese style ayam was fabulous. We both loved it and their seafood were very fresh and tasty. Prawns were well cooked. Do order their mango juice with sour plum! First taste of it, will make u dribble but 2nd mouth onwards, it'll make u addicted to it. It's also helps in your appetite. Will definitely revisit if got chance!Show less

Author: 451sameerl
Title: Amazingly fresh seafood with a Portuguese influence.
Review: Definitely recommended.  Beautiful food. This place has won awards and all sorts! 5pm they open, right by the Portuguese square.

Author: Joannica
Title: Moderate
Review: Food was OK.  Not exceptionally delicious, but just OK. Price was reasonable.  Service OK, staff friendly enough

Author: nader_khedrNeedham, Massachusetts
Title: Superb food superb service
Review: Delicious and amazing taste, can’t say more one of best seafood meals we had as a family We ordered crabs, shrimps, mussels, squid, fried rice, fresh juices were superb Only thing that wasn’t that good was noodles Caven was very helpful and took time to explain to us multiple dishes flavors with patience to questions It’s also a Halal Restuarant A must to eat Their Restuarant number is 10 and they deserve a 10/10 Show less

Author: TaniaM3831Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Highly Recommended!
Review: J&J corner has got to be my favourite stall to dine at the Portuguese Settlement. When you're here, try out their Portuguese baked fish, black pepper brinjal, baked otak-otak, salted egg fried sotong and devil's curry. Amazing flavours and just the right amount of heat (spicy). You must also try their signature Mango Juice with Asam Buih - yummy! Always a great dining experience here. Don't get frightened when you park your car and see all our Portuguese brothers and sisters approach you. They're only there to help pick a food stall. So just say J&J corner and they will guide you there :) I will definitely return when I visit Melaka, or rather "balik hometown". I have eaten at J&J Corner 3 times now. So yeah, I'm consider myself a regular :)Show less

Author: _G2339XS
Title: Delicious Seafood
Review: We tried the Portuguese baked fish and it tastes very nice. The black pepper brinjal was also tasty. However, the sambal for the squids was too spicy. Price was very reasonable and don't forget to try their mango juice with sour plum which I think is the nicest in Melaka. Good service too. Show less

Author: desilvagsingapore
Title: great service
Review: Second trip to J&J and found the service provided by CLAUDINE,HENRY DAPHNE AND HENRY extremely courteous, helpful and patient. If u need a cab from the jetty, they will kindly call one for you. Their recomendation of food was excellent and turned out to be their specialty on their menu. Must try are the Brinjol Black Peper,Portugusse Baked Fish as well Squid Fritters and Crab ButterGarlic.Their Mango Juice is a must must try. Best time to visit is during sunset. Thank you so much for the excellent service rendered to me and my elderly mum. Always a treat and joy to visit J&J. Keep up the good food and service everyone.Show less

Author: 773rheagKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: SUCH A WASTE !!
Review: My two journey from KL was a total waste. NOTHING was good. It was just two of us. We ordered prawn, lala (ginger cili padi style) , dable curry and an omelette. Prawn was to sour, lala's shell was more than the meat but we put our hope it that dable curry. Guess what it was such a disappointment. Super sour like a sour nasi lemak sambal. Last but not least, the omelette was burnt. Ohh god how it's even possible to call themselves the best shop among the other 9 stalls. Anybody won't wants to go Portuguese settlement for dinner, please think twice and PLEASE DO NOT GO TO THIS PARTICULAR SHOP. Such a waste. Show less

Author: edwintcsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Totally worth it at Stall No 10!

At last I've decided to trust TripAdvisor for the suggestion and it says store number 10. It's true and totally lives up to the name! Got to say it has got good service! Author: Julie S
Title: Dinner
Review: J & J has always given us excellent food and service. We always visit this restuarant several times when we come home which is yearly.Favourite dishes are : - squid fritters , chilly crab, chilly kangkong , black pepper brinjal.Their salted egg crabs is a new favourite.I would highly recommend a visit or several to this restuarant.Show less

Author: Sk GSingapore, Singapore
Title: No-frills authentic Kristang food
Review: This time we're whetting our appetite for Devil's Curry and their no-frills authentic Kristang food while watching the Malacca Straits. We ordered Butter Garlic Crab, Portuguese Baked Fish, Curry Debal, Calamari and Chicken Fritter, and Brinjal grilled with black pepper. The dinner ends with the refreshing "Joes Only One Mango Juice", freshly squeezed mango juice with sour plum. Thumbs up!Show less

Author: jenscwernerMarkt Schwaben, Germany
Title: Portugese-Eurasian-style fresh seafood
Review: J & J Corner is located at the popular food centre at the Portuguese Settlement. There are 10 Portuguese style seafood stalls here, numbered 1 to 10. J & J Corner is stall #10 at the far end of the food centre, furthest from the car park.The style of cuisine (Portuguese-Eurasian) is unique to the Kristang community here which are descendants of Portuguese and local marriages during the 16th/17th century of Portuguese rule.We had spicy baked fish and crispy fish with a sweet and sour sauce. All very fresh and tasty. I tried the halved egg plants with black pepper, fried in a pan, slightly caramelized outside but still juicy inside. For drinks you can also try local coconut juice or yummy mango juice. I really love this Portuguese style of cooking and it is a nice place to sit and watch a beautiful sunset over the Malacca Straits. Show less

Author: Pris_ShillaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!!
Review: First time dined at J&J Corner after several visit to other restaurant at the Portuguese Settlement. Happy to say... Their food did not disappoint us. Especially their Portuguese baked fish was too good and so is their Mango asamboi juice to die for . Their pricing is also quite reasonable. Well recommended Show less

Author: danta83
Title: Portuguese Seafood
Review: Must try for the Portuguese baked fish as it's simply delicious. Service was excellent and they even arranged a driver to take us back to the city.

Author: JAMILEYJAAFARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Tasted Is To Simple And Sweet"
Review: Every time I go to Nyonya Restaurant. I would imagine very tasty Traditional "Nyonya" dishes like the "Nyonya Florence Tan" cooking show. Today is a bit disappointing because only 2 types of Vegetables that I ordered can be said delicious. Fish and squid "Sambal"(Chili paste) is too simple and sweet, "Masak Lemak Udang" (cook use coconut Milk & spice) too strong the seasoning until it loses its delicious taste. The owner of this restaurant needs to make changes to the cooking recipe. You should go to Baba And Nyonya Restaurant at Genting Primier Outlet (GPO) Genting Highland and try their cuisine. Your location of the restaurant is very attractive next to Mahkota Parade but dishes are too simple. As We know Melaka is a popular tourist destination and Nyonya cuisine should be very delicious not like what I eat today. I will come again for second time to taste the cuisine. Please do not embarrassed the deliciousness of Nyonya's traditional cuisine.Show less

Author: IbrahimAwang
Title: Lovely Place and Good Service
Review: When we arrived, one of gentleman (staff ) approched my wife explained about food & restaurant. I recently hosted my daughter birthday at Malacca for this Aidiladha holidays. There were several Nyonya traditional dishes to choose from menu and I chose Siakap Nyonya, Udang Lemak Nanas, Sotong Kunyit, Oyster Veg and Sambal Belacan not to forget it's was delicious lunch. My family enjoying the meal till we request additional rice.The restaurant had a beautiful ambience and decorations, soft lighting, great background music and a very classy feel to the whole set-up. One more thing, as we are muslim, there are Halal certificate at front door.Mr.Jamal (staff) were very helpful and obliged to our requests and needs. He suggested have a dessert homemade Cendol with gula Melaka..my gudness..it was fantastic ! My family and the birthday girl had a great time and everyone commented how good the whole vacation was. It was truly a memorable experience at Nyonya Suan and we all thoroughly enjoyed ourselves at Melacca this time.While we looking at the menu they serve Keropok Ubi..taste good,I never had it before so because of that,my wife bought 1 dozen (12pckt) Keropok Ubi and half dozen (6pckt) original Gula Melaka.I am definitely come back to Nyonya Suan and thanks for Mr.Jamal too.Show less

Author: NitaKrisnanKota Tinggi, Malaysia
Title: Well Done !
Review: Our weekend in Malacca this time really enjoyable.Before we drove back home,had lunch with Nyonya crusine.Lucky went we arrived it's just 2 table inside,not crowded yet and food arrive just in time.While we snap photo before left.. bunch of people coming (Malay family)They have 2 type of fish:A) Seabass/Siakap/Gerang- everyone knows this type of fish & how the meat taste, structure a look like.B) Perch (fillet)- fish meat soft & moist,for me it's similar with Dorry fish.We order 1st-Perch sweet & sour and request the fish crispy fried in order make fish taste better.2nd-Prawn Lemak Nanas - their signature "Lemak Nanas" really fantastic.3th-Sotong Kunyit (Spicy) this squirt also very good.4th- Oyster Tauhoo Veg - Mix veg such as Pak Choy,Mushroom,Carrot inside with taufu..it's incredible.5th-Sambal Bendi-wonderful sambal not so spicy for me..it's sour,sweet.. it's kind unique sambal.Lastly we take Seafood Tauhu- home made and it's crispy like nuggets also superb!Overall food here it's good and it's Nyonya recipes not your mama cooking!Even you go another restaurant they represent their own, that's normal..mamak's also different curry style..am I right? I'm not agreed with previous reviews say that food here bad..but I do believe they did wrong combination.Waiter/server here also did a good job,he had food aknowledge and friendly.Nice ambiance indoor air conditioning and the most important thing.. washroom are clean.. for me working as Safety & Health..I'm really concerned about hygiene so if a food are delicious but toilet are dirty..what do u aspect?.. believe me..when I'm go to restaurant..I go and check their toilet first..that's show their attitude.Price are reasonable and its located in center of tourism area, some more restaurant also well organized & nice decorations.We had few great photos here.Thanks for a great experience Nyonya Suan and I will back for more.Show less

Author: IzwanHash
Title: Authentic Nyonya Food
Review: Beautifully decorated place, good quality food, and excellent service. They use wonderful ingredients in their dishes and the staffs are attentive. a very reasonable price ,delicious & it's HALAL. Good for lunch or dinner with colleagues, business partner and big family gatherings.Every time we came to Melaka,Nyonya Suan our favorite restaurant..its a must! Keep it up.Show less

Author: Texan CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Superb Ambience
Review: We had our cravings in the smaller Jonker Street outlet. The walls splatter with ceramic, aluminium colourful serving plates of all sizes. The staff very attentive & friendly. We must admit, each time we are into Malacca, peranakan food is one of our must eats. Their main branch use to be within two lanes opposite Dataran Palawan shopping center, next to "newton hawker".Its been many years, on our many visits.We are shocked, because the Jonker Street outlet has closed its shuttle.We went to the main branch opposite Dataran Palawan, & the staffs confirms. Anyway, we ordered 2 desserts, ( chendol ) but the quality lost to that of Jonker.The price was also higher, but we were there for quality which we could easily get from our regular travels here. Just 3 weeks, & we will be back into Malacca/Muar this 7 - 11 September.Show less

Author: OnAJolidaySingapore
Title: Misleading pricing, mediocre taste
Review: Located on Jonker Walk at a corner. The shop has beautiful interior wall decor which is nice for photo. As for food wise, tried their Chef recommendations Udang Lemak Nanas (Pineapple prawn) @ RM35 and Kangkung Belacan (Stir fried water spinach with shrimp paste) @ RM15. The vegetable portion is actually big, but the prawn wasn’t fresh. Would say that the food didn’t taste exceptional, just normal, these dishes had to be eaten with rice due to the heavy tasting gravy. We ordered refilled water and on the menu given to us it was stated RM0.80/glass, however when settling the bill, we were charged RM1/glass. When we pointed out to the cashier, she immediately whipped out another drinks menu which stated RM1/glass. This menu was not given to us at the start and as a matter of principle we informed the cashier but they insisted the pricing had been revised to RM1/glass and they would always provide both menus (which shows different drinks pricing) to the customers. Don’t feel that is appropriate and it’s irresponsible to mislead the consumers. They claim that they are already in the midst of updating the old menu.Show less

Author: Squiff123
Title: Very disappointing treatment; satisfactory nonya food; dreadful otak otak

The bill, which was over RM70, was presented; however, we were told that that credit cards were only accepted over RM80. There were no indications of this ruling anywhere in the restaurant and we were not informed of this when we asked if credit cards were accepted. A rule made up on the spot, perhaps?I felt sorry for the service staff who was very apologetic.Show less

Author: ViaBenGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: Nyonya food is fantastic!
Review: I went to Nyonya Suan for dinner to try the famous Nyonya cuisine and it was fantastic. The udang lemak nenas (prawns / coconut milk / pineapple) was awesome, the oyster sauce mushrooms and tofu nyonya were great and the lime sour plum juice was perfect in its salty / sweet oddness.By Melaka standard this is an expensive restaurant and it is outside the main tourist area but I think it is an excellent option to try local food.I would definitely go back.Show less

Author: Soink_85Mersing, Malaysia

The following were ordered:1) Jenahak (tail portion) Asam Pedas - Savored similar dish during our first visit and to our surprise it tasted deliciously same! 2) Egg omelette with Cincalok - Nice but may be slightly salty than the usual omelette due to the use of Cincalok3) Steamed lady fingers with Sambal - Finger licking!4) Beancurd oyster sauce style with vegetables - Simple and tasty.Recommended for a family meal as the restaurant may cater a big family of 8 to 10 with their big round tables.Show less

Author: JoyceLYPTaiping, Malaysia
Title: Too pricey
Review: 1st time trying Nyonya food after searching for one online - reviews were goodIt is a Halal restaurantOrdered :1. Sambal bendi Sambal not spicy enough and it is sweet and watery. Rate it 3/0 But maybe that's how sambal in Nyonya style should be? But it just ain't my cup of tea. 2. Tauhu NyonyaTexture of tauhu is good - smooth. Sauce was a bit sweet, but was quite tasty. Rate it 7/10 3. Ikan goreng asam The gravy was excellent - spicy and sour enough. Only down point is it is pricey for quite a small piece of fish. They serve the keropok as tidbits - but we are charged for it. RM 2.50And a bowl of rice is RM 2.50So 3 dishes for 2 person with drinks ordered (causing RM 3 per person) came up to RM 90 - pricey Overall, I would rate it ⭐⭐⭐ only Show less

Not going here anymore Show less

Author: JaclynW128

Author: Dinesh E
Title: Terrible service

Author: Zack D
Title: Thumbs up

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Yummy food
Review: Restaurant Nonya Suan has been around since 1998. Compared to other Melaka nonya restaurant,it may look a little quiet,however, do not overlook this place for the food is still decently delicious. I highly recommend you the sambal udang with petai which was aromatic and spicy. The chap chye tasted good too. Last but not least, asam fish was fresh. Good meal altogether for me. Do try itShow less

Author: ellenpssJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice food but rather expensive
Review: We had dinner here during a short holiday in Malacca. We ordered ikan gerang asam, tauhu nyonya & pokchoy garlic. The food are also nice, especially the ikan gerang asam. However, the portion was very big for the 2 of us. We couldn't finish our order. The place is comfortable, with aircon & soft music. The location is also strategic cause it is located near to a number of big hotels. The price is rather on the high side compared to others. But overall, we enjoyed our meal here.Show less

Author: flyingseagulSingapore, Singapore
Title: great prawn omelette but tasteless seafood toufu
Review: i wanted to let hubby had a try on nyona food last minute we saw this restaurant we just walked in.the rendang chicken is very flavourful with plain rice..however the chicken parts used were all chicken breast which hubby did not fancy.the prawn omelette was the best dish..prawns were fresh and egg fried with enough wok hei..the disappointment was the seafood toufu.deep fried but tasteless.i cannot find any trace of seafood in it.the service was very good..staff were polite and obliging.Show less

Author: zedelforNoumea, New Caledonia
Title: Tasty Tucker
Review: Our first Nyonya cuisine encounter and a very good experience. We tried several dishes and all were very tasty including the Ice Kacang. We are used to sweet desserts made with fruit etc so was a surprise to find rice, corn, cendol, beans, grass jelly etc. We also decided to try durian for the first time, despite its reoutaton as having the well-earned reputation as smelling like rotting flesh (tick). This is not criticism of the restoran at all, after tasting the dish we very quickly decided we do not like durian and any descriptions of it being delicious, king of fruits etc etc are questionable! Nyona Seru's prices were very reasonable and we'd recommend to anyone wanting to try nyonya food.Show less

Author: Esther P
Title: Nice Nonya Food
Review: Very convenient location, along the road side, next to a Karaoke. Restaurant is spacious and full of decors. Lots of food to sample.

Author: youke_worldwideSingapore
Title: Good foor a bit of a smell
Review: So when we entered the restaurant the place had a bit of a smell - I think maybe because it is peranakan food. They had a table at the back which could take 14 people so that was good for our group. place was full so obviously good food. There were a couple of dishes that I really really liked - in particular the pineapple prawns which is full of curry and very creamy and also the rendang chicken was also very very good. Other dishes like the buah keluar chicken and chop chye was also good.Show less

Author: LoongMSingapore, Singapore
Title: Decent Nyonya restaurant in a convenient location
Review: We dropped by for lunch at Nyonya Suan on a quiet Thursday afternoon. It is conveniently located beside the Mahkota Parade shopping center. Our favourite dish was the steamed fish cooked in nyonya style. The garoupa was fresh and the spices hit the mark. It was a satisfying meal that warmed our stomach. Show less

Author: ferrymulSingapore
Title: Good Pineapple Prawn and Nyonya Tofu
Review: We went here because we want to enjoy nyonya food, however we were suprised that the food are "pork free", which normally an indication a sub-par taste and quality.We ordered a few nyonya food, namely Ayam buah keluak (a bit bitter), Pineapple Prawn (very tasty and fresh), Nyonya Tofu (Sweet and delicious) and Kangkong Belacan (extremely Spicy). As sides, we were ordered cracker (soft and nice), and sambal belacan, which is heavenly.We love the food here, though i think there is a better nyonya restaurant than this one, due to the 'pork free' policy.Nevertheless, a good alternative nyonya food in malacca.Show less

Author: Enkidu-backpackerKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: High quality nyonya cusine with good service
Review: First the waiter guided us to the table, we ordered 3 food from menu: rendang chicken, fish and pine-apple prawn. i have tried nyonya food previously i kualalumpur and melacca, but i have to confirm the food quality in this restaurant is really good. i highly recommend their prawn pine-apple which is in a very tasty sauce made of coconut milk, pine-apple, i guess melacca sugar and more, we really loved it. foods we ordered even didnt have the spicy label on menu, were still quite spicy, mostly the fish which is highly recommended by chef, was very spicy, even waiter told us they ahve not used any chilli and spicy taste is coming from the nyonya sauce. prices are quite high, but i can accept it for that quality. the restaurant have good decoration with a collection of old coins/paper notes and some history about nyonya culture.Show less

Author: Francisphx
Title: Awesome lunch
Review: Ordered the Ayam Rendang (RM17), Asam Slice Fish (RM25), Kangkung Cili Belacan (RM11) and Telur Dadar Chincaluk / Fermented Baby Shrimp fried egg (RM9). So happy because I really love the food here so much as compared to the rest of the Nyonya restaurant nearby.

Author: HaggisHalifax_CanadaHalifax, Canada
Title: Very tasty food

We also had Ayam Pongteh , chicken, potatoes and mushrooms, this was also great. The service was excellent and fast. We just walked in with no reservation. We will be back again before we leave Melaka.Show less

Author: Jin G

Author: 646tand

Author: mccmPJ malaysia
Title: Excellent durian nyonya cendol
Review: We went to this restaurant for peranakan nyonya food as it is located within walking distance from our hotel. It takes reservation so we did not have to wait. The service was fast too. We ordered telur dadar cincalok, Ayam rendang, Ayam goreng cili, fried kailan, sotong kunyit and ikan lemak nenas. However, the waiter took the wrong order and we were served ikan asam pedas. It was quite a disappointment as I have never tried masak lemak nenas, and it is a chef recommendation kind of dish. I did confirm with a waitress but since we have touched the dish, we didn't ask for a replacement. Luckily the fish turned out to be fresh and tasty, and my sister liked the eggplants very much. The ayam rendang, telur dadar and sotong were good. The ayam goreng cili not my taste, and the chicken was kind of tough. After the main meal, we ordered durian nyonya cendol as dessert. The cendol was so delicious with the correct blend of coconut milk, gula melaka and fresh durian flesh. It was the best durian cendol I have tasted so far, much better than the infamous jonker 88 baba durian cendol.Ps: I left my credit card in the restaurant and the owner took the efforts to call me many times. I was walking and did not realise my phone ringing. He then sent sms and Facebook message to me until I was contactable. I feel very grateful for him and the staffs there.Show less

Author: V00DooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still good after all these years
Review: Ate here many years ago at their own premises. Bit disappointed that they don't serve pork but decided to give it a try as it was close by. Was even more disappointed when we found out that they ran out of buah keluak (which we missed out at all the other restaurants as most were closed on Mondays and/or Tuesdays). So had the chicken rendang instead. Very nice, but not outstanding. We also ordered the ikan lemak nenas (steamed fish in coconut curry and pineapple) which was quite expensive (approx RM70+) but quite large and enough for 4 adults. It was the best dish by far! We finished every last scrap of the dish (including the gravy) and even sucked at the bones! Soooooo good!The 2 veg dish we had was the ladies fingers with sambal (another must-have dish) and the brinjal with chili. (yummy but a tad salty for me). All very good. Didn't order any dessert as we were already too full. Literally stuffed! Show less

Review: located next to Mahkota parade mall this restaurant has thrived on group travellers, particularly the organised tours and the business is so good that they ignore your bookings or reservations made prior to the visit.the person at the cash counter ( he could be the owner ) definitely needs a lesson or two in public relations. courtesy calls you to make a simple apology if you fail to have the table ready for reservations. here it is the opposite - so what if you have made the reservations. we are not ready for you and you just wait until a table is ready. why in the first place accept reservations then.this attitude may be acceptable to the uninitiated. let me tell you there are countless other nonya food options in malacca, cheaper and with better cuisine. you do not have to depend on nonya suan.food is nothing special. they do not have the sambal belachan which many diners of nonya food also enjoy.suggest you do not waste your money and time trying to dine at nonya suan.Show less

Author: CyclogirlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not truly Nyonya
Review: Nyonya cuisine is so popular in Malaysia and Singapore that there are woefully, poor imitators. I have found a couple of other so-called nyonya restaurants in Melaka that obviously have malay influences, eg the "lemak" dishes have thicker coconut milk or the spicy gravies were too spicy and oily. The Restoran Nyonya Suan chefs very likely chinese and the waitresses only spoke chinese dialects or mandarin. You would expect them to be able to speak in the malay dialect that nyonyas use. The dishes were watered down and missing a key ingredient or two, eg, the pongteh had more soya sauce than preserved soya bean paste and the chapchye left out some ingredients like sweet dried soya bean skin. True-blue nyonya cooking is meticulous, all the ingredients must be in and there are no short-cuts like blending sambal belacan in an electrical blender instead of pounding it in a granite pounder. For more authentic nyonya cuisine, do eat at Kocik Kitchen (Jln Tun Tan Check Lock) or Nancy's Kitchen nearby at Jln Hang Lekir. Both are close to Jonker Walk.Show less

Author: TJLimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Better than when I was there 2 years ago
Review: The food and service level was way better than when we were there 2 years ago.They have moved to a new location which is easier to locate.The same dishes we ordered tasted so different now. It was really delicious.I asked the owner's son if they had changed ownership. He said they have been the owner since they started but the chef had been changed.Really a recommended restaurant to go.Show less

Author: Nai BShanghai, China
Title: Poor Value
Review: Though it has a good location, the food was not as nice as before. It is over commercialised and the sauce tend to be watery with not much authentic taste. The Asam Ikan Pedas with the Jinak Fish Tail with the watery asam sauce- a let down! The Fried Kangkong Belachan was so tough and old - what a pity! The Ayam Masak Keluak has only 2 keluak and 2-3 pieces of chicken floating in a bowl of sauce. The Otak Ikan is quite tasty but with minimal herbs. Overall, for the price paid, the meal is under value. Total bill for 3 persons at RM134 is not cheap.As the dessert like Cendol is must for any Nyonya meal, again disappointed as the green cendol was frozen hard and Gula Melaka not thick enough.We have better meals in the past from their old location and will think about it for our next visit.Show less

Author: hweeyingJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Not Recommended
Review: We had visited this restaurant after we went to upside down museum nearby. We ordered Nyonya fish, curry chicken, chicken ponteh, mix vegetables (zhap chua) and canceluk egg. The steam fish overcooked; chicken cut very big pieces. We only like the fried canceluk egg and mix vegetables. We were so disappointed with the food quality here. Total cost RM171. Still acceptable price. But the food really awful therefore not recommended at all!!!Show less

Author: foto_melakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Nyonya Cuisine
Review: This is without doubt one of the best restaurants in town serving authentic nyonya food. A trip to historic Malacca will certainly be incomplete if you do not try nyonya cuisines which have made Malacca a perfect haven for nyonya food lovers. As nyonya cuisines are very much influenced by the ethnic Malays, you can certainly expect a lot of spices and chillies being used in nyonya cuisines.The food here is excellent, true to the taste of nyonya cuisines. It is no wonder that this restaurant seems to be a favourite of many whenever they are in Malacca. Some may feel that the prices here are a bit expensive but personally speaking, I feel that the prices are worth paying as you will be getting some of the best nyonya food around.The restaurant is located smack in the centre of Malacca town, thus making it easier to spot for first-timers to Malacca. However, this can also be a headache especially on weekends and public holidays as the main road where the restaurant is located is prone to traffic congestion. Furthermore, parking space is a premium here on weekends and public holidays. So you may have to walk a little to get to the restaurant,But then, this should be worthwhile as you will work up an appetite for the cuisines.Show less

Author: lockey1967Havant, England, United Kingdom
Title: The best we have tasted.
Review: This is the forth time we have visited, and the second since they moved to the bigger restaurant. The food is always of excellent quality, with seadfood nyonya cooking some of the best we have tasted anywhere. The staff are very friendly, and always make sure that you are satisfied with the quality. The prices are good value, if you want quality food at a decent price you will love this place. I visit malaysia (and Malacca each year) and after about 15 years of visits I can say that the food it good, sorry, no excellent and will be back again in may 2015 for more food.Show less

Author: PoppyJnSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but not worth the higher price tag
Review: We tried Nyonya Suan in it's new location along the main street below The Explorer Hotel. Seems like the standards have changed to be more presentable and spicier, compared to what we tried a couple of years ago in their old location. The food is still tasty and the environment more enjoyable now. But the price! We had late lunch and most of the dishes were sold out. We can only ordered 4 very simple dishes (like fried egg and kangkong) with drinks and it cost MR130! The service was less than desired too, probably they were rushing to close and rest. Not sure if we will go back again...Show less

Author: 341anniep
Title: Average food, yet expensive
Review: Food just average and price a bit expensive compare to other nyonya restaurant.  Convenient location for those not driving.

Author: vandylimSingapore
Title: Super expensive!
Review: Came here for dinner and totally regretted! They are opposite mahkota parade shopping mall, opposite 'San Su Gong'.They don't have much varieties and we paid $170RM for 6 dishes and 6 drinks? Ridiculous steep price! I should have stick to Cottage Spices where I won't even hit $100 for 8 dishes with drinks!Food is average, fried chicken is saltish and fishball soup taste like those in food centre! Chincalok omelette is fragrant, portion is small and overall the price is too expensive! Good lesson paid, first and the last time!Show less

Author: WenWongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated restaurant with average food & high price tag
Review: We went to this restaurant after seeing the review on Tripadvisor but it was a total disappointment! We ordered fish, beancurd with home made sauce, nyonya chap chye, ladies finger with sambal, fried omelette with cincaluk, and otak-otak.Firstly, we noticed that only tourists are eating there when we first stepped into the restaurant. That was probably the first sign that the food may not be good since the local don;t even want to eat there!Secondly, the food cooked were so so only, nothing special but expensive. The chap chye is just average, the beancurd with home made sauce is even worse. It's just normal bean curd taken to deep dry and the so called home made sauce is just some diluted bottled soy bean sauce which you can purchase from supermarket. The omelette with cincaluk is just normal fried egg with probably 1 tablespoon (or less) of cincaluk. We could hardly taste the cincaluk. The steamed fish was ok but pricey. I have eaten a much better one in Penang and it is cheaper as well! The ladies fingers was horrible. It does not taste horrible but it is not what it claimed to be. It's just steamed ladies fingers and the so called special sambal is some diluted canned chillie sauce that you can get from supermarket. And this dish cost about RM10!! Anyone without cooking skill can also make this dish!the otak-otak taste the same as those from factory, nothing fantastic and definitely not worth mentioning. Overall experience: terrible, food are expensive and not worth coming back!this restaurant seems like is catered for Singaporeans. The entire restaurants were full of Singaporeans except us. The food is probably tasty by Singapore standard, but definitely not by Malaysia standard. We tried some nyonya food in Singapore previously and the standard of food serving in this restaurant is rather similar to the one in Singaore. The Singapore restaurant that we tried claims to be one of the best nyonya restaurants in Singapore but food were rather average. Well, the food in Nyonya Suan is cheap if you convert to SGD but I would say: why waste the money to come here if you have better choice out there? For Nyonya food, Penang is still the best!Show less

Author: choihoweboonPenang
Title: Good Nyonya Food but a pricy one.
Review: 12 of us had dinner here. Food choices are a bit different as compared to nyonya food in Penang. The famous nyonya "inchi kaybin" (friend chicken with special spices) / 'jiu hoo char' (fried vegetables with cuttlefish slices) / ikan asam pedas were not available. I would say the Melaka nyonya food is more to the Malay side while the Penang nyonya food is more to the Chinese (or Hokkien to be specific) side. The dishes we ordered were Rendang Ayam, Ayam Pongteh, and a few more dishes which is quite "Malay-ish". Taste was not bad. But the billed totalled up RM325.00. To me, it's quite pricy compared to Penang's nyonya food which taste better at cheaper price.Show less

Author: Are-Narz

Author: AzmythKL
Title: Pricey.Limited choice.
Review: Was looking for a place for lunch that serves no alcohol and pork since there were Muslims among us. The place looked nice and comfortable plus not overly crowded. Since it was the Chinese New Year we were offered their Special Lunch (6-8pax) which we passed since the choices weren't too appealing and a little too pricey (RM290).So we had to pick from their SHOCKINGLY LIMITED SELECTION OF FOOD-7 of us and we placed our order under 5 minutes for there were nothing much to argue about. LOL. Either this or that. And fish? They only have a single kind. I mean, even a regular restaurant will have 2 to 3 kinds! Chicken? Either rendang or i cant remember what it's called. Drinks. Oh my. They were SO refreshing! Instead of just more water and sugar we got really good assam boi,lime juice and soya. 5 stars for this one. Food tasted good,leaning towards home cooked food. Not something you could have just about anywhere but definitely not worth the price we paid for. We had rice with chicken,prawn,squid,ladies fingers,and juices and it cost us RM250. A regular serving of each too.Would I go again? Definitely not. Too pricey and lacks variety. W were too tired too walk any further to find another place that caters for Muslims. So we had to settle here. Or else we would have left the moment we saw their menu.Show less

Well maybe.The service was reasonable brisk and there is a small section selling local produces and spices,etc. The notable dish was the Chicken curry...the rest were just passable. The chendol was satisfactory at best. If in Malacca and not sure which Peranakan restaurant to choose, Restoran Suan should not disappoint. But don't expect the sky.Show less

Author: whit3

Author: sensesawaken

Author: Mark TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Needs more staff
Review: Arrived at about 12noon to try this out..Place was empty. As we (4) were eating customers started to come in.
