I believe that they were either too busy and short handed, or have to make the nearly 100 servings for the bussed tourists. Verdict: Not impressed. Over hyped.Show less

Author: altytudeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very Satisfying!
Review: I am a big fan of Nyonya cooking and one of my objectives of visiting the historical city of Melaka well known as a bedrock of Nyonya culture was to enjoy as much good Nyonya food as possible. Got prepared for this by collating information online through reading food blogs, travel blogs and mass media reviews. Shortlisted this restaurant and several others.Nyonya Suan was the first restaurant we dined at on this trip and i was totally glad that it worked out really well.The restaurant was located in Plaza Mahkota area, a relatively quiet part of the business district of Melaka, not at all difficult to locate. It had a slightly rundown interior which somehow came across as honest, no fanciful, kitschy Peranakan decorations. It was comfortably spacious too.There were just two of us and we ordered:1). Sotong Kunyit - Squid fried with tumeric(yellow ginger) rempah, RM$10.00 for small serving: Read of this signature dish of Nyonya Suan on some blogs and decided to check it out, bingo, excellent choice. The sotong was very fresh, no fishiness at all and of just the right texture and bite - not overcooked to rubbery chewiness, not too hard and yet retained some firmness, juicy too. The flavor of the tumeric rempah(spice blend) was really good - tasty, unique and thoroughly satisfying. The little gravy from the rempah, cooking oil and i guessed natural seafood flavor of the sotong was excellent as accompaniment to steamed rice, full of umami. Must try!2). Assam Fish - fish cooked in a spicy tamarind gravy, RM$16.00 for small serving:Was told the fish used was Ikan Janak - a fish caught in the nearby Malacca Straits, Chinese call it Ang-Cho. Fish was fresh, no doubt about that, no unpleasant fishiness, firm flesh and sweet tasting. The okra that was cooked with the fish was nice too. Tamarind gravy was well-balanced, sour, sweet and some spiciness, would have liked it a liitle spicier though. This gravy was really appetizing and went really well with steamed rice. This however caused us some dilemma as the sotong kunyit gravy was also fantastic with rice and there was only so much rice one could and should eat. Recommended.3). Sambal Bendi - steamed okra served with balacan(fermented shrimp paste)chilli condiment, RM$8.00:Simple dish. The sambal was very interesting though too sweet and not spicy enough for us. It had a complex yet refreshing taste resulting from blending many different spices and herbs and i speculated may be some gula melaka(palm sugar) and ginger flower. Not exactly a perfect dish for me but certainly interesting enough to warrant at least trying once.Service was nothing fanciful but efficient and unobtrusive, more than adequate. They also didn't push us to over order or order expensive dishes. I would certainly recommend Nyonya Suan to those who enjoy Nyonya cuisine and also those new to cuisine.Show less

Author: Ian GBarnsley, United Kingdom
Title: Tasty and great value
Review: Freshly made pizza and real juice juices. On the river. Don't bother walking down to the HRCafe as someone suggested unless you want to pay 8 times the price to sit in a theme park.Laid back and relaxed 'we are together' is a bit of a gem.Show less

Author: Jillian FMelbourne, Australia
Title: Delicious pizza!!!
Review: This place does freshly made, absolutely delicious vegetarian pizza. Their juices and drinks are also freshly made and yum! After travelling for a while with a family of fussy eaters, and sometimes being disappointed with meals, this place was a amazing! Their food and drink was highly rated by the whole family. Service was great and the location on the river made it a very relaxing place to sit and rest, just a little way away from the busy jonker street and dutch square. Show less

Title: Great place to chillax

Author: sunshine_city88
Title: Plain pizza

Author: Coastal810300
Title: look no further
Review: Amazing margherita pizza!  overlooking  the maleka river an lovely setting to spend time eating pizza and enjoying hot/cold drinks

Author: Steve CSydney, Australia
Title: Late night supper

Great location over looking the river watching the boats go by and the tourist strolling along the walkway.We tried two pizza’s including the Triple Cheese and the Tempeh - both very tasty, good size, great value @ $20 Rm each.Didn’t expect to get great pizza in Malacca but glad we tried it.Great decor as well.Well worth the visit.Show less

Author: miss_nidyJakarta, Indonesia

I love the vintage vibes on this cafe. I would highly recommend this cafe if you want a cozy place to hang out and enjoy Malacca River at night.Show less

Author: Theexecchef
Title: Very Very Good!
Review: Lovely small place with good tasty food/ Laksa is VERY good.. also the chicken curry… owner/ chef is nice and genuinely cares about what he serves. Decor is nice and very photogenic, we will return and also recommend this little place to friends…

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia

The cafe is right in front of Calanthe Art Cafe. The Asam Pedas was so good, different from other asam pedas. The Otak-Otak is something to try when eat here. Overall, it’s good and definitely will come here again! Show less

Author: JosieM958

Author: joey_kua

Author: haphuongthao14Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam

You will be full after 1 dish. The price is cheap. Show less

Author: Alex DLondres
Title: Well worth it, you won't be disappoointed
Review: Stopped there starving for an evening meal. What a find! We shared an amazing laksa and a chicken curry, will other little sides and a beer. Proper local home cooking. It was nice to step in for some aircon after walking around in the heat. The service wasn't slow at all, but not a microwave job either.I saw reviews saying it wasn't cheap: I cannot disagree more. This is a small restaurant, with all mod cons therefore they will have to pay for rent, electricity etc. You will find cheaper in you eat at a hawker stall instead, yes, but we didn't find any with that specific type of food. and all in all, it cost us about £10 if you do the conversion.Definitely recommended!Show less

Author: vibe0
Title: Amazing
Review: We had the best laksa and curry chicken and you HAVE to try the passionfruit juice! Would definitely recommend and come back. Location is perfect and close to the main street.

Author: G1801LMfrancisb
Title: Amazing Lunch
Review: Great food, great service! The food was some of the best in Malaysia and it took only a few minutes to prepare!

Author: Ibbo1966Rugby, United Kingdom
Title: Lovely but not best VFM (Value For Money)
Review: Lovely, peaceful and traditional restaurant environment, small and minimalist decoration, but very nice.The food was very good quality Nyonya menu, small range but all very tasty. Portions are quite small, but are actually big enough for a meal and the food price is good. The fresh made drinks are also very nice but are overpriced (RM9 each) and this means that overall the total bill for 2 adults and 2 children was RM80 which is not the best value.Service and food preparation was quick and we were in and out of the restaurant in 40 minutes.There are many places to eat that are cheaper, but the food would not be as good as Mama Taste.I recommend this restaurant if you want good quality local Nyonya food and are not too concerned about the cost or value. If go without drinks then the food value is very good.Show less

Author: Joannica

Review: Tucked in one of the lanes the setting was comfortable. Customer service was excellent , the staff were very accomodative. The food was good but price on a slightly high side.

Author: ATK88Sydney, Australia

Wanted to order the Durian Cendol but the nice lady boss told me due the price of durian too high , that's why no durian cendol during my visit . I will definitely give a try - next year ( she told me haha )Shop Close : Every ThursdayShow less

Author: kianglong81Malaysia
Title: Ordinary home cook

Review:
We found this small restaurant in Malakka and I can only say that this was the best dinner in Malaysia

Chicken rice balls was tasty as was the steamed chicken that came with it. We also had the otak-otak and steamed ladies fingers. Good overall and a nice experience.Show less

Review: Ordered the ala carte Curry Chicken set with rice and bread and the nice uncle recommended the fried potato leaf veggie dish for sharing and a lime juice. The Curry was very nice and went really well with the rice and crispy toasted bread. The potato leaf dish was really unique and nice too. Lime juice was refreshing and thirst quenching. Highly recommended!Show less

As a tourist, i don't expect much from them.Show less

Author: TingxT
Title: Delicious!

Review: This small non eye catching peranakan restaurant is just opposite the famous Calanthe Art café (which serves the 13 Sates coffees specialties). We had walked along the streets a few times, but it was never in our "To try" list when we visited Melaka in the past. This round, as we had arrived late in the afternoon and were trying to solve our hunger pangs, we just walk in as it was the first restaurant we walked passed. The service is indeed slow as per some reviews, but the food is worth waiting for. Highly recommended their Laksa, their chicken rice(the chilli is good!) , & Otah. I must admit, in fact the standard is better than some of those highly rated restaurants along Jonkers. The service is good and friendly and I will definitely go back to patronize them during my next trip to Jonkers area. Show less

Author: InscribeSligo, Ireland
Title: Slow service but great food!
Review: Mama Taste is a Malaysian Restaurant located at Jonker Walk, Bandar Malaka, Melaka Malaysia. Although we dropped in without booking there was no problem in getting a table. It wasn't overcrowded although it was lunchtime but that may be because the service was fairly slow as it too 20 minutes to get our chicken rice. Even so the food was delicious and well worth waiting for.Show less

Author: soapy23Singapore
Title: Yummy fresh and friendly
Review: Wonderful home-made taste of Assam fish and prawns, and chicken rice balls. Fresh ingredients and prompt service. Avoid peak timing as kitchen is manned by just the couple running the restaurant, if you don't mind waiting patiently and with a smile. They are open all afternoon so why squeeze with the peak hour crowd?Show less

Author: Nicole B
Title: Local Nonya Food
Review: This unassuming place was our introduction to Nonya (Chinese Malay) food here in Melaka.  It's off the main drag just a bit, cheap, and quite tasty.  Menu in English as well.

Author: Leonard S
Title: That hommy feeling.
Review: A little place located on Hang Kasturi, just around the Jonker Street area. This little restaurant serve home cooked Nyonya cuisine. They don't really serve a lot of menus. Price is still reasonable, taste average for me. But this restaurant is pretty packed, even got Q during dinner time. The service still need more attention, maybe because it's a home cook, home business, so they kinda lack of people to serve. It's quite a time from we sat down until they noticed us and ask for order, but not much to try they ran out of foods already. We tried only the curry.Show less

Author: Lengtan67Kuala Lumpur
Title: Simple Nyonya Home Cook Food
Review: A quaint little cafe located on the first left turning from the Jonker main street, directly opposite another cafe named '13 States Cafe'.MaMa Taste has a limited and simple menu to sample some of the home cooked nyonya dishes i.e. Ponteh Chicken, Otak - Otak, Chicken Rendang Noodle, Chicken Rice Ball and fried morning glory (Kangkung) or some other vegetables with the local prawn paste.I ordered a Chicken Rice Ball, Chicken Rendang Noodle and "MaMa Herbal Tea" - a bitter herbal tea in which I was later told that the drink was prepared from a home-grown herbal where the roots were used to prepare this drink. As the food portion was not big, just nice to sample more dishes.The food I ordered were pretty tasty despite the chicken rice ball being a bit cold, most probably pre-cooked and it was just served without heating.The food and drinks were also reasonably priced making it affordable to sample more items from its menu.No harm in giving it a try, reasonably priced with decent sized portioning.Show less

Author: M3657RVstephanieg
Title: Magnifique
Review: We were in Melaka and found this little cafe to eat breakfast.The food was so good! They even helped to make it dairy free because of allergies.We did not only have a good time because of the food but also because of the nice staff.We had some real good conversations and they helped us with planning our trip, where to go and what to see.I will come back and recommend it to everyone!:)Show less

Author: Mark BCraigieburn, Australia
Title: Wonderful!
Review: From the moment Samantha charged at us from the front door exclaiming that she had "too much food!", we fell in love with Jeremy's cooking and Samantha's hospitality. Limau Limau started to feel like a home away from home. Excellent juices and the best coffee I'd had during out month in south-east Asia.Show less

Author: tkastberg
Title: Quintessential cozy cafe
Review: Newly opened cafe. Beautiful interior.We had breakfast quasedillas that were to die for. Also the best flat whites we had in all of Malaysia. The owners, a young couple, took great care of us. We ended up staying a few hours.Nice calm jazz music in the background. Absolutely awesome cafe!Show less

Author: anilaker12
Title: Perfect place to enjoy breakfast and lunch
Review: The chef(jeremy) and staff are excellent and vibe of the place is really comfortable.Foods are even better :) Thanks for everything :)

Author: arvidbonde
Title: Meh..
Review: Cosy atmosphere & friendly staff but less than average food. Ordered crepes but was premade and heated, with cream and jam.

Author: 26hoy
Title: Excellent experience and like the perfect Chef MEAL 🍴
Review:
I like it all... Chef recommended.
Design was amazing and very artsy and cool place to dine.
Sandwiches 🥪 and mixed berries

Author: Kirsmaria
Title: Great place
Review: We had a lunch at Limau Limau, great place. Healthy dishes and smoothies. Fresh fruit. The staff was very friendly.

Author: MazliAMCMalaysia
Title: A Must Visit
Review: Fantastic ambience. After the hustle and bustle of outside walk, this place offers you a calm and relaxing ambience where you can enjoy great delicious food. You do have to wait for your food for long but it was worth it. A visit that I will definitely repeat.Show less

Author: leo H
Title: Very good, high quality food
Review: I specifically recommend the milkshakes. Everything is made right in front of you. they speak and understand English.

Author: Yasotha BPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Over rated
Review: after reading the many positive reviews at the trip advisors, we plan to go there from PJ just to taste the durian cendol. But not worth it. We are crazy durian fans too. But the cendol taste is not so. the musang king rm23 p/pax. For us it's overrated. It is a normal taste of cendol.Show less

Author: WMei23
Title: Awesome!!!
Review: The cendol is indeed super delicious!!! Full flavored with the perfect aroma and gula melaka yet it’s sugarless - awesome! And their duriansssss are super fresh !!!! I love how friendly the people here... this place will be my destination each time I step into Melaka! Thank youuuu Durian Dreamland Good job guys XoxoShow less

Author: 428peggykSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ms
Review: Wow wow wow very expensive...chendol so so only, not that good, coconut not that thick. Durian pancakes also not that good, very very small pieces. Chendol with a piece of mongshanwang cost ringgit 25, not worth..durian not fresh. We spent ringgit $131 there. Will not go back again. Actually the shop next door is good and cheaper, I have tried the last time I was there in November.Show less

Author: khooj277
Title: Fabulous Durian Chendol
Review: I am never a fan of chendol because most of the time, chendol (green jelly like substance) is always hard and starchy, the gula melaka taste like sugar syrup and overall, it's always too sweet to my liking. But this one, the durian puree is homemade with a mixture of D24 and MaoShanWang durian, gula Melaka is fragrant and not too sweet (which you can add more if you prefer by a separate bottle placed on the table), the coconut milk is not too heavy with the other condiments of corn bits and kidney beans, this chendol is out of the world tasty! Must try if you are in Jonker Street!Show less

Author: 253rona
Title: Fantastic Musang King Durian
Review: Wow!!! Excellent service, clean and bright.  Friendly English speaking staff.  I went 2 days in a row!  1/4 the price of the same thing in Singapore.  I’m totally spoiled by the wonderful staff and delicious durians.

Author: sheira_shsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Clean and bright
Review: When we arrived, the place was almost empty. We were worried initially. Perhaps its not as good as the ones full of people.We liked that they were much cleaner than the other shops and brighter. Price was like everything else on Jonker Street - quite steep.Nevertheless, i loved my musang king cendol. Just nice and not too sweet. I may not make the effort to come again but it wont hurt you to explore and skip the crowd at other shopsShow less

Author: juleskarzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Musang King desserts
Review: We love MSK durian and to chance upon a stall that sells MSK Chendol, pancake, mochi, Moon cake, etc was such a dream. We've tried their MSK Chendol and MSK mochi which were definitely not a disappointment. We definitely will come back for more if we're on Jonker Street. Show less

Author: 196meeraa
Title: Best Durian Cendol
Review:
Visited yesterday it's been long time I was graving for good cendol. This really never dissapoint us. The normal cendol was Rm6,Normal Durian Cendol was Rm7 and Durian King cendol was Rm20 .
We only tried normal Durian.Tasted really good.

Author: SPSHI
Title: Nice clean and friendly place to chill on your tropical holiday!!!!
Review: Not exactly hidden in the cluster of shops/restaurants along Jonker Street. (They are located along the main street and situated close to the performance stage). It is very hard not to miss the striking colour of this gem. This place serve desserts which are of local flavours and many will find it a great place to rest while continuing their journey when visiting Melaka. The more adventurous ones might want to challenge the king of tropical fruits! Durian as the place is closely associated with. The quality of durian is second to none as the varieties offered are of good selection. Owner and staffs are very friendly and they are very approachable.Show less

Author: shi_family0707
Title: High quality durian
Review: This place have high quality durian and durian products, definitely worth the visits. I love the maoshanwang and durian cendol.

Author: Adventure402614
Title: Durian musang king cendol
Review: My lover is the durian musang king cendol is so yummy ...If you like to have durian-flavoured delights such as durian cendol and durian pancake , durian egg pudding ,durian parfait ++Boss here handsome ,friendly , good services.will arrange for my next trip with my friends again.Show less

Author: Serafinasim
Title: Delicious desserts!
Review: The cendol is very tasty and smooth! The coconut jelly is very refreshing too!  The durian is also very creamy and delicious! The most special dessert is the durian mochi, the best durian dessert i had ever try! Recommends this shop very much!!

Author: raymonds217
Title: Best Durian cendol in town
Review: Must try this durian Cendol special price reasonable and very tasty . the original cendol also nice the taste of gula Melaka very special

Author: raymond s
Title: Cendol
Review: there is a few kind of cendol, i had tried all very special and tasty and very nice customer service ! Durian price are very reasonable and acceptable

Author: travelingfool49State College, Pennsylvania
Title: Great mango smoothie!
Review: Don’t ask me how two people who don’t like durian ended up in this place! We saw a sign for mango smoothies outside and stopped in. They have a giant model of a durian inside, which is perfect for snapping some pictures while you wait. I can’t speak for the durian products, but the mango smoothies were on point. Show less

Author: BrinVINCEible
Title: Great Food; Well-thought of design/Ambience
Review:
The ambience is well thought of, from the interiors even up to the restroom. The place is spacious and is inviting for a good chill.

The food and especially the drinks are great!

The staff/crew are very friendly and helpful (especially for first timers)

Author: MayH480
Title: Nice food & service
Review:
Come here to celebrate wife's birthday.
We really enjoy the food especially the Iberico Pork Belly & Pesto Pasta.
Great environment & friendly staffs.
Highly recommended!

Author: Karen L
Title: Good service, great food!
Review: Came here for a family meal, love the fact that the staffs are attentive. Good food, nicely done up place and will definitely come back.

Author: shiuanyng
Title: Great food, a must try!
Review: Love the food here, especially the pesto pasta. Nice place with a great ambience and friendly staff. Would highly recommend this place to friends and family. Definitely coming here again :)

Author: evitayap420
Title: Perfect Environment
Review: Carbonara // Appetizer // World Cup Platter // Chef's Special // : Good food, good services and enjoyed the environment there! Very Satisfied and full :)

Author: suria n
Title: Nice environment
Review: Best pesto pasta in town! Try out the iberico belly! Reasonable pricing and very good environment :)

Author: 604augustinew
Title: BBQ
Review:
Good quality food especially the spaghetti  aglio oilo and pork belly!!!! 
Good environment, love the rock wall so much !!!! Good job

Author: AdelineC550
Title: Lovely
Review: Food was great. Ordered spaghetti (carbonara, tomato & aglio olio) and all are yummy! Friendly staff too. Great food, nice service and reasonable price 👍

Author: GraceC3118
Title: Atmosphere was calming and relaxing!
Review: A hidden bar just by the road. Loving the Iberico Pork Belly and Honey Balsamic Salad was a must too! This combination which don’t really feel sinful for on-diet-person! And, price was reasonable for the food with great interior environment as in Malacca. Will be back for sure!Show less

Author: Emily G
Title: Good
Review: Delicious food with good environment. Felt comfortable when dine in. And staff was friendly too. Excellent.

Author: chuahonlyAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Tantalizing delicacies with a touch of elegance.
Review: If you're looking for a place with a touch of flair with the history of Melaka written on the walls, and amazing Western food, The Base is the place to be! I had been to a number of places in Melaka on my holiday and this restaurant was the principal highlight of our food tour. We ordered some pasta and ribs as recommended by the waiter and the food was no disappointment. Tender beef melting off the bones with overflowing sauce is something I will never forget. Service was all right and the ambiance was well accompanied with jazz music. Look for Matthew Chua as he served us and was extremely helpful with our meals. Keep an eye out for this gem in Melaka and enjoy the dawn of The Base before its ascend to wide-spread presence.Show less

Author: Athirauzir
Title: Mamee Cafe
Review: The Staffs are really helpful and friendly. Good place and food. Highly recommended for families and tourists.

Author: Glenda T
Title: Clean environment
Review: The environment is clean. Staffs are friendly. Food are tasty. Souvenirs are available for selection.

Author: chinv_12Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Ice kacang just ok
Review: it was very hot that day, and I happened to be in front of Mamee and decided to give the place a try.I went to the cafe and ordered ice kacang, small serving and taste just so so. I prefer the ice kacang from street stall next to the canal across from the red church.Show less

Author: OnAJolidaySingapore
Title: Great Mamee dishes, unprofessional staff
Review: Most tables were reserved for a tour group and we took the counter table, not that we minded. But what really irritated us was that one staff ushered us to that seat, awhile later another male staff came over and told us rudely to shift 2 seats to the left because they made adjustment to the reserved seats and there was 2 empty seats in between us, the staff wanted to eliminate the empty seats in between. His approach was rude and unfriendly, and that didn’t go well with us, naturally we declined him. Mamee restaurant should focus more on staff training.On the bright side, the dishes we ordered were pleasantly tasty! Ordered Mamee Mee Goreng Mamak (RM10.80) which came with 2 tender fragrant satay. The other Nasi Lemak Noodles (RM10.40) had wonderfully flavoured noodles which we felt tasty! The fried drumstick was also crispy on the outside and moist on the inside! Highly recommend to order these 2 dishes!Show less

Author: Lynns98816
Title: Workshop for kids
Review: This place is combination of shop, cafe, and workshop. To join the workshop we should buy at least 4 cup noodles (the empty one) and we could choose the flavor and toppings for it. The kids could color the cup by themselves.They also have shop that sells all about Mamee snacks and its variants. We found that the price was a bit expensive, compare to the Giant Supermarket, but the selections were complete.Overall, if you bring kids and have extra time, we suggest you to visit this place. Show less

Author: Vicente8
Title: Marketing and good taste experts
Review: The Malacca’s outlet of Mamee Double Decker, Malaysia’s flagship brand who exports his famous Mamee Monster's noodle cups all over the world. In the middle of touristic Jonker Street, the old shophouse has been converted into a restaurant serving classic Malaysian favorites. The building also includes a museum and other rooms dedicated to public activities like cup noodle making and personalization. The place is quite packed with grown-up Monster fans and their children during weekend and holidays, so we wisely had our lunch in the cafe on a workday. Despite the ubiquitous merchandising and TV screens shooting branded videos, the shophouse has been nicely preserved and the decoration is taking advantage of the original material and natural light. It is clean, spacious and the big kitchen is just behind a long glass window. We nearly felt home, like invited by granny Mamee, which we presumed was the original intention. Service was attentive and fast. Both specialties we ordered – Nasi Lemak and Hainanese Chicken Rice Ball - were nice in many aspects: presentation, ingredient, consistence and taste. The rice balls had a real traditional touch. Portion size were a bit small though, especially the tiny little drum stick with the rice balls. Price was reasonable and aircon was just perfect. Well down!Show less

Author: Anne L
Title: Interesting
Review: Interesting place to visit. Kids would love it. Food are also not bad. Learn about the history of mamee and production of their instant mee

Author: samhisyam
Title: It’s real Mamee
Review: Recommend to get the Laksa Nyonya & Thai Maggi Goreng. It taste exactly like Mamee Seasoning with the spice of individual dishes. Superb!

Author: nikkileonard
Title: great food and service
Review: The workshop is a must do!  The head on downstairs to have a great meal with friendly service.  Definitely a must do while in Melaka.

Author: Bhavin_AthaMumbai, India
Title: Great Laksa
Review: Visited this place on a trip to Melaka. This place looks like an average local dinner but serves up great dishes like the sea food Laksa. We had a great dining experience. Ordered some noodles and desserts too. Quite inexpensive as well. Good fun and must visit here to soak up the local flavor.Show less

Author: Thipa R
Title: Fun!
Review: Bring your little ones here to explore how Mamee was made and learn a little bit of the history behind home grown Mamee brand! They even have noodles making workshop for your little ones!

Author: sufang_25
Title: Visit, learn & eat!
Review: Food is nice and portion is big. Price affordable. I visit Mamee Cafe after workshop Lil Monster Kitchen at 1st floor. It is a very good place to hang out with children. Recommended!

Author: PhoebeL865
Title: Nice food and Cozy Place
Review:
food are good, nice place and friendly staffs. 

i found that the chicken rice ball was quite ok compare to the those specialize restaurant. I do not need to q-up for the food at least.

Author: FrequentFlier660825
Title: Worth it
Review: Its a good cafe for some very nice beverages. The location is good too. Parking is not a problem too.

Author: nroomasHino, Japan
Title: Hidden Gem on Jonker Street
Review: It is located inside the Mamee Jonker House. It is a spacious, very clean cafe with a welcoming atmosphere. Comfortably air-conditioned. The service staff are very nice, and the manager is a very polite and friendly gentleman.We all had the famous chicken rice ball. Unlike some other famous places, we didn't have to stand in line at all. The steamed chicken served was nice and tender, and the rice balls are bigger than that are typically served elsewhere in Melaka; two rice balls are served per one order. The dish was juicy and delicious; the rice was not completely mashed so that I still felt the texture of grain, which I thought was better.This is run by Mamee, and so there are naturally quite a few noodle dishes. They also have cendol, which you can enjoy when you are tired with walking in a hot weather and want to rest in a cool and cozy place. We also appreciated that their washrooms were sparkling clean. The chicken rice ball cost us 10.80 RM plus 6% GST each.Show less

Author: idie Z
Title: Halal Chicken Rice Ball
Review: If you're at jonker street area, you will see a few restaurant / cafe selling chicken rice ball at the line-up is long. Its all at chinese restaurant / cafe and its non-halal. But don't worry, you can find this shop Mamee Jonker House. Once you enter the shop its a merchandise, but do walk in further inside the is a cafe with very cool ambience. The cafe it Halal, there is a halal logo at the door. The chicken rice is nice but it will be nicer if it come with soup.Show less

Author: 771susanaj
Title: Must try
Review: Delicious food in generous portion with considerably cheap price. The staff is friendly and helpful. But sometimes it takes quite some time for the food to come.

Author: sharonbalasingam
Title: Crabs galore
Review: Scrumptious crabs cooked in 3 different styles. Clean ambiance. Friendly and helpful waitresses. Very reasonably priced.

Author: SporeSamSengSingapore
Title: Not bad
Review: For the price of the wanton mee, I feel its worth a try. Laksa beehoon also not bad. The cheese beehoon is OK if you try abit, but not recommended for 1 person to finish even the small portion as after a while you can get sick of the taste. Salted egg sotong not bad.Served by a middle aged lady, looking very neat. Service was good, friendly I must say.Show less

Author: DorisChin
Title: Great zi char
Review: Nice zi chat food, price is moderate, special dish is cheese prawn bee hoon. Was packed when we went on wed night. Recommend to those looking for casual meal with friends and family. Had to wait around 10-20minsfor food to be served

Author: Soon Joo KSingapore, Singapore
Title: A perfect place for family casual dining
Review: Came here with my tour group in September 2019.The cheese prawn bee hoon was simply delicious.It deserves to be the trademark dish of this restaurant.The restaurant is accessible by car and there are parking lots not too far away, if you happen to have no available lots upon arrival.The oyster omelette was also quite delicious and worth ordering.Those who can eat seafood may consider the chilli prawns, but you may need to de-shell them with quite some effort.Will likely come back and try other dishes on the menu, if I should come back to Melaka again.Show less

Author: Sherman O
Title: Eating Alone
Review: I enjoyed my dinner here at Zhong Tai Melaka! This is my second visit. The servers are very friendly and helpful.

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Cheap and friendly
Review: Dined here for a quick late bite to eat - the food is relatively cheap and the staff are friendly. We had noodles, house special egg fried rice, crispy crab/fish cakes, squid and chicken claypot. The chicken in the claypot had a bit of a weird twang to it which put us off a little. Squid and other dishes were nice though. Show less

Author: SungodezzBristol, United Kingdom
Title: Definitely worth a visit
Review: 4:of us ate here on a Tuesday evening, we were seated quickly and served quickly. Only 2 of us could speak the language, which was lucky because our server couldn’t speak English. We ordered 4 noodle meals, jasmine tea and a beer and was served quickly and very efficiently by May - she was very attentive and looked after us very well the whole time. Our drinking cups were always full. The food was hot and very tasty and we had a lovely evening. The bill was very cheap so all in all a win all round. We would definitely dine here again.Show less

Author: myanhmeomeo
Title: very good and delicious
Review: vey nice and delicious, must try this one. I will come back this restaurant. there are many dishes in here

Author: 944angiep
Title: Good and affordable seafood in Thai style
Review: Sea salt baked fish in Thai style. Cheese baked prawns and bee hoon. BBQ pork ribs. Very good seafood selection cooked in Thai style. Lots of food choices in a non aircon restaurant. Will be back again.

Author: bhavani3001Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon and Grilled Fish
Review: We went twice to this place during our short stay in Melaka, quite an accidental find. First time Thursday night, it was really crowded and service was very very slow.Second night was empty and the staff said the customers on thurs night were mainly visitors of the nearby hospital, and Fridays the hospital is closed.Both nights we had the cheese prawn Bee Hoon and grilled fish, which were really good. I’ve never had anything like the cheese prawn Bee Hoon before, it was unique and interesting.The grilled fish was excellent, although it took a long time to prepare. The crispy pork belly was also good.The place is open till very late, so it’s ideal for supper.Show less

Author: Ric333888
Title: Never Ever Visit !!!
Review: Never ever go for this restaurant!!! Was there on the 2nd day of CNY. Reached at 6.30pm and Food Ordered by 7pm. No communication on food delayed during food ordering when restaurant not full. Waited for an hour food still not served. Check with their counter, being informed its coming!! Waited for another 20mins, still being informed in sarcastic manner that the food is coming! By the way, table that came later food served and left. End of the day just walk off. A big No to this restaurant.Show less

Author: phooneyySingapore
Title: Great food worth waiting for!
Review: I am from Singapore. My family of four came here on the second night of Chinese New Year. We were told to wait an hour for the food to arrive, of course we waited, my dad loves chinese food. My Favourite dish here is the Cheese Bee Hoon and Claypot Sliced pork. Two other dishes that we ordered was Tom Yam Soup(the red one) and Kai Lan w roast meat. P. S. This restaurant serves pork !Staff service was great too! She recommended food to us and treat us like family. Ambience, was a little cozy and stuffy because the section where we sat was not air-conditioned. Howevere, there is music playing in the restaurant too and I think is a bonus for me. Price was affordable! We paid RM147.50 in total for 4pax for 4 dishes + a pot of tea. To sum up, you can have a great dinner with your family here if you come to Melaka and this place is highly recommended. This serves as an alternative to Tong Sheng Restoran or Amboi Nyonya which are overcrowded with long queues. Show less

Author: SunshineLeo07
Title: Good Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon
Review: Their cheese prawn bee hoon is a must have. Their salted egg crab is good too but overrated. The place can get crowded and may have to wait long for the food to arrive.

Author: janelleyeo_
Title: Not expensive, yummy
Review: They definitely know how to cook in their spices! Portions are pretty small compared to other Melaka restaurants where the small is more of a medium portion. Very good food! Highly recommend the popular fish, salted egg sotong, and the prawn paste chicken!

Author: DerekH2189Singapore
Title: Terrible food, totally cheated
Review: Seemed a very promising place but Guess I was wrong, never judge a book by its cover and this case, the restaurant by the pictures of the food in the menu. Pasted around the restaurant is recommendation by Trip Advisor. Alas, surely, something went wrong somewhere.I came hungry and tired and just wanted to give this place a try because Thong Seng Restaurant was closed. Ordered the signature dishes, cheese bee hoon and fried pork belly. Terrible terrible mistake. The cheese bee hoon was so so. The pork belly was cold! Surely pre-fried and stored for a long time before being reheated and poured with the sauce before serving to us. The oil from the deep fried pork belly tasted horrible. The salted egg sotong was the ‘bomb’! We were like biting into rubber! Goodness. Never ever have I tasted such badly prepared sotong. The service was so so. When I asked the waitress why is the food so bad, she just ignored me and quickly and conveniently busied herself with other customers, totally ignoring me and avoiding coming too near to our table. Give this place a chance. No way. Please do not visit this place. The experience seriously affected my mood. Show less

Author: pipit78
Title: Good food
Review: Good food with reasonable price, and awesome uncle who made sure we got everything, definitely will come again

Author: MarkS960
Title: zhong Tai
Review: The food and services are averaged. Quite pricy for the seafod dishes. We had spicy crab and it was not fantastic and pricy. The barbecue seafood dish was poor and the prawns not very fresh. The Penang Cha Kway Tiao was too oily.

Author: SimPKSingapore, Singapore
Title: Reasonable priced meal
Review: We had lunch at this coffee shop. A typical eating place located in a suburban like environment. The server advised us to have the small portion serving each of chicken congee, hokien noodle, wat tan hor (flat noodle fried with won ton meat in gravy). The small portion when served was really large and sufficient for one person. The hokien noodle was fried with dark sauce and the noodle appeared black and simmering in hot gravy. All the main entrees were delicious. The Malaysian coffee went well with the meal. To find such a location serving such nice food was really a treasure. Show less

Author: globetrotterCKYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average food
Review: We landed here as Tong Sheng around the corner was not opened for about a week. The cheese beehoon with prawn is alright, unfortunately we did not get to try the crab beehoon as crabs were sold out around 730pm. Whole fish done teochew style was fresh. Show less

Author: Texan CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Breakfast Lunch or Dinner
Review: We were surprised, with the variety & for them to cater to simple mixed vegetable rice to fine finning or even seafood.Ask us what type of a restaurant, Family oriented Restaurant.From a simple bread & coffee to wan tan noodles breakfastLunch could be a mix vegetable (30 type of dishes) choice.Dinner can be arranged a fine dinning with seafood & Roasted Pig in advance bookings.Ending up with a bill to pleasantly surprise you.Show less

Author: cmkoh
Title: Underwhelming
Review:
We ordered their recommended dishes and all of them tasted only so-so. Probably why they have no queue as compared to the other restaurants nearby. Prices are a bit on the high side too.

A miss.

Author: I_S_B_L_o
Title: Unique cheese prawn mee hoon
Review: Cheese Prawn Mee Hoon is the best! The salted egg tofu is also great! Service is good & quick. Cleanliness is not too bad.

Author: Tay-SherdanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great meal!
Review: I was quite turned off by the Long Q outside Tong Sheng and decide to try this restaurant. It ended up to be an excellent idea! My family of 6pax ordered 2 crabs- 1 salted and 1 Chilli, cheese prawn bee Hoon, 1 veg dish, 1 marmite pork ribs. All tasted excellent! We sat in the aircon area and ordered drinks as well. There is a green Apple mixed with some other fruit, the drink is light n refreshing! Prompt service, good food! Save all the queueing. All add up RM310. Show less

Author: SShanghaiSydney, Australia
Title: Great crabs
Review: This place was ideal for dinner. You pick your crab live from the tank and then choose the sauce for your crab. The restaurant has a really nice relaxed and local feeling. The pricing is good and the service was efficient given the restaurant was very busy on Saturday night. Definitely for me a good highlight whilst in Melaka. Show less

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Worth to try
Review: Ok I tried Tong Seng before. So let me do some comparison. I personally prefer Zong Tai. Their cheese beehoon smell good n yummy. The crab is fresh. U are allow to choose the live crab u like and they will weight in front of you so u dont have to worry being cheated. But unfortunately I choose the wrong flavors. The lady said will make the chili crab less spicy however is still very spicy that I can't enjoy my crabs though I can really take spicy. Guess melaka influence by nyonya that why non spicy is = spicy. Less spicy is = very spicy. Their spicy is = mala sichuan spicy. This is based on other restaurant that I tried .  Ok back to Tong Seng the cheese beehoon is too cheesy that feel bit too much and the crab is expensive and u don't get to see the weight of the crab. Show less

Author: uncle_sim123
Title: Nice Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon
Review:
10 mins walk from Hatten hotel. 
Cheese Prawn Bee Hoon (rm$35) must try. 
Hoclick prawn not so nice because not crispy. 
Will come again to try more dishes. 
Quite packed. But no long queue.

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: There is better food and service around
Review: We wanted a change from a few nights of Nyonya food. The crab tank and menu looked promising. The restaurant was half-full. We ordered a deep fried fish which was ok, long beans in garlic which were full of large garlic pieces but not much taste and a steamed tofu with salted egg yolk which never even arrived despite asking for it. The waitress looked helpless, walked to the counter and never returned. Finally we decided to settle the bill. At least the item was not on it. Overall disappointing.Show less

Author: Christopher L
Title: A local eatery with great variety of fresh hawker food as well as seafood
Review: Walked past this eatery at 10.30pm in search of supper and it's still very busy. The prawn beehoon is awesome at rm35. It's uniquely Melaka. The crabs are also very popular but we didn't order as we are just looking for a quick supper. The century egg chicken and vegetables and steamed salted egg egg with soya beancurd are very local taste and absolute delicious. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: Raymond K
Title: Caution here
Review: Booked, selected and ordered crabs and specials at this restaurant early. Thot that was the proper thing to do. Arrived 10 minutes before booking time. First the fried rice tasted funny, found out they used vegetarian char siew. Then the salted egg crab arrived. Waited and waited for my other baked crabs. Finally after getting annoyed, and asked them, was told my selected earlier crabs went to another table. Can anyone believe that story? They subsituted with two more crabs. By the way they also forgot about my cheese prawn noodles. Goodbye to that.First and last visit.Just be careful if you visit.Show less

Author: nsujeet
Title: Cheez Prawn must try food
Review: Just had cheez prawn, lady finger. Amazing cheese prawn. Must try. Not so expensive. Other dishes we try was lady finger. For frink their special guava mix juice is good.

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good old classic wanton mee
Review: We ordered the cheese bee hoon here one night during our stay in melaka. Compared to the famous tong sheng, the bee hoon here tasted more cheesy. But lacked the wok hei found at tong sheng!This place serves breakfast too and I love their wanton mee. No frills but tasty!Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Re Visited
Review: After reviewing this restaurant last year on 16th Feb 2016 last year, I thought I will review it again. I noticed that they are now recognized by Trip Advisor as a recommendend restaurant.They now also provide free Wi-Fi for customers dining there.Open at 7am daily for breakfast till close to 12 midnight, this place draws different crowds from the breakfast uncles to office attire lunch workers and tourists in the evening. Menu provide a wide variety of food which includes their popular cheese mee hoon to salted or milk cooked crabs. However, this round only have the opportunity to try their wan tan noodles. Noodles tasted ok with the 'qq' or so called springy bite texture which was good. The only bug bear was the char siew (roasted pork slices) which was a little tough for my liking. Overall ambience like most coffee shop restaurant around malaysia. Music from local radio was provided and place is spacious and clean. Located just across The Strait's and Novetel Hotel, Zhong Tai provides ample parking right at their doorstep.Do place parking coupons as traffic wardens are quite active.But parking coupons can be bought from Zhong Tai friendy female cashier. Overall improvements has been made since last year but could be done even better. Show less

Author: 155freddyt
Title: Thumbs up!
Review:
Do not miss this, must try!
Delicious, reasonable price and friendly services!

Seafood are fresh, the source of prawn rice noodle, dry curry chicken and their chef made asam chillie are simply irresistible!

Author: aarono364Singapore
Title: Nice food with reasonable price
Review: This restaurant is just within 100m of the famous Tong Seng restaurant. We went to tong Seng restaurant and was told that we have to queue for at least 2hrs to be able to order food so we decided to try this restaurant instead as they also specialize in shrimp cheese bee hoon. We do not have to queue for this restaurant and surprisingly the food is delicious and we are glad that we did not spend hours waiting at tong Seng. Staff are friendly and efficient. We ordered 6 dishes for a family of five which included a steamed fish and the shrimp cheese bee hoon and it only cost us 210myr. We find the price very reasonable for a delicious meal like this. Show less

Author: visitor080808
Title: The worst food in Melaka
Review:
Visited this restaurant yesterday with 4 other friends.
Their so called seafood platter was all cheap frozen items with no flavour. 
The food was flavourless, service was very bad and it took ages to get the bill which was inflated to a touristic price.

Author: watertaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Poor Service, Average Food
Review: Went here as Thong Seng around the corner had a long line of people. Service was quite messed up. Had to constantly remind the non-English/Mandarin service staff for chilli, additional drinks, cutleries, etc. Melaka is the home of good local food, and this restaurant doesn't quite match the standards of the other restaurants. Tried the signature Cheese Bee Hoon with Mini-Lobster, first time trying this dish, so nothing to compare to. Pretty expensive for average food.Show less

Author: obscuresunshineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Last Minute Decision Worth It
Review: We were walking around and saw their menu advertising their Cheese Prawn Noodles - decided to just try it. We had 7 pax and luckily we were there early enough that they still had seats, upon their recommendation we ordered the grilled fish (RM38 for a small) - extremely good and quite a big fish We also ordered the marmite pork, qi long vegetable, salted egg tofu and prawn paste chickenOverall the service was excellent and the food is really good!Show less

Author: tomaaaaaatoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Bad service attitude and not that cheap
Review: Settled for this because the other one was packed. Food was average, but the lead/boss attitude sucked.Ordered their "special" cheese prawn Mee Hoon. Taste was ok, but gelat (Malay for full because of a certain richness from oil/cheese/butter), prawns were 5 halves, not full prawns, so ingredients abit lacking. A green vegetables which was ok, and pork deep fried with fermented beans. Taste for pork was decent, but half the plate of pork was PURE FATS. Not even a shred of meat. When I brought this up, the lead/owner had the cheek to say, oh we serve the dish like this...(see picture of proof of the dish). If the service had been a tad better maybe they would wrangle a 3 out of me. There's a reason why there isn't a queue for this so called "restaurant" and I now understand why. Damage was 75rm.Show less

Author: Michellelimmy1217
Title: Service bad, bad food taste and oily, and expensive with low quality
Review: The cashier did not communicate and inform earlier that the hee kiaw mee has only one option of noodle which is yellow mee. During payment i requested for kuey teow option and cashier say ok. After the food serve they told me there is only one option which is fatty yellow mee. They refuse to change. The taste is bad and the fishball is artificial and taste like plastic. This is first and the last time for me to visit this shop. The food taste bad but expensive. They use cheap and low quality material. The mee soup bowl crack. The floor full of wet tissue and food residue. It is not recommended to visit this shop.Show less

Author: Arthur Elfin CSingapore, null, Singapore
Title: Wanton noodles is good
Review: Take out lunch @ Zhong Tai Don't be deceived by the plain look of this wanton mee! The egg noodles were springy with a good texture. The sauce was piquant unlike those in SG that are normally mixed in ketchup. The wantons are nice too but quite small. The roast pork that came with the noodles were a little dry and wasn't succulent. But for SGD 2, there's absolutely nothing to complain about! A second helping anytime! Bonus: The cashier was honest. I misheard her and gave her (a lot) more but she corrected me and returned the money.Show less

Author: youke_worldwideSingapore
Title: Breakfast Wan ton
Review: So this place under the restaurant is like a food stall but it's actually run by the restaurant. It opens at 7am but when we came there wasn't the people and completely emptying - so the atmosphere felt so-so . Even then they got our orders confused. Sigh ! The Wan ton was okay - I thought it was a bit light on the taste but my friend thought the sauce was just right. Show less

Author: 865yvonnek
Title: Good Food & Excellent Service
Review: Just an impromptu choice and definitely with no regret. Was attended to almost immediately. Only 2 of us and we were like at a lost to order. The lady was full of patience and try to recommend their top seller. Ended that we only wanted the baked/grilled fish, she was nice to inform us that this dish need to wait 40mins. But she recommended us a veggi and their super nice fried pork to go with our beer while waiting. Truly enjoyed the dinner ...Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Food
Review: We have our dinner at the Zong Tai restaurant in Melaka Raya tonite (8 April).. This is the fourth time we have our dinners there. This time we have salt-egg crabs, slice pork meat and stir fried vege for two of us..There are a varieties of food in the menu to choose. For budget food there is also an array of pre-cooked dishes for selection. Show less

Author: robertlimSingapore, Singapore
Title: Normal Dishes
Review: The restaurant is located along Jalan Melaka Raya 3 and can be found easily. As we were there during 2nd day of Chinese New Year, the restaurant was crowded and orders taking was slow. Food was not well prepared and got to wait a long time for each dishes to be served.Show less

Author: Mic W
Title: Not up to par
Review: Had high hopes for this place as we were walking by. Unfortunately disappointing. Perhaps it was over CNY, but our food came out one by one in 15 to 20 min intervals. Had the cheese prawn meehun, the black pepper crab and chicken stock frog legs. The overarching theme is overcooked. The prawns in the cheese sauce was dry. The sauce was ok. The crab was very disappointing. The black pepper flavour was not evident. The sauce was very sweet. And the crab was overcooked and dry, even though it was live. Wouldn't go again.Show less

Author: ShawngohysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good dinner location
Review: Zhong Tai is a good seafood restaurant near to Estadia Hotel. The price is reasonable with crabs selling at around RM$ 128/kg. We had our dinner then costing to around slightly less than RM$ 300 at the end. For those who have not tried before, you can also go for the Thai baked fish. We ordered too much therefore had to give that up this time round. Show less

Author: Andonjt
Title: Cheese prawn bee hoon
Review:
Tried the beehoon at both Zhong Tai and the famous Tong Sheng. 

I personally liked a Zhong Tai more as they are much more flavourful and the fragrance is so much stronger.

Author: Aikhong
Title: GOOD ENOUGH PRAWN CHEESE BEE HOON
Review:
The prawn cheese bee hoon here is not bad though the one at Tong Sheng is a tad tastier.
However, I like the Tom Yam soup here. It is fresh and as spicy as the authentic one should be.

Author: summerkopiteaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Cheese Beehoon
Review: Everyone says to try Tong Sheng Cheese Bee Hoon. I guess if you don't mind waiting for at least an hour.. else I feel Zhong Tai is just as good. The staff is also friendlier and smiling despite the dinner crowd. I tried their prawn cheese bee hoon (small size was RM37.50) and I like it. Even my husband who is not a cheese person was also impressed.Show less

Author: Nickolas H
Title: Pretty Good
Review: Tried dinner here and was pleasantly surprised by cheese prawn bee hoon and some other dishes recommended by staff. Did not try salted baked fish cos the wait was relatively long (45 minutes). Price was reasonable~

Author: Michelle P
Title: Excellent food and service
Review: Have eaten a few times now, can't fault the service or food. And prices are reasonable also. Definitely eat here again and again

Author: AS_WongHong Kong, China
Title: nice place
Review: went there two nights in a row for dinner. ate the crabs and fish plus a few other dishes for just two of us. That shows how delicious the food were and at a very affordable price too. Spent less than 300RM per night when we had about 1.2kg of crab, a fish and two or three other dishes. Of special mention is the green dragon veg. Show less

Author: Eng Wee C
Title: Crabs @ 98 to 128 per/kg
Review: come early for economy food, porridge  almost finnished. when I was there only crabs and Tilapia fish avbl.other fishes not avbl. good price for small portion. value for money if coming in a group larger than 4 persons

Author: InnekeH
Title: Taste is average, near estadia/hatten hotel
Review:
Ordered sour spicy crab, bittergourd soup, paku pakis stir fry, grilled fish in thai style. Price is not expensive, however taste are not fantastic.

It's an open foodcourt/hawker.

Author: tpshSingapore
Title: Fresh seafood & good food
Review: Chanced upon this seafood restaurant, located near Hatten Square, opposite Ee Ji Ban chicken rice, same block as the Starbucks coffee joint at the corner.We ordered 2 sour and spicy medium crabs with 4 fried buns, 1 small veggie, 1 Malaysian Hokkien mee, 1 small Thai style grilled fish for a total of RM $189 for 2 pax.Taste has the "wok hay" and delicious.Waitress gave us the recommendations of the dishes and even helped us to de-bone the fish. Thank you for going the extra mile for us! We didn't expect her to do that. Worth trying. Show less

Author: win2motJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Reasonable price
Review: I came across to this restaurant as I stayed at Estadia Hotel. The place is within walking distance and the price is reasonable! It is a self-service restaurant and the foods vary from vegetables, chicken, pork etc. I took two plates for only RM 9. Since I'm Indonesian, the taste of the food just fine because of the similarities. I recommend this restaurant if you want to save your money more on food and spend more on sightseeing. Show less

Author: mengzaiSingapore
Title: Dinner with family
Review: Ordered 2 crabs & cereal prawn as my seafood choice. was disappointment that the crab meat quality was bad. meat was soft & crab claw have very little meat. prawn meat quality was bad. meat was soft with no texture.other dishes was only so so. 南乳炸肉 was over cooked & meat was tough.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Zhong Tai Restaurant
Review: Have tried this restaurant out of curiosity as it is located in the middle of Melaka Raya 3. Opened from 7am till 11pm. this restaurant caters for tourist and local workers working nearby. They do have a wide variety of dishes especially for lunch compared to the rest of the economical food stores. Food however is average but freshly cooked daily. Have spoken to the boss and found out that Antz bar and another local massge centre belongs to them. Do try their spicy and sour chilli crab which is tasty and also their signature Toufu with pork.. Prices are inexpensive.and location is very convenient to Hatten or Estadia hotelShow less

Author: jesuisenamourez
Title: Contemporary Vegan friendly and organic restaurant
Review: Found this place by accident and realised it’s by the same owner behind Lutan 21. The food here is quite affordable and towards Malaysian cuisine. Love the spicy noodles and fried bitters round with brown rice vermicelli. Friendly servers

Author: zalnikor
Title: Nice Chinese Vegetarian Restaurant
Review: Worth the visit if your in the area. Tried a nice Nyoman curry noodle dish. Had there dumplings which were fried  should have had just boiled ones. Oh well. Also tried the red bean dessert,nothing special. Their other restaurants Lutan21, is better in my opinion.

Author: Jodiejemo
Title: The best organic food
Review: Was impressed by the taste of the food from restaurant. The taste is absolutely different compare with others that I've visited previously. I'll definitely come back.

Author: simonwong88Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Kuchabe Taman Desa, Kuala Lumpur
Review: A few buddies of mine decided to dine @ Kuchabe Taman Desa branch in Kuala Lumpur. We were trying some new menu to us ala vegetarian. Surprisingly, the food tasted delicious & the kopi got oomph (the real kick in coffee taste). Must try the kampung styled fried rice & the pumpkin barley drink. Well worth our time to visit this outlet. Thumbs up Show less

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Healthy Meals
Review: As I seldom take vegetarian nor organic food, this restaurant has not let me down. When I stepped into it, it reminded me much of Vege Planet (a vegetarian restaurant in Melaka Raya). Infact, there is a connection! I recognised Louis at the counter, as he was from the previous restaurant. Parking space ample and the restaurant faces Terra Nova Hotel (across the main road).Loved the mixed traditional and modern interior decos and table setting with some touches of olden days' stuff. Clean, high ceiling and cosy. I was admiring one side of the wall, neatly displayed used printing plates. I also loved the olden day wooden larders where they placed the extra bowls and accessories which the customers can help themselves.Service was efficient although had one waiter and another at the the counter. Menu was given upon seated and customers will write their own orders. Food served was fast. I have tasted the Kuchabe Salted Tea (Lei Char) and the second visit, I ordered the Chincai. Its Tomyam Fried Rice. Food tasty and presentation good too. Loved the way they presented their food using chinese or baba nyonya tablewares. Feels at home too!!Staff friendly and I will return again!Show less

Author: tpLong
Title: Vegetarian
Review: Restaurant with nice ambiance and unique decor with traditional dishes.  Food taste is okay for me, however, it will be good choice for organic food lovers.

Author: 2632Lee
Title: One if the best vegetarian stall I've ever tasted
Review: Hakka porridge is my top choice because the various side toppings to go along with the porridge was actually similar to those Teo Chew porridge. Natural flavour coming from the fresh ingredients are essentially bringing the ying&yang taste.

Title: Delicious food & excellent environment
Review: A modern approach to the traditional food in Malaysia. Great ambience with the presence of old school windows as well as wooden benches with marble table.

Review: Nice and tasty vegetarian food. Setting is cosy. Recommend to try. Inside make me feel comfortable. I like it👍🏻

Title: Delicious food and nice food presentation
Review: Vegetarian restaurant with delicious meal and nice food presentation. No onion and garlic. Worth to come again.

Author: CaroLynn128Calgary, Canada
Title: Fantastic food
Review: Love this place. Service was prompt and good. There was only one guy taking orders, serving tables and cleaning the tables but boy was he fast and efficient.Food served was fresh and tasty. There was a good selection of food and drinks variety to suit everyone in our group of 6. The place was very clean and inviting. Decor was tasteful with an old world charm.Show less

Review: We liked this restaurant for the fresh fish and nice staff. Fish are in tanks and as fresh as you can get. Just out the city center with huge car park. We had lobster and shrimps all well cooked.

Author: John-C_EWSingapore
Title: One of my new favourite Melaka Satay places
Review: It was Recommended by a local when we were visiting Melaka using the VTL agreementI Love Melaka Savoury style pork satay… wish it was available in Singapore too. For RM1 you get a well marinated and relatively thick cut of meat. Still quite juicy and had quite a good char. Ming Sate which I also love has more char but it also resulted in slightly drier meat and their meat not as thickSuukee also has a more expensive pork belly version but I couldn’t really taste that signature savoury flavour of Melaka Satay.. so I will still stick to the normal satayUnfortunately we couldn’t try the chendol cos it was a Tuesday and we went too early when they just open …coconut milk haven’t delivered yet.Another plus point is easy to find and A lot of parking car lots availableShow less

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: So-so satay, but forget about service
Review: We were recommended to try the satay here. Prices range from $1.00 per stick upwards. Onions and cucumber slices are charged separately. The waitress approaches the table, pen and order sheet ready, stands by the table to pressure you to order. We ordered six different types.Fifteen-twenty minutes later (we were their only customer), the waiter brings our order and plonks the plate on the table and walks away.The satay taste was ok, but portions are small and tasted abit too dry. We wanted to order vendor, but the staff members seem too busy chatting among themselves to notice us. We did not want to interrupt their gossiping party!Went up to settle the bill..cashier comes up, punches in the orders made, presents to bill without a word. I paid, she takes the money, puts it into the cash register, turns around, and walks away.Staff need not attend charm school. But some basic training on manners and customer service would be helpful.Show less

Author: Makan_Tidor
Title: Come here for the cendol
Review: Not as great as reviewed, the pork meat, intestines and liver are over grilled and dry, gravy is decent with a hint of pineapple sweat and soreness; cendol is good for Melaka standard, way better than a lot of those touristy stalls..

Author: SLL36
Title: Refreshing new satay place.
Review:
Refreshing new satay place.
