Meat was ok though sauce can improve but it’s ok and clean as fairly newly developed location.

Author: Destan2010
Title: Hainanese satay
Review: Good hainanese satay located in a new business area. Need to grab over from the old town area. The satay is nice with nice mixture of pineapple and peanut spicy gravy.

Author: tck90823
Title: Comfortable place for satay
Review: Nice place for satay. There is aircon which differ from other satay shop. The pork satay was nice and worth coming.

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Satay for Tea Time
Review: Easy location as its just by the main road with ample parking spots outside the restaurant. Had it for tea and the restaurant was not busy. Upon entering the shop, I smelt something unpleasant. Cant figure it out but my nose soon got used to it. I was expecting to smell the burned fragrance of satay. The walls could have more photos of satays and its old establishment.A female order taker whom I mistaken as local has some slang in her speech. The menu looked confusing to me when she explained it. Finally, ordered what I wanted and requested my cendol dessert to be served last.Menu was basically individualised item and priced separately. Would be better to have a set of satay with ketupat and cucumber. The intestine was soft, chicken and pork were just average. Preferred more charred. Cucumbers and onions were fresh. Rice was also on the soft side.Cendol, the green stuff was fresh and yumi but once it contacted with the ice, it hardened. Overall acceptable, but more santan and gula melaka will be great.Satays were $0,90 per stick, ketupat was $1.40 per piece, Cucumbers+onions at $1.00 per serving and Cendol at $5.80. Total amount was $19.00. I still prefer my satay at food courts.Show less

Author: SueySingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Satay in aircon comfort
Review: Good for snack and escape from the heat. We had the chicken satay, intestine satay, pork belly satay and otak. The sauce (peanut with pineapple) was a tad too sweet and would be better w a bit more peanut. Satay was good though the chicken was too lean and would be nicer with a bit of fat. Cucumber and onion charged. Good and friendly service.Show less

Author: ericy160
Title: Afternoon Snacks
Review: I’ve order a full house set of satay, mmm delicious specially this mouthwatering Cendol Melaka it’s a must to have..

Author: Hannah CPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Best cendol in Melaka
Review: We had the pork, chicken and pork belly satay, otak otak and the ketupat and onion and cucumber. The pork and chicken satary were great, the pork belly satay not so nice. The otak otak was really good. Cendol here was the best we've had in Melaka, we even came back on the way back to KL just to tapau the satay and have the cendol once again before going home. The cendol is just the right consistency and creaminess and sweetness.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Second Time Review
Review: I was here when they began operation few years back end now I an here again. Satay chicken is marinated but a little salty for my taste, however, pork satay was ok. This round I have ordered otak to go along. Tasted also a little salty too. Their pineapple satay sauce remains as good as before. Overall, I think they still maintain their standards like before. Worth a try if you are tired of Nonya food in Melaka for a change Show less

Author: phoebet546
Title: Air conditioning and comfy
Review: This satay shop is air conditioned and has a bit of an "atas" set up compared to most satay shops / stalls in Melaka. The good thing about this is, it makes eating satay enjoyable minus the heat. Parking is convenient too.

Author: KTCathy
Title: Centrally Located
Review: Famous for the sauce with pineapple in it. Tried the pork and chicken one, tastes good but still not as good as machap baru, still for the distance suukee is a good choice.

Author: teenagesab_87
Title: Hainanese Treasure
Review: By Malacca Hainanese Satay family, authentic and in a different experience now. Love the sauce and the satay!!!

Author: sheronlee
Title: Not Bad
Review: The restaurant is rather new and comfortable. The satay (chicken and pork) are tasty and succulent. However, the sauce is not to my liking.

Author: MELAKABAGUSSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good but still not the best
Review: Place is new row of shop houses, henceforth, parking and traffic is kinder to the soul.Ordered 20 sticks of chicken and and 20 sticks pork satay. It was tender, juicy and fresh, but not the best though.Had 2 bowls gravy. It wasnt spicy but we liked it a lot.Would come again.Show less

Author: Kelly NSingapore
Title: Yummy satay and have repeated the order half way
Review: We read the review on TripAdvisor and have decided to try it. We ordered chicken and pork satay 10 sticks each. One Ketupat (Malay rice dumpling) and some cucumber and onions (yes u need to order, not complimentary).We have repeated the order when we ate it half way as we found it is yummy. Not much fat found in the satay, which I really like. The satay gravy also very yummy and it won't make you thirsty too (meaning it is without or with very minimum MSG).Service is not bad but can be better and they should give complimentary cucumber and onions.We will go back again.Show less

Author: IchigoKurosaki55
Title: Nice satay in clean env
Review: Very nicely done satay, especially the intestine, pork and chicken  .. in clean Abd cooling env .. the satay sauce is extremely good .. pls keep it up!

Author: Culture696745
Title: Satay Party
Review: Its more than pork and chicken satay, we had "spare parts" like pork intestines and liver, chicken gizzards. Visited many times before and not disappointed once yet. Airconditioned but just right so as to not chill the satay.

Author: LGohMelaka
Title: Unforgettable Satay!!
Review:
Had many many sticks of the yummy and most important tender pork satay!!

Peanut sauce hot and very nice

Place - Air cond and lots of parking

Author: lc0ngMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Satay
Review: Best place for satay for its ambiance. The place is new and air conditioned. Ease of parking. Nice presentation of food. Run by 2nd generation using traditional recipe, The satay is excellent and u can request it to be grilled well done or otherwise. Generous supply of pineapple satay source upon request. Using traditional Ketupat not the plastic wrapped Ketupat. For hygiene, the satay sticks are never recycled. Just about 10 sen extra per stick compare to other satay stalls and u stand to enjoy the above. I love it.Show less

Author: didoz85
Title: Loving the satay here!
Review: Lots of meat in 1 stick of satay. Sauce is yummy. Will be good if they provide free cucumbers and onions (currently priced at $1 per small bowl).

Author: wengshengl
Title: Best satay in Malacca
Review: The taste is unforgettable, and luring me to order and order again. Pork satay taste better with its pineapple satay sauce. Its chicken satay is also one of the best in the shop. Its soft, juicy and tender one. The perfect taste with comfortable environment make me enjoy the night much!!! Its a must visit place in Malacca Show less

Author: Chee Mun C
Title: Yummie!
Review:
Nice place. Clean, not oily, not smokey and comfortably cool. There are high chairs for children too!

People are friendly and polite, and of course, they serve YUMMIE satay! Two thumbs up!

Author: donaldyeow
Title: a truly malacca taste satay
Review: when ever I got visitor from outstation, Suukee Satay will be one of our destination ! Simply cause we love the taste of traditional satay !

Author: Cheehau
Title: Authentic Hainanese Satay
Review: The new concept satay outlet, probably the first in Melaka gives you clean and comfortable environment to enjoy the hainanese satay. The ideal mixture of pineapple and peanuts sauce (secret recipes) makes perfect satay sauce. The satays were broiled on special selected charcoal to ensure best bbq texture and quality. Must try! Show less

Author: OccasiontravellerPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Finally a perfect place to enjoy Hainanese satay
Review: i must say although i crave for hainanese pork satay till i always made an effort to indulge in it everytime I'm in malacca, i hated the atmosphere. The restaurants i went before have no air con and often they bbq the satay in front of the open air restaurants. everytime i ended up smelly and hot no matter how tasty the satay. We visited suukey today after one of our regular shop is full house and what a blessing in disguise.Satay is as good as those i had before. We ordered 50 sticks but ended up walloping double of it. best thing is, its air con and no oily smoke. Service was fast. Every top up came within minutes. Glad i found this place. Although it may be a bit more expensive 90sen per stick, but we enjoyed every bit of it. Show less

Author: LaksamanaKiagos
Title: Nice Reasonable Priced
Review: Craving for Asam Pedas Melaka and was introduced to this old school type restaurant near our hotel. Ordered Asam Pedas Stingray, Beef Stripes and Fush Roe. All come with a plate of rice, simple vegetable and salted egg. The verdict is HEAVEN. Hightly recomended.

Author: DESERT_DESHKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The Original Asam Pedas Claypot
Review: The Original Asam Pedas Claypot started from this Chinese Malay couple. I have been to this restaurant many times over the last 2 decades. However, the quality and taste of the food has dropped down and the price has been increased. The order taker wasn’t focused and need to repeat the orders few time and yet a wrong item was sent. I believe he must be a new staff or a part timer. But, can be improved.Manage to have few words with the lady owner. As per her, all her children’s are helping in the business. Noticed the crowd are still there regardless locals or tourists. Hope the quality of the food and price can look into it. This place is still recommended,,,Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Taste ok, a tad expensive
Review: Alfresco dining. Service is fast. Taste is not as hot probably moderated to suit general palate. Its a tad expensive. They don’t issue receipt: left you wondering if you have paid the right price or if you have been fleeced or they add up wrongly. I wish the authorities enforce where it matters.Show less

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Just average
Review: Went there after noticing that there were numerous reviews.Unique presentation in claypot but gravy was too salty.There were a variety of fish to choose from.However our preference of jenahak was not available so we picked tenggiri which was not the right choice.Fish was not tasty though meaty.Overall dinner was not up to our expectations.Not likely to visit again.Lots of seating both inside and outside.Service was good.No problem with car park.Show less

Author: sisetantedd
Title: went to asam pedas claypot
Review: went to asam pedas claypot at Kota Laksamana . order ikan jenahak asam pedas , personally i think this is not the best asam pedas in town . the taste is sour and less of spices . 2/5 ⭐️⭐️

Author: jacqui c
Title: Loved it
Review: We decided to try the claypot and was surprised at how lovely it was. The staff were helpful in choosing which one to have as we had never had one before. Was not busy as we went on Monday night. We will go back.

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Alfresco.
Review: Ambience: its not a fancy restaurant. Just tables on the street carpark vacated upon sundown. Locals throng the place because the place adopts standard transparent pricing. Not a tourist trap. So if you want to taste the local asam pedas (hot sourish herbs soup that comes with your preferred selection: meatballs, stingray, mackerel), minus all frills, this is the place. Show less

Author: petgroominc
Title: Where the locals eat
Review: Halal Malaysian favs served here. Pick and pay self serve. Good Malay food with wide variety of spicy diahes of seafood, meats and vegs

Author: Danesh714
Title: Awesome
Review: Varies choices of food,the special thing ia the asam pedas claypot.. It served in claypot,so it taste could be abit different. .. Strategic places,so someone who still seaching where to eat after walking around banda hilir,go here 😁

Author: zaharullailKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Quite Expensive
Review: We bought two type asam pedas fish. The price more than RM50 excluding rice and drink. Very expensive and its not worth it and not affordable. Try find other places because this area is favourite for the tourist. Therefore price always increase as an advantage and less choices.Show less

Author: Nazura AKL
Title: Not the real asam pedas Melaka
Review: The sauce is not thick enough and the fish/fish head tasted bland. I guess they must have cooked the fish/fish head separately from the sauce. I have tried other shops for asam pedas in Melaka and this shop is not as good as others. I will recommend Selera Kampung & Hajah Rahmah asam pedas. Far better than Claypot shopShow less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Other better ones available
Review: Went to this Asam Pedas shop as the one we wanted to go to was close. This shop also sells roti canai besides asam pedas. We can choose the type of fish you want, either pari, tenggiri or kembong. I also chose not to have rice but roti canai. I felt that there were many much better asam pedas shops around Melaka. The asam pedas gravy was too sour for my liking and the roti canai was just average. Choose another asam pedas shop for better options.Show less

Author: ISZISMAEL
Title: A must try!
Review:
One of the best choices of asam pedas in the city centre of Melaka.

Try their asam pedas pari, tenggiri and tetel.

Avoid going on weekends as it will be supercrowded.

Author: PebblesJetsonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem a stone's throw away from the touristy side
Review: So glad we discovered this place this time around. It's a world away from the touristy Jonker & Jalan Tan Cheng Loke and is in the residential part of town just behind them. The assam pedas is a nice balance of spicy and sour, and not sweet at all, and the sambal belacan that comes with it was the bext part of the meal tbh. There are a few choices of fish - kembung, tenggiri, pari etc, and the set comes with rice, salted egg, sambal belacan and cabbage. We went on a Saturday night and the place was packed and it took awhile to wait for a table to be vacated. At 8.45, they had to turn people away as they ran out of food. Brisk business indeed. Also tried the roti John sardin and the otak-otak.Show less

Author: aareadha
Title: Less than expectation
Review: The service was quite fast even they got a lot of customers. However, the taste of asam pedas is less than my expectation. Affordable price. Asam Pedas comes with rice, telur masin, and sayur kobis.

Author: EusoffCasperSingapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: Heard by many it was a must-go. To me, so-so. One kind of food for asam pedas but you can choose your fish. But you cant choose your veggie or your sides. Price is also overrated. Environement was not as clean and service was above average. But luckily the asam pedas was good.Show less

Author: pamtjhSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average food, language barriers
Review: Went there for supper as it was late and was one of the few eateries still open. Ordering food was difficult as the menu was written on a white board in Malay and the waiter could not speak English. Would suggest to have a picture or English menu for tourists. We had the Assam pedas and Mee goreng (fried noodles) which were average, not overly spicy.Show less

Author: n_haniShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Delicious!
Review: it was a rainy day yet still pack with customers. luckily we manage to get seat inside. We had asam pedas pari, asam pedas jenahak, chicken & beef satay, and otak-otak. Asam pedas pari doesn't meet my expectation but asam pedas jenahak was simply delicious! The satay was not bad but the peanut sauce just so-so.Show less

Author: Da Y
Title: Hustle bustle eating spot..
Review:
Took advice from a friend,so we decided to give a try.. As usual the asam pedas fish and chicken were just ok.. We also ordered sate, which tje gravy was sooo weird?. 
Place also very packed with high turnover..

Author: HockLye
Title: Packed
Review: Which means it’s good, but a little salty. I especially like the fish roe and the salted egg that came with the rice. They also have the usual fried noodles, rice, satay, otah, roti canal, roti John and burgers.

Author: gracep1572
Title: Late night supper
Review:
Overall good experience 
Order 1 ikan pari set, 1 ikan kembong set and one telur ikan plus 3 drinks less than RM50..
Nice asam pedas

Author: shazzana
Title: Reminds me of Nenek’s Asam Pedas
Review: One taste of the asam pedas ikan pari (sting ray) took me back instantly to my late grandma’s asam pedas! Went at about 6pm on a Wednesday evening and it was quite a laid back atmosphere. We paid RM33 for 2 asam pedas ikan pari sets, an omelette and 3 drinks. Show less

Author: Thumb_rangerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Melaka, alternative for food
Review: If you are sick of the tourist areas for meals, do try a visit Kota Laksamana. This is a hawker Center located about 1.5km away from the Melaka city and you will certainly need to have your own set of wheels to get here. If you are relying on Google maps (as I am), set your destination for Kensington Western Fusion Restaurant. Kota Laksamana will be within sight.Dining is free sitting, possibly at an open area. You will be treated to an array of some 30-40 stalls serving local delights at a fraction of what you will pay in a city restaurant. My own favourite is the Hokkien noodles whipped up at PJ Botak, cooked over a charcoal stove. Other food served includes Wanton Noodles, Yong Tau Foo, grilled seafood/fish, friend oysters. Show less

Author: DRamedyAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Best asam pedas still
Review: I've probably tried all the asam pedas restaurants in Malacca including this place and none bring me memories like the one at Asam Pedas Pak Man, Ujong Pasir. So for travellers and tourists, don't waste your time, just head to Pak Man's, no regrets, just tears coz it'll be spicy.Show less

Author: FaizulRuslan
Title: not bad
Review: quite crowded especially during weekends. price is bit pricey depends on the type of fish u choose. the taste is okay but not consistent maybe depends on who is preparing the dish. the waiter is not friendly.

Author: smk d
Title: KL asam pedas
Review: Good asam pedas, good under d tree atmosphere, amazing asam pedas accoording to tourist, kinda good according to locals

Author: Jaimi a
Title: Superb Asam Pedas
Review: This restaurant serving the best Asam pedas in melaka I have been so far. Suitable for all ages of Asam pedas fans.

Author: butterscotchiesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty but rude boss!
Review: I came for dinner with a whole troop of my relatives during the EidulAdha festive, as many eateries were closed. Feeling all excited when we found this place, we split into 2 long tables that the staffs efficiently laid out for us. The next minute, a man (whom later we found out was the boss) took our orders but spoke hurriedly, sounded pissed & unacceptable body language ugh - no menus were given and as first timers we did not know. I clearly did not understand why he was not able to explain/speak to us (HIS customers) respectfully! The food took awhile to come, which was understandable as the place was pretty crowded. I ordered the Nasi Ayam, and my aunties had the Nasi Lemak & Asam Pedas Rice set (that's basically what were available at that point of time) and all were really good. Maybe we were just hungry but I guess the place is worth the try! Closes till 4 AM so not bad for supper in Malacca.Show less

Author: Zack D
Title: Lives up to the Reputation as a Popular Restaurant.
Review: The thing about Asam Pedas is everyone has his/her ideal Asam Pedas taste. Some like it Spicy, sour, both, thick, diluted or even less. So individuals taste is difficult to satisfy. As for me, I love eating Asam Pedas from many places, i rate this one of the top in my list. The right taste, fast service, and affordable. Location is also near to Jonker Walk. I give this a thumbs up and recommends it. Show less

Author: majugigih
Title: Not special asam pedas.
Review: The taste of asam pedas here not the original asam pedas. No asam and pedas. Means no sour and spicy. Infront of the restaurant have 2 more asam pedas restaurant and highly recommend to eat there, because more delicious then this restaurant.

Author: WaimZ
Title: Perfect place for Asam Pedas Lover :)
Review: - Arrive at the shop at 9pm. Crowded already. Need to find parking bcos this restaurant is famous so people come here often i think.- Better eat outside, except rainy days. hahaha- Varieties of menu, Main dishes is ASAM PEDAS. Asam pedas pari,tetel, telur ikan and much more u can pick.- I choose ASAM PEDAS TETEL. It comes with package of rice, sayur n telur masin. it was really awesome! i really enjoy it! soooo delicious ASAM PEDAS TETEL!Around the restaurant also got another asam pedas restaurant, U can choose if u want. For me this restaurant service and food is awesome but too crowded. Not suitable if u come had infant or rainy days.9 / 10 stars for me. :)Show less

Author: LoveTravel702533
Title: Food was excelent
Review: Really love the asam pedas at this restaurant. Never miss to eat here if in town. Price is normal and food is simple. Arrive there early such as 1900 or 2000 hours or late 0100 till 0400 hours. After 2000 hours, you will be standing for a while to find a table as its a peak hours at this place. Service wise its fast order and food ready in short time. The only problem when you want to pay the bill as there is only few person will receive the payment. Maybe the owner it self. There is alot of staff standing by to clean the table once empty by customer and take oder. Show less

Author: Ulun64
Title: Can't find the Assam and Pedas.
Review: I ordered the Assam Pedas fish and it's was a total disappointment. The hot and sour fish is savory at all. It's totally bland. Maybe next trip I will try the restaurant opposite of them.

Author: GogoAGogoAGogoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious but overated
Review: It was no doubt that it was good but that's it. The asam pedas fish wasn't spicy enough. And it was crowdy filling the whole streets with tables. Luckily i had it earlier before dinner time or else the service is gonna be slow. The staffs are very friendly and well-mannered.Show less

Author: diyanaaliPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Popular but the taste was below the expectation
Review: There are to many asam pedas restaurant in Melaka and don't know which one to choose, after searching we thought that might be this is the place we can eat good asam pedas. The services quiet fast, they will take you order once you seated, there are limited menu and type of fish (Pari,Kembung & Tenggiri). My first impression after ate the asa pedas is ermmm..it's below my expectation. The taste was so so..not recommended. I ate asam pedas kembung and my friend had asam pedas pari, the asam pedas set came with rice+fried cabbage+sambal belacan+half of telur masin, we had sirap limau and ate otak-otak (6 pieces) and for that we need to pay RM39.Show less

Author: 549iskandarz
Title: I have been searching everywhere and finally found one
Review: I have been searching everywhere for a good asam pedas since melaka is famous with one. Keep found close shop and such. And finally found one. And it didn't disappoint me. Asam pedas claypot at jalan laksamana is must try

Author: NanaSari
Title: Asam pedas hajjah mona
Review: Excellent food and good for those that like sour and spicy taste of asam pedas.But i think for me is too sour the taste is like a vinegar

Author: A7862XIadamcGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: First place in malacca
Review: I was taken here by two local guys and we had the sting ray good, only go if you like local feel, not for those who want the five star dinning with wine served for those who want to try something of malacca come, sit at the disorderly tables elbow to elbow with the locals eat be merry and feast of spicy goodness.Show less

Author: Nadrah B
Title: Overated.
Review: Really2 humble for the taste. Does not satisfy my taste at all and not even spicy. Very2 dissapointed. A bit salty but it's okay since I like salty food. 1/5.

Author: droppuru
Title: I'm local, for me, the price is quite ripped off.
Review:
The food is quite nice though. 
Recommend​ the chicken rice and asam pedas.
Roti John is not bad too.

Author: pure14
Title: Finger licking good...
Review: Best combination of asam pedas with stingray fish. Their asam pedas is really good. Fast service too.

Author: Jeffrey HKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas Claypot Kota Laksmana
Review: Cleanliness ; 1/10Tables are scattered on a parking zone. My table was near the drain go figure. Dirt and paper trash everywhere. Waiter & Order; 2/10Waiter hardly spoke and we are guessing what to order coz no menu. You have to look at the big board signage to order. Waiter did not oso explained the serving amount for 1 or 2. One pot can feed 2 person if you order for kids it oso comes with Rice, Salted egg, sambal belacan and boiled cabbage. Taste/Flavour; 1/10I myself cook Asam Pedas and there was so many ingredients is missing such as; Bunga KantanDaun Kesum/Adam Jawa/TamerindBelacan/Prawn PasteVery 2 FlatWe hate not finish our food so it was quite dreadful. Avoid at all cost if you have the choice go to Asam Pedas pokok besar better deal. It cost RM94 for 2 piece of Jenahak and 2 Fish Roe, 5 drinks Teh 0'Ice and 10 stick of satayThe taste of the food is tasteless and not recommended. Over sell by the Singaporean crowd. Sigh... Take it from me ..avoid avoid avoid. Show less

Author: elixir16Klang, Malaysia
Title: Not worth the hype
Review: For all that we have read about this place on TA, we decided to give this shop a go. To our dismay, when we arrived the shop was not set up as it has just finished raining.We stood around waiting for 20 mins (mind you I'm heavily pregnant) for the staff to clear the tables and attend to the crowd that were waiting for a table. But you could hardly see who the staff were and even harder to get their attention.As we were only a couple and there was only a long table available, we asked a staff if it ok to sit at the long table and he said ok and took our order. Moments later, a guy who I assume is the owner, rudely told us to find a different table as we were only 2 pax. Mind you, he asked us, THE CUSTOMERS, to find our own table and not that he would find a table for us. In fact, it had started to drizzle, and he made an announcement to say that if you have ordered too bad if it's raining, you can't change your table. The food itself is nothing great, perhaps the entire waiting and the so called "service" that we received from the restaurant probably put us off the entire thing. The restaurant itself was dirty, stuff and generally unpleasant to be in. The owner should honestly work on his PR skills, but sadly since people seem to flock to his shop I doubt he would actually care or bother. Show less

Author: Sheena BKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hits the Spot
Review: We went to Melaka wanting to experience good asam pedas and had a couple of places in our list. This place was one of it and it did not disappoint. Loved the whole local and outdoorsy feel of the place. Food came in hot and fast. I believe serving the rice with salted egg makes all the difference. Make sure you know your fish before you order. We ordered the jenahak asam pedas and it was perfect. I saw people ordering a bowl each but we shared one instead, which made the price way cheaper for two people. A great touch to the whole experience is having people passing by each table selling cut fruits. Tadaaa, desserts!Show less

Author: mandyt227
Title: Not asam at all!
Review: This is the last time im going there cause asam fish not sour at all. Fish also over cooked. Very dissapointed :(

Author: Aikim J
Title: Glad I came
Review:
Wasn't sure how good is the Adam pedals ,
It's quite amazing but it's not spicy enough. 

The taste just nice, sour -spicy. 
They come with salted egg and some cabbage. 

Unfortunately the Teh Halia can't make it. 

Still have room for improvement.

Author: Azahari E
Title: Perfect Asam Pedas
Review: Should try stingray (Ikan Pari) or snapper (ikan jenahak) asam pedas.... try to be there before 7pm.

Author: naza93Duisburg, Germany
Title: Fast serving restaurant
Review: The food was delivered within 5 minutes after u've placed ur order which is quite impressive since the place was packed with people. My cousin ordered meat asam pedas while myself asked for ikan pari(sting ray). They served it with egg and some veggies with rice which is very tasty, i really love the taste of salty egg. Everything were good but i think they can do it better, the taste can be improved by using a fresh fish and avoid over cooking cause my asam pedas pari does not taste fresh at all. Maybe from overcook or the fish itself was not quite fresh. Hoping to get fresh fish in my next visit to melaka :)Show less

Author: HerwieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Asam Pedas! The best in Melaka!
Review: Took Grabcar from Equatorial Hotel to the place (RM6) one way. Return was RM7 somehow. The place itself is located in a row of shophouses. Basically it is an outdoor eating place with tables and chairs along the road (which is closed at night). Had stingray and mackerel fish asam pedas. The place of rice came along with veges and salted egg. Excellent combi! Portion however was small. I think an average person would need at least two claypots instead. Gravy was thick but good enough to slurp through as soup at the end of your meal! It was also quite spicy but so so sedap! Definitely would go again if i ever visit Melaka. With currency conversion it would be a cheap eat for us. But at RM10 a claypot with the amount of fish in it, it may be a pricey meal for the locals.Show less

Author: dramanbhonsleMumbai, India
Title: Spicy. Saucy. Perfect.
Review: Spicy curry & fish are best friends. Our friends at this humble neighbourhood no frills resto know exactly how to balance the fiery curry with the salted egg and the succulent & incredibly fresh fish (of your choice).. Go here for a truly local, fuss free & cost effective experience of Melaka's culinary scene! Show less

Author: diveenjoker
Title: Worth it
Review: Ate one set of asam pedas ikan pari . It was so delicious . The gravy was thick , not too spicy . Just good for everyone to have a meal there . Worth trying it 👍👍

Author: ZahwanL
Title: The best Asam Pedas ever!
Review:
I will visit this restaurant every time I go to Melaka. The asam pedas was delicious! My favourite is Asam Pedas Telur Ikan. The portion is big and its really reasonable!

Please visit this restaurant!

Author: UlfahKamaruzamanKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Just average asam pedas
Review: Had dinner here on a short trip to Melaka as it was not that far from where we were staying. The service was fast. And the food is cheap but was just okay, nothing to shout about. The fish however, was fresh. We had the assam pedas ikan pari (ray). Show less

Author: carimakanman
Title: Asam Pedas Kota Laksamana
Review: If you are an avid asam pedas lover, you get to savour the thick and rich asam pedas gravy served in claypot. You can also get to enjoy Roti John and other Malay food.

Author: idawae83
Title: Delicious Malay Dish
Review: Ordered 2 set of Asam Pedas Tetel (meat) & Asam Pedas Telur Ikan (fish's egg). Both taste good. Opens at 6pm.

Author: dietermiezardKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Favorite Asam Pedas Fish in Claypot
Review: Came here twice because it has very nice delightful taste of Asam Pedas Claypot Fish!!!The cheapest price for this Rice + Asam Pedas Ikan Kembong is only RM10! Otak-otak also available for RM0.80 per piece.Not far from Pak Putra Tandoori. In malay, if it's a nice food, we say "Sedap!"Show less

Author: zuhdi k
Title: Tidak Menarik
Review: not nice for asam pedas here. just biasa biasa. you can come here with family and friends. just one place to visit in melaka

Author: KamarolKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice tasting asam pedas
Review: My friend and I had the ikan pari asam pedas and also some otak otak. The asam pedas gravy here taste better then the gravy at Asam Pedas Pokok Besar. But I am giving the Asam Pedas Claypot Kota Laksamana only an average rating because the otak otak that we had smells very fishy and tastes very fishy. I could only ate a little bit and discard the rest of the otak otak I was eating. Show less

Author: Nina-NFKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: We Are Hooked
Review: This is one of the best place to sample Melaka Asam Pedas. It is not far from Jonker Street. Most of the times it's a challenge to get a table for 4 or more. They are open for lunch and dinner but one shop opens for lunch and the bigger one just opposite opens for dinner. Show less

Author: YanaaYunuu
Title: Asam Pedas paling sedap!!
Review: Even dah balek hometown, still terliur. 1 set cuma rm10. Please maintain price ni smpi biler sbb nak dtg lg nanti bwk family. I mkn asam pedas ikan pari yg sgt sgt sgt sedap!! Roti john dia rm6.50 pon sgt sgt sgt sgt sedap!! Semua sedap!! Puas ati. Parking senang. Cari seat senang, order amek cepat, mknn pon cpt smpi. What else i can say?? Mungkin in terms of restaurant presentation dia nmpk mcm biase2 je, tapi yg penting perot senang hati maa ! Guys! U should come here & u will know why they say Melaka is bery popular with their Asam Pedas!!Show less

Author: Benjamin Y
Title: Good supper place in Melacca
Review: Decent supper place in Melacca. A must try is the awesome clay pot stingray, although the stingray was not the best ever the gravy was interesting and super yummy.

Author: jaja136Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Appalling service and over-rated!!
Review: Once we found a seat, our orders were taken quite promptly. We decided to ditch the asam pedas as it did not suit our tastebuds. We ordered satay instead, with drinks for 4 people. The drinks came about 15 minutes later, and were below average. Where we sat, we could see the satay man, preparing and grilling the satay. We waited for almost 40 minutes and ours never came, despite asking the attendant about our orders. From where we sat, there does not seem to be a system in taking the orders - in-house dining and takeaways were lumped together, the satay were grilled in batches, which slowed the process down remarkably, and the rules of "first come first serve" did not apply, thus some order went "missing" in the stack. Generally, I feel the food is over rated. Service is definitely appalling. Suggest to avoid unless you are extremely desperate to experience the above.Show less

Author: Ezyan N
Title: The best asam pedas in Melaka
Review: During my university time, this place is a must go every week. The beef asam pedas is so addictive that i need to eat this almost every week. The place usually pack with customers, be it malays,chinese,indians or foreigners! The foods are cheap too.

Author: MichelleGuan
Title: crowded n slow
Review:
the place is crowded and slow when you call for bill! it more advisable to call bill once they serve food.
but the roti sardin is really nice.

Author: del1007
Title: Not as good as before
Review: I think the taste is not as good as before. Maybe it's just me. I don't know. With the price they charge, I think the food should be better.

Author: Paul T
Title: Paradise in the mouth
Review: If life is is not colourful without spiciness, it is hell.This is my food heaven where taste dances in harmony with spiciness. A tang of saltiness from salted egg. Sourness of asam encircles the dish.A combination of all that is served and placed in the mouth is the apex of harmony. A heaven on earth :)Show less

Author: amn23
Title: Hot gravy
Review: Open during daytime when most of asam pedas restaurant only open in the evening. The gravy is ok for a mild spicy food lover.

Author: chong s
Title: One man meat is another man poison
Review: I'm not a asam pedas fans. Never like sour food. But my friend is very into this. We went because of her, she insisted this is the best asam pedas ever. With the fish in the asam soup, she can eat 2 big bowl of rice. This is way to much for a petite small eater. I teased her that was called rice in asam soup. However the shop is very discomfort. Narrow seat and hot environment. One could easily missed it because it is just a wooden house with very minimal deco. It is not made for me, but for those who like asam pedas, u might give it a try.Show less

Author: jancyranit
Title: Bad service!
Review:
Very bad service! Waited almost 20 mins for bill. Food are not so good. Ok ok only. Environment totally out! Soo much of flies and mosquito! 

😦

Author: FarhannaMZF
Title: Asam Pedas.
Review: Big crowd every night, fast service. We loved it! Had Tenggiri Asam Pedas. Fish Roe Asam Pedas, Stingray Asam Pedas. A must visit if you come to Melaka.

Author: Abhimanyu APetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: The Best Ever Asam Pedas
Review: This is the Place which serves the Best Asam Pedas ever... It is served in a clay pot and the types of fish are up for ur choice to order, It can be the Ikan Putih (Cod) or Tenggiri (Mackerel) or Bawal (Pomfret) or Pari (Stingray). The asam pedas which is a malay delicacy with the twisty flavour of spicy hotness with mild sourish gravy is served with a bowl of white rice and stir fried cabbages and one whole salted egg which is cut to half.They also serve satay (marinated chicked barbeque served with spicy peanut gravy, otak-otak (marinated fish filled wrapped in coconut leave and grilled) and other local malay cuisines. Other dishes which are typically available are the fried rice, fried noodles, soup noodle and also dumplings.This is a prominent place of choice for dinner and the place gets packed with customers as soon as 7pm. They are open from 6pm -4 am only. It is always better to be there before 7pm. Parking could be a bit tricky as there are limited parking space nearby and so you might need to take a walk.It s a great place to hang out for dinner while listening to the street artists who will be playing the chinese instrument, Er-Hu or those playing the guitar to a malay song. You may pay them generously for entertaining you...but thats an option.Show less

Author: SamEng527
Title: FIRST AND LAST
Review: Over rated. Worst service ever! Not attended. The lady boss scolded us for not being patient while we had been waiting for so long for our bill.

Author: Shahul Hameed SKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated & pricey
Review: I certainly expecting a lot from this Asam Pedas Claypot. The restaurant was huge with many outdoor seating. The assam pedas did not taste bad at all, but it wasn't just as good as I expected it to be. The next day we went to Hajjah Mona restaurant, and the assam pedas was much more authentic and taste way better, not to mention, cheaper. I would certainly will skip this place the next time Im in Malacca.Show less

Author: 686izamiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great Asam Pedas
Review: This restaurant mainly operated at nighttime from 6pm to 4 am. The main dish would be among the popular food in Melaka Asam Pedas dinner set. They also offer roti canai..burgers..Goreng2..The place is close to Jonker Street..Can walk but confirm tiring. The food especially asam Pedas is good. The services also good only hard to define which is the employee and which are customers since no indicators like uniform etc. The only person we could define well is the cashier with her aproon on. Congested during weekends and hard to find parking especially during CNY. Have to change table when it rains since dining under the skies. A good business for the owner but I do hope they upgrade some good facilities for the customers. I do recommend but please come early and when thw skies are clear.Show less

Author: divineramblingsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local signature dish that meets your expectations
Review: Does it meet the expectation? Yes. Was it the best I ever had? No. I frequent the place whenever I visit Melaka and while they still maintain the originality of the taste with accompanying thousand year old egg and a little bit of vegetables, the quality and the quantity had degenerated over the years. Come for the Malay diner experience with live band (if you're lucky). The thing that would amaze you the most is the ability of the owner lady to memorize your order and bill you spontaneously.Show less

Author: Ahmad Zaim H
Title: Wrong business listing time
Review: The business was listed to be operational from 6pm -  4am. Whereas it was published to be operational during lunch time. Really disappointed. What more can I say.

Author: norwan a
Title: Nice asam pedas place
Review: Melaka has many nice asam pedas place and asam pedas kota laksamana is certainly one of them. The choice of fishes is not that many, though.

Author: LatinaSepetSandakan, Malaysia
Title: "The best asam pedas in Malacca"
Review: Been here this year just to taste the asam pedas. This place known as "asam pedas pokok besar" among local people. To me th asam pedas was good and tasty. You can choose what type of fish do you want-reasonable price and you should try it.Show less

Author: Ja'ziz D
Title: Not to my expectation
Review: We went there for lunch have to wait 10 mins for table.The Assam fish is good not spicy enough for me but my 8yrs old son like it.

Author: Silent88
Title: My Experience In Restaurant Asam Pedas Kota Laksamana
Review: Served nice and delicious "ikan kembung"@mackerel asam pedas in claypot with famous nasi lemak. For drink, you  can order tea tarik or teh O kosong here!

Author: Abu Bakar MShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: I guess being a Malaccan, this restaurant doesnt really interest me at all and this review would probably be a little biased. Truth be told, there are far better places to eat than this place, just that it operates till the wee hours of the night. I have yet to recommend any of my friends or family to have a meal here.Show less

Author: saisamal
Title: Not spicy asam pedas
Review: Average asam pedas. Not spicy, more sour and a bit expensive. 3 main course (ikan jenahak) costs Rm76. Worth a try!

Author: Aztecna92
Title: GOOD SERVICE WITH DELIOUS FOOD
Review: One of my feveret restaurant in melaka their asam pedas claypot most popular in melaka .. satay here was very yummy and juicy .. always come here if got free time

Author: Far_Zauri
Title: Hot but tasty stingray asam pedas
Review: Tasty! We ordered asam pedas since the dish originated from Melaka and they does not disappoint! Served with plain rice, sambal belacan and veges, it was a truly a local experience. Will come again.

Author: zoem882London, United Kingdom
Title: Basic but good Asam Pedas
Review: This is a very basic restaurant, but it was full when we visited and every time we passed it. The Asam Pedas is okay, and that's what you go for. We had a snapper version. I wouldn't recommend trying the roti canai as this was not very well made and the dhal it came with was very tasteless. Show less

Author: travelsajaKuching, Malaysia
Title: Must Try Asam pedas
Review: Asam Pedas – A Minangkabau style of spicy and sour dish usually served with fish or seafood. At Hajjah Mona Asam Pedas, you should also try their Asam Pedas Daging Tetel (tender beef with chunky bits of fats, tendons and bones). The madly piquant dish is usually served with steamed rice with blanched bean sprouts and half a salted egg.Service was fast, though the workers there have this certain air of arrogance surrounding them. This particular young chap manning the satay stall for one, was clearing a few tables without waiting customers while I tried to request for him to clear ours first. He glanced at me and immediately looked away like it was none of his business. Not a very clever way of managing customer relationship, really.Anyway, the food arrived relatively quick, understandable since none of them was cooked from scratch. They have these boiling cauldrons (or large woks) with pieces of fish in them, and another one with beef that are being perpetually heated to a boil. So, they only need to scoop your preferred choice – Ikan pari (stingray), Ikan tenggiri (mackerel), Ikan parang (saito/wolf herring), Ikan kembong besar (large mackerel?) and fish head, or Daging Tetel (softened beef with fats and tendons).Show less

Author: merelisopvakantie
Title: Found this by accident - great dinner!
Review: We found this place by accident when we walked around the city. It was very crowded with locals so we figured the food must be good. And it was! We had the stingray and mackerel (by recommendation) which was kind of spicy for me but it tasted very good and being there was a great experience. :)Show less

Author: Nash911Kajang, Malaysia
Title: Nice simple and cheap...
Review: worth tasting this food at this place. U can have various choice of fish and is served in the hot clay pot. The rice comes together with salted egg and vegetable.. Just sufficient for a simple dinner. The environment is on the open space with mixed crowd of Chinese, malays and Indians and foreigners too Show less

Author: harithcyrilKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Assam Pedas
Review: Was "pumped" up with all the reviews on this place. Keeps coming up first in all the #assampedas lookup. Quite laid back, not sure if the owners are really happy to see customers....just got that feeling. Food was simple, which is something i like. Good value for money. Beef was great. On the other hand, fish was horrible. Was continuously boiled for along time which made the sauce salty. Overall...average experience.Show less

Author: RamunNikCyberjaya
Title: Good experience for those who looking for fast & easy eatery
Review: Without prejudice:Setup for the restaurant is very minimal. Located at a corner lot of a terrace house. Location is within walking distance from Jonker Street. If you are from Hotel Casa Del Rio, turn left and just walk. Even though I am not fancy of Jonker Street itself, I pleased with the location. Lets talk about the food. As usual, I am here for food hunting. Specifically asam pedas ikan pari (stingray). They also have option of ikan kembung. On the plus point: To compare this shops’ asam pedas to others, it has slightly bitterness flavor compared some shop where the dish is very acidic, which I enjoyed it both ways. I do not try any other dish (they also serve other rice dish but I did not try it). Other dishes i.e.: fried cabbage, salted egg complement the asam pedas. The gravy has all beautiful flavor of herbs used in the recipe. On the minus side, we were there quite early (6.00pm for dinner). The gravy taste was like not perfectly cooked. I can even identify the taste of asam jawa quite strong in it. Maybe if you reach there around 8pm (dinner peak time) perhaps the taste is better. Next point: I used to enjoy my asam pedas with some ladies' fingers (bendi), but it was not in the meal. Just a simple fish and asam pedas. The freshness of the singray was great but does it feels like something is missing, like eating a sup kosong with a piece of chicken in it. That’s all. However the owner manages to bring the price at very reasonable price, like RM4.50 per dish. Conclusion: Would I go back to this shop? Yes, indeed. But I am looking for other version of asam pedas which may be better than this shop. Lets go for food hunt!!Show less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Halal Asam Pedas
Review: Asam pedas here ok only and services quite slow. If go on weekend need to wait for 30 minutes for food.

Author: MardymanLincoln
Title: We enjoyed it
Review: I can't tell you if this is a good example asam pedas or not as this was the first and only time we had tried it, but we enjoyed it.Ordering is easy, even for foreigners, the menu is displayed on the restaurant frontage and is easily read from the pavement seating, and the person who served us did her best to provide any help required. The asam padas came with all the accompaniments, all we had to do was choose the fish we wanted and any side dishes.The dish was hot and sour, but not excessively so, and the service good.Show less

Author: SaifulJanisPuchong, Malaysia
Title: Good taste asam pedas
Review: Exact location Jln Laksamana 2, Taman Kota Laksamana. Belongs to Hajjah Mona. Actually a corner lot house. You can order in a set which includes asam pedas (choose your fish), bean sprout & rice. If you are an "asam pedas addict", this may disappoint you bcoz the asam is not that "powerful". For someone who prefers mild asam, this will be the choice.Show less

Author: poonkerzJohor, Malaysia
Title: Not as good as the hype
Review: Had a short holiday trip to Melaka of a few days, so I went there to try it After reading/hearing all the hype "best adam pedas in Melaka" about this place,. Ordered asam pedas tenggiri with some side-dishes. In my opinion, the adam pedas was not the best I've ever had (maybe because I'm a Johorean. I still prefer the taste of Muar's Asam Pedas). Slightly watery, overpowered peppery taste. But still good, just not on par with all the hype about the place.Show less

Author: azamin99Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average quality, bad PR
Review: Review say they re good..i give it a try..many patron, we re lucky tio get a table..most dish have pricing, except fish head dishes..i called waiter, asking for the price, he said no idea..cslled the supervisor, also say no idea..i ask how big is fish head, no idea, price no idea..ok, i make the order..the fish head is small, n cut into half..just enough for one..price rm38.! OMG...! So watch out, order whats clearly stated prices..otherwise, U ended up like me..!Show less

Author: ISZISMAELShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas as a closure of my Malacca Trip
Review: Asam pedas is a must food to enjoy when you visited Malacca. You can easily found Malay Restaurants selling this food around the state. But if you prefer, late night foods and outdoor seating restaurant, Asam Pedas Claypot at Kota Laksamana is definitely the best choice. They have different types of asam pedas but ill prefer Asam Pedas Tenggiri and Asam Pedas Telur Ikan (must try). you can also order plain roti canai with asam pedas gravy or curry. Price is reasonable and service is fast.Show less

Author: adekdudut
Title: its been so long not to eat this.. perfect..
Review: i am an asian. i like to eat the asam pedas (sour and hot taste) food. its been so long, since i move to another city, to find a perfect taste or asam pedas. once i enter this restaurant, i feel amazed by the the taste given. its perfect. but maybe a little bit chili and hot for foreigner who doesnt have eat chili habit. even for me that eat hot chili in my daily life, this food a little bit hot. so be careful for the guys who cant eat hot and chili food.but the chicken with green chili is very very delicious. this one better then the fish with sour soup and chili taste. the fish soup is perfect for malacca in the end of the year since its cold there and the warm of the soup perfect for your body.Show less

Author: Syahid B
Title: Original taste of Asam Pedas
Review: It is the place to go should you are looking for original asam pedas of Melaka. To me it is a bit salty and not spicy enough, but that should mean tourists would like the taste of it. There are two restaurant - one for day and another for night. I only had the chance to taste the day food because it was crazy crowded at night due to its location that is within walk to Banda Hilir and Jonker Street. Show less

Author: H3rm3s
Review: Lot of ppl here but then I don't really think the food here is that nice as how ppl said... hmm... maybe diff ppl diff taste... it's still worth a try...

Author: Huapatrick
Title: Famous Asam Pedas Melaka
Review:
A short drive from the hotel.
Though the place was crowded, service was fast.
Great asam pedas ikan tenggiri  and nasi lemak!

Author: Puteriandalas
Title: Malaysian taste.
Review: More warm smiles and welcome gestures  from the attending staff, but the fish curry and vegetables soup are delicious though a bit hot (Chilli) for non-chilli lovers. Prices of food are considerably cheap.

Author: TheFoodEater90
Title: The Akak Is So Hot
Review: The owner is the akak yg hot gila and i enjoy the food and the view of her butt so much! So worth it!

Author: LeongZhiHong
Title: Only average
Review:
This is not the best taste of Asam pedas you can find around. As some members reviewed, it is only average. 
Price is reasonable and portion is big.

Author: Cook Z
Title: I come here for the roti
Review: They make one of the best roti in town IMO. I'm not a big fan of fish and curry, so have never tried their Adam pedas fish head. But I'm a regular here for their roti and nasi goreng (fried rice).

Author: Fanazmi
Title: Above average Asam Pedas.
Review: Very busy place in the evenings, so do expect to wait. Had 2 servings of Asam Pedas (2 different types of fish). The gravy was quite tasty and had all the flavours. Fish was fresh and portion was quite ok for the price.

Author: SNuraishahKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not the real deal
Review: The dilemma is: two asam pedas restaurants on the same street. Both shops face each other. The other one (Asam Pedas Pokok Besar) is well known among locals, but this one has the bigger signboards. And more lights. And wifi. And it showed up on Google. Which does not always mean better quality, as we discovered. I had the asam pedas tenggiri set. Having been raised on asam pedas by my mum, who is from Muar, I was disappointed. Asam pedas should be what its name says it is: sour and spicy, with a hint of daun kesum. Here, it is mostly salty and the gravy is too thick for my liking.So, we decided to give the other restaurant (Pokok Besar) a try too. Turns out that Pokok Besar is the real deal - it smells right, it looks right, and it also tastes right. Sour, spicy and with a good dose of belacan (shrimp paste). Although our order took some time to arrive, this may be because each serving is cooked individually (or at least, time is needed to cook the fish in a pre-cooked asam pedas).Although Pokok Besar seems to have fewer customers, we noticed that they tend to be locals, and we saw one buying asam pedas in bulk to take away. Asam Pedas Kota Laksamana appeals to the younger crowd and out-of-towners, but it doesn't deliver on taste.Show less

Author: LishazniaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Don't be fooled by its popularity.
Review: Honestly, there is a much better place for Asam Pedas than this place. And the other restaurant is just right across the street. We came here because of reviews but we were disappointed when we tasted the soup which was more salty than anything else. The only good thing about it was that the fish was fresh. So on impulse we decided to take home some of the Assam Pedas from the restaurant across the street and were we thankful that we did. The taste was waaaaaaay better. Plus the only cooked it for us on the spot rather than a mass produced stock like the one we had at this restaurant. So if you want good assam pedas, go to the restaurant across the street, Assam Pedas Pokok Besar.Show less

Author: arai33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Super! Changed my view of Assam Pedas
Review: Wow, prior to this trip, I've always been skeptical of Asam, always thought it was similar to Tom Yam, accept Tom Yam is much more flavourful. Now it seems to me that it's cause I've never had a proper serving of good Asam Pedas! Piping hot, spicy and savoury with very very fresh tasting fish! Mm MM! I'm salivating as I type this and recall the claypot fish... Yummy! Forget about ambience and service. More often than not, street food is the best food, both tasty and reflective of local culture and history.Show less

Author: salehuddinmohamadPutrajaya, Malaysia
Title: SO YUMMY..
Review: LIKED: The "tetel and daging asam pedas" is their best signature dish here..i don't really like their fish asam pedal as it doesn't taste as good as the former..it's a good dish for spicy food loverDISLIKED: It open at 5.00pm till 3.00am..so, only dinner i must say..No parking lot..just park yours at the free-and-easy roadside parking..Show less

Author: suite001
Title: Ikan pari assam pedas
Review: I love melaka assam pedas. This was a new place we were trying out. Not as sour or spicy as we'll like though.

Author: JohariJemainKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Vs Asam Pedas Muar
Review: There are 2 kinds of asam pedas lovers. Can't explain why but MUAR and Melaka Asam pedas is completely different. To me as a asam pedas lover, of course i love the Muar taste compared to Melaka taste.Cook it more asam, more pedas, or the diffrent combinations of secret ingredients, i still prefer the Muar style of cooking.So when i went sight seeing, just had to c this shop. nothing great about this meal tho. Meaning i wouldn't go the extra mile in searching fot this shop again for the asam pedas. Just like the normal melaka taste.....Show less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: nice asam pedas fish
Review: there is 2 restaurants in kota laksamana which is equally good... Both are on the same street...One is next to the famous roti nan... Another is nearer jonker street. Both are served in claypot. I like the ikan pari/rayfish best. Spicy hot, although not the extremely hot type. The fried chicken and satay in the shop nearer jonkerstreet are also good. Worth a visit if u r in melaka town and is looking for something sour and spicy for dinner or late supperShow less

Author: koksekMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Asam Pedas
Review: Its totally not asam pedas to my taste. I had in the past asam pedas which is totally different. Why can"t they serve asam pedas as in the good old days, where our grand mother used to prepare and the the aroma is really delicious where theirs a saying quote" orang lalu dibelakang rumah tidak sedar'" unquote. Author: vanillajunkieKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: not bad
Review: Not bad. Yeah, really. Been here every time I'm in town. Honestly I don't really fond of their asam pedas. They're good, but the taste and texture hardly consistent, unlike the other asam pedas restaurant nearby, Hajah Mona.Again, the asam pedas is good but the taste and texture changes everytime! The only time when I enjoyed this dish the most is when I got there early, around 8pm and when eaten accompanied with satay and otak2. Ah! I love the roti cana I with the asam pedas's gravy as well! Other than that...... Just awful.. Nasi lemak, chicken rice and other goreng2 (stir fried) stuff are just awful.Show less

Author: Twenkly
Title: Is Not Worth Try...
Review: I just don't like the taste, the laksa is better! You can try it if you are very curious.But i can tell you, sometimes the roadside dish is better, like fried banana, cendol, ABC and more.

Author: AsianEDMBromma, Sweden
Title: Just OK
Review: Well, the asam pedas is a lil' bit watery and not that "umph!" like what I had in Johor. The stingray fish served with the asam pedas also not really a fresh one. Pretty hard. I guess it was an old stingray :( Anyway, thumbs up for the prompt service and nice drinks. Show less

Author: Ashral
Title: The Best Asam Pedas in Melaka
Review: I like to taste asam pedas clay pots, it spice and delicious, you can choose some fish of asam pedas like (stingray, jenak, siakap, parang and kembong)

Author: princess1224Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: average only
Review: try this asam pedas clay pot after knew it by website that one of the famous place for eating in melaka.we go for dinner.the shops were combine by two shops.crowded by mostly malay,then chinese tourist (maybe like us too). 1 claypot fish serve with a plate of white rice,half piece of salt egg and few of fried cabbage,cost around RM8-9.honestly to be said,the taste vary from the name,yes...perhaps every place taste &cooking style will different...but,we are not so satisfy as the taste was vary from what we imagine...yes...asam pedas,suppose to be sour & spicy,but,we only can taste it spicy,nothing was sour(asam).feel very dissapointed...anyway,since we reach,just try it...perhaps we are really misunderstanding on each place got their own taste....Show less

Title: taste of fish and its soup is really nice
Review: its a restaurant in between houses (taman) with excellent price and other local varities

Author: Dylan1980

Review: kinda normal to me, it's famous maybe due to it's popularity but not a worth visit

Review: Explosive tastes for those who loves hot and spicy!

Author: hillsixtynine
Title: Not bad...
Review: I wouldn't say this is the best place to have asam laksa but it's adequate if you are craving for that authentic meal.

Author: syapik_hassanKuala Lumpur
Title: The best asam pedas in town
Review: So spicy, but with no chilli seeds. You might not get stomach ache or churn, IF you drink a lot of water. You can choose to have kembong fish, pari, siakap, bawal merah, senohong, and many more. Price depends on the type of fish and weight.Show less

Author: shajipapa
Title: Check it out for spice lovers..........
Review: It's the best seafood experience I had so far but yet sooo near!!!!

Author: Angel_PoohBearSingapore, Singapore
Title: 1st time VISIT
Review: The restaurant is surprisingly quiet, maybe it's Monday. Few dishes worth trying - fried carrot cake, century egg porridge, yong tau foo, fried beancurd roll. The chee cheong fun which was highly rated is not up to our liking. The cheese dumpling & jade siew mai were both a disappointment. Overall experience is good as the place is clean & the lady boss is friendly. Will visit again with family to try other items on the menu.Show less

Author: 27Vivien77
Title: Dellicious dim sum, warm service
Review: We came by on Thursday but it was closed. Met the lady owner who told us that it will open on Friday. We had steamed harkau, siewmai, yong tau foo etc. The chicken porrige was really yummy. Prices are reasonable. Service was good.

Author: puspanathanPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Very clean and efficient restaurant.
Review: Very clean and efficient restaurant. Service was good and fast. They have a great variety of offerings. Heavy on pork but adequate other choices. Their jasmine tea was quite good with a light touch of jasmine unlike other places which a quite heavy with artificial jasmine smell. Very reasonably priced. Show less

Author: Van TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rustic ... like Dim Sum used to be for the nostalgic
Review: Not the best or most delicious we've had but passable. The big draw I got was the old- school, nostalgia inducing service, portions, and tastes. While most dim sums in Singapore tend to be 'gentrified' and modernised affairs, its nice to come to a decent, humble, not overly polished dim sum place. While its nice being surprised by new creations and flavour alchemy today's chefs feel they need to differentiate ... sometimes its nice just going back to the basics.We went on a Saturday 10AM. Not overly crowded, but not empty either. Fast and attentive service. Nice to be visited by the glass cart full of dim sum, and the steamer tray. The service was really good -- they were quite attentive to our allergy requirements ... and made good suggestions on dishes we could and could not take.overall, an uncomplicated simple affair ... it didn't totally wow us but sometimes wow isn't what you're looking for.Show less

Author: 414tashat
Title: The worst dim sum ever
Review: I am wondering why the ratings are at the best. This is the worst place to eat for dim sum.. Dry and tasteless.. Definitely not coming back. Waste of time

Author: bennyvectra
Title: Simple and delicious Dim Sum
Review:
Simple and delicious Dim Sum. Almost all the items were delicious.
Staff were friendly and helpful.

Will definitely return here when I visit Melaka

Author: GanL
Title: Lots of dim sum to choose from
Review: Went in for brunch. Ordered a pot of Chinese jasmine tea to go with the dim sum. Lots of dim sum to choose from. Highly recommended the fried carrot cake and the porridge.

Author: Rimi SLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Delicious, speedy, lovely service
Review: The dim sum here was freshly cooked, yummy and presented to us quickly upon arrival. The staff sat us at a nice table and directed the air-con towards us because it was so hot. The dishes came and were delicious! If you like sweets then the lotus bun is a recommend. The conghee (rice soup) is also a must have for a proper breakfast.Show less

Author: Putri_zi
Title: 好吃
Review:
好吃， 點的大部分都很好吃
可惜hakao的皮不好吃
Price is reasonable due to the fresh ingredients, average 4RM or above
But it worthed, will be my breakfast list 😍

Author: liliannekimNorth Wales, Pennsylvania
Title: So-so dim sum
Review: Went for a late lunch on a Saturday afternoon. Place was empty except for a table full of waiters and proprietor(s). Then two other tables trickled in. Food was tasty though got cold pretty fast as the meal progressed. By the end of the meal, Phoenix claws were gelatinously congealed and siew Mai was a little hardened. I wonder how other restaurants keep their dimsum warm right up to the last tasty bite? Something this place can learn to do. Friendly staff though. Show less

Author: CaroLynn128Calgary, Canada
Title: Cleanliness issue and lots of flies
Review: Went there for lunch bout 1.30pm. The food was average but there is a lot of choices to be had. However, i do like to eat in a place without having to swat off flies from my food and surroundings. The floors looked like they weren't swept all day. The owner should look into closing the big doors instead so the pests would not be flying in so freely and losing the cool air from the air cond.Show less

Author: ongboon18Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy dim sum
Review: The dim sum spread is reasonable.The staffs came to us with the dim sums for selections. The glutinous rice and salted egg steam bun taste good and it run out fastWe reached around 10am and the crowd had thin down..Parking is ample.Pricing is reasonable and the place is air-conStaffs are polite.Show less

Author: Kelly CSingapore
Title: Wide spread with great service
Review: Initial plan was to visit the dim sum place at Jonker but was told that the food wasn’t fantastic. So did a quick search and found this place. Crowded & packed but service was not compromised. The waiters will walk around with huge baskets & trolleys with a wide spread. My recommendation: Yong Tau Foo, Char Siew Bao, Chee Cheong Fun, Carrot Cake, Egg Tart, Chicken Feet, Pork Ribs, Siew Mai. Comes with WiFi too, isn’t it wonderful? :)Show less

Author: adrian0714Singapore, Singapore
Title: Dumplings “Bakchang” are de best
Review: I actually came for the “bakchang”. After trying dumplings from a number of shops around town, I feel the dumplings offered here do it for me. Price-wise, they keep it reasonable and affordable, while many had chose to blatantly inflate their prices. Kudos to the Lim family Show less

Author: AlanL3814
Title: Fast service
Review: Fast service, food price mid range but since it has air cond quite justified the price. 5pax (4 adult, 1 toddler) bill come out to be RM75. We order quite a lot and eat until full.

Author: Chenny L
Title: Not too many choices
Review: Chee cheong fang was so so but the fried carrot cake was good. Not too many choices though. Went at 9a.m. on Monday and it was not packed

Author: I_S_B_L_o
Title: Authentic handmade dim sum
Review: All dim sum were handmade. The queue was long but my friends & I were seated in less than 15 minutes. Service was prompt and efficient. Prices were extremely reasonable. Interesting dim sum varieties. Worth another trip!

Author: rachelcB5086VA
Title: Satisfying!
Review: Had a very satisfying dim sum meal here. The food are served in small or medium plates in great variety. My favourites are the fried salad prawn dumplings, salted egg custard buns and the fish balls.

Author: tatianac4444
Title: Not good...
Review: Here it goes, my first poor review on TripAdvisor. I was in the mood for dim sum and followed the suggestions of previous TripAdvisor visitors. Unfortunately my experience was “poor” and that’s putting it nicely. I walked from the touristy jonker Street area with hopes to enjoy something fresh and off the beaten path but this was short of my experience. Important to note, this is not a vegetarian friendly restaurant and absolutely cannot serve to a vegan. Majority of dimsum was with pork, beef and or chicken leaving me with close to zero vegetarian options so I went with the following; steamed prawns OK, friend Carrot cake OK, fish cakes NOT GOOD, Thai tofu REALLY NOT GOOD (I watched it come out of the microwave which is conveniently located on the main dining floor) and Chinese tea NOT GOOD (only tea option available). The energy was off in this place from my arrival, all staff and owner Were sitting together at a table, the only occupied table upon my arrival. And I was a table for one, the only table throughout my meal there. They began to close the shutters before I got up to leave. That was my “g2g” sign. Show less

Author: VelestrynSingapore, Singapore
Title: Warm dim sum from the push-cart
Review: This place was recommended by my dad. We went on our first day at 4+pm but it was closed even though it's stated on TripAdvisor that is closes at 1030pm. Do note that they close at 3pm instead. We love the chili tofu and crispy prawn wrapped in wanton skin. Congee was done well and had an old school/nostalgic feel to it. Hakkao, siew mai and carrot cake were average. Prices here are reasonable. A pity that the Nonya Bakzhang was sold out during the weekend.Will definitely visit here again if we are back in Malacca!Show less

Author: brsterkAuckland, New Zealand
Title: Mediocre food and service
Review: Restaurant clean, spacious but food came cold. Asked for porridge to be heated up but came back exactly the same. Price is OK. The yong tauhu is delicious and the salted egg yolk custard bun is not bad. The nyonya dumpling was out of stock (we were there at 12pm). I think I will go back only if I am craving for their yongtauhu or custard bun.Show less

Author: Brandon C
Title: Better Dim Sum Restaurant
Review: Have been to 3 different dim sum places in Melaka and this is the best of the 3 so far. Off the touristy Jonker area, Dim Sum Garden seems to be popular with the locals as the place was filled with them with no tourists in sight. A definite thumbs up already. The waitress rattled off a list of dim sums and we quickly got our orders in. They were brought to our table almost immediately from the push cart. Though the taste was acceptable for most dishes, I wish they were pipping hot as most seem to be luke warm, even to the touch. The yam dumpling (wu gok) was excellent as were the lui sha bao, banana red bean pancake, and chicken feet. Overall, will continue to hunt for the next better dim sum place in melaka, and if that fails, then it will be back to Dim Sum Garden again.Show less

Author: cathydelCairns, Australia
Title: Fresh and delicious yum cha.
Review: We walked from Jonkers Lane at 10.30 and reached this restaurant at 11.15 am. Dim sum and steamed dishes were being prepared on the pavement outside then wheeled around to tables. The place was clean and staff friendly with enough English to explain new dishes we hadn't experienced before. Siew Mai, cheese mai, and steamed pork were standouts from the cart. We also ordered a chef special of pork slippery noodles - can't remember the Chinese name but there was fatt in it! It was superb. Noodles were so light and the sauce with shrimp paste and chili was delicious. The whole meal including Chinese tea cost about $11 Australian and we had plenty. Great experience. Wifi was good too - need that to find your way home if walking!!Show less

Author: joeyfun81Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good
Review: Stayed at imperial heritage and chanced upon this when we drive out to look for breakfast. Price of dim sum was rm 3.20, rm 3.50, rm 5.00. We liked the Chi Cheong Fun, congee and carrot cake the most. Thank you for the varieties for the affordable price. Show less

Author: Fats88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Yummy All The Time
Review: About 1km from Mahkota Parade, this restaurant is our favourite dim sum place each time we visit Melaka. Most dim sums were freshly steamed and nice. Staff would proactively make their rounds offering a large variety of dim sums. The nonya chang (dumpling) using blue pea flower or bunga telang had lean pork filling- not oily at all. Prices are not high- moderate. Good place to yum cha in Melaka!Show less

Author: Chun L
Title: Best Dim Sum in Malacca!
Review: I was attracted by the air conditioning and free wifi, but the food was beyond my imagination. We had so much food and they were all very good. I particularly like the Salted Egg Yolk Bun which is probably the best I have ever had. Same goes to the Cheese Siu Mai, Nyonya Chang and Spare Ribs. The restaurant is very clean and the price was very reasonable, I'd definitely return. I heavily recommend everyone to try it out!!Show less

Author: wanderlust091London, United Kingdom
Title: Perfect dim sum!
Review: I've tried many places but this is real dim sum - high quality ingredients, everything was hand-made instead of pre-packed, very reasonable price. Service was swift yet polite; food was served in the traditional trolley method; restaurant was clean. Nothing can be faulted. My favourite dishes were the crispy salad prawn, salted egg yolk custard bun (liu sha bao), cheese dumplings and pan fried radish cake.Show less

Author: lim0510
Title: one of the best dimsum in melaka
Review: lovely HK style dim sum. the service was really fast though the queue can be quite long on weekends. definitely will return.

Author: carmenc555
Title: Very expensive
Review: Dim sum was average, g cheong also average. I think is a over pricey for 4 (1 adult + 3 childs) pax @RM 88. Would not come back again eventhough good service from the tawkey. There are many eating places around.

Author: LewisSG
Title: Will visit again!
Review:
Food is better than average, prices are very very reasonable. On average 3-5 ringgit. Service was prompt on a pretty crowded Sunday morning.
Will visit again 😋

Author: audreylsg83
Title: Nice for dim sum
Review: This is the 2nd time we been here. The dim sum is delicious and the chicken porridge is also good. The service is real fast. Price is not too expensive.

Author: FromKluang
Title: Nice Dim-sum restaurant
Review:
Good Dim-sum with air-conditional.
Usually full house on weekend and public holiday.
Many variety of Dim-sum you can try.
Must try the Yong-Tao-Fu really nice.
They also selling good Nyonya dumpling.
Service is great. Overall good choice for Dim-sum

Author: CFbonsaiFremantle Western Australia
Title: Fresh tasty dim sum in a cool clean restaurant
Review: This restaurant is not on the usual tourist trail but worth seeking out. It was walking distance from our hotel (Equatorial) and when we arrived mid-morning on a Tuesday wasn't too busy. Clientele were all local residents apart from ourselves, all enjoying fresh and tasty dim sum. The staff were friendly and the restaurant was air conditioned and very clean. We enjoyed a wide range of dishes including pork buns, dumplings, chickens feet, carrot cake, fried wontons and glutinous rice. We ran out of space to sample more food. Cost for two of us was MYR 45. Restaurant is open from 7am to 3 pm every day ( a little later on weekends). Show less

Author: tayhockseng
Title: Worst eatery in Melaka
Review: Don’t waste time. Rubbish food... worse than canteen food. Says has a wide variety of nyonya kueh but there was only spring roll and goreng pisang!! Nasilemak only packet ones. Worst coffee anywhere !

Author: keaxn
Title: Good food
Review: Very good food and friendly staff, chendol is nice. Laksa is hot and tasty, just like my girlfriend. :)

Author: ahmao1996
Title: Best Nyonya Food Everrrrrr
Review: The best of the best Nyonya food in Melaka and Malaysia ，Nice environment ，Friendly Staff ，especially the aunty extremely friendly。

Author: harryberry89
Title: One of the best hidden gem for nyonya food
Review: Superb nyonya laksa! A must try and not to forget cendol for desert. Friendly chef and crews, feels very homey. Compulsory stop if you’re in Melaka.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Restaurant Attached with House
Review: An old nyonya restaurant at street vendor. Famous with its curry laksa & cendol. Cendol is too sweet. Curry is acceptable

Author: merryheartsgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Feeling like Home cooked breakfast
Review: The place is quite a run down roadside stall attached to a wooden house which is hard to notice. Look out for the owner’s old red car. The owner was very hospitable & friendly. Love the Nyonya laksa, chicken rendang & lontong which were good. The rest like mee siam & mee goreng were a disappointment, taste rather bland. The ice Kopi is very good, a bit like Vietnamese ice coffee. The chendol were so so coz the ice was very coarse, taste of the gula Melaka (local brown sugar) was good though. In terms of price, it was quite reasonable. We spent RM51 for 4 persons. Show less

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Yummmmmy!
Review: Located along the main road. You will not miss it as there are plenty of cars parked in front of the stall/house. A humble house with stalls at the side. Nyonya laksa was authentic and yummy. Cendol was ok. They also serve rendang chicken and several types of pre fried noodles. They even have nasi lemak. Good authentic homecooked food. Show less

Author: Alvin K
Title: My Home Cooked
Review: The place where remembered me of home cooked food that i missed a lot. Friendly owner with nice local like ambiance. Always visit this nice local peranakan nyonya food outlet whenever happen to be in Melaka. All food are nice to my taste bud

Author: elisa gKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Hidden Gem
Review: A local friend recommended the place and the food was fantastic! Love the laksa, cendol, nyonya dumpling and nasi lemak. Very friendly ladies who ran the business. They were cool, calm and pleasant despite the large crowd. Bought extra rice dumplings and a bottle of cencaluk to bring home. Highly recommend!Show less

Author: kiangggSingapore, Singapore
Title: A rare gem!
Review: My Dad who grew up in Malacca brought us here for lunch. It’s a rare gem, with authentic Nyonya food in a rather inconspicuous location. It’s located about 10 minutes Drive from the main central Malacca area but it’s well worth the drive. Parking is fairly easy to find outside the place.What I love most about the place is that it feels like home. Judy and Charlie (the Chef/owners) are really friendly and full of warmth. My favorite dish here is the Laksa, so flavorful!Great place to go if you’re craving some delicious Nyonya food for breakfast/lunch. Will be back when I’m back in Malacca!Show less

Author: Matt SWolverhampton, United Kingdom
Title: My number 1 place to eat in Malacca
