Review: I had the pleasure of living in Malacca for 3 years, so this review is based on my experiences over the last 3 years, rather than one specific visit.In summary, it was my favourite eating place in Malacca, simply because of how good the food is ... price doesn't even come into my thinking - but it is also a very cheap place to eat, making the value outstanding.From memory, it is open 5 days per week (closed Tuesday and Wednesday) and open from approx 8.00am until 2.00pm - but my recommendation is to get there before midday otherwise you risk your favourite dish being sold out.The setting is very basic, you are seated in the front garden/parking area of a small roadside house, and unless you know where to look it is very easy to drive past without noticing the sign (which is partially hidden by a tree)! The food served is known as Nyonya (Baba Nyonya or Perenakan) which is an almost unique fusion style found in Malacca, Penang and Singapore, historically based on a combination of Malay and Chinese cooking styles.The menu is quite small, Nasi Lemak, Chicken Rendang, Lontong, Siam Noodles ... BUT what they cook is perfect!It is well worth a visit for the high quality food, and it offers an alternative to some of the larger Nyonya restaurants in Malacca, the location is Klebang, which is a short 15 minute (approx 10km) drive out of Malacca (heading north along the coast, in the direction of Port Dickson).They don't serve alcohol, but as you would be going for brunch, it isn't the end of the world!A must visit for Malacca.Show less

Author: 880sky
Title: Breakfast
Review: They serve nice laksa. Is a home based cafe, the waitress there are very friendly, feel like being home.

Author: tanhosengkl
Title: Authentic nyonya food.
Review: Authentic nyonya food. Make me missed my mum cooking. The cendol is simple and nice. Just opposite the Bayan condo. Pineapple tart is good.

Author: DoreenLooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So. So. Good.
Review: 2 bowls over 2 days, and we even packed more laksa to bring back to KL :) Nothing pretentious about this place. Really good laksa and cendol. Very generous with ingredients and gula melaka. Flavours were rich and comforting. Soooo good. Good food, off the crazy Jonker/ town area, friendly owners :) Show less

Author: scubadude9
Title: Good Nyonya food in Melaka
Review: Chance upon this gem while in Melaka, was recommended by the hotel concierge to this eatery. A must try is the laksa, while to desert must be the cendol with gula melaka, delicious !!!

Author: NafLiverpool
Title: Breakfast
Review: Lovely small authentic  nyonya food. I love the cendol,very generous and the laksa was also very good. Mind you this place is just a warong or hawker style eatery but worth visiting if you are in the area.They are close every Tuesday & Wednesday.

Author: rowenaneblett
Title: Laksa at its best
Review:
Taken to this restaurant by friends who live in Melaka. Best Laksa I have ever eaten.
Also tried the Cendol a definite must try. 
So glad we were taken as we would not have found Nyonya, no frills very simple but tasty.

Author: aryindo
Title: Nice food
Review: Ate the nyonya laksa and cendol and the taste is good. It is quite far from town and we need to ask the taxi to wait for us. If not we might have difficulty going back to town.

Author: jasonsim90
Title: Nyonya Laksa and Cendol
Review:
If you are Cendol lover, this is the place you definitely want to try it out! 
Nyonya Laksa, super delicious! The curry is very thick and not spicy. The served portion is just nice for one pax.

Author: Cliff6108Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Almost like dining at home
Review: Whenever I crave for nyonya laksa, Nyonya Delight comes to mind. The gravy is of the right consistency which is full of flavor. Cockles are fresh and this to me is a must for nyonya laksa. Then a bowl of their awesome chendol for dessert makes a perfect meal.Show less

Author: vanessakohPETALING JAYA
Title: Always satisfying
Review: We like to stop here for brunch or lunch. Bong (the proprietor) has excellent lontong, a broth with coconut milk , vegetables and glass noodles served over pressed rice cubes. Her nyonya laksa is an especially aromatic version as she uses lots of daun kesum. Then, there's her rich, spicy chicken rendang. If you have any space left, her cendol is also total yummmmm. And, her prices are so very reasonable - You have enough money left to take-away some nyonya chang for the next day!Show less

Author: SLChongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Homestyle nyonya food
Review: Nyonya Delight is located along the main road from Klebang, Melaka heading north. It's a small establishment that is an extension of the owner's residence. They serve local staples such as nyonya laksa noodles, nasi lemak, mee siam noodles, fried kway teow noodles, lontong, chicken rendang, etc. They also serve cendol, which is a local desert. The cendol has a generous portion of gula melaka (brown sugar made from coconut). We went for lunch and the place was almost full on a Wednesday afternoon. The food was of acceptable taste at reasonable price but I'm giving this place a rating of 4 due to the friendly service that makes one feel very much at home. They are open from 7am to 3pm only, so plan for either breakfast or lunch for your visit.Show less

Author: Sook Ling TKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good homecook breakfast
Review: This small eatery is located in a house, and of course it served home cooked style of food. We tried the nyonya laksa, mee siam and nasi lemak (coconut rice) with chicken rendang. The food is great and best of all, its value for money. The service was excellent too, they made me felt like home.Show less

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Nyonya cuisine of Malacca
Review: A very small and unique family operated café in a kampong house by main road offering nyonya cuisine.( Nyonya or Peranakan are found mainly in Malacca/Penang. They are Chinese but speak the local Malay language).You get good lontong , nasi lemak, laksa and delicious nyoya cakes here, all home cooked. Its one of the best local cuisines offered in Malacca at very reasonable prices. The husband and wife team also speak English. Closed on Tuesday and opened for breakfast until about 2pm.Show less

Author: seesbc
Title: Awesome
Review: It's a fine dining Chinese restaurant with a remarkable view of A Famosa from the window.The services from the staff is remarkable and the food is tasty and served fresh and hot.Plates, bowls and spoons are sterilised with hot water before serving. A big plus especially during the pandemic, and a plastic bag is provided to place out face maskShow less

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Good Food
Review: Nice restaurant in Pahlawan, clean and good ambience. Friendly service. We had Shanghainese Dumpling, Sweet Sour Fish and Prawn and Vege. Good Dumplings and good food. The Pu Er tea was good as well. Good lunch

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice and Tasty Food
Review: We had our dinner at the Dragon-i Restaurant at Dataran Pahlawan Melaka. Cozy and nice restaurant. We had mini Dumpling as starter. Good and tasty Siao Long Pau. The French Beans fried with Minced Meat and Deep Fried Fish were tasty and nice too. The ice Hawthon Plum Tea and Ice Fruity Dark Tea were nice and flavorable. Good and enjoyable dinner we hadShow less

Author: 934charlieg
Title: Lunch
Review: I had tried their dumplings and lamian soup. Its delicious and also the service here is excellent. I would highly recommend to my friends and family

Author: Vince2882
Title: Dragon-I Restaurant, Dataran Pahlawan, Melaka
Review: Always like the wide choice of Chinese cuisine at mid range price in Dragon-I Restaurants, so we decided to give the one in Dataran Palawan a try. Nice Ambience and Deco. Food that we ordered were good and yummy.

Author: puchkaBengaluru, India
Title: Poor
Review: This restaurant inside the Mega Pahlawan Mall looked very impressive from the outside so we walked in expecting to enjoy a good meal. But it turned out as a.bad experience. The waiters barely understand English and quite brusque in their behaviour with foreigners. We ordered spring rolls and chicken with soya sauce. The surprise is that what you assume as complimentary is actually chargeable. And they arrived without even ordering for it. Like glass of chilled water, wet wipe, peanuts. Prices are steep. Wouldn't recommend eating here unless you are in a big group.Show less

Author: avinashchandraaBengaluru, India
Title: Poor food and very poor service
Review: We were extremely disappointed with both food and quality of service. They charge for everything like wet towel, glass of water, nuts etc. Ordered spring rolls and diced chicken with walnut in soya sauce and paid RM 51. There is a 10 percent service charge. It took more than 40 mi T to bring food. Show less

Author: RossR908
Title: Satisfactory lunch
Review: Had lunch here and thoroughly enjoyed it. Even though it was busy the staff were professional and attentive and the food was served in a timely fashion. Really good range of Chinese dishes at mid range prices. Would happily dine here again.

Author: EYeoSingapore, Singapore
Title: OK food at decent prices
Review: We usually lunch here when we are in the Mall. It is one of the less crowded restaurants, offering decent food at decent prices. Don't expect too much in terms of service and you won't be disappointed. The restaurant is clean, cool, and offers good food at ok prices. We usually just have a bowl of noodles and some dim sum each. I have nothing to recommend particularly, but nothing specific to criticise either.Show less

Author: Alice11-22-3
Title: Bad service!
Review: The servers seemed to be lacking in common/basic customer service. We were in the midst of eating when a waiter (Male, dressed in black jacket) rudely took the condiments tray away from our table to the table beside us WITHOUT even asking if we are done with it. We then requested for the condiments to be brought back to us. However, after a while another server, this time (Lady, dressed in black jacket) did THE EXACT SAME THING. I cant believe that for a big franchise like this, there is insufficient condiments for every table? And when we were there, it wasnt even during rush hours and the restaurant was almost empty except for few tables. The whole situation is very appalling, in the end we didnt enjoyed our dinner. The fact that the 2 who did such thing were not dressed in the common servers attire seemed to suggest that they are of higher position and should be the ones who lead the junior servers. But with such attitude, I seriously doubt their capabilities. I also noted that they seem to single us out since this only happen to us(TWICE!), and not to other tables. Why were there differential treatments, when I am paying equally for my food and services?When we told them off, no aplogies were given.Eventho the food is good, but bad services like this really put me off.Show less

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Good Lunch
Review: Had Nyonya Dumplings and Seafood La Mian & it was pretty much good portion and price. I like their sambal place onto the table. Too many dishes with pork and future menu design, please include non pork dishes and it would very much attracts customers. It's just a tencent opinion to increase yields. Show less

Author: TH06MAYLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Lunch for two
Review: We dined here at around midday on a Saturday. The staff weren’t very friendly unfortunately. We were given some beans on arrival. No napkins/serviettes. I had fried pork chop with mixed rice with a Carlsberg. My partner had the Szechwan chicken with a fruity iced tea. The chicken meat had a lot of bone and skin unfortunately, unlike other establishments where she has had the same dish. My dish was good though. The bill was around 85 RM (£16). The bill included a charge for the beans (listed as ‘titbits’) and for the moist cleaning towels - only around 5 RM in total but it annoys me when European restaurants do that with bread and/or olives. Show less

Author: trvkakiSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of our frequent chain
Review: This chain of restaurants is one of our frequent ones when we visit Malaysia for holiday, mainly as they are commonly found in major shopping malls.They are decorated cosy enough for a nice meal and service was relatively better than most restaurants.Their food was generally not bad and the portion of a good size. During this visit, the waiter informed us that they are running a RM1 promotion for a fried red snapper dish which further brings down the usual bill size.We will drop by this restaurant again as long as they managed to uphold their food standards.Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice Dumplings
Review: The Siao Long Pau (small dumpling) as starter is nice. Hot and tasty eat with vinegar and gingle. We have Fried Garupa in sweet sour with a tinge is spiciness and Australian Beef Chives for our rice. Tasty and delicious food. Good ambience and comfortable seating. Friendly service inspite of crowded patrons on holiday in Melaka.Show less

Author: krystaleh
Title: Very good Chinese
Review: Tasty and substantial portions. Came across this place by accident when hungry. Fab meal and good value. Pictures helped us order and all meals were good especially the beef in black bean with noodles.

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Good but kinda expensive
Review: Nice ambience. Love the spicy and sour noodless.  But not much ingredients.  Sweet and sour fish very normal. Service quiet slow. Order the abalone glutinous rice it cost RM 28 and the abalone is so tiny. Not worth. Overall quite expensive.

Author: sivasagi25
Title: Late lunch
Review: Only Chinese restaurant in Dataran Pahlawan.well located facing A Fomasa Fort.Great view.Nice ambient restaurant.Ordered Soup,Beancurd,Prawn,Beef and dumplings.Food tasted just good nothing special.pricing wise slightly on higher side.

Author: AmmyY14
Title: Service doesnt match with the food
Review: The food is really delicious at Dragon-i but the service at this branch is not that good. As the waiter and waitress are a bit blur and we were expecting them to be very friendly but disappointingly they arent... Anyway, the food is good here especially the xiao long bao. yummyShow less

Author: Chan KArau
Title: Food good but service is so so
Review: Food is good and food portion is reasonable.but the service is not worth for me have to paid 10 % service charge.the waiter came to take order without smile is no matter, but feel like i can afford for the price. i request a cup of warm water, after 3 time requesting. finally came with cold water.Show less

Author: MollyswayDenpasar, Indonesia
Title: Good standard chain restaurant
Review: Had lunch at Dragon I and found it to be nice. Have dined at this chain before. They do good Xiao Long Bai, fried Chicken with Dried Chillis, Sichuan Fish, Noodles and Fried Rice.Quality of food is quite high, service is good for local Malay. It is a clean and well decorated restaurant and is good for lunch or dinner. It was not busy but I had a late lunch. Would recommend this to other travellers looking for a reasonable feed in MelakaShow less

Author: KhidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Consistent quality food and service
Review: Whenever I see a Dragon-i restaurant in Malaysia, I know I can count on the restaurant to deliver quality food and service regardless of which branch it is. This is also one of my must eat restaurant whenever I travel to Malaysia. After the super lousy lunch at Fugo Ryori, the dinner at this restaurant made me very satisfied for the rest of my day. Show less

Author: Momotei
Title: Good food
Review:
I went to the one located in the mall. Nice ambience. Food is good. I ordered fried cod fish, half crispy duck, a vegetable and 3 drinks. About RM 210.
Will come again.

Author: RingoWYTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: FUGO RYORI at Bukit Beruang (Opened recently)
Review: Food served by Fugo Ryori always up to standard, I had tried another one but I have to mention the one in Bukit Beruang. The service was very good. As we did a little birthday celebration at the restaurant and they take all our requirements politely! They even prepare candle for us when they saw we are missing it. How warmth! I will definitely would want to visit again (of course, call for reservation as the restaurant comply to SOP for RMCO)Show less

Author: malaccatourism
Title: Latest Fugo ryori in Bukit Beruang
Review: Recommended japanese fine dining experience. Liquors are rip offs but food , presentation, ambiance and service makes that neqligible for a perfect dining experience.

Author: homa_l62
Title: Excellent
Review:
Polite and warm hospitality staffs, thus good service.
Food is delicious and in good quality.

Strongly advice you to make a reservation at least one day before or even earlier.

Author: chiachiangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely female staff and decent Japanese food
Review: We came here after the restaurant nearby we wanted was closed for lunch. Next, we chances upon this Japanese restaurant and was pleasantly surprised. Loved the service by the female staff, very helpful and genuine. The menu is very extensive and they even have a sake bar. Even the chawanmushi comes with different option. We had two kinds of udon and maki. Show less

Author: Thengle
Title: Good lunch at a reasonable price.
Review: The service was good and the rolls were tasty. Nice place for a very affordable sushi meal. Even on a crowded weekend, the service was quite timely as well.

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great tasting!
Review: Was actually heading for Wa Zen Japanese restaurant but was closed today, Anyway, Fugo Ryori was just round the corner so I drove by here.The service was not as bad as some trip advisor reviewers as mentioned. In fact, it was smooth sailing all the way. Dinner was a simple meal of sushi as shown in my photo. Overall,freshness was there and ambience was good. Two thumbs up! Show less

Author: 123yaps
Title: Very unpleasant experience
Review: My family and I go there for lunch because my friend said it was nice. We travelled far to reach the place. Go in around 12.15 noon, the place almost two third empty. Got ourselves a seat. The manager came and told us that table already being reserved although I couldn't see any reserve sign there. I saw another table got reserved sign and not this table. I ask whether there's any place we could seat. Immediately he said all already being reserved. I find it annoying because I was not being informed I need to reserve a place first before going there. Secondly, the distance we travelled there just to eat. Thirdly, they don't even bother to find a place to accomodate people who are walk in customers. No apology was given at all for the treatment. Even though some customers may have reserved a place, but what was the time reserved for the customers? We came so early, maybe we could have already eaten and left before the customers come. My husband just said dont ever come here again. Indeed, if every new customers think like that, how long will this restaurant last even though the food people said is delicious, simply because they only want to serve existing customers and reject new ones. I feel the same way because I can find other nice restaurants everywhere where I can enjoy my food without subjecting to such treatment. If, you dont want disappointment, dont go there, its not worth the effort.Show less

Author: Sandra WMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Brilliant Food!
Review: Generally I don’t eat Japanese food but friends took me to Fugo’s Batu Berendam branch and I was converted on the spot! The food here is amazing, definitely the best I have eaten. The menu is large and the staff very helpful with explaining the dishes. Portions are ample and beautifully presented. Prices very reasonable. The atmosphere is relaxed and friendly. It was very busy when we went during the week and we were advised to book. Will definitely be coming here regularly.Show less

Author: Relax817354
Title: Authentic Japanese Cuisine
Review: We came across Fugo Ryori at Batu Berendam by accident. So we tried it for dinner. Parking space is ample enough, unlike the one at Melaka Raya. We were given a thick book of menu. That shows the food choices are incredible. Ultimately, we ordered 7 different food items from the menu and 2 different drinks. Some of the pics are attached. Conclusion: no regrets. We'll come again to sample other food items.Show less

Author: CarolMelakaMelaka
Title: A treat from relative.
Review: I seldom go to a japanese restaurant as it is not my cup of tea. However when my sister and brother in law came down to melaka for a makan visit we were invited for a hearty meal at Fugo Ryori. The food serve though may be on the high side but the quality of the food served there is excellant. I could say that whatever that was ordered on the table was good to taste. Certainly a must try for all japanese food lovers.Show less

Author: nerrisateohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: The best japanese restaurant in town!
Review: Is it my 6th visit here and their new menu makes me want to come every week! Their sashimi portion is generous, food was delicious (so far i tried sushi/soba/unagi rice/hotpot), and their dessert never let me down. The price is acceptable for a student like me and my friends, totally worth stuffing my belly! Show less

Author: June P
Title: Reasonably priced Japanese food
Review: Tasty Japanese food that is not too expensive. Ambience is good too and the toilets are clean and almost hotel standard. We ordered quite a number of dishes and the bill was less than RM400 for a family of 5.

Author: ChngLT
Title: Good Food
Review:
Went with my family for dinner..  Food was good..  Portions especially the sashimi were generous
A let down was the soup noodles.. It was because of the texture of the noodles..tasted wierd. 
Overall..  It is worth a visit if you are craving for japanese

Author: AuldSoul
Title: The best Japanese in town!
Review: Had dinner here and we explored literally the whole menu. Loved every dish and the recommendation is sake! Staff is friendly and welcoming. Totally loved it. Attached bill is for 2 people.

Author: GTWiratiJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Great Taste in the middle of Curry Foods
Review: It was 8pm. I felt hungry and my hotel didn’t have room service. Then I went out to find a place to eat. This Japanese restaurant only one in this crowded area Malacca City. I ordered package Beef Teriyaki, Unagi and Chicken Karage.It’s good taste except the salad. They only used thousand island sauce. If they use sesame sauce, it will be good cause it connects to the taste of soya sauce.Show less

Author: rhclim
Title: Good food at a reasonable price
Review: We had dinner and were not disappointed by the food served. It was recommended to us by the hotel staff. The staff were pleasant and helpful and the ambience was what one would expect in a Japanese restaurant.

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Its our favourite Japanese restaurant as its near to our residence. Parking spaces limited as the restaurant is located on the main street of Melaka Raya.We always made advance reservation to avoid disappointment. Also due to aged parent, we prefer to dine at ground floor.Greeters were polite and speedily ushered us to our reserved table. The air conditioning can be cold so my elderly folks prefer a warmer area.We loved the garlic rice and whole squid besides the other dishes. All the dishes tasted good n are well presented. Service is efficient too. We also loved the pickled ginger. One of my family members ordered Mizu Shingen Mochi for dessert and I ordered Nama Matcha Ice. Can't describe all the dishes we ate, you need to taste it for yorself.If you are a member, there is a 10% discount on your bill. This can amount to free desserts ordered.Show less

Author: 330edwinalLos Angeles, California
Title: Slow and inconsiderate service
Review: Similar to another review below, the food came out slowly. Eventually everything came out except for my grandfathers meals and we ended up waiting over an hour. We asked the waitress 4 times and eventually asked the manager twice for the last order. No offer to comp the last order even when we asked. Bad service, will not recommend. There are other places to get similar food without the slow attitude.Show less

Author: Taym130
Title: Love This Place
Review: When I first step in, I and my family received a very warm greeting as all the service line welcome us, food presentation was nice, definitely will dine in again

Author: Loyingyi Y
Title: Delicious!!!
Review: The best jap restaurant in melaka so far i visited. Especially their fish salad highly recommended! Staffs are friendly also although they were quite busy also. Will be back one day.

Author: Loyingyi Y
Title: Delicious!
Review: The best japanese restaurant in melaka so far i visited. Especially fish salad highly recommended😋. Staffs also very friendly n patient even i know they were quite busy.

Author: bppj2
Title: Amazing Japanese Food
Review:
For me Fugo Ryori Japanese Restaurant is the best Japanese restaurant in Malacca town!

This place is one of my family’s favorite restaurant.We always enjoy our dinner at here!They provide good service,nice environment and amazing food !

Author: phoebet546
Title: Wide selection of Japanese food
Review:
Their menu is pretty extensive.
Food is decent
We were a little unlucky as we were seated beside a family who clearly did not care about other diners' feelings by letting their kid scream and cry the whole time.

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Great sushi
Review: Had a wonderful evening out at this Japanese restaurant. Very affordable for its quality. Am contend

Author: derekang1980Singapore
Title: Excellent authentic Japanese cuisine
Review: The food was quite exceptional! Standard of all the dishes we ordered were all quite authentic and up to mark. Some items were also very unique and original like the dragon fruit maki. Service was attentive and efficient! All the wait staff were very polite and had attention to details. Most likely due to the excellent management and outlet manager who was seen at the fore front greeting customers, checking on everyone's welfare! Show less

Author: Iwan34Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Bad Service ...
Review: Went on a Sunday with 2 friends , the restaurant was busy with few small groups. Already had a bad feeling on service when we were asked to wait for sometime for them to clear an empty table. Once seated made us wait for half hour just to order. Tehy keep ignoring the bell numbering system, actually should just dont have that. More interested to take care of bigger groups than individual tables with 2-3 persons. We walked out and they just see and ignore us. Too much business for them I thinkl...Will never go there again. Tried it before and was okay but this time really kill off the intention.Show less

Author: KhidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Never again
Review: We were full of expectancy before we came here for lunch after reading the reviews. We arrived about 20 mins earlier and discovered to our dismay that they only open at 12 pm sharp so we had to go another place to grab a drink and waited for the restaurant to open.Indeed, the decor is great but that is about all you get. The service from one of staff who seems to be the in-charge was severely lacking. He greeted us with a sour face and never acknowledged us each time we said thank you. When we asked to return or replace the sashimi ordered because the maguro looked very aged, he kept telling us this was how it was supposed to look. The meal all the way downhill after that. We just could not wait to finish our unpleasant meal and leave.For people like us who have travelled to Japan and had Otoro and Maguro at Tsukiji and Kuromon markets, the sashimi they served was a sad excuse. The slices were too thick and the maguro was almost brown in colour. I have never sashimi so lacking in lustre (see photographs). In the end, he reluctantly replaced the maguro with salmon although we requested for Hotate and were willing to top-up for the difference. His reason was that the Hotate were still frozen. Are you kidding me? How can a restaurant open for business at 12 pm and some of your ingredients are still frozen?If there is anything I can find to praise about this restaurant, it was the waitress who is working part-time there. She is a gem and I hope the restaurant recognises her value.Show less

Author: Andrew T
Title: Highly Recommended Japanese Restaurant
Review: Fugo Ryori offers great quality and good Japanese cuisines at reasonable price. It could easily be placed higher than the usual franchised Japanese restaurants brand. They offers a wide ranges of food served from fresh ingredients and sushi is made fresh in order. The waitress and on duty manager is polite and friendly, making the dining experiance more enjoyable. Show less

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Another awesome Japanese joint in Melaka
Review: Came to this place with my friend as we always pass by this restaurant wondering how's the food here. The ambiance is outstanding and the environment is welcoming. The staff are attentive and friendly also. We ordered a Hakutsuru Josen sake and it was superb (we parked the bottle here as well - we will be revisiting the place soon with my other friends). We ordered the Kuro Mental Sizu, Lobster Tata Maki, Salmon Cheese Mentai Maki and the Gyoza (these are the ones I highly recommend) - I'm speechless and in awe with the quality and the similarity to the taste I got when I visited Japan a few years back. It was very delicious and succulent. We also ordered the Ika Teriyaki which was done superbly well. The sets are good as well. We finished off with the usual desserts, even those were nice. A nice finisher to an outstanding meal. Pricing is reasonable even though it would be in the high side (I can tell you it's worth it). Show less

Author: Cassandra Y
Title: Awesome Pawsome!!
Review: Last night my friend and I decided to eat sushi, so we eat here. "Shake Sashimi" (Salmon) was really fresh, which you should try it! At last, we eat dessert, Vanilla Monaka Ice-cream. Ohh, it's super duper yummeh! But I would like to apologize for you guys got to work a little longer as we're the last customers to come out..Didn't know it close at 10pm as we were first time here. However, your service are really great! Definitely will come back again and recommend this to my friends & family.Show less

Author: Tammy L
Title: average jap restaurant
Review: Food always out of stock, limited choices .However staff are very friendly and hope they can improve on the food menu

Author: Ck L
Title: Cosy jap restaurant
Review:
4 adults n 4 children visited e restaurant last night. Atmosphere was great. Staff was polite n responsive. 

Food was great no doubt e price was consider expansive. 

We spend rm 220 overall.

Author: 68Seng
Title: Father's Day Celebration
Review: Food served very slow. Serving came not in proper sequence. One of the main course left out and spoil our dinner mood when we have to wait till very late as the meal was for our father. Spoil our father day celebration. need to improve and pre inform customer if we have to wait. Show less

Author: DesDiFai75Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Quality Jap in Melaka
Review: Family got really tired of eating all the usual popular choices in Melaka so we decided for some Jap instead. Checked out this place and their banner offering 20% discount for this month enticed me even more :)Place is pretty nice and near the hotel where we stayed as well. Ordered the set meal, udon, maki and salad and they hit the mark! Very well done in quantity, quality and value. Service was good and ambiance well decorated and thought off as well. Kudos to you.Show less

Author: nabilahkhalid
Title: Thirst squeezer!
Review: A refreshing beverage. The taste is sweet and has creamy aftertaste from the ice cream. It is very good

Author: Sally MPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Must try!!
Review: Travelling last minute with my partner. The famous Coconut Shake in Batu Berendam area you need to try this. Even Q line so long but is fast. I bought coconut shake special is RM4.20 per cup. Not too sweet. And I like this. This picture also with the owner coconut shake batu berendam is Sister Nurul. My friend sister so we visited them together. Hope her business success in future. ❤️❤️Show less

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Visited place to try its coconut milk shake
Review: Popular place amongst locals.However I found milk shake too sweet.Coconut was not soft but you get hard pieces of coconut in your mouth.Drink tasted of sugar and ice cream.No taste of coconut water.Place served other local delicacies and lots of local snacks.Lots of seating and place is spacious.Ample public parking.Service was good.Show less

Author: nuruljoannaotKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food hunting
Review: We stayed at Amverton Heritage Hotel, Ayer Keroh. So only took 7+km to get to Batu Berendam food court. Due to the long weekend, this place was jammed pack with people. Better go there at least with your partner because the looooongggg line up for Coconut shake and Kuih Keria Gula Melaka. So better splits with your partner in order to get the food and drinks quick. Here we bought kuih keria gula melaka for 20pcs (10pcs =rm6), coconut shake special (with vanilla ice cream on top), nasi lemak ayam goreng bertepung (soooo delicious) and mee rojak (also mouth watering because of the spiciness, savoury and sweet taste). Coconut shake was yummy (a little bit sweet tho) and that kuih keria was soft on inside. Unfortunately we forgot to take pictures of them. Hahahaa.. Definitely will repeat back once we back in Melaka. Please expect some trouble with getting proper parking lot. Show less

Author: Aidil85
Title: Tasty coconut shake
Review: Their coconut shake is one of my personal preference. When we came to Melaka we always go to this place to get our coconut shake. Their staff is very friendly and very efficient.

Author: pychia
Title: Taste ok, limited parking
Review: Limited parking by roadside and shoplot. Price reasonable but taste nothing to shout about. A lot of other food choice available. Free coconut water or longan drink for patron. Fried baby crab quite nice.

Author: Puanmh2017Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Short visit to Melaka
Review: Tried the coconut shake and cucur udang here. The coconut shake is just ok not so good compared to one in Taman Melawati Kuala Lumpur. Reasonable price . Parking space quite limited but there are RELA staff to help you. No doubt have to queue but the seller are efficient . Tried also cucur udang here but taste below par.Show less

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Coconut Shake
Review: The coconut shake taste below par. Price is reasonable & unlimit top up coconut drink. Limited parking around the outlet

Author: anfiqahb
Title: Worth to give a shot !
Review: I am not a fan of coconut shake, but it tastes good. The place is good for chilling, relaxing and enjoying Malay's way of tea time. Variety of Malaysian's food offered and be prepared yourself for taking lots of calories !

Author: Cammal_BrownBoyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Here for the first time and tried the coconut shake. Not bad taste and quite similar to the other famous one in Klebang. Seating space is a lot and price is rm3.70 for the special version which comes with a scoop of ice cream. Will come back if im in Melaka. Show less

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: A much needed thirst quencher
Review: A delicious thirst quencher. Must try! Apparently a signature drink of Melaka.If you arrive on Friday do take note that they close during afternoon Muslim prayer time. However, the sale of the shake is at the restaurant behind.Fascinating location to find traditional Malay snack sold by neighbouring stalls.Show less

Author: megatshamsulnizamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Worth a visit!
Review: Theirs is on par in term of quality with the one in Pantai Klebang but with lesser waiting time. Have varieties of coconut shake n water. And have been told that coconut water is free of charge n free refill if you dine in. And also pls try traditional kuih keria which is only located next stall. However, parking is limited. Show less

Author: Pamzinzi
Title: Short Trip to Malacca
Review: Very well known with its coconut shake. Will get this drink every time visited Malacca. Fast service and recommended to those who visit Malacca. It really quench your thirst in any wheather especially during hot and sunny day. Thumbs up!

Author: NUR WAHIDAH A
Title: best coconut shake ever
Review: Outstanding, thirst quenching shake everyone should try.. will not dissappoint you!! just be prepared to wait a long queue, but fast service, no worry. other stalls sell food, and banana fritters..

Author: hanitau
Title: JJCM
Review: You can get the well known kuih keria antarabangsa from here. It is less hassle in terms of the waiting time as compared to the one in Limbongan. They also hv keropok lekor, banana fritters, donuts, sweet potatoes fritters & many more. The yong tau fu is also ok besides the mee rojak. Drinks like mata kucing & coconut water is free of charge if you dine in. Worth a visit if you are in Melaka. Show less

Author: anisemayoJenjarom, Malaysia
Title: Niceee
Review: For RM 3.70 per cup of special coconut shake, worth to buy! They even have free refills on each of the table. So u can just add in ur cup. The place is like a mini food court place. There are kuih keria, rojak, juices, fruit stalls next to this stall. Show less

Author: cikjah
Title: okey
Review: follow my friend to come here and try coconut shake and other dish.. good price but for coconut shake i dont like chocolate sprinkle.. i like in klebang more

Author: Itazzi
Title: Affordable and worth the visit
Review: If you want to see a different perspective of malaysian hip signature dish, u can try the local coconut shake and also the kuih keria.It’s gonna quench ur thirst especially during hot season. U can also try out air kelapa lemon if u are a lactose intolerant, as the coconut shake has milk as one of the base ingredient in it. Quick service though the queue is long, but it might not take hours for u to stand in line. There are of course plenty of other kuih, Parking is limited, u have to play smart and create ur own parking space. Show less

Author: achik95
Title: Better then Klebang
Review: For those who came to Melaka for coconut shake, you better choose here then the klebang one. Their coconut shake is smoothier plus, for those who dine in, you can top up your water for free and there are free coconot water.

Author: fadhli0Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious coconut shake with shorter waiting time
Review: The coconut shake is of comparable quality with the one in Pantai Klebang. Plus point for this outlet is that the waiting time is a lot lesser and the turn around per customer is faster. Parking is a hassle though as there are limited legal parking spaces around the area. The kuih keria stall next to it is worth a try. It tasted better than the Kuih Keria Antarabangsa and with a lot shorter waiting time.Show less

Author: Ahmad A
Title: Delicious Jagung Bakar and coconut shake
Review: must try jagong bakar (grill corn) and coconut shake.. or do try new stall mango shake with kueh gelang gula melaka.

Author: Elyn D
Title: Must try!
Review: The best coconut shake in Melaka! You must try coconut shake in Batu Berendam. Personally I prefer this coconut shake rather than coconut shake in Klebang.

Author: dinida
Title: Delicious Coconut shake at great price!!
Review: Love the coconut shake which is at great price. There's long queue but serving is fast! Also bought the Kueh Keria nearby , delicious!!

Author: MuhammadM3165
Title: Excellent place for local cuisine
Review: A very popular Coconut Shake (definitely better choice than Klebangs) and offer various local foods such as Laksa, Mee Rebus etc. There is also several food stall that sell other type of snacks such as Goreng Pisang, Keropok Lekor and Donat.Come on the evening for merrier environment.Show less

Author: NorthvannerNorth Vancouver, Canada
Title: Perfect place to stumble upon!
Review: Had just arrived in Melaka, and endured the worst karaoke ever at Barlacca further along the river. Literally stumbled upon this place and so glad we did. Fa was exceptionally accommodating and sweet. Had so much fun we went back the next night, when we met Mandi and some of Fa's friends. Highly recommended!Show less

Author: TracyandNick
Title: Lovely cafe, great fun and very accommodating
Review: Surprise find, Mandy and the staff were lovely they accommodated our requests, the food was lovely, quickly home cooked and the music was great. We danced the night away and had a lovely evening by the canal side. Great hospitality

Author: Mandype30
Title: Dinner
Review: Excellent night. Lovely staff. Thanks Mandy and Fe....😊 Impromptu singing and dancing with lovely freshly cooked food!!

Author: A958GNbriancMaidstone, United Kingdom
Title: Great food, beer and music
Review: Had three nights in Melaka and visited D'Paris every night. Great atmosphere, mainly due to Fa who is a very friendly and welcoming host. Menu may be small but the food is delicious and freshly cooked. Probably the best priced beer too. Lovely view right on the river opposite the church and superb playlist of classic rock, Queen and a bit of reggae thrown in! Definitely worth a visit or two if only to meet Fa who was such a pleasure to meet.Show less

Author: Andy_Sufficent
Title: Very good Thai Food, very
Review:
Very good Thai Food, very friendly owner and Thai cook. Fa is just super friendly and nice to talk to!
I definitely recommend this place!

Author: Petebrackpool
Title: Excellent
Review: Very enjoyable meal at a gorgeous setting. Cocktails are excellant, taste better and loads cheaper than the hard rock down the road. Customer service by Fa was brilliant, she was really chatty and friendly. Clean western toilets. Food was excellant. Would highly recommend. 👍👍😊

Author: Varwara
Title: Great place by the river/ Отличная еда и вид
Review: We had a very good dinner with coctails here. The staff is friendly, food was very good (glass noodles and TomYam) and not spicy. Portions are big and coctails are great. The church is just across the river, so we enjoyed the view

Author: LovelyDinosaurWokingham, United Kingdom
Title: Great spot by the river
Review: Being along the river amongst another 10 or so bars/cafes completion is rife for the passing trade. D’Paris must be fairly new as this is the first review on TA! Service was really friendly, the beer comparable to other places along the river (c.RM18 for a large bottle of beer - 660ml), and good variety of local, Thai, Chinese and Western dishes on the food menu. Chilli Chicken was crazy hot spicy, but the Chicken Curry was really good. Both were clearly freshly cooked. Bar was playing good selection of pop/rock tunes at a level you could chat over. Staff were asking if we had any favourites we wanted them to play!Great place to sit and drink along side the river :)Show less

Author: oyangc
Title: Service
Review: Today we went from there, the service person name is Atik.he is very skinny but i show Work very hard, He tolk very simply but every speech hildy got fun.we are enjoy our visit, hope will there Again for get fun from atik..

Author: A4900WDandreag
Title: Fabulous lunch experience
Review: Friendly and fantastic service. Especially Daya who was very helpful in recommendations on the menu and an excellent photographer.  Food was Great. Ambiance surreal.

Author: thilakawatti t
Title: GravyBaby with Nino
Review: I think one of the best restaurant here in melaka jonker, i have great food thanks to Nino who is a great help on choosing our food, enjoyed a lot this nihht, very commedable and surely will comeback, and also ill mention the great vibe and view of the shop. Thanks Nino and GravybabyShow less

Author: RJCF1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice location with good service and food
Review: This Gravy Baby has a good location. The staff are attentive and the service is good. As in all Gravy Baby outlets they do sometimes run out of certain menu items but it is not a big deal at they have a large choice on the menu. A good place to visit for a few drinks, nice food and good location.Show less

Author: Lll6033
Title: Overall ok
Review: Nice view restaurant due to beside the river.But it is too noisy even I went during weekend, the guests talked so loud with the high volume of music played in restaurant, headache thou.The food is ok, I ordered mantou which a bit salty but the tacos is nice. A bit pricey.If you prefer to a happening place, you may suitable with it. But if you prefer with a quiet place with nice music, you should be considered.Show less

Author: DaiwahjingHong Kong, China
Title: Dinner by the river
Review: The staff and their team is friendly and helpful, food is great and so is the view, one of the staff name Naim he is very helpful i order steak and my husband order they don’t have so we choose another dish and he try to bring us the dish very quick so we can eat more or less the same time, will definitely visit again if we travel to Melaka.Show less

Author: Happygolucky444Phuket, Thailand
Title: Brunch
Review: Came here twice. Thought maybe will be different because when the first visit,what we initially ordered,came back all not available... ending we order food that only available...2nd visit,my goodness...same thing saying that not available because good business..huh..as early as 1130am,no more waffles,no more pies,no more all items we want to?? Lol... ambient was good...food ,emm..there are lots of good cafes around.Show less

Author: Seankhoo91
Title: 1st time here for anniversary
Review: Good food,good service from all the staff from taking orders to serving to clearing the table..their manager Naim(i guess) made sure we had a pleasure time and comfortable..tq..

Author: Ms_penny8888
Title: Excellent service and fantastic food
Review: If you are thinking to rewind yourself after a long day of work, Gravy Baby Melaka is the place to be. Situated by the river bank, with an excellent service and superb food what else could you ask for. Kudos to their bartender, Mohi for the incredible lychee mint cooler and their server Kaiyum for the excellent service and warm welcome. Well done and keep up the good job. Will be back again soon for another round of yum food.Show less

Author: 590jacksonc
Title: Fantastic Dinner, Super Great Environment and friendly staff.
Review:
Lychee Mint and Apple Cooler is awesome.
All the food is awesome! Highly recomended
Thank you bar tender Mr Mohi to make us nice drinks and Mr Kaiyum very helpful and friendly

Author: Jtan8992Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Service Recovery from a junior staff
Review: We visited this outlet in the evening. Was presented the full menu but later found out that half of the items were not available only after we ordered. Essential items like pizzas, beer (it’s a pub isn’t it?!) were unavailable. Sensing our disappointment and growing anger our server Gayung ,(hope I got that right) went out of his way to take care of us, giving special attention and ensuring the food we ordered were properly prepared. Food was quite good; however the 2 chicken dishes were dry. It would have been nicer to have a beer to go with it ‍♀️. The pub’s ambience and surrounding scenery made up for the initial disappointment. Worth another visit. ( note that no senior staff came to explain or pacify us throughout our dinner. The supervisor (?) was nonchalant at best). Kudos to Gayung for his good initial and service recovery. Well done. Not so for his superiors.Show less

Author: sujilovesfood
Title: Great family hangout
Review: Great food being served by friendly n courteous stewards..... a place to visit again n again. Spc thanks to Jose for his great hospitality .... keep up the good job man...

Author: NicksonC18
Title: NOT SUITABLE FOR FAMILY
Review: Loud music starts at 6pm. The loudspeakers with extra bass makes that place more like a drinking place then a real restaurant.Brought my family twice there, still have to give a bad review. Food i normal. Burgers are ok but costly. Best thing in here: The view of the riversideShow less

Author: David G
Title: Escape the rain
Review: We have jumped in here on 2 occasions in July and Dec 2020 to escape a thunderstorm. On both occasions we had excellent food from cakes to burgers. Overlooking the river, worth visit.

Author: dyganonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Bye Bye Sid's Pub, Hello GravyBaby
Review: Sid's pub is owned by GravyBaby. Everytime when we visited, The headline of receipt is always Gravybaby for years.GravyBaby has totally taken over the restaurant. No more pork is served. All sausage and bacon is horrible substitution. Look like we have to we have to find new place for drink and dinner now.Show less

Author: sazanis
Title: Enjoyable Dinner with warm hospitality
Review:
I enjoy the Gravy... 
Superb Ribeye and excellent cocktails... 
Thanks to Naim for the great explanation of the dishes and recommendations... 
Cozy environment

Author: mohdoqba
Title: All in all great experience
Review:
Nice ambiance, excellent food, fabulous coffee and awesome view. On top the service is excellent, specially by Mr. Naim. 

An ideal place for breakfast, lunch, afternoon coffee, dinner and for some of us what we call in-betweens.

Author: EvaShereen
Title: Good fnb and good service by Nain
Review: I love this place. Food was so good and delicious esp the beef pizza. Mr Nain was very polite , fast and kind to serve us. Good job to u and all team... wish u all the best and hope to come back again !

Author: unicxrnlisa
Title: Amazing Service
Review: Good service crew, nice food and cool atmosphere! The chillest waiter, Naim. We came here for 3 days in a row. Definitely will come back for our next trip to melaka.

Author: Lovelytravellerchina
Title: Excellent view , excellent service
Review: Lovely eatery in the Melacca ciry . Delicious food with a large variety that will suit all tastebuds. Staff are friendly, helpful and accommodating to diners with allergies! Rimon was very attentive and very Friendly . we will definitely return again.

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Good breakfast, nice riverside seats...
Review: Has a really nice selection of breakfasts and good coffee. There are also a few tables next to open windows that offer river views, which is nice.

Author: khairilrazaliKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Great place, good food
Review: Love the ambiance. We had goat cheese tartine and big English breakfast and coffee. The food was delicious and fulfilling after our morning stroll around Porta de Santiago. The staff were really nice. However, the service was super slow. We waited for about an hour from the moment we ordered till we got our meals. I guess their morning supply arrived late because we saw them taking stuff into the kitchen while we were waiting for our meals. It would be nicer if they inform us beforehand of that situation.Show less

Author: Justalhafiz
Title: Good lighting and decor for
Review: Good lighting and decor for photography. Cakes are so-so and overpriced. Easy to spot and accessible by pedastrians.

Author: Vivianlim865
Title: Love Melaka
Review: Environment is nice, Cappuccino nice, Chocolate milkshake very sweet. But food served too slow. Nice cafe to chill up.

Author: bigbrother888888
Title: Good Breakfast
Review: Good Breakfast, not as cheap as some of the other places, nice relaxing, cool design.  decent food pie and mash in the afternoon seems to be popular. worth a visit.

Author: serenawild
Title: Lovely view and lovely staff :)
Review: After a good meal at the KL restaurant we came for breakfast which was very pleasant (slightly more expensive than local places but it’s western food and certainly not a rip off). There’s loads to chose from on the menu so its the kind of place that would suit everyone. The view is lovely and our server Sazzad was very friendly and attentive making us feel very welcome! Show less

Author: Gapyearizzie
Title: Nice location and good service.
Review: We previously went to the GravyBaby in KL and liked it so we decided to go again. I got a pie and mash, which was pretty good considering we’re in Malaysia and it was a nice break from curry! Gravy was a bit odd. More expensive than local food but for western food it is reasonably priced. The building is right on the river and we got a table next to the window so the view was beautiful. Our server Sazzad was very friendly and helpful. If you’re craving western food I’d recommend. Show less

Author: CanadaVoyage123Singapore
Title: Service and view good, food horrible
Review: Wanted a place to eat with some variety. Gravy Baby sounded like a tourist trap and should have known better but late and hungry, we said “what the heck”. Wrong move. View is nice, service friendly, good choice of food, but quality below mediocre. Sent my plate back (which pissed my wife off as she knew she was going to eat her cold burger alone and wait until I finish mine, which I gobbled up) as main course (chicken) and sides were cold. People sitting next to us (4 pax) left as they were waiting for close to an hour, sipping on their drinks, waiting for their food to arrive.Bottom line, if you like cold and over cooked food, not in a rush (need two hours to dine in), Gravy Baby is the place for you. Enjoy.Show less

Author: siokjinKajang, Malaysia
Title: first visit, good food and did not disappoint
Review: went with my family on a Monday after reading a review from a blog, and since many shops were closed on Monday. What turned out to be a casual visit ended up with surprisingly great nyonya food and almost zero crowd. Had pai tee, pongteh and chicken curry. it's a non-halal restaurant if I remember correctly. The cendol was also great! Great price with set meals, hence we got free veggie.Will definitely visit again, provided I find any other better ones and don't have to queue over an hour just to eat. we hope there is customer loyalty promo for us giving an honest yet good review :DShow less

Author: William7788Singapore
Title: 4 out of 5 of us got food poisoning
Review: Had mee Siam, nasi lemak n popiah to share. Four but one of us got very bad food poisoning and he did not eat the mee Siam. Never had this problem eating here previously. Food hygiene questionable

Author: herbertsmith241065Melbourne, Australia
Title: Genuinely home cooked.
Review: Very few places in this over commercialised town has a nice cheap place to eat a simple no frills meal. The meals are like what our nyonya friends would do for us. No msg and classic. We came here for breakfast and had a great meal or two. The place was quiet and about 13 mi s walk from our room at Silverscape. Well worth a visit as there are many great places to eat around here at 11am!Show less

Author: adng1129Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great home cook food at reasonable price
Review: Nice little family run Nyonya restaurant with great tasting food.  Had a simple meal of Nyonya Laksa, Popiah, Pie Tee and Cendol. All made to perfection. Even gave us more Laksa soup on request coz we dranked up every drop.Best of all, we only had to forgo a Starbucks Frappuccino Venti to pay for the meal. Definitely worth a visit when in Melaka.Show less

Author: Krypt0nkid
Title: Hidden gem for authentic nonya food
Review: We had badass nonya food here at the unicorn cafe. The food was so good, we even bought back some of the dried stuff sold. The Otah-otah was one of the best I've tried.

Author: butterandflySingapore, Singapore
Title: A must-go when in Malacca
Review: The last time I was here was 2 years ago and we chanced upon this little eatery while looking for authentic Peranakan food. We fell in love with their Babi Pongteh. 2 years on, we knew we had to go back to have a taste of the their yummy authentic Peranakan food.This time, we ordered the Babi Pongteh, which was as yummy as we remembered it to be. We tried the Cincalok omelette, Nyonya Chap Chye and Ikan Pari. It was all really good. They serve really nice chendol too and the family that runs the restaurant are very friendly and makes you feel at home.This is truly a hidden gem in Malacca.Show less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Hidden gem for nyonya food
Review: This is a hidden gem which my mother recommended. It serve authentic nyonya food. We order popiah which tasted wonderful. Probably one of the best in Melaka. The laksa also tasted good. However the mee siam noodle was not very good. They also serve rice with other nyonya dishes which we do not partake.However overall the food was good.Show less

Author: k0hk3Singapore, Singapore
Title: Simply yummy
Review: Located at Melaka Raya 10, a rather far end from the Dataran Pahlawan area, it is about 12 minutes walk from Hatten Hotel. There are many eateries and restaurants around this area.Very simple décor but delicious food. Family run business and unpretentious - this is a home-cooked Peranakan cuisine. We were there at about 2pm, hence it was quite empty. We ordered the very popular Pai Tee (MYR 4.50) which came in a set of 5 small crispy snacks wrapped with turnip, dry shrimps and bean sprouts. A small bowl of home-made chilli was also provided. It was simply yummy.The otak (MYR 10) was steaming hot when served. Kind of grilled fish mixed with spices and coconut milk. I love its freshness and coconutty flavour. Another enjoyable dish.Nyonya Chap Chye (MYR 8) despite its mild curry colour, it was spicy. A combination of cabbage, long bean and red carrot cooked in curry. You need white rice to go with this dish.The Nyonya laksa noodle (MY 6) in spicy broth was mild. It did not have too rich in coconut milk flavour. Ingredients were hard boiled egg, taupok, bean sprout and some vegetable.Lastly not to be missed was the chendol (MYR 3.80)– Nyonya cuisine star player. We ordered one bowl to share. I could taste that the coconut milk was home-made. Gula melaka was sweet but not overly sweet. It was also very aromatic.Serving authentic Nyonya food with such affordable price, this is a gem find. It is all about the food here.Show less

Author: amadeusgalileosabrePerth, Australia
Title: little gem
Review: opened 1030am to 430pm, closed on Thursday, this non-halal Peranakan cafe is run by a family. food are delicious. we had 3 dishes; Nyonya Laksa, Nasi Lemak with Babi Asam and the Otak-Otak. they are superb. the cafe is clean and wonderfully decorated with Peranakan decór. will definitely return again, no doubt.Show less

Author: KurtM28Malmo, Sweden
Title: Hidden gem
Review: In a backstreet not far from Mahkota shopping center is this gem of a little cafe. Family- run it already closes at 4.30pm. But do come here for Strait Chinese breakfast or lunch and you will not be disappointed. Great food, super clean and tidy and very friendly. Go for their My Laksa, their tender Babi Asam (Sour Pork) and the cendol with a twist, and you will leave with a smile on your face. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: MatzhuangSingapore
Title: Fantastic Home-cooked Food at Reasonable Prices
Review: Had a late lunch at Unicorn Cafe recently and I must say that the food was great! The food feels like home and this family run business is so warm and welcoming. Our favorites were the popiah and kueh pie ti. Do leave some space for their durian chendol - the durian is a slab of actual durian from a local organic plantation and chendol has the right amount of Gula Melaka (not overly sweet). Best of all, prices are very reasonable. Serving is on the small side, but that means u can order a greater variety of food. Show less

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Ideal for quick bite
Review: Came over for tea time as I was recommended by my spouse. Understand that this quaint coffe place also serve peranakan dishes like babi pongteh and likes like otak otak and others. Do try their pai tee or popiah dishes which tasted nice.

Author: Stephanieteoh1988
Title: True to no MSG
Review:
Their food was rather bland, could use a little more salt for flavours. The best dish was their cendol melaka. 

Perfect with the burnt sugar taste.

Author: JimC619Spencers Wood, United Kingdom
Title: Nyonya cuisine delight
Review: I wanted to leave a review after catching this from YouTube vloggers @chasingaplate. Whilst my wife is from Melaka she did not know about this place. But glad we did venture. What the sell was keeping up traditions and the place been run by family. Yep sounds as if your in their kitchen. It's a welcoming place relaxed and many nods to the heritage. Melaka is often not on the list but I think it be up and coming for more Western travellers now that Impression Melaka will open this year. Tie it in with their UNESCO status and great food this been one of them. I warn you pork is on the menu and richly deserved. Their Sek bak belly pork slow cooked in spices and soy sauce. Chicken satay but not as skewers which they make quite clear. My favourite the Cendol a newcomer to this for me it was so yummy I often share this but easily could have kept it to myself. Lovely mix of curious travellers and locals. Highly recommendedShow less

Author: morgant467
Title: Fantastic Nyonya food & cendol dessert
Review: Excellent Nyonya food and dessert. Affordable prices. Definitely shouldn't miss this stop in Melaka.

Author: 559tany
Title: Nyonya food
Review: Loved the otah and kueh pie tee. Food were all on the oilier side though. Babi ponteng was literally swimming in oil haha

Author: teh s
Title: Lunch
Review: We came here based on review by others. Supposed to serve great Nyonya food minus the tourists crowd and price. However I am quite disappointed. The food is so so. Served not piping hot but kinda cool. The touted cendol although served with fresh santan and gula melaka paled tremendously we realised they used frozen cendol. The only highlight is their pai ti and otak otak. So in conclusion, this place is ok only for a simple lunch away from the crowd and for reasonable price. Show less

Author: SLL36
Title: Good eatery out of mainstream
Review:
Good friendly staff and very responsive 
Food is good and tasty.
Cendol is alternate to the Aunty and madam places.
They are here to stay!

Author: Vhphoenix
Title: Friendly, fast, tasty
Review:
Friendly people who serve with nice smile, fast serving for the food and very delicious food. Reasonable price and nice environment. 
Keep the good job 👍🏽😊

Author: fongh881
Title: Only cendol
Review:
Practically everything else is bad, too salty . Wait time is horrendous, i dont know what is going on in the kitchen. Had to forego a dish due to the wait time. 

Only the cendol was slightly above average i give them that atleast.

Author: chriswithac17Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best chendol you can find
Review: I'm from KL and visited this place twice in the same month. Being a foodie, I've tried many eateries throughout the country and I have to say this is the best chendol I've had. Don't be fooled by the looks of this place, it might not be the most crowded or have people queing for hours for a table, but it packs a punch. I've never had gula melaka and the coconut milk this fresh anywhere. The coconut milk tastes as if it was freshly squeezed every few minutes. If you're in melaka looking for cheldol, skip jonker 88 and come here. As for the food, it's very good as well, almost on par with Nancy's kitchen and Donald & Lily so if you hate being made to wait for a table but want some splendid nyonya food, here's the place to go. Do keep in mind that their servings are personal portions so you can order a larger variety if you're in group. Service is excellent as well. Definitely a place you'll remember after your visit.Show less

Author: KiddySingSingapore, Singapore
Title: Below average Nonya food
Review: In a city with many Nonya restaurants, this unfortunately does not make the cut. The chendol was thin and lacking in flavour. The laksa was also watered down. In the words of my friend, the pie tee was soggy. The popiah too was plain. Portions were small. Show less

Author: KlCarmenKL
Title: Off the hectic track
Review: On the way down to south state, passed by Melaka. How could we not stop by for lunch. Internet fate bought us here .The price range is affordable and the shop is spacious with ample seats for us to plonk down and yak. Ordered pai tee ( RM 4.00) Nyonya popiah (RM 5.50) CIli Garam Ikan ( RM 9.90), Satay Jantan ( RM 7.90) , Otak otak (RM 10.00), pong teh babi (RM 9.90) Pong teh ayam (RM 7.90) , Durian cendol (RM 4.50) , mee siam (RM 5.50)The meals are individual sized as in one dish plus rice or just the noodles. Mixed review for the same dish different people who tasted it have difference preference. But we all agreed the pai tee was good.Decent place for a meal. And it is wallet friendly. No service charge nor GST was noted on the bill.Show less

Author: evee_gerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Laidback Nonya cafe
Review: Came on a Sunday and surprisingly, many shops in Melaka were closed. But unicorn cafe however was opened for business. The interior design of the cafe was set on the 1960s Melaka feel. Read about the nonya popiah and pai tee and came to try the 2 dishes. Was surpringly good. Both dishes came with pork lard (can choose not to include it if you can't take pork lard). The chilli with the pai tee wasn't too hot and it was on the side, tasted alittle of lime on it. Show less

Author: Pioneer662309Batu Pahat, Malaysia
Title: Cheap And nice food
Review: This restaurant is very walking distance from Hatten hotel. Food is nice and cheap. We had Nonya popiah, Pai tee , ikan Gerang asam , otak and a chendol. Waiting time is around 20 mins . Taste is great especially ikan gerang asam and otak. The chendol is good as well , not too sweet but just nice, suitable for all age. The only things is the Chilli paste / sambal is not spicy enough, just the Colour look scary ( too red) . :DThis cafe don't have nice or out standing decorations. It don't even have aircon just a lot of ceiling fan. Overalls the environment is comfort and clean . Show less

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: pretty good Nyonya joint...
Review: Found this place through a blog. Simple restaurant located in Melaka Raya specializing in Nyonya cuisine. Prices are reasonable. Service is friendly & attentive. Wasn't crowded when we were there on Sunday for lunch. Off the beaten path.The 4 of us tried quite a bit. We had the cili garam fish, asam pork, seh bak, pai tee, popiah, cincalok omelette, brinjal sambal & their house special chicken curry. The main dishes came with rice & lemak sayur. Overall good flavors & pretty authentic. Decent portion size. We also had their cendol which was disappointingly lacking in flavor. Drinks were below average too.While it wasn't memorable I would still return when in Melaka. Worth a stop for Nyonya goodies.Show less

Author: Jack C
Title: Lunch
Review: Came for lunch and find the nyonya laksa average, if comes with cockles, will be nicer. Ordered cendol, taste is ok.

Author: PatYKC
Title: Decent Nonya Place
Review:
A place I usually come for nonya food. Key items which I like are the top hats and popiah. Cendol is equally good as well. 
Check out the pics.

Author: bhcohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A must for lunch lovers
Review: My wife and I have a beautiful lunch at this place which is not well known as yet. It is a little Nyonya cafe in the heart of town. We had the Mee Siam, Pai Tees and Popia and Cendol after. We were very impressed by the great food and level of service for such a little cafe. We will definitely make this a regular eating place for us. I suggest anyone reading this review to give it a try. I am sure you will not be disappointed.Show less

Author: Taveller C
Title: Super lunch place!
Review:
This is a small nonya food cafe.

Food is good and authentic! My family loves eating here and we make repeat visits and try not to miss it when we are in Melaka. 

The mee siam, laksa, popiah and chendol always hits the mark.

Author: coachmelleow
Title: Nice easy Nyonya Lunch...
Review: Love the Cendol, Mee Siam and Ponteh Pork... They are the Best things to eat at Unicorn. Value for money!

Author: melyam525Malaysia
Title: Nice Nyonya Food
Review: We arrived on a weekday around 1ish, and there was not much crowd in the cafe. Service was swift. We ordered pai tee, nyonya laksa and also nyonya popiah. The pain tee was crispy and nice, you really need to dip it with their chilli to have the full flavour. Nyonya laksa was rich and tasty as well. However, I find the nyonya popiah was not that appetising as the skin was a bit thick and the fillings lack flavour. We also ordered their cendol with durian and it was nice.Show less

Author: jimmyl702Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Lack of staff
Review: I came in a group of 14 person with my friends. We have been wait for 45 minutes for our food but were yet to come out. There are only two chef in kitchen, one bartender and one waiter. Other than that, the food was nice with acceptable price.Show less

Author: cmfchrisSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Nice quaint little cafe
Review: We were there for lunch. There wasn't a crowd but sufficiently filled with customers. They offer lunches in sets (with rice and veg). Such as babi pongteh, garam ikan sambal, satay jantan, etc. I have the menu here. We enjoyed the babi pongteh and seh bak. The pohpiah is also good but the hint of lard is a little too strong for my liking. Their sambals are to die for! The cendol was good, with very fine shaved ice. The best thing is that food was cheap! You'd paying so much more at some of those nyonya restaurants.Show less

Author: cori0702
Title: Street food, Electric atmosphere
Review: Going to Melaka is an awesome experience. The street food at the Food festival is amazing! Dutch architecture enhances the beauty!

Author: GeraldineA246
Title: Amazing experience
Review: Just an amazing experience. Many different stalls to pick from. People were very friendly too. Prices are very reasonable.

Author: Traveller_ChrisS
Title: Nice walking night market
Review: Nice shopping walking street in the Melacca Night Market. Loads of food, very similar to bangkok night market. the street food was nice to much on. Signature Nyonya food will need to be in the restaurant though.

Author: BadBoyzNew York
Title: Outdoor dining at it's best
Review: Not for everyone. But you do what the locals do. Lucky came down on weekend Sunday and was able to enjoy this experience. Stalls and stalls of fresh food and drinks you can choose right there, purchase right there, cooked right there and dine right in the open air tables. Much tastier when it's made fresh to mouth within minutes. Bring your own supply of wet naps. Thanks for reading.Show less

Author: SiambuddhasSingapore, Singapore
Title: All you can eat
Review: Do remember ...friday sat sun might not be the same stalls if u are going to skip somethign which u like most to buy...it may not appear at the same spot tml night and u might be extremely regretting not to get it on the day itself............foods... ~ Lovely !Show less

Author: AileenChua
Title: Great food does not need to cost a bomb
Review: Great selection of food. Loved the oysters which were very fresh. The laska was good too, so were the fried oysters and grilled mini lobsters. Just walked a little, we also had yummy Korean ice cream and Bibik Chendol. Life is great.

Author: 1mightymouse
Title: great weekend night outing
Review: be prepared to be overwhelmed by the crowd, hawker stalls selling fresh seafood to noodles to local dishes, a plethora of cheap trinkets, souvenirs and crafts. be adventurous and try out as many dishes as you can.

Author: Iratdog
Title: Great selection
Review: Caught this on my first night in town. It is quite good. Huge oysters done a few ways. Really, if you went so far as to show up at this fantastic food festival you're bound to find a few things you'll enjoy.

Author: owenjulliesJohannesburg, South Africa
Title: Night market visit
Review: We visited the Jonker market food festival which was very full and overcrowded lost to see and eat we had a good time and enjoyed the fresh seafood and satays not even the rain could dampen the evening everyone was in a good mood and enjoyed the experienceShow less

Author: Eon C
Title: Quite nice
Review: food not bad, environment suitable for those who carrying family together. special recommended fried kuey tiao, tomyam noodle, and satay

Author: JulianChow
Title: A surprise find
Review: A surprise find, thought it was just a convenient store selling mamee products but there’s a full restaurant serving local and western cuisine. The food is really not bad, service is not bad too

Author: Roam28730489713
Title: Lousy Service and Bad Food
Review: Extremely lousy service, the manager keeps coughing around and not wearing mask and the staff didn't wear the mask properly.The food taste very bad curry laska no taste at all,the chicken rice chili taste a bit sour.Waste of time and money not going to visit anymore and not suggest anyone to come.A great place and location but lousy food and serviceShow less

Author: jokl78
Title: Big mamee shop
Review: If you like mamee, you must come here. They have mamee souvenir. Small mamee figurine showing how mamee is made. And a mamee cafe

Author: VivasummerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fun activity for kid in cool air
Review: A good rest stop a long Jonker. They have a shop outside with their cute mascots, that my kid enjoy posing after. They also offer noodle making workshop for kid which was obviously fun to the kids as there were so much laughter. Parents can temporary rest while waiting. Not recommend to get a drink here though, bought a glass of green tea and it was like 9 rm?!Show less

Author: Robin P
Title: Great Plaza to Visit!
Review: Special place to visit. Worth of time to know the process of Mamee Monster! You can design your own Mamee noodle and make it the unique Mamee for memory. Definitely will come and visit again.

Author: NixnawSingapore, Singapore
Title: Make your own mamee cup noodle
Review: Make your own mamee cup noodle for RM$15.Good experience for young kids. My 5yo enjoyed himself. This is probably his first time eating instant noodle. Oops. Color his own cup and choose his own ingredients to be added into the cup. Most of the sharpies run out of colors. Especially the blue color! Then the cup noodle is sealed and boxed.Certain days they do have the actual mamee noodle making classes at level 2 kitchen. We missed it. Not sure when it is available. May need to check beforehand. Show less

Author: V123I
Title: Disappointed..rude service
Review: Nothing special..the only thing special is their rude service..I asking about why my food order so slow but the staff replied " nanti nanti " especially the female cook..she seem more focus on chit chat among themselves instead of cooking?! Really disappointed on this trip, pls improve your service.Show less

Author: Stryfe88
Title: Nice gift shop that also serves ok food
Review: Mamee do stand out among other shops and restaurants in Jonker Street as it features the famous Mamee monster which kids loves to take pictures with. Nice decoration that served ok food.

Author: neris2912Singapore, Singapore
Title: Fun for kids -Noodle Doodle
Review: Main attraction here is that for 5RM, kids can colour and draw on their own personal Mamee cup noodles. Thereafter you can decide what ingredients to include with the noodles, which will be sealed right before your eyes, for you to home as a souvenir. The entire activity takes about 15 to 30 mins depending on how much effort you want to put into your colouring. It is a walk in activity that is available the whole day. Just pay for the empty cup at the merchandise counter and proceed to the inner room where you will find all the colour markers on the table. In the adjacent room, they have a Mamee cafe which sells drinks, chicken rice and of course Mamee noodles. As expected , the prices are higher than a normal coffee shop or cafe. The environment is overall quite clean and pleasant and thankfully the food is not bad. Useful if you want to just feed the kids with something that they will definitely enjoy without too much fuss. Show less

Author: wesleywaisiu
Title: Similar concept as the Cup noodle museum in Japan
Review: Originally from Melaka, Mamee noodle is very famous in South East Asia. This cafe / Museum is good for kids with activities for them. And a lot of merchandise of Mamee noodle as well.

Author: hulapiggy
Title: Only if you are interested in Mamee Monster
Review: Other than the instant noodles and snacks, you get to learn how to make your own cup noodles! Quite a one time fun! You can also get souvenirs like tshirts, apron, cups, key chains, etc.

Author: goh_ginny
Title: Fun for kids
Review: We brought the kids here to customise their own cup noodles. Actually concept is simple but the kids enjoyed it and bought a few cups each. Each cup is RM5.20 is which is relatively not that cheap but ok for the fun of it.

Author: eelino0Singapore, Singapore
Title: Last session is at 4.30pm
Review: I didn't find this piece of information on the website - perhaps it's there, but i guess it's quite hidden. I recommend arriving way earlier than 4.30pm. Or perhaps, better yet, arrive first thing in the morning (first session is 1030am) and then plan your day from there. The experience is a must-do, according to my 8 year old niece. She created her own mamee snack and shared with the whole family afterwards. Seeing her face light up with joy and satisfaction when we ate her mamee snack made it one of the best experience in our Melaka trip.Show less

Author: jpliow1
Title: Great with kids
Review: Can coloring your own instant noodles cup. Then you can customize the ingredients inside it then watch the staff seal & packing your noodles.You also can make your own mameee noodles snack experienced the whole process start from powder to packing noodles.Last but not least, food in here is fantastic, we like the chicken rice, taste better than others famous shop in MalaccaShow less

Author: JodiePanudju1974Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Convenient place that serves halal food in the middle Chinese shopping complex.
Review: We always realise that finding a halal restaurant at Jonker Street has always been difficult. But since early this year, this restaurant open to public. And it is very helpful for moslem family like us.The food are quite pricy, but the portion are big enough and taste good as well. The drinks are even pricier.But the cool thing about this place is they have some merchandise shop and also displays related to the brand, which fun for photo taking.The staffs are cheerful and polite. Keep up the good work, guys.Show less

Author: Nooradilahlala
Title: Tasty & Delicious foods
Review: The foods at this place was very tasty & meet my expectation. The problem is only the location because its quite crowded n we need to walk a quite far due to it stated at between of another shop at center of jonker walk.

Author: Khairiyana M
Title: Wonderful Place
Review: A nice place to visit for family with a cafe, Mamee museum, Cup Noodle factory which you can do up your own cup noodle!

Author: JourneyGlobe
Title: Noodle making
