Inefficient and under trained personnel, at least the one serving (don't know about the kitchen).Show less

Author: JoCeLynMika
Title: Taste great, if Maki can make it smaller will be perfect!
Review: My favor Kimuchi soup still taste good. Softcrab Maki prefer smaller size, is good can make it 8 slices instead of 4. For another Kimuchi pork slice, really can't taste the pork slice only taste the vege and crunchy flour.

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Outstanding Japanese food in Melaka
Review: Just paid a visit to this fantastic Japanese restaurant as we frequently pass by the Kota Syahbandar main road and notice this grand restaurant. Ample parking is available (dinner time). The ambiance was something to be experienced (do you believe it, it felt like I'm revisiting one of those restaurants in Nagoya, Japan). Staff are friendly (even though one of them could not understand it comprehend simple English - assistance from another staff was required).The menu is widespread and offers a great variety of great authentic Japanese food. Pricing was a bit on the higher side, but the food was lovely (did not mind the price). The Gyoza, cheese baked tori and most of the rolls was lovely. The ingredients were definitely fresh. The takoyaki was like the ones I had in Japan (the octopus was tasty). Membership for this restaurant only available once RM400 or more is spent on one bill. So, need to visit with nore friends the next time for the membership. Show less

Author: jenscwernerMarkt Schwaben, Germany
Title: Much improved since my last visit
Review: One year after my first visit to Ichi Zen I came here again, and must give a better rating. Nice and friendly Staff, could be still a bit more attentive (E.g. asking occasionally if one wants another tea etc.). The best is the food, a huge variety of all kind of Japanese specialities, octopus, dumplings and seaweed, sashimi, different type of sushi roles ... we tried a lot of these. And it was all fresh and yummy. I would give a 5-star rating if they would have come and proactively refill the ginger, the hot tea and asking if we want something else. But I will come here again...Show less

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: One of my favourites
Review: Been there a few times, like it and they are fast. I tend to go for sets but I observe many customers like their sushi.

Author: Christina S L
Title: Food galore!
Review: Food was authentic and tasty. Service very friendly n fast. We ordered way too much but could take home the food we could not finish. Definitely a return visit in the near future😍

Author: chandras015
Title: Cheating restaurant!
Review: Meal was reasonable till the bill came and good experience was spoilt. When first seating down, had asked several times if there were any offers with food/cards etc. Only showed menu with some offers. Nothing else mentioned.When leaving, saw has discount with Parkson card which gives you 10% discount - which we took. However, also says for every MYR50 spent, you get a scoop of ice cream free!. We did not know this and had bought 2 scoops for kids earlier. Upon asking, lady captain was making a fuss on giving the free ice cream. Looks like not genuine about giving benefits! And this was captain lady-what nonsense.Show less

Author: JoCeLynMikaMalaysia
Title: Lunches
Review: My favor Japanese restaurant at Melaka. Today order a set with 2 dishes and add on one chawanmushi. The eggplant with taufu cook with spicy miso sauce was nice and the pork belly cook with ginger sause was so so nia. Overall was satisfied… still is the best in Melaka.Show less

Author: Maria A
Title: Sushi n sashimis best
Review: Good quality service. Good food cozy place. Price reasonable just fine for a good japanese dine .. foods are fresh. Staff will welcome you in japanese greetings it feels like your in japan, lol . Overall its good.

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Sunday Lunch
Review: We walked into the restaurant as the other shop we wanted to go was full house.Was attracted to their banner at the door entrance on their set lunch. However, when we wanted to place our order, it was told that the set lunch was sold out. Then we have to reselect our food. It would have been most helpful if the waitress could have suggested their promotional items.I like the ambiance and the restaurant looks classy. Ample parking space though it could be crowded on weekends and holidays.Show less

Author: Gerrit94
Title: Great Sushi
Review:
The place is very nice. The Sushi I had was very good and delicious and also the service is good.
The price was also not bad for such food.
I would always go there again.

Author: edwinlycSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food and fantastic service and located next to a great massage center
Review: Our group of 20 people decided to have dinner here after great massage time at Scent & Senses. Thankfully we went in before peak dinner time and manage to get the table. Service was good. The captain was patience and even able to customise my order.This place is pack during peak time and be prepare to wait. Sashimi is fresh and generously thick.Show less

Author: Wlyong925Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: goog food, good services, reasonable price
Review: First impression is the staffs are friendly and helpful and patience. The restaurant is cozy with spacious dining table... It is good to bring baby along. Serve ala carte meals and set meals. Food serve fast no matter how busy is the restaurant. I presonally like the salad and the sashimi. Hot food are good as well especially the kakuni ramen with port broth. I have been there more than 10 times... suitable for gathering with friends, business discussion and family outing.Show less

Author: Clement NMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Service not so good
Review: We went there for a dinner on 15/3/2016 at about 7pm. We ordered quite a number of foods . During eating the foods, we called the waiter ( 2 waiters) to top up the drink (hot tea). We have to called 3 times then only one of the waiter slowly came over to top up the tea for us. Quite frustrated. Service is no good !Show less

Author: NeerChan
Title: Not as satisfying as it used to be...
Review: It used to be our regular jap restaurant. When friends ask,we recommended it. Their sashimi slices were thick, sukiyaki beef was up to my standard...When we were return from being outstation for 2 months, we were surprised at the quality of their food. Overall deteriorated. Sashimi slices still thick, deep fried oysters still ok,but the shiitake lacked of the usual ingredients and tasted bland. Staffs are still pretty efficient,although not as smiley as you want them to be. Show less

Author: huiyeeg2015Kuala Lumpur
Title: Fine dining look alike but food was poor
Review: Ambience was good. However, the taste of the food doesn't meet the standard of fine dining. We had a way overcooked salmon and the sushi rice was too soft. I've been to their chain restaurant Edo Ichi in Kuala Lumpur and the standard was very high. I guess the level of competition amongst Japanese restaurant in Melaka was way too low until they can lower down their standard. What a disappointment.Show less

Author: FromKluang
Title: Good Japanese restaurant
Review:
Good quality of foods.
One of the better choice for Japanese food in Melaka. 
Sashimi is very fresh. Overall foods is great.
But disappointed for their service, staff is unexperience and not well trained.

Author: tani_paniSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food good service
Review: It was a raining afternoon when we came here. The staff was very kind to manage our wet umbrellas.The food quality is good. Service is not bad. Price is acceptable.A good place to come to be it for business, family gatherings or with friends.Show less

Author: tanel2015
Title: Great service and great food
Review: My brother brought my mum and me to this restuarant.Ambience was nice and the staff was very friendly, welcoming and patient even though we arrived 20min before they closed for their afternoon break.My brother ordered his all time favorite - the salmon skin salad. I think this salad came with soft shell crabs and salmon skin. We requested for salmon skin only and they were accommodating about it. The dressing was very special and they had no 2nd words when we asked for extra dressing.Other items we had ordered included grilled chicken on stick, deep fried tentacles, grilled onions and eel sushi etc.The tentacles were fried to perfection and was heavenly with the sauce.The grilled chicken took a long time to arrive. I think it is becos it took alot of effort to stick and grill it. The texture was beatiful.The onions is so so. Nothing to brag about. The eel sushi is ok. Nothing special about it. The quality is good and ingredients were fresh.On the last order request, we ordered one more salad and tentacles.This is a place to come to for decent quality Japanese food and at a decent price.The quality is more than decent. They are good in fact.Show less

Author: jenscwernerMarkt Schwaben, Germany
Title: Average Japanese Food served by moody staff
Review: I love Japanese Food, especially as it is a good alternative to the often oily food you get here in Malaysia. You can get a lot of deep fried (tempura) stuff too, but I tried the smoked mackerel teriyaki, some Sushi and Temaki Sushi (hand roll). While the food quality was more or less ok (the tuna didn't seem fresh though) I was disappointed by the never smiling servants providing a slow, clumsy and rude service. Very unusual for a Japanese restaurant. Show less

Author: esquire838
Title: Authentic Baba Breakfast
Review:
They offer limited fares for breakfast (Malacca baba menu) but the place has been established for quite some time. setting is amidst open air roofed shed with concrete floor and shaded by trees. 
Price wont hurt u at all. accepts e-Wallet payment.

Author: Y1479KSmarkcMalaysia
Title: Middle of the pack on food.
Review: Middle of the pack on food. Nice ambience it its cool (morning, evening). I wouldn't come in the afternoon, even with the trees. Food portions are small and the wait is long enough that we'll be going somewhere else for more food. Wouldn't go out of my way. Show less

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Overrated
Review: Their curry laksa serve in small portion & taste ordinary. Price is at high edge. No parking & hygiene can be improved

Author: james b
Title: Hidden little food gem
Review: Tasty food, helpful owners. Just ordered the pop piah and nyonya dumplings. Food was tasty and dirt cheap.

Author: shmnme
Title: Beware Eat money!
Review: They overcharged a bottle of kaya rm$5.50 but they charge to rm$18. Asked for a receipt the man was thinking how to key into their system and when he keyed kaya it showed $5.50 but he added takeaway charge of $12.50 to charge it to $18!!! Be careful of their overpricing! The blackboard showed one charge $5.50. But they overcharge tourist!! Dishonest seller and dishonest cafe! Show less

Author: Chicken_LuxSingapore, Singapore
Title: Local food in a quaint rustic setting
Review: Decades ago in small town Malacca, a man set up shop selling comfort food in his backyard. Today on our smart devices, we write about the delight of sitting under his rambutan trees, feeding ourselves mouthful after mouthful of laksa - this version is a light coconut broth, packed with strong laksa leaf flavors. Pair it with either kueh pie-tee or home-made eggskin popiah, or both! Also on the menu are: mee siam (in between dry and moist, but not the most tasty), nasi lemak, cendol, toast and eggs and Kaya. Try also their kueh cucur and apom. If you're lucky,  Slender, what i name the bushy-tailed kitty that comes to rub up against you, may grace your dining experience with her regal presence. Show less

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Cendol
Review: Their foods are a bit overrated. However, the cendol is really good & priced very reasonable. Home style business & limited parking in front of the restaurant

Author: khaosk9Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special
Review: One of our local friends recommended us to try out this “restaurant” as it is one of the local’s favorite store. I really didn’t see anything special. With a menu as small as that, I wouldn’t call it a restaurant. The food is average, nothing so special about their nasi lemak. The pohpiah and paitee was also average, it appears to be bland without the hot sauce. This place has a lot of flies and mosquitoes too due to the riverside. We do not get a chance to try out their nyonya kuihs as they are already sold out the time we were here. Cendol on the other hand is acceptable but it is far from good or delicious, the waiter is a tat impatience and do not try to answer our questions. Show less

Author: baristakelly
Title: Simple affordable lunch at Baba Low under the tree
Review:
Nyonya Laksa is good. Nasi Lemak rice a little hard. Mee Siam wet style.
Simple set up and reasonable price. Clean.
Stall under the tree and open till 4pm. 2nd visit.

Author: Ngan H
Title: Ordinary stuff
Review: This outlet sells baba nyonya food. It has its own place and a wide compound that can accommodate many people. Alas, the food here is just average. And overpriced! Normal cendol is RM3 (the portion is small), can you imagine that? If you come in the afternoon, say about 2.30pm, almost all food is sold out except nyonya laksa and drinks.Show less

Author: alexo273
Title: Family
Review: Very nice food as compared to the city.  Forget about the service and ambient. Value for money. A must when I am in Malacca with my family or friends. Must bring my family here as they love the chendol.

Author: 321juliust
Title: Nasi lemak was good
Review:
First time visit here and surprisingly. .it was crowded.

Try the nasi lemak and apam balik.   It was good and less oily. Must try local nyonya morning food available.  

Mee siam just average only.

Author: Pictureski
Title: Cheap local food & great taste
Review: Just hidden behind Baba Charlie Cafe, you will find this simple open air local restaurant that offers baba food such as laksa, nasi lamak, mee siam and chendol at good price.

Author: MikeCMelbourneMelbourne, Australia
Title: Simple place for a Malaysian meal
Review: Unlike food places in the city, this place is less congested and more comfortable.Food wise, it is OK. Very average by Malaysian standard. I tried the cendol and the curry laksa. Certainly had better ones elsewhere in Malaysia..but they are not bad. The price is not exorbitant, so at least you are not paying through your nose for average food.Show less

Author: spidergirl_KLPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Simple fuss free place.
Review: No frills place for simple breakfast. Menu consists of Nasi Lemak, Mee Siam, Curry noodles, popiah and Pie tee. I enjoyed the popiah. It is bigger size than what is usually sold in Penang or Klang Valley. The filling is tasty wuth enough gravy and sauce. The wrap is soft and thin. We ordered everything on the menu. I like the nasi lemak, the rice is "creamy" enough and grain. I find the sambal is not well cooked, as can still taste the rawness of the chili. Service is pretty fast, well, we were there about 8.30am, before larger crowd came later. Show less

Author: CeciltongSingapore
Title: Not to be confused with Baba Charlie
Review: I have been coming to this place for years for breakfast/brunch and continue to enjoy the atmosphere and the food. The laksa was good, and the chendol was ok. I took away ambon which was piping hot and delicious. The kaya is not very fragrant but very tasty.Show less

Author: teresayee
Title: Mouth Watering Food
Review:
My first choice (of places of eat) whenever I come back to Malacca to visit my in-laws. 

Try their mee siam, apam and nyonya laksa!
Yum!

Author: Calvary09Singapore, Singapore
Title: Baba Low Nonya Kueh - DISAPPOINTED1
Review: Made a special trip to the shop cos of the online reviews. I bought an assortment of kuehs 5 or 6 types including the ondeh2,tapiocca, the coloured ones as well as the dumplings and kaya.The kueh standard i would reckon is below that of the KSL pasa malam kueh. The kuehs are so floury, chewy and cloyingly sweet. The Ang ku kueh is not too bad. The nonya dumpling is pretty with a tinge of blue from the blue pea but is a tad too sweet. The kaya has a nice pandan fragant but very watery. Thought baba charlie is almost like an institution and kind of sad to note the poor quality of their stuff isShow less

Author: JiaS_12Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Inexpensive Nyonya Food
Review: Limited variety of Nyonya delicacies but not expensive. We tried everything from the menu, Laksa, Mee Siam, Nasi Lemak and kuih. We were there at 7:30am, we were told that they are not ready. We waited quite awhile. They did not have pai tee and coffee (!) that day. Anyway, we still enjoy the food very much without the coffee. Price: Laksa (RM5), Mee Siam (RM4), Nasi Lemak (RM4), Poh piah (M3.50)Show less

Author: pingpingjoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A Great Breakfast Place Offering Really Good Mee Siam!
Review: This place opens as early as 7:30am and though the menu is limited but order all of them and you won't regret it! Mee Siam, Laksa and Pai Tee are our top favourites! And if they are making traditional kuihs on the day you're visiting, grab them - nowhere else makes them! The only off putting part is that you'll have to wait to get a table and for food (which you may be warned that it'll take 45 minutes to 1 hour but rest assured, the food are mostly pre-readied so you won't be waiting too long). Show less

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Average
Review: Limited choices of nyonya delicacies. We had tried almost everything - laksa, popiah, pai tee, nasi lemak, apom, kaya and mee siam. The stall is just very near our house. Maybe we have had these food for years so find it just normal and nothing to rave about. Sometime we do a takeaway when there's a crowd. If you like takeaways please bring your own containers as the charge extra RM 0.30 for the case. Fresh batch of Kaya every sat as they make them on the off day. Their Kaya is made from duck's eggs. Prices are very reasonable too.Show less

Author: leerockzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Eat like a local under the mango trees
Review: Food was great especially the Mee Siam. Nasi Lemak was so so. Laksa was nice but totally different from Penang Laksa as the noodle is those thinner type and the ingredients is totally different. The popiah skin is thicker than the usual popiahGood food with reasonable pricing and environment and lots of parking spaceWorth a visit if you are in MelakaShow less

Author: chrischoong007Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Good ol Malaccan food
Review: Situated under a big mango tree, this stall run by Baba Low serves up good Peranakan food. What I love about his popiah is that they use the egg skin type. Love it! They also serve nyonya laksa which is ok only. Their pai tee caps are also good. I bought their kaya which is like how my granny use to make, delish. The stall is in an open air and under a big mango tree which makes it cool throughout the day.Show less

Author: LeeC4485
Title: Good Nyonya Food
Review: Personally it was a good visit. Had nyonya laksa which wasn't too spicy; but tasty overall. Open-air environment with old-school stools and table setting, which was totally fine. The place is situated under many trees so it wasn't too hot. Very limited choices tho; less than 10 options on the menu. Not a touristy place hence, no superficial, over-the-top customer service.We visited the place around 10am on a Tuesday, no crowd/queue, but shortly after we ordered, people starting coming.Show less

Author: Steve513KLKL
Title: Local taste
Review: Saw some review on how good the food are so decided to drop by. Well, it was past lunch time and seat is readily available. Parking is easy too. Ordered popiah, mee siam and also a cendol. Nice but I have taste even better food elsewhere. Good to try it if you are around that area. Show less

Author: neevrap02
Title: Good Nyonya Food
Review: Limited menu items available but the items available are good. They offer some noodle dishes and some famous nyonya chicken and seafood dishes served with white rice. The shop is in a simple setup with wooden tables and chairs and is open aired. Overall i enjoyed the food here and would come back againShow less

Author: Diana7737Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not worth it
Review: Located under a tree with limited seatings. People are not friendly, saw them raising voices to some customers over some orders issue. Tried nyonya laksa & mee siam but it was plain normal. Price are slightly over compared to other places that also serves good nyonya laksa.Show less

Author: Lee L
Title: Very dirty!
Review: The spoon and chopsticks are not washed properly, can see stains clearly. Very doubtful on the food hygiene.

Author: budakSFOSan Francisco, California
Title: Nyonya food that even a Baba (the male version of a Nyonya) would approve of.
Review: Everytime I visit my home town, I am sure to stop over here, to partake in the nyonya food like mee siam and laksa. The food is excellent and always tastes as authentic as it can be.Sure it is not a 5 star restaurant but you cannot have it at affordable prices if you expected air conditioning (restaurant has covered seating), super classy restrooms/toilets (it has one public toilet, that is kept relatively clean, definately not classy).And if you cross the very busy Tengkera Road, you get to Baba Chua's which has a huge assortment of Nyonya cakes to take home.Show less

Author: LEACHAN
Title: Horrible everything
Review: Horrible food and ugly service . Lady boss is especially rude and food prep environment is very disgusting .  Bad experience will never come again .

Author: V00DooKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The highlight of our Melaka trip
Review: Being a weekday (Wednesday), there was no queue when we arrived (approx 10am). But it quickyly filled up with several regulars (from they way they were loudly greeting each other upon arrival!). Plenty of parking available in front of the hut/stall. Best to visit only on a dry day as there is limited covered seating.We ordered everything on the menu except for the chendol as we preferred coffee with our breakfast. The coffee and cham (coffee/tea mixed) are very good. A must order! Nyonya Laksa 10/10! A must order! Mee Siam 7/10 for taste, 5/10 for texture. Flavour was good but it was a little too soft and wet, in my humble opinion. Perhaps this is a Melaka norm?Popiah 9/10 - pricey by Malaysian standards at RM3 each but wrapped in a homemade crepe instead of the usual commercial wrapper. Larger than the norm too. Fillings were not soggy at all, very nice texture.Pai Tee 10/10 - same turnip/jicama filling as the popiah but topped with julienne cucumber & egg, plus crispy fried shallots.Nasi Lemak 7/10 - tasted good, but nothing special. I would rather have another nyonya laksa.Cucur Tuang 9/10 - a sweet fried kueh shaped like a flying saucer with crisp/chewy edges. I loved it! Would've eaten more if I wasn't already stuffed to the gills. Key ingredient was the gula Melaka. Yum! Apom Gula Melaka 6/10 - another type of kueh (really looks very rude - haha) but I pretty bland/mediocre compared to the cucur.We had 1 laksa, 1 nasi lemak, 1 mee siam, 3 popiah, 3 serves of pai tee, 4 kuehs and 6 coffees - less than RM50. Our best meal in Melaka!I read that many people complained about the service but I found the old chinese couple manning the till & coffee station very friendly and chatty. Perhaps it was not such a busy day? A clean toilet is available for use just beyond the kitchen which is attached to the house next to it.Show less

Author: aflame_SGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great place for cheap nyonya food
Review: Was there on a public holiday morning for brunch, surprisingly no queue.We ordered every type of food that is available and tried all. The nasi lemak was alright, laksa was nice. We don't like the mee siam as they are too 'wet'. Pai Tee and Chendol was pretty average. But the Popiah was really good! Worth to just go there for the Popiah.Price is considered cheap and no worries for parking too. Recommended.Show less

Author: lingsue123Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya laksa and cendol
Review: Reached at 10am on a Saturday morning and there were lots of empty seats. Loved the nyonya laksa, it's the kind that I like, with mint leaves and lime. Cendol was good and doesn't taste like the other cendol I've had, which are usually more powdery and overly sweet for my liking. Popiah here was so-so.Show less

Author: 398limw
Title: 486 Baba Low
Review: We enjoyed everything here except the chendol which was quite ordinary.  The laksa was exceptionally good. The queue was long at 10 in the morning but we felt that it was worthwhile for such authentic Nyonya cuisine. Prices were reasonable.  Lots of parking areas too.

Author: kwlee23200
Title: Twice in 2 days
Review:
To me, I do like: 
*****Pai Tee –  Crispy cups filled with a mixture of yam bean, cucumber, egg and fried shallots.
Laksa, Popiah and Cendol worth to try. ! :-0

Author: Th WPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Deliciously cheap dinning under a Tree
Review: For me its the best curry laksa noodle in town. They do have a branch in Kuala Lumpur, but the ones in Melaka are the best. Nicely located under a Kuinin Treee tuck away from the tourist area. If you are lucky you will be greeted with smells of Kuinin mangoes should the trees are bearing fruits. Prices are cheap and affordable. They are closed on Fridays tho, so plan your trip well. Key in these coordinates (2.204694, 102.231669) onto your GPS to get you there.Show less

Author: Elain386
Title: Nice food
Review:
Nice nyonya laksa , very reasonable price. 
Pai Tee wasn't good. 
Location at a nice hut, plenty of parkings.

Author: wernwyec
Title: Good nyonya food
Review: Went there with my friends on a Sunday morning. Reached abt 10.30am. Crowd was lesser. Laksa and Pai Tee were very tasty. Mee siam was good. Popiah was ok. Cendol was just average. Nice little place under shades of kuinin trees.

Author: dreamcraft2001
Title: Yummy Nyonya Laksa
Review: Fresh food under a tree sitting. Authantic nyonya food. Parking a little troublesome as limited. Order your food before sitting down.

Author: kanimoliepPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Delicious laksa @cosy Baba Low
Review: I love the laksa! Ordered laksa bihun. Delicious. Portion just nice. It's awesome when mixed together with the sambal. My bf tried the nasi lemak.. was good too. Managed to find this place using waze as there's no big signboard to Baba Low. Nice cosy place. Show less

Author: kenkehSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Waze my way here to find the location
Review: Thank god there's waze now days , just key in 486 Baba Low and it will bring you there . I came here alone after my breakfast at my hotel and I was greedy and I want to try a few of the dishes as it was my first time to this place and I really love mee Siam . At the end I have to take away some of the dishes as I can't finish the food .The ambience was a shack surrounded with big trees so it was kind of shady . My mee Siam taste ok , poh piah ,cendol and pai tee taste so so . Am I coming back here in future ? Why not .Show less

Author: renixa
Title: Nothing special
Review: Nothing special. Taste so so. Noodle not hot enough. Save gas I think. Popiah skin too thick. But inner vege taste not bad. Nasi lemak worst. Staff not enough. Food serve slow.  Not much ppl also have to wait long time.

Author: malaysianconniePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Simple nyonya breakfast
Review: This simple open air , self service restaurant, under the yum yum ( mango tree, in this case) does serve a lip smacking nyonya laksa and a sweet Mexican hat for breakfast. However I found the pie tee basket sadly lacking, it's too hard. It's should be nice and crisp ,though the filing of bengkuang is okay. It also serves good kaya made of duck eggs, full of good old fashion sweetness, and the way my grandma used to make. It will taste equally good with Pulut Tekan too.Additional items on the menu of Nasi Lemak, Meehoon Siam was quick and fast even though it's was a crowded labour day weekend.Expect crowds in the weekend mornings and there is ample parking around the area.Must be prepared to help rearrange tables and chairs as they are pretty short handed.Show less

Author: DesDiFai75Kuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Nice cozy lazy afternoon
Review: Went there for late lunch as I found myself in Tengkera and the place is situated in a corner lot without much signage leading to the location. Luckily I had my Waze on. Place is a distant reflection of their other branch in Bangsar BUT it is Melaka and we gotta chill a little :)Food is pretty much the same (albeit cheaper then Bangsar but hey! It is Bangsar...). Chendol in Malaka is not so sweet with the gula melaka as the one you find in Bangsar but to each their own level of sweetness. Show less

Author: SanHecKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simple yet delicious Breakfast
Review: Looking for some light and baba&nyonya taste of breakfast? Come to 486 Baba Low in Jalan Tengkera. (corner house, you might easily pass this place as there is no signboard)SIgnature dish:Popiah (fresh spring roll)Nyonya laksa Pie tie Nasi LemakCendol Mee SiamTasty food and reasonable price.Show less

Author: BoonBNE
Title: Still keeping up with the good taste of the few items served
Review: I visit this eatery every time I am in Melaka. The quality and taste of the food served are still good. The Po Piah was firmly wrapped and not soggy as what I had in the food centre.

Author: yktangphotography
Title: Quick lunch...just ok only
Review: Been reading about this place, but we tried their nyonya laksa. nasi lemak and cendol.  Nothing fantastic, just normal. Overrated.

Author: shirleychau
Title: Good Nyonya Laksa
Review: Good nyonya laksa, chendol, yummy nasi lemak and pie tee, if you don't mind the shabby corner.  Reasonable price and easy to find, ample parking.  Good food the start the morning breakfast as they open at 7.30am.

Author: Gerard VPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: nice food away outside the city centre
Review: I've been here a few times...the food is always fresh. Pai Ti is the highlight, Mee Siam is good too. Popiah taste is ok but not to my liking because I prefer the normal thin skin version. There have been times I have gone there after midday and some menu items were sold out. The location is excellent if you are driving because there is ample place to park. The shady trees add to a great atmosphere.Show less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Hunt for Nyonya Food
Review: Baba Low quite famous for nyonya laksa, cendol, pai tee, and popiah. can try their apam balik. Overall baba low serve quite nice nyonya food.

Author: pamcyySingapore
Title: Plan to arrive early or be disappointed.
Review: Gem hidden at a shady corner of the street. We were lucky enough to try one of every dish they sell and really liked the popiah and dry mee siam. It would be better if they could add some meat like tuna flakes or shredded chicken. But i'm not sure if its because we were the last customer as we only had vegetable and fishcakes. Most items will be sold out around 3pm. Show less

Author: DoreeseW
Title: Food is good. ..
Review: Good nyonya food, but expect no good customer service during peak hours.  But.  Mee siam is damn good !

Author: Eittus
Title: yummy food
Review:
Easy to park.

I tried the laksa and mee siam. Laksa is pretty good. Mee siam the dry type. A little on the sourish side. Popiah is not bad. Quite alot of fillings. Didn't like the nasi lemak. Not much ingredients. Coffee is good. Strong.

Author: ernichan
Title: Nyonya laksa tasty
Review: Tasty Nyonya laksa, would avoid the popiah, rather too soggy w overly thick skin, atmosphere is ok if u don't mind the lack of fans and the heat...close proximity to baba Charlie kueh is a plus

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: A Place For Breakfast
Review: One of my normal joints if I am lazy to prepare my own breakfast. The food is so-so and not really authentic peranakan style. My usual order would be the "mee siam". Occasionally, the "mee siam" would have the "burnt" smell....eat at your own risk. The nasi lemak, laksa, "popiah" and "pai tee" are quite good. However, the drinks such as coffee and tea are watery and tasteless.Show less

Author: AileenleeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice nasi lemak
Review: Go early if you do not want to be disappointed. I went there around 1pm and was told the curry laksa and mee siam was already finished. Opted for the nasi lemak instead. The portion was reasonable with the usual nasi lemak ingredients such as sambal, peanuts, and ikan bilis. They added some fried kangkung to it. The sambal was nice and blended well with the rice. Rice was cooked to perfection like how a nasi lemak rice is supposed to be. Did not try anything else, however I would like to try the curry laksa next time as it is highly recommended in blogs.Show less

Author: sabahrefugiselangor
Title: So-so only
Review: Well, first off, the lady serving us was not polite (not rude, but not polite).It's not hard to find. You may key in the coordinates:2.204694, 102.231669 and pls only visit if you have a car, it's not worth it to walk or travel by cab there.they serve peranakan or "Baba Nyoya" food namely Mee Siam, Pai Tee, Popiah, Nyonya Laksa, and they also serve Nasi Lemak. If you're bringing children, they may have the popiah and pai tee as the rest are all spicy. They also serve cendol there.The food was so-so only. I liked the Pai Tee but there were mixed review on the overall taste of the food there. There are plenty of seats there (I got there around 12pm). It was cheap too, we ordered- Mee Siam- Nyonya Laksa- 2 Popiah- 2 Pai Tee- 2 Cendols- 2 Milo IceAll adding up to less than RM35. They say the kaya spread is good too, but I have not tried/ bought it.Show less

Author: SchyiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Local peranakan cheap eats at its best
Review: Visited this eatery on a post-holiday Monday, so there was not much crowd around which was good. This is a very humble local cheap eats and I enjoyed very much on the food being served hot and fresh when ordered. The ingredients are simple but the best represents the local culture and living. We ordered baba laksa, nasi lemak and pie tee and they were tasty.Show less

Author: Sam_Kin_KitKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Below average, not my type
Review: Expectation was high before we came, but end in disappointment. We ordered nyonya laksa, popiah, cendol, some kuih, mee siam, nasi lemak, coffee. The nyonya laksa looks really appetizing but seriously, no kick, just bland with lots of coconut milk taste which is not my taste. In the end, we felt only the popiah is good. Kuih was ok, the rest all below average. Way too overrated, don't think i will come back.Show less

Author: Juan Alfonso R
Title: Great Food
Review:
Located near Malacca Internatonal school and away from the busy tourist area made parking an easy and ample for all.
Nothing more to say; Great Food all round... Enjoy!

Author: DoreeseWKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Mee Siam here is the BEST !
Review: It serves nyonya food i.e Top Hat (Pie Tee), Mee Siam, Laksa, Nasi Lemak , Pohpiah (Spring Roll) (** am already drooling)The local dessert Cendol is just average, but you can try ...My fav gotta be the Mee Siam , remember to ask for the gravy if you take-away.It is normally PACKED on weekend breakfast , reach early if you don't want to wait long for your food .Expect little "customer-friendly" service as the staffs are overloaded, but, worth for the taste of the food.Also, there are some local cakes - apam balik, but it runs out fast .... Hope you enjoy it.... P/S: located in Jalan Tengkera, turn into Kampung Lapan ....open till 4pm , closed on FridaysShow less

Author: Ipchloe
Title: Out of expectation
Review: Queing to eat their food but found out that their dim sum is not so nice and food are very small portion. Not recommended. Surprising that there are alot of tourist queing outside the shop when we dine. Not recomended.

Author: VoonQin-EnIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Dim Sum! Dim Sum!
Review: Dim sum is good and the price is reasonable, probably have to wait for the table if you arrive late, suggest to come here about 7:00 to 7:30am when you craving dim sum as breakfast, recommend their 叉烧包 (pork bun) and 流沙包 with a cup of hot chinese tea to warmup your stomach in early morning...Show less

Author: AileenChua
Title: Best Dimsum at reasonable price
Review: Serves good dimsum at a reasonable price. Be prepared to queue unless you go there at its opening time at 5.30 am. Worth the wait.

Author: CasChen
Title: Breakfast
Review: Had breakfast there and order a variety of dishes.  The glutinous chicken and pork ribs were good.  The pork bun as well.  Price is reasonable.  They have more choices of fried items instead of steam items

Author: Happyperson2468
Title: Very tasty food
Review: Very good quality dim sim in small portions. As it was raining very heavily there was no queue. Alot of chioces of din sum

Author: crowley44
Title: Good value Dim Sum Breakfast
Review: Very very crowded restaurant, be prepared to wait for seats. Dim sum was tasty and in small portions, gotta snatch the waiters attention to get orders. Value for money and worth a try.

Author: Johnstanno
Title: Cheap and good
Review:
It gets really crowded after 8am. Tim sum are really delicious especially char siew bun, 荷叶饭 and 流沙包. The 4 of us spent merely MYR 50+ in total to have perfect breakfast.

Food served promptly and staff are all friendly. Must try!!

Author: AileenChua
Title: Family lunch
Review: Great tasting dim sum at affordable prices. Queue was long so make sure to be there before 10.30 am or risk being turned away as the dim sum could be sold out by 11.30 am.

Author: JesA51
Title: Lousy Breakfast place
Review: Rest looks dirty. Dim sum served was cold. RM3 for a small bun (1 mouth bite size)is very over priced. They use instant coffee and tea bag.should have gone to macdonald for breakfast! Very over over rated ....not value for money and not worth the time and effort.Show less

Author: YinG27Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Weekend breakfast - so so dim sum, bad service
Review: Brought my whole family for a weekend breakfast at this dim sum restaurant. The business seems good with long queue. However their service is bad as though the customers owe them. With the amount of money spent, there is better dim sum and service around malacca town.Show less

Author: laikaum
Title: Average Dim Sum Place
Review: We had our breakfast there, but honestly the dim sum and coffee and tea were only considered as "average".

Author: bent2182
Title: Cheap and tasty...
Review:
Just order whatever you like, i should say everything is tasty.
But 1 thing not good is waiting time is long and serving food is slow...

Author: WSLEE74Kuantan, Malaysia
Title: Dim sum with reasonable price
Review: A dim sum restaurant which visited by locals as well as visitor. We reached at 830am and its already packed. Managed to shared a table with a local man coming every morning for breakfast. Not much of variety but one round of ordering is enough to fill up your stomach fully!Show less

Author: Esther TSingapore, Singapore
Title: Old-school dim sum place -- that's just about it
Review: Went early in the morning before 8am for breakfast and it was already buzzing with activity (apparantly it opened at 5.30am and close at 1pm... off day every Tue). Got a table easily - its really a very old school tea house where they have servers going round with trays of dim sim for your selection. But certain 'special' dishes need to be ordered, e.g. porridge, custard bun, lotus rice, glutinous rice...Cheap, good value - taste average. Come for the experience, not for the food. Show less

Author: FromKluang
Title: Old Dim-Sum
Review:
One of oldest Dim-sum restaurant and famous restaurant in Melaka.
The big Pao is good but the rest of the dim-sum is just average or below average.
The price is reasonable. Just for experiences.

Author: mikelim8116
Title: good variety of dim sum
Review: More than 12 vatieties of dim sum to choose from. I find the ingredients used were freshly made. Price is reasonable.

Author: linggeeerococo
Title: Reaonsable priced and old school dim sum
Review: Just came back from the dim sum. My friend and I woke up at 6am to avoid the weekend queue. The eatery was quite empty when we reached at 6.15am. Thirty porridge is really good. A must try. As the crowd came at around 7.30am, we were already full from our food. Portions are small which is good as we can try more variety. It is right opposite the mosque so you won't missed it. Show less

Author: Braveheart2013Whitby, Ontario
Title: 4 mini BBQ Bao for a table of 7 people
Review: The" bao" is nice but the way they do business is not customer friendly. Was here last year and it seems that there is always a shortage of BBQ buns. They are good but very small and it seems that they place limits on each table. Here's a suggestion: IF BBQ buns are popular , why not make more of them? I won't be going back there again given the choice. I find it utterly ridiculous that most places that has been on the blog and receives favorable reviews, the owners become arrogant and rude. My mum asked the owner the simple questions of how much the Big Buns were and instead a simple answer from one of the lady owner, she gave her a rude reply.. look at the pricing menu on the wall. What goes around comes around. By the way their dim sum like siow mai, etc is so so only.Show less

Author: Edith CSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good big bao
Review: We queue for nearly 45 mins to get a seat. By then most of the items were already sold out.I will definitely not go for the siew Mai or Har kow. Anything that has similar skin as Har kow is terrible. It is soft and mushy. This place definitely not serving authentic dim sum if that is what you are looking for.But I will highly recommended the big bao. The filling tasted like beef but we were told that it is pork. It is very juicy and flavourful. Beware when eating as the juice will squirt out if you pinch from the bottom. Show less

Author: LisaMarieSykesMajorca, Spain
Title: Best breakfast around Jonker Street
Review: It's actually the only breakfast option around the Jonker Street area before 9am.We had been trekking up and down the streets desperately looking for a coffee since before 8am, and our tour was coming to pick us up at 8:30. Everywhere was closed until we finally saw the welcome sight of plastic tables, a steaming wok and plenty of Chinese people drinking coffee.We went in, not really knowing what to expect and we were immediately seated, coffee was brought to us and the girl said "you want dim sum?" That was as far as the menu went and so, of course we said that yes, indeed we did.Almost immediately we were served two large dim sum that were steaming hot and full of flavour. I have no idea what the filling was but it tasted good.Then we were presented with a huge tray of fresh-out-the-steamer dim sum with all kinds of choices on there for us to pick what we wanted.It was all delicious and cheap and was served very fast.My advice here: just go with the flow.Show less

Author: Minijade
Title: Super Oily Dim sum
Review: My dining experience at here is a nightmare. This is my first time ever to taste such oily dim sum. The staff just put on exceed oil on the plate in order to prevent the meat stick on the plate. I don't felt alright after having such oily dim sum in the early morningShow less

Author: gourmetkinglondonLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Breakfast of champions
Review: Yes its basic and yes it's not the friendliest of places BUT the Dim Sum is amazing. The owners don't speak much English or I anticipate much Malaysian either but for me it was the highlight of my stay in Malaka. They generally cater for a local crowd and mainly Chinese customer but that said it made for quite an experience. A particular young lady who could speak some English would always make her way over hand help us when ordering our dishes. They served strong black coffee (in a bag) and the food was to die for. I am English through and through and after a night out on the town after drinking many beers there is nothing better in the morning than a bacon sandwich or fry up to cure that hangover. Well yes there is and in comes in the form of Dim Sum from Rong MaoSince returning the UK I have lost count of the amount of times I have longed for their Dim Sum. If you want a smile and attentive service this might not be the place for you, but look beyond this for an amazing breakfast fix and you can't go wrong!!Show less

Author: Yap KNegeri Sembilan, Malaysia
Title: BEWARE! RUDE LADY PROPRIETOR
Review: Wanted to buy some take-away paus but was snapped by this rude lady saying "No Take-Away!" (Rude & Loud). A lady before me was served for take-away. Why can't I be served for take-away after the front lady? What's wrong with her? Her manners was disgusting. Had come across many good proprietors who are professional in handling customers with efficiency, calmness, happy & smiling attitude. With her manners, customers will be turn-off & never return. Few months ago, we, (family of 3) ate dim sum for breakfast & ta pau 15 char siew paus & 4 tai-paus with other steam & fried dim sums. All the paus were charged as tai-paus prices. We were over-charged for the char siew paus after recalculating later. How can they make such a mistake? Don't they know their pau sizes & pricing? Are they doing on purpose as we ate & bought lots of dim sum back? CHEATED! Readers, BEWARE... of their charging on your food.Show less

Author: evippsrDenpasar, Indonesia
Title: Best Breakfast ever in Melaka!
Review: This restaurant by far has the best dim sum plates and porridge we ever had in Melaka. It is cheap and good. To come here though you must arrive early because everything is finished by 1pm! We ordered 13 plates of dim sum, a bowl of porridge, and tea, and it costs us only around RM30! Never leave Melaka without having your breakfast here! :)Show less

Author: WINSONLOH
Title: as if like Shanghai Xiao Loong Pow (but in Bigger size)
Review: Big pow made it so much like eating Xiao Loong Pow. Becareful during the 1st bite as the sauce will burst out.

Author: CeciltongSingapore
Title: Come for the experience (if not the food)
Review: They are nowhere near the standards of Tim Ho Wan, so one has to be realistic. However, it is pleasant enough place for breakfast and they offer a 2-star dim sum experience (if Tim Ho Wan is 5-star). A novelty factor is that you are offered the selection of food on a tray and you pick whatever you want (or attracts you). I usually stop by at this coffee shop after visiting my favourite fried noodle shop at Jalan Hang Kasturi), which I wrote about in a separate review.If you are here in the morning and have another half an hour to spare, I would suggest taking into nearby sights. As you leave the coffee shop, there is a small Malay kampong to your right (beside the temple), and you will see samples of houses on stilts. The kampong is also the burial site of some Acehnese fighters who resisted the Portuguese during the troubled days of European conquests in the East.To the left of the coffee shop, and on the right side of Jalan Tukang Besi (Blacksmith Street), you will find an old blacksmith, and if you visit on the right day, hammering and dipping the metal into water over and over again. Jalan Tukang Besi is the road beyond Jalan Tukang Emas (Goldsmith Street) where the coffee shop is located.If you ware walking towards the junction of Jalan Tukang Emas/Jalan Tukang Besi and Jalan Hang Kasturi, turn left into Jalan Hang Kasturi, and you will find Jalan Kampung Kuli on your right. On the corner of the street, you will find a sign maker, and one visit, I stumbled upon the owner chipping and cutting away into the wood to create a traditional Chinese sign. Slightly further down Jalan Kampung Kuli (on the left) is the popiah skin maker. Again, if you are there in the morning, you will find a lady or her son making thin popiah skins in their home. She sells them fresh if you want to buy the skins. This lady and her son operates their popiah (thin rice pancakes filled with radish/meat/lard/egg) stall at Jonker Street in the afternoon/night. On Jalan Hang Kasturi, you will also find forgers of aluminium. If you walk towards the end of this street and cross over Jalan Kampung Pantai, you will find a shop selling traditional Peranakan baskets and other wedding paraphernalia.Show less

Author: OdeliagigsJB
Title: The worst din sum i have ever taste
Review: The food is horrible, the har gao was over steam and the skin seem to be peeling off already, the big bao which was recomended was horrible, it was too oily and the sauce inside is too dark untill the whole bao look really bad. The shop is full of ppl and the owner is really rude, when i ask her for a plate, she say no plate and she got no time to wash her plate?! How to eat without plate?! We order 7 plate and a pu er tea cost us RM 18 not cheap at all...i will never come back...Show less

Author: xiaoye lSingapore, Singapore
Title: Traditional dim sum coffeeshop
Review: Serves dim sum in a coffeeshop. The big bun (da bao) was very good. So was the glutinous rice in lotus leaf. Good tea selection. I recommend Cha Wang (Tea King). Don't expect it to be as good as Chinese restaurant standards. This is where the locals go for their weekend morning dim sum with their family and friends.. Show less

Author: khimsiusingapore
Title: Old School Dim Sum
Review: We skipped the complimentary breakfast from the hotel every day just so that we can go eat dim sum here. There are no push carts here but you will be presented with their dim sum selection once you have settled down in the rickety table and chairs. They served mostly locals but over the years I have seen more and more tourists venturing to this place. The rough-and-tumble dim sum may not be the best in towm but it is definitely value for money.Show less

Author: t0kid0kiSingapore
Title: Dim sum in an old school environment
Review: Decided to have breakfast here after reading the reviews. We were rather late - arrive around 10.30am where the morning crowd is already gone.The dim sum portion are rather small which is good as you can try more variety. However the food is average and could be better if it is served piping hot. Service is rather good as we had wanted to order the sushi dim sum but was sold out. The owner came to us about 5mins later that he will steam 2 new portions for us to try.Show less

Author: Bridget CForfar, United Kingdom
Title: Fantastic Dim Sum
Review: We found this on our last morning last year - such a shame. We won't make the same mistake this year on our holidays - we'll be having breakfast here probably most days. It is very local but we were welcomed and didn't feel out of place at all. Everything we tried was excellent and the tea kept flowing. A great place away from the crowds to relax - just see what comes out of the kitchen and try it all and it won't break the bank either.Show less

Author: CarolynnAng5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Local Dim Sum in Malacca - Jonker
Review: Location: this is at Jonker street (at the end / back of it). The landmark is to find the mosque: Masjid Kampung Kling, along this road Jalan Tukang Emas. If you are staying at jonker street area, just make a short walk - there is no need to drive!Time: No Tuesday! It is closed on Tues. Go early, very early, it opens from 5am and usually it is for early morning crowd and gets very busy at weekend (when both tourists and locals are there). It is crowded and so, patience is key. Food: Dim sum of course! One of the popular dim sum is the meat bao (bun) which is juicy and big, and usually we will have one to share with 2-4 pax (as you would have other dishes). This dish runs out pretty fast so be there early if you want to try it, try your luck if you are there at 8am. They have both steam and fried dim sum. If you don't know what you want, look out for those servers who come by in large trays with little saucers of dim sum, either point it out or just bring them onto your table. Go with Chinese Tea! I like the porridge and most of the little dishes. Don't be deceived by the little saucers, you eat by variety so you can fill your stomach very fast. I won't say all the dishes are fabulous but they are good. Anyway if you don't like some of them and you are in Malacca you would definitely be trying out food elsewhere. So don't worry about having all food filled your stomach at this place. Price: super reasonable and you won't regret it.Atmosphere: This is local and this "tea place" as the chinese name is 荣茂茶室 has been here for years. The lady boss is fast and does excellent maths calculation! This is where you get the feel of the local buzz, the local chitchats in the early morning. One might find this place a little too buzzy and the servers are always so busy moving around, shouting out orders or clearing tables or rushing to attend customers and one might feel lost but this is how it is and just by being there, you feel half local already! You would leave this place, feeling..ah...nice to have a dim sum at this place! (and now, to the next food stop!)Show less

Author: kelvin_wonz
Title: My second time here and it’s
Review: My second time here and it’s as good as always. Favourite place to hang out when I come to Melaka. Definitely recommended to bag packers & travellers.

Author: Jack H
Title: Great coffee and fantastic host
Review: Highly recommended, the coffee is great and the service fantastic. You should visit when you are in Melaka

Author: Loessie221Bruges, Belgium
Title: Super nice vegetarian & vintage café
Review: I was honestly amazed when I found this place, while it has so little recommendations! The food is amazingly good & healthy, staff is friendly and the whole café is in vintage style. Everything you see, you can also buy. They even have a typewriter which you are allowed to use to write postcards. So definitly a recommemdation. Show less

Author: sheila1026109
Title: Always good
Review: Always delicious cendol. Been here many times. Good staffs. Lots of products and options. Will return for sure.

Author: sheila1026109Penafiel, Spain
Title: Just walked in and was pleasantly
Review: Just walked in and was pleasantly surprised. This is not listed as one of the top Cendol place in Melaka but it really should be number one. Rich coconut milk, free flow gula Melaka. Most importantly, very warm customer service. I noticed the shop owner family member calling the worker as ‘kakak’ which shows they treat their workers well and those are subtle signs of a healthy happy place. Show less

Author: Voyage63996463382
Review: Cendol and pineapple tart is nice at here. All the products were fresh and the dishes had the warmth of home-made food. The owner takes great care in selecting the best quality ingredients. The shop also caters for all tastes by providing a large selection of the best wines of the region, which are pricy but worth sampling.Show less

Author: 286karing
Title: Nice chendol
Review: Nice chendol served with free flow of Gula Melaka! However the price of the chendol is more pricey than other restaurant. Their home made pineapple tart using butter to bake is tasty too.

Author: Christopher_SNZSingapore River, Singapore
Title: Most Authentic Chendol and Gula Melaka
Review: Title says it all, they sell a lot of good stuff here - the chendol is the highlight and you can add high quality brown sugar gula melaka to it. If you do buy the brown sugar, make sure you get the higher grade one in the box.Excellent!!Show less

Author: komododeesingapore
Title: Yummy chendol!
Review: I'm not really sure how "authentic" chendol ought to taste like but we loved Christina's! Absolutely refreshing after a day in the hot sun. And served not too sweet, with a bottle of gula melaka at the side for those with a sweet tooth. Thumbs up!Show less

Author: SingaporeGenieSingapore, Singapore
Title: Probably the best chendol in Malacca town
Review: We walked to a couple of places to have this favourite dessert of mine, and this place does it best. Simple and fresh ingredients, reasonably priced and good service. They don’t drown it gula melaka and toss in fancy stuff. Very authentic. Another plus point is that it’s off the Main Street so it’s not crowded with tourists. Beats its neighbours hands down. Show less

Author: Ipchloe
Title: Nice cendol and friendly service
Review: We were heading to a famous cendol shop at jonker street but found it was a mess with customers eating their food standing without seats. so we left n head back then saw this little shop selling cendol so we tried. Their cendol is very tasty and their ingredients are good and fresh. Their service is also very good. Small shops with limited seating, however, they put up an extra table and sufficient seating for us when the existing 3 were occupied.Show less

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: good pineapple tarts & cendol...
Review: My go to place for pineapple tarts whenever I visit Melaka. Love the buttery layered variety. They also have decent cendol especially the one with durian. Service is friendly & attentive. Small shop located near the bars along Jonker street. Sells a lot of good cookies, tarts & food items to take home. Reasonable prices. Parking a pain but short walk from the open space.Show less

Author: Erico2709Singapore, Singapore
Title: Small place but exccellent chendol
Review: I find the chendol tasty and just right in terms of sweetness. It has the traditional or durian flavoured chendol to suit your taste. The place is quite small so may be tricky to find a seat if you have too big a group. They also send other local pineapple tarts, etc. as well.Show less

Author: ysl1018
Title: Highly recommended local food
Review:
Fresh and good homemade style local food:- fish ball noodle. 
There r variety of selection of yong tau foo, all freshly made.
Great location too as it is near to Jonker ealk( within walkkng distance).
Friendly boss

Author: imchristeng
Title: Nice fishball.
Review: Nice fishball. Highly recommended. Suitable for family and child friendly area. Will visit again when we drop by Melaka again.

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Century Egg with fish paste
Review:
Noodles are good. 
Ingredients for the yong tau foo is fresh. Century Egg with fish paste is good. Very special taste. 

Got to try the dry noodles with chilli. 👍🏼

Author: iamkayoh
Title: Great food and reasonable price
Review:
Very nice noodles and yong tau food. 

Separates fried and boiled items so that the fried items do not get soggy. 

Nice! Favourite item is the fried brinjal. 
Love it!

Author: Deepak S
Title: Best noodle melaka
Review: I travel in melaka One week .  first time try the teo chew fishball noodle soup . This is simply the best food in melaka . Must try

Author: Hew55Alcala De Henares, Spain
Title: The Best Home Made Fresh Fish Ball
Review: Probably the best fish ball noodle I have ever had. The fagrant of the pork lard in the dry noodle with more than 10 options of different fresh fish ball, this restaurant is such a gem. Even though they are only selling fish balls, but you will be satisfied with the varieties in their menu. The owners are very passionate with what they are making and we are very happy to have found this place. Will definitely go back with friends.Show less

Author: Thomas T
Title: Fishball Noodle
Review: Fresh and delicious home-styled fishball noodles. Thoroughly enjoyed the meal. Owner/chef is a friendly guy. Will go back for more.

Author: Noelle T
Title: Fresh and healthy Teochew style noodle
Review: We stumbled upon this place while looking for another restaurant in the vicinity. They offer no frills simple fish ball / Yong Tau Fu noodles. You can order dry or soup option. Chill can be added to the dry noodle. For the KL folks, be warned that the dry option does not contain dark sauce but still quite tasty. The fish ball and yong tau fu are fresh, which is really the most important thing you need. It is healthy food and can give your stomach a nice rest from the laksa and cendol you had in the afternoon. Service is excellent, especially to tourists who may not be familiar with how to pick out your own stuff. if you're not sure what you want, the shop owner will help explain to you.Show less

Author: jookuanl
Title: Excellent meal.
Review: Best fish ball noodles in town. Friendly atmosphere. Clean environment. Prices reasonable. Great parking. Efficient service.

Author: Mayberline M
Title: Best yongtaufu in town
Review: Home made fish ball very delicious and fresh..... Many types of choices to choose like egg,Taufu, ladies finger.Especially that century egg fis ball,vegetable fish ball and abalone fish ball.Their Teow Chew style née dry and home made chili sauce also gave me a different experience

Author: StevenY688
Title: 5 star fishball restaurant
Review: i never had before so delicious fishball in my life, price reasonable, and in a week i ate 5 times 😜. Boss are very friendly and very hardworking

Author: jademoonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Home Made Fishball
Review: The place has got the best fishball and other stuff eg taufu, ladies fingers etc stuffed with the fish paste. Can eat it with the noodles. Tasty, good and no msg (I didn't feel thirsty after drinking the soup). Price is moderate to a bit high, but it's worth it.Show less

Author: edwinchowywMelaka, Malaysia
Title: A low class joint - really not worth the visit
Review: We had dinner in this restaurant on the 25.8.19. My wife and me with my 3 lovely children.I think I should just go straight to the point 1. The bread took 30 minutes to arrive. And it was only after we had to request for some 2. They served my daughter ‘s carbonara after 45 minutes . Then it was another 30 minutes of wait for the other main course to arrive. 3. The carbonara was watery- never had a watery soup like carbonara in a 5 star hotel restaurant before.4. The service is ridiculous poor.And it is just a waste of my time writing more about the low quality food and service in Olio.Olio .. I will remember you for a very long time.Trust me.. the food at the nearby hawker centre would be more satisfying...Horrible experience Show less

Author: abrogers2001Perth, Australia
Title: Good menu - a little disappointing
Review: To have an Italian restaurant in our hotel (Ramada Plaza) was a pleasant surprise. It has a interesting menu with all the courses well presented. We had Eggplant Tapas and Baked oysters with spinach sauce for entrées and double cooked lamb shanks and Spaghetti Marinara for main course. All were excellently cooked and tasty, but the oysters were undercooked.There is a short but well composed wine list but the wine waiter could not tell the difference between the Montepulciano and the Valpolicella, that they had on the list and brought the wrong one.It is not cheap for Malaysia and cost us A$100 for the food and A$80 for the wine.Show less

Author: amritpalss2018Melaka, Malaysia
Title: BAD !
Review: visited last week and was Massively disappointed with the service and food. My squid ink pasta tasted like canned food. Very bland. My wife ordered lamb shank and the sauce was some soggy marinara sauce.My apple pie dessert was an epic disaster. Pie was served cold for a start and the pie crust fell apart before I could even touch it. I asked for a replacement and all I got was another piece of pie which was reheated in the microwave. My friends sat in a different table were also disappointed with their pasta.Time for olio to buck up massively.Show less

Author: PKYeoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good food, good environment, vastly improved.
Review: The food quality has definitely improved compared to my last visit. Some of the new starters which must try includes the seafood soup, gamberi (chicken), pan seared foie gras, roasted peruvian chicken. Aglio olio and chicken picata was also good.Show less

Author: amritpalss2018Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice
Review: Nice place. Little dim tho. Food was great. Staff was helpful with wine selection. Bit costly tho but fineShow less

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Romantic Italian dining
Review: Good quality Italian food in a Romantic setting. Suitable for special occasions. Service and quality are good

Author: Thipa R
Title: Nice ambience, mediocre food.
Review: Yes, the title pretty much sums it up.We arrived around 8.45pm.The ambience was nice, dark and cosy.A duo were performing for a short while, before proceeding to the bar I think.Service was mediocre, we purchased a bottle of their red wine, the waiters did not even bother to check and fill our glasses after round one. Wine was good though.The grilled chicken was the only thing that was nice. The squid ink, oglio olio and carbonara pastas were severely mediocre!The cheese cake and mushroom soup were nice.For the price, to say I was disappointed would be an understatement. Will not consider this place again. Show less

Author: Michael WLeopold, Australia
Title: Nice Restaurant, situated in the Ramada Hotel
Review: This a nice quite restaurant located in the Ramada Hotel. Nice ambience and very friendly staff. The food was good, my wife really enjoyed the organic mushroom and cream soup and my lobster tail bisque was superb. I had a seafood pizza for mains, could have done with a little more seafood.Show less

Author: TheHutMelaka
Title: Great dining experience
Review: Excellent Italian food. Tried Lasagna, Grill Salmon and pizza (Couldn't remember the name of the pizza). Superb taste and quality! Keep up the good work!!

Author: Meghan B
Title: Very romantic and great food and great service
Review: Candle light, flowers, live band with no extra cost, this is place to go for a romantic outing. Great service, reasonable price and awesome ambience.

Author: Christina S LMelaka, Malaysia
Title: company was great😏
Review: i have not been to Olio in a long time. the food was passable, the service a little slow, ambiance was very nice. the entertainment was unnecessary and unfortunately i found the 'ladies' to be poorly dressed for the standard of the hotel! the older staff were very friendly n able to communicate. the new staff though could not even understand what we wanted n had to ask for clarification from the older staff!!Show less

Author: jimbP8569CY
Title: Olio - fab food
Review: We visited Olio after another restaurant closed early - they were great - a lovely welcome - great atmosphere-fine food- the 'wine buffet' with free flowing wine for 85rm was a definite plus for us alcoholics- definitely worth a visit

Author: Cricketfan16
Title: Excellent Meal
Review: Very authentic Italian restaurant, good service, staff and atmosphere.  Very tasty meal and thoroughly enjoyed.

Author: Steve HPuchong, Malaysia
Title: A little slice of Italia
Review: Once our choice for a bit of fine dining it is still to my knowledge the best Italian restaurant in Melaka. It's not cheap by any stretch but the pastas we've had and the pizzas have always impressed. The tiramasu has to be seen to be believed - make sure there are at least two fanatics of the dish in your party otherwise you'll be wasting most of it. Wine selection is good and the overall atmosphere is pleasant.Show less

Author: miaziadaMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: Olio Italian restaurant has very nice food and not very expensive for a 5 star restaurant at the Ramada Plaza hotel. Ravioli stuffed with mushrooms were very delicious and my son had the salame pizza that was cooked in a wood fire oven. Delicious!!Show less

Author: jacksU1396EPKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Limited choice but taste ok
Review: This is cosy italian restaurant located at 1st floor of plaza ramada.So we decide to give a try and can satisfied.Friendly staff , good service and nice cosy and romantic interior.We ordered mushroom soup, lamb shank and their hawaian pizza.Their foid portion not bad and their pizza is good but for lamb shank just so so only.The price is slightly on higher side but what u expect for tis kind of fine dining restaurantPlenty of wine selection available.Overall...im satisfiedShow less

Author: Travelfather59Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Can be better
Review: My wife and I went there for dinner. the menu spread was limited and not much of choices. The pastas were also not out of the ordinary. I just decided to have a soup and my wife, dessert. The Cioppino soup was average. I found it a bit too thick for my liking although ingredients was fresh. Two type of breads were served out of which one was extremely dry. Maybe its due to the low volume of customers. Maybe. The dessert was disappointing. We waited for sometime for the dessert and were told that it was coming from the coffee house. That pretty much sums up what you will expect. One would expect better from Ramada Plaza.Show less

Author: Zingg HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Food & Service
Review: We been invited to a Birthday Dinner Party. The menu which Chef Mozart created was outstanding. Many guests commented with good remarks. The service was just greatand couldn't be better. The Restaurant Manager, Mr Gabriel and his team gave a verygood and excellent service.Show less

Author: RuurdvanElburgHilversum, The Netherlands
Title: Classy restaurant with good food but a bit cold due to strong airco so bring something slightly warmer if you go
Review: This is definitely a more expensive restaurant located on the second floor of the ramada plaza Melaka hotel. It is nicely decorated with prizes for appetizers and entrees of around 20-25 rgt and main courses of 35 - 185 rgt the latter for the most expensive dishes. Very friendly staff to serve you. The air conditioning is quite cold so better bring a litltle bit warmer clothes because they can not adopt the airco as it is centrally controlled in the hotel. We had nice dishes only if you like tiramisu as it is made in Italy and Europe do not order it here as it is really different! From what European people consider tiramisu!Show less

Author: Bas dRotterdam, The Netherlands
Title: Absolute CRAP
Review: Bad service, very untasty pizza, the mozzarella sticks were still frozen, after complaining, they gave me the SAME plate where i already took a bite off. The pizza that we ordered tasted like cartboard. They did not bring any of the dishes at the same time. Although the restaurant was empty. You should avoid this placeShow less

Author: Thijs d
Title: Bad kitchen
Review: Went here during our stay in the hotel. Half of our table had a starter served. Then 10 minutes they served mozzarella sticks which were still frozen inside. Those were sent back and they came back with the same ones, warmed up in the microwave. The pizza was like a piece of cardboard. Super dry. And served 1 munite after we finished with our starter. So half of the table was done by the time we got our main course. Bad experience, I would not visit again.Show less

Author: danieloR2895ZGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Solid food but on the expensive side
Review: The restaurant has a nice, rustique, romantic setting. The live music may be special and entertaining for some. I think the type of music and presentation does not match a traditional Italian restaurant but rather a pub. The food is solid. Nice and warm bread nicely presented. The salad was fresh with a mild dressing. Pizzas are thin crust and well prepared if one loves it that way. Personally I prefer thicker crust but thats not an issue. True Italian would be nice with pork ham which is obviously not possible but the menu is creative to have a good choice. Pasta was al dente and tasty. The selection of wines is very limited and expensive. We ordered two Italian wines. Both out of stock. The only available Chianti is priced MYR 375 per bottle which was too steep. Settled for an Australian wine. Ok but not my preferred choice with Italian food. Service was friendly and attentive.Show less

Author: ScorpionTravellerKuala Lumpur
Title: The only decent Italian dining in Malacca
Review: This is our second visit to Olio. As Italian cuisine lovers, we find Olio is the only establishment that serves decent Italian food in Malacca. The menu has a mix of Italian and Western dishes. Breads served were delicious, accompanied by a mini trio of butter, olive oil with balsamic vinegar and an hors' doeuvres, smoked tuna (with a pinch of pesto, I think). No explanation provided by the waitress when serving. Choice of pasta is rather limited, I was hoping to try their Tortellini (there's Agnolotti) but not available. So I opted for Linguine with Lobster Slipper, which was all right but a tad too salty. Even the lobster was salty. Pasta are made fresh according to the menu, but it did taste like "off the packet" linguine. My husband had the Tandoori Chicken Pizza which came in generous portion, enough to feed two people. Chicken didn't exude enough flavour of tandoori spice and pizza would have tasted better with fresh tomato sauce, rather than from tin. The crust was tasty, thin with slight burnt around the edges.Service overall was good and unobtrusive. We took up the wine buffet promotion but was not made aware by the waiter that it's self-service; only discovered when we asked for refill. Therefore, such communication to guests is necessary especially in a hotel establishment where personalised service is expected. Would request the team to look into their ambient music, which seemed confused with Italian and non-Italian genres. The two-piece band performs in the evenings, and choice of songs do not complement the atmosphere and rather noisy to have conversations. Feel such performance is more suited for lobby lounge.Show less

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: One of the Best
Review: I love dining in this restaurant. The food is really good and the staff are extremely helpful. The beef medallion and the cod fish are extremely awesome. Their pizzas especially the calzone is really yummy. The baked oyster and the mushroom soup are so good that you could not resist. If you want good Italian food, this is the place to go.The ambiance is nice and it is a good place to relax. I have read other reviewers who complained about the slow service. My advice is to make reservation.Show less

Author: Sameer JMumbai, India
Title: Good Food but slow service..
Review: We had some delicious Italian Food in Olio but the service was a bit slow, although the person taking orders was very courteous.. the waiters would disappear at times specially when you needed something. The ambiance is lovely and even had a live music till 8.30 which we enjoyed.. we just loved the pizza which thin crisp and tasty. Decently priced fine dine restaurant definitely worth going in melaka.Show less

Author: BenMoraisPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: A wonderful Expereince
Review: We had a celebratory dinner at Olio Italian Restaurant at the Ramada Plaza Hotel in Melaka recently.My wife and I had a slipper lobster starter. It was well presented and tasted simply great.My wife then had a roasted cod for the main course and I had a steak.Both were done superbly. Our compliments to the chef.Overall the service was courteous, friendly and prompt.Show less

Author: Azran1
Title: Underwhelming
Review: If you're looking for Italian food, then this is the only one we found in town. Service was slow and lacked energy/interest. Food was average, and ambience was quiet. Oh, they had a 'live singer' which was odd.

Author: Zingg HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Cosy nice atmosphere for dinning
Review: Food was superb. My steak was good meat and done medium rare as I ordered. Salmon and Codwere also done well. Channti wine was served in perfect temperature. The desserts were alsodelicious. As an Italian Restaurant, they should stock Grappa and I was surprise that I couldnot order Grappa with my esspresso. The other guests that came to the Restaurant were notproperly dressed as they were in shorts, t-shirt and flip flops. The Restaurant should have somenotice placed infront to educate people on the dress code for fine dinning.Show less

Author: MickYoongMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Authentic Italian Restaurant in Melaka (211213)
Review: It was a Saturday evening, five of us dined in and ordered salads which was fresh and seared tuna appetizer which was good to last bite. The delectable seafood soup was infused and the shrimps, scallops and mussels were fresh, juicy and nicely cooked. Mushroom soup was just thick enough to my taste.Those breads were awesome! Grilled beef tournedos and rib eye were fresh and succulent, cooked to my desired taste. Chicken piccata was tender and toothsome. Lasagna well presented and with minced chicken fillings to her liking. Finally the array of sea food platter was really out of this world came in hot and cold plates, squids, scallops shrimps,clamps and mussels well cooked fresh and juicy. Limed oysters and smoke salmon in cold. Freshness of oysters were recommendable. Desserts, Choc Lava and Aromatic cappuccino Tiramisu sponge cake, Trio Gelato were mouth watering. Good ambiance, authentic and worth the money!Show less

Author: SurgewindKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Romantic Dining Experience!
Review: We had a birthday dinner last night at Olio's. The service was good with smiling and friendly staff, food was superb, and the ambience was so romantic!! We love this place!! Would highly recommend this place to all!!Show less

Author: WranglerdarlesBendigo, Australia
Title: Wedding banquet

Noticed a lot of locals dine here; meaning not Singaporeans but diners who hail from malacca. Food is really good; tried the tea leaves chicken, we loved it. Food is reasonably priced and the portion is huge. Will come again next time Show less

Title: Great food, nice ambience and inexpensive
Review: We went to a few restaurants for dinner in our one week stay in Melaka last week ... and was perhaps our best rated restaurant. The food is good and the ambience is pretty classy and air-conditioned. There were about 12 of us and had about 8 dishes. The bill came up to RM$250 (about USD$63!!!) ... on another night we had dinner at another non air-conditioned (so-called) popular place, the bill came up to RM$205 for 5 dishes. New lagoon restaurant is value for money and good food.Show less

Author: cherylwA1293IQKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good Malaysian Chinese (Cantonese-style) food in a pleasant ambience
Review: We've been here numerous times over the last 2+ years, for both casual family dinners and celebrations - larger-scale year-end dinners and only just - a family wedding. In all instances, we've had a good experience - from a quality of food & service perspective.Food is tasty, local Malaysian Cantonese-style cuisine. They have the usual variety of pork, chicken, seafood, noodles etc. Prices are mid-range, good value for money. Service is pretty ok for a restaurant of this standard, which I'd consider to be upper mid-range. They allowed us to bring our own wine without corkage too! And their roasted suckling pig had no 'smell' that sensitive noses can pick out!Show less

Author: johnxavier
Title: dinner with family at New Lagoon Restoran
Review: a good selection of food and dishes available.Nice ambiance with cheerfula and helpful staff.Not too pricey
