Review: This is a nice place just outskirts of malaka town about 2.6 km from Hatten Hotel where I stay. We just finished a corporate meeting and wanted a place to chill. Great food and we had beer and stout served . The pictures below are self explanatory on the food being served. They also had a modern digital karaoke machines , for more fun . Unfortunately the place closes at 10.30pm Show less

Author: Mm W
Title: Worst attitude and service
Review: The worst restaurant ever. Service sucks.Should you consider to do wedding here, PLEASE DO NOT EVER HAVE THAT THOUGHT!!!I was here to attend my good friend's wedding. And this is what the groom and we as a guest face during the whole event.1) menu written they will serve "sun hock" fish, but what we get is HALF of "siak-pan" fish. 2) during pre set up for dessert table and photo booth, the restaurant refuse to move tables n chair for the crew to do it.The owner said if you know how to dismantle the table, then you do yourself. (Unexpectedly, the groom and friends are all from food n beverage line) End up, the groom n friends have to do it themselves. The staff and owner just stand and look.3) during dinner, the staff keep rushing to clear your dish even there's still obviously untouched because everyone was busying enjoying the video shown on stage.4) please bare in mind, even your whole plate is full of prawn shells, they will not replace you a new plate. WILL NEVER! (even I don't encourage ppl to change plate for every different dish, but this is ridiculous)5) the staff's attitude will make you want to flip table. While they are rushing to clear your dish away, telling you there's no place for the new dish. I told her to please change our unfinished dish into a smaller plate, but guess what she tell me? She said: " DO IT YOURSELF"6) just when they place the dessert on your table, they on the light in the ballroom to the brightest and off the air con. Great just great! Asking u to leave the restaurant now!There's many more... so people please don't choose to do your wedding here. You will regret your whole life. They have the worst service and attitudeShow less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Nice environment
Review: Come here to attend my friend wedding dinner. Quite surprise this restaurant willing to spent money on zoom cctv camera. Love the environment here, sound system and food here taste better than other chinese restaurant. Next time will consider this restaurant for my wedding.

Author: FromKluang
Title: Comfortable restaurant
Review:
Was there few time.

A lot of parking space available.
The foods is not bad and service is good.
Definitely come back again for business and family gathering.

Author: Happygolucky444
Title: Best restaurant for now
Review: Almost everything in the restaurant is good is good...good environment ...visited almost every weekend.... one of the best family restaurant I must say, in melaka...

Author: SantawangKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Looks and Nice Food Alone Is Not Good Enough If Owner Is Not Humble.
Review: This is my 3rd visit there. I've read the other 3 earlier reviews and now would like to give my point of view. The ambiance of the restaurant is nice. Well light place, someone to greet you at the door (like all Chinese Restaurants do) and walk you to your table. Orders were taken promptly and food served within 20 minutes of ordering. At that time, I counted about 6 tables occupied + some guest in VIP rooms.What I was not happy about was the owner which I felt was proud and arrogant. He practised selective greeting to certain table. I even walked passed him and not even a word of hello, how's the food etc. I thought this would only happen during the 1st or 2nd visit due to the peak period cause the restaurant was just opened for business but I was wrong. The only time I was entertained was when I walked to the Cashier counter to make my payment. I was dressed quite simple that night. Maybe he thought I was a poor chap who just hit some 4D number and not a regular like some of his VIP guest. As my title says it all, Looks, Nice Food Alone Is Not Good Enough If Owner Is Not Humble. This is definitely my last visit to this place.Show less

Author: Your_MelakaMalacca, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Dining Ambience
Review: Pleasant service and great cuisine. Attended from the door to the table, the waiter and the waitress are friendly and they warmly welcome you. Best attempt is extended to get available table of your choice. From the moment you're seated, warm tea is served and ice cubes make its way to the table for those who prefer drinking cold. Soothingly as you enjoy the warm fragant tea, the tender music pleases your mood and the refreshing cool air pamper you while warm and steamy foods are timely delivered to your table from the kitchen.The joy of dining is elevated with the quiet ambience, cosy lighting and creative wall design, excellent for anyone who would like to capture and mobile upload to Facebook for their close to like. There is a wide range of cooking styles one can order and do not hesistate to ask for recommendation. The waiter and the waitress are please to attend to your request promptly.The whole dining experience is complete with desserts and fruits. A restaurant to feast.Show less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: I have eaten in many Chinese restaurants in Melaka and I have found by far this is one of the best food served so far. The food was tasty. We had 5 dishes and a dessert. The scallop vegetable dish was just wonderful. The noodle was good, the soft shell crab was a wee bit salty though. The chicken & steam fish was good. The dessert coconut pudding was very good.The ambiance of the restaurant was also good. Overall I would give this Chinese restaurant a thumbs up.Show less

Author: Cliff6108
Title: Tantalizing food that will keep bringing you back here for more!
Review: Quiet ambience, quick attentive service and most importantly the range of deliciously prepared dishes. Salted egg yolk crab dish is my favorite among several. I've visited this restaurant three times in the past year and I went home fully satisfied each time.

Author: munchongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Fully baked pork knuckle in Melaka; something different and genuinely nice
Review: I ordered a pork knuckle 3 days in advance as recommended online - thanks to the many fans here; and to add on to the chorus of praise, the meat was a little chewy but not tough, the fat was not greasy and went extremely well with the Franziskaner beer, and the tendons were like fresh collagen.Although there was no aircon, the ambience was just nice. The lady owner and the staff were genuinely friendly and chatted with us. It was the first time in Melaka that we got back to the hotel after midnight. We arrived at 6pm :-)I felt so good after that dinner that I made up my mind to go back every time I visit Melaka and I forgave the hellish Grab trip the night before that made me give up my dinner plans. It's wonderful what genuinely friendly people I get to meet in Melaka.Three thumbs up!!They are only open for dinner and I strongly recommend the pork knuckle. Have it with a beer.Show less

Author: marc147Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic German sausage in Melaka
Review: We had excellent German sausages there and the staff was friendly with a good service. will visit the place again. Just for your info if you want pork knuckle at the place you need to pre-order 2 days a head. But the neighboring table had pork knuckle and smelled and looked good. Will go back on my next trip to Melaka but that time will pre-order knuckle.Show less

Author: Kittyhomestayma... T
Title: Serves a variety of sausages & such a clean restaurant!
Review: This place specializes in sausages although i am told their pork knuckle is also popular. Probably the only place in Malacca that specializes in German sausages & German style pork knuckle. So if you love sausages this is the right place for you. You have to book in advance for the pork knuckle as it takes pretty long to prepare.I like the chicken chop & lamb chop as they are well seasoned. The mashed potatoes served with it is yummy too.Another plus point is the restaurant looks very clean. Even the kitchen looks clean & tidy.They only open at night though. Show less

Review:

Author: larslindbeckCape Town Central, South Africa
Title: maybe the chef was in a bad mood that day
Review: i happened to cycle pass the "new" german restaurant one day. i love sausages and wanted to try. i was in company with a friend so we stopped and order one dish to try. and to be honest. i was very disappointed. being born in sweden i have been able to visit germany many times and buy german sausages from shops in sweden so i did have expectations. the sausages were tiny, maybe ok for most asians :-) , but for me it looked more like a starter than a main dish when they put the plate on the table. the mashed potato was a bit too watery for my taste. but we are all different. if you like german food you should try for yourselfShow less

Author: schaumloeffel

Review: the food is very good, well prepared by an experienced German chef, the sausages are wonderful. I can fully recommend it. A draft beer instead of the available bottle beer would make it perfect!

Author: GieGieTayMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Amazing Homecook German Food
Review: The cafe locate behind the RHB Bank Melaka Raya. Must try the pork knuckle if you come here. The taste same like what I eat in Munich. Really yummy..... The sauce for the sausages are taste very good too. According to them, the sauce mixed with 20+ spices and some spices they import from German.If you want to try German food, come here.Show less

Title: Can try if you are looking for real German sausage
Review: You can find the German sausage here. Basically the sausage is nice but I am not favour on some side dishes they served together.It will be nice for beer lovers as the beer sell by the hotel café is quite cheap compared to other restaurant. Somehow I just feel the environment is a bit hot and certain seats may be very smoky due to they are near to the kitchen which is open.You may enjoy the food but if the weather is hot, you may wont enjoy sitting there long.Show less

Author: Sri Preakash S

Review: Immaculate taste will definitely tickle your tastebuds. Enjoyed every bid of the bite. Sausages were something special.  Nestled in a quiet place, chefs were real Germans... need I say more... :)

Review:

Author: PeteandMareGeorgia
Title: A happy surprise!
Review: We sought out this restaurant because its name promised something we were craving...German sausages. Good ones are hard to beat. These are exceptional! The biggest surprise was finding a celebrated German master chef manning the kitchen and turning out authentic German specialties, like Ghouladh. It was delicious. Rich with the subtly pungent taste of paprika in a complex gravy, over a nice pile of madhed potatoes. Our other meal was an assortment if six sausages, very good saurkraut and red cabbage. The sauce oh the sausages was perfect. Each one was so good, yet different. We love this place!Show less

Author: CratfieldPensacola, Florida
Title: Three times in that week!
Review: yum yum yum yum ! Pork sausages!! We went in 10 paxes.Tried garlic sausages, oehlengar (i dont know how to spell it), curry sausages, Potpuurri sausages and german pork knuckles! up to my expectation~! It is located in Cozy hotel and dining there were one of the most peaceful and cozy experience of nightlife in Malacca. Great with Paulaner.Chef was funny! With red cheeks greeting the customers humbly. The manager was also very polite. They were both Great German!!! Opens till 1-2am? we were there till 12am i guess.Such a shame not many know i supposed the hidden gem in Malacca.Show less

Author: McWheelersMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Pork Sausages!!!!
Review: Been here twice and enjoyed the food both times. I had Potpourri of Sausages which was very yummy. They initially four sausages one of which was chicken which to my surprise turned out to be lovely! But second time I visited they replaced the chicken with something else. Chef recommended white sausages the second time around and I wasn't disappointed!Unfortunately they are not child friendly as there are no high chairs available and it was tough keeping our 3 year old in his seat. Also on our second visit our 3 year old had Fish & Chip which was rather 'rubbery' (I'm sorry nice guys at this restaurant... Hope you are open to constructive criticism)Other than that all is great. Their pricing is very fair too!Hope everyone enjoy it as much as we did!Show less

Author: FarahInaniR

Review: 'Asam pedas' Ghazal cafe is the best 👍🏻. Im really falling in love with 'asam pedas' Ghazal cafe. Try it babe.

Author: LaksamanaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Malay cooking
Review: If you are looking for authentic Malay home cooked food in Melaka's China town,Ghazal Cafe is definitely your best choice.Must try their Laksa Johor,it is really tasty and different from the others, the gravy are cooked with fresh fish with spices,thick and spicy.There are also Asam pedas,fried rice,mee bandung and many more on their Menu.Give it a try and I am sure you will come back for more.Show less

Author: Muhammad Faiz B
Title: Best place

Author: Astroboy2014
Title: Best cafe which served  real Malaysian food
Review: I like the Asam Pedas , lasksa johor whic served with spaghetti . Love the katira drink. Lastly they also have different menu for set lunch.yummy

Author: Along L

Review: my group meeting and these cafe can make you feel easy and welcome. no GST .. hahaha and the food are good. we will come back

Author: Eyasin M
