Review: excellent ghazal cafa food i so enjoy my food in ghazal cafa when my friends say u go to ghazal cafa food is very nice and i go there wow nice .L johor  mee bundung. asam pedas. coffee muar so nice food

Author: Velestryn
Title: Really Tasty
Review: This was near our hotel, so we visited this place 2 nights in a row! The chicken wasn't dry at all! Great for supper! Each costs 2.60RM.

Author: ArineC5
Title: Great wings
Review: Great crispy chicken wings!!! Service was fast and friendly too. Price is reasonable. I like the outdoor seating.

Author: KatHoSgSingapore, Singapore
Title: Tastiest and most juicy!
Review: Chanced upon this stall while exploring malacca. The stall was clean and owner was friendly so our group ordered. The wings turned out to be superb and the chili was complimenting! We went for seconds. Good food must eat more. Do try it out for yourself and just thinking about it now makes my mouth water...Show less

Author: derekang1980Singapore
Title: Slight increase in price but still excellent taste
Review: There is a slight increase in the prices of the wings due to the increase in operating costs according to the owner, but expect the same excellent taste and standard. What impress me the most about this stall is the consistency which never fails to impress me. There is another outlet operated by the owners Mother in 新天地3 which is offers the same standards. As the wings are BBQed here at Newton to about 70% and then ferried to the above location for further BBQing! And all done via charcoal the good old way! Service is prompt although many patrons still forget their table numbers when ordering at Newton cause there are close to 80 tables and it's not easy to recognise or differentiate customers. Recently reviewed Newton and have also provided inputs on the stalls to must-try (including BBQ wings) such as fried oyster egg and the fried radish cake! Show less

Author: derekang1980Singapore
Title: 再上一层！
Review: 一年前刚来，味道鲜美好吃。一年后，生意兴隆和旺了需多！一定要早来而且下定单 不然需要等一下咯！A big improvement to the environment, extra helper meant a shorter waiting time but still a very busy and frequented by locals and bus loads of foreigners! A must try if you're in Melaka, cause this chicken wing beats any other stall in Singapore and Malaysia!Show less

Author: PaulTan1005Singapore
Title: Excellent Long last yummy wings
Review: I'm from Melaka and have been eating the wings from this stall for almost 10+ years since they were at Fajar. Currently residing in Singapore, I've been following their stall move to Newton and subsequently the opening of a branch at Ujong Pasir, they currently only have one main branch at Newton Food Centre and another at 新天地 at Pandan Malim (Jln Makanan). Beware cause they have some branches trying to duplicate. The wings are crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside which I learn from the boss Jimmy that it's a trade secret in their marinating process coupled with the use of charcoal for BBQ! Their Chilli is a mix of garlic and some secret ingredient that makes it mild spicy and appetising. I give this stall in Melaka a 5 star and must try! Show less

Author: Kenji0710Singapore, Singapore
Title: BBQ wings
Review: Jonker food street needs to move aside for this amazing place with a wide variety of CHEAP & TASTY local delicacies! Prices are a fraction of what you paid in Jonker (4.50 per wing vs 2.50 per wing!) We tried Jonker the night before and most of the famous food stuff there have deteriorated in terms of taste. Found this amazing place on trip advisor and came to try it out. Oh boy.... we were glad that we came! The wings at this stall are freshly bbq upon order and it is crispy on the outside and juicy within. The chilli sauce helps to enhance the taste for those with a preference for spicy stuff. The owner has willingly acceded to my request for a pic to be taken. I have heard that this is the only stall in melaka and there is another one which is a copy. Am happy with what i have tried. There are other food that you may try - bbq sting ray (rm 20), Fried Oyster (rm 15 for large) and curry laksa. We followed the gps and it brought us here accurately. Alot of locals dine here and the washroom is also decently clean. Show less

Author: Irin C
Title: Yummy Chicken Wings
Review:
Came across this stall at newton food centre.
The chicken wings are perfectly roasted over charcoal!
Inexpensive and finger licking good!
Must try!

Author: Robert DHawthorne, California
Title: Best Wings in the World?!
Review: I have been eating these wings for at least 10 years with my wife's family as they are from Melaka, I am author of SE Asian food and have been cooking and eating Malaysian food for 28 years..I don't say this carelessly..."these are my favorite wings in the world". Their crackling crisp skin, garlic rich chili sauce and a smoky goodness that is unmatched. To set realistic expectations...the flavor is simple...that's the point...Jimmy is a craftsman of charcoal roasting as he cooked these wings over roaring hot Indonesian charcoal and he manually spins and basted them into perfection. Now....will they be your favorite wings, best is an opinion, but trust me, they are awesome. Usually my first meal in Melaka is at Newton Food Centre and these wings are always the first thing I eat. DON'T MISS THEM IF YOU COME TO MELAKA!!!Show less

Author: joochint
Title: Delicious food!
Review: You must order the chicken wings! We loved them so much that we ordered a second portion after our dinner! And also, their homemade chili is to die for! Have the chili with everything!! The staff is friendly, and the service is pleasant. We were late on a weekend night and it was really crowded!! Would suggest going earlier to beat the crowd!! Show less

Author: Tang L
Title: Surprise!
Review:
[Non Halal] 
Was surprise to see the crowd queuing and had lunch here. The trotter was sold out but we're okie with limited selection to go with the yam rice.

Author: RickyR1305Singapore
Title: Delicious meal for breakfast or lunch
Review: Typical Melaka style coffeeshop, but dun be fool by the setting, The Bak Kut Teh is absolute heavenly and goes perfectly well with yam rice. I order the biggest bowl with all the ingredient inside to try everything! Pop in some green chili if you love to spice up your appetite. The taste is still the same i last visited many years ago.Show less

Author: jeffchia88Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great Bak Kut teh with Yam rice
Review: Certainly delicious food for breakfast in Malacca. The stewed meat is tender and tasty.The menu had various combinations of sets comprising of Rice, Lean meat, Tofu, Liver and Intestines stewed in soya sauce to cater for different customers. (Photos of the menu are submitted to Trip adviser for publication with this review)The soup is flavoursome, dark but clear. The Yam rice at RM1.50 is yummy and a good filler for a full meal with the stewed pork dishes.The menu had various combinations of sets comprising of Rice with selection of stewed Lean meat, stewed Tofu, stewed Liver and stewed Intestines.Show less

Author: Jack F
Title: Soup at 7.5 RM
Review: One of the good food here is soup, you can buy it for RM 7.5 only. The price of food here is not too expensive and tasty.

Author: ailee98
Title: Similiar to Bah Kut Teh..
Review: We been eat here many time and the taste still the best.  Do order their specialty 'yam rice' and eat together with the 'medicinal pork soup'.

Author: kAkaLow
Title: not a preferred choice
Review:
walked quite a distance to locate this shop, was recommended by a friend that we must try.

this is something special which i've never tried before, but due to it's location and the queue, I guess visiting once would be enough..

Author: MandyC86
Title: Home taste
Review: May have a try on this chinese spice soup in Malacca. If want to compare with penang one, Of cause i would said penang yam rice more tasty and more ingredients. But this yam rice and it soup like my home taste. Recommended to try.

Author: Choo NIpoh, Malaysia
Title: herbs meal
Review: First try for breakfast , the owner ask us to order at stall before we go for seat , the woman who bring us meal was bad attitude . They only sell pork meat soup and yam rice , something like bak kut teh we often take , herbs soup taste not bad , we get free refill for soup .Show less

Author: HappyCowBelleMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Coolies cuisine
Review: If you want to know the ancestors south after eating something to add strength and hard work to earn the ocean returned to the countryside, this is the best place. Simple ingredients, soy sauce, soup Angelica, lean pork, tofu, etc., is one of the world's most delicious meal. Although the place is small, but still can not stop the crowd rush to the shop. Not only tourists, but also locals like to come here to eat their food. Parking is hard to find, the owner will kindly help you look at the car. When the police come, and then call you to remove the car.What an interesting picture...Show less

Author: Maria Z
Title: Healthy soup
Review: My hubby brought me to this Kok Keong Restaurant, nearby from Jonker Walk area, special order is Yam Rice & Pork Meat Soup, for me is similar like Bak Kut Teh

Author: globalwanderer924
Title: Best veggie food in Asia
Review: I had the soy ribs in the yam ring and OMG it was delicious, the "ribs" had a meaty texture and the sauce was perfect, ho edtly best veggie food I've had in Asia, highly recommend.

Author: riccardoa745
Title: Nice little family business
Review:
Few choices on the menu. Polite and cute young waiter helping us taking the order.
Lovely dishes, fast service and good environment.
We recommend it. All free cruelty. 💚💚💚
Thanks!!!

Author: Rose H
Title: They use healthy salt; No MSG
Review: It’s a lovely restaurant. A lot of options; reasonable price; healthy salt; no MSG; local vegan food. They also sell some vegan snacks, like local cookies, chips, sauces...Really happy to have dinner there. Highly recommended!

Author: oliver-k6Canton of Zurich, Switzerland
Title: Good vegetarian restaurant in Melaka
Review: Restaurant is located a little bit outside of the city center but easy to find. Restaurant offers a great variety of fresh vegetarian dishes (also local dishes) for great prices. Staff is friendly and service is fast. We also enjoyed the atmosphere as there were no other tourists but only friendly local people. Restaurant offered free WiFi (password can be found on the wall where the WiFi sticker is).Show less

Author: Sander v
Title: No added MSG
Review: The food was delicious and served quickly. Friendly staff. Small shop included. All the food is prepared without added MSG.

Author: Maria_RapsoffAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: vegetarian gem in Melaka
Review: My partner and I were looking for a vegetarian restaurant and we found Vege Good. It is a little outside of the historic city centre (ca. 15-20 min walk) but it is worth it! We loved the dishes, so we went there for dinner two evenings in a row. Try the VegeGood Yam ring, the satay and the sweet and sour ribs- just delicious. Also the fried noodles were very flavorful.The owner and the waitress are very friendly, too. It seems to be a popular place for the locals, too.I can recommend going to VegeGood!Show less

Author: 127ramaa
Title: Vegetarian all round
Review:
We had a nice meal for 7 people. Needed to make a reservation. There are only 6 tables. It is a small restaurant. 

We had soup, mock meat curry and lots of vegetables.

Author: Emma B
Title: Great wholesome food
Review: Excellent mock fish, crunchy veg and lovely wheatgrass milk. Visited at lunch time and wasn't busy. Would like to eat here again

Author: jokl78
Title: Pork chop
Review: Came here for lunch. Only 1 table. Pork chop was flavourful and nice. Noodle was ok and small in portion.

Author: Mausmu
Title: Something I couldn't find in singapore
Review: I have to come here for a fix whenever I come to Malacca. The pork chops is well marinated. And fried to perfection. Noodles and chilli is average.

Author: ckthyapKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very tasty pork chop noodles
Review: Went to this 40 years shop for their pork chop noodles. This corner shop has a simple decor and is non air-conditioned. You will generally give it a miss unless recommended by friends. I try their signature pork chop noodles. The pork chop taste very excellent and you can order an extra pork chop without the noodles. Will come back again.Show less

Author: Nicholas_Seah
Title: Still taste delicious after all these years!
Review: This one of my favourite in Melaka. Definitely a must eat everytime I'm in town. The beef noodles with side dish of fried pork ribs are my favourite. Not to forget the sambal chilli to go with it. Must eat if you're in Melaka

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice noodles, but...
Review: First time trying out this place.The noodles is all the same type for every variety. Looks like fettuccine with gravy and the type of meat you want.Taste is good, however the portion is not big.The shop is nostalgic as it is a very small and old shop.Reasonably priced, but the portion may be shrinking.Show less

Author: Higuma2017Australia
Title: Absolutely gorgeous. Best in Melaka.
Review: I've eaten in a lot of places in Melaka. This is the one that stands out as providing the best food experience. The flvours are out of this world. They have simply the most gorgeous chilly sauces, in a broad variety of different styles and flavours, all incorporated into beef jus. I am not even into chilies, but these sauces were the best ones I have ever head. Nothing over the top in spicyness. Just .... dreamy!Show less

Author: bran3
Title: Still as good for the price
Review: Noodle and pork taste yummy, but as the last reviewer wrote the pork was in pathetic size.Price point at rm5 small rm5.50 big still acceptable.

Author: 225matthewn
Title: Shrinking portion of pork chop
Review:
The noodles were excellent - al dente and slippery. 
The pork was nice but pathetic in size. 
Beef broth was excellent especially during the wet weather. 
Pork trotter was nicely cooked and tender.

Author: aikichin
Title: Average tasting
Review: I felt the food to be lackluster and the amount of beef or pork per serving wasn't sufficient. I was disappointed but they must be doing something right. Clearly the food here is popular as the store was packed to the rafters with customers. It just wasn't for me.Show less

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Taiwan Pork Ribs Noodle which tasted better than the one in Taiwan
Review: If you are looking for a fine dining restaurant or one which is air conditioned with a wide range of selections made available in their menu then this is not an eatery joint that I would recommend you to visit. However, if you are the adventurous sort and don't mind sharing tables with others in a warm and sweaty environment, do check out this restaurant.There is just something about this pork ribs noodle that lures people to come back for more. Their ingredients are pretty much simple. Just deep friend pork ribs served along side their home made noodles and broth. At times simplicity in life is just what we need to enjoy a good road trip especially if your trip involves tasting the local delicacies.The pork ribs noodle here definitely tasted better than the one I have tasted in Taipei.Show less

Author: rachndale2000
Title: Not open at this address when we visited
Review: We went eagerly to this restaurant after reading reviews, however it wasn’t open every time we drove past. We ended up eating at the stall they have on the top floor of Mashona Parade shopping centre. Roti Pratt was delicious

Author: n_jaswantSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value for money
Review: A basic and pretty straightforward restaurant offering non-veg and veg thali.Spacious and clean restaurant, tasty food and the best part is the restaurant staff always have smile on their face.Do visit this Indian Restaurant when walking around Little India.We enquired and came to know this hotel doesn’t serve ala carte.Dosa was also not available (although few revies have mentioned).Pickle and papad were great add-onShow less

Author: Abhi_sgpSingapore, Singapore
Title: Saved our day
Review: Indian vegetarian options in Malacca are limited. Pak Putra has meat hanging at entrance and Tandoori also looked pretty much like roadside restaurant. Kiran's was the only restaurant which looked decent. Unfortunately when we went it was closed. Owner was very helpful and provided us roti and daal which we were happy to eat after a long day. Show less

Author: Tene17
Title: Awesome, cheap and tasty!
Review: It is just below Aurora Hotel which we were staying at. They would cater for the hotel if there is more than 15 guests for breakfast. If not, the guests could go and grab them self a decent breakfast or lunch. Moreover, it is cheap! I think it's cheaper than mamak because certain mamak is so overrated nowdays.Show less

Author: Srivalli
Title: Glad to get vegetarian meal
Review: When we were searching for Indian vegetarian meal options in Melaka,this restaurant was our best option.The ambience is nice and not very crowded and it is kid friendly.Very good taste of items as well

Author: nroomasHino, Japan
Title: Clean, Friendly, Inexpensive and Tasty
Review: My wife, daughter and I had lunch there after two o'clock. We selected a few items we wanted to have from what was displayed in a show case. They were served on a banana leaf with a choice of rice: white steamed rice or slightly seasoned rice mixed with green peas and a boiled egg.Yeogynth, the manager, is very friendly and ready to explain about what they offer to those who are not familiar with Indian cuisine. It is a clean, air-conditioned, and cozy place that serves delicious Indian food. For three of us, the lunch cost only about 30 RM. Highly recommended.Beware that the map shown in the Tripadvisor is not accurate. It is located on Jalan Munshi Abdullah, but coming from the south on Jalan Bunga Raya, you turn left instead of right. You find it on the ground level of Aurora Hotel.Show less

Author: rajamanusingapore
Title: good option for vegetarians
Review: This restaurant is located at the ground level of Aurora hotel.It looks very clean with a decent range of menu of north and south indian dishes.the manager is vry friendly helpful and can explain about any of the cuisine that may be alien to you. operates for breakfast, lunch and dinner/they also to groups.Show less

Author: Prakash VChennai (Madras), India
Title: Vegetarians have limited options, but visit never the less for clean place & value for money
Review: Restoran Kirans Delights in Melaka, Malaysia boasts of South & North Indian Cuisine. When we went inside, we were slightly disappointed to learn that only vegetarian food available was Dosa and Rice.This is a spacious restaurant and is clean. The service is good, and our food was served quite fast, given the crowd in the hotel.The dosas were good, so was the sambar. Biryani (indian flavored pullao variety of Hyderabad) was ok, but lacked the flavor and taste of its Indian namesake.If you are visiting Melaka and want to have Indian food, you can visit here. There is not much variety, but that's alright when you are in such kind of a town.Show less

Author: monica a
Title: Tasty food and wonderful service
Review: We just rolled into Melaka with 3 tired kids after a drive up from Singapore. We were just looking to get the kids fed before bed, but we found a great little restaurant. The staff was wonderful and they worked hard to meet our needs. The whole family left well fed and content. We will absolutely come back the next time we are in Melaka.Show less

Author: Bendelvey
Title: family outing
Review: The food is good,not too pricy.A very clean restaurant.Breakie,lunch and Dinner served.A la carte is also available.

Author: iamtjSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, excellent service
Review: We were looking for vegetarian food and accidentally came across this restaurant. They have a decent selection of veg dishes and the chef was happy to customise curry as per the requirements of fussy customer (we had one with us!). Special thanks to Mr Yeogynt (not sure of the exact name) for the great service. Show less

Author: redruby_2006
Title: Suprise.. Tasty seafood fried rice
Review: The lamb curry there was nice. But oddly, they do have the most tastiest seafood fried rice I've had so far. I'll come back again for the fried rice!

Author: BluDaisy7Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent food and atmosphere
Review: Whenever I'm in Melaka, I'll always visit Kiran's Delight. The food is good, and the menu is extensive, and the price is cheap! No GST charged. The staffs are helpful, honest and polite. Overall, a great experience. For an air conditioned restaurant, with clean amenities, this is truly a game changer. Their prices are cheaper than most similar restaurants, not to mention, the food taste way better too!Show less

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Yummy Noodles
Review: I like their Curry Chicken Noodles and Sarawak Dry Noodles. Overall it's a bit pricey. Environment is comfy and they serve Vegetarian meals as well!

Author: Randy EHonolulu, Hawaii
Title: Very affordable, and o.k.
Review: I didn't have noodles, but had the vegetarian rice dish they offered. It was pretty good, above average by a little, very affordable, and simple. I ordered a lemon and honey iced tea and it tasted, literally like it was 99% sugar. Didn't taste any ginger, and I imagine that there was some honey in it but it was mostly sugar. Don't recommend that drink.Show less

Author: CarolMelakaMelaka
Title: Sarawak noodles
Review: For those who loves to eat kolok mee and sarawak laksa, this is the place for you. Even though its not as authentic as the ones we eat in Kucing Sarawak but its worth trying as it is reasonable in price and the portion is big. The ambience is cosy and a nice place for families, couples and office staffs.Show less

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Nice noodles
Review:
We love their spicy pan mee!
Good environment and affordable price!
Service was good and fast! 
We will be back again!

Author: Elyn L
Title: Average noodles
Review: I had tried the recommended Pan Mee here. It tasted good but I think most of the housewives could cook better. It's quite pricey, you could absolutely get a cheaper and tastier Pan Mee in KL. However, their sambal was nice.

Author: blessedwoman08Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy 'Ban Mian' & reasonable prices
Review: Passed by this place when going Nancy's Kitchen and decided to give it a try. I ordered the signature 'Ban Mian' soup and my hubby ordered the Sarawak kolo mee. The soup is very tasty, however, the kolo mee tasted so-so. Will visit again to try other noodle dishes.Show less

Author: Jedai79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Food!
Review: We think we walked past this restaurant in Dec 2015 but we patronised its neighbour, Casa De Cafe instead. Finally, we lunched at Face to Face on 23 Dec 2017. For sure, we wouldn’t have lunched at Nancy’s Kitchen (Nyonya Food) because of poor before-patronage service, the waiting time and the nonchalant attitude of its staff. In Dec 2015, we had our meal at Casa De Cafe, thus, we wanted to try the food at Face to Face.When we went in at about 11.45am, there was only one other table occupied by one male customer. We were doubtful initially, thought food must be not-very-nice and that was why so quiet. Who knows, after we placed our order, more and more customers came and most importantly, they were mostly LOCALS!!!!! Our strategy for restaurants is easy, eat where the locals eat and usually that choice won’t go wrong. (Later we found out why at 11.45am, only one table with one customer because the restaurant only opened at 11.30am) My shredded chicken hor-fun was good! My green tea latte was FANTASTIC!!!! Our dessert of Barley ginkgo nuts (白果腐竹薏米糖水）was good too as this was the first time chef put peanuts in the soup and that was a surprise for our taste buds. However, partner did not find pork or pork rib noodle dry nice. Partner ordered another drink too. All in, about 30 plus Ringgit. Air-conditioned environment and free wifi! Thumbs up!!!! Opening Hours 11.30am till dinner time. Forgot the exact closing time, think 8pm or 9pm. Will we come again? Sure! We will eat at Face to Face and then go to Yeast Bakery to buy their cakes, bread, buns & biscuits/cookies. Show less

Author: Michelle LJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: I went this place twice. Both have been good. The noodles taste are consistent. Everything we ordered was delicious. Though I do not think the Sarawak Laksa is authentic enough as compared to those in Sarawak. The price is reasonable. Drinks are tasty too. I do miss the food there.Show less

Author: VisitJohoreSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food & reasonable price
Review: The interior design is rather inferior. But that is mend by their delicious food. We tried curry chicken rice (4.5/5), bread with peanut butter (3/5) and barley with gingko nut (3/5). Yet to try their sarawak noodle but I heard is very good. Worth a visit to try if its within your taste choice.Show less

Author: JoCeLynMika
Title: Lunch
Review: Price range for drinks around RM3.50 and above. Foods around RM 7.50 and above. Portion medium, usually I will take lo Mee.

Author: Maria Z
Title: Great place for family
Review: They served Sarawakian Noddle nice and delicious, so surprised now they already have vegetarian menu, so I can ask my relatives who vegatarian to try here

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Best sarawak mee
Review: Love to come here for sarawak mee. food here very nice and environment also not bad. suitable for family dine in.

Author: Audrey A
Title: Great 1st time.
Review: Had the sarawakian noodle with soy and chili (cili kolo mee) ...the taste is like homemade cook by mama.. good job.

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: Good Food and Fast Service
Review: This shop is known for its noodles. I especially like the dark sauce and chilli sauce sarawak noodle. The noodle is very tasty and gives me the nostalgic feeling when I was a young child eating "koh lok mee". The helping is big and makes you want more. They also placed a variety of condiments such as dried shrimp sambal, chilli on the table. The drinks in this cafe is also reasonably priced. I like the black ginger tea. Hot, sweet and with a little heat.Show less

Author: EveJYinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Loyal customer for 9 years
Review: A very underrated satay hut and not enough people rave about it. The pork satay here is the only reason i will visit Melaka every year. Very well marinated pork satay and perfectly sticked together with balance of pork meat & pork lard. We enjoyed having it just the satay without satay sauce - love it so so so much!Show less

Author: Harrison-F-Carter
Title: Enjoyed our visit...
Review: Came recommended as a good satay option and it lived up to our hopes for our visit. Lovely sauce and nice meats. Good.

Author: Thomas606Singapore, Singapore
Title: Refreshing Satay Hut - Die Die Must Try
Review: We really wanted to try satays after visiting Melaka so many times. We chanced upon this place after googling it. Based on the reviews, we decided to give it a try. The location of this nondescript cafe is a few shops away the original shop of Nadaje Millie Crepe, not the one located at Mahkota Shopping Mall. The satays were very tasty and refreshing. The peanut sauce was light and refreshing, and it did not overpower the meats and innards.Being new to the place, we kept our innard satay order small at 45 sticks. Surprisingly, the children ‘fought’ with us for the well-marinated satays, and we gulped up the bulk of the innard satays. The children had never tasted innard satays, even for some ‘younger’ adults.The satays were well cooked and not burnt. I was very surprised by the aroma and taste. They took effort and time to cook the satays. We ended up ordering 90 sticks of satays, with subsequent orders for more innard satays. Many locals would call in to order their satays for evening gathering. The shop would be closed by 5 pm. They are open at about 12 pm. If you are early, you can try the Nadaje Millie crepes first. Please try your crepe small so that you have enough space for the satays.Show less

Author: CrescentiaL1
Title: Nice Satay and special sauce (non halal)
Review: The satay is marinated really nicely and taste is good. Not overly burned when served. They have few varieties.But my usual favourite is the pork satay and my partner would go for the spare parts (pig internal organs). The sauce that they serve with the satay is different because it is made out of pineapple (shop owner shared this with me) and not the usual peanut sauce. I personally love the sauce. It goes well with the satay. They are generous in giving you extra sauce on the side if you need more for the satay.I could easily eat 20 sticks of the satay here myself. LOL... yumz.The place is just few steps away from the famous Nedeja crepe cake place.No aircond in the shop but there are fans.Show less

Author: beeb9
Title: Yummy Pork Sate
Review:
Delicious. Have some spare parts too. Should try if you are around Mahkota Parade area.

Just a little too humid at 3pm.

Author: SayYesToFood
Title: Not a satay lover
Review: I am not a satay lover so I can't judge it.the sauce is good and it's like a normal satay shop.Overall good.

Author: Terrencechen
Title: Pork satay is available here
Review:
Nice place to try! Pork satay is available and the price is reasonable.

The only issue is no air con available and it will be a bit hot in afternoon.

Author: John-C_EWSingapore
Title: Delicious savoury Hainanese pork satay
Review: Just few shops away from a famous Mille crepe shop... so far this is my go to place for delicious savoury Hainanese style Melaka satayReally Wish KWONG satay has this version so that I can have it anytime!!The pork meat could be a little bit bigger. What I like is the peanut sauce is not too over powering with pineapple .. I can still taste the well marinated charred pork and balances well between salty & sweetSomebody in Spore or JB pls make Melaka Hainanese pork satay!Show less

Author: TJLim
Title: Good Satay
Review: Satay grilled on the spot for you. So it is really fresh and succulent. The gravy is great with a tinge of grated pineapple. Price is very reasonable. Service is also good and friendly.

Author: 919DISAPPOINTEDGUESTSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good innards satay
Review: Situated at Jln Plaza Makhota a brightly yellow ambience of modern coffee shop offering its delicious charcoal satay as quickly as they can as orders stream in nonstop.Its special gravy is pineappled curry base little spicy and acidy sweet a good mix of taste and complement it very well when you dip your succulent well bbq skewers of satay ..... you are in satay heaven.To enjoy the highlight is to forget your cholesterol as you gobble and savour the various innards that are mixed in a skewer.The counter is busy with freshly squeezed fruit juices and ready packed drinks of water chestnut, lime and many others to quench your thirst.As you wait patiently the kitchen is 'firing' your satay and innards and you cant wait to savour them as the wonderful aroma permeates the shop .... dont miss when you are in Melaka ..... yum Show less

Author: ccjy2001
Title: Did not meet expectations
Review: Went for dinner and the food served was very salty especially the soup noodle dishes. Was a great disappointment as we went there before years ago when better quality food were served.

Author: andrewssmalacca
Title: Breakfast here the best
Review: A nice collection of addons to the mee and the minced meat along with the spicy sambal, a delicacy to relish.

Author: AlvinFYK
Title: Good decent breakfast
Review: Was walking around looking for Unicorn cafe for breakfast but it was either closed at 9.30am or moved to another location. This place serves fish ball noodles and duck noodles. Great value for money at a simple coffeeshop

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Fishy
Review: Drop by for lunch for some simple meal today. Tried their fishballs which supposedly came from wolf herring. Fishballs tasted light with no fishy taste. Bouncy to the bite. Not highly recommended but still ok for a light meal

Author: Hui Jun LAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Recommended.. Tasty
Review: With only soy sauce and a little bit of pork mince (I guess is pork) for this dry noodles with fishballs, it's already tasty! I didn't eat curry, but my husband told me, this curry mee also delicious. Each bowl cost RM6. For me, this price still acceptable if compare with KL. I ate this as breakfast. Easy to find parking. Show less

Author: Jedai79Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very Nice West Saury Fish Balls 西刀鱼鱼丸超好吃！
Review: We have been sick throughout our 11-day West Malaysia trip so much so that we ran out of ideas of what to eat “next”. On 23 Dec 2017, we were along the main road where we could find Yong Peng Fishballs and had initially enquired at a Korean steamboat buffet restaurant, RM33 (plus another 6% GST) per pax, must finish eating within 2 hours. Soup base was kimchi and another non-spicy one. Well, it’s soup-base buffet and not Korean BBQ, thus should be ok for our sore throats but partner did not want, thus we just cruised down the road in search of other FOOD outlets. There were a few newly-opened, black framed glass buildings, very modern on our left and they either served western food or bar/pub like, “The One Cafe”, “Cibo”, “Go Lounge & bistro” etc. Then, we chanced upon this huge sign that read, “Yongpeng fishball” on our right. At Taman Sentosa, JB , we saw West Saury Fishballs (西刀鱼丸）too but haven’t tried them before. We used to have such fish in Singapore and we had home-made fishcakes using West Saury. However, we hardly find such fish in Singapore anymore.Parked our car and headed towards coffee shop. We had brunch at Face to Face Noodle House (we’ve just reviewed it) at elevenish, hence I was hungry and needed to have meat dish. I ordered braised duck rice. Well, the braised duck was ok (nothing fantastic) but the rice was (ahem!) lumpy and cold, probably dished out from a rice cooker without a “keep warm” mode. Even the 卖相 (food presentation) of the braised duck rice was not good, the slices of duck were seemingly thrown onto the heap of lumpy rice. Super CMI. Partner ordered noodles from the West Saury Fishball stall. It looked more delicious than my braised duck rice. Dinner round 2, I ordered a bowl of West Saury fishball soup, RM1 for each fishball, and the size of fishball was small. But fishballs were spongy and tasty. The fishballs were definitely more yummy than my braised duck rice. Partner also had round 2 : yong tau foo which consisted of yangzhou fishball (扬州鱼丸）- fishball with meat fillings. Compliments to the two dark complexion staff at the fishball stall. They are from Myanmar and they spoke perfect mandarin. They probably could speak simple English too.Show less

Author: DelsonMoo
Title: Good food, reasonably priced
Review: The fish balls are nice and tasty, and if you try the duck noodles, you'll love it. The soup taste just great, and the chili will definitely urge you to come back for more.

Author: kAkaLow
Title: just another fish ball noodle
Review: nothing very special in particular, and quite a distance away from the malls. attitude and taste was totally different from my first visit 2 years ago..

Author: CHRISLL8
Title: Forgettable and Skip It
Review: Owner is grouchy and only reason we stopped here is for the carpark and a quick fix. Better places elsewhere

Author: Hew H
Title: Pricey Fish Ball Noodle
Review:
Our lunch bill came up RM26.50 for 02 bowls fish ball noodle soup, 01 fish- cake and a coffee.  We have tasted better quality fish balls/ cakes & noodle soup elsewhere at a much cheaper price.
Will unlikely not visit this place again.

Author: poopshooterPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: decent noodles & yong tau foo...
Review: This is our go to place for supper. They actually open all day so its very convenient & as a bonus its located on the main Melaka Raya road so you can't miss it. Do note it is a simple restaurant & cleanliness is questionable. Service is a hit & miss. Price wise on the high side.They serve 5 types of noodles (kon lou (dry), curry, lum mee, etc) as well as fresh yong tau foo. I think in the day they also have chicken rice with roasted meats. Our favorite would have to be the yong tau foo. Decent variety, fresh & tasty. Eat it with the belacan cili sambal. Addictive stuff. The soup itself is quite flavorful & isn't full of msg.Worth a stop if you are looking for something odd hours of the night.Show less

Author: carimakanmanmalacca city
Title: Yong Peng Fish Ball
Review: The name does not suggest that it is in Yong Peng but situated in the commercial hub of Malacca , Taman Melaka Raya. Food is delicious. You can get noodles ( curry and yong taufu and rice such as roasted pork and stewed pork ) ............all deliciously prepared. Price is reasonable. The nice thing is it opens 24 hours a day.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: Yong Peng Fish balls was recommended by my friend in Melaka .However, according to them, their standards has fallen.As I was not very convinced,i went over to have their ikan parang (wolf herring) fish balls. It basically tasted average as in not so fishy but not "bouncy" to the bite. Not really worth the effort to eat there but if you are not too fussy,i guess it's okShow less

Author: Asia-aficionado
Title: Tasty fare, fresh. Pricey.
Review: Filling, fresh and served piping hot. The fish balls here are nice - that's what they're famous for - however, the price is a bit on the high side. But a great place to go for a simple, fast and filling lunch.

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Best Supper in Town
Review: After arriving late morning in Melaka, we were craving for food to eat and finally we noticed Yong Peng Fish Ball outlet serving an array of fishballs stuffs. Ordered plain Yong Fau Foo with black sauce and it well accompanied with home made Sambal Belacan. Must try the sambal and definitely you will ask for second round. Keep it Up YPFBShow less

Author: ZhongguoKMKunming, China
Title: Lots of flavor
Review: Simple food with lots of flavor. I had the fish balls with addition of crab meat. The broth was delicious and the thin rice noodles were tender. The fish balls themselves were as expected. Soul food for people who want a fast, light meal or big snack. Inexpensive.Show less

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Had a wonderful dinner with
Review: Had a wonderful dinner with my family. It did live to its reputation as one of the better pork satay outlet in Melaka. We ordered 20 sticks each of pork & chicken satay & another 10 sticks of pig intestine satay. This was accompanied with ‘kutupats’ (rice cakes) and a wonderful sweet-sour spicy gravy. The pork & chicken satey was crips and juicy as well - well marinated and barbecued. The intestines is one of the best I have tasted. Would highly recommend this satay outlet - a must eat when in Melaka Show less

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: It is shrinking....
Review: After having dinner, friends wanted to try out this place. Came here right after dinner.Ordered pork satay and pork intestine satay to try. Not really wanting to eat as already had dinner.The place was crowded, and had to wait for about 30 minutes after placing an order.The satay is shrinking in size. Taste is about average. However, the consolation is they still provided proper ketupat (rice cooked in weaved leave), a very traditional form, rather than the rice cooked in packed plastic bags.Show less

Author: MichaelinaChuaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Pork satay finest moment
Review: A favourite pork satay restaurant. Has the right amount of lean and fat meat to keep it a juicy bite. The specialty is it’s pineapple inspired satay sauce which is one of Malacca’s old charm. An family recipe handed down among family, it is aromatic and the optional dash of chilli oil makes for a sweet and hot delight. I remember my first taste of this sauce - my tastebuds popped in applause. The ketupat is still wrapped in palm leaves, a nostalgic rarity. Show less

Author: Pang O
Title: Very nice satays
Review: One of the best satays you can get in Malacca.  It can get really busy but it is worth the wait though.

Author: feleonchocoKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pork Satay - Non-halal - Be Early & Enjoy!
Review: PLEASE TAKE NOTE THAT THIS EATERY IS NON-HALAL:Let me just bring you through the place rather quickly and in a meaningful manner. Give it a thumbs up if you like this format or find it useful.Before the Food:Parking - If approaching from the city, its located on the left, try to find parking on the right side of the restaurant (LANDMARK: Restoran Zu Chuan), you should be able to find some parking spots there or you may try your luck betting on those that are located in front of the restaurant.Waiting: Be there early, the restaurant opens at 6.30p.m., but you should be there early to get your spot. Do take note that they do take bookings, you may call them up to reserve. Otherwise, on festive seasons, you'll most likely find that the satay has been sold/booked out. WAITING TIME: Roughly 30-45 minutes on full capacity, depending on circumstances of the owner /worker.During The Food: If you prefer to have your sauce / kuah / whatever you call it not spicy, have them not to put in the sambal when you order.Satay: Awesome mixture of pork meat and intestines. A little bit to the salty side but manageable.Sauce: A good note of pineapple separates it from the rest as its a little more watery but more flavor content.Ketupat: Not bad, what you would expect but can be better to according to some.Drinks: Homemade / Tin available.Price: $ (Affordable)OVERALL: 7/10 in my personal scale.Note: Please do go with minimal expectation especially if you know you're late or you're about to bump into peak hour. Should you choose to wait, there's noodles that you can order from the next door.Seafood meehoon:GREAT. 7/10 as well. A good mixture of seafood (no fish meat) in meehoon with light soup. Tad tad bit spicy. Roughly RM15-20 per pax. ORDER IF YOU ARE WAITING / GOING TO WAIT.OTHERS: Will review next time.Show less

Author: jsipalay
Title: flavorful Hee Kiaw Mee
Review: They were out of laksa when we came to dine so we had the satay which was so so and the hee kiaw mee which was very good with a generous amount of delicious fishballs hope to come back someday and try their laksa.

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Good laksa
Review: Serves very delicious laksa in the morning. Besides laksa they used to sell mee Siam. Nowadays the mother and son only sell laksa and fish ball noodles. By evening, the satay stall will set up outside this coffee shop. I have tried the pork satay but found it not too appealing. The pork is so measly and the layer of fats between so huge!! The sauce is good though. Show less

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: New stall ...
Review: For pork satay in Malacca? Where do you go? There are a few shops to choose during day time. But when the craving is in the evening, this is the place to go.They start business at around 6pm. Even when the shop has just open for business, the place is already quite full. Almost all tables has been occupied. Not easy to find an available table.Now, there is a noodles stall in the shop. Give it a try, and it is quite good. You can have a choice of dry or soup base. Tried the dry noodles, and the stall will give you a bottle of chilli sauce for it. Seems like this is the Southern style of eating dry noodles. Anyway, adding in the chilli sauce, it is quite tasty though.When the food is served, you have to pay. Same goes for the drinks.Only the satay runs on the concept of eat first, pay when you leave. From the way it goes, it is because many people will add more sticks to their original order.Show less

Author: khguan
Title: Pork satay!
Review: Chinese style pork satay with a special dipping sauce. Also have fishball noodles which is pretty good taste. One thing though the satay is very small portion... one bite per skewer. It would be perfect if they make it bigger portion per skewer.

Author: otyew
Title: Pork satay at night
Review: If crave for a good pork satay at night, this is the place. Pork and intestine is good. RM0.70/piece

Author: nadhizzati
Title: Affordable price, Nice Food & Awesome Experience
Review: Affordable price with a great family friendly environment. If you are looking for an asian cuisine dish as a part of your experience in Melaka, this place is a great place to start!

Author: JaydenWong_31
Title: Reasonable price
Review: Harga okay. Boleh masak based on our demand. Since last visit dengan family, ada yang tanak pedas, kurang pedas dan pedas. Well done. Recommended to try chicken or beef briyani

Author: nathasyaaa
Title: Recommended
Review: variety of food (local food), cozy place and suitable for big family to dine in here. near to tourist place.

Author: OsmanYatim26
Title: Halal food
Review: Still have a room for improvement. Nice concept and great food especially air bunga telang with a slice of lemon ( highly recommended).

Author: goodmoodfamilyDa Nang, Vietnam
Title: Vegans and vegetarian friendly!
Review: We did our laundry near to the restoran and meanwhile we where waiting our clothes we jumped in to eat the lunch and that was a great discovery! There is so many choises for vegans and vegetarians. Lots of variations of rice, noodles, soya, tofu and of course other options - meat and seafood. Staff are very polite and friendly. We loved that place! Show less

Author: Hafizah N
Title: Worth it
Review: Im looking for siput sedut and yeah Restoran Ole Rasa serve you the best! Not too spicy which good for me.

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Yummy and Scrumptious
Review: I've always preferred to have typical Malay food whenever stop by at Melaka Raya and this is one of the place runs by duo brothers. price are ressonable and you may find ample of dishes bth left and right side. My usual dish are Ikan Keli Lemak, Ikan Bakar Cencaru or Kembong, Ikan Masin Goreng, tempeh Goreng, Nangka Muda Berlemak, Teur Dadar Kicap and Siput Sedut. You must try this eatery once in a lifetime.Show less

Author: hawkuan
Title: Busy place
Review: Food was good and hot. Place was busy throughout the night were were there. The restoran was quite central and easily accessible

Author: MightyRedsFikSingapore, Singapore
Title: Scrumptious
Review: I was looking for an Indonesian/Malay food that is clean ( no cats ) and have lots of variety of dishes and I found one. If you can't locate it .. just look for Novotel hotel which is a stone throw away. The ikan bakar ( grilled fish ) is yummy and so are the other dishes like sambal squids, asam pedas, lemak and so on. Staffs are ok . Luckily for me I came during off lunch hours which is almost 2pm and the crowd wasnt as much as it's during lunch time. Show less

Author: AIK71Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent curry chicken and sambal sotong
Review: Was there about 11:30 and manage to call the last roti. We could not decide what to eat on the shelf as there are so many variety and the kitchen kept coming out with more. Crowd begins to form so we knew we are in the right place. Food did not disappoint us as the curry chicken is so tender and sotong is yummy. We eventually paid RM$30 for 4 roti, 2 full plate of rice and food， 4 drinks. Great! The young manager needs to be commented as he told me frankly that the lontong is not hot when I wanted to order. For honesty and integrity, I will come back again. ! Show less

Author: sandranatalia33
Title: Yummy
Review: This is indonesian restaurant in melacca. Staff mostly indonesian. They have alot of ready cook foods on table. Freshly cooked every morning and run out fast. The food is cheap and yummy. Will definetely come back again.

Author: Ayimbun
Title: Good Choices of Kampung Food !
Review:
Excellent variety of choices for Kampung food. Tasty & fast service.
Will definately go there again..

Author: g_maze86Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Typical Malay Food
Review: This restaurant is situated just behind my office and it is really convenient. The food served there is just typical malay food, I think the price has gone up this year but it is worth a try, They have nasi briyani every Thursday and free fruit on Friday.Show less

Author: MYMaziah
Title: plain rice with wide varieties of malay food
Review: the restaurant is very clean and hygeinic. The workers are friendly. The food are delicious too.Plain rice is served with varieties of malay food like the famous ikan bakar with sweet & sour sauce. A must try!

Author: Aley S
Title: Limited choices of breakfast
Review: My 3rd visit, they only offered set of breakfast and the choices are limited only 2 menus. Cafe was clean and body temperature was check regularly on the guests.  Could be more variety for breakfast, to be on par with your hotel services.

Author: Lugosi915Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Seafood Laksa
Review: Came here for their signature Nyonya Seafood Laksa on a Friday Night, after watching the Encore Melaka. The Laksa taste nice but some of the seafood served wasn't really fresh, the hard boiled egg taste a bit weird but if you aren't that picky/particular on freshness then it's fine. Loved the Classic Mojito though. There's a live band too.Show less

Author: KongYLanMalaysia
Title: Amazing Choices for Breakfast
Review: We had breakfast at the River Cafe and was very impressed by the selection of food provided. The breakfast we had was a combination of a la carte and buffet. At the buffet table, there was a porridge section, a noodle section on top of the usual hot/cold food, salad and fruit, bread and cereal. The staff was attentive and cleared our dishes when we finished. The cafe was semi open air, it was nice to enjoy our breakfast with the river breeze.Show less

Author: exquisitektc
Title: Could Be Way Better
Review: In line with the hotel, the service here is simply decent or passable by minimal standards. Selection is average. Price is high.

Author: Low2002
Title: Average food
Review:
Lunch buffet - acceptable choices available, not much variety, quality average
Breakfast - average, egg menu good but quality of preparation not consistent - Portuguese egg  was over baked

Author: johnill1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Saturday night buffet
Review: We invited two friends to join us and the buffet was not for anyone on a diet. There was so much food , so much choice and all delicious.The only sad thing was they did not have the wine I wanted but their house wine was quite acceptableShow less

Author: Debaprasad BHyderabad, India
Title: A comfortable place to seat and dine!!!
Review: As like all the eateries along the river the big catch is riverfront . This was one of the place I tried during my stay at Melaka. A nice cool place to enjoy your dinner choice is yours if you prefer outdoor or indoor. Both the way it was nice. Not to crowded and good food affordable.Had a nice time.Show less

Author: Janny1974traveller
Title: Good food and drink
Review: A lovely setting with friendly staff. The food is good and there is a good drink selection. Pizzas and salads are great.

Author: Ivan C
Title: Great Location
Review: Great location next to the Malacca river, staff service great but lack understanding of English, the meals good quality but same menu as the cafe's next door. Good atmosphere and nice and clean

Author: summerdays83
Title: Lovely food
Review: Breakfast here was a delight, and would highly recommend their Thai Nyonya buffet available on Friday nights. Not crowded even on weekends, and a nice view of the river if you sit outside. Inside, you get the benefit of live music after 8pm

Author: MsiaRunner
Title: High quality food and constantly full house!
Review: One of the best quality and authentic Japanese food in Melaka. Atmosphere is good and clean. Prices are mid to high range. And this place is always full especially towards the weekends. Make sure you call first and reserve.

Author: sze2276
Title: Busy Restaurant
Review:
Better call to reserve a table first before going. Reached there before 6pm hence still managed to get a table.
Authentic Japanese food. Tasted awesome.

Author: Tania D
Title: Worth a visit
Review: Absolutely delicious food, amazing service, good selection of wines and designed with a traditional Japanese theme. I highly recommend 😊😋

Author: 3mike3cMalaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Had to wait for sometime for a table and was given a miserable table at a corner with a table space to fit 2 dishes. It was an uncomfortable experience for dinner. Waiter refused to provide another table.Food was only so so and price on the high side for a small town like Melaka,Not recommended. There are better and cheaper options elsewhere.Show less

Author: ccjy2001
Title: Great and a quite reasonable dinner
Review: The atmosphere of the restaurant was great. Went twice and had to make reservation even on weekdays as business is really good. Food was pleasant. Price was slightly above average.

Author: Winnie800
Title: First visit
Review: Is my anniversary and choose to have the dinner. Better make reservations before go to avoid waiting time. Fresh sashimi and reasonable price. Will revisit again.

Author: JooannxxSingapore
Title: Enjoyable and good quality
Review: My family had lunch at Wa Zen. We found this place by accident and was pleasantly surprised. The quality of the sashimi was superb and the pricing is reasonable. The grilled hamachi and squid were beyond amazing! Almost every dish we ordered was a hit! Would definitely return.Show less

Author: Cynthiakee
Title: Not
Review: Portion of sashimi is still quite generous as before, but the dressing is way too much. Garlic fried rice is not nice at all compare to last time. I think Melaka needs a better Japanese restaurant. Ambient is still very good overall.

Author: Pknowlesi
Title: Good Food At Reasonable Prices
Review: The layout of the restaurant ensures that diners will have privacy, the layout makes this restaurant very interesting. The prices are reasonable and they are of good quality. Good and prompt table service was provided. Will definitely come back again!

Author: SerhatSozen92
Title: Must try for sushilovers!
Review: During our visit we tried this sushi restsurant! It was definitely the best choice we made. The sushis were extremly fresh, good divided (rice/fish) and sitting are was like traditional Japanese. And above all the personal were very friendly!

Author: bunnyespressoCentral Melaka District, Malaysia
Title: Service sucks to the max
Review: I decided to try Wa Zen as my friend recommended it to me. A waitress was asking me whether I wanted hot or cold tea in Mandarin. I couldn't understand her. So I asked if she could repeat that in English, but she replied me rather rudely. She spoke as though she was pissed. It dampened my mood and ruined my appetite. The food's reasonable but I did not enjoy my dinner that visit. Show less

Author: ShirleyLXY
Title: A need to try japanese restaurant!!!
Review: We came back forth from KL just to eat this. Need parking coupon for the car park but we don't have Malacca's and guess what? This restaurant provide us an 1 hour coupon for free. This is so nice!!!! Then the food, environment, service from staffs are excellent!!! It is a worth experience and place to eat!!! Show less

Author: YummyfatmanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place
Review: Went to this restaurant felt very comfy... got seated and was told by my friends that this restaurant needs booking and we were lucky to have a table... food served and knew the reason why it was so successful... service was quite ok and food was great... later was introduced to the lady boss and then I confirmed why this place needs queuing up... great for all .. another must try place!Show less

Author: I_S_B_L_oSingapore, Singapore
Title: Inexpensive and good sashimis
Review: The sashimis are quite fresh! The mochi and natto are good too. I didn’t go to have dinner because it was fully booked! My friends and I went dinner else where then returned at 9pm to have dessert and try their sashimis. Many people raved about how good the food is and it is true! Do remember to call and make booking at least a few days ahead.Show less

Author: chuahonlyAuckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Best In Melaka
Review: The best Japanese food by a mile as I was having a craving for Japanes one week. The service was great although do remember to make a reservation as it is fully packed any day of the week. Amazing salad and the sushi was one to die for. However, the ambience was quite poor but the food definitely compensated that tiny flaw. A must go to Japanese place when visiting MelakaShow less

Author: KevinL7278
Title: Full and Satisfied
Review: Large portion and reasonable price. If you’re craving for Japanese food in Melaka, this is your perfect choice.

Author: VinaTraveler
Title: Not good as you thought!
Review: Came here with a friend and ordered Tempura and some sashimi! Not the taste I was expecting and it is quite pricey compared to some Japanese restaurants in town. Though the ambiance is good - To come back? Perhaps considerable.

Author: Lucien_LEBry-sur-Marne, France
Title: Good restaurant
Review: Had dinner at this japanese restaurant with my family.This is a really nice place, really cosy and the food is really good.It is advised to book to a table in advance as it is really crowded.We will be back for sure for our next trip in Malaysia.Show less

Author: R HMunich, Germany
Title: Fantastic experience
Review: We came to the restaurant without a reservation but the staff were very helpful and managed to get us a table at the sushi bar - which in itself was a highlight, allowing us to watch the chefs.The menu is overwhelming (in a positive sense) and we ordered a variety of sushi dishes and were blown away by the generosity of the portion size and the quality of the food. I wish we could have tried more!We had a great experience and went away very satisfied and would love to return if we are ever in Melaka again.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Oishi
Review: Wa Zen Japanese food is fresh and tasty. We ordered unagi and shishamo and other variety of dishes and all tasted good. One of the best Japanese restaurant as recommended by Tripadvisor. Overall two thumbs up

Author: FLBBPCMM
Title: Good n delicious
Review: Sashimi is very fresh and nice presentation. They have wide selections of food that will spoil ur choice. Tried the mochi is a waste of money as their mochi is very plain flour there is no filing just top with peanut not nice at all. Ambience is good if u have large group better make reservations so can get private room. Price wise a bit expensive but overall good to tryShow less

Author: howf2017
Title: Family Dinner
Review: Overall good experienced and decent pricing. Salmon belly didn't much impresses me, grilled Saba, SHASHIMI platter and Softshell was good (my opinion). Service was good and staff are friendly too.

Author: Lini E
Title: Worthwhile Japanese meal
Review: For the food quality, the price is very reasonable. Need to book for dinner time. Always full. Because it's a bang for buck, great service too.

Author: IvanT2882
Title: Best Japanese cuisine
Review: Very impressed with the swift service and quality of the Japanese dishes! I enjoyed the dining experience!! Love the dishes there like the tempura!! It's lip smacking.

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Yummy Sushi & Side Dish & Set Meal
Review: Although it's a bit pricy but definitely worth the price! Environment is comfortable especially the toilet which have TV inside lol. Service is efficient too. Always order the Salmon Set because the salmon are so fresh and juicy!

Author: Clara M
Title: Superlicious Sushi
Review: Highly recommended by a close friend and their food exceeded expectations. Didn't book in advance so have to sit at the sushi counter. The sashimi is fresh and the sushi is yummy. Also tried the grilled squid and eel sushi. I must say that ithe food there is more than worth the grab ride there and back.Show less

Author: owenw983
Title: Lovely Dinner
Review: Sumptuous meal with decent serving and great service!  We reached there and the place fully booked but when I told them we would be fast, they accommodated.  Wonderful!

Author: PKYeoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: BEST Japanese restaurant in town! MUST TRY!
Review: Fresh seafood, great service, very clean typical but modernly designed Japanese restaurant. Often patronized by ex-pats Japanese. You need to call at least 2 days in advance to book a table especially during weekends. Try to order some of the dishes which are not in the menu. Simply the best!Show less

Author: carol_lslin
Title: Best japanese restaurant in melaka
Review: Visited this restaurant several times for the past 3 years - food standard is well maintained. Soft shell crab and unagi dragon maki are my all time favourites. Sashimi is fresh - must try!!

Author: 857bettyl
Title: Dinner on 15/4
Review:
Great food and service, clean restaurant, friendly staff, quick turnaround for food serving.

Will definitely visit WaZen again in my next trip with family.

Author: lancelotcymHong Kong, China
Title: Nice Japanese Food with Expensive Price
Review: GOOD- I ordered sashima which is fresh and thick, bbq chicken which is soso and fried pork with pepper which is nice for wine- A comfortable and clean restaurant with welcoming serviceBAD- Very expensive compared to other restaurants in Malacca- Pretty far away from Malacca City and Jonker Street- I ordered a serving size of plum wine and they gave me a small bottle of plum wine and charged me for that without telling me it is not a serving size, and they said even for serving size the price on the menu is outdated, it was pretty dishonestShow less

Author: TanE247
Title: Best place for japanese food lovers
Review:
Love this japanese restaurant! 
The food is fresh and delicious!
Recommended to make prior reservation if you have a group of 4 pax and above.

Author: Kim Yong L
Title: BEST Japanese restaurant in MELAKA
Review:
Loved the restaurant ambiance.
Their service is very good as well!
Our favourite was Salmon teriyaki and mango sushi roll! 

We will visit this place again!!!
This place is recommended to everyone! :)

Author: KhL109
Title: excellent food!
Review: came here for dinner and i must say this is the best japanese restaurant i have been to so far. fresh and succulent sashimi, mango in sushi was a delightful twist, fresh cold tofu is also a must try. do call up and make reservation few days priorShow less

Author: SG2019FebTiong Bahru, Singapore
Title: Average Food but service is excellent
Review: Read about so many good reviews about this restaurant in the Trip Advisor and decided to give it a try to see how good it is. I usually do not eat Japanese Food when I visit Melaka. I am not into Japanese Food by my son and wife they are. And their conclusion is average but the service is good. I like the attentiveness of the waitresses. The food I gave it 2 .5 stars, because of good service, I added another star.My wife order Salmon Belly and Grilled Squid and I ordered the Grilled fish a day Garlic fried rice. My son ordered the samsumi, we all agreed that some of the reviews in the Trip Advisor were over rated. Show less

Author: SherrinC4
Title: Excellent service and food
Review: Fresh and succulent food. Excellent and attentive service. Nice ambience and decor. Wide selection of food.  Must visit!

Author: R7578GDkarenaSingapore, Singapore
Title: A truly satisfied meal
Review: This is our 2nd trip to Malacca. After reading all the reviews of this restaurant, we decided to make a reservation for our 1st night here. We were early but we were greeted with warmth. This is a big contrast to the cold air-conditioning. Thank goodness my daughters &I brought our cardigans along. We ordered a total of 3 set meals, 1 plate of sashimi, 2 Chawanmushi, 1 ikura chawanmushi, 1 tempura udon, 1 grilled squid & many others. All these were devoured by my hungry family of 5!My Husband & I loved their sashimi, which is fresh and thickly cut! Every piece of sashimi felted like a party in our mouths.We came out of the place, happily stuffed, RM288 poorer and made another reservation to come back on a Saturday night! This is definitely a place to come if you truly enjoy Japanese cuisine!Show less

Author: Roberto-Singapore
Title: Good Japanese food.
Review:
Visited this restaurant several times. 
Good to make prior reservation if you have a group of 6 and above.
Food is fresh and good.

Author: Yvonne G
Title: Reasonable price
Review: Food is good. Many varieties available. Prior booking is required. Prices are reasonable and service is wonderful.

Author: Jack L
Title: Best bang for your buck
Review: This is the best value for money japanese restaurant i have come across anywhere. The dragon maki and salmon sashimi r our staples! Make reservations to avoid disappointment.

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Best Japanese restaurant in Melaka
Review: Finally visited this restaurant after such a long time. Luckily booked a table, it was full on a weekday amazingly. The only reason for that is the food here is excellent. The restaurant ambiance is superb with a wide variety of food options in the menu. Took the curry rice and salmon carpaccio (which was awesome). Took a few options of rolls with a few more of my friends. Drinks are also available in this establishment. Even the desserts were outstanding. The cost is justifiable and reasonable. Would visit this place again, recommended to everyone. Show less

Author: coachmelleow
Title: The Best Japanese in Melaka Town!
Review:
We went in without a reservation and the manageress still managed to pull tables together for 10 of us. Amazing environment, sumptuous food and pls try their Fruit Sake!😊👍🏼

Will definitely be back to this place any time we are in Melaka!

Author: Legal_itinerantKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: One of the best Japanese meals
Review: We came with friends who knew this place so the food we had was probably some of their favourites. We had a lobster and fish sashimi and grilled yellow tail head which were all delicious and beautifully presented. They have private rooms but as this is a small restaurant it gets a little noisy.Show less

Author: ambrose l
Title: Great Japanese Food
Review: This place is without a doubt one of the best Japanese Restaurants in Malacca. Was looking for a good place to celebrate a friend's birthday (someone who loves japanese cuisine), so we decided to make a booking for this place.No regrets. Taste of food is 5 stars but they can definitely improve on food preparation time. Extra orders took about an hour to arrive.Show less

Author: nataliasZ8112JESingapore, Singapore
Title: Awesome Japanese restaurant at hidden location
Review: Was introduced to this restaurant by a friend and we keep coming back to this restaurant every time we visit Malacca! Lots of varieties other than sushi, but the best is their smoked duck!! It's taste so good and it's melt in your mouth! A must place to go if you are a Japanese food lover!Show less

Author: D19650311
Title: Consistently good - best Jap in town
Review: Over the past 4 years I have been over 10 times. Always great food, service is excellent. Prices are reasonable. Must go if you like Japanese. Definitely be back

Author: TanLipBengZSingapore, Singapore
Title: Unbelievably Good!
Review: Visits this Japanese restaurant when we were in Malacca for a short holiday from 22 to 24 June. It was recommended by a friend and so we decided to give it a try and had lunch there.The various sashimi are very fresh. The rest of the food delectable! The service staff are attentive. For the price point it is definitely value for money.It was so good that we decide to go back there for dinner the next day!Show less

Author: hkimwah81
Title: Excellent Japanese Food!
Review:
Food is authentic, fresh, awesome. Interesting menu, affordable, variety of choices. 
Like the sashimi, carpaccio... PLS book before you come, full seating all the time!

Author: happynjoyful
Title: Good food n good service
Review:
1. Nice jap restaurant. 
2. Food is quality n service is good. 
3. Good variety -  appeal that all appetite. 
4. Good recommendation from other reviewers!

Author: Summer W
Title: Fresh Sashimi!
Review: I'm surprised to find Japanese food of such quality in this little small town. The food is fresh and the service was good, in which exceeded my exepectation. Very happy with the sashimi combo and the sesame ice-cream.

Author: Jane LBangkok, Thailand
Title: Very fresh, I'm in Japan of Melaka
Review: You have to order miso with pork soup. The spider maki roll was awesome. Plus a crispy large cracker with raw fish cubes, prawn etc that was a "pizza" hit. Garlic rice was very delicious as the rest of our order. Rice with red bean gravy was a great dessertShow less

Author: 5lovefood99Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Favorite Place To Go For Japanese Food
Review: Really love the japanese food serving here~Is Fresh n worth the price for the food~the service here also good and the waiters are nice~the food serve is fast and it won't get you waiting too long when you hungry~definitely will come and visit again~ Show less

Author: ePackeStockholm, Sweden
Title: Fantastic

Author: Waifun7788
Title: Moderately good

Author: Terence Tan WSingapore, Singapore
Title: Dollar value
Review: Went to wa zen with the recommendation of my Cousin. When I first enter the restaurant, ambience was very nice. Really like that we were seated in a somewhat private corner. The menu was extensive and reasonably priced. Although we waited for about an hour Long for ALL the food to arrive, I think it was worth the wait. fresh ingredients and the staff was very friendly as well. Will definitely recommend this to others. And I will definitely head back there Show less

Title: Delicious food!!
Review: The sashimi in this restaurant is simply THE BEST. Super fresh and nicely presented. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who likes Japanese food! It gets busy, so make a reservation if possible (we arrived -without reservation- around 7.30 pm on a Wednesday night and the restaurant was full, but we were told to come back 1 hour later, and I'm glad we did!)Show less

Author: JoanneLeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great ambiance & Good service
Review: The staffs are friendly and attentive. Love their extensive choices on menu. Their hot dishes were good. However being a sashimi lover I somehow don't fancy their raw fishes. Few occasions we ordered and found their fishes to be fishy and texture is somehow mushy. Skip the raw fishes and you'll be fine. Wa Zen is easy to find and it sits just right in the middle of town.Show less

Author: Jack C
Title: Terrayaki chicken is nice
Review:
This is one Japanese restaurant that you need to book advance before going there.
If not, chances are you may not find a seat to eat.
Ordered spider roll and terrayaki chicken.
Both taste is good and price is quite reasonable.

Author: Rosemary6015
Title: Best Japanese food in Town
Review: Wa Zen Restaurant provides very good hospitality to its patrons and take good welfare of its customers. It serves varieties of Japanese food while maintaining the tastes of the food. The waiters and waitresses will ask for feedback on the food served after the meal. The business is run by the locals, unlike those famous Japanese restaurant under franchising chains. It is truly a good place to have Japanese food, be it dinner or lunch. Price is average and service is good!Show less

Author: Pooh_tyan
Title: Best Japanese Food In Melaka
Review:
Best Japanese food in Melaka. Good environment, food taste above standard.
The business is so good everyday full house.  Call to make reservation earlier especially weekends, public holiday and festive season.
Reminder: The restaurant closed on every Sunday.

Author: chong s
Title: The best in melaka
Review: I cannot say it is the best Japanese restaurant, but it is the best Japanese restaurant in melaka. I have tried almost all Japanese restaurants in the town, this is the best so far.Price wise, all of them almost the same price. It is little pricy as in a town like melaka, it is compatible to the price of Japanese restaurant in big city like kuala lumpur. In fact some Japanese restaurant in Kuala Lumpur is even cheaper and more delicious. But what to do, you are in melaka now and you are craving of Japanese food, so this is the best that u can get at the area.Show less

Author: baccus60Penang, Malaysia
Title: Best Japanese restaurant in Malacca
Review: Forget all the other Japanese restaurants in Malacca. My family and I have been Wa Zen customers for many years now and we all agree it serves the most authentic Japanese cuisine. Menu is varied and choices plenty. Food is fresh, healthy portion sizes and good value for money. Near excellent service too.Show less

Author: NanthiniBalakumaranIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Good japanese food
Review: Been to this place few times and each time it was without a doubt good experience. The sushi choices are good and portion sizes are good too. The sashimi is fresh and delicious. The deserts are a delight to the palate too. The 2 advice would be make sure to call and place a reservation and go with a group or few friends. Definitely will recommend this place.Show less

Author: David H
Title: The Best Japanese Restaurant In Melaka
Review: Fresh, innovative tasty food. Service very good. Interior very much like restaurants in Japan. Good choice of Sake. Good value for money.

Author: GattoMelakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good
Review: Arguably the best Japanese Restaurant in Melaka. It has an innovative menu. There are copy cats around but they pale by comparison. Fresh seafood is brought in weekly. Those who patronise Wa Zen regularly will know which day fresh produce arrives. You can see the increase in the number of patrons on that particular day. Pricing is not cheap but I do not mind paying for good quality food. Service is fairly good. The waiters are attentive and efficient. Parking can be quite a problem, even though the restaurant has hired a plot of land as car park.Show less

Author: Tinalim304
Title: My favorite restaurant in town
Review:
I visit this restaurant nearly every week.
Love the endless variety of dishes here. The chef are more than willing to concort new dishes every now and then.
Atmosphere here is friendly and warm.

Author: TrueReview94Melaka, Malaysia
Title: I wonder if they Seppuku if they had a bad service night...
Review: As ridiculous as my title serves, i am going to say what sounds equally ridiculous. "This is the best Japanese restaurant in Melaka." Mind you , although it is ridiculous, both of them are what i really had in mind about Wa Zen. The point of this being ridiculous is because there are so many Japanese Restaurants in Melaka and all had their opinions on which is the best. There are Ohan, iichizen, sakura house, sakae sushi, sushi king and so much more. Many argued that iichizen is the best but for me i felt like iichizen had given us one of the most disappointing meals... ever! this is mainly because the sushi in iichizen was so modified it tasted so much like western cuisine. The sushi was dressed with so much dressing the taste disappears. Wa Zen in the other hand is much more authentic. Note it is not 100% authentic japanese food. They had a couple of modifications to the food to suit our malaysian buds, but my do they taste great. I had the avocado sushi and the golden roll, which both had fruit as the main ingredient. Both are equally amazing. The avocado sushi had a buttery introduction which is a great compliment towards sushi. The Golden roll is almost the same as the avocado sushi in creativity of its taste but both are polar opposites when it comes to the taste itself. If you really need to choose one, go for the avocado. Thank me later. :)as appetizers my family and i normally had the three combinations. The idako is flavourful and the sweet spicy tinge builds the appetite. The seaweed was fresh and crunchy and the jellyfish has the crunchy,chewy texture which was strangely pleasant. as for the main course normally go for the avocado roll, golden roll, grilled squid, mackerel, salmon pizza and the salad with sesame sauce. Amongst all of them i highly recommend the grilled squid.It was grilled to perfection as it is neither too dry nor it is too raw. The texture was not as chewy and the taste was spot on. The sweet sauce and the squid both compliments each other rather than contrasting with one another. As for dessert i had the sorbet. Although it was quite normal actually. the best dessert is to go with the matcha ice cream and red green paste. And of course the purpose of my title. Well, My family and i came here regularly for dinner and each and every night the service was great. They are polite and informative, and they service with a smile. Most of all, this restaurant never made us wait longer than 10 minutes for our food. Hence, i wonder if the samurai spirit actually motivates them to perform flawlessly each night. All in all, great food, great service, great environment, great value. Definitely coming here again.... and again.... and again...... and again.Show less

Author: DaveChoongPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Better place a booking before visit
Review: Been there for 3-4 times and end up it always need to take time to get the seat for us except the last time when i called up to make booking. Fast serving and good food overall which i tried few items from the menu. However, the overall atmosphere bit dark unless you seat in the private compartment, friendliness of the staff need to improve as well (more smile... :D)Show less

Author: joann_yeenMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice food , average service & atmosphere
Review: Wa Zen definitely is one of the Japanese restaurants that serve good food. Reserved for a table in April and the designated seat is in a darker area. Space to walk is limited and the dimmed lighting made the whole dinner time a little bit uncomfortable. Make sure you reserve your table before you come.Their curry rice is good!Show less

Author: 303ceciliah
Title: Best Gyoza
Review: Their gyoza properly one of the best I ever ate, even better than I used to eat at 餃子の王将 (Gyoza no Ohsho)

Author: quekkaiheng
Title: Japanese food
Review: The restaurant the price on the menu's quite reasonable.  Value for money. The restaurant rest day in on Sunday.

Author: JordanNg772Malaysia
Title: Popular Japanese restaurant with well prepared food
Review: One of the popular and possibly the best Japanese restaurant in the quaint tourist town of Melaka. The food is done well for one such restaurant comparable with places in the capital of Malaysia, Kuala Lumpur. Price is reasonable. Do make reservations when visiting due to the popularity of the place. Show less

Author: flyingFrenchman29Paris

My recommendation : the foie gras with scallop, both panned and in generous portion - a miracle. Booking is strongly advised. Parking is easier than in the busier parts of the city.Show less

Author: peramakan

Author: LavenaD1

Review:

Author: LawanyaKrishnan

Author: Tcheg01

Review:
