Author: VicchuahPoint Cook, Australia
Title: Good mushroom soup but overall not a satisfying dinner.
Review: After reading multiple good reviews about this restaurant in Melaka, my wife and I decided to have some first-hand experience with dinner at the restaurant. It's a cozy restaurant with a nice atmoshere except for a group of noisy youngsters and the staff were friendly.However the dinner was overall not satisfying.The mushroom soup was good.The chicken cacciatore with the grilled chicken we ordered tasted okay, however it does not resemble any chicken cacciatore I've had before locally or overseas and the portion was a bit tiny for the price paid.The seafood chowder we ordered was however a letdown to us as there were much too few ingredients in the chowder based on its price, 3 tiny mussels which is about one-quarter of the size of normal mussels, 3 tiny clams, 1 prawn which was not fresh and 1 tiny scallop. Actually this is the first time I've seen such tiny mussels.Overall not satisfying.Show less

Author: JegaPMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Visited Miller’s Kitchen today.
Review: Visited Miller’s Kitchen today. I actually had the best chicken chop here. The chicken is grilled, making it very succelent and juicy. Portion is great too! Only thing is the sauce is too little and I did ask for more sauce. The lamb shank taste good and I can know it’s good quality as the meat is fresh and served with a lot of herbs and spices.Seating layout is good. Highly recommend this place. Food pricing is also reasonable taking into consideration it’s Restaurant layout and ambiance. Show less

Author: aurfeiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Ummm... keep your expectations in check
Review: I might have had my expectations heightened when I found this restaurant on top of the list of Italian restaurants in Melaka on the TripAdvisor app. I find it difficult to give it more than three stars.It seems like a decent joint run by an honest couple, at least those were the only workers during our visit, a waitress and a cook. So it's a bit of a shame that the food was average but it is slightly overpriced. Maybe the cook was having an off day, I'll give it the benefit of a doubt considering there are many good comments given for their food.Show less

Author: Smi8806
Title: Best Western Food For Dinner
Review: The food is awesome🥰🥰..we finished the whole meals😅. Price also reasonable. Definitely will come back here again.

Author: Savemuch123
Title: Nice food near Bei Zhan
Review: We ordered clam chowder soup, ribeye steak and calamari. The soup was not bad. Calamari a bit let down, not so crispy. The highlight is the ribeye steak. V short handed of staff. Only 1 foreign middle aged staff serving us. Thank God is not crowded so still managed to get some attention. Price wise, a bit steep. But value for money if u hv more friends coming along n order the ribeye steak.On the whole, can make a visit.Show less

Author: Laura MToulouse, France
Title: The Great mushroom soup!
Review: We searched for a pasta restaurant for our kids and we found the Miller's kitchen restaurant. It was really great: spaghetti for the kids (kids menu - they asked to be reserved), and a super creamy ice cream). As for the adults, the super renowned mushroom soup , and a great salad. Everything served with the smile of an nice American. Greatly recommended.Show less

Author: fionalyeMelaka, Malaysia

The owner gave us a complimentary salad for my mum as she was quite full to take any main and was there just for the mushroom soup and calamari.Show less

Author: Tayrosie
Title: Best value for money
Review: The food we ordered was good, especially my chicken chop which was tasty and juicy. The owner is friendly and restaurant has good ambience.

Author: sharon h

Review: The food is really good especially their mushroom soup as well as their calamari which personally is my favourite and my friends and family too. The owner Neville is very friendly and kind. The pastas as well as the fish and chips is my daughter's all time favourite.The owner once gave me a complimentary desert when my friend told him she was celebrating my birthdayShow less

Author: john41492
Title: Great experience, definately coming back!

Author: sim choo t
Title: Good lunch at Millers Kitchen
Review:
My family had an awesome and excellent chicken chop, it was moist and tender at Millers. Their fish and chips was so good.
The owner Neville was extremely friendly and the kids just love him.
We will definitely be back.

Author: Chong3394
Title: Highly recommend
Review: Tasty food and the owner is superb nice. He provide a slice of Birthday cake and sing the birthday song along. Thank you so much. Definitely will visit again

Author: cai h
Title: Nice warm service n excellent food
Review: Went there first time, warm welcome from owner. Gave us the pesto bread complementary as he said our steak would take some time to prepare. Yummy pesto bread! Steak were nice n juicy, big portions of vegetables n crispy onion rings too. Overall, we enjoyed our meal there with the warm n generous service from the boss himself!!Show less

Title: Wonderful experience
Review: Came for the first time for my birthday treat. Menu had a wide range of variety for you to choose. Chose chicken chop and beef lasagna and they tasted delicious. Rich in flavour. When the owner, Neville, got to know that it was my birthday, he prepared a surprise dessert which was impromptu! Great guy and definitely a must visit!Show less

Author: Pollyana T
Title: Homemade taste
Review: We ordered one spaghetti bolognese, one pesto and one spaghetti prawn alfredo, all of them was very good taste like homemade  and the price is good too.

Author: DaphneSylvia
Title: Food
Review: Good food and comfortable and such clean environment! Would definately visit again next time! The service was impeccable too! The price is reasonable considering the high standard of food and service.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food and a quiet place....
Review: Did not know where to go for dinner. So check around found this. Since have not been here, give it a try.There is only one person managing the front - taking orders, serving and also being the cashier.The person was friendly and helpful. Looked through the menu and ordered seafood chowder and wanted garlic bread with cheese to go with it. He recommended pesto bread, which also have cheese and vegetable on top of it too. Go along with his recommendation.Since he was alone, therefore service was a bit slow. But nevermind. Not in a hurry.The seafood chowder is really good and thick broth. Some places the broth were watery.The menu is a little limited and can be pricey too.Parking can be a challenge as there are plenty of eateries around the neighbourhoodCan come back to try their chicken chop and other items in the menuShow less

Author: prutbc
Title: Mushroom Soup
Review: The main reason for me to revisit this restaurant is definitely their mushroom soup. They are my favourite! However, pastas were slightly plain for me.

Author: Ashxn7im
Title: Underrated hidden gem in the Heart of Malacca.
Review: I am today years old when I ate the best lamb shank. The meat literally falls off the bone, so tender and beautifully cooked and seasoned to perfection, the mashed potato with the perfect texture, beans and carrots add the perfect sweetness and crunch along with the savoury rosemary sauce. The mushroom and pumpkin soup, perfecto! Don’t get me started with the fluffy and beautiful garlic bread. The pesto bread, topped with melted mozzarella and Parmesan cheese, divine. My friends have tried the beef lasagna, Angus Beef Rib Eye Fettuccine and beef burgers, and they couldn’t stop mentioning how amazing the food is with every bite. The owner, Neville Jacob, is a humble and amazing chef. Definitely this place is an underrated gem. Will definitely be celebrating all my upcoming birthdays here.Show less

Author: dainasr
Title: Good food and good value
Review: The food was awesome and value for money. Hubs long time favorite the Mushroom soup is always the best  and superb. Most of the food has its own best.

Author: ohshafiqaSingapore
Title: underwhelmed
Review: we tried this restaurant due to the good ratings found in tripadvisor - but our visit is far from satisfactory. the decor was kind of outdated and kitschy (I might be biased but I hate fake brick walls), and the atmosphere was not what we expected. we proceeded to other our food, nonetheless. took quite a while for the food to arrive, which wouldn't be such a sore point if it had been worth the wait. spoiler alert: it was not. I ordered the aglio olio with bacon and my partner ordered the lamb rack. my dish had a weird aftertaste, and if not for the bacon which I asked to be added, I wouldn't have been able to eat more than a few spoonfuls. the lamb rack was better - but the meat used was full of fat and the seasoning was not done well. so disappointed with how our food turned out.. but at least their portion was huge (we couldn't finish it, though).service was alright - and we give props to the server for being concerned about how our dinner went. I just don't get why this place is rated highly amongst the steakhouses in melaka. this would definitely be my last visit to this restaurant..Show less

Author: kevinrH4114IA

Review: First time to eat at Millers Kitchen and am very impressed. We had the Irish Stew and Beef Lasagna. Both were decent size and good flavor. Now planning to come back one night for dinner. Very clean and nice ambiance.

Author: lipita

Review: Good meals can be found here. Fairly sizable menu with some unusual choices thrown in (Irish stew). A little heavy on the sauces, so if you like things with a lighter touch, just let the chef know.

Author: reenee_kPenang Island, Malaysia

Prices are pretty affordable, lots of pasta to select from around MYR20 all the way to MYR1xx for a ribeye steak. Service was a little slow when we were there probably because it is so quiet, they probably weren't really expecting people for dinner. Do try if you're looking for quality western dishes!Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia

I love their mushroom soup any chicken chop. Tender any juicy. Lots more good things to comment but I will leave it to you to decide. Two thumbs up. Keep up the good work Millers Show less

Author: Exploration826651

The chicken chop is so juicy !😁

Author: MusicaZ

Author: MichaelO3315

Author: TeresaB190
Title: Fabulous

Author: KaTieLami

Author: Tipster M

Author: Stefan N
Title: Great Italian Food
Review: Fantastic food, Great taste, good price, everything fine. Italian food, as well as burgers and good Desert

Author: SLChongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good food and friendly service
Review: We were at Millers Kitchen Restaurant in Kota Laksamana, Melaka to celebrate a family member's birthday. Millers Kitchen has a western menu, with pastas, pizzas and steaks as the main items. Food and service were good, although we had a rather long wait, as they only had one cook at the time of our visit. The mushroom soup is very good and there are vegetarian choices for pasta and pizza. Other food items were also good, although the pasta I had could have done with a bit more tomato taste for added zing. The fish and chips were also interestingly served in a mini steel bucket and had peas in it too. The owner was very friendly and although busy with other customers, did take time to chat, checking the food quality, etc. Only cash payment is accepted and Millers Kitchen should consider adding credit card payments. Overall, a place with simple decor, good food and friendly service, which is great for a family gathering.Show less

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Cosy warmth ambience
Review: Good place to catch up with friends or family. Warm ambience and serene probably due to the lighting. Food is tasty but the portion is a little on the small. No pork served.I love the carbonara and chicken chop. The chicken is so succulent and tender. I prefer mushroom soup to the vegetables soup. Highly recommended. Prices are a tad expensive for melaka standard. We ended the meal with some ice cream on the house. Thanks Mr Neville !! Definitely be back.Show less

Author: teenagesab_87
Title: affordable
Review: found it by accident when my friend and I were finding for a place to dine. not bad, affordable and good for friends and family

Author: eumingy

They have a wide variety of food, ranging from salads, chicken, beef, and pizza. Do drop by and give them a try. This restaurant is indeed a hidden gem in Melaka. Would really recommend their miller ceased salad with Cajun chicken which my family and I loves :)Show less

Author: Naveena V
Title: Superb dinner 😇
Review: It's my second visit to this restaurant with my mom and friend. Very cozy restaurant. Very very friendly chef & staff. Their food here are superbly awesome. 😍 Definitely will come back again. Recommended

Author: Narmadha87
Title: Bland and not fresh
Review: We went to Nancy’s kitchen following a long holiday hiatus due to the pandemic. The last we visited this place, food was so delicious so we had to go again. The dishes came surprisingly fast so it didn’t seem like they cooked it there and then. Only the PaiTee really lived up to its taste and we enjoyed it. Don’t think I’d be coming here again.Show less

Author: Alcinito
Title: Try the durian mochi cendol
Review: Lunched here on a day trip with my family. Good food, good value and a lot of selection. Met and chatted with Nancy. The durian mochi cendol is to die for.

Author: juanh187Petaling Jaya, Malaysia

This restaurant is often ranked high in many reviews, but I don’t understand whyShow less

Author: Mandytanyy

Review: Food with price was not satisfying, the menu shows chicken/prok rib is WITH buah keluak but actually is WITHOUT keluak, and each charge for rm2, the food is not fresh, not worth for trying

Author: neversaydont
Title: Price is average. But food
Review: Price is average. But food is not fresh. Compare to their previous generation. It’s two different world of taste. I rather u charge slightly higher price with good quality food provided instead of giving us fair price but inferior food quality.

Author: Charles TPenang Island, Malaysia
Title: Dour and impersonal service, otherwise food good , but not outstanding.
Review: Why is it so hard for Melaka's restaurants staff to show warmth and welcoming enthusiasm? At "Nancy" and other Peranakan restaurants we were sadly faced with staff who made no eye contact, did not smile or showed any warmth and talked loudly among themselves. It felt like we were eating in someone else's home and intruding on. Where is the F&B professionalism seen in HK,Thailand or Japan. In China they shout a robust " welcome , welcome or Huān yíng huān yíng, qǐng zuò , in Japan "irasshaimase" but in Melaka,they were sullen and stare at you ? Is it Covid or a habitual public response?Show less

Author: jokl78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Super cheap but not nice
Review: We came in 3 for dinner at 5pm. Ordered alot.Popia - not niceMeat ball - not badKang kung belacan - not niceSambal petai prawn - not badBak pongteh - niceOtak otal - tastelessCurry chicken - so soCendol - not badSo much food and only cost us rm100Show less

Author: friedbananas88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Rustic & authentic
Review: Authentic nyonya food at very reasonable prices. I was pleasantly surprised by the cincaluk omelette which was light, fluffy, and not overpowering. The salt and pepper fish was fresh and very nicely done, as was the asam pork. I had expected the omelette to be oily as usually is the case with deep fried omelettes, but not here! Two thumbs up for our experience. The restaurant also sells a variety of nyonya delicacies like kuih and tidbits - we bought some dumplings to take home with us. Show less

Author: sheila1026109
Title: Expensive
Review: Very expensive. Small potion. I understand cost is high. Taste is just OK. Go if you are willing to try your chance on getting good food. It is definitely not cheap

Author: KevinRPC
Title: Over rated food
Review: Absolutely mediocre food. Really disappointing. Infact one of the worse in the city without a doubt. Only the ambience is ok not the food.

Author: Nelson170017Alor Setar, Malaysia
Title: Overall was good, but I believe they can do better
Review: Services great. Food came out within 5minutes, impressive. Ayam buat keras awesome, sambal sumbat Ikan cencaru good, cencalok egg nice, the sambal paste for lady’s finger awesome! The only I was abit disappointed was the nyonya laksa not nice, too much tumeric flavour, and the petai prawn not up to standard, because even my mum would make this dish better than hereShow less

Author: mia7jane
Title: Snacking
Review:
I dropped by for a durian cendol (it is seasonal), popiah and pai tee. The popiah skin a litte different from others now. I prefer to the traditional popiah skin.
Good pai tee! I had their kopi O too!

Author: mia7janeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: My favorite place
Review: Nancy's kitchen is always my favorite nyonya restaurant whenever I visit Malacca. My recommendation is their asam pedas fish and pai tee. Cendol is a must eat! They also have a lot of freshly baked nyonya biscuits and nyonya dumplings. All are good, quality is consistent. I never walk in and walk out disappointed. I truly enjoy myself every visit! Show less

Author: ML991
Title: Delicious nyonya dumplings
Review: We didn't have a sit down meal at the restaurant.  We bought nyonya dumplings from the restaurant.  The dumplings are delicious and cheaper than from another famous store in town.

Author: Rinster2211Melbourne, Australia
Title: Quick lunch
Review: Went to Nancy's as we went to a local bakery in the same neighbourhood. Also this is a highly recommended restaurant Had quick small lunch. Dishes were on spot. But to mention is the buah keluk which they sell per piece. The filling was very smooth. And they also sell Nonya style baked goods. Looks ample parking. Worth a try if unsure where to go for Nonya food but will need to drive or be driven there. Show less

Author: Fonglin
Title: Disappointed with their alkaline dumplings
Review: After having my lunch there, I decided to buy 6 alkaline dumplings home.  Was really disappointed when I opened it after I got home.  All 6 were not fully cooked.  It was a waste to throw it away but it couldn't be eaten ...

Author: April J
Title: Mediocre Food
Review: I read reviews on TripAdvisor before coming here. I find the reviews over rated. The food was mediocre. The ice kacang & Chang tho was rather good

Author: Jojofamily88
Title: Arrogant
Review: The staff were extremely arrogant, especially the cashier (outright rude and ....no words to describe her). The food is over rated. I would not return.

Author: leongm832
Title: Cocky server and owner
Review: Cocky owner with stuck up attitude, know nuts about her e pay and promo she posted. Slow service and cold food.

Author: VickyTjse
Title: Recommended Authentic Nyonya Food
Review: Was told Nancy’s kitchens’ food was really good. Finally I get to try, yea, their food was amazing! Price are reasonable. They serve their food at fast speed as well. Recommended. I love their otak otak to the max!

Author: SimonKhng
Title: Bad service
Review: Food a bit disappointed and the price reasonable. The most cant accented is the service. They come to collect plate without asking and during that time we still having our food. When we complain, they just act like nothing and didn’t apologize at all. This kind of restaurant better don’t go.Show less

Author: FoodEnthused
Title: Not worth the hype
Review: We went for a late lunch to avoid the crowds but were extremely underwhelmed by the food. Nothing special nor traditional, a poor representation of Melaka Nyonya food. Pity the tourists who don't know better and flock there for an authentic meal.

Author: 806katherinelSingapore, Singapore
Title: Popular Peranakan Restaurant
Review: This was my second visit to Nancy's Kitchen, it is still one of the best restaurant serving authentic peranakan cuisines. The dishes are simple and very tasty. We ordered the Ayam Buah Keluak, Chap Chye, Braised Pork, Ayam Assam, Kueh Pai Ti, Otah Otah, Nonya Chang, Bak Chang. I love all the dishes but my two favourites are Ayam Buah Keluak and Chap Chye. The Buah Keluak Nut is sold separately for RM2 each. I can eat 4-5 nuts each time. The nut stuffing and sauce is simply delicious, chicken is tender too. You must try this dish here. Since CNY is approaching, we also bought some cookies at the restaurant to bring home. Am highlighting the Prawn rolls in popia skin - it's outstanding, the best I have tasted so far. Definitely will be back here again when I visit Malacca.Show less

Author: Junn T
Title: Great food
Review: Food was great and not too salty! Location was accessible and price was affordable! Definitely worth a visit to try peranakan food ☺️

Author: desboo
Title: Good Nyonya Food. Make reservation the day before to reduce waiting time during peak periods
Review: We love the food here. Babi Ponteh, Candlenut Chicken, ladies fingers, chap chye, salted vegetable duck soup are our must order dishes.

Author: E1245ZXannecKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Excellent nyona cuisine
Review: Walked in at 2pm- waited 45min for table. Ordered the Asam fillet , fried prawn with chilli (quite spicy), duck with preserve veg soup and cendol. Great ambience and the food is fresh and delicious. They sell Melaka famous pineapple tarts and dodol, cookies, crackers too. Show less

Author: JoGSKSingapore, Singapore
Title: OK eat in food but takeaway kueh were not fresh
Review: We had late lunch at around 3.30pm on a weekday and it was still crowded. (Likely due to its extended lunch hours) Told to go to the 3rd level which we realised was kind of a storeroom where they added 3 to 4 tables to allow for more seating. (The main eating area are level 1 and 2.) Food was acceptable except that the salted veg duck soup came with very little meat even though we ordered large portion. But staff was prompt to inform kitchen and added more duck for us after we told them. The assam fish we ordered was fresh but fish hasnt absorbed the flavour of the gravy yet.After our meal, we were told to pay on level 1 and we proceeded downstairs. Picked up some kueh and CNY cookies while queuing to pay. When I ate the kueh back in hotel, they were hard and certainly not freshly made. The pineapple tarts were thankfully decent.Show less

Author: anarX9499IU
Title: Yummy Food
Review: Definitely needs to try this restaurant! A very nice homemade style and traditional food! Even needs to queue up for tables but dont need to wait too long!

Author: 39steo
Title: Not value for money
Review: Had lunch at Nancy's kitchen on a weekday. Fish curry (ikan lemak nenas) was a rip-off. Fish was tiny, can only feed a cat i think, but cost RM30. Other dishes like chicken curry and soy sauce pork taste as if the meat was pre-cooked, and it was just different gravy poured on top of it. The only saving grace was the popiah which was tasty with an eggy skin. Will not go back there again.Show less

Author: Jacqueline L
Title: Delicious Authentic Nyonya restaurant
Review: My favourite is their chillies pastes. They served generous and different chillies paste (sweet, sour, belacan, asam etc) for different dishes, simply boasted our appetite. Especially for chillies lovers. Very fresh otak-otak. A lot of Malaysian cookies for sale too.

Author: Awesometrave12
Title: Food
Review: Too much of praises on the food. Went with certain expectation however, was greatly disappointed. Prices are higher than other restaurant. Possibly due to the signature name.

Author: RKTHSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious variety
Review: If you need a good fix on Peranakan food, this is the place. Every visit to Melaka must include this restaurant for us. They were originally located in an old small cramped shophouse in a side street along Jonker Walk before moving to this bigger current place a few years ago. There’s many Peranakan dishes and equally many diners queuing during mealtime so avoid peak periods otherwise you may need to queue for half an hour at times. The takeaways like dumplings and chilli shrimp paste are also pretty goodShow less

Author: liemei_tan
Title: Must try resto
Review: We noted this restaurant as it was rated as good peranakan resto in malacca. Overall, I would recommend the popiah and beef rendang, suitable for those who don't like spicy food

Author: Judy H
Title: Yum yum!!
Review: We went there for lunch today and had a wonderful Nyonya Laksa. So flavourism. Service was friendly and efficient. It is definitely a place to visit for excellent Nyonya food.

Author: pbkoonPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Quality deteriorated badly
Review: We ordered 7 different dishes. Only 2 were acceptable - the pie tee chilli sauce was good, and the ayam buah keras. Itik tim and chap chye was particularly bad with a weird off-taste. When we visited 3 years ago, the food was much better. Won’t be coming here again in the future!Show less

Author: Shaukat A
Title: Great Nyonya Food in Melaka
Review: Extensive menu and amazing taste of some of the best Nyonya dishes. Enjoyed chicken curries, steamed vegetables and seafood dishes. Great flavours and highly recommended by myself.

Author: JoyA1378
Title: Excellent Service. Authentic Nyonya crusine
Review:
Suitable for large group, you can order more variety of dishes. 
Surprise by the variations in preparation of chicken using different spices and cooking method. 
Order taker know the menu well and able to offer 2 dishes of vegetarian including one fried egg .

Author: ccjy2001Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great authentic Nyonya food
Review: One of the better Nyonya restaurants in melaka which serve quality food. Price can be slightly more on the pricey side. Recommended to make reservations before going as tables are limited and operating hours is short. They sell kuih and other traditional cookies and etc which is a must to buy before leaving, the kaya especially!Show less

Author: Sab26ess
Title: Great Nyonya Food
Review: We like the authenticity of the taste of this Nyonya restaurant. When we are unable to go to the place, we use Grab Food to order them. Great selection and they offer set lunch and dinner.

Author: RandolphCarter1919Australia
Title: Cooking class and meal
Review: A local antique dealer recommended Nancy's and when we googled the restaurant we found and booked a cooking class. It was such a great experience with Nancy, her sister and brother all cooking away and helping out, a real family affair. We cooked candlenut chicken and curry chicken in the traditional nyonya style. Nancy is a wonderful person and a bad review I read gave her low ratings as there were foreigners as wait staff, how racist are these people. Nancy employs disadvantaged people and is family run. She has a huge array of products you can buy to take with you also. 6 stars. Show less

Author: jo272019Batu Caves, Malaysia
Title: Overated
Review: I would say they r more better restaurants in MalaccaU need to wait for nearly 1 hour to be seated during lunch hoursThey will ask u to write name in a list to be seated according to turns but they don't follow. People just come in n talk something to d person in charge cut the queue and eatFood are prepared earlier. It is not hot or fresh I will never go here againShow less

Author: SingaporeFranSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great dinner!
Review: Great place for dinner! We loved it especially the crisp Kueh Pie Ti. Unfortunately Nancy’s success also causes a problem... there seem to be queues there all the time! If you are big group you may be able to get a reservation but generally people just wait...Show less

Author: VA_PoohLuvTravelKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience, good food
Review: Love the pie tee and cendol, the best so far compared to the other places we went.We were seated upstairs that may have some privacy but there is a smell that's not so pleasing, maybe they should do something about that. Overall, everything is good.Show less

Author: Stryfe88
Title: Decent food.
Review: This is an authentic no frills nyonya restaurant. Taste good and price is reasonable. However don't expect top notch service, rather it is decent enough if you are here looking for good food and ok service.

Author: StaceyPetalsDenisMalaysia
Title: What a let down, average food quality and poor service
Review: My friend and I flew into Melaka for a 3 days 2 nights stay solely for food. We visited 6 restaurants in a day. It is sad to note food in Nancy's Kitchen was prepared by non-skilled foreigners mostly who doesn't really care for proper food preps and presentation. I can go into each dish and dessert but this review will be very long. Overall, I do not think it is worth the wait for table for the average quality food and poor service. Foreigners are in kitchen preparing food (when I asked with concern, I was assured there is a local cook in the kitchen), take orders (the foreign lady with a sour face and not answering questions on food), server (after we finished the popia for a long while then the foreign worker brought the chili sauce) and clean. Attitude was poor and food quality was average, in fact, some of the desserts we had else where are way better then here. I left the paid dessert on the table and told the cashier the glutinous rice of kuih was partially cooked. I am fond of Nyonya food and had won a gold award at the Battle of Chefs Asia in this category, I know what each dish I order should be the tastes reasonably. If you are visiting, just skip those Nyonya Kuih displayed on the tables next to cashier, seriously they are not worth your time/money. We took all the pictures of the dishes we ordered but didn't feel they deserved to be posted on our Facebook as we do not rec-commend the restaurant.Show less

Author: SusanC4948Melbourne, Australia
Title: Our introduction to popiah
Review: We visited for lunch and bought candlenut chicken (yum). the fried port balls (even more yum) and the popiah. The popiah wasn’t just “yum”, it was “Do they have popiah in Singapore” (yes), I will buy this book that tells me how to make it (and had to get two), it was let’s just go to Clayton (Victoria, Australia) and see if there are popiah skins for sale (not found so far) or see if any restaurant sells them (not found so far). I think popiah will be a lifetime obsession after this visit.We were lucky to just turn up early for lunch and grab an upstairs table. It still was quite busy so I think reservations might be a good idea. Nancy’s kitchen itself was a good quality restaurant. Service was good. I liked the ambiance. Menu has good pictures if you are unsure of what to order. They serve wine by the bottle but not by the glass. You can also undertake kitchen cooking lessons here. We hadn’t booked for the lessons but I am sorry we didn’t because I really, really want to learn to make popiah!Show less

Author: Suelowst
Title: The famous and popular Nancy's Kitchen
Review: The food is real authentic nyonya . But the sitting arrangement of the tables leaves much to be desired, whether its downstairs or upstairs ;-(This restaurant is very popular but you get no peace having your meal as people will be standing next to your table, wanting to snagged it the moment you get up - makes for a very uncomfortable meal. Won't bother to come back for another meal.Show less

Author: waiyeechee
Title: Bad, overhyped food
Review: I went here with my family due to a friend’s recommendation and I am very disappointed in the food here. We ordered their chicken curry, steamed prawns and fish and the only thing that was even decent was the sauce that came with the fish. Everything else was bad, at most subpar. The cutlery that was provided was dirty as well, which is a huge letdown because the very least that a restaurant can do is ensure that the cutlery is clean. I will definitely not be returning to this restaurant anymore and will not recommend it to anyone. Show less

Author: Brenda L
Title: A Taste of Local Food
Review: I never imagined that this restaurant is very popular. All I know is they served popular local dishes... One good decision we made was reserve a table. I was so surprised when we got there. People are queueing outside, waiting to be seated. Then the staff seated us on the 3rs level! Again I was amazed cuz I thought they only have the dining area at the ground level. The restaurant owns 3 levels to house many patrons. And so we ordered the signature dishes.. my favourite was the shrimp with chili.. i forgot the name but it was soo good. After that delicious meal, we went and saw a longer queue this time... oh my..So here's a tip, better reserve a table when you plan to dine at Nancy' Kitchen to avoid waiting and be on-time.Show less

Author: EugeneH1963
Title: Good food
Review:
Restaurant came with recommendation and we were not disappointed.  Good Nyonya food, ok service and cosy dining environment. 

Will return again.

Author: IdrisA788
Title: Baba nyonya authentic
Review: Dropped by for an early lunch so was relatively quiet and service was great. Started with the pai tee which was great. Had tamarind fish asam pedas,brinjal,cincalok egg omelette and squid. Excellent!

Author: komododeesingapore
Title: Quite decent but skip the pineapple tarts
Review: Quaint restaurant decor and we enjoyed most of the dishes we ordered. We arrived at about 11.20am and managed to get a seat after waiting about 20min. The more memorable dishes were the laksa (packed a punch and was generous with ingredients), otah, chap chye and fried fish with ginger and spring onion. The ondeh ondeh was yummy too. Regret buying only one pack but three bottles of pineapple tarts which turned out to taste rather bland.Show less

Author: kimkohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great lunch
Review: We ordered a wide array of dishes—poh piah, kueh pie tee, ayam buah keluak, babi pongteh, sambal kang kong, chap chye, otak, cincalok omelette and fried lady s fingers. The ayam buah keluak was very delicious. Pork for babi pongteh was not as tender as expected. Everyone liked the poh piah as the skin was very well made and fillings generous. We ended the meal with chendol and also tried their durian muah chee. Kelondong drinks were nice!All 5 of us agreed that the food was good and worth a return visit. Show less

Author: khooi77Singapore, Singapore
Title: Average
Review: Had dinner here with the family. Did a reservation so did not have to wait.To be frank, I did not find the dishes to be spectacular. Average is where I would rate it.If I had to wait in line for a table, I would rate this below average.Show less

Author: 49karenlSudbury, United Kingdom
Title: THE BEST MEAL IN MALACCA
Review: I found Nancy's Kitchen Restaurant on one of my research forays for our trip. I am so glad I did as it proved to be the best meal we had in Malacca.Nancy's is not located in the main town area but a traxi ride away at a site where there are multiple eating abodes.The food is all Nonya and excellent, the restaurant is quite basic and not at all grand the food is delicious and excellent value, I understand there are cookery classes available too, which I am sure would be worth attending.Show less

Author: jenyeeann
Title: what is so dam good
Review:
Waited for 1 hour. What is so good?? 
Service dam slow. So noisy. Will NEVER return. Price not cheap. If you pay this type of price so much better food else where.

Author: claudiabsyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing Impressive
Review: Decided to dine here during our recent visit to Melaka after reading so many good reviews about this restaurant. Ordered spring rolls, pai tee, 1 chicken dish, 1 pork dish (can't remember the name of the dishes), 1 vege & 1 soup. The only thing good was the pai tee. The chicken dish (something like rendang) was below average. Pork dish was sour & oily. Soup was salty. Vege & spring rolls were so so. I think this restaurant is over rated and we will not visit here again in our future trips to Melaka.Show less

Author: FCorbett1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful Peranakan food
Review: I make sure that I pay a visit to Nancy’s Kitchen every time that I visit Melaka, as we are always guaranteed a delightful meal when eating here. It reminds us of a homemade meal and we always leave feeling incredibly full and happy. Unless you make a reservation, you might have to wait outside the restaurant for up to an hour before getting a table. Regardless, the food is served very quickly when you arrive. It’s a little more expensive than usual restaurants around Malaysia, but it’s definitely worth it. Very much recommended for a visit to Melaka. Show less

Author: 7erence7amCanberra, Australia
Title: Traditional Peranakan Food
Review: It used to be really authentic, and tasted top notch (trust us, my mom is Peranakan). But for some reason, it has lost some of its appeal. It’s still a good place to go to for Peranakan food, but it used to be much much better.Show less

Author: snah55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Best Family Friendly Peranakan Restaurant in Melaka
Review: We had 2 meals here at Nancy’s, food is awesome. As parents traveling with a 2 year old, sometimes we are concerned about the food outside but here it’s healthy and delicious. We ordered bakwan kepiting soup and rice and informed it was for our child and they cooked it less salty, also ordered the fish ball soup for our second time eating here for this trip, it came with vegetables too, not just fish ball. Both were so delicious with home cooked flavor my child enjoyed very much. The restaurant is clean and comfortable with strong aircon so it’s good environment for my child to eat in. Baby high chair provided and also the 2nd floor toilet has a baby diaper changing table! No one would post this pic but it’s important for parents who travel all the way from Singapore to eat here and most of the time by the time we arrive at the restaurant, the child needs a change of diapers already. It goes to show the heart of the owner of this restaurant, willing to go to the details. You can hardly find this kind of service in Malaysia, but Nancy’s kitchen has a spirit of excellence, very well thought through. Highly recommend for parents with young kids to dine here for the food and clean environment. It’s our 3rd visit to Melaka and we will still come back here to eat again in future.Show less

Author: F8167KNsimonw
Title: Good food
Review: I enjoyed the butternut chicken, although enjoyed the fried fish with spring onions (Chinese style) more. The food was good but not as amazing as I had been led to believe. A bit of a walk fro the centre

Author: SanJK89Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A must peranakan in Melaka
Review: One of the best place i ate in Melaka. It will be very crowded so better to do booking a day earlier otherwise u need to que up. Awesome food with variety of dishes with reasonable price. They have up to 2 to 3 floors and comfortable dining. Staffs are friendly and efficient.Show less

Author: SIE YAN CCanterbury, United Kingdom
Title: A must when in Malacca
Review: We literally turned up 15 mins before the Sat lunchtime rush and was lucky to get a table. Menus are packed with nyonyas/peranakan influenced fusion of SE Asian food from glutinous rice to stir fry green beans in belacan. Everything we ordered were well cooked and beautifully presented and the best things is... they all come at once which is a great feast to the eyes when one wants to take a pic in one take. Will definitely return on our next visit there.Show less

Author: stefanomigliorisi
Title: Tasty Peranakan Food!
Review: Booked the day before, therefore no line when we arrived. Tasty food, had 5 small dishes: chicken, pork, softshell crab, veggies and a GREAT SOUR VEGETABLE DUCK SOUP TOTALLY RECOMMENDED. On the way to go we also bought some items and their shop.

Author: AlexS13606
Title: Eatable peranakan restaurant
Review: First time trying this restaurant. Non of the dish stands out as good or bad. Conclusion very average perankan restaurants.

Author: KishanRajSitiawan, Malaysia
Title: Good Nyonya Food Worth The Wait
Review: Went there for dinner on a Saturday and was lucky to get a table for two. We were addressed promptly by the waiter and our order taken must try their nyonya cendol! And their chicken pongteh! Food arrived within twenty minutes of us waiting. Overall our visit to this place was decent but please do make sure you call a day ahead to make reservation to avoid disappointment of not getting a table. Show less

Author: SG-lmh
Title: Nyonya food
Review: We arrived without reservation before 2 pm of Good Friday. Had to wait for about half an hour to get a table. The service is fine and fast. The food is normal Nyonya food.

Author: minniepoohbearSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious and affordable peranakan food
Review: Went for late lunch on weekday with no waiting time. Ordered Pork Fried with Bean Curd Skin (Ngoh Hiang) - taste average,; Nyonya Acar Sauce with Roasted Pork (Acar Pork) - I like this the most as it’s sour and savory and the pork is tender; Assam Pedas - the fish was fresh and soft, the spicy and sour sauces goes well with rice ; Duck with Salted Vegetable Soup (Sup Itik Tim) - can tell that the soup was cooked long enough for the duck to be tender and soft, the soup was sour and delicious. Overall the food was excellent and is good value for money. Show less

Author: RLAM88Greater London, United Kingdom
Title: Definitely recommended
Review: Had lunch with friends, very tasty and enjoyable. We ordered two veg, one steam fish curry in coconut sauce and soft shell crab fried. All the dishes were very good except the soft shelled crabs as it was far too oily. We also ordered pai tee for starter and absolutely delicious and definitely must try.We had chendol for dessert and it is delicious, highly recommended.Show less

Author: LST100
Title: Overpriced, horrible service!
Review: We are a family of 4 and were prepared to queue for the authentic Peranakan cuisine. However, the restaurant manager couldn't handle the large crowds and allocated seats badly, for example, seating 2 people at an empty table meant for 4 (even though we were supposed to be next in line). We ended up waiting over an hour before being seated. We were then rudely seated upstairs at an empty table meant for 7 (yet another poor seating decision by the restaurant manager). Food was also overrated - it was cold, pre-cooked, not fresh and bland. For example, we had overcooked beef rendang (likely to have been microwaved prior to service), which made it tough to chew. There are better Perenakan restaurants in Melaka that are more authentic and delicious! Nancy may have been known for its cuisine once upon a time, but it's now cutting corners to make profits out of its patrons.Worst of all - the waiters accused us of not paying our bill! When we were about to drive away from the restaurant, a waiter ran to our car accusing us of not paying. We had indeed paid the bill and had to go inside to resolve the situation. It turns out that the restaurant made an ERROR and gave us the WRONG bill, and they did NOT apologise to us for accusing us. We live in the town next to Melaka and heard a lot about this restaurant and wanted to enjoy a nice family meal together. However, the experience was ruined by Nancy's lack of service and hospitality and quality of food. We will never return and will be telling our family and friends not to go to Nancy's.Show less

Author: rblackwoTaupo, New Zealand
Title: A great gluten free option in Melaka
Review: I have celiac and overall it has been hard finding gluten free eats in Asia. After reading a tripadvisor review saying that this restaurant has many gluten free options we decided to give it a try. The staff were knowledgeable about pointing out menu items that did not have any gluten (including soy sauce). We had the rendeng chicken, the coriander pork ribs, vegetables and curry sauce with a side of rice. I enjoyed the food. Recommend making a reso because there was a massive line out the door and you will be seated straight away. I would give this place five stars if they had their menus identified with which items contained gluten. I realize that the gluten issues are not prevalent in this part of the world so I am not hopeful.Show less

Author: hopepestSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy
Review: A nice spot for yummy traditional nonya food. Duck soup is a little on the salty side (this is from a person who likes things salty). Saya lodeh is awesome creamy with coconut milk. Babe ponteh is nice, my only qualm is that the oil/fat wasn't emulsified into the gravy and the was lean meat included (and it was tough).The ondeh ondeh was amazing! Show less

Author: KooKokKeeSingapore
Title: Let Down
Review: This restaurant was recommended to me and my wife has visited it before and has good memories of it. However, the food might as well have come out of a tin! The taste was ordinary and certainly lack the flair of true peranakan food. Very disappointing!Show less

Author: ExploreSmallTowns
Title: Pleasant Nonya Restaurant
Review: We went off-peak at 3pm on a Sunday to avoid the queues. The restaurant was bustling. The menu is quite extensive and we were spoilt for choice. The food was good although we can tell that it was cooked a while ago and warmed up. The kueh pie tee was excellent. It is nice to be able to order the exact number of buah keluak.Show less

Author: Yong T
Title: Not worth it
Review: Nothing special, long q for normal nyonya food, I think still lot restaurant better than this.not recommend

Author: dwinty123Cambridge, United Kingdom
Title: fantastic flavours make up for overcooked meat
Review: Though a fair distance from Malacca's centre we deemed the 20 minute walk worth it, and it was. Their banana flower was perfectly spicy with a taste you won't forget. The flavour of their Peranakan curry evoked Thai memories and the Pong Teh's scrumptious sauce reminded me of home, but with a distinctly Nyonya twist. There's no denying Nancy really knows how to cook, but the only sour taste I was left with, was that of overcooked chicken that stuck to the mouth, and pork that took a minute to chew. Perhaps we were just late in service, but Nancy's is still more than worth it.Show less

Author: Volatile75Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not too bad
Review: 2nd time here @ ~ 3pm. No queue. Good and decently priced. Ordered fish slice lemak curry, pie tie (so so), assam prawns, beef rendang, soup, friend rice (for kids) and friend egg with prawns. Service was fast and polite. But the food taste appeared to be a little inconsistent. Above average definitely but not sure if they changed the chef or something. Show less

Author: yvonne t
Title: Family lunch
Review: Visited this restaurant for family Sunday lunch. Super long queue before we can get a table cause they are very famous. Food served very fast & clean restaurant.

Author: SyLu23
Title: Dishes were tasty and their chendol was mind blowing.
Review: Great chendol. The best in Melaka. Dishes were great too.. Loved their butter squid and dry sambal prawns..

Author: adriankoh1981Singapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Nonya food, as good as grandma made it.
Review: As a straits-born Chinese person I love my Peranakan food. Nancy’s kitchen is exactly what I needed for my fix. Sambal Petai, itek tim, Nonya new goreng, and sambal fried fish were excellent. Bak buah keluak was satisfying, but did not make as much of an impact with me. What struck my family was now homely the restaurant and the fare was. You’ll see Peranakan-themed decorations, massive piles of sweets and snacks, the smell of the kitchen (which you can see from within the restaurant). It’s not a big place, with seating for maybe 50 people at most, and most of the time you spend on hod is find yourself I didn’t have space for desserts, but managed to squeeze in one slice of their amazing kueh lapis. Show less

Author: 944angiepSingapore, Singapore
Title: Yummy Nonya food home cooked style
Review: Loved the kueh pai tee, buah keluak, otak otak, and cendol. Good tasting traditional Nonya dishes. Not high on their Ngoh Hiang and their stir fried vegetable dishes were simple and nothing fancy. Very affordable priced. Will recommend the place to those who want a taste of Nonya fare!Bought some home made chilli at end of our visit. Show less

Author: joweit
Title: Melaka Weekend Trip
Review: The standard of the food drop tremendously. 90% of the dishes are prepared with just add in the pre cook sauce. You can say is like fast food Nyonya food. Not worth the time to que for table.

Author: Barney1984Edinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Great nyonya food
Review: We hunted this restaurant down after seeing it recommended in Lonely Planet. We arrived around 12 and the restaurant was already very busy but we managed to get a table upstairs straight away. The food was quick to arrive. We ordered three small dishes plus rice between two of us which was plenty. All the dishes can be ordered in small, medium or large size but I’d recommend small so you can try more things. The candlenut chicken was fantastic. Big pieces of chicken-on-the-bone in a lovely lemongrass heavy sauce. I could have eaten another portion! We also ordered deep fried squid which was crispy and tasty and a lovely pork dish. Total bill with a drink was 60 RM which I thought was very good value for the quality of the food. Show less

Author: Christina WKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: didn't meet up to expectations
Review: Five golden girls found good reviews on this restaurant. We decided to order the Malaccan dishes different from what we have eaten the day before. We ordered Chicken ponteh, Fish lemak with pineapple, popiah, Four angle bean, Nonya and Hokkien chungs and white rice accompanied with 2 jugs of Chinese tea. For dessert we had cendol and kuih ku color. The total bill came up to RM139.25 (inclusive of taxes).Chicken ponteh was delicious - big chunks of chicken in a delicious aromatic brown sauce. The fish lemak was not salty enough (according to my friends) though I beg to differ. The sauce was rich and made aromatic with coconut milk - I enjoyed the fish thoroughly. The half fish is ikan kurau and cost RM52. Price is reasonable for half a fish.The huge chunks of pineapple were tasteless. Hmmm...why? The four angle bean was crunchy and spicy - good! The popiah was disappointing because the "skin" was thick and chilly paste not spicy enough. The julienne turnip was too thick though. The Nonya chung was good - enough spices and the pork filling was tasty. The glutinous rice was well steamed (soft and yet chewy). The size was just right. However, it's not true for the Hokkien chung which cost a whopping RM9 each (the Nonya chung cost RM5.30). For its cost, the Hokkien chung was 25% bigger. The filling was sufficient but not salty enough - I agreed with my friends on this. The hugh chunk of pork fat was a slight turn off though it was a required ingredient. Pretty blend. Dessert was above average - the cendol, shaved ice and gula melaka was good and delicious. But the red beans in the cendol was a tad too sweet and the coconut milk was lumpy (powdered? or frozen?). All in all, the cendol was too sweet for comfort due to the red beans. The Kuih Ku came in a variety of colors of red, purple, green, yellow and ash. The green bean filling was the same for all so the colours were just colouring (hopefully they were vegetable colouring)! Because of the colouring, we expected the filling to be different - a disappointment. Our two jugs of tea was strongly laced with chlorine! We could taste it that the tea which looked like colored water plus chlorine!What surprised us was the continuous flow of customers coming into the restaurant as we walked in at 2:30pm and we waited 15 minutes for a table. There were only 8 tables so that accounted for the line. We left at 3:45 and customers were still coming in! When is lunch-time for the Malaccans?All in all, we agreed that lunch at another Malacca cuisine restaurant the day earlier was better.Show less

Author: 881tayk
Title: Kuehs not fresh nor tasty
Review: Visited Malacca again after a 2-year break. Went back to Nancy’s kitchen as usual to buy kuehs before driving back to Singapore. I’ve just tried all the kuehs at home. They were terrible. The kueh salet was warm at the shop leading me to think that it was freshly made. However, it’s not. It must have been frozen and microwaved or steamed to sell for the day. It tastes stale. Waste of money. The kueh ku skin is hard and it tastes stale too. Overall, all the kuehs taste bad and are not fresh. I will not be buying kuehs from Nancy’s again unless they improve and I hear good reports from fellow travelers in future. It’s sad to see a once good restaurant become so bad now. I think the owner needs to wake up to the feedback. Show less

Author: SimoneOngKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Food With Reasonable Price
Review: Nyonya food with reasonable price and big portion. Food taste is just normal to so so. Better online make reservation 1 day before you visit, if not have to wait for long time. As my experience for this time, me and family wait for around 45min. Maybe during CNY and lunch time.Show less

Author: sumianand8902
Title: The food is good
Review: The restaurant is constantly pack... But despite having full house,  they still provide good customer service. And the food is very good. It is better for you to call first before going to avoid disappointment

Author: kruban78
Title: Average but authentic
Review: I really don’t have much to stay. Came here once with family for dinner. Authentic food but didn’t taste that great. Decor is nice and clean. Friendly staff.

Author: Félix M
Title: Great place, great food, great price
Review: Typical Malay food. Good quality, good price & good service. It’s recomendable to make a reservation in advance.

Author: Lucie_Simon_Food
Title: Delicious Peranakan food and fun cooking class
Review: We loved making authentic Peranakan style food, with Nancy. This is a popular family-run restaurant, running cooking classes upstairs. The Nyonya Laksa and Bean paste stew, rich and aromatic, with a perfect balance of savory, sweet and spicy. Utterly divine!

Author: Aliza07
Title: Fantastic buah keluak and chendol
Review: First time to this place recently recommended by tour guide. Best Peranakan food coming from a Peranakan myself!

Author: Woon29Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food
Review: We visited this restaurant based on friend's recommendations.We also made reservation before hand.The best dish is the fried fillet fish and pork. The chap chye and chendiol are just average. But pricing is reasonable.We wanted to try the ondeh ondeh but were already sold out.When we left the restaurant, we heard a group complaining that the food is not good to those queueing and waiting for their table. We felt that they should let the customers try out as it is also subject to individual taste and preference.Show less

Author: MichaelinaChuaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great food
Review: When a restaurant gets really good, food and service often suffers because it’s a matter of feeding so many with less or quicker. This is a restaurant that has managed to upscale its capacity to serve THREE floors of guests from a medium sized kitchen.Eaten here three times and the meals have been excellent. Because it is a Nyonya establishment I can just imagine how meticulous the chef and staff must be to keep it consistent. On all times the fish and seafood have been fresh and the meats divine. I would say in my very limited experience of Nyonya food that the cook has done an absolutely fabulous job at hitting the fine balance of flavours so that you get a spike of sour, a hit of sweet, a rush of savoury or a pop of heat and for those who love the richness of creamy curries, just the enveloping hug of santan.How complex? Cendol. One of my favourite traditional dessert dishes. Sounds easy to make but it can taste as bland as a potato or mind numbing sweet if it’s done wrong. The santan is fresh and the shaved ice is fine. The green cendol is buried in the dark liquid gold of gula melaka. And it all comes in a small bowl that makes your cry for more but just enough to know that it’s good for your soul.Service does tend to be a little cold though perhaps of the long hours. Some of the welcome staff are spot on with catching your eye or hand signal and are quick with their service and helpful. A couple look like they would like you to leave. Understandable since Nancy’s is one of those few restaurants that serve through the from lunch till 9pm for weekends. Otherwise good work everyone!Show less

Author: SohyinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard dropped drastically
Review: Came here because it was near to Encore Melaka and also because of previous good experience at their old premise. However we were quite disappointed with the quality of food. We went to different restaurants and always order a Melaka laksa to try. Nancy’s laksa has to be the worse, rather tasteless and not rich like others. The other dishes were also not impressive. It is definitely not worth the wait if we didn’t pre book a table. Service wise, they were not very good either. Partly because of crowd and not enough staff. So I won’t be going to Nancy’s Kitchen. Just go to nearby Donald and Lily.Show less

Author: YAJNA
Title: Nice restaurent with unique food for Melaka with Portuguese touch
Review:
Quite crowded having 2 floors for sitting 
The menu include for vegetarians as well 
Had good lunch and there is a special menu made of fish , 
All six of us enjoyed and it is a nice place not to be missed

Author: LynnC2551
Title: lunch
Review: the best meal we had in Melaka. Most of the items were nice except the soup was too saltish with the duck meat too hard to chew. and the chap cai was overly cooked. had to pay rm$3 for the sambal chilli

Author: AliciakhyKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Affordable nyonya food
Review: I have been eating at Nancy's Kitchen when it was still located near Jonker Street. To be honest, the food quality has dropped over the years but it is still pretty good. Me and my friend came here from lunch, about 3:30 pm on a Sunday and it wasn't that crowded so we got a seat immediately.We ordered, the sour vegetable and duck soup (S), cencalok egg (M), pogeh pork (S), brinjal chili (S) and assam tamarind fish fillet (S). All this plus 4 rices, and plain water added up to RM 78, which was pretty affordable for a 4 person meal.My favorite was the brinjal chili and assam tamarind fish fillet, but if you are not on a budget, I would suggest getting the fish instead. Also, the ambience at their jonker streeet store previously was more homey and nicer, but it was much smaller. We did not get the cendol this time, but the cendol is pretty good too, so I would suggest you to try that.Show less

Author: melmeleats
Title: Food tastes so amazing!
Review: Affordable food and super tasty as well. What's there not to like? If you're in Melaka and needing some peranakan food, this is the restaurant to go to! My favourite has to be the squid with Petai! super amazing!

Author: Angeline LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing
Review: It was our first trip to Malacca and SO looking forward to the foodie side of Malacca that we heard so much about. We decided on Nancy’s Kitchen for lunch on our first day. Stepped in, it was buzzing and busy downstairs, they sent us upstairs and that’s when the disappointment set in :( It was a ambient-less dining room, empty of any soul or love and clattering with the sounds of plates banging away in the stewarding area as it was right next to the hall! Service was nice and pleasant. Food arrived. Another disappointment :( we were so sad but we ate anyway as we had a whole day of travel and really hungry. Had the tamarind pork (cold and just flavourless. It was slices of pork covered in tamarind paste, literally, with the seeds), had the sour vegetable soup and fried rice and was again just bland and nothing to shout about. Overall, we wouldn’t return and we wouldn’t recommend the upstairs to anyone. Took away everything they’re known for I guess.Show less

Author: FrankiePngSingapore, Singapore
Title: Drop in Food Quality
Review: Had a family of 25 person eating at this restaurant and most felt that the food is mediocre for the first time. I had ate in this restaurant for more than 10 time and ordered almost the same food and also felt the food standard has drop and lost its consistency. The Sambal Udang Petai was not fresh and the prawn meat was so soft and soggy. The only food I ate was nice was their Ayam Pontei and Ayam buah keluak that is still consistent.Show less

Author: 677yenlIpoh, Malaysia
Title: Didn't expect it to be good. Pleasant meal
Review: We long heard that Nancy's kitchen serve very well nyonya food. Few trip down to Melacca didn't get the luck as the queue was always long, plus reservations required. Since our trip is always made impromptu, reservations do not work.Today, we were lucky enough as we reach Nancy's kitchen at 5pm where theres no queue and the food served pretty quickly.Cendol shocked us the most, as it is served in such a small bowl, look so pathetically small, and 2 extra bowls for sharing. But it was good, though it's quite sweet to my preference.Waiter recommend us pork rib with black nut, surprisingly good.I would love to visit again to try some other dishes. Show less

Author: markwcliffordReading, United Kingdom
Title: Fabulous
Review: We tried a few dishes as we wanted the full Nancy's experience. The Spring roll starter was wonderful, the pork with shrimp a powerful taste sensation. The pork in tamarind was fruity, hot and sour with lovely tender meat. The signature chicken candlenut was the standout, however, accompanied by fried ladies fingers. Spicy, tender and full of flavour, this dish was worth the visit alone. Nancy's Kitchen is a foodies' delight!Show less

Author: Andrea_NSCKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Overrated, better food elsewhere
Review: We came here after reading the recommendations online. What came was a big disappointment. For one, the cendol arrived half-melted. We couldn't taste the gula melaka, so we asked for more. The service took so long that the cendol melted even more. When we saw the gula melaka that came, then we understood why we couldn't taste it. It was very diluted, almost watery consistency and lacked that special gula melaka fragrance. Going on to the food, the Nyonya fried bihun was the dish that shocked me the most. Instead of the dry, sour-ish reddish-orangey noodles, what was just the normal wet soy sauce bihun. The assam fish and vegetables were forgettable. I ordered my favorite sambal petai prawns, and it was so bland that frankly, even my neighbourhood dai chow does it better. Overall, there are better places in Melaka for Peranakan food. Try Amy's.Show less

Author: colin1201
Title: a bit inconvenient, but food is rich in flavour
Review:
make a reservation because the place is very crowded.
but the food is very good value, and the flavour of the food is robust.

Author: 253SASingapore, Singapore
Title: Satisfying meal
Review: Nancy’s Kitchen has long been rated as one of the few places to go for good Nyonya food in Malacca, and judging by the crowd at lunch, its reputation is well earned. We found the quality of the food to be good, and we had a very satisfying meal. The restaurant's atmosphere is casual, which gives off the vibe similar to one being invited into a friendly neighbour’s home for some delicious Nonya food We had a prior reservation so we managed to beat the queue. You have been warned.....Show less

Author: p399Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Simply overrated
Review: Ordered 7 varieties of food and all were not fresh and had the worst taste. The only good commendable was pietee In fact found hair in the vegetable dish, have attached the pivot proof too. I guess this would be my first and last visit to this place.Hope Nancy takes this matter seriously before people check out from your place.Show less

Author: Daydream825711
Title: Inauthentic peranakan cuisine
Review: Food lacked flavour, small quantity and pricey. Best to skip this  restaurant if you are looking for authenticity.

Author: DominicSewJurong East, Singapore
Title: Just Average, rather disapointed !!!
Review: My relative brought us there as he was told this is once of the recommended Nyonya Restaurant. 12 of us has ordered difference type of nyonya food like Kueh Piatie, Asam fish, Sambal Udang Petai, Chapchai, Telur Goreng, Soft crab etc. The Kueh Paitie is rather delicious, however telur goreng and asam fish is too salty. Sambal Petai a bit below standard !!! A bit disappointed dining trip.Show less

Author: Michael LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nyonya food was not as good as we had expected
Review: We were expecting very good nyonya food since Nancy's Kitchen featured prominently and ranks near the top of our search for nyonya food in Malacca, the home of nyonya cuisine.We found the food rather average. We had the candlenut chicken which was one of their signature dishes. It was served lukewarm and the chicken was rather tough and too chunky. Service was ok. The place was rather busy on a Friday evening. We think there are better nyonya food options in Malacca.Show less

Author: Shants71Melbourne, Australia
Title: Yummy Family Meal
Review: Really lovely nyonya food with something for everyone in the family. I am always a fan of Itik Tim, which was good here, Kueh Pietee was fresh and tasty, not stale like in some other places. Loved the Lemper as well. For me the Ngo Hiang was the boat disappointing sub-par dish and mostly just flour. The serving staff was courteous and attentive, though the ladies behind the counter were too busy chatting to bother with any niceties.The setting and atmosphere is probably nicer on the ground floor than the functional first floor. You can feel more of the buzz and activity on the ground floor.Overall, it was a good experience :)Show less

Author: Mike_TangSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Nonya Food
Review: Easily accessible by Grab or car. There's a wait list during peak hours but its worth the wait. You get a taste of authentic nonya food. Overall pretty good but I feel they might have tweaked the taste to suit foreigners... Assam and Buah Kurak were slightly sweet versus others i have tasted is more sourish and bitter. If you like Nonya food, this is the place surely.Show less

Author: ColSuku
Title: Nyonya food here is very tasty.
Review: The Nyonya restaurant is one of the best we have visited.  Their Nyonya food is very tasty that the last time we went to Malacca, we went there twice.

Author: 10keziaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tasty lunch at Nancy Kitchen Melaka
Review: As its customary to have Nyonya meal when you are in Melaka, we went to Nancy Kitchen for very late lunch at 3 pm before departing back home to KL.We ordered 4 dishes small size for 3 pax. The sambal prawn with petai is really good to go with rice. The fried fish could do with more chilli paste thou so we need to order extra sambal belacan to go with it. The veges were nicely done. All in all we enjoyed our meal and looking forward to go there again when in Melaka.Show less

Author: Marmitefan58
Title: Disappointed
Review: I was keen to try Nancy’s but was a little disappointed. The candlenut chicken was tasty but served lukewarm, the rice was also lukewarm. The service was not great, staff on their phones not observing customers. The prices are reasonable and there is plenty of choice. Would I return? Possibly notShow less

Author: zuiying68
Title: Crowded place of Nonya Food
Review:
Very crowded place and you had to wait for quite a while before you had a table and the time was around 2pm.
Food was average as I was expecting a heavy taste.
Service was friendly and good.

Author: 18bsr
Title: Crowded place
Review: We were a little bit curious to try out this restaurant, as we had heard so much about it.3 of us came in Saturday before 1pm, this place already full of ppl. We waited for about 15 mins to get seats. We were lucky as we saw some diners were turn away(ask to come the next day).Food we ordered:1) 2 rolls of popiah (fantastic)2) 2 servings of Pai Tee(fantastic)3) Chap Chai (average)4) Ngor Hiang (poor)5) Assam fish (average)6) Udang Lemak (average)The price is reasonable, service is good and fast. We bought the Love letter and kueh Bangkit back home. Was a little disappointing.Hope to be back and try some others dishes.Show less

Author: maroon2533
Title: The food is AMAZING!
Review: Everyone should try the Belacan fried rice. This place has good staff and although its Malaysia, the staff can speak English. This place is great for families for all 3 meals.

Author: sengfattlMalaysia
Title: Nice nyonya cuisine with great services
Review: We come back and dine here because this restaurant provide comfortable ambience. The restaurant offer 3 storey of dining place with fully air conditioning. The q is long yet it manage to clear timely. So no worries with long waiting time. However, still advice to come early, especially weekend. I personally love the nyonya dumplings, onde onde, cendol, and assorted cookies. Of course, not to forget to mention their signature nyonya cuisine. I will come back again... Show less

Author: Robbie OMelbourne, Australia
Title: Great food !
Review: Wonderful food with my favourite dishes being the Top hats and tamarind pork ! ... my family also enjoyed the duck soup... we got there early as we had heard it gets busy and quickly and as we were leaving a queue was forming out the front ! Show less

Author: limcl33Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overrated
Review: We have visited this famous “authentic Nyonya” cuisine on Monday. Haiz~ this worst ever Nyonya food! Buah keluak chicken is dry and tasteless :( Chap Choy was overcooked and it taste weird.. this is the first time we visit this restaurant and probably the last time.Show less

Author: Flyn1170Singapore
Title: Snacks and Kueh Better than Actual Meal
Review: The best part of Nancy’s is the snacks and kueh they sell. Food wise, it has never really been that good. Average Peranakan food at best. Some dishes were generally better than others. The Assam fish was good as was the ayam buah keluak (but be forewarned that the buah keluak, despite that being the dish’s name, does NOT come with the dish. You need to pay per nut). Rest of the dishes were okay. The belacan, which is also chargeable, is average. Both soups we ordered (duck and fish all) were the weakest dishes. Diluted. Service was fine. Despite being busy, the waitress gave very good advice on the portion for the large group of us.she was spot on accurate. There’s was no wastage of food. I’m nearly certain there are better Peranakan restaurants around. But the snacks and kueh, especially the ondeh-ondeh, make the trip worth the effort. Show less

Author: Panda6551Singapore, Singapore
Title: Very Disappointed
Review: They served us what was suppose to be Bakwan Kepiting soup. It was cabbage / carrot soup with meatball. Where were the bamboo shoots ? The chap chye was full of cabbage. Dish was tasteful. The curry fish had nice gravy. Overall dining was not impressive. The only redemption was the chili belacan and chendol. Service was SLOW. Try Lin Cafe.Show less

Author: Melvin_NeoSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing food
Review: Not been to Nancy since it moved to this location. Quality of food has really dropped. There was mainly cabbage in the chap chye and the ngoh hiang was a factory processed meat roll and not real minced meat and prawns. See photo. Very disappointed as food used to be very good in the pastShow less

Author: Desmond C
Title: Delicious Nyonya Cuisine
Review: This restaurant serves delicious authentic nyonya cuisine 😋. We went around 11am to have lunch early before drive back to KL but the shop already almost full of patron. Remember to make reservation to avoid disappointment or long wait ☺️

Author: marvin_ngrwSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Hi Nancy!
Review: Nancy's kitchen is one of the best baba nyonya restaurant that you must try whenever you are in Melaka. The queue worth it all, just be patient and you will enjoy the delicious cuisines. Very crowded over Friday Saturday and Sunday, you may choose to visit during weekdays if you are nearby. Payment has been made easy by GrabPay and Credit Cards unlike many other local restaurants payment by cash only. What must you order? Babi Pongteh, Cincaluk Omelette, Fried Squid and so many others from the menu. NANCY is very friend over at the counter too and their staff are very pleasant. 5 mins to Encore Melaka and 5 mins drive to Jonker Street. Enjoy Nancy's Kitchen you will never go wrong! Show less

Author: 58gayathrij
Title: Ok
Review: Went for lunch ...jst to taste the nonya food here...however wasnt so great...jst overated i guess...the veg dishes were so dry...and over cooked...simply ok

Author: 15aBelleSingapore
Title: Authentic peranakan cuisine
Review: Went with a couple of friends and was blown away by the food. Pure, delicious nonya home cooked food awaits you. We had the banana flower, jackfruit cooked in curry, sambal sotong, duck soup and a lot more. Very flavorful but we find it just a tad salty. Never mind just eat more rice! We even shared a nonya laksa which was awesome. Prices were reasonable but parking can be a nightmare so beware of long waits for parking. Reservations highly recommended so u don’t have to wait too long. There’s no sitting area for you to wait so a lot of people were standing to wait for their turn. If u have old folks or children, just reserve a table in advance. Will definitely be back to eat again if given a chance. Super yums!Show less

Author: PickyPeggy
Title: Not the best
Review:
Give this a miss! There are many other better peranakan restaurants in Melaka.

Beef rendang was dry, chap chye was bland and mainly cabbage, ngoh Hiang tasted like processed food. Only saving grace was the jackfruit curry, only available weekends.

Author: 428peggykSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ms
Review: Visited the restaurant for lunch on 4 Nov, but too crowded. Manage to buy bachang and Nonya Chang back. The ambience was good and nice. The price quite reasonable. The Chang not too bad, but a little salty. Will go back my next trip for lunch or dinner.Show less

Author: hellgalz
Title: An awesome place for nyonya food
Review: Food at nancy's is still the best. Well kept with their taste and authenticity. Cendol is a definite killer, nvr say no to cendol even if you are very full.

Author: MilkplumSydney, Australia
Title: Nice food
Review: We went on a Thursday for lunch (around 1pm) and were seated straight away, even as a walk in. We walked from Jonker St which is seemed far in the hot sun but quite pleasant if you go by the river (which we did on the way back).Ordered the chicken candlenut (great), ngor hiang (nice but not freshly made), popiah (floppy, not great), sweet potato leaves and a kind of scrambled egg dish (tasty).Food came out quickly.Everything was nice enough, and they give plenty of rice, which is good. Portions come in different sizes and small means even couples can try a whole bunch of different things. We ate everything.Nice atmosphere and prices are reasonable! As we left we bought some kuih bangkit and pineapple tarts which I’ve yet to try. The kuih salat (pictured) wasn’t great unfortunately! Very disappointing as I had been hunting all over Melaka for kuih.Show less

Author: Rajasegaran T
Title: Good Nyonya food.
Review: Good food with great taste. Authentic Nyonya food. Only the location is out of the tourist belt. Too far to drive there. Ambience and Decor is great.

Author: javiercard2017Bilbao, Spain
Title: Yummy nyonya food
Review: Nancy's Kitchen has long been the number one place to go for good Nyonya food in Jonker Wal. Its atmosphere isn’t at all pretentious - it's like stepping into a friendly neighbour's dining room for some delicious food, and dishes come piping hot from the kitchen. Try out their sek bak (braised pork) and sambal sotong petai (sambal squid with bitter beans) with white rice for the ultimate finger-licking experience. Nyonya popiah, pineapple tarts, and Nyonya cendol are also sold here for visitors who can’t get enough of Nyonya tantalising delicacies.Show less

Author: JannChiaAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Rating of 4/5
Review: We were craving for nyonya food yday and decided to try this restaurant. II think the food is nice but not sure whether is the best nyonya food in malacca as i have never try other nyonya restaurants so unable to compare. There are so many other options in malacca so will definitely try out new restaurant instead of coming back here. We forgot to order their pai tee which i think should be nice. The place is quite nice. Service was also ok. We didnt have to wait long for the food. Show less

Author: Epitome_6
Title: Nice selection of nyonya kuih
Review: Onde-onde is my favourite and theirs are not too sweet. The nyonya dumpling is also very delicious. Would return to try their dishes since we were rushing to go to another destination.

Author: CoolhealthKota Kinabalu, Malaysia
Title: Busy Nonya kitchen
Review: This is a popular destination for locals and visitors alike. There is limited seating and best to call for reservations.Nancy’s offers the traditional Nonya dishes and also some less common ones.Service is prompt even to the point of feeling rushed.Being small it is cosy and can be noisy.Overall good value for money and one should at least visit once.Show less

Author: alvinwlsaw
Title: So-so only.
Review: Have tried much better/tastier nyoya food before. Nothing much to shout about. Dabel chicken curry was a total disappointment.

Author: Daniella SMaidstone, United Kingdom
Title: Food was ok
Review: We were taken to this restaurant by a local and told it was authentic Peranakan food so we were quite excited to taste. Plus we know malacca was an old port town with various spices coming though so wondered what the flavours would be. We ordered around 6 dishes for 3 of us to share. To be honest it was a bit of a let down as the food seemed quite bland to me. The chicken curry was bland, the sour prawn soup wasn’t sour enough, the steamed okra was only ok with the chilli sauce dip. The rice was ok.We were hungry and appreciated the recommendation so it was ok but I honestly wouldn’t eat there again.Plus he fact that it was quite busy so they put us up on the 3rd floor which is basically a store room with 3 tables so we were surrounded by boxes and packages as we ate, a bit unusual and not a full peranakan experience for me.Show less

Author: KLG77
Title: Sunday Lunch
Review:
The restaurant always pack so it is advisable to go there earlier.

The food is yummy and delicious.  It is suitable for kids too. They also sell nyonya kueh too.

When you in Melaka, should go there as you won’t regret it.

Author: TheangMing
Title: Love the food and the friendly waiters
Review: My second visit to this restaurant. The food still as yummy and the price is very reasonable. Steam lady’s fingers is a must try it comes with a spicy and sour sauce which blend so well with the Vege.

Author: juvinseeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Miscommunication
