Review: We enjoyed a delicious meal here. Try the ayam buah keluak - it's delicious, and very interesting.  Good beef rendang and a lovely fresh sambal belacan.

Author: 647merlinaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Food, Reasonable Price
Review: You will not get such authentic Peranakan food out of Malacca. Finally had the chance to taste a really good Chicken Pong Teh. All that I had previously was no where in comparison. A simple Daun Keledek Garlic was cooked to perfection. Love the simple yet tasty Cendol with quality Gula Melaka.Show less

Author: KwanO8Singapore
Title: Aunty Lee @ Ujong Pasir, Melaka
Review: Jus visited the restaurant over the weekend, learnt tat Aunty had passed away last year, so sad. BUT the food is still at it BEST , no change in taste. Thanks to the daughter whom I think has the recipe . My recommendation to all those tat if you visit Melaka , you must try to find this place, not difficult, as about 10 mins drive from Jonker or Melaka Raya.The curry mutton, the chilli deep fried fish. the new fresh scallop with garlic n gingerand of course the chendol and sago with gula melaka.Take note tat there is another one next to the highway with the same name, But what I recommend here is the one at Ujong PasirShow less

Author: S YBandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam
Title: Yum nyonya food
Review: Food was great, but only reachable by cars. Love the special dishes I never had in my life before, like Cincalok Omelette.Show less

Author: DrFeelGood9133Singapore, Singapore
Title: Oh my taste buds... delicious nyonya dish
Review: Was recommended this quaint little restaurant for authentic nyonya cuisine. Found the gem! Ayam Buah Keluak. A very difficult and rare dish of chicken and black nuts ( this nuts have to be processed for 3 months before being edible) so many restaurants shun from making this dish. Also had their sambal petai prawns - stink beans with chilli sambal and prawns... Wow... this I indeed a rare find. I as a foodie recommend this place! Show less

Author: Daniel L
Title: Authentic Nonya Food
Review: Friendly staff, good food, prompt service. Small place. Enjoyed the red / Sambal type chicken, Sambal Kangkong, rendang. Fabulous and tasty. They close on tuesdays so we had to come back again on Wednesday but worth the trip.

Author: jyshaiButterworth, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: I love their curry mutton but the sambal petai was a bit too hot for my liking. Service is good and food portion is big.Show less

Author: 398limwSingapore, Singapore
Title: Value for Money
Review: We visited this place ten years ago, it was only 1/3 of its size. Despite the expansion, the homely feel is still there. We had Ikan Assam Pedas which was awesome. The size was huge though It was supposed to be small but the freshness is fantastic. The spicy sourness brought out its inherent sweetness. Yummy! The other dishes were good too but we really like the sambal sweet potato leaves and the ayam goreng. The duck soup was too salty so it is not recommended. The lemak prawn nanas was v good too but the beef rendang was average. Ayam Goreng which was fragrant and crispy as well. Show less

Author: SamuelOngKajang, Malaysia
Title: Not bad
Review: The nyonya food are modern type , if you are looking for original nyonya foods this is not the place. The food here are mostly spicy not recommended for a bunch of kids. Cendol is a must try. Show less

Author: KnixL
Title: Nice food, nice service & nice boss
Review: I been recommend by friend to visit this restaurant & they did not disappoint me with their yummy foods. The best I like is Lemak Nanas Prawn.

Author: Mouse-PrincessSingapore
Title: Not worth the visit if u are foodie n tourist
Review: Was in Meleka for wedding dinner. Host booked this restaurant and said the best Chengdol.Total disappointment on the Chengdol. Host has preordered the food so we were supposed to have all their specialty but all the dishes were just very average in taste. I am ok to eat there if I live around there and out of convenience. Definitely not worth the visit as a tourist ... Show less

Author: AlicenNgTKPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good authentic nyonya Malacca food
Review: Excellent nyonya Malacca home cooked food. The mutton curry is a Must Try! It's tender, full of spices, no mutton smell at all! Another dish is the Sambal Petai, it's superb awesome! The ikan bilis (small fried anchovies) are crispy that goes so well with the fresh petai. A Must Try! Cendol here is good too. The drawback of this shop is there's no car park as the shop is quite small and it's quite out of the town area. You need a car or take a taxi to get there. Show less

Author: BBB_RiderSingapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Nonya Food
Review: First time here, recommended by a Penang friend. We offered the following:1) Tempura fried fish sweet n Sour (black sauce) - 9/102) fried chicken - 8.5/103) chap cai (mixed vege' Nonya style) - 9/104) fried egg with "chai por" - 8/105) sambal blachan (chargeable at Rm$3/=) 10/10** to die for!Prices are slightly steep I felt but most authentic Nonya restaurants are not cheap.We took a grab car from Hatten to the Restuarant at about RM$7/=. Short 10 min drive. Coming back might be a challenge as we took a while to get a grab on a weekday evening.Show less

Author: louis899Vancouver, Canada
Title: Excellent Nyonya Cuisine
Review: We ordered sweet potato leave, steamed chilly fish and chicken pongteh. The chicken and vegetable were very good.The chilly fish was too spicy for us.There are other fish dishes however.I also ordered chendol for dessert and the shaved ice and gula Melaka ( palm sugar) , put in a small cup separately for you, was great!Restaurant offers a wide choice of nyonya dishes but do inform the staff when placing your order whether you prefer your dish spicy or otherwise.Service was efficient and staff friendly and multi lingual.Car park is not a problem.Just park further down the road.Restaurant also sells gula Melaka and homemade kaya.Show less

Author: Q5atSimeiSingapore
Title: Not impressed
Review: The reviews I read gave it top marks but I wàsnt impressed by the food. The fried sea bass was so so..the sambal kang kong was ok. Nothing really stood out. The place was packed though with diners even at 3pm long after lunch. The food was not bad but not something I would die die go back to eat.Show less

Author: Elain386
Title: Excellent nyonya food
Review:
Food are authentic, reasonably price. 
Restaurant a bit crowded , as tables are placed quite near to each other. 
Recommended dishes: itik tim, lemak nenas, and the cendol

Author: AlvinC1157
Title: Its good
Review: Food's Great...Great place...Comfortable..And Good Service....Especially the Fish Cli Garam...Its taste just perfectly nice....Show less

Author: marilyne2375
Title: Quaint setting
Review: Nice family themed peranakan restaurant. Nice and friendly staff. Food was tasty but on the pricey side for the portions received.

Author: ongt2013Singapore, Singapore
Title: Authentic Paranakan food
Review: I was recommended to try this restaurent by my friend. I arrived Malacca and took about 15min to locate this place as its a bit out of town. The taste is really good especially the fried brinjal and the sambal prawn with petai (stinky beans). Chendol is also very good. Service is very good and friendlyShow less

Author: flyingace28Malaysia
Title: Good nyonya food
Review: The dishes were really delicious. We had the fish tempra, limau purut chicken, pong teh chicken, radish omelette, sambal Ikan bilis. Pie tee was served quite differently, quite nice, but pricey. The sambal Ikan bilis & limau purut chicken was excellent! Full of flavor and really authentic. Not too missed is their sambal belacan,,,,,but it comes with a price,,rm3. We realized that in Melaka, sambal is not complimentary, unlike other states like KL or Penang. However, being spicy food lovers, we just had to try. And we did not regret, it was good! Really fresh n spicy. book in advance for a table, as the place is not that big.Place is in a residential area, bit tricky to find.Show less

Author: atpy88Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good place for peranakan cuisine
Review: Made reservations via restaurant website and pre ordered our dishes. Thumbs up for their prompt response of confirmation the next day. Brought my Korean friends here for lunch, they enjoyed it! As a half peranakan myself, their dishes were lovely, almost close to home. Loved their cendol with thick coconut milk. Area for improvement would be keeping up their dishes standards. There was lack authenticity taste as compared few years back (when the restaurant owner was still around) Show less

Author: aflame_SGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Average Nyonya Food in Melaka
Review: Visited this Nyonya restaurant for the first time with my family during on of the weekends trip to Melaka. Luckily we reservation ahead of time, the place was quite packed when we arrived. Ordered Ayam Pong Teh, Chai Poh Omelette, Kangkung and Nyonya Chap Chai. All the food were as expected except the Chap Chai that was below par.The chendol we had was quite nice, loved the gula melaka. But was a bit pricey. All in all, the dining experience was quite alright.Show less

Author: Noelle T
Title: Must have their Cendol
Review: It was rather difficult to order as it was only the two of us. Yet, we really enjoyed all 3 dishes we had : the Pie Tee set, Chicialok omelette and the Chili garam prawns. The food was homemade and authentic. The pie tee condiments were freshly grated and prepared which is fantastic. Just when we thought we couldn't have any more food, we decided to share a cendol, wow, it was heavenly. A generous separate cup of gula melaka came separately from the cendol so you can decide how sweet you want your cendol to be. It was just a simple bowl of no frills cendol but the taste is just perfect. The price is slightly on the high side but it's worth the money.Show less

Author: Lina_TanSGSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best and real authentic Nonya Cuisine in Malacca
Review: After losing our way, we finally made it to the restaurant. As we have booked and ordered beforehand, the dishes were served quite promptly. Everyone agreed that the Nonya cusine were the best we have eaten so far. The Ayam buah keluak had a generous serving of the buah keluak and was very delicious. The pineapple curry fish is another winner. The lady fingers and sambal petai with prawn were done beautifully. The cincalok egg omelette was very nice compared to the ones we had at other Nonya restaurants.This is a must visit place if you want authentic Nonya cuisine.Show less

Author: HelloChrisTanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food with a little more love...that is a little off town..
Review: Aunty Lee might not be right smack in the heart of Jonker like the rest of supposedly good Peranakan restaurants, but it has been worth the extra travel for me to get to. The travelling has actually given me a chance to explore the other areas of Melaka, and find other nice eats along the way. hehehe..Sitting in a row of shophouses along Ujong Pasir, is a vibrant purple shopfront that your eyes wouldn't miss. This will where you will find the good food of Aunty Lee. Many locals come here, but over the years the restaurant has gained some popularity and bus loads of tourists have been flooding the place.Sometimes i struggle with the thought of local homely places that has become popular. It's like i am happy that their business is doing well. But at the same time, i am afraid of the drop in standard. The last time i was here, was about 1.5 years ago, i am glad that i still like the food 1.5 years later.My all time favourite dishes - Cili Garam (fried fish with a chilli paste on top), Cinjalok egg, Lady's fingers with another type of dip and of course, a Peranakan meal is never complete without having Buah Keluak.Show less

Author: Yeoh M
Title: 1 day trip with friend.. Cari makan.. 👍👍😍😍
Review: The food is nice.. The environment also not bad.. The homemade pie tie is nice.. Just a bit too expensive.. Show less

Author: genekhooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Still same good quality after all these years
Review: Visited them many years ago. Still good quality, authentic Peranakan food. However, prices have increased substantially. Convenient parking available 3 minutes' walk away.Show less

Author: Rororo97Singapore, Singapore
Title: first time
Review: first time to Aunty lee. Food was alright except the chap chai which wasn't tasty.Location is not very near the central town area about 15 mins drive from mahkota areaShow less

Author: VickyLimXSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Nyonya taste - will definitely return
Review: My family of four walk in for dinner without reservations last Saturday.Restaurant was already running full even thou' we walked in at exactly 6pm ( opening dinner hours)We did not wait for long before we were offered a table for four at a corner of the restaurant near the kitchen.Overall service was good and the standards of the nyonya cuisine were generally high. We clean up all the 5 dishes ordered ( with special mention to the Nyonya fish Tempra which was fried to perfection and the sauce was divine) like there's no tomorrow.Cendol is a must have for a visit to the restaurant. Definitely bringing back friends/ other family member to the restaurant in my next visit to Malaca.Show less

Author: KelLy L
Title: Melaka Trip
Review: The most authentic cendol that I have. Must try sweet and sour fish. Clean and friendly environment. Fast order too :)

Author: SheleneSaw
Title: Food Nyonya visit
Review: Complete brilliance!! Coming back again for sure!! Recommend the Chilli Garam Fish and the cendol with thick Gula Melaka. Cozy and warm staff!

Author: Nelsonw289
Title: Aunty Lee
Review: This is one of our favorite restaurant, we always come here to dine whenever we are in malacca. The pongteh, bukelah chicken are the must have.

Author: Loong Zhen G
Title: Excellent dishes!
Review: The food here is amazing,we've tried ordering one of their fishes comes with tempura sauce.Their omelet taste freakin good too!

Author: Jermaine L
Title: Melaka trip
Review: The food is nice :) the food was prepared very quickly! The price is reasonable, and the people here are nice and friendly!

Author: Juanyang0221
Title: Auntie Lee Nyonya Food
Review: The food here is nice and they serve food very quickly. The price is also very reasonable. I'll definitely recommend this place to my friends.

Author: haksoonchia28Petaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Lunch visit
Review: We went there and ordered Jenahak Fish ,Ayam ponteh,petai ikan bilis.Cincalua eggs and sweet potatoes vegetables. The ayan ponteh was good but the snapper fish was horrible.The fish chilli sauce taste worst than a malay hawker stall.The price was very expensive. They charge us the fish at 100 per kilo. The normal price is 45 at the most.Maybe they know we are not local.Never go there againShow less

Author: spacer0cket
Title: Food ok, but lousy service & expensive
Review: We came after hearing about the authentic nyonya food from friends. Food was ok but nothing to shout about. The price is on the higher side tho, and the experience was not very pleasant. Firstly the person taking the order said ok to all our orders. But the the drinks came wrongly done. A drink which I cancelled earlier ended up being served, while 2 other juices which I requested for without ice came with ice. The waiter bringing the drinks were of course unhappy and said he was just following the order chit. In the end he changed the drink for me but I suspect that he just threw away the ice & added in water to make the cup fuller. The service was also bad, I had to pull the side table to place our drinks by myself cos when I requested from the waiter, he said that it's 'there' and gestured for me to go over to the other side of my table to get it myself. Towards the end, a waiter stood nearby and asked if we have finished eating cos they have started packing up. By 9:45pm he was standing thee taking whichever plate that we finished.Show less

Author: shlim1188Singapore
Title: Food, Drinks and services
Review: Visited on 1st May 2016, very disappointed.Food - so so, not that fantastic.Drinks & Juice - extremely lousy. some of us order Soursop Juice, Apple Carrot and orange Juice, all their juice are extremely diluted, does not taste like jucie but water.Service - even worst, very slow, un-friendly. Very rude.The put a jar of ice water on the table but did not provide cups, how to drink water without cups ?In conclusion, if they don't improve their service and food and drinks quality, will not go there is have other choice.Show less

Author: iloveperthMalaysia
Title: Not so awesome
Review: Visited last Saturday was greatly disappointed. It was overcrowded because they cater to bus load of tourists now. Their dishes are overpriced and mass cooked, has lost its authentic touch. Was told that this restaurant was sold but its name still remains.Show less

Author: 585ming
Title: My favourite stop
Review: I first came to know this restaurant in August 2014. The food was so delicious that I have made a few trips there since then. I even brought my in-laws there and last December, a couple of foreign colleagues. They enjoyed the food. I have tried a number of dishes and they were all good and I will endeavor to try out other dishes in my future trips. My top 3 favourites are the ayam limau purut (curry), lemak nenas with prawns and fried sweet potato leaves. And a good meal for me will not be complete without their Cendol Gula Melaka - the palm sugar they use is of good grade. The fragrant sweetness is heavenly!If you have a big group, I would recommend making a reservation and pre-order the dishes online especially if you're planning for a weekend do. I will follow up on my reservation with a call just to ensure they have received it. They have a website: www.auntylee.com.myShow less

Author: RynnnaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Peranakan food for the soul
Review: Knowing that it would be packed especially on the weekend, we made a reservation about a month in advance. We called to confirm our reservation the day before and were pleasantly surprised when the person on the other line knew for what time and for how many persons. While Aunty Lee's is a little further off from the regular haunts of tourists in Melaka, it didn't stop foodies from driving a little further for what I can only describe as one step closer to Grandma's cooking. Parking was not the easiest being around the residential areas and there were many places we couldn't park in, but that was not about to deter us. The chefs take great pride in their craft and it shows in the bountiful flavors that does a little dance in your mouth as you take each bite. What was impressive though was the pride that the servers took in promoting the dishes. From describing the process to making the perfect buah keluak, to what dishes go well together, makes you salivate and wonder why do the dishes not magically appear on your table. A regular evening at Aunt Lee's is just like reunion dinner at Grandma's; its so loud that you can't hear what the person across the table from you is saying, there's so much activity you barely have room to move, but it feels, smells, and tastes like home.Show less

Author: sakthin
Title: Everything we are was delicious
Review: I loved the food,everything we are here was delicious.The tempra fish was delicious and fried chicken is the best I have tasted.Can't wait to come back to melaka to try the rest of the food in the menu.

Author: cymkl
Title: Its the best
Review: Every single dish is fantastic. Its the best Peranakan food ever. Staff are friendly and polite. We have eaten there a couple of times and will definitely return again.

Author: ThingYanTShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: So good. Nothing can describe better
Review: Oh Gosh... After being stuck in all the touristy restaurants like in the Portuguese Settlement and Jonker street, finally I know what is authentic and tasty.This is my first time eating Baba Nyonya food in Melaka and I started off my meal with Nyonya Kuih Pie Tee. I was so lucky that the chef was in good mood to make this appetizer that was not in the menu. This is so good! The pie crust was so thin, the filling was so tasty and I wish the sambal could be spicier. I ordered three other dishes that were recommended by the waiter. They were very good especially the fish. Fresh and crispy! The restaurant is also very clean and tidy with air conditioning. I will totally come back here again!Show less

Author: allansakhoo
Title: Undisputedly Authentic
Review: Undisputedly the most authentic peranakan cuisine in Melaka. We ordered the Chicken Buah Keluak, Fish Lemak Nenas, Anchovies Sambal Petai, Omelette Cincalok & Kangkung Belacan.The service was good & the food came within 10 minutes.The Chicken Buah Keluak was well marinated & oozing with a burst of flavors. Each of us was given a mini fork to dig out the "flesh" from the keluak shell.The Fish Lemak Nenas was cooked to perfection & the fish tasted fresh & firm. It blended well with the rich & delicious gravy mixed with sweet pineapple wedges.The Anchovies Sambal Petai was fried just right with onions, petai slices and crispy anchovies.The Omelette Cincalok offered a savory delight & the Kangkung Belacan, though common, complemented well.After such a great meal, we hardly had room for dessert.For drinks we ordered soursop which came with generous strips of its fruit & tasted refreshingly great!For a sumptuous meal like this, the total bill came up to RM150.Show less

Author: Jason H
Title: Slightly costly
Review: The foods are ok in general but I feel that it's slightly costly for local people like me. Not sure about other days but the asam fish I took on 14Feb was awful and smelly! Maybe there were too many customers on that day? Anyone here got similar experience?Show less

Author: SumiologyLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Poor
Review: Average taste. I think the tourist who give good reviews are not familiar with authentic Peranakan food. Having grown up in Melaka i can attest that good here is mediocre. Nancy's kitchen definitely has better variety and taste. Food portions are small especially for the fish - huge hike up from market price.Show less

Author: Adrian922704Nilai, Malaysia
Title: a good restaurant with big portions and excellent service
Review: Today i had dinner at the restaurant and i must say their portions are huge for a peranakan restaurant, be sure to order the fried chicken and mutton curry you wont regret it, my only advise is to book a head of time to avoid having to wait and also skip the chap choy as i found it to be sub par with other restaurants in melakaShow less

Author: samueldarknightPenang, Malaysia
Title: Unique food
Review: I wouldn't say this restaurant is appropriate for all but for me, this is a good place to have a great nyonya cuisine. Very unique I would say.I had the Ayam Pongteh, which compared to my previous review of fat cupid's Ayam Pongteh in Langkawi, has a more herbal/spice/natural flavour to it. It tasted unique and light, I could easily eat more, which I did.I also had the beef rendang which is compared to the Ayam Pongteh, a stronger flavoured dish. It's packed with flavours of spices and it goes well with rice. The beef is tender and it easily breaks down in your mouth. The two dishes above which I highlighted is great.Everything else I had was above average. Overall this restaurant is a must go if you really want to try some nyonya food.Great food, great service.And it only serves dinner.Show less

Author: 489lawrencec
Title: Awesome baba and Nyonya food
Review:
Food is awesome and must call to book in advance. It's pack to the brim!
Sambal petai, terung grill and the itik soup is soulful. Can taste the Nyonya-ness

Author: Graciie23
Title: Great Authentic Peranakan Food
Review: I have been searching for good authentic Peranakan food and finally found this after my 4th visit to Melaka! Not naming others but those Peranakan restaurants at and near Jonker aren't something to rave about.Emailed and made reservations with Jasmine from Aunty Lee to secure seats and lucky I did so. It was super crowded when I arrived near to 1pm on a weekend.Their ayam buah keluak (I ordered extra keluak too) is super sedap! We cleaned up the plate including the sauce! The cincalok egg omelette and chap chai were cooked nicely too.I will be back to Aunty Lee for my next visit! Show less

Author: janson71
Title: It's delicious nyonya food!
Review: Great nyonya food here. Very delicious and the pricing is reasonable. Go early to avoid a large crowd!

Author: Robertng168
Title: Lunch for 3
Review: Has lunch with my family. Food is excellent and service is good. It is located away from there tourist belt but they came by bus load. They also sell belacan, curry powder etc. Would come back again when in Malacca..

Author: ekeviny78
Title: Delicious Peranakan food!
Review:
One word - Scumptious!! 
Perfect meal for our lunch as we head back home. Well cook and cendol was excellent too. 
The only low light was fried chicken. Just average. But the rest was brilliant. 
A must go place .

Author: Shane190373
Title: Great place to eat out
Review: Family from Malaysia took us to this restaurant and we loved the traditional food. We went during the week. It is a very small restaurant with airconditioning. Most the time you apparently need ti book. Worth a visit. Near the Portuguese Settlement area.

Author: 211selinan
Title: Authentic Nyonya food
Review: What a fantastic find.  Enjoyed their Gulai Nenas with sumptuous shrimps and Dried Shrimp kerabu cucumber. Reservation required if you decide to visit this restaurant after 7pm. A must-try in Malacca.

Author: 402theresajKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Delicious Nonya food
Review: Friends recommended us to try Aunty Lee's Nonya food so just before heading back to KL we stopped over to have lunch there.It was a little difficult locating her restaurant but we manage to reach there just in time for lunch. Thank goodness we had reservations as the place was full.The restaurant was small with about 8 tables. Quite a tight setting. We immediately placed our orders and the food was served quite fast.We had fish Assam pedas, chicken lim au purit, chap chai, bending Ilan, and Otak-Otak. For drinks we had chrysanthemum tea and sour sop juice. All-in the bill came up to Rm117 for three of us. Overall the food was tasty and service was good.Show less

Author: 264eddielMelbourne, Australia
Title: One of the best ever .... Peranankan cuisine
Review: With a group of friends. We decided to explore this place that many people strongly recommends that going Melaka. This is the place to have a seriously good meal of nonya / Perankan cuisine.Restaurant was not flash but walking into the restaurant having booked. You can feel that this is the place to be. It's packed, everyone appears to be having their spicy meals ... Wholeheartedly feeling contended.From curry fish to curry chicken to prawns, to sambal Kang kong, even the deep fried calamari was very good, otak ... Melts in the mouth. It's simply awesome.The Chendol , or dessert was one of the best comparable with the best in Penang.I can't wait to make another trip to Aunty LEE.Show less

Author: pamcyySingapore
Title: Best Nonya food in Melaka
Review: Tried a couple peranakan restaurant in Melaka and none come close to Aunty Lee. They serve truly authentic and delicious nonya dishes that's totally worth travelling the distance for. We had the sambal fried fish, cincalok omelet, beef rendang, curry chicken, chap chye, otah and duck soup. All were very very yummy! If we had to choose favourites, it would be the curry chicken, chap chye and fried fish.Service was pretty satisfactory and we didnt have to wait too long for our food. Show less

Author: FromKluangMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Great Nyonya Foods
Review: Have dinner with KL and JB friends at Aunty Lee in Aug15.The quality of foods still maintain.Recommend foods;1. Duck soup - itek-tim2. Fish chilli garam3. Fried chicken4. Sambar prawn5. Chincalo eggs6. Steam lady finger7. Ponteh chicken8. mixed vegetable9. Kangkong Belachan.10. Otak-otak11. Redang chicken12. Mutton curry.Show less

Author: StanleyGohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Nyonya Food In The Malacca Tradition
Review: While there are many restaurants in Malacca serving Nyonya dishes, this is one of the very few to have truly authentic Nyonya dishes like those served by Nyonya ladies of the older generation. There used to be a long waiting time before your food is served, but with new and younger cooks manning the kitchen, waiting time has been cut and piping hot dishes are at your table in about half an hour.As there tend to be an influx of Singapore customers especially during the weekend, customers should try to reserve a table before turning up to avoid having to wait for the next available table.Service is good.Show less

Author: szetwinnePetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Don't mind coming back for more
Review: Recently got to know about this restaurant. The food isn't exceptionally great, but I really enjoyed the food, and the fish is fresh and yummy!Twice I went at about 9pm and there was no queue. The restaurant people told us to come on weekdays instead of weekends or public holidays to avoid the crowd. The staff are very friendly.I would definitely come back once in a while.Show less

Author: 13_MelAustralia
Title: Excellent food and no wait
Review: We ate at this place several times including twice on the one day. On each occasion the staff were very friendly and helpful. The food came promptly and we could not fault it. We had a wide variety of dishes and I would definitely recommend eating there.Show less

Author: Wendy T
Title: Food Excellent!  Long Wait
Review: True to many reviews, the food was good.  Try the fried fish with chilli and the chicken curry.  It is really good.   However, we waited close to 1.5 hr for the food.  Staff friendly, though.   Should try the restaurant if you can wait.   Overall, Good!

Author: ragamuffinkidSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quite Average
Review: Had dinner there on the day I arrive Malacca. I have heard of this place so I wanted to try. It's not really to the expectation in general, but it wasn't so bad until it's not edible. The Cincalok Omelette didn't seem to have a lot of Cincalok. Nonya Chap Cai is decent. Chendol - it's served as a big bowl since there were 10 of us, and not served as individuals. Aunty Lee Friend Chicken - YESSS! Maybe because I love fried chicken )Service - Pretty good and attentive. That's the plus point.Show less

Author: Feli C
Title: Overrated Peranakan Restaurant
Review: Went there for dinner with high expectations when read many were impressed with the Peranakan food there. The ambient at the upper floor of the restaurant did not felt awesome. We ordered their famous dishes like chilli garam fish, fried chicken, cencaluk egg and chap chai. Hero of all these dishes is the fried chicken while the rest were unacceptable. Chilli garam fish (small) cost RM52 was over fried so it was super crunchy overall, flesh was not moist but super dry. Cencaluk egg was salty here and there around the fried egg and not evenly tasty. The chap chai did not look and smell apertizing at all unfortunately. Wish I didn't need to write such an awful review but sorry it's the truth about this overrated restaurant :(Show less

Author: KookaaqJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Average
Review: Visited this place for lunch on a Sunday afternoon. Food was ok, not to say very good but acceptable. Pricing is on the high side. I think a glass of plain water for 60 cents is ridiculous. Also their chendol is stingy on red beans. Carpark is limited.Show less

Author: Stoney7788
Title: Great good and Gd price
Review: Lots of great nonya food and had good fish n squid dishes. Spicy and yet consistently yummy would highly recommend for those going outside the city to discover new bites

Author: LipSengYapKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best Nyonya Food EVER!
Review: Look no further, if you fancy Nyonya cuisine, this is the place to be. Been here many years back and they are still as good. They still prepare and cook the traditional nyonya ways, highly recommended to order the Ayam Limau Purut and Cincalok Fried Eggs.Show less

Author: Handsome128
Title: overrated
Review: food is ok but overrated, more like a home cook kind of food, service is very good, price is acceptable

Author: ChangPing
Title: nice traditional food
Review:
I like food and service here.. it is like home cook by mom 

wonderful feeling shall try and will be back soon

Author: kelvinkoh
Title: Great Nonya Food
Review: If you are ever in Malacca, don't miss the peranakan food at this place. In particular, don't miss the Udang Lemak Nenas - Its prawn and pineapple cooked with coconut milk and spices! It's to die for!!

Author: Amy T
Title: Good Peranakan food
Review: In terms of taste and service , food was reasonably good. Try their cencaluk omellete and chicken keluak ..really nice ! We missed out on ayam pongteh cos we ordered quite a lot of others .Worth a visit.

Author: POH LENG YSingapore, Singapore
Title: Food quality feedback
Review: I've eaten here before - and have even recommended friends. Tonight was a total disappointment. The ikan chilli garam was not crispy and not salted at all. Came out bland and swarthed in oily sambal. The sambal bendi was equally tasteless. Cecaluk was too salty. Petai sambal dish had too much ikan bills and few dehydrated petai. If they do not improve back to their original standards- forget about returning here :(Scale of 1-10 I'd give 2Show less

Author: AgnesW1
Title: Short trip
Review: This place is by far the best nyonya food I had tasted. We didn't have to wait for a long time for food to be served. Everything were delicious and service excellent. Will recommend everyone to try the food there. Yummy.

Author: LumbazzKuala Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Heaven
Review: Arrived with my wife and parents to this restaurant around 1:15PM and was still greeted a welcoming into the restaurant. A first sight, the decoration was simple but somehow still special.We had ordered four five items on:1. Friend Egg with Cincalok: 3 out of 5, couldn't taste much of the cincalok. This could either due to the egg had been over cooked or there wasn't enough cincalok but overall still enjoyed the dish2. Otak Otak: 5 out of 5, enough said it was just that awesome3. Lady Finger with Sambal: 5 out 5, another gem in the restaurant. Sambal that came with the lady finger was awesome, not spicy and just blended well with the lady fingers4. Chicken: 5 out of 5, never had I tasted just soft and perfectly cooked chicken. (Forgive me for not remembering the name of the chicken). It so well cooked that you could even taste the gravy within the chicken itself.5. Cendol: 4 out of 5, the gula melacca isn't any ordinary gula malacca. The family could break down of it's contents. At first the gula malacca is bitter then sweet. A great dessert non the less.Overall, the we paid what we get for and I would not hesitate to come back here again in my future endeavors. Thank Aunty Lee!Show less

Author: johnofklKuala Lumpur
Title: Good food
Review: I have read some good and bad reviews of this place on tripadvisor. During our visit, we ordered many dishes and although some were average, most of the dishes were actually very good - better than any other Nyonya place I've had in Melaka so far, and I've had quite a few.A word of warning - plan your visit in advance! Call a few days ahead to book and order your food by telephone. Their website has the menu (a google search will also turn up various food review blogs have dish recommendations with pictures) This will ensure minimal waiting time for a table and for the food.My personal favourites were the:1. Prawns Lemak Nenas. The prawns were fresh, big and not overcooked. The slight spiciness of the curry was tempered by the sweetness of pineapples and a good amount of coconut milk.2. Fried chicken. The chicken had been marinated in local spices and was served to us freshly fried. Hot, fragrant and crispy. 3. Kerabu Timun4. Chicken Buah KeluakShow less

Author: jklee6PJ
Title: The Best
Review: Everything was good. Best Nyonya food I've had (and I've had quite a few, mind you) in Selangor, KL & Melaka. The place was nice and cozy too. If I had to recommend one dish, it'd be the "Udang Lemak Nenas" (prawns in pineapple...gravy). Just be sure to check that they're open on that night that you plan to visit (I think they're closed on Tues)Show less

Author: mcleeSingaporeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not Bad
Review: Had our lunch here. Our group of 12 was packed to a small table just enough for us. Amble parking was available in an open space beside the building that housed te restaurant. Restaurant was small and squeezy. Food was not bad and I will give it a slightly above average rating. The fried chicken and fish was great. The service was average....one staff trying to take many orders and the cooking really took a while. Overall, it was an average experience for nice home cook food.Show less

Author: David H
Title: Always Excellent, Authentic Peranakan Cuisine
Review:
Not sure about some of the other reviews, but our meal was as good as before and I think the omelette was better. 
Tried a few new dishes and enjoyed them all. The sambas is very tasty.

Author: Deslim
Title: Salty and Mediocre
Review:
Food (egg omellete and soup) was very salty. Very disapointed as this a family trip and we had looked forward to good nonya food. What a dampenener.

Other dishes were nomal and not nonya in essence. Not recommended.

Author: jervenus0932
Title: Ordinary home-styled cooking with 5 star hotel pricing!!
Review: Wasn't my initial choice but visited this restaurant due to huge crowds in other nyonya restaurants in my list, got to know Aunty Lee through random browse in some food blog with high recommendation. Decided to give it a try n make a call to shop, to our surprise, there was still table available for our big group. The shop is located rather far from city center n difficult to locate if you driving in late evening. Small shop with only 6-7 tables, 2 tables were occupied when we enter, too bad I shd had pre warned of that on a Saturday dinner time when all other nyonya restaurant are fully occupied with huge crowds. Environment wise nothing to comment abt, not much deco. After food order, we waited not too long for the food served. However, we got shocked with the food portion served, it is small to the price stated, our food bill was RM465 for 12 adults n 4 kids. Overall the food tastes very normal, portions are pathetically small, and overpriced! For that price, we feel we could get a better quality food, more satisfying food portion, n nicer environment in city center! Would definitely not going back n not recommended anyone..Show less

Author: BerniechiahumphriesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Changed of Management & Cook
Review: On our way to Aunty Lee's Restaurant, we were already warned by Cabby that Management has been changed & Food not the same anymore . We went ahead anyway as I had already placed Order for my Birthday Dinner. Upon reaching Aunty Lee's , we realised all the Staff have changed. I checked with the Counter lady whom I believed is the Manager or the New Owner. She confirmed Aunty Lee's Restauarant has already been Sold & Cook also changed.We gave it a shot anuway since we were already there. It's really very different. The Food is either too salty or too sweet.. Worst of all I've to pay for Aunty Lee's Price but NOT Aunty Lee's Food. NOT WORTH IT. Really waste of time & money.Show less

Author: luvimp
Title: I think i don't understand nyonya food if this is the best
Review: Was recommended by friend and came here to try. I am rather disappointed. Overpriced fish, lime overpowered squid, over sweet pong teh chicken and salty otak otak sum up my meal. I tried many better restaurants. Will not recommend this.

Author: SoonhoeLSingapore, Singapore
Title: Worth the hassle to get there.
Review: Many of the roads in malacca are one-way and getting there is not easy especially in the evening. Moreover, Sungei Ujong is not even on the Malacca tourist map! However, it was worth the effort because we were not disappointed with the food!We ordered a Nonya Chap Chai and a Chicken Pong Teh and they were good. The Ikan (threadfin) Chuan Chuan was really nice. However the Tofu Taucho was rather bland. There are no prices in the menu and the items were a little pricey compared to the other restaurants we have visited but it was well worth the money paid and the journey travelled.The staff is also friendly. We recommend this place for the food!Show less

Author: JackNgWeiKeePuchong, Malaysia
Title: The best ever nyonya in Melaka
Review: This is the third times I visit aunty lee, food still at high quality authentic or i can say aunty lee is simply the best nyonya I ever had throughout malaysia. But this time the only thing different I noticed is that they have expended their business to the next shop from just one single which only contains 7-8 tables also their service has been very much improved and I didn't have to wait for at least 30 mins for my dinner to be served. Show less

Author: Shalinni GKL
Title: Great Nyonya Food
Review: Great food, pleasant servers, fast service and very very good cendol.It is about a 15 minute drive from town but it's worth the drive. Remember to make reservations, as the restaurant is small and can only serve a limited number of persons at a time.Show less

Author: Seah_hazel
Title: Aunty lee food...
Review:
Ordered the otah , chup chai, sotong, beef redang , shrimp egg..

Food is not as what I have expected.. 

Sg beef redang taste better

Sotong sourish taste.. Not fantastic

Egg well liked by my kids..

Author: audreyc69Singapore, Singapore
Title: A must try in Malacca!
Review: I chanced upon a review on Restoran Aunty Lee and decided to give it a try, especially after the blogger wrote that beside eating at the restaurant, she was so impressed that she 'tapao' , i.e. ordered takeaway to bring home to Singapore. If you drive along Jalan Ujong Pasir, look for the Petronas Station on your right and Aunty Lee restoran is just a few seconds away on your left. I did not make a reservation as I was there on a Friday around 2pm. The restaurant was not crowded. But as it is not a very big place, I do recommend making a reservation if you are heading there on a weekend.The decor is nothing to rave about. Small little place compartmentalized in 3 sections. As there were only 2 of us, we ordered only 4 dishes. For me, the best dish was the Cili Garam. I was a little worried that it will be very spicy but it turned out more aromatic. Every mouthful leaves me wanting more. It was a simple fried fish but the chilli paste makes a whole world of difference. The 2nd most like dish was the Bendih Ulam. It is basically steamed lady fingers, but again the topping that went to the dish was undeniably wonderful. I asked the staff for the ingredients that went into the topping and he very willing shared with us. The other 2 dishes that we had were the Assam Udang (very generous serving with at least 8 prawns) and the Cincalok Omelette. To end the meal, we have to order the Chendol, I mean we are in Melaka, the land of chendol! All i can say is that, you die die must try. No regrets. The total cost of the meal was about RM110.Aunty Lee, I have been to Malacca many times, but this trip is most memorable todate thanks to the delicious food that you served us. I will be back for more :)P/S : I left my mobile phone on the table and your staff very quickly ran after us to return the phone to me. Thank you so much.Show less

Author: 341anniep
Title: Great food, great people
Review: Love their nyonya food and service. Suggest to make reservation before go, especially on Public Holidays or weekend. Show less

Author: WonglcMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Delicious home cook style Nyonya foods
Review: Have lunch with family & friends, ordered 8 dishes, all very delicious.Location is just 5 to 10 min drive from town centre.Parking spaces available at front & side open parking space.Show less

Author: Clo_TTWHong Kong, China
Title: A must for Malacca!
Review: We visited Aunty Lee restaurant with booking in advance. The food here is very delicious and you can try the authentic taste of nyonya cuisine. Having travelled around Asia and ate most of Asian cuisine, the food of Aunty Lee brought me surprise and gave me great exposure of this traditional Malaysian cuisine.All dishes come in portion small/ medium/ large, so only two of us have tried 5 hot dishes plus dessert. Highly recommend the signature fish, butter prawn and cincalok omelette. Reservation is a must.Show less

Author: KennethLimBWShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Yes, A Must!
Review: My comment is just simple, come and try, you will never regret! Ask the boss for the recommended dishes. The Chili Fried Fish was superb. Show less

Author: jackdrum6St. Petersburg, Russia
Title: Sometimes 5 stars isn’t enough
Review: On our only night in Melaka we were looking for some genuine Peranakan Nyonya food. We had been recommended a few places by friends but my partner found a place listed on Trip Advisor called Aunty Lee that looked good. It was relatively close by to where we were staying so we decided to go there. After a harrowing walk down the street, we finally arrived, where Tony the owner took us to a table. We told him we wanted authentic local food. What he brought out after that can only be described as outstanding. Pineapple, Mango & King Prawn Laksa, an Okra salad (garnished with a delicious onion like sweet sauce (so glad we didn’t order the usual greens with oyster sauce!), Egg Salt & Pepper Squid, fried rice for two, and my personal favourite… the Chilli Garum Fish (which on the night was the Golden Snapper variety). I wasn’t going to order this dish as I thought by the name it would be too hot, but instead you tasted the depth of flavor in the chilli and it only had a mild kick. Tony’s explanation to accompany each dish enriched the experience for us, and we finished up with the local Chendol dessert, complete with a bowl of palm sugar syrup for us to administer ourselves. My partner who normally doesn’t eat dessert was blown away by this, and afterwards Tony took us out the back to show us some of the produce he grows including the leaf that the Chendool extracts its colour and flour like flavor from. What an experience! I can’t guarantee that anyone who is visiting Aunty Lee’s on any other night would receive the same level of service that we did on that Monday night. What I can guarantee is that you will find the food exceptional and very well priced as we did. Thanks again Tony… we are already discussing the next trip which we think will be at least two weeks in Melaka alone, and will be sure to visit again.Show less

Author: Tan KSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good Food !
Review: Was recommended by my brother to MUST try the Nonya food whenever in Malacca. So on Thursday 20th June, did drove up for the week-end trip with the family of 4 . Intended to have our lunch but my waze gps guide drop short of giving the exact location and did stopped to ask a local, he did not gave proper direction.. so missed the lunch and have to settle for chicken rice at Jonkers street.However determined and ask Holiday Inn staff where we were staying for direction... and drove there again and finally and located the resturant around 1845hrs ... no crowd problem on a week day!Thanks Tony for the excellent service and tips on the recommended food to trip on our first visit... We like the the chilli, it was really garang and very good tasting food. No MSG enhanced favour that you feel very thirsty after effect.Its highlight of our trip and worth the drive from Singapore ...... who knows we might just drive up to Malacca for lunch and back home again ...Hey Tomy . ... hope your venture to bring this excellet food closer to us .. a dream come true ... save the driving for us yah !Tan KL from Singapore !Show less

Author: jabez25Singapore, Singapore
Title: Reservation is a Must
Review: This was one of two well known Peranakan restaurants we ate at. Both are good. Aunty Lee is much better. It is a really small restaurant, so reservation is a must. The service provided by the manager Tony was fantastic - from the reservation, to calling to say we are late , to providing directions, to having the kids meal ready as we arrive to recommending the best dishes for the adults. He was also honest that the restaurant was no longer run by Aunty Lee, but the food is Aunty Lee approved (she said "close enough"). Ask him about Aunty Lee for the full story.The meal was great, but I cannot remember the dishes names. But we had the best Cendol we tried in Malacca there. Unlike the other places, the gula malaka was served in a separate cup and you can add as much or as little as you want. I think their gula malaka is the most fragrant out of all the other Cendol places we tried.Show less

Author: CTSLSingapore, Singapore
Title: A must
Review: We found out about this place from some blog and it never fails to disappoint. Love the food, whatever is recommended is always fresh, great tasting and very satisfying. We make it a point to have dinner here every time we come to Malacca and it's one of the highlights.Show less

Author: Tania CSelangor
Title: Authentic Peranakan Cuisine at Restoran Aunty Lee
Review: We got the contact from hotel reception staff. Called up for direction and was precisely directed to the destination with no fuss. It is situated at Jalan Ujong Pasir, Taman SINN, Melaka. We parked our car at the side of the Restaurant where there were some single storey houses along the side road. Ordered our dishes as the staff's recommendation. The fried fish with chilli paste is good, sambal prawn & petai was average, where I think I can get better one in KL. Cabbage cooked with black fungus/glass noodles was disappointing, it was strongly recommended by the staff ! The Peranakan chicken is the best among all. Overall, we finished all dishes with clean plate as we were very hungry then. Pricing is slightly pricy, I would not say it's worth that much for the food served and the portion is a bit small for 4 of us. One thing I find good is the home made chilli powder packed in 250gm per packet for RM6.00. I bought 4 packets. 2 packets for meat and 2 packets for seafood. Tried it out at home and find that it's good. The shop is closed on Tuesdays. Business hours : 11.30am-2.30pm, 6.00pm-10.00pm.Show less

Author: Doug SSingapore, Singapore
Title: One of the best Nonya meals we've had!
Review: Second time visiting Restoran Aunty Lee and it surely didn't disappoint. On this occasion, we were here on a weekday evening, so it is much less crowded than on a weekend. We had the chap chye, some keropok, the Devil's chicken, Cendol, Sambal Petai, Otak, Cili Garam Ikan and Tempra Prawns. Food and service were top notch! We've had nonya food across Melaka, but this was certainly the best!Well, I guess when it is not so busy, the atmosphere will be a little more cosy and everyone's happier. There were some mosquitoes though. Will definitely be back!Show less

Author: MayTan21Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya restaurant visited by locals
Review: This is my second time visiting this restaurant - 1st time with my family & 2nd time with my hubby. The food overall was above average compare to other Nyonya restaurants around town but the service provided was 1st rate. We came half hour early & was standing awkwardly in the restaurant, a young lady usher us to sit at a large table to make us more comfortable first & asked us to order our drinks since they are cleaning a table for 2 before shifting us. The most memorable in their menu are cincalok omelette, lady fingers vinaigrette, fried fish with chili garam. I have tried other Nyonya restaurants in town before and would prefer Aunty's Lee anytime. Please bear in mind that you must call in advance for reservation due to limited space in this restaurant.Show less

Author: Rach456_13Singapore, null, Singapore
Title: Long waiting time even wih earlier reservation and ordered.
Review: Heard very good comment of the delicious food. My friends was there around 7.30pm and waited till 8.38pm yet the food still not yet serve. I was very disappointed with such lousy service. I've helped my friends to call for reservation and even ordered the food we wanted to eat for dinner. Ended up the restaurant gave them stupid reason of order mixed up? This is unacceptable for F&B line. No matter how nice the delicious the food they can prepare but I would real,y banned this restaurant for such lousy service.Show less

Author: explor a
Title: Tasty chicken curry
Review: the chicken curry was excellent. the other dishes we order were a bit too oily. overall it is worth trying.

Author: sharewiseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rare "home cooked" treats
Review: a bit difficult to find, took forever to get there (from main town (jonker's side) possibly it was during an impossibly busy weekend where the whole world flocks to tiny charming malacca.Foodwise, advise to book as we didn't and waited forever to get our food, thank goodness it was well worth the wait. I consider my standard for nyonya food on the higher side as mum's cooking is (naturally) the best, normally nyonya (northern). This place i guess is one of the better nyonya retail i have been. Fried fish with sambal chill was really delicious, so was the otak and sambal petai. Chendol also really yummy.Show less

Author: SueLynnTiongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Try the ikan cili garam and sambal prawn
Review: Getting to Aunty Lee Restoran is a little tricky as this small shop house is located in a housing estate in Ujong Pasir. Fortunately, my father in-law is from Ujong Pasir so he knew the area like the back of his hand.It’s best to call ahead and reserve a table. Better still, call ahead to reserve a table and order your food. Otherwise, you might have to wait or risk missing out on popular dishes. We dined in a party of seven that evening, so we ordered quite a few items to share.Of all the dishes I tried, the ikan cili garam and sambal petai prawns were noteworthy. The cili garam was hand pounded and stir-fried till paste is aromatic. This went very well with the fish, which was relatively fresh.The sambal petai prawns packed a wallop of flavour and heat. A bit oily, this dish, but the petai was crunchy and the prawns were fresh and sweet.The cincalok omelette was pretty basic but nicely done. I liked the Aunty Lee fried chicken; this was well marinated and the meat was juicy. The fried sotong was nothing to shout about but Kerabu Timun was refreshing.The Nyonya Chap Chai was tasty from the generous amount of beancurd paste and packed with black fungus and beancurd skin. Food is a bit pricey for Melaka standards, but it's still worth a try.For more pictures and a full review, visit: http://www.bangsarbabe.com/2013/05/aunty-lee-melaka.htmlShow less

Author: Bcda
Title: Best Nyonya food in Town
Review: Everytime my friends came to melaka from other part of malaysia or Singapore I used to bring them here for Dinner or Lunch. Because myself tried many places nyonya food in melaka, none of them as good as Aunty Lee.At first you need to make a phone call booking for how many persons & what dish to order..Recommend these Cincaluk Omelette, Ikan Masak Chili Garam, Kangkung Belachan, Udang Masak Lemak with Pineapple, Tauchu Taufu & Sambal sotong & petai.Other than that in the menu also not bad, I tried the brinjal once also not bad.Show less

Author: xiaoye lSingapore, Singapore
Title: Standard has dropped
Review: Was here 2 years ago. This time, I ordered kangkong, otah, cinalok omelette and a spicy chicken dish. They tasted not as good as I was here the last time round. I may still give this place a try the next time i come. Still a very popular place for Nonya food. Do make reservation in advance. No way you can get a table by walking in. Do expect to wait a little as they serve table by table.Upon arrival, they will then instruct the kitchen to prepare your dishes. They cook table by table. They serve table by table.Show less

Author: g3rlSingapore, Singapore
Title: Not as good as expect
Review: Heared people saying that she serves really good peranankan food, however, it's somehow not very true.Quite disappointed with the service.As her shop is usually packed and people make reservation in advance, we accept the fact that we were not able to eat in.We asked if we can place our order for takeaway and then collect at a later timing (we even requested for our dishes to be cooked last), but, her daughter don't seem to understand us and kept thinking that we insist on getting a place to eat in, argued for quite some time that i almost wanted to just leave and not patronize.Anyway, her food is not the best, i've tasted better peranakan food.Will not go back to patronize her.Show less

Author: 2adults3kidsonBudgetPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Was okay but not great
Review: Got to know this place from blogs and write ups, a home style setting in a small shoplot tucked in a residential area of Melaka, Aunty Lee is a popular outlet evident from the buses from Singapore patroning the restaurant hence expectations were understandably high. The food presentation was good with nice large prawns and generous portions for every dish, the taste could be described only as average. The pricing is reasonable at USD80 for 7 different dishes for a table of 10 but all in all not sufficient to persuade me to return if I am in Melaka again. Perhaps spoiled by Little Yum Yum in Kota Damansara back in PJ.Show less

Author: tanjtan
Title: Everything was Great!!!!
Review: Even nicer than Nancy's Kitchen.  All the food we loved.  A tad on the salty side though.  And be prepared to wait for your food as they prepare it only when you arrive.

Author: BerniechiahumphriesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Best Authentic Nonya Food in Melaka
Review: Was there 3 days ago for Lunch. Had Chilli Crispy Fish, Udang Nanas, Belachan Kangkong, Aunty Lee Chicken with special sauce and Special Sambal Belachan with their best Chendol for dessert..They are all very Authentic Nonya Food and very delicious. This is a Must Try Authentic Nonya Food Restaurant then you will know the difference. Of Course there are many Nonya Food Restaurant floating in the Market in Melaka but how Authentic is their Nonya Food is another question..Have to Book in advance. Best is to text Jasmine @012-3980669 to make Advance Booking and place Order instead of calling Restaurant Line cos quite difficult to get through. She'll defiinetly call back. I'll always go back there to enjoy my Nonya Food each time I visit Melaka. If they can maintain their Standard, they'll be the Best Authentic Nonya Food Restaurant in Melaka.Show less

Author: jotaro-zenKuala Lumpur
Title: Simple Good Nyonya Food - Like Home-cooking but GO EARLY!
Review: Aunty Lee, the lady reminds me of my granny - a typical Penang Nyonya lady who was well known for her Nyonya Kuehs (cakes) and of course her cooking. Going to Aunty Lee was almost like going back to my grandmother's.The colorfully garish exterior and simple/colorful interior gave me a poor first impression. The place did not look or feel Nyonya-ish.But when the food came, all my doubts evaporated. The food is good, even for me who is of Nyonya parentage.We had :1. Cincaluk omelet, with the cincaluk adding a certain tanginess and zing to the egg.2. The fish curry was perfect with a very fresh fish and a gravy that is not overly tasty or creamy.3. Stir-fried kankong belacan, this was good but could do with some fresh prawns thrown in.4. Ayam Pongteh - if you are there don't miss this.5. Otak-otak, this was spicy and slightly hard; unlike the Penang version which is softer and has Daun Kadok.6.Cendol - the only disappointing dish as the Gula Melaka provided was too thin and as such did not have that good coconut aroma.But overall a good, tasty meal that satisfied even me, a Baba with slightly higher expectations when it comes to Nyonya food.But make reservations and go early as the place can be crowded.For more read :http://jotarofootsteps.blogspot.com/2012/11/yummy-nyonya-temptations-aunty-lee.htmlShow less

Author: Rachcharis
Title: the food is so so GOOD
Review: The food is worth the wait - waited for easily 40mins. Must order the Fish Goreng Garam (heavenly), Cincalok omelete. Can give itek siok a miss.

Author: MagicStique
Title: waited 90 minutes for something that is finished in 9 minutes
Review:
If you want dinner, better go there and wait after you have finished your lunch.
Oily food, certainly not going there anymore. 
Price is too high for a restaurant that is cramp and noisy, and no parking.

Author: Tan H
Title: Very good nonya food
Review: This is probably the best nonya food restaurant in Malacca.  There isnt one dish I dislike.  The restaurant is small and fills up fast.

Author: y ySingapore
Title: Service fail but food is still the best
Review: The waiting is ridiculous , the service is definitely will not pass the service sector exam . But , the "ikan chilli garam" ( fried fish with chilli ) is worth the wait...The fish was fresh and crispy , even our fussy children love it. Because of our young children, I usually order the fish with chilli on the side instead of the usual way of spreading over it. It's a must order dish when we go to Aunty Lee. There was one time the lady server did not let us order the fish because only 2 of us eating ( she said it was too big for just 2 of us ) But I finally managed to negotiate of getting half the fish instead, sharing with other 2 diners who came later & happended to order the same dish ( their order actually were also rejected initially ) . Other food that we ordered : chicken pongteh , duck soup , egg omellete with chincalok , pineapple prawn, stir fry vege , fish curry, they all were ok , no complain. About the lady server, most people will find her offensive , but I think the she is just too straight forward . She is actually quite friendly and "frank" . Aunty Lee herself is the only chef in the kitchen. I think there is only 1 or 2 girls helping her in the kitchen . So, it's a bit more like home cooking meal instead of restaurant, I would understand the waiting time is rather long even after reservation.Show less

Author: gladyschaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: we got over charge for the meal
Review: We ordered 7 dishes for 8 persons, all the food are tasted so-so only. one of the dish is fried fish with chili was charged at RM70+, which is too expensive!! We will come back here and go somewhere else as there are many good Nyonya food restaurant in the town. Show less

Author: Kim RMalaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: "Worth the Wait"
Review: As a Westerner' living in Melaka I rate Restoran Aunty Lee as my favourite. Food is always wonderful, delicious and fresh. No franchise rubbish served here. In defense of Staff we have always found them more than friendly and helpful. One thing to consider is the popularity of this Restorant, hence Booking ahead is best. If you want superior food waiting is required.Restoran Aunty Lee is authentic Nonya unlike others. Enjoy the experience and remember you are in Malaysia where all things take a little extra time.Show less

Author: doomslairSingapore
Title: Expensive food n ridiculous waiting time
Review: One of my first few stops after a 4hour drive from Singapore. I called several hours in advance to book a table for my family of 8. The dshes had to be ordered in advance too. Definitely something challenging for me as it was my first trip to the restaurant.As reminded countless of times, we had to be early. But upon reaching 10 minutes earlier, we had to wait another 30 minutes! Service was understandably slow; there was only 1 lady who played the roles of a cashier, waitress, cleaner etc.Food was oily and salty. I ordered the chincalok egg (oily) and chap chai (salty). The chicken was ok. I also ordered the fish (expensive) and flower crab (RM60 for 1kg). The crabs were not very fresh and it compromised the sweetness and texture of the flesh. I wouldn't recommend. We ordered 6 dishes but only 5 were served. Turned out that they forgot the prawns. So much for ordering in advance!Total bill was RM210+. Definitely pricey for 5 dishes. Fish + crabs about RM110. So veggies + chicken + egg + rice about RM 100!! There are better options out there.Show less

Author: Meepley
Title: I agree with the part on the tyrant server
Review: Our party of 10 waited sooooooo long for our food that night, and mind you, what you get to eat in the end probably isn't what you ordered. It's what they have left to cook. It is that erratic. Tyrant server even overheard telling the chef not to cook such delicious dishes coz we asked for more rice and they had run out of it. Ridiculous. Dont think I'll go back. Even if food was really not bad. Show less

Author: MrsfootlooseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, idiosyncratic service
Review: We were a party of 5, 4 tourists and 1 local who assured us this was one of the top 2 local restaurants in Melaka. Rule no. 1: book in advance, not just for the table but for your ENTIRE order, because you will not be allowed to order extra without some sort of chiding; even then you'd be lucky to get just an omelette because Aunty has to cook for the rest of the people (who hadn't even arrived), we were told. Booking a table without specific orders of food doesn't guarantee you a table. Next: you can BYO. They have proper wine glasses. Just don't ask for extra glasses for water unless you relish being scolded. The food? It was good. The fried fish with sambal was particularly good. Crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. The sambal was just right; not too spicy that it overwhelmed the taste of the fish. The sambal prawns with petai, the squid with black sauce, and the ayam buah keluak were also good. The chendol was excellent- the best of the 4 we tried that day. Would I go back? I would probably check out the other restaurants in Melaka but I wouldn't rule out going back for the food & quirky service. Show less

Author: FootlooseSingaporeSingapore
Title: Food was decent, just watch out for the front of restaurant tyrant
Review: We were in Melaka on a food tour and were recommended this restaurant by locals. It is outside the tourist area on the main road out to Muar.The Peranakan home-cooked style food was delicious and reasonably priced. The sambal ikan goreng was excellent - crispy on the outside and succulent on the inside. The spices didn't overwhelm nor mask the taste of the fresh fish. We enjoyed the creamy and tasty buah keluak -1 nut per diner. The sambal prawns with petai and sotong in black vinegar were hits too. The itik tim was just right and not too salty. The highlight was the chendol - the ice wa finely shaved, the green stuff was fresh and not rubbery. It came with gula melaka in a separate bowl so you could add as much (or as little) as you like. It was, unanimously, the most outstanding of the 4 chendols that we had sampled that day!! Just beware the tyrant server (maybe she's related to the boss....) She has to be experienced to be believed but hey... she adds to the local flavour.Tips:1. make dinner reservations for 6.30 pm or be prepared to wait (no kidding!!);2. don't just reserve a table, place your dinner orders in advance too or risk losing the entire reservation;3. house policy of corkage-free BYO is great and they actually have decent wine glasses (ask for extra glasses for water at your risk - you have been warned!!!)Despite all this, the place is always packed - testament to the quality and taste of the food. So the upshot is: if you're prepared to put up with their idiosyncracies, you will be rewarded.Show less

Author: The Settlement ... S
Title: I may go back there if there are frens who want to go.
Review: Food is good, no doubt about it.  However, if you plan to go you had better make an early reservation or you will have to wait > 1 hour before you are served.

Author: DanChoo
Title: Good Authentic Nonya Food
Review: Decent Nonya food, must try the chendol...Best to reserve a table else it get crowded fast...

Author: nqssafeMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Chocolate Lovers 😍
Review: One thing I liked a lot about Molten Chocolate Cafe was their presentation. The things I ordered looked exactly like what was advertised on the menu. Portion size was perfect for sharing and you really feel like you get your money’s worth here. There’s chocolate in almost everything and the range of desserts offered include crepes, pancake, waffle, brownies, ice cream and fondues.Show less

Author: Karen C
Title: Chocolate Heaven
Review: The chocolate ice cream and waffer are so yummy ! A must-eat for chocolate lovers ... we were at Molten Melaka

Author: yisiewt
Title: Short trip
Review: Nice place to chill . A variety of chocolate desserts . Combinations of chocolate , crepe and brownies.

Author: tkdevi0
Title: Awesome chocolate cafe
Review: We loved the desserts and drinks served here that we patronized it twice in a row for the 2 days which we stayed there. The chocolate tasted yummy and not so sweet!

Author: Alnedra
Title: Great for Choco-holics!
Review: Try their crepes or lava cakes. Be warned, you will get chocolate overload! Staff are polite and quite fast, although some dishes like the lava cake take time to make.

Author: naphthys
Title: Decadent chocoalte dessert
Review: We ordered the crunchy lotus crepe.. all i can say that it was sooooooo goooddddd... the sweetness is just right, portion is big enough for 2. Will be going back again soon to try other menu

Author: r0zturk
Title: We kept coming back!
Review: It was our go-to for dessert during our trip! Loved everything that we ordered including the coffee! Service was superb! Highly recommended!

Author: Maiden0422
Title: Kids Favorite
Review:
Will Not miss Molten Chocolate Café wherever its located.
Loved by the Kids and price is reasonable with lot of varieties.

Author: ReinaJ27
Title: Recommended for Choco Lover
Review: Perfect fondue, good quality chocolate, nice brownies to deep in. Latte also smooth. Definitely will come back. Next visit, must try their cakes and waffles.

Author: 545hendra
Title: Coklat is yummmy
Review: I really really..love this chocolate.. very recommend .. every piece of bite chocolate very smooth ..

Author: yisiewt
Title: Short trip
Review: The desserts and drinks are all very tasty and pretty looking . Desserts make right from chocolate fondue . But service wise a bit slow .

Author: CJ_JimmySingapore, Singapore
Title: Desserts to die for!!! Super delish!!
Review: We chance upon this cafe during our recent trip to Melaka. All the desserts were to die for!! Wish we could order everything in the menu but because we just had lunch we only ordered 2 desserts to share among 5 of us. A must to visit in Melaka!! Everything was just Yum.!!! A+++Show less

Author: sh4545
Title: Absolutely delicious
Review: Had the chocolate fettuccine (crepe cut up into pasta strands and generously drizzled with warm chocolate sauce + a scoop of vanilla ice-cream) and the lava cake with a scoop of vanilla ice-cream and both were so good. Lava cake melts in your mouth. Only problem was that the service was slow. Took about 15 minutes just to get the server's attention to place our orders. Show less

Author: 458carah
Title: Chocolate heaven awaits...
Review: We have been back here 4 times now. This place is fantastic. The menu choices are a little limited but what they do do is increadible! I’d highly recommend this to anyone who loves chocolate! Be warned it is a little pricey though.

Author: mengzai
Title: Yummy fondue & great service staff
Review: Order fondue Tower, pan cake &  coffee.  Great  environment. polite & professional staffs.  Staffs know their  job & product well.  All items made only upon order,  fresh & tasty.

Author: VthyaK
Title: If you're craving for chocolate, this is the place to go
Review: good service, very very rich chocolate. a good competitor for dip and dip I'd say.only tried their chocolate lava cake and waffle stick, both were excellent

Author: chngliant
Title: Everything Chocolate
Review: Lovely place to indulge if you are a choc lover...  This was our second visit after 1 year...  Still good and yummy..

Author: rajashril
Title: Heaven for chocolate lovers
Review: Yummy chocolate desserts. from french crepes to Belgian pastries and waffles, Molten chocolate's unique menu is a heaven for chocolate lovers.

Author: Lau JSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lovely Tea with Dark delicious chocolate ice cream cake and chocolate with coffee for tea
Review: Yummy delicious dark rich chocolate ice cream cakes and coffee. The staff are very helpful and the prices of the food are reasonable. It is a very unique place to unwind and having Tea at Molten Chocolate Cafe makes us feel worth the journey to Malacca.Show less

Author: grainnelarkin
Title: Delicious
Review: We came here twice during our stay in Melaka and loved it both times! Every dish looked amazing as it came to the table, and tasted just as good. Service was great and the food was really good value. Would love to go again to try more from the huge and varied menu!Show less

Author: paradisicalmostly
Title: Ok for Chocolate fanatics
Review: The staff is ok, the coffee and tea where just ok, the brownie as dry even with the ice cream and i've had much better waffles.

Author: christine c
Title: Good place to relax your tired feet
Review: Nice ambience....the molten crepe was awesome...though churros was so so...I wasnt a great fan of chocolate...but I enjoyed the planet chocolate drinks and very impressive.. creative nutty beverage...find the prices abit expensive..maybe it's really a price to pay for nice ambience...

Author: joeyfun81
Title: Nice treat
Review: It was a good treat after dinner. Was skeptical that it might taste like normal Malaysia chocolate but we were wrong! The Belgium chocolate drink was thick with strong taste. Not too sweet. It's just opposite imperial heritage hotel.

Author: Midas G
Title: Nice pizza place
Review: Very nice place at the river and serving top quality pizza's. Service was good and food was very reasonably priced.

Author: BoardingPass692622
Title: Delicious pizza!
Review: We went there for a Pizza Margeritha and two iced teas. The teas were very good and the pizza was truly amazing!!

Author: Chia Wei T
Title: Fresh yogurt by the river
Review: We passed by and where attracted by the artwork. After taking some pictures we got tempted into a coffee and a delicious handmade yogurt. I only tried the jackfruit but was very tasty and the smell of the pizza was amazing, shame we had already eaten. We will be backShow less

Author: yourlondonguideVeyrier-Du-Lac, France
Title: A charming Surprise
Review: We came here as we where trying to escape the rain that had just started to ruin our only day in Melaka, when a charming guy called us in and offered an organic Tea as part of a small promotion that they where doing for the day.We purchased 2 pizza's three cheese and tempe both were individually delicious and finished with a few surprisingly very tasty coffees. When we return to Melaka we will be sure to check this place out again, lovely service and beautiful Pizza's.Show less

Author: A-food-enthusiastLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Best Pizza in Asia served by a great host
Review: I have had the chance to be living in Melaka for a little while now, and had the pleasure to experience the amazing Pizza from Voyage together. Having stayed in there backpackers and being a pizza chef myself I was eager to try it out. My low expectations got ridiculed when i received a pizza and fresh juice worthy of a European chef standard. The owner and his wife are a pleasure to be around and this has now become a regular eatery and cafe for me in my new home of Melaka.Show less

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Long Q
Review: One of the famous & popular nyonya food in jonker streey. Most of the time are crowded & need to Q. Foods are taste ordinary & service can be improved

Author: carynjen13Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not as bad as everyone say
Review: We wanted to go to Jonker 88 since it's the well known one. The queue was so long, daddy hates queueing for food so he said let's go next door.Ice 86 was empty, we grab a seat and ordered our food. Daddy says this is much better, more peaceful. (He believes in helping shops that are overshadowed by the famous ones). Our food came fairly quickly. It was quite good and reasonably priced and best of all no queue. I haven't tried Jonker 88 yet so I can't comment on which is better.Dad likes the Curry Laksa, sister enjoyed her sushi rolls and the gula Melaka on my ice kacang is soooo thick (yummy). You will never get that kind of thickness in KL, its always diluted.Anyways I think people should give this restaurant a try. If you don't like it then go ahead and queue for Jonker 88.Show less

Author: Siambuddhas
Title: Do not mix up with Jonker 88
Review: Was feelings that jonker 86 is the 1 famous..but nar....it was 88...but nevermind..we tried...everything were ok...average for a hot day of long stroll around the street...worth sitting and chill off........

Author: Paul M
Title: A good place to get a cooling ice
Review: Despite being nearly closing time,2pm,the staff willingly met our requirements.All were very cheerful no doubt pleased to have custom.

Author: FionakceKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing
Review: So we decided to give this shop a try instead of the famous shop right next door which we would usually go... so unfortunate to us..it’s disappointing. Curry noodles was average, asam Laksa was not good as it was made sardine instead of kembong fish...would not been able to finish the bowl if it wasn’t for the prawn paste, rojak presentation was no good, sauce were watery and fruits were all soft and soggy lastly Kopi o ice was too diluted. Show less

Author: VeronAng
Title: Disappointing
Review: We went there just for chendol after dinner. We had both the original and durian. They were very stingy on the gula Melaka syrup. So we are just eating plain ice shaving mostly. The couple who prepared the dessert was unfriendly and looked angry.

Author: hairinaazmi
Title: I WANT MORE !!
Review:
should try their sago melaka, assam laksa , curry mee ang of cos cendol !!
Worth to wait .. weekend will be more crowded.

make sure you bring along your extra tissue !

Author: 268caseylPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Food, Name and Front of Restaurant is Misleading
Review: You would think this is just another hole in the wall outlet and the name QQ Ice would have just desserts on the menu. Surprisingly the food we tried - popiah, fried mushrooms, curry laksa and cendol were up to standard. And inside were clean, airy seating areas. Show less

Author: haqin5
Title: The one that I loved
Review: They have the best curry laksa that I have ever taste before . And of course the durian ice , i forgot the name but it was completely amazing in my tongue . All I can say it was a great culinary trip ! I suggest you to visit this restaurant when you visited Melaka.
