But if you came on weekend, you need to be patience because this place will be full of many people from another place . I gave 8.5/10 for this place and of course the dishes . Show less

Author: NaomiL651
Title: best durian chendol
Review: Head here for a different type of chendol and if you love durian. Otherwise, for traditional chendol head to Bibik house (just a few shops down Jonker street)

Author: 1mightymouseFootscray, Australia
Title: yummy
Review: 88 was closed on a monday, so i came to 86 which is a couple of doors away from taman wirsan dunia - a tiny manicured park popular with tourist. i had grass jelly drink to quench my thirst and spicy, rich and creamy nonya laksa which was fantastic. i discovered that the woman i shared the table with was the owner's daughter, feeding her little daughter lunch. i learnt that the business has been thriving for 20 years and it is a good place to go for authentic malacca food.Show less

Author: PeggyT753
Title: Must try the local food here
Review: There are many interesting and Creative food here. Food is cheap and very simple Coffeeshop setup with internal seats. During weekend night, some part of the stall are at the roadside for us to buy and eat as we enjoy the night market. We especially like the innovative Japanese popiah suitable for vegetarians too. Also the Chou Tofu. Don't forget to order the variety of ice drink/dessert. They also serve Wantan Noodles, Laksa,etc. Show less

Author: Dan333_Malaysia
Title: Next to 88!
Review: Similar type of foods as in 88 but not as good. If you are not prepared to fight for food in 88, this is a good alternative. At least one can eat more comfortably and peaceful.

Author: 1stPaladinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly
Review: For a start, it's less crowded than Jonker 88. Tried the ice kachang. Although the ice shavings are coarser than Jonker 88 overall the taste is just as good. If one asks nicely, they will even bring over a jug with their signature thick gula Melaka. Overall much friendlier than Jonker 88. Will definitely go back next time.Show less

Author: MezzapazzeSingapore, Singapore
Title: Rich, yummy, chendol!
Review: We came to Jonker 88 for the popular Chendol.The shop is always crowded and it is almost impossible to get a seat. Hoards of tourists and locals come here for the chendol and apparently the laksa noodles.We had lunch already so there was no room for more laksa noodles although it looked good. Will try that the next time we come. There are two queues, one for laksa and/or chendol, the other one is only for chendol orders. Quite chaotic but you'll find the order soon enough.The chendol is super yummy! Coconut milk is rich and together with gula melaka (and chendol of course), it's a match made in heaven! We love coconut milk so the chendol dessert is a hit.Show less

Author: Choi Yee C
Title: no table
Review: nice place to visit everytime go melaka, not so good is a lot family sit whole area occupy alot of seat

Author: Fonglin
Title: Tried Durian Chendol
Review: This shop serves local malaysian food but we didn't know until we went in to try their durian chendol.  The durian chendol was good with thick durian paste but I wish it was a bit more watery.  Service was ok

Author: EveSarah
Title: Good Food, Rustic Feel
Review:
Wantan mee was good and filling. Thumbs up
Didnt get to eat the rojak as it was sold out... 
Mango Ice Kacang.... cool and refreshing with fresh coconut milk...

Author: chindian101Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: The best Durian Cendol ever!
Review: This stall is way better than Jonker 88 Dessert. Food to die for here:* durian cendol (generous amount of durian)* Rojak * Nasi LemakNot sure why Jonker 88 is so famous with long Qs but personally i feel Jonker 86 is so much better in terms of quality and price. I came here twice and will surely be back here again. Show less

Author: highfever88
Title: Average Cendol
Review: We only had the cendol shaved ice. It was average tasting. We had wanted to taste the Nyonya food, eg noodles but was sold out when we went at 9pm on Sunday. So, go earlier if you want to try the food.

Author: WhiteFox1287
Title: Awesome Double Durian Cendol!
Review: If you're here. You really have to try the double durian cendol. It's shaved ice with sweet brown sugar, durian (king of fruits), kidney beans & coconut milk. Freaking cooling & delicious. Come early as they run out of it fast. I think it's only open from Friday to Sunday. Enjoy! :)Show less

Author: Risyen
Title: nice cendol
Review: my aunt & I had tried Jonker 86 QQ Ice and the other very famous kopitiam. Both of them are selling Melaka cendols but we feel Jonker 86 is better. My aunt is a very talented chef. She recommends great food.

Author: sv628
Title: nice & not squezzy
Review: if too long queuing  up at Jonker 88, the next door, you should go in here! the Cendol, original is great!

Author: Leonard S
Title: Delicious
Review: The nyonya cooking here is very good, very tasty and definitely worth the price. Cendol was also nice. But it could be really crowded during dinner time. Located on the famous Jonker street market. Order taken in front at the entrance. Really recommended.

Author: KinWaiKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice food but a lot of people
Review: The first experience of this restaurant is a LOT of people !!!! You need to wait for the table and then you need to queue to order and pay for the food. Great selection of Baba and Nyonya noodles and delicious cendol they offer. It is a great place to visit if you dont mind the waitShow less

Author: eugeneltcPG
Title: Nice Nyonya Laksa
Review: In a street that are filled with Western Food, cafe and souvenir shops, this Nyonya style kopi tiam is a much welcome relief. The Nyonya Laksa is good and comes with mild sambal.

Author: ivonnaxAsiain, Spain
Title: Chendol was okay.
Review: For cold dessert, go to the counter on the right side and order directly (self-service). A bowl of chendol is 4MYR. Pay directly to gentleman behind the counter.For food, we tried Char Siew rice (roasted pork rice) - taste is forgettableYong Tau Fu noodle - the noodle is very average, the Yong Tau Fu is okay.Bak Chor Mee (Minced meat noodles) - taste forgettableFried dumplings - good, but pricey (5 for 6MYR).Menu is available at the food counter, take the order chit and fill it up with foods that you would like to buy. Hand the order chit to lady behind the counter. Pay when food arrive at your table.Plenty of room in a spacious old colonial house.Maybe will go back again jus for dessert Show less

Author: yummy221
Title: One of the best Durian Cendol dessert
Review: Tested both Jonker 88 & QQ ice .My preference is QQ 86 better durian Cendol.Creamy and original taste of durian with gula Melaka.Delicious 好吃。As wheather too hot never try any laksa beside dessert.(I'm a superb fan of durian)

Author: 488lawrencel
Title: Over-rated
Review: The chendol is good but certainly over-rated.  There are equivalent and even better chendol sold at other outlets.  Don't even attempt to try the food sold at this outlet.  It tastes so below par that it is not worth eating.

Author: Mokkey8
Title: Good choice on Jonker Street
Review:
Plenty of choice with most Malaysian 'classics' like laksa, wantan etc but also came here for their great choice of cendol and ice desserts.

Good place to drop by on Jonker Street - unpretentious and not overpriced.

Author: faithepie
Title: Anniversary Dinner @ The River Grill
Review: Dined in at The River Grill for my parents’ anniversary dinner. Truly enjoyed our table by the river and the ambience was as charming as the food served. There are various selection to choose, from local to international cuisine. The dessert was also exquisite. Giving it what the locals would deem as the highest of compliment: not too sweet. Miss Zima was such a sweetheart and very accommodating. She gave use quite an extensive list of recommendations. Thank you very much for the outstanding food and experience.Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: New Year Celebration 🎉 Dinner @River Grill
Review: We stayed here for 3nights and have dinner celebration in the same hotel! Price per pax were cheap compare to other restaurants in a hotel. It’s a 4-course dinner for adult. Food was perfect, with class and presentation. We ordered kids meal for our sons. Pizza was good but the spaghetti was so-so. But overall, we had great time here @River Grill. Staff are friendly and helpful. Show less

Author: VicchuahPoint Cook, Australia
Title: Not really a great dinner
Review: My friends and I decided to have dinner at this restaurant at Casa Del Rio, a five-star hotel in Melaka. We were seated by the side of Sungei Melaka with a nice view and ambience.We ordered some local foods and a salmon pizza to share. There was almost no salmon on the pizza, just a few pieces of fish which I was not very sure is salmon because of the color and doesn't taste like salmon.Show less

Author: dr_ganltSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Romantic Place
Review: Located by the side of Sungei Melaka nice quaint set up with live music and good ambience for a romantic Valentine Day dinner for me and my wife. We did not make any reservation fortunate to find a tabke for us. Good food and good place for lover birds.Show less

Author: PE G
Title: MOST HORRIBLE Buffet Dinner - Please avoid!
Review: I went to the RiverGrill for the buffet dinner to celebrate my birthday. I was horribly disappointed with the poor quality food and extremely unfresh seafood!The food was way below expectation for RM$98 per pax. All the seafood were extremely unfresh plus they were so tiny in size. The crabs were just shells, no meat, and no one seems to be replenishing any of the food! Totally ruined my birthday celebration! I've never had such a bad hotel buffet before. I will not even eat there if it were free!Show less

Author: Excursionista14Philippines
Title: One of the best hotel buffets
Review: We dined here for breakfast and dinner when we stayed at Casa del Rio.First of all, the ambiance is really nice. It can go from casual to formal, depending on the occasion. You can also choose to sit outside with an unobstructed view of the Melaka River or sit inside with the comforts of air conditioning. We liked the unique setup of semi-buffet for breakfast where you get to choose one set/plated item from their menu then also get to enjoy the breakfast buffet offerings. We also got to try the Saturday Riverside BBQ Grill. We really enjoyed the food. At first we thought maybe there wasn't much guests that weekend, but maybe we were just too early. Then people started pouring in after 7:00pm and the restaurant was almost full.There's a good variety of Asian and Western fare, and food was replenished in a timely fashion. There was also live entertainment by Mango Soul. Overall, we were very pleased with the food quality. I can say this with confidence because people kept coming back for seconds.Show less

Author: Janny1974travellerDubai, United Arab Emirates
Title: Just OK
Review: A shame. We looked forward to this. After a few trips to Melaka, we decided to go for it and you get your money’s worth but the food quality is poor. The staff are lovely but the food in general has a lot of improvement to be made to get decent ratings. The bbq meat was all over cooked as was the seafood. The buffet is not replenished often enough either, which means that you have to wait and ask a few times. We mostly enjoyed the salad which was literally greens and crudités . Ice creams are extremely artificial and the chocolate drops and toppings cheap. It is a shame because the hotel is great and cannot be faulted - if they get the kitchen sorted this hotel would be brilliant. During the day, food a la carte is a lot better.Show less

Author: Explore818817
Title: Good Service, However...
Review: Had made reservation earlier and went there for dinner. Their service was great, the staff are friendly and helpful. Most of the food taste nice. The salmon fillet are not bad too. Personally love their chicken quesadillas and pizza. The portion of the food are quite big too. However, the grilled rack of lamb was quite hard and one of the mushroom soup we got are salty.Show less

Author: lipita
Title: Exorbitantly expensive for poor quality food
Review: Nothing much to say except I left feeling I overpaid by 50% for the quality of food I ate. There are much better restaurants for your ringgit.

Author: thedonbk
Title: Sunday high tea to be improved
Review:
Perfect location to unwind your Sunday. 6 star for its atmosphere. It feels like in the colonial days. So nostalgic! 

However the food selection can be improved. For exquisite boutique hotel like this we expect a little more.

Author: FreshprinceofBA
Title: Great Buffet Dinner by the River
Review: The buffet menu have been changing to suit the needs of locals like me here. A wide range from rice, noodles, tandoori as well as western and BBQ items on offer. Great atmosphere for those looking to eat outdoors.

Author: 655frederiquebMelbourne, Australia
Title: Quick and delicious
Review: We came here around 9pm and were looking for a place that would provide quick food. This was the place to be, as the have a really large buffet. The big range of foods were great and tasty, and even the dessert range was amazing. The place also offered 'a la carte' if you prefer that. Downside would be that the prices are pretty high .Show less

Author: Rsn M
Title: The finest restaurant in Malacca
Review: The dishes are sumptuous and succulent.Great staff and always welcoming with a smile.The man who started this concept Mr Chew Chert Fong is always obliging to any requests.Music plus great food and nice ambience for the whole family.Overlooking Malacca River gives the cosy outlook to the restaurant.Show less

Author: Nick BSouth Wales, United Kingdom
Title: Nice ambience but that's it
Review: We popped in for two mango lassis and two local lunch dishes. The mango lassis looked and tasted like broccoli over flavoured with mint...beyond bad, almost comically so. They did look a bit nonplussed and ashamed and took them away and took an alternative order without baulking or arguing, so full marks for that. we then had a local dish each...one a nasi goring and one a malay curry. Both very ordinary and prawns didn't taste at all fresh. Nice service in an empty restaurant and the waiter was a nice guy and liked his football. As so often happened on our trip, really nice helpful people let down by bland or mediocre food, so one almost feels bad writing a less than good review.Show less

Author: alexis0102
Title: Portuguese buffet
Review: It was our very first time to visit a Portuguese buffet dinner that available every Saturday. But we are quite disappointed with the foods as we don't see much Portuguese selections.Waiter approach asked how is the food , we just frankly comment that the crabs they served are over cooked ! It tasted like a spoil meat texture it was awful as I'm a crab lover!But the food is overall all tastes good. We enjoyed the seats by the river , nice environment and good services. Show less

Author: Micky3885Dublin, Ireland
Title: Nice lunch by the river
Review: Stopped here for lunch after walking around the older parts of town and to avoid a heavy rain shower. Very nice setting along by the river.Service was very efficient and friendly, food (pizza and Chinese fried rice) was tasty and well presented. Nice cold beer was a good addition too. Show less

Author: Brightontraveller-2Brighton, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent European style food & service
Review: The Casa del Rio River Grill is not the place to go for local food and ambience. However it provides European-style 'fine dining' with the style, service and prices to match.Sitting on a candlelit terrace watching the lights on the river, it is a wonderful location to eat.I had mushroom soup followed by salmon with risotto, drinking white wine (Chilean Chardonnay). Food and drink was excellent quality. Service was impeccable.The only query I had was the bill stating a 10% service charge followed by a space requesting an additional amount to be added for a tip. Probably I don't understand Malaysian tipping practice, but the waiter was bewildered when I asked about this.Show less

Author: simplytravelandeatSingapore, Singapore
Title: Great pizza but mediocre local food
Review: Visited this place for dinner while touring Melaka with my family. They have pretty limited selections for local dishes. Was hoping to have local food for dinner but since we had been seated, we decided to give it a try. Server by the name of Shen was very helpful and attentive. One of the best service I've experienced in Melaka. The restaurant is very nicely decorated and it feels like as if we are in Spain. I guess that's positive about this restaurant. The local dishes were really not up to standard. However the pizza was really good. End of the day, we tried consoling ourselves saying that maybe this is a western food restaurant and as such, local food was lousy.Show less

Author: DYYMS2Singapore, Singapore
Title: Worst Saturday BBQ Buffet
Review: Worst BBQ buffet ever!!! Was there last Saturday with my family of 11 person .Satay not replenished, imagine going for a buffet and they can tell you the food is finished before 8pm. BBQ items very limited ie lamb, steak , chicken wings, squid with a very slow pace of cooking where people need to queue. Dessert limited, hot items limited, & a high class hotel serving ice cream potong? It should DEFINITELY not worth RM84 per pax. From the way they do the service, I ashamed to tell people that it is Singapore owned hotel. Please learn from holiday inn or equatorial nearbyShow less

Author: DutchiesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very good foor in nice surroundings
Review: On the terrace, with view over the river, we had a truly lovely meal. Steamboat was very good and so was the curry. Too bad the curry arrived when the steamboat was nearly finished, but that was the only flaw. Excellent, friendly service and very decent prices.Show less

Author: Always_b_NaturalSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful stop on the River walk
Review: We stopped for supper on a Friday night - first time in Melaka. I had back problems, and just couldn't go on any longer without a rest. And that was really lucky!The location is beautiful, and romantic. There is comfortable seating, lovely views, nice lighting. Especially for patio seating - there was no trouble with wobbly tables or chairs. Everything was solid and comfortable. Service was attentive but not intrusive. The servers were friendly and helpful, explaining anything we asked about.We sat on the terrace along the river and really enjoyed the lights and people, the boats scooting up and down. The evening was perfect, and I don't remember any mosquitoesEverything was very clean. Very very clean.My husband ordered the hot and sour soup. ORDER THIS, IF YOU ORDER NOTHING ELSE! I don't like hot and sour soup (the texture) and I could have finished this up myself! Smooth, but not the slimy texture, just the right spice, crunchy veggies, toothsome broth, the chili oil was a treat. To die for!Husband had a beautiful steak cooked exactly to order. The whipped potato side was creamy and comforting.I ordered the Kung Pao Chicken, and it was really delicious. I had planned on ordering a steak, but am I ever happy I changed my mind. Nice sides, lots of dry chili, beautifully presented, and awesomely tasty - I finished it all!Show less

Author: Banda-in-JapanTokyo, Japan
Title: Fantastic buffet
Review: We managed to stop here on a night when they were offering a fantastic buffet and really enjoyed our meal. Most of the offers were Nonya-style foods, with some western dishes also available. The broad variety was so much that we couldn't sample everything, but it all looked wonderful and we very much enjoyed every dish we tried.The special senior discount for travelers aged 55 and over was also very welcome!Show less

Author: MiminazilaKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not a place for buffet spread..
Review: We were hungry after walking around Central Melaka and decided to get a bite at the hotel. They only served buffet on weekends so we decided to try it out. Not much of a spread for RM 55++ compared to other hotels buffet spread... one or 2 dishes of Portugis origin...others are the normal common local Malay food, like salad, rojak buah, soup noodle, etc. The dessert spread is not much...a few local kuih, cakes and pengat pisang...the food taste is not something to shout about... but the staff were warmth and friendly, the ambiance is nice with light live music by a pianist...nice eating place by the river...but honestly it's not worth the $$ you spent...Show less

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: A tasty Sunday Hi Tea
Review: Although the number of items on display are perhaps less than you would expect, the quality of the food is very good indeed.This is not your typical Hi Tea though. First there is usually about 6 different types of cold starter - various salads with seafood, meats, cheeses. A wide selection of breads and two different soups.Then there are the hot dishes. Again usually 6 or so, some Asian style and some more Western.There is always a roast and every time I have been there it has been roast lamb. However the provision of potatoes and vegetables is very hit and miss. Some weeks these are avaiable, some weeks not. So on this front you might be disappointed .Outside is a BBQ grill with sausages, chicken tikka and the like.Then the desserts. Possibly the best desserts in Melaka. Plenty of choice of cakes, pastries and puddings. Oh and of course ice cream.Throughout a two man Jazz Band plays in the background - they can be quite loud, so don't get a table too close to them or conversation will be impossibleAll in all a very enjoyable lunch time.Show less

Author: pl55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Wait staff needs to buck up
Review: The bread is outstanding and the grilled boneless chicken is good. However, the minestrone was indifferent at best and my dad's roast rack of lamb did not look appetising. Anyway, what was to be our farewell dinner was marred by inexperienced wait staff and an irresponsible supervisor/manager.The fiasco was due to our untypical order - out of the 5 of us, 2 had main courses and the remaining 3 had soup and salad. We took pains to explain that food for all 5 people should be served at the same time. Apparently the poor waiter was so confused, he did not put the order for the 2 main courses in. Anyway, after repeated reminders, I approached the supervisor/manager for an explanation of what happened and all I got was a meaningless apology with no information of what happened and when I could expect my missing main courses. Anyway, all ended well when the food eventually arrived and the Executive Chef approached us to apologise for the service lapse and to explain what happened.Anyway, I would only stick with River Café and the Bar in future for F&B inside the hotel for a stress-free experience.The breakfast service at the Grill was pretty good and quite unlike my dinner experience.Show less

Author: Zulkarnain23
Title: Lack of selection
Review: Went there a few times during my visit in Malacca. I was there for three time just because I stayed at Casa Del Rio. Foods portion is pretty small... not so tasty and not many choices.

Author: 882reidune
Title: lovely sunday afternoon
Review:
Spent at the river grill !! Music was nice..food excellent! We were welcomed by Shirley who explained to us the offers we had. We choose the Lunch buffet..with high tea following.In the end we had 50% off as seniors!!!
We spent hours.. And

Author: sarahhobartHobart, Australia
Title: Christmas Eve Buffet
Review: When I was searching for a nice Christmas Eve dinner buffet I sent an email, and the reply was very prompt with the menu attached. Good service straight up.We found the staff extremely solicitous, almost too much though. Every time we came back with a plate, someone was waiting to put our napkins back in our laps.The food was nice, good but not great.There was roast turkey, but no gravy. Roast beef but no horseradish sauce. The carving guy was sick, and kept coughing. He was trying to avoid the food, but should not have been stationed there if he was not well, standing all night over the food. The broccoli tray was empty, and it was the only veggie dish to accompany the roasts.The mushroom soup was well done, but there were no bread rolls, only loaves that you had to slice yourself, and I couldn't see butter anywhere.On the plus side, the coleslaw with walnuts was one of the best salads I have tasted at a buffet. The prawns were really fresh and there were heaps of them. Also, the Pilaf Rice, Kapitan Chicken Curry, and the Dry Crab Curry were MAGNIFICENT.Overall, it was a mixed bag, really outstanding in some aspects and mediocre in others.Show less

Author: AngeliaJolieNewark, New Jersey
Title: Good food, good service
Review: The restaurant is based in the hotel , and it is true the best restaurants are based in hotels in Malaysia, that is what we have found. We had a nice meal in pleasant surroundings on the terrace. Food was good. Only downsides was lots of river boats going passed and there was a smell from the river. Also cat roamed the outside area, something that I don't like when eating.Show less

Author: MM2HLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent service
Review: Although we live in Melaka, we had never been to Casa del Rio, so we decided to put that right by trying the Sunday Hi-Tea at the River Grill.We received a very warm welcome and chose to take a table inside rather than on the terrace. We then walked around the buffet stations to see the dishes on offer. There was an attractive range of appetisers and a variety of main dishes, a carvery station/waffles/pancakes outside and a range of desserts and fruits. The dishes were a range of Malaysian and international foods, which gave my husband plenty of choices but seeing as I don't eat meat and can only eat fish if it doesn't look like a fish (yes, I know!), I was a bit stuck. However, when we explained the predicament to the hostess, she couldn't have been nicer. After some discussion, they offered to prepare a fish fillet dish for me, which when it arrived, was perfectly cooked and sufficient to feed both of us.My husband tried the lamb casserole, which he pronounced excellent. The roast lamb on the carvery was a little pink for his taste but the chef sliced some to cook a little further and my husband said that then it was perfect. We enjoyed our plates of salad, which were crisp and appetising with some nice little flavour touches. Desserts were also very pleasant. And not only could you have your choice of coffee style but decaffeinated was available, which is quite hard to come by in Malaysia.Service was attentive but discreet and the jazz trio playing were very good if not a little loud. The ambience was that of a dining room somewhere in Spain/Portugal/Italy and certainly unique in Melaka.If we could suggest an improvement or two, it would be to offer a selection of vegetables and potatoes to accompany the western-style dishes, rather than rice, which wasn't entirely compatible. It would also be nice to see a vegetarian option among the main courses, although if you have a specific requirement, it seems that the staff will go out of their way to meet your needs.At RM45++ we thought the meals were good value given the location, setting and western fare and we will now put the River Grill on our circuit of places to dine.Show less

Author: AbdulL827England, United Kingdom
Title: Excellent food and wonderful location
Review: The River Grill restaurant is part of a beautiful hotel (Casa del Rio) that sits astride the river in the old part of Melaka. There is seating inside and outside on a terrace overlooking the water.We were welcomed by the most friendly staff who were totally attentive but not always on your shoulder. The menu is very versatile. Pasta, steak, local dishes and a sprinkling of adaptations from around the world (my wife had the crispy Moroccan lamb and loved it). I had a steak which was done to perfection. As with most restaurants in Malaysia the price of wine tends to be high and does put a dent in your bill.Though a very romantic setting, we noted that they catered equally well to families with young kids as well.This is a place you keep for that special evening on holiday or if you just fancy a treat.Show less

Author: Andrew TCanberra, Australia
Title: Can't go to Melaka without eating here!
Review: Do yourself a favour and have at least one meal here. Consistently the best restaurant service we receive in Malaysia for this style of restaurant. All the waiting staff deserve the applause but the best meal on the menu is the Spicy Morrocan Lamb - chef take a bow! 8 of our party of 10 order ed this and no disappointments. Also the massive parmesan cheese wheel will delight any cheese lover. All the girls give the loos the double thumbs up! Show less

Author: brandenburg5Amsterdam, The Netherlands
Title: nice setting, interesting menu, but needs to improve
Review: We had lunch here and were rather disappointed. Chicken rendang had a really nice sauce but the chicken itself was almost entirely bone - it needs to be better than this for 30 ringit, when you get a wonderfully large portion of tandoori chicken for 7 ringit at Pak Putra, 5 minutes' walk away. The grilled red snapper was also rather disappointing, a not very large piece of fish swimming in a huge oily broth.Show less

Author: marina hKL
Title: Amazing food n service
Review: Went for a birthday dinner and throughout March 2012, every friday, they add a buffet to the menu list. March is all you can eat Roast Lamb and unlimited salads. I'd drive from KL to Malacca just for this! plus, one of the few places that does Steak tartare and my husband loved it. Service was great, discreet but knowledgeable. Location is relaxing and just round the corner of Jonker. Lovely place. Show less

Author: Espoo_FinlandMeriGentofte, Denmark
Title: Upper scale restaurant look and feel, food only average
Review: The service was very friendly, and sitting by the river is very nice.The food was unfortunatelly only average. It lacked the spices from the region, I felt like this is the type of asian food you get in Europe. The red snapper was very spicy, not very fresh and slightly dry. The price was expensive 30 RM. The stir fried vegetable dish was ok, but it was something I could have done.I understand if you go here when you are staying at the Casa del Rio hotel and you are short on time, but otherwise do go and explore the city! For example, the Riverine restaurant was only 5 minutes walk, much cheaper and more authentic and same river view.Show less

Author: Malaysiantraveller68kuala lumpur
Title: A new place in Melaka for fine dining
Review: Went to The River Grill as nearby Harper's was closed that night. They are both next to Melaka River but at the moment, Harper's has the better views. There were ongoing construction works on the other side of the river from The River Grill, perhaps to create more outdoor commercial and dining outlets which would certainly enliven the view and atmosphere in the future.The Moroccan lamb was full of interesting flavours and definitely worth a try. The chicken roulade was good too. Portions were small but quite filling. The desserts we had such as the sticky date pudding and chocolate mousse-cake were OK but not too outstanding or memorable. Nice place for fine dining. Staff were attentive and friendly. However, there were too many mosquitoes, even in the indoor dining area!Show less

Author: CygniCygniLisbon, Portugal
Title: Top-notch food and service!
Review: Our lunch in this restaurant undoubtedly counts as one of the best we had in our 3-country tour of southeast asia recently (being a bit of a foodie, that says quite a lot). We chanced upon it while looking for a decent place to have lunch along the river, after we changed our mind about having lunch in another place nearby (Donald & Lily's) as we were quite disappointed with what we saw. At the River Grill, the service was impeccable -- courteous, prompt, friendly, with the waiters speaking excellent English, and helpful (with the choice of menu), certainly much better than in some 5-star places we've been. The food was simply excellent -- each dish well-prepared. We ordered the 4-dish sampler (it had a vegetable dish- local spinach, a shrimp dish, chicken curry, and mussels), an ox-tail stew, and fried soft-shelled crabs for starters -- which was the killer dish -- i have not had such succulent crabs. Check my photos -- each dish tasted as good as it looks. The restaurant overlooks the river, and I imagine it is more interesting to dine in the terrace in the evening. The only downside to our meal was the ambience -- the restaurant (obviously new) was having some construction on the other part of the terrace where we were, so there was a bit of noise. The interior of the restaurant, however, was elegantly furnished. The cost of the entire meal which was a feast in itself was very reasonable -- cheap even, for the quality that we got. Great alternative if one wishes to have excellent local food in a good setting without the need to break the bank. Overall, a place I would highly recommend!Show less

Author: kentdiBali, Indonesia
Title: Good service, good food, excellent staff
Review: After having a very average meal in our hotel we were looking for somewhere else to eat. We saw the Casa del Rio hotel whilst we took the cruise up the Melaka River. An excellent choice. The staff were professional and attentive, the food excellent - the best roast beef - and a good wine list. An excellent evening at a reasonable price. The hotel this restaurant is in is new and somewhere we would stay if visiting Melaka again.Show less

Author: macedonboyGlasgow, United Kingdom
Title: Fine veggie food
Review: Came here for dinner during my first night in Malacca. The place was half full when I arrived, so the restaurant had no problem accommodating me. The place is laid out like a typical Chinese Buddhist restaurant with Buddhist statues and other religious items. The menu is fairly extensive and pretty much spans the entire spectrum vegetarian versions of chinese food. The drinks menu is sparse in contrast to the food menu though.Eventually I settled on an Assam Fish with rice and a sour plum juice drink. The fish meat substitute had an amazing slimy feel and impressive fish like crumbly texture, while the sauce was only slightly spicy and made a great accompaniment to the rice. The prices here are reasonable, though it is more than other vegetarian places in Malacca.Show less

Author: ClassyrcIlford, United Kingdom
Title: Just go
Review: Wow! Ordered two of the set meals (12R each) and a fresh juice (5R) and was SO impressed. The service was quick, the food was AMAZING and the prices are reasonable. This was probably the best meal we've had in all of Malaysia (and we're not even vegetarian). The sweet and sour was perfectly weighted and the chicken* and potato curry was delicious. The curry reminded me of a Thai red curry (not too spicy coconut curry).*Chicken is actually a soya substitute. You have to go here! Show less

Author: BrvergTaiping, Malaysia
Title: Poor Customer Service
Review: As we of walked in, hoping to try lunch here, the restaurant operator greeted us with a "sorry we are full", eventhough we noticed a large round table empty without the reservation signage on it. It looked like he prefers to accommodate the bigger crowd, for bigger profit. We left dissapounted. We will never reccomended this place to our family and friends.Show less

Author: KimOfTheNorthNottingham, United Kingdom
Title: Yummy food and extremely good value
Review: We had a selection of yummy vegetarian dishes here. We thought we would play it safe for lunch and order 4 'small' plates so we could try a variety of things. The small plates were actually bigger than what we were expecting! So we were well and truly full for the rest of the day! The food is delicious (although the fried pumpkin dish was a bit too oily for me) and the man serving us was friendly. It's slightly out of the main hub of Melaka but definitely worth the jaunt.Show less

Author: AussieGeez
Title: What a gem!!!!!!
Review: Being vegetarian, my husband wanted to find a nice place to eat. We’d read the reviews, and decided to try Green House out for ourselves. Oh my gosh .. the reviews were right!! Upon asking, our host helped us to decide on some dishes for us, even with our special dietary requirements, and our 8 year old who is a picky eater. He was most accommodating!! It was just enough for us too, not too many to share. Wow .,. The food was incredible, so much so, that we have come a 2nd time!! Possibly a 3rd time before we leave. If I could give this place 6 stars, I would!! It’s not too far a walk from Jonker Street. Its a real gem, and I don’t think many tourists know about this place, as it’s a little tucked away. We’ve only ever seen locals here. Come over and try it for yourselves .. you certainly won’t be disappointed!!!! Thank you so much to the owner!!Show less

Author: xiaopuipui87
Title: Great find!
Review: Found this place by chance. Great service and food. They help to expedite our orders as we are in a rush to catch our coach back home, despite the crowd. Thumbs up!

Author: David H
Title: I love this place!
Review: We loved eating here. It was one of the best meals we've had in Malaysia.We've found quite a few places serving all vegetarian food, but none of them have been as good as this place. I keep thinking about the meal! Try the butter fried pumpkin! And the fresh pineapple juice. And the crispy eggplant. In fact, fast for a couple of days before you visit and then order as much as you can. Show less

Author: CurtDog22
Title: Great food and juices
Review: This is a great choice if you are looking for cheap and fresh food. The chicken (soya) and potato curry was delicious, so creamy and a good amount. 12RM for the curry and rice. Plus the nicest pineapple juice I have had to date.

Author: trouty96Northamptonshire, United Kingdom
Title: Best chinese food so fae and all vegetarian!
Review: All the food here is vegetarian (if it says chicken / fish it's mock!)! Myself and my boyfriend who is non vegetarian agreed this was one of the best meals on the trip so far! I had the sweet and sour vegetable croquettes which was 12myr on a set meal with rice! Was really tangy and fresh! Very nice food and all very reasonable, especially with the set meals coming with the rice; would really recommend it! Show less

Author: ladislasp2018
Title: Nice service and good food
Review:
We went randomly on this restaurant and we did a huge banquet with a small budget that wouldn’t have last long in any other restaurant nearby. 
The waiter was so nice to us.

Author: Stew328Shanghai
Title: Very pleasant surprise
Review: At our table of 12 we ordered the pizzas, risotto, mushroom soup, lamb, chicken, pastas and deserts. All we’re well-prepared. Friendly staff attentive to customer needs. Not a big place so doesn’t feel like you’re lost in a crowd. All in all I was pleasantly surprised to find delicious Italian in a small-medium size city in SE Asia.Show less

Author: zacharyr827Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Absolute Waste of Money.
Review: Absolute waste of time and money. There is absolutely nothing special about this place. Food was extremely basic. Presentation was horrid. Not worth the trip outside of the hotel area. The service staff was very friendly, however the chef seemed to have difficulties. There were only 3 tables seated in the small restaurant but they seemed to be overwhelmed. The filet mignon tasted as though it came from a freeze dried box.I have spent much time in Italy and am not sure if the chef has ever been there. Very disappointing....Show less

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Probably the best fine dining restaurant in Malacca
Review: We had a very enjoyable meal here and we were extremely impressed by the quality and presentation of the food. It was quite clear that much love had gone into the preparation and presentation of the dishes, indeed the chef made it his duty to explain the dishes we ordered.As a frequent visitor to Lafite in the Shangri-la, KL, the food and attention to detail here surpasses this 5* KL establishment, which is becoming more and more concerned with revenue than customers. That's not something I could say about the Casa Cucina who seem to be putting their customers first.The only draw back was being brought hot black tea at the beginning of meal as part of the "set". Non-alcoholic drinks were available. Perhaps you may consider a part exchange towards a glass of beer or wine in future?Waitress service was ok.Overall 4* but food quality and presentation, 5Show less

Author: robert c
Title: Night to day
Review: I went when it first opened. I was disappointed. I was convinced that I should give it a new try. WOW. Good food in malacca finally.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Italian Fine dining....
Review: Searched around and saw this place. First time and give this place a try.Walked in and the worker greeted and direct to an available table, and was given their menu.The staff suggested their passion fruit juice. Ordered Iberico pork collar and mushroom soup.Food is really good and was given a complimentary dessert.Would definitely able to come back again to try other dishes.Show less

Author: danielcY6181JZ
Title: Good food friendly service.
Review: I visited the restaurant again, this time with a friend who was vegetarian. The chef came out to make his recommendations which turned out to be very good. We also ordered dessert and enjoyed it too.

Author: michael l
Title: Melaka's finest western cuisine for now
Review: Great food andIô presentation, good service, qualify as Melaka's finest western cuisine for now, though ambience could be improved.

Author: petrinajoanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic Place
Review: Went here over the weekend for dad’s Birthday. In fact chose this place as it was pet friendly. Called about 3 hours before and they were all prepared for us the moment we walked in. With a reserved table, menu suggestions as we are vegetarian. Dad was only planning to snack but once the chef came out and gave told us he could prepare a full vegan meal, he was tempted into having a meal. Everything was delicious! The salad was great! Highly recommend the vanilla panacotta and the tiramisu for dessert. Certainly will visit again!Show less

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Italian restaurant
Review: The pizza we ate was of good quality but the prices of their menu are to high. The place looks a bit old fashioned decorated  which doesn't give the feeling of a romantic evening out.

Author: dheepaj2016
Title: Great place for Italian food
Review: Casa Cucina is a hidden gem in Melaka for great Italian food. The taste is as great as the food presentation. An extra appreciation would be to Mr Andrew the owner, who is a very warm person, as we had visited his restaurant for a birthday party. He even gave a complimentary creme brulee and panna cotta for my friend as it was her birthday that was celebrated. Definitely a must go place in Melaka. Show less

Author: Tan_909Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Service
Review: A few days ago i visited this restaurant. The restaurant is acutally a family style restuarant and is very cosy and it is easy to get parking due to it located in a newly develop area. the owner is very attentice to guest but i could sense due to us being the only table. the place was a bit messy but maybe due to just finishing renovation. Service:The service i receive would be a 6 on a scale of 10.-We were greated polity.-Drinks came fast/food as well.-The owner/chef should dress approprite le even thou it was not peak hour in the restaurant at least not in sandle and short.Food:Scale of food 7 out of 10-The food is actually nice-Main Food is fresh and not pre cooked(Other than the chesscake could taste and see it was not fresh)-Would ask chef for his opinion on what was the days special if he had time.He needs to buck up on his service crew. Set proper gromming standard for staff and make sure they know how to recommed the days special but not too pushy. The food is good and also he has to start better promotions to attract more people as the location of the restaurant is not that visible unless you are looking for it. I would visit this restaurant again as i would to see the development of it as it is the only intalian restaurant in melaka located outside a hotel.Show less

Author: WanderingNekoMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Not too bad
Review: We dined here on a Saturday night without reservations, and barely got a table for four inside as it was quite a small place. It was a quaint restaurant with limited seating and a kitchen visible from the dining area as it was only separated by glass panels. It would be wise to make reservations due to its small space, especially during weekends.There was only a waitress, who could barely speak English and wasn't very informative. The menu was slightly limited and quite pricey for its selections. What we ordered were well-plated and very delicious, even though my alio olio was a bit too oily. The portions were also too small for its price and not exactly filling. If you are expecting food that tasted exactly like those you had in Italy or some restaurants in KL you are pretty much expecting the impossible. I realised later they also have daily specials written on a small blackboard at the back which the waitress did not bother recommending them to us, and they were written in Italian so I could not understand them.Another note is that since the kitchen was clearly visible, we could see eveything in it, and I'm not very pleased with what I see. Despite being quite recent, the kitchen seem poorly maintained and the two cooks (not sure if I can call them chefs) seemed unhygienic. The owner, the main chef I presumed, was communicating with the cooks in quite a noisy "pasar malam" manner, which utterly contrasted the theme of the restaurant. In overall, we did have an enjoyable time and a pretty short wait for delectable italian cuisines, and would definitely come back again.Show less

Author: 215luciawKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food but terribly long wait!
Review: Came on a Saturday night. Made prior reservations, so our seats & table was taken care of when we arrived. However when it came to our food and drinks - good grief! We were made to wait for more than an hour just for a glass of iced water! I understand that this could be due to not having enough staff - but really, that is not my problem as a customer.The lady waitress who could barely speak English was reminded repeatedly for us to get our drinks served (Could barely understand what she was muttering to us)Next was the food. I reckon we had waited for more than 1.5 hours for the first dish to be sent to us. And the best part was when everyone in my party of 5 had received our food and finished it, except for 1! She had to wait for MORE THAN TWO hours to get her food.Despite the long wait, the mains tasted good. EXCEPT for the carbonara which was really light in taste (Nothing like what we had when we were in Italy, or any of the Italian restaurants in KL mind you).Anyway all I wanted to say is, please get your system and timing sorted out. I'm not too sure I'd return again no thanks to the long wait.P/S: The chef (who I was made to understand is the owner himself) was pretty arrogant when commenting about his food. Told us that regulars don't need to browse the menu but just need to ask for him to recommend the food. Erm ok thanks for the info but for first timers, how were we supposed to know that? LOL.Show less

Author: matsallehlagiMelaka
Title: Tasty
Review: Located in the newly built shoplots of Kota Laksamana (and not to be mistaken with Casa de Cafe located on the main road) this recently opened restaurant serves good value Italian cruisine. The place is new, clean and well lit with the kitchen separated by glass from the dining so you can see the chef at work. The menu is fairly extensive and the serving staff (just one on the night we came) is friendly and helpful (… quick to provide an “off the menu” antipasta). The pasta was cooked to perfection and the pan fried fish (which we were informed, when we ordered, was different to that on the menu) was very tasty. It does not serve any soft drinks, only fresh juices, coffees, teas and beer, and there is a bit of a wait for orders to arrive as everything is made fresh. Will definitely be returning. Cost was about RM150 for 5 adults for dinner.Show less

Author: JasmyinKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, quaint place
Review: This place is a little hard to find if you're not looking out for it. It is located at the last row of the commercial centre facing the residential houses. When we arrived, it was about 7.15pm so there were fewer patrons. We had the potato leek soup (creamy and yummy), bruschetta (bread was a tad bit hard to bite in), grilled flounder (just nice portions, not too big and very well cooked - came with a side of potatoes and asparagus), chicken skewers (delicious skewers with homemade sauce and deep fried seasoned potatoes), lamb rack (not so much a rack, small portion, cooked to perfection, goes very well with the mint sauce and accompanied by a generous portion of mashed potato), italian cheesecake (not dense enough, I personally didn't like it but if you like fluffy cheesecake, then you'd enjoy this) and tiramisu (thick coffee taste - extremely appetizing). The drinks were nothing to shout about but the fruit juices were pricey (ranging from RM5.90 to RM8.90). Total damage to the wallet for the three of us was RM146.00I'd like to go back to try the pasta next time around. This place has a glass panel separated kitchen and therefore you get to see what the chef is up to. Their pasta looks to be of a generous portion and is strewn with bacon and bacon bits (if you're a bacon fan). Overall, this place has good food and if you come earlier, the crowd is much smaller.Show less

Author: Daenielle
Title: Great value for money
Review: Lunch sets were very well priced for the quality of food. Ingredients were fresh and quality. RM12.90 got me a starter, main and drink.

Author: VoraSwatiHongkong
Title: Surprise !
Review: A small place tucked away on a quiet street, We walked in after reading good reviews of the place. The place offered a couple of choices so we decided to stay on n try it out. The food was good, but the best was yet to come! When we were ready to pay and leave, I decided to chat up a bit with the lady ( the ex hotelier in me taking over), to see if they can do a little more for us if we returned the next day. She offered to put me on to the young talanted chef. And we were just blown ower by the response we got. This guy knows his craft and when we went there the next day, there surely was a range of vegetarian dishes to choose from ...which I guess were prepared for us specially.Surely will return to this place if ever again in Melaka and I strongly recomend everyone visiting this ancient town to do so!Best of luch Team Casa Cucina!Show less

Author: ong23Melaka, Malaysia
Title: a must try when in Melaka
Review: never expected much when I go in for the first time and with the decor thought it is going to be expensive. To my surprise the food is very good and special which is something you can't find in Melaka and the price is also very reasonable. I especially love the pastas like alio olio, amatriacina, cabonara and the pesto. Not to mention the beautiful soups and salads..... very fresh indeed. It is a must try if you love italian food when in Melaka and the service is very good. In addition the chef is young and handsome and also makes me feel at home in his restaurant.Show less

Author: JasmineLimHL
Title: fine italian in melaka
Review: very good food at a really good price! this italian cafe is very cosy and serves at its finest - the taste is definitely exceeding local standards and with the menu selection touching on fine italian dining, be prepared to expect some culinary art! definitely a must try, as this is about one of the very few italian cuisines in melaka that not only feeds your appetite but is good value for money. must try's: chicken roulade, sea bass, seafood linguine, duck and greenpea mash. Show less

Author: AlexCWM
Title: The food is unexpectedly tasty, authentic and healthy.
Review: You will not find such healthy western food anywhere else because they use all fresh supply to cook. It brings a different taste of western food into Melaka. A different look on western cuisine. The decoration of the food is done very well. Very fine cooking at a reasonable price. If you are someone who enjoys Italian food you will definitely enjoy the cooking of this chef from Singapore. The dessert is also very good, it is not very heavy and it blends with the food. They also serve very good coffee. Their set lunch is very cheap and delicious. A must try for food lovers.Show less

Author: Dylan E
Title: Perfect place to relax while exploring Malacca
Review: Great coffee and food, beautiful art, and very friendly staff, and all this with peaceful chillhop playing in the background. The owner's family has owned the building for generations, what used to be an antique shop was partially converted into a cafe to give what is now a perfect spot to take a break while exploring Malacca.Show less

Author: Jonas B
Title: Antique-styled café with nice food and drinks
Review: Cozy café with nice food and drinks. Great variety of non-alcoholic beverages. Stylish interior with antiquities. Very friendly staff!

Author: JuliKristinaJakarta, Indonesia
Title: Nice cafe and super friendly owner
Review: I was strolling around Masjid Kampung Kling at Jonker neighbourhood, and find this brand new cafe + antique store. The ambience is nice plus the owner [ Mrs.Fauziah] is super friendly. Bought a dragon tea cup there and she didnt mind to help me took a pic of me. The food is only light snack, perfect companion if you only need to chill and relax.Show less

Author: David G
Title: Just great
Review: Lovely stuff and atmosphere. Cheap and very good food. Also the drinks were excellent and additionally a lot. I really recommend!

Author: nicolaightHamburg, Germany
Title: Very cosy and nice ambient
Review: The cafe looks very cosy - and it is. Nice music, stylishly furnished and the staff is very friendly. Cold and hot drinks, ice cream (didn’t taste it, but looked very nice at the table next to our) and other small side dishes for 8-12rm is very good value for money. We can recommend the cheese sandwich!Show less

Author: michelletK7573PVMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Lunch
Review: This is an old antique shop has converted into a cafe sitting in the vibrant UNESCO gazetted area of Jonker Walk, called Serama Boutique Cafe. Serama Boutique Cafe has a wide array of different food offerings. I would strongly recommend their desserts - "Snow ice kacang" with variety of toppings . Besides the food, the concept of this cafe has the authentic antique and contemporary design & deco pieces being displayed in the cafe. Show less

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wasn't the intended place, but....
Review: Friends wanted to have Nyonya food for dinner. Walked to the intended shop and found out they don't serve certain items. Oh well, cross the road and came to a Chinese restaurant and found out the place was full with people (tourists) and no more available table.Walked further down to another Nyonya restaurant, found out they were already closing.Finally came in here and there are available tables. But it is also getting crowded and full.Crowded places and get chaotic and orders may get mixed up.So, was expecting to be average or mediocre.Ordered braised pork knuckle (small), stir fry choy sum with garlic, taufu with minced meat on hotplate, and they have ostrich meat, so ordered ostrich meati n black pepper sauce, and the person taking orders recommended oyster omelette. We went ahead with it.Even though crowded, did not have to wait very long for our orders to be served.Surprisingly, the food is really good.Price is reasonable.Enjoyed our dinner.Parking can be a challenge as there are many restaurants and eateries along the main road of Melaka Raya.Show less

Author: petgroominc
Title: Classic chinese restaurant serving favourite chinese dishes
Review: Old chinese restaurant still going strong after 30+years. Yam cake with minced pork, sweey & sour ribs are cooked well. Food is not oily but tasty

Author: jameso315Singapore, Singapore
Title: Below par food quality, better go for hawker
Review: Visited this Chinese restaurant with my family (4 adults + 1 child) based on reasonable review rating posted on TripAdvisor. However, this shall be my last visit as the food quality went horribly wrong. The salad prawn taste was horrendous. The fried prawn was stale and tasteless and routinely coated with some mayonnaise perhaps to enhance the taste but failed miserably. To my dismay, we did ask for recommendation from the waitress and were told that a few prawn dishes like butter/cereal prawns as well as salad prawns were equally good. We had good reason to suspect that the prawns were from frozen supply which could explain for their poor quality. The other dishes were equally mediocre. The yam ring was overly soaked with watery chicken sauce that was filled within and as a result, its crispness was lost and left with a soggy feel. Worst yam ring I ever had in my lifetime. The oyster omelette served on a hot plate surprisingly contained tiny oysters with hardly any taste. This was despite charging us a special rate by weight due to our request for bigger presumably more succulent oysters. Overall, food quality was disappointing without doubt below our expectation. I suppose any decent hawker is able to easily surpass this expectation. Show less

Author: skyeliz
Title: Serve Good Chinese Food!!
Review: Always visit Good New World restaurant for lunch or dinner whenever I'm in Malacca. Service is always good and my family enjoy the Chinese food serve there- sea cucumber, soup and seafood. Portion is generous and quality of food is consistent over the years. Wi-fi is also available at the restaurant.Show less

Author: Roberto-Singapore
Title: Good food, good meet up
Review:
We pre ordered the suckling pig a week before the dinner gathering and reservations made. 
The service was excellent, the food, especially the suckling pig, was beautifully done and no letdown. 
Price was reasonable and we will return! !

Author: Alan W
Title: Very popular Chinese restaurant with quality of food to match
Review: Varied ranges of dishes with sea food specialities such as sea cucumber. Polite attentive staff. Get there early on public holidays

Author: Pang O
Title: Consistent and reliable food
Review: This is one of the better known and busy Chinese Restaurant in Malacca which is popular with large family gatherings and special functions.  Service is good and so is the quality and quantity of food.

Author: GAAH4Singapore, Singapore
Title: Nice dinner
Review: Been here as recommended by my friends for their suckling pig. Do note that their suckling pig is quite a lot for 5 adults. Rather cloying after we finished it! Lol...Would be good if you have 7-8 adults to share. Other food were nice too!should gv it a try!its within walking distance from Hatten hotel. Show less

Author: Lionelsg
Title: Good Tasty Food
Review:
This restaurant would evoke more nostalgia than chic, but we enjoyed our dinner thoroughly!

We arrived early and the diners gradually builds up. Still kitchen was fast and efficient! 

Loved the yam and pork dish. We finished everything!

Author: sy3717Subang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Tasty Food
Review: We had dinner on Friday evening and the restaurant was full house. However, the food we ordered came out fast and quite a big serving. We loved the signature toufu with pickled radish as the toufu was internally so soft but outer skin was crispy fried. Not forget to mention the colourfully mixed fried vegetable with lotus, very nice. Most of its staff are long serving workers and having your meal here will give you a nostalgic feel.Show less

Author: munisxc
Title: Ah ah
Review: This time i jusz try Indonesia set rice, yummy really delicious and moderate portion, reasonable price. Should try this dish.

Author: helensngSingapore, Singapore
Title: GREAT PLACE FOR A SHORT BREAK
Review: Were were in Malacca over the long weekend (15th to 17th June) with a group of sisters from our church. We spent not only quality time but also the food and the peranakan heritage are something we looked forward to. People there were friendly too. Walked through Jonker street and bought quite a number of delicacies. Will visit again.Show less

Author: Vacation811481
Title: Food is delicious
Review: 很好吃的素食餐廳。腐竹皮很特別，我們還點了兩盤。服務也好周到。每一樣菜都很用心，有特色。強力推薦！建議可以先預約，那天我們去都客滿了！下次想試試他們的火鍋！highly recommended! Many varieties! Advised call to book in advanced too!

Author: hlc1982
Title: Hidden gem in Melaka
Review: One of the older restaurants that has been around for a long time. Haven't been here for over 10 years, and came back again recently to find the food is still as good as ever! Good portion and cheap! Highly recommended!

Author: muniswaran m
Title: Dont miss
Review: A must try item,asam fish rice set(authentic),finger lickin veg fried sotong.My little daughter realy enjoy both item i mentioned.Very reasonable price,clean but location not on prime area, try using gps to locate this restaurant.

Author: Akaur5Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good wholesome vegetarian food
Review: We had lunch at Mei Lin and thoroughly enjoyed the hearty vegetarian fare served. The variety of food was excellent. We had heard about their excellent steamboat offerings, especially the steamboat with black pepper soup, but it was too hot for us to try it. We really enjoyed the following dishes:- the rendang was fantastic - it was was the star dish and was made with mushrooms and was spicy and rich - the sambal fish was spicy and strong - the sambal petai prawns were well-flavoured - stir fried long beans were well cooked and the long beans were of the right texture without having gotten too softWe only wished they served brown rice with their dishes!Show less

Author: SurgewindKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Romantic Candle Light Dinner
Review: This small, cosy, quiet and dimly lit dining room is perfect for dating candle light dinner. The food was delicious, well presented, and very reasonably priced. The service was top-notch. However it took us quite a while to wait for the food, bearing in mind that we had ordered the food prior to our arrival. Therefore we would advise to make a reservation or even order on the food to avoid disappointment.Show less

Author: KLCLCC
Title: Overpriced average food!
Review:
Service was poor and the food was overpriced and below expectation! 
It was a terrible experience for us! 
We won't be back!

Author: Ms_Hs_Msgs_YTMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Perfect little hole in the wall
Review: i forst visited Mio Amore 2 uears ago on a whim amd I have been in love since. its a tiny, dimly lit DINING ROOM (not a restaurant-please note)they have rules there. like talking softly amd rowdy kids not allowed. I LOVE IT!its italian food well made. so far, i have not been disappointed. the panacotta dessert is to die for delicious. light and creamy with a delicious berry coulie sauceits a great place for a date. very date nightish. the restaurant itself is very small amd cozy. it only seats at most 25 people. so if you plan to come here, go with someone classy.Show less

Author: S955LSsebastiank
Title: Pleasantly surprised
Review: Arriving at the restaurant, it looks a little secluded and dark but the internal decor and quiet ambience was minimalistic yet really comfortable. Food. It's great. Really great. I have low expectations for any western food including italian offered in melaka until here. We ordered pork and chicken for mains. They were both cooked perfectly, leaving a succulent and sauce absorbing meats. It was not at all tough as I expect pork or chicken breast to be. The sauce is also really exquisite, nothing like I've tasted before. Its not simply any bbq or black pepper sauce. It's apple and raisin based, having a really fragrant and new taste which goes well with the proteins. Sauteed mushrooms and lava cakes was really delightful as well. Presentation and service was also top notched. On top of that, it doesntr burn a hole in your wallet for a fine dining experience. I have attached some photos but please don't judge the taste from the photos as there is low lighting and I didn't have a good camera. Please give it a try, as a Malaccan, I vouch for it.Show less

Author: pearlycarolSelangor, Malaysia
Title: Nice place
Review: Good location in Melaka Raya. Only a minute drive from DoubleTree Melaka. Ample of parking space if ure there early.There's only a sous chef in the restaurant so expect to wait for abit if there's a crowd. But once food is served, it's worth the wait. However, there's no pizza is in the menu. Upon checking with the chef, he told us he's short handed. That's a shame, I'm sure the pizzas will be equally yummy :)If you're unsure of what to have, do check out Today's Special. I found out only after placing our order. A tad too late.Show less

Author: Cem YPula, Croatia
Title: Overall great experience!
Review: The food tasted great, the service was excellent, they served a free appetizer & refilled our glasses with ice water every time we finished it (&did not charge extra). A nice ambiente with great Italian background music& a quick chat with the chef rounded up a pleasantly surprising dinner! Recommend it to everybody who likes Italian/Western food.Show less

Author: sheronlee
Title: Exquisite food
Review: The nice little restaurant serves fantastic Italian food. The smoked duck is simply exquisite and the best I have ever eaten. The salmon was brilliantly cooked with crispy skin whilst retaining its moist.

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Fine dining, excellent food, great ambience
Review: Fine Italian dining. Great for couples to have a romantic dinner. The atmosphere is quiet with soft music at the background.Food are cooked upon order. So expect long waiting time if the restaurant is packed. Do tell them your preference that is, if you like the food less salty and so on. They are pleased to accommodate.We had mushroom soup, fried baby shrimps an appetizer, linguine carbonara and chicken diavola. All in with juices costs RM100/=Staff are friendly and cheerful. Excellent place to savour Italian food in malacca.Show less

Author: carol_lslin
Title: A good choice of Italian cuisine at Melaka
Review: Staffs are friendly with food served fresh from kitchen. They will take some time to prep ur meal if there was no pre order beforehand. Still the restaurant able to provide a decent italian atmosphere through their decoration. Enjoyed the cuisine served.

Author: Zingg HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Italian Food
Review: This restaurant serves authentic Italian food. There are always specials of the day listed on the board. The food is prepared fresh and it takes time for the food to be served.The restaurant does not serve wine but you bring your own of which the corkage is charged at Rm20 per bottle. Service is friendly and good. We have been severaltimes there and each time the food and service was good. Restaurant is open every evening for dinner only except Wednesday.Show less

Author: gwennie00
Title: Nonya Laksa RM5.50
Review: First time here and there's only two small carts selling either nonya laksa or prawn mee. Had the laksa which was quite flavorful laksa with lots of ingredients. Love the crunchy taupok the best.

Author: debs_ng
Title: Pretty Good
Review:
We ordered the prawn noodles and curry laksa. Gotta say that the food tasted pretty good though a tad salty.

Is it value for money? Well, we would have appreciated a bit more ingredients in our noodles to make the price worthwhile.

Other than that,...if you have the neck for getting drinks with your food, then you gotta be patient. The old ladies in charge of drinks are a bit slow and they do not like having customers go up to them to place orders.More

Author: laurelin88
Title: Good, affordable food but please improve on cleanliness
Review:
Reduced a star because my parents nearly slipped on the slippery floor and they commented the sink and toilet were very dirty!
As mentioned by other reviews the noodles offered were good. However the puffs (we tried curry and coconut) were amazing! I would prefer...a takeaway when I revisit.More

Author: TK L
Title: Delicious Wanton Noodles
Review: I went there twice and surprisingly the first time was better even though it was very busy. The noodle was cooked just right with a bit of bite to it. Love the accompanying chilli. The coffee was thick and refreshing.

Author: KY G
Title: Puff Galore all types of variety of filling to choose from
Review:
You can have your curry mee or mee suah for breakfast here. 
Next you get to savour the famous puff form the next stall. you have fillings which cater to adults and kids. It was heavenly.

Author: josepho53
Title: Good noodles for breakfast
Review:
Went to this restaurant which was originally situated at Jonker Street and the moved to its present location. The place offers 3 choice of noodles - laksa, fish ball noodles & prawn noodles. Also on sale is their famous curry puff. I opted for the...fish ball noodle soup which reminded me of the taste of the this noodle during my school days. It was tasty & good. 
Highly recommended.More

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Nyonya Laksa Or Penang Prawn Mee?
Review: Yung Lai Siang is famous for their delicious Nyonya Laksa Or Penang Prawn Mee. Both Noodles have prawn crackers as their special ingredient. For me i lovew their penang prawn mee but please don't compare it with KL or Penang.

Author: Yvonne G
Title: Good food!
Review:
It's a day to day coffee shop for the locals. This place is known to the tourists for the Laksa and Penang Prawn Noodles.
Food is definitely good and caters to many of locals. 
It's not too easy to find this place unless using a...GPS but it's worth coming. Value for money
Parking is easy. Many people come from far to try out. Friendly people operating the stalls.More

Author: gcatucciKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Best soft boiled eggs
Review: The place is open, super busy and super friendly.They were out of tables, and the accommodated up in the back family dining room behind the kitchen.Great creamy coffee, but the kaya toast and soft boiled lived up to their reputation we saw on some TV show.Show less

Author: JimmieLim
Title: My best breakfast meal during my 5 day trip to Malaysia
Review: You just have to be here to taste the out-of-this world kopi, kaya-butter toast. Try the RM1 nasi lemak too. Very delicious! Only disappointing was the mee goreng. Worth the detour on my way back from KL to Singapore.

Author: Wolv3rin3
Title: Poaches N' Toasties for Brekkie
Review:
Super busy on a weekend breakfast time.
We had some chicken rice ball which were quickly sold out.
A must have to dip their kaya toast into the smooth running yolk poached eggs. Kopi is good too.

Author: linyy29Singapore, Singapore
Title: Great local place for simple & nice breakfast!
Review: Great local place for simple & nice breakfast! This place was already packed full when we reached at about 9am on a weekday. Tried their nasi lemak (quite small pack) but it was very tasty and a couple sitting at the same table, had 3 packets each! Their laksa was also one of the "must try and must eat"! The soup base was cooked just nice and not too thick. I ordered their famous bread toast, egg and coffee (kopi) and I must say this is so much better than those of "bigger name cafes". Best of all, you cannot find such kinda of prices anymore!Show less

Author: siennylovesdrawingMalaysia
Title: Very delicious 😋🤤 breakfast served here
Review: 1️⃣st visit to this local kopitiam in Malacca with my family membersVery crowded & have to queue for table to enjoy breakfast There are noodles & chicken rice stalls, however we enjoyed the toast bread with Kaya & sliced butter as well as half boiled eggs Very tasty breakfast with my family here, all of us love this kopitiam very muchAlso noted lots of Malacca locals were here for breakfast too Baby chair available for my niece ✅Serving very fast though very crowded Must visit this kopitiam during your trip to MalaccaNon halal dining placeMore of my lifestyle travelling blogging ‍ via my blog & link at profile ☺️Show less

Author: jennyharjitk
Title: Hidden gems
Review: Excellent half boil eggs, Tea C or Cham, Herbal soups...Price very reasonable only toilet don’t provide 🧻

Author: bunnyespresso
Title: Great place for breakfast!
Review: Would usually come here for their kaya toast in the morning. Taste really good with the sliced butter. Goes well with coffee 'cham c'.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Wonderful Nyonya food ...
Review: Friend suggested here for lunch. The first thing that comes to mind is don't think Nyonya/Peranakan food is going to be nice in Malacca, unless it is home cooked.When arrived at the shop, there were not that many customers. Maybe we were early. There is no printed menu, but the menu was written on blackboards and hung on the wall inside the shop, The owner came to us to take our order. With that sort of impression, really lost in what to order. So, asked the owner to suggest. She suggested Assam pedas with ikan pari (assam pedas with manta ray), telur cincalok (fried egg with cincalok), and sambal petai with pork. AS there were only 2 of us, that should be enough. When the food arrived, Tasted it. Well, was proven wrong for the first impression. The food is really good. Very surprising. Most of the well known Nyonya restaurants provided nyonya cooking but it was not delicious or mediocre.For the portions, it is not cheap. However, the good taste compensates for it.Will come back again to try other dishes whenever back in Malacca.Show less

Author: arwinzen
Title: Love letter to Malaysian cuisine
Review: Quaint little restaurant that gives a feeling of being in a Malaysian home. The menu was handwritten on a chalkboard that lies on the side of the wall.The food was really amazing. We had the chicken pongteh, bak cili garam, lemak nenas ikan (with prawns), and egg with bilis. Every single dish felt like a love letter to Malaysian cuisine. My favourite was the chicken pongteh and the lemak nenas. My family loved the cili garam pork. The egg and bendi were a pleasant surprise as well.Even the drinks that we had were great. We had the serai ginger honey lemon which really soothes the throat with the warmth from the ginger. We also had 3 servings of cendol. Perfect way to end a fantastic meal. We only wished we had found this place earlier during our visit. Can't recommend highly enough! The owner and the family are lovely people too! She was very accommodating in explaining the different pre-made frozen products that were available for purchase.Thank you for the brilliant meal.Show less

Author: BenjaminFarAway
Title: Home cooked feel and flavor - really good peranakan food
Review: Really good home cooked food - great taste and home feel, visited twice and enjoyed the food and ambiance very much

Author: jkanjanaphoomin
Title: Best Authentic Nyonya Laksa in Melaka
Review: Take it from a Malacca Straits-born who grew up eating peranakan (Baba and Nyonya) food. ‘Our Place’ laksa is worth waking up early for. Only on Saturdays (from 08:30) and make a reservation if you want to make sure you get a a taste of this thick, mouth-watering laksa. There was a generous helping of the daun kesung and cockles... stuffs that make a Laksa truly authentic Nyonya!!Show less

Author: Paul M
Title: A very pleasant lunch with friends
Review: This was my first experience of Nyonye style food and it was very good.Well presented by very cheerful staff in ample portions.Wide range of choice.Good desserts that rounded off the meal

Author: Clarice_1011Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Worthy Cozy Peranakan Dishes
Review: The food was nice. Especially Lemak Nanas FIsh and Sambal FIsh/Sotong/Udang. They have a great service and friendly too. The food were highly recommended. They have great oldies too. There's something special for their dessert which is Cendol with coconut ice cream. Not shave ice but coconut ice cream with cendol's topping. The dessert is highly recommended too !!!Show less

Author: Emily7394Melaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Cozy Peranakan Food Cafe
Review: Tried their curry chicken, pongteh bak, and bak asin.Curry chicken is very thick curry. taste is good.Pongteh bak is superb. Love it. the pork is cook very well, melted in my mouth. Highly recommended. Wanted to try pongteh chicken as well, but very early sold out already.Bak asin is 3 layer pork. 2 words to describe it "very salty". and the pork smell very obvious. not recommended for this dish.Each set come with white rice and some salad. Reasonable price.Show less

Author: tsehweiMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Satisfying
Review: I wouldn't say it was great, but then I only tried one dish - the Chicken Chop with Buttermilk Gravy. I also ordered iced soya bean. No complaints about the soya bean. The chicken chop was very tasty, but it got a bit buttery after awhile. Every dish comes with rice and vegetables on a separate plate. The whole meal cost RM10.30 - RM8.50 for the chicken chop and RM1.80 for the soya bean. Wifi is available here. Take note that this is a non-halal shop. There's ample parking space outside. The parking in the "square" is free. You'll need a parking coupon for the other parking spaces outside (RM0.60 an hour).The owner was very friendly and chatty. The decor and atmosphere were conducive for a relaxing day with friends. I came here with a group of 16 people.All in all, it's a nice place to chill and hang out with friends on a budget. The rest who ordered Senangin, Babi Asam Garam and Pongteh Chicken said that those were very tasty. Will go back and try those on my next visit. =)Show less

Author: BenYorkieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: An All-Round Excellent Dining Experience
Review: A lovely historic interior all furnished in traditional Nonya style - its a treat to just sit and enjoy the surroundings.And with this there is a varied Nonya menu, well cooked delicious food, which we thoroughly enjoyed. Bright and helpful service,k and prices which are very fair indeed - especially given the top quality of everything here.One of our best dining experiences recently and a location we absolutely recommend.Show less

Author: EilinglKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Beautiful setting for Peranakan dinner
Review: This restaurant is unlike any restaurants because the decor and interior is jaw-dropping gorgeous. I love how some of the heritage of Peranakan is preserved in this place. The food is delicious although a little more pricey than other restaurants but worth every dime. Be sure to check the whole place out from the front doors to the toilet!Show less

Author: hallothere
Title: Top notch nyonya cuisine in Malacca
