Review: Best Nyonya cuisine I have ever enjoyed! The staffs are friendly. We were given a table even though the restaurant was fully booked. We had the egg plant, pork dish, and prawns. The cendol was amazing. I would come back again.

Author: Stew328
Title: Nyonya food with something for everybody
Review: Delicious Nyonya food in an authentic peranakan setting. Chef Kiong definitely knows his stuff — experienced and conversant in a variety of flavors. Ideal destination for family gatherings.

Author: zittofiedSingapore
Title: Wonderful private dining experience in a live museum
Review: If you're looking for a private dining experience in a live museum filled with gilded Peranakan history, look no further.The moment I stepped into the Peranakan Mansion, I was greeted by a grand chandelier and specially curated antiques, including a quaint pawn shop counter in place of the cashier's desk. With soft olden-day music playing in the backdrop, the ambience was on point and I was soaking it in. Imagine taking a trip back into time, and being invited to dine in one of the most fabulous Peranakan mansions around!Having walked around the space (it's pretty long), I was ready for a feast. Peranakan culture is largely defined by its cuisine -- and it was wonderful. The dishes served were unlike our typical hearty Nyonya food at home (which I do greatly appreciate as well). What the chef prepared here was refined and well-balanced -- from the fluffy Roti Babi, to the tenderness and richness of the Itik Lor, the flavoursome Babi Tohay -- I was extremely pleased. While it is not the lightest on my pocket by my Malaccan standards (~RM70/pax), it is a price I'd happily pay again for an experience and feast like this. I thoroughly enjoyed my evening at the Peranakan Mansion and will certainly be back for more.Show less

Title: Arabic food
Review:
Reasonable prices, good service, delicious food

Review: A very suitable restaurant for social events Prices are cheap compared to other restaurants They have parking near the door of the restaurant The staff is very friendly

Author: sami8616
Title: Good restaurant
Review: The best restaurant in Melaca  I go with me family and all me friends all like the food I am coming every day

Title: Arabic food in melaka
Review:
Authentic Arabic taste and reasonable prices
The best Arabic restaurant ever

Author: wshaprMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Atsmopheres
Review: Treating my outstation friend for Nyonya food. I like the environment which is quit spacious. Price of the food is ok except the fish is abit pricy. No waiting or queuing like Nancy kitchen. The only drawback is the location not easy to find. We use waves and direct us to "Lu Ye Yen" Restaurant. It seems like it is hidden opposite that.Show less

Author: SLL36
Title: Modern clean place
Review:
Good choices of Nyonya food in a clean environment with plenty of car park.
Variety of several nice dishes to go along with your rice themed dinner.

Author: meowleng92
Title: Good taste but limited space
Review:
Variety local baba nyonya food. There are big and small portion.
Those small are quite small. 
The cendol is nice with alot of red beans.
Only Sat and Sun has kuih-muih which made from the owner mum.
Book your seat if possible.

Author: chysharon
Title: Best Nyonya Food in Melaka
Review: Food is great with decent price. Great place for friends and family gatherings too. Nice ambience.....

Author: weerene26Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice and Affordable Nyonya Food Choice
Review: Nice and Affordable Nyonya Food ChoiceFound this restaurant via Google and went there with family, six of us. Tasty authentic Nyonya food, decent overall atmosphere at affordable pricing. Ordered 1 prawn, 2 chicken dishes, 2 vege, 1 Otak-otak, a soup and a Chendol and paid less then RM90. The only set-backs might be some delay in terms of floor service and food serving due to shortage of manpower. Good food worth the waiting after all!Show less

Author: KarenMayAngMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya laksa
Review: Heard so much of their food, went to try their Nyonya laksa . When the laksa came out. I found the aroma nice and taste okay, but the gravy was too heavy and choking for me in the sense after a few mouthful, I was already bloated up. Moreover laksa with fish cakes ,bean curd , fish balls and without cockles doesn’t taste original.Show less

Author: Desmond L
Title: Decent place to have nyonya food
Review:
One of the affordable and excellent Nyonya cuisine which located at Non-tourist spots.
Highly recommended to those plan to have a decent local dinner and would not burn your wallet.

Author: baristakelly
Title: Simply delicious authentic home taste Nyonya dishes
Review:
I must admit their dishes; Simple and simply delicious. Reasonable price. Cosy and comfortable place. Friendly service.

Must try their palm sugar Gula
Melaka Chicken Wings, Cincaluk Omelette, Gerang Asam Tamarind Fish and Sambal Terung or Brinjal. Enjoy makan makan

Author: AliceN1243
Title: Best Fresh Oyster from Canada
Review: Probably the best fresh oyster we have ever tasted. Ordered off from the menu. Just leave it to the lady boss and you will have the satisfactory dinner in this place. The rare beef belly pot is also another super dish.

Author: Relax817354
Title: Great taste of Japanese Cuisine
Review: We've been frequented this restaurant ever since they were known as Sushi Boat at Dataran Pahlawan. That must mean something, right? Good food. I love the Salmon with white sauce, in fact, anything with their white sauce is sedappp. Other set meals are worth a try too!Show less

Author: Eric L
Title: A pleasant surprise
Review: We found the menu prices quite reasonable and were pleasantly surprised at the presentation and taste of the food. The portions were quite sizable too. This led to a very satisfying dinner. Will definitely come back again.

Author: EZYC4
Title: Great food with reasonable price!
Review: Meal come with big portion, they do have private room without extra charge! Maximum can contain 25 pax! Also, i found out there are many Japanese love to visit here!

Author: nel93Penang Island, Malaysia
Title: Moderate In Overall
Review: The toilet facilities here are bad, by which the restaurant owner installed the Coway Toilet facilities but not usable. Moreover, the area provided for cleaning is so... so... limited.The Salmon Roe provided is not really fresh, but of course the Sashimi and Salmon Belly are okay with it. And the price is not really cheap. Meals for 6 pax cost about RM250 with moderate food quality. Overall the service is of moderation.Show less

Author: corinan332
Title: Great taste, fair prices
Review: Authentic taste, beautiful food presentation. Die die must try Salmon Belly Shashimi, Hamachi Cappaccio, Salmon and Tuna Sushi White Sauce & Ebi Motoyokaki (grilled prawn). Reservation required for Fridays + Weekends dining.

Author: sheronlee
Title: Nice food with good service
Review:
One of the many Japanese restaurants in Malacca. The food was fresh especially the salmon and tuna sashimi. The sushi and hand rolls were done pretty well too. The waiting staff were attentive and polite.

The pricing is reasonable and the decor is quite pleasant.

Author: mohd khairi h
Title: Fresh
Review: The best Japanese restaurant I've been to so far. Well, at least in Melaka. Try the unagi and soft shell crab sushi set. Heaven! And oh yeah, sashimi. But I really had a hard time to finish it up by myself (since others don't seem to enjoy much)Show less

Author: DarlingSunshineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Cozy family restaurant; Value for $$
Review: Stumbled upon this little gem while searching for Japanese fare as kids were craving for some udon. A warm welcome greets us and it seems we'r probably the only non-locals in the restaurant.Plenty of set lunch/dinner to choose from. Prices are reasonable RM20 onwards. We order the Udon & Chirashi set for the kids. The Yakitori was yummy and priced at RM3 onwards. And kids were delighted with the sweet treat - free green tea ice-cream that comes after the meal for every set lunch ordered.Overall I must say it's a decent restaurant and fair enough, we returned for a lunch before heading home. Thumbs up.Show less

Author: Tee_MalaccaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Fresh and Delicious Japanese Cuisine that I can Found in Melaka Raya
Review: We tried Grilled Oyster Bento dinner set (RM30), Tempura and Raw Fish dinner set (RM32) and Chicken Nanbam Bento dinner set (RM26). I purposely ordered oyster because want to try whether freshness of the seafood can be satisfied. The result is I love it so much! They grilled the oyster with their homemade white sauce, and the taste is so good! Besides, the dinner sets that they offered all in large size! I got too full at the end! Now this is the Japanese restaurant that I love most among the Japanese restaurants in Melaka Raya, already planning back again in coming week. During weekend night, it is better to make reservation.Show less

Author: nqssafe
Title: Delicious Cendol 😍
Review: A very good place. Never thought dalam mall pun ada jual this delicious Cendol! Service is fast & price reasonable 👍🏻

Author: ARahimBSSIngapore

Review: Had a plate of rojak yesterday at about 9 pm. I heard he said, just inform him, minta maaf ajer. One of the waitress came back to me and inform that manager minta maaf and said," Char Quay dari ais box mmg keras cam tu,".What rubbish !!!Show less

Author: krishna_nadig
Title: Delicious, delectable, mouthwatering and so on...
Review: Amongst the dishes that I ordered for my family, the best one I liked was "Jom Sotong Bakar". It was spicy and yummy, just like the way I wanted! The kids meal & white coffee was nice too. Definitely will visit again..

Author: nusmik
Title: Delicious Snowy Ice Chendol
Review: Stopped by for a coffee break and couldn’t resist to order the snowy ice Chendol . It was a marvellous choice! Super delicious and the snowy ice kept the Chendol from melting right to the last drop!

Author: liyana1987
Title: Delicious local food
Review: Tried their fried mee hoon. It was delicious. I always order their lemongrass tea which is good also. They used to have ikan bakar but now their menu is rather limited. Staff and boss were very nice.

Author: garetjax72
Title: Good food and drinks right in Dataran Pahlawan
Review: Pretty good food and drinks at the western end of Dataran Pahlawan mall. The Jom fried kway teow and beef mac & cheese were particularly good. A nice place to have lunch while shopping.

Author: Evin D
Title: Nice Food
Review: Really nice food, great spot for a bite to eat. Great service too. Ordering food was very efficient and the food was prepared very quickly.

Author: Qcruiser
Title: Very good.
Review: This restaurant at is very inviting with friendly staff. Being westerners they explained what everything was etc. We settled for dishes that were not too hot and they were very good. We really enjoyed our lunch.

Author: GanL
Title: Relaxing
Review: After shopping in Pahlawan Mall, we went in for tea time. Nice coffee and lemon tea. Enjoy the interior decor. We sat there, relax, watching  people walking to and fro.

Author: j0celynling
Title: Jom Coffee Restaurant - varieties of choice, food for all!
Review: A good place for dining with so many choices I enjoyed their cendol and nasi lemak ...its surprsingly good! Would come back again

Author: rutheransColombo, Sri Lanka
Title: RUBBISH
Review: This place is strangely receiving fantastic reviews. In one word it is - Rubbish. There is a lot of fuss to implement SOPs to enter this crammed and uncomfortable property with poor seatings and very uncomfortable tables and chairs. The menu is not easily readable on a poor QR Code format. The juices are not bad. But their food is poor on flavour, badly finished and plated eg you will get a bowl filled to the brim and bits will fall as you eat. Service is awful. It seemed to be that their high ratings have gotten to their heads and they are just dishing out the - take it or leave it attitude. Even chicken is tough and badly done. The outlet next door Bulldog - scores in comparison. They stood out like a sore thumb for me as Malacca F&B otherwise brimmed with hospitality and professionalism. This outlet reminded me of the rough and uncouth one gets in Pudu and Chow Kit in the old days - unless they have a different service standard for Caucasian guests.Show less

Author: Yanzer79
Title: Bad service
Review: Run by a bunch of ladies with bad services. They are no eye candy either... food is so so actually. Don’t really understand the big fuss. Lol.

Author: mao489
Title: Great service
Review: Loves this place with lots of natural lighting. It is not just the food and drinks that are good. They definitely have good staff that provides extraordinary customer services. Orders two mushroom pastas (that can be vegetarian friendly) this afternoon without notifying the server that we are vegetarian. However the server is willing to serve us another two vegetarian pasta at his own costs when complaints are made. Lastly, the server did told us that during busy hours he might forgot to check the customer needs (in our case, vegetarian), so do remember to inform them next time. A server who can handle complaints and find way to compromise at their own costs (perhaps not the best way to handle such complaints).But I must say, sharing plates does provide extraordinary customer services. Well done and thank you.Show less

Author: ceberus07Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average service and low in hygiene.
Review: I was having lunch with my friends there. I noticed a few things happened there and one of them are a chinese barista guy wasn't friendly at all. Before we entered, he raised his voice on us telling us no outside drink allowed well at least tell us nicely. We wanted to go other place to eat but he came and told us to enter but only drink finish before enter but we threw our drinks instead. We sat near the counter area and I noticed that guy plays phone at times without alert. Instead of him doing the job but he ordered the staffs to do the job but he just stood there and does his phone stuffs. Overall, the floor staffs were nice and friendly so credits for them. Food was good too and I would give 5 but due to one guy's service on us I had to give 2. Please refer to him and do something pls thanksShow less

Author: hogepageMelbourne, Australia
Title: Bad and weird food, okay atmo
Review: Food was crazily over seasoned... and kind of weird in the way fusion places often are. Fried rice I could only taste cheese and butter underneath the overwhelming salt. Unpalatable. “Pancakes” are more like tea cakes. My kids didn’t even finish them - kids not eating pancakes!? I had a “cold brew” which unfortunately was some bottled thing, not made in house.Staff were friendly, and the space is nice. Stick with a standard coffee and you’re probably okay.Show less

Author: MMXBNSingapore

Review: Chanced around this cafe while roaming around the area and that was the best decision made! There is a huge selection of choices on the menu from mains to desserts and everything we got were super yummy. The coffee was amazing as well! The staff are all super friendly and the ambience is really nice. Definitely gonna return whenever we go to Malacca.Show less

Author: lnb-traveller

Review: Good menu with a lot of choices of international food and more local food. Staff are welcoming and friendly.

Author: PANG1717

Review: This is my first time dining here with my spouse and kid for my birthday. We had an excellent experience here, big portion of food, fantastic desserts and coffee! Satisfying meal! Will definitely come again!

Author: sara20b
Title: Best Brunch
Review: Delicious brekkie burger and pandan pancakes washed down nicely with cold coffee brew. Friendly service and relaxed ambiance!

Author: kristym964Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great cafe with fantastic food!!
Review: This little cafe was recommended to us by the staff at our hotel as we were looking for somewhere to eat that our 2.5 year old son would also find something he liked. We would never have come across the place on our own but we were so pleased we went there. The staff were very friendly and the food was fantastic, we even ended up having lunch there the second day as well. Definitely recommend this place.Show less

Author: RJCF1Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Busy Weekend Restaurant
Review: We visited on Saturday evening. The place was very busy but we managed to get a seat in the extension across the road. Food was good and service was excellent. It appears that they took table reservations so may be advisable to visit/call in advance to arrange your reservation.Overall a great, lively place with good food, good service and live music, I can only talk about Saturday evening though. Well worth a visit.Show less
Restaurant: Mamasita Mexican Restaurant And Tapas Bar

Author: jezebela2022
Title: Mamasita Melaka
Review: Amazing food, great portions and absolutely loved the ambience & vibe ✨♥️ Great choices and friendly service as well.
Restaurant: Mamasita Mexican Restaurant And Tapas Bar

Author: SrnH23
Title: Delicious food
Review: The food was a bit on the small side but it makes up for it with its delicious taste. Although we had it by take away, it was still delicious. Should definitely try it.
Restaurant: Mamasita Mexican Restaurant And Tapas Bar

Author: Rekha KHaringey, United Kingdom
Title: Terrible food and dreadful service
Review: I came across this restaurant during a short visit home and doing the Jonker walk at night. I should have guessed that it was not going to be a good experience when the so called waitress turned her nose at me when I asked her if they served char kway teow. We had walked a long way so we took our chances. My rice dish was very average. They got the order wrong for my son and then took a long time to get it right. The waitress was unhelpful and unfriendly. Such dreadful service and I winced at the audacity of the service charge. To add insult to injury, I paid this dreadful place two dollars more than billed only to have the waitress and the manager run after my son and I as we were leaving - suggesting I had underpaid. When I pointed out her mistake, not even an apology. There is so much good food in Malacca - this place doesn't come close.Show less

Author: patber66Malaysia
Title: Christmas Day Dinner
Review: Food nothing to shout about, order their local delicacies and western. Local food taste are ordinary with MSG while their Spaghetti assuming were cooked with powder milk instead of fresh cream which tasted a bit funny. Overall I would skip this long q during the weekend and enjoy way much tastier outlets nearby giving their price range another points down. Show less

Author: chongj242
Title: Expensive and non-tasty food
Review: The food served here is not tasty and the ingredients used have been stored for quite some time. I ordered prawn platter with fried onions and ginger and it costs about rm18. However, it came in a small proportion and used cheap ingredients. Not recommended and will not come again.Show less

Author: mohdivanhKuching, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya fare, and home cooked, me thinks
Review: The place is not great and neither does the food stand out, but all the same, I would not knock this place. The operation seems to be family run with home style cooking of nyonya dishes such as pongteh chicken, otak otak, cincalok omelette. I feel they scrimp on ingredients, so the food could have been way tastier if more cincalok or ginger/onions had been used. Drinks such as soursop were also sparingly infused with the needed ingredients but charged on the high side. You may end up here lije we did when other places were full. Not much interaction between operator and customer, so no feedback can be obtained - or maybe feedback thought to be not needed.Show less

Author: ronznMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Service is really poor here
Review: What shocks me is how terrible the service is me and my friends were really hungry we came in and we found a table but all the dirty dishes were still on the table and I’m really pissed about it and when we sat down and we were ready to order the dishes weren’t even cleared from the table and the waiter and waitress’s face was just annoyed and he gave us a waiting hand but we kept waiting for 8 minutes and still no service even when I myself ran out of the restaurant to look for another cafe/restaurant for food I came back 15 minutes later and told them we could leave and the dishes were still on the table I was in awed at how understaff these people they need more workers and some proper training for their food and service which will help them unless they want this restaurant to close down. (JUST STAY AWAY FROM THIS PLACE END OF DISCUSSION )‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️‍♂️Show less

Author: uniqueinasiaMetro Manila, Philippines
Title: Great place for local cuisine in Melaka..
Review: It's hard to miss the Melting Pot, situated right on Jalan Hang Jebat street, within few hundred meters from famous Jonker Street of Melaka. Though it doesn't look fancy from outside, the food served here is authentic local cuisine (both Malay & Nyonya cuisine) and is of great taste!Quality of service provided is good, serving time could take easily upto 20 minutes. Seating capacity at the restaurant is moderate, this could cause some waiting time during peak hours. The feedback is based on my experience over lunch at this restaurant, and I am quite happy with quality and taste of food, also the service quality. I would certainly recomend the Melting Pot, to have a great experience with local cuisine in Melaka. Show less

Author: SashSo
Title: Nice lunch
Review:
We just came across this eatery when walking past in Jonker Street. It is a very simple restaurant serving really nice food. Their service is also really nice. 
Fresh juices highly recommended - especially the passion fruit juice.

Author: KateNic99
Title: Suitable for family
Review: Whenever I go to Malacca, I will dine in here. It is cozy for children. The taste of food is good. Overall it is satisfying.

Author: Ian TNorwich, United Kingdom
Title: Trid it twice.
Review: After a very hot walk up and down Jonkers we decided this was the local to try. Not disappointed. Very friendly and the front is very willing to explain the food on offer. Seriously good value. As a westerner you have to convince her you like chilli. Had to try it again the next day. Still good.Show less

Author: WorldGluttonKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disappointing Melting Pot !!!
Review: It was very late in the evening , it seems most of the eateries are closed when we walk down the street from Aava Malacca Hotel. We chanced upon this banner "Traditional Nyonya Cuisine" The Melting Pot Restaurant which seemed to be quite busy. The waitress immediately showedus inside, gave us the menu . Browsed through , ordered Otak Otak,Yong Chow Fried Rice, Kangkong Belacan, Cincaru Omelette with mineral water & canned drinks.Food service was abit slow, probably due to too many customers. Restaurant do have free wifi service for customers. Our food did not meet our taste. The otak otak smells fishy, it is tough , fried rice and belacan kangkong tasted salty & bland. Cincaru Omettle has pickled cincaru flavour but no cincaru at all. However it is moist & gooey and tasted delicious!All in all the food is not at all savoury but just good enough to curb our hunger !!!!Show less

Author: mervduniaPhnom Penh, Cambodia
Title: OK, but Melaka offers so much more
Review: I arrived in Melaka early one evening and felt a bit peckish, but not starving...dropped in for a tasty otak-otak...made a mental note of the place and returned two nights later for more of a meal. The food was OK but lacked some of the lively flavours that can be found in Nyonya cuisine. Service was good in the beginning but almost non-existent after...Even to get and pay my bill I had to search around. Three staff members were busy eating at a table near the back. I won't likely return, as Melaka has a bounty of wonderful eateries to choose from.Show less

Author: cityangel78Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nothing special
Review: Limited space, need share table, and it take so long for foods to be served. We ordered Pongteh chicken, fried kangkung with belacan. Cincaluk eggs. The chicken average taste, kangkung belacan smell good but cincaluk eggs, I cannot taste the cincaluk. Just taste like fried onion egg. The food portion quite big. They charge white rice quite pricy. Rm1.80/bowl. Even more expensive than KL.Show less

Author: Csaba FBudapest, Hungary
Title: Not impressed
Review: Before I went in, I checked their menu outside and saw fried pasta, which I wanted to try. The staff didn't speak very good English, but after a longer conversation it turned out, they didn't have pasta at all. So I ordered chicken with rice, neither of which was especially tasty, but OK. Paid 23 myr.Show less

Author: ysp_lelyana
Title: Nice halal food in Melaka
Review: if you need to find halal peranakan cuisine, come to this place. The menu is vary and the taste of food is good. The serving is not too long but not really quick - just average. I think because of less staff for late dinner.

Author: Munich1
Title: Good food, nice service
Review:
Chinese cuisine - no bad surprises
and just to mention  service was very nice and friendly, they even emptied the staff table for us in order to be seated

Author: Musigny_gcSingapore, Singapore
Title: Service is sloppy and slow
Review: Service is sloppy or somehow intentionally slow. The service personnel took our order before other tables by 5-10 mins but other tables’ food was served before us. When we reminded the service person she only asked us to wait but when our dishes came, they were only lukewarm. Our waiting time longer than 30 mins. Show less

Author: galacsea
Title: Very average. Slow service
Review: The menu is fairly unappealing. We went there for lunch and had the ponteh chicken, which is good but lacks vegetables. Just oddly cut pieces of chicken in a lot of sauce. Rice on the side is a extra. Service is unsmiling and excruciatingly slow.

Author: novgal
Title: Good Meal
Review: This is a just a standard restaurant. Ordered Chicken Tomyam, Pai Tee and also fried kangkung and Coke which cost about RM50. The food was tasty and the portion for the above meal was enough for 3 pax. Even though it was full house, food was served in about 10 minutes.Show less

Author: The_Traveler010710Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Great Food!
Review: We came across this restaurant when we were strolling around Jonker Street. We were sceptical at first but after the food came, we were surprised and the food tasted very good except the tauhu. Other than that, no fuss, price not so expensive (about RM80 with 2rice). Show less

Author: QcruiserQueensland
Title: Okay
Review: We walked past this place and it looked alright, so we decided to have dinner there. The guy was extremely friendly and really tried very hard to recommend us dishes. Husband fell for it and got the deep fried tofu, plus something else which he said he didn’t want. I had the nasi lemak and it was just okay. The chicken had lots of fat and skin. Don’t think we will be back.Show less

Author: IratdogKerhonkson, New York
Title: Nice
Review: Dropped in for dinner lately. Chinese New Year is over. So is the crush of tourists. I'm glad I stayed longer and now see the "regular" traffic. I was served promptly. The Hokkien Mee I order was delicious. Watermelon Juice was uncorrupted and refreshing. Prices were good. Away I went.Show less

Author: esh0307kl
Title: Decent food , incompetent service
Review: The food is decent , however it's the lack of little things 1- letting us wait for the menu while the waitress fiddled with her own stuff2- no asking if we wanted sugar in our fresh juice3- dishes being served separately - with the excuse of only one cook Having said that the beef sambal - although tad oily has a good kick Fried rice - first dish was awesome and the second had huge grains of salt Show less

Author: Mature_traveller00Sydney
Title: Obviously a polarising experience!
Review: Not sure about recommending a restaurant that gets such good and bad extreme reviews. Here's what we found:My wife is a vegetarian who also eats seafood so very attracted by the "no pork fat or lard" sign. What we ordered came off the top of the recommended dishes and my chicken, her fish, and the kangkong balachan were absolutely delicious! Yeah, the beer wasn't at -360Kelvin but I can live with that. Seemed like best nonya cooking we have had so far in Malaysia, but maybe we were lucky and the place was not crowded.Show less

Author: travelgal_258Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food, if you have time
Review: This place deserves a 3.5 rating if there is a 0.5 rating. It is better than average but not VERY good as a whole, considering the review is from someone who turns semi-hungry to very hungry/angry during the wait.Visited this place on Christmas Day. The food was superb and staffs were friendly.The wait to get our order was not too pleasant though - we went in at about 7.45pm and got a table at 8.20pm. It was another wait until 9.30pm before the first dish (sambal kong hong) was served.Show less

Author: Ling156Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good food but long wait
Review: We went in about 8pm and managed to get a table immediately. Ordered the ponteh, sambal kangkong, cincalok omelette and seafood tom yam soup. All we're fantastic but the waiting time was about 50mins. We also ordered takeaway of fish fillet (sweet and sour rice and sambal). While there the crowd was continuously streaming in and out. Some couldn't wait and I saw at least 2 groups of people leaving after making their order. All in all, I think the food is worth the wait. Show less

Author: benwolf223Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: not worth going and wasting money
Review: The Melting Pot is not worth going to just for a meal, I ordered the spring onion fish with rice and it was damn salty, it's like they want me to get a heart attack/ cardiac arrest! Also the drinks are not that amazing either. I would not recommend this place to anyone in the world, this is the worst choice ever! also the price was not cheap either and it is a waste of money! Show less

Author: vernmadden
Title: Fail as a restaurant
Review: Ignore the menu most of it was not available. Beer is warm. Service is cold. Go anywhere but here in malacca.

Author: Jacky84Singapore, Singapore
Title: Superb nonya food in jonker street
Review: This restaurant is located in jonker street along the main road, thus you will never miss it. We are very tired and hungry from the long bus ride, so quickly want to find a restaurant that are not full and crowded, so happen to chance upon this restaurant. The waitress are friendly, recommend us all the popular dishes. We have ordered quite a lot and the dishes served fast. Free Wi-Fi is provided in the restaurant, no serving of water though. The restaurant is not expensive and price reasonable for the portion given, highly recommended to try.Show less

Author: ongkeekeat
Title: Great Peranakan Nyonya food @ Jonker Night Market
Review: Peranakan Nyonya Food at affordable pricing.  Huge serving.  The sambal prawn set dinner is really delicious.  A decent food outlet along Jonker Night Market street, if you wish to have a sit-down dinner instead of filling up the stomach with snacks.

Author: VananKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: best value, nice food
Review: A tiring journey in Jonker walk under the scorching sun of course require an air-conditioned restaurant to relax your body and mind. The Melting Pot is suitable for it. It is a renovated restaurant with a modern cafe bar atmosphere. But still retains the atmosphere of the interior wood and heritage and it is air-conditioned. The food selection consists of local and western cuisine. The food is quite tasty and maintaining local flavors. Prices are reasonable. A slight delay to serving even with a numbered customers.Show less

Author: Sampatboy
Title: Nyonya cusine
Review:
My fav order Chilli garam, pongteh chicken, and kangkung belacan! 

Fantastic nyonya foods!!!
Must try!!

Lovely people, lovely food^^

Author: ngamandaSingapore, Singapore
Title: Highly recommended!
Review: The authentic Nyonya food is a must try! The Melting Pot also surprised us with their unique and healthy Brown Rice Nasi Lemak set and Coconut Oil Fried Rice. This precious gem is a lovely place with its good service and one-of-a-kind decor!!Recommended it to my friends and they love it too! Show less

Author: kce49
Title: Very great environment, food & price are worth of value
Review: Must try! Traditional Nyonya cuisine especially Ponteh Chicken, Salted Cili Chicken, Kangkong Belacan, deep fried tofu, Tom Yam Soup, Cincalok (shrimp paste) Egg....and the best is their homemade Iced Lemon Tea, healthy and low sugar contain is a merit!

Author: U5289XFandrewt
Title: Tasty food
Review: We arrived in town on a Monday evening, had no idea that half the town closes on Mondays. We stumbled across this place, and it was by far the busiest restaurant despite only having one other table occupied (every where else was completely empty). We ordered two of the signature dishes and both were delicious. Service was ok. Overall I would recommend giving this place a go for their local dishes.Show less

Author: June C
Title: Good baba and nyonya dish
Review: The waiter recommended the PongTeh dish. We ordered that and it was delicious! We also ordered the thai style tofu, which is great. Nice place, good service and good food.

Author: 494marionp
Title: Okay.
Review: Food was ok but expensive. Jonker street is more expensive compared to the side streets. Service was ok, food took a while but it was Saturday.

Author: boundlessfun
Title: Good food
Review: Ate here on two occasions. Food was good for the price, fresh ingredients. Service was horrible!, waited over 50 minutes before being served both nights. Restaurant has A/C but they don't use it.  Nicely decorated inside.

Author: AndrewN424Tadley, United Kingdom
Title: Decent value and surprisingly quiet
Review: On a Sat afternoon we were expecting all restaurants to be packed, but this one was literally empty when we arrived. We chose local specialities which were all tasty enough, even if the portion sizes were a little smaller than I would have liked. Add a bucket or two of beer and a good lunch was had!Show less

Author: Justinlyh
Title: Not bad and worth trying
Review: Visited this restaurant during a long weekend holiday, that was lunch time, we ordered chicken chili garam, taste very nice, one of the restaurant signature dish. Must try. Omelette cencaluk not bad. Thier ice lemon tea also taste great. Will come back again.

Author: elisewong0Kuala Selangor, Selangor, Malaysia
Title: If I could rate a negative, I would
Review: When we got there, my aunt and cousin were already sitting at the table with an additional person with her back facing us. I didn't know who it was and when we saw who it was, it was the waitress sitting on the table and did not move a budge when we sat down, not even a smile to us. Even after ordering, she's still talking about what-- even I dunno. We just wanted her to get out orders to the kitchen. We were hungry from walking around jonker Street. If that was bad enough, we had to wait an hour for our food to arrive and there was nobody in the room! When the food finally arrived. The rice came at a very tortoise pace. All that time waiting, they could at least prepare the rice and forks and spoons so we can eat readily but noooooo... Now for the food. It is not authentic at all. The pom tay was diluted. In actuality,the stew was suppose to boil with the potatoes for a while to the point the stew is thick and the potatoes super soft but this was far from it. Their prawn fritters, I think.. Even the local store by the road that sells 'cucur udang' actually tastes better. The otak otak was alright. The Tom yam was alright but they use very cheap cuts of meat for every dish. For the pom tay, they use chicken breast (with skills, you can make the breast soft but the meat was incredibly tough and dry) as for the Tom yam, there was very few fish meat and a lot more of fish cakes. Really? The kangkung was alright. The omelet was meh... We came out of the place very disappointed and VERY angry. Show less

Author: QingY106
Title: Discovered a good cafe
Review:
Here have really really delicious brunch❤
The price also reasonable. Can come and have a try.You will like it.

Author: yeeqingxuan96
Title: 很温馨的店 价廉物美
Review: 很棒的店!Nice!!尤其是Salmon scramble 值得一try😍 spicy korea burger也很大份 Big breakfast 也有很多的选择😋 食物满便宜的说 一杯chocolate才11块☺️ 希望出更多特别的菜单 让我们有更多的口服...

Author: JeaNcyeeKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Brunch in Melaka
Review: Went there with a bunch of friends for brunch. Happen to pass by and surprise this is a cafe rather than it's look like a tailor shop. Choice of food is good. Price reasonable around mid range. Abit noisy if this place is crowded, mayb of the area's space design. Service is slow but they already inform us when we enter as they are short of staff on that day. They free us a latte (price deduct from our bill) because of the bad service (we wait almost 1 hr for our food that day) when we pay our bill. So sweet...Show less

Author: Christopher L
Title: Very high quality food, reasonable prices and old times nostalgia
Review: Walked by this shop and really thought it's a old school Tailor shop. Then decided to be curious and walked in. And it's such a pleasant surprise! We ordered an old fashion waffle rm12.90 and a herb sausage pizza rm23.90 to share! Very very yummy. Both are warm and crispy. Freshly made. Will definitely make a revisit each time we visit Melaka.Show less

Author: violetmin6
Title: Overrated.
Review: Overrated. Service was slow and no much special for the food. Rose latte coffee was good. Good spot to take photos, but not dine in.

Author: Highgater1London, United Kingdom
Title: Hidden coffee Gem
Review: This cafe is hard to locate as the entrance is on a side street. (It is not on Melaka Raya 1 even though it is their official address) it’s located on side of Hatten Shops near 7-11.The front shop looks like a tailor shop as it has models. Once you push the door open you will see the tailor counter as if you are in a tailor shop. Turn right and left to get into the cafe.They serve fantastic coffee. They have hot and cold coffees, milk coffee (lattes) or hot/cold brew where you can choose your beans. They serve western and local food and the waffle is great. If you are in a hurry, this is not a place to go as the service can be slow. You will need to order at the counter .Show less

Author: Han LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Surprising find
Review: Chanced upon this place while taking a stroll off the main road. The entrance resembles that of a tailor shop and the counter upon opening door too. Inside the cafe, its an "old school" feel, many Instagramy spots for IGers. They serve hand brew coffee with various types of beans for you to try out. The waffle and brownie are great dessert options to go with the coffee. Great ambience and quiet spot for you to take a respite from the crowd in Melaka.Show less

Author: LachezisSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quaint cosy place
Review: A must visit cafe if your are into cafe-hopping during your trip. Coffee and food is good. Everything from the food served to the ambience is “instagramish” (lol)! Typical of JWC cafes... Less than 5 Min walk from the bus terminal near @ Manhattan Square. Good to rest your feet or while waiting for your coachShow less

Author: Rose_Pg14
Title: Pineapple Tarts
Review: Smells good the tart. Not too sweet. To me is just average,  not exceptionly good.. may be is personal preference. The wooden house is by road side, not difficult to find. Family home style business.

Author: xkampungboySingapore
Title: Bee Bee - pineapple tarts in Nyonya land
Review: Day trip to Malacca for a food binge and to cart back some 16 cans of Pineappletarts. Arrived in the morning at BeeBee — got to taste some samples ... and based on that places order to return in the afternoon to collect. Baked to order. Final Verdict. Jam is good but they have use Planta margarine instead of butter. A disappointment . I have tasted better pastries. Should not compromised on butter. Oh well if that is the best Malacca had to offer bought anyway. Bee Bee also had the other type ( rolled ) tarts . No samples . Butter used. But not as nice. The shophouse is a nondescript house that we were at first not even sure it is the place. It is. As homemade as you can have .Show less

Author: Jolcy
Title: THE ULTIMATE PINEAPPLE TART
Review: BEST PINEAPPLE TARTS EVER!!! Well-baked, savoury, buttery pastry with a rich pineapple filling that's just-the-right-goldilocks level of sweetness! This is the ONLY go to place you will EVER need for traditional homemade pineapple tarts!

Author: ClareT634
Title: Food Legacy - Pineapple Tart
Review: I grew up making this type (shape & style) of tart during special occasions Chinese New Year & Christmas. We don't make it anymore bcos the process is too laborious. So when my good Melaka friend recommended Bee Bee Pineapple tart, I thought "Erm... ok".... but when I but when I bit into the tart, my childhood scenery & feeling flashed by. Much like how you see in movie.Yum... yum... The sweetness of the jam and balanced perfectly with the salty pastry. I've always preferred the pastry base that has a bite, rather than the crumbly short log like pastry.So Bee Bee pineapple tart is PERFECTION for me. Aaah... I'm in heaven.Show less

Author: Jlee993
Title: Burnt
Review: Used to be one of the best places to get pineapple tarts, however, got 2 boxes of quite badly burnt pastries.

Author: Food4godsKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: a nice crunch!
Review: The pineapple tarts are very good, how nyonya tarts are to be. It is very addictive and you will need more than 1 box of them!The muruku comes in 2 type. The thin ones are very good too. Crispy and the spices come through very nicely. Not too powerful and oily.Buy more!!Show less

Author: Cecilia Y
Title: Homemade Pineapple Tarts
Review: A rare find.  Tarts made from scratch by Bee Bee herself.  Love the tarts and will return to get them again.

Author: IdrisA788
Title: Top of the pineapple tart pops!
Review: Innocuose house along Jalan Parameswara hiding probably the best handcrafted pineapple tarts in Melaka. Auntu Yan Choo proved to be a gem and her tarts were a treat!!

Author: spockrockerSingapore, Singapore
Title: Very average tarts.
Review: I'm a huge fan of Malaysian food and pastries but these tarts were a huge disappointment.Pineapple part was dry. Pastry (got the butter covered ones) was drier and had zero butter taste. Now i understand why the owner said "no sample" when we asked for some to try.Show less

Author: ushag86Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pineapple tarts
Review: What I like about these tarts are the fact that it is not too sweet. Also, u have to go there to buy the tarts personally as its lovely to smell the freshly baked tarts in the house. If you are lucky, you will be able to see ladies placing the deco on top of the tarts which are really tedious to do with their fingers for each tart. I was amazed when I saw this.Show less

Author: saisaras_sivarajahSingapore, Singapore
Title: The pastry smells egg-y
Review: After all the positive comments on tripadvisor (ignoring the negative comments) we decided to get some pineapple tarts from this place. First of all, it was quite hard to locate. It is actually along a main street which makes spotting it difficult and parking even worse. When we enter the main hall where the baking is done, we were greeted by an unfriendly aunty. She was short of asking us "why are you here?". The tone in her voice, her body language all suggested that she was in a very bad mood that day and she was taking it out on us. When we requested for a taste of the tart before deciding the number of boxes to purchased, she refused saying that none of her tarts were spoiled that day, so we could not have any to taste. So we ended up buying one box of tarts for Rm15 and after tasting it decided that one was enough. The pastry had a very eggy smell and taste to it. I just don't like that smell in my cakes and pastry and so that really out me off. As for the pineapple filling, that was good. But other shops such as Bibik House seems to have similar tasting filling too. So up to you to decide!Show less

Author: CindyOng_Sbg
Title: Delicious Tarts
Review: Generous mounds of pineapple nestled on savoury pastry. A definite must try for pineapple tart lovers:)

Author: pw1717
Title: Not as sedap
Review: I used to buy quite a number of boxes of tarts but it seems that the standard has dropped.  The crust is hard and more flaky compared to the past.  However, the pineapple filling is still quite exceptional.

Author: Ee Guan L
Title: Overrated
Review: Flaky crust, not-tasty pineapple filling - honestly, I don't know what the fuss was all about. xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: pineapple tarts talk!
Review: Melaka is surely a pineapple tart stop. This is among the best in Melaka. Nothing fancy to the look but the taste is great!

Author: 907yapk
Title: Quite good
Review: Is a quite good and recommended Pineapple tart that selling in Malacca. Recommended although is a bit high price if you don't mind.

Author: Popcorn17Singapore, Singapore
Title: Not nice at all...:(
Review: Since this store have so many reviews so I decided to drive to this particular pineapple tart house to buy some and try. But after trying, I felt that the pineapple tarts is nothing like Singapore's tarts, no buttery taste and very dry taste like biscuit instead and worse of all more expensive then those sell at jonker street, won't recommend to friends.Show less

Author: Felicia TMalacca
Title: Perfect Malacca Pineapple Tart
Review: Just bought some for friends and tasted some.The outlook is not very attractive, it looks darker color , a bit like over burn but with the first bite ( must eat the crust and the jam together ) the impression change. Perfect match.If you like the type which the crust is melt in your mouth then you will not prefer this type. The crust is crunchy, a bit salty . The pineapple jam is not so sweet and not so dry. Nice !! Typical Malacca pineapple tart. Must try.Show less

Author: ganadelineSingapore, Singapore
Title: Simply forgettable
Review: I do not like the pineapple tarts at all. The pineapple jam is rather sweet and not tangy. It did not taste like it is hand made by grating the pineapple manually. They use commercially-made jam. I know because it sticks to your teeth and lacks the fibrery look which will actually give the jam some form of crunch when eating it. The crust is strangely salty. It does not really melt in your mouth and dry. Butter used is not of quality too.Tried other shops selling these tarts but none of them can deliver. In fact some are even worse. Gave up trying the tarts. Prefer the tambun biscuits instead and one shop does make very good ones on Jonker street.Still prefer home-baked tarts.Show less

Author: travelMAKANKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Pastry is salty
Review: The pastry is a bit salty. I am not going back. There is a shop opposite Aik Cheong Coffee Roaster in Jonker Walk that bakes fresh pineapple tarts, 'loe poh peang' (wife biscuit) & Tambun Biscuit. They have samples for you to try. Author: wshaprMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Impressed hotel restaurant food
Review: As a Malaccan, I seldom go to Melaka hotels for food as outside hawkers food is more tasty, delicious and cheaper than tasteless and expensive hotel food. However, this restaurant in the hotel changed my perception. Initially, we wanted to have our family CNY Eve food here to utilize the RM 300 membership voucher given by the hotel , however, the menu had been fixed and we gave up. We finally visited this restaurant on the Malaysia GE14 on 9th May after the voting. We decided to celebrate Mother's day earlier on that day and we chose this hotel without any booking in advance. To our surprise, we were the 1st customer without any waiting. Even though the new Myanmar waiter was his 1st day work and he kept mentioning not able to recommend the dishes, but, he tried his best to fulfill our needs like he informed the chef to gave us more gravy for crab meat tau fu dish etc. The dishes seemed large to 5 of us, but, we were able to finish it. Author: NVJoeReno, Nevada
Title: King Kong and Ping Pong
Review: Voracious as giant prehistoric apes, we prowled the streets of Malacca in search of dinner. Since it was our only night in town, we hunted for some indigenous Nyonya cooking.Nyonya is Chinese-Malay fusion cuisine, first blended when Chinese immigrants to the Straits Settlements combined their cooking techniques with local Malaysian ingredients. At last, we tracked down Baba Fred Nyonya, a simple establishment busy with casual customers. The welcoming staff and English menu made ordering surprisingly straightforward.We easily agreed on the mixed chicken (steamed and roasted) and nyonya fried rice. When we added kangkong garlic and chicken rice balls, our waiter quipped, “King Kong and Ping Pong”.All joking aside, the chicken was tender and juicy, the nyonya rice was fried to perfection, the kangkong water spinach was laced with garlicy goodness, and the dense rice balls were packed with flavor and fun to eat.To sum it up, Baba Fred Nyonya dished up tasty, home-style fare, served in portions large enough to satisfy King Kong, after a ferocious game of table tennis.Show less
