I am open to share in private with the manager about our various experiences of this restaurant.I have been in this Loyalty program for the last 10 years and have stayed in many of their properties in the Pacific, Australia/NZ, Europe etc. but this one certainly is an ENIGMA . Just hoping that the new Ibis that is to open soon here in Melaka will not be in the same category.Show less

Author: Amy Tiramisu K
Title: Great buffet spread (breakfast)
Review: waiter/waitress are very hardworking! They are very attentive. noticed that they are mostly teenagers, hope Novotel pays them well!

Author: HuixianW2
Title: hotel stay at Novotel with free breakfast
Review: good spread of halal international buffet, suitable for all to come. Filling breakfast time spent with friends.

Author: Ethan926
Title: the square breakfast
Review: comprehensive coment is above average, it is convenient for business trip. The breakfast food include China, America and local style. The only thing lacking is the selection of food is fewer.

Author: chanss2017
Title: poor selection
Review: replenishment of food is slow, staff is also not responsive. utensils/cups are not replenished. food selection also very limited. almost the same selection everyday

Author: 142eirarSeoul, South Korea
Title: Short vacation in Melaka
Review: The food here are nice. The promotional lunch and dinner with free drinks was really worth to try. The nasi goreng kampung is nice... The staff was friendly too. Have a good time here. Absolutely a place to chill... Show less

Author: General_kohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Below average food
Review: Don't waste your time here. There are better food along the street than this. The variety is very limited and many of the food are cold. Show less

Author: pirdmnParis, France
Title: Great tandoori and naan !
Review: We went there around 23h00, had a great tandoori chicken + cheese naan + orange juice ! Was only 16.5MYR each !Tandoori was yummy and not dry at all, with the right amount of spices !Maybe this restaurant isn't that good looking, but the food is good! Show less

Author: wesleywaisiu
Title: Nice food for supper
Review: Nice place for supper after midnight. The Indian food from this place is nice, especially the tissue prata. The cleanliness of this place should improve a bit.

Author: Faridah F
Title: Al Dubai Restaurant...cool places ...sea view. ..
Review: Amazing n cool place...tandoori n naan was juicy n yummy..mango lassi also...the building is nice n creative design.. goood serve....friendly owner ....must try it..recommended

Author: albatross-549Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Lahore Street Food in Malaysia
Review: The place is relatively new, but has made a great beginning in serving the Pakistani flavours, like roasted gosht, Tandoori Chicken, Naans etc. The essence of the place is the authentic taste of the preparations served.It also caters to the local flavours of Malaysia, but I would recommend it for enjoyinng the Lahore street food taste in Melaka MalaysiaThe ambience is average as it has outdoor seating as well.Show less

Author: Hiker788
Title: Good Briyani after a busy day
Review: Good ambient. Nice restaurant setup but unfortunately i went there during MCO, So they only open for take away. Heard they used to be packed during non-mco period. The food is tasty and great. They do have many choices.

Author: Vijay T
Title: Good Biryani House in Melaka
Review:
Good ambiance.  Clean restaurant. Excellent & fast service.
Ordered veg biryani.
Taste of the biryani was very good.
However, the veg biryani had no vegetables in it. Just mock chicken gravy.
Food came lukewarm, was not hot.
Raita was excellent.
Masala chai is good.

Author: Butterflypost
Title: A unique place
Review: Come   , eat and enjoy.near major hotels,owned by a major in the malaysian army.Has river view.Tasty flavour.Large choice.Green theme.

Author: willwin9391
Title: Best pineapple cake in town
Review: Best pineapple cake in town, they also have another flavour like greentea, and the skin is very soft and will melt in your mouth..!! Must try

Author: i_want_to_travel_the
Title: loving all the bread!
Review: their bread are so very nice! i dont wonder a lot of people are getting there just to buy lots and minding the distance at all.

Author: mca8811
Title: convenience to hotel guest
Review:
I visited the melaka raya branch, which is very convenient to hotel hatten n equatorial guest.
Nice n delicious pastries of course.
Address is 181, jalan merdeka, taman melaka raya, 75000 melaka. Can call 06-2862463 (as namecard but not sure bcoz nvr call)

Author: Juli L
Title: First time and not last time
Review: Well, I went there, the staff there very friendly, what ever i ask them, they let me try, and I bought golden pineapple cookies, green tea, chicken mushroom cha siew puff was so yumm, and than the kaya puff yummy will be back and recommend to friendShow less

Author: JoanneLeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Fresh pastries out from oven!
Review: This shop offers a wide selection of pastries from savory ones to sweet ones. One of my favorite item from their shop is definitely their BBQ chicken siewpao (baked bun). The pastry has got the correct amount of flakiness to it and each bun is glazed with honey/ malt syrup and the sweetness and crispiness of the pastry compliments the filling of the bun very well.Besides siewpao, their egg tarts and pineapple tarts are also highly recommended. Price is definitely reasonable and staff are all attentive and friendly. It also sells a range of local snacks and other pastries, you'll sure be spoil by choices when you do visit.Show less

Author: karenmR8990WESydney, Australia
Title: Fab dinner
Review: We ventured in from the street with no knowledge if there was any English menus or even English speaking staff. It’s essentially a Hawker type cook on street place. Well, they have a very large, easy to understand English menu and the food is AMAZING! Can recommend Singapore Noodles - prob the best I’ve had in Asia. And the chicken dishes, veg dishes. All great. Totally recommend!!!Show less

Author: Jovial D
Title: superb stuff
Review: the food is fresh and clean. the ambiance is breath taking especially around the place. one should not miss the snacks and fried goodies.

Author: Wendy CGold Coast, Australia
Title: Amazing Local Food
Review: What a beautiful little place. Run by a family. Beautiful fresh food. The son does the cooking. We went there 3 times for dinner. So fresh . The satay chicken and rice was so good we went back the next day and had the same. Simple food at a great price. We left a tip on each nite as we thought the price was too cheap for what we got. Changed from Satay Chicken on the 3rd nite to Curry chicken, Just as good. Beautiful spices.Show less

Author: Best127Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good for Local Breakfast
Review: Prepare to queue and wait for seats as this is a small coffee shop that housed the popular Wan Tan Mee stall. Other than the Wan Tan Mee, the coffeeshop’s owner serves the usual butter kaya toasts, wrapped nasi lemak and some Nyonya kuehs. This Wan Tan Mee is full of childhood memories made in the simplest yet authentic way. The rest of the breakfast items are not bad. All priced reasonably.Take note of their address as below due to their outdated address stated in some websites. Address: No.3 Jalan Hang Lekiu, 75200 Melaka. Show less

Author: alanchua1967
Title: Heng Huat coffee shop at jonker street jln hang jebat!
Review: Good wanton mee,coffee &tea Delish! A quaint little coffee shop with many more choice of food to discover...Die die must try....👏👏👏👍👍👍

Author: GanL
Title: Enjoying the songs
Review: Went in to have coffee and toasted bread to take a break from the free of charge open air singing performance at the Jonker Walk stage. Nice coffee, nice toast, cheap. Nice to sit there and watch the people gathering at Jonker Walk.

Author: satoyuriko
Title: old style wanton mee and kaya toast
Review: This is a must go place for me whenever in Melaka. I enjoyed the old style wanton mee, the kaya toasts, and the half boiled kampong eggs. Coffee and tea are good too. Price is wonderful!

Author: faustinekaySingapore, Singapore
Title: Not as tasty as expected
Review: Stumbled upon this coffeeshop to realize it was a popular recommendation for wanton mee. Place was packed and generally smaller dining parties had to share a table. The service was of slower pace, it took about half an hour for us to receive our orders, perhaps due to the peak long weekend crowd.Taste wise, we felt it was much more bland than what we are used to in Singapore.Show less

Author: 837lewmSingapore
Title: 传统阿婆云吞面 Traditional Grandma Wantan Mee
Review: This particlar stall ‘传统阿婆云吞面‘ serves traditional childhood-taste wanton noodles in a old Heng Huat Coffee Shop. Cheap (RM 4.50, RM5.50, RM 6.50) and delicious. Plain (without black sauce), but TASTY and fragrant! Unfortunately， it opens in the morning 7.30 am till 11.30 am.Besides, must also order the chee cheong fun and steam yam cake (next to this wanton mee stall in the same coffee shop), you will love it!Show less

Author: NavindranR5
Title: Porky Good!
Review: There aren't many places to have good pork western cuisine in Melaka. Here's one of the places. Prices are decent. Not expensive. Food is tasty and good. Worth the visit.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still very much the same....
Review: Came in early, and it was very quiet. Greeted by the only worker at the shop front, and given the menu. Ordered pork belly chop, wild mushroom soup with garlic bread with discounted price. The promotion/offer is still the same as 3 months ago.Past 1pm and the crowd started to come in.So, want a quiet meal, this is the place to come to have but make sure it is before the lunch break hour.Show less

Author: ANZIO28
Title: We have been on several occasions
Review: We found the service quite good. Both the manager/owner and waiting staff were friendly and attentive. We have ordered both spaghetti bolognese and olio and we enjoyed both dishes. My wife tried the Thai bihun which she liked and we found the sauces that went into the salad dish rather tasty. The meat that is being served is not inexpensive but it is of good quality. One gets what one pays for.Show less

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Tuck in a corner...
Review: Searched around this area and found this place to try out their food.It is located in a quiet part of this new area. As the shop name suggest, their menu consist of mainly meat dishes, and especially pork dishes. Ordered French pork shop, and the waiter explained that the meat would be chewy, which is fine.Also ordered mushroom soup. The waiter recommend to take their garlic bread, where, it only cost MYR2 rather than paying for the full price. The food is good and price is reasonable. As it as weekend, parking was a chellenge, as parking was free during weekends.Show less

Author: phoebet546
Title: Pork specialty diner
Review: This double storey diner looks welcoming. Didn't go up to the 2nd floor, so can't comment on how it looks. But the ground floor itself feels spacious.There is a deli refrigerator, but it was empty. Was expecting to see ham, bacon, pork cuts, sausages n etc for sale.The food was tasty. I enjoyed the pork belly, it was well seasoned. It was savory and has some charred caramelized bits. Show less

Author: FindTravelPartner
Title: Pork Cafe
Review: overall food is so so only. The only thing that i hate is some of the dish in menu need preorder, i think they need to improve their menu.

Author: samnatkarenSingapore, Singapore
Title: Good decent Nyonya cuisine in a accessible location
Review: The restaurant is near towards the end/start of Jonker street and is one of many nyonya restaurants in the area. The place was recommended to us by the hotel staff. The chap chay, fried chicken wings and fried omelette are really good and taste better than alot of places. However the chilli fish dish was horrible which was really a disappointment. The uncle servicing us is really friendly and service is prompt and polite. Overall, if you are looking for a meal in jonker, i will say this is a decent place to tryShow less

Author: macvanteh
Title: Could be way better
Review: The dishes were served slow and the taste did not meet our expectation about Nyonya cuisine. We came to this restaurant because the other Nyonya restaurant had long queue and we would not come back again.

Author: Rita Y
Title: Decent Tasting Nonya Food
Review: I have visited this place a few times over a few years and the quality has remained pretty consistent, tasting like the food you would get when you visit your Nonya friend's home.I only wish that they can improve on their ayam buah keluak (at least 2 shells were empty in our medium size order) and use bigger shrimps for their shrimp petai dishShow less

Author: derrickawcw
Title: Great place to eat
Review: Authentic nyonya food, not many choices, friendly efficient staff, cosy basic environment (noisy outside because of night activities; noisy inside because of sound reflections)

Author: ongkoks2008Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nyonya Foods
Review: Located along the Jonker Street. It was insanely packed or crowded due to Hari Raya holiday season.We had 6 dishes in the restaurant for 2 tables with 13paxs. The asam curry fish was great, otak-otak was awesome, fried cincaluk eggs & vegetarian food were pretty decent. Of course, we ordered pineapple juice drink too. The bill came to RM400.80.Show less

Author: KieranWeeSingapore, Singapore
Title: The worst Peranakan food I ever tasted
Review: Can across this place and decided to give it try after reading some of the positive reviews given. Ordered- Ayam Buar kelauk- chap chai- Prawn sambal with petai- pineapple fishThe only not too bad dish was the prawn, but wait till you check out my pictures on how big these shrimps are!!The ayam buar kelauk was a disaster , it tasted horrible. The cod fish wasn't fresh and the sauce was overly sweet. Coming from a Peranakan heritage , I feel so shameful they even dare serve such food!!! Even my mum home cook taste a million times better!!Those who claim the food here isn't bad have either been bride by the owner or have loss their taste. Lastly , it's super over priced !!! Check out my pictures and it tells a story.Show less

Author: RONALDODIMATTEO
Title: Very good local food
Review:
The food is simple but it tastes delicious
Very famous place in Melacca, in joncker street, close to the stage with some karaoke contests

Author: Corsair AKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Friendly owner, pleasant food
Review: My friends and I were walking around the Jonker Street on Saturday and since the shop only opens until 2.00pm, we were a bit worried that the shop might closes by the time we reach there. So, once of my friend went there to book 2 tables and the owner kindly told my friend she'll wait to serve all of us before closing the shop. The owner even warmly greet us after our meal. Overall, good food and pleasant experience.Show less

Author: Deon L
Title: Review on Restoran Anak Nyonya
Review: Excellent review? Ooops sorry to disappoint the readers. A very bad waiting experience. Waited nearly an hour for the dishes (cold dishes). Food wasnt fantastic, not an authentic peranakan cuisine. Portion was small and lack of quality.If you were to ask me to visit again? My answer is a firm NO. Not worth waiting. Waste of time.Show less

Author: Ernest K
Title: Home Feel Nyonya Food
Review:
Varieties of Nonya Food. Good Nonya chilly paste. Only thing is the food is not hot enough when served.
Overall OK.

Author: 704marlenehBurlingame, California
Title: Wonderful giant chicken curry bun!
Review: When we saw these huge buns, we had to try one, especially when our tour guide told us it was the only restaurant in Melaka that made them. It was a beautiful presentation when they served it. First they cut the bread with scissors into wedges, which they fold back to expose foil. They open up the foil to expose parchment paper, which is then opened to the curried chicken stew. You break off the bread wedges and dip into the yummy chicken stew. Not only was this a fun experience but it was excellent food.Show less

Author: Debaprasad B
Title: Something new!!!
Review: I happen to be at this place by chance as I was passing bye the name attracted me thought it to be some Indian eating joint. It was actually a Chinese delicacy which i immensely liked. Quite reasonable  and very tasty.

Author: ReccaHuang
Title: Nice
Review: The bread goes well with the chicken curry , cant go wrong with trying this one. We love it so much that we actually got a 2nd one the next day

Author: Mohnazmi
Title: Just Ok
Review: Overall for western talam just nice, noodle soup just ok , meatball also ok. I give 3/5 for their food.

Author: kheiza
Title: Fussy
Review: No bad. I am very fussy bout food but this restaurant not bad at all. 3days im at melaka no satisfaction on food until i found this place.

Author: Nurhafidah93
Title: Never come back 🤯
Review: The service was really bad! There is not much people at the place! The food was served very late!! The taste of the western dulang was bad !! Not suitable with price !! The meatball was very hard to chew!

Author: madocznavera
Title: besen means basin but they serve not only mee / noodles
Review: it was an experience eating here.. however.. get ready to have a moderate waiting time.... of oucrse the serving size is huge... but can be finished by 2 ppl. check the operating times... taste is not bad la...

Author: e_janz
Title: Unique
Review: Another food attraction in Melaka. The soup noodle was served in 'besen' (big bowl). They use to have beef and chicken soup last time but during my visit they only have chicken soup. Delicious...

Author: ralf e
Title: Unique
Review: Another food attraction in Melaka. The soup noodle served in a 'besen' (big bowl). Last time you may choose between beef or chicken soup but now they only have chicken soup.

Author: Fiey15_R
Title: just a plain mee soup
Review: It is just mee soup in a large bowl. Nothing special. The drinks all too fancy type, not much variety to choose.

Author: hkrishna2014Padang, Indonesia
Title: Awesome...
Review: I give this noodle 5 stars. Man, i love it. Besen means moreless big bucket. And it is big. We ordered mie besen Medium and talam dua muka, that contains lamb ribs, lamb grilled, potato and egg yolks pudding. Both of the foods tasted awesome. The beverages are delicious too. And big.. I mean big portion. Show less

Author: AinilIShah Alam
Title: Nice tasty food
Review: This restaurant has an interesting concept of serving ( in besen / big bowls that come in different sizes ) & they cook tasty food too. We had western & mee soya soup. Both were yummy. To eat in this restaurant, you have to queue by writing your name in the q-book first, then grab a seat in front of the restaurant & wait for the waiter to call your name once the table is ready. Show less

Author: guruprasad08
Title: Decent place near Jonker Street
Review: Good place to hangout with a live band and beer. Beer selection can be improved as you have too less options to choose from. Shisha and friendly staffs was the best part of this place ..

Author: AbangBob
Title: Nice place
Review: Nothing Irish but had a live music. Drinks are not expensive but can be a nice place to hang around and good drinks.

Author: Yew Mun LSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nice place to chill out...😊
Review: The atmosphere of this pub was very nice and the drinks prices are reasonable. There was also live band performance and best of all I was able to catch the Liverpool vs Crystal Palace match there.Very lucky indeed to be able to catch the game while holidaying in Melaka. The lady boss and her staff were very friendly too. Cheers Irish Harp!Show less

Author: poopshooter
Title: drinks & live football...
Review: A nice hangout along one of the streets in Jonker Walk. Good place to catch live football games. Decent drink offers. Service is friendly & attentive. They also have live music but we missed it. Nice to have a chilled beer & people watch. Recommended.

Author: tontotaylorLightwater, United Kingdom
Title: Great Atmosphere down a quiter Street.
Review: If you after a chilled out evening enjoying a few Beers and listening to the live music this is the place. Good selection of Drinks at reasonable prices.Food menu is limited but food can be purchased at the adjacent eateries and consumed here.Service staff are great and really want to make your evening. Good live music covering the usual favourites. Definitely worth a visit. Show less

Author: 552WendyH552
Title: Good music
Review: This is a nice place to chill after dinner and walking Jonker Walk. The two singers are great fun, will join you for a drink between sets. Happy hour finishes just before the music starts.

Author: Andrew JKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Luck of the Irish!
Review: The wife and I were in Melaka last Sunday (7 May) specifically, Jonker Street. After walking through the night market and having a drink at the Geographer Cafe, I was in desperate search of a sports bar/ or a bar that screens EPL matches live. Arsenal was playing Man United, so it's a massive game for us football fans.The Irish Harp is just down the road from Geographer Cafe and we made it in time for the match, luck of the Irish eh? I had three half-pints of Guinness for RM50 and it tasted heavenly from standard two-part pour by the bartender, we also had some light snacks and enjoyed the match.Special mention to the one-man band that night (didn't get his name) who played some classic tunes and sang really well.Overall, it was an excellent experience - great beer, lovely music, not too crowded, the usual snacks on the menu that goes well with your brew and football..... what more could a lad want?Show less

Author: ecossegeo
Title: Poor service, rip off at "Happy Hour"
Review:
Run by kids, very poor service, order during "Happy Hour", but beware you may get charged full price.
Mainly a place to go and watch football on several TV's.
With so much to choose from locally why would you come here.

never again for us..

Author: RubySong
Title: quit relaxing place for a drink with relaxing songs
Review: its quite alright to sit , relaxing listening to simple 2 pcs band. low chair with back rest... can sit for 2 to 3 mugs of beer. not that crowded.

Author: bshim7822Langkawi, Malaysia
Title: Freestyle visit
Review: Just to have a free style drinking after heavy foods. The shop always displaying football matches like others. It is located not on the main street, therefore not a add strategic location for shoppers. Happy and after happy hours drinking for Heineken per hotel $18, per bucket is $68 and $75 respectivelyShow less

Author: Prameela_Rajaratnan
Title: Dinner
Review: We went there on recomendation. It was excellent. The noodle had a very refreshing flavour. We tried 3 different types and each type was as superb as the other. The service the attention the ambience was equally great.

Author: Jaysham A
Title: Superb Dinner
Review: We went for dinner. The noddles was light and every spoon of the soup was so tasty. we had 2 drinks and it was also so tastefully done. But to top it, the ambiance and service was equally excellent. Service with a smile was so much appreciated. The owner Eunice, was so ready to meet and chat with us. It was a totally nice experience and definitely I will visit again and recommend my friends.Show less

Author: Lil Ly cMalaysia
Title: Homey meals, quick and affordable
Review: This is the place for some chicken/pork chop rice or noodle; soup or dry. Also dumplings and stir fry vegetables. It's kinda simple Taiwanese cuisine. Available a good range of beverages from juices, milk tea n pearls and the usual coffee n tea.Tastes is excellent, service is quick and the owners a husband n wife team is super friendly. The restaurant is air conditioned and deco modern, whereby you can have meals comfortably. Show less

Author: Billie J
Title: A Hidden Gem in Malacca
Review: Very nice and comfy place to have breakfast under the sun with family and friends. Excellent service, coffee and food. Will definitely return.

Author: Mohnazmi
Title: Delicious
Review: All food especially pasta very delicious my rating 4.5/5 . Desert just nice , price just ok . Overall highly recommended.

Author: marilyne2375
Title: good choices
Review: good choices available for breakfast although the dishes sometimes are slow to be refilled. staff attending are friendly and helpful.

Author: Nobodyseek3rsMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Chicken Chop With Salted Egg Sauce Delicious !!!!!!!!
Review: Located in Kings Green Hotel Malacca, the place called Hibiscus Cafe! you can get their delicious but affordable chicken chop in Malacca. Starting from RM 19, you can get their huge portion of chicken chop with choices of salted eggs sauce, black paper sauce or mushroom sauce. Usually, on chicken chop dish you’ll get chicken chop with sauce, fries and coleslaw.One of their popular dish in here is fried chicken chop with salted eggs sauce so I decided to order that. At first glance, it’s huge (the portion size is generous) and when I took the first bite, it was awesome! The chicken is tender, batter taste good, fried to perfection, the sauce is thick, creamy and taste awesome and their fries portion is more than fair!Show less

Author: rahidaha2018
Title: Chicken Chop
Review: I’ve tried the chicken chop here..marvelous!!! And the price also reasonable..i give ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️!!! Should come and try!!!

Author: thomas P
Title: Awesome Chicken Chop Sauce
Review: Best chicken chop wz their signature sauce can hv either breaded or grilled great taste is on promotion now, they also hv the afternoon teh tarik time wz goreng pisang cucuk udang keropok lekor and more good taste too

Author: Thomas T
Title: Fried Oyster
Review: One of the better ones that we have had. Enjoyed this better than the one at a nearby stall. Oysters were fresh and chilli sauce was piquant.

Author: leecK9330OU
Title: Local Chinese Restaurant
Review: Overall, their food are tasty. Howver osyter eggs are over cooked. Price is reasonable. Service can be improved

Author: AnuvatC
Title: Local favorite
Review: This place may not on top of travel guide list but it got good rating and always full of locals so I tried. Not disappointing at all. Food is good and service is great. I liked every dishes we ate there especially fried oysters and sweet and sour pork ribs in yam ring. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: JiaYee82Auckland Central, New Zealand
Title: Great place for unpretentious excellent food
Review: Melaka at times seem to consist of nothing but food outlets and small hotels, so choices can be bewildering when looking for a good meal. Like all our Melaka tastings this came with a local recommendation from people whove lived and worked in the city for much of their lives. Amidst all the dinky/trendy in neighbouring streets looks a little mundane but don't be put off, the food is great.Excellent 'spring rolls', tofu, fresh beatifully cooked pomfret, mushroom noodles...satisfying dinner for four Rm 134 all up inc. the fish, usually the most expensive dish, and tea. Show less

Author: Lengtan67Kuala Lumpur
Title: Better Than The Ones in KL
Review: May not be the best that I had tasted but definitely better than the ones I had in KL.It may be a bit bland provided each mouthful goes with the chili sauce provided.Rather chewy as powder used for the batter is made from sweet potato instead of tapioca, as I was told by the lady.Don't expect it to have huge oysters after all, it only cost RM 12 for a big portion.Is a corner shop is located end Lorong Hang Jebat, if we are walking from Jonker Street.Show less

Author: gluttonsaysSingapore, Singapore
Title: Mediocre oyster omelette
Review: I tried the oyster omelette for supper. It was RM8 for a 'small' portion. It was average, i wouldn't buy it again. The oyster was so small and minuscule, i think it would have been better if they added cockles instead. On a more positive note, the omelette is well-textured, with the right amount of starch added in it. The chilli complements the omelette very well. I just won't have it again because i've had better ones back home, but everything is worth a try and this one is not too bad to start off! :)Show less

Author: Scottygirl82Malaysia
Title: Great local restaurant
Review: From the street this place looked somewhat less than appealing, but we are delighted we took the risk!Local clientele in any restaurant always give us comfort - and we were not disappointed. We were served promptly and with a smile, which is always a good start. We ate fish, prawns, kangkong and noodles - we were very happy with all the food, and left absolutely nothing on our plates.Show less

Author: Terminator4everSingapore, Singapore
Title: Friendly personnel...Gd food
Review: Don't be afraid to try out this place, the decor might look unsophisticated but the food quality is satisfactory. We came as a group of 9; 4 adults & 5 children. Tried out the soft shell crabs, sambal prawns (small prawns but fresh), Pork ribs in yam ring (2x) sambal/garlic kangkong, hor fun (full of wok hei), fried meesua, oyster noodles...I wouldn't order the meesua or oyster noodles again as they were just ok only, other than that we cleaned up all the plates 100%. Thumbs up for the friendly service fr the young man who took our order, he kindly allowed us to drink our own wine to accompany our food. Thumbs up, keep it up!Show less

Author: chociq
Title: Tiny oysters
Review: We read good reviews about this place. Were let down by the tiny oysters. The batter texture were yummy though. Now if only the oysters are way bigger, I would rate this very good.

Author: NuttyCheeseSingapore, Singapore
Title: Greatly underwhelming for fried oyster
Review: We saw some good reviews on blogs about the or chien (fried oyster) here and went to look for it. We ordered a medium to share between two, and the portion was pretty generous. However, the taste was such a let-down. The oyster size was tiny, but it was fresh at least. There also weren't that many oysters with respect to the size of the dish, so there were lots of mouthfuls of just egg/flour. To be fair, most fried oyster places are the same, but if the egg/flour is tasty, that's fine.We couldn't finish the plate as it was such a boring dish.Show less

Author: tigercranesf
Title: Authentic Nyonya Food
Review: One of many Nyonya type restaurants in Melaka. The food is good, but the portions seem small to me. The restaurant was not crowded on my visit. The food came quickly and was quite good.

Author: SupattraPiBangkok, Thailand
Title: All OK
Review: We had lunch here as recommended by our tour guide. We got to the restaurant around 1pm and it's empty ! Even light & air-con was not on. We thought of changing a restaurant but as too tired - we gave it a go. We order 4 dishes, otak otak - duck soup - bean sprout - and local vegetable with chili paste. Food turned out to be a lot better than expected. We cannot really say it's authentic or not but definitely tasty. It cost us around 18 usd which not too bad at all.Show less

Author: chinchai2016Selangor, Malaysia
Title: Rubber band cooked together with pandan chicken
Review: Food takes long time to serve. Food is not up to par. Prices are at the high side. Only 1 waiter is working. Found out rubber band after opened the pandan leave of the Pandan Chicken. Asked the waiter for restaurant manager, he said no boss. Huge disappointment. Definitely will not return.Show less

Author: WindLynnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Food is average but slightly overpriced
Review: Referrred by aunt to this nyonya restaurant but ended up very disappointing ! We were there on Feb 20 after a long night looking for this restaurant. As we entered, there was nobody in the restaurant. Aircond all off & many mosquitoes !!! Then a foreign staff came from the kitchen behind & have us. The ambience is very poor that we hesitated to leave or order. I just can't stand the mosquitoes ! So worried for my 18mo son ! Since it was late, we decided to order. When cendol was served, there's no red beans & whatsoever. When asked the staff, he told us cendol does not has red beans ! Also we ordered 3 cendols and 1 turned out to be half of the other 2. Food presentation is poorly done ! Won't refer anyone there ! Food is just so so and yet they are slightly overpriced ! Like KL city price ??? Show less

Author: 558dylant
Title: Dine in
Review: Tried it because other restaurants were full. Very nice ambient and place to hang out. Food price a little expensive for two pax quantity.

Author: gemsyasia
Title: Surprisingly GOOD Peranakan food!
Review: My family and I love the food. The few dishes we ordered tasted quite authentic. So we had an enjoyable lunch. At first we were apprehensive as the staff were all Malays and not Peranakan, so I guess the chef is probably Peranakan. It was a welcome surprise!Show less

Author: Justinlyh
Title: Average and ok
Review: We were here for lunch, ordered kankung belacan, sambal prawn, telur cencalur, and fried sambal rice. The taste was ok. The restaurant hide inside from the main street. Melaka cendol for dessert, not bad too.

Author: ismailHasan
Title: Tasty...!!
Review: It seemed like its operational hours was almost done when we were getting there. Or it its doors were always closed? I didnt even care, because my tour guide has booked us tables and foods.This restaurant located in a shophouse but decorated with Malaya-Chinesse style.The fried chicken was tasty with an authentic recipe.Oh, dont worry it has been certified Halal from Malaysia GovermentShow less

Author: Neoyo
Title: Not recommended
Review:
I would not recommend this restaurant, simply becoz the food
is not up to par. How good if I don't follow the tour...sigh

Author: UnnieKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Recommended!! Best nyonya food in Melaka
Review: This is my 4th times having dinner at this restaurant. This time going with my colleagues who haven't been here even they have been visited Melaka few times. I guess I've tried almost all of the menus served in this restaurant. I'm not a fussy type however it is not easy to convince me to say "this food is delicious". Prawn cooked with pineapple in coconut milk, lady finger/brinjals with sambal, cincaluk with eggs, chicken curry...Oh gosh...it was so delicious. Free flow for chinese tea. The staffs was so efficient. they will top up your drink without you having trouble to call them.The most recommended dessert you should try is "cendol". Definitely come back again..Show less

Author: reramajantanKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Well done
Review: Tq guys u did very good job. Nice cocktail i had i dnt mind cincai service coz as long what u order u got wht u want.stf very friendly all of them and cnt mention any names sorry yah.especially the small lady wearing spectackle look like chinese but i think indian coz got nandek.they are very helpful food also very good.music yes i love it.well done guys will come back soon Show less

Author: raven781Tokyo, Japan
Title: Nice place to chill out and relax
Review: I've been to this outlet many times at the newly relocated at Kota Laksamana and the location is strategically good. Whenever I comes here with a group of friens=ds, we like to order a bucket of beers and Pizza. Moving forward, Movida could provide a selection of thin or thick crust pizza in the menu because Iam a thick crust pizza lover. When you order thin crust, it comes burnt and you can't hold the pizza properly. This is my 10 cent point of view. ThanksShow less

Author: fjj_foojiajun
Review:
Will visit everytime when come to melaka. 
Surprisingly the food serve very here. I like the food here more than the food at those fine dining restaurant,

Author: ReubenC1606Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not too bad
Review: Nice place to unwind after a long day and have a couple of pints. For me, the staff were quite attentive and friendly.But with the music blasting, this isn't the right place for a quiet evening. Be prepared to raise your voice slightly higher than usual just to have a conversation with your buddies. Though I would definitely recommend this place.Get's quite busy some nights especially leading up to weekends. But a nice bar none the less. Show less

Author: FromKluang
Title: Reasonable drinks
Review:
Foods is good especially the Spaghetti.
The pizza is nice too. 
Their drink is reasonable price for happy hour.

Author: Wayne D
Title: Service is absolutely terrible
Review: Brought my frens from kl on a friday night just to chill and have a few Pints. The staffs are foreigners for all i know, they speak very rude towards us, almost start a fight. What terrible service they have. Beers are watered down, cant even get a good taste of the malt, definitely wouldnt recommend anyone hereShow less

Author: Ella J
Title: Love The Food
Review: I visited this place twice, I tried the Seafood Olio Spaghetti it was great. Food is fantastic. Will come back again.

Author: raven781
Title: Reasonable Happy Hour
Review: Chill out with friends on sunny Sunday and its was good. Ordered Hawaiian Pizza and the taste is succulent thus nice presentation. Now the outlet change from Hatten Square to Kota Laksamana.

Author: MynameisrickKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Not what i expected
Review: Its just not.my day or the food is not that good..first of all i got the chicken not properly cook..Its still.uncook..But its ok.with that bcoz the waiter told.me.the chef has to.work.from.morning and they might be tired..Fine with that..But the taste is bland..Mb the strong product bcz of the ambience..Show less

Author: JennS357Singapore, Singapore
Title: Magnificent Stay
Review: Organising a trip for senior citizen isn't easy. Hatten Hotel at Malacca make my life so much easy and the room ia huge and clean. My parents enjoz the stay very much and the hotel provide shuttle service to Jonker streets which nees not walk for at least half an hour to town. We uave enjoz this trip very much and feel ease to go againShow less

Author: 718belindagJurong East, Singapore
Title: Most terrible service and irresponsible owner
Review: Most terrible service from this restaurant EVER!! Waiter spilled hot barley all over me. Instead of apologizing he just got me a box of tissue and walked away. I had to call him back to clean up the floor and table, and get me a new chair because it was wet. Throughout the whole incident, the restaurant owner conveniently busied himself away from our table and I had to ask him over to talk. The owner told me it could be because my kid had distracted the waiter which caused the incident when all the while my child was just seated beside me minding his own business? Honestly that was the worst kind and most irresponsible excuse anyone could find for a mistake they made. Nothing offered to make amends so nothing else to be said. Just my bad luck to be here. There’s nothing fantastic about their food. Please don’t come to this restaurant. Show less

Author: pkh_travels
Title: Dinner in Melaka
Review: Arrived in Melaka about 4pm, checked in hotel and went out for dinner. Saw Ah Hui Bak Kut Teh in Melaka Raya. Decided to try this shop and ordered BKT, sesame oil chicken, sweet sour pork and tofu. Hot and delicious food. Must try.

Author: darylouSingapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent Taste
Review: Understand that Bak Kut Teh is highly favoured meal in Malacca. So when we arrived, my first lunch is to hunt for great B.K.T. we were blessed when we decided to stop by Ah Hui BKT. We were attended promptly and we recommended all their signature dishes. And we ordered all their recommendation. Mins later, we were served with their freshly cooked dishes and it's truly 5 stars standard.It's a Gem and enjoyed our lunch. Highly recommended. Show less

Author: MayL2012Singapore, Singapore
Title: Tasty pork rib soup and fried liver
Review: We have lunch here and ordered the pork rib soup, fried liver and fried potato leaves. The portion was generous with a good amount of ribs in tasty herb soup. The fried liver was done just right. They have other dishes as well. A good and clean place to have a simple meal.Show less

Author: debs_ng
Title: Delicious!
Review:
Went around searching for dinner and discovered this restaurant. We ordered the mapo tofu and red wine ginger chicken, together with yam rice.

Super loved the tofu though it was a little bit too salty. The chicken was superb as well.

Highly recommended!

Author: ignoramarkSingapore, Singapore
Title: Lack of service
Review: Wanted to visit and try their bak kut teh. However we wasn't able to get their staffs' attention as we seem to be quite invisible to them and they just keep walking past us. Not sure if it is because there is just 2 of us and they seem to be friendlier to other tables of big groups. In the end, we have to leave without eating as we are just unable to orderShow less

Author: adrianohhjr
Title: Average food choices
Review: You can choose between air con and non air con sitting arrangements however the air con room has an extra 10% service charge. The food is just average

Author: 745chanw
Title: Delicious bak kut  teh.
Review: The food price is reasonable and taste is good. Highly recommended. Worth a try when in melaka. One of the must try.

Author: leonardil292
Title: Ah Hui Bakut Teh
Review:
Ah Hui Bakut Teh, close to Strait hotel, also close Imperial Herritage hotel, this is the best bakut teh in town.
Good taste, many variety of pork menu.

Author: ErikW1787
Title: Common taste on other bak kut teh restaurant
Review:
Ah hui bak kut teh - since 1983
Menu : claypot bak kut teh + yam rice ( nasi talas).
Quite good bak kut teh, but nowadays u can commonly find this kind of taste in other places.
Score 7/10

Author: xxiaohao
Title: Good Lunch...
Review: This restaurant is just a short walk from Novotel Hotel Malacca. Ask around or use Google Map for direction.The restaurant was staffed by foreign workers, but owned by local Chinese. The staff was able to communicate in English. Food-wise, the sweet and sour chicken and sambal kangkong were good. Their bah kut teh was not the peppery version, which is good for individuals whose throats react badly to spicy stuffs.Buah Long Long drink, made with the fruit, Buah Long Long, is a must try to get a sense of the local culture. Show less

Author: RichardChiaBSingapore, Singapore
Title: Most expensive Bak Kut Teh in Malacca.
Review: As is lunch time. So we take a walk from hotel. Going Nyonya food. As we were half way to the restaurant. I saw my father in law cannot walk further. So saw this Bak Kut Teh. I sugguested that we settle our lunch in this Bak Kut Teh. After lunch settle the bill. I could not believe the lunch cost more Rm100. Will not re visit again.Show less

Author: AileenChua
Title: Lunch
Review: Kidney and liver were done just right. Pork trotters were good. So were the pork ribs soup. They offered yam rice and mee suan. Tasty and affordable.

Author: 987johnt
Title: Authentic Chinese breakfast
Review: Recommended if you want to experience some local Chinese breakfast ~~ nice hospitality from lady boss

Author: Philip918Singapore, Singapore
Title: Overpriced ! Average cuisine .
Review: Our first restaurant of choice was packed and so we walked over for a meal at nearby Ah Hui Bak Kut Teh which was empty at that time.We ordered a good range of their food choices.We started off with bak kut teh which had a strong herbal flavor, the pork meat seemed unpalatable. Their fish head curry was bland and watery. The other dishes I forget because they were definitely unmemorable. What was memorable was walking out after paying a hefty bill.Show less

Author: jchen9430Memphis, Tennessee
Title: avverage Bak Kut Teh
Review: we came to this place since they claimed they were a Bak Kut Teh specialist. However, I have to say that I have had better Bak Kut Teh even in my friend's house, not in Malaysia. Their Bak Kut Teh is a little more to the sweet side. The price is much higher than Malaysia standard. Almost $13 per bowl of Bak Kut Teh. Would not recommend this place unless you can't find any other restaurants to go.Show less

Author: MegahYangSingapore, Singapore
Title: service was quick and good, food was average
Review: me and my friend were looking for malaysian bak kut teh. we wanted to go to the other store which has better reviews but it was closed, so we tried this one. i find it weird to find spring onion at the top of the soup which probably used more for decoration than actual taste. the soup was too clear for what i would expect, and the amount of garlic is not enough, although i can add it myself later. The spices put in the soup is also not cooked long enough. for a bak kut teh lover like me, this is not a place that i would recommend or would come back again.Show less

Author: snah55Singapore, Singapore
Title: Good Bak Kut Teh Broth
Review: We tried this place as it was near to our hotel, a pleasant surprise. Ordered a bowl of claypot bak kut teh, sweet potato leaves and fried whole fish. All of them taste delicious and we even ask for extra serving of the bak kut teh soup. Total price RM 80, mostly because the fish was a little pricier at RM50 but was worth it as it was fresh. Show less

Author: vernon_kohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Felt scammed by the substandard food quality and overpricing
Review: Decided to try out this restaurant as it's very near our hotel and it looked crowded when we passed by during lunch hour. The much anticipated experience turned out to be a rather terrible one. The bak kut teh was rather bland and the pig trotter lacked the usual flavour. The real shocker came when we received the invoice. Close to RM300 for food orders definitely not worth that kind of pricing. I strongly caution against visiting this restaurant unless u r desperately out of better options. Show less

Author: Mfamilysgp
Title: Overrated
Review: Tried for lunch. Service was very slow even though restaurant was not crowded. The food was just solo and service is small for the price I paid.

Author: Germ19
Title: Nicer than Song fa!
Review: It is a must to have in Malacca.  The cai pok egg is also very nice!  It's a pity that the cai puay which we had 2 yrs ago has been removed from menu

Author: wong mSingapore, Singapore
Title: a meal at AH HUI BAK KUT TEH
Review: This was literally across the street from the hotel I was staying at - so very convienient so I decided to give this place a shot for dinner - the bak kut teh was fine and the soup tasted fine but this place is not as peppery as some other location ( suits me fine ) - the Yam rice was good and tasty .As I was dining alone - I did not have a chance to taste a bigger variety but their menu has a good variety The pricing is very fair - way within what I was expecting to pay - so this means value for money The only slight negative is that the service that brought the food should be speeded up - somewhat on the slow side of thingsShow less

Author: donaldt22
Title: Early lunch
Review: So so ... Cannot really taste the herbal in the Herbal variation and the standard option is not peppery enough. The bah kut is soft and tender though.

Author: joshuaalex383
Title: Delicious
Review: the eatery is just located opposite fenix hotel. Bak Kut Teh is delicious and serving just about right. Service was also fast.

Author: Bryan C
Title: Decent bak kut teh but...
Review: The food was decent and the prices were average. We liked the herbal taste of the soup that wasn't too overpowering. Other dishes such as sweet and sour chicken were not bad as well. However when we requested for a soup topup, the amount was less than a bowlful and they told us that we were only allowed one refill :( they should definitely allow us to top up the soup more! Show less

Author: MrGoh
Title: Very yummy
Review: This restaurant is nice and clean. The place is also air conditioned. A cool respite from the heat outside! The pork rib is nice. But we were disappointed with the fried kidney. The rice was a little too hard too.

Author: kelvinkoh
Title: Pok ribs in claypot
Review: Nice clean place. The food that was served came fast and the pork ribs were tender and juicy. The broth was particular tasty and could not get enough of it.

Author: Growler888
Title: Meat too tough, expensive
Review: Went there at night because everyone was tired after a long day. Ordered the mixed claypot bak kut teh and premium one, vinegar pork trotters. Also ordered 2 veg and tea. 1. The bak kut teh's portion was small for a single person. Meat was tough. The other ingredients were also limited edition.2. The long beans were tough and tasted abit raw.3. The worst choice was the vinegar pork trotters. Tasted like a mix of raw pork and vinegar. Nothing like what I had at some other shops.Total damage was RM 100. Totally not worth it. The other stall at Melaka Raya 4 was so much better but they usually sold out at 2pm...Show less

Author: LowLCSingapore, Singapore
Title: I love its stir fried liver and kidney with red wine
Review: I have visited this shop at its original location in Batu Pahat. I have not tried the one in Malacca. Recently my family of five went to Batu Pahat and we ordered the two different versions of its pork ribs. One claypot was purely filled with pork ribs and thicker soup while the other claypot was served with a mixture of cut pork ribs, intestines, etc. The soup is lighter in taste. We also ordered a deep fried fish and a plate of the stir fried liver and kidney in red wine. While the pork ribs tasted good, this dish is really great. For someone like me who doesn't really eat liver, I finished that dish! It is the way it was cooked, I supposed. The tenderness of the liver and kidney were just right and it was a good lunch for all five of us.If you visit Batu Pahat, make an effort to visit them. You will not regret!Show less

Author: Gnoskcoy
Title: Flavourful soup..excellent for the rainy days
Review: Only had stomach for a bowl of special flavour bak kut teh. Can taste that the soup has a lot of flavours in it and is very well brewed with different chinese herbs in it.However find the meat texture disappointing, as it could be softer and more tender, without small pieces of bones attached to it.Show less

Author: Aikku_01
Title: Ms
Review: Such a wonderful place! So peaceful and relaxing athmophere. Nice river view, good beer, bad jokea and good company!

Author: jamjam12345
Title: Perfect spot for an afternoon beer
Review: We had a beer here but no food. Perfect spot for a beer. We were here at 6.30 so it was a great temperature. It is right on the canal across from some street art. It was very pleasant and a beautiful location. Staff were friendly, the sun was setting. No complaints here!!!! Would highly recommend. Show less

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Nice Cafe
Review: Located in Pukau Melaka, choice of open air seats (which we took the option) nice songs and music (on Tursday) and good ambience. Good place to have Western Food and beer. One new joint to hang out in Melaka.

Author: prutbcMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: 1st visit
Review: The relaunched was on 10 Dec 2019 and we went there for chilled out on 14 Dec, Saturday while they were having a pair of singer performing through the night. It wasn't a good and smooth performance thou as we assumed they were gaining experience for performing live. To be honest, the food taste was average but the environment is good for family dining and company meetings/events.Show less

Author: 2010LUIH
Title: Awesome food
Review: The price of the food is of higher end but the excellent quality make up for it. Impressed by their chicken chop, pork chop and coffee. The ambience is good and the service is accommodating and friendly. Will definitely come here again.

Author: Easonchan0010
Title: I am coming back here.Great job
Review: Great food and beverage. Friendly service. Awesome promotions. Lovely view and nice enviroment.Best in Melaka

Author: AcesGoPlacesKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Disorganised Kitchen...Food Average
Review: We were a group of 9. Ordered around 8 dishes for dinner. Service was very slow as we got our food an hour after we ordered. Our group had 5 muslims and 4 non muslims but as it was Ramadhan somehow our food came last despite being there first. We could forgive this oversight as it was Ramadhan.However they were disorganised in the kitchen. Soup came with only 4 serving bowls. Ordered two plates of fried rice but only one came with the other 30 minutes later. Not sure why they did not fry it together. We had to serve ourselves the eating utensils.Food wise just average. Steam fish was very fishy. Vegetable dish came last. The worst part: overuse of MSG. The best was the sweet and sour chicken dishShow less

Author: KIS891
Title: Very delicious chinese halal restaurant
Review: Ths food was excellent. Been here since 2yrs ago. Never disspointed. Even families from Singapore said the food waste the best so far. Dont miss it!

Author: 321gooner
Title: tasty food and quality
Review: been there so many times. must try (sotong goreng telur masin) sure will not disappointed each one of you.

Author: Zulhisyam M
Title: NIce seafood
Review: the service was nice...the only setback is the chair and table is too moderate...But overall it was a very good dine in and very recommended

Author: NOR AISAH A
Title: Palatable
Review: we ordered crispy lemon chicken (quite tasty), sizzling tofu (ok) and garlic baby kailan (ok). However, the whole tasting experience felt something was missing than the usual Chinese Muslim food.

Author: normiflorence
Title: Best halal chinese cuisine
Review: Reached restaurant at 2.30pm...they still served customers though their resting period is from 3pm to 6pm...food quality tiptop..

Author: azimfakhri
Title: Best
Review: Worth the price. Milky butter prawn is the best along with japanese tofu with crab meat.Definitely come here again. Kudos to the owner !

Author: foto_melakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Easy Dining
Review: For those who love Chinese food but often face difficulty in looking for halal Chinese food, fret no more. You will definitely find that the Chinese food serve at this restaurant to be among the best in town.No matter what your liking is...be it seafood or simply vegetable, there is a wide variety of choices for you to choose from. The restaurant is just like any other typical Malaysian restaurant, so do not expect much. Nevertheless, the service is fast and prompt.One word of warning though. The restaurant can be really crowded on weekends and public holidays.Show less

Author: Prisca2u
Title: Delicious food
Review: Excellent Indian food, buzzing (a good sign that locals love the food here), and plenty of parking if you are coming by car. Getting parking in Melaka is difficult so this is key when choosing a place to eat. 😊

Author: Badamparuppu
Title: Good foos
Review: Excellent food, courteous staff but a little pricey. Comfortable seating. Chicken was out of the world.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Very good food...
Review: This place is friend's recommendation.Came here for banana leaf rice. Usually banana leaf rice is table service where wait staff will come round to lay the banana leaf, put the rice and the basic vegetables. The rest is go over to the food counter to choose and they will bring you in small plates.This place is self service. You pick what you like including the vegetables and meat from the food counter. The staff will lay a piece of banana leaf on a metal plate and put the rice on top of the banana leaf rice, and the rest is up to you.Picked a piece of fish, kurma chicken, deep fried bitter gourd, curry chicken and some vegetables.The staff came round to the table to provide the papadum.Food is really good. The environment is good too as we sat outside under the trees which is very shady.The location is not along the main road and rather quite.Very nice environment and price is quite reasonable too.Show less

Author: xl0104Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Newly explored restaurant
Review: Found this restaurant in foodpanda list. As it's not far away from my house, so we decided to drive there for lunch.The place is cosy and homey.Food portion is generous and not salty.We ordered ginger wine mee suah and fried kuey teow, it was tasty. The dessert was delicious too.Will come again next timeShow less

Author: melakaG1234Melaka
Title: Great food...
Review: As the place is small, might want to go slightly earlier or later to avoid the lunch crowd. The place is a challenge for those not familiar with the place as it is not visible from the AMJ but definitely worth hunting it down. The food I would describe it as more fusion malaysian /Chinese. Do try the nasi lemak, the ginger wine noodle,and the roasted pork fried rice. The cendol is good as well but I find it depends on who is preparing it. The lady host gives a generous serving of coconut milk and caramel and thus makes it quite wonderful. Show less

Author: 932michelleeFasoula, Cyprus
Title: Spectacular!!
Review: Absolutely fantastic food! Friendly waiters and waitress, comfortable and chill atmosphere. Ordered 10 dishes for my family and each & every single one of them is unbelievable delicious! My bf kept saying that the chef has a great palette which i do have to agree with him, it's not salty, not oily, nothing is bland BUT perfectly balance! We learnt that the head chef, also the owner of the restaurant, has 18 years experience working as a head chef in Switzerland and they even made their own cheese. At first we thought "Gather house" specialty is mainly desserts BUT don't let that fool you, they have AMAZING food as well. Try their Yam Prawn (with their signature cheese), Herbal chicken, German Pork Knuckle !(special request, one day ahead), and Cendol! The price is reasonably Cheap and affordable too. Though it's a little bit tucked away from the city, but well worth the drive. Show less

Author: D5349ANleew
Title: Simply some of the best food I've eaten
Review: we went to the restaurant for dinner one evening based on a recommendation from a friend. the chief has been working as an asian cook in a high brow hotel for 18 years and finally wanted to move back to his home base. we came straight from Penang which has some of the best food i've ever eaten in this country & the food in this restaraunt is on par if not better than anything i've eaten over my 6 years in this country. we came back the next night because there's no way we could leave without trying some of their other dishes. it's well worth the trip out of town to eat at this place & i dare say its essential if you live here.Show less

Author: PknowlesiSingapore, Singapore
Title: Nothing Extraordinary
Review: Nothing out of the world. Food was normal but a tad on the pricey side considering the set meal for 2 cost RM$37.50 and comes with a plate of sliced pork, 5 fish ball, 5 crab stick, cabbage, Kang Kong, egg tofu and bee Hoon. Service was ok. Show less

Author: YummyfatmanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Another branch in Malim
Review: Passed by this place in malim and saw a familiar t shirt at the end of the night market and found out it was a second branch on the second day of the opening ... place is very well decorated with a zen design and decided to dine there ... totally a great experience as I was told by the staff that it was totally renovated by the boss ... this is the first time I experienced a Mookataa dining with an in built fan inside the table ... started my dining and the tom yam was simply great ... had an enjoyable dining with my family ... this experience is better than any of the Mookataa shop I visited so far! Good for family and friends! Show less

Author: justwanaeat
Title: Great mookataa
Review:
Cheap and scrumptious Mookata !! 

The black pepper slice pork was superbly nice... The tomyam soup tasted perfect 
A great visit!

Author: Yummyfatman
Title: Best Thai mookataa
Review: Been ard most part of Thailand and found out this place Ori Thai ... the food was fantastic and service was very good.... one of the best Mookataa I had so far .... a must try place!

Author: prutbcMelaka State, Malaysia
Title: Mookata
Review: We requested (refill) few rounds of soup and glass noodles.. coz their tomyam soup quite nice.They have few types of set depends on how many pax of peoples and also separate combo set for side dish like mushrooms, sausage, ham, fish ball, etc. Worth trying at this shop for Mookata first time experience.BTW, I will visit again with another bunch of friends.Show less

Author: Gilbert T
Title: Dinner
Review: What can I say. Value for money. The tomyam soup was fantastic. Recommended to go. Service is also good.

Author: HanKohSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious Local Supper
Review: I stayed 2 nights at the nearby hotel.Stumbled across this supper place without research and discovered gem by accident The dried noodle was very nice and it tasted better with the round yellow I wanted to try the laksa which was sold out both nights! That shows its popularity.Overall, a great supper placeShow less

Author: CHRISLL8
Title: Delicious hangover food at a fair price ! :)
Review: My 2nd time here and it amaze that yummy food should be kept simple. The soup base is clear without grease and salt pepper chicken is amazing (too bad no beer)

Author: Mfamilysgp
Title: Local Kopitiam That Opens Late into the Night
Review: A local eatiery that sells yu jiao noodles and curry mee. Open around 7 pm and late into the night. Quite crowded but service is not that great.

Author: Actuarial_MathSingapore
Title: Excellent for Late Night Supper for Tasty and Cheap Noodles, Opens till 4am
Review: One night in my hotel room 2+am, I saw from my window many cars driving up to this restaurant and there were many patrons eating at this restaurant. Curiosity got the better of me and I checked it out the next evening.To my amazement, they were selling simple dishes at cheap prices. They served popcorn chicken, chicken cutlet, noddles. among other Chinese food. I bought 2 packets of their signature dried instant noodles MYR4.50 per packet. It came with fisballs, fishcake slices, minced meat, and minced slices, i added extra dumplings at MYR1 per packet. They were heavenly! The next evening, I went back for another round of takeaway.The lady boss told me they open till 4am. This is a place you would want to go for yummy and appetizing late night supper.Show less

Author: Donna M LMetro Manila, Philippines
Title: Authentic Taiwan taste
Review: Went here for dinner as it was very near from our hotel. My guy said the taste was authentic from first bite. We liked their set menu as it was a little cheaper. Ordered dumplings fried pork set and veggie and meat noodle soup. Price is okay for the serving. The service was fast, got no problem at all.Show less

Author: Michaela RLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Good value and tasty food
Review: Came here for lunch as we were in the area. The restaurant has a lot of options for meat and rice or noodles dishes, it seems mainly Taiwanese. That makes it a bit different from other local restaurants. We ordered a noodle dish each and some vegetables, the food was tasty and the portions were a good size, not excessive but good for the price. They also make bubble tea and other Taiwanese drinks - the large serving is huge! Overall, it was a good lunch and the service was friendly and quick, so would definitely recommend this restaurant.Show less

Author: teenagesab_87
Title: 24 hours cafe
Review: this small and cosy cafe opens 24 hours. Good food. Good Ambience. Friendly staff. Opposite Novotel Melaka.

Author: 594joannelMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Nice cozy place for family with small kids
Review: Nice ambience with a relaxing feel. Food choices is mainly Italian with a nasi lemak for local choice. The food is good for its price and the recommended pizza was awesome. They have many high chair for children and a step for kids to reach the sink Show less

Author: travbro
Title: Resort In A Housing Estate
Review: I'm impressed by the ambiance, decoration and entire set up from the choice of furniture, color and matching. Food was fantastic and prepared by artistic chef and friendly staff.

Author: prutbc
Title: Nice place
Review:
Good service 
Simple,  nice environment 
Suitable for small event like gathering, birthday party, discussion

Author: tasya14
Title: waffle was rock hard.
Review: so we ordered a caramelized banana and cream waffle and to my surprise i got a cardboard flavored ‘waffle’ instead. cutting it to pieces was equivalent to the scene in The Incredibles when Mr Incredible was cutting his son’s steak and the plate broke. the only thing i somewhat enjoyed was the banana. staff told me that the ac made it hard which makes no sense at all (insidescoop pun ada ac but sedap je waffle dia) they wouldn’t even give me a new one. paid 16 bucks to eat cardboard y’all. the ‘waffle’ was a 0.4/5 for me.Show less

Author: tehaisliiiimau
Title: Hardened waffle
Review: First of all, I would say the ambience is peaceful but the food doesn't match with it especially this waffle. I may have forgotten its name but I never forget how hard it is to cut into. I was struggling with my knife to cut this piece of rock. And as we called the waiter, he simply explained that the air conditioner is the cause of the hardened waffle. Definitely would buy the ones that is selling melaka mall which cost about RM3 but still worth itShow less

Author: nur farhana hAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Amazing (Delicious & Good Ambiance)
Review: Food, service, ambiance, and staff are nice and promptDefinitely will recommend and revisit. My team mates have a lots of allergies (gluten and dairy) and some are vege but they able to cater to meals that match to her conditions (some adjustment made to the foods)Portion are just nice .We have great lunch and some after meal (dessert).Great place for whole day meal either breakfast, lunch, tea-time and dinner.Show less

Author: esquire838Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Good food, service could be better
Review: The ambience is cozy, suited even for family diners. They offer decent selection of food; large portions and well presented. The menu entries are only one liners; wish they could have photo menu or at least more description. My only not so pleasant experience was when I ordered the house specialty coffee but it arrived warm, indicating that it was left to cool after the barista prepared it before it was served. This should not have happened; I expect to enjoy my coffee when I paid RM15 a cup!Show less

Author: gwynchua
Title: COMPLAINT OF COFEOLOGY (WILL NEVER VISIT IT AGAIN IN MY WHOLE LIFE )
Review: It was 1st for me to visit cofeology. Firstly,I've experienced a long waiting time that there are only very few of customers.Next,the sandwich i ordered is dry and stale. Plus,the portion of the ingredients in the sandwich is not divided equally(ex.some has tomatoes while some does not have). Lastly,the most terrible thing that had causing me to write this review,is,the main course that I ordered is not served. Due to the long waiting time, I've asked the waiter to check on my food. The result is, the waiter telling me the food is forgotten to be cooked and no further actions are taken.What's the matter now? I am the customer, I've waited so long for the food and it ends up nothing.And you, as a waiter is just throwing the problem to me and do nothing to solve the situation. What does it mean by "Dapur tak masak dish ni" ? So? I have to cook by myself isit?Will never step in this place again. Cofeology sucks.Show less

Author: ZanaMS
Title: Delicious food
Review: The ambiance was good for gathering and the food was delicious with big portion. They also provides delivery around Melaka Tengah area.

Author: Dr YKuantan, Malaysia
Title: Great coffee and food. But...
Review: We were impressed with the quality and taste of coffee and food served. Nice atmosphere. Great set lunch options like butter chicken and carbonara. Family friendly. Even has stacks of uno and chess set for customers. But were disappointed at the following1. Waiter told us that butter milk chicken was not spicy. But the sauce contained bird's-eye chili and the rice was obviously hot. I can't serve that to my toddler. 2. Banner outside the cafe promised 20% discount for May bank cards but we were only given 10% off. Too lazy to argue-was told we will be given 20% the second visit (we were only passing by tourist)Show less

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: Overrated
Review: Read many sharing in the social media about this cafe. So decided to have lunch there. Service is average but food is not that great. Ordered the grilled chicken. The chicken was served with salad and mashed potatoes. The chicken is quite tasty but the mashed potatoes is cold. The salad consists of tomato, some leafy green and big chunk of capsicum. The coffee and waffle are great. A nice place to hang out but not to have food.Show less

Author: kkhannnn
Title: Rediculas place
Review: so slow service and disrespect costumer . i am not going  there and i will suggest that other that plz don't disrespect your self to go there.

Author: kkhannnn
Title: Rediculas place
Review: The service is so slow and rude costumer service.i will suggest that plz don't go there to disrespect your self.

Author: eyegloryBatu Berendam, Malaysia
Title: Nice place to chill out, but please improve your food
Review: To sum up, this is a nice place to hang out with family or friends. They offer many choices for drinks i.e. coffee or tea, and snacks like cakes or waffles.The decoration is nice, the set up is good, I think the drinks are okay too.. it just that the foods ordered don't taste good. The pasta we ordered was a bit salty. This is not the first time that we've been disapointed with their foods.Another point is, maybe you guys need to serve your customer faster. I don't think it is wise to make someone who ordered just a waffle to wait like 20-30 minutes.Show less

Author: maytjehhThe Hague, The Netherlands
Title: Yummy
Review: Happy to find this place! We orderd honey lemon ice to cool down from the heat and it was really delicious! For diner we had the chicken lemon and the rendang with nasi lemak. So good!! Especially the chicken lemon is amazing. Highly recommended! We tried the ginger chicken aswell. Also very good :-). Place is clean, good clean toilet and friendly staff with a relaxed vibe. It's a bit far from Jonker street, but it's worth the walk. Great value for money. Show less

Author: ThomasFromEarthKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food
Review: This place has some great food, the nasi lemak and the lemon chicken are just some of the amazing dishes they have. We ordered two times because of the very good quality. The very friendly people take the time to awnser all the questions you may have and the overall vibe here is very good. They play relaxing music and you don't get the feeling you are near a serious road at all. You will definitely not regret eating here so go for it! :)Show less

Author: actionreaction
Title: Excellent food
Review: Its nice cafe and I ate the food all very nice and hope if been melaka will eat again and also ask others once try their food.

Author: kfl2021
Title: Ayer Keroh Best Chicken Rice.
Review: Food is delicious, staff friendly and helpful, dining environment so comfortable, highly recommended.

Author: Sightseer106488
Title: Good food selection. Very yummy
Review: I always go there for the chicken rice balls, laksa, herbal soup and bean curd (tau Kee). Food is yummy, friendly staff, air conditioned. Great place to visit.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice relaxing environment...
Review: Chicken rice is chicken. No difference.Usually it is sold and eaten in either a coffee shop sold from a stall within, coffee shop style specialty shop or in high class restaurant like hotels etc.This shop is set in a contemporary environment. A cafe concept. The food is of no difference from a coffee shop where soft boiled eggs, toasted bread with kaya, and hainanese chicken rice and noodles.Because of a contemporary cafe concept, it has a nice relaxing environment to enjoy ones mealThey are not located along the main road, so, parking can be easyShow less

Author: 879raymondk
Title: Cool place with variety of local food
Review: Variety of local food and one of the cheapest beer in town. Very good service and friendly staff.....

Author: 879raymondk
Title: Gathering
Review: Crabs is cheap. Beer is cheap. Nice environment! More than 30 hawkers stall to choose! Will come back again!

Author: uw0tm8Auckland, New Zealand
Title: A clean and tidy hawker center for once!
Review: For a hawker center, it is a lot cleaner than your typical. Food is quite good, especially the bak kut teh and hakka mee. Beer and non alcoholic beverages are quite nicely priced. Just don't mind the resident dog who will come and walk past every now and again!Show less

Author: 879raymondk
Title: Gathering
Review: Cheap beer and variety of food with cozy environment. More than 30 food stall. 4 Muslim stall . Reasonable price and most importantly they provide very good service. Will come back again.

Author: Tay-SherdanSingapore, Singapore
Title: Wonderful meal- best meal in malacca
Review: I was recommended to dine at this restaurant through some locals in malacca. It was an absolutely good recommendation! We pre ordered suckling pig and it costs RM220, very worth it and a big pomfret, drinks, 1 Veg dish. Total bill about RM350! The suckling pig crispy and succulent. Pomfret v fresh. I would definitely return. Lastly, clean place and very good service. Pls remember to call them for prebooking of suckling pig. We have 6 pax in total. Show less

Author: BabaSeowMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Quality does not age with time
Review: This Chinese Restaurant is one of my personal favorite. As a matter of fact, my family members love visiting this joint too. This is a really old restaurant and as I could recall I have been to this place ever since I was a toddler. It is not an easy task for a restaurant operator to maintain their food quality for three decades and this one has proven that it is possible. Do check out their Rojak Chicken Dish ( deep fried boneless chicken fillet simmered in satay sauce with other ingredients) According to my dad, this restaurant is also popular because of their steamboat cuisine with beef being their meat of choice. Hence, for those who do not eat beef might abstain from their steamboat set.Show less

Author: PatYKCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: An Old Place
Review: This is a very old restaurant. Since I was a kid man .... and I am like > 40 years old. Good food with reasonable price and it is those kind of place that you want to eat something that you grew up on. Love the "free range chicken" that's steam. I always order that.Show less

Author: Glencheck
Title: Excellent Chines restaurant
Review: We run into this place when strolling around Melaka searching for a place to have diner. Where authentic Chinese, tea served all along the diner. Dishes were tasty and sufficient.

Author: clsommerWurzburg, Germany
Title: Authentic Chinese Food in a simple atmosphere
Review: Everybody looked at us (European) when we went in, thinking that we had crushed a party. But it just seems that tourists do not so often come this way. Service was very attentive, tea was plentiful, the fruit juices natural, and with 6 "medium" dishes for six adults we had more than plenty. The tofu dish was excellent, and so was the mildly spicy beef. We also liked lemon chicken, reast duck, fried rice and the noodle dish. The room is a simple hall, it can be noisy, and everything is very clean.Show less

Author: Chin-PinSingapore, Singapore
Title: Ok food …
Review: This place came highly recommended by local relatives. Our party of four adults and three children tried the beef fillet steamboat, yam ring, rojak, beef stir fried with spring onions and seafood kway teow. The beef steamboat was good, yam ring well cooked and rojak (with out of this world tofu) was excellent. The seafood kway teow was also very good. Not keen on the stirfried beef though. All in all it was a good meal, but cannot say the same about the ambience ….…Show less

Author: szotdogsMelbourne, Australia
Title: Good!
Review: Came across this place on a walk back from Masjid Selat. Unfortunately I came late in the evening and selection was limited, but I was happy with the service, cost and the quality of the food. The waiter spoke excellent English and I was hoping to come back again as it was close to my hotel but unfortunately ran out of time. Will return for my next visit though!Show less

Author: AlvinC1206
Title: great lunchie
Review: Had a great lunch here with family..food served was fast and efficient...prices too are reasonable...many wall pictures of food around and good atmosphere...good recommendation to try

Author: BenC4921
Title: Authentic Nyonya food in town
Review: Authentic Nyonya food new in town, I love the taste, price also reasonable. Staff here intimacy and helpful.

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Delicious Chinese Food
Review: Pork Dumplings is the must try here! Eat your dumplings with vinegar is superb! Dumplings are juicy with full of meat. Besides, Pork Ribs Ramen is another must try dish. Prices are affordable and I would definitely come back again!

Author: chenyeewangMalaysia
Title: The BEST Dumpling and Noodle place in Melaka and more....
Review: If you are looking for a great dumpling and hand made noodle place in Melaka Raya area, this is it. The noodle and dumpling here is one of the best I have ever had and the price is very reasonable and service is great. The restaurant is a few minutes walking distance from the center or Melaka Raya and the deco is very rustic and they even provide comic books for you to read. At the back of the restaurant, there is DIY sauce station with a variety of condiments.We ordered a few dumpling and noodle dishes and they all taste great and the Thai Tofu is also amazingly good. The owner even remember what we ordered previously when we return back.They also offer a few vegeterian dishes. Best kept secret in Melaka!Show less

Author: Christian J
Title: One of the must try in melaka!
Review: The noodle and the dumpling (usually called kwotie) is very good.  We've been here twice, before the restaurant move to new place. Hopefully i could visit this place when i revisit melaka.

Author: Paecy
Title: Great, succulent dumplings!!
Review: Went to this place for lunch and ordered a pork trotter's noodles and spare ribs noodles. Place was kinda packed during lunch hour and I guess that says a lot. The food came and I found the noodles a tad overcooked. However, this place is famous for their home made dumplings which are served in soup or dry (pan fried) and has a variety of fillings. The dumplings taste so good that I would just come back solely for them. The fillings are delicious and they were pan fried and seared to perfection. Thumbs up!!Show less

Author: azrin73Shah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Excellent steak choices
Review: Wide variety of steak from wagyu to angus grain fed. Service was good with explaination on price and quality of beef. I ordered wagyu tenderloin and bbq chicken. Both presented well and quality was above average. Paid rm270 inclusive of drinks wgich is quite normal when u order wagyu steak. Overall recommended.Show less

Author: karl2727Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
