Title: Hidden good steakhouse in Malacca!
Review: Me’nate is one of the best local Malaysian halal steakhouse which their steak or foods already infuse with local taste. To any expat whom wanna try something different they can try this steakhouse! This place is suitable for family gathering, birthday party, meeting friends even to have a cup of coffea or tea coz they got barista there! U can stay until long night till 12am..Show less

Author: cs_cheeseng
Title: Relocation of famous duck noodle
Review:
The awesome duck noodle has been relocated to Richard's Warong, just 5-10min drive from Soon Yen .
Warong is just located by the road side, opposite the kopitiam is the huge government clinic. Easily kissable when driving along the road.

Author: Jo-AnnKYTanShanghai, China
Title: Not bad of a variety!
Review: We had bak kut teh and wantan noodles. Pretty good coffee too. Both pretty good. Waited for the Nyonya kuih there but there were limited ones left; did not buy any as they didn’t look good. But this foodcourt has a good variety of food stalls. Crowded. Parking is just by the main road but I wasn’t comfortable parking that way so I parked further up the road. Show less

Author: Yvonne GMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Relocation of the famous duck noodle soup
Review: The restaurant has a good variety of food, especially the duck noodle. Unfortunately the duck noodle has relocated elsewhere to Lorong Pandan righ opposite the Klinik 1 Malaysia.There are still very good food in the restaurant, like the fried fishballs, nonya kuih and very reasonable priced pineapple tarts. Not forgetting the very rare mee hoon siam and laksa. There is western breakfast as well and other delicacies.Show less

Author: tifyCKuala Lumpur, Wilayah Persekutuan, Malaysia
Title: Best Duck Noodle
Review: Omg! This is the best duck noodle we had so far.We had the dried ones. Thick and aromatic duck sauce with choices with noodles, mee hoon & keow teow; served with a bowl of clear duck soup. You can add-on side dishes: eggs, bean curbs, intestines...Prepared for waiting. We waited for around 30min but worth the waiting. Reasonably priced RM7 with add-on eggs and bean curbs.There are other stalls recommended in the restaurant but we didn’t get to try.It’s a good place for breakfast with varieties and taste of local.Show less

Author: DelsonMooSingapore, Singapore
Title: Popular Duck Noodle Known To Locals
Review: We were recommended to this duck noodle stall by a foodie friend, and he claims this stall at the best duck noodle in Melaka.We tried and indeed it is good.The ducks are soft, tender and succulent, which means you won't get it stuck in your teeth.The side dish are tasty and seriously, you'll ask for more.However, after our meal, all of us felt very thirsty, and even after drinking lots of water, we don't seems to be able to quench our thirst.That can only mean one thing ... lots of MSG !!To be frank, if I have a duck craving and some hot soup, I'll still come back again. ;PShow less

Author: AntzgilerBayan Lepas, Malaysia
Title: Great local breakfast + nyonya kuih under one roof!
Review: Soon Yen Coffee Shop is where locals go for breakfast, and so should you!One-stop for delicious local breakfast:Famous Duck Noodles, Nyonya Laksa, Siam Laksa & excellent Nyonya Kuih!! The Nyonya Kuih is definitely authentic and cheaper than tourist places! Must try -> Kuih Kochi & Apam!!The opening hours are ~7am onwards, for normal breakfast crowds. Prices are reasonable since it's not a "touristy" area yet.Show less

Author: mpmilestogo
Title: Nice dinner along the river
Review: Stopped for the lamb kebab roti. Very mice place to sit outside for awhile and eat. They have a few vendors for food and the river is right there!

Author: Fatimah SMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Unique restaurant concept
Review: I accidentally dined in this restaurant when trying to try the famous Cendol Kampung Hulu. I had the asam pedas telur ikan mayong with ramen. the asam pedas was great initially, before I started to taste fishy. I found that the telur ikan mayong was half cooked, and so it influenced the whole taste of asam pedas. I believed this restaurant served best food, it just the telur ikan mayong didn't cooked well that day.Show less

Author: Jovial D
Title: lunch in a boat!
Review: the experience one gets here is that of pampered isolation. the ambiance and the feel is so fresh and clean. the food is great and the location adds to the beauty and taste. simple superb

Author: foto_melakaMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Relaxing By The River
Review: One thing that really caught my attention about this cafe is its location. Located along the banks of the Melaka River, this is definitely a perfect place to enjoy your meal or coffee while enjoying the view. As such, the outdoor sitting along the river bank is a must although some may prefer the indoor seating. Overall, the place is really comfortable and the ambience is just magnificent.Where food is concern, this place serves the best of both local and international cuisines. However, it is the local dessert called cendol which is the biggest hit here.However, the service may be a bit slow.Show less

Author: LTY1986
Title: Cut throat price 割喉价钱
Review: I used to eat at Hup Huat when I was a student in Melaka when they were operating under zinc roof behind Renaissance Hotel. Recent years they have relocated to a shop at Semabok. So I went there with my wife yesterday. We ordered Oyster sauce chicken without rice for 2 person (the smallest portion allowed to be ordered was 2 person), 6 pieces of fried prawn wantan, and 2 cups of tea. That's all.Bill came to RM32.60. I was dumbfounded to see the bill. I have already thrown away the bill. Chicken for 2 person cost RM18 !! Seriously?!! This is Semabok, not Jonker Street, shop is not located at a prime location in Melaka, and its not a tourist spot too. Even in JB or KL, I have not come across such exorbitant prices. The price for fried prawn wantan was about RM1.50 a piece if I didn't remember wrongly. Its also expensive considering the size of the prawn they used, have shrunk significantly in size, taste has also become poorer as its not as juicy as before when they used bigger prawns.2 cups of milk tea cost RM5.6, which is also significantly more expensive than anywhere else in Malaysia.For all the nostalgia feeling I had when I ate the food after so many years, I was left disappointed. For a restaurant at a location like Semabok Melaka, the price they charge, is crazy. I will never eat at this place again.Show less

Author: edwinchowywMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Avoid this place at all cost !
Review: Never in my life have I been so disappointed with a Chinese meal. It use to be a favourite among locals. They have been in business for decades but today's dining experience was a real let down.The food was really bad. My children love WanTon noodles and we ordered 4 servings.For the first time, both may kids couldn't finish their portion. We (My wife and me) would usually gobble up the remains- but this time, no one touched the noodles. The noodles were soggy. There was only 2 slices of barbecue pork which was tasteless. The soup tasted as though it was laden with some chemical concoction.The fried Wanton had barely any filling. The meal costs RM52, which is does not commensurate with the quality of the food.This is the breakdown:1 bowl of Wanton noodle- RM 6 each bowl1 cup of Barley- RM 2Fried Wanton- 10 pics X RM 1.40 = RM 14A plate of Vegetable with Oyster Sauce- RM12I voted 1 out of 5 but but to be objective about my assessment I have not tried their Congee and other dishes on their menu.Verdict: Poor food quality. Not worth the visit. Try at your own risk....Show less

Author: KennyLCCPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Childhood food and memories
Review: My family and myself have been to this shop ever since it was located behind the now demolished Rex cinema. Our favourite food still taste the same. We order our usual which consist of fried prawn Wantan, oyster chicken, fried rice, and dry Hor Fun. It’s also one of the places that I is on my list whenever I come back to Melaka. Show less

Author: AcuraMelody
Title: Yummy food
Review: Was there during the long weekend and lucky we still manage to get a seat. Ordered fried wanton and also there porridge and noodles. Awesome wanton and also hk porridge. The noodles does not taste good as previous before they more to this location

Author: flochua
Title: Great Fried Wanton
Review: The fried wanton was crispy and delicious. The chilli that came with the wanton is really good with just the right amount of spiciness and sweetness. The wanton mee, fish porridge and fried rice were also worth eating.

Author: Cassandra Y
Title: Awesome!
Review: The char siew was good and the chicken was tender.. Their fried wanton was so delicious because inside it's a prawn! Also, their soup have crabby taste which this is my first time try it. Because normally others shop serve pepper soup or just normal chicken stock porky soup. Oh..this was so delicious ever! Definitely will come back again! Show less

Author: MyLittleLife
Title: Nice HK Style Porridge
Review: Tried their HK Style porridge and fried prawn dumpling. Food are delicious and the price is reasonable

Author: JiunX1
Title: Childhood memory
Review: Always here since I was a child. Their taste still same and delicious. Pot congee, fried wonton, and black sauce chicken are always in my order list.

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Worth a try for a Chinese lunch experience
Review: Dropped by this restaurant for a meal as it faces the Lebuhraya AMJ (I travel through this road back from work). The ambiance is cosy, fully air conditioned and the staff are friendly and prompt. The food offered here is delicious and most importantly, good value for money. Try the congee or the chicken or charsiew rice, the chilli sauce offered hits the spot as well.Dr.Ruben KumarMalaysiaShow less

Author: carimakanmanmalacca city
Title: Hup huat Restaurant
Review: Nice chinese congee and various other food served here.In the second generation of doing the food business. Wasactually, famous plying the trade in Jalan Bunga Raya ( behind the previous Federal Cinema ) but has shifted to own premise a few years ago. century egg congee, wan tan Mee, char siew, siew mai , fried rice are some of their likeable food to be tasted.Show less

Author: AnggunLim92
Title: TASTLESS
Review: Your spaghetti carbonara was tasteless. Sorry. I’m a fan of carbonara but sadly yours is the worst so far.

Author: dayangkuhusna
Title: Great servis for dinner, the
Review: Great servis for dinner, the food are great and the price affordable. The view just nice. Staff are friendly⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Author: Meow94Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Food & the river
Review: First of all, we found this restaurant by coincidence. We were looking for restaurant to eat and happend to pass by this restaurant. We were attracted as the restaurant was right beside Melaka river. I ordered carbonara, its so creamy. Food presentation was nice. The only thing I dont like is the cheese they put on top of the potato wedges. The cheese smells bad. Maybe its the type of cheese they use. My friend ordered butter prawn. It was delicious! Overall, if you are looking for place to eat and chill by the river, you can consider to visit this restaurant. Show less

Author: ViaBenGreater London, United Kingdom
Title: It's the location more than the food
Review: This is a nice restaurant in a great location by the river - the outdoor tables are great to enjoy the view and the evening breeze just a short walk from the happy chaos of Jonker Street. Service is friendly but a bit amateurish, food is fine, the decor is Tourist artsy.Come here to enjoy the view - but Malaka has plenty of better places when it comes to food.Show less

Author: Dhia Aurora Ais... A
Title: Good food but rude staff
Review: I was there with my friend . I called their waiter . And he came and asked us 'ye apedahal tu' . I think its very rude . For all . I loved the food . Thats all

Author: Aisyah S
Title: Nice Dinner By The Riverside
Review: Food was good - ordered the chicken tortilla wrap and the chicken butter cream served wth rice. Pleasant dining by the river with a nice view. Food took a while to come, though but worth the wait.

Author: Ahmad Fakhrul R... Y
Title: Too slow.
Review: Service was too slow. After more than 1 hour still hungry waiting for the food end up cancelled some of the order. Even need to wait for the menu list as they dont even have enough menu. Im not sure if anyone willing to wait that long. The staff seem quite stress but i think its due to lot of complains because too slow. Show less

Author: AndrewU_11Perth, Australia
Title: Good eats with a good view
Review: We went here on a Saturday evening having walked past in the afternoon. We sat outside and watched the river and the people. Lots of locals enjoying the late evening sun.Place seems pretty popular and the staff were helpful and friendly. The food wasn’t bad, but I think you have to pick and choose. My prawn sambal was lovely, my wife’s chicken slalom was a bit heavy on the mayo and light on the chicken and my son’s American hot dog was almost cold and have bolognese sauce on it and mayonnaise and ketchup on the chips.Prices were quite reasonable and the location is great.Show less

Author: Frans d
Title: Nice place to watch the river, not so nice to eat at.
Review:
Staff is showing lack of interest in customers. Coffee is good, krupuk stale and what is called prawns in the menu is just regular udang / shrimp.
Disappointing experience.

Author: 207aur_lienmDivonne-les-Bains, France
Title: Average food, nice location on riverside
Review: The place is nice, decoration mostly done of wood. Tables outside gives a nice view on the river.Food is average: I took the asam pedas salmon special but was very common taste... the appetizers arrived after the main dish, appetizers is usually served first to open appetite I still recommend this place because of the view and location. Yesterday a local man proposed his gf there so the place is quite romanticThere are other bars on the other side of the river where you can have some drinks afterwardsShow less

Author: Eric LLabuan Island, Malaysia
Title: Great for a quick bite
Review: If you are around this area (Malim, Lor Pandan, Pokok Mangga), this is a great place for lunch. Local food served is tasty, in adequate portions and extremely reasonable. Service is prompt and friendly. They also blend fresh fruit juices. Quite busy at lunch time and tends to close earlier than its stated 4 pm closing time. Worth a visit.Show less

Author: Yvonne G
Title: Great food
Review: Could get quality and nice food. Prices are competitive. Place is suitable for family or friends meeting. Very clean place

Author: sheronleeMalacca, Malaysia
Title: Tasty Home-cooked Meals
Review: This place has many good food. For those who loved Nyonya cuisine, Uncle Guan offers fantastic Nyonya laksa and "chicken pongteh" with rice. The taste is just awesome. They also offer nice "lor bak".For those who loved Penang Assam Laksa, you need not travel all the way to Penang. The broth is simply mouth-watering.Show less

Author: RoadtrippersAsiaPenang, Malaysia
Title: Nice Kambucha Tea
Review: Had a little time around the area so decided to check out this cafe for some drinks and found this Kambucha Honey Tea on their menu.Kambucha is some fermented tea ~ giving you that vinegarish taste with some hint of alcohol. I had it with honey so it gives the drink a little sweetness.Nice cafe to hangout I would say and the do have some pretty delicious looking food items on their menu.Show less

Author: angela5206
Title: Great Western Food in Malacca
Review: Beautiful interior design and GOOD western food. Highly recommend Pork Belly , Carbonara and Tomato Soup.

Author: Ah JMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Finally Great Western Food without being in a hotel
Review: Very welcoming from all of the staff and owner with very prompt and efficient service and excellent food and a varied menu. You can choose from various meats as well as pasta dishes and even local asian dishes (limited). The Chef and owner, Anthony, is very accomodating for any special food needs and can even cook special meals. The meals are excellently cooked, although you may have to wait up to 30 minutes, if very busy, as all meals are cooked to order, but worth the wait. They have an air conditioned interior as well as a fan cooled external "garden" area with an excellent ambience.Highly recommended if you are in search of excellent quality food, with excellent service and a great overall vibe at very reasonable prices.Also ask about any "specials" as sometimes they get meat which he smokes and serves up different styles (smoked pork was delicious).Show less

Author: C3451ZUmichaelt
Title: This Restaurant is permanently closed
Review: We were trying to find this restaurant but not able find it. Ask around nobody knows about this Chef Anthony. Finally found that they closed the restaurant for the past 3 years. Should remove the reviews.

Author: vanessakohPETALING JAYA
Title: Seafood that always delights
Review: Whenever we come down to Melaka, we make it a point to visit Chef Anthony for the seafood. His seafood is always a perfect delight-- fresh, often just pulled out of the sea earlier in the day! (ie Happy fish- better than the half dead specimens in tanks which some restaurant refer to as "live") A fishermen when he has the time, Anthony makes it a point to buy direct from his fishermen brother or buddies or even fishes for them himself. Then his preparations - aiyayayay! He is a wiz with both Western and Eastern cuissine. Last night we had a yen for cincaru sumbat ( stuffed with sambal) and it was perfectly authentically nyonya style! I also love his teochew steamed ikan batu ( a coral fish) and his XXL prawns fried in an aromatic dried prawn & curry leaf mix. And his prices are so reasonable!Show less

Author: Tony YMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Malaccan Portugese cuisine
Review: Was privileged to dine here on a special day. Chef Anthony's does offer periodic buffet and having dined there before, I was given an sms that notified me of the Portugese Buffet Dinner.Geraho fritters, Saybak, Pork Curry Devil, Portugese baked fish, Cincaru Soy Limang were only a few of the dishes I can recall.Looking forward to dropping in again!Show less

Author: phoebet546
Title: Food was alright
Review: Went with family of 7.Ordered curry devil, say bak, kang kung, scallops, mussels, okra and baked fish. The baked fish was abit dry and tasteless. Definately not enough sambal gravy and too little onions as garnish. Scallops were not meaty and pretty small in size. It was very pungent, probabaly too much of garlic. Curry devil tasted good, not too spicy and chicken was cut not too tiny pieces.Say bak was different from the nyonya style that im used to eating at home. Would prefer it with more gravy. Kangkung belacan was nice. There were small shrimps like "gerago". It was just nice...not too salty or spicy.Chilli okra and mussels were alright. Nothing to shout aboutShow less

Author: janelleteohPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Prefect Seafood and Dinner Cuisine @ Melaka
Review: This restaurant have best seafood cuisine with reasonable price! It's too perfect for me, who loves seafood. Especially I must recommend you guys try the CRABS, nicely cooked and reasonable price. The seafood price mostly are based on market price, I went on Aug2013, the price for the crabs is RM70/kg (around 3 crabs, not big one) For me this price is acceptable. I went dinner on the 1st day, and take away one more KG back to KL. :D I just loves seafood soo much, and they serve it in quality cooks. The Portuguese chef is amazing. :) Clean and nice boss. The only thing for this restaurant to improve is the decoration, atmosphere there might need some renovations. But for the nice food and reasnable price, I think this place is a MUST go restaurant in Melaka.Show less

Author: gof48
Title: Not there yet
Review: Sorry to disagree with the other reviews, but we cannot give 5 stars, at least not yet. Anthony's showed the potential to be 5 stars, but it isn't there at the moment. In fairness, we went on a Saturday evening and the staff was swamped. There were several tables with large groups, but not all the tables were taken. Tip #1 - arrive before7 or, if you cannot, come after 9. We arrived at 7:30 and waited 1 hour, 15 minutes for our food.We had six dishes... The best were the mussels in oyster sauce, the Portuguese chicken Devil, and the garlic butter prawns. For the mussels, the sauce is quite unique...a traditional oyster sauce with some unusual spices. The mussels were huge and meaty, and the dish was a real winner. As was the Portuguese chicken. This was cooked in a curry devil sauce...a tangy tomato sauce. The prawns were large and fresh. One complaint here is that they were served last, and after the very spicy earlier dishes, we really could not taste the garlic sauce that well, but the prawns were still winners due to their size and sweet freshness.The curry leaf slipper lobsters were a disappointment. Not much meat and they were a bit overlooked. The salt and black pepper fritters were nothing special and a bit rubbery. The sweet potato leaves were fine, but noting special.But talk about value for money! All this, plus beers and many drinks for about S$60. Tip #2- they don't take credit cards.The ambience isn't great, but it is a happy, cheerful place and the wait staff went out of their way to make us feel welcome.Anthony works alone in the kitchen and he gets backed up. he needs another cook on busy nights. He also may be trying to do too many dishes at this point given his lack of staff. Perhaps cutting the menu back a bite old improve the kitchen's efficiency.We would definitely come back...the food is that good. With a little tweaking, he will get our 5 stars!Show less

Author: andlflohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great Seafood and Portuguese cooking
Review: My family and I have tasted the seafood at this restaurant and have found the fish, crabs and oysters to be very fresh. The cooking is done well by a well-known chef called Anthony who has worked overseas as well as some of the famous hotels in Melaka and elsewhere. Being Portuguese he also has mastered his native family dishes. The restaurant serves great grills as well - beef, lamb, etc....Show less

Author: Sui TMelaka, Melaka, Malaysia
Title: A must go restaurant in Melaka
Review: Clean and pleasant ambience. this restaurants serves awesome variety of Portuguese food (baked fish, kangkung belacan, scallops, sambal squid, otak otak, cincalok omelette) which i have ate a few times before - very yummy. also, i've tried their western cuisine which is really good too! a must try restaurant in melaka!! I'm sure u'll love it!Show less

Author: StanleyGohMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good Home Cooked Portuguese Food at very reasonable prices
Review: I have been to this restaurant a number of times, making it a point to bring friends who come to Melaka looking for good Portuguese food. Many of these friends have continued patronising this restaurant.My last visit was in April 2013.The food prepared is truly authentic home cooked Portuguese food. Among the dishes I love and recommend are their Garlic Butter Scallops, Portuguese Baked Fish, Curry leaf slipper lobsters, sambal sotong, kangkung belacan and ambila curry . Order a glass of their mango juice to go along with the food and you will probably also contemplate coming back for more of their food.Show less

Author: G_Gan
Title: Great Food !
Review: There were 10 pax in our group. We ordered fish, prawn, squid, vegetable, otak-otak and omelette. All the food were finished off!!! The otak-otak was really good with an excellent sambal topping!

Author: Hasyimahhisam
Title: Mee bodo tengkera melaka
Review:
The best mee u must try.. 
Taste very special. 
U must put the kicap & cuka 
Telur sambal powerr
U come 7am

Author: ttye0
Title: Tasty soup
Review: Always crowded with Muslims during tea time around 2-5pm.They served simple noodles soup with pulled chicken and sawi.The soup based was sweet with a lot of ajinomoto add in.Totally no 2nd visit.

Author: hjmokh
Title: Only 1
Review: The best local flavour soup in town. Our family had visited quite often. This restaurant has improved a lot especially clean and service. Value for money. Its about 1.5-2km radius from any hotel in Melaka town or Bandar Hilir. You can also reach by a ‘abang beca’ and enjoy your way there. Historic Tengkera Mosque is just next to it.Show less

Author: manjaredd
Title: Soup noodles lover? Lets try here!
Review: I love soup. Noodles will be my second choice if they offer vermicelli.I'd been to this place and had tried vermicelli soup.. Suitable as snack in between lunch to dinner time.The taste is not bad.. they also offer spring rolls which is also tastes good.i give 3 stars.Show less

Author: 327danelj
Title: Nasi Lemak Royale
Review: Perfect restaurant,easy to access, delecious and my family members like the foods so much, the price also affordable.

Author: myrfndMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Original From Kedah
Review: Good location.. Easy parking n hospitable n fast serviceFirst u need to Que for ur order.. Request what u want n pay.. Kindly warn the staff not to flood ur plate with multi graviesThere r much choices from beef fried chicken n fish etc.Prices are reasonable.Worth a tryNo regrets n recommended. Show less

Author: David Ignatius LMelaka, Malaysia
Title: First and Only Visit
Review: Brought my party of 20 friends to Palazzo for dinner during Chinese New Year last week as the other eateries in town were either fully occupied or closed for the festive week. It was everyone’s first trip to Palazzo and were all in high hopes of having a nice dinner in all it's glitter. However, lo and behold, the food was not up to expectation at all. We had a variety of dishes among my party and all of them were not one would expect of a fine dining restaurant. The food was bland, some salty, some not fully cooked and the portion was rather inadequate which in turn made them slightly overpriced. The only consolation was the premises was quite well designed and decorated. Sadly, my party and I made an agreement never to visit Palazzo anymore in the future.Show less

Author: gerarddutchy
Title: Romantic evening out
Review: Good quality western food for Malaccan standards. With its Mediterranean-style interior, it makes for a fair getaway from the city bustle - especially in the hands of the professional and attentive members of staff. We will be coming back when next in the area again.

Author: jennifer wMalaysia
Title: Soothing Ambience
Review: I took a friend to this place as its the best and presentable to treat her a lunch on her birthday.Parking space was convenient, spacious and enclosed in the restaurant compound. The restaurant was quite on the weekday. The interior was well set up and ideal place for a formal occasion. There is a corner with a long table that is suitable for a group event. There are more sitting areas for smokers at its exterior. Also, at the back of the restaurant, there is an open space for outdoor event or reception. Possible to hold a small wedding or birthday celebration. My friend ordered the Cantonese Fried Kuey Teow and I wanted to try the Lei Char Bee Hoon. A drink was included and we chose Honey Lemon.The Lei Char Bee Hoon tasted good for as I always love the conventional one (rice with various cut vegetables and green minty soup). It was my first time eating it as I have not seen it in other shops. The prices we paid for these food were reasonable for a well set up establishment. This restaurant also serves western food.Show less

Author: Cosmopolitan107667
Title: Dinner at Palazzo restaurant
Review: Saw few Muslim family having dinner in restaurant , pork free , good taste for spaghetti & pizza, I like the petal meehoon very much

Author: melakaG1234
Title: Great place
Review: Food is good, although not spectacular. Menu is a bit pricey for Melaka standards but the lunch sets were reasonable. Western and Malaysian food are both quite well cooked. Great ambiance and very nice bungalow building with ample parking space.

Author: edwinchowywMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Good location , nice ambiance
Review: Had lunch here recently . They have a choice of eastern(Asian) and western menu. Tried their local menu. It was a lunch menu which came with a free drink.Decent food . Nice cozy atmosphere . Service was satisfactory. Price of the set lunch was reasonable. Would recommend this if one is looking for a quick lunch.Show less

Author: Ah JMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent Quality of food and very good wine selection
Review: I was looking for a really good western fare restaurant as I am planning a birthday party for around 12 people and had passed the restaurant a few times whilst driving to Aeon so I decided to give it a try. The staff welcomed me and showed me to my table, a small two seat table as I was on my own, and I went through the menu and was very pleased with the large menu selection. I ordered a mushroom soup for starter and a grilled chicken with mash potatoes for entree. My soup arrived and my first taste was excellent but then I saw something moving on my plate and it was an ant so I returned the soup. when I checked my table there were quite a lot of ants as the table was pressed up against the wall so I moved the table and called the waiter over. I showed him the ants and he just stated he was "sorry about that" and that was it. So I used the serviette to remove the ants and the Nepalese waiter brought my new soup and it was delicious. The entree arrived and this too was delicious and so the food would get an excellent rating including value for money. However the fact that there were ants on the table and I was not offered another table by the waiters was vert disappointing. Based on the service I will probably not be having my birthday dinner at Palazzo's and will probably end up in one of the 5 star hotel restaurants which is quite a shame really based on the food.Show less

Author: Yong T
Title: Beautiful place for a quiet dining
Review:
A new restaurant away from town. Beautiful and quiet. Good for family dining as it it very spacious. They served western food. variety of food is less but taste is okay

It is very good that restaurant has its own parking space

Author: Silent88Seremban, Malaysia
Title: My Dining Experience in The Palazzo Cafe & Restaurant
Review: New western cafe & restaurant located in between Ayer Keroh & Malacca city. Served westerner food, from salad,mushroom soup, main course, desserts and coffee. Portion of the food are small, tasted from average to good. Provide free car park. Bad experience will dining, seated next to a smoker. Air-con dining area are fully reserve. No so friendly and don't provide good professional customer service. Poor timing for starter, main course and dessert. Price from medium to upper. Overall rating 2.5/5 star!Show less

Author: nurlidaf
Title: Variety Food
Review: Here have variety food to choose. To food hunter this place is very recommended and the price is reasonable

Author: PeterLai0166077Melaka, Malaysia
Title: Excellent!!!!
Review: This is the BEST Laksa ever!Former DJ JoeVegas was the cook that created this dish...Unique soup and instead of cockles its replaced with salted fish.At first i tought it was wierd but after i tasted the soup with the mixture of salted fish and its simply tastes GREAT!100% SATISFACTION....Show less

Author: HanglooseBro94Zurich, Switzerland
Title: best pub in town
Review: Seriously not kidding.! If you are looking for an authentic evening with very friendly locals. It is the place to be here in malacca. They serve a good range of beers and other stuff. pubfood is also good.It is possible to play music here. and they also have a small band here who comes to play. They also have a pool table .Show less

Author: sulynnh2017
Title: Fun time out
Review: Great place to chill with friends or family. Enjoy a game of pool or dart and maybe some dancing. Freezing cold beers.

Author: sulynnh2017
Title: Sunday fun
Review: Chill, relax, cold beers!!! Freezing cold beers!!! Bring us back to the good times with good oldies.

Author: CaroLynn128
Title: Meh.. Overpriced slow food
Review: Waited so long for mediocre food. Way overpriced for the kind of food you can get anywhere else in the city.

Author: blujasAmpang, Malaysia
Title: Good quality Chinese restaurant
Review: It was recommended to us by relatives. We brought mom on her birthday. They have ground and level 1. It’s decent. Not wow but decent. Had their fried Mee sua, Vietnamese pork belly, lemon chicken, two types veggies, pork ribs in yam ring. Don’t order their soup - by my standard, both their hot sour soup and old cucumber soup were sub parShow less

Author: FromKluang
Title: Good environment
Review: Is a better Chinese restaurant in Melaka with good foods & pleasant atmosphere. Suitable to bring guest here for lunch and dinner. They have VIP rooms with Karaoke for business or family. Recommend to try their Nyoya style steam fish.

Author: josepho53Johor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: Good food
Review: Well, this is one of the better Chinese restaurants in Melaka. I liked the decor of this restaurants and the food is above average. Service was excellent and pricing I. The medium range.I loved the braise pork with dark soya sauce which tasted like excellent. The sesame chicken was good. The tau foo (bean curd) in pot fish was acceptable. The vegetable that we ordered was mediocre. Overall a good place to go to for some good Chinese food.Show less

Author: Murray CMornington, Australia
Title: Great food
Review: A wide range of Chinese food and all very delicious. We had a table for 12 so got a wide range of dishes to share. I liked the fish particularly but the chicken, pork, vegetables, prawns, etc were all great. Not too noisy, no parking problems. A great evening enjoyed.Show less

Author: carol_lslinMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Standard not up to par
Review: Visited this restaurant 3 times in total. First visit tried their pumpkin prawn during peri CNY period. Was amazed by how the dish was prepared. However on return visit later on , prawns were not fresh , and the whole dish was bland. Other dishes were as usual restaurant standards. 3rd visit there was nothing to shout abt. Overall it is a good place if u run out of place to go.Show less

Author: DrRubenMalaysia
Title: Awesome Chinese food in Kota Syahbandar
Review: Recommended by my fiancee's family. It's their frequent family meal location. Located well, parking easily available. Decent ambiance with good waiters and staff. The 4 season cold starters was outstanding, surprised with the presentation and taste. Also ordered the fish Nyonya sambal style, pork "paiquat wong" - red wine sauce and yam basket chilli chicken. All of these dishes were sufficient in amount for 8 people, the dishes were superb and delicious as well. A bit pricey, there are better restaurants out there that have equally delicious tasting dishes with cheaper prices. Show less

Author: Spoilt_TravellerSingapore
Title: Excellent food and pleasant atmosphere
Review: A competent Chinese restaurant that produces good quality Cantonese dishes. Do try their signature dishes but do not be disappointed if they inform you that they no longer have some of their dishes (screened on the TV) on offer. Do try their cod fish done 2 ways (steamed, pan fried), sea cucumber, hokkien noodles and seafood items. Show less

Author: ambrose l
Title: Modern Chinese Food
Review: Pretty good chinese food with a fancy outlook. You need to book for a place if you're looking to dine here during weekend nights.

Author: NicNecromancer
Title: Best choice for family
Review: Best choice for family or friends gathering. Superb food with 5stars services. Easy parking, easy to reach.

Author: drdanielwywongMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic North Eastern Thai cuisine
Review: The restaurant is now located at Taman Kota Laksamana at Jalan KLJ 1. Discovered this gem by accident. Generous portions. Good value for money. Enjoyed the lovely food cooked by Thai chefs. Wonderful hospitality by the owner and Thai wife. Will definitely be back with family and friends.Show less

Author: bunnyespresso
Title: Great foood
Review: Tried their minced pork and green milk tea. It's my all time favorite. I would really recommend coming here. Favorite Thai restaurant. Love it 😋

Author: David HMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Authentic Thai Food
Review: Very good Thai food prepared by Thai cook and her Melakian husband. As example the green curry chicken has a more tasty and more clear sauce you usually find in Malaysia & Singapore. The roasted pig knuckle with the crispy crackling skin and slightly sweet sauce is amazing. Worth the visit. All of the beverages are authentic from herb tea, soya and sesame drink and Thai beer.The Tom Yam is clean and nicely spicy. This a charming family run business. Very nice people.Show less

Author: 2020Amia
Title: Great Taste
Review: Its a non halal chinese food which serve pork and alcohol. I tried a few dishes with family and friends (refer picture).I really like the tofu and mango drinks. The pork with chilli is a bit spicy for my taste bud but it also delicious. Overall would recomend and will come back to try the other dishes.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYang
Title: Great, but could be better
Review: Tried this newly opened restaurant in melaka as recommended by Facebook friends. The cheese crabs was the best but noodles overly salty. Do book in advance for business is usually good. Overall, great tasting but can be improve

Author: claud1ne
Title: Great food, great hospitality
Review: Great food and great hospitality. However, I recommend fellow tourist using a grab instead of driving on their own as the restaurant is not very obvious from the roadside (if you don't look closely you will easily drive pass the place)

Author: marvin_ngrwSubang Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Good Food!
Review: Lovely food, butter cheese or butter prawn cheesy noodles. MUST TRY! Crabs and many other recommended dish from the boss is worth to try. Good to have family comfort food and they have been doing local regular market. Not very touristy but worth it if you are looking for local food to try for dinner. Try it!Show less

Author: blessedwoman08Singapore, Singapore
Title: Simple zi char stall
Review: Was recommended by locals to try out this open air zi char stall by the street. The crabs were quite small but fresh. The lalas were nice. Rest of the food was ok. It can get quite hot dining here and you will be busy swatting away the houseflies. Show less

Author: garetjax72Singapore, Singapore
Title: Excellent crab. Good value.
Review: Pretty much a roadside zi char restaurant that is a bit off the beaten path along Jln Temenggong. Had crabs done in sweet and spicy sauce, and with salted egg yolk, fresh and big la la clams, wok fried greens and char kway teow. The crabs and clams were very good and fresh, and the noodles had good wok hei. All in all, the entire meal (including 4 medium-sized crabs), came in just over MYR200, which is pretty good value.Show less

Author: RowntreeKL
Title: Crab and prawn noodle
Review: Had dinner with parents(only a party of 3 people).Servicewise,it is self service for utensils.It would had been helpful if the one taking the order had clearly stated e.g prawn noodle will cost RM15 per prawn as it was not made known when order was made.Similarly for the price/weight of crab as it may vary but should had been made known from the start.Being a tourist attraction in Malacca does not mean that customers do not have the right not to order lesser.Show less

Author: joykoo
Title: Nothing to shout about
Review: Typical cze char stall. Went there because of recommendation by local friends. Had the chicken soup in coconut, salt bake crab, steam partin fish, vegetable, tofu and lala. Bill came up to RM313.

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Fantastic
Review: This in indefinite restaurant is located in between a row of shophouses. you need to drive slowly along jalan termenggong (One Way Street) passby a nearby wet market which is opposite to Tiga Ros restaurant. Food is Chinese Zi Char type but delicious.They are famous for their crabs cook in different varieties but do check their other popular dishes like La La shell fishes and also steam groupers. Had diiner many times at this place and highly recommended to all who like food enough to venture here. Do try and taste it for yourself. Don't say I did not tell you this secretShow less

Author: OngAKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Fried Oyster Omelette (Oh Chien)
Review: Waited for 1 hour to get mine. The omelette smells really good, thanks to the great amount of eggs added and also the special chilli paste used. Cost RM9 for normal portion, and RM12 for a large portion, for which is quite a generous amount. The taste is good when added with the sauce provided. Otherwise, it taste slightly bland (don't see the owner putting any flavouring like soy sauce or salt). The number of oysters added is not that many, and a bit overcooked. Nonetheless, it is still a very good oh chien.Show less

Author: marta f
Title: Like home
Review: You feel like home. You can see how the chef prepares each dish while a kind service explains you every single detail about the products. Very clean and cheaper than Europe. Amazing.

Author: Proteus55
Title: Lovely wantan mee and delicious o'chien
Review: A must try when in Melaka. Portions of the oyster (o'chien) is big. Noodles are reasonably sized and priced. The wantan noodles are  lovely with and come with 3 delicious dumplings. Be prepared to wait though, there's usually a crowd.

Author: zachhh_lim
Title: Wonton mee is fine. Wonton itself isn't.
Review:
Came at night, around 8ish. Minimal queue. The mee (noodles) is ok. The wonton quality is not consistent. Some tasted weird. Very unnerving experience while eating - kept thinking about the different meat that they put into the wonton. 

I think it is overhyped.

Author: ongkeehongSingapore, Singapore
Title: Delicious fried ostyer and wantan noodle
Review: We visit at the evening. The wantan noodle was serve in plain colour, no black source, chili source or tomato source. But it tasty and serve well in the seasoning oil. The fried ostyer was long queue, we got ours in the 7 frying. But it worth the wait. You won't taste flour, yet full of oyster, fried till dry but not over fried. There was a fried Hokkien Mee stall at the end, looks delicious but we are too full to try it out.Show less

Author: sivam127
Title: general dishes ,lunchand snakcs
Review: front line food kept expose  at all times , inconsistence frying of mee goreng and others. sometimes slow in service need to remind for extra side dishes .

Author: cutebutdeadly
Title: This is what u call asam pedas???!!,
Review: Please find other place to eat. Wrong place!!food is tasteless and expensive. Nothing good about this place

Author: TheruthiVancouver, Canada
Title: Nice authentic Indian banana leaf meal
Review: Made me feel like I was back in south inda. However I ordered a lassi that had ice in it and they couldn't assure me that it was made from safe water (to their credit, they gave me another ice less one for no charge). Their chai is a lot more expensive than other nearby places (the best and cheapest chai I had was at the madras cafe).Show less

Author: Jovial D
Title: wow coffee shop
Review: this place has the right blend of ambiance, taste, presentation and quality. one must come here to experience the unique manner of presenting the dishes and coffee.

Author: JustinB4148
Title: Unique coffee experience in Malacca!
Review: Great coffee and service with a fantastic selection of coffees that leave you very satisfied and wanting more! Run by two extremely friendly and knowledgeable guys who clearly love what they are doing and might infect you with their making and drinking coffee.

Author: Roland DLondon, United Kingdom
Title: Typical Subway Meal
Review: The sub of the day is only 8.50 ringette (about £1.50) and a drink is 2.65 ringette with a refill costing 1.05 ringette. The sandwich was good. The service was OK. There are lots of seats. The restaurant is at one side of the Mall, near an entrance. Alas, there is no wifi.Show less

Author: 54austin
Title: Cheap beers, friendly hostess
Review: Can't vouch for the food, but the beers here are the cheapest on the river.  The hostess is a really friendly woman that we looked forward to seeing each night.  This bar was our favorite place to chill out in Melaka.

Author: Kathy HPhoenix, Arizona
Title: Wonderful place to eat or hang out
Review: I'm staying in the Sunflower Hotel for 6 weeks total and I absolutely love this little cafe. It's extremely well-run, the staff are attentive and friendly, and the food is really good. They have a small but varied menu and great prices. I am writing a book during my stay and the atmosphere is very relaxing. I'm going to miss this place.Show less

Author: kimb8819Uganda
Title: Had a wonderful time...recommended
Review: Also known to many as the Sunflower Hotel Cafeteria. This place has a cool ambience n atmosphere. Wonderful service with friendly and interactive staff. Fast internet. My friends n I had all our breakfasts n most suppers there. The food was tasty good. Big thanks to Ganesh for being so helpful and informative about the area(whats good to eat, directions on how to n where to get the public bus n all). Also, he,Danese n the Chef made our dinners . We were always received with smiles. Impressive. Keep up the good spirit. Terima Kasih guys. Show less

Author: DaniDania05Seremban District, Malaysia
Title: My fav place to hang out in Melaka!
Review: Really love the ambiance. Very great place to hangout while working. The milkshakes, the teokbokki, coffee & tea, even cakes, I tried it all already! Superb! And plus the best thing is, it’s a Book Cafe! So I can just grab one and read while enjoying my choc milkshake. I miss that time already.. hoping for covid to go away so that I can visit the cafe next time.Show less

Author: Vgemini91Johor, Malaysia
Title: Love the ambience
Review: Very old school place. Love Luna and Summer. In case you're wondering, those two are the adorable furry treats. They liven up the place and make it more welcoming. Good selection of mocktails and coffee. Definitely would go there. Jamie and Jessie are good hosts and well.Show less

Author: Ronnie L
Title: Nice environment but food does not match
Review: We wanted to try a less familiar restaurant while holidaying in Port Dickson.This restaurant is 30 minutes drive from Teluk Kemang towards the direction of Pasir Panjang,. It is built over the sea, There are ample parking spaces and the walkway over the sea to the restaurant is fine for most apart from the very elderly. The walkway will take wheelchairs ( and motorcycles). Some people fish from the walkways leading to the restaurant. One has the choice of dining under the stars in the sky canopy or indoors. We of course chose the former. It was a pity that there was little sea breeze that night. They had a clever way of repelling mosquitoes jn that open air environment located near mangrove trees.We had sting ray assam pedas - it was good. The mussels and squid with salted egg were ok at best. We didn't order prawns because they didn't look fresh. Crabs, cockles, lala, bamboo clams and various fish and vegetables were also available.This restaurant Is 50% more costly than similar food in Umbai and Crystal Bay in Melaka and the food is not as delicious.The restaurant seriously lacked patronage on a week day. It was a nice change but we doubt that we would return if the food quality and pricing are not improvedShow less

Author: Gcling85
Title: Trip to melaka
Review:
Must try cincau milk tea.
Hainam Braised pork bun.
Kaya butter toast.
If possible buy a bottle of handmade hainam chilli and handmade kaya back home.

Author: JAMILEYJAAFARKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: "Small Shop But Tasted 5 Star"
Review: You want to enjoy hotel-class food and prices like regular restaurants ... !!! Almost 7 years I enjoy the food here and it still tastes just as good. Chicken Rice, Fried Rice, Any Noddle (Mee) Any Kuey Teow, Many Soup and many more to eat. You just order from the menu everything is delicious. This shop has 2 branches, Food Court Mini Malaysia & Food Court near MITC Mosque. The taste and price are well worth it.Show less

Author: RingoWYTKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A good dining venue for family and friends
Review: Children like to visit this restaurant, if not the food, it must be the ambient. Nice smiles you could see from here, even though life is tough. I always believe that if a local restaurant (not francaise or under the wing of some big company), be able to survive/ pull through the MCO during outbreak, it has to be something that worth the support.Show less

Author: malaccatourismAyer Keroh, Malaysia
Title: Interesting, tasty meals.
Review: Came here with my sons and daughter in law as it was a perfect night for a Hot pot dinner! Service was good, fast and efficient. Menu dishes were all available, no fuss about time for Food to arrive as even though the restaurant was running Full House everything arrived into our table within 13 minutes.Dishes were tasty as the Hot Pot sauce and Spicy Broth was perfect with the recommended dishes.Show less

Author: WeeWeiYangMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Simply Appetising
Review: This is one nice place for a hot pot. The Claypot rice is a must try and most of the dish is easy to eat like fish ball etc.. Only bug bear is the ordering can be somewhat confusing for customers as the menue and order list is not very user friendly. They also repeated the one and only Chinese new year song which can be quite irritating Show less

Author: queeniekoh1211
Title: Impressive Giant Burger
Review: Whole family of us share the super giant burger, and their ice dessert is really nice, and they offer a lot of big cup beverage & their portion o food is big . With very reasonable price.

Author: joannaleelee
Title: Just ok
Review: Tried the ouster noodles and Kong pao chicken. Pricing was slightly high considering the average taste of food. Be sure to try other menu selection as it offers plenty of other varieties. Plenty of outdoor seats however, tables too high for the chairs which made the eating experience weird. Show less

Author: FindTravelPartnerMalaysia
Title: Huge and Mega Burger
Review: First time order huge burger, in the end it take 4 peoples to finish that burger, fries and coke. Please order original taste if you want to try their signature burger and it cost you RM69 for huge burger, fries, wedges, and 1 jar of coke.Operation hours : Mon: 2:00 pm - 12:00 amWed-Sun: 2:00 pm - 12:00 amShow less

Author: DayanaIzyan
Title: Sunday outing @ TheTaste Project Cafe
Review: It was my first visit to TP on last Sunday afternoon..=)My family was having an awesome brunch at the Taste Project café. The ambience of the café was suitable for those who have kids like me and the food was superb. Thumbs up for the Spicy Buttermilk Pasta, a must try one! Other menus like Mushroom soup, Bacon Carbonara, Crispy Chicken Chop and Capsicum Rice with Stew Chicken were delicious too, with good portion and reasonable price. Surely will come again..Show less

Author: Fazilah D
Title: Gastrofusion Culinary Adventure
Review: An excellent place with cool ambience that offers various kinds of Italian pastas with Asian touch. The fruit teas are just right to complement the pastas. There cakes and cookies too. They are on Facebook as : Taste Project and their Instagram  is @tasteprojectmlk.

Author: sy3717
Title: A taste of Hakka Cuisine
Review: A very cosy restaurant which serves reasonably priced authentic Hakka cuisines. Come here for any Hakka cuisine that will certainly recall your sweet memory. The noodles in this restaurant are homemade and no boric asid. We ordered Hakka noodle with minced meat, pork ribs noodle...and ginger  wine mee sua for our breakfast.  As we were the early birds, they were still not ready to serve some of the dishes that we were so anxious to try.    Satisfied with the service.More

Author: QingR8
Title: authentic Hakka Cuisine
Review: Reasonably priced authentic Hakka cuisine. Thumbs up for its signature dish,  vermicelli noodles with rice wine.

Author: Debaprasad B
Title: Yummy breakfast!!!
Review: As i was searching for some traditional breakfast just happen to be here on someones recommendation. A nice neat clean family run pocket friendly join with amazing food with great taste. Loved the place and will visit again.
Restaurant: Wonton Stall at Jalan Hang Kasturi

Author: Choonfong
Title: Savory Wanton Noodles
Review: Had wonton noodle soup for 4 persons; the little meat dumplings are freshly cooked and served piping hot with the noodles. The kids loved it. Price is affordable and the place quite clean and neat
Restaurant: Wonton Stall at Jalan Hang Kasturi

Author: CeciltongSingapore
Title: Delicious breakfast noodles @ Jalan Hang Kasturi
Review: This has become a non-negotiable part of all my trips to Melaka - breakfast in the living room of a gracious Malaccan lady who sells fried noodles (mee/kuay teow/bee hoon) and nasi kuning, kuehs, and other snacks. I stumbled upon this place on a morning walk many years ago, while I noticed locals on motorbikes stopping and taking away. I don't think she meant to open up her living room but since I asked whether there was a place to sit, she offered me her living room. Her cooking is simple but delicious, and brings back memories of my granny's cooking. You can have the noodles with sambal or topped with curry gravy. On an earlier occasion, I asked whether she sold tea/coffee, and she took my order. Little did I realise that she sent her daughter to a neighbouring coffee shop to ask them to deliver it to her living room. I felt really bad for putting them out, but they were more than happy to extend their hospitality. Now I don't order coffee, but being a gracious host, she offers me complimentary Chinese tea whenever I visit. Sitting in her living room is like visiting a living museum. What you find there transports you back to the 50s-70s. Often I go away feeling that I have just visited a friend in Melaka. On some of my previous walks, I was accompanied by with wife, and she really enjoyed the noodles and the experience. On our last trip, recently, she felt too tired to get up but gave me instructions to take away a serving of the noodles, and being man, I didn't register her request. She was so upset when I returned empty handed, and nothing else I did would pacify her that day. Her stall is diagonally across from "Tee Soon Loong Chan Teo Chew Seafood Restaurant" and is on the stretch of Jalan Hang Kasturi between Jalan Hang Jebat (Jonker Street) and the junction of Jalan Tukang Emas and Jalan Tukang BesiShow less
Restaurant: Wonton Stall at Jalan Hang Kasturi

Author: Explorer2399
Title: great restaurant

Author: FongYT
Title: Pizza
Review: A cozy place, very quiet. They served good pizza. My daughters love it, commenting better than shakeys, pizza hut and dominos....hahaha.

Author: LadySandoraKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Forget the Italian Restaurant
Review: We drove over for a meal at Milan, the "Italian" restaurant. It opens at 5pm but when we arrived at 6.15pm, the cashier was unattended, there was no one to be seen in or around the restaurant or the adjoining coffeehouse. After standing around for 5 mins, I went towards the kitchen, asked a chef on break if there was any service crew available and he alerted a waiter from the back who handed us the menu. It had a limited and strange list of food available for an Italian restaurant, including Taj Mahal pan grilled chicken. Interestingly, all the food came well presented, including the Pasta Frutti De Mare which was unfortunately way too sweet to be fully enjoyed. The grilled fish was regrettably tough and the baby corn on all our plates had turned sour. Service was non existent with one waiter (with very limited English) doing his best attending to other guests who arrived subsequently. It's worth mentioning too that when I first rang the hotel for some information, the telephonist could not understand simple English. When we arrived, I notice that the carpark does not have have a fully covered walkway to the hotel. If it rains, it would be a major inconvenience. There were no porters at the door to help with bags either and the lobby is on the mezzanine floor via an escalator. If you are travelling with kids, or if you intend to do lots of shopping, this is not a hotel for you.Show less

Author: aliakberhabib
Title: Not bad at all
Review: Ordered the Tandoori pizza and was surprised at hw difference and good it was. Wasn't expecting much but was pleasantly surprised at the quality and the size of the pizza. Service was good though even when the restaurantwas completely empty.

Author: ec00wl
Title: Affordable & delicious food
Review: The meal was out of my expectation & surprisingly good. The atmosphere is rather cozy and the restaurant is fairly new.

Author: DriveUSA-JPSaitama, Japan
Title: マラッカ島入口のモール内にある
Review: 「Riviera Pulau Melaka City」という名のモールの中心部、噴水前に店がある。マラッカ名物のチキンライスボールはRM5.9、通常のチキンライスがRM5.4と、高級仕様のモールの一等地にある店としては非常にリーズナブルな価格設定。Show less

Author: azrulhanis
Title: Homecook Amusement
Review: Returning back after few months for tempting fried threadfin + sambal squids with prawns and not forgotten the Otak-Otak

Author: Dhiba16

Review: Too expensive as I only ordered 3 items and they charged us 82++ for 2 persons. When I asked the owner, she could tel me that, it’s their own fish. That’s Ridiculous! Not recommended at all..my best advice is please don’t go unless you really wanna waste your money. Not worth at all..regretted!Show less

Author: azrulhanis

Review: Absolutely homecook foodies with the best assam snapper fillet and fried threadfin fish. Go with sambal squids and prawns...

Author: xx017Minneapolis, Minnesota
Title: Truly famous
Review: I was introduced to this restaurant and later brought my parents too. This damilynown restaurant only serves 3-4 dishes. They are very standard to every table but it's truly spectacular. Their dishes are :- sotong sambal masak petai (sambal squid with petai) - 5⭐- asam fish - fish cook in sour asam. Unlike the regular asam, it doesn't have a lot of chilli. 4⭐- fried fish - 3⭐- otak otak - 5⭐- deep fried eggs - must try... 5⭐ Show less

Author: izwanhShah Alam, Malaysia
Title: Delicious for a price
Review: We ordered fried fish, garlic kangkung, and the sambal petai shrimp and squid with rice and were charged around rm70.. Personally that's a bit overpriced, the food is good especially the sambal petai but not at that price point.. I would give this place 5 stars if they could reduce the price or improve on the experience.. The place doesn't even have a menu so the price is quite unexpected, and somehow you should already know what to order if you are planning to go there .. Anyway it is worth a try and the auntie is friendly.. The restaurant is not halal certified but I have seen Muslims going there and they serve only seafood..Show less

Author: Rose RAdelaide, Australia
Title: Wholesome food
Review: It was just after Chinese New Year and their food stock was limited. We were recommended 6 dishes and were not disappointed. The stir fry salt fish bean sprouts was just right and so was the sambal kangkong. Very nice Assam fish, unusual deep fried eggs but with soft yolks, tofu, and deep fried fish with sambal were all delicious. Will come again. Because it’s a Seafood restaurant it smells fishy on entering which can be a bit off putting. Show less

Author: SteveL1970Malaysia
Title: Evergreen
Review: Was there for early dinner on 22/7/2017 with mom, wife and daughter. As usual, their red snapper in tamarind sauce, sambal squid with smelly beans and fried egg are our usual orders. Have always patronised this place since 1997. Taste is always consistent although slightly pricey. The portions are huge. We ordered 7 rice which is considered many as my daughter did not eat. So, the food was consumed by 3 adults.Do not have much choices but rest assured, always well done. Kitchen manned by family members unlike those commercialised pre cooked famous eateries which are manned by foreigners. These foreigners have either strayed away from the original peranakan recipe or full secret not passed down Waiting time was fast as we arrived at 5.45pm. Later more tables came in and noticed they are local families with many aged 45 years old above. Guess they must know that this place, although slightly pricey still serves good food. Most vehicles parked outside have local plates.Show less

Author: Diana7737
Title: Best asam fish!
Review: I keep going back for their signature asam pedas fish. The broth is full of flavor. Tried their kangkung belacan & cuttlefish belacan. Both dishes are spicy but each brings out different flavor. Highly recommended, worth every visit & price reasonable.

Author: Caspari H
Title: A nice restaurant to enjoy seafood.
Review: This place serves tasty and fresh seafood. A must try dish is the otak-otak and asam fish. The price is slightly expensive but the food is quite good.

Author: dac546
Title: Visited again after several years : still very expensive
Review: Not recommended unless you are willing to pay 5 star prices for 2 star ambience, food and service .  Sambal petai is not bad but super expensive . Dinner for 2 costs RM 79.

Author: joy777777Indonesia
Title: the most expensive restaurant i ever been
Review: The most expensive restaurant in melaka. Better dont try even the food not bad. I suggest u to eat around melaka raya, such as: zongthai restaurant, station one cafe, hailam kopitiam n there's still a lot of good n cheap restaurant to grab. Remember...nvr try city famous.... the waitre or waitress come near with a knife on their hand...Show less

Author: Mohd CSingapore
Title: Appetizing food
Review: This restaurant serves a handful of food, so please don't expect fancy menu. The standard items available are:a) Assam fish or fish head (usually red snapper - jenahak)b) Deep fried fish served with some light soya sauce (usually threadfin - senangin)c) Sambal prawn mixed with squid (can also request for sambal prawn or squid only)d) Otak-otak (Muar style - steamed square fish meat pate, slightly spicy)e) Fried kang-kung chillif) Stir fried taugeh (bean sprout)g) Telor Bom (deep fried cluster of chicken eggs with light soya sauce)h) Tau foo (egg beancurd with romaine lettuce-yau mak in sauce)Food quality has not changed much since my first visit in 1997. The only difference is the price of food (like almost anywhere else). The most expensive item on the menu are the fish, prawn or squid. Expect to pay over MYR30 for half a fish head and MYR25+ for sambal prawn and squid. The restaurant has their signature chilli paste which is used to cook the assam fish, sambal and fried kangkung, which is not too spicy. The assam is different from the local Melaka Masak Asam or Nyonya Assam. It is just a combination of the signature chilli paste with tamarind (assam jawa) juice on steamed fish. Simple but appetizing with hot rice. And their prawn and squid are cooked just nice, it is probably the only place where I really enjoy squid as they are soft instead of chewy.To locate this restaurant, when driving on Jalan Merdeka in Melaka Raya (heading towards Mahkota Parade), stay right after you see a stretch of 3 restaurants (Old Town, The Library & Papa Rich) on your left. Turn right into the lane where the Yong Peng Fish Ball restaurant is and follow the road to end of a row of shops. The Famous City Seafood is on your left. Alternatively, program this coordinate into your GPS: 2.18778 N, 102.256723 E.This restaurant is not certified Halal but they do not serve any meat. You will find Malay patrons occasionally. Food is served relatively fast even on a busy evening.Show less

Author: cochleartraveller
Title: Good assam fish head.
Review: The food here is good, basically the specialise in seafood. Nice but hard to find, I think the telur bomb started here in Melaka.

Author: sheronlee

Review: The food here is simply awesome especially the deep fried fish with sambal. The sambal prawn and squid is also yummy.

Author: dac546Iskandar Puteri, Malaysia
Title: Overated and Over priced
Review: this restaurant is located behind the melaka raya road , behind the main shophouse. we ordered assam fish, sotong+ prawn sambal, and taugeh. the total bill came out to be RM 58++ for 2 persons. I challenged the bill and they said its a special kind of fish. In summary , definitely NOT VALUE FOR MONEY. Unless you really have to where else to eat in malaccaShow less

Author: Altamm
Title: Great place to grab a simple but filling breakfast!
Review: I think the place is underated. The service was very polite and quick. Prices are reasonable (as it is on the main touristy-area) and food simple but good. Coffee-selection for all tastes. Really recommend! :)

Author: dr_ganlt
Title: Cool Place
Review: A good variety of mangoes in different preparation and other local appetisers and durian cakes, puddings and set meals are available. We had red bean puddings, ginger sweet potatoes and fried raddish cakes for our high tea today. We have this at the Hui Lau...San at Dataran Pahlawan Megamall in Malacca.
