Author: Chia Wei T
Title: Fresh yogurt by the river
Review: We passed by and where attracted by the artwork. After taking some pictures we got tempted into a coffee and a delicious handmade yogurt. I only tried the jackfruit but was very tasty and the smell of the pizza was amazing, shame we had already...More

Author: yourlondonguide
Title: A charming Surprise
Review: We came here as we where trying to escape the rain that had just started to ruin our only day in Melaka, when a charming guy called us in and offered an organic Tea as part of a small promotion that they where doing for...More

Author: A-food-enthusiast
Title: Best Pizza in Asia served by a great host
Review: I have had the chance to be living in Melaka for a little while now, and had the pleasure to experience the amazing Pizza from Voyage together. Having stayed in there backpackers and being a pizza chef myself I was eager to try it out....More

Author: jojopancakesSingapore, Singapore
Title: Disappointing and sloppy
Review: There was a long row of nonya restaurants along jonker street. We thought this looked the most promising and we soon learnt our lesson that appearance and accreditations certs may not always be the best gauge for good food. The dishes served was bland. The salted vegetable duck soup (itek tim) was a far cry from the picture on their menu. See the pics and you will know what I'm talking about. It tasted like plain water with a hint of duck essence. This is the nicest description I could give. Go at your own risk! Show less

Author: jyeongllSingapore, Singapore
Title: LONG wait for mediocre food
Review: 40 minutes wait? It's probably more worth it if the dishes are up to the mark. The portions are little and the taste of Ayam Buah Keluak is disappointing. You would expect the colour of the curry be blended with the nut to make it darker, not bright red.The Itek Tim salted vege is way too salty. They need to wash and soak off the preserved salt before cooking?Only two cooks. No system of a proper restaurant management. If there are two dishes of the same, they could have cooked two portions instead of serving the orders out table by table. The maids were helping to clear tables and serve. The drinks were done by I assume his daughter and she does cashiering.By the time we left, it's a good hour or so. If it is not opened till late, we could have gone to the Amy's or Nancy's.Show less

Author: juihongKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: I love this cuisine
Review: If you come to Malacca, you’ll be remissed to bypass Nyonya cuisine. Nyonya cuisine comes from the Peranakans, descendants of early Chinese migrants who settled here during the Sultanate of Malacca and marrying local Malays. The dishes combine Chinese and Malay influences to create a mix of delicacy that is my absolute favourite. For other recommendations, also try the Ayam Masak Merah, Prawn with Sambal Belacan and Curry Fish Head.Show less

Author: WanderlenMalaysia
Title: Wrong address for this restaurant
Review: The address stated on TA is wrong. Was trying to find the restaurant but kept leading me to 88 Jonker street which is another restaurant serving different nonya food.Since we can't eat spicy food, we ordered the salted vegetable and duck soup, omelette and chicken. The first two were good but the last dish was disappointing which was very pretty dry. Serving size ranges from small to large.Ordered the cane drink which was not bad. The cendol tasted better than 88 Jonker St except the shaved ice was pre-prepared as it was pretty hard.Overall, it was a fairly satisfying meal.Show less

Author: CrystalismKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Average Nyonya food around Jonker area
Review: Overall I'm pretty satisfied with their food. Some dishes are slightly too salty but goes OK to have with rice. Dishes like sambal prawns, prawn is so small and they did not even bother to de-shell. Petai is sliced into so tiny portions, like quarter the size. Just not quite happy with the way they ration things for a dish. Sometimes, setting the price a little bit more and use better ingredients will not harm. Rationing here and there is like might as well I just cook at home then. If you're already charging not really cheap prices, give it the best to your customers. You have really good sambal, don't waste them on lousy portions/ingredients. If I remember correctly they do sell their sambal separately for an extra fee. Then again, Nyonya cravings satisfied!Show less

Author: Mei G
Title: Average
Review: Recommended by hotel staff ,Dont like the food here ,very salty n Serving very slow ,served after waited for half an hour

Author: Manhow R
Title: Nyoya Cendol tasty
Review: First time nyoya.....It's tasty.....unfortunaly,the cendol have been destroy by my own hand~anyway,speak ,commend, is useless...All u have to do is taste it,trust me~is tasty and sweety~hehe

Author: JLee1982
Title: This is not nyonya food
Review: There was nothing authentic about the food. The normal flavour from the herbs used in nyonya food was not present. Only recommended for tourists, if you are a local forget it.

Author: Foo_YC
Title: Seriously Great Food!
Review: We were there for dinner on a Friday night. Did not do any bookings. When we arrived, it was full house. We had to wait for half an hour to get a table and another half to three quarters hour until the food arrives. The food is very delicious and very authentic. Price is slightly on the high side but worth the taste. The shop is located towards the end of Jonker Street if we assume the start is where Hard Rock is. And very near to a roadstage. Reminder that Jonker Street is closed to vehicles on Friday to Sunday evenings. Recommended for everyone as its not all super spicy. Show less

Author: BabyprotectorHong Kong
Title: Finished everything we ordered as everything tasted so good!
Review: We drove to Malacca by car from Singapore, arrived at 1:30pm, after checked in hot, immediately we looked for a restaurant for late lunch. We found this restaurant it was clean, but at that time (2pm) there were no guests. I cannot remember what we ordered, we just ordered few disks the waiter recommended, UNBELIEVABLY GOOD!We finished everything and were fully satisfied! One of the best meal we had in our Malacca vacation!Show less

Author: sanyuanwMoscow, Russia
Title: unforgetable food
Review: 3adults plus 2 kids arrived around 7 pm，door was closed but with a sign "open". It turned out to be a clean and comfortable restaurant . We ordered spicy chicken, eggs, tou fu, green vegetable and dim sum. It's really delicious and we finished all. This dinner makes our Melaka trip ends perfectly plus just costed 68 RM!Show less

Author: lillopillo
Title: Nice local food
Review: We arrived at around 8.30, thankfully there was not too many people. The older guy who took our order (i guess he looked like the owner) talked to me (I look Chinese) in some chinese dialect, it sounded Teochew or Hokkien. We ordered pineapple juice (very nice and cool!), Chap Chui (chop suey, mixed vegetables), Ayam Pongteh, and Fried mushrooms (I'll post 3 pictures) + 2 big portions of rice. The Chap chui was sweet thanks to the cabbage. It had some vermicelli too. The Ayam Pongteh taste nice, the flavour is not strong although the color of the sauce might make you think otherwise. The chicken pieces without bones were quite dry, but the ones with bones were so tender. The fried mushrooms were pleasantly crispy and not oily at all. The meal costed about 35 MYR for 2 persons. It felt like having dinner at a family's house, because groups of people kept on coming in, and talking joyfully, tables are big and round, with a glass centerpiece, like in Chinese restaurants. The plates are also like the ones we can have at home :)Show less

Author: lemonwguitar
Title: Good food
Review: Despite the fact that i am not good with spicy food, their nyonya dishes were delicious! The homemade goodness was appetizing and delicious. The staff were friendly and prices were good too. Will recommend!

Author: Tabasco_chillKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Great food, slow preparation
Review: Sat down and ordered by 2:06pm and by 2:46pm, no food to be seen yet... thankfully its tasty pineapple juice manage to cool us down ;-) we ordered sambal squid, duck dish, sambal cockle, lady fingers, cincalok omelet, fried chicken wings, bill was only RM120, too good for 4 adults and 1 kid. Definitely will repeat the order for omelet, duck dish and fried chicken wings, oh and the pineapple juice for sure. Show less

Author: 9357MarkYSingapore, Singapore
Title: Home cooked Nonya dishes
Review: The eating place is located the other end of Jonkers street where there is a performing stage setup. Most would miss this shop house unit as there are many street vendors outside. We were first timers and orders ayam pongteh, prawns fried in tamarind, kangkong chilli, egg omelette, saled veg duck (giam chai ah). The food tasted ok and the servings was just nice for the 5 of us, Service was good. I believe its run by a family and I took a name card at the cashier with the name "Lucy Wee" - probably the boss or the manager. We started dinner around 630pm and by the time we left at 730pm it was full house and a queue could develop then. Other dishes on the menu included all the usual and regular nonya favourites like assam prawns, otah, etc. The meal was cheap and good - value for money.Show less

Author: evershine777
Title: A unique own style of Nonya food
Review: We like the food - home style kind of cooking.  The food presentation is like homecooked style and do not look appetising at all.  However, it taste good an unique. The sauce is unique and slightly different from the usual nonya style.

Author: Riotzone
Title: Nice and vegetarian meal
Review: Lots of variety and great Nonya food in tradditional setting. We are vegetariand and there was enough veggie food on the menu. Nice and tastefull cooking.

Author: HelenaGuerraWashington DC, District of Columbia
Title: First nyonya meal
Review: We were trying to find some restaurants, around Jonker Street, recommended by Lonely Planet and TripAdvisor but all of them were closed. This restaurant looks very popular among locals, there were no tourists. We had a small chicken stew with potatoes and rice. And a small spicy fish curry. Both were really good. Specially the chicken dish.The pineapple juice was refreshing but not natural.I also had a great food experience (even better than in this restaurant) at Nancy's, some type of cuisine: nyonya.Show less

Author: aucyang
Title: The best satay in town
Review: This is the best satay. Istart eating this satay when I was still a kid, my father will buy this satay every time we go back melaka, they was at the corner restaurant behind Ramada hotel, now they have move to a new shop.

Author: megatshamsulnizamKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Amongst the best nasi lemak in town
Review: - varieries of dishes - nasi lemak pandan and freshly made ayam bakar is a match made in heaven- medium spicy sambal also not to be missed- their roti canai also very nice- price is reasonable- very friendly staffs n fast service- spacious dining area - acessable from main road- crowded during lunch, weekend n public holidaysShow less

Author: myrfndMelaka, Malaysia
Title: For the best nasi lemak..
Review: The joint have been in existence for years...from a road side stall to a better place to sit n enjoy the various dishes..with squids fried chicken beef eggs etc...they do serve noodles n fried stuff..The stall still exists for take awaysDont miss it when u are in Melaka..Show less

Author: Jovial D
Title: superb
Review: the range of food here is really great. we went in for the mee goreng - one of the standard dishes here. it is as common as arabian shawarma but every place has its own rendition. CT SFKM dishes out superb stuff. dont miss it

Author: BvdS_NZMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great food, cheap with good service
Review: Visited on a quiet night, so don't know if everyone will get the same level of service. The food was great, generous portions and at low cost. We sat in the 'beer' garden out the back, which you get to through a slightly shambolic, but quite clean, kitchen (don't get put off by it). Menu had English, and at least one of the people working there also spoke to a reasonable level. Would go again, but for simple cheap eats, not as an atmospheric type of place.Show less

Author: dominico789Hong Kong, China
Title: Good variety of food and taste good
Review: It is located at ground floor of Terminal Pahiawan next to Hatten Hotel at heart of Melaka. The restaurant looks like fast food outlet but the food quality is far much better than most of those local restaurants. The food variety is good range covering local cuisines plus western food like spaghetti. It caters for kid choices as well. The tastes of different dishes were well cook after placing orders but not pre-cooked. Value for money Show less

Author: AlnedraSingapore, Singapore
Title: Quiet spot at Pahlawan Terminal for good and economic food
Review: Don't be put off by the lack of customers most of the time, as it's a little out of the way except for those waiting for their coaches. Their beverages are ok, but their chicken dishes are quite good. They also have very cheap economic dishes such as mee siam or fried rice. Show less

Author: surayu75Jeddah, Saudi Arabia
Title: Dinner with family.
Review: Delicious lamb chop, juicy and tasty. Special homemade black pepper sauce, the best black pepper sauce I ever taste. My kids love the chicken chop, you can choose to have it grilled or fried.. of course the kids love it fried.. so crunchy! We had Soda Lychee, Root Beer Float, Chocolate Vanilla and Ali Cafe coffee.Their Spaghetti Seafood Carbonara was a hit, always sold out before 10.00pm. So i will sure come again to taste it. They also serve traditional Malay delicacy, Nasi Lemak. But their Nasi Lemak is special because it is a green pandan flavour served with Crispy Fried Siakap also known as Barramundi. But their trademark is Nasi Lemak Pandan served with Sotong Raja, big crispy giant squid. The taste are superb. My daughter love it so much, she want it everyday. Show less

Author: qishe
Title: Nice foods
Review: Nice foods. My dad love it and wants to eat here like all the times. I came a bit late the other day and the finished their carbonara and watermelon juice. So please come early.

Author: tpLong
Title: Vegetarian Thai Food
Review: New vegetarian restaurant in Kota Laksamana area.  Delicious and reasonable price.  Recommended Coconut Kari.

Author: Stephen-Peter J
Title: Tandoori Naan
Review: I have eaten here several times, and I always order tandoori chicken and naan even though there are several other options to choose from. The food is average, but so are the prices. Service is fine and there is plenty of parking for customers.

Author: ahelasumi
Title: good food
Review: good food. a little hot as the kiosk is an open air style.  located at busy street, nearby got a mall, bank and petrol station.

Author: lildaisyintheskyPeymeinade, France
Title: Scam on Price
Review: I WOULDN'T RECOMMENDOrdered two plates of Mee goreng sotong at 7.50RM each but the bill came and we were charged at 16.30RM each. Asked why, employee said that the sotong itself cost 12RM and the rest for the noodles!. Are you kidding me??? Sea food cost nothing in Asia. Disgusting! Feeling cheated plus dishonest people! Won't go back!! Show less

Author: LaksamanaKiagosJambi Province, Indonesia
Title: Nice Reasonable Priced
Review: Was there with my family and suddenly having a crave for Nasi Kandar. Went to Subaidah whichnis opposote to the hotel we were staying. Ordered simole Chicken curry with vegetable and calamari for myself. Taste good, vegetable fresh and not soggy. The chicken curry is not so spicy but well spiced. Highly recommended.Show less

Author: coyok
Title: another typical mamak restaurant
Review: As the tittle suggest, this place is typical of mamak restaurant which is fast service, good food and drink. Only the location makes it stand out from the rest.

Author: LaurenceHay45Melaka, Malaysia
Title: EXPENSIVE
Review: This restaurant originated from Penang. They have quite a variety of dishes for breakfast, lunch and dinner. The food is hot if you go for breakfast and lunch but not dinner. I notice that most of these Indian Muslim eatery only cook their dishes once, meaning the dishes that they cook in the morning will be sold until night. If you want warm cook food it is the fried noodles or Roti Canai. The place is very warm as it is situated at the walkway and it is air-conditioned. Don't go for Seafood item as it is very pricey, even their chicken dishes is expensive. The price is comparable to Pelita Nasi Kandar Restaurant i n Kuala Lumpur. Show less

Author: Puanmh2017
Title: Family Trip June 2017
Review: Delicious nasi kandar in MElaka other than PEnang. Recomended for nasikandar lovers, We spend RM148 for 6 pax lunch . The price is reasonable i think.

Author: evcavaLuxembourg City, Luxembourg
Title: Good, local, fair prices, recommended!
Review: I've taken inspiration from many trip advisor reviews for my stay in Melaka and am once again really disappointed to see how overrated all those pricey tourist traps are ... whereas there's only a few reviews for this local restaurant.I just stopped by to have a quick break from the mid-day sun and ended up having lunch, as the menu was really inviting.Subaidah serves a variety of local Indian food, there's a loooot of choices on the menu, even for small snacks.Had a lovely cheese roti and two teh Tarik for mere 8 RM. I'm not a local so I guess my opinion concerning the food might not be reliable, but I've had enough teh Tarik over these weeks to give my opinion: this one was definitely very good :) The place was clean, staff nice and reliable. I'd be back in a heartbeat and highly recommend Subaidah for a good meal in a central location with very fair prices. Show less

Author: AiniemnKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A bit pricey
Review: The restaurant is located just at the corner of the Imperial Heritage Hotel building. We had a late checked-in to the hotel and wanted to have some supper and since this restaurant appeared to be the nearest and still open, so we hopped in to this restaurant. It is actually a nasi kandar restaurant. The food photos in their menu shown quite attractive. We ordered one mee goreng mamak and roti London suggested by the waiter. The mee goreng quite spicy but wasn't tasty. There's nothing special about roti London, it was actually a slice of bread topping with slices of fruits (photo attached) and scoop of ice cream. I think everyone knows how'd the taste be .However, I would consider the foods here is expensive. Show less

Author: Suhaimi Y
Title: Pleasant experience!
Review: Subaidah offers an array of Indian local cuisine. The restaurant was very clean as compared to other local open air restaurants in the area. Food was nice and very affordable. The tea tarik was exceptionally nice. Loved going there for breakfast during our stay in Malacca :)Show less

Author: ezhonda
Title: Can be better
Review: Im so lucky to have another nasi kandar store in front of my hotel. Previously was Pelita in KL but now Subaidah opposite Equitorial hotel. Went for dinner dishes was  not too fresh but reheated using microwave oven....price is more suitable for pple in melaka....

Author: MF15
Title: WIll not go again
Review: Went during breakfast around 10 am on a Sunday. Food was OK (however, quite expensive for street setup) but tables were not cleaned on timely manner. Possibly due to understaffed. Dirty floor.

Author: uninvitedguest82Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: old memories...
Review: this place reminds me of old memories when I was still studying at college...back then i used to ate here with my friends...and last week i revisited the restaurant and this time with my family...the nasi beriyani ayam were just ok for me...but i like their mee pak itam...it's a spicy fried mee with a squid in it...my kids really really like it...we also packs two mee pak itam to be brought back to our hotel...services were fast & price is reasonable...Show less

Author: RoulNaser
Title: Best place to reward yourself after that calories shed, walking by the river!
Review: Our favorite spot after brisk walking by the river almost everyday! They used real fruits for the ice cream is already a winning point, while the host was hospitable and friendly.

Author: jamusteo
Title: Bring your own seafood
Review: We bring our own prawn for them to cook. Their Sambal goes well with most of the seafood which goes the best with stingrays and prawns.

Author: DorisChin
Title: Light broth
Review: Light ba ku teh, chain is from johor. Love the non oily and non salty broth. Comes in Claypot! Has you Tiao to go with ba kut teh. Feels dun free! Also has yam rice

Author: IwanYoelianto
Title: STRONG HERBAL SOUP
Review: Nice. I like their soup herbal is extremely strong. Their meat ball also delicious. Next visit i will order 2 portion with 1 rice. I like their Bak Kut The. Price is reasonable. Location is located opposite Novotel or Straits Hotel. Strategy area.

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Trying to upsell....
Review: Located just opposite Novotel Malacca.It is a very small shop. Their bak kut teh is average.The owner is trying to upsell by suggesting in adding mushrooms etcReasonable price and parking is available at the back of the shop, which is a public parking space where you need to use parking coupons, during weekdaysShow less

Author: Wicky1991Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: A stick is not enough!
Review: Located at a small island in Melaka, this restaurant is in a newly-developed area. This restaurant offers an awesome experience for those who enjoy eating ‘lok lok’ and they only charged RM1 for each stick! You can either cook in soup, grill or fried. The ingredients are fresh. You can have as much as you want. It’s definitely a better choice if you’re bored with satay celup in Melaka. Show less

Author: _NessumLondon, United Kingdom
Title: THE SALTED EGG PRAWNS
Review: We went on recommendation from my Malaysian friend in the UK, she said whenever she comes back she HAS to come here before she leaves. Not to disappoint, she also asked her mum to book me a table. Initially turned up, only 2/30 tables were full, started having doubts. I was told to order the salted egg crab and curry leaf, we are not huge fans of crab so we got the prawns (300g of each, the owner said 200 will not make it tasty enough, we also ended up getting the chilli instead of the curry leaf), ok an extra 100 was not going to break the bank balance in any way (100g = 12 ringgit). We also got the kangkong belachan, small butter chicken and 2 rice. Boy oh boy, BEST MEAL EVER!!! The salted egg prawns, I will be dreaming of this dish for the rest of my life, just the garlicky, oniony, salted egg goodness with rice with satisfy anyone!!! A little bit spicy too to give it a kick, washed down with beer.... Not the most cleanest of places, but I don't care. The veg has the right amount of 'wok hei' (to be honest, the chef knows what he's doing with all the dishes) and butter chicken isn't the Indian curry. It's in the Portuguese quarter, get a grab there. Closed on Wednesdays.Show less

Author: nurjannahzain
Title: Cosy Dinner
Review: I was celebratinv my friends farewell, the foods and desserts were totally excellnt! Defo Would recommend my friends and family for special occasional! good job Mr Laurson! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻 Thumbs for your team!

Author: kamshagee
Title: Nice view and friendly services
Review:
Nice view and great dinner course , cozy and comfort place to hang out with friends , thanks a lot to Manager Laurson who hv provided with very well manner and good etiquette in the hotel dining . 💜
Thank you and very recommended !

Author: ayeeepamirul
Title: Good food ! Nice view
Review: Hello ! I’ve been here 4 times i guess . It feel very welcoming when the staff is super friendly & the food is also good ! The price ? Reasonable of course ! View ? Superbbbbbbb !

Author: raidzwanJohor Bahru, Malaysia
Title: BAD QUALITY OF COFFEE!!! NO Star Deserves!!!
Review: Dear Sky Deli/The Shore Melaka,I like to comment on your so called 'fresh Brew' coffee cappuccino.The chronology:-At 9.25pm, me with 4 of my friends enter our restaurant and greet nicely by our staff.-On that time, I ask if the restaurant is available for eating and was replied that the food order already close and only available for drinks only.-We agreed and was invited to have a drink, so we order the 5 drinks and 2 cakes for this time.-Wait patients about a 20minute which is we still ok and no complaint due to this is the normal waiting time.-Once the all order reach, we were served by below 50°C of HOT cappuccino.-For your information, the standard milk temperature to froth is 55°-65° C and Max of 70°C.-And for your information there is no any coffee powder should be on your coffee since its a fresh brew with the coffee machine. Either your coffee machine is broken or your barista is not a trained person to make a coffee.-I was served by waiter name Mr.Ariffin from beginning till the bill is settled.And I would like to inform this type of service and quality of food/drink totally ruin your restaurant standard.After this, I will not hesitate to review in others platform or social media. Attached here all photo and video for your review.From The coffee lover and your disappointed customer.holiday and you ruin my relaxing weekend.Already 5days email sent to your team privately,but no response,its example of bad customers relationship.Show less

Author: LynnC2551
Title: Food was terrible...
Review:
Had their apple salad and fish & chips. the fish&chips - fries should be the safest but it wasn’t nice at all. 

the ambience was ok nice view but toilet was badly managed.

Author: Trek36751001924
Title: Highly recommended!!
Review: Celebrating my mother in law birthday at ski deli... the food taste was good n superb,, nice view,, staff also very friendly n helpful.. prizing so unexpected.. very cheapest compare to others place

Author: Fiona MEdinburgh, United Kingdom
Title: Not too much of a rip off for a captive audience
Review: When we arrived to go to the sky tower the restaurant was closed for a private party, but just as we finished it opened, so we popped in for a drink and to cool down. Iced lemon tea was expensive compared to other places we have been, but food was relatively good value for such a location and the spectacular views. My Caesar Salad was 15 ringgits. Salad had a bit too much dressing for my taste. Show less

Author: ScottJTaipeiTaipei, Taiwan
Title: Closed for lunch!?
Review: Went here for lunch and were rudely informed that they were closed for a party booking and wouldn’t open until 2 o’clock! It was quite clear that the staff simply did not care. After traipsing up 40 or so floors, I would not go back again. Signs in the elevator would have saved time and prevented disappointment.It’s the attitude that doesn’t paint a good picture of Malaysia to foreigners like me.Show less

Author: PeaceWalkerzSingapore, Singapore
Title: Up in the sky
Review: Came down after viewing The Shore Sky Tower in the afternoon. Ordered a Chicken Marryland & Nyonya laksa. The food was well presented. Maybe the food I ordered was common so I have not much to comment on it (Not in a bad way). The view is beautiful. It would be good to bring your love one to the restaurant or celebrate birthday in the sky.Show less

Author: judithchrisalFrance
Title: Lunch in the sky
Review: Came across this restaurant by accident when doing the riverside walk and wanting to get out of the sun for a break. We really enjoyed it and found it a much better experience than the other reviews here indicate. The service was both friendly and efficient, the food was relatively simple but fresh and well presented and we didn’t think it was overpriced considering the view and real estate costs involved. Try finding similar in other cities!!Show less

Author: evelynong76
Title: Good dining place for city view
Review: We came to this restaurant/cafe because we wanted to go to the sky garden on 41st floor of the Shore Residences. It is located same 41st floor. It has very nice city view and good sitting arrangements so you can talk freely without disturbing others.The food serve here are mainly western. We ordered spaghetti and seafood pizza, the food is delicious :) and price is reasonable.Only concern is the lift, only 1 lift serve to come to 41st floor and it skips the lobby very often so you have to wait long for it.Show less

Author: 14050TanY
Title: Staffs are helpful
Review: the staffs here are all served with smile face, even we brought a lot kids, they treat every kids as VIP, very polite.

Author: Sunflower4676Geraldton, Australia
Title: BAD SERVICE :(
Review: Loved the restaurant; modern, sophisticated and clean.Loved food.Loved the view.Everything was awesome up until we finished our lunch. The staff did not come and remove our dishes. My husband had to move them to another table as it was not enjoyable having them sit in front of us for so long. After this, staff still do not remove the dishes from the other table, this did not bother us too much, we were more annoyed at the fact that most of the staff were on their mobile phones and did not come and see if we wanted anything else. We tried to get the staff's attention on a couple occassions as we wanted to see the menu again. No one attended to us. With this, we got our son to go a get the menu as we wanted to order a coffee and some dessert. Still no one came to us to take our orders. As a result, we left the Sky Deli very annoyed and frustrated. Such a shame as we loved the view, food and the restaurant setting. Word of advice to the manager: mobile phones should not be used when there are customers in the restaurant.NOT A HAPPY CUSTOMER AT ALL!!!!Show less

Author: wttan31Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Nice ambience but food is way too common
Review: View of Malacca city is nice, however food served is way too common comparing the price bucket they offered.Ordered food as follow:1. Chicken Tonkatsu Wrap - nothing special but just don't serve with tapioca chips, normal chips or wedges even fries could do the business.2. Mushroom soup - way too common, is serve from instant soup base and not house creation.3. Apple salad - dressing feel plain...again way too common.Show less

Author: Bedok157
Title: Food so so. Only good for high floor viewing
Review: Order one fish n chip plus a plate of chicken maryland. The chicken was so hard to bite. Food come in big plate but not taste nice. Price is at high end.

Author: sfj0106
Title: Brunch in the sky
Review: Very nice to sip your hot chocolate or tea here.maybe it's quite confusing which lift to use to get here,but when you manage to get here,you will definitely love the view.it's worth to try the cuisine at the sky deli.

Author: 68Seng
Title: Ramadan open fasting with my staffs.
Review: Located at level 42 of the Shore Shopping Mall. Very good environment with scenic view of Malacca city. We were having a buffet dinner with fasting month menu. Unfortunately, the foods not balance with the price and nice top view from the tallest restaurant in Malacca. The main Malay Foods served were very limited and taste very poor. The main course type of dishes served were very common hawker or road side stall type, not matched with the price we paid for that kind of high class restaurant and worsen by the bad taste. Staffs service was ok. Show less

Author: Flagdent
Title: Good 360 view of Melaka
Review: Amazing view of the historic Melaka city, 360. Western and local food available at the restaurant located here.

Author: KarrieanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Absolute potential
Review: This restaurant is placed in an amazing location, 42 floors up and the view is quite fascinating. My friends and I decided to have coffee there after we finished lunch (at another restaurant). I look forward to going back again, next time to have a meal. I found the ambience very relaxing and the environment rather elegant. Just note that if you want to bring your own celebratory cake, they charge RM30 to let you consume it. After I have my meal there, I will submit another review. Watch this space.Show less

Author: thru_my_sensesMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great environment but not great food.
Review: It's located at level 42 of The Shore tower in Melaka. Supposed to be the highest restaurant in Melaka, well it has a great environment with a spectacular view of the entire Melaka but the food is way below par. The price is on the high side and the food tastes like those found in usual food courts or normal cafes (some food courts' food taste even better). The menu is limited as well. Hopefully this will improve soon otherwise, it will be a waste of such a great environment.Show less

Author: SLChongPetaling Jaya, Malaysia
Title: Authentic tasting vegetarian food
Review: The restaurant name "Ye Su Lin" is a play on "coconut tree" in chinese. Hence, the coconut motifs located throughout the restaurant. The decor is clean and simple with outstanding pink chairs. We had been driving past this place as it is located along one of the main roads, but not stopped to try the food until recently. We found the lo han kuo herbal drink robust and ladies finger with sambal authentic. The vegetarian shrimp curry with pineapple was bursting with spicy flavour. The butter monkey head mushroom, tasty and almost meat like in texture to the extent that the non-vegetarians in our group didn't miss their meat! Those who live spicy dishes will certainly not be dissapointed.Service was a bit slow, with the owner doubling up as waiter and cashier, but the wait was worth it for the great tasting food. Certainly worth a second visit.Show less

Author: j0j0s77Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: So so taste we were recommended quite a big portion for 2
Review: Came here for chicken rice ball, the taste was ok, but the chilie sauce which for me was the soul of any chicken rice was ordinary. The staff that took our order recommended assam fish too, later we found that it's slightly a big portion for the 2 of us. Th recommendation was not accurate, probaby everyone else could be more specific during orders.Show less

Author: Liangoh99
Title: Good authentic hainanese chicken rice
Review:
Their chicken rice balls are fragrant and delicious - not mushy or overly grainy.
The self-made Chilli sauce hits the right spot and goes well with the chicken and the rice. Steamed chicken tender & tasty

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Still very much the same...
Review: It has been 3 1/2 years since the last time came here to eat.Same location. Ordered chicken rice (poached) and the owner upsell their black bean soup. That is fine. For the chicken ordered 1/4 lower portion, which consist of the chicken drumstick and thighAlso ordered normal bowl of chicken rice instead of the chicken rice balls.The rice were wet and sticky.Price on the high sideShow less

Author: ann cKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Authentic chicken rice balls are served here
Review: Supposedly the son of 1 of the 2 pioneers of authentic chicken rice balls in Melaka. One can order individual portion or sets accordingly to your headcount. Our group of 6 went for the RM60 set that came with 1 whole chicken - half steamed & half roasted, rice balls, small serving of vege. Side order of their signature black bean soup is at RM5 per big bowl, enough for sharing among 2. The rice balls are obviously hand-made resulting in their uneven sizes, and never the perfect spheric shape. The chilli & garlic condiments are roughly chopped in chunky bits, best with the black sauce. Overall, a decent meal, the rice balls were flavourful & chicken moist & juicy.Show less

Author: Van TSingapore, Singapore
Title: We didn't find it too bad despite the other reviews
Review: Unlike the other places nearer Bandar Hill/Jonker street (e.g. Ee Ji Ban), this place had an honest "hawker" feel. It was a little pricy for its locale but not overly high. The chicken was both tender and succulent as expected ... won't survive in this place of competition otherwise. We got the sauce by the side so we could rate the meat on its merits.The Black Bean soup was savoury bordering on over salted, as was the cabbage.The drinks weren't exceptional and I'd save and go some place else for drinks.Show less

Author: Debaprasad B
Title: Move on to better place!!!
Review: Average place . Nothing much to talk about there are far better and cheaper eateries out here . Targets tourist to extract  dollars . can give it a pass.Food was ok.

Author: Joanna_CF

Review: The place is small with only few tables. Parking is easy along the road. Chicken rice comes in dining sets or you can order for one portion. Overall food was ok. Price is quite reasonable

Author: Tze Yee C

Author: WoonWGMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Quality and Price
Review: Apparently the 'Kai Mei' or the chicken rear side portion of the chicken is more expensive than the Drum stick or any other parts of the chicken. It's extremely expensive in Melaka (for that matter any where else) for a plate of Hainanse chicken rice ! Quality is so so. Very disappointed that such shops exist in a tourist city of Melaka!Show less

Author: MNDCWTrieste, Italy
Title: Avoid - indifferent food at ripoff prices just for tourists
Review: Hainanese Chicken Rice (a Singapore dish invented by someone from Hainan, hence the name) can be rolled into balls. Guess what this place alls its speciality? And servies it as a so-called delicacy at extra high prices on the basis of this innovation... Wow! AVOID here and look for the true heritage of Melaka - Nyonya/Peranakan food which is amongst the world's best cuisines..Show less

Author: Patrick SPetaling Jaya
Title: Balls of pleasure
Review: Escape from the tourist traps of Jonker Walk and get your chicken ball rice fix here.No queues, no hungry mob chaos and no rude staff buckling under pressure.From what locals tell me, the owner is related to one of the famous chicken ball rice outlets in Jonker Walk.My first chicken ball rice experience was at Jonker Walk.The flavours here are similar in consistency.While the taste of the chicken is no big deal (for a KL boy!), the rice balls are the best in terms of texture and flavour.The best way to fully enjoy the rice balls are to drizzle some thick soy sauce and the chilli sauce.The black bean soup must not be missed, while the assam fish will impress hardcore foodies (nothing beats the Malay version though!).Of course, don't take my word for it. In my opinion, this place and this kind of food is perfect for kids.The first bite of the rice ball is a novelty unlike any food experience found in Malaysia.My record for most balls eaten was six, but my niece beat me by two once.The first time is always memorable when it comes to chicken ball rice here.Come early, as parking here can be a hassle and you need to get those scratch off coupons.Happy eating. Show less

I won't elaborate much about the chicken rice because it's not fantastic. However, their Assam fish is appetising and sour enough for my taste buds. Fish was the frozen kind but still tasted fresh. Black been soup is a failure so don't even try if you are a soup aficionados.Show less

Author: MelindaKoh
Title: Chee Cheong Fun in front of Kedai Makan Leong Heng restaurant
Review: The food in this restaurant is so-so but this Chee Cheong Fun stall is just right in front of this restaurant and it is really smooth and delicious. They sell the normal chee cheong fun and another special type is the "Yam Chee Cheong Fun" which is really nice and normally we will take 2 plates. Must try this if you happen to visit Melaka. Make sure to be there before 12pm or 1pm because they are selling very well and probably will finish all by noon.Show less

Author: AndrewaididPoland
Title: Malacca eating
Review: Malacca revisited after 30 years was a disappointment. What I had told my wife sounded so promising, yet reality had a very sobering effect on both of us. Beside the town being far more dirty and full of concrete constructions, there were huge CROWDS! The bicycle taxis with their absurdly loud onboard music were a pain in the butt and additionally spoiled the atmosphere. But let me get to the point: food. Finding a place to eat on the famous (?) Jonker Street at lunch time was virtually impossible (am not talking of top-notch venues withtop-notch prices), they were available. having walked the street up and down three times, we decided to inspect a side road - Jalan Tokong, as it says on my restaurant bill. And we came across Tames Cafe. From the outside it isn't obvious you will find food there. You have to stop and eyeball the place carefully. Only then will you realize it's a restaurant. It turns out to be a family-run nyonya place. Food was great, particularly chicken rendang. At a cost of MR22, we had a two-person portion. Fried rice and fried noodles cost MR 5 each. Excellent value. Greens (morning glory, I presume) were not that good, but what the hell! Had a nice chat with the mom of the house, got the rendang recipe. Bought some spices and wonderful tea to utilise at home. The location is 50, Jalan Tokong, a street diagonally parallel to Jonker Street.Show less

Author: AuJusCoTucson, Arizona
Title: Excellent Nyonya Food
Review: Melaka was dead on Wednesday night and very few restaurants were open. We were hungry so we walked in whatever was open. Boy, we were pleasantly surprised. The food was really flavorful, with a bit of a kick, but not too spicy. It's perfect to wash down with beer (which Tames also sold). We ordered Rendang chicken, Kangkung Belacan, and Otak. The owner lady recommended the Otak as it was homemade. We were glad we accepted her recommendation. It's the best Nyonya food we had in Melaka. The decor was basic, and there were 3 generations of family members hanging out in the dinning room. I felt like I'm back to 1970s again, but the old school feel is part of the charm. Everyone, especially the owner lady, was friendly. When you're in Melaka you should give Tames a try.Show less

Our family of two adults and a child had the sweet and sour pork, sour vegetable soup with toufu, fried rice and mixed vegetables. Not much care was given to each dish's presentation, but no complaints about their tastes. Dish prices for small portions (what we had) was about MY$6 to MY$9. The wait staff were responsive and helpful though not what I'd call warm or friendly. On the overall, it was a decent offering especially considering its asking price. Lots of other items on the menu, so we might return here again for a second going.Show less

Author: lupari2Phuket, Thailand
Title: A Banquet in a Chinese Temple
Review: This Chinese restaurant, recommended to us by our cab driver as the best Chinese seafood restaurant in Melaka was so good, that instead of trying somewhere else on our second night we returned.. Both nights the bill, including beer, cost approx.RM 200 for 6 courses and beer for 4.The restaurant itself is quite humble and very small butt after dark from Wednesday to Saturday it spills into the forecourt of the Chinese temple next door giving a wonderful and unique ambience.Apart from us (2 couples) who were celebrating our wedding anniversaries there were large family groups celebrating birthdays on both nights - it seems to be a very popular place. The extra space that the temple provides is great for families with young children We would definitely recommend the chilli crab and lemon chicken - our favourites from the large sampling we had over the 2 nights.Show less

Author: Travelove58
Title: Ordinary taste but packaging is nice.....
Review: This shop has the history of its origin & roots written on some products packaging.It's a simple shop, just like any ordinary bakery or confectionery. No fanciful decor. One can see these products are being made & baked fresh- the man at the back end of shop was making doughs of pre-baked products & trays of baked products can be seen.The packagings were beautiful & of good quality. Very well designed & gives a nostalgic touch to their products. We bought 3 items:1. Biscuit Tambun- not bad but a little hard. Definitely not as good as Him Hieang brand from Penang.2. Lotus Biscuit - seems to be their signature item as the old auntie was promoting very hard. Cost RM $3 per piece. Not cheap. Taste is average.3. Crispy Walnut Cake - Each piece is wrapped individually. Taste average & nothing special.Overall, we would say the products we bought are not bad, but we have tried better ones elsewhere in Malaysia. We don't see long queues or big crowds in the shop although we were here or passed by few times during our visit to Jonker Walk. They claimed to be "Malacca Famous product ". Well, judge for yourself.Show less

Title: Nice Nyonya Meal with the Family, good service too
Review: We came to melaka Nonya village with a group of 10 people for dinner at 6.30pm on a groupon voucher. Staff and customer service was overall good. One of the male staff there was extremely courteous and accommodating to my father in law who had mobility problems.Food wise, I thought it was above average and tasty. I had no complaints on the quality of food at all and the serving size were reasonable. We did not have to order and additional dishes in addition to the ones in our voucher. The voucher meal also came with a desert of a local coconut delicacy.My only reservations on this restaurant was that this restaurant also caters for tourists and large tour buses. So after 7pm huge hoards of Chinese tourists started flocking in by the dozen. The restaurant quickly became full house. It then became very noisy and the toilets became extra dirty due to the influx of people. Perhaps the establishment should ensure that normal guests are not put off by the state of the toilets by ensuring that the toilets are more frequently cleaned during such periods.Show less

Author: IwanYoelianto
Title: NICE SINGLE FOOD AND MANY MENUS
Review: Nice and single food for those are plan and like to eat per portion per person. Food taste was good and average price. They did not have ala carte order, they have concept combination with rice in 1 plate.

Author: Johnfrazel
Title: Well Cooked, Love their seasonings and Price
Review: The food is delicious, the price is really good, considering the area. I like their sauce on the seafood and fishes. It is really delicious, I asked for more chillis personally.

Author: HockLye
Title: Barely
Review: Edible. While the price is good, the quality of the ingredient and cooking is below average. Service is efficient. With so many options around, it’s a wonder that they survive.

Author: Annytsl
Title: Disappointing
Review: Came back to here after 2yrs but the quality of food has changed. The delicious fish and chips were reduced to some skinny over fried and dry fish fingers.Cordon bleu is also dry and over fried with barely any cheese in the middle. And the mushroom sauce is like some gooey sh*t you kept in your fridge for years and finally decided to take out and eat. Chef changed or something? Very disappointing. Not coming bck anymoreShow less

Author: wilsonw125
Title: Best of the best
Review: Small restaurant but serve the Best western food restaurant in Melaka, good for family, only open at night

Author: HanermanMelaka, Malaysia
Title: Great food, cozy ambience
Review: My family and I have eaten here several times and keep coming back! Great food (the best steak in Melaka) and friendly staff all with a low price. My daughter (the fussy eater) loves their fish n chips and my wife roams all over the menu. Today she had lamb chops and I had the rib eye steak. We are definitely coming back again!!Show less

Author: MelanieQ59
Title: Good Food Bad Dessert
Review: The environment become nicer after renovation. Self service and Duck Mee is a must try here. Tips for you order add on minced meat into duck mee because the combination is soooo good! However the Tong Sui and Dessert Soup served here are sucks. Taste like sugar syrup without the original ingredient taste. Dont waste your money to order desserts instead just order the foods will do! Show less

Author: szekai1031
Title: Still okay
Review: Environment and the food still okay , not very nice also , don't expect too high , the only good thing is open till very late .

Author: Long MKuala Lumpur, Malaysia
Title: Duck noodle it is...
Review: This place has a very bright and clean dining area. The shop is well kept and tables were well spaced out. You would not feel claustrophobic. It's a family run businessTo order your food, you have to go to the area where the food is prepared, so that you can choose what you want to eat and tell the owners.. And then go back to your table to sit and wait for your order.It may take some time when the place gets busy.There is also a refreshments stall within the shop. Again, you have to go to the stall to order your refreshments.The food is really good. Worth a try and may even come back again, provided you like duck. The noodles can be served dry or soup.Show less

Author: Kim K L
Title: Real Nyona Food
Review: Food is cooked, supervised by a true baba Lau Cheng Kim. I have known him since student days in Malacca High School. He was a school teacher and he started his nyona food stall at the back of his house compound in Tranquerah Road
